3987.oracleText: When nothing remains, everything is equally possible.

4057.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, scry 1.
4057.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，占卜1。

4064.oracleText: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.
4064.translation: 逝者晓得生者尚未领悟的教训。

4065.oracleText: Scry 2, then draw two cards. You lose 2 life.
4065.translation: 占卜2，然后抓两张牌。你失去2点生命。

4076.translation: 由你操控的生物具有敏捷异能。

4134.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
4134.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

4236.oracleText: Take an extra turn after this one.
4236.translation: 于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。

4243.oracleText: Shuffle your library. Then exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card without paying its mana cost.
4243.translation: 洗牌。然后放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌且不需支付其法术力费用。

4245.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, exile that card from your graveyard.
4245.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，将该牌从你的坟墓场放逐。

4246.oracleText: Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library face down. Put that card into your hand at the beginning of your next end step.
4246.translation: 支付1点生命：牌面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌置于你手上。

4259.oracleText: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.
4259.translation: 象牙塔中居民奉求知为毕生追索，在此处牺牲力量换取知识必有回报。

4260.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you gain X life, where X is the number of cards in your hand minus 4.
4260.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你获得X点生命，X为你手牌的数量减4。

4272.oracleText: The shadow of the candle looms tall even as its light grows dim.
4272.translation: 蜡烛火光渐弱，而其阴影愈显高大。

4280.oracleText: Equipped creature has deathtouch and lifelink.
4280.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有死触与系命异能。

4290.oracleText: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.
4290.translation: 用钉子与锤头才能打开外壳，但其滋味值得花上这番工夫。

4306.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有非基本地行者异能。

4318.oracleText:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya
4318.translation:
「我们怎么可能逃得过天空？」
～纳雅日种群亥真

4382.oracleText: Bred for battle in the Grand Coliseum, these wurms annihilated whole ecosystems when released into the wild.
4382.translation: 这类亚龙是为了在大竞技场战斗而育种，被野放后随即破坏整个生态系统。

4391.oracleText: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.
4391.translation: 每颗泪珠都是一滴不朽。

4429.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Draw a card.

4441.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
4441.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

4482.oracleText: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.
4482.translation: 满载的棺木就像满载的宝库～两者都对贼有吸引力。

4489.oracleText: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.
4489.translation: 他排除掉森林高处的任何威胁…除了蜘蛛本身。

4499.oracleText: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.
4499.translation: 若让大自然恣意而行，必将盈满任何容器，挣脱任何限制，漫出任何疆域。

4500.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
4500.translation: 在每个维持开始时，派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

4517.translation: 由你操控的生物具有践踏异能。

4585.oracleText: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.
4585.translation: 许多死灵术士的遗言是同一句～用来结束亡物仪式的那句。

4598.oracleText:
"There are only fifty words in the cyclops language, and ten of them mean ‘kill.'"
—Ertai
4598.translation:
「独眼巨人的语言只有五十个字，而其中十个的意思是『杀』。」
～尔泰

4601.oracleText:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer
4601.translation:
「别低估大自然对人为影响的适应能力。」
～玛洛术士莫黎墨

4610.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
4610.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将其置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

4623.oracleText: Target blocking creature gets +7/+7 until end of turn.
4623.translation: 目标进行阻挡的生物得+7/+7直到回合结束。

4655.oracleText: [Buried under a thin layer of dirt, it was known for centuries as Mount Sardia.]
4655.translation: 它还给一层土埋着的那数百年中，人们称之为沙地亚山。

4694.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains flying until end of turn.
4694.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得飞行异能。

4736.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each Forest you control.
4736.translation: 你每操控一个树林，所结附的生物便得+1/+1。

4751.oracleText: All damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to enchanted creature instead.
4751.translation: 所有将对你造成的伤害改为对所结附的生物造成之。

4759.oracleText: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies collect jewels for theirs.
4759.translation: 一般鸟儿收集细枝筑巢， 鹊则是收集宝石来筑巢。

4832.oracleText: The power of the wild, concentrated in a single charge.
4832.translation: 倾注在单次冲锋上的荒野力量。

4863.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or land.
4863.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或地。

4873.oracleText:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts
4873.translation:
「千万别忘记了，在多明纳里亚诸般神奇之中，有个生命的系统存在着；里面包括了猎物与猎者，彼此不会争战或是抢夺远古力量。」
～百兽女皇裘蕾尔

4887.oracleText: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.
4887.translation: 它的铁蹄巨响将梦击入绝境。

4910.oracleText: You have no maximum hand size.
4910.translation: 你的手牌数量没有上限。

4931.oracleText:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"
4931.translation:
「它们呻吟、碰撞，站起身来，口不言语，眼不理睬；看到死人如此复生，即使在梦中，还是很古怪。」
～山缪·泰勒·柯律芝，「古舟子咏」

4933.oracleText: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.
4933.translation: 西瓦山脉无庸置疑的主人。

4983.oracleText: Sometimes you have to read between the minds.
4983.translation: 有时你必须寻找心外之意。

5089.oracleText: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.
5089.translation: 某位神器师不慎把它掉落在摆满钱币的地窖中。她到现在还没能把它找出来。

5144.oracleText: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?
5144.translation: 幼龙无法了解人类这种生物～既然不想被杀，那他们又为什么是用肉跟宝藏做的？

5172.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, each other player sacrifices a creature.
5172.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位其他牌手各牺牲一个生物。

5188.oracleText: Dwell longest on the thoughts that shine brightest.
5188.translation: 愈有吸引力的念头愈需三思。

5189.oracleText: Draw three cards, then discard a card.
5189.translation: 抓三张牌，然后弃一张牌。

5191.oracleText: Its victims are known by their eyes: shattered vessels leaking broken dreams.
5191.translation: 遭袭者的眼睛都爆裂着血丝，破碎梦想从中流泄。

5195.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Tap target artifact, creature, or land.

5206.translation: 目标对手牺牲一个生物。

5249.translation: 消灭目标已横置的生物。

5277.oracleText: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand?
5277.translation: 是否要将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上？

5389.oracleText: You may cast spells as though they had flash.
5389.translation: 你可以将咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

5479.oracleText: They only appear in emergencies, and emergencies never last long.
5479.translation: 他们只在紧急状况现身，而紧急状况从不会持续太久。

5504.oracleText: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.
5504.translation: 这是地平线远处的树林，尚待征服的山脉，无尽汪洋彼端的新大地。

5556.oracleText: You draw two cards and you lose 2 life.
5556.translation: 你抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

5569.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有先攻异能。

5572.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has trample.
5572.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

5642.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
5642.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

5645.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may untap target creature and gain control of it until end of turn. That creature gains haste until end of turn.
5645.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以重置目标生物并获得其操控权直到回合结束。该生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

5648.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may draw two cards.
5648.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以抓两张牌。

5654.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
5654.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回场上。

5756.oracleText: Return up to two target creatures to their owners ' hands?
5756.translation: 是否要将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上？

5773.oracleText: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield?
5773.translation: 是否要将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回战场？

5774.oracleText: Select any number of creatures to sacrifice.
5774.translation: 选型并牺牲任意数量的生物。

5800.oracleText: {oT}: Target attacking or blocking creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
5800.translation: {oT}：目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

6005.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o1}.
6005.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

6049.translation: 由你操控的生物具有威慑异能。

6055.oracleText: At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card.
6055.translation: 在你的抓牌步骤开始时，额外抓一张牌。

6056.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, discard your hand.
6056.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，弃掉你的手牌。

6116.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

6186.oracleText: All creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn.
6186.translation: 所有生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

6209.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, that player discards a card.
6209.translation: 每当任一牌手施放咒语时，该牌手弃一张牌。

6212.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的生物得+1/+0。

6319.oracleText: Creatures you control get +0/+2 until end of turn.
6319.translation: 由你操控的生物得+0/+2直到回合结束。

6332.oracleText: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other on the bottom of your library.
6332.translation: 检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张置于你的牌库底。

6483.oracleText: If you control a creature, damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead.
6483.translation: 若你操控任何生物，则将使你的生命减少至1以下的伤害，改为减少你的生命至1。

6623.oracleText: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
6623.translation: 抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

6642.oracleText: Counter target spell. Untap up to four lands.
6642.translation: 反击目标咒语。重置至多四个地。

6656.oracleText: You draw three cards and you lose 3 life.
6656.translation: 你抓三张牌且失去3点生命。

6735.oracleText: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."
6735.translation: 「我不喜欢把自己当成海盗。较合我意的说法，是促进地方经济发展的人。」

6736.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.
6736.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一对手造成战斗伤害时，你可以抓一张牌。

6819.oracleText: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.
6819.translation: 但愿所有消息都如其传令般美好。

6853.oracleText: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.
6853.translation: 泥土无法留存魔法驱使之物。

6963.oracleText: Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.
6963.translation: 每当所结附的生物向任一对手造成伤害时，你可以抓一张牌。

6971.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Draw a card.

6981.oracleText: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

6982.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
6982.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

7165.oracleText: It lights up the sky, beckoning enemies only to repel them.
7165.translation: 网的光芒照亮天际，将所吸引来的敌人一一逐退。

7177.oracleText: {o1oG}: Return target basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
7177.translation: {o1oG}：将目标基本地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

7208.oracleText: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.
7208.translation: 其他的非瑞克西亚人，都曾在恶梦中见过这巨兽。

7265.oracleText: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.
7265.translation: 「这感染蔓延太广，从塔吉纳的高处已经看不到边界。」

7323.oracleText: The wurms become so big, a single scale can be used as a roof for a human dwelling.
7323.translation: 亚龙愈长愈大，光是一片鳞甲便可让人当成住家屋顶。

7379.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.
7379.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

7393.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
7393.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

7400.oracleText: Naya's trees grow tall and sturdy. Their foliage intertwines to form dewcups, rainwater pools where the elves gather to celebrate life.
7400.translation: 纳雅的树木长得高大强壮。树叶交缠形成露杯，妖精从中收集雨露以赞颂生命。

7401.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature for each 1 life you gained.
7401.translation: 每当你获得生命时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则你每获得1点生命，就在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

7404.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this permanent.
7404.translation: 在结束步骤开始时，牺牲此永久物。

7431.oracleText: At his side, humble beasts become weapons more deadly than sharpened steel.
7431.translation: 生性温和的动物为他战斗时，也能成为比利剑更强大的武器。

7434.oracleText: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.
7434.translation: 妖精相信多头龙神是他们的祖神兽，正在纳雅地底沉睡着，以遭遗忘的法术为食。

7494.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

7515.oracleText: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.
7515.translation: 不论机械生命或生体生命，都有办法繁衍。

7516.oracleText: Whenever an artifact creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may create a 1/1 blue Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
7516.translation: 每当由你操控的一个神器生物对牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

7541.oracleText: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
7541.translation: 所有生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

7590.oracleText: Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
7590.translation: 派出两个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

7597.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has trample.
7597.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

7634.oracleText: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.
7634.translation: 每个头都争抢猎物最美味的部分，瞬时将之撕裂。

7648.translation: 放逐目标进行攻击的生物。

7658.oracleText: "The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws. We are the Claws of Marisi, stalking, pouncing, drawing blood."
7658.translation: 「云岭拿卡地只会坐着空想，全是群软爪子。 我们是马力希之爪，随时潜行、扑击，见血才会高兴。」

7761.oracleText:
"It is sacrilege to confine a gargantuan to the grinding of straight lines. I will pray that it remembers who is the master of this land."
—Syeena, elvish godtoucher
7761.translation:
「囚禁巨兽来作这种粗活，根本是违背天理。我但愿他能记得谁才是大地的主人。」
～妖精神疗师赛意娜

7764.oracleText: Target opponent sacrifices a creature, discards three cards, then loses 5 life. You return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand, draw three cards, then gain 5 life.
7764.translation: 目标对手牺牲一个生物，弃三张牌，然后失去5点生命。你将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上，抓三张牌，然后获得5点生命。

7811.oracleText: Other artifact creatures you control get +1/+1.
7811.translation: 由你操控的其他神器生物得+1/+1。

7851.oracleText: Artifact spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
7851.translation: 你施放的神器咒语减少{o1}来施放。

7925.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+0 and has first strike.
7925.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+0且具有先攻异能。

7941.oracleText: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.
7941.translation: 格利极这世界盛产的只有死亡与腐败。死灵术士与恶魔所使用的交易标准是死尸，不论完整或是片段。

7951.oracleText: Counter target spell that targets you or a permanent you control.
7951.translation: 反击目标咒语，且该咒语须以你或由你操控的永久物为目标。

7964.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player discards a card.
7964.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每位牌手各弃一张牌。

8028.oracleText: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.
8028.translation: 对死灵爵主来说，杀戮与征兵是同一件事情。

8048.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有死触异能。

8497.oracleText: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
8497.translation: 将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

8538.oracleText: "I do not like it," said Grizzlegom, "but I will take every soldier I can get."
8538.translation: 「我不喜欢这样，」格里兹戈姆说，「但我会抓住每一个我能找到的士兵。」

8539.translation: 每位牌手各失去1点生命。

8540.translation: 每位牌手各获得1点生命。

8615.oracleText: The first spell you cast each turn has cascade.
8615.translation: 你每回合中施放的第一个咒语具有倾曳异能。

8629.oracleText: "This violent wasteland is an indictment of its people. These cowards lack the will to oppose disorder."
8629.translation: 「这暴烈荒地正是对其住民的审判。这些懦夫缺乏对抗失序的意志。」

8678.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may draw a card.
8678.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以抓一张牌。

8739.oracleText: Target creature gets +4/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
8739.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+4/+2且获得践踏异能。

8742.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each creature you control.
8742.translation: 你每操控一个生物，所结附的生物便得+1/+1。

8745.oracleText:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic
8745.translation:
「我在乙金中从未找到的启示，却埋藏在寇特蛇的鳞片中。」
～维多肯异教徒拉那洛

8789.oracleText: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.
8789.translation: 在断片会聚之时，许多的生命型态就此消失无踪。

8790.oracleText: Destroy target nonland permanent and all other permanents with the same name as that permanent.
8790.translation: 消灭目标非地永久物和所有与之同名的其他永久物。

8841.oracleText: A match for any army—even its own.
8841.translation: 任何军队的好对手～包括自己这一边。

8849.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
8849.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

8856.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+2 and has vigilance.
8856.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+2且具有警戒异能。

8949.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+3 and has first strike.
8949.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+3且具有先攻异能。

8996.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
8996.translation: 目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

9116.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life.
9116.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你失去1点生命。

9261.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
9261.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。

9422.oracleText: Each spell is an intricate tapestry, and Kira is the great unraveler.
9422.translation: 每个咒语都像是织工繁琐的挂毡，而绮罗的解结手艺无人能比。

9423.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability for the first time each turn, counter that spell or ability.
9423.translation: 每当此生物在一回合中首度成为咒语或异能的目标时，反击该咒语或异能。

9481.translation: 横置还是重置目标永久物？

9511.oracleText: Put target creature card from that player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control?
9511.translation: 是否要将目标生物牌在你的操控下从该牌手的坟墓场放进战场？

9525.oracleText: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.
9525.translation: 啮骨牙一夜间杀了三个鼠帮头子，从此一统鼠界。鼠人称他为大头目。

9527.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a Rat: Create X 1/1 black Rat creature tokens, where X is the number of Rats you control.
9527.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个老鼠：派出X个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，X为由你操控的老鼠数量。

9600.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature.
9600.translation: 在你的维持开始时，牺牲一个生物。

9832.oracleText: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.
9832.translation: 目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。

9856.oracleText:
"How can we wage war against ourselves? What happens when the kami of our very souls rise against us? I answer simply: We cannot. We die. There can be no victory in this war."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda
9856.translation:
「我们怎能向自身宣战？若自己灵魂之神与我们作对，又会如何？我的答案很简单：不行。我们会死。这场战争不会有胜利者。」 
～密师范致今田城主

9873.oracleText: To the sorrow of all, its dark reach grasped and crushed those who guarded its silent vigil.
9873.translation: 最令人哀痛的，是其夜幕竟转而攫杀过往的卫众。

9874.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, target opponent discards a card for each Shrine you control.
9874.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你每操控一个祭祠，目标对手便弃一张牌。

9879.oracleText: To the sorrow of all, its rage became focused on those who once stoked it.
9879.translation: 最令人哀痛的，是其盛怒竟转而对付过往的侍众。

9913.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, tap all lands that player controls and untap all lands you control.
9913.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，横置所有由该牌手操控的地并重置所有由你操控的地。

9915.oracleText: To the sorrow of all, its fire was turned toward those who worshipped it.
9915.translation: 最令人哀痛的，是其净火竟转而对付过往的信众。

9916.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you gain 2 life for each Shrine you control.
9916.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你每操控一个祭祠，便获得2点生命。

9923.oracleText: To the sorrow of all, its winds found sin in the hearts of those who once learned from its wisdom.
9923.translation: 最令人哀痛的，是其清风竟转而判罚过往的修众。

9924.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card for each Shrine you control.
9924.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你每操控一个祭祠，便抓一张牌。

9929.oracleText: To the sorrow of all, its web became a net that strangled those who helped weave it.
9929.translation: 最令人哀痛的，是其罗网竟转而窒息过往的织众。

9930.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token for each Shrine you control.
9930.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你每操控一个祭祠，便派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

9965.oracleText:
"From the clouds, you can see as far as the distant horizon. It's a reminder of the infinite possibilities of everyday life."
—Noboru, master kitemaker
9965.translation:
「从云际放眼望去，可以看到远方的地平线；也提醒着日常生活里有无限多的可能。」
～风筝大师升

10026.oracleText: Target creature you control gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.
10026.translation: 选择一种颜色。目标由你操控的生物获得反该色保护异能直到回合结束。

10063.oracleText: You may tap or untap target permanent.
10063.translation: 你可以横置或重置目标永久物。

10141.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
10141.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

10191.oracleText: Whenever a creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, destroy that creature.
10191.translation: 每当任一生物成为咒语或异能的目标时，消灭该生物。

10202.oracleText: Pay 1 life: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
10202.translation: 支付1点生命：目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

10215.oracleText:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower
10215.translation:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

10337.oracleText: Distribute counters among any number of target creatures.
10337.translation: 将指示物分配给任意数量的目标生物。

10365.oracleText: The mine's riches never end, nor do the moans of the spirits doomed to haunt them.
10365.translation: 井内的矿藏从不枯竭，纠缠其间的鬼魂哭嚎也从不间断。

10524.oracleText: Draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.
10524.translation: 抓三张牌，然后将两张牌从你手上以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

10539.oracleText: Those who hear its roar perish. The lucky ones only feel its fetid breath.
10539.translation: 听其吼声者灭亡。幸运者只感受到它恶臭的气息。「暂译」

10555.oracleText: Target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.
10555.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

10600.oracleText:
"My battle cry reaches ears far keener than yours."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter
10600.translation:
「我的战嚎能让比你听力更敏锐者都能听到。」
～玖瑞加猎人赛妲

10601.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Snake creature token, a 2/2 green Wolf creature token, and a 3/3 green Elephant creature token.
10601.translation: 派出一个1/1绿色的蛇衍生生物，一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物和一个3/3绿色的象衍生生物。

10625.oracleText: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.
10625.translation: 只有透过奥札奇心灵的歪曲思考路径，才能敲开晶石来汲取其间力量。

10644.oracleText: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."
10644.translation: 「找到它的探险家没能做成一笔好生意。他只不过变成有钱人而已。」

10680.oracleText: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.
10680.translation: 乱铲和落尘很快便掩盖了他们的辩词。

10690.oracleText:
"Granted, it's the pinnacle of utter destructiveness. So what would you call two of them?"
—Riku of Two Reflections
10690.translation:
「同意，这是彻底的破坏性的巅峰之作。那么你会怎么称呼两个人呢？」
～复影黎库「暂译」

10693.oracleText: Pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost
10693.translation: 支付等同于其法术力值数量的生命，而不支付其法术力费用。

10699.oracleText: Counter target instant or sorcery spell unless its controller pays {o1}.
10699.translation: 除非目标瞬间或法术咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

10709.oracleText: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.
10709.translation: 在自然界中，没有半块骨头或半片肉会被浪费掉。

10848.oracleText: {oBoR}: Dragon creatures get +1/+1 until end of turn.

10934.oracleText: {o3oW}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
10934.translation: {o3oW}：由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

10945.oracleText: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.
10945.translation: 秘密存在的底密尔公会，其徽记没有外人见过～除了手底亡魂之外。

10948.oracleText: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.
10948.translation: 这徽记的意义随你观点不同而变化：可能是足以自傲的自然循环护卫，也可能是向黑暗出卖灵魂以求永生的恶徒。

10951.oracleText:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos
10951.translation:
「你有没有用手捧过波洛斯印记？这印记比外表看起来要沉重许多～因为它承载了厚实的力量与荣耀。」
～阿固寇斯

10954.oracleText: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.
10954.translation: 盟会的印记象征天人合一；树木支持着太阳，太阳滋养着树木。

10957.oracleText: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.
10957.translation: 伊捷总能从自己教授的课程中学到些什么。

10960.oracleText: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.
10960.translation: 古鲁的地界标志不需要刻意清楚标示。看到用鲜血，鼻涕，或粪便涂抹的痕迹，就晓得这边属于古鲁。

10963.oracleText: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.
10963.translation: 伊捷印记的设计经常变化，每次都更接近尼米捷浮华的画像。

10999.oracleText: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.
10999.translation: 对析米克联合而言，其印记并非荣誉之徽记，而是注册商标。这熟悉图像在任何生体用品上都可见到，证明了为其投资的高超技巧，精妙创意，以及昂贵费用。

11014.oracleText: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.
11014.translation: 拉铎司印记以白骨制成，要拿鲜血煮过，并且用来杀生之后才能算是大功告成。

11131.translation: 是否要消灭目标神器或结界？

11143.oracleText: Return target Dragon permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield?
11143.translation: 是否要将目标龙永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场？

11169.oracleText: Mages of Esper measure their wealth and status by the number of servants in their retinues.
11169.translation: 艾斯波的法师衡量自身财富与地位的标准，是随员中仆从之数量。

11201.oracleText: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.
11201.translation: 当亚莎离开班特时，她确信即使自己不在，这世界依旧能拥有保护与秩序。

11202.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying.
11202.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

11231.oracleText: {oT}: Target land you control becomes the basic land type of your choice until end of turn.
11231.translation: {oT}：选择一种基本地类别。目标由你操控的地成为该类别直到回合结束。

11275.oracleText: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.
11275.translation: 有史以来，格利极从没人因衰老而过世。

11281.oracleText: Born of volcanic forces, it thrives on the absolute panic it inspires.
11281.translation: 它诞生自火山之力，以自己引发的纯然惊惶为食。

11307.oracleText: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.
11307.translation: 对萨坎沃来说，巨龙是蛮勇生命的极致具现。

11449.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 and has flying.
11449.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+3且具有飞行异能。

11474.oracleText:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth
11474.translation:
「若能熟知班特的地势与废墟，对抗入侵者时就会成为无上利器。」
～艾紫培提瑞

11481.oracleText: There is no world where angels fear to tread.
11481.translation: 没有天使不敢踏入的世界。

11533.oracleText: In a world where death is always violent, cruel weapons are as common as rocks.
11533.translation: 在死状向来惨烈的世界中，各式残酷武器就如石头般四处可见。

11548.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

11553.oracleText: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.
11553.translation: 金塔庙原是建造来荣耀阿拉若的生物，早已消失多年。在祖神兽苏醒后，它们再度出现。

11592.oracleText: The Phyrexian death machine awoke, its coldsteel heart imbuing it with sinister new power.
11592.translation: 非瑞克西亚的杀戮机械已起动，其寒钢核心将活跃的恶毒力量灌注全身。

11613.oracleText:
"There it was, clawing the ice as it chittered and clicked its teeth. We fled in horror before it unearthed its grisly meal."
—Aevar Borg, northern guide, journal entry
11613.translation:
「那东西就在冰上刨着，咕哝的嘴里牙齿卡卡作响。在它挖出那可怕食物前，我们早给吓跑了。」
～北境向导艾瓦·柏格的旅行日志

11766.oracleText:
"Our border lands fall under the grip of Heidar's second winter. Go forth and reclaim them for Yavimaya."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order
11766.translation:
「边境地区已陷入亥达的二度严冬。让它们重回亚维马雅的怀抱吧。」
～杜松教派德鲁伊长老凯莎

11780.oracleText: {oR}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

11808.oracleText: Ice exploded into steam in its wake, hissing like a thousand serpents hailing their blazing master.
11808.translation: 所经之处寒冰裂为水气，有如千百巨蛇齐颂声威。

11822.oracleText: The few surviving humans of Krov would have welcomed the return of winter and its sterilizing cold. They often peered northward, hoping that the snow's edge had reached their infested city-tomb.
11822.translation: 对库维城少数幸存者而言，却宁愿冬日与抑制病菌的严寒再度降临。他们经常朝北张望，希望雪地边境重回这疫病肆虐的死城。

11843.oracleText: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.
11843.translation: 霜风会的法术不循正道而行，使得独角兽自北方荒野回返，准备再赴战场。

11853.oracleText: Gain control of target noncreature spell. You may choose new targets for it.
11853.translation: 获得目标非生物咒语的操控权。你可以为它选择新的目标。

11935.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 2 or less.
11935.translation: 消灭目标力量等于或小于2的生物。

11984.oracleText:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master
11984.translation:
「阿肯真是爱唠叨的蠢材！非瑞克西亚的技术是上天送来的宝贵礼物。比如这精致的饰品…」
～霜风会首领亥达

12174.oracleText:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dul, the Necromancer
12174.translation:
「拉席克陛下，请赐予我应得的力量。」
～死灵术士林杜

12208.oracleText: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.
12208.translation: 也许你能击碎她的盾，但却永远无法降伏她的灵魂。

12220.translation: 每位牌手各牺牲两个生物。

12234.oracleText: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.
12234.translation: 黑暗势力不是每次都会派仆役来执行肮脏任务。

12347.oracleText: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.
12347.translation: 再小的魔力石碎片中都包含着无穷能量与广袤空间～即集于这脆弱水晶中的无数维度。

12360.oracleText: With limited resources and near unlimited time, Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.
12360.translation: 凭借有限的资源和几乎无限的时间，Kerrick使用一只野兽的零件建造了另一只野兽。

12369.oracleText:
"The second stage of the illness: high fever and severe infectiousness."
—Phyrexian progress notes
12369.translation:
「疾病的第二阶段：高烧和严重传染性。」
～非瑞克西亚进展纪录「暂译」

12388.oracleText:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer
12388.translation:
「火焰是举世共通的语言。」
～神器大师尤依拉

12426.oracleText: Create three 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
12426.translation: 派出三个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

12448.oracleText: Draw a card, then discard a card.
12448.translation: 抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

12468.oracleText: Choose amount of life to pay.
12468.translation: 选择要支付的生命数量。

12506.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
12506.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

12526.oracleText: "Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."
12526.translation: 「有时我会意外抓到别的东西，但我知道其缘由终将揭晓。」

12537.oracleText: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.
12537.translation: 塔帖立遗迹让学者思索数百年却找不到解答。其秘密一直就躲在个刻着符文的头里面。

12540.oracleText:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer
12540.translation:
「这世界已经靠各种机械来运作着。有一天，它们会提醒我们这事实。」
～神器师莎琪亥

12541.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
12541.translation: {oT}：在每个由你操控的神器生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

12556.oracleText: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.
12556.translation: 再小的悔恨种子也能开出救赎之花。

12562.oracleText: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."
12562.translation: 「你必须先自己成为某事物，才能够真正了解它。关键之处在于，这过程中千万不要迷失自我。」

12563.oracleText: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.
12563.translation: 抓三张牌。然后除非你弃一张神器牌，否则弃两张牌。

12589.oracleText:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

12671.oracleText: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.
12671.translation: 许多洁英都能左右手同使。纺思将惯用左手与惯用右手之人的心灵连结起来，让双方都能学会彼此的技巧。

12672.oracleText: Knight creatures you control have double strike.
12672.translation: 由你操控的骑士生物具有连击异能。

12729.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has flying.
12729.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且具有飞行异能。

12739.oracleText:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner
12739.translation:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

12745.oracleText: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."
12745.translation: 「我等了解龙族的炽焰与狂愤。他们了解我等的怒火与荣耀。我们将一同编织前所未见的毁灭篇章。」

12746.oracleText: Dragon spells you cast cost {o2} less to cast.
12746.translation: 你施放的龙咒语减少{o2}来施放。

12801.oracleText: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.
12801.translation: 这迷宫般的设计具现了俄佐立法律的核心精神～用来试练意志、延缓变化的精密结构。

12920.oracleText: Every culture has its unlucky numbers. In a city where you're either alone, in a crowd, or being stabbed in the back, two is the worst number of all.
12920.translation: 每个文化都有独特的不祥数字。 在城市之中，不论你是独行，在人群之中，或是正遭背刺，二都是最糟糕的数字。

13062.oracleText: He unmakes the world in his own image.
13062.translation: 他以自我形象来让这世界消失。

13130.oracleText: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.
13130.translation: 消亡生灵哀求转生之所。

13237.oracleText: {oR}: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

13299.oracleText: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.
13299.translation: 从晓明殿最高的一层，直到蒙鸠地最暗的阴影，此号角的银色音符在空气中闪烁，让听闻者都为之牵动。

13300.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Elf spell, you may create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
13300.translation: 每当你施放妖精咒语时，你可以派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

13307.oracleText: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.
13307.translation: 在美感的文化中，会将最美丽者崇敬如神。

13309.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
13309.translation: {oG}，{oT}：派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

13348.oracleText: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.
13348.translation: 思绪碎片经过折射与散射，化为炫目智慧奔流而出。

13547.oracleText: A single fear unleashes a torrent of nightmares.
13547.translation: 唤醒无尽梦魇的一丝畏惧。

13548.oracleText: Target creature and all other creatures with the same name as that creature get -2/-2 until end of turn.
13548.translation: 目标生物及所有与其同名的其它生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

13617.oracleText: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
13617.translation: 将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

13682.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Target Blinkmoth creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
13682.translation: {o1}，{oT}：目标光蛾生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

13754.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has protection from red and from blue.
13754.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有反红保护与反蓝保护。

13791.oracleText: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.
13791.translation: 传说在训诫仪式之中消失的知识，都会藉由井水涌回。

13792.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {oX}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained. If you do, draw X cards.
13792.translation: 每当你获得生命时，你可以支付{oX}，X须等于或小于你所获得的生命数量。若你如此作，则抓X张牌。

13858.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有不灭异能。

13925.oracleText: It rarely moves, standing stock still in its clearing. When it does stir, ravens stop their cawing and crickets their chirping. All of nature watches in awed silence.
13925.translation: 它纹风不动地在空地伫立。一旦它略有动作，乌鸦为之歇声，蟋蟀因此并息。整个大自然都敬畏地屏息观望。

14095.oracleText: Counter target spell. Its controller draws a card.
14095.translation: 反击目标咒语。其操控者抓一张牌。

14148.oracleText: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
14148.translation: 派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

14321.oracleText: Her poppets bring joy to the truly depraved.
14321.translation: 她的顺仆为最邪恶之徒带来欢乐。

14322.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a Scarecrow: Draw a card.

14323.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Return target artifact creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
14323.translation: {o4}，{oT}：将目标神器生物牌从你的坟墓场移回场上。

14382.oracleText: Target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
14382.translation: 目标牌手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

14435.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token for each Elf you control.
14435.translation: 你每操控一个妖精，便派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

14492.oracleText: Two times the size, four times the smell.
14492.translation: 尺寸变成两倍，体味变成四倍。

14493.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
14493.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

14883.oracleText:
"No rest. No mercy. No matter what."
—Memorial inscription

14884.oracleText: Creatures you control have flying, first strike, vigilance, trample, haste, and protection from black and from red.
14884.translation: 由你操控的生物具有飞行，先攻，警戒，践踏，敏捷，反黑保护与反红保护异能。

14902.oracleText: If an opponent would search a library, that player searches the top four cards of that library instead.
14902.translation: 如果某对手将搜寻某牌库，则改为他搜寻该牌库顶的四张牌。

14939.oracleText: The musical sound of its turning triggers the tumblers of revelation.
14939.translation: 它转动所发出的乐音，能触动启示的机栓。

14941.oracleText: Spells you cast of the chosen type cost {o1} less to cast.
14941.translation: 你施放的该类别咒语减少{o1}来施放。

14983.oracleText: Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
14983.translation: 派出三个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

15349.translation: 重生每个由你操控的生物。

15391.oracleText: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.
15391.translation: 技艺纯熟的伊捷时法师，能在沙漏两粒沙落下的时间差里完成一回壮绝复仇。

15394.oracleText:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator
15394.translation:
「你的约定不能毁弃。但你，倒是可以。」
～俄佐立将军阿果托

15425.oracleText: Creatures you don't control get -1/-1 until end of turn.
15425.translation: 不由你操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

15603.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Exile target card from a graveyard.

15607.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
15607.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

15755.oracleText:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra
15755.translation:
「瞧瞧她，曾是如此无邪。死亡最在行的，就是挤干这种…缺陷。」
～撒芙儿

15756.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice a creature: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
15756.translation: {oB}，牺牲一个生物：目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

15864.oracleText: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.
15864.translation: 欧娜之歌有如走调的晚餐铃声。所有仙灵都回到家中，只留下欧娜进餐，享用着他们献上的窃来眠梦与流言。

15865.oracleText: Choose a creature type. Draw a card for each permanent you control of that type.
15865.translation: 选择一种生物类别。你每操控一个该类别的永久物，便抓一张牌。

16090.oracleText: Counter target spell. You gain 3 life.
16090.translation: 反击目标咒语。你获得3点生命。

16474.oracleText: Her leadership forged the Weatherlight's finest crew.
16474.translation: 她领导组建了晴空号最优秀的船员。「暂译」

16479.oracleText: Other enchantments you control have shroud.
16479.translation: 由你操控的其他结界具有帷幕异能。

16783.oracleText: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."
16783.translation: 「我竟会将生命虚掷于战斗中。我该作的是创造，而不是破坏。」

16784.oracleText: {o1oWoU}, {oT}: Return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
16784.translation: {o1oWoU}，{oT}：将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

16832.oracleText: Sacrifice a land: Target creature you control gains shroud until end of turn.
16832.translation: 牺牲一个地：目标由你操控的生物获得帷幕异能直到回合结束。

16867.oracleText: Tap up to two target creatures.
16867.translation: 横置至多两个目标生物。

16878.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying.
16878.translation: 派出两个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

17165.oracleText: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.
17165.translation: 大地暴烈地自宝珠汲取能量，仿佛亘古以来便未进滴水。

17347.oracleText: {o1}: Exile target card from a graveyard.

17650.oracleText:
"Most faeries are harmless pranksters. Every now and again, though, you get one that crosses over from mischievous to malicious."
—Gaddock Teeg
17650.translation:
「大多数仙灵只是无害的捣蛋鬼。但是，你不时地会碰上某个从捣蛋跨入恶意的家伙。」
～加达提格

17687.oracleText: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful. Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.
17687.translation: 黎撒拉那的至美艾简命令数百株树起身，好依照自己认定的美丽模样重新栽下。金叶林就此诞生。

17709.oracleText: You may activate abilities of creatures you control as though those creatures had haste.
17709.translation: 对由你操控的生物而言，你可以将其视同具有敏捷异能地来起动其异能。

17789.oracleText: Destroy target attacking or blocking creature.
17789.translation: 消灭目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物。

17797.oracleText: Steady and silent as the deep current, the reejerey guides the course of the school.
17797.translation: 理骑士沉稳如深流，引导群体的动向。

17798.oracleText: Other Merfolk creatures you control get +1/+1.
17798.translation: 由你操控的其他人鱼生物得+1/+1。

17799.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Merfolk spell, you may tap or untap target permanent.
17799.translation: 每当你使用人鱼咒语时，你可以横置或重置目标永久物。

17838.oracleText: Mined from a cave in the Dark Meanders, it shines brightest when no one is looking.
17838.translation: 它是从暗曲礁的洞窟中挖出来的，只在没人看时放出明亮光芒。

17893.oracleText: Put target noncreature permanent on top of its owner's library.
17893.translation: 将目标非生物的永久物置于其拥有者的牌库顶。

17938.oracleText: Boggarts get so excited when they find something new to smash that they really don't notice who gets underfoot.
17938.translation: 若发现有新东西可以打烂，都会让波尬兴奋得忘掉谁会给踩扁。

17959.oracleText: Target creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
17959.translation: 目标生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

17987.oracleText:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg
17987.translation:
「如果你住在巨人背上，就只需要害怕一个人。」
～加达提格

18047.translation: 所结附的生物具有连击异能。

18079.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, that player draws seven cards.
18079.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，该牌手抓七张牌。

18126.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance.
18126.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒异能。

18156.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature, two +1/+1 counters on another target creature, and three +1/+1 counters on a third target creature.
18156.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，在另一个目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物，在第三个目标生物上放置三个+1/+1指示物。

18281.oracleText: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.
18281.translation: 这龙兽的脾气暴躁，训练不足，个性固执，非常适合测试主人的意志。

18311.oracleText: Attacking creatures get +2/+0 until end of turn.
18311.translation: 进行攻击的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

18341.oracleText: The druids of Mazar treat each seedcone with respect for the warrior it will become.
18341.translation: 每一个球果都受到麻栅德鲁伊的敬重，因它终将成为战士。

18360.oracleText:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid
18360.translation:
「如果野兽藏身在雄伟橡树中，弓岂能奈他何？如果橡树有咆哮的野兽护身，斧头岂能奈他何？」
～妖精高位德鲁伊戴欧诺

18389.oracleText:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage
18389.translation:
「我给他们的幻梦奇妙无比，让他们舍不得回到清醒的世界。」
～人鱼法师加俐得

18421.oracleText: "We are goblinkind, heirs to the mountain empires of chieftains past. Rest is death to us, and arson is our call to war."
18421.translation: 「我们是鬼怪族，数代酋长以来的山脉帝国传人。不到死不休息，纵火就是战争的动力。」

18449.oracleText: If a source an opponent controls would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage.
18449.translation: 如果由对手操控的某来源将对你造成伤害，则防止此伤害中的1点。

18497.oracleText: All are prey to the eyes of the wild.
18497.translation: 在荒野之眼看来，一切都是猎物。

18516.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. You gain 4 life.
18516.translation: 消灭目标神器或结界。你获得4点生命。

18531.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life.
18531.translation: 每当你获得生命时，目标对手失去等量的生命。

18580.oracleText: {o1oG}: Create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
18580.translation: {o1oG}：派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。

18608.oracleText: Put that card on the bottom of your library?
18608.translation: 是否要将该牌置于你的牌库底？

18615.oracleText: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

18656.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
18656.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得先攻异能。

18671.oracleText: Like all jungle plants, the vines must fight and claw for sunlight. Once their place is secured, they grow strong, sharp, and impenetrable.
18671.translation: 藤蔓一如所有丛林植物，必须奋力挤出空间来争夺阳光。一旦保住了位置，它们便长得更韧，更尖锐，也更牢固。

18673.oracleText:
"Do not mistake a quiet rampart for one that is unguarded. Some things stir only when they need to."
—Bonovar, siege commander
18673.translation:
「别以为这样毫无动静的壁垒就一定无人看守。有些东西只在有必要时才会动起来。」
～攻城指挥官波诺瓦

18703.oracleText: "Poor little sun-dweller out past curfew. And to think, you might have survived if it wasn't so close to suppertime."
18703.translation: 「可怜的阳光子民，怎会在宵禁时刻出门呢。想想看，要不是那么接近晚餐时分，你说不定还能活下去。」

18755.oracleText: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."
18755.translation: 「什么东西我几乎都放火烧过了～树，石头，甚至是水。现在该来烧烧云。」

18783.oracleText: Whenever an opponent discards a card, that player loses 2 life.
18783.translation: 每当一位对手弃一张牌时，该牌手失去2点生命。

18798.oracleText: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.
18798.translation: 只要握在真信者手上，这把剑是古物还是摹制品都不重要。

18799.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+0 and has first strike, vigilance, trample, and haste.
18799.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0且具有先攻、警戒、践踏与敏捷异能。

18834.oracleText: She wears the talismans of every creature she can evoke.
18834.translation: 她戴的饰符包含了每种自己能唤出的生物。

18842.oracleText:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane
18842.translation:
「只要一个享福，整群都能享福。」
～金鬃贾佐

18859.oracleText:
"Impossible! How could they overwhelm us? We had barricades, war elephants, . . . and they were barely a tenth of our number!"
—General Avitora
18859.translation:
「不可能！我们怎会给打到溃败？我们有路障，战象…而且他们数量不到我们的一成！」
～阿维托拉将军

18860.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn.
18860.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

18872.oracleText: The locks on the cages of the damned are opened with keys of marrow, sinew, and blood.
18872.translation: 受诅者囚笼的锁，要用骨头，肌腱，与鲜血打造的钥匙开启。

18904.oracleText: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
18904.translation: 将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

18971.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature loses all abilities and becomes a blue Frog with base power and toughness 1/1.
18971.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物成为基础力量与防御力为1/1的蓝色蛙生物且失去所有异能。

19023.oracleText: A thin shell lies between the roc and a world of bite-sized treats.
19023.translation: 洛克鸟与充满一口美食的世界之间，只隔着薄薄一层壳。

19048.oracleText: The gods are not always kind, but they do have a soft spot for plucky underdogs.
19048.translation: 神明并不总是仁慈，但他们对勇敢的手下经常会心软。

19049.oracleText: If you have less life than an opponent, you gain 6 life. If you control fewer creatures than an opponent, create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
19049.translation: 如果你的生命少于某位对手，你获得6点生命。如果由你操控的生物数量少于某位对手，派出三个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

19275.oracleText: Don't underestimate the aerodynamic qualities of the common goblin.
19275.translation: 别小看了一般鬼怪的空气动力学品质。

19367.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, that player loses 2 life.
19367.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，该牌手失去2点生命。

19389.oracleText: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.
19389.translation: 对非瑞克西亚人来说，死亡既非终点，亦非仅只一次的事件。

19398.oracleText:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
19398.translation:
「我们光耀的感染已经掌握大局。」
～大修道士艾蕾侬

19404.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal any number of creature cards from among them and put the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
19404.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中任意数量的生物牌，并将所展示的牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

19422.oracleText:
"If there can be no victory, then I will fight forever."
—Koth of the Hammer
19422.translation:
"If there can be no victory, then I will fight forever."
—Koth of the Hammer

19523.oracleText: A productive warren requires a good deal of prodding.
19523.translation: 繁旺的繁殖地需要大量的刺激。

19526.oracleText: "We lost our homes and our kin. We won't let those rotters take our future as well."
19526.translation: "We lost our homes and our kin. We won't let those rotters take our future as well."

19541.translation: 消灭目标非神器的生物。

19548.oracleText: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.
19548.translation: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

19549.oracleText:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One
19549.translation:
「我相信许多世界都将臣服于非瑞克西亚。秘罗地只不过是第一个。」
～细语者希欧蕊

19579.oracleText: Creatures your opponents control get -2/-0 until end of turn.
19579.translation: 由对手操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。

19617.oracleText:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur
19617.translation:
「如果那脑子无法理解浆液的秘密，就多加几个脑子。」
～卜算手信众卢米

19619.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, each opponent loses 1 life.
19619.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

19646.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, you may gain 3 life.
19646.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，你可以获得3点生命。

19647.oracleText: Whenever an opponent discards a card, you may gain 3 life.
19647.translation: 每当任一对手弃一张牌时，你可以获得3点生命。

19736.translation: 是否要放逐目标神器或结界？

20118.translation: 结附于不具飞行异能的生物

20223.oracleText: Distribute counters among one or two target creatures.
20223.translation: 将指示物分配给一个或两个目标生物。

20691.translation: 由你操控的绿色生物得+1/+1。

20843.oracleText: Shuffle it into its owner's library?
20843.translation: 是否要将它洗入起拥有者的牌库？

20852.oracleText: The minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.
20852.translation: 夏浓山脉的牛头怪以好斗而闻名。他们还以对死者的赞美诗而闻名，为朋友和敌人而唱。这些赞美诗可以持续数天，以低沉而令人难以忘怀的声音充满山谷。

20919.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by enchanted creature.
20919.translation: 防止所结附的生物将造成的所有战斗伤害。

21116.oracleText: Target creature gains first strike until end of turn.
21116.translation: 目标生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

21147.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
21147.translation: 目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

21255.translation: 消灭目标进行攻击的生物。

21285.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
21285.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

21398.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand?
21398.translation: 是否要将目标生物移回其拥有者手上？

21871.oracleText: All creatures able to block target creature this turn do so.
21871.translation: 本回合中，所有能阻挡目标生物的生物皆须阻挡之。

21887.oracleText: Seafarers fear sailing off the world's edge not so much as down its gullet.
21887.translation: 海员们担心的不是驶离世界的边缘，而是驶入世界的腹地。「暂译」

21915.oracleText: Destroy all creatures target opponent controls. Draw a card for each creature destroyed this way.
21915.translation: 消灭所有由目标对手操控的生物。每以此法消灭一个生物，你便抓一张牌。

22142.oracleText: Exile up to three target cards from a single graveyard.
22142.translation: 将至多三张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌放逐。

22554.oracleText: Target creature gains trample until end of turn.
22554.translation: 目标生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

22794.oracleText: Put it on the bottom of its owner's library?
22794.translation: 是否要将它置于其拥有者的牌库底？

23289.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control.
23289.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将该生物牌在你的操控下移回战场。

23340.oracleText: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.
23340.translation: 这些面具，就像孕育它们的古树般，给了树灵们力量。

23341.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 for each other enchantment on the battlefield.
23341.translation: 战场上每有一个其他结界，所结附的生物便得+2/+2。

23415.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has trample.
23415.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

23441.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature gains haste until end of turn.
23441.translation: {oT}：目标生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

23488.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice a land: Destroy target nonbasic land.
23488.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲一个地：消灭目标非基本地。

23541.oracleText: Each creature deals damage to itself equal to its power.
23541.translation: 每个生物各对本身造成等同于其力量的伤害。

23586.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies, you gain 1 life.
23586.translation: 每当一个生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

23701.oracleText: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has trample.
23701.translation: 每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物均具有践踏异能。

23781.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life and create a 1/1 black Faerie Rogue creature token with flying.
23781.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你失去1点生命并派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的仙灵／浪客衍生生物。

23827.oracleText: Target creature gets -4/-0 until end of turn. If you control a Wizard, draw a card.
23827.translation: 目标生物得-4/-0直到回合结束。如果你操控法术师，则抓一张牌。

23850.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
23850.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

23938.oracleText: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.
23938.translation: 树妖与妖精共享树林的好处，但其实妖精只是觉得从高处往下看的风景不错。

23951.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card.
23951.translation: 每当一个由你操控且上面有+1/+1指示物的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手弃一张牌。

24061.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each other attacking creature that shares a creature type with it.
24061.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，战场上每有一个与它具共通生物类别的其他攻击生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

24124.oracleText: Counter target artifact or enchantment spell.
24124.translation: 反击目标神器或结界咒语。

24172.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有飞行异能。

24184.oracleText: A step in one direction is two steps away from another.
24184.translation: 往正确的方向踏一步，便会比往其他方向多出两步之远。

24254.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, draw a card.
24254.translation: 每当你施放神器咒语时，抓一张牌。

24321.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
24321.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

24342.oracleText:
"As expected, this sphere's design reflects the colors of the four moons . . . plus another?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher
24342.translation:
「正如所料，此球的设计反映了四个月亮的颜色……还多加了一种？」
～大学者庞棣飞

24353.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
24353.translation: {o3}，{oT}：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

24374.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.
24374.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。

24383.oracleText: Put up to two creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
24383.translation: 将至多两张生物牌从你手上放置进场。

24536.oracleText: Creatures you control gain first strike until end of turn.
24536.translation: 由你操控的生物获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

24593.oracleText: Destroy all creatures with power 3 or greater.
24593.translation: 消灭所有力量等于或大于3的生物。

24610.oracleText: Goblins generally have two possessions: one per hand.
24610.translation: 鬼怪的双手通常各有主见。

24635.oracleText: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."
24635.translation: 「灵思如风中花瓣般飘飞；我只需面朝着微风。」

24636.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card, you may pay {o1}. If you do, draw a card.
24636.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

24765.translation: 是否要横置目标永久物？

24772.oracleText: Exile target card from a graveyard?
24772.translation: 是否要将目标牌从坟墓场放逐？

24775.oracleText: Distribute counters among one, two, or three target creatures.
24775.translation: 在一个、两个或三个目标生物之间分配指示物。

24878.oracleText: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card, then put all cards revealed this way into your hand.
24878.translation: 从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到你展示出一张非地牌为止，然后将所有以此法展示的牌置于你手上。

24913.oracleText: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.
24913.translation: 空圆地遇难者将自己死时的恐惧传给生者。

24914.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
24914.translation: 派出两个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

24925.oracleText:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel
24925.translation:
「工具与工匠可能会毁灭，但创作此行为将生生不息。」
～艾紫培提瑞

24934.oracleText: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.
24934.translation: 如果说狼人痛恨什么，那就是颈环～尤其是艾维欣教会的象征物：艾维欣颈环。

24949.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
24949.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

24966.translation: 由你操控的神器生物得+2/+2。

24973.translation: 目标牌手牺牲一个生物。

24993.oracleText: Players have no maximum hand size.
24993.translation: 牌手的手牌数量都没有上限。

25034.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
25034.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

25049.oracleText: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.
25049.translation: 盖司利用亡者的残躯，锻造一大群守卫来保护其王座。

25053.oracleText: A devil's hands are never idle.

25078.oracleText: Create X 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying.
25078.translation: 派出X个4/4白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

25183.oracleText: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.
25183.translation: 对尊重树林的人，泰坦尼亚的奖励方式就是将他变为树林的一部分。

25193.oracleText:
"I do not know which gives me more pride: the legions of soldiers marching in thunderous lockstep, or the cry of the skyknights riding their rocs like jagged lightning overhead."
—Razia
25193.translation:
「我不确定究竟是哪一项更让我骄傲：是无数士兵如雷霆般的行军步伐，亦或驾驭洛克鸟的空骑士似闪电般掠过长空。」
～拉基雅

25216.oracleText:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept
25216.translation:
「无论你做什么，我都能轻松地加以抹消。」
～魔法专家尔泰

25218.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o1} for each card in your graveyard.
25218.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者为每张在你坟墓场的牌支付{o1}，否则反击之。

25293.oracleText: Create a 6/6 green Wurm creature token.
25293.translation: 派出一个6/6绿色亚龙衍生生物。

25328.oracleText: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.
25328.translation: 天使歌声并非只是传入耳中的旋律，而是震撼心灵的回响。

25378.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, draw a card.
25378.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，抓一张牌。

25460.oracleText: Choose a creature or planeswalker card.
25460.translation: 选择一张生物或鹏洛客牌。

25862.oracleText: With or without witnesses, the suns continued their prismatic dance.
25862.translation: 不论有没有人张望，五阳依旧多彩舞动着。

25865.oracleText: Creatures you control of the chosen color get +1/+1.
25865.translation: 由你操控的该色生物得+1/+1。

25908.oracleText: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."
25908.translation: 当秘罗志士出现，熔炉居民等着洼巴司下命令。他的命令震慑了所有人：「随他们来。」

25926.translation:
「好好欣赏蒙福的完美。」
～细语者希欧蕊

26043.oracleText: As long as you have 0 or less life, all damage is dealt to you as though its source had infect.
26043.translation: 只要你的总生命为0或更少，则所有对你造成的伤害均视为其来源具有侵染地造成。

26072.oracleText:
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond."
—Elspeth's journal
26072.translation:
「游击队挖出古怪的神器。没人知道其来源，但却给予他们往后生命的希望。」
～艾紫培的日志

26080.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
26080.translation: 目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

26144.oracleText: Imprisonment teaches revenge. Hobbling teaches resignation.
26144.translation: 监禁教出复仇。跛行教出屈从。

26237.oracleText: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."
26237.translation: 「吉塔厦的人私下传着其他世界之流言。如果他们确实存在，我们必得向之展现非瑞克西亚的壮丽。」

26240.oracleText: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."
26240.translation: 「这不是目标，而是过程～用来创造完美的非瑞克西亚。」

26241.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, draw seven cards.
26241.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，抓七张牌。

26251.oracleText: "As long as my hand holds a blade, there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again."
26251.translation: "As long as my hand holds a blade, there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again."

26539.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token.
26539.translation: 派出一个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。

26709.oracleText: You draw X cards and you lose X life.
26709.translation: 你抓X张牌且失去X点生命。

26718.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. You may put that card into your hand unless it has the same name as another card exiled this way. Repeat this process until you put a card into your hand or you exile two cards with the same name, whichever comes first.
26718.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。除非它与另一张以此法放逐的牌同名，否则你可以将该牌置于你手上。重复此流程，直到你将某张牌置于你手上，或是你放逐了两张同名的牌为止。

26776.translation: 每位牌手各牺牲一个生物。

26917.oracleText: Draw two cards, then discard two cards.
26917.translation: 抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。

26939.oracleText: {oT}: Target player draws a card, then discards a card.
26939.translation: {oT}：目标牌手抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

27006.oracleText: Whenever a spell or ability an opponent controls destroys a noncreature permanent you control, you may destroy target permanent that opponent controls.
27006.translation: 每当由对手操控的咒语或异能消灭任一由你操控之非生物的永久物时，你可以消灭目标由该对手操控的永久物。

27039.oracleText: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.
27039.translation: 优秀的策士把握机会。伟大的策士创造机会。

27338.oracleText: Tap up to four target creatures.
27338.translation: 横置至多四个目标生物。

27518.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
27518.translation: 在你的维持开始，若你的坟墓场中有四张或更多的生物牌，你可以将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场中移回你手上。

27736.oracleText: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."
27736.translation: 「不论成功或失败，智者都能从中学习。」

27829.oracleText: "Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws."
27829.translation: 「现实将我放逐了。我不再受到它的规则约束。」

27831.oracleText: {o2oU}: Turn target face-down creature face up.
27831.translation: {o2oU}：将目标牌面朝下的生物翻回正面。

28046.oracleText: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.
28046.translation: 灵俑为生者悲叹，却为喜获死亡的人庆贺。

28081.oracleText: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.
28081.translation: 每枝花，每片叶和每朵瓣都精确地相同。

28113.oracleText: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.
28113.translation: 在死尸僵硬之前，必须先把嘴给撬开； 否则返回的灵魂会找不到入口。

28118.oracleText: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.
28118.translation: 她跨越物质疆界，直探所有生物获取力量的信念。

28120.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Aura spell, you may draw a card.
28120.translation: 每当你施放灵气咒语时，你可以抓一张牌。

28131.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has first strike.
28131.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有先攻异能。

28268.oracleText: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.
28268.translation: 猎人将幼年野猪引诱到开阔地带，希望能捕捉到更大的猎物。「暂译」

28276.oracleText: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.
28276.translation: 不论是从训练、骑乘还是风味来说，甲虫都堪称鬼怪军事创新一绝。

28404.oracleText: Where the dead outnumbered the living, mimics scavenged faces from the fallen.
28404.translation: 在亡者远多于生灵之地，擅仿人在逝者间搜集面容。

28645.oracleText: Counter target spell that targets a permanent you control.
28645.translation: 反击目标咒语，且该咒语须以由你操控的永久物为目标。

28964.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may draw a card unless that player pays {o1}.
28964.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，除非该牌手支付{o1}，否则你可以抓一张牌。

29001.oracleText: {o1oG}, Sacrifice a land: Create two 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens.
29001.translation: {o1oG}，牺牲一个地：派出两个1/1绿色松鼠衍生生物。

29002.oracleText: {o1oG}, Sacrifice a land: Squirrel creatures get +1/+1 until end of turn.
29002.translation: {o1oG}，牺牲一个地：松鼠生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

29094.oracleText: Destroy target land. Its controller loses 2 life.
29094.translation: 消灭目标地。其操控者失去2点生命。

29460.oracleText: Designed like the gargadons of Keld—big and brutal.
29460.translation: 参考凯尔顿的乳齿巨象之设计：庞大而残暴。

29550.oracleText:
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir."
—Szadek
29550.translation:
「我敢说，若是真有人能透视我们的心思，就算他理解力再强，也将完全无法承受底密尔会堂背后的真相。」
～札戴克

29589.oracleText: Their denial reaches far into your future.
29589.translation: 他们连你的未来都全盘否定。

29603.oracleText: Other permanents you control have hexproof.
29603.translation: 由你操控的其他永久物都具有辟邪异能。

29877.oracleText: Counter target instant or sorcery spell.
29877.translation: 反击目标瞬间或法术咒语。

29946.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o4}.
29946.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。

30011.oracleText: Exile target attacking or blocking creature.
30011.translation: 放逐目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物。

30019.oracleText: "Let the song of Selesnya be heard above the rhythm of our thundering hordes!"
30019.translation: 「让瑟雷尼亚之歌声与我们大军行进的鼓动一同飘扬！」

30020.oracleText: Creatures you control get +3/+3 until end of turn.
30020.translation: 由你操控的生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。

30024.oracleText: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.
30024.translation: 由于过度采伐之故，所谓的「老树」在拉尼卡已经十分罕见。据说以老树雕成的像，是用来让仅存的古老自然精怪有歇息之处。

30066.oracleText: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.
30066.translation: 智者乐意向每位听众传授各种不同的古老智慧，让大家都能受益。

30067.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, you may draw a card.
30067.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，你可以抓一张牌。

30111.oracleText: If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead.
30111.translation: 如果某效应将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为它派出两倍数量的该类衍生物。

30132.oracleText: Tap three untapped creatures you control: Tap target creature.
30132.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的生物：横置目标生物。

30150.oracleText:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter
30150.translation:
「在滚滚战尘中，我见到金色鬃毛上闪耀的阳光，荣誉之光辉披甲现身；我于是丢下了剑，为身处这愚蠢战争而流泪。」
～古鲁叛逃者卓文

30165.oracleText: In a space where there is no room, in a structure that was never built, meets the guild that doesn't exist.
30165.translation: 在某个没有房间的地方，有栋从未建造的建筑，藏着不为人知的公会。

30196.oracleText:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—The Invokers' Tales
30196.translation:
「我们所熟悉的生活已面临存亡关头。面对意图将之夺走者，我们必须展现力量。」
～《召现师传说》

30197.oracleText: {o8}: Target creature gets +5/+5 and gains trample until end of turn.
30197.translation: {o8}：直到回合结束，目标生物得+5/+5且获得践踏异能。

30232.oracleText: As it spins, dead voices shriek in an ever-increasing cacophony, rending the mind asunder.
30232.translation: 它转动的尖削杂音有如不断增强的亡者之声，让心灵为之裂解。

30244.oracleText: The baloth's instincts boiled, its muscles pulled taut, and its razor-spines bristled, as it turned to face—a runt meepling.
30244.translation: 那巴洛西的本能沸腾，肌肉暴张，尖锐骨板立起，转身面对的～却是一个鬼吼鬼叫的小家伙。

30245.oracleText: Target creature must be blocked this turn if able.
30245.translation: 目标生物本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

30248.translation: 所结附的生物具有守军异能。

30256.oracleText:
"The purpose of existence is simple: everything is fuel for the magmaw."
—Jaji, magmaw worshipper
30256.translation:
「生存的意义很简单：万物都是岩浆喉的燃料。」
～岩浆喉崇敬者甲忌

30343.oracleText: It wasn't long until the elves had developed a use for every part of the Eldrazi.
30343.translation: 妖精不需多久便开发出利用奥札奇全身任一部分的方法。

30383.oracleText: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.
30383.translation: 祭师发出的吵杂声音并不是用来激起战意，而是要盖掉那些被奥札奇吓跑者的尖叫。

30384.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have target creature get +2/+0 until end of turn.
30384.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以使目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

30394.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each creature you control.
30394.translation: 你每操控一个生物，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

30452.oracleText: Goblins in the first wave of a fire raid always bemoan the aim of everyone else.
30452.translation: 火攻第一波出阵的鬼怪，总会埋怨其他人的准头。

30475.oracleText:
"It's so cute when it's sleeping, isn't it? Actually, it's still as abhorrent as ever, but at least it's not trying to kill us."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage
30475.translation:
「它睡着的样子真可爱，不是吗？其实它还是一样的可恶，但至少它目前没在想着要杀掉我们。」
～塔晋息法师诺言达

30476.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if enchanted creature is untapped, tap it.
30476.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若所结附的生物为未横置，则横置它。

30498.oracleText:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—The War Diaries
30498.translation:
「我们的敌人一心要消灭所有生灵。别妄想能与之订立盟约。」
～《战场札记》

30586.oracleText: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.
30586.translation: 它将爆发力包在石般坚硬的皮肤内。

30592.oracleText: The best defense is a good offense.
30592.translation: 最佳的防御就是有效的攻击。

30708.oracleText: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.
30708.translation: 艾法曾是深受探险家欢迎的中途站，现已成为鲜闻语声、防卫森严的地方。

30738.oracleText: Those who seek to disturb the harmony of life will see their instruments taken from them.
30738.translation: 干扰生命乐章者，将发现自己无器材可加入合奏。

30759.oracleText: Reveal the top card of your library?

30975.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+2 and has vigilance.
30975.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+2且具有警戒异能。

30988.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}.
30988.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。

31079.oracleText: One night Oona bottled the sky. The next night she aligned the stars and released it.
31079.translation: 有一晚，欧娜将天空装进瓶中。第二晚她调整过星星的排列后，便将之释放。

31230.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature becomes the color or colors of your choice until end of turn.
31230.translation: {oT}：选择一种或多种颜色。目标生物成为该些颜色直到回合结束。

31389.oracleText: Whole again in honor and horn.

31390.oracleText: {o2o(G/W)}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 green and white Elf Warrior creature token.
31390.translation: {o2o(G/W)}，{oT}：派出一个1/1，绿白双色的妖精／战士衍生生物。

31426.oracleText: Enchanted creatures you control have shroud.
31426.translation: 由你操控、且被结附的生物具有帷幕异能。

31465.oracleText: Lands you control are every basic land type in addition to their other types.
31465.translation: 由你操控的地均额外具有所有基本地类别。

31481.oracleText: Create three 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
31481.translation: 派出三个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

31497.oracleText:
"He is a ghost that has never known life."
—The Seer's Parables
31497.translation:
「他是个不知生之滋味的鬼魅。」
～《预言师寓言》

31703.oracleText: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."
31703.translation: 「刚德，塔德温华域的英雄，在此长眠。愿他永远领导我们的探索。」

31704.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
31704.translation: {oT}：派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

31861.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+0 and has trample.
31861.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+0且具有践踏异能。

31864.oracleText: Target creature deals damage to itself equal to its power.
31864.translation: 目标生物对本身造成等同于其力量的伤害。

31908.oracleText: {oT}: You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
31908.translation: {oT}：你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

32099.oracleText: Hidetsugu never relinquished a grudge. He let it burn within him, gathering ever greater intensity until the final moment of vengeance.
32099.translation: 碑出告的怒火绝不轻易止息。他会将愤怒于心内不断闷烧，在复仇一刻全数爆发。

32243.oracleText: To Mirrodin, an explosive. To Phyrexia, a missionary.
32243.translation: 对秘罗地来说，是个爆裂物。对非瑞克西亚来说，是位使者。

32274.oracleText: When breaking someone's face once just isn't enough.
32274.translation: 如果把某人的脸打烂一次还不够的话。

32315.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains first strike until end of turn.
32315.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+1且获得先攻异能。

32334.oracleText: All goblin rituals serve a dual purpose as fertility rites, even the destructive ones. Especially the destructive ones.
32334.translation: 所有鬼怪祭仪都包含了繁殖仪式的目的，就算是带毁灭性的也一样。 尤其是带毁灭性的。

32337.oracleText: "Just think how strong I'll be if my arms don't tear off!"
32337.translation: 「如果我的手臂没断掉，想想看我会是多强！」

32353.oracleText: It subsists on a diet rich in screaming metal and molten blood.
32353.translation: It subsists on a diet rich in screaming metal and molten blood.

32392.oracleText:
"See how gratefully this world accepts our blessings."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
32392.translation:
「瞧瞧，这世界是如此心存感激地接受我们的祝福。」
～核心卜算师金吉塔厦

32393.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, proliferate.
32393.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，增殖。

32397.oracleText:
"When everything looks like a nail, you really need to get yourself a hammer."
—Krol, goblin furnace-priest
32397.translation:
「当每件东西看来都像钉子，你真的该替自己找把槌子。」
～鬼怪熔炉僧克罗

32404.oracleText:
"Death shall prevail as long as our will falls to rust. May necessity anneal our resolve."
—Ghalma the Shaper
32404.translation:
「如果我们的意志生锈，死亡便将横行无阻；但愿困境能激励我们的决心。」
～塑型师佳玛

32472.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has haste.
32472.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有敏捷异能。

32478.oracleText: Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell that targets only a single Golem, that player copies that spell for each other Golem that spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those Golems.
32478.translation: 每当任一牌手施放仅以单一魔像为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，该咒语每能以一个其他的魔像为目标，该牌手便将该咒语复制一次。每个复制品都要以这些魔像之一为目标，且不能重复选择。

32527.oracleText: The suns of Mirrodin have shone upon perfection only once.
32527.translation: 秘罗地诸阳只映照在一个完美杰作上。

32530.oracleText:
"Grant me loft. Grant me light. Grant me the accuracy I need to kill all who threaten Bladehold."
—Prayer to the Whitesun
32530.translation:
"Grant me loft. Grant me light. Grant me the accuracy I need to kill all who threaten Bladehold."
—Prayer to the Whitesun

32568.translation: 被所铸造的东西铸造出来。

32570.oracleText: Spells you cast that share a card type with the exiled card cost {o2} less to cast.
32570.translation: 你施放之与所放逐的牌具共通牌张类别之咒语减少{o2}来施放。

32576.oracleText: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.
32576.translation: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.

32597.oracleText: Target creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
32597.translation: 目标生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

32615.oracleText: An Auriok shield is polished to a mirror finish even on the inside, enabling its bearer to watch foes ahead and behind.
32615.translation: 欧瑞克盾牌就连内侧都打磨得光亮如镜，让持盾者可以看到前后两方的敌人。

32616.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+3 and has vigilance.
32616.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+3且具有警戒异能。

32636.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has protection from green and from blue.
32636.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有反绿保护与反蓝保护。

32682.oracleText:
"If it wasn't a blackened, stinking, melted abomination before, it certainly is now."
—Koth of the Hammer
32682.translation:
「如果它之前不是个发黑、发臭、融化的憎恨兽，现在就真的是了。」
～锤族的寇斯

32725.oracleText: You gain 1 life for each creature you control.
32725.translation: 你每操控一个生物，便获得1点生命。

32739.oracleText: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.
32739.translation: 此秘耳一如烁光荒野：一片空白的画布，却将用来建构伟大的造物。

32753.oracleText:
"They'll soon become accustomed to wearing skin that is not their own."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
32753.translation:
「他们很快就会习惯穿戴着不属于自己的皮肤。」
～大修道士艾蕾侬

32754.oracleText: {oT}: Target permanent becomes an artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
32754.translation: {oT}：直到回合结束，目标永久物额外具有神器此类别。

32959.oracleText: Distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures.
32959.translation: 将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标生物。

33044.oracleText: Reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all land cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
33044.translation: 展示你牌库顶的四张牌。将以此法展示的所有地牌置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

33076.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
33076.translation: 目标生物得+3/+0直到回合结束。

33210.oracleText: This cat has two lives and it's hunting for more.
33210.translation: 这只猫不只有两条命，还想搜捕到更多。

33476.oracleText: Red spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
33476.translation: 你施放的红色咒语减少{o1}来施放。

33478.oracleText: Green spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
33478.translation: 你施放的绿色咒语减少{o1}来施放。

33846.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this permanent: Draw a card.

33952.oracleText: Put that card on the bottom of that player's library?
33952.translation: 是否要将该牌置于该牌手的牌库底？

33954.oracleText: Put it on top of its owner's library?
33954.translation: 是否要将它置于其拥有者的牌库顶？

34302.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has flying.
34302.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有飞行异能。

34345.oracleText: {o1oU}, Discard a card: Draw a card.

34386.oracleText: When CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it.
34386.translation: 当CARDNAME成为咒语或异能的目标时，将它牺牲。

34400.oracleText: The pits have their own form of mercy.
34400.translation: 死斗坑中有其独特的慈悲。

35150.oracleText: Other creatures you control with flying get +0/+1.
35150.translation: 由你操控且具飞行异能的其他生物得+0/+1。

35180.oracleText:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis
35180.translation:
「金属腐坏，木材短缺，信念是我们最好的武器。」
～寇利斯侍僧塔瓦勒

35719.oracleText: Creature spells of the chosen type cost {o2} less to cast.
35719.translation: 所选类别的生物咒语减少{o2}来施放。

35993.oracleText: {o1oB}, Pay 2 life: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
35993.translation: {o1oB}，支付2点生命：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

36283.oracleText: Gain control of all permanents you own.
36283.translation: 获得所有你拥有之永久物的操控权。

36404.oracleText: Choose two target creature cards in your graveyard. Sacrifice a creature. If you do, return the chosen cards to the battlefield tapped.
36404.translation: 选择两张目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌。牺牲一个生物。如果你如此作，则将所选之牌横置移回战场。

36438.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
36438.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

36633.oracleText: {oR}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Sacrifice the creature at the beginning of the next end step.
36633.translation: {oR}：你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。该生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，牺牲该生物。

36703.oracleText: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.
36703.translation: 召唤魔神者全职记得号令之力，无人忆起悔恨之痛。

37045.oracleText: Put it on the bottom of your library?
37045.translation: 是否要将它置于你的牌库底？

37059.translation: 结附于由对手操控的生物

37427.translation: 由你操控的其他生物得-1/-1。

37845.oracleText: Return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
37845.translation: 将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

37920.oracleText: "Cast out by my tribe, I am a pariah trapped in this mammal's carcass. Only my true kin hear my cries."
37920.translation: 「这个世界将由适格的君王所统治，而不是这些丑陋的觊觎者。」

37921.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control six or more lands, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.
37921.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控六个或更多地，则派出一个5/5红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

37928.oracleText: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.
37928.translation: 探险家的报偿，就是目睹明天的可能性。

37929.oracleText: You may play an additional land this turn.
37929.translation: 本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

37968.oracleText:
"The longer the journey, the more one learns."
—Isanke, Halimar seastalker
37968.translation:
「旅程越长，学到的越多。」
～哈利玛海袭人鱼伊珊格
