229696.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，直到回合结束，每个由你操控且力量等于或大于4的生物各得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

229698.oracleText: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.
229698.translation: 在林地外一哩的范围内，你就能感受到她的目光。在林地之内，你就能感受到她的利刃。

229699.oracleText:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon Arel's head. She hears the wisdom of our ancestors."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice
229699.translation:
「猎杀一头雄鹿，把犄角绑在阿瑞尔头上。她能听见先祖的智慧。」
～通灵祭师恰努尔

229701.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, put that many +1/+1 counters on it.
229701.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，在其上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

229703.oracleText:
"Look how cute it is now!"
—Vivien Reid
229703.translation:
「瞧瞧它现在多可爱呀！」
～薇薇安瑞德

229704.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +7/+7 and has trample.
229704.translation: 所结附的生物得+7/+7且具有践踏异能。

229705.oracleText: "The bones of the past will tell their tales—if you know how to speak their language."
229705.translation: 「逝者的骨骸会诉说他们的故事～只要你了解他们的语言。」

229707.oracleText: "The further into the future I look, the less certain my vision. Even now, the middle distance is obscured by fire."
229707.translation: 「我望向未来，看得越远，我的预示就越难确定。即使是现在，中间不远处也因火焰而变得模糊不清。」

229709.oracleText: The only casualties were a snapped spear, a lost helmet, and some bruised egos.
229709.translation: 仅有的战损是折断一柄长矛，丢失一顶头盔，以及丧失部分信心。

229711.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability of a creature or land that isn't a mana ability, you may draw a card.
229711.translation: 每当任一对手起动生物或地上不属法术力异能之异能时，你可以抓一张牌。

229712.oracleText:
"Whether we like it or not, our arrival has altered the landscape."
—Malcolm, navigator of the Belligerent
229712.translation:
「不管怎样，我们的到来已经改变了地境。」
～好战者号领航员马科姆

229714.oracleText: {o2oG}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
229714.translation: {o2oG}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

229716.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
229716.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，派出一个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。

229719.oracleText: When it passes, the dead are displaced by flourishing life.
229719.translation: 所经之处，枯骨朽尸展新碧。

229721.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229721.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物或地牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229722.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
229722.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。

229723.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have vigilance, trample, and indestructible.
229723.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2且具有警戒，践踏与不灭异能

229724.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have vigilance, trample, and indestructible."
229724.translation: 你获得具有「由你操控的生物得+2/+2且具有警戒，践踏与不灭异能」的徽记。

229725.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. When a creature is put onto the battlefield this way, it deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
229725.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以将其中一张生物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。当以此法将生物放进战场时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

229727.oracleText: The best of their trade know every bolt of their rigs, stem to stern.
229727.translation: 业内最顶尖的人熟悉从船头到船尾的每一颗螺栓。

229728.oracleText: As long as you control an artifact, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 and has flying.
229728.translation: 只要你操控神器，CARDNAME便得+2/+0且具有飞行异能。

229731.oracleText: Each creature you control with defender assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power and can attack as though it didn't have defender.
229731.translation: 每个由你操控且具守军异能的生物皆依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量；且能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

229733.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
229733.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

229734.oracleText: Discard a card: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a Human with base power and toughness 1/1, loses all abilities, and gains hexproof. It can't be blocked this turn.
229734.translation: 弃一张牌：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为基础力量与防御力为1/1的人类，失去所有异能，并获得辟邪异能。它本回合不能被阻挡。

229736.oracleText: {o7}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.
229736.translation: {o7}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个5/5红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

229737.oracleText: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets beyond imagining. Many have become meals trying to learn them.
229737.translation: 祀徒相信它身上藏有远超想象的秘密。但大多数想要解开秘密的人都成了它的盘中餐。

229739.oracleText: Cries of anguish quickly spurred cries of action.
229739.translation: 苦痛呻吟迅速唤来行动呐喊。

229740.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens. Until end of turn, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain haste.
229740.translation: 派出两个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得敏捷异能。

229744.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 10 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
229744.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成10点伤害。

229745.oracleText: Put target creature or planeswalker card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
229745.translation: 将目标生物或鹏洛客牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

229746.oracleText: Exile all but the bottom card of target player's library.
229746.translation: 放逐目标牌手牌库中除了最后一张以外的所有牌。

229748.oracleText: Sister of Nicol Bolas. Survivor of the Elder Dragon War. The most vicious of her kin.
229748.translation: 尼可波拉斯的妹妹。长老龙之战的幸存者。在其族内最为残暴。

229749.oracleText: CARDNAME has hexproof if it hasn't dealt damage yet.
229749.translation: 如果CARDNAME还没造成过伤害，则它具有辟邪异能。

229750.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
229750.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

229752.oracleText: "I turn around and see nothing, yet I know it is behind me. Its fingers rummage in my mind, crafting new ideas."
229752.translation: 「我转身望去，什么也没看见，但我确信它就在身后。它的手指在我脑中拨弄，正欲构筑全新思想。」

229755.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life this turn, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
229755.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中你曾获得生命，则派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

229757.oracleText: "The threads of magic that protect this place were woven by my will."
229757.translation: 「保护此地的缕缕魔法由我的意志织成。」

229759.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oGoU}. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control, and that creature gains flying until end of turn.
229759.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oGoU}。当你如此作时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且该生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

229761.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, for each player, choose target permanent that player controls. Those players sacrifice those permanents. Each player who sacrificed a permanent this way reveals the top card of their library, then puts it onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card.
229761.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，为每位牌手各选择目标由该牌手操控的永久物。这些牌手牺牲这些永久物。每位以此法牺牲永久物的牌手各展示其牌库顶牌，然后如果它是永久物牌，该牌手便将它放进战场。

229763.oracleText: Whenever you become the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {o1}.
229763.translation: 每当你成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，除非该咒语或异能的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

229766.oracleText: Knowledge itself is neither good nor evil. Just as the wrong book in the wrong hands could doom all existence, the same book in the right hands could save it.
229766.translation: 知识本身无正邪之分。不法之徒手持善典也能毁灭世界，而正义之士手持恶籍也能拯救众生。

229769.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile an instant or sorcery card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then put the exiled cards that weren't cast this way on the bottom of that library in a random order.
229769.translation: {o4}，{oT}：目标对手从其牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张瞬间或法术牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。然后将所有以此法放逐且未施放的牌以随机顺序置于该牌库底。

229770.oracleText: The grave robbers were startled, for the door to the mausoleum was already open.
229770.translation: 盗墓者看到陵墓大门早已洞开，自己也受惊不浅。

229771.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
229771.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

229773.translation: 所经之处，七彩虹霓紧相随。

229777.oracleText: Entrepreneurs have attempted to sell the water, but to no avail. Whatever magic it contains disappears upon bottling.
229777.translation: 不少商人打过出售泉水的念头，但却没人成功。无论水中蕴含何种魔法，一经装瓶便都消失无踪。

229780.oracleText: Made in its creator's image, though slightly more clangy.
229780.translation: 依创造者想象而建，只是更为浮夸。

229781.oracleText: Planeswalkers seek out great monuments throughout the Multiverse, knowing that their builders were unwittingly drawn by the convergence of mana in the area.
229781.translation: 鹏洛客在多重宇宙间寻找巨大纪念碑，因为他们晓得其建造者是不自觉地受该处聚集的法术力吸引而来。

229782.oracleText: A sharp axe solves most problems.
229782.translation: 利斧在手，能解决大多数问题。

229783.oracleText: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.
229783.translation: 冲击将士兵四散震飞～随后坑中有人影起身。

229785.oracleText: Thievery requires subtlety, from the beginning of the heist to the end.
229785.translation: 盗窃需要从始至终都心细。

229787.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+0, has vigilance, and is a Knight in addition to its other types.
229787.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0，具有警戒异能，且额外具有骑士此类别。

229788.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance that's attacking.
229788.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物，且正进行攻击。

229790.oracleText: The municipal senate makes extensive use of the thopters, mostly to gather dirt on rival senators.
229790.translation: 市议会广泛使用扑翼机，多数是为了搜集敌对议员的污点。

229795.oracleText: Its light exposes enemies and lays secrets bare.
229795.translation: 它的灯光能暴露敌人，揭露秘密。

229796.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Until end of turn, your opponents and creatures your opponents control with hexproof can be the targets of spells and abilities you control as though they didn't have hexproof.
229796.translation: {o1}，{oT}：直到回合结束，对具辟邪异能的对手及由对手操控且具该异能的生物而言，你能将其视同不具该异能地指定为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标。

229797.oracleText: The most holy treasures are kept far from unclean soil.
229797.translation: 最神圣的珍宝存放在远离不洁土壤之处。

229798.oracleText: The bedrock has many gifts to give.

229799.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
229799.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

229801.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a white card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229801.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张白色牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229803.oracleText:
"The healers of Bant are second to none. I owe them a great deal for their tutelage."
—Ajani Goldmane
229803.translation:
「班特治疗师的医术举世无双。他们的指导让我受益良多。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

229805.oracleText: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.
229805.translation: 她像撒拉守护众生一般保卫全城。

229807.oracleText: A pair of domesticated griffins escaped from captivity a century ago. Now the skies are filled with the songs of their descendants.
229807.translation: 百年前，一对驯养狮鹫逃出囚笼。如今其后裔的歌声响彻云际。

229815.oracleText: {o5oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control can't be blocked this turn.
229815.translation: {o5oU}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

229817.oracleText: As long as you control a Tezzeret planeswalker, CARDNAME has menace.
229817.translation: 只要你操控泰兹瑞鹏洛客，CARDNAME便具有威慑异能。

229820.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
229820.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

229821.oracleText: Destroy up to two target creatures. Put up to two creature cards from graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
229821.translation: 消灭至多两个目标生物。将至多两张生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

229822.oracleText:
"I'm not picky about what comes up, but the less decay, the better."
—Liliana Vess
229822.translation:
「我对唤起的东西并不挑剔，不过腐烂程度越低越好。」
～莉莲娜维斯

229823.oracleText: CARDNAME has deathtouch as long as you control a Liliana planeswalker.
229823.translation: 只要你操控莉莲娜鹏洛客，CARDNAME便具有死触异能。

229824.oracleText: Once every seven years it flies on spectral wings over the moors of ancient battlefields.
229824.translation: 每隔七年，它就会扇起魂魅之翼，飞越曾为厮杀战场的漫漫荒野。

229825.oracleText: {o5oBoB}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
229825.translation: {o5oBoB}：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

229827.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a black card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229827.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张黑色牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229828.oracleText: The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city of Naktamun crave only to spread their curse.
229828.translation: 他们死后漂浪在拿塔蒙城护帘之外，唯愿能有更多的人遭受这般诅咒。

229829.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature your opponents control.
229829.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

229830.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
229830.translation: CARDNAME对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

229832.oracleText: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."
229832.translation: 「给予龙应有的尊重者，才配冠上我们的称号。」

229833.oracleText: As long as you control a Dragon, CARDNAME has flying.
229833.translation: 只要你操控龙，CARDNAME便具有飞行异能。

229835.oracleText: "I am most myself when I am least human."

229836.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a red card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229836.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张红色牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229838.oracleText: Whenever you activate an ability of a Sarkhan planeswalker, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
229838.translation: 每当你起动萨坎鹏洛客的异能时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

229840.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
229840.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

229842.oracleText:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid
229842.translation:
「从后方靠近。这样就算它暴冲，你也不会立刻遭殃。」
～薇薇安瑞德

229844.oracleText:
"This imprint was the familiar of a friend."
—Vivien Reid
229844.translation:
「这印记来自一位朋友的佣兽。」
～薇薇安瑞德

229847.oracleText: "Would you rather feel the edge of my blade or the sharpness of my fangs?"
229847.translation: 「你是想尝尝我的利刃还是我的尖牙？」

229849.oracleText: Each of Vivien's arrows is an invocation of a species.
229849.translation: 薇薇安每枝箭都是一种生灵的具现。

229851.oracleText: Sarkhan wandered into a tomb and back in time.
229851.translation: 萨坎步入一处坟墓，然后回到了过去。

229852.oracleText: Just as the sun rises at dawn and the days lengthen in summer, the Sun Empire has awakened after long years of quiet.
229852.translation: 如同破晓日升，夏昼渐长，烈阳帝国在沉寂多年后已然觉醒。

229853.oracleText: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against enemy forces.
229853.translation: 川流使凭借无匹匿踪绝技，与敌对势力拉锯对抗。

229861.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control, and that creature gains flying until end of turn.
229861.translation: 在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且该生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

229865.oracleText: Return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand?
229865.translation: 是否要将目标由对手操控的生物移回其拥有者手上？

229874.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control with the greatest power.
229874.translation: 在目标由你操控之力量最大的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

229875.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control with the greatest power.
229875.translation: 在目标由你操控之力量最大的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

229876.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229876.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张神器牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229877.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
229877.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张神器牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

229878.oracleText: Create two 0/1 black Cleric creature tokens.
229878.translation: 派出两个0/1黑色僧侣衍生生物。

229879.oracleText: Create two 0/1 black Cleric creature tokens.
229879.translation: 派出两个0/1黑色僧侣衍生生物。

229882.oracleText: Until your next turn, creatures you control gain "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
229882.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，由你操控的生物获得「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

229883.oracleText: Until your next turn, creatures you control gain "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
229883.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，由你操控的生物获得「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

229885.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
229885.translation: 直到回合结束，每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，将其复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

230233.oracleText: Destroy all Equipment attached to that creature at end of combat.
230233.translation: 在战斗结束时消灭所有贴附在该生物上的武具。

230897.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 7 damage to target opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls.
230897.translation: CARDNAME向目标对手，由对手操控的生物或由对手操控的鹏洛客造成7点伤害。

231044.oracleText: {o4oR}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.

232018.oracleText: You cannot pay 3 life for {2, CardId}.
232018.translation: 你无法为{2, CardId}支付3点生命。

232020.oracleText: Red instant and sorcery spells you control have lifelink.
232020.translation: 由你操控的红色瞬间与法术咒语具有系命异能。

232021.oracleText: Whenever a white instant or sorcery spell causes you to gain life, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or player.
232021.translation: 每当一个白色瞬间或法术咒语让你获得生命时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

232035.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
232035.translation: 目标生物得+2+1直到回合结束。

232057.oracleText: Target player reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
232057.translation: 目标牌手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

232058.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
232058.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

232064.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may have it deal 1 damage to any target.
232064.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以让它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

232066.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Exile two cards from your graveyard: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
232066.translation: {oR}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐两张牌：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

232068.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target player or planeswalker.
232068.translation: CARDNAME对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

232069.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} for each Elf you control.

232075.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} deal 1 damage to any target?
232075.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}对任意一个目标造成1点伤害？

232155.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts their first spell each turn, counter that spell.
232155.translation: 反击每位对手在每个回合中使用的第一个咒语。

232156.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever an opponent casts their first spell each turn, counter that spell."
232156.translation: 你获得具有「每当任一对手施放每回合中他的第一个咒语时，反击该咒语」的徽记。

232225.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or land.
232225.translation: 牺牲一个生物或地，以作为施放无情决断的额外费用。

232250.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target. If a creature is dealt damage this way, it loses indestructible until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
232250.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。如果某生物以此法受到伤害，则它失去不灭异能直到回合结束。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

232256.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target.
232256.translation: 当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

232257.oracleText: Create two 1/1 red Devil creature tokens. They have "When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
232257.translation: 派出两个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物。它们具有「当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

232279.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or pay {o5}.
232279.translation: 弃一张牌或支付{o5}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

232321.oracleText: {oT}, Tap an untapped creature you control: Add one mana of any color.
232321.translation: {oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

232346.oracleText: {oT}: Add two mana of any one color.
232346.translation: {oT}：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。

232347.oracleText: Enchanted land has "{oT}: Add two mana of any one color."
232347.translation: 所结附的地具有「{oT}：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。」

232353.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. Transform CARDNAME.
232353.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。转化CARDNAME。

232354.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals damage equal to its power to any target.
232354.translation: {oT}：此生物对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

232355.oracleText: Creatures you control have haste and "{oT}: This creature deals damage equal to its power to any target."
232355.translation: 由你操控的生物具有敏捷与『{oT}：此生物对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。』

232356.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control have haste and ‘{oT}: This creature deals damage equal to its power to any target.'"
232356.translation: 你获得具有「由你操控的生物具有敏捷与『{oT}：此生物对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量』」的徽记。

232361.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's end step, that player draws a card. If the player is your opponent and has four or more cards in hand, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player.
232361.translation: 在每位牌手的结束步骤开始时，该牌手抓一张牌。若该牌手是你的对手，且其手牌为四张或更多，则CARDNAME对他造成2点伤害。

232412.oracleText: When you cast this spell, you may return target Angel or Human creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
232412.translation: 当你施放渐逝之光布鲁娜时，你可以将目标天使或人类生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

232435.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it. That player discards that card.
232435.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张瞬间或法术牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

232438.oracleText: Choose one or more — • Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it. That player discards that card. • Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. • Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
232438.translation: 选择一项或多项～ •  目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张瞬间或法术牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。 •  目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。 •  目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

232452.oracleText: Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell that targets only CARDNAME, that player copies that spell for each other creature they control that the spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those creatures.
232452.translation: 每当任一牌手施放仅以CARDNAME为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，该咒语每能以一个由他操控的其他生物为目标，该牌手便将该咒语复制一次。每个复制品都要以这些生物之一为目标，且不能重复选择。

232540.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard two cards.
232540.translation: 弃两张牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

232546.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, this emblem deals 5 damage to any target.
232546.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

232547.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a spell, this emblem deals 5 damage to any target."
232547.translation: 你获得具有「每当你施放咒语时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成5点伤害」的徽记。

232615.oracleText: Pay 50 life: CARDNAME deals 50 damage to any target.
232615.translation: 支付50点生命：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成50点伤害。

232650.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Add one mana of any color.

232720.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control as you cast this spell.
232720.translation: CARDNAME对任意数量的目标生物造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配，X为于你施放此咒语时，由你操控之生物中力量最大者的数值。

232739.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.
232739.translation: {oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

232740.oracleText: Create a colorless artifact token named Etherium Cell with "{oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."
232740.translation: 派出一个无色，名称为乙金源的衍生神器，它具有「{oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

232893.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
232893.translation: 弃一张牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

232910.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any type that a land you control could produce.
232910.translation: {oT}：加一点法术力，其类别为由你操控的地能产生之任一类别。

232957.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Add five mana in any combination of colors.
232957.translation: {o5}，{oT}：加五点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。

232964.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if there are ten or more nonland permanents on the battlefield.
232964.translation: 如果战场上有十个或更多的非地永久物，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

232999.oracleText: At the beginning of enchanted player's upkeep, that player loses 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card.
232999.translation: 在所结附的牌手之维持开始时，除非该牌手牺牲一个非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则便失去3点生命。

233140.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} for each creature you control.

233148.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a Dinosaur you control.
233148.translation: 如果此咒语以由你操控的恐龙为目标，则它便减少{o2}来施放。

233170.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. When that mana is spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.
233170.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。当该法术力用来施放瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语，且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

233182.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell of the chosen type.
233182.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放该类别的生物咒语。

233209.oracleText: When that mana is spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.
233209.translation: 当该法术力用来施放瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语，且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

233222.oracleText: Each player chooses any number of creatures they control with total power 4 or less, then sacrifices all other creatures they control.
233222.translation: 每位牌手各选择任意数量由其操控的生物，且这些生物的力量总和须等于或小于4，然后牺牲所有由他操控的其他生物。

233240.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a Merfolk card from your hand or pay {o3}.
233240.translation: 从你的手上展示一张人鱼牌或支付{o3}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

233255.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature. If you have the city's blessing, instead each opponent sacrifices half the creatures they control, rounded up.
233255.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个生物。如果你有黄金城祝福，则改为每位对手各牺牲一半数量由其操控的生物，小数点后进位。

233259.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a Pirate card from your hand or pay {o2}.
233259.translation: 从你的手上展示一张海盗牌或支付{o2}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

233280.oracleText: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of cards in their graveyard.
233280.translation: 每位对手各失去等同于其坟墓场中牌的数量之生命。

233310.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is your life total.
233310.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为你的总生命。

233401.oracleText: Target player shuffles up to three target cards from their graveyard into their library.
233401.translation: 目标牌手将至多三张目标牌从其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

233476.oracleText: Whenever this creature transforms into CARDNAME, it deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker and 2 damage to up to one target creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls.
233476.translation: 每当此生物转化为CARDNAME时，它向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害，并对至多一个目标由该牌手或该鹏洛客之操控者操控的生物造成2点伤害。

233538.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
233538.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

233545.oracleText: {oT}: Exile target land card from a graveyard. Add one mana of any color.
233545.translation: {oT}：将目标地牌从坟墓场放逐。加一点任意颜色的法术力。

233549.oracleText: Lands you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
233549.translation: 由你操控的地具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

233561.oracleText: Players can't gain life this turn. Damage can't be prevented this turn. CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker.
233561.translation: 本回合中，牌手不能获得生命。本回合中，伤害不能被防止。CARDNAME对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

233577.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target.
233577.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

233591.oracleText: Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.
233591.translation: 牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

233599.oracleText: {oT}: Choose a color. Add one mana of that color for each charge counter on CARDNAME.
233599.translation: {oT}：选择一种颜色。CARDNAME上每有一个充电指示物，便加一点该色法术力。

233620.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
233620.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

233622.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
233622.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

233625.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Add three mana of any one color.
233625.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：加三点任意颜色的单色法术力。

233683.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature, nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
233683.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非生物且非地的牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

233684.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature. • Create two 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens. They gain first strike until end of turn. • Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature, nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
233684.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害。 •  派出两个1/1白色战士衍生生物。他们获得先攻异能直到回合结束。 •  目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非生物且非地的牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

233701.oracleText: Choose two — • Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. • Target player discards a card. • Destroy target artifact. • CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
233701.translation: 选择两项～ •  将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 •  目标牌手弃一张牌。 •  消灭目标神器。 •  CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

233779.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 10 damage to any target.
233779.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成10点伤害

233782.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. If you control an Urza's Power-Plant and an Urza's Tower, add {oCoC} instead.
233782.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。如果你操控「克撒的／动力炉」和「克撒的／塔」，则改为加{oCoC}。

233784.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. If you control an Urza's Mine and an Urza's Tower, add {oCoC} instead.
233784.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。如果你操控「克撒的／矿脉」和「克撒的／塔」，则改为加{oCoC}。

233786.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. If you control an Urza's Mine and an Urza's Power-Plant, add {oCoCoC} instead.
233786.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。如果你操控「克撒的／矿脉」和「克撒的／动力炉」，则改为加{oCoCoC}。

233823.oracleText: You may exile two blue cards from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
233823.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐两张蓝色牌，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

233851.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
233851.translation: 支付X点生命，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

233935.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell.
233935.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语。

233982.oracleText: {oXoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals X damage to any target.
233982.translation: {oXoR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。

234044.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
234044.translation: 牺牲此生物：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

234045.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+1 and has "Sacrifice this creature: This creature deals 1 damage to any target."
234045.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+1且具有「牺牲此生物：此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

234143.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW} or {oU}. CARDNAME deals 1 damage to you.

234156.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature card from it. That player discards that card.
234156.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非生物牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

234161.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.
234161.translation: 牺牲一个神器或生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

234162.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to any target.
234162.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

234277.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a creature card from your hand.
234277.translation: 从你手上展示一张生物牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

234327.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.
234327.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

234385.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard X cards.
234385.translation: 弃X张牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

234407.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Add one mana of any color.
234407.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

234409.oracleText: Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {o2} for each creature they control that's attacking you.
234409.translation: 对每个生物而言，除非其操控者为其支付{o2}，否则它不能攻击你。

234430.oracleText: Each opponent can cast spells only any time they could cast a sorcery.
234430.translation: 对手只可以于其能施放法术的时机下施放咒语。

234492.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU} for each artifact you control.

234538.oracleText: When Archon of Justice dies, exile target permanent.
234538.translation: 当正义统领死去时，放逐目标永久物。

234548.oracleText: {o2oUoU}, Remove a wish counter from Djinn of Wishes: Reveal the top card of your library. You may play that card without paying its mana cost. If you don't, exile it.
234548.translation: {o2oUoU}，从祈愿巨灵上移去一个祈愿指示物：展示你的牌库顶牌。你可以使用该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未如此作，则将它放逐。

234549.oracleText: Whenever Frost Titan becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {o2}.
234549.translation: 每当冰霜泰坦成为由对手操控的咒语或异能之目标时，除非该咒语或异能的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。

234559.oracleText: {o1oB}: Return Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
234559.translation: {o1oB}：将重组骷髅妖从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

234561.oracleText: Whenever a creature dealt damage by Sengir Vampire this turn dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Sengir Vampire.
234561.translation: 每当一个本回合中曾受到辛格氏吸血鬼伤害的生物死去时，在辛格氏吸血鬼上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

234562.oracleText: Sorin Markov deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
234562.translation: 索霖马可夫对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

234563.oracleText: Sorin's Thirst deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life.
234563.translation: 索霖的饥渴对目标生物造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

234570.oracleText: When Goblin Arsonist dies, you may have it deal 1 damage to any target.
234570.translation: 当纵火鬼怪死去时，你可以让它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

234573.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Exile two cards from your graveyard: Grim Lavamancer deals 2 damage to any target.
234573.translation: {oR}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐两张牌：狰狞熔岩术士对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

234575.oracleText: Lava Axe deals 5 damage to target player or planeswalker.
234575.translation: 熔岩斧对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

234577.oracleText: Shock deals 2 damage to any target.
234577.translation: 电震对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

234588.oracleText: Adaptive Automaton is the chosen type in addition to its other types.
234588.translation: 适境机械兽额外具有该类别。

234593.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Buried Ruin: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
234593.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲深埋遗迹：将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

234602.oracleText: Fling deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target.
234602.translation: 投掷对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲生物的力量。

234620.oracleText: When a non-Angel creature you control dies, transform Archangel Avacyn at the beginning of the next upkeep.
234620.translation: 当一个由你操控且非天使的生物死去，在下一个维持开始时，转化大天使艾维欣。

234623.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Avacyn, the Purifier, it deals 3 damage to each other creature and each opponent.
234623.translation: 当此生物转化为净罪天使艾维欣时，它向每个其他生物和每位对手各造成3点伤害。

234666.oracleText: {oT}, Tap an untapped creature you control: Transform Town Gossipmonger.
234666.translation: {oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物：转化贩谣镇民。

234669.oracleText: Incited Rabble attacks each combat if able.
234669.translation: 盛怒暴民每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

234671.oracleText: {o2}: Incited Rabble gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

234684.oracleText: Whenever Bearer of Overwhelming Truths deals combat damage to a player, investigate.
234684.translation: 每当悟真客对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。

234687.oracleText: When you sacrifice a Clue, transform Daring Sleuth.
234687.translation: 当你牺牲一个线索时，转化大胆侦员。

234736.oracleText: When Persistent Nightmare deals combat damage to a player, return it to its owner's hand.
234736.translation: 当不散梦魇对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将它移回其拥有者手上。

234739.oracleText: {o1oU}, Discard two cards: Return Stitchwing Skaab from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
234739.translation: {o1oU}，弃两张牌：将缝翼尸嵌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

234744.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, remove an ice counter from Thing in the Ice. Then if it has no ice counters on it, transform it.
234744.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，从冰封巨物上移去一个寒冰指示物。然后若其上没有寒冰指示物，转化它。

234747.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Awoken Horror, return all non-Horror creatures to their owners' hands.
234747.translation: 当此生物转化为觉醒惧兽时，将所有非惊惧兽的生物移回其拥有者手上。

234754.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target Accursed Witch cost {o1} less to cast.
234754.translation: 由对手施放且以受诅巫婆为目标的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

234756.oracleText: When Accursed Witch dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target opponent.
234756.translation: 当受诅巫婆死去时，将它在你的操控下移回战场且已转化，并贴附在目标对手上。

234772.oracleText: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield. Each of those creatures is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types. Put Ever After on the bottom of its owner's library.
234772.translation: 将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。这些生物各额外具有黑色此颜色与灵俑此类别。将至死不渝置于其拥有者的牌库底。

234788.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Demon-Possessed Witch, you may destroy target creature.
234788.translation: 当此生物转化为着魔巫婆时，你可以消灭目标生物。

234800.oracleText: When Relentless Dead dies, you may pay {oB}. If you do, return it to its owner's hand.
234800.translation: 当无情亡者死去时，你可以支付{oB}。若你如此作，则将它移回其拥有者手上。

234827.oracleText: Burn from Within deals X damage to any target. If a creature is dealt damage this way, it loses indestructible until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
234827.translation: 内火自燃对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。如果某生物以此法受到伤害，则它失去不灭异能直到回合结束。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

234843.oracleText: Fiery Temper deals 3 damage to any target.
234843.translation: 火爆对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

234847.oracleText: Whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to you or a permanent you control, you may have Flameblade Angel deal 1 damage to that source's controller.
234847.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的来源对你或任一由你操控的永久物造成伤害时，你可以让焰刃天使对该来源的操控者造成1点伤害。

234849.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform Geier Reach Bandit.
234849.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若上回合没有任一咒语施放过，则转化基尔山贼。

234852.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform Vildin-Pack Alpha.
234852.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若某牌手上回合施放了两个或更多咒语，则转化维汀群首领。

234857.oracleText: Howlpack Wolf can't block unless you control another Wolf or Werewolf.
234857.translation: 除非你操控另一个狼或狼人，否则嚎群狼不能进行阻挡。

234862.oracleText: Discard a card, Sacrifice Insolent Neonate: Draw a card.
234862.translation: 弃一张牌，牺牲无礼稚儿：抓一张牌。

234866.oracleText: Lightning Axe deals 5 damage to target creature.
234866.translation: 闪电斧对目标生物造成5点伤害。

234871.oracleText: Reduce to Ashes deals 5 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
234871.translation: 烧成灰烬对目标生物造成5点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

234888.oracleText: Whenever Briarbridge Patrol deals damage to one or more creatures, investigate.
234888.translation: 每当荆桥巡卫对一个或数个生物造成伤害时，探查。

234892.translation: 当旁道讯使死去时，探查。

234904.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform Duskwatch Recruiter.
234904.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若上回合没有任一咒语施放过，则转化暮巡班招募官。

234907.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform Krallenhorde Howler.
234907.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若某牌手上回合施放了两个或更多咒语，则转化展爪嚎狼。

234928.oracleText: Werewolf of Ancient Hunger's power and toughness are each equal to the total number of cards in all players' hands.
234928.translation: 恒饥狼人的力量和防御力各等同于所有牌手手牌的总数。

234929.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform Werewolf of Ancient Hunger.
234929.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若某牌手上回合施放了两个或更多咒语，则转化恒饥狼人。

234932.oracleText: Sage of Ancient Lore's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your hand.
234932.translation: 古训智者的力量和防御力各等同于你的手牌数量。

234935.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if no spells were cast last turn, transform Sage of Ancient Lore.
234935.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若上回合没有任一咒语施放过，则转化古训智者。

234946.oracleText: {o1oG}, Sacrifice Vessel of Nascency: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
234946.translation: {o1oG}，牺牲起源皿：展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中一张神器、生物、结界、地或鹏洛客牌置于你手上。将其余牌置入你的坟墓场。

234962.oracleText: Arlinn, Embraced by the Moon deals 3 damage to any target. Transform Arlinn, Embraced by the Moon.
234962.translation: 月持雅琳对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。转化月持雅琳。

234969.oracleText: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token. Transform Arlinn Kord.
234969.translation: 派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。转化雅琳珂德。

234972.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's end step, that player draws a card. If the player is your opponent and has four or more cards in hand, Fevered Visions deals 2 damage to that player.
234972.translation: 在每位牌手的结束步骤开始时，该牌手抓一张牌。若该牌手是你的对手，且其手牌为四张或更多，则狂热视像对他造成2点伤害。

234975.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice The Gitrog Monster unless you sacrifice a land.
234975.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你牺牲一个地，否则牺牲噬人蛙怪。

234990.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Remove X charge counters from Brain in a Jar: Scry X.
234990.translation: {o3}，{oT}，从瓶中脑上移去X个充电指示物：占卜X。

235000.oracleText: When Harvest Hand dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.
235000.translation: 当镰手稻草人死去时，将它在你的操控下移回战场且已转化。

235028.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice five creatures: Transform Westvale Abbey, then untap it.
235028.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲五个生物：转化西行谷修道院，然后将它重置。

235109.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you both own and control Gisela, the Broken Blade and a creature named Bruna, the Fading Light, exile them, then meld them into Brisela, Voice of Nightmares.
235109.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若由你拥有且由你操控的永久物中同时有破碎之刃姬瑟拉与一个名称为渐逝之光布鲁娜的生物，则放逐它们，然后将它们融合为梦魇异音布瑟拉。

235129.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you both own and control Graf Rats and a creature named Midnight Scavengers, exile them, then meld them into Chittering Host.
235129.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若由你拥有且由你操控的永久物中同时有墓地鼠群与一个名称为午夜拾荒客的生物，则放逐它们，然后将它们融合为吱响寄主。

235138.oracleText: {oT}: Exchange target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
235138.translation: {oT}：将目标对手的总生命与浩劫之树的防御力交换。

235141.oracleText: Whenever Hanweir Garrison attacks, create two 1/1 red Human creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
235141.translation: 每当翰威驻防兵攻击时，派出两个1/1红色人类衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。

235144.oracleText: Whenever Hanweir, the Writhing Township attacks, create two 3/2 colorless Eldrazi Horror creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
235144.translation: 每当纠拧镇区翰威攻击时，派出两个3/2无色奥札奇／惊惧兽衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。

235147.oracleText: Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell that targets only Mirrorwing Dragon, that player copies that spell for each other creature they control that the spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those creatures.
235147.translation: 每当任一牌手施放仅以镜翼巨龙为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，该咒语每能以一个由他操控的其他生物为目标，该牌手便将该咒语复制一次。每个复制品都要以这些生物之一为目标，且不能重复选择。

235150.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodbriar.
235150.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个永久物时，在血荆灵上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

235155.oracleText: When Spell Queller leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
235155.translation: 当镇咒灵离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

235163.oracleText: Whenever Aetherstorm Roc attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on it and tap up to one target creature defending player controls.
235163.translation: 每当乙太暴洛克鸟攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物，并横置至多一个目标由防御牌手操控的生物。

235194.oracleText: Whenever Eddytrail Hawk attacks, you may pay {oE}. If you do, another target attacking creature gains flying until end of turn.
235194.translation: 每当漩迹鹰攻击时，你可以支付{oE}。若你如此作，则另一个目标进行攻击的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

235204.oracleText: Whenever Gearshift Ace crews a Vehicle, that Vehicle gains first strike until end of turn.
235204.translation: 每当变速高手搭载载具时，该载具获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

235212.oracleText: Impeccable Timing deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
235212.translation: 完美时机对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。

235240.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control an artifact, Toolcraft Exemplar gets +2/+1 until end of turn. If you control three or more artifacts, it also gains first strike until end of turn.

235280.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each artifact you control.

235364.oracleText: Embraal Bruiser has menace as long as you control an artifact.

235386.oracleText: When Lawless Broker dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
235386.translation: 当不法掮客死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

235528.translation: 每当塔侧渗透者成为横置时，它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

235687.oracleText: Whenever Veteran Motorist crews a Vehicle, that Vehicle gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
235687.translation: 每当老练车手搭载载具时，该载具得+1/+1直到回合结束。

238210.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的吸血鬼：将不亡先祖从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

238213.oracleText: Desperate Castaways can't attack unless you control an artifact.
238213.translation: 除非你操控神器，否则危急落难人不能攻击。

238226.oracleText: Whenever Fathom Fleet Captain attacks, if you control another nontoken Pirate, you may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 2/2 black Pirate creature token with menace.
238226.translation: 每当莫测舰队船长攻击时，若你操控另一个非衍生物的海盗，则你可以支付{o2}。如果你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色，具威慑异能的海盗衍生生物。

238264.oracleText: {oB}: Skittering Heartstopper gains deathtouch until end of turn.
238264.translation: {oB}：掠行断心虫获得死触异能直到回合结束。

238278.oracleText: Whenever Vicious Conquistador attacks, each opponent loses 1 life.
238278.translation: 每当恶毒征服者攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

238290.oracleText: Bonded Horncrest can't attack or block alone.
238290.translation: 坐骑角羽龙不能单独进行攻击或阻挡。

238300.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Treasure, Captain Lannery Storm gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
238300.translation: 每当你牺牲一个珍宝时，兰娜莉速腾船长得+1/+0直到回合结束。

238308.oracleText: Dual Shot deals 1 damage to each of up to two target creatures.
238308.translation: 接连射击对至多两个目标生物各造成1点伤害。

238310.oracleText: {o1oR}: Fathom Fleet Firebrand gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
238310.translation: {o1oR}：莫测舰队惹事人得+1/+0直到回合结束。

238313.oracleText: Fiery Cannonade deals 2 damage to each non-Pirate creature.
238313.translation: 激烈炮击对每个非海盗的生物各造成2点伤害。

238316.oracleText: {o7oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice Fire Shrine Keeper: It deals 3 damage to each of up to two target creatures.
238316.translation: {o7oR}，{oT}，牺牲炎祠守卫：它对至多两个目标生物各造成3点伤害。

238322.translation: 顽强蛮汉不能进行阻挡。

238324.oracleText: Headstrong Brute has menace as long as you control another Pirate.
238324.translation: 只要你操控另一个海盗，顽强蛮汉便具有威慑异能。

238326.oracleText: Lightning Strike deals 3 damage to any target.
238326.translation: 闪电炼击对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

238329.oracleText: {oT}: Lightning-Rig Crew deals 1 damage to each opponent.
238329.translation: {oT}：电擎船员向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

238331.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Pirate spell, untap Lightning-Rig Crew.
238331.translation: 每当你施放海盗咒语时，重置电擎船员。

238334.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Makeshift Munitions deals 1 damage to any target.
238334.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个神器或生物：代用军火对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

238344.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Raptor Hatchling is dealt damage, create a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token with trample.
238344.translation: 激怒～每当迅猛龙幼雏受到伤害时，派出一个3/3绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙衍生生物。

238346.oracleText: Repeating Barrage deals 3 damage to any target.
238346.translation: 持续齐射对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

238353.oracleText: Rile deals 1 damage to target creature you control. That creature gains trample until end of turn.
238353.translation: 惹怒对目标由你操控的生物造成1点伤害。该生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

238360.oracleText: Destroy target land. Star of Extinction deals 20 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
238360.translation: 消灭目标地。灭绝星落对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成20点伤害。

238369.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Sun-Crowned Hunters is dealt damage, it deals 3 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
238369.translation: 激怒～每当旭冠猎龙受到伤害时，它向目标对手或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

238376.oracleText: As long as you control another Dinosaur, Thrash of Raptors gets +2/+0 and has trample.
238376.translation: 只要你操控另一个恐龙，迅猛龙击群便得+2/+0且具有践踏异能。

238379.oracleText: Whenever Tilonalli's Knight attacks, if you control a Dinosaur, Tilonalli's Knight gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
238379.translation: 每当蒂洛纳理骑士攻击时，若你操控恐龙，则蒂洛纳理骑士得+1/+1直到回合结束。

238382.oracleText: Whenever Tilonalli's Skinshifter attacks, it becomes a copy of another target nonlegendary attacking creature until end of turn.
238382.translation: 每当蒂洛纳理变貌师攻击时，选择另一个目标进行攻击且非传奇的生物。蒂洛纳理变貌师成为该生物的复制品直到回合结束。

238387.oracleText: Unfriendly Fire deals 4 damage to any target.
238387.translation: 蓄意开火对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

238391.oracleText: Whenever you cast your third spell in a turn, you may transform Vance's Blasting Cannons.
238391.translation: 每当你施放同一回合中的第三个咒语时，你可以转化凡丝轰击炮阵。

238394.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Spitfire Bastion deals 3 damage to any target.
238394.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：喷火堡垒对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

238418.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Deeproot Champion.
238418.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在繁根林斗士上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

238421.oracleText: Whenever Deeproot Warrior becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
238421.translation: 每当繁根林战士被阻挡时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

238424.oracleText: Drover of the Mighty gets +2/+2 as long as you control a Dinosaur.
238424.translation: 只要你操控恐龙，巨兽牧者便得+2/+2。

238429.oracleText: Whenever Emperor's Vanguard deals combat damage to a player, it explores.
238429.translation: 每当皇帝的先锋对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，令它勘察。

238435.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control four or more creatures, transform Growing Rites of Itlimoc.
238435.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控四个或更多生物，转化伊替莫成长仪式。

238442.oracleText: {o7oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice Ixalli's Keeper: Target creature gets +5/+5 and gains trample until end of turn.
238442.translation: {o7oG}，{oT}，牺牲依夏理守卫：直到回合结束，目标生物得+5/+5且获得践踏异能。

238447.oracleText: {o3oG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on Jungle Delver.
238447.translation: {o3oG}：在丛林探索客上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

238450.oracleText: Kumena's Speaker gets +1/+1 as long as you control another Merfolk or an Island.
238450.translation: 只要你操控海岛或另一个人鱼，库莫那传谕便得+1/+1。

238464.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Ravenous Daggertooth is dealt damage, you gain 2 life.
238464.translation: 激怒～每当贪食匕牙龙受到伤害时，你获得2点生命。

238467.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Ripjaw Raptor is dealt damage, draw a card.
238467.translation: 激怒～每当断甲颚迅猛龙受到伤害时，抓一张牌。

238477.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Snapping Sailback is dealt damage, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
238477.translation: 激怒～每当急攫帆背龙受到伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

238479.oracleText: Spike-Tailed Ceratops can block an additional creature each combat.
238479.translation: 刺尾犄角龙每次战斗可以额外多阻挡一个生物。

238498.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores, put a +1/+1 counter on Wildgrowth Walker and you gain 3 life.
238498.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察时，在野生行客上放置一个+1/+1指示物且你获得3点生命。

238508.oracleText: Deadeye Plunderers gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
238508.translation: 你每操控一个神器，必达舰队劫掠者便得+1/+1。

238512.oracleText: Whenever Dire Fleet Captain attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each other attacking Pirate.
238512.translation: 每当焦炬舰队船长攻击时，每有一个进行攻击的其他海盗，它便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

238515.oracleText: Whenever Gishath, Sun's Avatar deals combat damage to a player, reveal that many cards from the top of your library. Put any number of Dinosaur creature cards from among them onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
238515.translation: 每当烈阳化身基撒斯对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从你的牌库顶展示等量的牌。将其中任意数量的恐龙生物牌放进战场，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

238523.oracleText: Huatli, Warrior Poet deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures. Creatures dealt damage this way can't block this turn.
238523.translation: 战士诗人华特莉对任意数量的目标生物造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。以此法受到伤害的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

238538.oracleText: Tishana, Voice of Thunder's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your hand.
238538.translation: 雷霆之声提莎娜的力量和防御力各等同于你的手牌数量。

238551.oracleText: When Conqueror's Galleon attacks, exile it at end of combat, then return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.
238551.translation: 当征服者巨帆船攻击时，在战斗结束时放逐它，然后将其在你的操控下移回战场且已转化。

238561.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may transform Dowsing Dagger.
238561.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以转化探源匕首。

238563.oracleText: {oT}: Add three mana of any one color.
238563.translation: {oT}：加三点任意颜色的单色法术力。

238567.oracleText: Elaborate Firecannon doesn't untap during your untap step.
238567.translation: 精巧火炎炮于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

238569.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Elaborate Firecannon deals 2 damage to any target.
238569.translation: {o4}，{oT}：精巧火炎炮对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

238571.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may discard a card. If you do, untap Elaborate Firecannon.
238571.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则重置精巧火炎炮。

238575.oracleText: Whenever Fell Flagship deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card.
238575.translation: 每当极恶旗舰对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手弃一张牌。

238587.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a charge counter on Primal Amulet. Then if there are four or more charge counters on it, you may remove those counters and transform it.
238587.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在原初护身符上放置一个充电指示物。然后如果其上有四个或更多充电指示物，你可以移去这些指示物并转化它。

238600.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores, put a +1/+1 counter on Shadowed Caravel.
238600.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察时，在影笼轻帆船上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

238609.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control seven or more lands, transform Thaumatic Compass.
238609.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控七个或更多地，转化奇术罗盘。

238651.oracleText: As long as you control a Jace planeswalker, Jace's Sentinel gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
238651.translation: 只要你操控杰斯鹏洛客，杰斯的哨卫便得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

238720.oracleText: When Baffling End leaves the battlefield, target opponent creates a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token with trample.
238720.translation: 当不知所终离开战场时，目标对手派出一个3/3绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙衍生生物。

238724.oracleText: Whenever Bishop of Binding attacks, target Vampire gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the power of the exiled card.
238724.translation: 每当镇魂主教攻击时，目标吸血鬼得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为所放逐之牌的力量。

238733.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to Everdawn Champion.
238733.translation: 防止将对霞辉斗士造成的所有战斗伤害。

238736.oracleText: Famished Paladin doesn't untap during your untap step.
238736.translation: 饥馑神圣武士于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

238738.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, untap Famished Paladin.
238738.translation: 每当你获得生命时，重置饥馑神圣武士。

238744.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Imperial Ceratops is dealt damage, you gain 2 life.
238744.translation: 激怒～每当帝国犄角龙受到伤害时，你获得2点生命。

238748.oracleText: Whenever Majestic Heliopterus attacks, another target Dinosaur you control gains flying until end of turn.
238748.translation: 每当庄严旭翼龙攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的恐龙获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

238751.oracleText: When Martyr of Dusk dies, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
238751.translation: 当暮影殉道者死去时，派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。

238756.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, if you lost life last turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Paladin of Atonement.
238756.translation: 在每个维持开始时，若你上回合曾失去生命，则在赎罪神圣武士上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

238758.oracleText: When Paladin of Atonement dies, you gain life equal to its toughness.
238758.translation: 当赎罪神圣武士死去时，你获得等同于其防御力的生命。

238769.oracleText: Skymarcher Aspirant has flying as long as you have the city's blessing.
238769.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，野心天行客便具有飞行异能。

238774.oracleText: Snubhorn Sentry gets +3/+0 as long as you have the city's blessing.
238774.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，哨卫短角龙便得+3/+0。

238782.oracleText: Sun-Crested Pterodon has vigilance as long as you control another Dinosaur.
238782.translation: 只要你操控另一个恐龙，旭盔翼牙龙便具有警戒异能。

238787.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Trapjaw Tyrant is dealt damage, exile target creature an opponent controls until Trapjaw Tyrant leaves the battlefield.
238787.translation: 激怒～每当残暴笼颚龙受到伤害时，放逐目标由对手操控的生物，直到残暴笼颚龙离开战场为止。

238804.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't attack with a creature this turn, sacrifice Curious Obsession.
238804.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你于本回合中未以生物攻击，则牺牲好奇求索。

238812.oracleText: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile Flood of Recollection.
238812.translation: 将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。放逐回忆满盈。

238819.oracleText: When Induced Amnesia is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return the exiled cards to their owner's hand.
238819.translation: 当引发失忆从战场进入坟墓场时，将所放逐的牌移回其拥有者手上。

238822.oracleText: Kitesail Corsair has flying as long as it's attacking.
238822.translation: 只要航筝海盗正进行攻击，它便具有飞行异能。

238836.oracleText: River Darter can't be blocked by Dinosaurs.
238836.translation: 河流穿梭客不能被恐龙阻挡。

238853.oracleText: As long as you have the city's blessing, Slippery Scoundrel has hexproof and can't be blocked.
238853.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，矫捷恶棍便具有辟邪异能且不能被阻挡。

238857.oracleText: Spire Winder gets +1/+1 as long as you have the city's blessing.
238857.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，尖顶缠蟒便得+1/+1。

238864.oracleText: Whenever Warkite Marauder attacks, target creature defending player controls loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
238864.translation: 每当战筝劫掠者攻击时，直到回合结束，目标由防御牌手操控的生物失去所有异能，且基础力量与防御力为0/1。

238874.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
238874.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

238880.oracleText: Whenever Dinosaur Hunter deals damage to a Dinosaur, destroy that creature.
238880.translation: 每当恐龙猎人对任一恐龙造成伤害时，消灭后者。

238886.oracleText: Dusk Charger gets +2/+2 as long as you have the city's blessing.
238886.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，暮影战马便得+2/+2。

238900.oracleText: Grasping Scoundrel gets +1/+0 as long as it's attacking.
238900.translation: 只要贪婪恶棍正进行攻击，它便得+1/+0。

238910.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, if you have the city's blessing, put a +1/+1 counter on Mausoleum Harpy.

238916.oracleText: You may cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard if you gained life this turn.
238916.translation: 如果你于本回合中曾获得生命，则你可以从你的坟墓场中施放立誓吸血鬼。

238925.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a Vampire card from your hand or pay {o1}.

238932.oracleText: {o1}, Discard a card: Tomb Robber explores.

238945.oracleText: Bombard deals 4 damage to target creature.

238956.translation: 如果冲锋巨牙龙将对某牌手造成战斗伤害，则改为它对该牌手造成两倍的伤害。

238967.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Fanatical Firebrand: It deals 1 damage to any target.
238967.translation: {oT}，牺牲狂热惹事鬼：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

238977.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, Form of the Dinosaur deals 15 damage to target creature an opponent controls and that creature deals damage equal to its power to you.
238977.translation: 在你的维持开始时，化身恐龙向目标由对手操控的生物造成15点伤害，且该生物对你造成等同于其力量的伤害。

238980.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Frilled Deathspitter is dealt damage, it deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
238980.translation: 激怒～每当褶领漫毒龙受到伤害时，它向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

238986.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Needletooth Raptor is dealt damage, it deals 5 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
238986.translation: 激怒～每当锐齿迅猛龙受到伤害时，它向目标由对手操控的生物造成5点伤害。

238992.oracleText: Reckless Rage deals 4 damage to target creature you don't control and 2 damage to target creature you control.
238992.translation: 难遏怒火对目标不由你操控的生物造成4点伤害，且对目标由你操控的生物造成2点伤害。

238996.oracleText: When Rekindling Phoenix dies, create a 0/1 red Elemental creature token with "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this creature and return target card named Rekindling Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn."
