238999.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't attack with a creature this turn, sacrifice See Red.
238999.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你于本回合中未以生物攻击，则牺牲勃然大怒。

239002.oracleText: Shake the Foundations deals 1 damage to each creature without flying.
239002.translation: 地表震颤对每个不具飞行异能的生物各造成1点伤害。

239006.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Silverclad Ferocidons is dealt damage, each opponent sacrifices a permanent.
239006.translation: 激怒～每当银甲暴猛龙受到伤害时，每位对手各牺牲一个永久物。

239009.oracleText: Stampeding Horncrest has haste as long as you control another Dinosaur.
239009.translation: 只要你操控另一个恐龙，狂奔角羽龙便具有敏捷异能。

239012.oracleText: Storm Fleet Swashbuckler has double strike as long as you have the city's blessing.
239012.translation: 只要你有黄金城祝福，速腾舰队仗剑客便具有连击异能。

239015.oracleText: {o2oR}: Sun-Collared Raptor gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
239015.translation: {o2oR}：旭羽迅猛龙得+3/+0直到回合结束。

239024.oracleText: Whenever Tilonalli's Summoner attacks, you may pay {oXoR}. If you do, create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens that are tapped and attacking. At the beginning of the next end step, exile those tokens unless you have the city's blessing.
239024.translation: 每当蒂洛纳理召唤师攻击时，你可以支付{oXoR}。若你如此作，则派出X个1/1红色元素衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时，除非你有黄金城祝福，否则放逐这些衍生物。

239028.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Cacophodon is dealt damage, untap target permanent.
239028.translation: 激怒～每当啸齿龙受到伤害时，重置目标永久物。

239049.oracleText: Giltgrove Stalker can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
239049.translation: 熠金林伏击客不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

239070.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Overgrown Armasaur is dealt damage, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
239070.translation: 激怒～每当蔓生悍扫龙受到伤害时，派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

239075.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Polyraptor is dealt damage, create a token that's a copy of Polyraptor.
239075.translation: 激怒～每当多态迅猛龙受到伤害时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为多态迅猛龙的复制品。

239086.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Thrashing Brontodon: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
239086.translation: {o1}，牺牲痛击霆伟龙：消灭目标神器或结界。

239088.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, reveal a Dinosaur card from your hand or pay {o1}.
239088.translation: 从你的手上展示一张恐龙牌或支付{o1}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

239091.oracleText: Wayward Swordtooth can't attack or block unless you have the city's blessing.
239091.translation: 除非你有黄金城祝福，否则刚愎剑齿龙不能进行攻击或阻挡。

239103.oracleText: Sacrifice Atzocan Seer: Return target Dinosaur card from your graveyard to your hand.
239103.translation: 牺牲阿佐坎预言师：将目标恐龙牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

239110.oracleText: Whenever Deadeye Brawler deals combat damage to a player, if you have the city's blessing, draw a card.
239110.translation: 每当必达舰队好斗者对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若你有黄金城祝福，则抓一张牌。

239115.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Elenda, the Dusk Rose.
239115.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，在暮影蔷薇依莲达上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

239119.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then if that creature has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, transform Hadana's Climb.
239119.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后如果该生物上有三个或更多+1/+1指示物，转化哈达那登高。

239124.oracleText: Put a loyalty counter on Huatli, Radiant Champion for each creature you control.
239124.translation: 你每操控一个生物，便在辉光斗士华特莉上放置一个忠诚指示物。

239130.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return it to the battlefield under your control, then return Journey to Eternity to the battlefield transformed under your control.
239130.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将它在你的操控下移回战场，然后将追寻永生在你的操控下移回战场且已转化。

239135.oracleText: {o3oBoG}: Return Jungle Creeper from your graveyard to your hand.
239135.translation: {o3oBoG}：将丛林匐行怪从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

239138.oracleText: Tap another untapped Merfolk you control: Kumena, Tyrant of Orazca can't be blocked this turn.
239138.translation: 横置另一个由你操控且未横置的人鱼：欧拉兹卡暴君库莫那本回合不能被阻挡。

239149.oracleText: Whenever you attack with at least two creatures that have first strike, double strike, vigilance, and/or haste, transform Path of Mettle.
239149.translation: 每当你以至少两个生物攻击，且其中有至少两个生物各具先攻、连击、警戒和／或敏捷之任一异能时，转化艰困路途。

239152.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}: Metzali, Tower of Triumph deals 2 damage to each opponent.
239152.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}：得胜高塔梅札理向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

239156.oracleText: {o3oWoB}: Exile target creature. Then if there are three or more cards exiled with Profane Procession, transform it.
239156.translation: {o3oWoB}：放逐目标生物。然后如果放逐区中有三张或更多以渎神行列放逐的牌，将它转化。

239163.oracleText: Whenever Raging Regisaur attacks, it deals 1 damage to any target.
239163.translation: 每当愤怒帝王龙攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

239166.oracleText: Relentless Raptor attacks or blocks each combat if able.
239166.translation: 不休迅猛龙每次战斗若能攻击或阻挡，则必须如此作。

239169.oracleText: Whenever Resplendent Griffin attacks, if you have the city's blessing, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
239169.translation: 每当华辉狮鹫攻击时，若你有黄金城祝福，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

239172.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Siegehorn Ceratops is dealt damage, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
239172.translation: 激怒～每当攻城犄角龙受到伤害时，在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

239174.oracleText: Storm Fleet Sprinter can't be blocked.
239174.translation: 速腾舰队疾步客不能被阻挡。

239178.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control five or more artifacts, transform Storm the Vault.
239178.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控五个或更多神器，转化突袭宝库。

239189.oracleText: Awakened Amalgam's power and toughness are each equal to the number of differently named lands you control.
239189.translation: 醒转拼合像的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之地中名称不同者的种数。

239198.oracleText: Whenever Captain's Hook becomes unattached from a permanent, destroy that permanent.
239198.translation: 每当船长的铁钩从永久物上卸装时，消灭该永久物。

239203.oracleText: {o2}: Golden Guardian fights another target creature you control. When Golden Guardian dies this turn, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.
239203.translation: {o2}：金辉守护者与另一个目标由你操控的生物互斗。本回合中，当金辉守护者死去时，将它在你的操控下移回战场且已转化。

239216.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Exile Silent Gravestone and all cards from all graveyards. Draw a card.
239216.translation: {o4}，{oT}：放逐肃穆墓碑和所有坟墓场。抓一张牌。

239229.oracleText: Whenever Vraska's Conquistador attacks or blocks, if you control a Vraska planeswalker, target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
239229.translation: 每当瓦丝卡的征服者攻击或阻挡时，若你操控瓦丝卡鹏洛客，则目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

239233.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker and each creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls.
239233.translation: CARDNAME向目标对手与由其操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

239234.oracleText: Angrath, Minotaur Pirate deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker and each creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls.
239234.translation: 牛头怪海盗安戈斯向目标对手或鹏洛客与由该牌手或该鹏洛客之操控者操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

239237.oracleText: Destroy all creatures target opponent controls. Angrath, Minotaur Pirate deals damage to that player equal to their total power.
239237.translation: 消灭由目标对手操控的所有生物。牛头怪海盗安戈斯对该牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于这些生物的力量总和。

239240.oracleText: Angrath's Ambusher gets +2/+0 as long as you control an Angrath planeswalker.
239240.translation: 只要你操控安戈斯鹏洛客，安戈斯的伏击客便得+2/+0。

239314.oracleText: Benalish Honor Guard gets +1/+0 for each legendary creature you control.
239314.translation: 你每操控一个传奇生物，宾纳里亚仪队兵便得+1/+0。

239331.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Daring Archaeologist.
239331.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，在大胆的考古学家上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

239336.oracleText: Sacrifice Dauntless Bodyguard: The chosen creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
239336.translation: 牺牲不屈护卫：该生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

239341.oracleText: {o4}: Exchange your life total with Evra, Halcyon Witness's power.
239341.translation: {o4}：将你的总生命与宁城见证人艾芙拉的力量交换。

239352.oracleText: Gideon's Reproach deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
239352.translation: 基定的怒责对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。

239364.oracleText: Knight of Grace gets +1/+0 as long as any player controls a black permanent.
239364.translation: 只要任一牌手操控黑色永久物，美善骑士便得+1/+0。

239374.oracleText: Whenever Pegasus Courser attacks, another target attacking creature gains flying until end of turn.
239374.translation: 每当飞天骏马攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

239377.oracleText: Discard a historic card: Sanctum Spirit gains indestructible until end of turn.
239377.translation: 弃一张史迹牌：圣所精怪获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

239387.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, Serra Disciple gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
239387.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，撒拉信徒得+1/+1直到回合结束。

239395.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Tragic Poet: Return target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
239395.translation: {oT}，牺牲悲剧诗人：将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

239439.oracleText: Target player takes an extra turn after this one. Return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Exile Karn's Temporal Sundering.
239439.translation: 目标牌手在本回合后进行额外的一个回合。将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。放逐卡恩的时间碎裂。

239458.oracleText: Relic Runner can't be blocked if you've cast a historic spell this turn.
239458.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过史迹咒语，则亡命窃宝客不能被阻挡。

239473.oracleText: Tempest Djinn gets +1/+0 for each basic Island you control.
239473.translation: 你每操控一个基本海岛，暴风雨巨灵便得+1/+0。

239478.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control Time of Ice.
239478.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。于你操控冰雪时代纪的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

239480.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control Time of Ice.
239480.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。于你操控冰雪时代纪的时段内，该生物于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

239497.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, Cabal Paladin deals 2 damage to each opponent.
239497.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，柯帮神圣武士向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

239510.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard. Dark Bargain deals 2 damage to you.
239510.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，另一张置入你的坟墓场。黯境交易对你造成2点伤害。

239513.oracleText: When Deathbloom Thallid dies, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
239513.translation: 当死华散绿菌死去时，派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

239523.oracleText: {oB}: Dread Shade gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

239526.oracleText: {o3}: Tap Drudge Sentinel. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
239526.translation: {o3}：横置苦力哨卫。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

239543.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls is dealt damage, put a +1/+1 counter on Kazarov, Sengir Pureblood.
239543.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物受到伤害时，在辛格氏血脉卡札罗夫上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

239548.oracleText: Knight of Malice gets +1/+0 as long as any player controls a white permanent.
239548.translation: 只要任一牌手操控白色永久物，恶意骑士便得+1/+0。

239554.oracleText: When Lich's Mastery leaves the battlefield, you lose the game.
239554.translation: 当巫妖掌控离开战场时，你输掉这盘游戏。

239557.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, you may pay {oB}. If you do, return Lingering Phantom from your graveyard to your hand.
239557.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，你可以支付{oB}。若你如此作，则将徘徊幻影从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

239564.oracleText: Rat Colony gets +1/+0 for each other Rat you control.
239564.translation: 你每操控一个其他的老鼠，老鼠群落便得+1/+0。

239566.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Rat Colony.
239566.translation: 名称为老鼠群落的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

239580.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Thallid Omnivore gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If a Saproling was sacrificed this way, you gain 2 life.
239580.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：杂食散绿菌得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果以此法牺牲的是腐生物，则你获得2点生命。

239589.oracleText: Whenever Urgoros, the Empty One deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card at random. If the player can't, you draw a card.
239589.translation: 每当虚无幽灵乌格洛对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手随机弃一张牌。若该牌手无法如此作，则你抓一张牌。

239601.oracleText: Put up to one target creature or planeswalker card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. Destroy up to one target creature or planeswalker. Exile Yawgmoth's Vile Offering.
239601.translation: 将至多一张目标生物或鹏洛客牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。消灭至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客。放逐约格莫夫的邪恶献祭。

239604.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if that spell was kicked, Bloodstone Goblin gets +1/+1 and gains menace until end of turn.
239604.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若该咒语已增幅，则直到回合结束，血玉髓鬼怪得+1/+1且具有威慑异能。

239607.oracleText: Champion of the Flame gets +2/+2 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it.
239607.translation: 源火斗士上每贴附一个灵气和武具，便得+2/+2。

239611.oracleText: Fiery Intervention deals 5 damage to target creature.
239611.translation: 火热干预对目标生物造成5点伤害。

239613.oracleText: Choose one — • Fiery Intervention deals 5 damage to target creature. • Destroy target artifact.
239613.translation: 选择一项～ •  火热干预对目标生物造成5点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

239617.oracleText: Fight with Fire deals 5 damage to target creature. If this spell was kicked, it deals 10 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets instead.
239617.translation: 耀火扬威对目标生物造成5点伤害。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为它对任意数量的目标造成共10点伤害，你可以任意分配。

239624.oracleText: The First Eruption deals 1 damage to each creature without flying.
239624.translation: 创世涌动对每个不具飞行异能的生物各造成1点伤害。

239627.oracleText: Sacrifice a Mountain. If you do, The First Eruption deals 3 damage to each creature.
239627.translation: 牺牲一个山脉。如果你如此作，则创世涌动对每个生物各造成3点伤害。

239642.oracleText: As long as there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, Ghitu Lavarunner gets +1/+0 and has haste.
239642.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有两张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，基图奔熔客便得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

239646.oracleText: Goblin Barrage deals 4 damage to target creature. If this spell was kicked, it also deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
239646.translation: 鬼怪齐射对目标生物造成4点伤害。如果此咒语已增幅，则它再对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

239652.translation: 由你操控的鬼怪具有敏捷异能。

239664.oracleText: Jaya's Immolating Inferno deals X damage to each of up to three targets.
239664.translation: 雅亚的燃焰炼狱对至多三个目标各造成X点伤害。

239673.oracleText: Whenever Keldon Warcaller attacks, put a lore counter on target Saga you control.
239673.translation: 当凯尔顿战呼人攻击时，在目标由你操控的传纪上放置一个学问指示物。

239676.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Orcish Vandal deals 2 damage to any target.
239676.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器：莽撞半兽人对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

239679.oracleText: Radiating Lightning deals 3 damage to target player and 1 damage to each creature that player controls.
239679.translation: 放射闪电对目标牌手造成3点伤害，且对每个由该牌手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

239682.oracleText: Rampaging Cyclops gets -2/-0 as long as two or more creatures are blocking it.
239682.translation: 只要莽闯独眼巨人被两个或更多生物阻挡，它便得-2/-0。

239693.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice a Goblin: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
239693.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲一个鬼怪：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

239694.oracleText: {o1oR}, Sacrifice a Goblin: Siege-Gang Commander deals 2 damage to any target.
239694.translation: {o1oR}，牺牲一个鬼怪：攻城指挥官对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

239699.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step, if CARDNAME wasn't kicked, sacrifice it.
239699.translation: 在结束步骤开始时，若CARDNAME未增幅，则将它牺牲。

239700.oracleText: At the beginning of the end step, if Skizzik wasn't kicked, sacrifice it.
239700.translation: 在结束步骤开始时，若嘶气客未增幅，则将它牺牲。

239703.oracleText: You may cast Squee, the Immortal from your graveyard or from exile.
239703.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场或放逐区中施放不死斯奎。

239706.oracleText: Whenever Two-Headed Giant attacks, flip two coins. If both coins come up heads, Two-Headed Giant gains double strike until end of turn. If both coins come up tails, Two-Headed Giant gains menace until end of turn.
239706.translation: 每当双头巨人攻击时，掷两枚硬币。如果两枚硬币均是正面，则双头巨人获得连击异能直到回合结束。如果两枚硬币均是反面，则双头巨人获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

239709.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, for each Aura and Equipment attached to Valduk, Keeper of the Flame, create a 3/1 red Elemental creature token with trample and haste. Exile those tokens at the beginning of the next end step.
239709.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，源火守卫瓦杜克上每贴附一个灵气和武具，便派出一个3/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的元素衍生生物。在下一结束步骤开始时，放逐这些衍生物。

239715.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, you may pay {o2oR}. If you do, return Warcry Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
239715.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，你可以支付{o2oR}。若你如此作，则将战嚎凤凰从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。

239720.oracleText: Wizard's Lightning deals 3 damage to any target.
239720.translation: 法师雷击对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

239734.oracleText: Whenever Corrosive Ooze blocks or becomes blocked by an equipped creature, destroy all Equipment attached to that creature at end of combat.
239734.translation: 每当腐蚀流浆阻挡一个佩带武具的生物，或被一个佩带武具的生物阻挡，在战斗结束时消灭所有贴附在后者生物上的武具。

239743.oracleText: When Gaea's Blessing is put into your graveyard from your library, shuffle your graveyard into your library.
239743.translation: 当盖亚的祝福从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场时，将你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

239746.oracleText: Gaea's Protector must be blocked if able.
239746.translation: 若能阻挡盖亚守护者，则必须阻挡之。

239777.oracleText: Multani, Yavimaya's Avatar gets +1/+1 for each land you control and each land card in your graveyard.
239777.translation: 你每操控一个地或你坟墓场中每有一张地牌，亚维马雅化身穆塔尼便得+1/+1。

239783.oracleText: Pierce the Sky deals 7 damage to target creature with flying.
239783.translation: 划破苍穹对目标具飞行异能的生物造成7点伤害。

239796.oracleText: Steel Leaf Champion can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
239796.translation: 钢叶斗士不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

239805.oracleText: You may have Thorn Elemental assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked.
239805.translation: 你可以让刺棘元素如同未受阻挡地分配战斗伤害。

239823.oracleText: If Darigaaz Reincarnated would die, instead exile it with three egg counters on it.
239823.translation: 如果复焚龙王达里迦将死去，则改为将它放逐且上面有三个蛋卵指示物。

239832.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if that spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on Hallar, the Firefletcher, then Hallar deals damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.
239832.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若该咒语已增幅，则在炎箭贺拉尔上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后贺拉尔向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于其上的+1/+1指示物数量。

239854.oracleText: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy can't be the target of abilities your opponents control.
239854.translation: 西赛后人莎娜不能成为由对手操控之异能的目标。

239858.oracleText: Whenever a Saproling you control dies, Slimefoot, the Stowaway deals 1 damage to each opponent and you gain 1 life.
239858.translation: 每当一个由你操控的腐生物死去时，寄舱客黏足向每位对手各造成1点伤害，且你获得1点生命。

239870.translation: 艾斯鹰滑翔翼不能进行阻挡。

239873.oracleText: {o2}: Amaranthine Wall gains indestructible until end of turn.
239873.translation: {o2}：不朽之壁获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

239880.oracleText: {o6}, {oT}, Sacrifice Bloodtallow Candle: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.
239880.translation: {o6}，{oT}，牺牲鲜血蜡烛：目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。

239887.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, attach Forebear's Blade to target creature you control.
239887.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物死去时，将先人之剑贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

239897.oracleText: Whenever Howling Golem attacks or blocks, each player draws a card.
239897.translation: 每当嚎叫魔像攻击或阻挡时，每位牌手各抓一张牌。

239908.oracleText: Whenever you cast a historic spell, you may pay {o1}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of Mishra's Self-Replicator.
239908.translation: 每当你施放史迹咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为米斯拉的自仿工人之复制品。

239917.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC} for each artifact you control named Powerstone Shard.
239917.translation: {oT}：你每操控一个名称为魔力石碎片的神器，便加{oC}。

239928.oracleText: When Sparring Construct dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
239928.translation: 当战训组构体死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

239941.oracleText: Whenever Weatherlight deals combat damage to a player, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a historic card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
239941.translation: 每当晴空号对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张史迹牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

239956.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice Memorial to Folly: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
239956.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，牺牲愚行纪念碑：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

239960.oracleText: {o4oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice Memorial to Genius: Draw two cards.

239964.oracleText: {o3oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Memorial to Glory: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
239964.translation: {o3oW}，{oT}，牺牲勇行纪念碑：派出两个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

239968.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice Memorial to Unity: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Then put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
239968.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}，牺牲齐行纪念碑：检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。然后将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

239972.oracleText: {o4oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice Memorial to War: Destroy target land.
239972.translation: {o4oR}，{oT}，牺牲战行纪念碑：消灭目标地。

239992.oracleText: As long as you control a Teferi planeswalker, Teferi's Sentinel gets +4/+0.
239992.translation: 只要你操控泰菲力鹏洛客，泰菲力的哨卫便得+4/+0。

239995.oracleText: Add {oRoR}. Chandra, Bold Pyromancer deals 2 damage to target player.
239995.translation: 加{oRoR}。舞焰勇将茜卓对目标牌手造成2点伤害。

239997.oracleText: Chandra, Bold Pyromancer deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
239997.translation: 舞焰勇将茜卓对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

239999.oracleText: Chandra, Bold Pyromancer deals 10 damage to target player and each creature and planeswalker they control.
239999.translation: 舞焰勇将茜卓对目标牌手及每个由其操控的生物与鹏洛客各造成10点伤害。

240002.oracleText: Chandra's Outburst deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
240002.translation: 茜卓的爆发对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

240006.oracleText: Whenever Karplusan Hound attacks, if you control a Chandra planeswalker, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.
240006.translation: 每当卡普路桑猎犬攻击时，若你操控茜卓鹏洛客，则此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

240014.oracleText: Whenever a white instant or sorcery spell causes you to gain life, Firesong and Sunspeaker deals 3 damage to target creature or player.

240084.oracleText: Whenever a creature or planeswalker you control dies, you may sacrifice Ajani's Last Stand. If you do, create a 4/4 white Avatar creature token with flying.
240084.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客死去时，你可以牺牲阿耶尼奋绝抗击。若你如此作，则派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的圣者衍生生物。

240108.oracleText: Whenever Herald of Faith attacks, you gain 2 life.
240108.translation: 每当信念传令使攻击时，你获得2点生命。

240125.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures, Leonin Vanguard gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you gain 1 life.
240125.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多生物，则狮族先锋得+1/+1直到回合结束，且你获得1点生命。

240128.oracleText: Whenever Leonin Warleader attacks, create two 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink that are tapped and attacking.
240128.translation: 每当领战狮族攻击时，派出两个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物，它们为横置且正进行攻击。

240139.translation: 只要新手骑士上结附了灵气或佩带了武具，它便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

240287.translation: 每当播疫惊惧兽攻击时，每位对手各失去2点生命。

240390.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if Inferno Hellion attacked or blocked this turn, its owner shuffles it into their library.
240390.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若业火地狱兽本回合曾进行攻击或阻挡，则其拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

240396.oracleText: Lightning Mare can't be blocked by blue creatures.
240396.translation: 霹雳牝马不能被蓝色生物阻挡。

240431.translation: 鬃毛野猪不能被多于一个生物阻挡。

240440.translation: 每当你施放一个以犄角德鲁伊为目标的灵气咒语时，派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

240520.translation: {o7}，{oT}，牺牲巨龙信徒：派出一个5/5红色，具飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

273087.oracleText: Whenever Truefire Captain is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target player.
273087.translation: 每当精炎队长受到伤害时，它对目标牌手造成等量的伤害。

273089.oracleText: Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn. Then target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.
273089.translation: 由你操控的生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。然后目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

273092.oracleText: If you would draw a card, instead look at the top three cards of your library, then put one into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
273092.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌，则改为检视你牌库顶的三张牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

273093.oracleText: Pay 4 life: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
273093.translation: 支付4点生命：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将之横置。

273094.oracleText: Pay 4 life: Underrealm Lich gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
273094.translation: 支付4点生命：地底境巫妖获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将之横置。

273098.oracleText: You may sacrifice another permanent. If you do, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
273098.translation: 你可以牺牲另一个永久物。若你如此作，则你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

273100.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game.
273100.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手输掉这盘游戏

273101.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game."
273101.translation: 你获得具有「每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手输掉这盘游戏」的徽记。

273102.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Wee Dragonauts gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
273102.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，袖珍龙航师得+2/+0直到回合结束。

273109.oracleText: As long as you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, CARDNAME can attack as though it didn't have defender.
273109.translation: 只要你本回合施放过瞬间或法术咒语，CARDNAME便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

273110.oracleText: As long as you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, Piston-Fist Cyclops can attack as though it didn't have defender.
273110.translation: 只要你本回合施放过瞬间或法术咒语，冲拳独眼巨人便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

273116.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. That creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
273116.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。该生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

273117.oracleText: Create three 2/2 green and white Elf Knight creature tokens with vigilance.
273117.translation: 派出三个2/2，绿白双色，具警戒异能的妖精／骑士衍生生物。

273121.oracleText: Gain control of target creature with power 2 or less.
273121.translation: 获得目标力量等于或小于2的生物之操控权。

273122.oracleText: Surveil 3, then return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
273122.translation: 刺探3，然后将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

273132.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target. Target player draws X cards.
273132.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。目标牌手抓X张牌。

273133.oracleText: Expansion // Explosion deals X damage to any target. Target player draws X cards.
273133.translation: 迸裂对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。目标牌手抓X张牌。

273136.oracleText: Explosion deals X damage to any target. Target player draws X cards.
273136.translation: 迸裂对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。目标牌手抓X张牌。

273138.oracleText: You may put two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control. Then all creatures get -4/-4 until end of turn.
273138.translation: 你可以在一个由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。然后所有生物得-4/-4直到回合结束。

273153.oracleText: Response // Resurgence deals 5 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
273153.translation: 回击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成5点伤害。

273154.oracleText: Creatures you control gain first strike and vigilance until end of turn. After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase followed by an additional main phase.
273154.translation: 由你操控的生物获得先攻与警戒异能直到回合结束。在此行动阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段，以及接于其后之一个额外的行动阶段。

273155.oracleText: Response deals 5 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
273155.translation: 回击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成5点伤害。

273158.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
273158.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+1且获得死触异能。

273159.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, creature, or enchantment.
273159.translation: 消灭目标神器，生物或结界。

273164.oracleText: {o(R/W)o(R/W)o(R/W)o(R/W)}, {oT}, Sacrifice Boros Locket: Draw two cards.

273168.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Remove X +1/+1 counters from CARDNAME: It deals X damage to any target.
273168.translation: {oX}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去X个+1/+1指示物：它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。

273169.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Remove X +1/+1 counters from Chamber Sentry: It deals X damage to any target.
273169.translation: {oX}，{oT}，从会盟堂哨卫上移去X个+1/+1指示物：它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。

273170.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
273170.translation: {oWoUoBoRoG}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

273171.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}: Return Chamber Sentry from your graveyard to your hand.
273171.translation: {oWoUoBoRoG}：将会盟堂哨卫从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

273173.oracleText: {o(U/B)o(U/B)o(U/B)o(U/B)}, {oT}, Sacrifice Dimir Locket: Draw two cards.

273178.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 for each Gate you control and has vigilance and menace.
273178.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有警戒与威慑异能，且你每操控一个门，它便得+1/+0。

273181.oracleText: {o(B/G)o(B/G)o(B/G)o(B/G)}, {oT}, Sacrifice Golgari Locket: Draw two cards.

273184.oracleText: {o(U/R)o(U/R)o(U/R)o(U/R)}, {oT}, Sacrifice Izzet Locket: Draw two cards.

273186.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
273186.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

273187.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Rampaging Monument.
273187.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，在莽闯碑像上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

273189.oracleText: {o(G/W)o(G/W)o(G/W)o(G/W)}, {oT}, Sacrifice Selesnya Locket: Draw two cards.
273189.translation: {o(G/W)o(G/W)o(G/W)o(G/W)}，{oT}，牺牲瑟雷尼亚坠饰：抓两张牌。

273191.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to target creature.
273191.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成3点伤害。

273192.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice Silent Dart: It deals 3 damage to target creature.
273192.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲无声袖剑：它对目标生物造成3点伤害。

273195.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Shuffle up to five target cards from your graveyard into your library.
273195.translation: {o2}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：将至多五张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

273196.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile Wand of Vertebrae: Shuffle up to five target cards from your graveyard into your library.
273196.translation: {o2}，{oT}，放逐椎骨魔杖：将至多五张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

273213.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
273213.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共3点伤害，你可以任意分配。

273214.oracleText: Ral, Caller of Storms deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
273214.translation: 风暴唤师拉尔对任意一个，两个，或三个目标造成共3点伤害，你可以任意分配。

273215.oracleText: Draw seven cards. CARDNAME deals 7 damage to each creature your opponents control.
273215.translation: 抓七张牌。CARDNAME向由对手操控的每个生物各造成7点伤害。

273216.oracleText: Draw seven cards. Ral, Caller of Storms deals 7 damage to each creature your opponents control.
273216.translation: 抓七张牌。风暴唤师拉尔向由对手操控的每个生物各造成7点伤害。

273220.oracleText: Precision Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
273220.translation: 精准电击对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

273222.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you control a Ral planeswalker, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each card in your hand until end of turn.
273222.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你操控拉尔鹏洛客，则你每有一张手牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

273223.oracleText: Whenever Ral's Staticaster attacks, if you control a Ral planeswalker, Ral's Staticaster gets +1/+0 for each card in your hand until end of turn.
273223.translation: 每当拉尔的静电术士攻击时，若你操控拉尔鹏洛客，则你每有一张手牌，拉尔的静电术士便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

273225.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. That creature gains menace until end of turn.
273225.translation: 在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。该生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

273226.oracleText: For each creature card in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
273226.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

273229.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if you control a Vraska planeswalker, you gain life equal to CARDNAME's power.
273229.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若你操控瓦丝卡鹏洛客，则你获得等同于CARDNAME之力量的生命。

273230.oracleText: When Attendant of Vraska dies, if you control a Vraska planeswalker, you gain life equal to Attendant of Vraska's power.
273230.translation: 当瓦丝卡的随员死去时，若你操控瓦丝卡鹏洛客，则你获得等同于瓦丝卡的随员之力量的生命。

273235.oracleText: Target a legendary permanent that is an artifact, creature, or enchantment.
273235.translation: 指定一个神器，生物或结界为目标，且该永久物须为传奇。

273236.oracleText: Target a creature with toughness 4 or greater.
273236.translation: 指定一个防御力等于或大于4的生物为目标。

273237.oracleText: Target an attacking creature without flying.
273237.translation: 指定一个进行攻击且不具飞行异能的生物为目标。

273238.oracleText: Shuffle up to four target cards from your graveyard into your library?
273238.translation: 是否要将至多四张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库？

273243.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} deal 4 damage to them?
273243.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}对他造成4点伤害？

273244.oracleText: Search for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards.
273244.translation: 搜寻至多两张基本地牌和／或门牌。

273245.oracleText: Search for a basic land card or Gate card.
273245.translation: 搜寻一张基本地牌或门牌。

273246.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card or Gate card?
273246.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或门牌？

273248.translation: 牺牲一个具守军异能的生物。

273249.oracleText: Target up to three multicolored cards.
273249.translation: 指定至多三张多色牌为目标。

273250.oracleText: Target up to one creature you control.
273250.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的生物为目标。

273251.oracleText: At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game.
273251.translation: 在该回合的结束步骤开始时，你输掉这盘游戏。

273255.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature.
273255.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害。

273258.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped creatures you control.
273258.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的生物。

273262.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control?
273262.translation: 是否要在一个由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物？

273264.oracleText: Search for a basic Forest or Plains card.
273264.translation: 搜寻一张基本树林牌或平原牌。

273266.oracleText: Search for an instant card and/or a sorcery card.
273266.translation: 搜寻一张瞬间牌和／或一张法术牌。

273268.oracleText: The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.
273268.translation: 夏浓山峰从无静寂之时。

273432.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} deal 4 damage to you?
273432.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}对你造成4点伤害？

273568.oracleText: The Cabal assured the Seven Houses that hostages receive all the food and rest they require.
273568.translation: 柯帮向七大家族担保，人质所需的食物与休息都会得到满足。

273570.oracleText: "No single arrow can pierce an entire flock."

273573.oracleText: It is ancient, immense, and irresistible.
273573.translation: 它古老而巨大，且诱惑难挡。

273576.oracleText: "Those who stood in my path now lay behind me."

273580.oracleText: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.
273580.translation: 凤凰火焰安静不张狂，悄无声息地掠过峡谷。

273584.oracleText: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.
273584.translation: 参天大树也敌不过重跺恐龙。

273586.oracleText: "Watch carefully. The gap between death and victory is thinner than your blade."
273586.translation: 「看仔细了。丧命与获胜之间的距离，比剑刃还窄。」

273589.oracleText: "Lately I've seen the biggest bounties of my career—and for the biggest names."
273589.translation: 「自从我干这行以来，从未见过最近这样如此高额的赏金～要的还全是大人物的命。」

273593.oracleText: Selesnya guildmages do not sleep so the rest of the Conclave can.
273593.translation: 瑟雷尼亚的公会法师彻夜看守，确保整个盟会都能安然入眠。

273596.oracleText:
"Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant
273596.translation:
「你们这些家伙就在拘留所里好好待着吧。保证让你们吃得到饭。但抬不起头。」
～波洛斯军士黎布斯

273599.oracleText:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant
273599.translation:
「四个城区内爆发古鲁骚乱。从块头最大的闹事者开始，一个一个都给我逮起来。」
～波洛斯军士黎布斯

273604.oracleText: The Izzet mage knew she would neither get her thermoinverter back nor have the satisfaction of exploding it herself.
273604.translation: 伊捷法师知道这样一来，不仅手中的热能反转器会一去不返，自己也无法享受亲手引爆它的快感。

273609.oracleText:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara
273609.translation:
「若要兴战，须先保证心境祥和。」
～艾玛拉

273613.oracleText: There's no greater honor than joining your chosen guild, and no greater shame than failing it.
273613.translation: 效命公会可算无上荣耀，辜负公会则是最大耻辱。

273616.oracleText: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.
273616.translation: 天使谢过了广场上喂鸟群众的好意。

273619.oracleText: "Yes, there's competition between our equenauts and the Boros skyjeks. At least they think it's a competition."
273619.translation: 「没错，波洛斯会拿我们的飞马骑士和自己的空耶克做对比。至少他们觉得还有得比。」

273621.oracleText:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia
273621.translation:
「你们不必掌握高深剑法，不用依靠厚重盾牌，也无需仰赖我的祝福。只要心存真理，就能为阳园而战。」
～欧瑞梨

273624.oracleText: Ravnica's convoluted power structure often boils down to who can muster the most swords on a given block.
273624.translation: 拉尼卡的复杂权力结构通常一句话就能说清楚：谁能在地头上集结到更多打手，谁就是老大。

273628.oracleText: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.
273628.translation: 伤员还未看到它自云中振翅现身，便已望见其所携药瓶反射的微光。

273630.oracleText: He ferried weapons, spells, exotic animals—but his most dangerous cargo was the truth.
273630.translation: 他经手送过各种货物～武器、咒语、异兽～但其中最危险的还是真相。

273634.oracleText: There are two lives: the life you live before you see a unicorn, and the life you live after.
273634.translation: 生活分两段：见过独角兽之前，和见过独角兽之后的。

273638.oracleText: Good at carrying things. Really good at knocking them down.
273638.translation: 善于驮载货物。更善于弄翻载荷。

273642.oracleText: "I've raised her since she was a pup, and she's raised me since I was a recruit."
273642.translation: 「我从她还是幼狼时就抚养她长大；她从我还是新兵起就拉扯我成长。」

273649.oracleText:
"Article 5.8.2. Ensure proper restraint of any and all arms, legs, claws, jaws, tails, tentacles, and tendrils as appropriate."
—Azorius Arrester Procedure, Appendix B
273649.translation:
「第5.8.2条 拘束时务请确保所有手、脚、爪、颚、尾、须、卷等部位均已妥善固定。」
～《俄佐立逮捕人规程》附录B

273651.oracleText: "Too many have disappeared in these dark days. I am the light that will lead them home."
273651.translation: 「在黑暗世道中，有太多的人迷途不归。我就是指引他们回家的明光。」

273653.oracleText:
"The Golgari believe they should be given what they deserve. On this we agree."
—Tajic
273653.translation:
「葛加理人觉得他们应得的就该给他们。我们同意这一说法。」
～塔疾克

273656.oracleText: Rocs' innate fearlessness makes them ideal mounts for emergency response.
273656.translation: 洛克鸟天性勇敢，无所畏惧，正是紧急出动时的理想坐骑。

273660.oracleText: "Sometimes an angel passes by and gives me a little nod, like, ‘You're a daring one!' That always makes my day."
273660.translation: 「有时身边会有天使飞过向我点头致意，好像在跟我说『你真厉害！』这就值了。」

273664.oracleText: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"
273664.translation: 「在把剑交给你之前，让我先瞧瞧你能不能躲过我这一下！」

273666.oracleText:
"The trouble with youths these days is that, in outright defiance of their elders, they refuse to be bought."
—Karlov of the Ghost Council
273666.translation:
「年轻人如今的问题在于，出于对长者的强烈叛逆，他们拒绝被收买。」
～鬼影议会的卡洛夫

273669.oracleText: In the quiet before a battle, Boros soldiers whisper prayers that steady their nerves and focus their minds.
273669.translation: 波洛斯士兵会利用战前的片刻宁静来默念祷文，用以集中精神、平复情绪。

273672.oracleText: "The Tenth has always been my home. This city is constantly embroiled in one crisis or another, but I'm determined to protect my piece."
273672.translation: 「我一直以第十区为家。虽然整座城市危机接连不断，但我决心守护自己的一切。」

273681.oracleText: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."
273681.translation: 「我专长于统一极限理论，熟知超越这一极限的各类方法。」

273684.oracleText: All those who trade in questions must answer to the Dimir.
273684.translation: 所有惹出是非的人都要被底密尔查个究竟。

273691.oracleText: First, dispose of the evidence. Then dispose of your knowledge of its disposal.
273691.translation: 首先，将证据处理干净。然后，再将处理证据这事的记忆处理干净。

273694.oracleText: The letters arrive, all sealed and read.
273694.translation: 信件已平安送达，虽封缄安然无恙，但内容均尽收眼底。

273698.oracleText: "Laws apply only to those who lack the vision to see past them."
273698.translation: 「律法只能约束那些无法看穿它的人。」

273705.oracleText: Beneath Ravnica's streets runs a layer of tunnels, then caverns and waterways, then terrors and nightmares.
273705.translation: 拉尼卡街道下方有一层隧道，其下方是洞穴与水道，更下方便是惊惧兽与梦魇。

273708.oracleText:
"Who are the agents of the Dimir? No one and everyone."
—Lazav
273708.translation:
「谁是底密尔的密探？谁都不是，谁也都是。」
～拉札夫

273713.oracleText: In a climate of suspicion, Isperia gathered the guilds to propose a radical idea: cooperation.
273713.translation: 在重重疑云笼罩之下，伊佩利召集各公会面议，大胆提出建言：合作。

273718.oracleText:
"Most compete for insects at street level. Some dwell near Izzet laboratories and ride the thermal updrafts."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer
273718.translation:
「多数只在地上捕食昆虫。有些则会栖息在伊捷实验室附近，借着热气流高升。」
～析米克生物工程师约洛夫

273726.oracleText: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.
273726.translation: 谣言如鸦群飞舞城中，看似不经意间就停在市民肩头。

273729.oracleText: A composer wrote a symphony based on the drakes screeching outside her window. Reviews were mixed—except among the drakes.
273729.translation: 某位作曲家就着自家窗外的龙兽啸鸣谱写了一支交响曲。听众褒贬不一～但龙兽的回应却出奇一致。

273732.oracleText:
"What bait do you cast to catch a dream?"
—Ravnican riddle
273732.translation:
「捕梦该投什么饵？」
～拉尼卡谜语

273737.oracleText:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security
273737.translation:
「我们这是在四十楼，只有一扇窗户，连阳台都没有。谁都不可能进得来。」
～欧佐夫警卫长米诺斯

273741.oracleText: She memorized every arcane text in the Ismeri Library by the time she was sixteen. Now she quizzes sphinxes in her spare time.
273741.translation: 她在十六岁时就已将依梅里图书馆内每条秘法咒文倒背如流。如今她在闲暇之余以给史芬斯出题为乐。

273744.oracleText: "My doors are called trespassing, my signatures, forgeries. They don't respect my talents, and I don't respect their labels."
273744.translation: 「我造门通行无阻，他们说我擅闯空门；我签名随心所欲，他们说我伪造印鉴。既然他们看不起我的才能，我也不理会他们对我的看法。」

273750.oracleText: Genius is finding the edge of what's possible, then jumping over it.
273750.translation: 所谓天才之举，便是发现可能的边界，然后一跃而过。

273752.oracleText:
"How thoughtful of the Legion to train its soldiers to fit our spell's specifications."
—Nefara, Dimir agent
273752.translation:
「教团真为我们着想，士兵的训练方式根本就契合我们咒语特性。」
～底密尔密探涅法拉

273755.oracleText:
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds."
—Lazav
273755.translation:
「我们收到情报，某些公会已经受到了外来入侵者的影响。直到我们调查清楚之前，务必挡下一切恶意行为。」
～拉札夫

273763.oracleText: The first thing the mist chills is the mind. Victims never cry out or even murmur in surprise.
273763.translation: 雾气首先麻痹心智。受害者从没有机会大声叫喊，甚至都不会发出惊呼。

273766.oracleText: "There's no need to sound the alarm. You are minding your post admirably. I am authorized. All is well."
273766.translation: 「不必拉响警报。你正恪尽职守。我已获准通行。一切平安无事。」

273769.oracleText: Fog haunts the streets, rendering the familiar as otherworldly, changing neighbors into shadows, and muffling cries for help.
273769.translation: 浓雾弥漫大街小巷，置街景如异境，化邻里作魅影，掩呼救于其中。

273773.oracleText:
"What wishes do they grant? Mostly pinching-related ones."
—Omik, superintendent of waterworks
273773.translation:
「它们能满足什么愿望？应该都是跟夹人有关的吧。」
～水务主管欧米克

273776.oracleText: The Dimir rarely make statements, but when they do, the message is clear.
273776.translation: 底密尔很少公开发声，可一旦如此，他们的信息便再明确不过。

273780.oracleText:
"Bats are welcome to eat thousands of my pets. I have multitudes more that will ultimately eat the bats."
—Izoni
273780.translation:
「蝙蝠大可畅食我那数以千计的宠物。我拥有的数量之大，终将吃掉蝙蝠。」
～依佐妮

273788.oracleText:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni
273788.translation:
「连老鼠都会囤积财宝。你的珍贵宝贝又有什么特别呢？」
～依佐妮

273790.oracleText: No guilds—that is her rule. The House vampires unnerve her. The Combine would dissect her, the Legion burn her, the Conclave "cure" her. The shadows are all the family she needs.
273790.translation: 拒不参加公会～这便是她的处世原则。底密尔吸血鬼让她心神不宁，析米克想要拿她来活体研究，波洛斯誓要将她处以火刑，瑟雷尼亚愿能为她「治愈」一切。而阴影是她所需的唯一依靠。

273797.oracleText: All things considered, his first day on patrol could have gone better.
273797.translation: 从各方面的情况来看，他的第一天巡逻本可以更顺利些。

273802.oracleText: The sound of every twisted secret tempts you to hear another.
273802.translation: 每一则扭曲秘密的声音都诱惑着你再听一则。

273805.oracleText: The party of Rakdos revelers cackled and capered as the thing approached. It hissed, and they jabbed their torches at it, giggling when it recoiled. Then, one by one, the torches went out—and the screaming began.
273805.translation: 拉铎司狂欢人眼见怪物靠近，愈发情绪高涨、欢声雷动。见到此物仅会嘶嘶作响，他们便争先恐后用手中火把戳刺，以其蜷缩躲避之姿为乐。突然之间，火把接连熄灭～而后尖叫四起。

273807.oracleText:
"Variety is also the spice of death."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman
273807.translation:
「物种多样也为死亡增趣。」
～葛加理祭师习拉雅

273810.oracleText: "They don't even feel the cut. I'm ordering a drink in a nearby tavern before anyone notices something's wrong."
273810.translation: 「对方一点都不会觉得痛。等到有人发现出事的时候，我已经在附近酒馆喝上一杯了。」

273813.oracleText: The hive has a long memory. It knows how every member ever died, and to whom it owes the grudge.
273813.translation: 母巢的记性极佳。它清楚每一位成员的死因，以及要寻仇的对象。

273818.oracleText:
"I prefer the big and looming to the small and skittering."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman
273818.translation:
「相比渺小掠行的生物，我更喜欢大到遮天的那种。」
～葛加理祭师习拉雅

273824.oracleText: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.
273824.translation: 拉尼卡最安全的堡垒通常既不安全也保不住人。

273827.oracleText: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.
273827.translation: 无人欢迎他的到来，但人人都得奉上贡品。

273834.oracleText: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.
273834.translation: 瓯坎的杀手会从他们之前的杀害对象身上提炼毒素。

273837.oracleText: Dimir assassins have the precision to slay a single memory.
273837.translation: 底密尔杀手能精确地将单段记忆斩草除根。

273843.oracleText: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."
273843.translation: 「我的能力可谓慷慨。我让从我手下幸存的人对生命心怀感恩。」

273849.oracleText: Only the patrol's armor was found, so tainted with the acrid smell of sudden death that it could never be worn again.
273849.translation: 整支巡逻队尸骨无存，就连仅剩的盔甲也被猝死产生的恶臭熏得再也无法穿戴。

273852.oracleText: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."
273852.translation: 「我已亲眼见过拉尼卡的命运。相信我，我这是为你好。」

273855.oracleText: The Golgari adorn themselves with the exoskeletons of iridescent insects. It's only fair the insects do likewise.
273855.translation: 葛加理人喜欢用多彩昆虫的外骨骼打扮自己。昆虫也只好仿效人类而为之。

273859.oracleText: In its territory, living is an affront.
273859.translation: 在它的地盘上，活着就是令它难堪。

273863.oracleText:
"I sang songs of sorrow for my lost love. Imagine my horror when, one night, they were answered."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate
273863.translation:
「我经常会用悲伤的歌曲来缅怀逝去的爱人。有一天晚上这曲突然有回声应和，不难想像我当时会有多惊恐。」
～欧佐夫神职者米拉娜

273866.oracleText:
"The alliances were already frayed. All we do is find the loose threads and pluck."
—Lazav
273866.translation:
「同盟早已松动。我们只是找到线头，然后一抽而已。」
～拉札夫

273871.oracleText: "Sure, I hear things. I hear plenty. But how am I to talk with this parched throat?"
273871.translation: 「没错，我消息灵通，情报繁多。但我这副干涩的嗓子又能说什么呢？」

273880.oracleText: "Don't stop till your horns come out their back."
273880.translation: 「在牛角戳穿他们之前不要停。」

273882.oracleText: "Not my first edition of The Advokist and the Urchin!"
273882.translation: 「放过我那本初版《倡议人和恼人鬼》！」

273886.oracleText: In the wake of Niv-Mizzet's disappearance, Ral found himself leading the guild. He had dreamed of this day, but couldn't help feeling like a pawn in someone else's game.
273886.translation: 尼米捷失踪之后，拉尔发现自己可以领导公会。他曾梦想过这一天的到来，却又不禁感觉自己像是旁人局中的棋子。

273889.oracleText: "This sort of innovation occurs when you set out to improve an electric tea kettle and misplace a decimal."
273889.translation: 「如果你准备改进电茶壶，但算错了一位小数点，就会出现这类创新。」

273895.oracleText:
"It's both an ingress-denial mechanism and an attractive hallway light!"
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer
273895.translation:
「这东西既是个不错的门禁装置，也是盏漂亮的廊灯！」
～伊捷电流术士达西维

273900.oracleText:
"The League accepts no responsibility for former members and the damage they may cause."
—Maree, Izzet chamberlain
273900.translation:
「因伊捷联盟原成员之私人行为导致的一切后果，本联盟概不负责。」
～伊捷侍从玛蕾

273904.oracleText: Turns out coffee is the weird aunt of invention.
273904.translation: 其实发明之母还有咖啡。

273911.oracleText: "I spent some time in the Legion, but I'm done taking orders all day."
273911.translation: 「我在教团待了一段时间，但我受够了整天听人指挥。」

273913.oracleText: Rain runoff in the Smelting District is known to spontaneously burst into flame.
273913.translation: 矿石提炼区的雨后积水常会自燃。

273918.oracleText: The Boros banner stands tall even if its bearer doesn't.
273918.translation: 即使掌旗身材矮小，波洛斯旗帜仍能高高屹立。

273927.oracleText:
"He's got more finesse than most goblins. He smashes windows with his fist rather than his forehead."
—Arrester Polgar
273927.translation:
「他比多数鬼怪更有手段。他会用拳头来砸窗，而不是用脑袋。」
～逮捕人波嘉

273933.oracleText:
"They play by spitting fire at each other. Don't be offended if one gives you a love-scorch."
—Esfir, Rakdos dragon wrangler
273933.translation:
「它们平时就会相互吐火嬉闹。如果哪天有条龙向你喷出爱的火焰，可别觉得它恨你。」
～拉铎司训龙师艾丝菲

273937.oracleText:
"The Izzet are blamed for every little disaster, which is unfair because we only cause most of them."
—Mizzix of the Izmagnus
273937.translation:
「他们每场小灾难都要拿我们伊捷是问，这太不公平了，又不是全部都是我们造成的。」
～伊捷首法师米捷兹

273941.oracleText:
"Commander, we caught the Dimir spy and took her ashes into custody."
—Kramm, Wojek security officer
273941.translation:
「指挥官，我们逮到了底密尔间谍，她的灰烬已经收监。」
～沃耶克警卫克拉姆

273947.oracleText:
"They tell us the wilds are ours, then they brick them over. They can lie to our faces but not to our fists."
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage
273947.translation:
「他们曾说荒野都归我们，然后就用砖块把野地都盖住。他们的谎言也许骗得过我们的耳朵，但挡不住我们的铁拳。」
～古鲁公会法师顾拉

273952.oracleText: "Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."
273952.translation: 「根本就没人听我抱怨！就算我用棒子逼着，他们都不听！」

273959.oracleText: Some Gruul druids believe that boars are spawn of the great Ilharg, the mighty Raze-Boar who will one day rise and level the city.
273959.translation: 某些古鲁的德鲁伊相信，野猪都是伟大的衣哈格留下的后代，并且这位强大的蛮野猪神总有一天会崛起并夷平整座城市。

273968.translation:
「别逮捕他，召他入伍！」
～指挥官叶程

273971.oracleText:
"They said obey and you'll be happy. They said you'll be safe. But we're not safe. We're not happy. And we will not obey."
—Domri Rade
273971.translation:
「他们说，听他们的就会好过。他们还说，听他们的就会安全。但我们一点都不安全。我们一点都不好过。我们再也不听他们的了。」
～多密雷德

273973.oracleText: "I packed three more electroconduits into each test wand. You'll experience a brief tingling sensation."
273973.translation: 「我在测试用魔杖里又多塞了三个电流导管。你可能会觉得有些许刺痛。」

273975.oracleText: "Light a torch and deliver this letter" were his instructions, which he unfortunately reversed.
273975.translation: 原本给的指示是「点火，送信」，但他弄反了。

273979.oracleText: "By all means, take another step toward the captain."
273979.translation: 「有本事你就试试看能不能再靠近队长一步。」

273982.oracleText: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.
273982.translation: 问题不在于巨犀兽的热情，在于拉尼卡缺少护栏。

273987.oracleText: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."
273987.translation: 「对我来说，再小的老鼠口中话语之声，都比整条锡街的喧闹狂欢来得响亮。」

273990.oracleText:
"I am the very soul of battle, but even I would never advise open war with the Conclave."
—Aurelia
273990.translation:
「我是战斗之魂，但就连我也不建议对盟会开战。」
～欧瑞梨

273993.oracleText:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide
273993.translation:
「两点之间最近的路线并不总是最安全的。」
～城区向导塔米娜

273995.oracleText:
"The Dimir may look all they want. We never grow tired of swatting their bugs."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant
273995.translation:
「底密尔可以尽情刺探。我们会不厌其烦地拍扁他们的臭虫。」
～瑟雷尼亚法皇荷路杰

273997.oracleText: "This is Mileva, in the Tenth. We've got an elf in the plaza with a chip on her shoulder. Actually, it's more of a morningstar."
273997.translation: 「我是第十区的米勒娃。我们在广场上发现了一个刺头妖精。确切地说，扛着一把刺头锤。」

274001.oracleText: "The route is direct but challenging. Incidentally, how are you with heights?"
274001.translation: 「路线可直达但较具挑战。顺便问一句，你恐高吗？」

274005.oracleText: Cats place their gifts with care, so that a bare foot will step on them in the middle of the night.
274005.translation: 猫会精心摆放自己的礼物，好让打赤脚的人在深夜踩个正着。

274008.oracleText: What the Golgari can't claim through patient undercity expansion, they seize in brazen topside sorties.
274008.translation: 凡是葛加理无法藉助缓慢扩张地底城以获取之物，他们便会靠野蛮地面侵攻来夺。

274012.oracleText: Some rooftop gardens attract bees; others capture dragons.
274012.translation: 有的屋顶花园吸引蜜蜂；而有的则能困住巨龙。

274018.oracleText: Nearly invisible strands of web reach far beyond its lair to alert it of the approach of prey.
274018.translation: 一条条肉眼难见的蛛丝延伸至远离巢穴之处，提醒它有猎物靠近。

274020.oracleText:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

274025.oracleText:
Feed on food, you eventually rot. Feed on rot, you live forever.
—Kraul saying
274025.translation:
以粮为食，终成腐尸。以腐为食，必得永生。
～刻洛谚语

274032.oracleText:
"There is nothing stronger than many hearts united for a single cause."
—Emmara

274041.oracleText: Selesnya grows its ranks in more ways than one.
274041.translation: 瑟雷尼亚扩张军伍的方式不止一种。

274049.oracleText: Nature's way of saying "take the long way home."
274049.translation: 大自然版本的「长路归家」。

274051.oracleText:
"Light up the dark to find your way, and the dark may seek you out."
—Zalin the Gutter Bard
274051.translation:
「点亮黑暗把路寻，黑暗便会要你命。」
～贫窟吟游诗人翟林

274053.oracleText: Suddenly, all the haggling didn't seem so important.
274053.translation: 突然间，什么买卖都不重要了。

274058.oracleText: Ravnica's diversity produces blossoms of opinion in a rich soil of perspectives.
274058.translation: 拉尼卡的多样理念浇溉，加之广阔视野的沃土栽培，方有如今百花齐放的社会盛景。

274065.oracleText: Golgari crops bloom in strange soils, touched only by long-traveled light.
274065.translation: 葛加理的作物能在奇异土壤上生长，仅靠远距阳光滋养。

274069.oracleText:
"Be like the grazers of the Saruli. Keep your herd close, and stay alert for encroaching danger."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad
274069.translation:
「效法撒路里的草食动物吧。紧密集结成群，并时刻提防危险来袭。」
～瑟雷尼亚树灵拉黎亚

274071.oracleText: Once part of a wealthy merchant's private zoo, the herd roams feral throughout the Tenth, where it will remain until the guilds can agree to relocate, cull, or befriend it.
274071.translation: 这群冠角牛曾经属于某位富商的私人动物园，如今它们在第十区野放漫游，直到各公会同意重新安置、汰劣留良或细心安顿之。

274073.oracleText: Dimir assassinations are choreographed like dance routines. Each challenge is anticipated and countered with graceful ease.
274073.translation: 底密尔的刺杀如同精心设计的舞蹈动作。完美预计到每一项挑战，并从容应对。

274077.oracleText: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.
274077.translation: 俄佐立的权力真空。瓦丝卡的留念信物。

274089.oracleText: "Send your champion. I could use a light workout."
274089.translation: 「派你们的冠军过来。我正好要热热身。」

274093.oracleText:
"Within the song of Mat'Selesnya, one becomes all."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant
274093.translation:
「在太瑟雷尼亚的歌声之中，独木成林。」
～瑟雷尼亚法皇荷路杰

274097.oracleText: "Please accept this offering. I sincerely hope to leave my mace at my side."
274097.translation: 「请接受这份馈赠。我衷心希望不用举起手边的战锤。」

274101.oracleText: "It is not your time. The Legion still needs your blade."
274101.translation: 「还没到你就义的时候。教团依旧需要你执剑战斗。」

274110.oracleText: "Just as leaves fall and the tree blooms again, one day I will fall and the Conclave will endure."
274110.translation: 「叶落枝复繁，就算我哪天倒下，盟会亦将长存。」

274122.oracleText: "I've seen your house, and you've been a lovely, if unwitting, host. But at last it's time for farewells."
274122.translation: 「敝人曾在贵府盘桓数日。阁下虽乏细致，但款待还算周到。叨扰多时，这生就此别过。」

274127.oracleText:
"Commander, what's the signal to attack?"
"You'll know."
274127.translation:
「指挥官，进攻的信号是什么？」
「到时候就知道了。」

274133.oracleText: Just assume every conversation is on record.
274133.translation: 你当每句话都有据可查就好。

274136.oracleText:
"People would sooner savor sweet lies than chew plain truths."
—Lazav
274136.translation:
「相比干嚼乏味的真相，人们更愿意品尝甜蜜的谎言。」
～拉札夫

274142.oracleText: "Whatever hatred destroys, a single act of trust can revive."
274142.translation: 「无论仇恨摧毁何物，只消一丝信任便能重生。」

274146.oracleText:
"The Erstwhile—rotten of body and outmoded in dress, but unfailing in loyalty."
—Vraska
274146.translation:
「故军～内有腐烂肉身，外有过时着装，可是忠心不二。」
～瓦丝卡

274161.oracleText: In the Legion, no flagpole is merely decorative, and every ceremonial sword bears an edge.
274161.translation: 教团之内，装饰旗杆非摆设，仪式用剑尽开刃。

274165.oracleText: From death she grows living grandeur.
274165.translation: 她能从死亡中催化灿烂生机。

274170.oracleText:
"Result 752: Rapid mass redistribution.
"Result 753: Calamitous reverse synthesis.
"Result 754: Acute disarrayment."
—Izzet research notes
274170.translation:
「结果752：物质快速重新分配。
「结果753：逆向合成造成灾难性后果。
「结果754：严重紊乱。」
～伊捷研究纪录

274172.oracleText: "We gather the past from surface dwellers and sell it right back to them."
274172.translation: 「我们收集地上居民的过往，再卖回给他们。」

274177.oracleText: Giants know a solid hit is one part strength, four parts leverage.
274177.translation: 巨人都知道重击靠的是一分力量和四分巧劲。

274182.oracleText:
"It's like blowing up an arcane library in a thermobaric explosion. But in a good way."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker
274182.translation:
「就像是在热压爆炸中把奥术图书馆炸飞了一样。不过结果是好的那种。」
～伊捷觅爆师波力安东

274186.oracleText: "Countermagic is a simple process of breaking matter into its elementary particles."
274186.translation: 「反击魔法是将物质碎散成基本粒子的简单过程。」

274194.oracleText: "We are the shield that never breaks, the bough that never burns, the song that can never be silenced."
274194.translation: 「我们是敲不碎的盾牌，是点不着的粗枝，是掩不住的歌声。」

274197.oracleText:
"Those who show no mercy to the weak deserve no mercy from the strong."
—Firemane Kavrova
274197.translation:
「不愿对弱者手下留情的人，也不配获得强者的宽恕。」
～炎鬃卡洛娃

274223.oracleText: "Our forces number more than the leaves of Vitu-Ghazi. Do not provoke us."
274223.translation: 「我军人数比维图加基的树叶还多。别惹我们。」

274235.oracleText:
"Three daggers left in an angel's back, three enforcers with memory loss, three keys stolen from my own belt—and you talk of peace?"
—Tajic, to Aurelia
274235.translation:
「天使的背上插着三把匕首，三名执法者的记忆缺漏，本人的腰带上有三把钥匙被偷～这时跟我谈和平？」
～塔疾克质问欧瑞梨

274242.oracleText: City air is a constant drizzle of private thoughts.
274242.translation: 城市的空气是不断飘落的个人思绪。

274247.oracleText: "The dagger is just the distraction. I carry the real killer in a vial at my side."
274247.translation: 「匕首只是幌子而已。我随身携带的瓶子才是真正的杀人利器。」

274257.oracleText:
"The dead gain new purpose here. What is strange in the eyes of other guilds is harmonious in ours."
—Devesh, Golgari shaman
274257.translation:
「亡者在此地收获了全新的目标。其他公会眼中的怪异，即是我们眼中的和谐。」
～葛加理祭师得维许

274262.oracleText: "I long for peaceful times, when I may tend to my garden instead of our borders."
274262.translation: 「我期盼重回能够照看花园而不是看管边境的和平年代。」

274264.oracleText: Squadrons of skyknights are available for deployment around the clock, capable of reaching any district in the city within minutes.
274264.translation: 空骑士中队随时可供调遣，能在几分钟内抵达城市内任何地区。

274266.oracleText: He heard stars and saw thunder.

274276.oracleText:
"Now do you understand what we meant when we said disperse?"
—Eksari, Boros patrol leader
274276.translation:
「现在都明白听见『散开』时该怎么作了吗？」
～波洛斯巡队首领艾萨莉

274280.oracleText: A swiftblade is an artist, each fiery trail of their blades a fleeting masterpiece traced on the air.
274280.translation: 快剑手挥洒如艺师，每道迅猛的剑光都会在空中留下一副转瞬即逝的杰作。

274289.oracleText: "It's truly the highest honor, isn't it? To be remembered? Pity for you."
274289.translation: 「英勇事迹被人永记心间？这确实算是最高荣誉了吧？真可惜。」

274291.oracleText: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.
274291.translation: 拉尔的风暴在玄秘探测之时劈啪作响：鹏洛客正在潜入拉尼卡。

274301.translation:
「现在该轮到你们躲躲藏藏了。」
～瓦丝卡

274310.oracleText: A well-chosen word can restore a mind or snap its tethers.
274310.translation: 说对词，或能将心智恢复，或能让其崩溃。

274319.oracleText:
"Something's causing electrospheric disruption in the blazekite's spire-vanes. Find the cause, and tell them to keep it up!"
—Juzba, Izzet tinker
274319.translation:
「有东西导致火焰风筝螺旋叶上的电子层受到干扰。找出原因，让他们再加把劲！」
～伊捷修补匠裘巴

274325.oracleText:
"Hold on to your ideals. They'll be tested more than your armor or the edge of your blade."
—Tajic
274325.translation:
「请始终坚持心中理念。行伍一生当中，它要比身上盔甲或手中利剑经受更多考验。」
～塔疾克

274329.oracleText: Its hyperpneumatics can punch through a wall and the spy on the other side.
274329.translation: 它的超冲拳能砸穿墙壁，以及在墙壁另一头的间谍。

274333.oracleText: "The reign of the Swarm begins. Let us rise now and dress ourselves in vengeance."
274333.translation: 「群落的统治开始了。让我们披上复仇的外衣，崛起吧。」

274335.oracleText: "Selesnya's soil is sacred, and you're about to meet it with your face."
274335.translation: 「瑟雷尼亚的土地神圣不可侵犯，而你马上就会用脸来见识一下。」

274337.oracleText: He has a job to finish, and it's you.
274337.translation: 他还有一件工作要收尾～就是你。

274393.oracleText:
"We pass these along to our fellow soldiers to recognize deeds of valor. It won't stay with you for long."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage
274393.translation:
「坠饰会在同袍将士之间相传，当作英勇行为的褒奖。你不会一直留着它。」
～波洛斯公会法师阿劳涅

274404.oracleText: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.
274404.translation: 按照公会传统，凡是多彩混色灯光照亮的鹅卵石地面，都可当作中立地带。

274407.oracleText:
"Wear this, and take your place among the shadows—wise, lethal, and unseen."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster
274407.translation:
「戴上此物，与阴影同行～机敏、致命、隐密。」
～底密尔间谍大师依蕾娅

274411.oracleText: Each night it visits a different guildgate around the city, digging its talons into fresh stone.
274411.translation: 它每晚都会前往城内不同的公会门，在此前从未停留过的石块上歇脚。

274417.oracleText:
"Wear it at all times. It will guide our reanimators to your corpse."
—Mazirek, kraul death priest
274417.translation:
「请随时将此物戴在身上。它能够指引我们的复活师找到你的尸体。」
～刻洛死亡僧侣马兹瑞

274421.oracleText:
"Remember to discharge your locket every seven hours. Unless you prefer the spontaneous aether overload, of course."
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer
274421.translation:
「切记每七小时给你的坠饰放电一次。当然如果你喜欢它自发引起的乙太过载则另当别论。」
～伊捷电流术士达西维

274425.oracleText: "Be advised: suspect is nine stories tall, marble hair, answers to Saint Gusztav."
274425.translation: 「请周知：疑犯有九层楼高，大理石头发，跟圣古塔夫一模一样。」

274435.oracleText: "These terms are acceptable to House Dimir. Shall we shake on it?"
274435.translation: 「底密尔会堂接受你们的条件。握个手吧？」

274439.oracleText: Made by the mad for the work of the wicked.
274439.translation: 由疯子制成，为邪恶所用。

274444.oracleText:
"The more trust breaks down, the more we must throw open the front gates."
—Aurelia
274444.translation:
「彼此之间信任越是薄弱，我们就越要敞开大门。」
～欧瑞梨

274446.oracleText:
"It is our duty to protect all those in need. But the other guilds have never shown themselves worthy of that protection."
—Tajic
274446.translation:
「虽说为需要帮助的人提供保护是我们的职责，但其他公会从来就不值得我们去保护。」
～塔疾克

274448.oracleText:
"Every guild dreads infiltration. I should know—I've been a member of all of them."
—Lazav
274448.translation:
「每一个公会都憎恨被渗透。这点我清楚～我每一个公会都待过。」
～拉札夫

274450.oracleText:
"You've found this place only because you were summoned. Pray you're worthy of the invitation."
—Etrata
274450.translation:
「你能发现这里纯粹是因为你被召来此地。希望你配得上这份邀请。」
～艾庄塔

274452.oracleText: The Chamber of the Guildpact stands as a reminder that even the bitterest struggles can end in cooperation.
274452.translation: 十会盟堂的存在时刻提醒着人们，即便是最艰苦的斗争也能以合作收场。

274456.oracleText:
"Shut the gates. In the Underrealm we will outlast the coming doom."
—Vraska
274456.translation:
「把大门关上。在地底境里，我们能安度来袭的末日。」
～瓦丝卡

274458.oracleText:
"Jarad was a friend to the Devkarin. Now we slink through neglected tunnels, befriending those who crawl them."
—Izoni
274458.translation:
「贾雷曾是戴卡林一族的朋友。如今我们在遭弃的隧道中潜逃，与爬行其中的家伙们作伴。」
～依佐妮

274462.oracleText: Every laboratory buzzes with new experiments, each a piece of Ral's ambitious project.
274462.translation: 每一间实验室都忙着全新的实验，每一项实验都是拉尔野心计划的拼图。

274464.oracleText:
"Yesterday I didn't recognize my own guild. Today I see why. And for tomorrow I must be prepared."
—Niv-Mizzet
274464.translation:
「遥想昨日，公会翻天变化让我不敢相认。时至今日，我方才洞悉其中缘由。为了明日，我必须做好准备。」
～尼米捷

274467.oracleText: Cradle of the Golgari's new kingdom. Grave of those who wronged its queen.
274467.translation: 葛加理新王朝的摇篮。迫害其女王者的坟墓。

274472.oracleText:
"You will not be trained here. You will be forged."
—Commander Yaszen
274472.translation:
「在此处你不仅将受到严格训练，更将经受千锤百炼。」
～指挥官叶程

274475.oracleText:
"Everyone who crosses that threshold is our most cherished friend. Everyone who crosses it again is our bitterest enemy."
—Trostani
274475.translation:
「踏入那门槛者，便是我们最亲的朋友。踏出那门槛者，便是我们最恨的敌人。」
～卓塔妮

274477.oracleText:
"We leave our gardens open, so all may know wonder, but guarded, so all may know peace."
—Emmara
274477.translation:
「我们敞开花园，让人人都能见证奇迹；但也严加看守，让人人都能享受和平。」
～艾玛拉

274480.oracleText:
"A massive new Izzet building project with an unstated purpose? Probably fine."
—Zija, Simic mutationist
274480.translation:
「伊捷意图不明的全新大型建设计划？应该没什么蹊跷。」
～析米克突变师琪佳

274483.oracleText:
"Where the roots reach, there the temple rises."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel
274483.translation:
「繁根所及之处，殿堂拔地而起。」
～瑟雷尼亚福音师尼斯卡

274486.oracleText: Few believe Duskmantle exists. Fewer find it. None live to bear witness.
274486.translation: 没什么人相信暮篷存在。亲眼见到者更少。而见到后还能报信的，则一个都没有。

274496.oracleText: Ral had wielded lightning all his life but had never harnessed the power of an entire guild.
274496.translation: 拉尔能随意召使闪电，但却从未驾驭过整个公会的力量。

274505.oracleText: The kraul once skulked in the outskirts of Golgari society, but with Vraska's rise, they became valued forces of the Swarm.
274505.translation: 刻洛族过去在葛加理社群的地位非常边缘，但随着瓦丝卡崛起，它们成为群落的主力军。

274507.oracleText: When the Erstwhile were unearthed from their tombs, they became a ready-made army for Vraska.
274507.translation: 故军从坟墓中破土而出后，立即成了瓦丝卡现成的军队。

274513.oracleText: The ultimate answer to intrigue and subtlety.

274544.oracleText: Search for a card named Ral, Caller of Storms.
274544.translation: 搜寻一张名称为风暴唤师拉尔的牌。

274545.oracleText: Search for a card named Vraska, Regal Gorgon.
274545.translation: 搜寻一张名称为蛇发女王瓦丝卡的牌。

274547.oracleText: If this spell was cast from your hand and you've cast another spell named Approach of the Second Sun this game, you win the game. Otherwise, put Approach of the Second Sun into its owner's library seventh from the top and you gain 7 life.
274547.translation: 如果此咒语是从你手上施放，且你本盘游戏中施放过另一个名称为神日迫临的咒语，则你赢得这盘游戏。若否，则将神日迫临置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第七张的位置，且你获得7点生命。

274593.oracleText: Additional effect when spent on: A Multicolored Creature Spell
274593.translation: 用于支付以下费用时有额外效应：多色生物咒语

274693.translation: 猎魂罗刹不能进行阻挡。

274698.oracleText:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis
274698.translation:
「到头来，还是第一个世界最难征服。随着我在世界之间穿行，我的力量愈发强大；无论向哪里下手，都会让下一次更为轻松。」
～欧尼希兹

274700.oracleText: Target an attacking creature to give a +1/+1 counter.
274700.translation: 指定一个攻击生物为目标，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

274702.oracleText: Seismic Rupture deals 2 damage to each creature without flying.
274702.translation: 地动爆裂对每个不具飞行异能的生物各造成2点伤害。

274703.oracleText: Tap all creatures your opponents control with toughness 2 or less.
274703.translation: 横置所有由对手操控且防御力等于或小于2的生物。

274704.oracleText: Target blocking or blocked creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
274704.translation: 目标由你操控且进行阻挡或被阻挡的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

274721.oracleText: Cast this spell only if a creature is attacking you.
274721.translation: 只能于有生物攻击你时施放此咒语。

274722.oracleText: Remove all counters from target creature. It can't have counters put on it for as long as Suncleanser remains on the battlefield.
274722.translation: 移去目标生物上的所有指示物。于承阳净化僧仍在战场上的时段内，该生物上不能放置指示物。

274723.oracleText: Target opponent loses all counters. That player can't get counters for as long as Suncleanser remains on the battlefield.
274723.translation: 目标对手失去所有指示物。于承阳净化僧仍在战场上的时段内，该牌手不能得到指示物。

274992.oracleText: Each player with exactly 13 life loses the game, then each player gains 1 life.
274992.translation: 每位生命正好为13的牌手各输掉这盘游戏，然后每位牌手各获得1点生命。

274994.oracleText: Each player with exactly 13 life loses the game, then each player loses 1 life.
274994.translation: 每位生命正好为13的牌手各输掉这盘游戏，然后每位牌手各失去1点生命。

275020.oracleText: Goblin Cratermaker deals 2 damage to target creature.
275020.translation: 滥炸鬼怪对目标生物造成2点伤害。

275022.translation: 消灭目标无色非地永久物。

275101.oracleText: Put any number of cards into your graveyard and the rest on top in any order.
275101.translation: 将任意数量的牌置入你的坟墓场，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

275102.oracleText: This creature must be blocked by each creature able to do so.
275102.translation: 所有能够阻挡此生物的生物皆须阻挡之。

275166.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature card from it. That player discards that card.
275166.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非生物牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

275172.oracleText: Have Risk Factor deal 4 damage to you? If you decline your opponent draws three cards.
275172.translation: 是否要令风险因素对你造成4点伤害？如果你选择「拒绝」，则对手抓三张牌。

275607.oracleText: Additional effect when spent on: An Instant or Sorcery Spell
275607.translation: 用于支付以下费用时有额外效应：瞬间或法术咒语

275608.oracleText: Spend only on: A Creature Spell of the Chosen Type: {0}
275608.translation: 只能用于支付：所选类别的生物咒语：{0}

275610.oracleText: Spend only on: Instant or Sorcery Spells
275610.translation: 只能用于支付：瞬间或法术咒语

275611.translation: 只能用于支付：已增幅的咒语

275614.oracleText: Spend only on: A Creature Spell
275614.translation: 只能用于支付：生物咒语

275739.translation: 从这些生物中选择一个。

275768.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}与该生物互斗？

276556.oracleText: Spend only on: An Instant or Sorcery Spell
276556.translation: 只能用于支付：瞬间或法术咒语

276832.oracleText: Skeletons you control and other Zombies you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch.
276832.translation: 由你操控的骷髅妖与由你操控的其他灵俑得+1/+1且具有死触异能。

276973.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 2/2 red Dragon creature token with flying and "{oR}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
276973.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个2/2红色的龙衍生生物，且具有飞行异能与「{oR}：此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

276974.oracleText: When Dragon Egg dies, create a 2/2 red Dragon creature token with flying and "{oR}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
276974.translation: 当龙卵死去时，派出一个2/2红色的龙衍生生物，且具有飞行异能与「{oR}：此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

278036.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on Knight of Autumn.
278036.translation: 在暮秋骑士上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

278358.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent an opponent controls to its owner's hand?
278358.translation: 是否要将目标由对手操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上？

278360.oracleText: Choose an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard.
278360.translation: 选择你坟墓场中的一张瞬间或法术牌。

278393.oracleText: Return a creature card to the battlefield.
278393.translation: 将一张生物牌移回战场。

279365.translation: 指定至多一位牌手为目标。

279447.oracleText: {o4oWoW}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Your life total becomes 10.
279447.translation: {o4oWoW}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：你的总生命成为10。

279448.oracleText: {o4oWoW}, Exile Angel of Grace from your graveyard: Your life total becomes 10.
279448.translation: {o4oWoW}，从你的坟墓场放逐恩典天使：你的总生命成为10。

279450.oracleText:
"If we cannot have peace, we will have justice."
—Aurelia
279450.translation:
「如果和平不保，我们必将昭彰正义。」
～欧瑞梨

279451.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
279451.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的生物数量。

279453.oracleText: A ray of hope breaks through the shroud of rain.
279453.translation: 冲破风雨阴云的希望之光。

279457.oracleText: Law is the light of civilization.

279458.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, that creature gains flying until end of turn.
279458.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则该生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

279460.oracleText: "In you go, big guy. Watch your head."

279461.oracleText: Exile target creature with power 4 or greater.
279461.translation: 放逐目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

279463.oracleText: "These are your streets. Defend them! This is your neighborhood. Honor it! This is your city. Save it!"
279463.translation: 「这是你们的街道。要自己来守护！这是你们的家园。要自己来添辉！这是你们的城市。要自己来拯救！」

279465.oracleText:
"What makes a frog lizard any worse than a bird horse? Prejudice against the Simic, that's what. It's unfair!"
—Thados Arquef, Guardian Project biomancer
279465.translation:
「长得像青蛙的蜥蜴凭什么比不上长着翅膀的马？告诉你，就凭大家对析米克有成见。太不公平了！」
～卫护计划生机术士萨多斯阿奎夫

279467.oracleText:
"Lies cannot long withstand the harsh light of day."
—Lavinia
279467.translation:
「谎言终将暴露在明光之下。」
～拉温妮

279468.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Scry 1.
279468.translation: 消灭目标神器或结界。占卜1。

279474.oracleText: "You two, cover the alley! You, with me! Eyes on windows, balconies, and rooftops. Who knows what a fish-octopus-crab can do!"
279474.translation: 「你们俩，给我看好巷子！你，跟我来！窗口、阳台、屋顶这些地方都给我盯紧了。谁知道那个鱼头蟹身八爪怪能闹出什么乱子来！」

279477.oracleText: When the established order falters, what remains are ordinary people and their struggle to survive.
279477.translation: 现有秩序崩溃之后，只见平凡民众在乱世中艰难求存。

279478.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
279478.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

279480.oracleText: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.
279480.translation: 在动荡之时，民众更渴望从严正说辞中得到慰藉。

279483.oracleText: With the new guildmaster's innovations, arresters can arrive on the scene moments before a crime is committed.
279483.translation: 自从有了新公会首领的发明之后，逮捕人现可在罪行刚要发生之时赶到现场。

279484.oracleText: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. It gains first strike until end of turn.
279484.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的生物，然后将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

279486.oracleText: The helmet reveals no eyes to witness your penance, no mouth to offer absolution.
279486.translation: 这面头盔上不露眼，无从看你忏悔；下无开口，不能赐你宽恕。

279487.oracleText: Knight of Sorrows can block an additional creature each combat.
279487.translation: 哀恸骑士每次战斗可以额外多阻挡一个生物。

279492.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 for each card exiled with it.
279492.translation: 每以CARDNAME放逐一张牌，它便得+2/+2。

279493.oracleText: Lumbering Battlement gets +2/+2 for each card exiled with it.
279493.translation: 每以缓行城垛兽放逐一张牌，它便得+2/+2。

279495.oracleText: When the price of your sins comes due, the Church of Deals is there to collect.
279495.translation: 罪行代价账期一到，行商教会便会上门收取。

279498.oracleText: A hunter in the city requires the utmost cunning to survive. It must pounce only if the kill is certain, and leave the remains where no one will see.
279498.translation: 生于城市的捕猎者需深谙机敏狩猎之道方能存活：有十足把握时方才扑击，而后藏猎物遗骸于隐蔽之处。

279500.oracleText: The guildmasters loom large in the political sphere, but in the end, the rulers of Ravnica are its people.
279500.translation: 虽然公会首领在政治领域可谓举足轻重，但最终掌控拉尼卡命运的还是拉尼卡人民。

279501.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+3 until end of turn. Untap them.
279501.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+3直到回合结束。将它们重置。

279503.oracleText: A friend in good times, a guardian in bad times, and a savior when all else fails.
279503.translation: 顺境中的挚友，战乱下的靠山，绝望时的救星。

279504.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
279504.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

279505.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Resolute Watchdog: Target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
279505.translation: {o1}，牺牲坚毅看门狗：目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

279510.oracleText:
"If you can't control your mount, I will control it for you."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar
279510.translation:
「如果你管不住自己的坐骑，那就让我来替你管。」
～俄佐立轻骑兵米瑞拉

279511.oracleText: Enchanted creature has defender and loses flying.
279511.translation: 所结附的生物具有守军异能且失去飞行异能。

279513.translation:
「我在等你的馈赠。」
～欧佐夫僧侣达莎

279516.oracleText: She breathes fair winds to tired griffins and lifts songbirds beyond the reach of stalking cats.
279516.translation: 她向疲惫狮鹫送去助力清风，将受困鸣鸟拎离野猫魔爪。

279518.oracleText: Any challenge to Azorius authority is met with swift and potent retribution.
279518.translation: 任何胆敢挑战俄佐立权威的人都会立遭严惩。

279522.oracleText:
"Many wings haunt the skies these days. Few of them bear good tidings."
—Lavinia
279522.translation:
「如今天空布满羽翼，但鲜有好事相传。」
～拉温妮

279524.oracleText: "I keep reminding myself we do this because others can't, because we love this city. If we don't save it, no one will."
279524.translation: 「我时刻提醒自己：我们甘愿披上戎装，是因为我们无可替代，是因为我们深爱这座城市。如果我们不出面，还有谁能来救？」

279525.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap another target creature you control.
279525.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置另一个目标由你操控的生物。

279526.oracleText: Whenever Tenth District Veteran attacks, untap another target creature you control.
279526.translation: 每当第十区老兵攻击时，重置另一个目标由你操控的生物。

279528.oracleText: During your turn, spells your opponents cast cost {o1} more to cast and abilities your opponents activate cost {o1} more to activate unless they're mana abilities.
279528.translation: 在你的回合中，对手施放的咒语增加{o1}来施放，对手起动的异能也增加{o1}来起动，但法术力异能除外。

279530.oracleText: A pet that can hunt both flesh and spirit is precious in a place where smiling assassins keep company with ghostly shadows.
279530.translation: 在笑面杀手和魂魅幽影共处之地，既能追击活物又能猎捕鬼魂的宠物就显得尤为珍贵。

279531.oracleText: {oB}: Twilight Panther gains deathtouch until end of turn.
279531.translation: {oB}：暮色猎豹获得死触异能直到回合结束。

279533.oracleText: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, put a +1/+1 counter on each of those creatures and they gain vigilance until end of turn.
279533.translation: 由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则在这些生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它们获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

279535.oracleText: Loitering is not only illegal but unwise, since those who stay too long in one place are apt to be stepped on.
279535.translation: 滞留街头既触犯法律，也非明智之举：因为在一处逗留过久容易被踩扁。

279538.oracleText: Law is the voice of reason.

279539.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, draw a card.
279539.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则抓一张牌。

279544.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, draw a card, then discard a card.
279544.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

279545.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Benthic Biomancer, draw a card, then discard a card.
279545.translation: 每当在深洋生机术士上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

279547.oracleText: If you can see your breath, it's too late to run.
279547.translation: 如果你能看到自己的呼气，就已经来不及跑了。

279551.oracleText:
"The best way to keep a secret is to forget it."
—Lazav
279551.translation:
「守住秘密最好的办法，就是将它彻底忘记。」
～拉札夫

279552.oracleText: Target player shuffles their graveyard into their library.
279552.translation: 目标牌手将其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

279556.oracleText: Few Ravnicans are aware of the vast reefs in their world's hidden ocean. Far beneath the great sinkholes, where the light is blue and dim, merfolk tend the coral labyrinths that feed the benthic ecosystem.
279556.translation: 几乎没有拉尼卡人知道，这个世界的隐密汪洋之还遍布有广阔暗礁。海底深处仅得泛蓝微光，人鱼在此悉心照料盘曲交错的珊瑚丛，进而维系整个赖此为生的深洋生态。

279558.oracleText:
"It's not enough to defeat our foes. We must learn from them, too."
—Vannifar
279558.translation:
「光是击败敌人还不够。我们还必须效仿他们。」
～凡妮法

279559.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.
279559.translation: 反击目标生物咒语。在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

279561.translation: 「就连我的脑袋里都有他们的眼睛！」

279565.oracleText: Faeries are easily offended and quick to exact a quirky revenge.
279565.translation: 你很容易就会冒犯到仙灵，然后转眼就会受到他们的诡异报复。

279569.oracleText: "I've been through every guildgate in this city, and no one sees me come or go."
279569.translation: 「我已拜访过全城每一扇公会门，但从未有人见我进出。」

279572.oracleText: Whenever Gateway Sneak deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
279572.translation: 每当门前偷袭客对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

279574.oracleText: Searching the city for Fblthp felt like sifting the rain for a single drop of blood.
279574.translation: 在全城人海中找到夫毕佐，就像在滂沱大雨中筛出血滴。

279576.oracleText: Those who cross the Dimir find enemies everywhere they turn.
279576.translation: 反抗底密尔的人会发现自己四面皆敌。

279577.oracleText: Gain control of X target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
279577.translation: 获得X个目标生物和／或鹏洛客的操控权。

279579.oracleText: Whenever this creature blocks a creature, that creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
279579.translation: 每当此生物阻挡一个生物时，后者于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

279582.oracleText: CARDNAME has hexproof as long as you control an Illusion.
279582.translation: 只要你操控虚影，CARDNAME便具有辟邪异能。

279583.oracleText: Mesmerizing Benthid has hexproof as long as you control an Illusion.
279583.translation: 只要你操控虚影，催眠渊栖怪便具有辟邪异能。

279587.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Persistent Petitioners.
279587.translation: 名称为执着诉愿人的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

279589.oracleText: "To control the present we must master the future."
279589.translation: 「为宰制当下，我们必须掌控未来。」

279590.oracleText: Draw three cards. Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, instead scry 3, then draw three cards.
279590.translation: 抓三张牌。附案～如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则改为占卜3，然后抓三张牌。

279592.oracleText: "Citizen! Your crime has been recorded. Cease movement and await arrest, or further penalties will be immediately imposed."
279592.translation: 「市民！你的罪行已被记录。请立刻停止手中行动，静待被捕，否则将绝不宽贷。」

279595.oracleText: {o7oU}: Adapt 4. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
279595.translation: {o7oU}：演化4。你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

279597.oracleText: "When properly invoked, the plasma globule encloses the offensive spell with a satisfying slurp."
279597.translation: 「如能恰当召唤，电浆球应会完全包裹攻击咒语，你还能听到一声饱嗝。」

279599.oracleText: The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.
279599.translation: 如今拉尼卡大街小巷到处都是公会离脱成员，滥用专业技能牟取私利。

279602.oracleText:
