351786.oracleText: Choose one — • Create two 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature tokens. • Choose target artifact you control. Each other artifact you control becomes a copy of that artifact until end of turn.
351786.translation: 选择一项～ •  派出两个3/3无色魔像衍生神器生物。 •  选择目标由你操控的神器。每个由你操控的其他神器均成为该神器的复制品直到回合结束。

351788.oracleText:
"Come on, it's not even that deep!"
—Gorin the Brazen

351791.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -2/-0 and loses flying.
351791.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物得-2/-0且失去飞行异能。

351792.oracleText: Create a 4/4 blue Elemental Bird creature token with flying.
351792.translation: 派出一个4/4蓝色，具飞行异能的元素／鸟衍生生物。

351793.oracleText: Islands you control have "{oT}: Draw a card."
351793.translation: 由你操控的海岛具有「{oT}：抓一张牌。」

351794.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Islands you control have ‘{oT}: Draw a card.'"
351794.translation: 你获得具有「由你操控的海岛具有『{oT}：抓一张牌』」的徽记。

351796.oracleText: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.
351796.translation: 它从周遭每一道浪潮漩涡当中，看到未来事物逐渐苏醒。

351799.oracleText:
"If you need to disappear for a while, I know a place."
—Bilivus, master archivist
351799.translation:
「如果你要消失一阵，我知道一个好地方。」
～书库辖员总管比利沃斯

351801.oracleText: "Forget what you have learned from other teachers. I bring you the truth."
351801.translation: 「忘记你从别人那学到的东西。我来告诉你真相。」

351803.oracleText: "I study the past to find hope for the future."
351803.translation: 「我究研过去，是为了替将来寻找希望。」

351807.oracleText:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass
351807.translation:
「久行于这片险恶海域的船只，都免不了碰上一两个鬼魂。」
～贝克蒂霸司总帅

351809.oracleText:
"When you are gone, will anyone remember your story?"
—Unknown
351809.translation:
「你死去后，是否还会有人会记得你的故事？」
～无名氏

351810.oracleText: Counter target activated ability, triggered ability, or legendary spell.
351810.translation: 反击目标起动式异能，触发式异能或传奇咒语。

351811.oracleText:
"Don't you have somewhere else to be?"
—Sharuum the Hegemon
351811.translation:
「难道你没有其他该去的地方吗？」
～支配者韶伦

351813.oracleText: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.
351813.translation: 天空遍布咒文，魔法如甘霖一般落向饥渴的大地，播撒时节智慧。

351814.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control a creature with flying.
351814.translation: 如果你操控具飞行异能的生物，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

351816.oracleText:
"Yarok's waters rush and rage
Where armies bled into the sand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 2
351816.translation:
「奋战勇士尽血染，
雅魔奔流空飞涎。」
～《哀巴勒格》，2节

351818.oracleText:
"The knights charged forward on wings of wind, and the necromancer's horde roared in helpless rage."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire
351818.translation:
「骑士大军乘风冲锋从天而降，空留死灵术士大军无助怒吼。」
～柯琳娅，《骨塔围攻纪》

351820.oracleText:
"Your death will take a mere moment, but it will feel like an eternity."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood
351820.translation:
「虽然夺命实际只需一瞬间，但之前的苦痛会让你觉得要一辈子。」
～鲜血掮客维利司

351821.oracleText: Agonizing Syphon deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
351821.translation: 苦痛吸魂对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

351823.oracleText: "Skill, imagination, smarts: none of it matters unless you have the nerve to use it."
351823.translation: 「技能、预想、本事：这一切都只有在你有胆去作的时候才有用。」

351824.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
351824.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。

351825.oracleText: Whenever Audacious Thief attacks, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
351825.translation: 每当斗胆盗贼攻击时，你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。

351826.oracleText: "One knife, two knives, three knives, four—which will drop you to the floor?"
351826.translation: 「一二三四飞刀起～猜猜哪刀中到你？」

351828.oracleText: Leaf and soul alike wither at its touch.
351828.translation: 经它触碰，枝叶灵魂尽枯萎。

351829.oracleText: Creatures your opponents control can't have +1/+1 counters put on them.
351829.translation: 由对手操控的生物上不能放置+1/+1指示物。

351831.oracleText:
"You've heard that a vampire can't enter a home without an invitation? A lie meant to help you sleep at night."
—Kerin, watch sergeant
351831.translation:
「有人跟你说吸血鬼从来不会擅闯家门？那不过是骗你夜晚安睡的谎言罢了。」
～警备队长柯林

351835.oracleText: Return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield, then return another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
351835.translation: 将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，然后将另一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

351837.oracleText: Blood seeps into the stone, and darkness emerges.
351837.translation: 鲜血渗入石缝，黑暗随之现身。

351840.oracleText: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.
351840.translation: 她生时是马戏团的杂技演员，因而练就了一身流畅华美的杀人技艺，就连遭她毒手的人也对其表演赞叹不已。

351841.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodthirsty Aerialist.
351841.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在嗜血舞空客上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351842.oracleText:
"I will make your bones into a weapon that will lay even the mighty low."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen
351842.translation:
「我会将你的骨头化作击倒强敌的武器。」
～札戈斯沼的墨垂兹

351844.oracleText: "Living or dead, everyone responds to the proper motivation."
351844.translation: 「无论是死是活，只要给对刺激都会动。」

351852.oracleText:
"Let this serve as a reminder of your failure."
—Exdratha, bog witch
351852.translation:
「用这疤痕来让你永远铭记这次失败。」
～腐沼巫婆艾卓莎

351854.oracleText: It beckons silently, waiting in the darkness.
351854.translation: 它在黑暗之中静静等待，悄然回应。

351855.oracleText: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
351855.translation: 你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

351856.oracleText: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
351856.translation: 你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

351857.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
351857.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

351858.oracleText: Dread Presence deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.
351858.translation: 颤栗鬼影对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

351863.translation: 「我感受到了你的痛苦。很精致。」

351866.oracleText:
"If you manage to get to the heart of the bog, you'll find things there that make zombies seem downright lovable."
—Byaras, backwoods guide
351866.translation:
「如果你能够进到腐沼中心，你会发现跟那里的东西比起来，还是灵俑来得顺眼。」
～蛮荒林向导拜亚斯

351871.oracleText: His whips twist and tremble like living things, moved by the fury of the horde he commands.
351871.translation: 他手中长鞭像活物版不停翻搅、抖动，随着他麾下大军怒火而动。

351875.oracleText: {o2oB}: CARDNAME gets +3/+3 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
351875.translation: {o2oB}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+3/+3且获得死触异能。

351876.oracleText: {o2oB}: Knight of the Ebon Legion gets +3/+3 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
351876.translation: {o2oB}：直到回合结束，黑檀军团骑士得+3/+3且获得死触异能。

351877.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
351877.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌手失去过4点或更多生命，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351880.oracleText:
"With a single word, they were unmade."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire
351880.translation:
「只消念动一字，他们全都化烟散去。」
～柯琳娅，《骨塔围攻纪》

351882.oracleText:
"By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end."
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand
351882.translation:
「无论我日程有多满，我都会挤出时间来亲自动手。」
～玛切莎女王

351884.oracleText:
"The bog doesn't give a stinking bubble about your title, wealth, or piety. It's just hungry."
—Byaras, backwoods guide
351884.translation:
「无论你是达官显贵、万贯财主还是虔诚信徒，对于这片腐沼都没有区别。它就是饿了。」
～蛮荒林向导拜亚斯

351885.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker that's green or white. You gain 1 life.
351885.translation: 消灭目标绿色或白色的生物或鹏洛客。你获得1点生命。

351888.oracleText:
"Now, that's a zombie!"
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen
351888.translation:
「乖乖，这才是灵俑！」
～札戈斯沼的墨垂兹

351889.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, discard a card.
351889.translation: 在你的维持开始时，弃一张牌。

351891.oracleText:
"One for you, one for me. What could be more fair?"
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand
351891.translation:
「你一个，我一个。还有更公平的方式吗？」
～幕宾柯希斯

351894.oracleText: "The Great Serpent slumbers now, but all warmbloods will grovel in the dirt at its awakening!"
351894.translation: 「虽然巨蛇仍在沉睡，但待它觉醒之时，所有温血动物都将屈膝臣服！」

351895.oracleText: {o5oB}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
351895.translation: {o5oB}，{oT}：CARDNAME向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

351896.oracleText: {o5oB}, {oT}: Sorcerer of the Fang deals 2 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
351896.translation: {o5oB}，{oT}：蛇毒术士向目标对手或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

351898.oracleText: Target creature you control gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. If it's a Vampire, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
351898.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。如果它是吸血鬼，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351899.oracleText: You may sacrifice a Vampire. When you do, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
351899.translation: 你可以牺牲一个吸血鬼。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

351900.oracleText: You may sacrifice a Vampire. When you do, Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
351900.translation: 你可以牺牲一个吸血鬼。当你如此作时，骄傲血领索霖对任意一个目标造成3点伤害，且你获得3点生命。

351901.oracleText: You may put a Vampire creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
351901.translation: 你可以将一张吸血鬼生物牌从你手上放进战场。

351903.oracleText:
"The skull is rigid, but the mind is so deliciously supple."
—Eromena the Mind Render
351903.translation:
「虽然头骨坚硬，但心灵可口。」
～裂灵埃罗梅纳

351904.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. Exile all noncreature, nonland cards from that player's hand and graveyard.
351904.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。放逐该牌手手上和坟墓场中所有非生物且非地的牌。

351905.oracleText:
"There are always more like you."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen
351905.translation:
「总有更多像你这样的。」
～札戈斯沼的墨垂兹

351907.oracleText:
"Don't think of it as selling your soul. It's more like you're bequeathing it to me."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood
351907.translation:
「别把它当作是出卖灵魂。不妨想作你把灵魂留给了我。」
～鲜血掮客维利司

351908.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
351908.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将该生物牌在你的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

351910.oracleText: "This place suits me: craven authorities and plentiful prey."
351910.translation: 「这地方适合我：管制宽松，猎物充足。」

351912.oracleText: "Try to steal from me and I'll add your skull to my collection."
351912.translation: 「尽管来试着偷我东西，我的收藏品里还没有你的脑袋。」

351913.oracleText: Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
351913.translation: 每当你每回合首度失去生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

351916.oracleText: "You can sign, or you can spend your life imagining what might have been yours."
351916.translation: 「在这签字吧，不然你花一辈子也想象不到自己能得到什么。」

351917.oracleText: {oB}, Pay 2 life: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
351917.translation: {oB}，支付2点生命：目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

351918.oracleText: Whenever you lose life, draw that many cards.
351918.translation: 每当你失去生命时，抓等量的牌。

351920.oracleText:
"Yarok's nightmares lurk and wait
Where dark despair is near at hand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 3
351920.translation:
「黑暗绝境临眼前，
雅魔梦魇静沉眠。」
～《哀巴勒格》，3节

351923.oracleText: {o2oB}: Yarok's Fenlurker gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
351923.translation: {o2oB}：雅若克的潜沼灵得+1/+1直到回合结束。

351925.oracleText: {o1oR}: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
351925.translation: {o1oR}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

351928.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals X damage to each opponent and each planeswalker they control, where X is the number of land cards in your graveyard.
351928.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它向每位对手和每个由对手操控的鹏洛客各造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中的地牌数量。

351929.oracleText: When Cavalier of Flame dies, it deals X damage to each opponent and each planeswalker they control, where X is the number of land cards in your graveyard.
351929.translation: 当烈焰骁骑死去时，它向每位对手和每个由对手操控的鹏洛客各造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中的地牌数量。

351931.oracleText: Put a loyalty counter on each red planeswalker you control.
351931.translation: 在每个由你操控的红色鹏洛客上各放置一个忠诚指示物。

351932.oracleText: Create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
351932.translation: 派出两个1/1红色元素衍生生物。它们获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们牺牲。

351935.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, this emblem deals 1 damage to you.
351935.translation: 在你的维持开始时，此徽记对你造成1点伤害。

351936.oracleText: Each opponent gets an emblem with "At the beginning of your upkeep, this emblem deals 1 damage to you."
351936.translation: 每位对手各获得具有「在你的维持开始时，此徽记对你造成1点伤害」的徽记。

351937.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each non-Elemental creature.
351937.translation: CARDNAME对每个非元素的生物各造成3点伤害。

351938.oracleText: Chandra, Awakened Inferno deals 3 damage to each non-Elemental creature.
351938.translation: 觉醒炼狱茜卓对每个非元素的生物各造成3点伤害。

351939.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
351939.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

351940.oracleText: Chandra, Awakened Inferno deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
351940.translation: 觉醒炼狱茜卓对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

351942.oracleText: Elementals you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
351942.translation: 由你操控的元素得+2/+0直到回合结束。

351944.oracleText: Chandra, Novice Pyromancer deals 2 damage to any target.
351944.translation: 舞焰新手茜卓对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

351946.translation:
「球？毛球冒火时看你怎么对付。」
～茜卓纳拉

351947.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. Spend this mana only to cast an Elemental spell or a Chandra planeswalker spell.
351947.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。此法术力只能用来施放元素咒语或茜卓鹏洛客咒语。

351948.oracleText:
"There's plenty of fire to go around."
—Chandra Nalaar
351948.translation:
「火还有很多，尽管烧。」
～茜卓纳拉

351950.oracleText: Whenever you activate a loyalty ability of a Chandra planeswalker, you may pay {o1}. If you do, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy.
351950.translation: 每当你起动茜卓鹏洛客的忠诚异能时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则复制该异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

351951.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Discard a Mountain card or a red card: Draw a card.
351951.translation: {o1}，{oT}，弃一张山脉牌或红色牌：抓一张牌。

351957.oracleText: "I love digging. It gives me lots of time to think about how much I love digging."
351957.translation: 「我喜欢挖东西。挖东西的过程中有很多时间让我想我有多喜欢挖东西。」

351958.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact or land: Draw a card.
351958.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲一个神器或地：抓一张牌。

351959.oracleText:
"Yes, it's huge and strong and breathes fire. But we're smart!"
—Tadith the Wise, last words
351959.translation:
「没错，虽然它比我们强壮，还能喷火。但我们比它聪明！」
～睿敏塔蒂丝的遗言

351961.oracleText:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words
351961.translation:
「快散开，你们这帮蠢货！快散开！」
～队长马登的遗言

351962.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 4 damage to any target and 3 damage to each of up to two other targets.
351962.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成4点伤害，且对至多两个其他目标各造成3点伤害。

351963.oracleText: Whenever Drakuseth, Maw of Flames attacks, it deals 4 damage to any target and 3 damage to each of up to two other targets.
351963.translation: 每当烈焰巨口卓库瑟攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成4点伤害，且对至多两个其他目标各造成3点伤害。

351964.oracleText: Not every job in the goblin army is glamorous. Actually, no job in the goblin army is glamorous.
351964.translation: 并非鬼怪军队中所有差事都是体面活。实际上，鬼怪军队里没有体面活。

351966.oracleText:
"I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—"
—Thaedus the Clever, last words
351966.translation:
「我都计算过，一条飞空巨龙单次喷吐能够覆盖的范围是～」
～聪智塞得斯的遗言

351967.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature except for creatures you control with flying.
351967.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成2点伤害，但由你操控且具飞行异能的生物除外。

351968.oracleText: Flame Sweep deals 2 damage to each creature except for creatures you control with flying.
351968.translation: 烈焰横扫对每个生物各造成2点伤害，但由你操控且具飞行异能的生物除外。

351970.oracleText:
"I'm afraid your dinner got a little . . . overcooked."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper
351970.translation:
「你的晚餐恐怕有些…糊了。」
～旅店主马兰法斯瓦

351971.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker that's white or blue.
351971.translation: CARDNAME对目标白色或蓝色的生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

351972.oracleText: Fry deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker that's white or blue.
351972.translation: 煎烤对目标白色或蓝色的生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

351975.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
351975.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

351976.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, Glint-Horn Buccaneer deals 1 damage to each opponent.
351976.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，烁角海贼向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

351980.oracleText: "I opens my mouth to catches the bugs!"

351984.oracleText: "I am but a humble traveler. I have no taste for sneakery nor thiefiness."
351984.translation: 「我只是个普通的旅客。我没兴趣悄悄将东西带进来，也不热衷偷偷把东西顺出去。」

351985.oracleText: {oT}: Another target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
351985.translation: {oT}：另一个目标力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

351987.oracleText:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign
351987.translation:
「衣冠不整，恕不接待。」
～市集招牌

351988.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+2 until end of turn.
351988.translation: 目标生物得+3/+2直到回合结束。

351990.oracleText: She swings with the ease of flowing lava and hits with the force of a meteor.
351990.translation: 她挥拳似熔岩流动般轻柔，似流星坠地般强劲。

351991.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Elemental you control.
351991.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你每操控一个元素，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

351992.oracleText: Whenever Lavakin Brawler attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Elemental you control.
351992.translation: 每当熔身好斗灵攻击时，你每操控一个元素，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

351994.oracleText: If Leyline of Combustion is in your opening hand, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield.
351994.translation: 如果你的起手牌中包含了烧燃地脉，则你可以让它在战场上来开始游戏。

351995.oracleText: Whenever you and/or at least one permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player.
351995.translation: 每当你和／或至少一个由你操控的永久物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，CARDNAME向该对手造成2点伤害。

351996.oracleText: Whenever you and/or at least one permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, Leyline of Combustion deals 2 damage to that player.
351996.translation: 每当你和／或至少一个由你操控的永久物成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，烧燃地脉向该对手造成2点伤害。

351997.oracleText: Rage is the culmination of an accelerating cycle of anger and violence that feeds itself in battle, spreading like a flame from one warrior to another.
351997.translation: 狂怒是在战斗中不断累积的怒火与狂暴相互快速转，最终达顶的状态。这一情绪能如星火一般，接连点燃每位战士心中激情。

351999.oracleText:
"Stand still and try not to look like prey!"
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide
351999.translation:
「别乱动，尽可能别让自己看上去像是猎物！」
～旷野向导史格霍奈

352005.oracleText: Sacrifice this creature: It deals 1 damage to any target.
352005.translation: 牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

352006.oracleText: Equipped creature has "Sacrifice this creature: It deals 1 damage to any target."
352006.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有「牺牲此生物：它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

352008.oracleText: Their loyalty is not to any master, but to the pack.
352008.translation: 它们的忠心不属于任何主人，而属于自己的犬群。

352010.oracleText: {o1oR}: Each creature you control named Pack Mastiff gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
352010.translation: {o1oR}：每个由你操控且名称为獒犬群的生物各得+1/+0直到回合结束。

352012.oracleText:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words
352012.translation:
「我拿走几个它肯定也不会发～」
～妙手赛莉娅的遗言

352017.oracleText: Reckless Air Strike deals 3 damage to target creature with flying.
352017.translation: 鲁莽空袭对目标具飞行异能的生物造成3点伤害。

352018.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature with flying. • Destroy target artifact.
352018.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对目标具飞行异能的生物造成3点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

352019.oracleText: Choose one — • Reckless Air Strike deals 3 damage to target creature with flying. • Destroy target artifact.
352019.translation: 选择一项～ •  鲁莽空袭对目标具飞行异能的生物造成3点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

352020.oracleText:
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire."
—Harra the Adjudicator
352020.translation:
「在恶者终享安息之前，必须以火净化。」
～裁决者哈拉

352022.oracleText: It's in the nature of fire to grow.

352023.oracleText: When you next cast an instant spell, cast a sorcery spell, or activate a loyalty ability this turn, copy that spell or ability twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
352023.translation: 本回合中，当你下一次施放瞬间咒语，施放法术咒语或起动忠诚异能时，将该咒语或异能复制两次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

352024.oracleText: Dinosaurs rarely understand the idea of boundaries between the wild and the urban landscape.
352024.translation: 随着拉尼卡的荒野增广，就连爱好自然者都不得不面对日益凶猛的自然威胁。

352026.oracleText:
"Keep your flammables out of reach."
—Kerin, watch sergeant
352026.translation:
「把手头的易燃物都放远点。」
～警备队长柯林

352031.oracleText:
"Yes, she can be a nuisance. But at least my tea never gets cold."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper
352031.translation:
「没错，她确实很烦人。但至少我的茶不会凉了。」
～旅店主马兰法斯瓦

352032.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
352032.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对所攻击之牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

352033.oracleText: Whenever Scorch Spitter attacks, it deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
352033.translation: 每当炙焰喷吐蜥攻击时，它对所攻击之牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

352034.oracleText: "I love this thing! It's my best invention since the boulderfist gauntlet!"
352034.translation: 「我爱死这东西了！这是岩锤护手以来我最棒的发明！」

352036.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, choose target Elemental creature card in your graveyard with toughness less than CARDNAME's toughness. Return that card to the battlefield tapped and attacking. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
352036.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的元素生物牌，且其防御力须小于CARDNAME的防御力。将该牌横置移回战场且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

352037.oracleText: Whenever Thunderkin Awakener attacks, choose target Elemental creature card in your graveyard with toughness less than Thunderkin Awakener's toughness. Return that card to the battlefield tapped and attacking. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
352037.translation: 每当雷身醒眠灵攻击时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的元素生物牌，且其防御力须小于雷身醒眠灵的防御力。将该牌横置移回战场且正进行攻击。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

352038.oracleText: The cage is a crucible for the rage that builds inside, refining it into something pure and terrible.
352038.translation: 这铁笼好似熔炉，不断锤炼遭羁其中者积累的怒火，将其锻成更纯粹可怕之物。

352040.oracleText: Sathros turned his restraints to revenge.
352040.translation: 萨索洛斯把缚身刑具化作复仇武器。

352041.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as it's attacking.
352041.translation: 只要CARDNAME正进行攻击，它便得+2/+0。

352042.oracleText: Unchained Berserker gets +2/+0 as long as it's attacking.
352042.translation: 只要破链狂战士正进行攻击，它便得+2/+0。

352045.oracleText: {o1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from CARDNAME: CARDNAME gains hexproof until end of turn.
352045.translation: {o1}，从CARDNAME上移去一个+1/+1指示物：CARDNAME获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

352046.oracleText: {o1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from Barkhide Troll: Barkhide Troll gains hexproof until end of turn.
352046.translation: {o1}，从树皮巨魔上移去一个+1/+1指示物：树皮巨魔获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

352048.oracleText: "Many have walked here, but there is only one trail I seek."
352048.translation: 「此地足印繁杂，但我只追寻一条踪迹。」

352049.oracleText: {o5oG}, {oT}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
352049.translation: {o5oG}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

352053.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may exile it. If you do, put another target card from your graveyard on top of your library.
352053.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以将它放逐。若你如此作，则将另一张目标牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

352054.oracleText: When Cavalier of Thorns dies, you may exile it. If you do, put another target card from your graveyard on top of your library.
352054.translation: 当荆棘骁骑死去时，你可以将它放逐。若你如此作，则将另一张目标牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

352056.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 as long as there are three or more land cards in your graveyard.
352056.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有三张或更多地牌，CARDNAME便得+2/+2。

352057.oracleText: Elvish Reclaimer gets +2/+2 as long as there are three or more land cards in your graveyard.
352057.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有三张或更多地牌，垦殖妖精便得+2/+2。

352060.oracleText: The strongest pack has the fiercest pups.

352063.oracleText: Hydra spells you cast cost {o4} less to cast.
352063.translation: 你施放的多头龙咒语减少{o4}来施放。

352064.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell, CARDNAME fights up to one target creature you don't control.
352064.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物成为咒语的目标时，CARDNAME与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

352065.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell, Gargos, Vicious Watcher fights up to one target creature you don't control.
352065.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物成为咒语的目标时，卫护恶龙加戈斯与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

352067.oracleText:
"Shed your faded husk! Emerge sleeker and stronger!"
—Tyris, fauna shaman
352067.translation:
「褪去旧皮！变快，变强！」
～动物群祭师泰莉丝

352069.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. It gets an additional +2/+2 until end of turn for each card named Growth Cycle in your graveyard.
352069.translation: 目标生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。你坟墓场中每有一张名称为生长循环的牌，它便再得一次+2/+2直到回合结束。

352071.oracleText:
"Grief and rage and nightmares fade
Where hope and comfort make their stand."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 4
352071.translation:
「怨恨凶咒全退散，
喜乐希盼把志言。」
～《哀巴勒格》，4节

352074.oracleText: He and his pack sing the same mournful song to the moon.

352078.oracleText: "I am rooted in the life of all that thrives around me. You cannot move me."
352078.translation: 「我与周遭滋养生命同扎根，无人能将我与之分开。」

352079.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG}. If you control four or more creatures, add {oGoG} instead.
352079.translation: {oT}：加{oG}。如果你操控四个或更多生物，则改为加{oGoG}。

352081.oracleText: If Leyline of Abundance is in your opening hand, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield.
352081.translation: 如果你的起手牌中包含了丰足地脉，则你可以让它在战场上来开始游戏。

352082.oracleText: Whenever you tap a creature for mana, add an additional {oG}.
352082.translation: 每当你横置一个生物以产生法术力时，额外加{oG}。

352083.oracleText: {o6oGoG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
352083.translation: {o6oGoG}：在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

352084.oracleText:
"The living don't ever stay living, and the dead don't always stay dead."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves
352084.translation:
「生者不永生，死者不恒死。」
～墓地哲人杰葛

352085.oracleText:
"If a careless elf ends up caught in a spider's web, we must expect nature to take its course. Do not blame the spider for being a spider."
—Dellin Berting, Tolarian entomologist
352085.translation:
「如果见到粗心妖精误困蛛网，我们只能让他听天由命。切勿怪罪蜘蛛遵从本性。」
～陶拉里亚昆虫学家德林博汀

352087.oracleText: A strong leader means a growing pack.
352087.translation: 头狼凶狠，意味狼群得以壮大。

352088.oracleText: Other Wolves and Werewolves you control get +1/+1.
352088.translation: 由你操控的其他狼和狼人得+1/+1。

352089.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't cast a spell this turn, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
352089.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中你未施放过咒语，则派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

352093.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life. If that creature was an Elemental, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
352093.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。若该生物是元素，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

352094.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life. If that creature was an Elemental, put a +1/+1 counter on Overgrowth Elemental.
352094.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。若该生物是元素，则在茂生元素上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

352095.oracleText:
"Even the pterodon, who chases the clouds from its skies, must bow to the great forest below."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer
352095.translation:
「就算翼牙龙能驱逐云彩，它们也得屈服于地上的茂密树林。」
～烈阳帝国弓箭手马休兹

352097.oracleText: "Awake, and lift your faces to the sun."

352099.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets a creature you control, draw a card.
352099.translation: 每当你施放以由你操控之生物为目标的咒语时，抓一张牌。

352101.oracleText:
"In times of need, the forest creates its own protectors."
—Vivien Reid
352101.translation:
「危难之时，森林自会肇生守护者。」
～薇薇安瑞德

352104.oracleText: {oG}: CARDNAME gains your choice of reach, trample, or haste until end of turn.
352104.translation: {oG}：选择延势，践踏或敏捷。CARDNAME获得该异能直到回合结束。

352105.oracleText: {oG}: Shifting Ceratops gains your choice of reach, trample, or haste until end of turn.
352105.translation: {oG}：选择延势，践踏或敏捷。变幻犄角龙获得该异能直到回合结束。

352107.oracleText: The apes of Yavimaya draw strength from the spirits of their ancestors.
352107.translation: 亚维马雅的猿猴从先祖灵魂中汲取力量。

352108.oracleText: When Silverback Shaman dies, draw a card.
352108.translation: 当银背猿祭师死去时，抓一张牌。

352111.oracleText:
"Tread too hard in the forest and it will tread on you in return."
—Vivien Reid
352111.translation:
「若是肆意踩踏树林，小心树林反过来把你踩在脚下。」
～薇薇安瑞德

352112.oracleText: Other Elementals you control have trample.
352112.translation: 由你操控的其他元素具有践踏异能。

352114.oracleText: Draw a card if an opponent has cast a blue or black spell this turn. Spells you control can't be countered this turn. You and permanents you control gain hexproof from blue and from black until end of turn.
352114.translation: 如果本回合中有对手施放过蓝色或黑色咒语，则抓一张牌。由你操控的咒语本回合不能被反击。你和由你操控的永久物获得反蓝辟邪与反黑辟邪异能直到回合结束。

352116.oracleText: Distribute two +1/+1 counters among up to two target creatures. They gain trample until end of turn.
352116.translation: 将两个+1/+1指示物分配给至多两个目标生物。它们获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

352117.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker.
352117.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

352121.oracleText: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
352121.translation: 将CARDNAME上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

352122.oracleText: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on Voracious Hydra.
352122.translation: 将贪餮多头龙上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

352123.oracleText: Voracious Hydra fights target creature you don't control.
352123.translation: 贪餮多头龙与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

352126.oracleText: Roots reach deep, and sometimes they tap into things better left undisturbed.
352126.translation: 树根直探地底深处，难免会触及某些不应滋扰之物。

352128.oracleText:
"When the forest walks, it's too late to run."
—Horent, Khalni druid
352128.translation:
「等到树林站起身来，想跑就已经晚了。」
～坎尼德鲁伊霍伦

352129.oracleText: {oGoGoGoGoG}: Untap target land you control. It becomes a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.
352129.translation: {oGoGoGoGoG}：重置目标由你操控的地。它成为5/5，具敏捷异能的元素生物。它仍然是地。

352133.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and can't be blocked by more than one creature.
352133.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1，且不能被多于一个生物阻挡。

352135.oracleText: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."
352135.translation: 「树林间传来的每一声足音，都是心跳鼓动，将力量贯通我全身。」

352139.oracleText:
"With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire
352139.translation:
「白骨要塞中每杀出一个骑士，都让女王士兵气馁一分。」
～柯琳娅，《骨塔围攻纪》

352142.oracleText: The destruction of a wildfire with the tenacity of a jungle vine.
352142.translation: 燎原野火与坚韧藤蔓合为一体。

352143.translation: 由你操控的其他元素得+1/+0。

352144.oracleText: {o2oRoG}: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Elemental you control.
352144.translation: {o2oRoG}：你每操控一个元素，CARDNAME便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

352145.oracleText: {o2oRoG}: Creeping Trailblazer gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Elemental you control.
352145.translation: {o2oRoG}：你每操控一个元素，匍行开路灵便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

352147.oracleText: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.
352147.translation: 空中飞鸟皆是这精魂后代，聚其羽翼之下为求安宁。

352150.oracleText:
"Alone, it's a fortification. At the head of its troops, it's a battering ram."
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide
352150.translation:
「独自一人，堪称守城精兵。率军作战，则是攻城良将。」
～旷野向导史格霍奈

352151.oracleText: Ironroot Warlord's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
352151.translation: 铁根军头的力量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

352152.oracleText: {o3oGoW}: Create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
352152.translation: {o3oGoW}：派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

352158.oracleText: "The pen is mightier than the crown."

352159.oracleText: Legendary spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
352159.translation: 你施放的传奇咒语减少{o1}来施放。

352160.oracleText: You may play this card from your graveyard.
352160.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场使用此牌。

352161.oracleText: Exile two legendary cards from your graveyard: Until end of turn, each legendary card in your graveyard gains "You may play this card from your graveyard."
352161.translation: 从你的坟墓场中放逐两张传奇牌：直到回合结束，你坟墓场中的每张传奇牌均获得「你可以从你的坟墓场中使用此牌。」

352163.oracleText: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

352164.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
352164.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

352167.oracleText: "I strike in the same place as many times as necessary."
352167.translation: 「就算是同一个地方，我该打几次就打几次。」

352169.oracleText:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves
352169.translation:
「过往英雄的光辉事迹鼓舞我们精神，腐败肉身滋养我们成长。」
～墓地哲人杰葛

352170.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
352170.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

352172.oracleText:
"What he doesn't burn, he smashes."
—Captain Wellis, ogre wrangler
352172.translation:
「他会把烧不掉的东西都砸烂。」
～食人魔训练师威利斯队长

352173.oracleText: {o2oBoR}: Destroy target creature that was dealt damage this turn.
352173.translation: {o2oBoR}：消灭目标本回合中受过伤害的生物。

352179.oracleText:
"No, not ‘washed' ashore. It walked ashore."
—Shafring Hulm, beachcomber
352179.translation:
「不，它不是『冲』上来的。它是自己走上来的。」
～海滩拾荒客沙林霍姆

352184.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token that's tapped and attacking.
352184.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

352185.oracleText: Whenever Skyknight Vanguard attacks, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token that's tapped and attacking.
352185.translation: 每当空骑士先锋攻击时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

352190.oracleText:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—Lament for Bala Ged, stanza 1
352190.translation:
「巴地境域皆涂炭，
雅魔悲切徒伤感。」
～《哀巴勒格》，1节

352193.translation: 没有哪种准备程度比得上准备过度。

352194.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return all cards exiled with CARDNAME to their owner's hand.
352194.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌移回其拥有者的手上。

352195.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice Bag of Holding: Return all cards exiled with Bag of Holding to their owner's hand.
352195.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲百宝囊：将所有以百宝囊放逐的牌移回其拥有者的手上。

352197.oracleText: "There's only one way to be sure it's really dead."
352197.translation: 「要保证对方死透，只有一种办法。」

352198.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +10/+10 and loses flying.
352198.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+10/+10且失去飞行异能。

352202.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen color, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
352202.translation: 每当你施放该色的咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

352203.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen color, put a +1/+1 counter on Diamond Knight.
352203.translation: 每当你施放该色的咒语时，在晶钻骑士上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

352205.oracleText:
"I see it taunting me whenever I close my eyes."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief
352205.translation:
「我一闭上眼，就看见它在诱我上前。」
～大盗迅指奈芮

352211.oracleText: {o2oWoUoBoRoG}: Exile the top three cards of your library. You may play them this turn without paying their mana costs.
352211.translation: {o2oWoUoBoRoG}：放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

352212.oracleText:
"Best bury them right. We don't want any gruesome encores."
—Constable Trosk
352212.translation:
「最好把他们都埋严实了。我可不想让恶心的东西再让我们好看。」
～保安官卓斯克

352215.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card of the chosen type from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
352215.translation: {o3}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中一张该类别的生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

352217.oracleText:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief
352217.translation:
「锁头想被打开，财宝想被解放。」
～大盗迅指奈芮

352222.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library.
352222.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：放逐你的牌库顶牌。

352224.oracleText:
"Good! Now put it with the other widdle bunnies."
—Sargis Haz, artificer
352224.translation:
「很好！接下来把它和其他小白兔放在一起。」
～神器师莎琪亥

352227.oracleText: Even its shadow is a dazzling rainbow.
352227.translation: 它连影子都是绚丽霓虹。

352229.oracleText:
"The last blast is the biggest."
—Sargis Haz, artificer
352229.translation:
「最后一声最响。」
～神器师莎琪亥

352230.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Retributive Wand deals 1 damage to any target.
352230.translation: {o3}，{oT}：报复法杖对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

352231.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, it deals 5 damage to any target.
352231.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，它对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

352232.oracleText: When Retributive Wand is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, it deals 5 damage to any target.
352232.translation: 当报复法杖从战场进入坟墓场时，它对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

352234.oracleText:
"The next model should be able to achieve a rescue without self-destruction."
—Sargis Haz, artificer
352234.translation:
「下一个型号应该就能做到不需自毁也把东西捞上来。」
～神器师莎琪亥

352235.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Choose target permanent card in your graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn. Return it to your hand.
352235.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：选择目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌，且须为于本回合中从战场进入该处者。将该牌移回你手上。

352236.oracleText: Sacrifice Salvager of Ruin: Choose target permanent card in your graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn. Return it to your hand.
352236.translation: 牺牲遗迹回收械：选择目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌，且须为于本回合中从战场进入该处者。将该牌移回你手上。

352237.oracleText: With five lenses on its "head," it sees the world in a range of colors beyond ordinary perception.
352237.translation: 它「头」上装着五色镜片，能够透过超越常人感知的色相观察世界。

352238.oracleText: The sculptor, like most artists, put his heart and soul into his work. But the newly awakened golem decided it wanted its creator's other, more tangible parts.
352238.translation: 其雕塑师一如其他的艺师，将心血与灵魂注入自己的作品。但这甫苏醒的魔像决定了：自己需要创造者其他更加具象的部分。

352239.oracleText:
"The artificer assured me that the vial is strong enough to contain the dragon's breath. I just need to make sure to throw it far enough."
—Kunh Mei, last words
352239.translation:
「神器师向我再三保证，这瓶子足以承受龙炎高温。我只需要扔得够远就行。」
～昆梅的遗言

352241.oracleText: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.
352241.translation: 只有在你放弃搜寻时，洞窟才会露出其间的秘密。

352253.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Put two +1/+1 counters on up to one target creature.
352253.translation: 你获得2点生命。在至多一个目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

352254.oracleText: Exile target creature. Its controller gains 2 life.
352254.translation: 放逐目标生物。其操控者获得2点生命。

352255.oracleText: Creatures you control gain flying and double strike until end of turn.
352255.translation: 由你操控的生物获得飞行与连击异能直到回合结束。

352260.oracleText: "Now is not the time for your light to fade."
352260.translation: 「现在还不是你的光辉消逝之时。」

352263.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Twinblade Paladin.
352263.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在双刃神圣武士上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

352264.oracleText: As long as you have 25 or more life, CARDNAME has double strike.
352264.translation: 只要你的总生命为25或更多，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

352265.oracleText: As long as you have 25 or more life, Twinblade Paladin has double strike.
352265.translation: 只要你的总生命为25或更多，双刃神圣武士便具有连击异能。

352267.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -5/-0.
352267.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物得-5/-0。

352268.oracleText: Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands.
352268.translation: 将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

352269.oracleText: Creatures you control with flying get +5/+5 until end of turn.
352269.translation: 由你操控且具飞行异能的生物得+5/+5直到回合结束。

352271.oracleText:
"It soars on the winds of dreams."
—Mu Yanling
352271.translation:
「它乘幻梦清风腾飞云霄。」
～沐燕灵

352272.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Yanling planeswalker.
352272.translation: 只要你操控燕灵鹏洛客，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

352273.oracleText: Celestial Messenger gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Yanling planeswalker.
352273.translation: 只要你操控燕灵鹏洛客，传音青鸟便得+1/+1。

352275.oracleText: "They come to drink, to bathe, and—I believe—to play."
352275.translation: 「它们来我身边饮水、洁身～以及嬉戏。」

352282.oracleText: Up to one target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
352282.translation: 至多一个目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

352283.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target. You gain 4 life.
352283.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。你获得4点生命。

352284.oracleText: Sorin, Vampire Lord deals 4 damage to any target. You gain 4 life.
352284.translation: 吸血领主索霖对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。你获得4点生命。

352286.oracleText: Until end of turn, each Vampire you control gains "{oT}: Gain control of target creature."
352286.translation: 直到回合结束，每个由你操控的吸血鬼均获得「{oT}：获得目标生物的操控权。」

352288.oracleText: "I have no patience for sipping blood from crystal goblets. I want to bite and tear."
352288.translation: 「我没有耐心捧着水晶酒杯啜吸鲜血。我只想开怀畅享。」

352289.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
352289.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有对手失去过生命，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

352292.oracleText: "My people serve the dragon Kolaghan, but I give my blood for a greater lord."
352292.translation: 「我的族人侍奉巨龙寇安甘，但我却愿意为更强大的主子抛洒鲜血。」

352297.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
352297.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

352298.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller.
352298.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害，且对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

352299.oracleText: Chandra, Flame's Fury deals 4 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller.
352299.translation: 盛焰怒火茜卓对目标生物造成4点伤害，且对该生物的操控者造成2点伤害。

352300.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 10 damage to target player and each creature that player controls.
352300.translation: CARDNAME对目标牌手和每个由该牌手操控的生物各造成10点伤害。

352306.oracleText:
"Whoever thought of making mobile volcanoes was a genius."
—Chandra Nalaar
352306.translation:
「想到带上火山一起走的人可真是个天才。」
～茜卓纳拉

352307.oracleText: {o1oRoR}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target player.

352308.oracleText: {o1oRoR}: Pyroclastic Elemental deals 1 damage to target player.
352308.translation: {o1oRoR}：熔屑元素对目标牌手造成1点伤害。

352310.oracleText:
"Fire is always dancing, leaping and whirling, seeking more fuel. It never rests, so why should I?"
—Chandra Nalaar
352310.translation:
「火焰始终舞动、跳跃、旋转，不断燃点事物充盈自身。烈火永不停歇，那我为何要停？」
～茜卓纳拉

352311.oracleText: Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
352311.translation: 每当任一对手受到非战斗伤害时，由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

352315.oracleText: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
352315.translation: 从你牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张生物牌为止。将该牌置于你手上，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

352321.oracleText:
"I think it's trying to tell us that the forest is angry."
—Vivien Reid
352321.translation:
「我想它想要跟我们说的是：森林发怒了。」
～薇薇安瑞德

352322.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets CARDNAME, draw a card.
352322.translation: 每当你施放以CARDNAME为目标的咒语时，抓一张牌。

352323.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets Gnarlback Rhino, draw a card.
352323.translation: 每当你施放以糙背犀牛为目标的咒语时，抓一张牌。

352326.oracleText:
"Regardless of where they come from, crocs are usually able to find their way home. For this one, home is me."
—Vivien Reid
352326.translation:
「无论家园在何处，鳄鱼总是能够找到归去之路。但对这鳄鱼而言，我就是它的家园。」
～薇薇安瑞德

352327.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Vivien planeswalker.
352327.translation: 只要你操控薇薇安鹏洛客，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

352328.oracleText: Vivien's Crocodile gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Vivien planeswalker.
352328.translation: 只要你操控薇薇安鹏洛客，薇薇安的鳄鱼便得+1/+1。

352329.oracleText: Headquartered at the Bastion of the Honorable, the soldiers of Ghirapur are charged with the task of keeping peace in the city.
352329.translation: 吉拉波的军队主力驻扎在骁勇堡内，肩负着维系城市安宁这项重任。

352330.oracleText: In the cloudy skies and dim light of autumn, a flash of white wings is a reminder that better times lie ahead.
352330.translation: 秋暮时分的压顶乌云让人透不过气，然长空尽头划过的白色羽翼，提醒众人仍有美好未来可期。

352332.oracleText: Her mount's hollow crest can produce a trumpeting warning that carries for miles, summoning more knights to her aid.
352332.translation: 她身下坐骑羽冠中空，用作号角时警告鸣响可传彻数哩，召来骑士同袍相助。

352333.oracleText:
"As the knight struggled to stand, his squire took up his blade. The foe advanced not a single step."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire
352333.translation:
「骑士中箭倒地，挣扎想要站起。正在这时，他身边扈从捡起掉落长剑挡在身前。面对此景，敌人竟不敢前进半步。」
～柯琳娅，《骨塔围攻纪》

352334.oracleText: The merfolk know every contour of their coral homes; each reef is a garden in times of peace, and a refuge and fortress in times of war.
352334.translation: 人鱼熟知自己珊瑚家园的各处蹊径：平时，每座暗礁都可当作花园；战时，每座暗礁都能用作要塞。

352336.oracleText:
"Writhing tendrils of darkness stitched him back together. Though his will and body both were broken, the necromancer's magic would not let him rest."
—Krinnea, Siege of the Bone Spire
352336.translation:
「扭曲的黑暗卷须将他重新拼成人形。虽然他身心俱裂，死灵术士的魔法仍让他不得安息。」
～柯琳娅，《骨塔围攻纪》

352337.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+3 until end of turn.
352337.translation: 目标生物得+1/+3直到回合结束。

352338.oracleText:
"If we've run out of warm bodies, then cold bodies will have to do."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen
352338.translation:
「如果尚有余温的尸体用完了，那么已经死透的躯骨能派上用场。」
～札戈斯沼的墨垂兹

352339.oracleText:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen
352339.translation:
「灵魂、肉身，甚至双眼～这些都不是精准夺命的箭术所必需之物。」
～札戈斯沼的墨垂兹

352340.oracleText:
"What does it mean when the dead feed on the dead? When no new life emerges, but only more death? Is it not an endless spiral into annihilation?"
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves
352340.translation:
「当死者相食，这意味着什么？当新生不在，唯死者堆积，这又意味着什么？这难道不是引致全面毁灭的无尽回旋吗？」
～墓地哲人杰葛

352342.oracleText:
"Compared to the hunger of the fires within the earth, the appetite of a mere wurm is nothing."
—Phelgis Ojin, Keral Keep acolyte
352342.translation:
「与地底烈焰的饥渴相比，区区一头亚龙的食欲根本不值一提。」
～科瑞尔要塞侍僧费吉奥金

352343.oracleText: Engulfing Eruption deals 5 damage to target creature.
352343.translation: 没顶爆发对目标生物造成5点伤害。

352346.oracleText:
"It's just playing with us, Marsden."
—Dafynne the Radiant, last words
352346.translation:
「马登，它只是在和我们闹着玩呢。」
～辉耀戴芬的遗言

352347.oracleText: The spikes of bone protruding from its hide serve primarily as protection, but as they accumulate bits of foliage from the surrounding forest, they also provide camouflage.
352347.translation: 皮下探出的骨刺原本主要用于自保，但当其上积满森林的残叶之后，也能起到伪装之用。

352348.oracleText:
"Even the smallest creatures are fierce in defense of their own territory."
—Vivien Reid
352348.translation:
「就算是体型最为渺小的生物，在守卫自己地盘的时候也会凶相毕露。」
～薇薇安瑞德

352349.oracleText: "I sing to the branches, and they reach to the sky. I sing to the leaves, and they open to the sun. I sing to the roots, and they dig their fingers deep. I sing the song that creation sung."
352349.translation: 「枝桠闻我歌声，迎空扬碧伸扬。树叶闻我歌声，沐日茂密绽放。根茎闻我歌声，破土繁茂生长。问我旋律为何，这是造物之歌。」

352351.oracleText: Whenever another multicolored creature you control dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.
352351.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的多色生物死去时，在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回其拥有者手上。

352352.oracleText: Target up to two permanent cards in your graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn.
352352.translation: 指定至多两张在你坟墓场中且须为于本回合中从战场进入该处的永久物牌为目标。

413600.oracleText: A faerie's glee at her trove quickly fades to contentment, then to boredom, then to an urge to steal more.
413600.translation: 新有收获，仙灵都会笑逐颜开，但这种心情很快平复，继而生厌，接着就又打起再度行窃的念头。

413604.oracleText: "Even when hope is but a small flame fighting the night, I will serve the absent king."
413604.translation: 「纵使希望如暗夜中孤焰飘摇，我也会继续效忠失踪国君。」

413609.oracleText: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.
413609.translation: 在这座推崇忠诚胜过一切的城堡之中，没有什么能比过骑士与狮鹫之间的深厚羁绊。

413611.oracleText: At the market, no one heeded Hilda's frantic mooing. The fae curse was turning out even worse than she had feared.
413611.translation: 希尔妲发狂般地想要出声，但她的连连哞叫在闹市当中却无人理睬。她虽然料到会有这般下场，但仙儿诅咒的后果比她预想还要严重。

413613.translation: 当待售乳牛死去或当你弃掉它时，派出一个食品衍生物。

413628.oracleText: {o3oW}, {oT}: Create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.

413630.oracleText:
"They have forsaken their vows. The edict of the Circle demands their voices be silenced."
—Syr Tasdale, knight of Ardenvale
413630.translation:
「他们背弃誓约，言而无信。因此焰圈裁令他们从此言而无声。」
～雅登瓦骑士，塔戴尔爵士

"The fox grinned. ‘How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—Tales of the Fae
413635.translation:
「狐狸奸笑道：『巨龙，不如我们打个赌吧？如果我赢了，天空就归我。』巨龙哈哈大笑，随即接受了赌局。」
