413644.oracleText: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."
413644.translation: 「体型优势？他们都看不到我在哪。」

413646.oracleText: Fate will decide whether it's a bed or a tomb.
413646.translation: 是卧榻或灵棺，全看命运安排。

413652.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are five colors among permanents you control, there are six or more card types among permanents you control and/or cards in your graveyard, and your life total is greater than or equal to your starting life total, you win the game.
413652.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若由你操控的永久物之中所包括的颜色有五种，且由你操控的永久物和／或在你坟墓场中的牌之中牌张类别有六种或更多，且你的总生命等于或大于你的起始总生命，则你赢得这盘游戏。

413655.oracleText: Non-Archon creatures have base power and toughness 3/3.
413655.translation: 非统领生物的基础力量与防御力为3/3。

413659.oracleText: "Let's begin this conversation again, and this time you will only listen."
413659.translation: 「让我们再重新开始这段对话，但这次你只能听。」

413662.oracleText: "What good is loyalty to the crown if we are not also in service to those less fortunate? I fight for all of us."
413662.translation: 「倘若不能救助受难百姓，愚忠王权又有什么意义？我为我们所有人而战。」

413664.oracleText: "Until my last breath, I will defend the realm."

413665.oracleText: Whenever a white creature you control attacks, you gain 1 life.
413665.translation: 每当一个由你操控的白色生物攻击时，你获得1点生命。

413668.oracleText: For good or ill, most fae can't resist meddling in the adventures of any knight they meet.
413668.translation: 无论是出于善意还是恶意，多数仙儿只要遇上骑士，都会忍不住要干预他们的历险。

413671.oracleText:
"With the drum of hooves and a flash of blades, the monster's terrifying roar changed to a cry of fear."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights
413671.translation:
「但闻马蹄隆隆，只见剑光一闪，怪兽原本的骇人嘶吼转眼就变成惊恐哀号。」
～《金辉骑士传》

413672.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target attacking or blocking creature equal to the number of creatures you control.
413672.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

413673.oracleText: Outflank deals damage to target attacking or blocking creature equal to the number of creatures you control.
413673.translation: 侧翼突破对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

413675.oracleText:
"I wrote these tales with a quill made from a griffin's feather. And the winning of that feather is quite a tale itself."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales
413675.translation:
「书中传奇故事乃是用一根狮鹫羽毛制成的羽毛笔写就。而这跟羽毛的来历本身就是一段传奇。」
～说书人楚兰

413677.oracleText:
"If you're as loyal as you claim, now is the time to show it."
—Queen Linden of Ardenvale
413677.translation:
「如果各位自认忠心耿耿，现在便是展现时机。」
～雅登瓦的琳登女王

413678.oracleText: Create two 1/1 white Human creature tokens. Adamant — If at least three white mana was spent to cast this spell, you gain 1 life for each creature you control.
413678.translation: 派出两个1/1白色人类衍生生物。固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点白色法术力，则你每操控一个生物，便获得1点生命。

413679.oracleText:
Create two 1/1 white Human creature tokens. 
Adamant — If at least three white mana was spent to cast this spell, you gain 1 life for each creature you control.
413679.translation:
派出两个1/1白色人类衍生生物。
固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点白色法术力，则你每操控一个生物，便获得1点生命。

413681.oracleText: Syr Damon looked at the dragon and saw the faces of every innocent it had devoured. Suddenly, his sword blazed like the sun.
413681.translation: 戴蒙爵士抬头凝视巨龙，眼前浮现张张遭其果腹的无辜者面容。突然之间，他手中利剑燃起烈日亮光。

413683.translation: 并非只有拿剑的才能当英雄。

413688.oracleText: Tempered by fire and united in virtue, the knights of Ardenvale fight with a single, unbreakable will.
413688.translation: 雅登瓦的骑士历银焰之锤炼，怀美德而同心，因而作战时意志统一、牢不可破。

413689.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Adamant — If at least three white mana was spent to cast this spell, creatures you control gain vigilance until end of turn.
413689.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点白色法术力，则由你操控的生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

413690.oracleText:
Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. 
Adamant — If at least three white mana was spent to cast this spell, creatures you control gain vigilance until end of turn.
413690.translation:
在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。
固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点白色法术力，则由你操控的生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

413692.oracleText: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.
413692.translation: 一旦外敌从幻野闯入，边境沿途的烽火信标就会接连点亮。

413694.oracleText: "The realm must never yield to the chaos of the wilds."
413694.translation: 「世境绝不能屈从于幻野的混乱。」

413695.oracleText: Whenever Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
413695.translation: 每当狮爪艾林爵士攻击时，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

413697.oracleText: "At least up here I have some peace and quiet."
413697.translation: 「至少在这上面我还能有一丝清静。」

413699.oracleText:
"Be careful, dear. Some people deserve their curses."
—Marawen, barrow witch
413699.translation:
「亲爱的，当心点。有些人是活该受诅咒。」
～荒野巫婆玛拉雯

413701.oracleText: "May this blade guide you on your great journey, as it did me on mine."
413701.translation: 「愿这把剑能如同之前引导我一般，领君你踏上伟大征程。」

413702.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target Knight you control.
413702.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，在目标由你操控的骑士上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

413703.oracleText: When Venerable Knight dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target Knight you control.
413703.translation: 当高年骑士死去时，在目标由你操控的骑士上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

413705.oracleText: Every Ardenvale aspirant must step through the flame. Their honor determines whether they burn or shine.
413705.translation: 每位雅登瓦有志者都必须从焰圈当中缓步走过。而身上所存荣耀，决定了他们是遭火逼退还是闪耀于世。

413706.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Knight spell, create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
413706.translation: 每当你施放骑士咒语时，派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

413707.oracleText:
"In the wilds, your true training will begin."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
413707.translation:
「进到幻野后，你的真正训练就会开始。」
～狮爪艾林爵士

413709.oracleText: A true puppet master has no need for strings.
413709.translation: 真正的操偶师不需要提线。

413711.oracleText: Brazen Borrower can block only creatures with flying.
413711.translation: 厚颜借物灵只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。

413715.oracleText: Castle Vantress has no locks on its doors, but interlopers rarely make it past the foyer.
413715.translation: 虽然凡翠丝堡的大门从不上锁，但鲜有擅入者见过门厅之外的模样。

413719.oracleText: "If you're in our home, we expect you to mind your manners."

413722.oracleText: {oT}: Choose target artifact card in your graveyard. You may cast that card this turn. (You still pay its costs. Timing rules still apply.)
413722.translation: {oT}：选择目标在你坟墓场中的神器牌。本回合中，你可以施放该牌。（你依旧要支付其费用，且仍须遵守施放时机规则。）

413724.oracleText: {o1oU}, Discard two cards: Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
413724.translation: {o1oU}，弃两张牌：将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

413725.oracleText: {o1oU}, Discard two cards: Return Fae of Wishes to its owner's hand.
413725.translation: {o1oU}，弃两张牌：将趁愿仙儿移回其拥有者手上。

413727.oracleText: History may be written by the triumphant, but it's often rewritten by the troublesome.
413727.translation: 虽然历史由胜利者写就，但却经常会被捣乱者改写。

413728.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
413728.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

413729.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Faerie Vandal.
413729.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，在莽撞仙灵上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

413734.oracleText: That gnat was still hovering by the venison, and now both looked delicious.
413734.translation: 刚刚鹿肉上还有恼人蚊虫飞舞，现在这两样东西看起来都很美味。

413735.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a blue Frog creature with base power and toughness 1/1.
413735.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为1/1的蓝色蛙生物。

413737.oracleText: His name is spoken only in whispers—but he hears just the same.
413737.translation: 其他人提到他的名字时只敢细声低语～但他每次都能清楚听闻。

413740.oracleText: Whenever you cast a blue spell, tap target nonland permanent an opponent controls.
413740.translation: 每当你施放蓝色咒语时，横置目标由对手操控的非地永久物。

413743.oracleText: The boundary between real and imaginary is as thin as the page, and just as easily torn.
413743.translation: 一纸书页将现实与想象分割，但两者间的界限也如薄纸般脆弱。

413744.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if an opponent has seven or more cards in their graveyard.
413744.translation: 如果任一对手的坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

413746.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a knowledge counter on CARDNAME, then draw a card for each knowledge counter on CARDNAME.
413746.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个知识指示物，然后CARDNAME上每有一个知识指示物，便抓一张牌。

413747.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a knowledge counter on The Magic Mirror, then draw a card for each knowledge counter on The Magic Mirror.
413747.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在魔法明镜上放置一个知识指示物，然后魔法明镜上每有一个知识指示物，便抓一张牌。

413749.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, attach CARDNAME to target creature you control.
413749.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，将CARDNAME贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

413750.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, attach Mantle of Tides to target creature you control.
413750.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，将浪潮斗篷贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

413752.oracleText: Merfolk curiosity usually has dire consequences, but rarely for the merfolk.
413752.translation: 人鱼的好奇心通常会招致严重后果，但受难的绝少是人鱼本身。

413754.oracleText: {o2oU}: Put an hour counter on CARDNAME.

413755.oracleText: {o2oU}: Put an hour counter on Midnight Clock.
413755.translation: {o2oU}：在午夜怪钟上放置一个时刻指示物。

413756.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, put an hour counter on CARDNAME.
413756.translation: 在每个维持开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个时刻指示物。

413757.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, put an hour counter on Midnight Clock.
413757.translation: 在每个维持开始时，在午夜怪钟上放置一个时刻指示物。

413758.oracleText: When the twelfth hour counter is put on CARDNAME, shuffle your hand and graveyard into your library, then draw seven cards. Exile CARDNAME.
413758.translation: 当在CARDNAME上放置第十二个时刻指示物时，将你的手牌和坟墓场洗入你的牌库，然后抓七张牌。放逐CARDNAME。

413759.oracleText: When the twelfth hour counter is put on Midnight Clock, shuffle your hand and graveyard into your library, then draw seven cards. Exile Midnight Clock.
413759.translation: 当在午夜怪钟上放置第十二个时刻指示物时，将你的手牌和坟墓场洗入你的牌库，然后抓七张牌。放逐午夜怪钟。

413761.oracleText:
"Share your darkest secret and the Mirror will reveal your soul's essence."
—Ceri, royal mirrorkeeper
413761.translation:
「向魔镜说出你内心深处最黑暗的秘密，它就会揭示出你灵魂的本质。」
～皇家护镜师赛理

413765.oracleText: The fae raised the turtle from a tiny hatchling. They taught it whom to ferry—and whom to drown.
413765.translation: 仙儿将这只乌龟从小悉心养大。教会了它该送谁过河～以及该送谁落水。

413766.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking non-Human creature can't be blocked this turn.
413766.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的非人类生物本回合不能被阻挡。

413767.oracleText: Whenever Mistford River Turtle attacks, another target attacking non-Human creature can't be blocked this turn.
413767.translation: 每当雾滩河巨龟攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的非人类生物本回合不能被阻挡。

413769.oracleText: They comb the shallows of Lochmere for relics of a bygone era. And if they happen upon a lone traveler, all the better.
413769.translation: 他们仔细筛查密尔湖岸浅滩，搜寻往昔时代的遗宝。如果这时刚好撞见落单旅人，更是正中下怀。

413773.oracleText: "Poor, lost mage. Your feet are on land, yet you're in over your head, aren't you?"
413773.translation: 「迷途法师，你真可怜。虽然你双脚还在地上，但你整个人都已动弹不得，不是吗？」

413774.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a blue spell.
413774.translation: 如果此咒语以蓝色咒语为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

413775.oracleText:
"Sometimes the hardest choice is between two wonders."
—Gadwick, the Wizened
413775.translation:
「有时候，在两个奇迹中作选择才最困难。」
～老年法师盖威克

413781.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a creature, tap that creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
413781.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，横置该生物。它于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

413782.oracleText: Whenever Queen of Ice deals combat damage to a creature, tap that creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
413782.translation: 每当寒冰女王对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，横置该生物。它于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

413784.oracleText:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile
413784.translation:
「无论是由何种心灵所激发，美德仍然还是美德。」
～凡翠丝流犯马拉坎

413785.oracleText: Choose two target creatures controlled by different players. Return those creatures to their owners' hands.
413785.translation: 选择两个目标由不同牌手操控的生物。将这些生物移回其拥有者手上。

413787.oracleText: Ask a merfolk even a simple question and the answer is a journey far beyond the known.
413787.translation: 哪怕只是抱着简单问题，只要你虚心向人鱼请教，对方的回答也能带你领略超凡旅程。

413791.oracleText: His sword sounded like a silver chime on the glass jar, and the sprite laughed with delight.
413791.translation: 被关在玻璃瓶中的他不断用长剑敲击瓶壁，发出银铃般清脆声响。见到此景，仙子脸上露出得意笑容。

413792.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets -2/-0. It gets -6/-0 instead as long as its controller has seven or more cards in their graveyard.
413792.translation: 所结附的生物得-2/-0。只要该生物的操控者坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，便改为它得-6/-0。

413794.oracleText:
"If we didn't guard our secrets, they wouldn't remain secrets for long."
—Gadwick, the Wizened
413794.translation:
「如果我们不去守护秘密，那么秘密本身很快就不再神秘。」
～老年法师盖威克

413795.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
413795.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

413796.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, Steelgaze Griffin gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
413796.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，钢目狮鹫得+2/+0直到回合结束。

413798.oracleText: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.
413798.translation: 幻野居民也不总是想靠武力赶走入侵者。有时他们就只是把对方弄走。

413801.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of cards in your hand.
413801.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你的手牌数量。

413802.oracleText: Syr Elenora, the Discerning's power is equal to the number of cards in your hand.
413802.translation: 慧眼伊诺拉爵士的力量等同于你的手牌数量。

413804.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target Syr Elenora cost {o2} more to cast.
413804.translation: 对手施放之以伊诺拉爵士为目标的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

413806.oracleText: "Humans are so forgetful. Every page I steal becomes a secret they can't remember."
413806.translation: 「人类可真健忘。我偷的每张书页，竟都成了他们无法想起的秘密。」

413809.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Draw a card. Adamant — If at least three blue mana was spent to cast this spell, create a Food token.
413809.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。抓一张牌。固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点蓝色法术力，则派出一个食品衍生物。

413810.oracleText:
Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Draw a card. 
Adamant — If at least three blue mana was spent to cast this spell, create a Food token.
413810.translation:
将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。抓一张牌。
固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点蓝色法术力，则派出一个食品衍生物。

413812.oracleText: Rowan and Will exchanged a baffled glance. Could the stag in the vision lead them to their father?
413812.translation: 萝婉和威尔面面相觑：景象中的雄鹿是否能帮助他们找到父王下落？

413813.oracleText: Draw three cards. Adamant — If at least three blue mana was spent to cast this spell, scry 3.
413813.translation: 抓三张牌。固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点蓝色法术力，则占卜3。

413814.oracleText:
Draw three cards. 
Adamant — If at least three blue mana was spent to cast this spell, scry 3.
413814.translation:
抓三张牌。
固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点蓝色法术力，则占卜3。

413816.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack unless defending player has seven or more cards in their graveyard.
413816.translation: 除非防御牌手的坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，否则CARDNAME不能攻击。

413817.oracleText: Vantress Gargoyle can't attack unless defending player has seven or more cards in their graveyard.
413817.translation: 除非防御牌手的坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，否则凡翠丝石像鬼不能攻击。

413818.oracleText: CARDNAME can't block unless you have four or more cards in hand.
413818.translation: 除非你有四张或更多手牌，否则CARDNAME不能进行阻挡。

413819.oracleText: Vantress Gargoyle can't block unless you have four or more cards in hand.
413819.translation: 除非你有四张或更多手牌，否则凡翠丝石像鬼不能进行阻挡。

413821.oracleText: "Someone knows where the king is. They can't expect to keep it a secret from us."
413821.translation: 「一定有人知道国王在哪。他们不可能一直守着秘密不让我们晓得。」

413825.oracleText: She yearned to walk on dry land so she might take her vengeance there.
413825.translation: 她渴望能在陆上自如行走，如此才能亲自雪恨。

413826.oracleText: {o1oU}: CARDNAME loses defender and becomes a Human until end of turn.
413826.translation: {o1oU}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME失去守军异能且成为人类。

413827.oracleText: {o1oU}: Wishful Merfolk loses defender and becomes a Human until end of turn.
413827.translation: {o1oU}：直到回合结束，念愿人鱼失去守军异能且成为人类。

413829.oracleText: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.
413829.translation: 这口井是由密尔湖巫婆所造。它成全的，绝大多数都是自己的愿望。

413832.oracleText: {o3oU}, Sacrifice Witching Well: Draw two cards.

413835.oracleText: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.
413835.translation: 随着她选定继任准夫婿，原本的丧事就直接变成了喜事。

413838.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another black creature: Draw a card.
413838.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个黑色生物：抓一张牌。

413840.oracleText: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."
413840.translation: 「我的秘密配方？这我可不能告诉你。不过可以稍微提示一下。反正不是爱。」

413841.oracleText: Destroy target creature. Create a Food token.
413841.translation: 消灭目标生物。派出一个食品衍生物。

413844.oracleText:
"Taste the sweetness, breath for breath.
Keep the balance, death for death."
—Barrow witch incantation
413844.translation:
「甜美气息，口口相继。
平衡生死，命命相抵。」
～荒野巫婆咒文

413848.oracleText: Locthwain knights take pride in being the last ones standing in a fight or on a dance floor.
413848.translation: 无论是战场还是舞池，洛司温骑士都以站到最后为荣。

413849.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, other Knights you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
413849.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，由你操控的其他骑士得+1/+0直到回合结束。

413850.oracleText: Whenever Belle of the Brawl attacks, other Knights you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
413850.translation: 每当争锋巾帼攻击时，由你操控的其他骑士得+1/+0直到回合结束。

413852.oracleText: The Blacklances travel deep into the wilds, sometimes for years at a time, in search of the lost Cauldron of Eternity.
413852.translation: 乌枪骑士团为搜寻失落的永恒鼎镬，经常深入幻野，有时甚至数年不归。

413856.oracleText:
"The faerie plucked an acorn off the ground. One knight's quest was about to come to a bitter end."
—Tales of the Fae
413856.translation:
「仙灵从地上抄起一枚橡实。看来某位骑士的旅程即将以失败告终。」
～《仙儿传说》

413857.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice a Food: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
413857.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲一个食品：目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。

413859.oracleText: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.
413859.translation: 这只猫每天都会回来杀掉同一只老鼠，而老鼠每次都会掉入沸腾的鼎镬当中。

413861.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield.
413861.translation: 牺牲一个食品：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场。

413862.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Return Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
413862.translation: 牺牲一个食品：将鼎镬佣兽从你的坟墓场移回战场。

413864.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each creature card in your graveyard.
413864.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

413865.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, put it on the bottom of its owner's library.
413865.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

413869.oracleText: You may choose a creature card in your graveyard. If you do, return it to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
413869.translation: 你可以选择一张在你坟墓场中的生物牌。如果你如此作，则将它移回战场，且上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。

413873.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, any opponent may sacrifice a creature. If a player does, tap CARDNAME, you gain 3 life, and you draw a card.
413873.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，任意对手可以牺牲一个生物。若有牌手如此作，则横置CARDNAME，你获得3点生命，且你抓一张牌。

413874.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, any opponent may sacrifice a creature. If a player does, tap Clackbridge Troll, you gain 3 life, and you draw a card.
413874.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，任意对手可以牺牲一个生物。若有牌手如此作，则横置响桥巨魔，你获得3点生命，且你抓一张牌。

413876.oracleText: The dragon had a lot of things going through his mind that day. He didn't expect a sword to be one of them.
413876.translation: 巨龙那天脑袋里有很多东西穿过。但万万没想到会有一把剑穿过。

413879.oracleText: "Lord Rankle will see you now—all he asks is a small token of tribute."
413879.translation: 「兰卡大人现在肯见你了～他只要你献出一份小礼。」

413883.oracleText:
"Even as we mourn the last, we look to the next with joy. Hopefully, my new suitor will bring the Cauldron home."
—Ayara, First of Locthwain
413883.translation:
「我们要为前任致哀，更要为后任贺喜。希望我的继任准夫婿能把鼎镬安全带回。」
～洛司温首领阿娅拉

413884.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your graveyard.
413884.translation: 目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中牌的数量。

413886.oracleText: Target player draws two cards and loses 2 life. Adamant — If at least three black mana was spent to cast this spell, create a Food token.
413886.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点黑色法术力，则派出一个食品衍生物。

413887.oracleText:
Target player draws two cards and loses 2 life. 
Adamant — If at least three black mana was spent to cast this spell, create a Food token.
413887.translation:
目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。
固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点黑色法术力，则派出一个食品衍生物。

413889.oracleText: Those who say you only live once have never been touched by the Cauldron of Eternity.
413889.translation: 那些口口声声说生命只有一次的人，从未领受过永恒鼎镬的神奇。

413892.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a creature, create a Food token.
413892.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，派出一个食品衍生物。

413894.oracleText:
"Another angry mob? When will they learn to leave me be?"
—Terryn, Edgewall outcast
413894.translation:
「又一群愤怒暴民？他们要到什么时候才晓得不该来烦我？」
～边墙镇黜人泰琳

413895.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+1 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
413895.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+1且获得死触异能。

413897.oracleText: "I will find the king if I have to ride from summer to winter and back again."
413897.translation: 「我定将找回国王，纵使为此遍历寒暑也在所不辞。」

413901.oracleText: Even death cannot diminish the persistence of the knights of Locthwain.
413901.translation: 洛司温骑士坚韧不拔，就连死亡都无法动摇分毫。

413904.oracleText: He has slain a dozen witches, luring each with a promise of fresh children's bones.
413904.translation: 他以新鲜孩童尸骨作饵，藉此猎杀巫婆达十数人之众。

413905.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice an artifact or another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
413905.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个神器或另一个生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

413906.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice an artifact or another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on Malevolent Noble.
413906.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个神器或另一个生物：在恶毒贵族上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

413908.oracleText: In the wilds, the ravens steal far more than baubles.
413908.translation: 幻野之中的乌鸦，偷的可不只有饰品。

413909.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card. You may put a card that has an Adventure that player owns from exile into that player's graveyard.
413909.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。你可以将一张由该牌手拥有且具有历险的牌从放逐区置入该牌手的坟墓场。

413911.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put it on the bottom of its owner's library.
413911.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

413912.oracleText: When Murderous Rider dies, put it on the bottom of its owner's library.
413912.translation: 当夺魂骑兵死去时，将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

413915.oracleText: Oathsworn Knight attacks each combat if able.
413915.translation: 守誓骑士每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

413916.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to CARDNAME while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove a +1/+1 counter from it.
413916.translation: 如果CARDNAME于其上有+1/+1指示物时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并从其上移去一个+1/+1指示物。

413917.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to Oathsworn Knight while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove a +1/+1 counter from it.
413917.translation: 如果守誓骑士于其上有+1/+1指示物时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并从守誓骑士上移去一个+1/+1指示物。

413919.translation: 午夜骑士团不能进行阻挡。

413921.oracleText: "If it has ears, it will dance to my tune."
413921.translation: 「只要它有耳朵，就会随着我的旋律起舞。」

413922.translation: 由你操控的老鼠具有威慑异能。

413923.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 black Rat creature token.
413923.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}：派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物。

413924.oracleText: {o2oBoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice three Rats: Gain control of target creature.
413924.translation: {o2oBoB}，{oT}，牺牲三个老鼠：获得目标生物的操控权。

413928.oracleText: Each player loses 1 life and draws a card.
413928.translation: 每位牌手失去1点生命且各抓一张牌。

413929.oracleText: Each player loses 1 life and draws a card.
413929.translation: 每位牌手失去1点生命且各抓一张牌。

413930.translation: 每位牌手各牺牲一个生物。

413931.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, choose any number — • Each player discards a card. • Each player loses 1 life and draws a card. • Each player sacrifices a creature.
413931.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，选择任意数量的选项～ •  每位牌手各弃一张牌。 •  每位牌手失去1点生命且各抓一张牌。 •  每位牌手各牺牲一个生物。

413932.oracleText: Whenever Rankle, Master of Pranks deals combat damage to a player, choose any number — • Each player discards a card. • Each player loses 1 life and draws a card. • Each player sacrifices a creature.
413932.translation: 每当恶戏之王兰卡对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，选择任意数量的选项～ •  每位牌手各弃一张牌。 •  每位牌手失去1点生命且各抓一张牌。 •  每位牌手各牺牲一个生物。

413934.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if defending player has two or fewer cards in hand, it gains flying until end of turn.
413934.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若防御牌手的手牌为两张或更少，则它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

413935.oracleText: Whenever Reaper of Night attacks, if defending player has two or fewer cards in hand, it gains flying until end of turn.
413935.translation: 每当暗夜死神攻击时，若防御牌手的手牌为两张或更少，则它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

413936.oracleText:
"Into amethyst, I pour
Envy's shadow, sorrow's gleam.
Lure the one whose scorn I bore
That I may hear one final scream."
—Barrow witch incantation
413936.translation:
「水晶为器，注我心意：
忌妒难解，悲伤满溢；
心厌之人，速速靠近，
苦痛加身，魂魄散尽。」
～荒野巫婆咒文

413938.oracleText: Syr Tasdale declared that he never wanted to see the witch Ygretta again. Her familiars quickly granted his request.
413938.translation: 塔戴尔爵士刚说完自己再也不想见到巫婆依葛塔，后者的佣兽很快便满足了他的要求。

413939.oracleText: Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, that creature's controller loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
413939.translation: 每当一个生物攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客时，该生物的操控者失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

413941.oracleText: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."
413941.translation: 「我的使命？那还用说，当然是跟阿娅拉成婚。或者是死在成婚征途上。」

413943.oracleText:
"Imagine having your skeleton extracted through your ear, one bone at a time."
—Corliss the Wanderer
413943.translation:
「就想象是把你全身的骨头一根一根地从耳朵抽出来。」
～云游者柯力斯

413944.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player exiles that card. If a nonblack card is exiled this way, exile a card from your hand.
413944.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。如果你如此作，则该牌手放逐该牌。如果以此法放逐一张非黑色的牌，则从你手上放逐一张牌。

413946.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, or a creature card is put into a graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, or a creature card leaves your graveyard, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
413946.translation: 每当另一个生物死去，或一张生物牌从战场以外的任何区域进入坟墓场，或一张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

413947.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, or a creature card is put into a graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, or a creature card leaves your graveyard, Syr Konrad, the Grim deals 1 damage to each opponent.
413947.translation: 每当另一个生物死去，或一张生物牌从战场以外的任何区域进入坟墓场，或一张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，冷酷孔纳德爵士向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

413950.oracleText:
"Murder clad in crimson beauty,
An end to life and love and duty."
—Barrow witch incantation
413950.translation:
「谋杀外衣腥红美丽，
终结一生爱恨情义。」
～荒野巫婆咒文

413952.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Food: Target player loses 3 life.
413952.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲一个食品：目标牌手失去3点生命。

413954.oracleText: "Some are born to greatness. You were born to scrub greatness's floors."
413954.translation: 「有些人生来就是伟人。而你生来就是给伟人擦地板的。」

413962.oracleText: The hex swept through the village, its citizens falling one by one.
413962.translation: 邪术扫过村庄，村民纷纷倒下。

413963.oracleText: Creatures of the creature type of your choice get -3/-3 until end of turn.
413963.translation: 选择一种生物类别。该类别生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。

413965.oracleText: The giant had heard of locks, but he had yet to discover a door he couldn't open.
413965.translation: 虽然这巨人知道有种东西叫做锁，但他到现在还没遇到过打不开的门。

413966.oracleText: Target attacking creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Each attacking non-Human creature gains trample until end of turn.
413966.translation: 目标进行攻击的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。每个进行攻击的非人类生物均获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

413968.oracleText:
"Build a moat. If we're lucky, it can't swim."
—Syr Branigan, knight of Ardenvale
413968.translation:
「建条护城河。如果运气好的话，它游不了泳。」
～雅登瓦骑士，巴尼根爵士

413969.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and gains first strike until end of turn.
413969.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+1且获得先攻异能。

413970.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, Bloodhaze Wolverine gets +1/+1 and gains first strike until end of turn.
413970.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，血迷狼獾得+1/+1且获得先攻异能。

413972.oracleText:
"You think these walls will protect you? My, you have a dim view of the power of the wilds."
—Marawen, barrow witch
413972.translation:
「以为躲在墙后就能逃过一劫？唉，你们对幻野的力量一无所知。」
～荒野巫婆玛拉雯

413973.oracleText: Up to three target creatures can't block this turn. Destroy any of them that are Walls.
413973.translation: 至多三个目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。消灭其中所有为墙的生物。

413975.oracleText: Not every tale ends in glory.
413975.translation: 并非每个故事都有完满结局。

413979.oracleText: {oT}: Brimstone Trebuchet deals 1 damage to each opponent.
413979.translation: {oT}：火岩抛石机向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

413983.oracleText: "For every scar I've received, I've given ten back."
413983.translation: 「我身上的每道伤疤，我都已十倍奉还。」

413987.oracleText:
"The deal was struck and the favor had been done. And so, under the cover of night, the debt was paid."
—Tales of the Fae
413987.translation:
「对价早谈妥，事情已办完。月黑风高夜，报酬随人去。」
～《仙儿传说》

413990.oracleText:
"After the death of her mother, Cassia found that things that appear fragile can be very strong indeed."
—Beyond the Great Henge
413990.translation:
「母亲去世后，卡熙雅才发现，原来外表脆弱之人，内心也可以如此坚强。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

413991.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has haste.
413991.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

413993.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each attacking creature you control.
413993.translation: 你每操控一个进行攻击的生物，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

413995.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has double strike and trample.
413995.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有连击与践踏异能。

413997.oracleText: "The king would die for the realm. I would not hesitate to do the same for him."
413997.translation: 「国王甘愿为世境牺牲自己。我甘愿为国王牺牲自己。」

414001.oracleText: "Courage is the only shield I need."

414003.oracleText: Knights who excel in tournaments sometimes underestimate threats beyond the realm.
414003.translation: 精于竞技比武的骑士在面对世境之外的敌手时，偶尔会低估对方实力。

414004.oracleText: Attacking non-Human creatures you control get +1/+0 and have trample.
414004.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的非人类生物得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

414007.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking Knight you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
414007.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标由你操控且进行攻击的骑士得+1/+0直到回合结束。

414008.oracleText: Whenever Fervent Champion attacks, another target attacking Knight you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
414008.translation: 每当热忱冠军攻击时，另一个目标由你操控且进行攻击的骑士得+1/+0直到回合结束。

414009.oracleText: Equip abilities you activate that target CARDNAME cost {o3} less to activate.
414009.translation: 你起动之以CARDNAME为目标的佩带异能减少{o3}来起动。

414010.oracleText: Equip abilities you activate that target Fervent Champion cost {o3} less to activate.
414010.translation: 你起动之以热忱冠军为目标的佩带异能减少{o3}来起动。

414012.oracleText: "Just tell us how many you want and get out of the way."
414012.translation: 「只管说要多少数量，然后别碍着我们。」

414013.oracleText: You can cast spells only during your turn and you can cast no more than two spells each turn.
414013.translation: 你只能于你的回合中施放咒语，且你每回合所施放的咒语不能多于两个。

414015.oracleText: Giants believe that tossing redcaps at knights is the best way to deal with both.
414015.translation: 对巨人来说，把红帽客往骑士群里丢过去，是同时解决两个烦恼的最好办法。

414017.oracleText: The greatest challenge isn't the stifling heat but the crushing weight of those who failed before.
414017.translation: 此处最大的挑战，并非烈焰导致的窒息高温，而是先前未竟者的热切期盼。

414018.oracleText: Add seven {oR}. You can cast only one more spell this turn.
414018.translation: 加七点{oR}。本回合中，你只能再施放一个咒语。

414020.oracleText: "Fear of fire is a sensible instinct. If I were you, I'd be terrified."
414020.translation: 「恐惧火焰是可以理解的本能反应。如果我是你的话，早该吓坏了。」

414021.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
414021.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

414022.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, Irencrag Pyromancer deals 3 damage to any target.
414022.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，伊雷岩烈焰术士对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

414024.oracleText:
"Life is a tournament that rewards the bold."
—Syr Layne, knight of Embereth
414024.translation:
「生活就是一场比武，唯有最勇猛者方能得益。」
～鞍博雷骑士，蕾妮爵士

414025.oracleText: Choose target creature you control and target creature you don't control. The creature you control gets +2/+1 until end of turn if it's a Knight. Then those creatures fight each other.
414025.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物和目标不由你操控的生物。如果该由你操控的生物是骑士，则它得+2/+1直到回合结束。然后这些生物互斗。

414027.oracleText: "Gather round and tell me all from the courts and castles."
414027.translation: 「都过来，跟我说说宫殿城堡中的大事小事。」

414028.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create two 1/1 black Rat creature tokens.
414028.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，派出两个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物。

414030.oracleText: "Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value."
414030.translation: 「回收老旧废物。出售珍奇古玩。」

414031.oracleText: {o2oR}, Discard a card: Draw a card.

414034.oracleText: Knights kept returning from Ogre's Pass wearing nothing but bruises, so they decided to just pretend it was on their side.
414034.translation: 凡是途经食人魔隘口的骑士总是丢盔弃甲、满身瘀伤而回，他们决定当作它是跟自己一边的。

414035.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking Knight gains menace until end of turn.
414035.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的骑士获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

414036.oracleText: Whenever Ogre Errant attacks, another target attacking Knight gains menace until end of turn.
414036.translation: 每当食人魔游侠攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的骑士获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

414041.oracleText: Many tales of redcap terror begin with two simple things: bloodlust and stolen steel.
414041.translation: 许多红帽客的恐怖故事都以两件小事开头：杀气激昂，武器遭窃。

414043.oracleText: At first, Syr Fenwick scoffed when he saw his opponents for the final match.
414043.translation: 一开始，芬威克爵士并没有把决赛对手放在眼里。

414044.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If a nonred permanent is dealt damage this way, you sacrifice a land.
414044.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果有非红色的永久物以此法受到伤害，则你牺牲一个地。

414045.oracleText: Redcap Melee deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If a nonred permanent is dealt damage this way, you sacrifice a land.
414045.translation: 红帽客搏战对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果有非红色的永久物以此法受到伤害，则你牺牲一个地。

414047.oracleText:
"I admire their courage as much as I despise their savagery."
—Syr Carah, the Bold
414047.translation:
「我鄙夷他们的蛮野，但我欣赏他们的勇气。」
～勇威凯拉爵士

414048.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may tap an untapped non-Human creature you control. If you do, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
414048.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的非人类生物。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

414049.oracleText: Whenever Redcap Raiders attacks, you may tap an untapped non-Human creature you control. If you do, Redcap Raiders gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
414049.translation: 每当红帽客突击队攻击时，你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的非人类生物。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，红帽客突击队得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

414052.translation: 岩圈骑士不能进行阻挡。

414055.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if defending player has more cards in hand than you, exile the top card of their library. During any turn you attacked with a Rogue, you may cast that card and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.
414055.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若防御牌手的手牌数量比你多，则放逐防御牌手的牌库顶牌。于你以浪客攻击过的回合中，你可以施放该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

414056.oracleText: Whenever Robber of the Rich attacks, if defending player has more cards in hand than you, exile the top card of their library. During any turn you attacked with a Rogue, you may cast that card and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.
414056.translation: 每当劫富侠客攻击时，若防御牌手的手牌数量比你多，则放逐防御牌手的牌库顶牌。于你以浪客攻击过的回合中，你可以施放该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

414058.oracleText: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.
414058.translation: 眼见来袭火焰即将吞没自己，艾默莉爵士索性闭上双眼，在脑海中回想起雅登瓦堡的点点滴滴，好让家乡成为自己最后的回忆。

414059.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
414059.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

414060.oracleText: Scorching Dragonfire deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
414060.translation: 焦热龙炎对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

414062.oracleText: It emerged from the coldest depths of Lochmere only to face the fires of Irencrag.
414062.translation: 它从密尔湖冰寒深处一跃而出，却只见到伊雷岩烈焰相迎。

414063.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature. Adamant — If at least three red mana was spent to cast this spell, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.
414063.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成5点伤害。固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点红色法术力，则CARDNAME对该生物的操控者造成3点伤害。

414064.oracleText:
Searing Barrage deals 5 damage to target creature. 
Adamant — If at least three red mana was spent to cast this spell, Searing Barrage deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.
414064.translation:
炙火齐射对目标生物造成5点伤害。
固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点红色法术力，则炙火齐射对该生物的操控者造成3点伤害。

414066.oracleText:
"The gleam of rubies and my brothers and sisters by my side . . . what more could I want?"
—Brognold the Third
414066.translation:
「手中宝石辉光闪耀，身旁兄弟姐妹环绕…人生如此，夫复何求？」
～老三鲍诺

414068.oracleText: Seven Dwarves gets +1/+1 for each other creature named Seven Dwarves you control.
414068.translation: 你每操控一个其他名称为七个矮人的生物，七个矮人便得+1/+1。

414070.oracleText: A deck can have up to seven cards named Seven Dwarves.
414070.translation: 名称为七个矮人的牌，在套牌中的数量能有至多七张。

414072.oracleText: The ogre crashed through the massive door. The winged folios scattered like frightened birds.
414072.translation: 食人魔使尽全力破门而入。门后书籍受力四处飞散，好似受惊鸟儿扑翼逃窜。

414073.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage to an opponent, that player discards a card at random. If the player does, they draw a card.
414073.translation: 每当CARDNAME向任一对手造成伤害时，该牌手随机弃一张牌。若该牌手如此作，则其抓一张牌。

414074.oracleText: Whenever Skullknocker Ogre deals damage to an opponent, that player discards a card at random. If the player does, they draw a card.
414074.translation: 每当莽顶食人魔向任一对手造成伤害时，该牌手随机弃一张牌。若该牌手如此作，则其抓一张牌。

414076.oracleText: The purest virtue burns brighter than the sun and hotter than dragonfire.
414076.translation: 最纯粹的美德比阳光更耀眼，比龙焰更炽热。

414077.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. Adamant — If at least three red mana was spent to cast this spell, it deals 4 damage instead.
414077.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点红色法术力，则改为它造成4点伤害。

414078.oracleText:
Slaying Fire deals 3 damage to any target. 
Adamant — If at least three red mana was spent to cast this spell, it deals 4 damage instead.
414078.translation:
戕命火焰对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。
固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点红色法术力，则改为它造成4点伤害。

414080.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 7 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets. If at least seven red mana was spent to cast this spell, instead CARDNAME deals 7 damage to each of those permanents and/or players.
414080.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共7点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果施放此咒语时支付过至少七点红色法术力，则改为CARDNAME对每个这些永久物和／或牌手各造成7点伤害。

414081.oracleText: Sundering Stroke deals 7 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets. If at least seven red mana was spent to cast this spell, instead Sundering Stroke deals 7 damage to each of those permanents and/or players.
414081.translation: 碎裂斩对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共7点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果施放此咒语时支付过至少七点红色法术力，则改为碎裂斩对每个这些永久物和／或牌手各造成7点伤害。

414083.oracleText: "Duty and honor are reasons enough, but beating you will also be a pleasure."
414083.translation: 「责任和荣誉就足以让我动手，而亲自对付你则更大快人心。」

414084.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or an instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
414084.translation: 每当CARDNAME或由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语对任一牌手造成伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

414085.oracleText: Whenever Syr Carah, the Bold or an instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
414085.translation: 每当勇威凯拉爵士或由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语对任一牌手造成伤害时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

414086.oracleText: {oT}: Syr Carah deals 1 damage to any target.
414086.translation: {oT}：凯拉爵士对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

414088.oracleText:
"Remember all the great heroes who were careful and never did anything risky? Me neither."
—Syr Carah, the Bold
414088.translation:
「那些谨小慎微，从不愿冒险的骑士，你记得住他们的名字吗？我也记不住。」
～勇威凯拉爵士

414091.oracleText: A dwarf's grudge runs deeper than the mountains' roots.
414091.translation: 矮人一旦记仇，积怨便如山谷一样深不见底。

414092.oracleText: If a red source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
414092.translation: 如果某个由你操控的红色来源将向任一对手或任一由对手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量加2点伤害。

414094.oracleText:
"I would rather cast myself into the abyss than let my blood stain the cap of those monsters."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
414094.translation:
「我宁愿让自己坠入深渊，也不愿让这些怪物的帽子沾染我的鲜血。」
～狮爪艾林爵士

414095.oracleText: {o1oR}: Weaselback Redcap gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
414095.translation: {o1oR}：鼬背红帽客得+2/+0直到回合结束。

414097.oracleText: Beanstalk Giant's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
414097.translation: 豆茎巨人的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

414099.oracleText: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"
414099.translation: 「这是姜饼，和妈妈做的一样。有什么好怕的呢？」

414101.oracleText: "Warmth. Safety. A fully-stocked larder. You'll find nothing like Edgewall Keep in the wilds, I promise you that!"
414101.translation: 「温暖舒适。安全无忧。食物充足。你在幻野里绝对找不到跟边墙砦一样的地方，我保证！」

414102.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell that has an Adventure, draw a card.
414102.translation: 每当你施放具有历险的生物咒语时，抓一张牌。

414110.oracleText:
"A keen eye and steady hand are essential for defeating most foes, including hunger."
—Syr Grenphire, knight of Garenbrig
414110.translation:
「只要你眼神尖锐，身手稳健，就能够击败绝大多数敌人，包括饥饿。」
～盖伦碧骑士，格伦斐爵士

414111.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature with flying. Create a Food token.
414111.translation: CARDNAME对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。派出一个食品衍生物。

414112.oracleText: Fell the Pheasant deals 5 damage to target creature with flying. Create a Food token.
414112.translation: 猎取雉鸡对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。派出一个食品衍生物。

414114.oracleText: While the realm has laws, in the wilds there are other ways of balancing power.
414114.translation: 世境依靠法律均衡力量，幻野依靠的是其他办法。

414117.oracleText: The middle blade was just right.

414118.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. When you do, destroy target artifact or enchantment.
414118.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。当你如此作时，消灭目标神器或结界。

414119.oracleText: Whenever Flaxen Intruder deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. When you do, destroy target artifact or enchantment.
414119.translation: 每当金发入侵者对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。当你如此作时，消灭目标神器或结界。

414121.oracleText: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.
414121.translation: 他的手艺精湛无匹，数不清的盖伦碧骑士都托他之福而保住性命。

414125.oracleText: Garenbrig Paladin can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
414125.translation: 盖伦碧神圣武士不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

414127.oracleText:
"Find him a weapon as big as his dreams."
—Yorvo, lord of Garenbrig
414127.translation:
「给他一柄跟他梦想一样大的武器。」
～盖伦碧王约沃

414128.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell that has an Adventure, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
414128.translation: 每当你施放具有历险的生物咒语时，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

414131.oracleText: They look tasty, but best to plant them.
414131.translation: 虽然看着挺好吃，但最好还是拿去种。

414132.oracleText: You may sacrifice two Foods. If you do, create a 7/7 green Giant creature token. Otherwise, create three Food tokens.
414132.translation: 你可以牺牲两个食品。如果你如此作，则派出一个7/7绿色巨人衍生生物。若否，则派出三个食品衍生物。

414136.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a Food: Add one mana of any color.
414136.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个食品：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

414138.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
414138.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为由你操控之生物中的最大力量。

414142.oracleText: He ate them out of house and home and shed and barn and flock and herd.
414142.translation: 他吃空了他们的房子、家园、农舍、谷仓、鸡鸭、猪羊。

414143.oracleText: You may sacrifice a Food. If you do, target creature gets +5/+5 until end of turn. Otherwise, that creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
414143.translation: 你可以牺牲一个食品。如果你如此作，则目标生物得+5/+5直到回合结束。若否，则该生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。

414145.oracleText:
"Only the lion knows more stories than I do."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales
414145.translation:
「只有那头狮子知道的故事比我多。」
～说书人楚兰

414146.oracleText: Whenever one or more non-Human creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
414146.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的非人类生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

414149.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a green Elk creature with base power and toughness 3/3.
414149.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为3/3的绿色麋鹿生物。

414152.oracleText: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.
414152.translation: 他的思想选择独处，但内心表示反对。

414153.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack unless you control a 1/1 creature.
414153.translation: 除非你操控1/1生物，否则CARDNAME不能攻击。

414154.oracleText: Lovestruck Beast can't attack unless you control a 1/1 creature.
414154.translation: 除非你操控1/1生物，否则热恋野兽不能攻击。

414157.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Target creature blocks CARDNAME this turn if able.
414157.translation: 牺牲一个食品：目标生物本回合若能阻挡CARDNAME，则须阻挡之。

414158.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Target creature blocks Maraleaf Rider this turn if able.
414158.translation: 牺牲一个食品：目标生物本回合若能阻挡马利夫骑兵，则须阻挡之。

414160.oracleText: The elves remember every secret path from the days when they ruled the realm.
414160.translation: 妖精还记得他们称雄世境期间留下的每条秘密通路。

414162.oracleText: Whenever Oakhame Adversary deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
414162.translation: 每当橡树宫仇敌对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

414164.oracleText: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand. Put up to one other target card from your graveyard on top of your library. Exile CARDNAME. Adamant — If at least three green mana was spent to cast this spell, instead return those cards to your hand and exile CARDNAME.
414164.translation: 将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。将至多另一张目标牌从你坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。放逐CARDNAME。固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点绿色法术力，则改为将这些牌移回你手上并放逐CARDNAME。

414165.oracleText:
Return target card from your graveyard to your hand. Put up to one other target card from your graveyard on top of your library. Exile Once and Future. 
Adamant — If at least three green mana was spent to cast this spell, instead return those cards to your hand and exile Once and Future.
414165.translation:
将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。将至多另一张目标牌从你坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。放逐王脉永传。
固色～如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点绿色法术力，则改为将这些牌移回你手上并放逐王脉永传。

414167.oracleText: If this spell is the first spell you've cast this game, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
414167.translation: 如果此咒语是你本盘游戏中施放的第一个咒语，则你施放它时可以不需支付其法术力费用。

414168.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
414168.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物或地牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

414173.oracleText: Questing Beast can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
414173.translation: 寻水兽不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

414174.oracleText: Combat damage that would be dealt by creatures you control can't be prevented.
414174.translation: 由你操控之生物所造成的战斗伤害不能被防止。

414175.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to target planeswalker that player controls.
414175.translation: 每当CARDNAME向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，它对目标由该牌手操控的鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

414176.oracleText: Whenever Questing Beast deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to target planeswalker that player controls.
414176.translation: 每当寻水兽向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，它对目标由该牌手操控的鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

414179.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the greatest power among non-Human creatures you control.
414179.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控之非人类生物中的最大力量。

414180.oracleText: Non-Human creatures you control get +3/+3 until end of turn.
414180.translation: 由你操控的非人类生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。

414181.oracleText: Choose one — • Draw cards equal to the greatest power among non-Human creatures you control. • Non-Human creatures you control get +3/+3 until end of turn.
414181.translation: 选择一项～ •  抓若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控的非人类生物中力量最大者的数值。 •  由你操控的非人类生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。

414182.oracleText:
"Long after the magic wore off, the mice still dreamed of glorious galloping."
—Tales of the Fae
414182.translation:
「纵使在魔力消退许久之后，小鼠仍还做着驰骋奔跑的美梦。」
～《仙儿传说》

414184.oracleText: "Old battlefields make great gardens. So rich from the blood of the fallen."
414184.translation: 「故时战场现花舞。逝者鲜血滋沃土。」

414188.oracleText: After years of taunts and aerial assaults from Rankle's minions, the witches of Maraleaf Forest acquired new familiars.
414188.translation: 受够了兰卡手下长年累月的空袭滋扰，马利夫树林的巫婆找到了新的佣兽。

414190.oracleText: "Words are pointless. It's what you do with your hammer that counts."
414190.translation: 「信口开河毫无意义。唯有用手中重锤方能开拓天地。」

414191.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is Syr Faren's power.
414191.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为芳纶爵士的力量。

414192.oracleText: Whenever Syr Faren, the Hengehammer attacks, another target attacking creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is Syr Faren's power.
414192.translation: 每当阵锤芳纶爵士攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为芳纶爵士的力量。

414194.oracleText: He realized a bit late that he was supposed to plant the magic beans.
414194.translation: 等到他反应过来魔豆该是拿来种的时候，已为时过晚。

414195.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+3, has reach, and is a Giant in addition to its other types.
414195.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+3，具有延势异能，且额外具有巨人此类别。

414198.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Food, you may pay {o1}. If you do, look at the top two cards of your library. You may reveal a permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
414198.translation: 每当你牺牲一个食品时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则检视你牌库顶的两张牌。你可以展示其中的一张永久物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

414200.oracleText: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."
414200.translation: 「虽然现在你还只是脆弱枝桠，但我能帮你加速成长。」

414204.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. It gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
414204.translation: 牺牲一个食品：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将之横置。

414205.oracleText: Sacrifice a Food: Put a +1/+1 counter on Wicked Wolf. It gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
414205.translation: 牺牲一个食品：在恶狼上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将之横置。

414210.oracleText: "This one was wearing shoes made of glass. She'll be no ordinary prey."
414210.translation: 「这人穿的是用玻璃做成的鞋子。她可不是普通的猎物。」

414211.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, if you control another non-Human creature, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
414211.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，若你操控另一个非人类生物，则CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

414212.oracleText: Whenever Wildwood Tracker attacks or blocks, if you control another non-Human creature, Wildwood Tracker gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
414212.translation: 每当幻野林侦猎手攻击或阻挡时，若你操控另一个非人类生物，则幻野林侦猎手得+1/+1直到回合结束。

414214.oracleText:
"The monster was gaining on them. Twice it had found them. There was only one place left to hide."
—Tales of the Fae
414214.translation:
「怪兽越追越近；眼看着又要追上它们了。现在只剩一个地方可躲。」
～《仙儿传说》

414215.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a Food token.
414215.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个食品衍生物。

414216.oracleText: Create three 1/1 green Boar creature tokens with "When this creature dies, create a Food token."
414216.translation: 派出三个1/1绿色野猪衍生生物，它们具有「当此生物死去时，派出一个食品衍生物。」

414224.oracleText: In the end, death usually has its way.
414224.translation: 到头来，死亡仍独行其是。

414225.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player sacrifices a nonland, nontoken permanent. If that player can't, they discard a card, they lose 2 life, you draw a card, you gain 2 life, you create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance, then you sacrifice CARDNAME.
414225.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，该牌手牺牲一个非地且非衍生物的永久物。若该牌手无法如此作，则他弃一张牌、失去2点生命，你抓一张牌、获得2点生命、派出一个2/2，具警戒异能的白色骑士衍生生物；然后你牺牲CARDNAME。

414226.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player sacrifices a nonland, nontoken permanent. If that player can't, they discard a card, they lose 2 life, you draw a card, you gain 2 life, you create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance, then you sacrifice Doom Foretold.
414226.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，该牌手牺牲一个非地且非衍生物的永久物。若该牌手无法如此作，则他弃一张牌、失去2点生命，你抓一张牌、获得2点生命、派出一个2/2，具警戒异能的白色骑士衍生生物；然后你牺牲末日前兆。

414232.oracleText: The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.
414232.translation: 卫兵生好炉火，然后锁上了艾尔雯闺房的大门。等到了早上的时候，炉火已全部熄灭，艾尔雯不知所踪。

414233.oracleText: Exile the top five cards of your library. You may play cards exiled this way until the end of your next turn.
414233.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的五张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用以此法放逐的牌。

414235.oracleText: Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.
414235.translation: 其根系广布泥壤，所吸取的不仅是水分。

414236.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each color among permanents you control.
414236.translation: 由你操控的永久物中每包括一种颜色，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

414237.oracleText: Faeburrow Elder gets +1/+1 for each color among permanents you control.
414237.translation: 由你操控的永久物中每包括一种颜色，仙林境接骨木便得+1/+1。

414239.oracleText: When this creature dies, put a loyalty counter on each Garruk you control.
414239.translation: 当此生物死去时，在每个由你操控的贾路上各放置一个忠诚指示物。

414240.oracleText: Create two 2/2 black and green Wolf creature tokens with "When this creature dies, put a loyalty counter on each Garruk you control."
414240.translation: 派出两个2/2，黑绿双色的狼衍生生物，它们具有「当此生物死去时，在每个由你操控的贾路上各放置一个忠诚指示物。」

414241.oracleText: Creatures you control get +3/+3 and have trample.
414241.translation: 由你操控的生物得+3/+3且具有践踏异能。

414242.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +3/+3 and have trample."
414242.translation: 你获得具有「由你操控的生物得+3/+3且具有践踏异能」的徽记。

414244.oracleText: "Does it matter what it is? Take it and be grateful!"
414244.translation: 「别问东问西的，只管吃下去，谢谢我就对了！」

414247.oracleText:
"I agreed to light his way as long as he always had my back."
—Squill, Mistford pixie
414247.translation:
「我答应为他照亮眼前道路，条件是他为我照看身后安全。」
～雾滩河碧仙丝奎尔

414248.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 blue Faerie creature token with flying.
414248.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵衍生生物。

414249.oracleText: {o4oUoR}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

414251.oracleText: "I fight for my daughter, who may not set foot on a battlefield for many years. Remember who you fight for."
414251.translation: 「我奋勇征战全是为了我的女儿，好让她将来多年都不用踏足沙场。问问自己你是为谁而战。」

414253.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice an Island: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
414253.translation: {oU}，牺牲一个海岛：CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

414254.oracleText: {oU}, Sacrifice an Island: Lochmere Serpent can't be blocked this turn.
414254.translation: {oU}，牺牲一个海岛：密尔湖巨蛇本回合不能被阻挡。

414255.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice a Swamp: You gain 1 life and draw a card.
414255.translation: {oB}，牺牲一个沼泽：你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

414259.oracleText: Neither hostile nor friendly, pixies flit through the forest seeking the treasures of the wilds.
414259.translation: 碧仙既无恶意，也没好心。他们只是穿梭林间，探寻幻野珍宝。

414263.oracleText: Target artifact or creature loses all abilities and becomes a green Elk creature with base power and toughness 3/3.
414263.translation: 目标神器或生物失去所有异能，且成为基础力量与防御力为3/3的绿色麋鹿生物。

414264.oracleText: Exchange control of target artifact or creature you control and target creature an opponent controls with power 3 or less.
414264.translation: 选择目标由你操控的神器或生物和目标由对手操控且力量等于或小于3的生物。交换两者的操控权。

414276.oracleText: Draw a card, then discard a card.
414276.translation: 抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

414277.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+0 and gains first strike and trample until end of turn.
414277.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得先攻与践踏异能。

414278.oracleText: Draw four cards. When you do, CARDNAME deals damage to any target equal to the number of cards in your hand.
414278.translation: 抓四张牌。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成等同于你手牌数量的伤害。

414279.oracleText: Draw four cards. When you do, The Royal Scions deals damage to any target equal to the number of cards in your hand.
414279.translation: 抓四张牌。当你如此作时，皇族双子对任意一个目标造成等同于你手牌数量的伤害。

414281.oracleText: None of the other villagers dare venture into the wilds, so she feeds the whole hamlet herself.
414281.translation: 其他村民都不敢踏进幻野，她得凭一己之力养活整个村庄。

414282.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, create a Food token.
414282.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，派出一个食品衍生物。

414283.oracleText: Whenever Savvy Hunter attacks or blocks, create a Food token.
414283.translation: 每当机敏猎人攻击或阻挡时，派出一个食品衍生物。

414284.oracleText: Sacrifice two Foods: Draw a card.
414284.translation: 牺牲两个食品：抓一张牌。

414286.oracleText: Shinechaser gets +1/+1 as long as you control an artifact.
414286.translation: 只要你操控神器，逐宝仙灵便得+1/+1。

414287.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 as long as you control an enchantment.

414288.oracleText: Shinechaser gets +1/+1 as long as you control an enchantment.
414288.translation: 只要你操控结界，逐宝仙灵便得+1/+1。

414290.oracleText:
"A traditional lance is fine for the Burning Yard, but in the wilds you need a nastier bite."
—Kenver, Embereth weaponsmith
414290.translation:
「普通的长枪在烬炼场里也许已经够用，但你在幻野会需要更厉害的家伙。」
～鞍博雷武器匠肯瓦

414293.oracleText:
"As she reached the pinnacle, lightning flashed and her eyes blazed with newfound power."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights
414293.translation:
「抵达颠峰后，天际电闪雷鸣，她双眼绽放出新生力量的辉光。」
～《金辉骑士传》

414294.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player draws a card and loses 1 life.
414294.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每位牌手各抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

414296.oracleText:
"A good steed will carry you home. A great steed will carry you to glory."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
414296.translation:
「好马齐行家园路；良驹共驰荣光道。」
～狮爪艾林爵士

414297.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell that has an Adventure, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
414297.translation: 每当你施放具有历险的生物咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

414300.oracleText: CARDNAME's toughness is equal to the number of Knights you control.
414300.translation: CARDNAME的防御力等同于由你操控的骑士数量。

414301.oracleText: Wintermoor Commander's toughness is equal to the number of Knights you control.
414301.translation: 冬霜沼指挥官的防御力等同于由你操控的骑士数量。

414302.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target Knight you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
414302.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的骑士获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

414303.oracleText: Whenever Wintermoor Commander attacks, another target Knight you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
414303.translation: 每当冬霜沼指挥官攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的骑士获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

414310.oracleText:
"Headed to the wilds? Beware the dead riders who serve the Shadow Queen."
—Scalan, Edgewall innkeeper
414310.translation:
「要去幻野？当心效忠暗影女王的亡灵骑兵。」
～边墙镇旅店主斯凯兰

414311.oracleText: When you gain life for the first time each turn, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
414311.translation: 每当你每回合首度获得生命时，将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

414312.oracleText: When you gain life for the first time each turn, return Deathless Knight from your graveyard to your hand.
414312.translation: 每当你每回合首度获得生命时，将不亡骑士从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

414314.oracleText: Nothing remains of his foes but the gripping story of their downfall.
414314.translation: 他的敌人回归空无，仅余扣人心弦的败亡故事流传世间。

414315.oracleText: {o(B/R)o(B/R)o(B/R)}, Sacrifice another creature or an artifact: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
414315.translation: {o(B/R)o(B/R)o(B/R)}，牺牲另一个生物或一个神器：CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

414316.oracleText: {o(B/R)o(B/R)o(B/R)}, Sacrifice another creature or an artifact: Elite Headhunter deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
414316.translation: {o(B/R)o(B/R)o(B/R)}，牺牲另一个生物或一个神器：猎首精英对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

414318.oracleText: He endured the white-hot blaze of the Circle and the sweltering heat of the Irencrag, and he emerged victorious.
414318.translation: 他熬过忠诚焰圈的白热炽烤，挺住伊雷岩的红莲焰浪，最终一举夺魁。

414319.oracleText: {o(R/W)o(R/W)o(R/W)o(R/W)}: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

414320.oracleText: {o(R/W)o(R/W)o(R/W)o(R/W)}: Fireborn Knight gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

414322.oracleText: Despite its ferocity, its favor can be won with a gift of something it's never seen before.
414322.translation: 它虽然凶猛，但你可用其从未见过之物换得它的助力。

414326.oracleText: {oT}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
414326.translation: {oT}：由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

414328.oracleText:
"He has strength and courage—just way, way too much of both."
—Syr Faren, the Hengehammer
414328.translation:
「他既有力量，又有勇气～只是都多过头了。」
～阵锤芳纶爵士

414329.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by Knights or Walls.

414330.oracleText: Rampart Smasher can't be blocked by Knights or Walls.
414330.translation: 破壁巨人不能被骑士或墙阻挡。

414332.oracleText: "Respect the wilds? Certainly. Fear them? No."
414332.translation: 「尊重幻野？当然。惧怕它们？绝不。」

414333.oracleText: {o(W/B)o(W/B)}: CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
414333.translation: {o(W/B)o(W/B)}：CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

414334.oracleText: {o(W/B)o(W/B)}: Resolute Rider gains lifelink until end of turn.
414334.translation: {o(W/B)o(W/B)}：坚毅骑兵获得系命异能直到回合结束。

414335.oracleText: {o(W/B)o(W/B)o(W/B)}: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
414335.translation: {o(W/B)o(W/B)o(W/B)}：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

414336.oracleText: {o(W/B)o(W/B)o(W/B)}: Resolute Rider gains indestructible until end of turn.
414336.translation: {o(W/B)o(W/B)o(W/B)}：坚毅骑兵获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

414339.oracleText: While humans hear only a deafening roar, the fae hear music of breathtaking beauty.
414339.translation: 传到人类耳中的，只有震耳欲聋的怒吼；而传到仙儿耳中的，则是美妙绝伦的天籁。

414342.oracleText: Some are annoyed by the constant ticking as they clean the cobbles, but to the castle custodians, there's no sweeter sound.
414342.translation: 它们在清理地面时发出的滴答声让有些人厌烦不已，但对于城堡的监卫而言，这个声音再美妙不过。

414346.oracleText:
"The Northern Beacon flared, and even before the drawbridge finished its descent, the knights charged out."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights
414346.translation:
「只见北部烽火信标一亮，城内骑士等不及吊桥落稳便鱼贯而出。」
～《金辉骑士传》

414347.oracleText: {oT}: Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
414347.translation: {oT}：由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

414353.oracleText: The unlabeled vial was not vanilla extract after all.
414353.translation: 结果那个没标签的瓶子里头真不是香草精。

414354.oracleText: {o1}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste.
414354.translation: {o1}：CARDNAME本回合只能被具敏捷异能的生物阻挡。

414355.oracleText: {o1}: Gingerbrute can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste.
414355.translation: {o1}：姜饼怪人本回合只能被具敏捷异能的生物阻挡。

414357.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲姜饼怪人：你获得3点生命。

414361.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Golden Egg: Add one mana of any color.
414361.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲金蛋：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

414362.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Golden Egg: You gain 3 life.

414364.oracleText: Everything that inhabits Garenbrig is affected by the wild magic flowing through the Great Henge.
414364.translation: 所有盖伦碧境内的生灵，都会受到穿流巨石圆阵之间幻野魔法的影响。

414369.oracleText: Creatures you control of the chosen color get +1/+0.
414369.translation: 由你操控的该色生物得+1/+0。

414371.oracleText:
"The strings were gone, but he still felt the pull of invisible forces tugging at his mind."
—Beyond the Great Henge
414371.translation:
「虽然没了绳线的羁绊，但他的脑中仍觉得有一股看不见的力量在牵制着他。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

414373.oracleText: Exile CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
414373.translation: 放逐CARDNAME：派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

414374.oracleText: Exile Inquisitive Puppet: Create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
414374.translation: 放逐好奇木偶：派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

414377.oracleText:
"Don't let it fool you. Many of us got our first scars from Syr Nobody."
—Syr Layne, knight of Embereth
414377.translation:
「别小看它了。我们许多人的第一道伤疤都是木人爵士的手笔。」
～鞍博雷骑士，蕾妮爵士

414378.oracleText: {o3}: Jousting Dummy gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

414380.oracleText:
"As the traitor hurried across the courtyard, its eyes snapped open. It was time to pay the queen a visit."
—Beyond the Great Henge
414380.translation:
「叛徒慌张地穿过庭院，它的双眼突然睁开。拜访女王的时候到了。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

414381.oracleText: {o4}: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 and gains flying until end of turn.
414381.translation: {o4}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+2/+0且获得飞行异能。

414382.oracleText: {o4}: Locthwain Gargoyle gets +2/+0 and gains flying until end of turn.
414382.translation: {o4}：直到回合结束，洛司温石像鬼得+2/+0且获得飞行异能。

414384.oracleText: Syr Branigan always remembered to kiss his good luck charm, having lost his foot to wolverines the last time he forgot.
414384.translation: 巴尼根爵士总会亲吻自己的护身符～他上次忘记的时候，就被狼獾咬掉一条腿。

414385.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure instant or sorcery spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
414385.translation: 每当你施放历险瞬间或法术咒语时，将其复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

414387.oracleText: It frequently predicts imminent death by devouring.
414387.translation: 它每次吞食生灵，都足以验证自己预测的血光之灾确已发生。

414390.oracleText:
"It wandered slowly across the landscape, calling out in its lonely voice, but no other castles answered its cries."
—Beyond the Great Henge
414390.translation:
「它缓缓越过大地，孤独地呼唤，但其他的城堡从未应声。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

414391.oracleText: {o7}: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. It can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
414391.translation: {o7}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。本回合中，它能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

414392.oracleText: {o7}: Roving Keep gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. It can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
414392.translation: {o7}：直到回合结束，逡巡城砦得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。本回合中，它能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

414394.oracleText: "It's a witch's trick, this cauldron full of pain. I wouldn't dump it on any but the wicked."
414394.translation: 「这满满一鼎的痛苦都是女巫的杰作。我只会往邪恶的人身上浇。」

414395.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to target creature.
414395.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成3点伤害。

414396.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice Scalding Cauldron: It deals 3 damage to target creature.
414396.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲沸腾鼎镬：它对目标生物造成3点伤害。

414398.oracleText:
"The young squire gripped her sword as the clanking stranger emerged. It was no knight that had come to challenge her."
—Beyond the Great Henge
414398.translation:
「咔嚓作响的陌生人忽然出现，年轻的扈从握紧利剑。前来挑战她的根本就不是骑士。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

414399.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of artifacts and/or enchantments you control.
414399.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于由你操控之神器和／或结界的总数量。

414400.oracleText: Shambling Suit's power is equal to the number of artifacts and/or enchantments you control.
414400.translation: 跛行铠甲的力量等同于由你操控之神器和／或结界的总数量。

414402.oracleText:
"Accursed scarecrow! Sending folk in every direction is the same as sending them nowhere at all."
—Corliss the Wanderer
414402.translation:
「该死的稻草人！给人乱指路就和没指路一样。」
～云游者柯力斯

414404.oracleText:
"Reynald wished for an army to sweep away his enemies. The fae king smiled."
—Beyond the Great Henge
414404.translation:
「雷纳德许愿要一支军队，好帮他扫清敌人。仙儿国王微微一笑。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

414405.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another permanent, you may pay {o3}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of CARDNAME.
414405.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个永久物时，你可以支付{o3}。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为CARDNAME的复制品。

414406.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another permanent, you may pay {o3}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of Sorcerer's Broom.
414406.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个永久物时，你可以支付{o3}。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为术士扫帚的复制品。

414408.oracleText:
"Though long forgotten, the wheel continued to turn, spinning fate from a dusty attic."
—Beyond the Great Henge
414408.translation:
「虽然早已无人问津，但纺轮仍不停转动，在已满是灰尘的阁楼中继续编织命运。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

414411.oracleText: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.
414411.translation: 恩诺因犯罪被逐出盖伦碧，他求助仙儿术法好为其复仇志业打造完美武器。

414414.oracleText: No weapon stays on the rack for long in the Burning Yard.
414414.translation: 烬炼场架子上的武器都留不了多久。

414419.oracleText: The wafting smells are both scrumptious and suspicious.
414419.translation: 飘来的香味既馋人又可疑。

414420.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Create a Food token. If the sacrificed creature's toughness was 4 or greater, create two Food tokens instead.
414420.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个生物：派出一个食品衍生物。如果所牺牲的生物之防御力等于或大于4，则改为派出两个食品衍生物。

414422.oracleText: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.
414422.translation: 欠缺雅登瓦的忠诚，世境将为贪婪自噬。

414425.oracleText: {o2oWoW}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
414425.translation: {o2oWoW}，{oT}：派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

414427.oracleText: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.
414427.translation: 欠缺鞍博雷的勇气，世境将因踌躇溃败。

414430.oracleText: {o1oRoR}, {oT}: Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
414430.translation: {o1oRoR}，{oT}：由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

414432.oracleText: Without Garenbrig's strength, the realm would succumb to the wilds.
414432.translation: 欠缺盖伦碧的力量，世境将向幻野屈膝。

414435.oracleText: {o2oGoG}, {oT}: Add six {oG}. Spend this mana only to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
414435.translation: {o2oGoG}，{oT}：加六点{oG}。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语，或是起动生物的异能。

414437.oracleText: Without Locthwain's persistence, the realm would stagnate and die.
414437.translation: 欠缺洛司温的毅力，世境将致萧条灭亡。

414440.oracleText: {o1oBoB}, {oT}: Draw a card, then you lose life equal to the number of cards in your hand.
414440.translation: {o1oBoB}，{oT}：抓一张牌，然后你失去等同于你手牌数量的生命。

414442.oracleText: Without Vantress's knowledge, the realm would lose itself in darkness.
414442.translation: 欠缺凡翠丝的知识，世境将在暗域迷途。

414452.oracleText: From here, the path to anywhere may be found.
414452.translation: 此处密径错杂，寻对道路便可通达八方。

414461.translation: 每位英雄的旅程总有一处起点。

414472.oracleText: No one knows when the tournament began. All they know is that it will never end.
414472.translation: 谁都不知道竞技何时开始。他们只知道竞技永不结束。

414473.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}, {oW}, or {oB}. Spend this mana only to cast a Knight or Equipment spell.
414473.translation: {oT}：加{oR}，{oW}或{oB}。此法术力只能用来施放骑士或武具咒语。

414480.oracleText: Up to one target creature gets +3/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
414480.translation: 直到回合结束，至多一个目标生物得+3/+0且获得先攻异能。

414481.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each of up to two target creatures. Those creatures can't block this turn.
414481.translation: CARDNAME对至多两个目标生物各造成1点伤害。这些生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

414482.oracleText: Rowan, Fearless Sparkmage deals 1 damage to each of up to two target creatures. Those creatures can't block this turn.
414482.translation: 星火勇花萝婉对至多两个目标生物各造成1点伤害。这些生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

414483.oracleText: Gain control of all creatures until end of turn. Untap them. They gain haste until end of turn.
414483.translation: 获得所有生物的操控权直到回合结束。将它们重置。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

414485.oracleText: The keen-eyed guardians of Ardenvale are ever on alert.
414485.translation: 雅登瓦目光锐利的守卫从不松懈防务。

414486.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target Knight you control gains flying until end of turn.
414486.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由你操控的骑士获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

414487.oracleText: Whenever Garrison Griffin attacks, target Knight you control gains flying until end of turn.
414487.translation: 每当卫戍狮鹫攻击时，目标由你操控的骑士获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

414489.oracleText: "This sword is Sunrise. The other is Dawn. They mark the beginning of my days but the end of yours."
414489.translation: 「此剑名为拂晓。这剑则称黎明。我的光荣从它们开始，你的生命由它们终结。」

414490.oracleText: As long as you control a Rowan planeswalker, CARDNAME gets +3/+0.
414490.translation: 只要你操控萝婉鹏洛客，CARDNAME便得+3/+0。

414491.oracleText: As long as you control a Rowan planeswalker, Rowan's Battleguard gets +3/+0.
414491.translation: 只要你操控萝婉鹏洛客，萝婉的武卫便得+3/+0。

414496.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on up to one target creature you control.
414496.translation: 在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

414497.oracleText: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a copy of target creature you control. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.
414497.translation: 直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为目标由你操控的生物之复制品。防止本回合中将对他造成的所有伤害。

414498.oracleText: Until end of turn, Oko, the Trickster becomes a copy of target creature you control. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.
414498.translation: 直到回合结束，幻法仙灵瓯柯成为目标由你操控的生物之复制品。防止本回合将对他造成的所有伤害。

414499.oracleText: Until end of turn, each creature you control has base power and toughness 10/10 and gains trample.
414499.translation: 直到回合结束，每个由你操控的生物均获得践踏异能，且基础力量与防御力都为10/10。

414501.oracleText: They function as everything from assassins to jesters in the name of their fae king.
414501.translation: 他们挂着其仙儿国王的名头，从刺客到弄臣等等什么都做。

414503.oracleText: No matter the cruelty of Oko's jokes, he's always guaranteed the sycophant's laughter.
414503.translation: 无论瓯柯的玩笑有多残酷，都会有人发出谄媚的笑声。

414507.oracleText:
"My advisors recommend I let them eat you."
—Oko
414507.translation:
「我的谋臣建议我让它们吃了你。」
～瓯柯

414510.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.

414512.oracleText: {oR}: All creatures gain trample and haste until end of turn.
414512.translation: {oR}：所有生物获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

414513.oracleText: {o1oG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
414513.translation: {o1oG}：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

414516.oracleText: {o4oB}: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under its owner's control.
414516.translation: {o4oB}：将目标生物牌在其拥有者的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

414518.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each charge counter on CARDNAME and has vigilance.
414518.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有警戒异能，且CARDNAME上每有一个充电指示物，它便得+1/+1。

414519.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each charge counter on Mace of the Valiant and has vigilance.
414519.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有警戒异能，且勇者战锤上每有一个充电指示物，它便得+1/+1。

414523.oracleText: Silverwing Squadron's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
414523.translation: 银翼中队的力量和防御力等同于由你操控的生物数量。

414524.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a number of 2/2 white Knight creature tokens with vigilance equal to the number of opponents you have.
414524.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出数个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。其数量等同于对手的数量。

414525.oracleText: Whenever Silverwing Squadron attacks, create a number of 2/2 white Knight creature tokens with vigilance equal to the number of opponents you have.
414525.translation: 每当银翼中队攻击时，派出数个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。其数量等同于对手的数量。

414527.oracleText: The throng flitted from castle to castle, leaving a trail of star-crossed love, damaging rumors, and missing heirlooms in their wake.
414527.translation: 这群仙灵流连于城堡之间，所经之处满是不幸爱情、中伤流言和丢失遗宝。

414528.oracleText: {o3oU}: Create a 1/1 blue Faerie creature token with flying. Draw a card.
414528.translation: {o3oU}：派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵衍生生物。抓一张牌。

414530.oracleText: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.
414530.translation: 靛青巨龙高兴地用其一小部分珍藏换来了永恒月光。

414531.oracleText: As long as you control four or more artifacts, CARDNAME has hexproof.
414531.translation: 只要你操控四个或更多神器，CARDNAME便具有辟邪异能。

414532.oracleText: As long as you control four or more artifacts, Shimmer Dragon has hexproof.
414532.translation: 只要你操控四个或更多神器，闪光巨龙便具有辟邪异能。

414533.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts you control: Draw a card.
414533.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器：抓一张牌。

414535.oracleText:
"Fear not what's under the bed. The toys are watching."
—Beyond the Great Henge
414535.translation:
「无需害怕床底异响。那是玩具为你守护。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

414536.oracleText: Artifact creatures you control have flying.
414536.translation: 由你操控的神器生物具有飞行异能。

414537.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have target noncreature artifact you control become a 0/0 artifact creature. If you do, put four +1/+1 counters on it.
414537.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以令目标由你操控的非生物神器成为0/0神器生物。若你如此作，则在其上放置四个+1/+1指示物。

414541.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice a creature: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
414541.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲一个生物：目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

414543.oracleText:
"Hone the knife and mourn the least.
Three chimes to sound the sweet, grim feast."
—Barrow witch incantation
414543.translation:
「磨快手中刀具勿念悲伤过去，
耳闻悼铃三响静待苦宴就绪。」
～荒野巫婆咒文

414544.oracleText: Each player sacrifices three creatures. You create three Food tokens.
414544.translation: 每位牌手各牺牲三个生物。你派出三个食品衍生物。

414546.oracleText: "We fight with valor in our hearts and fire in our veins!"
414546.translation: 「勇气在心，我们战斗！血管燃火，我们战斗！」「暂译」

414548.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o2oR}. If you do, creatures you control get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of opponents you have.
414548.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o2oR}。若你如此作，由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X等同于对手的数量。

414549.oracleText: Whenever Embereth Skyblazer attacks, you may pay {o2oR}. If you do, creatures you control get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of opponents you have.
414549.translation: 每当鞍博雷破空兵攻击时，你可以支付{o2oR}。若你如此作，由你操控的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X等同于对手的数量。

414551.oracleText: Many an ancient treasure has been reduced to jagged caltrops by its snapping jaws.
414551.translation: 许多上古珍宝经其强颚利齿之后，化作满地狼藉。

414552.oracleText: {o2oG}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from CARDNAME: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
414552.translation: {o2oG}，从CARDNAME上移去一个+1/+1指示物：消灭目标神器或结界。

414553.oracleText: {o2oG}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from Steelbane Hydra: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
414553.translation: {o2oG}，从厌钢多头龙上移去一个+1/+1指示物：消灭目标神器或结界。

414555.oracleText: It will come to the defense of all wild things, from the shivering wren to the towering giant.
414555.translation: 它会挺身守护一切幻野生灵～小至战栗鹪鹩，大至耸立巨人。

414560.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact or enchantment spell, create a 1/1 blue Faerie creature token with flying.
414560.translation: 每当你施放神器或结界咒语时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵衍生生物。

414562.oracleText: When you cast this spell from your hand, copy it if you control an artifact, then copy it if you control an enchantment. You may choose new targets for the copies.
414562.translation: 当你从你手上施放此咒语时，如果你操控神器则复制之，然后如果你操控结界则复制之。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

414563.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. You create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
414563.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。你派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

414565.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
414565.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

414566.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Return target creature you control to its owner's hand.
414566.translation: {o3}，{oT}：将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

414570.oracleText: {o1oG}, Sacrifice another nonland permanent: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
414570.translation: {o1oG}，牺牲另一个非地永久物：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

414571.oracleText: {o1oG}, Sacrifice another nonland permanent: Gluttonous Troll gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
414571.translation: {o1oG}，牺牲另一个非地永久物：暴食巨魔得+2/+2直到回合结束。

414573.oracleText:
"By hoof, wing, or paw. For the realm!"
—Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
414573.translation:
「铁蹄翻腾，羽翼展扬，利爪出击。为了世境，全体冲锋！」
～灰谷英雄葛雯爵士

414574.oracleText: Whenever a Knight you control attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
414574.translation: 每当一个由你操控的骑士攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

414575.oracleText: {o6oWoB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return all Knight creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
414575.translation: {o6oWoB}，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有骑士生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

414576.oracleText: {o6oWoB}, Sacrifice Knights' Charge: Return all Knight creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
414576.translation: {o6oWoB}，牺牲骑士冲锋：将所有骑士生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

414579.oracleText: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.
414579.translation: 他于自己的婚礼上被变作龙形之后，随即吃掉了宴席、礼物和来宾。

414582.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on Korvold and draw a card.
414582.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，在寇沃上放置一个+1/+1指示物且抓一张牌。

414584.oracleText: Squires throughout the realm aspire to her mix of panache and martial prowess.

416432.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。
