423826.oracleText: Chandra's Triumph deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls. Chandra's Triumph deals 5 damage instead if you control a Chandra planeswalker.
423826.translation: 茜卓得胜向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。如果你操控茜卓鹏洛客，则改为茜卓得胜对该永久物造成5点伤害。

423827.oracleText: Divide damage between targets. (If you pay seven {oR} to cast this spell, it will instead deal 7 damage to each target.)
423827.translation: 将伤害分配给目标。（如果施放此咒语时支付过至少七点{oR}，则改为它对每个目标各造成7点伤害。）

423828.oracleText: Target a card to return to your hand.
423828.translation: 指定一张牌为目标，将其移回你手上。

423829.oracleText: Target a card to put on top of your library. (If you pay three {oG} to cast this spell, this target will be returned to your hand instead.)
423829.translation: 指定一张牌为目标，将其置于你的牌库顶。（如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点{oG}，则改为将目标移回你手上。）

423852.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice this creature.
423852.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲此生物。

424604.oracleText: Target a card named Rekindling Phoenix.
424604.translation: 指定一张名称为复焰凤凰的牌为目标。

425876.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. If this spell's madness cost was paid, it deals X damage divided as you choose among those permanents and/or players instead.
425876.translation: CARDNAME对任意数量的目标造成共2点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果曾支付此咒语的疯魔费用，则改为它对该些永久物和／或牌手造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。

425877.oracleText: Avacyn's Judgment deals 2 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. If this spell's madness cost was paid, it deals X damage divided as you choose among those permanents and/or players instead.
425877.translation: 艾维欣的裁决对任意数量的目标造成共2点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果曾支付此咒语的疯魔费用，则改为它对该些永久物和／或牌手造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。

425941.oracleText: Auto-Tap solution has changed. Select Auto-Pay to confirm the new solution or pay {1, Cost}.
425941.translation: 自动付费方案有变。点击「自动付费」确认新方案，或手动支付{1, Cost}。

426220.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
426220.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。

426222.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
426222.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。

426288.oracleText: When you cast a spell with the chosen name for the first time this turn, draw two cards.
426288.translation: 本回合中，当你首度施放具该名称的咒语时，抓两张牌。

426905.oracleText: Search for a card named Elvish Clancaller.
426905.translation: 搜寻一张名称为唤族妖精的牌。

427764.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
427764.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

427768.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of lore counters on The Triumph of Anax.
427768.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为阿那克斯凯旋志上的学问指示物数量。

427769.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of lore counters on CARDNAME.
427769.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为CARDNAME上的学问指示物数量。

427770.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of lore counters on The Triumph of Anax.
427770.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为阿那克斯凯旋志上的学问指示物数量。

427771.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of lore counters on CARDNAME.
427771.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为CARDNAME上的学问指示物数量。

427772.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of lore counters on The Triumph of Anax.
427772.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为阿那克斯凯旋志上的学问指示物数量。

427773.translation: 指定一个由你操控的结界为目标。

427787.oracleText: Creatures you control have base power and toughness 3/3 and are Elks in addition to their other types.
427787.translation: 由你操控之生物的基础力量与防御力为3/3，且额外具有麋鹿此类别。

427859.oracleText:
"If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor
427859.translation:
「如果我要问你的意见，相信你刚才已经听到了。」
～激流余生者潘明

427877.oracleText: Target an enchanted creature or enchantment creature you control.
427877.translation: 指定一个由你操控且受有灵气的生物或结界生物为目标。

427879.oracleText:
"You sure you want to see what emerges? You might not like it. It definitely won't like you."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy
427879.translation:
「你真的要看它会变出什么东西吗？你不会喜欢的。它显然不喜欢你。」
～持绊逸才季宁

427882.oracleText: "Take us home," she whispered, and the fox's eyes began to glow.
427882.translation: 「带我们回家，」她低语道，狐狸的眼中随即闪出一丝亮光。

427885.oracleText:
"A good forage if you can find it, but eat it before you get back to sanctuary. The guards won't let you bring it through the gates."
—Dennae, Savai hunter
427885.translation:
「如果你有幸找得到的话，它真是上好的美味，但千万记得要在返回庇护地前吃掉。守卫禁止携带这类东西进门。」
～撒维耶猎人笛奈

427886.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
427886.translation: 每当此生物合变时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

427888.oracleText: The Wanderer walks many paths. Her blade travels only one.
427888.translation: 飘萍走过无数道路，而她的利刃只走一条。

427890.oracleText: After what he viewed as Lukka's shocking betrayal, General Kudro enacted stringent security measures at every entry point into Drannith.
427890.translation: 寇卓将军把卢卡所为视作可憎叛行，于是他下令在通往卓尼斯的各处入口严加防范。

427892.oracleText:
"Out here we're nothing but our training."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage
427892.translation:
「行军在外，唯有训练成果靠得住。」
～紫铜军法师埃撒克

427895.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, create two 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink.
427895.translation: 每当此生物合变时，派出两个1/1白色，具系命异能的猫衍生生物。

427897.oracleText: "The night emboldens many monsters, but the mightiest will attack in broad daylight."
427897.translation: 「虽然不少怪兽会借夜幕壮胆，但最强大者敢在光天化日下来袭。」

427899.oracleText: Outside Drannith's walls, where collateral damage is of no concern, the Coppercoats are free to use more potent methods.
427899.translation: 在卓尼斯的高墙之外不用担心误伤无辜，紫铜军可以自由运用更加有效的制敌手段。

427901.oracleText: "The glowstones shine and dinosaurs roar to the south. Business will be brisk tonight."
427901.translation: 「光晶闪耀辉芒，恐龙朝南怒吼。看来今晚要忙了。」

427902.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card, you gain 1 life.
427902.translation: 每当你循环另一张牌时，你获得1点生命。

427905.oracleText: "Our sanctuaries must be beacons of reason and calm or else they will fall."
427905.translation: 「我们各处庇护地必须成为理性沉着的信标，否则必将败亡。」

427906.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands.
427906.translation: 所有对手都不能从其手牌以外的区域施放咒语。

427908.oracleText: Target Human creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
427908.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的人类生物得+1/+1且获得不灭异能。

427909.oracleText: Target non-Human creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
427909.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的非人类生物得+1/+1且获得不灭异能。

427910.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Target Human creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains indestructible until end of turn. • Target non-Human creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
427910.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  直到回合结束，目标由你操控的人类生物得+1/+1且获得不灭异能。 •  直到回合结束，目标由你操控的非人类生物得+1/+1且获得不灭异能。

427912.oracleText:
"Day 1: These fox pups have really taken to me.
"Day 4: Big. So big. Need additional security."
—Jonald, mission naturalist, research notes
427912.translation:
「第1天：这些狐狸幼崽真的喜欢上我了。
「第4天：真大。真的太大了。要严加看守。」
～实地博物学家贾纳德的研究纪录

427913.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
427913.translation: 每当你循环另一张牌时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

427914.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card, put a +1/+1 counter on Flourishing Fox.
427914.translation: 每当你循环另一张牌时，在待哺幼狐上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

427916.oracleText: After much arguing, the soldiers decided to keep it, on the grounds that it killed enough mice to count as an honorary monster slayer.
427916.translation: 在多番争论后，士兵决定把它留下来，理由是它捕鼠有功，足以算作荣誉怪兽克星。

427917.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
427917.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

427918.oracleText: When Garrison Cat dies, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
427918.translation: 当驻防猫死去时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

427921.oracleText: It could subsist on seeds but its preferred fare is your face.
427921.translation: 虽然它靠种子也能维生，但它喜欢吃你的脸。

427926.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, other creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of times this creature has mutated.
427926.translation: 每当此生物合变时，由你操控的其他生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为此生物已合变的次数。

427928.oracleText: Raugrin's coastline can be quite beautiful, as long as you avoid the volcanic dinosaurs, the sea dinosaurs, and the roaming beach dinosaurs.
427928.translation: 洛格凌的沿岸风光堪称绝景，只是你要小心躲开火山恐龙、栖海恐龙和四处游荡的海滩恐龙。

427930.oracleText: Through the eludha, bonders share the powerful abilities of their chosen companions.
427930.translation: 持绊人可以通过灵绊与他们的灵兽同伴共享强大的能力。

427933.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with vigilance.
427933.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且具警戒异能的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

427935.oracleText: "Take one wrong step out here and you're dead. I take only right steps."
427935.translation: 「在这里走错一步就会送命。而我一步也不会错。」

427940.oracleText: Choose one — • You gain 4 life. • Destroy target enchantment. • Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
427940.translation: 选择一项～ •  你获得4点生命。 •  消灭目标结界。 •  在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

427942.oracleText: It soars through currents of moonbeams to give hope to the forsaken.
427942.translation: 它翱翔于月光之间，为遭弃者带来希望。

427943.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control without flying dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a flying counter on it.
427943.translation: 每当一个由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个飞行指示物。

427946.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, you gain 4 life.
427946.translation: 每当此生物合变时，你获得4点生命。

427948.oracleText:
"Don't search the ruins of Orn during the day. Nethroi's many eyes will spot you instantly. Don't go at night either. You'll be dinner for the servals. Maybe just don't go."
—Rasai, Indatha hunter
427948.translation:
「不要在白天去探索奥恩遗址。涅司罗有很多眼睛会立刻盯上你。晚上也不要去。那边有薮猫游荡，小心变成它们的晚餐。也许干脆就不去比较好。」
～因达沙猎人拉塞

427950.oracleText: Each player chooses an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a planeswalker from among the nonland permanents they control, then sacrifices the rest. If {oBoR} was spent to cast this spell, you choose the permanents for each player instead.
427950.translation: 每位牌手各从由其操控的非地永久物中选择一个神器、一个生物、一个结界和一个鹏洛客，然后牺牲其余的非地永久物。如果施放此咒语时支付过{oBoR}，则改为由你来为每位牌手选择永久物。

427951.oracleText:
"If only they'd all act this docile. I could do something relaxing for a living. I've always wanted to bake biscuits."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage
427951.translation:
「要是它们一直都这样温顺就好了。这样我就可以去做一些更轻松的工作。比如说烤烤饼干。」
～紫铜军法师埃撒克

427953.oracleText: Lukka looked out from the parapet and saw not a monster to be put down, but a fierce kind of beauty.
427953.translation: 卢卡望向护墙之外，所见者并非要制服的怪兽，而是迷人的野性之美。

427957.oracleText: "Get in there, soldier! I want a pelt on my wall before lunch!"
427957.translation: 「士兵，给我上！我要在午饭前给我家的墙上添块皮！」

427958.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, other Humans you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
427958.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，由你操控的其他人类得+1/+0直到回合结束。

427959.oracleText: Whenever Perimeter Sergeant attacks, other Humans you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
427959.translation: 每当守备士官攻击时，由你操控的其他人类得+1/+0直到回合结束。

427961.oracleText:
"Drannith gives no quarter to traitors."
—General Kudro
427961.translation:
「卓尼斯绝无叛徒容身之地。」
～寇卓将军

427963.oracleText: {o2}, Tap two untapped Humans you control: Tap target creature an opponent controls.
427963.translation: {o2}，横置两个由你操控且未横置的人类：横置目标由对手操控的生物。

427965.oracleText: The giant tigers of Savai prefer to hunt at daybreak, when the crystals' warning glow is masked by the light of dawn.
427965.translation: 撒维耶巨虎偏好在破晓时分行猎，全因此时黎明曙光会盖过光晶的警示辉光。

427967.oracleText:
"Our volleys don't aim to kill. Impair them and the ground will do the rest."
—Alux, Skysail defender
427967.translation:
「我们的攻击并非瞄准要害。只要能够将对方击伤，大地会帮我们处理后续。」
～翔空城护卫亚卢斯

427968.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, tap target creature an opponent controls.
427968.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

427970.oracleText: As long as enchanted creature has vigilance, it assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
427970.translation: 只要所结附的生物具有警戒异能，它便依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。

427973.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, put a lifelink counter on target creature you control.
427973.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个系命指示物。

427974.oracleText: When you cycle Splendor Mare, put a lifelink counter on target creature you control.
427974.translation: 当你循环光彩牝兽时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个系命指示物。

427976.oracleText: "Amazing! And I was only trying to teach her to sit!"
427976.translation: 「太惊人了！我还只是想要教会她坐下！」

427977.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Put a flying counter on it.
427977.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。在其上放置一个飞行指示物。

427980.oracleText: After a disastrous day of battle, Lavabrink's lightning mages were recalled.
427980.translation: 经过一整天的灾难惨败，熔缘城的闪电法师部队奉命撤回。

427981.oracleText: If noncombat damage would be dealt to CARDNAME, prevent that damage. Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME for each 1 damage prevented this way.
427981.translation: 如果CARDNAME将受到非战斗伤害，则防止该伤害。每以此法防止1点伤害，便在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

427982.oracleText: If noncombat damage would be dealt to Stormwild Capridor, prevent that damage. Put a +1/+1 counter on Stormwild Capridor for each 1 damage prevented this way.
427982.translation: 如果聚风飞羊将受到非战斗伤害，则防止该伤害。每以此法防止1点伤害，便在聚风飞羊上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

427984.oracleText:
"World's better with one fewer poacher in it."
—Winota, heartbonder
427984.translation:
「少了一个偷猎者，世界变得更美好。」
～情念持绊人薇诺塔

427985.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap an untapped creature you control.
427985.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

427986.oracleText: Exile target tapped creature. Put a +1/+1 counter on the creature tapped to pay this spell's additional cost.
427986.translation: 放逐目标已横置的生物。在横置用以支付此咒语之额外费用的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

427988.oracleText: The floating city of Skysail has two rules: don't leave your crewmates behind, and don't mess with the guardrails.
427988.translation: 翔空城有两条规矩：不抛弃同伴，不乱动护栏。

427989.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
427989.translation: 每当你每回合首度循环另一张牌时，派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

427993.oracleText:
"It's Snapdax. You'd have a better chance of breaching a wall with a slice of bread."
—Krek, daysquad captain
427993.translation:
「那可是斯达兹。比起战胜它，也许你用面包砸穿墙壁会比较容易。」
～昼班队长柯列克

427994.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's blocking, instead put two +1/+1 counters on it.
427994.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果它正进行阻挡，则改为在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

427996.oracleText:
"The endurance of the ancient turtles in a land so harsh makes a strong case for patience, tranquility, and composure."
—Gavi, nest warden
427996.translation:
「在这片残酷之地中，古代的龟类仍能存活至今，正说明耐心、冷静、沉着有何等重要。」
～巢穴护卫盖薇

427997.oracleText: Bonder and bonded move in unison, intuiting each other's next move.
427997.translation: 持绊人与受绊者齐心行动，凭直觉就能知晓对方接下来的动作。

428000.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, tap up to X target creatures, where X is the number of times this creature has mutated. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
428000.translation: 每当此生物合变时，横置至多X个目标生物，X为此生物已合变的次数。这些生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

428002.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, put a flying counter on target creature you control.
428002.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个飞行指示物。

428003.oracleText: When you cycle Avian Oddity, put a flying counter on target creature you control.
428003.translation: 当你循环怪鸟兽时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个飞行指示物。

428005.oracleText:
"There is no law of nature that I have not seen Illuna break. Makes you wonder what is truly possible, does it not?"
—Rielle, the Everwise
428005.translation:
「我亲眼见到依卢那一一打破世间诸多必然法则。你难道不好奇何事才算作『或然』吗？」
～全知利艾尔

428008.oracleText: It loves blending into its environment, ambushing prey, and long scuttles on the beach.
428008.translation: 它喜欢融入环境，突袭猎物，疾步沙滩。

428011.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, draw a card.
428011.translation: 每当此生物合变时，抓一张牌。

428013.oracleText: Sanctuaries harnessed the glowstones' natural reaction to monsters to create a warning system.
428013.translation: 光晶对怪兽有着自然反应。待庇护地掌握其间规律后，便藉此建立了一套预警机制。

428014.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, you may pay {o1}. When you do, exile target artifact or creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
428014.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，放逐目标由你操控的神器或生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

428015.oracleText:
"I know the nightmares of Indatha seem scary, but when you break them down into their component parts, they're quite beautiful."
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist
428015.translation:
「我知道因达沙的梦魇看起来很恐怖，但如果你能将各组成部分拆开的话，你会发现其实它们还是挺美的。」
～克崔亚元素师奈拉

428017.oracleText: "Every flaw in the crystal represents a moment where our strategy might go wrong."
428017.translation: 「水晶的每处瑕疵，都代表我们战略中可能存在的错误。」

428018.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card.

428019.oracleText: If you feel a strange chill within the temperate Quartzwood, look up.
428019.translation: 如果你在和煦的石英林中感到一阵莫名寒意，不妨抬头看看。

428021.oracleText: Hunters' methods vary from simple and brutal to elaborate and brutal.
428021.translation: 猎人们手段多样，从单纯野蛮到精细野蛮都有。

428024.oracleText:
"Their paths aren't random, but they don't float with the wind. Could they be following surges in crystalline energy?"
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist
428024.translation:
「它们的行进路线并非毫无规律，但却也不是随风飘行。也许是跟着水晶能量的起伏而动？」
～克崔亚元素师奈拉

428028.oracleText: Skysail's strength was also its vulnerability.
428028.translation: 翔空城的优势也恰好是其弱点。

428029.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you control a creature with flying.
428029.translation: 如果你操控具飞行异能的生物，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

428031.oracleText:
"I want it to look me in the eyes and know the face of the man who put it down."
—Kelsien, the Plague
428031.translation:
「我要让它看着我的眼睛，把打倒它的人类面容瞧个仔细。」
～疫病凯鑫

428033.oracleText: "Coppercoats think they understand duty and loyalty, but they can't begin to fathom the depths of my bond."
428033.translation: 「紫铜军以为他们了解何谓责任与忠诚，但他们根本无法理解羁绊的深度。」

428035.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets -2/-0 and loses all abilities.
428035.translation: 所结附的生物得-2/-0且失去所有异能。

428040.oracleText: On Ikoria, reactive magic can make the difference between barely grazed and really dead.
428040.translation: 以魔法快速回应状况的效率，在依克黎结果会是轻微擦伤或一命呜呼的区别。

428042.oracleText:
"The eludha is total communication, total understanding. It makes regular human speech feel like garbled grunting."
—Winota, heartbonder
428042.translation:
「灵绊能让两者之间毫无保留地彼此沟通，相互理解。与此相比，人类之间的普通语言交流感觉就像是胡言乱语。」
～情念持绊人薇诺塔

428043.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you control a Human creature and a non-Human creature.
428043.translation: 如果你同时操控人类生物和非人类生物，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

428045.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, put a foreshadow counter on CARDNAME.
428045.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，在CARDNAME上放置一个预兆指示物。

428046.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, put a foreshadow counter on Ominous Seas.
428046.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，在恶兆海疆上放置一个预兆指示物。

428047.oracleText: Remove eight foreshadow counters from CARDNAME: Create an 8/8 blue Kraken creature token.
428047.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去八个预兆指示物：派出一个8/8蓝色巨海兽衍生生物。

428048.oracleText: Remove eight foreshadow counters from Ominous Seas: Create an 8/8 blue Kraken creature token.
428048.translation: 从恶兆海疆上移去八个预兆指示物：派出一个8/8蓝色巨海兽衍生生物。

428051.oracleText:
"You've never had to trust your breath to an inhuman creature who could crush you at its whim, and I truly feel sorry for you."
—Eagan, seabonder
428051.translation:
「你从来没试过将自己的呼吸托付给能够轻易撞碎你的非人生物，我真为你感到惋惜。」
～海栖持绊人易晶

428052.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn.
428052.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

428053.oracleText: Whenever Phase Dolphin attacks, another target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn.
428053.translation: 每当腾跃海豚攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

428055.oracleText: It always knew it was destined to be more than a frog.
428055.translation: 它早就知道自己命中不会只是一只蛙。

428056.oracleText: Each creature spell you cast costs {o1} less to cast if it has mutate.
428056.translation: 如果你施放的生物咒语具有合变异能，则它减少{o1}来施放。

428057.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, if it has mutate, draw a card, then discard a card.
428057.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，若它具有合变异能，则抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

428060.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, you may return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
428060.translation: 每当此生物合变时，你可以将目标由对手操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

428062.oracleText:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro
428062.translation:
「持绊人神通广大，能与上天穿水入地各类生物搭档。就当他们知道一切。」
～杰琳娜寇卓

428068.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, create an X/X blue Shark creature token with flying.
428068.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，派出一个X/X蓝色，具飞行异能的鲨鱼衍生生物。

428069.oracleText: When you cycle Shark Typhoon, create an X/X blue Shark creature token with flying.
428069.translation: 当你循环聚鲨台风时，派出一个X/X蓝色，具飞行异能的鲨鱼衍生生物。

428071.oracleText: Remarkably, dinner continued with no further interruptions.
428071.translation: 值得一提的是，此后晚餐便再无波折，平安结束。

428072.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature becomes a blue Serpent with base power and toughness 4/4.
428072.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的蓝色巨蛇。

428075.oracleText:
"You're telling me we spent a year securing the sanctuary against pterosaurs, rambeasts, and nightfangs . . . and we were robbed by what?"
—Endris, Drannith magistrate
428075.translation:
「我们花了整整一年的时间来加固庇护地，防卫翼龙、羊羚和夜牙兽入侵…然后你现在说我们是被什么东西偷了来着？」
～卓尼斯官员恩姬丝

428076.oracleText: Whenever Thieving Otter deals damage to an opponent, draw a card.
428076.translation: 每当窃獭向任一对手造成伤害时，抓一张牌。

428079.oracleText: There is no boat big enough.

428083.oracleText:
"Its weak spot is easily spotted, but only if it's swooping down on you."
—Jonald, mission naturalist
428083.translation:
「它的弱点并不难找，但只有它向你俯冲时才能看到。」
～实地博物学家贾纳德

428087.oracleText: Their bond grew over time, as did the height of their jumps.
428087.translation: 其间羁绊愈发深厚，跳得也愈来愈高。

428090.oracleText: {o2oU}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with flying.
428090.translation: {o2oU}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

428092.oracleText: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.
428092.translation: 殒落的生命绝不会被轻易遗忘。

428094.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
428094.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

428096.oracleText:
"Fools wear armor against it as if the worst it could take is your blood."
—Gavi, nest warden
428096.translation:
「愚蠢的人们觉得大不了就是被它吸点血，穿上盔甲就自认安全。」
～巢穴护卫盖薇

428100.translation: 恐惧能穿透最厚实的盔甲。

428101.oracleText: Destroy target creature. Put a menace counter on a creature you control.
428101.translation: 消灭目标生物。在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个威慑指示物。

428103.oracleText:
"I have a number of hyper-specific phobias and this somehow hits all of them."
—Aaru, Zagoth lumberjack
428103.translation:
「我有一些在非常特定的情况下才会发作的恐惧症，而这东西竟能引致它们全都发作。」
～札苟斯樵夫亚鲁

428107.oracleText: "If you've never feasted on Zagoth terror-pig, I got the best price you'll find."
428107.translation: 「要是你从未尝过札苟斯恐猪的味道，我这里的价格最公道。」

428110.oracleText: The living fear Nethroi's whispers. The dead heed them.
428110.translation: 生者畏惧涅司罗的低语，而死者则从其召唤。

428114.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, each opponent discards a card.
428114.translation: 每当此生物合变时，每位对手各弃一张牌。

428117.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, each opponent sacrifices a creature.
428117.translation: 每当此生物合变时，每位对手各牺牲一个生物。

428118.oracleText: "How did we find each other? So there I was, exploring a mound of monster corpses . . ."
428118.translation: 「我们是怎样相遇的？我当时，应该是在一堆怪兽尸体中翻找…」

428119.oracleText:
"The poacher's trade isn't monster parts. It's myth. People pay to be part of the fantasy."
—Kelsien, the Plague
428119.translation:
「偷猎者卖的不是怪兽奇异身躯，而是狩猎故事。人们愿意付钱来成为轶事的一个环节。」
～疫病凯鑫

428120.oracleText:
"You're not my quarry, little one. I'm after whatever comes to investigate your cries."
—Kelsien, the Plague
428120.translation:
「你不是我的猎物，小家伙。我要抓的是闻声赶来的那东西。」
～疫病凯鑫

428123.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, destroy target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
428123.translation: 每当此生物合变时，消灭目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

428125.oracleText:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist
428125.translation:
「我曾见过它们活过熔岩、踩踏甚至是棘蜥的肠胃。它们就这么滚出来，安然无恙地活下去！」
～翔空城动物学家加涅特

428126.oracleText: {o4oB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
428126.translation: {o4oB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

428127.oracleText: {o4oB}: Return Durable Coilbug from your graveyard to your hand.
428127.translation: {o4oB}：将硬壳蜷曲虫从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

428129.oracleText: "What she sees, I see. What she tastes, I taste."
428129.translation: 「吾见彼之所见。吾尝彼之所尝。」

428132.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with lifelink.
428132.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且具系命异能的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

428134.oracleText: The definition of "bite-sized treat" depends on who you ask.
428134.translation: 「易入口美馔」的大小取决于你问谁。

428137.oracleText:
"Nature is more merciless than any hunter I've ever known."
—Zai, nightsquad captain
428137.translation:
「大自然比我认识的所有猎人都要无情。」
～夜班队长泽耶

428141.oracleText:
"They say it survives on a purely bioluminescent diet. It's only active during the darkest of Indatha nights, making verification highly challenging."
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist
428141.translation:
「他们说这东西仅靠吃发光生物来维生。它只在因达沙最黑暗的夜晚中活动，因此要验证这点也变得十分困难。」
～翔空城动物学家加涅特

428143.oracleText: Most monsters are more frightening when they skitter unseen in the dark. Most.
428143.translation: 对于大多数怪兽来说，是它们藏身黑暗窸窣移动时才最令人畏惧。至少大多数是这样。

428147.translation:
「不是它们死，就是我们亡。」
～寇卓将军

428148.oracleText: Destroy target creature with no counters on it.
428148.translation: 消灭目标其上没有指示物的生物。

428149.oracleText: Remove up to three counters from target creature.
428149.translation: 从目标生物上移去至多三个指示物。

428150.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target creature with no counters on it. • Remove up to three counters from target creature.
428150.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标其上没有指示物的生物。 •  从目标生物上移去至多三个指示物。

428152.oracleText:
"The cruelest monsters inspire the greatest tales. The greatest tales inspire the cruelest hunters."
—Rielle, the Everwise
428152.translation:
「最凶残的怪兽留下最精彩的故事，最精彩的故事鼓舞最凶残的猎人。」
～全知利艾尔

428157.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of times this creature has mutated.
428157.translation: 每当此生物合变时，每位对手各失去X点生命，且你获得X点生命，X为此生物已合变的次数。

428159.oracleText: "There's no roar so mighty that it can't be silenced."
428159.translation: 「无论咆哮有多宏伟，都能令其噤声。」

428162.oracleText:
"By halves does youth depart. I remember halves of names, halves of years, halves of myself."
—Ogaro, wandering sage
428162.translation:
「青春好年华，半数已流逝。回忆仅余半数的名字，半数的时光和半数的自我。」
～云游智者欧家洛

428164.oracleText: Hunter and hunted both died thinking they had outwitted the other.
428164.translation: 猎人与猎物同归于尽，都以为自己已智取对手。

428165.oracleText: This spell has flash as long as you control a permanent with flash.
428165.translation: 只要你操控具闪现异能的永久物，此咒语便具有闪现异能。

428167.oracleText:
"And then the shadow took living form, and the shadow devoured the man whole—body, mind, and soul."
—Tales of the Ozolith
428167.translation:
「然后这片阴影开始自己行动起来，随即将那人全数吞下～身体、心灵、灵魂一样不剩。」
～《欧佐晶岩传说》

428168.oracleText: Destroy target nonland permanent if it's a creature or if {oGoW} was spent to cast this spell.
428168.translation: 选择目标非地永久物。如果它是生物或如果施放此咒语时支付过{oGoW}，则消灭之。

428170.oracleText: "The big fella sounds hungry. Let's send him to bed without his supper."
428170.translation: 「听这大家伙的吼声，它好像是饿了。让我们帮它节省一顿晚饭，早点送它睡觉去吧。」

428174.oracleText: Each scorpion's venom is unique, thwarting sanctuary healers' attempts to develop an antidote.
428174.translation: 每只蝎子的毒液都与众不同，令庇护地治疗师的解药研究停滞不前。

428175.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
428175.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

428176.oracleText: When Serrated Scorpion dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
428176.translation: 当锯尾蝎死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

428178.oracleText:
"Yesterday it was flying tigers and crumbling bridges. Who knows what today will bring?"
—Dol, Lavabrink quartermaster
428178.translation:
「昨天有会飞的老虎和坍塌的桥梁。谁知道今天会有什么？」
～熔缘城军需官达尔

428180.oracleText:
From now until the crystals stop glowing
—Ketria oath meaning "forever"
428180.translation:
从今开始，晶熄方休
～克崔亚誓言，意指「永远」

428181.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a lifelink counter on it.
428181.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个系命指示物。

428183.oracleText:
"With the frequent mutations, predator-prey relationships seem to change every moment. I already like it here."
—Vivien Reid
428183.translation:
「由于生物变异频繁，猎者和猎物之间的关系似乎每时每刻都在变化。我已经喜欢上这里了。」
～薇薇安瑞德

428184.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter and a lifelink counter on target creature.
428184.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物和一个系命指示物。

428185.oracleText: "I appreciate you not letting me fall to my death in the acid bogs. Now, can you let me down?"
428185.translation: 「非常感谢你救了我，没让我落入酸沼丧命。那现在能把我放下来了吗？」

428187.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, put a deathtouch counter on target creature you control.
428187.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个死触指示物。

428188.oracleText: When you cycle Void Beckoner, put a deathtouch counter on target creature you control.
428188.translation: 当你循环虚空召兽时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个死触指示物。

428190.oracleText: Ears can't hear them. Eyes see too many of them.
428190.translation: 耳朵难闻其声。眼目满是其人。

428194.oracleText:
"It's just a snake. A many-eyed snake with venom that turns your blood to smoke, but still, just a snake."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy
428194.translation:
「那只不过是一条蛇。虽然它长了很多眼睛，还有剧毒能将你的血液化烟散去，但它毕竟只是一条蛇。」
～持绊逸才季宁

428195.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
428195.translation: 每当此生物合变时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

428196.oracleText:
"Don't ask me what to do if you miss. They're stingdrakes. Don't miss."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain
428196.translation:
「别问我没打中该怎么办。那可是刺针龙兽。给我中。」
～熔缘城队长欧席因

428198.oracleText:
"Ah, we have a critic."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain
428198.translation:
「啊，有个敢说话的。」
～熔缘城队长欧席因

428199.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.

428200.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Blisterspit Gremlin deals 1 damage to each opponent.
428200.translation: {o1}，{oT}：蜇息怪灵向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

428201.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, untap Blisterspit Gremlin.
428201.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，重置蜇息怪灵。

428203.oracleText: The sound of Vadrok's gigantic wings is ominous. But the true terror is when they fall silent.
428203.translation: 瓦卓克扇动巨翼的声音固然是不详预兆，但翼声沉寂之后，恐怖时刻才真正来临。

428204.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
428204.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于你坟墓场中瞬间和法术牌的数量加总。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

428205.oracleText: Blitz of the Thunder-Raptor deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
428205.translation: 雷鸣龙闪击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于你坟墓场中瞬间和法术牌的数量加总。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

428206.oracleText: The soldier had given up his wealth, his title, even his home, but he had no room for regret. At last, he had saved his friend.
428206.translation: 士兵放弃了一切财产、荣誉甚至家园，但他毫无一丝后悔。至少，他救出了自己的朋友。

428208.oracleText:
"Let the brutes fight. If they kill each other, we lose no more soldiers today."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain
428208.translation:
「先让怪兽互相残杀。如果它们同归于尽，我们今天就不会死人了。」
～熔缘城队长欧席因

428211.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
428211.translation: 每当此生物合变时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

428213.oracleText: The first line of defense, and the last person you want to anger.
428213.translation: 他是你的最前线守卫，也是你最不想惹恼的人。

428214.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
428214.translation: 每当你循环另一张牌时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

428215.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card, Drannith Stinger deals 1 damage to each opponent.
428215.translation: 每当你循环另一张牌时，卓尼斯术击师向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

428217.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target Phoenix card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
428217.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标凤凰牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

428218.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Feather: Return target Phoenix card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
428218.translation: {o1}，牺牲翎羽：将目标凤凰牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

428219.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, create a red artifact token named Feather with "{o1}, Sacrifice Feather: Return target Phoenix card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped."
428219.translation: 每当此生物合变时，派出一个名称为翎羽的红色衍生神器，此神器具有「{o1}，牺牲翎羽：将目标凤凰牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。」

428222.oracleText: From a certain perspective, it's an inspiring story of overcoming obstacles.
428222.translation: 从某种角度来说，这是一个不畏艰辛克服万难的励志故事。

428226.oracleText:
"Water and bone tell many tales, but fire is fickle. It would rather consume than reveal."
—Rielle, the Everwise
428226.translation:
「流水骸骨显迹象，烈火无形难留踪。比起揭示未来，它更喜欢吞噬一切。」
～全知利艾尔

428227.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library. If you do, draw a card.
428227.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。你可以将一张牌从你的手上置于你的牌库底。如果你如此作，则抓一张牌。

428228.oracleText: Fire Prophecy deals 3 damage to target creature. You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library. If you do, draw a card.
428228.translation: 烈火预言对目标生物造成3点伤害。你可以将一张牌从你的手上置于你的牌库底。如果你如此作，则抓一张牌。

428230.oracleText: Fragile, floating Skysail suddenly seemed like an appealingly safe place to live.
428230.translation: 脆弱飘摇的翔空城突然间像是个安全宜居的福地。

428231.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
428231.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害。过量伤害改为对该生物的操控者造成之。

428232.oracleText: Flame Spill deals 4 damage to target creature. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
428232.translation: 烈焰如注对目标生物造成4点伤害。过量伤害改为对该生物的操控者造成之。

428234.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature gains trample and haste until end of turn.
428234.translation: {oT}：目标生物获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

428235.oracleText: Enchanted land has "{oT}: Target creature gains trample and haste until end of turn."
428235.translation: 所结附的地具有「{oT}：目标生物获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。」

428237.oracleText: The two looked at each other, and neither fled. "I see," the soldier murmured. "We're both just fighting for survival out here, aren't we?"
428237.translation: 双方目光交汇，谁都没有向后退却。「我懂，」士兵低声道。「我们彼此拼命，不就是为了在这里求得生存吗？」

428238.oracleText: Create a 1/1 red Dinosaur creature token with haste and a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
428238.translation: 派出一个1/1红色，具敏捷异能的恐龙衍生生物和一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

428239.oracleText:
"Though the road through Raugrin is lined with alarm crystals, some monsters seem to be adapting. We've had raptors feigning attacks on provision caravans, while others try to sneak through the lava curtain."
—Dol, Lavabrink quartermaster
428239.translation:
「虽然洛格凌道路两侧都设有预警水晶，但有些怪兽似乎已找出适应之法。之前就有过一批迅猛龙佯攻粮车，掩护另一批怪兽穿越熔岩屏障的事情。」
～熔缘城军需官达尔

428244.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with menace.
428244.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且具威慑异能的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

428246.oracleText: Lukka's bond provided not only friendship, but also the most powerful weapon in his arsenal.
428246.translation: 卢卡的羁绊不仅让他与野兽结下深厚友谊，还让他手中多了一把强大武器。

428248.oracleText: Some crystals glow in the presence of monsters, forming a convenient warning system. Some monsters have learned to outrun the light.
428248.translation: 有些水晶会在怪兽出现时发出光芒，从而形成有效的预警系统。而有些怪兽则已学会跑得比光更快。

428249.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Put a first strike counter on it.
428249.translation: 目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。在其上放置一个先攻指示物。

428251.oracleText: Lavabrink's boiling moat is a deterrent for most, and a relaxing bath for one.
428251.translation: 熔缘城滚热的护城河是许多生物难以逾越的天堑，对其他生物而言却是难得的放松场地。

428254.oracleText: You may cast this card from exile as long as you control a Lukka planeswalker.
428254.translation: 只要你操控卢卡鹏洛客，你便可以从放逐区施放此牌。

428255.oracleText: Exile the top three cards of your library. Creature cards exiled this way gain "You may cast this card from exile as long as you control a Lukka planeswalker."
428255.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。以此法放逐的生物牌获得「只要你操控卢卡鹏洛客，你便可以从放逐区施放此牌。」

428257.oracleText: Each creature you control deals damage equal to its power to each opponent.
428257.translation: 每个由你操控的生物各向每位对手造成等同于自身力量的伤害。

428259.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if it doesn't have first strike, put a first strike counter on it.
428259.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若它不具有先攻异能，则在其上放置一个先攻指示物。

428260.oracleText: Whenever Momentum Rumbler attacks, if it doesn't have first strike, put a first strike counter on it.
428260.translation: 每当猛冲撼地龙攻击时，若它不具有先攻异能，则在其上放置一个先攻指示物。

428261.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if it has first strike, it gains double strike until end of turn.
428261.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若它具有先攻异能，则它获得连击异能直到回合结束。

428262.oracleText: Whenever Momentum Rumbler attacks, if it has first strike, it gains double strike until end of turn.
428262.translation: 每当猛冲撼地龙攻击时，若它具有先攻异能，则它获得连击异能直到回合结束。

428264.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers. If {oWoU} was spent to cast this spell, until your next turn, those permanents can't attack or block and their activated abilities can't be activated.
428264.translation: CARDNAME对任意数量的目标生物和／或鹏洛客造成共5点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果施放此咒语时支付过{oWoU}，则直到你的下一个回合，这些永久物不能进行攻击或阻挡，其起动式异能也不能起动。

428265.oracleText: Mythos of Vadrok deals 5 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers. If {oWoU} was spent to cast this spell, until your next turn, those permanents can't attack or block and their activated abilities can't be activated.
428265.translation: 瓦卓克传说对任意数量的目标生物和／或鹏洛客造成共5点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果施放此咒语时支付过{oWoU}，则直到你的下一个回合，这些永久物不能进行攻击或阻挡，其起动式异能也不能起动。

428268.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of times this creature has mutated.
428268.translation: {oT}：此生物对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为此生物已合变的次数。

428270.oracleText:
"It's either terrified or extremely mad at us, definitely one of the two."
—Jonald, mission naturalist
428270.translation:
「它要么是被吓坏了，要么是非常生我们的气，没有第三种可能。」
～实地博物学家贾纳德

428271.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
428271.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

428272.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, Prickly Marmoset gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
428272.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，带刺狨猴得+2/+0直到回合结束。

428274.oracleText: "I always thought wizards were supposed to have cats or one-eyed owls for familiars, but flaming dinosaurs work, too."
428274.translation: 「我总觉得法师应该养猫或独眼枭这类的佣兽才是，不过浑身冒火的恐龙也挺堪用。」

428275.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Pyroceratops.
428275.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在焰身角龙上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

428277.oracleText:
"How many claws does a monster have? Exactly one more than you've accounted for."
—Alux, Skysail defender
428277.translation:
「怪兽会有几只爪？总比你想的多一只。」
～翔空城护卫亚卢斯

428279.oracleText: Danger often lurks in the allure of crystal shards.
428279.translation: 危险往往就藏在水晶碎片的诱惑之中。

428280.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, you may have CARDNAME become a 5/4 Dinosaur creature with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
428280.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，你可以令CARDNAME成为5/4，具践踏与敏捷异能的恐龙生物直到回合结束，且仍具有其原本类别。

428281.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, you may have Reptilian Reflection become a 5/4 Dinosaur creature with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
428281.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，你可以令爬虫映影成为5/4，具践踏与敏捷异能的恐龙生物直到回合结束，且仍具有其原本类别。

428283.oracleText: Their feeding habits leave them with gizzards full of tumbled gems.
428283.translation: 它们的饮食习惯让其胃囊中满是磨得闪闪发光的宝石。

428287.oracleText:
"When monsters walk, the earth knows its place and yields."
—Rielle, the Everwise
428287.translation:
「怪兽迈步之时，大地应声崩裂。」
～全知利艾尔

428288.oracleText: Rumbling Rockslide deals damage to target creature equal to the number of lands you control.
428288.translation: 隆响石流对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的地之数量。

428290.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, put a first strike counter on target creature you control.
428290.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个先攻指示物。

428291.oracleText: When you cycle Sanctuary Smasher, put a first strike counter on target creature you control.
428291.translation: 当你循环庇护地破坏兽时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个先攻指示物。

428293.oracleText: Shredded Sails deals 4 damage to target creature with flying.
428293.translation: 翔帆损毁对目标具飞行异能的生物造成4点伤害。

428294.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target artifact. • CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature with flying.
428294.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器。 •  CARDNAME对目标具飞行异能的生物造成4点伤害。

428295.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target artifact. • Shredded Sails deals 4 damage to target creature with flying.
428295.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器。 •  翔帆损毁对目标具飞行异能的生物造成4点伤害。

428297.oracleText:
"The monster that scares me the most isn't the biggest."
—Taelya, Lavabrink pyromage
428297.translation:
「最令我害怕的怪兽，并非体型最大者。」
～熔缘城烈焰法师泰勒娅

428298.oracleText: CARDNAME has double strike as long as there are three or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.
428298.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有三张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

428299.oracleText: Spelleater Wolverine has double strike as long as there are three or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.
428299.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有三张或更多的瞬间和／或法术牌，噬咒狼獾便具有连击异能。

428301.oracleText: Lukka was ordered to kill a threat. He chose to make a friend.
428301.translation: 卢卡受命猎杀威胁。他选择结交朋友。

428302.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you control a creature with menace.
428302.translation: 如果你操控具威慑异能的生物，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

428304.oracleText: If a cycling ability of another nonland card would cause you to draw a card, instead exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a card that shares a card type with the cycled card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then put the exiled cards that weren't cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
428304.translation: 如果另一张非地牌之任一循环异能将令你抓一张牌，则改为从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张与所循环者具共通牌张类别的牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。然后将所有以此法放逐且未施放的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

428306.oracleText: Revenge is a path inevitably walked alone.
428306.translation: 复仇这条道路必将独自前行。

428307.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a creature: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
428307.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个生物：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

428308.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a creature: Weaponize the Monsters deals 2 damage to any target.
428308.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个生物：以兽为兵对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

428311.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, shuffle it into your library from your graveyard. If you've cycled a card named Yidaro, Wandering Monster four or more times this game, put it onto the battlefield from your graveyard instead.
428311.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，将它从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。若本盘游戏中你已将名称为游荡怪兽依达罗的牌循环过四次或更多，则改为将它从你的坟墓场放进战场。

428312.oracleText: When you cycle Yidaro, Wandering Monster, shuffle it into your library from your graveyard. If you've cycled a card named Yidaro, Wandering Monster four or more times this game, put it onto the battlefield from your graveyard instead.
428312.translation: 当你循环游荡怪兽依达罗时，将它从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。若本盘游戏中你已将名称为游荡怪兽依达罗的牌循环过四次或更多，则改为将它从你的坟墓场放进战场。

428313.oracleText: An adventure without a companion is hardly an adventure at all.
428313.translation: 没有行侣的冒险，就根本不能称为冒险。

428315.oracleText:
Laughed at the brushwagg
—Hunters' expression meaning
"died unexpectedly"
428315.translation:
嘲笑丛枝兽
～猎人用语，意指
「意外死亡」

428316.oracleText: {o3oG}: CARDNAME gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

428317.oracleText: {o3oG}: Almighty Brushwagg gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
428317.translation: {o3oG}：威能丛枝兽得+3/+3直到回合结束。

428320.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile X permanent cards, where X is the number of times this creature has mutated. Put those permanent cards onto the battlefield.
428320.translation: 每当此生物合变时，从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐X张永久物牌为止，X为此生物已合变的次数。将这些永久物牌放进战场。

428322.oracleText:
"They cast wards, thinking it will protect them, but the biggest monsters find a way through."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy
428322.translation:
「他们施放守护力图自保，然而最大的怪兽还是能一头撞破。」
～持绊逸才季宁

428323.oracleText: Exile up to three target enchantments.
428323.translation: 放逐至多三个目标结界。

428324.oracleText:
"I can bring down anything in Zagoth, but for some quarry the ratio of fight to meat is too high."
—Master Hunter Chevill
428324.translation:
「札苟斯境内一切怪兽都不是我对手，但有些猎物之肉量贴补不上所耗损的搏斗精力。」
～狩猎大师车维尔

428326.oracleText: The Zagoth wetlands are fertilized by centuries of Brokkos's former challengers.
428326.translation: 数世纪来源源不断的挑战者在布洛寇面前现身，然后化为札苟斯湿地的养分。

428327.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the revealed card's power.
428327.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所展示之牌的力量。

428328.oracleText: Charge of the Forever-Beast deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the revealed card's power.
428328.translation: 恒天犀冲锋对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所展示之牌的力量。

428330.oracleText:
"Turns out the case of the flattened outpost and the case of the missing kitten were related."
—Endris, Drannith magistrate
428330.translation:
「事实证明，哨站被踏平事件与小猫失踪事件之间确实有联系。」
～卓尼斯官员恩姬丝

428334.oracleText: The Ozolith's appearance spawned a new era of wild mutation on Ikoria. Some creatures hunted different prey, lived in new habitats, and thrived on mutation itself.
428334.translation: 欧佐晶岩的出现，拉开了依克黎野生变异的崭新篇章。有些生物次次猎捕不同猎物，更换栖息地，并靠自身变异成长。

428335.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control mutates, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature and you gain 2 life.
428335.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物合变时，在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且你获得2点生命。

428337.oracleText: It makes molehills out of mountains.
428337.translation: 它在高山之上打出鼹丘。

428341.oracleText: Sometimes the eludha is a sacred harmony of souls. Sometimes the bonder grabs some fur and holds on tight.
428341.translation: 有些时候，灵绊是靠心灵之间神圣共鸣来维系。而有些时候，则是靠持绊人抓紧坐稳来维持。

428342.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may change the base power and toughness of target Human you control to CARDNAME's power and toughness until end of turn.
428342.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以将目标由你操控之人类生物的基础力量与防御力更改为CARDNAME的力量与防御力直到回合结束。

428343.oracleText: Whenever Exuberant Wolfbear attacks, you may change the base power and toughness of target Human you control to Exuberant Wolfbear's power and toughness until end of turn.
428343.translation: 每当亢奋狼熊攻击时，你可以将目标由你操控之人类生物的基础力量与防御力更改为亢奋狼熊的力量与防御力直到回合结束。

428346.oracleText: Poachers use the harvested tongues to snare pests, plumb caves, and scale tall buildings.
428346.translation: 偷猎者用割下来的舌头来诱捕昆虫，探查洞窟，攀爬高楼。

428350.oracleText:
"One day I woke up and knew I had nothing left to teach her. So now I ride on her shoulders and follow where she leads."
—Gustin, wildbonder
428350.translation:
「有一天醒来之后，我意识到已经没有能够教她的东西了。于是我就骑上她的肩头，随她自由奔袭。」
～蛮野持绊人古斯丁

428351.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. Put a trample counter on it.
428351.translation: 目标生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。在其上放置一个践踏指示物。

428354.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
428354.translation: 每当此生物合变时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

428357.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
428357.translation: 每当此生物合变时，在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

428358.oracleText: On Ikoria, sandwurms never lie dormant for too long. In some regions, "no activity" is the greatest sign of danger.
428358.translation: 依克黎的沙丘亚龙不会长时静止不动。因此在部分地区，「没在活动」才是最大的危险讯号。

428360.oracleText:
"And I thought I had a big sweet tooth."
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist
428360.translation:
「我还以为我甜食已经吃得够多了。」
～翔空城动物学家加涅特

428363.oracleText: "We share the same nuanced opinion of hunters and military goons: smash them."
428363.translation: 「我们对猎人和大兵的看法基本一致：砸他们就对了。」

428366.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with trample.
428366.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且具践踏异能的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

428368.oracleText: "The key to bonding with monsters, no matter their size, is knowing where they like to be scratched."
428368.translation: 「怪兽不论大小，与其建立羁绊的关键都在于弄清楚它们喜欢你挠哪里。」

428369.oracleText: For safety reasons, the keeping of houseplants within Ikoria's sanctuaries is heavily discouraged.
428369.translation: 出于安全考虑，依克黎庇护地内强烈建议不要培养室内植物。

428372.oracleText: Whenever Kogla attacks, destroy target artifact or enchantment defending player controls.
428372.translation: 每当寇格拉攻击时，消灭目标由防御牌手操控的神器或结界。

428373.oracleText: {o1oG}: Return target Human you control to its owner's hand. Kogla gains indestructible until end of turn.
428373.translation: {o1oG}：将目标由你操控的人类移回其拥有者手上。寇格拉获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

428379.oracleText: Life is best taken one step at a time.
428379.translation: 生活最好一步一步地过。

428380.oracleText: Target creature gets +7/+7 until end of turn. Up to one other target creature blocks it this turn if able.
428380.translation: 目标生物得+7/+7直到回合结束。至多另一个目标生物本回合若能阻挡它，则须阻挡之。

428382.oracleText:
"Goriaks are as stubborn and hardy as I'd expect of a large herbivore in a wetland habitat. But I never expected them to have such beautiful voices!"
—Vivien Reid
428382.translation:
「跟我预料的一样，猿牦这种栖息于湿地的大型草食动物果然既倔强又莽撞。但我没想到它们的吼声那么好听！」
～薇薇安瑞德

428384.oracleText:
"The most unexpected weapon that a monster can wield is kindness."
—Tales of the Ozolith
428384.translation:
「怪兽运用的武器中最出人意表者便是善意。」
～《欧佐晶岩传说》

428386.oracleText: Return up to two permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand.
428386.translation: 将至多两张永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

428387.oracleText: Scavengers follow in Skysail's shadow, feasting on the carcasses of monsters that attacked the floating city.
428387.translation: 拾荒者追随翔空城的阴影移动，拿试图攻击这座漂浮城市的怪兽尸体果腹。

428389.oracleText:
"Need a medic! And some stonemasons!"
—Wyllon, Drannith merchant
428389.translation:
「医生快来！还有石匠！」
～卓尼斯商人沃伦

428390.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control. If the creature you control has trample, excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
428390.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。如果该由你操控的生物具有践踏异能，则过量伤害改为对后者生物的操控者造成之。

428392.oracleText:
"What's natural on Ikoria continues to delight me."
—Vivien Reid
428392.translation:
「依克黎一切自然现象都不断令我欣喜。」
～薇薇安瑞德

428393.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+3 until end of turn. Put a reach counter on it. Untap it.
428393.translation: 目标生物得+1/+3直到回合结束。在其上放置一个延势指示物。将之重置。

428395.oracleText: "And what did we learn? Never taunt a porcuparrot!"
428395.translation: 「我们得到了什么教训？别惹箭羽鹦鹉！」

428396.oracleText: Return target Human creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
428396.translation: 将目标人类生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

428397.oracleText: Return target non-Human creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
428397.translation: 将目标非人类生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

428398.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Return target Human creature card from your graveyard to your hand. • Return target non-Human creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
428398.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  将目标人类生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 •  将目标非人类生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

428400.oracleText:
"Your prey is in my custody now. Withdraw."
—Vivien Reid
428400.translation:
「你们的猎物现在受我保护。退后。」
～薇薇安瑞德

428401.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures your opponents control.
428401.translation: 于本回合中，防止由对手操控之生物将造成的所有伤害。

428403.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, put a trample counter on target creature you control.
428403.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个践踏指示物。

428404.oracleText: When you cycle Titanoth Rex, put a trample counter on target creature you control.
428404.translation: 当你循环霸巨龙时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个践踏指示物。

428406.oracleText: You may cast creature spells from the top of your library.
428406.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶施放生物咒语。

428407.oracleText: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. Put your choice of a vigilance counter, a reach counter, or a trample counter on it.
428407.translation: 派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。在其上依你的选择放置一个警戒指示物、一个延势指示物或一个践踏指示物。

428410.oracleText: Nothing returns from the nightmare nests of Indatha unscathed.
428410.translation: 没有东西能从因达沙梦魇巢穴中全身而退。

428412.oracleText:
"How can you be sure you pierced its heart? Do you even know where its heart is?"
—Trundan, Indatha poacher
428412.translation:
「你怎么确定已经刺穿了它的心脏？你知道它的心脏在哪里吗？」
～因达沙偷猎者川丁

428413.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. When you do, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
428413.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。当你如此作时，它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

428416.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
428416.translation: 每当此生物合变时，将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

428420.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard using its mutate ability.
428420.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用CARDNAME的合变异能来施放之。

428421.oracleText: You may cast Brokkos, Apex of Forever from your graveyard using its mutate ability.
428421.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用恒天霸犀布洛寇的合变异能来施放之。

428423.oracleText: Few monsters challenged Narset after they sensed her power.
428423.translation: 在怪兽感知娜尔施的力量后，胆敢挑战者所剩无几。

428424.oracleText: Target player draws X cards. CARDNAME deals X damage to up to one target creature or planeswalker.
428424.translation: 目标牌手抓X张牌。CARDNAME对至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。

428425.oracleText: Target player draws X cards. Channeled Force deals X damage to up to one target creature or planeswalker.
428425.translation: 目标牌手抓X张牌。通贯魔力对至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。

428427.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if your opponents control no permanents with bounty counters on them, put a bounty counter on target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
428427.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若所有对手均未操控其上有赏金指示物的永久物，则在目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客上放置一个赏金指示物。

428428.oracleText: Whenever a permanent an opponent controls with a bounty counter on it dies, you gain 3 life and draw a card.
428428.translation: 每当一个由对手操控且其上有赏金指示物的永久物死去时，你获得3点生命并抓一张牌。

428434.oracleText:
"I will preserve human life at all costs. I will stand alone against behemoths before I let them touch my city. I will hold the wall."
—Oath of the Coppercoats
428434.translation:
「我将不惜代价守护人命。就算孤身也会勇面巨兽，不让它们靠近城市。我定将坚守高墙。」
～紫铜军誓约

428435.oracleText: Exile target creature. If you don't control a Human, you lose life equal to that creature's toughness.
428435.translation: 放逐目标生物。如果你未操控人类，则你失去等同于该生物防御力的生命。

428437.oracleText:
"The ground under our feet is a record of every slight against the world, to be avenged at a time of its choosing."
—Gavi, nest warden
428437.translation:
「我们每次对世界的轻蔑，都由脚下的大地记录在案，等待合适的时机来复仇。」
～巢穴护卫盖薇

428438.oracleText: Return any number of permanent cards with different names from your graveyard to the battlefield.
428438.translation: 将任意数量名称各不相同的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

428440.oracleText: Search your library for up to three monocolored cards with different names and exile them. An opponent chooses one of those cards. Shuffle that card into your library. You may cast the other cards without paying their mana costs. Exile CARDNAME.
428440.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张名称各不相同的单色牌并将这些牌放逐。由任一对手选择其中一张。将该牌洗入你的牌库。你可以施放其余的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐CARDNAME。

428441.oracleText: Search your library for up to three monocolored cards with different names and exile them. An opponent chooses one of those cards. Shuffle that card into your library. You may cast the other cards without paying their mana costs. Exile Emergent Ultimatum.
428441.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张名称各不相同的单色牌并将这些牌放逐。由任一对手选择其中一张。将该牌洗入你的牌库。你可以施放其余的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐突发通牒。

428443.oracleText:
"Fear not the behemoth heard from miles away. Fear the stalking felidar, which reveals itself only for the kill."
—Rielle, the Everwise
428443.translation:
「远隔数哩就能听到吼声的巨兽不足为惧。反而是悄无声息，只在攻击时才会现身的隐蔽晶角兽才需要担心。」
～全知利艾尔

428445.oracleText: Creatures you control with vigilance have "{o1}, {oT}: Tap target creature."
428445.translation: 由你操控且具警戒异能的生物具有「{o1}，{oT}：横置目标生物。」

428447.translation: 由你操控的其他人类得+1/+1。

428450.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice two Humans: Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.
428450.translation: {o2}，牺牲两个人类：消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

428452.translation: 比卓尼斯的高墙更硬实。

428453.oracleText: Legendary Humans you control have indestructible.
428453.translation: 由你操控的传奇人类具有不灭异能。

428454.oracleText: {o2oWoB}: Exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a creature card, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
428454.translation: {o2oWoB}：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果它是生物牌，则派出一个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物。

428456.oracleText: No human eyes have ever witnessed the birth of an apex monster.
428456.translation: 未有人类亲眼见证霸兽诞生。

428457.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. Put any number of permanent cards from among them onto the battlefield and the rest into your hand. Exile CARDNAME.
428457.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中任意数量的永久物牌放进战场，其余则置于你手上。放逐CARDNAME。

428458.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. Put any number of permanent cards from among them onto the battlefield and the rest into your hand. Exile Genesis Ultimatum.
428458.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中任意数量的永久物牌放进战场，其余则置于你手上。放逐创生通牒。

428462.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland permanent card. Put that card onto the battlefield or into your hand.
428462.translation: 每当此生物合变时，从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张非地永久物牌为止。将该牌放进战场或置于你手上。

428464.oracleText:
"Inner peace is wonderful, and worth striving for. Outer peace is much less important."
—Taelya, Lavabrink pyromage
428464.translation:
「内在的平静是理想状态，值得努力追求。外在的平静就没有那么重要。」
～熔缘城烈焰法师泰勒娅

428465.oracleText: Target player gains 5 life, CARDNAME deals 5 damage to any target, then you draw five cards.
428465.translation: 目标牌手获得5点生命，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成5点伤害，然后你抓五张牌。

428466.oracleText: Target player gains 5 life, Inspired Ultimatum deals 5 damage to any target, then you draw five cards.
428466.translation: 目标牌手获得5点生命，启迪通牒对任意一个目标造成5点伤害，然后你抓五张牌。

428468.oracleText: Whenever you tap a nonland permanent for mana, add one mana of any type that permanent produced.
428468.translation: 每当你横置一个非地永久物以产生法术力时，加一点该永久物已产生的类别之法术力。

428469.oracleText: {o5oGoU}: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a non-Human creature card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
428469.translation: {o5oGoU}：检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中一张非人类的生物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

428472.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with menace becomes blocked, defending player sacrifices a creature blocking it.
428472.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具威慑异能的生物被阻挡时，防御牌手牺牲一个阻挡它的生物。

428473.oracleText: {oBoR}: Creatures you control with menace get +1/+0 until end of turn.
428473.translation: {oBoR}：由你操控且具威慑异能的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

428476.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
428476.translation: 每当此生物合变时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

428478.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Add {oU}, {oR}, or {oW}. Spend this mana only to cast a noncreature spell.
428478.translation: 你获得2点生命。加{oU}，{oR}或{oW}。此法术力只能用来施放非生物咒语。

428481.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this emblem deals 2 damage to any target.
428481.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

428482.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this emblem deals 2 damage to any target."
428482.translation: 你获得具有「每当你施放非生物咒语时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成2点伤害」的徽记。

428490.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, return any number of target creature cards with total power 10 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
428490.translation: 每当此生物合变时，将任意数量的目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌的力量总和须等于或小于10。

428492.oracleText: All they found in the hunter's camp were tiny paw prints and a lot of blood.
428492.translation: 他们在猎人营地中找到的，就只有小型爪印和大量鲜血。

428493.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, exile target red, white, or black creature card from your graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's 1/1. It gains haste until your next turn.
428493.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，将目标红色，白色或黑色生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐。派出一个衍生物，该衍生物为该牌的复制品，但它是1/1。它获得敏捷异能直到你的下一个回合。

428496.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
428496.translation: {o1}，{oT}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，则你可以将之放进战场。如果你未将该牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

428498.oracleText: "From this day forward, we confront this world together, lifting each other up."
428498.translation: 「从今天开始，我们将共同面对这个世界，相互提升彼此。」

428499.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card if you control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
428499.translation: 在你的维持开始时，如果你操控力量为战场上生物中最大值的生物，则抓一张牌。若否，则在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

428501.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control with trample deal combat damage to a player, create an X/X green Dinosaur Beast creature token with trample, where X is the amount of damage those creatures dealt to that player.
428501.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且具践踏异能的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个X/X绿色，具践踏异能的恐龙／野兽衍生生物，X为前述生物对该牌手造成伤害的数值。

428505.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, other creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn.
428505.translation: 每当此生物合变时，由你操控的其他生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

428507.oracleText: "Being all-knowing is a matter of remembering which things it is crucial to forget."
428507.translation: 「全知就是要记住必须忘却哪些事情。」

428508.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
428508.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+0。

428509.oracleText: Rielle, the Everwise gets +1/+0 for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
428509.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，全知利艾尔便得+1/+0。

428510.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards for the first time each turn, draw that many cards.
428510.translation: 每当你每回合首度弃掉一张或数张牌时，抓等量的牌。

428512.oracleText:
"Strike those abominations down. Let their names rot with their remains."
—General Kudro
428512.translation:
「打倒那些憎恨怪兽。让它们的名字连同尸首一起腐烂。」
～寇卓将军

428513.oracleText: Destroy all nonland permanents your opponents control.
428513.translation: 消灭所有由对手操控的非地永久物。

428515.oracleText: A crackling roar is the last sound many hunters hear.
428515.translation: 一道雷鸣嘶吼，是许多猎人听到的最后声音。

428516.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, you may pay {o2}. When you do, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life.
428516.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，你可以支付{o2}。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对目标生物造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

428517.oracleText: Whenever you cycle a card, you may pay {o2}. When you do, Savai Thundermane deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life.
428517.translation: 每当你循环一张牌时，你可以支付{o2}。当你如此作时，撒维耶雷鬃狮对目标生物造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

428519.oracleText: "I study bone because that's where truth dwells. One monster knucklebone is wiser than all that damp meat in your head."
428519.translation: 「我研究兽骨，是因为真相留藏其中。怪兽的指节骨都比你脑壳中那团浆糊更有用。」

428521.oracleText: The bounty on its head is as old as Skysail, but no one has ever tried to collect.
428521.translation: 翔空城从建立的第一天起就悬赏要拿下它的脑袋，但至今仍无人敢试。

428522.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each other creature you control with flying.
428522.translation: 你每操控一个具飞行异能的其他生物，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

428523.oracleText: Skycat Sovereign gets +1/+1 for each other creature you control with flying.
428523.translation: 你每操控一个具飞行异能的其他生物，翔狮君王便得+1/+1。

428524.oracleText: {o2oWoU}: Create a 1/1 white Cat Bird creature token with flying.
428524.translation: {o2oWoU}：派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的猫／鸟衍生生物。

428527.oracleText: Fear is its habitat, sanity its prey.
428527.translation: 恐惧乃栖所，理智为猎物。

428528.oracleText: Whenever you cast another spell that has flash, you draw a card and each opponent loses 1 life.
428528.translation: 每当你施放另一个具闪现异能的咒语时，你抓一张牌且每位对手各失去1点生命。

428532.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, it deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls and you gain 4 life.
428532.translation: 每当此生物合变时，它向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害，且你获得4点生命。

428534.oracleText: She wept, not from perfect understanding, but from serene gratitude.
428534.translation: 她虽然并未完全领悟颂歌真谛，却也折服于曲调间的祥和之景，不禁热泪盈眶。

428535.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, draw two cards.
428535.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，抓两张牌。

428538.oracleText: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.
428538.translation: 身形娇小若碧仙，怒火无情似巨龙。

428539.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Sprite Dragon.
428539.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在仙翼翔龙上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

428544.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
428544.translation: 每当此生物合变时，派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

428550.oracleText: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.
428550.translation: 娜尔施努力进入冥想之时，看到幼龙绕其身旁飞舞，思绪不禁飘到了远古部族时代。

428551.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, draw a card.
428551.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，抓一张牌。

428553.oracleText: Whenever a non-Human creature you control attacks, look at the top six cards of your library. You may put a Human creature card from among them onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. It gains indestructible until end of turn. Put the rest of the cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.
428553.translation: 每当一个由你操控的非人类生物攻击时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张人类生物牌放进战场，其为横置且正进行攻击。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

428555.oracleText:
"I defy this world to try our defenses now. Send pterons and skycats. Send Vadrok!"
—Janae, Coppercoat architect
428555.translation:
「我倒想看看这个世界如何突破我们的防线。翼兽翔狮尽管出阵；叫瓦卓克放马过来！」
～紫铜军军械师佳奈

428556.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target and you gain X life, where X is the number of cards with a cycling ability in your graveyard.
428556.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命，X为你坟墓场中具任一循环异能之牌的数量。

428557.oracleText: Zenith Flare deals X damage to any target and you gain X life, where X is the number of cards with a cycling ability in your graveyard.
428557.translation: 晶顶闪光对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命，X为你坟墓场中具任一循环异能之牌的数量。

428559.oracleText: Considering the zealous armies, vile poachers, and titanic monsters, it's always wise to keep one eye on the horizon.
428559.translation: 考虑到有狂热军队、卑劣猎者和庞巨怪兽，留点心思提防天边总是好的。

428560.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you gain 1 life for each creature you control with vigilance.
428560.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你每操控一个具警戒异能的生物，便获得1点生命。

428562.oracleText: "We are each other's shadow, fleeting yet always present."
428562.translation: 「我们彼此成影，虽踪迹不定却永远随行。」

428563.oracleText: Spells with flash you cast cost {o1} less to cast and can't be countered.
428563.translation: 你施放之具闪现异能的咒语减少{o1}来施放，且不能被反击。

428565.oracleText: Fiend Artisan gets +1/+1 for each creature card in your graveyard.
428565.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，塑生邪魔便得+1/+1。

428573.oracleText: Companion — No card in your starting deck has more than one of the same mana symbol in its mana cost.
428573.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中各牌之法术力费用内相同的法术力符号数量不得多于一个。

428574.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oWoUoBoRoG}. This mana can't be spent to pay generic mana costs.
428574.translation: {oT}：加{oWoUoBoRoG}。此法术力不能用于支付一般法术力费用。

428576.oracleText: She was born unable to walk. Through the eludha, she was able to fly.
428576.translation: 她生来便不能行走大地。但拜灵绊所赐，她能够翱翔天空。

428577.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target this creature cost {o2} more to cast.
428577.translation: 对手施放之以此生物为目标的咒语须额外支付{o2}来施放。

428578.oracleText: Creatures you control with flying have "Spells your opponents cast that target this creature cost {o2} more to cast."
428578.translation: 由你操控且具飞行异能的生物具有「对手施放且以此生物为目标的咒语增加{o2}来施放。」

428580.oracleText: Companion — Each creature card in your starting deck is a Cat, Elemental, Nightmare, Dinosaur, or Beast card.
428580.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中各生物牌均为猫、元素、梦魇、恐龙或野兽牌。

428581.oracleText: Each other creature you control that's a Cat, Elemental, Nightmare, Dinosaur, or Beast gets +1/+1 and has vigilance.
428581.translation: 由你操控且为猫、元素、梦魇、恐龙或野兽的其他生物得+1/+1且具有警戒异能。

428592.oracleText: Companion — Each nonland card in your starting deck has a different name.
428592.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中各非地牌的名称均不相同。

428600.oracleText:
"You're little now, yes, but one day your footsteps will make mountains tremble."
—Gustin, wildbonder
428600.translation:
「你现在还小，但总有一天你的脚步将震撼高山。」
～蛮野持绊人古斯丁

428601.oracleText: You may have this creature assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked.
428601.translation: 你可以让此生物如同未受阻挡地分配战斗伤害。

428602.oracleText: Creatures you control with trample have "You may have this creature assign its combat damage as though it weren't blocked."
428602.translation: 由你操控且具践踏异能的生物具有「你可以让此生物如同未受阻挡地分配战斗伤害。」

428604.oracleText: The call of the wild is rarely a solo.
428604.translation: 荒野呼唤极少不获应和。

428605.oracleText: Each creature you control with menace can't be blocked except by three or more creatures.
428605.translation: 每个由你操控且具威慑异能的生物均只能被三个或更多生物阻挡。

428607.oracleText: Companion — Each nonland card in your starting deck shares a card type.
428607.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中各非地牌之间均具有共通的牌张类别。

428612.oracleText: Companion — Your starting deck contains at least twenty cards more than the minimum deck size.
428612.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中包含之牌张数量须比套牌数量下限多至少二十张。

428616.oracleText: Companion — Each permanent card in your starting deck has an activated ability.
428616.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中各永久物牌均具有起动式异能。

428617.oracleText: Abilities you activate that aren't mana abilities cost {o2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
428617.translation: 你起动之不属于法术力异能的异能减少{o2}来起动。此效应无法将该费用中的法术力减少到少于一点法术力。

428618.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Target creature can't block this turn.
428618.translation: {o1}，{oT}：目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

428620.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose a kind of counter at random that CARDNAME doesn't have on it from among flying, first strike, deathtouch, hexproof, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance, and +1/+1. Put a counter of that kind on CARDNAME.
428620.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，从飞行、先攻、死触、辟邪、系命、威慑、延势、践踏、警戒和+1/+1等十种指示物内CARDNAME上面尚不具有者中随机选择一种。在CARDNAME上放置一个该种指示物。

428621.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose a kind of counter at random that Crystalline Giant doesn't have on it from among flying, first strike, deathtouch, hexproof, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance, and +1/+1. Put a counter of that kind on Crystalline Giant.
428621.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，从飞行、先攻、死触、辟邪、系命、威慑、延势、践踏、警戒和+1/+1等十种指示物内晶澈巨人上面尚不具有者中随机选择一种。在晶澈巨人上放置一个该种指示物。

428623.oracleText: Crystals nestle in the roots of Indatha's helica trees as if being nurtured by their embrace.
428623.translation: 因达沙的水晶受曲枝树根系环绕，仿佛受其呵护而不断成长。

428625.oracleText: The dark of night never truly falls on Ketria, where abundant crystals bathe the land in their glow.
428625.translation: 克崔亚的水晶遍布各处，以璀璨光芒照耀大地，令夜幕从未真正降临此处。

428627.oracleText: As it twists, so does all life around it.
428627.translation: 它扭曲之时，牵引周遭生灵一同变化。

428628.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control leaves the battlefield, if it had counters on it, put those counters on CARDNAME.
428628.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物离开战场时，若其上有指示物，则将这些指示物放置在CARDNAME上。

428629.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control leaves the battlefield, if it had counters on it, put those counters on The Ozolith.
428629.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物离开战场时，若其上有指示物，则将这些指示物放置在欧佐晶岩上。

428630.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if CARDNAME has counters on it, you may move all counters from CARDNAME onto target creature.
428630.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若CARDNAME上有指示物，则你可以将CARDNAME上的所有指示物移至目标生物上。

428631.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if The Ozolith has counters on it, you may move all counters from The Ozolith onto target creature.
428631.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若欧佐晶岩上有指示物，则你可以将欧佐晶岩上的所有指示物移至目标生物上。

428633.oracleText: The vegetation in Raugrin is dull, but that only makes the towering crystal structures gleam brighter.
428633.translation: 洛格凌的植被晦暗无彩，衬得高耸入云的晶体更显光耀明亮。

428635.oracleText: The same crystals that root deep enough to pierce Savai's catacombs also soar high enough to change its weather.
428635.translation: 撒维耶的水晶深可进地穿透陵墓，高可入云改变天气。

428637.oracleText:
"Sleep now, you big brute."
—Kelsien, the Plague
428637.translation:
「快睡吧，你这大傻兽。」
～疫病凯鑫

428639.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
428639.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

428640.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Sleeper Dart: Target creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
428640.translation: {oT}，牺牲催眠毒镖：目标生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

428642.oracleText:
"Stop trying to pierce the hide. Hit where it's softest: ankle, sole, hamstring."
—Master Hunter Chevill
428642.translation:
「别奢想这能刺穿硬皮。要指望脆弱的地方：例如脚踝、脚底或脚筋。」
～狩猎大师车维尔

428643.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to any target.
428643.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

428644.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice Springjaw Trap: It deals 3 damage to any target.
428644.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲弹爪陷阱：它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

428646.oracleText: From the fertile muck of Zagoth, everything—animal, botanical, and crystalline—grows with rugged beauty.
428646.translation: 札苟斯有着肥沃泥地，令此间万物～动物、植物甚至水晶～都孕育出粗犷美感。

428648.oracleText: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the eludha—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.
428648.translation: 联系持绊人与怪兽之间的神秘纽带称作灵绊，而有处庇护地只向持有这类羁绊者敞开大门。

428650.oracleText:
"It's not hard to grasp that this land does not belong to us."
—Gavi, nest warden
428650.translation:
「不难看出这片大地并未属于我们。」
～巢穴护卫盖薇

428653.oracleText:
"These lowlands were formed thousands of years ago by the behemoth Indath—its final footsteps before vanishing into the sea."
—Tales of the Ozolith
428653.translation:
「传说数千年前巨兽因达煞曾行经此处～而它在海中消失前最终留下的足印便演变为这片低洼之地。」
～《欧佐晶岩传说》

428657.oracleText: Nowhere on Ikoria are monsters more integral to the landscape than Ketria, where the river itself will stand up and roar.
428657.translation: 要论怪兽与地形结合的紧密程度，恐怕整个依克黎没有哪里能比克崔亚更高：此处的河流甚至都会自行起身咆哮。

428661.oracleText: Raugrin meets the sea with jaws wide, its coast spiked with teeth of crystal and granite.
428661.translation: 洛格凌张开巨口迎接海洋，水晶岩石仿佛尖牙耸立岸边。

428665.oracleText: Broad prairies feed the human sanctuary of Drannith and conceal a network of caverns where giant cats make their dens.
428665.translation: 此地的广袤沃原让人类庇护地卓尼斯得以安养生息，岩壁上的丰富洞脉也让巨狮能在这里筑穴建巢。

428669.oracleText: Hunters in the primeval wetlands become fluent in reading the ripples to tell when to pursue and when to flee.
428669.translation: 活跃于这片原始湿地的猎人们早已熟练掌握解读水面波纹，并以此判断何时该追击，何时该撤退。

428673.oracleText:
"Many thought they knew its weakness. They are dead."
—Kelsien, the Plague
428673.translation:
「很多人觉得自己知道它的弱点。他们都死了。」
～疫病凯鑫「暂译」

428674.oracleText: Lethal damage dealt to creatures you control is determined by their power rather than their toughness.
428674.translation: 对由你操控的生物而言，利用其力量来决定是否受到致命伤害，而不是防御力。

428675.oracleText: Target a Human creature you control.
428675.translation: 指定一个由你操控的人类生物为目标。

428676.oracleText: Exile target artifact or creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
428676.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的神器或生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

428677.oracleText: Target an artifact or creature spell.
428677.translation: 指定一个神器或生物咒语为目标。

428678.oracleText: Target a creature with no counters on it.
428678.translation: 指定一个其上没有指示物的生物为目标。

428681.translation: 指定至多三个结界为目标。

428682.oracleText: Change the base power and toughness of target Human you control to {1, CardId}'s power and toughness?
428682.translation: 是否要将目标由你操控之人类的基础力量和防御力更改为{1, CardId}的力量和防御力？

428684.oracleText: Return up to two permanent cards to your hand.
428684.translation: 将至多两张永久物牌移回你手上。

428685.translation: 指定一张人类生物牌为目标。

428686.translation: 指定一个非人类生物牌为目标。

428689.oracleText: It fights up to one target creature you don't control.
428689.translation: 它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

428690.oracleText: Return any number of permanent cards with different names to the battlefield.
428690.translation: 将任意数量名称各不相同的永久物牌移回战场。

428691.oracleText: Search for up to three monocolored cards with different names.
428691.translation: 搜寻至多三张名称各不相同的单色牌。

428692.oracleText: Cast the other cards without paying their mana costs?
428692.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用施放其他牌？

428694.oracleText: Put any number of permanent cards onto the battlefield.
428694.translation: 将任意数量的永久物牌放进战场。

428695.oracleText: Put a non-Human creature card onto the battlefield?
428695.translation: 是否要将一张非人类生物牌放进战场？

428696.translation: 牺牲一个阻挡它的生物。

428697.oracleText: Spend only on: A Noncreature Spell
428697.translation: 只能用于支付：非生物咒语

428698.oracleText: Target a red, white, or black creature card.
428698.translation: 指定一张红色、白色或黑色生物牌为目标。

428699.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life.
428699.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成2点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

428760.oracleText: Put up to one card on top of your library.
428760.translation: 将至多一张牌置于你的牌库顶。

429897.oracleText: All sounds harmonize with the Worldsoul.
429897.translation: 无声不与世界之魂相谐。

429900.oracleText: Time has ground mountains to sand, but the slivers ever remain.
429900.translation: 累月经年，纵高山亦化作砂土，然裂片妖依然留存。

429902.oracleText: Other Sliver creatures you control have outlast {o2}.
429902.translation: 由你操控的其他裂片妖生物具有延生{o2}。

429905.oracleText: Pure souls shine bright as daybreak.
429905.translation: 纯洁灵魂如破晓之光照耀世间。

429906.oracleText: As long as another Aura is attached to enchanted creature, it has first strike and lifelink.
429906.translation: 只要所结附的生物上贴附有另一个灵气，该生物便具有先攻与系命异能。

429908.oracleText: The most tenacious members of the hive instinctually guard the First Sliver.
429908.translation: 在母巢中，最强健的成员会自发地去守卫原初裂片妖。

429909.oracleText: Sliver creatures you control have exalted.
429909.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物具有颂威异能。

429916.oracleText: Whoever survives the first blow lives to land the second.

429918.oracleText: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.
429918.translation: 她为她视作家人的同伴送去护体符印。

429919.oracleText: {oT}: Another target creature you control gains protection from colorless or from the color of your choice until end of turn.
429919.translation: {oT}：选择一种颜色。另一个目标由你操控的生物获得反无色保护或反该色保护异能直到回合结束。

429921.oracleText: The tribe was as strong as his longing, their territory as vast as his isolation. The changeling knew he had found a home, and a form.
429921.translation: 此部落势力强大、领土广袤，正满足他的野心与不群。化形顿时明白自己的归宿所在，形体所存。

429923.oracleText: Where fickle form meets lasting loyalty.

429927.oracleText:
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"
429927.translation:
「愉悦啊，与所钟爱的行走在大草原上。」
～《昼与夜的恋曲》

429933.oracleText:
"These polearms were supposed to help!"
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol
429933.translation:
「我以为这些长枪能救我们！」
～宾纳里亚巡卫梅里可艾达

429944.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells this turn.
429944.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：所有对手本回合都不能施放非生物咒语。

429945.oracleText: Sacrifice Ranger-Captain of Eos: Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells this turn.
429945.translation: 牺牲亿欧护林队长：所有对手本回合都不能施放非生物咒语。

429950.oracleText: There was a time all craven beasts cowered before Avacyn's divine might.
429950.translation: 在过去，艾维欣神力足以镇住胆小野兽。

429951.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a Coward creature with base power and toughness 0/1.
429951.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为0/1的懦夫生物。

429956.oracleText: When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.
