429956.translation: 面对托米尔的庞巨地蚋虫，沃泽尔召唤塞哥维亚天使相抗～多重宇宙间破坏性最小的一场战事由此爆发。

429959.oracleText: Creatures you control with flying get +1/+1 until end of turn.
429959.translation: 由你操控且具飞行异能的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

429960.oracleText: Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying and vigilance.
429960.translation: 派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使衍生生物。

429961.oracleText: You get an emblem with "If you control a creature, damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead."
429961.translation: 你获得具有「如果你操控生物，则将使你的总生命减少至1以下的伤害，改为减少你的总生命至1」的徽记。

429976.oracleText: "For glory! For justice! For our queen!"
429976.translation: 「为了荣耀！为了正义！为了女王！」

429977.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
429977.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

429986.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, return target creature card with power 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
429986.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，将目标力量等于或小于1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

429987.oracleText: When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, return target creature card with power 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
429987.translation: 当薄暮云雀离开战场时，将目标力量等于或小于1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

429990.oracleText: Families of the fallen donate the swords of their loved ones to bolster the city's defenses.
429990.translation: 战殁者的亲眷纷纷捐出逝者所藏宝剑，以期增强城市工事。

429991.oracleText: {oW}: Wall of One Thousand Cuts can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
429991.translation: {oW}：千剑之墙于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

429997.oracleText:
"Never let them take their eyes off you."
—Sidar Jabari
429997.translation:
「一定要让他们始终盯着你。」
～西达将军贾巴力

430003.oracleText: He traded a lamp for a scepter, the scepter for a ruby, and the ruby for a simple rug.
430003.translation: 他用盏灯换了根权杖，再用权杖换了颗红宝石，再用红宝石换了块不起眼的毛毯。

430014.oracleText: A wizard can be outnumbered but never outsmarted.
430014.translation: 法师可能会在人数上处劣势，但绝不会在智谋上落下风。

430017.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes blocked, you may return it to its owner's hand.
430017.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物被阻挡时，你可以将它移回其拥有者手上。

430023.oracleText:
"This one will need direction. After all, each of its eyes is larger than its brain."
—Cyla, Lord of the Aerie
430023.translation:
「这小家伙需要你为它指往哪边飞。毕竟它的脑子比任何一只眼睛都要小。」
～羽巢之王塞拉

430024.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.
430024.translation: 只要你本回合已抓两张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

430025.oracleText: Eyekite gets +2/+0 as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.
430025.translation: 只要你本回合已抓两张或更多牌，巨眼兽便得+2/+0。

430028.oracleText: "The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."
430028.translation: 「了解其中奥妙者，能够从涟漪交错的动向中读出未来。」

430035.oracleText: Its shell can withstand anything but a thaw.
430035.translation: 它的寒冰外壳刀枪不入，唯热火可侵。

430041.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control ten or more snow permanents, sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, create Marit Lage, a legendary 20/20 black Avatar creature token with flying and indestructible.
430041.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控十个或更多雪境永久物，则牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则派出传奇衍生生物玛莉雷基，其为20/20黑色，具飞行与不灭异能的圣者。

430042.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control ten or more snow permanents, sacrifice Marit Lage's Slumber. If you do, create Marit Lage, a legendary 20/20 black Avatar creature token with flying and indestructible.
430042.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控十个或更多雪境永久物，则牺牲玛莉雷基沉眠。若你如此作，则派出传奇衍生生物玛莉雷基，其为20/20黑色，具飞行与不灭异能的圣者。

430051.oracleText: Whenever Mist-Syndicate Naga deals combat damage to a player, create a token that's a copy of Mist-Syndicate Naga.
430051.translation: 每当潜雾帮那伽对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为潜雾帮那伽的复制品。

430053.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a 1/1 blue Illusion creature token with flying.
430053.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的虚影衍生生物。

430054.oracleText: Whenever Moonblade Shinobi deals combat damage to a player, create a 1/1 blue Illusion creature token with flying.
430054.translation: 每当月刃忍者对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的虚影衍生生物。

430057.oracleText: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.
430057.translation: 它常常现身法师学院，汲取青年逸才脑中灵感。

430058.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on Oneirophage.
430058.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，在噬梦蛸上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

430060.oracleText: Within each of us lurks the fathomless.
430060.translation: 我们内心都有深不可测的一面。

430061.oracleText: Until end of turn, up to two target creatures each have base power and toughness 3/3, gain flying, and become blue Illusions in addition to their other colors and types.
430061.translation: 选择至多两个目标生物。直到回合结束，它们的基础力量与防御力为3/3，获得飞行异能，成为蓝色虚影，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。

430064.oracleText:
"Ninjas can run across water, pull ladders from pockets, kill with a kiss, and slip between bricks. Pack of lies, I say."
—Benden, teahouse gossip
430064.translation:
「忍者能踏水而行，上天入地，一吻封喉，穿墙过隙。要我说，这些都是骗人的。」
～茶楼包打听本登

430071.oracleText: "As the sky opened up, we ran for shelter. Halfway there I came to the sudden realization that, already soaked, there might be more to gain from experiencing the rain than running from it."
430071.translation: 「天空突然暴雨倾盆，我们匆忙寻地躲避。但在找到半路时，我一时兴起：既然已全身湿透，为何不索性漫步雨中？这样或许能有更多收获。」

430074.oracleText: Searching the future for answers often leads to further questions.
430074.translation: 从未来探寻答案，往往会发现更多问题。

430077.oracleText: A living fossil active after eons of dormancy.
430077.translation: 亘古沉眠后再度苏醒的活化石。

430079.oracleText: Sliver creatures you control have "{o2}: Untap this creature."
430079.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物具有「{o2}：重置此生物。」

430106.oracleText: Every cry lifts her allies toward the thunder.
430106.translation: 每一声呼喊都助力战友雷霆飞升。

430107.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, target creature gains flying until end of turn.
430107.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

430108.oracleText: When you cycle Windcaller Aven, target creature gains flying until end of turn.
430108.translation: 当你循环唤风艾文时，目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

430121.oracleText: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.
430121.translation: 变幻面容埋下猜疑祸根。猜疑祸根长出孤独人生。

430122.oracleText: Changeling Outcast can't block and can't be blocked.
430122.translation: 化形黜人不能进行阻挡，也不能被阻挡。

430124.oracleText: "Please, come in! Hors d'oeuvres are on the table."

430125.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
430125.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个生物死去时，在每个由你操控的吸血鬼上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

430126.oracleText: Whenever Cordial Vampire or another creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
430126.translation: 每当热忱吸血鬼或另一个生物死去时，在每个由你操控的吸血鬼上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

430136.oracleText: Each Sliver creature card in your graveyard has unearth {o2}.
430136.translation: 你坟墓场中的每张裂片妖生物牌均具有破坟{o2}。

430140.oracleText: {oB}: CARDNAME gains menace until end of turn.
430140.translation: {oB}：CARDNAME获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

430141.oracleText: {oB}: Endling gains menace until end of turn.
430141.translation: {oB}：末灵精怪获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

430142.oracleText: {oB}: Endling gains deathtouch until end of turn.
430142.translation: {oB}：末灵精怪获得死触异能直到回合结束。

430143.oracleText: {oB}: CARDNAME gains undying until end of turn.
430143.translation: {oB}：CARDNAME获得不息异能直到回合结束。

430144.oracleText: {oB}: Endling gains undying until end of turn.
430144.translation: {oB}：末灵精怪获得不息异能直到回合结束。

430145.oracleText: {o1}: Endling gets +1/-1 or -1/+1 until end of turn.
430145.translation: {o1}：末灵精怪得+1/-1或-1/+1直到回合结束。

430155.oracleText: "Why throw away a perfectly good identity?"

430162.oracleText: Spells of madness often require a sacrifice of sanity.
430162.translation: 疯魔咒语通常需要牺牲理智。

430165.oracleText: Not all monsters fight with teeth and claws.
430165.translation: 并非所有怪物都靠尖牙利爪来打斗。

430166.oracleText: Four walls and a roof won't provide safety from that which is buried.
430166.translation: 四面高墙和厚实屋顶也挡不住来自地底的滋扰。

430175.oracleText: Too stupid to survive, too dumb to die.
430175.translation: 笨得活不了，蠢得死不掉。

430182.oracleText:
"I think someone is stealing from my laboratory. It had better not be you!"
—Geralf, letter to Gisa
430182.translation:
「总觉得有人从我实验室里面偷东西。最好不是你干的！」
～基拉夫致基沙

430185.oracleText: Return two target creature cards that share a creature type from your graveyard to your hand.
430185.translation: 将两张目标具共通之生物类别的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

430186.oracleText: Choose one — • Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. • Return two target creature cards that share a creature type from your graveyard to your hand.
430186.translation: 选择一项～ •  将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 •  将两张目标具共通之生物类别的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

430200.oracleText: Freshly promoted to "first rock," Zaz was eager to make an impact.
430200.translation: 刚晋升为「尖石」的查仔等不及要有冲击性的表现。

430202.oracleText: Sacrifice a Goblin: Target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
430202.translation: 牺牲一个鬼怪：目标牌手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

430209.oracleText:
"I just felt a drip. It must be about to rain."
—Stoneway Market vendor, last words
430209.translation:
「好像有水滴落下。一定是要下雨了。」
～石道集市商贩的遗言

430210.oracleText: Unblocked attacking Ninjas you control have lifelink.
430210.translation: 由你操控、进行攻击且未受阻挡的忍者具有系命异能。

430215.oracleText:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—The Red Book of Mezdrithalik
430215.translation:
「若想看透死亡的面纱，只需一穿而过。」
～《梅崔札力的红皮书》

430216.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Zombie you control dies, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
430216.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的灵俑死去时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

430217.oracleText: Whenever Undead Augur or another Zombie you control dies, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
430217.translation: 每当不死卜算师或另一个由你操控的灵俑死去时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

430218.oracleText: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.
430218.translation: 无论埋得多深，有些邪物就是不会瞑目。

430220.oracleText: It doesn't contain venom. It is venom.
430220.translation: 它不带毒。它本身便是毒。

430222.oracleText: Eyeballs that portend unpleasant futures become slimy snacks instead.
430222.translation: 预示凶兆的眼珠子成了软滑的点心。

430223.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control dies, scry 1.
430223.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，占卜1。

430224.oracleText: Whenever Warteye Witch or another creature you control dies, scry 1.
430224.translation: 每当疣眼巫师或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，占卜1。

430227.oracleText: Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature: Put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature and draw a card.
430227.translation: 支付1点生命，牺牲另一个生物：在至多一个目标生物上放置一个-1/-1指示物且抓一张牌。

430241.oracleText: Slivers can turn a last stand into a stunning victory.
430241.translation: 裂片妖能将破釜沉舟局面化作精彩胜利。

430242.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
430242.translation: {oT}：此生物对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成造成1点伤害。

430243.oracleText: Hellbent — As long as you have no cards in hand, Sliver creatures you control have "{oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker."
430243.translation: 背水战～只要你没有手牌，由你操控的裂片妖生物便具有「{oT}：此生物对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成造成1点伤害。」

430245.oracleText: A hunger to soar must be sated.
430245.translation: 一飞冲天的渴望必须得到满足。

430246.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a Dragon with base power and toughness 4/4, flying, and haste.
430246.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为基础力量与防御力为4/4，具飞行与敏捷异能的龙。

430247.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Until end of turn, Bogardan Dragonheart becomes a Dragon with base power and toughness 4/4, flying, and haste.
430247.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：直到回合结束，博卡登化龙师成为基础力量与防御力为4/4，具飞行与敏捷异能的龙。

430249.oracleText: When it wriggled closer to a thrum of slivers, their talons hardened and glinted in the sun. One took a playful swipe at a tree trunk, and its new blade cut clean through.
430249.translation: 只见它甫一靠近裂片妖群，后者的前爪就逐渐锋利成型，甚至能够反射太阳辉光。其中一个仅是朝着树干比划一下，其新生利刃就已将其连根切落。

430252.oracleText:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion
430252.translation:
「火焰一直是我最忠实的伙伴。」
～贾瑞卡萨隆

430253.oracleText: Draw a card. Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +1/+0 for each card you've drawn this turn.
430253.translation: 抓一张牌。直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能，且你本回合每已抓一张牌，便得+1/+0。

430258.oracleText: Telepathy changes minds, necromancy changes lives, but geomancy changes the world.
430258.translation: 读心术能改变心智，死灵术能改变生命，而大地术则能改变世界。

430262.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. If that creature is a Goat, it also gets +3/+0 until end of turn.
430262.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。如果该生物是山羊，则它再得+3/+0直到回合结束。

430269.oracleText: A mother only a child could love.
430269.translation: 老娘疼幼子，长大不认妈。

430273.oracleText:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV
430273.translation:
「很难说它们繁殖地中成堆的血块是破败弃物，神圣祭坛还是警示用具。」
～《撒尔帕汀帝国》，卷四

430278.oracleText:
"Brilliant! They evolved away from energy-taxing brains and respond only to spinal reflex arcs from the hive mind."
—Rukarumel, field journal
430278.translation:
「奇妙极了！它们没有朝着耗费能量的大脑方向进化，而且只对母巢主脑的脊椎反射弧作出反应。」
～陆卡陆梅的现场日志

430279.oracleText: Sliver creatures you control have "{oT}, Discard a card: Draw a card."
430279.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物具有「{oT}，弃一张牌：抓一张牌。」

430282.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if there is a land card in your graveyard.
430282.translation: 如果你坟墓场中有地牌，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

430293.oracleText: A dragon's loyalty cannot be earned, but it can be bought.
430293.translation: 巨龙的忠心赢不到，但买得来。

430294.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each land card in your graveyard.
430294.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张地牌，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

430296.oracleText: The thunderhead that leads in the storm.

430297.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Goblin you control dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
430297.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的鬼怪死去时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

430298.oracleText: Whenever Pashalik Mons or another Goblin you control dies, Pashalik Mons deals 1 damage to any target.
430298.translation: 每当帕沙力克将军芒氏或另一个由你操控的鬼怪死去时，帕沙力克将军芒氏对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

430299.oracleText: {o3oR}, Sacrifice a Goblin: Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
430299.translation: {o3oR}，牺牲一个鬼怪：派出两个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

430318.oracleText: {o3oRoR}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens.
430318.translation: {o3oRoR}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：派出两个1/1红色元素衍生生物。

430319.oracleText: {o3oRoR}, Exile Seasoned Pyromancer from your graveyard: Create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens.
430319.translation: {o3oRoR}，从你的坟墓场放逐干练烈焰术士：派出两个1/1红色元素衍生生物。

430323.oracleText: "If you think twice, I'll cut twice."
430323.translation: 「如果你多想一次，我就再砍一次。」

430324.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, CARDNAME has double strike.
430324.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

430325.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, Spinehorn Minotaur has double strike.
430325.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，脊角牛头怪便具有连击异能。

430327.oracleText: Victories against the hive are tragedies.
430327.translation: 胜过母巢会引大祸临头。

430328.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target player or planeswalker.
430328.translation: 每当此生物受到伤害时，它对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

430329.oracleText: Sliver creatures you control have "Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target player or planeswalker."
430329.translation: 由你操控的裂片妖生物具有「每当此生物受到伤害时，它对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。」

430331.oracleText: Alone in the charred desolation of her kingdom, she regretted many things—most of all not acting sooner.

433587.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token, then put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control."
433587.translation: 你获得具有「在你回合的战斗开始时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物，然后在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物」的徽记。

433589.oracleText: Basri carries on his god's legacy, spreading her teachings throughout the Multiverse.
433589.translation: 巴席利继承他的神明遗志，继续在多重宇宙中传扬其教诲。

433594.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
433594.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有+1/+1指示物，则派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

433595.oracleText: Whenever Basri's Lieutenant or another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
433595.translation: 每当巴席利的副官或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，若其上有+1/+1指示物，则派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。

433597.oracleText:
"The will to fight and act as one is not limited to a single world. Oketra's teachings are universal."
—Basri Ket
433597.translation:
「『齐勇如一』之道并非只在一个世界中通用，欧柯塔的教诲放之四海而皆准。」
～巴席利柯特

433599.oracleText: "I look to the heavens for hope, but you will kneel."
433599.translation: 「我可仰首祈天助，而你只能屈膝求垂怜。」

433602.oracleText: It's often mistaken for the coming dawn as it gallops across the horizon.
433602.translation: 它在地平线远端的驰骋身影，常常让人误以为曙光将至。

433605.oracleText: "My falcons are family, as much as any other member of my clan."
433605.translation: 「我与部落伙伴如家人般亲密，我跟手下鹰隼也是如此。」

433606.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying that's tapped and attacking.
433606.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

433607.oracleText: Whenever Falconer Adept attacks, create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying that's tapped and attacking.
433607.translation: 每当训隼专家攻击时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

433609.oracleText:
"Be glad the griffin set you back on your feet when it was done with you. My goat wasn't so lucky."
—Arram, goatherd
433609.translation:
「如果被狮鹫掳走还能回到地面，你就该庆幸自己捡回一条命。我的羊运气可没那么好。」
～山羊牧人亚兰

433612.oracleText: When griffins started nesting atop the northern tower, the castellan worried they'd be a nuisance. Instead, they took the entire castle under their protection.
433612.translation: 起初狮鹫开始在北塔塔顶筑巢的时候，城主还担心它们日后会成为安全隐忧。但没想到它们却成了整座城堡的安全保障。

433613.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, create a 2/2 white Griffin creature token with flying.
433613.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得了3点或更多生命，则派出一个2/2白色，具飞行异能的狮鹫衍生生物。

433620.oracleText: The light washed over him, and in the wind he heard the roars of all the pridemates who had come before.
433620.translation: 他沐浴在明光之中，风中传来此前曾历经此处的群伴呼吼。

433622.oracleText: Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures, if two or more of those creatures are attacking you and/or planeswalkers you control, draw a card.
433622.translation: 每当任一对手以生物攻击时，若其中有两个或更多生物攻击你和／或由你操控的鹏洛客，则你抓一张牌。

433623.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts their second spell each turn, draw a card.
433623.translation: 每当任一对手施放每回合中其第二个咒语时，你抓一张牌。

433625.oracleText: If a source would deal damage to you, prevent that damage and put an incarnation counter on CARDNAME.
433625.translation: 如果某来源将对你造成伤害，则防止该伤害且在CARDNAME上放置一个转生指示物。

433626.oracleText: If a source would deal damage to you, prevent that damage and put an incarnation counter on Nine Lives.
433626.translation: 如果某来源将对你造成伤害，则防止该伤害且在九命护身上放置一个转生指示物。

433627.oracleText: When there are nine or more incarnation counters on CARDNAME, exile it.
433627.translation: 当CARDNAME上有九个或更多转生指示物时，将它放逐。

433628.oracleText: When there are nine or more incarnation counters on Nine Lives, exile it.
433628.translation: 当九命护身上有九个或更多转生指示物时，将它放逐。

433629.oracleText: When Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, you lose the game.
433629.translation: 当九命护身离开战场时，你输掉这盘游戏。

433631.oracleText: He will be your loyal champion, and his pack your protectors. All he asks for is a full belly, a spot by the fire, and all the love in your heart.
433631.translation: 它会成为你的忠诚勇士，它身边犬群会成为你的贴身护卫。而它要求的，不过是果腹伙食、炉边歇息和满心关爱。

433636.oracleText: Emphatic words with powerful gestures. Clearly this was playtime.
433636.translation: 急切语气加上威风动作，显然这是玩乐时间。

433640.oracleText:
An untroubled mind
Dwells in perfect harmony
With a peaceful heart.
433640.translation:
平和无庸扰，
柔光温煦清风到，
静居宁心躁。

433641.oracleText: {o5oW}: Tap target creature. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each Shrine you control.
433641.translation: {o5oW}：横置目标生物。你每操控一个祭祠，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

433643.oracleText: "I don't know that I'll win every fight. But I have faith, and that's carried me this far."
433643.translation: 「我不知道我还能继续赢多久。但我有坚定信念，而这正是我动力源泉。」

433644.oracleText: Discard a card: Tap CARDNAME. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
433644.translation: 弃一张牌：横置CARDNAME。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

433645.oracleText: Discard a card: Tap Seasoned Hallowblade. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
433645.translation: 弃一张牌：横置干练圣剑兵。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

433647.oracleText:
"You know it's a great show when the Azorius arrest the props, too!"
—Judith, the Scourge Diva
433647.translation:
「当俄佐立人连道具都一起逮捕的时候，你就知道这一定是场好戏！」
～灾祸歌伶裘蒂丝

433648.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
433648.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

433650.oracleText: She raised him from an orphaned pup and gave him a life of love. With his last act, he thanked her.
433650.translation: 它幼时曾是流浪孤犬，幸好遇她悉心照料，得以一生幸福成长。而这养育之恩，它靠这最后的舍命相助为报。

433651.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Another target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
433651.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：另一个目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

433652.oracleText: Sacrifice Selfless Savior: Another target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
433652.translation: 牺牲无私救助犬：另一个目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

433654.oracleText: Whenever Siege Striker attacks, you may tap any number of untapped creatures you control. Siege Striker gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature tapped this way.
433654.translation: 每当攻城进击兵攻击时，你可以横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的生物。每以此法横置一个生物，攻城进击兵便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

433656.oracleText: "All are welcome in the angels' light."

433659.oracleText: "Gilded with gold from a dragon's trove, it is! And etched with the image of the dragon I slew to take it."
433659.translation: 「这盾上镀的可都是我从龙穴里面发现的金子！我还特地把杀掉的那条龙样子刻在上面当作纪念。」

433661.oracleText:
"There's nothing quite as satisfying as delivering a good kick to the face."
—Adrasteia, Akroan captain
433661.translation:
「没有什么事情比往敌人脸上狠狠踹一脚更解气的了。」
～阿喀洛斯队长阿卓斯蒂娅

433663.oracleText: "I've been carrying a sword since before you were born. I wouldn't give up my oath for all the peace and comfort in the world."
433663.translation: 「在你出世之前，我已佩剑征战四方。就算你拿全世界最安逸的生活来引诱我，我也不会背弃誓言。」

433664.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
433664.translation: {oW}，{oT}：在目标其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

433665.oracleText: {o4oWoW}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
433665.translation: {o4oWoW}，{oT}：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

433667.oracleText: A unicorn chooses only the most virtuous and noble of knights to be its companion.
433667.translation: 骑士中唯有至德至尚者，才能被独角兽选作伙伴。

433670.oracleText: In dire times, even a place of refuge can become a weapon of war.
433670.translation: 在困难时期，就连避难之地也能成为作战利器。

433672.oracleText: "There is no age at which you stop learning."

433675.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a permanent was put into your hand from the battlefield this turn, draw a card.
433675.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有永久物从战场置于你手上，则抓一张牌。

433679.oracleText:
"I offered to pay him to do the job, but he refused. So I took matters into my own hands."
—Tahim, the Puppetmaster
433679.translation:
「我原本提议付钱来雇他做事，但他拒绝了。所以我只好亲自出马。」
～操偶大师塔西姆

433680.oracleText: You can't choose an untapped creature as this spell's target as you cast it.
433680.translation: 于你施放此咒语时，你不能选择未横置的生物作为其目标。

433682.oracleText: "Another village, another angry mob. Why do I even bother unpacking?"
433682.translation: 「又一座村子，又一群暴民。我又何苦把东西拿出来呢？」

433683.oracleText: Draw a card, then draw cards equal to the number of cards named Frantic Inventory in your graveyard.
433683.translation: 抓一张牌，然后再抓若干牌，其数量等同于你坟墓场中名称为狂搜库存之牌的数量。

433686.oracleText: Whenever Ghostly Pilferer becomes untapped, you may pay {o2}. If you do, draw a card.
433686.translation: 每当魂魅小偷成为未横置时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

433687.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell from anywhere other than their hand, draw a card.
433687.translation: 每当任一对手从其手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语时，你抓一张牌。

433688.oracleText: Discard a card: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
433688.translation: 弃一张牌：CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

433689.oracleText: Discard a card: Ghostly Pilferer can't be blocked this turn.
433689.translation: 弃一张牌：魂魅小偷本回合不能被阻挡。

433691.oracleText: "Fear is a rational response, but waiting won't make it any easier. Just jump!"
433691.translation: 「会害怕是正常反应，但干等着也没办法缓解。跳就对了！」

433692.oracleText: {o2oU}: Target creature gains flying until end of turn.
433692.translation: {o2oU}：目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

433694.oracleText: "I specialize in missing manuscripts, pilfered poetry, and lifted letters."
433694.translation: 「我擅长弄丢手稿，偷取诗篇，截取信件。」

433695.oracleText: Whenever Library Larcenist attacks, draw a card.
433695.translation: 每当书库窃犯攻击时，抓一张牌。

433697.oracleText: The mage scowled as yet another bolt splashed harmlessly against seemingly empty air.
433697.translation: 看着又一道电光在似乎浑然无物的空中悄然四散，法师不禁皱起了眉头。

433698.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o1}. If you control a creature with flying, counter that spell unless its controller pays {o4} instead.
433698.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。如果你操控具飞行异能的生物，则改为除非该咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。

433700.oracleText:
"Next time, try something more appropriate for your skill level."
—Barrin, Tolarian archmage
433700.translation:
「下次先从与你本事相若的咒语开始。」
～陶拉里亚大法师巴林

433701.oracleText: Counter target instant or sorcery spell unless its controller pays {o3}.
433701.translation: 除非目标瞬间或法术咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

433703.oracleText: "I sang of storms, there came a squall. I sang of waves, the seas grew tall. I sang of love, but no voice called."
433703.translation: 「唱起风暴之歌，天降疾风应和；唱起浪潮之歌，海洋积势添色；唱起爱情之歌，四下无声合辙。」

433704.oracleText: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's Planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?
433704.translation: 水晶球涌动着泰菲力鹏洛客火花的力量。尤依拉带给他的是祝福，还是诅咒？

433707.oracleText: Creatures you control attack each combat if able.
433707.translation: 由你操控的生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

433710.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target CARDNAME cost {o3} more to cast.
433710.translation: 对手施放之以CARDNAME为目标的咒语增加{o3}来施放。

433711.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target Pursued Whale cost {o3} more to cast.
433711.translation: 对手施放之以遭猎白鲸为目标的咒语增加{o3}来施放。

433713.oracleText: Charts and instruments work fine, but the best navigators aren't above a spell or two to nudge the tides in a more favorable direction.
433713.translation: 海图和器具固然有用，但最好的领航员只消一两个咒语就能让浪潮朝着自己想要的方向流动。

433714.oracleText: Choose one — • Draw three cards. • Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands.
433714.translation: 选择一项～ •  抓三张牌。 •  将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

433716.oracleText: Some who die senseless deaths return as formless spirits, seeking answers where there are none.
433716.translation: 毫无意义逝去的生命会以没有形态的灵魂重返世间，茫然追寻并不存在的答案。

433720.oracleText: "Stop locking your knees as you strike! Now stand up and try again."
433720.translation: 「攻击时膝盖别僵着！起身再试一次。」

433721.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +0/+2 and another target creature gets -2/-0.
433721.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+0/+2且另一个目标生物得-2/-0。

433723.oracleText: Great literature can transport the reader.
433723.translation: 伟大的书籍能令读者通天。

433727.oracleText:
Truth lurks in the depths,
Invisible from the shore.
Knowledge inundates.
433727.translation:
真相藏水间，
冰寒湖底知识现，
岸边不得见。

433730.oracleText: "What is this that is neither future nor past?"
433730.translation: 「有个东西，既不是未来，也不是过去，那是什么？」

433731.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. If this spell was cast from anywhere other than your hand, put each of those cards into your hand instead.
433731.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。如果你是从你手牌以外的任何区域施放此咒语，则改为将这些牌都置于你手上。

433733.oracleText: The Blessed Sleep doesn't come easily to a mind chained by regrets.
433733.translation: 心灵遭悔恨束缚者，难享受福安眠。

433734.oracleText: Shacklegeist can block only creatures with flying.
433734.translation: 桎梏游魂只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。

433735.oracleText: Tap two untapped Spirits you control: Tap target creature you don't control.
433735.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的精怪：横置目标不由你操控的生物。

433737.oracleText: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.
433737.translation: 失落于海中不一定意味着无法再度寻得。

433740.translation: 每当硬背巨牙鲨攻击时，占卜1。

433742.oracleText: This spell costs {o2oU} less to cast if you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
433742.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过瞬间或法术咒语，则此咒语减少{o2oU}来施放。

433745.oracleText: Choose one or more — • Counter target spell. • Counter target activated or triggered ability. • Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. • Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control. • Target player draws a card.
433745.translation: 选择一项或多项～ •  反击目标咒语。 •  反击目标起动式或触发式异能。 •  将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。 •  派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的生物之复制品。 •  目标牌手抓一张牌。

433747.oracleText: You may activate loyalty abilities of CARDNAME on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant.
433747.translation: 你可以在任意牌手的回合中，于你能够施放瞬间的时机下，起动CARDNAME的忠诚异能。

433748.oracleText: You may activate loyalty abilities of Teferi, Master of Time on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant.
433748.translation: 你可以在任意牌手的回合中，于你能够施放瞬间的时机下，起动弄时宗师泰菲力的忠诚异能。

433749.oracleText: Target creature you don't control phases out.
433749.translation: 目标不由你操控的生物跃离。

433750.oracleText: Take two extra turns after this one.
433750.translation: 于本回合后进行额外的两个回合。

433752.oracleText:
"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?"
—Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi
433752.translation:
「好啦，你是懂得比我多。但你真的要炫耀这点吗？」
～茜卓纳拉，致泰菲力

433754.oracleText: Teferi's legacy lives on in Tolaria through the study of time magic and a tradition of irrepressible mischief.
433754.translation: 对于时间魔法的持续研习和学生间难以克制的作弄传统，让泰菲力的精神得以在陶拉里亚流传。

433756.oracleText: "Tarassel's sixth law of temporal recursion is easy to understand as long as you know the first seven."
433756.translation: 「只要你晓得了塔拉希尔时间递归律的前七条，第六条就很容易理解。」

433758.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, target opponent mills two cards.
433758.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，目标对手磨两张牌。

433760.oracleText: Fishing boats often follow hunting drakes to find the largest schools of fish.
433760.translation: 渔船常常跟在行猎龙兽后面，这样便能找到渔获量最大的鱼群。

433761.oracleText: Whenever you attack with two or more creatures with flying, draw a card.
433761.translation: 每当你以两个或更多具飞行异能的生物攻击时，抓一张牌。

433763.oracleText:
"It's contemplative, resourceful, and original. Everything else aside, it's the perfect student."
—Naban, dean of iteration
433763.translation:
「它沉着冷静，思维敏捷，做法独到。不考虑其他因素的话，最好的学生就该像它这样。」
～迭演院长奈班

433764.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, you may pay {o1}. When you do, you may tap or untap target creature.
433764.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，你可以横置或重置目标生物。

433766.oracleText: Sometimes knowledge takes on a life of its own.
433766.translation: 有时候，知识会自己演绎出生命。

433767.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.
433767.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，CARDNAME便不能被阻挡。

433768.oracleText: Tome Anima can't be blocked as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.
433768.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，魔典活灵便不能被阻挡。

433770.oracleText: On the open sea, there is nowhere to hide.
433770.translation: 在广阔的大海中，没有一处藏身之地。

433771.oracleText: {o1oU}, Discard CARDNAME: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
433771.translation: {o1oU}，弃掉CARDNAME：检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

433772.oracleText: {o1oU}, Discard Waker of Waves: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
433772.translation: {o1oU}，弃掉弄涛巨鲸：检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

433774.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains your choice of deathtouch or lifelink until end of turn.
433774.translation: 选择死触或系命。直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+1且获得该异能。

433779.oracleText: There are still places where a smile and a handshake are all you need to seal a deal.
433779.translation: 幸好还有些地方只要露个脸、握个手就能够谈成交易。

433780.oracleText: You draw two cards and each opponent discards two cards. Each player loses 2 life.
433780.translation: 你抓两张牌且每位对手各弃两张牌。每位牌手各失去2点生命。

433782.oracleText: "Some savor the hunt. I savor the kill."
433782.translation: 「有人享受猎捕过程。而我享受夺命时刻。」

433784.oracleText: "Six consecutive life sentences" takes on a new meaning when necromancy is involved.
433784.translation: 当能够动用死灵术时，「六个连续终身监禁」就有了新的意义。

433787.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in your graveyard.
433787.translation: CARDNAME得+X/+0，X为你坟墓场里的生物牌中力量最大者的数值。

433788.oracleText: Carrion Grub gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in your graveyard.
433788.translation: 腐肉幼虫得+X/+0，X为你坟墓场里的生物牌中力量最大者的数值。

433792.oracleText:
"Even the rats refuse to set foot inside. I fear to think what might be waiting in there."
—Gravedigger's journal
433792.translation:
「就连老鼠都不敢进去。我甚至都不敢去想里面会有什么在等着我。」
～掘墓人日志

433796.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+1, has flying, and is a Demon in addition to its other types.
433796.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+1，具有飞行异能，且额外具有恶魔此类别。

433797.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard by paying 3 life and discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs.
433797.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放CARDNAME，但在其他费用以外，还须额外支付3点生命并弃一张牌。

433798.oracleText: You may cast Demonic Embrace from your graveyard by paying 3 life and discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs.
433798.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场施放恶魔之拥，但在其他费用以外，还须额外支付3点生命并弃一张牌。

433803.oracleText: "In this world, it's kill or be killed. I'd rather not be the latter."
433803.translation: 「在这世上，不是你杀人就是被人杀。我宁愿不要被人杀。」

433805.oracleText:
"First, the darkness fell. Terror came next. After that, only despair remained."
—The Tragedy of Morein
433805.translation:
「首先，黑暗降临。随后，恐惧到来。最后，只剩绝望。」
～《莫雷因之殇》

433806.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
433806.translation: 每当CARDNAME被一个生物阻挡时，该生物的操控者失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

433807.oracleText: Whenever Gloom Sower becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
433807.translation: 每当散霾惧兽被一个生物阻挡时，该生物的操控者失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

433810.oracleText: As blood touched the empty page, it formed words that seared themselves into the wizard's mind.
433810.translation: 鲜血落在空白书页上后，就转变成为烙印在法师心灵中的字句。

433812.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with deathtouch attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
433812.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具死触异能的生物攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

433813.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with deathtouch deals damage to a planeswalker, destroy that planeswalker.
433813.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具死触异能的生物对任一鹏洛客造成伤害时，消灭该鹏洛客。

433815.oracleText: "Defy me and I will burn the flesh from your bones. Betray me and I will steal the breath from your lungs."
433815.translation: 「胆敢反抗我，我就会把你骨头上的血肉烧尽。胆敢背叛我，我就会把你双肺中的空气偷走。」

433818.oracleText: Each player discards a card. Each opponent who can't loses 3 life.
433818.translation: 每位牌手各弃一张牌。每位无法如此作的对手各失去3点生命。

433819.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your graveyard.
433819.translation: 目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中牌的数量。

433820.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It gains haste.
433820.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。它获得敏捷异能。

433821.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of combat on your turn, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It gains haste."
433821.translation: 你获得具有「在你回合的战斗开始时，将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。它获得敏捷异能」的徽记。

433823.oracleText: Liliana inspires horror in many and fanatical admiration in a few.
433823.translation: 莉莲娜让许多人恐惧不已，也引来了少数人的狂热崇拜。

433825.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, you may pay {o1oB}. If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
433825.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，你可以支付{o1oB}。若你如此作，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

433827.oracleText: The purple banner of the House of Vess is a symbol of death wherever it's flown.
433827.translation: 维斯家族紫色旗帜飘扬之处，即象征死亡来到。

433831.oracleText: Servants at Vess Manor are chosen for their strong work ethic and respectful demeanor. Being alive is not required.
433831.translation: 维斯宅邸挑选仆从，看重的是敬业态度与得体举止。至于是死是活并不重要。

433837.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each soul counter on CARDNAME.
433837.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个灵魂指示物，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

433838.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each soul counter on Malefic Scythe.
433838.translation: 凶邪镰刀上每有一个灵魂指示物，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

433839.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, put a soul counter on CARDNAME.
433839.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个灵魂指示物。

433840.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, put a soul counter on Malefic Scythe.
433840.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物死去时，在凶邪镰刀上放置一个灵魂指示物。

433842.oracleText: Her footsteps are whispers, her passage a last breath.
433842.translation: 她的脚步如细语轻声，悄然之间便令人咽气。

433843.oracleText: {o2oB}: Masked Blackguard gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

433847.oracleText:
"Oh, don't be so dramatic. When your eyes bleed, and your brain leaks out your ears, then we'll talk about lost sanity."
—Braids, dementia summoner
433847.translation:
「哦，别这么夸张。等到你鲜血涌出双眼，脑干流出双耳的时候，那才算是失去神智。」
～惧像召唤师布蕾德

433848.oracleText: Target player draws cards equal to half the number of cards in their library and loses half their life. Round up each time.
433848.translation: 目标牌手抓等同于其牌库中牌数量一半的牌，且失去等同于其总生命数量一半的生命。各数量小数点后均进位。

433850.oracleText:
"Your crops will rot. The air itself will turn against you. You will suffer as I have suffered."
—Karaz, outcast
433850.translation:
「你的作物将腐烂。就连空气也将与你作对。你将经历我的痛苦。」
～黜人卡拉兹

433851.oracleText: Remove two loyalty counters from each planeswalker.
433851.translation: 从每个鹏洛客上各移去两个忠诚指示物。

433852.oracleText: Choose one — • All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn. • Remove two loyalty counters from each planeswalker.
433852.translation: 选择一项～ •  所有生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。 •  从每个鹏洛客上各移去两个忠诚指示物。

433854.oracleText:
"I love those who are eager to serve."
—Liliana Vess
433854.translation:
「我喜欢这些热切想要效命的家伙。」
～莉莲娜维斯

433856.oracleText:
Renounce all limits,
False chains binding potential.
Power knows no bounds.
433856.translation:
锐锋破局限，
挣脱枷锁潜能现，
强威力无边。

433859.oracleText:
"Drink from the vein? How provincial."
—Lord Duchorvin
433859.translation:
「直接从血管喝？真粗野。」
～杜卓温领主

433860.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you've gained 3 or more life this turn.
433860.translation: 如果你本回合中获得过3点或更多生命，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

433863.oracleText: Being trapped between two forms of unlife is a fate worse than mere death.
433863.translation: 夹在两种不死形体之间，这结局比死去更悲惨。

433864.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
433864.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得了3点或更多生命，则将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

433865.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, return Silversmote Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
433865.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得了3点或更多生命，则将嵌银食尸鬼从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

433867.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice Silversmote Ghoul: Draw a card.

433871.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, CARDNAME gets +2/+1 and has deathtouch.
433871.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+2/+1且具有死触异能。

433872.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, Thieves' Guild Enforcer gets +2/+1 and has deathtouch.
433872.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，盗贼公会执法者便得+2/+1且具有死触异能。

433874.oracleText: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"
433874.translation: 「要吃要喝的时候如此积极。要你奉献的时候却摆手拒绝？」

433875.oracleText: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

433876.oracleText: "Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."
433876.translation: 「经由奉献恶者之血，我们必将得到救赎。祈祷吧。」

433877.oracleText: {o3oBoB}: Creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn.
433877.translation: {o3oBoB}：由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

433879.oracleText: The best recipes start with reliable cookware.
433879.translation: 美味食谱始于可靠炉具。

433880.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain 1 life and draw a card.
433880.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

433883.oracleText: Its spark is worse than its bite.

433884.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
433884.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

433885.oracleText: Whenever Bolt Hound attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
433885.translation: 每当电闪猎犬攻击时，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

433891.oracleText: Whenever Brash Taunter is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target opponent.
433891.translation: 每当鲁莽挑发鬼受到伤害时，它向目标对手造成等量的伤害。

433893.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Brash Taunter fights another target creature.
433893.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：鲁莽挑发鬼与另一个目标生物互斗。

433895.oracleText: Discard your hand, then exile the top three cards of your library. Until end of turn, you may play cards exiled this way.
433895.translation: 弃掉你的手牌，然后放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用以此法放逐的牌。

433896.oracleText: Chandra, Heart of Fire deals 2 damage to any target.
433896.translation: 烈焰之心茜卓对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

433899.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the total amount of noncombat damage dealt to your opponents this turn.
433899.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为所有对手本回合中受过的非战斗伤害总数量。

433900.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, CARDNAME deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
433900.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源向任一对手造成非战斗伤害时，CARDNAME对目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

433901.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, Chandra's Incinerator deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
433901.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源向任一对手造成非战斗伤害时，茜卓的焚焰灵对目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

433903.oracleText:
"Is it purebred? No, but it's pure fire."
—Chandra Nalaar
433903.translation:
「你问它是不是纯种？不是，但它是纯火。」
～茜卓纳拉

433904.oracleText: {oT}: Chandra's Magmutt deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
433904.translation: {oT}：茜卓的熔岩犬对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

433906.oracleText:
"I think Chandra just wanted something to blame random scorch marks on."
—Jace Beleren
433906.translation:
「我觉得茜卓只是要找个东西来把胡乱烧痕怪罪上去。」
～杰斯贝连

433907.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains double strike until end of turn.
433907.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源向任一对手造成非战斗伤害时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0 且获得连击异能。

433908.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, Chandra's Pyreling gets +1/+0 and gains double strike until end of turn.
433908.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源向任一对手造成非战斗伤害时，直到回合结束，茜卓的幼火灵得+1/+0 且获得连击异能。

433910.oracleText: You may cast Goblin spells from the top of your library.
433910.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶施放鬼怪咒语。

433911.oracleText: As long as the top card of your library is a Goblin card, CARDNAME has all activated abilities of that card.
433911.translation: 只要你的牌库顶牌是鬼怪牌，CARDNAME便具有该牌的所有起动式异能。

433912.oracleText: As long as the top card of your library is a Goblin card, Conspicuous Snoop has all activated abilities of that card.
433912.translation: 只要你的牌库顶牌是鬼怪牌，张扬嗅探客便具有该牌的所有起动式异能。

433914.oracleText: "Your eyes aren't playing tricks on you. I am."
433914.translation: 「欺骗你的不是你的双眼。是我。」

433915.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
433915.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

433917.oracleText:
"One day the mountain's fire will rise up to burn away our chains and end this age of oppression."
—The Molten Prophecy
433917.translation:
「总有一天，山中烈焰将猛烈翻涌，焚尽我们周身镣铐，终结这一压迫时代。」
～《熔铁预言》

433918.oracleText: If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage to that permanent or player instead.
433918.translation: 如果某个由你操控的来源将对任一永久物或牌手造成伤害，则改为它对该永久物或牌手造成三倍的伤害。

433920.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack unless you control four or more artifacts.
433920.translation: 除非你操控四个或更多神器，否则CARDNAME不能攻击。

433921.oracleText: Gadrak, the Crown-Scourge can't attack unless you control four or more artifacts.
433921.translation: 除非你操控四个或更多神器，否则戴冠祸害加札克不能攻击。

433922.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a Treasure token for each nontoken creature that died this turn.
433922.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，本回合中每有一个非衍生物的生物死去，便派出一个珍宝衍生物。

433924.oracleText: "Quiet in the library" soon gave way to larger concerns.
433924.translation: 「馆内保持安静」很快就不是最头痛的事情了。

433925.oracleText: Create two 1/1 red Goblin Wizard creature tokens with prowess.
433925.translation: 派出两个1/1红色，具灵技异能的鬼怪／法术师衍生生物。

433927.oracleText: To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.
433927.translation: 对拉铎司人而言，兴奋呼喊与恐惧尖叫是一回事。

433928.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
433928.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

433929.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, Havoc Jester deals 1 damage to any target.
433929.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，浩劫小丑对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

433931.oracleText: "I'd rather go out in a blaze of glory than fade away and be forgotten."
433931.translation: 「我宁愿化作夺目烈焰，也不甘漫灭遭人淡忘。」

433932.oracleText: {oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker.
433932.translation: {oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

433933.oracleText: {oR}, Sacrifice Heartfire Immolator: It deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker.
433933.translation: {oR}，牺牲心火煽焰师：它对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

433935.oracleText:
"We'll pay no more tribute to that tyrannical lizard. A new age starts today!"
—Mayor Kadrim, now deceased
433935.translation:
「我们绝不再向那只暴躁蜥蜴低头进贡。全新时代就从今天开始！」
～已故凯德霖市长

433936.oracleText: {oR}: Hellkite Punisher gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
433936.translation: {oR}：惩焰残虐者得+1/+0直到回合结束。

433938.oracleText: Bedbugs aren't the only things you need to worry about biting you at night.
433938.translation: 至于会在晚上钻出来咬你的东西，需要防备的绝非仅有臭虫一种。

433939.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on Hobblefiend.
433939.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：在噬踵邪鬼上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

433941.oracleText: Some dogs just aren't meant to be indoor pets.
433941.translation: 有些狗就是不适合养在家里当宠物。

433942.oracleText: {o1oR}: Igneous Cur gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

433944.oracleText: Kinetic Augur's power is equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
433944.translation: 跃动卜算师的力量等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌的数量加总。

433948.oracleText:
Rage smolders within,
An all-consuming wildfire
Burning fear to ash.
433948.translation:
恚怒积心间，
聚作野火耀漫天，
惧相全化烟。

433949.oracleText: {o1}, Discard a land card or Shrine card: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
433949.translation: {o1}，弃一张地牌或祭祠牌：CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

433950.oracleText: {o1}, Discard a land card or Shrine card: Sanctum of Shattered Heights deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
433950.translation: {o1}，弃一张地牌或祭祠牌：嶙峋圣殿对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

433952.oracleText: There was no witty retort, no confident boast to accompany the attack. There was only pain.
433952.translation: 这次攻击带来的，没有机智回击，也没有自满吹嘘。只有无尽痛楚。

433953.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. That permanent loses indestructible until end of turn.
433953.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。该永久物失去不灭异能直到回合结束。

433954.oracleText: Soul Sear deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. That permanent loses indestructible until end of turn.
433954.translation: 炙烤灵魂对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。该永久物失去不灭异能直到回合结束。

433956.oracleText: {o1}: Another target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
433956.translation: {o1}：另一个目标力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

433957.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Discard your hand: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control with power 2 or less deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
433957.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，弃掉你的手牌：直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

433959.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target CARDNAME cost an additional 3 life to cast.
433959.translation: 对手施放之以CARDNAME为目标的咒语须额外支付3点生命来施放。

433960.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast that target Terror of the Peaks cost an additional 3 life to cast.
433960.translation: 对手施放之以峰顶惧龙为目标的咒语须额外支付3点生命来施放。

433964.oracleText:
"Remind me again, what's the going rate for betrayal these days?"
—Captain Rhenmir
433964.translation:
「再提醒我一下，最近背叛的行情怎么样？」
～伦米尔队长

433965.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Add two mana of any one color.
433965.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。

433967.oracleText: "I'd like to introduce you to the new and improved me."

433968.oracleText: Exile target creature. That creature's controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. That player puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles the rest into their library.
433968.translation: 放逐目标生物。该生物的操控者从其牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张生物牌为止。该牌手将该牌放进战场，然后将其余的牌洗入其牌库。

433970.oracleText: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.
433970.translation: 蛮力不一定就是正义，但能赢得胜利。

433971.oracleText: Double the power of target creature until end of turn.
433971.translation: 将目标生物的力量加倍直到回合结束。

433973.oracleText: Seeing it coming a mile away is little comfort if you can't get out of range in time.
433973.translation: 如果你来不及逃出生天，奋力跑到远离火光一哩开外，也不会让你安心多少。

433974.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 6 damage to each of up to two target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
433974.translation: CARDNAME对至多两个目标生物和／或鹏洛客各造成6点伤害。

433975.oracleText: Volcanic Salvo deals 6 damage to each of up to two target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
433975.translation: 火山迸发对至多两个目标生物和／或鹏洛客各造成6点伤害。

433977.oracleText: If a tree fells you in the forest and no one is around to hear it, "does it make a sound" is the last thing you need to worry about.
433977.translation: 如果你在森林中被树木击倒，而周围又没人听到，你恐怕都没有时间去思考「树这么动到底会不会出声」这件事。

433978.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
433978.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

433979.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, Burlfist Oak gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
433979.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，瘤拳橡树得+2/+2直到回合结束。

433981.oracleText: The forest's cover offers shade, shelter, and an increased risk of sudden death.
433981.translation: 茂密树林既提供了遮阳树荫、栖息处所，也让致命猎手有了可乘之机。

433982.oracleText: Canopy Stalker must be blocked if able.
433982.translation: 若能阻挡树冠伏猫，则必须阻挡之。

433983.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you gain 1 life for each creature that died this turn.
433983.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，本回合中每有一个生物死去，你便获得1点生命。

433984.oracleText: When Canopy Stalker dies, you gain 1 life for each creature that died this turn.
433984.translation: 当树冠伏猫死去时，本回合中每有一个生物死去，你便获得1点生命。

433986.oracleText: What the rangers thought were warning growls turned out to be nothing but monstrous snoring.
433986.translation: 原本护林人当作是警告的低沉吼声，后来发现不过是怪兽的熟睡鼾音。

433987.oracleText: As long as you control a creature with power 4 or greater, CARDNAME can attack as though it didn't have defender.
433987.translation: 只要你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，CARDNAME便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

433988.oracleText: As long as you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Drowsing Tyrannodon can attack as though it didn't have defender.
433988.translation: 只要你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，昏睡暴伟龙便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

433990.oracleText: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
433990.translation: 派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

433992.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, choose one — • Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. • You gain 3 life. • Draw a card.
433992.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，选择一项～ •  派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。 •  你获得3点生命。 •  抓一张牌。

433993.oracleText: Whenever Elder Gargaroth attacks or blocks, choose one — • Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. • You gain 3 life. • Draw a card.
433993.translation: 每当年长庞巨兽攻击或阻挡时，选择一项～ •  派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。 •  你获得3点生命。 •  抓一张牌。

433995.translation: 犬类求人施舍。猫类主动占有。

433996.oracleText: Other Cats you control get +1/+1 and have protection from Dogs.
433996.translation: 由你操控的其他猫得+1/+1且具有反狗保护异能。

433997.oracleText: Whenever one or more Cats you control deal combat damage to a player, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment that player controls.
433997.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的猫对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，消灭至多一个目标由该牌手操控的神器或结界。

433999.oracleText:
"We're all food for something in the end."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman
433999.translation:
「我们终究会成为某些东西的养料。」
～葛加理祭师习拉雅

434000.oracleText: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. If a creature died this turn, create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
434000.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果本回合中有生物死去，则派出两个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

434002.oracleText: Up to one target creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.
434002.translation: 直到回合结束，至多一个目标生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。

434003.oracleText: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. Then if an opponent controls more creatures than you, put a loyalty counter on CARDNAME.
434003.translation: 派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。然后如果任一对手操控的生物比你多，则在CARDNAME上放置一个忠诚指示物。

434004.oracleText: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. Then if an opponent controls more creatures than you, put a loyalty counter on Garruk, Unleashed.
434004.translation: 派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。然后如果任一对手操控的生物比你多，则在无拘贾路上放置一个忠诚指示物。

434008.oracleText:
"It certainly takes after its master: big and brutish, and you can smell it from a mile away."
—Liliana Vess
434008.translation:
「它确实跟其主子一样：身躯庞大，脾气暴躁，而且一哩开外就能闻到气味。」
～莉莲娜维斯

434010.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may reveal a creature card or Garruk planeswalker card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
434010.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶等量的牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌或贾路鹏洛客牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

434011.oracleText: Whenever Garruk's Harbinger deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may reveal a creature card or Garruk planeswalker card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
434011.translation: 每当贾路的开路兽对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶等量的牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌或贾路鹏洛客牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

434016.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, CARDNAME gets +0/+2 and has vigilance.
434016.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+0/+2且具有警戒异能。

434017.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, Gnarled Sage gets +0/+2 and has vigilance.
434017.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，糙节智者便得+0/+2且具有警戒异能。

434020.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
434020.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后该生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

434022.oracleText: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.
434022.translation: 对多头龙来说，大多数问题只要多加几个头就能解决。

434023.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature.
434023.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后将该生物上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

434025.oracleText: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."
434025.translation: 「人类带来的只有苦难与欺瞒，别无他物。我的树林不欢迎他们。」

434026.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token.
434026.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，派出一个2/2绿色的猫衍生生物。

434027.oracleText: {o4oGoG}: Until end of turn, creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
434027.translation: {o4oGoG}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物之基础力量与防御力为X/X，X为你的手牌数量。

434029.oracleText: The elves of Llanowar look to their past to determine the shape of their future.
434029.translation: 罗堰妖精追忆过往，形塑未来。

434032.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
434032.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

434033.oracleText: Whenever Ornery Dilophosaur attacks, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Ornery Dilophosaur gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
434033.translation: 每当暴躁双冠龙攻击时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则暴躁双冠龙得+2/+2直到回合结束。

434037.oracleText: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.
434037.translation: 祭师以戈厄塔之眼观察世界，发现其余一切不过都是它的猎物。

434038.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn. Then it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
434038.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束。然后它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

434040.oracleText:
"What did you catch today, my pet? Ah, it looks like a bit of vampire stuck between your teeth."
—Atla Palani, nest tender
434040.translation:
「你今天逮到了什么东西，我的宝贝？啊，看起来你的牙缝里塞了点吸血鬼。」
～护巢人娥拉帕拉尼

434041.oracleText: Target opponent sacrifices a creature with flying.
434041.translation: 目标对手牺牲一个具飞行异能的生物。

434043.oracleText:
"I hope the idiot who introduced these creatures to the jungle was their first meal."
—Opar, veteran guide
434043.translation:
「不管这些生物是被谁引到丛林里来的，我希望它们在这里的第一餐就把那些傻瓜都吃掉。」
～资深向导欧帕尔

434044.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and untap it.
434044.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物并重置它。

434045.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Sabertooth Mauler and untap it.
434045.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则在撕咬剑齿虎上放置一个+1/+1指示物并重置它。

434047.oracleText:
Beneath bright blossoms
Verdant with spring's rich bounty,
The soul blooms in song.
434047.translation:
满园春色中，
百花竞艳生机浓，
魂灵齐声颂。

434050.oracleText: "No sight is more beautiful than a clear sky."
434050.translation: 「没什么比晴空万里无一物的景色更美。」

434051.oracleText: {o2oG}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target creature with flying.
434051.translation: {o2oG}：CARDNAME对目标具飞行异能的生物造成1点伤害。

434052.oracleText: {o2oG}: Skyway Sniper deals 1 damage to target creature with flying.
434052.translation: {o2oG}：天路神射手对目标具飞行异能的生物造成1点伤害。

434054.oracleText: It spins its web throughout the undercity, strange growths sprouting in its wake.
434054.translation: 其蛛网遍布地底城，所经之处滋生异物。

434055.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, you gain 1 life and create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
434055.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，你获得1点生命并派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

434056.oracleText: Whenever Sporeweb Weaver is dealt damage, you gain 1 life and create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
434056.translation: 每当孢网编蛛受到伤害时，你获得1点生命并派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

434058.oracleText: Scents fade and footprints wash away, but some trails can never be erased.
434058.translation: 虽然气味会消散，足印会模糊，但有些踪迹永不会被抹灭。

434059.oracleText: Scry 3, then reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature or land card, draw a card.
434059.translation: 占卜3，然后展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是生物或地牌，则抓一张牌。

434061.oracleText: Its exploits are the stuff of legends among local chefs and fuel for nightmares among the forest thallids.
434061.translation: 它的功绩在当地厨师间传为佳话，但在林地散绿菌间却是噩耗。

434062.translation: 在掘菌野猪上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

434065.oracleText: Weak and strong alike seek shelter beneath its branches.
434065.translation: 强者和弱者都在其枝杈下寻求庇护。

434066.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw two cards.
434066.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以抓两张牌。

434067.oracleText: Whenever Warden of the Woods becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, you may draw two cards.
434067.translation: 每当护林树妖成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标时，你可以抓两张牌。

434071.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
434071.translation: 每当在另一个由你操控的非多头龙生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

434072.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on Wildwood Scourge.
434072.translation: 每当在另一个由你操控的非多头龙生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在野林祸害上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

434076.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of other attacking creatures.
434076.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为其他进行攻击的生物数量。

434077.oracleText: Whenever Alpine Houndmaster attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of other attacking creatures.
434077.translation: 每当山地驯犬师攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为其他进行攻击的生物数量。

434080.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on that creature instead.
434080.translation: 如果将会在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在该生物上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

434081.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you gain life equal to its power.
434081.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你获得等同于其力量的生命。

434082.oracleText: When Conclave Mentor dies, you gain life equal to its power.
434082.translation: 当盟会导师死去时，你获得等同于其力量的生命。

434084.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
434084.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

434085.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, Dire Fleet Warmonger gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
434085.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，焦炬舰队好战者得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

434087.oracleText: Explosions aren't necessarily failures, just a different kind of success.
434087.translation: 爆炸不一定是失败，或许只是另一种成功。

434088.oracleText: Create an X/X blue and red Weird creature token, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard. Then you may return an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile CARDNAME.
434088.translation: 派出一个X/X，蓝红双色的怪奇衍生生物，X为你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌的数量加总。然后你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。放逐CARDNAME。

434089.oracleText: Create an X/X blue and red Weird creature token, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard. Then you may return an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile Experimental Overload.
434089.translation: 派出一个X/X，蓝红双色的怪奇衍生生物，X为你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌的数量加总。然后你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。放逐实验性过载。

434091.oracleText: "Just a nibble for now. I wouldn't want to ruin my appetite."
434091.translation: 「现在啜饮一口就好。我可不想坏了胃口。」

434092.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, each opponent loses 3 life.
434092.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得了3点或更多生命，则每位对手各失去3点生命。

434094.oracleText: "My roots are ash, my heart a smoldering ember. What I could not protect, I will avenge."
434094.translation: 「我树根已化灰，心脏已成烬。我所不能卫护者，定将为其报仇。」

434095.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} for each creature with power 4 or greater you control.
434095.translation: {oT}：你每操控一个力量等于或大于4的生物，便加{oG}。

434096.oracleText: {o7oR}: CARDNAME deals damage equal to its power to target player or planeswalker.

434303.translation: {o2o(W/U)}：进行攻击且具飞行异能的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

434304.oracleText: Whenever three or more creatures you control with flying attack, each player gains control of a nonland permanent of your choice controlled by the player to their right.
434304.translation: 每当三个或更多由你操控且具飞行异能的生物攻击时，为每位牌手各进行以下流程～你选择一个由其右边牌手操控的非地永久物，该牌手获得该永久物的操控权。

434306.oracleText: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, instead put five +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
434306.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌但牌库没有牌，则改为在CARDNAME上放置五个+1/+1指示物。

434307.oracleText: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, instead put five +1/+1 counters on Ormos, Archive Keeper.
434307.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌但牌库没有牌，则改为在档案守卫欧莫斯上放置五个+1/+1指示物。

434308.oracleText: {o1oUoU}, Discard three cards with different names: Draw five cards.
434308.translation: {o1oUoU}，弃三张名称各不相同的牌：抓五张牌。

434314.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a creature, you may pay {o(U/B)}. If you do, draw a card.
434314.translation: 每当你牺牲一个生物时，你可以支付{o(U/B)}。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

434315.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a creature: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
434315.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个生物：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

434316.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a creature: Kels, Fight Fixer gains indestructible until end of turn.
434316.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个生物：战斗操盘手凯尔斯获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

434318.oracleText: A living pulse is an irresistible temptation.
434318.translation: 无法抗拒跳动脉搏的诱惑。「暂译」

434319.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
434319.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，每位对手各失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

434320.oracleText: When Nocturnal Feeder dies, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
434320.translation: 当夜行噬血鬼死去时，每位对手各失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

434323.oracleText: Big distractions mean tiny nuisances can slip by unnoticed.
434323.translation: 大的分心意味着微小的麻烦会在神不知鬼不觉中溜走。「暂译」

434324.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if an opponent discarded a card this turn, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
434324.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有对手弃牌，则你抓一张牌且你失去1点生命。

434325.oracleText: {o4oBoB}: Each opponent with no cards in hand loses 10 life.
434325.translation: {o4oBoB}：每位没有手牌的对手各失去10点生命。

434328.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, each opponent sacrifices a creature and you return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
434328.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则每位对手各牺牲一个生物，且你将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

434330.oracleText: A momentary lapse is all it needs to break free.
434330.translation: 一时的疏忽就能让它挣脱出来。「暂译」

434331.oracleText: Chained Brute doesn't untap during your untap step.
434331.translation: 受链蛮魔于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

434336.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature and planeswalker you don't control, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
434336.translation: CARDNAME对每个不由你操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌的数量加总。

434337.oracleText: Immolating Gyre deals X damage to each creature and planeswalker you don't control, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
434337.translation: 燃焰涡旋对每个不由你操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌的数量加总。

434339.translation: 闪电凤凰不能进行阻挡。

434340.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent was dealt 3 or more damage this turn, you may pay {oR}. If you do, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield.
434340.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有对手曾受到3点或更多伤害，则你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场。

434341.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent was dealt 3 or more damage this turn, you may pay {oR}. If you do, return Lightning Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
434341.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有对手曾受到3点或更多伤害，则你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则将闪电凤凰从你的坟墓场移回战场。

434343.oracleText: "The gods don't speak to mortals with gentle entreaties. They speak with thunder and fury."
434343.translation: 「诸神对凡人不是以温和的恳求说话。他们用雷声和怒火说话。」

434345.oracleText: Not all storms come from the sky.
434345.translation: 并非所有的风暴都来自天空。

434346.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
434346.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

434347.oracleText: When Living Lightning dies, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
434347.translation: 当生体闪电死去时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

434352.oracleText: Whenever Muxus attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each other Goblin you control.
434352.translation: 每当穆克斯攻击时，你每操控一个其他鬼怪，它便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

434356.oracleText: {o2o(B/R)}: Minotaurs you control get +1/+0 and gain menace and haste until end of turn.
434356.translation: {o2o(B/R)}：直到回合结束，由你操控的牛头怪得+1/+0且获得威慑与敏捷异能。

434358.oracleText: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.
434358.translation: 恶魔享受以鸽为弹的讽刺意味。镇民则理解不来。「暂译」

434360.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
434360.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，CARDNAME对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

434361.oracleText: Whenever another creature dies, Spiteful Prankster deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
434361.translation: 每当另一个生物死去时，怨毒捣乱魔对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

434363.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws their first card each turn, if it's not their turn, you create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
434363.translation: 每当任一对手抓其每回合的第一张牌时，若当前不是他的回合，则你派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

434364.oracleText: Whenever one or more Devils you control attack one or more players, you and those players each draw a card, then discard a card at random.
434364.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个魔鬼攻击一位或更多牌手时，你和这些牌手各抓一张牌，然后各随机弃一张牌。

434367.oracleText: Green spells you control can't be countered.
434367.translation: 由你操控的绿色咒语不能被反击。

434368.oracleText: {o4oGoG}: Until end of turn, each Elf creature you control has base power and toughness 5/5 and becomes a Dinosaur in addition to its other creature types.
434368.translation: {o4oGoG}：直到回合结束，每个由你操控的妖精生物成为基础力量与防御力为5/5的恐龙，且额外具有其他原本生物类别。

434370.oracleText:
"Is it the water? The stars? Whatever it is, something incredible is happening here."
—Eris, zoologist, journal entry
434370.translation:
「是水吗？是星星吗？不管是什么，这里正在发生一些不可思议的事情。"」
～动物学家艾瑞丝，日志一笔「暂译」

434371.oracleText: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, twice that many +1/+1 counters are put on that creature instead.
434371.translation: 如果将会在某个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量两倍的+1/+1指示物。

434373.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control fight or become blocked, draw a card.
434373.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物互斗或被阻挡时，抓一张牌。

434374.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {o2o(R/G)}. If you do, double target creature's power until end of turn. That creature must be blocked this combat if able.
434374.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{o2o(R/G)}。若你如此作，则将目标生物的力量加倍直到回合结束。该生物本次战斗若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

434379.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature with defender: All creatures gain trample until end of turn.
434379.translation: 牺牲一个具守军异能的生物：所有生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

434381.oracleText:
"That's the third time this month it's exploded on site. Maybe we should switch to something a little less defective."
—Kerrin, archaeologist
434381.translation:
「这已经是本月第三次在现场发生爆炸了。也许我们应该换成缺陷少一点的东西。」
～考古学家克林「暂译」

434382.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to any target.
434382.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意目标造成3点伤害。

434383.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice Lightning-Core Excavator: It deals 3 damage to any target.
434383.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲电核开挖人：它对任意目标造成3点伤害。

434385.oracleText: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.
434385.translation: 无数世代过去，石头磨损，显露出高山核心处的丰富颜色。

434389.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR} or one mana of the chosen color.
434389.translation: {oT}：加{oR}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434391.oracleText: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.
434391.translation: 人类视界之外还有一片隐蔽乐土，此处鸟语花香，绿意盎然。

434395.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} or one mana of the chosen color.
434395.translation: {oT}：加{oG}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434397.oracleText: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.
434397.translation: 驱使这片野花绽放的，并非季节更替，而是魔力起伏。

434401.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW} or one mana of the chosen color.
434401.translation: {oT}：加{oW}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434403.oracleText: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.
434403.translation: 于精妙微观世界中，尽览自然伟大奇迹。

434407.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU} or one mana of the chosen color.
434407.translation: {oT}：加{oU}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434409.oracleText: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.
434409.translation: 此地美景尽藏奇异之处，唯眼光独到者方能得见。

434413.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oB} or one mana of the chosen color.
434413.translation: {oT}：加{oB}或一点所选颜色的法术力。

434415.oracleText: The best techniques outlive their creators.

434416.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures attack, you may have target attacking creature gain double strike until end of turn.
434416.translation: 每当一个或数个生物攻击时，你可以使目标进行攻击的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

434417.oracleText: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the guard. The kami are coming."
434417.translation: 勇丸闻闻气味，喉间发出低吼。武野将军低头瞧着勇丸，轻抚其身以令其冷静。「叫部队留意。神明来了。」

434419.oracleText: The view is truly spectacular—as long as you don't look at Rishada itself.
434419.translation: 景色真的十分壮观～只要你不看李夏达。

434420.oracleText:
"The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands."
—Janus, speaker of the synod
434420.translation:
「知识之池知晓世界。蒙纳坷了解世界。」
～悉诺议长杰努斯

434421.oracleText:
"Well, this can't be a good sign." 
—Old Rutstein
434421.translation:
「嗯，这可不是个好兆头。」
～老鲁斯登

434422.oracleText: Takedowns in Valor's Reach are never meant to be lethal, but that doesn't mean they won't be incredibly painful.
434422.translation: 在英勇巅较量中，击倒对手时都不会狠下杀招，但这不意味着会手下留情。

434430.oracleText: Some Akroans make the dangerous pilgrimage to the volcanic temples of Purphoros, where oracles known as flamespeakers glean omens from lava.
434430.translation: 普罗烽斯火山殿堂内的焰语者先知善从熔岩中预知先兆，因此不少阿喀洛斯人甘冒危险前往朝圣。

434432.oracleText: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"
434432.translation: 「时机就在眼前。眼前只有荣誉。为了胜利与家人～前进！」

434434.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
434434.translation: {oG}，{oT}：加X点法术力，其颜色组合可任意选择，X为由你操控的生物中力量最大者的数值。

434435.oracleText: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.
434435.translation: 它强大的树枝上承载着赞迪卡四面楚歌的荒野希望。「暂译」

434438.oracleText: Creature spells you cast of the chosen type cost {o1} less to cast.
434438.translation: 你施放之具该类别生物咒语减少{o1}来施放。

434439.oracleText:
"Yawgmoth is dead, and his citadels lie empty. But there will always be some who seek power at any price."
—Karn
434439.translation:
「约格莫夫已经死了，他的堡垒空空如也。但总会有一些人不惜一切代价寻求力量。」
～卡恩「暂译」

434440.oracleText: Discard three cards with different names.
434440.translation: 弃三张名称各不相同的牌。

434441.oracleText: Cast target instant, sorcery, or artifact card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
434441.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间、法术或神器牌？

434442.oracleText: Target an instant, sorcery, or artifact card.
434442.translation: 指定一张瞬间、法术或神器牌为目标。

434443.oracleText: Have target attacking creature gain double strike until end of turn?
434443.translation: 是否要使目标进行攻击的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束？

434444.oracleText: Search for a card named Festering Newt or Bubbling Cauldron.
434444.translation: 搜寻一张名称为腐臭水蝾或冒泡鼎镬的牌。

435145.oracleText: Search for a card named Whisper Squad.
435145.translation: 搜寻一张名称为幽语小队的牌。

435146.oracleText: Put a menace counter on a creature you control.
435146.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个威慑指示物。

435147.oracleText: Put a deathtouch counter on a creature you control.
435147.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个死触指示物。

435148.oracleText: Put two loyalty counters on a planeswalker you control.
435148.translation: 在一个由你操控的鹏洛客上放置两个忠诚指示物。

436112.oracleText: Put a phylactery counter on an artifact you control.
436112.translation: 在一个由你操控的神器上放置一个避邪符指示物。

436917.oracleText: Select whether to mutate this card under or over the targeted creature. They mutate into the creature on top plus all abilities from under it.
436917.translation: 选择将此牌合变到目标生物的顶上还是底下。它们合变作顶上的生物，外加具有底下所有异能。

436922.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, proliferate.
436922.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，增殖。

436924.oracleText: A common foe is the death of old hatreds.
436924.translation: 共同敌人为世代怨仇划上句点。

436925.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures in your party.
436925.translation: 至多两个目标生物各得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你冒险团中的生物数量。

436928.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you and that player each gain that much life.
436928.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你和该牌手各获得等量的生命。

436929.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have at least 15 life more than your starting life total, each player CARDNAME attacked this turn loses the game.
436929.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多15点，则CARDNAME本回合中攻击过的每位牌手各输掉这盘游戏。

436930.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have at least 15 life more than your starting life total, each player Angel of Destiny attacked this turn loses the game.
436930.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多15点，则命运天使本回合中攻击过的每位牌手各输掉这盘游戏。

436935.oracleText:
"Archons dispense justice according to an ancient, and flawed, premise."
—Nissa Revane
436935.translation:
「虽然这条远古时期订立的假定难经推敲，但不妨碍统领依此执行正义。」
～妮莎瑞文

436938.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of creatures in your party.
436938.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你冒险团中的生物数量。

436939.oracleText: Archpriest of Iona's power is equal to the number of creatures in your party.
436939.translation: 艾欧娜大祭司的力量等同于你冒险团中的生物数量。

436940.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you have a full party, target creature gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
436940.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你的冒险团满编，则直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

436942.oracleText: "My cats have taught me more about the sacred than anything in some old ruin."
436942.translation: 「我身旁这些猫教会我有关圣物的事情，比某些古老遗迹还要多。」

436943.oracleText: Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token.
436943.translation: 每当你每回合首度获得生命时，派出一个1/1白色的猫衍生生物。

436944.oracleText: {o2oW}: Another target Cleric gains lifelink until end of turn.
436944.translation: {o2oW}：另一个目标僧侣获得系命异能直到回合结束。

436946.oracleText:
"Move, you wretched thing! You're scaring the hurdas!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad
436946.translation:
「快走，你这怪东西！荷得都被你吓到了！」
～哥马法达游牧人布斯陶

436950.oracleText: "I swing a sword. It's a simple life. A lot of adventurers just see me as some cheap muscle, but if my steel lets them return home with their lives and limbs intact, then I've done my job."
436950.translation: 「我用得一手好剑。生活就是这么简单。虽然许多冒险者只把我当成廉价打手，但只要我手中武器能够保证他们四肢健全平安归家，那我也算完成任务了。」

436952.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, those creatures get +2/+1 until end of turn instead.
436952.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为这些生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

436953.oracleText: "From legend it was forged, and to legend it returns."

436955.oracleText: "The gifts of the past must find their way into deserving hands."
436955.translation: 「历史的赠礼，必须平安送抵应授之人手中。」

436959.oracleText:
"Iona no longer guards this place. We do."
—Kasla, Emeria shepherd
436959.translation:
「艾欧娜虽不再庇佑此地。但我们仍继续守护。」
～伊美黎牧者卡丝拉

436960.oracleText: Create two 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature tokens with flying. Non-Angel creatures you control gain indestructible until your next turn.
436960.translation: 派出两个4/4白色，具飞行异能的天使／战士衍生生物。由你操控的非天使生物获得不灭异能直到你的下一个回合。

436963.oracleText:
"You called it the castle of a god. It is less than that, and so much more."
—Kasla, Emeria shepherd
436963.translation:
「你们将这称作神佑之城。神明已逝，天威犹存。」
～伊美黎牧者卡丝拉

436969.oracleText: In any adventuring party, the cleric is the heart: healing wounds, inspiring courage, and raising morale.
436969.translation: 无论哪支冒险团队，牧师都是队中核心：他们能够治疗伤口、激励斗志、鼓舞士气。
