488192.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, Eager First-Year gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
488192.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，热切新生得+1/+0直到回合结束。

488194.oracleText: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, World Champion XXVI
488194.translation: 第二十六届世界冠军Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa

488198.oracleText: Quintorius was a daydreamer, far happier digging through history books than practicing battle tactics. He agreed with the military academy on only one thing: he did not belong in their ranks.
488198.translation: 昆托力想象力丰富，相较于刻苦训练战术，他更喜欢遨游历史书海。不过他跟军事学院倒有一点意见相同：他不适合参军。

488200.oracleText: When honormancers work together, their compliments are complementary.
488200.translation: 当荣耀术士携手合作时，其颂美之声也盛赞相承。

488203.oracleText: All who hear his inspiring words are filled with hope and pride.
488203.translation: 凡听闻其鼓舞颂赞者，内心无不壮志昂扬。

488204.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
488204.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

488207.oracleText: {o0}: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard this turn. If that spell doesn't target a creature you control, it costs {o8} more to cast this way. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only once each turn.
488207.translation: {o0}：本回合中，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌。如果该咒语未以由你操控的生物为目标，则以此法施放时增加{o8}来施放。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。每回合只能起动一次。

488211.oracleText: {o6}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
488211.translation: {o6}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488212.oracleText: {o6}: Return Pilgrim of the Ages from your graveyard to your hand.
488212.translation: {o6}：将岁月朝圣客从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488214.oracleText: Gentle hands of stone whisk the careless from the crumbling ruins of Pillardrop.
488214.translation: 石头伸出手臂，轻巧而迅速地将粗心者带离摇摇欲坠的避柱遗迹。

488218.oracleText: "A language isn't dead until we stop learning from it."
488218.translation: 「只要还有人在研习，语言就没有消亡。」

488222.oracleText:
"Do not flinch from studying the horrors of the past. History's most important lessons are cloaked in terror and tragedy."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
488222.translation:
「研究过往惨事时，千万不要畏缩。历史最深刻的教训，就掩藏在这种种恐怖与悲剧之下。」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

488223.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488223.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488225.oracleText: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.
488225.translation: 虽然斯翠海文五个学院鼓励学生间的对抗情绪，但有些羁绊能够跨越一切阻碍。

488226.oracleText: You and target opponent each draw three cards.
488226.translation: 你和目标对手各抓三张牌。

488230.oracleText: When you cast this spell, copy it for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.
488230.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，你本回合中每施放过一个其他的瞬间和法术咒语，便将此咒语复制一次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

488231.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn.
488231.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

488234.oracleText: Whenever you attack, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature and untap it.
488234.translation: 每当你攻击时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并重置它。

488236.oracleText: "When I'm done here, they'll name entire buildings after me."
488236.translation: 「待我学成后，他们会用我的名字来命名整座校园！」

488238.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put its counters on target creature you control.
488238.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

488239.oracleText: When Star Pupil dies, put its counters on target creature you control.
488239.translation: 当明星学子死去时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

488242.oracleText:
"Hey, my great-great-grandfather had a dog just like that!"
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student
488242.translation:
「嘿，我曾曾祖父也养过一条这样的狗！」
～衡鉴修习法师卓迪尔

488243.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.
488243.translation: 每当一张或数张牌在你的回合中进入放逐区时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

488244.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Stonebinder's Familiar. This ability triggers only once each turn.
488244.translation: 每当一张或数张牌在你的回合中进入放逐区时，在缚石佣兽上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

488246.oracleText: The carved cliffs of Pillardrop thrum with the sounds of ancient spirits rising from the past.
488246.translation: 古代魂灵自过往现身，由此造成的动静令避柱峭壁嗡嗡作响。

488247.oracleText: {o4}, Exile a card from your graveyard: Target creature gains flying until end of turn.
488247.translation: {o4}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张牌：目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

488249.oracleText: "You might believe being dead for centuries has made me more lenient. I think you'll find the opposite to be true."
488249.translation: 「你可能会觉得，死了几百年后的我也许会变得宽容一些。但我觉得事实跟你想的恰好相反。」

488252.oracleText: "You've been cramming all night. You're taking a nap whether you like it or not."
488252.translation: 「你整晚都在挑灯夜读。不论你愿不愿意，现在你要休息。」

488254.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gains flying until end of turn if you control a creature with flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, indestructible, lifelink, menace, and trample.
488254.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，如果你操控具飞行异能的生物，则它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。且先攻、连击、死触、不灭、系命、威慑与践踏异能亦比照办理。

488255.oracleText: Whenever Thunderous Orator attacks, it gains flying until end of turn if you control a creature with flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, indestructible, lifelink, menace, and trample.
488255.translation: 每当雷霆雄辩家攻击时，如果你操控具飞行异能的生物，则雷霆雄辩家获得飞行异能直到回合结束。且先攻、连击、死触、不灭、系命、威慑与践踏异能亦比照办理。

488257.oracleText: The class learned little that day.
488257.translation: 那天全班学到了很小的东西。

488259.oracleText: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.
488259.translation: 有些荣休教授会定期回到校园，与学生分享自己漫游阿凯维沃时遇到的奇闻轶事。

488260.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card.
488260.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，抓一张牌。

488263.oracleText: Students who seek river herbs in Doradur quickly find themselves slightly damp and thoroughly surrounded.
488263.translation: 前往多拉度采摘河草的学生，很快就发现自己周身沾水，陷入重重包围。

488267.oracleText: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.
488267.translation: 茂典阁禁止携入兵器，但聪明的法师从不会毫无防备。

488268.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets an attacking creature.
488268.translation: 如果此咒语以进行攻击的生物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

488270.oracleText: "Kathorran War Chants, Vol. III? That doesn't even belong in this wing!"
488270.translation: 「《卡瑟朗战歌，卷三》？这书根本就不属于这一区！」

488273.oracleText: "Misery. Inadequacy. Failure. The common denominator is you."
488273.translation: 「悲剧。不足。失败。它们的公分母都是你。」

488274.oracleText: Return target spell or permanent with mana value 1 or greater to its owner's hand.
488274.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或大于1的咒语或永久物移回其拥有者手上。

488276.oracleText: When Dream Strix becomes the target of a spell, sacrifice it.
488276.translation: 当眠梦枭成为咒语的目标时，将它牺牲。

488280.oracleText: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.
488280.translation: 斗法塔比赛中，最重要的技巧是保持冷静。

488283.oracleText: You may pay {o2oU} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488283.translation: 你可以支付{o2oU}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488284.oracleText: If the {o2oU} cost was paid, you draw three cards, then an opponent creates two Treasure tokens and they scry 2. If that cost wasn't paid, you draw X cards.
488284.translation: 如果曾支付此{o2oU}费用，则你抓三张牌，然后任一对手派出两个珍宝衍生物且其占卜2。如果并非支付此费用，则你抓X张牌。

488286.oracleText: Kelpies are drawn to paradoxes, making them ideal companions for Quandrix mages.
488286.translation: 骏妖天生就会被矛盾事物吸引，这点让它们成为量析法师的理想旅伴。

488287.oracleText: {oT}: Untap another target permanent you control.
488287.translation: {oT}：重置另一个目标由你操控的永久物。

488288.oracleText: {oT}: Tap target permanent. Activate only if you control eight or more lands.
488288.translation: {oT}：横置目标永久物。只能于你操控八个或更多地时起动。

488290.oracleText: Kasmina had encouraged the twins to apply. Strixhaven would test not only their magical potential, but also their character.
488290.translation: 克蜜娜鼓励冰火双子申请进入斯翠海文学院深造：这里不仅能考验他们的魔法潜能，还可锤炼他们的人格品质。

488291.oracleText: When you cast this spell, copy it if you control a planeswalker, Cleric, Druid, Shaman, Warlock, or Wizard.
488291.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，如果你操控鹏洛客，僧侣，德鲁伊，祭师，邪术师或法术师，则复制该咒语。

488294.oracleText: "For sun's sake, I just want a crab!"
488294.translation: 「太阳在上，我只想变出一只蟹！」

488295.oracleText: Until end of turn, target nonland permanent loses all abilities and becomes your choice of a blue Frog creature with base power and toughness 1/1 or a blue Octopus creature with base power and toughness 4/4.
488295.translation: 直到回合结束，目标非地永久物失去所有异能，且依照你的选择成为基础力量与防御力为1/1的蓝色蛙生物或基础力量与防御力为4/4的蓝色章鱼生物。

488297.oracleText: If X is 1, scry 1, then draw a card.
488297.translation: 如果X为1，则占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

488298.oracleText: If X is 2, you may choose a player. They return a creature they control to its owner's hand.
488298.translation: 如果X为2，则你可以选择一位牌手。他将一个由其操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

488299.oracleText: If X is 3, create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488299.translation: 如果X为3，则派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488300.oracleText: If X is 4 or more, do all of the above.
488300.translation: 如果X等于或大于4，则以上皆作。

488302.oracleText: "Today is hydromancy? I thought it was amplimancy! I studied for amplimancy!"
488302.translation: 「今天是考水文占卜？我以为是考增效术！我都在念增术！」

488304.oracleText:
"Grux, for the last time, you have to do more than simply shout ‘Apply!' at the administrators."
—Pavil, admissions officer
488304.translation:
「葛兹，我最后一次告诉你：光对招生老师大叫『我要报名！』我们是绝对不会录取你的。」
～招生委员帕威

488305.oracleText: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell unless its controller pays {o3}. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
488305.translation: 除非目标生物或鹏洛客咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

488307.oracleText: Critics were struck first by the elemental's surprising grace, and then by its fists.
488307.translation: 评委先是为这元素的绝伦优雅倾倒，而后被它的数记重拳击倒。

488308.oracleText: Exile target artifact or creature. Its controller creates a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488308.translation: 放逐目标神器或生物。其操控者派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488310.translation:
「数学会咬人。」
～衡鉴修习法师毕姆

488311.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is one plus the total number of instant and sorcery cards you own in exile and in your graveyard.
488311.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为在放逐区和你的坟墓场中由你拥有之瞬间和法术这两类牌的总数加一。

488313.oracleText:
"Advanced Elemental Manifestations is canceled until all students have thawed."
—Prismari dormitory notice
488313.translation:
「高等元素具现学课程即日取消，复课日期待学生解冻后另行通知。」
～粹丽寝室公告

488315.oracleText: Zimone's brilliance drew attention from many, including the sinister mages known as the Oriq.
488315.translation: 琦梦的横溢才华引起诸方关注，包括欧理可那群恶法师。

488316.oracleText: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
488316.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张瞬间或法术牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

488318.oracleText: One of the first lessons divination students learn is how to recognize the difference between a portent and a simple surface ripple.
488318.translation: 在占卜学最初的几堂课上，学生们主要学习如何区分水面涟漪是否含有预示征兆。

488320.oracleText: "By my calculations, I should be able to achieve true enlightenment before graduation."
488320.translation: 「根据我的计算，我应能在毕业之前获致真正启蒙。」

488323.oracleText: Mages seek out the ancient beings known as the Archaics for their boundless knowledge of history and magic, dispensed only in cryptic metaphors.
488323.translation: 远古生灵古旅人遗世绝俗，其历史与魔法造诣深不可测，故而吸引众多法师苦寻其下落一求真知，到头却只收获晦涩难懂的神秘比喻。

488324.oracleText: If an opponent has more cards in hand than you, draw two cards. Draw three cards instead if an opponent has at least four more cards in hand than you.
488324.translation: 如果某对手的手牌比你多，则你抓两张牌。如果某对手的手牌比你至少多四张，则改为你抓三张牌。

488326.oracleText: To exact his vengeance, Extus needed followers. His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.
488326.translation: 埃陀斯需要更多人手才能实现他的复仇大计。于是他派渗透者深入自己意图破坏的各处学堂，就地招募有为修习法师来实施计划。

488327.oracleText: For each opponent, gain control of up to one target creature or planeswalker that player controls with mana value 3 or less.
488327.translation: 为每位对手各进行以下流程～获得至多一个目标由其操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物或鹏洛客之操控权。

488329.oracleText: Counter target instant or sorcery spell. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that spell and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.
488329.translation: 反击目标瞬间或法术咒语。从其操控者的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与该咒语同名的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手洗牌，然后每有一张以此法放逐的手牌，他便抓一张牌。

488331.oracleText: "By using the vortex, I can study for at least fifteen extra minutes between every class. I wasn't being reckless, Dean Imbraham. I was being efficient."
488331.translation: 「借助漩涡，我就能在每次课间至少空出十五分钟的学习时间。英巴罕院长，我这不是无谋，反而是在追求效率。」

488332.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more lands, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
488332.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，CARDNAME便得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

488333.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more lands, Vortex Runner gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
488333.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，漩涡奔越者便得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

488335.oracleText: Form and function in perfect unity.
488335.translation: 形式与功能的完美统一。

488338.oracleText: After drownings, devourings, and one highly unpleasant algae infestation, unsupervised portal use on campus was banned.
488338.translation: 自从多次溺水、吞噬事故和一次令人极度不快的野藻入侵后，学校当即禁止学生在未经监督的情况下开启传送通道。

488339.oracleText: {o3oU}: Target creature can't be blocked this turn.
488339.translation: {o3oU}：目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

488341.oracleText: "I would be kinder to my peers, Professor, but I simply don't have any."
488341.translation: 「教授，我也想对功力相若的人客气些，但就是遇不上。」

488342.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay 2 life. If you do, it gains flying until end of turn.
488342.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

488343.oracleText: Whenever Arrogant Poet attacks, you may pay 2 life. If you do, it gains flying until end of turn.
488343.translation: 每当傲慢诗人攻击时，你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则它获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

488345.oracleText: You may pay {o1oB} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488345.translation: 你可以支付{o1oB}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488346.oracleText: If the {o1oB} cost was paid, an opponent draws a card.
488346.translation: 如果曾支付此{o1oB}费用，则任一对手抓一张牌。

488348.oracleText: Most trudges are covered with decaying plant matter, making them ideal breeding grounds for fungal spores.
488348.translation: 大多数楚吉兽背上都覆有一片腐植层，令它们成为培养真菌孢子的最佳选择。

488350.oracleText: {o1oB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you gained life this turn.
488350.translation: {o1oB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你获得过生命的回合中起动。

488351.oracleText: {o1oB}: Return Brackish Trudge from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you gained life this turn.
488351.translation: {o1oB}：将盐碱楚吉兽从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你获得过生命的回合中起动。

488354.oracleText: When this creature dies, you gain 1 life.
488354.translation: 当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

488355.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
488355.translation: 派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

488356.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
488356.translation: 派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

488357.translation: 放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

488358.translation: 放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。

488362.oracleText: "Why, Gideon? Of all people, why save me?"
488362.translation: 「为什么，基定？为什么茫茫众生，你偏偏救了我？」

488363.oracleText: Return target planeswalker card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
488363.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于X的鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

488364.oracleText: Remove twice X loyalty counters from target planeswalker an opponent controls.
488364.translation: 从目标由对手操控的鹏洛客上移去两倍于X数量的忠诚指示物。

488365.oracleText: Choose one — • Return target planeswalker card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. • Remove twice X loyalty counters from target planeswalker an opponent controls.
488365.translation: 选择一项～ •  将目标法术力值等于或小于X的鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。 •  从目标由对手操控的鹏洛客上移去两倍于X数量的忠诚指示物。

488367.oracleText: Most students could barely endure Dean Embrose's scrutiny for a semester or two; Killian lived with it his entire life.
488367.translation: 面对安博斯院长的百般挑剔，大多数学生连一两个学期都忍不下去；但齐力安却得忍受一辈子。

488368.oracleText: Each player loses 2 life. You draw two cards.
488368.translation: 每位牌手各失去2点生命。你抓两张牌。

488370.oracleText: "I'd say it's still a fair fight—now my friend is about the size of your ego."
488370.translation: 「我觉得这还算是公平对决～现在我朋友已经跟你的自尊一样大了。」

488371.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. It gains lifelink until end of turn.
488371.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

488374.oracleText: Oculomancers see the ideal potion ingredient. The bats don't see it that way.
488374.translation: 在视像术士眼中，这是理想的药剂配方。但在巨眼蝠眼中，它们可不这么想。

488377.oracleText:
"I assure you, no one fails my course more than once."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean
488377.translation:
「我向你保证，我的课最多只会不及格一次。」
～银毫院长安博斯

488378.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is 7 minus the number of cards in that creature's controller's hand.
488378.translation: 目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为7减去该生物操控者的手牌数量。

488380.oracleText: The only feeling worse than not knowing the answer is the certainty you once did.
488380.translation: 比现在解不出题目更难受的，是你确信自己此前解出过同一题。

488384.oracleText:
"The strongest shadow spells come from disdain for someone else, not frustration with yourself."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean
488384.translation:
「最强大的黯影咒语源自蔑视他人，而非自我悔恨。」
～银毫院长安博斯

488385.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/-2 until end of turn.
488385.translation: 目标生物得+2/-2直到回合结束。

488387.oracleText: "Everyone thinks that leeches maintain a strictly sanguivorous diet, but in fact, most freshwater leeches are carnivores. Wait, where are you going?"
488387.translation: 「所有人都以为蚂蟥仅摄食血液，但实际上大多数的淡水水蛭也具有肉食习性。等等，你们怎么都走了？」

488390.oracleText: One of the Oriq's most powerful tools is the mage hunter, a vile monstrosity created to seek out and snuff out the arcane.
488390.translation: 猎法妖是专为找出并掐灭秘法来源而创造出来的恶毒怪物，因此它们算得上欧理可众手中的最强武器。

488391.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts or copies an instant or sorcery spell, they lose 1 life.
488391.translation: 每当任一对手施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，其失去1点生命。

488393.oracleText: Extus stood before his alma mater for a moment, remembering first his studies, then his vengeance. At his command, the mage hunters unfolded.
488393.translation: 埃陀斯驻足母校门前，心中澎湃的先是校园回忆，然后很快变成复仇恨意。随着他一声令下，猎法妖蜂拥而出。

488394.oracleText: Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller loses 1 life.
488394.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物进行阻挡时，其操控者失去1点生命。

488396.oracleText: When live specimens aren't readily available, Witherbloom mages make creative use of ragged spirits clinging to long-dead bodies.
488396.translation: 当手头没有可用的活体标本时，靡华法师便活用仍留在久逝尸体上的破碎灵魂来作替代。

488399.oracleText: "The professor said to first extract the venom glands, then the acid sac. Next up, the . . . meeping organ?"
488399.translation: 「教授说先摘除毒腺，然后再取下酸囊。下一步是…发声结？」

488400.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
488400.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

488402.oracleText: Nothing can quell the Oriq's thirst for the forbidden secrets of the past.
488402.translation: 没有什么能够浇灭欧理可众对于过往禁忌秘密的渴望。

488403.oracleText: {oT}: Search your library for a card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle. If it's an instant or sorcery card, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488403.translation: {oT}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。如果它是瞬间或法术牌，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488404.oracleText: {oT}: Search your library for a card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle. If it's an instant or sorcery card, put a +1/+1 counter on Oriq Loremage.
488404.translation: {oT}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。如果它是瞬间或法术牌，则在欧理可典法师上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488406.oracleText: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.
488406.translation: 斯翠海文禁止使用血腥时代的任何魔法，于是埃陀斯的研究从此开始。

488407.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice one or more creatures. When you do, copy this spell for each creature sacrificed this way.
488407.translation: 你可以牺牲一个或数个生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。当你如此作时，每以此法牺牲一个生物，便将此咒语复制一次。

488410.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
488410.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

488413.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
488413.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，每位对手各失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

488414.oracleText: You lose 1 life. Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
488414.translation: 你失去1点生命。检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

488415.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls.
488415.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最大者。

488416.oracleText: Each opponent may discard a card. If they don't, they lose 3 life. Repeat this process six more times.
488416.translation: 每位对手各可以弃一张牌。若其未如此作，则其失去3点生命。将此流程再重复六次。

488418.oracleText: Professor Onyx urged the twins to prepare for the dark mage Extus, sounding very much like someone familiar with the rise of tyrants.
488418.translation: 黑玉教授提醒冰火双子对黑暗法师埃陀斯早作准备，口气听起来仿佛就像她自己亲历过暴君崛起一样。

488419.oracleText: Choose one — • Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. • Target creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
488419.translation: 选择一项～ •  在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。 •  目标生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

488421.oracleText: "Your technique is sloppy, but there is talent there. Do it again, and keep your right arm in position this time."
488421.translation: 「你虽然技艺粗糙，但也还算是可塑之材。再作一次，这次记得把右手摆正位置。」

488422.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, draw a card.
488422.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，若其上有+1/+1指示物，则抓一张牌。

488423.oracleText: When Promising Duskmage dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, draw a card.
488423.translation: 当有为暮法师死去时，若其上有+1/+1指示物，则抓一张牌。

488426.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
488426.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

488428.oracleText: Foul specters hunt down those who try to back out of a deal with a daemogoth.
488428.translation: 与无丈魔交易后想要反悔者，下场就是会被邪秽幽魂找到。

488429.oracleText: {o5oB}: Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
488429.translation: {o5oB}：目标对手失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

488431.oracleText: "Ah, another future archmage for my collection."
488431.translation: 「啊，我的画作中又多一位未来的大法师。」

488433.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
488433.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

488435.oracleText: The sport of Mage Tower was conceived as a playful testing ground for young spellcasters.
488435.translation: 斗法塔运动既充满竞技又富有乐趣，因此被视作年轻法师的最佳试炼场。

488436.oracleText: Target player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker.
488436.translation: 目标牌手牺牲一个生物或鹏洛客。

488437.oracleText: Create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
488437.translation: 派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。

488438.oracleText: Choose one — • Target player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker. • Create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
488438.translation: 选择一项～ •  目标牌手牺牲一个生物或鹏洛客。 •  派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。

488440.oracleText:
"Don't look at me like that. It was either this or being eaten by a groff."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student
488440.translation:
「别这样看着我。你要么吃这个，要么被泽犬吃。」
～靡华修习法师迪娜

488441.oracleText: {o2oB}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
488441.translation: {o2oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

488442.oracleText: {o2oB}, Exile Unwilling Ingredient from your graveyard: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
488442.translation: {o2oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐受迫食材：你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

488444.oracleText: "I'll show you original research, you hack!"
488444.translation: 「让我给你瞧瞧真正的原创研究，你个代写枪手！」

488445.oracleText: Target creature blocks this turn if able. You may have it gain reach until end of turn.
488445.translation: 目标生物本回合若能进行阻挡，则必须阻挡。你可以使其获得延势异能直到回合结束。

488447.oracleText: "The Founder Dragons weren't even hatched when this scroll was written!"
488447.translation: 「这张卷轴写就时，创院巨龙都还没孵出来呢！」

488448.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may put an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard on the bottom of your library. If you do, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn.
488448.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库底。若你如此作，则放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

488449.oracleText: Whenever Ardent Dustspeaker attacks, you may put an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard on the bottom of your library. If you do, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn.
488449.translation: 每当热诚尘语师攻击时，你可以将一张瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库底。若你如此作，则放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

488451.oracleText: His troops took the Fortress of Caerdoon centuries ago, yet he fights on.
488451.translation: 虽然他手下部队数百年前就已攻占瑟盾要塞，但他仍在沙场征战。

488452.oracleText: {oT}: Attacking Spirits get +1/+0 until end of turn.
488452.translation: {oT}：进行攻击的精怪得+1/+0直到回合结束。

488454.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o1} and discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
488454.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o1}并弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

488455.oracleText: Whenever Conspiracy Theorist attacks, you may pay {o1} and discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
488455.translation: 每当同谋理论家攻击时，你可以支付{o1}并弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

488456.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more nonland cards, you may exile one of them from your graveyard. If you do, you may cast it this turn.
488456.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张非地牌时，你可以将其中一张从你的坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则本回合中，你可以施放它。

488458.oracleText: Will gasped as Rowan drew from the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl. For a moment, she was luminous, transcendent, terrible.
488458.translation: 看着萝婉不断地从斯翠海文魔旋中汲取原始魔力，威尔不由得屏住呼吸。在一瞬之间，只见萝婉通体红光闪耀，宛若毁灭神下凡。

488459.oracleText: CARDNAME deals five times X damage to each of up to X targets.
488459.translation: CARDNAME对至多X个目标各造成五倍于X数量的伤害。

488460.oracleText: Crackle with Power deals five times X damage to each of up to X targets.
488460.translation: 聚力劈响对至多X个目标各造成五倍于X数量的伤害。

488462.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard.
488462.translation: 从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

488463.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each non-Dragon creature, where X is the exiled card's mana value. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
488463.translation: CARDNAME对每个非龙生物各造成X点伤害，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

488464.oracleText: Draconic Intervention deals X damage to each non-Dragon creature, where X is the exiled card's mana value. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
488464.translation: 龙族干预对每个非龙生物各造成X点伤害，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。如果本回合中曾以此法受到伤害的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

488467.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each opponent. You may exile CARDNAME and four cards named Dragon's Approach from your graveyard. If you do, search your library for a Dragon creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
488467.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成3点伤害。你可以放逐CARDNAME，并从你的坟墓场放逐四张名称为巨龙来袭的牌。若你如此作，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张龙生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

488468.oracleText: Dragon's Approach deals 3 damage to each opponent. You may exile Dragon's Approach and four cards named Dragon's Approach from your graveyard. If you do, search your library for a Dragon creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
488468.translation: 巨龙来袭向每位对手各造成3点伤害。你可以放逐巨龙来袭，并从你的坟墓场放逐四张名称为巨龙来袭的牌。若你如此作，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张龙生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

488469.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Dragon's Approach.
488469.translation: 名称为巨龙来袭的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

488474.oracleText: "If the pen is mightier than the sword, just think what a giant tome could do!"
488474.translation: 「如果要说文胜于武、笔强于剑，那一本『巨』著威力该有多大！」

488476.oracleText: Rowan and Will were a natural fit in Prismari College, the school of outrageous elemental arts.
488476.translation: 粹丽学院以研究出格元素技艺闻名，正是最契合萝婉与威尔的去处。

488477.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to any target and 3 damage to any other target. Add {oRoRoR}.
488477.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成5点伤害，且对任意另一个目标造成3点伤害。加{oRoRoR}。

488478.oracleText: Explosive Welcome deals 5 damage to any target and 3 damage to any other target. Add {oRoRoR}.
488478.translation: 热烈欢迎对任意一个目标造成5点伤害，且对任意另一个目标造成3点伤害。加{oRoRoR}。

488480.oracleText: You may pay {o2oRoR} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488480.translation: 你可以支付{o2oRoR}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488481.oracleText: If the {o2oRoR} cost was paid, an opponent discards any number of cards, then draws that many cards.
488481.translation: 如果曾支付此{o2oRoR}费用，则任一对手弃任意数量的牌，然后抓等量的牌。

488482.oracleText: Search your library for up to three cards, put them into your hand, shuffle, then discard three cards at random.
488482.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张牌，将它们置于你手上，洗牌，然后随机弃三张牌。

488486.oracleText: Some spirits share ancient wisdom. Others just get mad you touched their stuff.
488486.translation: 有的魂灵乐于分享古代智慧。而有的则会因你乱碰私物而动怒。

488487.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488487.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488488.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, Fuming Effigy deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488488.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，熏烟肖像向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488489.oracleText: On rare occasions, a Prismari student will summon an elemental that shows such promise that it's permitted to stay and enroll.
488489.translation: 有的时候，粹丽学生能够召唤出颇具天资的元素，令到学院破格准许它们留存甚至入学。不过这极其罕见。

488492.oracleText: "No unauthorized summoning. No writing in the library books. And absolutely no indoor dueling!"
488492.translation: 「未经许可禁止召唤。馆藏书籍禁止涂写。绝对不准室内决斗！」

488494.oracleText: "While you were wasting time with abstract equations, I mastered ancient Oggyar fire magic. Your move."
488494.translation: 「当你还在浪费时间解开抽象算式时，我早已掌握了古代欧格牙烈焰魔法。看你的了。」

488495.oracleText: Heated Debate deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
488495.translation: 火热争辩对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。

488497.oracleText: Prismari fosters a burning need to create.
488497.translation: 粹丽学院志在培育对创造的热切需求。

488498.oracleText: Igneous Inspiration deals 3 damage to any target.
488498.translation: 火灵启迪对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

488500.oracleText: "Look at the detail in this stonework! Professor, our assumptions about early Kathorran tool use may not be correct."
488500.translation: 「看看这石雕细部的精妙处理！教授，也许我们对于卡瑟朗族早期使用工具的假设有误。」

488501.oracleText: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards. Then if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488501.translation: 弃任意数量的牌，然后抓等量的牌。然后如果你的坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488503.oracleText: The most distinguished Lorehold professors are eligible to receive extended tenure, even beyond the limits of their own mortality.
488503.translation: 衡鉴学院最杰出的教授有资格终身获聘，就算其业已离世也可继续任教。

488504.oracleText: {o5}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Create a tapped 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488504.translation: {o5}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：派出一个已横置的3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488505.oracleText: {o5}, Exile Illustrious Historian from your graveyard: Create a tapped 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488505.translation: {o5}，从你的坟墓场放逐显赫史家：派出一个已横置的3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488507.oracleText: Far from the trappings of royalty, Rowan and Will found inspiration from the most popular sport on campus, Mage Tower.
488507.translation: 在摆脱皇家礼典的束缚之后，萝婉和威尔能够积极参加校园内最受欢迎的运动项目～斗法塔，并从中收获大量灵感。

488508.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a creature token.
488508.translation: 如果此咒语以衍生生物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

488510.oracleText: When art projects collapse, Prismari students revel in the beauty of destruction. Everyone else runs for cover.
488510.translation: 当艺术作品轰然倒塌时，粹丽学生会在毁灭之美中尽情狂欢。而其他人则会慌忙寻找避难处。

488511.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
488511.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成5点伤害。过量伤害改为对该生物的操控者造成之。

488512.oracleText: Pigment Storm deals 5 damage to target creature. Excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
488512.translation: 染料风暴对目标生物造成5点伤害。过量伤害改为对该生物的操控者造成之。

488515.oracleText: A giant statue of a dwarf is still a giant statue.
488515.translation: 巨型的矮人雕像，也算是巨人雕像。

488516.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
488516.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于法术时机起动。

488517.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Pillardrop Warden: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
488517.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲避柱护卫：将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于法术时机起动。

488521.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is in your graveyard, if you would learn, you may instead return CARDNAME to the battlefield.
488521.translation: 只要CARDNAME在你的坟墓场中，如果你将温习，你便可以改为将CARDNAME移回战场。

488522.oracleText: As long as Retriever Phoenix is in your graveyard, if you would learn, you may instead return Retriever Phoenix to the battlefield.
488522.translation: 只要折返凤凰在你的坟墓场中，如果你将温习，你便可以改为将折返凤凰移回战场。

488524.oracleText: "I don't care what they think!" Rootha snapped. "I know I can do better."
488524.translation: 「我不在乎他们怎么想！」如莎打断道，「我只知道我能做得更好。」

488525.oracleText: Start from Scratch deals 1 damage to any target.
488525.translation: 从头开始对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

488526.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. • Destroy target artifact.
488526.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

488527.oracleText: Choose one — • Start from Scratch deals 1 damage to any target. • Destroy target artifact.
488527.translation: 选择一项～ •  从头开始对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

488529.oracleText: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.
488529.translation: 捕捉到的元素虽不稳定，但能够成为强大的能量来源。

488530.oracleText: Storm-Kiln Artist gets +1/+0 for each artifact you control.
488530.translation: 你每操控一个神器，暴风窑艺家便得+1/+0。

488531.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, create a Treasure token.
488531.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

488533.oracleText: Rootha created constantly, passionately, in hopes of impressing her greatest critic: herself.
488533.translation: 如莎对每次创作都投入十二分的专注和热情，只为能让最挑剔她的批评家满意：她自己。

488535.oracleText:
"Quintorius, would you care to explain why you didn't complete your homework?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
488535.translation:
「昆托力，你能不能解释一下为何没完成作业？」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

488536.oracleText: {oT}, Exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488536.translation: {oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488537.oracleText: {oT}, Exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on Tome Shredder.
488537.translation: {oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌：在毁卷狼上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488539.oracleText: "May your wretched name never grace the annals of history, you ignorant buffoon!"
488539.translation: 「祝你的丑陋名字永无法登诸年志之端，你个无知蠢货！」

488541.oracleText: "Tincture of murkroot and lizard feet? Simple. One that doesn't taste like murkroot and lizard feet? I'm working on it."
488541.translation: 「黯根蜥爪酊？轻而易举。要喝起来没有黯根和蜥爪味的？正在研究。」

488542.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
488542.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

488544.oracleText: "I made that! It's mine! Did you see that?"
488544.translation: 「那是我变的！是我变的！看到了吗？」

488545.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You gain 3 life.
488545.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。你获得3点生命。

488548.oracleText:
"Groffs are great for tracking pests through the muck, but securing the pests before the groff devours them is a dicey endeavor."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean
488548.translation:
「虽然泽犬擅于穿梭淤泥间找到害虫下落，但要想在它们吞下之前把害虫救出来，就得冒着生命危险。」
～靡华院长莉塞特

488549.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {o3}.
488549.translation: 牺牲一个生物或支付{o3}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

488551.oracleText:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator
488551.translation:
「留给量析队的时间不多了。如果他们想要抢下靡华队的苑像，他们得拿出镇住全场的本事。」
～斗法塔赛评夸米克

488552.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains reach until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it.
488552.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得延势异能。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488554.oracleText: It takes "devouring a book in one sitting" to a frightening extreme.
488554.translation: 它把「一口气消化一本书」演绎到了惊人的极端。

488556.oracleText: {o2oG}: Put CARDNAME from your graveyard into your library third from the top.
488556.translation: {o2oG}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

488557.oracleText: {o2oG}: Put Bookwurm from your graveyard into your library third from the top.
488557.translation: {o2oG}：将噬书亚龙从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

488559.oracleText:
"What a move! Lorehold gets caught flat-footed, and Witherbloom barrels ahead."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator
488559.translation:
「精彩突破！衡鉴队显得有点不知所措，靡华队趁机拉开距离。」
～斗法塔赛评夸米克

488561.oracleText: For pestkeepers, there's no sound more disheartening than breaking glass.
488561.translation: 对害虫看守来说，最吓人的莫过于听到玻璃碎裂的声音。

488562.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. If its mana value is 2 or less, create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
488562.translation: 消灭目标神器或结界。如果其法术力值等于或小于2，则派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

488564.oracleText: Witherbloom spells often take on the appearance—and personality—of their components.
488564.translation: 靡华咒语通常会保留其主要成分的外形～甚至天性。

488565.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control. When the permanent you don't control dies this turn, you gain 2 life.
488565.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。本回合中，当该不由你操控的永久物死去时，你获得2点生命。

488567.oracleText: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."
488567.translation: 「创院巨龙终结了血腥时代。能够侍奉他们是我的荣幸。」

488568.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488568.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488569.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Dragonsguard Elite.
488569.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在菁英护龙卫上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488570.oracleText: {o4oGoG}: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.

488571.oracleText: {o4oGoG}: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on Dragonsguard Elite.
488571.translation: {o4oGoG}：将菁英护龙卫上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

488573.oracleText: Search your library and graveyard for up to four creature cards with different names that each have mana value X or less and reveal them. An opponent chooses two of those cards. Shuffle the chosen cards into your library and put the rest onto the battlefield. Exile CARDNAME.
488573.translation: 从你的牌库和坟墓场中搜寻至多四张名称各不相同的生物牌，且其法术力值均须等于或小于X，展示这些牌。任一对手选择其中两张牌。将所选之牌洗入你的牌库，其余则放进战场。放逐CARDNAME。

488574.oracleText: Search your library and graveyard for up to four creature cards with different names that each have mana value X or less and reveal them. An opponent chooses two of those cards. Shuffle the chosen cards into your library and put the rest onto the battlefield. Exile Ecological Appreciation.
488574.translation: 从你的牌库和坟墓场中搜寻至多四张名称各不相同的生物牌，且其法术力值均须等于或小于X，展示这些牌。任一对手选择其中两张牌。将所选之牌洗入你的牌库，其余则放进战场。放逐生态鉴赏。

488576.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. That land becomes a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature that's still a land. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each land you had enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
488576.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。该地成为0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵生物，且仍然是地。在其上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于本回合中在你操控下进战场的地数量。

488578.oracleText: Most Quandrix students fundamentally disagree with the concept of "enough."
488578.translation: 大多数量析学生都从根本上反对「适量」这一说法。

488579.oracleText: Until end of turn, double target creature's power X times.
488579.translation: 直到回合结束，将目标生物的力量加倍X次。

488581.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Forest card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
488581.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

488583.oracleText: "If a seedling can push through solid stone, there's no limit to what I could do."
488583.translation: 「如果连幼苗都能突破顽石自由成长，那我的能力便高无止境。」

488584.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
488584.translation: 你获得2点生命。目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

488590.oracleText: First in his clan to attend Strixhaven, and now first in his class.
488590.translation: 他是曾是该部落第一位入学斯翠海文的巨魔，如今更是班上第一名。

488591.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+1 as long as you have 25 or more life.
488591.translation: 只要你的总生命为25或更多，CARDNAME便得+2/+1。

488592.oracleText: Honor Troll gets +2/+1 as long as you have 25 or more life.
488592.translation: 只要你的总生命为25或更多，求誉巨魔便得+2/+1。

488594.oracleText:
"She showed up to class on a what?"
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean
488594.translation:
「她是骑什么上学的来着？」
～靡华院长瓦伦丁

488595.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
488595.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488597.oracleText:
"Do you still believe my work is nothing but dry, boring equations?"
—Cairu, Quandrix mage-student
488597.translation:
「你还觉得我的成果就只是枯燥无聊的算式吗？」
～量析修习法师凯依璐

488598.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of lands you control.
488598.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的地数量。

488600.oracleText: "Remember the rules. No spells to the face!"
488600.translation: 「请双方注意规则。咒语不能打脸！」

488601.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you've cast another instant or sorcery spell this turn.
488601.translation: 如果你本回合中施放过其他瞬间或法术咒语，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

488602.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+2 until end of turn. Then it fights target creature you don't control.
488602.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+1/+2直到回合结束。然后它与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

488605.oracleText: Tondo lost his very first duel and has spent his entire life trying to get even.
488605.translation: 汤多输掉了平生第一次决斗，而后便耗尽余生要讨平旧账。

488606.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with power equal to its toughness attacks, it gains trample until end of turn.
488606.translation: 每当一个由你操控且力量与防御力相等的生物攻击时，它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

488612.oracleText: She's brilliant, if a bit overbearing.
488612.translation: 她聪智过人，甚至可以说是凌人。

488616.oracleText: "Linear growth? What am I, a first-year?"
488616.translation: 「线性增长？你当我还是一年级新生吗？」

488617.oracleText: {o4oG}: Double CARDNAME's power and toughness until end of turn.
488617.translation: {o4oG}：将CARDNAME的力量与防御力加倍直到回合结束。

488618.oracleText: {o4oG}: Double Reckless Amplimancer's power and toughness until end of turn.
488618.translation: {o4oG}：将鲁莽增术师的力量与防御力加倍直到回合结束。

488620.oracleText: Scurrid teeth evolved to crack open nuts, but they work just as well for crushing bones if the nest is threatened.
488620.translation: 怖鼠的牙齿进化后已能咬碎坚果，但如果巢穴受到威胁，也能用来咬碎骨头。

488621.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 as long as you control eight or more lands.
488621.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，CARDNAME便得+2/+2。

488622.oracleText: Scurrid Colony gets +2/+2 as long as you control eight or more lands.
488622.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，怖鼠群落便得+2/+2。

488624.oracleText:
"The bogs are deeper than you realize. Most of the space beneath the surface is taken up by these enormous karoks. You might think your feet are touching the bottom. They're probably not."
—Gyome, Witherbloom chef
488624.translation:
「腐沼的深度远超乎你的实感。这些庞大的鳄兽占据了水面下大多数空间。你会以为自己的脚已触到沼底。你很可能感觉错了。」
～靡华主厨纪尧姆

488626.oracleText: Cervins feed on the mana-rich plants around the star arches, imbuing their bodies with extraordinary grace and vitality.
488626.translation: 魔鹿以星拱周围富含法力的植物为食，因而体态优雅、充满活力。

488629.oracleText:
"It's like that old saying: what goes up . . . feeds the arboretum."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean
488629.translation:
「有谚道：凡事有起…必喂植物。」
～靡华院长莉塞特

488630.oracleText: Tangletrap deals 5 damage to target creature with flying.
488630.translation: 缠草捕物对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。

488631.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature with flying. • Destroy target artifact.
488631.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

488632.oracleText: Choose one — • Tangletrap deals 5 damage to target creature with flying. • Destroy target artifact.
488632.translation: 选择一项～ •  缠草捕物对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

488634.oracleText: You may pay {o3oG} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
488634.translation: 你可以支付{o3oG}，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

488635.oracleText: Search your library for up to four basic land cards and reveal them. Put one of them onto the battlefield tapped under an opponent's control if the {o3oG} cost was paid. Put two of them onto the battlefield tapped under your control and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle.
488635.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多四张基本地牌并展示之。如果曾支付此{o3oG}费用，则将其中一张在任一对手的操控下横置放进战场。将其中两张在你的操控下横置放进战场，其余的牌则置于你手上。然后洗牌。

488637.oracleText: "Hold still. I have a theory about what's going to happen to your face."
488637.translation: 「站定别动。我有一套关于你的面容即将变化的理论。」

488639.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more lands, CARDNAME gets +5/+5.
488639.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，CARDNAME便得+5/+5。

488640.oracleText: As long as you control eight or more lands, Augmenter Pugilist gets +5/+5.
488640.translation: 只要你操控八个或更多地，增威拳手便得+5/+5。

488646.oracleText: Pests are typically harvested before they outgrow their enclosures. Blex is far from typical.
488646.translation: 害虫一般在体型长超围笼之前就被采走备用。但毕雷兹很不一般。

488648.oracleText: Other Pests, Bats, Insects, Snakes, and Spiders you control get +1/+1.
488648.translation: 由你操控的其他害虫、蝙蝠、昆虫、蛇和蜘蛛得+1/+1。

488649.oracleText: When Blex, Vexing Pest dies, you gain 4 life.
488649.translation: 当乱心害虫毕雷兹死去时，你获得4点生命。

488652.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put any number of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 3 life for each card you put into your hand this way.
488652.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中任意数量的牌置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。你每以此法将一张牌置于你手上，便失去3点生命。

488654.oracleText: "Join me for the dawn of a new age."

488656.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, return target nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
488656.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，将目标非传奇的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488659.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 3 damage to each opponent.
488659.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，它向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

488660.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature. Create a 3/6 black and red Avatar creature token with haste and "Whenever this creature attacks, it deals 3 damage to each opponent."
488660.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个生物。你派出一个3/6，黑红双色的圣者衍生生物，且具有敏捷异能与「每当此生物攻击时，它向每位对手各造成3点伤害。」

488664.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability that isn't a mana ability, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to that player.
488664.translation: 每当任一对手起动不属法术力异能的异能时，CARDNAME对该牌手造成1点伤害。

488665.oracleText: Whenever an opponent activates an ability that isn't a mana ability, Flamescroll Celebrant deals 1 damage to that player.
488665.translation: 每当任一对手起动不属法术力异能的异能时，焰卷主祭对该牌手造成1点伤害。

488666.oracleText: {o1oR}: Flamescroll Celebrant gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

488670.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast spells or activate planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
488670.translation: 本回合中，所有对手都不能施放咒语或起动鹏洛客的忠诚异能。

488674.oracleText: Discard a card: Return Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios to its owner's hand.
488674.translation: 弃一张牌：将阿凯维沃圣法谕贾琦移回其拥有者手上。

488675.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a nonland card, you may cast it by paying {o1} rather than paying its mana cost. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield.
488675.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是非地牌，则你可以施放它，但须支付{o1}，而非支付其法术力费用。如果它是地牌，则将之放进战场。

488677.oracleText: To find Jadzi, one need only wander.

488679.oracleText: You may put any number of land cards from your hand onto the battlefield. Then if you control eight or more lands, you may discard a card. If you do, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
488679.translation: 你可以将任意数量的地牌从你手上放进战场。然后如果你操控八个或更多地，则你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

488680.oracleText: You may put any number of land cards from your hand onto the battlefield. Then if you control eight or more lands, you may discard a card. If you do, return Journey to the Oracle to its owner's hand.
488680.translation: 你可以将任意数量的地牌从你手上放进战场。然后如果你操控八个或更多地，则你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则将追寻圣法谕移回其拥有者手上。

488683.oracleText: {oT}: Exile the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put a study counter on it.
488683.translation: {oT}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，则将它置于你手上。若否，则在其上放置一个读书指示物。

488684.oracleText: {o4oG}: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put a +1/+1 counter on it for each different mana value among nonland cards you own in exile with study counters on them.
488684.translation: {o4oG}：派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于放逐区中由你拥有且其上有读书指示物之各牌间不同的法术力值数量。

488687.oracleText: {oXoUoU}, {oT}: Exile the top X cards of your library and put a study counter on each of them. Then you may put a card you own in exile with a study counter on it into your hand.
488687.translation: {oXoUoU}，{oT}：放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，并在所放逐的每张牌上各放置一个读书指示物。然后你可以将放逐区中一张由你拥有且其上有读书指示物的牌置于你手上。

488690.oracleText: Whenever an opponent attacks one or more planeswalkers you control, put a loyalty counter on each planeswalker you control.
488690.translation: 每当任一对手攻击由你操控的一个或数个鹏洛客时，在每个由你操控的鹏洛客上各放置一个忠诚指示物。

488693.oracleText: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card. If a creature card was discarded this way, draw two cards instead.
488693.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。如果你如此作，则抓一张牌。如果以此法弃掉一张生物牌，则改为抓两张牌。

488694.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of your next upkeep.
488694.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。在你的下一个维持开始时，将它放逐。

488698.oracleText: {oT}, Discard a card: Create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
488698.translation: {oT}，弃一张牌：派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

488699.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Each opponent mills cards equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
488699.translation: {o1}，{oT}：每位对手各磨若干牌，其数量等同于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

488700.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Exile four target cards from a single graveyard. Draw a card.
488700.translation: {o4}，{oT}：将四张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌放逐。抓一张牌。

488702.oracleText: "Death? Everyone does death. Let me show you something actually impressive."
488702.translation: 「死去？人人都会死去。让我给你看看更精彩的东西。」

488704.oracleText: Return up to two target creature, land, and/or planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand. Each player gains 4 life. Exile CARDNAME.
488704.translation: 将至多两张目标生物，地和／或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。每位牌手各获得4点生命。放逐CARDNAME。

488705.oracleText: Return up to two target creature, land, and/or planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand. Each player gains 4 life. Exile Restorative Burst.
488705.translation: 将至多两张目标生物，地和／或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。每位牌手各获得4点生命。放逐复归爆发。

488708.oracleText: {o4oR}, {oT}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonlegendary, nonland card with mana value 3 or less. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Put all revealed cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
488708.translation: {o4oR}，{oT}：从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值等于或小于3且既非传奇也非地的牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。将所有以此法展示且未施放的牌依随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

488710.oracleText: Other tapped creatures you control get +1/+0.
488710.translation: 由你操控且已横置的其他生物得+1/+0。

488711.oracleText: Other untapped creatures you control get +0/+1.
488711.translation: 由你操控且未横置的其他生物得+0/+1。

488712.oracleText: Whenever you attack, untap each creature you control, then tap any number of creatures you control.
488712.translation: 每当你攻击时，重置所有由你操控的生物，然后横置任意数量由你操控的生物。

488715.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent. If you've drawn three or more cards this turn, she deals 3 damage to each opponent instead.
488715.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。如果你本回合中抓过三张或更多牌，则改为她向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

488716.oracleText: Rowan, Scholar of Sparks deals 1 damage to each opponent. If you've drawn three or more cards this turn, she deals 3 damage to each opponent instead.
488716.translation: 火花学者萝婉向每位对手各造成1点伤害。如果你本回合中抓过三张或更多牌，则改为她向每位对手各造成3点伤害。

488717.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
488717.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

488718.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy."
488718.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。」

488721.oracleText: Up to one target creature has base power and toughness 0/2 until your next turn.
488721.translation: 至多一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为0/2直到你的下一个回合。

488723.oracleText: Exile up to five target permanents. For each permanent exiled this way, its controller creates a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488723.translation: 放逐至多五个目标永久物。对每个以此法放逐的永久物而言，其操控者派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488725.oracleText: He offered his light to make sure no others would be dimmed.
488725.translation: 他奉献自身光芒，确保无人生命就此黯淡。

488727.oracleText: Exile CARDNAME: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
488727.translation: 放逐CARDNAME：由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

488728.oracleText: Exile Selfless Glyphweaver: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
488728.translation: 放逐无私织符僧：由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

488730.oracleText: She cast a spell to purge all weakness. When the ink cleared, she stood alone.
488730.translation: 她施咒涤净弱者。墨渍褪去唯她孑自独立。

488731.oracleText: Choose a creature or planeswalker, then destroy all other creatures and planeswalkers.
488731.translation: 选择一个生物或鹏洛客，然后消灭所有其他生物和鹏洛客。

488733.oracleText: "You are so much stronger than you know."

488735.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
488735.translation: {oT}：在每个本回合在你的操控下进战场的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488737.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature, then CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that creature.
488737.translation: {oT}：在另一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后CARDNAME对该生物造成2点伤害。

488738.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature, then Embrose, Dean of Shadow deals 2 damage to that creature.
488738.translation: {oT}：在另一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后黯影院长安博斯对该生物造成2点伤害。

488744.oracleText: He channels his heart's passion into every fiery note.
488744.translation: 他将自己的内心激情，全数化作火焰音符喷薄而出。

488745.oracleText: Discard a card, then draw a card. When you discard an instant or sorcery card this way, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
488745.translation: 弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张瞬间或法术牌时，CARDNAME对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所弃之牌的法术力值。

488746.oracleText: Discard a card, then draw a card. When you discard an instant or sorcery card this way, Flamethrower Sonata deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
488746.translation: 弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张瞬间或法术牌时，喷焰奏曲对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所弃之牌的法术力值。

488749.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled, remove a hone counter from it.
488749.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐，则从其上移去一个磨练指示物。

488750.oracleText: When the last hone counter is removed from this card, if it's exiled, you may cast it. It costs {o4} less to cast this way.
488750.translation: 当从此牌上移去最后一个磨练指示物时，若它已放逐，则你可以施放它。它以此法施放时减少{o4}来施放。

488754.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of each opponent's library. Until end of turn, you may cast spells from among those exiled cards, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
488754.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐每位对手的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放所放逐之牌中的非地牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放这些咒语的费用。

488755.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488755.translation: 每当你从放逐区中施放咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488756.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, put a +1/+1 counter on Nassari, Dean of Expression.
488756.translation: 每当你从放逐区中施放咒语时，在展现院长纳撒理上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488759.oracleText: If a nontoken creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead. When you do, you may pay {o2}. If you do, create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
488759.translation: 如果某个由对手操控且非衍生物的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。当你如此作时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

488761.oracleText: "Life is as fleeting as it is vibrant. Embrace the brief blessing of a flower before it withers."
488761.translation: 「万物生命越短暂，生机就越旺盛。好好把握鲜花凋谢之前那转瞬即逝的祝福。」

488763.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {o1}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and those creatures gain trample until end of turn.
488763.translation: 每当你获得生命时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物，且这些生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

488765.oracleText: Some Quandrix mages prefer to study at twilight, watching their experimental equations trace glowing trails against the encroaching darkness.
488765.translation: 有些量析法师喜欢等到黄昏时刻才开始研究，因为在逐渐笼罩下来的夜幕当中，他们才能看到自己实验算式画出的轨迹辉光。

488766.oracleText: Return target permanent to its owner's hand. Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
488766.translation: 将目标永久物移回其拥有者手上。将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488768.oracleText: At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
488768.translation: 在每个维持开始时，派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

488769.oracleText: Pay 10 life: Untap all lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
488769.translation: 支付10点生命：重置所有由你操控的地。每回合只能起动一次。

488775.oracleText: "So you see, the reckless battle strategy of the Kathorran orcs was effective, but ultimately proved to be a double-edged sword. As did their double-edged swords."
488775.translation: 「所以我们可以看到，卡瑟朗族半兽人所采用的鲁莽战术虽然有效，但最终来说却是一把双刃剑。就跟他们挥舞的双刃剑一样。」

488778.oracleText: "Dean Valentin warns us not to consume the samples for our safety, but I think he's just being greedy."
488778.translation: 「瓦伦丁院长告诫我们说，为了自身安全着想，请勿吞服样品。但我觉得他就是太贪心。」

488779.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Blood Researcher.
488779.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在鲜血研究员上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488781.oracleText: A drop of ink is a nuisance. A torrent of inklings is a menace.
488781.translation: 一滴墨水只是小麻烦。一股墨灵则是大威胁。

488782.oracleText: Create X tapped 2/1 white and black Inkling creature tokens with flying. If X is 6 or more, destroy all noncreature, nonland permanents.
488782.translation: 派出X个已横置的2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。如果X等于或大于6，则消灭所有非生物且非地的永久物。

488784.oracleText: Needledeep had promised that his final project would be his biggest one yet.
488784.translation: 邃针曾向大家保证，他最后一个作品会是他有史以来最大的。

488785.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of cards in your library.
488785.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你牌库中牌的数量。

488788.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast during your end step.
488788.translation: 于你的结束步骤中，此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

488789.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker you don't control. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.
488789.translation: 消灭目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客。在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488791.oracleText: The only thing more delicious than a top grade is Gyome's signature cake.
488791.translation: 比好成绩更诱人的，只有纪尧姆的招牌蛋糕。

488793.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to any target. Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
488793.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

488794.oracleText: Creative Outburst deals 5 damage to any target. Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
488794.translation: 创意爆发对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。检视你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

488795.oracleText: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}, Discard CARDNAME: Create a Treasure token.

488796.oracleText: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}, Discard Creative Outburst: Create a Treasure token.
488796.translation: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}，弃掉创意爆发：派出一个珍宝衍生物。

488798.oracleText: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."
488798.translation: 「你失败的原因在于自身的软弱。我只不过是为你指出这一点。」

488799.oracleText: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less. Add {oB} or {oG} for each permanent destroyed this way.
488799.translation: 消灭所有法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物。每以此法消灭一个永久物，便加{oB}或{oG}。

488801.oracleText: Will's quick thinking meshed with Rowan's raw power to bring down the Blood Avatar.
488801.translation: 威尔的敏捷思维佐以萝婉的天赐纯力，双子齐心最终得以击败血腥圣者。

488802.oracleText: Exile the top X cards of your library. For each land card exiled this way, create a Treasure token. For each blue card exiled this way, draw a card. For each red card exiled this way, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488802.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的X张牌。每以此法放逐一张地牌，便派出一个珍宝衍生物。每以此法放逐一张蓝色牌，便抓一张牌。每以此法放逐一张红色牌，CARDNAME便向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488803.oracleText: Exile the top X cards of your library. For each land card exiled this way, create a Treasure token. For each blue card exiled this way, draw a card. For each red card exiled this way, Culmination of Studies deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488803.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的X张牌。每以此法放逐一张地牌，便派出一个珍宝衍生物。每以此法放逐一张蓝色牌，便抓一张牌。每以此法放逐一张红色牌，研学巅峰便向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488805.oracleText:
"Of course it offered you power. Demons always do. But trust me—the sweeter the prize, the more ruinous the price."
—Professor Onyx
488805.translation:
「它当然会赐予你力量。恶魔都如此。不过请听我一言～奖赏越甜美，代价越惨痛。」
～黑玉教授

488806.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, sacrifice a creature.
488806.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，牺牲一个生物。

488807.oracleText: Whenever Daemogoth Titan attacks or blocks, sacrifice a creature.
488807.translation: 每当无丈魔泰坦攻击或阻挡时，牺牲一个生物。

488809.oracleText: "Your pain for my wisdom. You'll get no better deal."
488809.translation: 「用你的痛苦换取我的智慧。你找不到更合算的交易了。」

488810.oracleText: When you sacrifice CARDNAME, each opponent discards a card, you draw a card, and you gain 2 life.
488810.translation: 当你牺牲CARDNAME时，每位对手各弃一张牌，你抓一张牌，且你获得2点生命。

488811.oracleText: When you sacrifice Daemogoth Woe-Eater, each opponent discards a card, you draw a card, and you gain 2 life.
488811.translation: 当你牺牲噬悲无丈魔时，每位对手各弃一张牌，你抓一张牌，且你获得2点生命。

488813.oracleText: No one ever asked what was in Dina's concoctions, so long as they worked.
488813.translation: 从来没人问过迪娜的合剂里面有些什么，只要药效到了就行。

488814.oracleText: Each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker. If you sacrificed a permanent this way, you may return another permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
488814.translation: 每位牌手各牺牲一个生物或鹏洛客。如果你以此法牺牲一个永久物，则你可以将另一张永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488817.oracleText: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o3}.
488817.translation: 除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

488818.oracleText: Choose one — • Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control. • Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o3}.
488818.translation: 选择一项～ •  目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。 •  除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

488821.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
488821.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为所牺牲生物的力量。

488822.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Dina, Soul Steeper gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
488822.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物：浸灵迪娜得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为所牺牲生物的力量。

488824.oracleText: "Now I can dedicate myself fully to zoetimancy and void theory!"
488824.translation: 「现在我就能专心研究雄生术和虚空理论了！」

488825.oracleText: Copy target creature spell you control, except it isn't legendary if the spell is legendary.
488825.translation: 复制目标由你操控的生物咒语，但如果该咒语是传奇，则复制品不是传奇。

488827.oracleText: The enraptured audience barely noticed their programs were suddenly blank.
488827.translation: 观众看得入神，根本没注意到他们的节目单瞬间变作空白。

488828.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control die, create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.
488828.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

488831.oracleText: If this creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else.
488831.translation: 如果此生物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。

488835.oracleText: Rootha passed with flying, living colors.
488835.translation: 如莎以出色的优异成绩高分过关。

488836.oracleText: Create two 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature tokens.
488836.translation: 派出两个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488837.oracleText: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}, Discard Elemental Masterpiece: Create a Treasure token.
488837.translation: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}，弃掉元素杰作：派出一个珍宝衍生物。

488839.oracleText:
"You've made a splash. Now show me a torrent."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean
488839.translation:
「你已能溅起水花。现在让我看看水流。」
～粹丽院长乌薇妲

488840.oracleText: Create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
488840.translation: 派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

488842.oracleText: "At first, the equations were simply numbers. But in those numbers I saw a story, and in that story I saw a pattern, and suddenly it all fit together!"
488842.translation: 「一开始，这些算式就只是数字。但我先从连串数字中读出故事，而又在故事之间发现规律，一切突然就对上了！」

488843.oracleText: Draw two cards. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
488843.translation: 抓两张牌。你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

488845.oracleText: His words poured forth on waves of golden light, scouring all fear from his audience's hearts and minds.
488845.translation: 他的言辞化作道道金光照耀众人，将听众心灵之间所有恐惧打消一空。

488846.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
488846.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

488848.oracleText: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.
488848.translation: 在激情与精进的张力之间，粹丽学生尽情起舞。

488849.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand, put one of them on the bottom of your library, and exile one of them. You may play the exiled card this turn.
488849.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，一张置于你的牌库底，一张放逐。本回合中，你可以使用所放逐的牌。

488851.oracleText:
"Fractals are just pseudo-dimensional manifestations of asynchronous biosymmetries. It's really quite simple."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean
488851.translation:
「分灵只不过是异步生物对称体在假维度空间下的具现。原理非常简单。」
～量析院长齐安妮

488852.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it.
488852.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物。

488854.oracleText:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr
488854.translation:
「年轻法师，你的反抗有点意思。现在你该了解自己实际上有多脆弱。」
～埃陀斯纳尔

488855.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker.
488855.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或鹏洛客。

488858.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell.
488858.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语。

488859.oracleText: Artifacts you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell."
488859.translation: 由你操控的神器具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语。」

488861.oracleText:
"When I look around, I see a world defined by patterns that still manages to defy them."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean
488861.translation:
「我环顾四周，看到的是一个早已有无数规律定义，却还能不断打破规则的世界。」
～量析院长齐安妮

488862.oracleText: Draw a card for each different power among creatures you control.
488862.translation: 由你操控的生物中每有一种力量数值，便抓一张牌。

488864.oracleText:
"As I stepped into the star arch, it all became perfectly clear. Life and death are not opposites, but an endless path, twisting around and back upon itself, never ending and never beginning."
—Zhaer, professor of biophilosophy
488864.translation:
「我踏入星拱，一切都变得豁然开朗。生死并非对立两面，而是一条无尽通途。这条道路蜿蜒缠绕，最后连结一体，无所谓终，也无所谓始。」
～生物哲学教授札依儿

488865.translation: 交换你的手牌和坟墓场。

488868.oracleText: Spirits you control get +1/+1 and have trample and haste.
488868.translation: 由你操控的精怪得+1/+1且具有践踏与敏捷异能。

488873.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card. Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
488873.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488875.oracleText: Dina raised her cup to Killian's lips, and for the first time in his life, he knew compassion.
488875.translation: 迪娜将杯子捧到齐力安嘴边，让他首度尝到受人同情的滋味。

488876.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains deathtouch and "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control."
488876.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得死触异能与「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。」

488878.oracleText:
"Think of an insult so vicious, so vulgar, that you hesitate to speak it aloud. The strongest, most aggressive inklings are born from such scorn."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean
488878.translation:
「在心里想一句骂人的话。它要够恶毒、够粗俗、够难听，到你自己都不好意思大声骂出口的地步。最强大、最凶猛的墨灵，就是诞生自这种辱骂之中。」
～银毫院长安博斯

488880.oracleText: Each other planeswalker you control has the loyalty abilities of CARDNAME.
488880.translation: 每个由你操控的其他鹏洛客均具有CARDNAME的所有忠诚异能。

488881.oracleText: Each other planeswalker you control has the loyalty abilities of Kasmina, Enigma Sage.
488881.translation: 每个由你操控的其他鹏洛客均具有谜样智者克蜜娜的所有忠诚异能。

488882.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it.
488882.translation: 派出一个0/0，绿蓝双色的分灵衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物。

488883.oracleText: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card that shares a color with this planeswalker, exile that card, then shuffle. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
488883.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张与此鹏洛客具共通颜色的瞬间或法术牌，放逐该牌，然后洗牌。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

488885.oracleText: "When your father is Dean Embrose, second best really isn't an option."
488885.translation: 「身为安博斯院长的儿子，我不能只屈居第二。」

488886.oracleText: Spells you cast that target a creature cost {o2} less to cast.
488886.translation: 你施放之以生物为目标的咒语减少{o2}来施放。

488888.oracleText: Ancient footfalls echo in her head, their timeless rhythm guiding the present.
488888.translation: 远古足音在她脑中回响，这段永恒踢踏节奏正指引当下发展。

488889.oracleText: {oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488889.translation: {oT}：此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488890.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, until end of turn, Spirit creatures you control gain "{oT}: This creature deals 1 damage to each opponent."
488890.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，直到回合结束，由你操控的精怪生物获得「{oT}：此生物向每位对手各造成1点伤害。」

488892.oracleText: Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488892.translation: 派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488893.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible and haste until end of turn.
488893.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得不灭与敏捷异能。

488894.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. Target player gains 3 life.

488898.oracleText: Choose two — • Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token. • Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible and haste until end of turn. • Lorehold Command deals 3 damage to any target. Target player gains 3 life. • Sacrifice a permanent, then draw two cards.

488900.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, mill a card. If a land card was milled this way, you gain 1 life. Otherwise, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488900.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，磨一张牌。若以此法磨掉一张地牌，则你获得1点生命。若否，则CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488901.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, mill a card. If a land card was milled this way, you gain 1 life. Otherwise, Lorehold Excavation deals 1 damage to each opponent.
488901.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，磨一张牌。若以此法磨掉一张地牌，则你获得1点生命。若否，则衡鉴挖掘向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

488902.oracleText: {o5}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a tapped 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488902.translation: {o5}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：派出一个已横置的3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488905.oracleText: "The weight of history can empower you or it can crush you. It's your choice."
488905.translation: 「历史之重能赐你力量，也能将你压垮。端看你如何抉择。」

488906.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, Lorehold Pledgemage gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
488906.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，衡鉴证法师得+1/+0直到回合结束。

488908.oracleText: She's an inspiration to everyone, even herself.
488908.translation: 她是所有人的灵感源泉，包括她自己。

488909.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn costs {oX} less to cast, where X is CARDNAME's power as this ability resolves.
488909.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你本回合中施放的下一个瞬间或法术咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为于此异能结算时CARDNAME的力量。

488910.oracleText: Whenever Maelstrom Muse attacks, the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn costs {oX} less to cast, where X is Maelstrom Muse's power as this ability resolves.
488910.translation: 每当涡心缪思攻击时，你本回合中施放的下一个瞬间或法术咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为于此异能结算时涡心缪思的力量。

488912.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. Tap two target permanents. Create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token. Draw two cards.
488912.translation: CARDNAME对任意数量的目标造成共4点伤害，你可以任意分配。横置两个目标永久物。派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。抓两张牌。

488913.oracleText: Magma Opus deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. Tap two target permanents. Create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token. Draw two cards.
488913.translation: 至炫熔彩对任意数量的目标造成共4点伤害，你可以任意分配。横置两个目标永久物。派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。抓两张牌。

488914.oracleText: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}, Discard Magma Opus: Create a Treasure token.
488914.translation: {o(U/R)o(U/R)}，弃掉至炫熔彩：派出一个珍宝衍生物。

488916.oracleText: Those who do learn from history may still choose to repeat it.
488916.translation: 从历史中学到教训的人，仍可能选择去重演历史。

488917.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. When that creature dies this turn, create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488917.translation: 目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488919.oracleText: The first thing a Quandrix mage learns is the laws of metaphysics. The second thing is how to break them.
488919.translation: 量析法师要学习的第一项内容，便是形上学哲理。第二项内容便是如何打破它们。

488923.oracleText: Necroluminescence is common among the undead creatures of Sedgemoor, giving the midnight swamp an eerie glow. It's comforting—from a distance.
488923.translation: 蓑草原上的不死生物大多会发出死冥磷火，令午夜时分的沼泽四处都有怪异幽光。看起来却也令人安心～只要你别靠近。

488926.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you gained life this turn.
488926.translation: 如果你本回合中获得过生命，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

488929.oracleText: As they learn to fly, young drakes have a tendency to accidentally impale trees, cliffs, and unsuspecting students.
488929.translation: 幼年龙兽在学习飞行时，往往会不小心穿透树木、山崖以及没留神的学生。

488931.oracleText: "May Ganathog bless us with bloody visions of glory restored!"
488931.translation: 「愿噶纳索予吾人荣耀复兴的血腥视像！」

488936.oracleText:
"Step 1: Put the pests in mud.
"Step 2: Wait."
—Gyome's Guide to Pest Breeding
488936.translation:
「第一步：把害虫埋入土中。
第二步：等着。」
～《纪尧姆育虫导论》

488937.oracleText: Create two 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
488937.translation: 派出两个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

488939.oracleText: The twins each researched spells to defeat Extus in their own way. Will hit the library. Rowan hit everything else.
488939.translation: 冰火双子分头研究能够击败埃陀斯的咒语：威尔习图书。萝婉袭他物。

488940.oracleText: Draw four cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an instant or sorcery card.
488940.translation: 抓四张牌。然后除非你弃一张瞬间或法术牌，否则弃两张牌。

488942.oracleText: "No one ever created great art by playing it safe!"

488943.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn. If that spell has mana value 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
488943.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。如果该咒语的法术力值等于或大于5，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488944.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, Prismari Apprentice can't be blocked this turn. If that spell has mana value 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on Prismari Apprentice.
488944.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，粹丽学徒本回合不能被阻挡。如果该咒语的法术力值等于或大于5，则在粹丽学徒上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488946.oracleText: Prismari Command deals 2 damage to any target.
488946.translation: 粹丽指命对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

488947.oracleText: Target player draws two cards, then discards two cards.
488947.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。

488948.oracleText: Target player creates a Treasure token.
488948.translation: 目标牌手派出一个珍宝衍生物。

488949.oracleText: Choose two — • CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. • Target player draws two cards, then discards two cards. • Target player creates a Treasure token. • Destroy target artifact.
488949.translation: 选择两项～ •  CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。 •  目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。 •  目标牌手派出一个珍宝衍生物。 •  消灭目标神器。

488950.oracleText: Choose two — • Prismari Command deals 2 damage to any target. • Target player draws two cards, then discards two cards. • Target player creates a Treasure token. • Destroy target artifact.
488950.translation: 选择两项～ •  粹丽指命对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。 •  目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。 •  目标牌手派出一个珍宝衍生物。 •  消灭目标神器。

488952.oracleText: Many have the talent to create, but few have the courage to share their creations.
488952.translation: 人人都有创造才华，但鲜有人有勇气分享。

488953.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
488953.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

488954.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, Prismari Pledgemage can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
488954.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，粹丽证法师于本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

488956.oracleText: "The secrets of our world will be mine."
488956.translation: 「这个世界的秘密都将属于我。」

488957.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
488957.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。你可以展示其中的一张地牌，并将该牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

488959.oracleText: Return target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand.
488959.translation: 将目标生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。

488960.oracleText: Choose two — • Return target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand. • Counter target artifact or enchantment spell. • Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. • Target player shuffles up to three target cards from their graveyard into their library.
