488960.translation: 选择两项～ •  将目标生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。 •  反击目标神器或结界咒语。 •  在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。 •  目标牌手将至多三张目标牌从其坟墓场洗入其牌库。

488963.oracleText: In the gardens spread across the Quandrix campus, fern turns to forest before class is even over.
488963.translation: 在遍布整个量析校区的花园里面，蕨类植物不消一节课的时间便能生长成林。

488967.oracleText: "The first step toward transcending physical limitations is discarding assumptions about what is possible."
488967.translation: 「超越实体界限的第一步，便是抛弃所有对于可能性的假设。」

488968.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Quandrix Pledgemage.
488968.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在量析证法师上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

488970.oracleText: "Every life has a story to tell. I won't let them be forgotten."
488970.translation: 「每条生命都有属于自己的故事。我绝不会让它们就此埋没。」

488972.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
488972.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

488974.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard. You may cast it this turn. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
488974.translation: 在你的维持开始时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。本回合中，你可以施放它。若以此法施放的咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

488976.oracleText: Return up to one target artifact card, up to one target enchantment card, up to one target instant card, up to one target sorcery card, and up to one target planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
488976.translation: 将至多一张目标神器牌，至多一张目标结界牌，至多一张目标瞬间牌，至多一张目标法术牌和至多一张目标鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

488979.oracleText: When it comes to transporting priceless, delicate artifacts, safety is more important than speed.
488979.translation: 当要运送易碎的无价宝时，安全性远比速度更重要。

488981.oracleText: Lorehold spirit statues are not forbidden from raising statues of their own.
488981.translation: 从未有人禁止衡鉴魂灵雕塑为自己立像。

488985.oracleText: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.
488985.translation: 摘离历史。摘离记忆。摘离现实。

488986.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
488986.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

488987.oracleText: Rip Apart deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
488987.translation: 拆离对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

488988.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. • Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
488988.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器或结界。

488989.oracleText: Choose one — • Rip Apart deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. • Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
488989.translation: 选择一项～ •  拆离对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器或结界。

488991.oracleText: With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step toward vengeance.
488991.translation: 只消致命一击，埃陀斯就将欧理可众的掌控权收入囊中，展开复仇的第一步。

488992.oracleText: Exile target creature. Exile up to one target instant or sorcery card from a graveyard.
488992.translation: 放逐目标生物。将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从坟墓场放逐。

488994.translation: 「艺术从无止境。只是会被抛弃。」

488995.oracleText: {o2}, Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
488995.translation: {o2}，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

488996.oracleText: {o2}, Return Rootha, Mercurial Artist to its owner's hand: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
488996.translation: {o2}，将善变艺家如莎移回其拥有者手上：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

488998.oracleText: Witherbloom students learn to see death not as tragedy, but as opportunity.
488998.translation: 靡华学生早已学会把死亡当作机遇，而非悲剧。

488999.oracleText: Choose target creature. When that creature dies this turn, search your library for a creature card with lesser mana value, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
488999.translation: 选择目标生物。本回合中，当该生物死去时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值小于前述生物的生物牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

489001.oracleText: "Would you prefer I destroy you using prose or verse?"
489001.translation: 「你希望我用什么来毁掉你，散文还是诗歌？」

489002.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control with flying dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
489002.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

489004.oracleText: Target player creates a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
489004.translation: 目标牌手派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。

489005.oracleText: Target player creates a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
489005.translation: 目标牌手派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。

489006.oracleText: Target player draws a card and loses 1 life.
489006.translation: 目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

489007.oracleText: Target player draws a card and loses 1 life.
489007.translation: 目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

489008.oracleText: Target player puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature they control.
489008.translation: 目标牌手在每个由其操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

489009.oracleText: Target player puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature they control.
489009.translation: 目标牌手在每个由其操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

489010.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may choose two. Each mode must target a different player. • Target player creates a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying. • Target player draws a card and loses 1 life. • Target player puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature they control.
489010.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以选择两项。每项均须以不同的牌手为目标。 •  目标牌手派出一个2/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的墨灵衍生生物。 •  目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。 •  目标牌手在每个由其操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

489012.oracleText: She had spoken the words a hundred times, but under the spotlight, in front of everyone, something new emerged. And the crowd went wild.
489012.translation: 虽然同样的内容她早已排演过数百遍，但这次在聚光灯下，在人群面前，她讲出了新意。观众情绪瞬间引爆。

489013.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
489013.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

489015.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
489015.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

489016.oracleText: Choose two — • Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains flying until end of turn. • Return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. • Target player draws a card and loses 1 life. • Target opponent sacrifices a creature.
489016.translation: 选择两项～ •  直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得飞行异能。 •  将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。 •  目标牌手抓一张牌且失去1点生命。 •  目标对手牺牲一个生物。

489018.oracleText: "I avoid violence. It is the last resort of the witless. But if you insist, I'll make an exception for you."
489018.translation: 「我一心避免暴力。那是蠢人的绝望之举。但如果你坚持，我会为你破例。」

489019.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME gains your choice of flying or lifelink until end of turn.
489019.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，选择飞行或系命，CARDNAME获得该异能直到回合结束。

489020.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, Silverquill Pledgemage gains your choice of flying or lifelink until end of turn.
489020.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，选择飞行或系命，银毫证法师获得该异能直到回合结束。

489022.oracleText: "I am very much in the mood to start handing out expulsions."
489022.translation: 「我正巧有兴致来给你们签发开除令。」

489024.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell with the chosen name, they lose 3 life and you draw a card.
489024.translation: 每当任一对手施放具该名称的咒语时，他失去3点生命，且你抓一张牌。

489026.oracleText: "It would be a crime to withhold my light from the world."
489026.translation: 「遮蔽我的光芒不让世界看到，这简直就是犯罪。」

489027.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast with mana value 5 or greater cost {o1} less to cast.
489027.translation: 你施放之法术力值等于或大于5的瞬间或法术咒语减少{o1}来施放。

489029.oracleText:
"Books are fantastic, but if you're really curious about the distant past, why not ask someone who was there?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
489029.translation:
「虽然书中记述非常精彩，但如果你真对这段遥远过往感兴趣的话，为什么不直接去问当事人呢？」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

489031.oracleText: "Don't you know first-years pay a toll to walk through here?"
489031.translation: 「你不知道一年级新生走这条路要付钱吗？」

489033.oracleText: When Spiteful Squad dies, put its counters on target creature you control.
489033.translation: 当怨毒小队死去时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

489035.oracleText: Sometimes the most radical thing you can do is think inside the box.
489035.translation: 有时候规圆矩方，便是你能作到的最出格事情。

489036.oracleText: Target creature has base power and toughness 4/4 until end of turn.
489036.translation: 目标生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4直到回合结束。

489038.oracleText: Quintorius beamed, his mind eager to absorb every historical fact the spirit wanted to divulge.
489038.translation: 昆托力脸上露出笑容，内心早急切想要吸收魂灵透露的一切史实。

489039.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, scry 1.
489039.translation: 每当一张或数张牌离开你的坟墓场时，占卜1。

489043.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may have the base power and toughness of other creatures you control become equal to CARDNAME's power and toughness until end of turn.
489043.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以使由你操控之其他生物的基础力量与防御力成为等同于CARDNAME之力量和防御力直到回合结束。

489044.oracleText: Whenever Tanazir Quandrix attacks, you may have the base power and toughness of other creatures you control become equal to Tanazir Quandrix's power and toughness until end of turn.
489044.translation: 每当塔那吉量析攻击时，你可以使由你操控之其他生物的基础力量与防御力成为等同于塔那吉量析之力量和防御力直到回合结束。

489046.oracleText:
"Learning to imitate a master is the first step in becoming one."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean
489046.translation:
「学着模仿大师，是成为大师的第一步。」
～粹丽院长乌薇妲

489048.oracleText: "I've got a special treat for you today."

489049.oracleText: Create X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life," where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
489049.translation: 派出X个1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命」，X为所牺牲生物的力量。

489051.oracleText:
"This must be the lost city of Zantafar, where my people lived before becoming nomads. Think of the history we'll learn here!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student
489051.translation:
「这里就是失落之城赞塔法。在成为游牧民之前，我的族人便是住在这边。想想我们能在这里学到多少历史！」
～衡鉴修习法师昆托力

489052.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Then you may discard two cards. If you do, draw three cards.
489052.translation: 你获得2点生命。然后你可以弃两张牌。如果你如此作，则抓三张牌。

489054.oracleText: "Whoever summoned that thing had better confess right this moment, or the whole class will be cleaning the ink receptacles for a month!"
489054.translation: 「召唤那东西的人最好现在就站出来认错，否则全班都得陪着你去洗一个月墨胆！」

489057.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value less than or equal to CARDNAME's power from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
489057.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以从其中施放一个法术力值等于或小于CARDNAME之力量的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

489058.oracleText: Whenever Velomachus Lorehold attacks, look at the top seven cards of your library. You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value less than or equal to Velomachus Lorehold's power from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
489058.translation: 每当维洛马楚衡鉴攻击时，检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以从其中施放一个法术力值等于或小于维洛马楚衡鉴之力量的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

489060.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of damage CARDNAME dealt to that player.
489060.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为CARDNAME对该牌手造成的伤害数量。

489061.oracleText: Whenever Venerable Warsinger deals combat damage to a player, you may return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of damage Venerable Warsinger dealt to that player.
489061.translation: 每当可敬颂战僧对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为可敬颂战僧对该牌手造成的伤害数量。

489063.oracleText: "All we are—every feeling, every action—powered by a single, delicate little organ. Life is so terrifyingly, beautifully fragile."
489063.translation: 「我们的一切～包括感情、动作～都源自这么一个小小的器官。生命这东西虽纤弱得可怕，但也纤弱得美丽。」

489064.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
489064.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

489066.oracleText: Target player mills three cards, then you return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
489066.translation: 目标牌手磨三张牌，然后你将一张地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

489067.oracleText: Destroy target noncreature, nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less.
489067.translation: 消灭目标非生物且非地的永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于2。

489068.oracleText: Choose two — • Target player mills three cards, then you return a land card from your graveyard to your hand. • Destroy target noncreature, nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less. • Target creature gets -3/-1 until end of turn. • Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
489068.translation: 选择两项～ •  目标牌手磨三张牌，然后你将一张地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 •  消灭目标非生物且非地的永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于2。 •  目标生物得-3/-1直到回合结束。 •  目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

489071.oracleText: "'Death is really just a transfer of energy. Those pests I harvested have the honor of becoming pure magic. What could be more beautiful?"
489071.translation: 「死亡不过是能量转移。我捉到的这些害虫有幸能够转变成纯粹魔法。还有比这更美丽的东西吗？」

489072.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, you gain 1 life.
489072.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，你获得1点生命。

489074.oracleText: "What are they complaining about? It's not like axiomatic leyline paratrigonometrics is hard."
489074.translation: 「他们在抱怨什么？公理系地脉对三角学又不难。」

489075.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
489075.translation: {o1}，{oT}：你可以将一张地牌从你手上横置放进战场。

489076.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Draw a card. If you control eight or more lands, draw two cards instead.
489076.translation: {o4}，{oT}：抓一张牌。如果你操控八个或更多地，则改为抓两张牌。

489078.oracleText:
"I appreciate the help, and honestly, it's very entertaining."
—Isabough of the Biblioplex
489078.translation:
「非常感谢你的帮忙，老实说，看着很有趣。」
～茂典阁的伊瑟伯

489082.oracleText: "There's nowhere in Strixhaven I can't find. Where do you need to go?"
489082.translation: 「斯翠海文没有我不知道的地方。你们要去哪？」

489086.translation: 你不能施放永久物咒语。

489089.oracleText:
"It's the largest library in the Multiverse. Of course it has the largest librarians."
—Kasmina
489089.translation:
「这里是多重宇宙中最大的图书馆。自然也有最大的图书馆员。」
～克蜜娜

489090.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
489090.translation: {o2}，{oT}：将目标牌从坟墓场置于其拥有者的牌库底。

489092.oracleText:
"Don't be fooled by the quiet. These old stones are trying to talk to you."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
489092.translation:
「别给这安静氛围给骗了。这旧石头想要跟你说话呢。」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

489095.oracleText: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven. Will saw a chance for arcane study. Rowan saw a chance for power.
489095.translation: 信封自动打开，邀请冰火双子就读斯翠海文。威尔将其视为研习秘法的良机。萝婉将其视作增强力量的际遇。

489096.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Letter of Acceptance: Draw a card.

489098.oracleText: "We don't cut through Sedgemoor anymore. Can't get five steps without a groff trying to fight its own reflection."
489098.translation: 「我们不会再抄蓑草原的近道了。走不出五步就会有泽犬跑来想与自己的镜像打架。」

489099.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets only CARDNAME, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
489099.translation: 每当你施放仅以CARDNAME为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

489100.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets only Reflective Golem, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
489100.translation: 每当你施放仅以反射魔像为目标的瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

489102.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a book counter on CARDNAME.
489102.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个书籍指示物。

489103.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, put a book counter on Spell Satchel.
489103.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，在咒法背包上放置一个书籍指示物。

489104.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a book counter from CARDNAME: Add {oC}.
489104.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个书籍指示物：加{oC}。

489105.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a book counter from Spell Satchel: Add {oC}.
489105.translation: {oT}，从咒法背包上移去一个书籍指示物：加{oC}。

489106.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Remove three book counters from CARDNAME: Draw a card.
489106.translation: {o3}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去三个书籍指示物：抓一张牌。

489107.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Remove three book counters from Spell Satchel: Draw a card.
489107.translation: {o3}，{oT}，从咒法背包上移去三个书籍指示物：抓一张牌。

489109.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Put a point counter on CARDNAME.
489109.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。在CARDNAME上放置一个得分指示物。

489110.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Put a point counter on Strixhaven Stadium.
489110.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。在斯翠海文赛场上放置一个得分指示物。

489111.oracleText: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, remove a point counter from CARDNAME.
489111.translation: 每当一个生物对你造成战斗伤害时，从CARDNAME上移去一个得分指示物。

489112.oracleText: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, remove a point counter from Strixhaven Stadium.
489112.translation: 每当一个生物对你造成战斗伤害时，从斯翠海文赛场上移去一个得分指示物。

489113.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a point counter on CARDNAME. Then if it has ten or more point counters on it, remove them all and that player loses the game.
489113.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个得分指示物。然后如果其上有十个或更多得分指示物，则移去所有此类指示物且该牌手输掉这盘游戏。

489114.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a point counter on Strixhaven Stadium. Then if it has ten or more point counters on it, remove them all and that player loses the game.
489114.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，在斯翠海文赛场上放置一个得分指示物。然后如果其上有十个或更多得分指示物，则移去所有此类指示物且该牌手输掉这盘游戏。

489116.oracleText: Choosing a college based on Mage Tower results is discouraged, but not unheard of.
489116.translation: 虽然不鼓励学生根据斗法塔成绩来选择学院，但这事并不罕见。

489117.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance and trample.
489117.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒与践踏异能。

489120.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.
489120.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

489122.oracleText: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.
489122.translation: 欧理可众密探潜伏在阿凯维沃的黑暗角落，难见踪影却无处不在。

489123.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target creature with power 3 or less can't be blocked this turn.
489123.translation: {o3}，{oT}：目标力量等于或小于3的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

489128.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's an instant or sorcery card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard. Activate only if you have exactly zero or seven cards in hand.
489128.translation: {o2}，{oT}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是瞬间或法术牌，则你可以展示该牌并置于你手上。如果你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。只能于你有正好零张或七张手牌时起动。

489130.oracleText: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.
489130.translation: 寒冰火焰形成的闷燃风暴。

489134.oracleText: A seething locus of reverent rage.
489134.translation: 虔静怒火形成的沸涌中心。

489139.oracleText: {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
489139.translation: {oT}：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你施放过瞬间或法术咒语的回合。

489141.oracleText: Mage-students obsessed with the secrets of the past choose Lorehold, the college of archaeomancy.
489141.translation: 着迷过往的修习法师，会选读究古学院衡鉴，深研历史之谜。

489145.oracleText: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.
489145.translation: 盎然凋败形成的饥饿巢穴。

489149.oracleText: Mage-students who see spellcraft as the highest form of expression choose Prismari, the college of elemental arts.
489149.translation: 热爱咒艺的修习法师，会选读元素学院粹丽，再创展现之威。

489152.oracleText: Mage-students who see the beauty in patterns and equations choose Quandrix, the college of numeromancy.
489152.translation: 醉心算式的修习法师，会选读数法学院量析，探寻规律之美。

489155.oracleText: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.
489155.translation: 正气堕落形成的闪烁信标。

489159.oracleText: Mage-students drawn to the power of language choose Silverquill, the college of eloquence.
489159.translation: 沉溺言辞的修习法师，会选读宏辩学院银毫，掌握文笔之力。

489162.oracleText: A verdant paradox of primal logic.
489162.translation: 原始逻辑形成的新绿矛盾。

489166.oracleText: Mage-students fascinated by the energies of life and death choose Witherbloom, the college of essence studies.
489166.translation: 痴狂生死的修习法师，会选读知命学院靡华，深耕菁华之能。

489168.oracleText:
"This must not become common knowledge. The consequences of such a spell are too great. Lock it away in the restricted archive, and destroy its record in the catalog."
—Director Taiva, to Isabough
489168.translation:
「这绝不能成为公共知识。此类咒语后果难以收拾。务必将其锁入受限文库，并销毁目录中的记载。」
～泰瓦馆长叮嘱伊瑟伯

489169.oracleText:
"For twelve days and twelve nights, Somat assailed the monster's shell. On the thirteenth morning, it cracked with the dawn."
—Heroics: A Book of Fables
489169.translation:
「索马特不断敲击怪物甲壳，十二昼十二夜间从未中断。到了第十三天清晨，甲壳终于裂出曙光。」
～《勇行故事：寓言合辑》

489170.oracleText:
"Evil is to be unshackled, not slain. Unlock your foe and release the miracle within."
—Keevan, docent of Kollema Hall
489170.translation:
「邪恶需要释放，而非消灭。解开封印敌人的枷锁，展现其中的惊人奇迹。」
～科玛学堂讲师基万

489171.oracleText:
"We asked for a home and received the world."
—Scroll of Nine Blessings
489171.translation:
「我们祈求一处家园，却得到了整个世界。」
～《九福卷轴》

489172.oracleText:
"The tyrant's bellow of rage trailed off into a whimper as the last of his fortune escaped his grasp."
—The Dethroner's Grimoire
489172.translation:
「眼见最后一丝财富逐渐抽离手中，暴君的愤怒狂啸也慢慢变成低声啜泣。」
～《逆臣秘录》

489173.oracleText:
"Knight Kathryn closed her eyes, bracing herself for the end. When she opened them again, she stood triumphant over her foe."
—Thadus the Healer, Memoirs
489173.translation:
「骑士凯萨琳闭紧双眼，准备好迎接生命最终时刻。但当她再次睁开时，却发现是她对手倒在脚下。」
～治疗师萨都丝，《回忆录》

489174.oracleText:
"The blademaster turned his fury to his new foes: root rot and cabbage slugs."
—Myths and Miracles, Vol. VII
489174.translation:
「大剑师转而将怒火发泄在新的敌人身上：腐根和菜虫。」
～《神话与奇迹》，卷七

489176.oracleText: Until your next turn, your life total can't change and you gain protection from everything. All permanents you control phase out.
489176.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，你的总生命不会改变，且你获得反一切保护异能。所有由你操控的永久物跃离。

489178.oracleText:
"Five suns! Can you even imagine how complicated the orbital calculations must be? What I wouldn't give to tackle an equation like that!"
—Zimone, Quandrix mage-student
489178.translation:
「五个太阳！你能想象这样轨道计算会有多复杂吗？真希望我能去处理这样的算式！」
～量析修习法师琦梦

489179.oracleText:
Infinite ideas flow through the Multiverse, waiting for an open mind."
—The Biblioplex: An Introduction
489179.translation:
「无数思绪在多重宇宙中流动，只待开明思想前去发现。」
～《茂典阁志：前言》

489180.oracleText:
"Every Planeswalker remembers the first time their mind touched the staggering vastness of the Multiverse."
—Kasmina
489180.translation:
「当思绪首度触碰广袤多重宇宙时感到的震撼，相信每位鹏洛客都不会忘记。」
～克蜜娜

489181.oracleText:
"One need not know the specific details of a spell to suppress its effect. Simply rearrange the rules of the reality within which the spell operates."
—Imbraham, Quandrix dean
489181.translation:
「至于压制咒语效果的具体细节也不用去了解。只需重新整理咒语作用实界内的规则就可实现。」
～量析院长英巴罕

489182.oracleText:
"Where do our forgotten thoughts go? I knew once, but I can't remember."
—Director Taiva, journal entry
489182.translation:
「那些遗忘的思绪都去到了哪里？我曾探见其踪迹，但也无从记起。」
～泰瓦馆长，日志一笔

489183.oracleText:
"Shatter your opponent's spell with enough force, and you'll shatter their confidence with it."
—Tome of Obstructions, marginalia
489183.translation:
「用足够的力量粉碎对手的咒语，还能一并粉碎对手的信心。」
～《障法巨著》，旁批

489184.oracleText:
"The wish most often granted is the wish to choose one's own destiny."
—Aethershrine, inscription
489184.translation:
「最常被保佑的愿望，都是希冀能选择自身命运者。」
～《乙太祭祠》，铭文

489185.oracleText:
"I can offer only information, young one. What path you choose is up to you."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios
489185.translation:
「年轻人，我只能提供信息。至于要走哪条路得你自己选。」
～阿凯维沃圣法谕贾琦

489186.oracleText:
"If they try to storm your palace, you must become the storm."
—Handbook of Imperial Spellcraft
489186.translation:
「如果他们想要如风暴般强袭你的宫殿，那你就必须化身风暴。」
～《皇家咒艺手册》

489187.oracleText:
"Guilt is not absolution. Regret is not justice. But it is right that you suffer."
—Extus Narr
489187.translation:
「内疚不是解脱。后悔也非正义。但你理应受苦。」
～埃陀斯纳尔

489188.oracleText:
"One brother fought for the sake of the Multiverse. The other for himself."
—The Elderspell Parable
489188.translation:
「兄弟争斗：一位心系多重宇宙，另一位只为自身称雄。」
～《至尊咒寓言》

489189.oracleText:
"They distrust my methods, but when they want results, whom do you think they seek?"
—Incantations of Lim-Dul
489189.translation:
「他们不相信我的方法，但当他们想要结果时，你猜又会去找谁？」
～《林杜咒文集》

489190.oracleText:
"Demons prefer to deal with those who believe themselves too wise to be fooled."
—Scroll case inscription
489190.translation:
「自以为绝顶聪明不会受骗者，正是恶魔青睐的交易对手。」
～卷轴盒铭文

489191.oracleText:
"An angel can shine like the sun, inspire the weak, and even threaten victory over darkness. But in the end it matters not, for it still dies like any other pest."
—Ob Nixilis
489191.translation:
「天使能如阳光耀世，能鼓舞弱者，甚至可能战胜黑暗。但最终这一切都不重要，因为他们也会像害虫般死去。」
～欧尼希兹

489192.oracleText:
"Magic brought peace to the Vastlands but was soon corrupted."
—The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells
489192.translation:
「魔法曾给过旷土和平，但很快就被腐化。」
～《神秘时代：咒法传》

489193.oracleText:
"It takes so little energy to erase a person. It's almost like the universe doesn't care that they existed at all."
—Extus Narr
489193.translation:
「彻底抹除一个人根本不费什么工夫。看似宇宙根本不在乎他们是否存在。」
～埃陀斯纳尔

489194.oracleText:
"To dwell within the Blind Eternities is unthinkable. To encounter those who do could shatter the mind."
—Chronicle of the Titans
489194.translation:
「深居黑暗虚空，此事根本无法想象：面会其间生灵，思绪便遭粉碎。」
～《巨物编年史》

489195.oracleText:
"It's always my brightest students who make the worst decisions."
—Shaile, Silverquill dean
489195.translation:
「作出最糟糕决定的，总是我那帮最聪明的学生。」
～银毫院长莎依儿

489196.oracleText:
"My colleagues revile the barbarity of the Blood Age, but I believe we have much to learn from the magics of endless war."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean
489196.translation:
「虽然同僚都厌恶去研究血腥时代的野蛮暴行，但我相信那段无尽战乱时期的魔法有很多值得我们学习。」
～银毫院长安博斯

489197.oracleText:
"Be careful when handling old magical trinkets. You never know who they've been."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean
489197.translation:
「处理古老魔法物品时请务必当心。你不会知道它们曾经是什么。」
～衡鉴院长欧歌塔

489198.oracleText:
"Will! They have a copy of Tales of the Fae here! Want me to read you a bedtime story?"
—Rowan Kenrith
489198.translation:
「威尔！他们这有本《仙儿传说》！要我给你读段睡前故事吗？」
～萝婉肯理斯

489199.oracleText:
"How did you get your hands on that? Wait, never mind. I don't want to know."
—Plargg, Lorehold dean
489199.translation:
「你是怎么拿到那东西的？算了，没事。我也不想知道。」
～衡鉴院长帕葛

489200.oracleText:
"Some mages duel using intricate spellcraft and superior tactics. Others just get really, really mad."
—Secrets of the Feradorn Sorcerers
489200.translation:
「有些法师是靠繁复咒语或超凡战术来赢得决斗。还有些就只是靠变得非常、非常狂暴。」
～《法拉东术士秘辛》

489201.oracleText:
"The first mages witnessed the fury of the raging storm and wished to answer back."
—The Stormwright Texts
489201.translation:
「原初法师曾亲眼见证翻腾风暴的怒火，并希冀能够对等回应。」
～《造风师手记》

489203.oracleText: Exile target card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile CARDNAME.
489203.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐CARDNAME。

489204.oracleText: Exile target card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile Mizzix's Mastery.
489204.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐米捷兹的精研。

489206.oracleText:
"To this day, I have no idea if the heavens were obeying him or attacking him."
—Ral Zarek, research notes
489206.translation:
「时至今日，我都还没弄清楚上天是在顺他的心，还是逆他的意。」
～拉尔查雷克，研究纪录

489207.oracleText:
"If the prospect of what could be doesn't electrify you to your core, why attend Strixhaven at all?"
—Nassari, Prismari dean
489207.translation:
「如果未来前景都无法从心底打动你，那又何必要来斯翠海文？」
～粹丽院长纳撒理

489208.oracleText:
"Her quest began as all quests do, with one small step in an unexpected direction."
—The Explorer's Testament
489208.translation:
「她的探索起初与其他人作法无异，都是朝着未曾想到的方向迈出了一小步。」
～《探索箴言》

489209.oracleText:
"As long as you are breathing, you always have something more to give."
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean
489209.translation:
「只要你还有气在，就总能贡献更多。」
～靡华院长瓦伦丁

489210.oracleText:
"You'd be amazed how much a single plant has to teach you."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean
489210.translation:
「你要是知道一株植物能教导你多少东西，必定会大吃一惊。」
～靡华院长莉塞特

489211.oracleText:
"The bloody din of invasion faded
And silent song rang through the woods again."
—"Song of Freyalise"
489211.translation:
「血腥侵略喧嚣退去，
静寂歌声传扬林间。」
～「妃雅丽兹颂歌」

489212.oracleText:
"On a world where time was torn asunder, destruction ruled the minds of all."
—Multiversal Metahistories
489212.translation:
「在时间支离破碎的世界上，破坏才是所有人的共识。」
～《多重宇宙元史学》

489213.oracleText:
"Nature is neither cruel nor kind. It operates on necessity, not sentiment."
—-Dina, Witherbloom mage-student
489213.translation:
「自然既不残忍也不仁慈。它行事遵循需求，而非情感。」
～靡华修习法师迪娜

489214.oracleText:
"Centuries of war had broken Arcavios, but a single seed began the long process of renewal."
—The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells
489214.translation:
「数百年连绵战事令阿凯维沃饱受创伤，但随着一颗种子落地，漫长复兴过程就此展开。」
～《神秘时代：咒法传》

489215.oracleText:
"Never reject the kindness of a serpent. It will not be offered twice."
—Druidic manuscript fragment
489215.translation:
「不要拒绝巨蛇心意。它不会来第二次。」
～德鲁伊手稿残篇

489216.oracleText:
"Neither blade nor tempest can assail the serenity of a tranquil mind."
—The Turrau Carvings
489216.translation:
「刀剑狂风都无法扰动平静心灵。」
～《图拉乌石刻》

489217.oracleText:
"A tale of a tyrant being humiliated and losing all his power? I'm inspired already!"
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student
489217.translation:
「暴君惨遭羞辱，力量尽失的故事？我有灵感了！」
～银毫修习法师齐力安

489218.oracleText:
"The hydraulic power grip was a failure, but the gauntlets were a shocking success."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus
489218.translation:
「虽然液压强力握把并不出色，但护手仍算巨大成功。」
～伊捷首法师的日记

489219.oracleText:
"I've gleaned greater insight from the spiraling of a single fern than I have from all the books I've ever read."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean
489219.translation:
「我从这株小小蕨类螺旋屈伸中得到的启悟，比我读过的所有书都要深刻。」
～量析院长齐安妮

489220.oracleText:
"Mages in the Blood Age would call down actual thunderstorms on their enemies. I bet we can replicate their technique."
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student
489220.translation:
「血腥时代的法师能够召唤真正的雷暴来攻击敌人。我相信我们也能做到。」
～衡鉴修习法师卓迪尔

489221.oracleText:
"From monarch to mulch as quick as could be."
—The Dethroner's Grimoire
489221.translation:
「最快速度化君王为粪土。」
～《逆臣秘录》

489228.oracleText: Target a planeswalker an opponent controls.
489228.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的鹏洛客为目标。

489229.oracleText: Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller loses 1 life.
489229.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物进行阻挡时，其操控者失去1点生命。

489230.oracleText: Have it gain reach until end of turn?
489230.translation: 是否要使它获得延势异能直到回合结束？

489232.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
489232.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌？

489235.oracleText: When the permanent you don't control dies this turn, you gain 2 life.
489235.translation: 本回合中，当该不由你操控的永久物死去时，你获得2点生命。

489237.oracleText: Put any number of land cards onto the battlefield?
489237.translation: 是否要将任意数量的地牌放进战场？

489238.oracleText: Exile it at the beginning of your next upkeep.
489238.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

489240.oracleText: Target up to two creature, land, and/or planeswalker cards.
489240.translation: 指定至多两张生物，地和／或鹏洛客牌为目标。

489241.oracleText: Tap any number of creatures you control.
489241.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控的生物。

489242.translation: 指定至多五个永久物为目标。

489243.translation: 选择一个生物或鹏洛客。

489244.oracleText: Target a creature spell you control.
489244.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物咒语为目标。

489245.oracleText: Put one of them into your library.
489245.translation: 将其中一张置入你的牌库。

489246.oracleText: Target an artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker.
489246.translation: 指定一个神器、结界或鹏洛客为目标。

489247.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
489247.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

489248.oracleText: Discard an instant or sorcery card?
489248.translation: 是否要弃一张瞬间或法术牌？

489249.oracleText: Target a Spirit, instant, or sorcery card.
489249.translation: 指定一张精怪、瞬间或法术牌为目标。

489251.translation: 指定一个单色永久物为目标。

489252.oracleText: Return a land card to your hand.
489252.translation: 将一张地牌移回你手上。

489253.oracleText: Reveal an Island or Mountain card?
489253.translation: 是否要展示一张海岛或山脉牌？

489254.oracleText: Reveal a Mountain or Plains card?
489254.translation: 是否要展示一张山脉或平原牌？

489255.oracleText: Reveal a Swamp or Forest card?
489255.translation: 是否要展示一张沼泽或树林牌？

489256.oracleText: Reveal a Plains or Swamp card?
489256.translation: 是否要展示一张平原或沼泽牌？

489257.oracleText: Reveal a Forest or Island card?
489257.translation: 是否要展示一张树林或海岛牌？

489258.oracleText: Search for up to three Plains cards.
489258.translation: 搜寻至多三张基本平原牌。

489259.oracleText: Target a card that is an instant or sorcery.
489259.translation: 指定一张瞬间或法术牌为目标。

489260.oracleText:
"Nassari's work is extravagant, but unfocused. They must refine their technique."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean
489260.translation:
「纳撒理的作品是奢华缺无侧重。他们必须完善技术。」
～粹丽院长乌薇妲「暂译」

489264.oracleText: Exile a creature card they revealed this way.
489264.translation: 放逐一张以此法他展示的一张生物牌。

489356.oracleText: Choose a creature an opponent controls chosen at random.
489356.translation: 随机选择一个由对手操控的生物。

489405.oracleText: Spend only on: Creature or Enchantment Spells
489405.translation: 只能用于支付：生物或结界咒语

489454.oracleText: Target up to one artifact card.
489454.translation: 指定至多一张神器牌为目标。

489455.oracleText: Target up to one enchantment card.
489455.translation: 指定至多一张结界牌为目标。

489598.oracleText: Spend only on: Foretelling Cards or Spells That Have Foretell
489598.translation: 只能用于支付：预示牌，具有预示异能的咒语

489654.oracleText: Cast a legendary spell from your hand, from your graveyard, or from among cards you own in exile without paying its mana cost?
489654.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从手上、你的坟墓场或放逐区里施放由你拥有的牌一个传奇咒语？

489657.oracleText: Choose any number of artifact tokens and/or creature tokens you control with different names.
489657.translation: 选择任意数量由你操控且名称各不相同的衍生神器和／或衍生生物。

490431.oracleText: Spend only on: Foretelling a Card From Your Hand or an Instant or Sorcery Spell
490431.translation: 只能用于支付：预示牌，瞬间或法术咒语

491682.oracleText: Have Shapeshifters you control become copies of that creature until end of turn?
491682.translation: 是否要使由你操控的变形兽都成为该生物的复制品直到回合结束？

491684.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent to put in its owner's library.
491684.translation: 指定一个非地永久物为目标，将其置入其拥有者的牌库。

491685.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent to return to its owner's hand.
491685.translation: 指定一个非地永久物为目标，将其移回其拥有者的手上。

491686.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Remove {2, Number} counter.} other {Remove {2, Number} counters.}}
491686.translation: {2, plural, =1 {移去{2, Number}个指示物。} other {移去{2, Number}个指示物。}}

491690.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, target creature you control has base power 2 until end of turn.
491690.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，目标由你操控的生物之基础力量为2直到回合结束。

491691.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
491691.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

491692.oracleText: Whenever Efreet Flamepainter deals combat damage to a player, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
491692.translation: 每当绘焰魔神对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

491693.oracleText: {oT}: You may exile an instant or sorcery card from your hand and put three hone counters on it. It gains "At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled, remove a hone counter from it" and "When the last hone counter is removed from this card, if it's exiled, you may cast it. It costs {o4} less to cast this way."
491693.translation: {oT}：你可以从你手上放逐一张瞬间或法术牌并在其上放置三个磨练指示物。它获得「在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐，则从其上移去一个磨练指示物」与「当从此牌上移去最后一个磨练指示物时，若它已放逐，则你可以施放它。它以此法施放时减少{o4}来施放。」

491694.oracleText: Exile an instant or sorcery card?
491694.translation: 是否要放逐一张瞬间或法术牌？

491699.oracleText: Put a voyage counter on it?
491699.translation: 是否要在其上放置一个远行指示物？

491707.translation: 指定一张雪境永久物牌为目标。

491920.oracleText: Distribute counters among any number of creatures you control.
491920.translation: 将指示物分配给任意数量由你操控的生物。

492330.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with deathtouch deals combat damage to a player, that player gets two poison counters.
492330.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具死触异能的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手得到两个中毒指示物。

492417.oracleText: Exile a card from your graveyard: Add {oC}. Spend this mana only to cast a spell that's one or more colors without {oX} in its mana cost.
492417.translation: 从你的坟墓场放逐一张牌：加{oC}。此法术力只能用来施放法术力费用中不包含{oX}的有色咒语。

492598.oracleText: Search for exactly two cards not named {1, CardId} that have different names.
492598.translation: 搜寻正好两张不同名称且其名称都不能是{1, CardId}的牌。

492599.oracleText: Search your library for exactly two cards not named {1, CardId} that have different names?
492599.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻正好两张不同名称且其名称都不能是{1, CardId}的牌？

492621.oracleText: Spend only on: A Spell That Is One or More Colors Without {oX} In Its Mana Cost
492621.translation: 只能用于支付：法术力费用中不包含{oX}的有色咒语

492630.oracleText: Choose a card to put into your opponent's hand.
492630.translation: 选择一张牌，将其置于对手手上。

492691.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Until end of turn, you may cast a creature spell from among cards exiled with CARDNAME without paying its mana cost.
492691.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：直到回合结束，你可以从以CARDNAME放逐的牌中施放一个生物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

492692.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Until end of turn, you may cast a creature spell from among cards exiled with Idol of Endurance without paying its mana cost.
492692.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：直到回合结束，你可以从以坚白雕像放逐的牌中施放一个生物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

492925.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target.
492925.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同该生物之力量。

492953.oracleText: Select whether to place this card into its owner's graveyard or back on top of their library.
492953.translation: 选择将此牌置入其拥有者的坟墓场还是牌库顶。

494061.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player chooses a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard. You return that card to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. The creature is a Vampire in addition to its other types.
494061.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手选择你坟墓场中的一张非传奇生物牌。你将该牌移回战场，且其上额外有一个+1/+1指示物。该生物额外具有吸血鬼此类别。

494062.oracleText: Whenever Drana, the Last Bloodchief attacks, defending player chooses a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard. You return that card to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. The creature is a Vampire in addition to its other types.
494062.translation: 每当最终血侯哲娜攻击时，防御牌手选择你坟墓场中的一张非传奇生物牌。你将该牌移回战场，且其上额外有一个+1/+1指示物。该生物额外具有吸血鬼此类别。

495888.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Plains card?
495888.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本平原牌？

495911.oracleText: Search for up to four basic land cards.
495911.translation: 搜寻至多四张基本地牌。

495912.oracleText: Put one of them onto the battlefield.

495913.oracleText: Put two of them onto the battlefield.

495929.oracleText: Search for a basic Forest or Island card.
495929.translation: 搜寻一张基本树林或海岛牌。

495930.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Forest or Island card?
495930.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张树林或海岛牌？

495937.oracleText: Each player looks at the top five cards of their library and may reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card from among them. Each player puts the cards they revealed this way into their hand and the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order. Each player gains 3 life.
495937.translation: 每位牌手各进行以下流程～检视其牌库顶的五张牌，展示其中的一张地牌和／或一张瞬间或法术牌，然后将以此法展示的牌置于其手上，其余则以随机顺序置于其牌库底。每位牌手各获得3点生命。

495939.oracleText: Reveal a land card and/or an instant or sorcery card?
495939.translation: 是否要展示一张地牌和／或一张瞬间或法术牌？

495946.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker to return to its owner's hand.
495946.translation: 指定一个生物或鹏洛客为目标，将其移回其拥有者手上。

495947.oracleText: Target up to one enchantment card
495947.translation: 指定至多一张结界牌为目标。

495950.oracleText: Target up to one planeswalker card.
495950.translation: 指定至多一张鹏洛客牌为目标。

495951.oracleText: Search for an instant or sorcery card that shares a color with this planeswalker.
495951.translation: 搜寻一张与此鹏洛客具共通颜色的瞬间或法术牌。

496055.oracleText: Put any number of them into your hand?
496055.translation: 是否要将其中任意数量置于你手上？

496056.oracleText: Target up to one creature or planeswalker an opponent controls that has mana value 3 or less.
496056.translation: 指定至多一个由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物或鹏洛客为目标。

496083.oracleText: Have the base power and toughness of other creatures you control become equal to {1, CardId}'s power and toughness until end of turn?
496083.translation: 是否要使由你操控之其他生物的基础力量与防御力成为等同于{1, CardId}之力量和防御力直到回合结束？

497103.oracleText: Exile each card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile CARDNAME.
497103.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐CARDNAME。

497104.oracleText: Exile each card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile Mizzix's Mastery.
497104.translation: 将目标在你坟墓场中且为瞬间或法术的牌放逐。对每张以此法放逐的牌而言，将其复制，你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐米捷兹的精研。

497172.oracleText: Choose two cards to be shuffled into your opponent's library.
497172.translation: 选择两张牌，将其洗入对手的牌库。

497185.oracleText: When you discard an instant or sorcery card this way, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
497185.translation: 当你以此法弃掉一张瞬间或法术牌时，CARDNAME对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于所弃之牌的法术力值。

497198.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, search your library for a creature card with lesser mana value, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
497198.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值小于前述生物的生物牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

497210.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature: Target player mills cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
497210.translation: 牺牲一个生物：目标牌手将其牌库顶若干牌置入其坟墓场，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。

497211.oracleText: Return it to its owner's hand?
497211.translation: 是否要将它移回其拥有者手上？

497212.oracleText: Have target player mill two cards?
497212.translation: 是否要令目标牌手磨两张牌？

497214.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Return {2, Number} card at random to your hand.} other {Return {2, Number} cards at random to your hand.}}
497214.translation: {2, plural, =1 {随机将{2, Number}张牌移回你手上。} other {随机将{2, Number}张牌移回你手上。}}

497215.oracleText:
"Into the smothering dark, Serra spoke a single word: ‘Hope.'"
—Song of All, canto 2
497215.translation:
「撒拉迈入窒息黯境，双唇微吐二字：『希望』。」
～《万物之歌》，2节

497218.oracleText: "No signs of any suspicious activity. Yet."
497218.translation: 「没有任何可疑活动的迹象。暂时还没。」

497226.oracleText: Exile target creature card from your graveyard. Create X 1/1 white Bird creature tokens with flying, where X is the exiled card's toughness.
497226.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐。派出X个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物，X为所放逐之牌的防御力。

497229.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a token that's a copy of target token you control.
497229.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控之衍生物的复制品。

497230.oracleText: When Specimen Collector dies, create a token that's a copy of target token you control.
497230.translation: 当标本收集人死去时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控之衍生物的复制品。

497231.oracleText: It feeds on metal filings suspended in the water, sieving flecks of precious ore through magnetic baleen.
497231.translation: 它摄食悬浮水中的金属屑，以带磁鲸须筛出碎粒稀有矿石。

497235.oracleText: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.
497235.translation: 它浮游水银海上空，警示任何将成形的违规思想。

497236.oracleText:
"I'm sure they were once someone important, but I couldn't tell you who they were."
—Doros, expedition guide
497236.translation:
「我确定他们生前都大有来头，但我没法一个个讲出名头。」
～探险队向导多罗斯

497237.oracleText: Delirium — This spell has cascade as long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
497237.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，此咒语便具有倾曳异能。

497241.oracleText: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

497243.oracleText:
"Friends, foragers, fuzzy fighters! Tonight we're after more than just acorns!"
—Larrel, Deep Forest hermit
497243.translation:
「各位朋友，各位食客，各位斗士！今晚，我们的目标不仅是橡实！」
～深林隐者拉蕾儿

497244.oracleText: {o5oG}, {oT}: Draw a card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each +1/+1 counter on creatures you control.
497244.translation: {o5oG}，{oT}：抓一张牌。由你操控的生物上每有一个+1/+1指示物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

497245.oracleText: They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.
497245.translation: 它们经常在街灯上休息，其重量把灯柱都压垮了。

497248.oracleText: For rule of the Aldering Forest, Numstail stole the acorn from Nestwind, who stole it from Brankie, who stole it from Lightroot, who stole it from Leafpaw, who stole it from Darkfur . . .
497248.translation: 为了统治赤杨环树林，饭尾从巢风偷来了巢风从班奇、班奇从灵足、灵足从叶爪，以及叶爪从黑毛…等偷来的橡实。

497250.oracleText: The boggart hopped carelessly among the roots . . . until the roots woke up.
497250.translation: 波尬在根须间无忧无虑地跳跃…直到根须醒转过来。

497256.oracleText:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer
497256.translation:
「你已经长大了，想变作什么？」
～析米克生物工程师约洛夫

497262.oracleText:
"Cease all psychic attacks pending intel on enemy countermeasures."
—Dimir communique
497262.translation:
「暂时停止一切心灵攻击，待有敌方反制手段情报后再做打算。」
～底密尔公报

497270.translation:
「死者壮大了损迹」
～爪扰毁损的雕像铭文

497271.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of card types among cards in all graveyards.
497271.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，它得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为所有坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量。

497288.oracleText: The thief doubled back twice, doused herself with perfume, crossed the ocean, and still woke up with her pursuer close on her heels.
497288.translation: 小偷两度折返迂回，香水洒满身，还横渡海洋，但醒来时追踪者依然紧随她身后。

497295.oracleText: "Everyone loves a dash of crushed pixie . . . except the pixie."
497295.translation: 「用一撮碧仙肉酱提味，人人都爱…碧仙除外。」

497300.oracleText: "Order up! Ooze aspic and jellied anurid eyes!"

497301.oracleText: {oB}, Discard a card: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
497301.translation: {oB}，弃一张牌：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将之横置。

497302.oracleText: {oB}, Discard a card: Necromancer's Familiar gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
497302.translation: {oB}，弃一张牌：死灵术士的佣兽获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将之横置。

497308.oracleText: Delirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, Dragon's Rage Channeler gets +2/+2, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.
497308.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，龙怒通念师便得+2/+2，具飞行异能，且每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

497309.oracleText: If an ability of a Shaman or another Wizard you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
497309.translation: 如果由你操控之祭师或其他法术师的某异能触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

497312.oracleText: It thrives on a steady diet of hastily disposed-of evidence.
497312.translation: 它以他人匆忙遗弃的证据为食，并借稳定供给而茁壮成长。

497314.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, you may create a 4/4 green Beast creature token.
497314.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以派出一个4/4绿色野兽衍生生物。

497315.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Herd Baloth, you may create a 4/4 green Beast creature token.
497315.translation: 每当在巴洛西群上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以派出一个4/4绿色野兽衍生生物。

497317.oracleText: The arrival of spring's first flowers is a sacred occasion to Karametra's acolytes, who fill the Setessan woods with song in celebration.
497317.translation: 对卡拉美特拉的侍僧来说，春花初绽乃是神圣时刻；每逢此景便会齐声欢歌，令整个瑟特萨森林充满节庆气氛。

497324.oracleText: Caution: Audience in front row may have throats ripped out.
497324.translation: 提醒：前排观众的喉咙可能会被扯开。

497326.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact or creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Ravenous Squirrel.
497326.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器或生物时，在贪食松鼠上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

497330.oracleText:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer
497330.translation:
「即便是在最黑暗的岁月之中，也绝不能停下手中创作。每件新发明都会给世界带来价值：或精致，或实用，或兼而有之。」
～乙太预言师列施蜜

497331.oracleText: The song of the Worldsoul can take on life in the most unlikely places.
497331.translation: 世界之魂咏颂会在出其不意间展现生命之威。

497337.oracleText: {oW}: Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp gains flying until end of turn.
497337.translation: {oW}：烁光怪蜂札巴兹获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

497340.oracleText: The path to knowledge is forged in hunger.

497341.oracleText: The path to unity is forged in understanding.

497349.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Sacrifice {2, Number} Clue.} other {Sacrifice {2, Number} Clues.}}
497349.translation: {2, plural, =1 {牺牲{2, Number}个线索。} other {牺牲{2, Number}个线索。}}

497350.oracleText: Create a 4/4 green Beast creature token?
497350.translation: 是否要派出一个4/4绿色野兽衍生生物？

497351.oracleText: Each creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
497351.translation: 每个由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

497840.oracleText: Until end of turn, each creature you control becomes a green Wurm with base power and toughness 6/4.
497840.translation: 直到回合结束，每个由你操控的生物成为基础力量与防御力为6/4的绿色亚龙。

498122.oracleText: Each noncreature artifact you control becomes a 0/0 artifact creature. Put four +1/+1 counters on each artifact that became a creature this way.
498122.translation: 每个由你操控的非生物神器成为0/0神器生物。在每个以此法成为生物的神器上各放置四个+1/+1指示物。

498187.oracleText: When the last time counter is removed from this card, if it's exiled, you may play it without paying its mana cost. If you don't, it remains exiled. If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste until you lose control of the spell or the permanent it becomes.
498187.translation: 当从此牌上移去最后一个计时指示物时，若它已放逐，则你可以施放它且不需支付其法术力费用。若你未如此作，它将继续被放逐。若你以此法施放生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到你失去对此咒语或永久物的操控权。

498203.oracleText: This spell can't be countered. (This includes by the ward ability.)
498203.translation: 此咒语不能被反击。（包括不能被守护异能反击。）

498204.oracleText: Copy target creature spell you control, except it isn't legendary if the spell is legendary. (A copy of a creature spell becomes a token.)
498204.translation: 复制目标由你操控的生物咒语，但如果该咒语是传奇，则复制品不是传奇。（生物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

498206.oracleText: {o0}: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard this turn. If that spell doesn't target a creature you control, it costs {o8} more to cast this way. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only once each turn. (You still pay the spell's costs. Timing rules for the spell still apply.)
498206.translation: {o0}：本回合中，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌。如果该咒语未以由你操控的生物为目标，则以此法施放时增加{o8}来施放。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。每回合只能起动一次。（你依旧要支付该咒语的费用，且仍须遵守咒语的时机规则。）

498209.oracleText: The weight of this magic weapon falls heavy on the wicked.
498209.translation: 这件魔法武器对恶人砸地特别重。

498211.oracleText: The noble steeds of the elven gods can sometimes be persuaded to allow mere mortals on their backs.
498211.translation: 有时你甚至能说服精灵诸神的尊贵坐骑，让它们允许一介凡人骑上背端。

498214.oracleText: Blink dogs protect the wild places of the world, driving away evil influences.
498214.translation: 闪现犬保护这个世界的荒野地带，驱离邪恶影响。

498219.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.
498219.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得了3点或更多生命，则派出一个3/3白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

498220.oracleText: {oWoWoW}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Put an enlightened counter on target Angel. It gains "You can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game." Activate only as a sorcery.
498220.translation: {oWoWoW}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：在目标天使上放置一个启化指示物。它获得「你这盘游戏不会输，对手也不会赢。」只能于法术时机起动。

498221.oracleText: {oWoWoW}, {oT}, Exile The Book of Exalted Deeds: Put an enlightened counter on target Angel. It gains "You can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game." Activate only as a sorcery.
498221.translation: {oWoWoW}，{oT}，放逐圣洁之书：在目标天使上放置一个启化指示物。它获得「你这盘游戏不会输，对手也不会赢。」只能于法术时机起动。

498223.oracleText: When all hope fails, its light remains.
498223.translation: 纵使希望全部消逝，独角兽光芒仍存。

498224.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Celestial Unicorn.
498224.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在天界独角兽上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498229.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
498229.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498236.oracleText: As long as you've completed a dungeon, CARDNAME gets +3/+0 and has flying.
498236.translation: 只要你完成过地城，CARDNAME便得+3/+0且具有飞行异能。

498237.oracleText: As long as you've completed a dungeon, Cloister Gargoyle gets +3/+0 and has flying.
498237.translation: 只要你完成过地城，回廊石像鬼便得+3/+0且具有飞行异能。

498239.oracleText: When equipped creature dies, you may have CARDNAME become a 2/1 Construct artifact creature with flying and ward {o1}. If you do, it isn't an Equipment.
498239.translation: 当佩带此武具的生物死去时，你可以使CARDNAME成为2/1，具飞行与守护{o1}的组构体神器生物。若你如此作，则它不是武具。

498240.oracleText: When equipped creature dies, you may have Dancing Sword become a 2/1 Construct artifact creature with flying and ward {o1}. If you do, it isn't an Equipment.
498240.translation: 当佩带此武具的生物死去时，你可以使舞空剑成为2/1，具飞行与守护{o1}的组构体神器生物。若你如此作，则它不是武具。

498243.oracleText: Exile target card from a graveyard.
498243.translation: 将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

498248.oracleText: "Not all of us have darkvision, okay?"
498248.translation: 「不是人人都有黑暗视觉，行了吧？」

498249.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, venture into the dungeon.
498249.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，深入地城。

498252.oracleText: "I swore a sacred oath to protect the weak and punish those who threaten them. As long as I draw breath, I will protect you."
498252.translation: 「我曾立下神圣誓言，立志扶弱惩奸。只要我还活着，就会保你平安。」

498257.oracleText: "When darkness closes in around us, my blade will light our path."
498257.translation: 「当黑暗迫近时，手中宝剑便会照亮前路。」

498258.oracleText: Target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls phases out. If that permanent is black, exile it instead.
498258.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客跃离。如果该永久物是黑色，则改为将它放逐。

498262.translation: 由你操控的龙具有守护{o1}。

498264.oracleText: Courage is neither a shield nor an axe, but the will to wield both in defense of the innocent.
498264.translation: 勇气既非盾牌也非利斧，而是敢于在战斗中挥舞两者保护民众的坚定意志。

498265.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is equipped, it gets +0/+2.

498266.oracleText: As long as Dwarfhold Champion is equipped, it gets +0/+2.
498266.translation: 只要矮人要塞斗士佩带武具，它便得+0/+2。

498268.oracleText: Flumphs siphon thoughts and energy from evil aberrations, and are often eager to share the dark knowledge they obtain with friendly adventurers.
498268.translation: 呋噜怪会从邪恶异怪处吸收思想与能量，之后便迫不及待地想要跟友善的冒险者分享它们新获得的黑暗知识。

498269.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, you and target opponent each draw a card.
498269.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，你和目标对手各抓一张牌。

498270.oracleText: Whenever Flumph is dealt damage, you and target opponent each draw a card.
498270.translation: 每当呋噜怪受到伤害时，你和目标对手各抓一张牌。

498273.oracleText: "I'll make sure you never mistake a roper for a stalagmite again."
498273.translation: 「我会确保你不再把树绳妖误认作石笋。」

498274.oracleText: As long as you've completed a dungeon, CARDNAME has double strike.
498274.translation: 只要你完成过地城，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

498275.oracleText: As long as you've completed a dungeon, Gloom Stalker has double strike.
498275.translation: 只要你完成过地城，幽光伏击客便具有连击异能。

498278.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has seven or more loyalty counters on him, he's a 7/7 Dragon God creature with flying and indestructible.
498278.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有七个或更多忠诚指示物，他便是7/7，具飞行与不灭异能的龙／神生物。

498279.oracleText: As long as Grand Master of Flowers has seven or more loyalty counters on him, he's a 7/7 Dragon God creature with flying and indestructible.
498279.translation: 只要百花宗师上有七个或更多忠诚指示物，他便是7/7，具飞行与不灭异能的龙／神生物。

498280.oracleText: Target creature without first strike, double strike, or vigilance can't attack or block until your next turn.
498280.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，目标不具先攻，连击或警戒异能的生物不能进行攻击或阻挡。

498281.oracleText: Search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Monk of the Open Hand, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
498281.translation: 从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张名称为散打武僧的牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

498287.oracleText: "This fight was over the moment you picked up that clumsy cleaver of a sword."
498287.translation: 「当你决定拿起那把笨拙砍刀时，胜负已分。」

498291.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, tap target creature defending player controls.
498291.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，横置目标由防御牌手操控的生物。

498292.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create Icingdeath, Frost Tongue, a legendary white Equipment artifact token with "Equipped creature gets +2/+0," "Whenever equipped creature attacks, tap target creature defending player controls," and equip {o2}.
498292.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出传奇衍生神器霜冻舌锋冰亡，其为白色武具，且具有「佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0」、「每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，横置目标由防御牌手操控的生物」与佩带{o2}。

498293.oracleText: When Icingdeath, Frost Tyrant dies, create Icingdeath, Frost Tongue, a legendary white Equipment artifact token with "Equipped creature gets +2/+0," "Whenever equipped creature attacks, tap target creature defending player controls," and equip {o2}.
498293.translation: 当霜冻暴君冰亡死去时，派出传奇衍生神器霜冻舌锋冰亡，其为白色武具，且具有「佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0」、「每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，横置目标由防御牌手操控的生物」与佩带{o2}。

498300.oracleText: "You're not the first to underestimate me."

498301.oracleText: Each opponent can't venture into the dungeon more than once each turn.
498301.translation: 每位对手每回合深入地城的次数不能多于一次。

498303.oracleText: A paladin's steed is a celestial spirit in animal form.
498303.translation: 圣武士的坐骑可谓动物化身的天界之灵。

498307.oracleText: Enchanted permanent is a Treasure artifact with "{oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color," and it loses all other abilities.
498307.translation: 所结附的永久物是珍宝神器，且具有「{oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力」，且它失去所有其他异能。

498310.oracleText: His mind is a tranquil meadow, his fists a raging storm.
498310.translation: 他内心静如安宁牧地，拳头疾若雷霆暴风。

498311.oracleText: Flurry of Blows — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
498311.translation: 疾风连击～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498312.oracleText: Flurry of Blows — Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Monk of the Open Hand.
498312.translation: 疾风连击～每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，在散打武僧上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498316.oracleText: Selune guides her devotees with majestic wisdom and grace.
498316.translation: 塞伦涅利用其庄严智识与美善来指引信众。

498323.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +1/+1 as long as you've completed a dungeon.
498323.translation: 只要你完成过地城，由你操控的其他生物便得+1/+1。

498326.oracleText: "Can't see this airship crashing in the near future. Sturdy as a rock."
498326.translation: 「这艘飞船短期之内不可能坠毁。它硬得跟石头一样。」

498327.oracleText: Magical Tinkering — {oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed artifact's mana value, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
498327.translation: 魔法工艺～{oW}，{oT}，牺牲一个神器：从你的牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，且其法术力值须等同于所牺牲之神器的法术力值加1，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。只能于法术时机起动。

498330.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast during your turn cost {o1} more to cast.
498330.translation: 对手于你的回合中施放的咒语增加{o1}来施放。

498332.oracleText: Whenever you attack, until end of turn, target attacking creature gets +1/+1 for each other attacking creature and gains double strike.
498332.translation: 每当你攻击时，直到回合结束，目标进行攻击的生物获得连击异能，且每有一个其他进行攻击的生物，便得+1/+1。

498337.oracleText: Her light touches every corner and her wings brush either wall, leaving no place for evil to lurk.
498337.translation: 她的光辉遍及每个角落，双翼横展整个房间，令邪恶毫无藏身之地。

498338.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, venture into the dungeon.

498339.oracleText: Whenever Planar Ally attacks, venture into the dungeon.
498339.translation: 每当异界誓盟使攻击时，深入地城。

498341.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+3 and has ward {o1}.
498341.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+3且具有守护{o1}。

498342.oracleText: Equip {o3}. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each other Equipment you control.
498342.translation: 佩带{o3}。你每操控一个其他武具，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

498348.oracleText: Magic can knit the body back together, but the courage to fight on comes only from within.
498348.translation: 虽然受伤躯体能借魔法外力愈合，但战斗勇气只能由内心催动。

498351.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Potion of Healing: You gain 3 life.
498351.translation: {oW}，{oT}，牺牲医疗药水：你获得3点生命。

498353.oracleText: "We are a product of our ancestors, the apotheosis of countless noble generations. Speak their names with reverence, and they will guide your path."
498353.translation: 「先祖在上，经历千百代繁衍，吾等有幸成其后辈。虔敬道出祖灵尊名，他们便会指引前路。」

498357.oracleText: "Don't give up! You are steel and fire, and victory is yours to seize."
498357.translation: 「别气馁！你们坚若钢铁，锐似烈焰，继续奋战则胜利可期。」

498358.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Up to one other target creature gets +0/+2 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
498358.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得先攻异能。直到回合结束，至多另一个目标生物得+0/+2且获得系命异能。

498360.oracleText: Swift eyes to scout the way ahead.

498361.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Tap another untapped creature you control: Venture into the dungeon. Activate only as a sorcery.
498361.translation: {o3}，{oT}，横置另一个由你操控且未横置的生物：深入地城。只能于法术时机起动。

498363.oracleText: "When I made my oath to Moradin, I left selfishness and cowardice behind. Every battle, I make that commitment anew."
498363.translation: 「当我向摩拉丁起誓时，就早已将自私与怯懦抛诸脑后。每次战斗，都让我能重温誓言。」

498365.oracleText:
"Hold on to your lunch!"
—Bartleby, gnome wizard
498365.translation:
「拿稳你的午餐！」
～地侏法师巴托比

498366.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, exile up to one target artifact or creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
498366.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，放逐至多一个目标由你操控的神器或生物，然后将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

498368.oracleText: Her tales of glory light a fire in the souls of the next generation of adventurers.
498368.translation: 她的光辉事迹，点燃了后辈冒险者心中的激情。

498371.oracleText: White dragons are unparalleled hunters, keenly focused on slaughtering their enemies.
498371.translation: 白龙是无匹猎手，专注于如何杀死猎物。

498377.oracleText: Choose one — • Rouse the Party — Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. • Set Off Traps — This spell deals 5 damage to target attacking creature.
498377.translation: 选择一项～ •  叫醒队伍～由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。 •  启动陷阱～此咒语对目标进行攻击的生物造成5点伤害。

498380.oracleText: "Hand over your loot and no one gets hurt!"

498381.oracleText: Choose one — • Make a Retreat — Return target creature you control to its owner's hand. • Stand and Fight — Target creature gets +1/+3 until end of turn.
498381.translation: 选择一项～ •  试图撤退～将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。 •  原地还击～目标生物得+1/+3直到回合结束。

498391.oracleText: Elemental Evil distorts the natural elements, limiting them to aspects of destruction.
498391.translation: 邪恶元素将自然元素尽数扭曲，令其只余破坏之途。

498401.oracleText: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell. Venture into the dungeon.
498401.translation: 反击目标生物或鹏洛客咒语。深入地城。

498403.oracleText: You may choose not to untap The Blackstaff of Waterdeep during your untap step.
498403.translation: 你可以选择于你的重置步骤中不重置深水城黑杖。

498404.oracleText: Animate Walking Statue — {o1oU}, {oT}: Another target nontoken artifact you control becomes a 4/4 artifact creature for as long as CARDNAME remains tapped. Activate only as a sorcery.
498404.translation: 活化自走雕像～{o1oU}，{oT}：于CARDNAME持续横置的时段内，另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的神器成为4/4神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

498405.oracleText: Animate Walking Statue — {o1oU}, {oT}: Another target nontoken artifact you control becomes a 4/4 artifact creature for as long as The Blackstaff of Waterdeep remains tapped. Activate only as a sorcery.
498405.translation: 活化自走雕像～{o1oU}，{oT}：于深水城黑杖持续横置的时段内，另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的神器成为4/4神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

498413.oracleText: "I'm always happy to lend a hand!"

498414.oracleText: Mage Hand — {oT}: Untap target permanent not named Clever Conjurer. Activate only as a sorcery.
498414.translation: 法师帮手～{oT}：重置目标名称不为机敏咒法师的永久物。只能于法术时机起动。

498422.oracleText: This spell costs {oU} less to cast for each instant and sorcery spell you've cast this turn.
498422.translation: 你本回合中每施放过一个瞬间和法术咒语，此咒语便减少{oU}来施放。

498423.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy.
498423.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。将其复制。你可以施放该复制品。

498424.oracleText: Whenever Demilich attacks, exile up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy.
498424.translation: 每当半巫妖攻击时，将至多一张目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。将其复制。你可以施放该复制品。

498425.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard by exiling four instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard in addition to paying its other costs.
498425.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放CARDNAME，但在其他费用以外，还须从你的坟墓场放逐四张瞬间和／或法术牌。

498426.oracleText: You may cast Demilich from your graveyard by exiling four instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard in addition to paying its other costs.
498426.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放半巫妖，但在其他费用以外，还须从你的坟墓场放逐四张瞬间和／或法术牌。

498428.oracleText: The only place you can be sure it's not is wherever it appears to be.
498428.translation: 你唯一能确定的，是它不在你看到它的地方。

498430.oracleText: Displacement — {o3oU}: Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
498430.translation: 移位～{o3oU}：将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

498431.oracleText: Displacement — {o3oU}: Return Displacer Beast to its owner's hand.
498431.translation: 移位～{o3oU}：将移位兽移回其拥有者手上。

498446.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've completed a dungeon, up to one target creature becomes a Bird with base power and toughness 1/1 and flying until end of turn.
498446.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你完成过地城，则直到回合结束，至多一个目标生物成为基础力量与防御力为1/1，具飞行异能的鸟。

498449.oracleText: Unlike most warlocks, those who make pacts with archfey are drawn to pranks and whimsy moreso than death and darkness.
498449.translation: 跟大多数热衷死亡与黑暗的邪术师不同，与至高妖精订立契约者更容易被恶戏和奇想所吸引。

498450.oracleText: Whenever you roll one or more dice, create a 1/1 blue Faerie Dragon creature token with flying.
498450.translation: 每当你掷一颗或数颗骰子时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具飞行异能的仙灵／龙衍生生物。

498452.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, venture into the dungeon.
498452.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，深入地城。

498453.oracleText: Enchanted creature has flying and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, venture into the dungeon."
498453.translation: 所结附的生物具有飞行与「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，深入地城。」

498454.translation: 灵吸怪学者葛拉吉拉克斯

498456.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
498456.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

498458.oracleText: She puts some coin in the Guild's pocket and sends a message at the same time.
498458.translation: 她往公会钱袋中放入金币，同时也送出一则讯息。

498459.oracleText: Whenever Guild Thief deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
498459.translation: 每当公会小偷对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498460.oracleText: Cunning Action — {o3oU}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
498460.translation: 灵巧动作～{o3oU}：CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

498461.oracleText: Cunning Action — {o3oU}: Guild Thief can't be blocked this turn.
498461.translation: 灵巧动作～{o3oU}：公会小偷本回合不能被阻挡。

498464.oracleText: CARDNAME has ward {o4} as long as it's untapped.
498464.translation: 只要CARDNAME未横置，它便具有守护{o4}。

498465.oracleText: Iymrith, Desert Doom has ward {o4} as long as it's untapped.
498465.translation: 只要沙漠厄运艾穆莉丝未横置，它便具有守护{o4}。

498466.oracleText: Whenever Iymrith deals combat damage to a player, draw a card. Then if you have fewer than three cards in hand, draw cards equal to the difference.
498466.translation: 每当艾穆莉丝对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。然后若你的手牌数量少于三张，则抓等同于该差距数量的牌。

498468.oracleText: "Shed your thoughts and let my will flow through you."
498468.translation: 「抛弃旧念，让我的意志贯彻全身。」

498473.oracleText: Draw two cards, then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library.
498473.translation: 抓两张牌，然后将一张牌从你手上置于你的牌库底。

498474.oracleText: This creature's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of cards in your hand.
498474.translation: 此生物的力量和防御力各等同于你手牌数量的两倍。

498475.oracleText: Create a blue Dog Illusion creature token with "This creature's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of cards in your hand."
498475.translation: 派出一个蓝色狗／虚影衍生生物，且具有「此生物的力量和防御力各等同于你手牌数量的两倍。」

498476.oracleText: Exchange your hand and library, then shuffle. You get an emblem with "You have no maximum hand size."
498476.translation: 交换你的手牌和牌库，然后洗牌。你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「你的手牌数量没有上限。」

498478.oracleText: "Your purpose may change along with your shape, but you will serve regardless."
498478.translation: 「你的用途可能会随着你的形态而变，但你仍将效忠于我。」

498479.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature becomes a Dragon with base power and toughness 4/4 and gains flying.
498479.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的龙，且获得飞行异能。

498481.oracleText: Pixies are well known as pranksters, but some delight in more helpful magic.
498481.translation: 皮克精出了名地喜欢戏弄他人，但有些也以施展帮助性的魔法为乐。

498482.oracleText: Grant an Advantage — If you would roll one or more dice, instead roll that many dice plus one and ignore the lowest roll.
498482.translation: 赋予优势～如果你将掷一颗或数颗骰子，则改为掷原数量加一颗骰子并忽略最小点数。

498492.oracleText: As long as enchanted creature is red, it loses all abilities.
498492.translation: 只要所结附的生物是红色，它便失去所有异能。

498494.oracleText: Frost giants carry the trophies of their greatest victories into battle, fashioned into armor of strength and savage beauty.
498494.translation: 霜巨人会将他们最伟大胜利的奖赏制成展现力量与野性之美的护甲，并穿戴它们冲上战场。

498504.oracleText: The way opened before him, and the dust of centuries stirred in the air.
498504.translation: 道路在面前洞开，数百年的灰尘在空中飘舞。

498505.oracleText: {o4oU}: Venture into the dungeon. Activate only as a sorcery.
498505.translation: {o4oU}：深入地城。只能于法术时机起动。

498508.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-0 until end of turn.
498508.translation: 目标生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。

498510.oracleText: "Ah, the old ‘trap door under a rug' trick. This is almost too easy."
498510.translation: 「啊，『地毯下活板门』的老把戏。这个太简单了。」

498511.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, venture into the dungeon.
498511.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，深入地城。

498512.oracleText: Whenever Shortcut Seeker deals combat damage to a player, venture into the dungeon.
498512.translation: 每当捷径探寻者对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，深入地城。

498514.oracleText: Wings take flight on whispered wind.
498514.translation: 在萧瑟寒风中展翅飞翔。

498517.oracleText: "My psychic blade cuts the mind and severs thoughts. Even if you survive, you'll never remember I was here."
498517.translation: 「我的心灵利刃能切割意识，斩断思想。就算你侥幸存活，你也不会记得我曾来过。」

498518.oracleText: Whenever Soulknife Spy deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
498518.translation: 每当魂刃者探子对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

498521.oracleText: Choose target player. Return half the creatures they control to their owner's hand, rounded up.
498521.translation: 选择目标牌手。将一半数量由其操控的生物移回其拥有者手上，小数点后进位。

498523.oracleText: A lucky draw from the Deck of Many Things gave Voltusk an inexplicable flash of understanding that he spent the rest of his life trying to repeat.
498523.translation: 万象无常牌的幸运一抽，让沃图克眼前闪过难以解释的一幕：他将耗尽余生想要重现这一情景。

498524.oracleText: Draw a card for each different mana value among nonland cards in your graveyard.
498524.translation: 你坟墓场中的非地牌间每有一种不同的法术力值，便抓一张牌。

498526.oracleText: The raging behir reared back, opened its terrible maw . . . and collapsed in a fit of horrifying giggles.
498526.translation: 愤怒的青足龙蛇向后一跃，张开了血盆巨口…随即因自己的骇人狂笑而无力他顾。

498527.oracleText: Each opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until that player has exiled cards with total mana value 20 or more.
498527.translation: 每位对手各进行以下流程～从其牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到所放逐之牌的法术力值总和为20或更多为止。

498530.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice Trickster's Talisman. If you do, create a token that's a copy of this creature.
498530.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以牺牲诈术师神符。若你如此作，则派出一个为此生物之复制品的衍生物。

498531.oracleText: Invoke Duplicity — Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice Trickster's Talisman. If you do, create a token that's a copy of this creature."
498531.translation: 召唤分身～佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以牺牲诈术师神符。若你如此作，则派出一个为此生物之复制品的衍生物。」

498535.oracleText: Target artifact or creature becomes a copy of another target artifact or creature.
498535.translation: 目标神器或生物成为另一个目标神器或生物的复制品。

498538.oracleText: When this Class becomes level 2, draw two cards.
498538.translation: 当此职业成为等级2时，抓两张牌。

498547.oracleText: Choose one — • Fight the Current — Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. • Find a Crossing — Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
498547.translation: 选择一项～ •  强渡急流～将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。 •  绕路通过～目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

498550.oracleText: "Give me just a moment! I almost have it."
498550.translation: 「再给我一点时间！就要看懂了。」

498551.oracleText: Choose one — • Foil Their Scheme — Counter target spell. • Learn Their Secrets — Draw two cards, then discard two cards.
498551.translation: 选择一项～ •  阻止阴谋～反击目标咒语。 •  了解秘密～抓两张牌，然后弃两张牌。

498556.oracleText: Choose one — • Distract the Guard — Tap target creature. • Hide — Target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn.
498556.translation: 选择一项～ •  引开卫士～横置目标生物。 •  就地藏身～目标由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

498561.oracleText: Yuan-Ti Malison can't be blocked as long as it's attacking alone.
498561.translation: 只要蛇人恶咒师单独进行攻击，它便不能被阻挡。

498562.oracleText: Whenever Yuan-Ti Malison deals combat damage to a player, venture into the dungeon.
498562.translation: 每当蛇人恶咒师对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，深入地城。

498566.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, for each opponent, you create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token unless that player sacrifices a creature.
498566.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，对每位对手而言，除非该牌手牺牲一个生物，否则你派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

498567.oracleText: Whenever Acererak the Archlich attacks, for each opponent, you create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token unless that player sacrifices a creature.
498567.translation: 每当高阶巫妖阿瑟瑞拉克攻击时，对每位对手而言，除非该牌手牺牲一个生物，否则你派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

498570.oracleText: Binding Contract — If you would draw a card, exile the top card of your library face down instead.
498570.translation: 魔鬼契约～如果你将抓一张牌，改为牌面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌。

498573.oracleText: {oB}: Return all cards exiled with CARDNAME to their owner's hand and you lose that much life.
498573.translation: {oB}：将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌移回其拥有者手上，且你失去等量的生命。

498574.oracleText: {oB}: Return all cards exiled with Asmodeus the Archfiend to their owner's hand and you lose that much life.
498574.translation: {oB}：将所有以魔王阿斯摩蒂尔斯放逐的牌移回其拥有者手上，且你失去等量的生命。

498578.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个结界。

498579.oracleText: Creatures you control gain menace until end of turn.
498579.translation: 由你操控的生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

498580.oracleText: Creatures you control gain menace until end of turn.
498580.translation: 由你操控的生物获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

498585.oracleText: Black dragons revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms.
498585.translation: 黑龙乐于摧毁人类王国。

498590.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you lost 2 or more life this turn, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
498590.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中失去了2点或更多生命，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

498595.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card. If an instant card or a card with flash is exiled this way, they lose 1 life. Otherwise, you lose 1 life.
498595.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌。如果以此法放逐一张瞬间牌或一张具闪现异能的牌，则该对手失去1点生命。若否，则你失去1点生命。

498597.oracleText: Those who die in the dungeon become its guardians.
498597.translation: 在地城中丧命者，会转而变成其守护者。

498598.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, venture into the dungeon.

498599.oracleText: When Clattering Skeletons dies, venture into the dungeon.
498599.translation: 当碎响骷髅妖死去时，深入地城。

498601.oracleText: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."
498601.translation: 「这枚戒指真漂亮！我用我的小刀和你换。」

498605.oracleText: Skeletons, Vampires, and Zombies you control get +1/+1.
498605.translation: 由你操控的骷髅妖、吸血鬼和灵俑得+1/+1。

498606.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, you may pay {o1}. If you do, create a 1/1 black Skeleton creature token.
498606.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1黑色骷髅妖衍生生物。

498608.oracleText: The good will be corrupted, the kind will be devoured, and all will be dragged into the bottomless Abyss.
498608.translation: 善良者会被腐化，宽容者会被吞噬，一切都会被拖入无尽深渊当中。

498609.oracleText: Target opponent discards two cards, mills two cards, and loses 2 life.
498609.translation: 目标对手弃两张牌，磨两张牌并失去2点生命。

498611.oracleText:
"I'll know what you know soon enough."
—Nihiloor, Xanathar Guild spymaster
498611.translation:
「你知道的，很快就会变成我知道的。」
～札那瑟公会间谍大师奈席洛

498612.oracleText: Target opponent discards a card. If mana from a Treasure was spent to cast this spell, instead that player reveals their hand, you choose a nonland card from it, then that player discards that card.
498612.translation: 目标对手弃一张牌。如果施放此咒语时支付过来自珍宝的法术力，则改为该牌手展示其手牌，你选择其中一张非地牌，然后该牌手弃掉该牌。

498615.oracleText: Though their forms embody Lolth's image, driders are those unfortunate drow who have failed the Spider Queen.
498615.translation: 虽然蛛化精灵外形神似罗丝，但他们其实是令蜘蛛女王蒙羞的不幸卓尔。

498616.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a 2/1 black Spider creature token with menace and reach.
498616.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个2/1黑色，具威慑与延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

498617.oracleText: Whenever Drider deals combat damage to a player, create a 2/1 black Spider creature token with menace and reach.
498617.translation: 每当蛛化精灵对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个2/1黑色，具威慑与延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

498619.oracleText:
"I think of it as giving them another chance to achieve their potential."
—Nestus Wrasse, necromancer
498619.translation:
「我把这看作再给他们一次发挥潜能的机会。」
～死灵术士奈特斯瑞瑟

498621.oracleText: Whenever you complete a dungeon, you may return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
498621.translation: 每当你完成地城时，你可以将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

498622.oracleText: Whenever you complete a dungeon, you may return Dungeon Crawler from your graveyard to your hand.
498622.translation: 每当你完成地城时，你可以将地城匍尸从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

498625.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard if a creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
498625.translation: 如果本回合中有名称不为龙巫妖黑檀死神的生物死去，则你可以从你的坟墓场中施放CARDNAME。

498626.oracleText: You may cast Ebondeath, Dracolich from your graveyard if a creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
498626.translation: 如果本回合中有名称不为龙巫妖黑檀死神的生物死去，则你可以从你的坟墓场中施放龙巫妖黑檀死神。

498628.oracleText: In the end, there was nothing beautiful to be seen.
498628.translation: 最后剩下的东西可不美丽。

498629.oracleText: Target creature gets -11/-11 until end of turn.
498629.translation: 目标生物得-11/-11直到回合结束。

498631.translation: 逃过一劫～或许只是暂时躲过。

498632.oracleText: Return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Venture into the dungeon.
498632.translation: 将至多一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。深入地城。

498634.oracleText: A drastic measure for dangerous times.

498635.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
498635.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

498636.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it."
498636.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。」

498638.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Pay 1 life: Create a Treasure token.
498638.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，支付1点生命：派出一个珍宝衍生物。
