498639.oracleText: {o2oB}: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn. If mana from a Treasure was spent to activate this ability, that creature also gains deathtouch until end of turn.
498639.translation: {o2oB}：目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。如果起动时支付过来自珍宝的法术力，则该生物再获得死触异能直到回合结束。

498644.oracleText: Dissolve — {oXoB}: Put target creature card with mana value X exiled with CARDNAME into its owner's graveyard.
498644.translation: 消化～{oXoB}：将目标以CARDNAME放逐且法术力值为X的生物牌置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

498645.oracleText: Dissolve — {oXoB}: Put target creature card with mana value X exiled with Gelatinous Cube into its owner's graveyard.
498645.translation: 消化～{oXoB}：将目标以凝胶怪放逐且法术力值为X的生物牌置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

498647.oracleText: Freed from the need to pay tribute to the dragon, the villagers gladly paid the dragon-slayers instead.
498647.translation: 当村民得知不再需要向巨龙进贡后，他们兴高采烈地改为将钱财支付予屠龙勇士。

498648.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Create a Treasure token.
498648.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

498651.oracleText: There is a stillness that walks with him, the quiet that follows great tragedy, when even the mourners are too exhausted to weep.
498651.translation: 他的出现令周围陷入沉寂，这是惨痛悲剧带来的沉痛窒息，就连哀悼者都已因过度伤悲而无力哭泣。

498652.oracleText: Tragic Backstory — Cast this spell only if a creature died this turn.
498652.translation: 悲剧背景～只能于有生物死去的回合中施放此咒语。

498662.oracleText: "I'll take care of it. You just be sure to hold up your end of the deal."
498662.translation: 「我会处理好这件事。你只管准备好你要付的那部分。」

498667.oracleText: "And to think, a year ago I was picking pockets in Waterdeep."
498667.translation: 「仔细想来，一年前我还只是在深水城当扒手的小混混。」

498668.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
498668.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

498669.oracleText: Whenever Hoard Robber deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
498669.translation: 每当集宝抢匪对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

498680.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, put a loyalty counter on CARDNAME.
498680.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个忠诚指示物。

498681.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, put a loyalty counter on Lolth, Spider Queen.
498681.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，在蜘蛛神后罗丝上放置一个忠诚指示物。

498682.oracleText: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
498682.translation: 你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

498683.oracleText: Create two 2/1 black Spider creature tokens with menace and reach.
498683.translation: 派出两个2/1黑色，具威慑与延势异能的蜘蛛衍生生物。

498684.oracleText: Whenever an opponent is dealt combat damage by one or more creatures you control, if that player lost less than 8 life this turn, they lose life equal to the difference.
498684.translation: 每当任一对手受到由你操控之一个或数个生物的战斗伤害时，若该牌手本回合中失去过的生命小于8点，则其失去等同于该差距数量的生命。

498685.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever an opponent is dealt combat damage by one or more creatures you control, if that player lost less than 8 life this turn, they lose life equal to the difference."
498685.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当任一对手受到由你操控之一个或数个生物的战斗伤害时，若该牌手本回合中失去过的生命小于8点，则其失去等同于该差距数量的生命。」

498689.oracleText: Aramil issued a long, heroic challenge, then the lich felled him with a single word.
498689.translation: 阿拉米尔历经艰险，终于向巫妖发出英勇挑战，但后者只消一言就将其终结。

498690.oracleText: Destroy target non-Angel, non-Demon, non-Devil, non-Dragon creature.
498690.translation: 消灭目标非天使、非恶魔、非魔鬼且非龙的生物。

498693.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets -2/-2. It gets -5/-5 instead as long as you've completed a dungeon.
498693.translation: 所结附的生物得-2/-2。只要你完成过地城，便改为它得-5/-5。

498695.oracleText: Erigan cried out in pain as a hideous weakness settled into his bones.
498695.translation: 随着骇人虚弱深入骨髓，艾瑞甘因而痛苦大叫。

498696.oracleText: Target creature gets -4/-1 until end of turn. If that creature is white, it gets -4/-4 until end of turn instead.
498696.translation: 目标生物得-4/-1直到回合结束。如果该生物是白色，则改为它得-4/-4直到回合结束。

498698.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, it gains deathtouch until end of turn.
498698.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，它获得死触异能直到回合结束。

498699.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks alone, defending player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
498699.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物单独攻击时，防御牌手失去2点生命，且你获得2点生命。

498701.oracleText: Ghouls devour the dead and any living creatures unwary enough to fall into their grasp.
498701.translation: 食尸鬼除了死者之外，也会吞噬不慎落入其手中的活物。

498702.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
498702.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

498703.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Sepulcher Ghoul gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
498703.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：葬尸地食尸鬼得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

498705.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
498705.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

498706.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
498706.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

498707.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, choose one — • Brave the Stench — Target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn. • Search the Body — Create a Treasure token.
498707.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，选择一项～ •  忍受恶臭～目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。 •  搜索尸体～派出一个珍宝衍生物。

498708.oracleText: When Shambling Ghast dies, choose one — • Brave the Stench — Target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn. • Search the Body — Create a Treasure token.
498708.translation: 当跛行妖鬼死去时，选择一项～ •  忍受恶臭～目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。 •  搜索尸体～派出一个珍宝衍生物。

498714.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice another creature or a Treasure: Draw a card.
498714.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲另一个生物或一个珍宝：抓一张牌。

498718.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile CARDNAME, all creatures and planeswalkers with mana value less than or equal to the number of void counters on it, and all creature and planeswalker cards in graveyards with mana value less than or equal to the number of void counters on it.
498718.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐CARDNAME、所有法术力值等于或小于其上虚空指示物数量的生物和鹏洛客，以及所有坟墓场中的所有法术力值等于或小于其上虚空指示物数量之生物和鹏洛客牌。

498719.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile Sphere of Annihilation, all creatures and planeswalkers with mana value less than or equal to the number of void counters on it, and all creature and planeswalker cards in graveyards with mana value less than or equal to the number of void counters on it.
498719.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐毁灭黑洞、所有法术力值等于或小于其上虚空指示物数量的生物和鹏洛客，以及所有坟墓场中的所有法术力值等于或小于其上虚空指示物数量之生物和鹏洛客牌。

498722.oracleText: Equipped creature can't be blocked as long as its power is 3 or less.
498722.translation: 只要佩带此武具之生物的力量等于或小于3，它便不能被阻挡。

498724.oracleText: Unsuccessful vampire hunters often wind up as ravenous spawn.
498724.translation: 吸血鬼猎人一旦失手，经常会沦落成嗜血衍体。

498728.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+0 and has deathtouch.
498728.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0且具有死触异能。

498729.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game.
498729.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手输掉这盘游戏。

498730.oracleText: {o5oBoBoB}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME gains "Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game."
498730.translation: {o5oBoBoB}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME获得「每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手输掉这盘游戏。」

498731.oracleText: {o5oBoBoB}: Until end of turn, Vorpal Sword gains "Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, that player loses the game."
498731.translation: {o5oBoBoB}：直到回合结束，斩首剑获得「每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手输掉这盘游戏。」

498734.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, each opponent loses 1 life.
498734.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则每位对手各失去1点生命。

498736.oracleText: When this Class becomes level 2, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
498736.translation: 当此职业成为等级2时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

498738.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses life equal to the life they lost this turn.
498738.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每位对手各失去等同于其本回合中曾失去之数量的生命。

498741.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, put that many +1/+1 counters on it.
498741.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

498742.oracleText: Whenever Westgate Regent deals combat damage to a player, put that many +1/+1 counters on it.
498742.translation: 每当西门城摄政对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置等量的+1/+1指示物。

498744.oracleText: Wights want the world to resound with echoes of their own cruel hatred.
498744.translation: 尸妖想令其残忍仇恨之反响回荡整个世界。

498746.oracleText: Life Drain — Whenever a creature dealt damage by CARDNAME this turn dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token and exile that card.
498746.translation: 吸取生命～每当一个本回合中受过CARDNAME伤害的生物死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物并放逐该牌。

498747.oracleText: Life Drain — Whenever a creature dealt damage by Wight this turn dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token and exile that card.
498747.translation: 吸取生命～每当一个本回合中受过尸妖伤害的生物死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物并放逐该牌。

498750.oracleText: "The air is sweet with the taste of your fear."
498750.translation: 「空气因你的恐惧变得更甜美。」

498751.oracleText: Whenever Yuan-Ti Fang-Blade deals combat damage to a player, venture into the dungeon.
498751.translation: 每当蛇人毒刃手对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，深入地城。

498752.oracleText:
"On the plus side, Throg no longer thinks he's clever."
—Xanathar
498752.translation:
「好的方面是，斯若革不再觉得自己很聪明了。」
～札那瑟

498753.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, venture into the dungeon.
498753.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则深入地城。

498755.oracleText: "This one is for goblins, this one is for owlbears, this one is for toast, this one is for . . ."
498755.translation: 「这个敲哥布林，这个打枭头熊，这个烤东西，这个用来…」

498756.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is equipped, it has menace.
498756.translation: 只要CARDNAME佩带武具，它便具有威慑异能。

498757.oracleText: As long as Armory Veteran is equipped, it has menace.
498757.translation: 只要军械老兵佩带武具，它便具有威慑异能。

498759.oracleText: If you would roll one or more dice, instead roll that many dice plus one and ignore the lowest roll.
498759.translation: 如果你将掷一颗或数颗骰子，则改为掷原数量加一颗骰子并忽略最小点数。

498761.oracleText: Whenever you roll one or more dice, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
498761.translation: 每当你掷一颗或数颗骰子时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得威慑异能。

498764.oracleText: {o1oR}: Goblins you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
498764.translation: {o1oR}：直到回合结束，由你操控的鬼怪得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

498765.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
498765.translation: 集群战术～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

498766.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever Battle Cry Goblin attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
498766.translation: 集群战术～每当战吼哥布林攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

498769.oracleText: Click your heels and become the wind.

498771.oracleText: "My grandmother saved the life of a brass dragon, and in return she was given a glimpse of the fire in its heart—a glimpse she passed down to me."
498771.translation: 「我的祖母救了一条黄铜龙，她所得回报是一瞥龙心中火焰～这一瞥则传承给我。」

498772.oracleText: Whenever you roll one or more dice, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
498772.translation: 每当你掷一颗或数颗骰子时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

498773.oracleText: Whenever you roll one or more dice, Brazen Dwarf deals 1 damage to each opponent.
498773.translation: 每当你掷一颗或数颗骰子时，铜威矮人向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

498775.oracleText: A simple fire spell that grows in intensity along with its caster.
498775.translation: 这单纯的火焰咒语随着施放者增长威力。

498776.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that permanent is green, CARDNAME deals 6 damage instead.
498776.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果该永久物是绿色，则改为CARDNAME造成6点伤害。

498777.oracleText: Burning Hands deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that permanent is green, Burning Hands deals 6 damage instead.
498777.translation: 燃烧之手对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果该永久物是绿色，则改为燃烧之手造成6点伤害。

498786.oracleText: "How do you kill what's already dead? That's how."
498786.translation: 「要怎样杀死已经死了的东西？就这样。」

498787.oracleText: When you roll a natural 20, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
498787.translation: 当你掷出原值20时，将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

498796.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may reveal a Dragon card from your hand or choose a Dragon you control.
498796.translation: 你可以从你手上展示一张龙牌或选择一个由你操控的龙，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

498797.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you revealed a Dragon card or chose a Dragon as you cast this spell, CARDNAME deals damage equal to the power of that card or creature instead.
498797.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。如果你于施放此咒语时展示了龙牌或选择了龙，则改为CARDNAME造成等同于该牌或生物之力量的伤害。

498798.oracleText: Dragon's Fire deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you revealed a Dragon card or chose a Dragon as you cast this spell, Dragon's Fire deals damage equal to the power of that card or creature instead.
498798.translation: 龙火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。如果你于施放此咒语时展示了龙牌或选择了龙，则改为龙火造成等同于该牌或生物之力量的伤害。

498816.translation: 烈焰骷髅不能进行阻挡。

498817.oracleText: Rejuvenation — When CARDNAME dies, exile it. If you do, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play one of those cards.
498817.translation: 返魂～当CARDNAME死去时，将它放逐。若你如此作，则放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌其中的一张。

498821.oracleText: Hate gets you only so far. A pointy stick can close the rest of the distance.
498821.translation: 愤怒只能帮你这么多。剩下的距离能靠一根尖棍来帮忙。

498822.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to target creature blocking it.
498822.translation: 每当CARDNAME被阻挡时，它对目标阻挡它的生物造成1点伤害。

498823.oracleText: Whenever Goblin Javelineer becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to target creature blocking it.
498823.translation: 每当哥布林标枪手被阻挡时，它对目标阻挡它的生物造成1点伤害。

498836.oracleText: In a hobgoblin's view of the world, the weak owe tribute and fealty to the strong.
498836.translation: 大哥布林的世界观是：弱者应该向强者进贡并效忠。

498837.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of Goblins that entered the battlefield under your control this turn to any target.
498837.translation: {oR}，{oT}：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于本回合中在你的操控下进战场的鬼怪数量。

498838.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}: Hobgoblin Bandit Lord deals damage equal to the number of Goblins that entered the battlefield under your control this turn to any target.
498838.translation: {oR}，{oT}：大哥布林山贼王对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于本回合中在你的操控下进战场的鬼怪数量。

498841.oracleText: Hobgoblins do not fear death, for those who fall in battle have gained glory eternal.
498841.translation: 大哥布林不怕死，因为战死者已得永恒荣耀。

498842.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, CARDNAME gains first strike until end of turn.
498842.translation: 集群战术～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则CARDNAME获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

498843.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever Hobgoblin Captain attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, Hobgoblin Captain gains first strike until end of turn.
498843.translation: 集群战术～每当大哥布林队长攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则大哥布林队长获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

498845.oracleText: Bugbears move with surprising speed for their size and bulk, a fact that has led to the demise of many unwary adventurers.
498845.translation: 以熊哥布林的身形与体重而言，他们的动作惊人飞快；许多冒险者因此大意丧命。

498847.oracleText: Anything can be a weapon if you swing it hard enough.
498847.translation: 只要够用力挥，什么东西都能当武器。

498848.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. Create a Treasure token.
498848.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

498849.oracleText: Improvised Weaponry deals 2 damage to any target. Create a Treasure token.
498849.translation: 临时武器对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

498851.oracleText: The ancient dragon Imvaernarhro has earned his fiery nickname.
498851.translation: 远古巨龙伊姆瓦尔纳奥以实力获得其火热外号。

498852.oracleText: {oR}: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn. When its power becomes 20 this way, it deals 20 damage to any target.
498852.translation: {oR}：CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。当它的力量以此法成为20时，它对任意一个目标造成20点伤害。

498853.oracleText: {oR}: Inferno of the Star Mounts gets +1/+0 until end of turn. When its power becomes 20 this way, it deals 20 damage to any target.
498853.translation: {oR}：星之山脉的狱火得+1/+0直到回合结束。当它的力量以此法成为20时，它对任意一个目标造成20点伤害。

498860.oracleText:
"We tried your way. Now we do it my way!"
—Jym, barbarian of Baldur's Gate
498860.translation:
「我们试过你的方法。现在用我的！」
～博德之门的野蛮人吉姆

498861.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. That creature gains haste until end of turn and can't be blocked by Walls this turn. Venture into the dungeon.
498861.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。该生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束，且本回合不能被墙阻挡。深入地城。

498863.oracleText: A tried-and-true favorite of many wizards, whatever their school.
498863.translation: 无论专精哪个学派，这是许多法师最爱的可靠法术。

498864.oracleText: Magic Missile deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
498864.translation: 魔法飞弹对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共3点伤害，你可以任意分配。

498867.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 8 damage divided as you choose among X target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
498867.translation: CARDNAME对X个目标生物和／或鹏洛客造成共8点伤害，你可以任意分配。

498868.oracleText: Meteor Swarm deals 8 damage divided as you choose among X target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
498868.translation: 陨星爆对X个目标生物和／或鹏洛客造成共8点伤害，你可以任意分配。

498870.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, you may put a Dragon creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
498870.translation: 集群战术～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则你可以将一张龙生物牌从你的手上横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。

498871.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever Minion of the Mighty attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, you may put a Dragon creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
498871.translation: 集群战术～每当强者奴仆攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则你可以将一张龙生物牌从你的手上横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。

498873.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast Dragon spells or activate abilities of Dragons.
498873.translation: {o1}，{oT}：加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放龙咒语，或是起动龙的异能。

498874.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal a Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
498874.translation: {oR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中的一张龙牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

498875.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice Orb of Dragonkind: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal a Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
498875.translation: {oR}，{oT}，牺牲龙珠：检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中的一张龙牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

498881.oracleText: "Most folks got mayhem in their hearts. Just gotta know their price."
498881.translation: 「人心多有破坏欲，开对价钱就行。」

498882.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. If mana from a Treasure was spent to cast this spell, that creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
498882.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。如果施放此咒语时支付了来自珍宝的法术力，则该生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

498884.oracleText: Red dragons consider the world and every creature in it as theirs to command.
498884.translation: 红龙认为此世界与其间每个生物都会听其号令。

498889.oracleText:
"They don't seem scary, but then you're suddenly standing there in your underclothes without a weapon. Then everything looks like a threat."
—Jarro, battle master
498889.translation:
「它们外表不可怕，然后你突然没了武器傻傻站着，只剩贴身衣物。接下来一切看起来都像是威胁。」
～战斗宗师雅罗

498890.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
498890.translation: 牺牲一个神器：CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

498891.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact: Rust Monster gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
498891.translation: 牺牲一个神器：锈蚀怪得+2/+0直到回合结束。

498897.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, CARDNAME deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to target creature.
498897.translation: 集群战术～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。

498898.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever Tiger-Tribe Hunter attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, Tiger-Tribe Hunter deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to target creature.
498898.translation: 集群战术～每当猛虎部落猎人攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则你可以牺牲另一个生物。当你如此作时，猛虎部落猎人对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的力量。

498903.oracleText: "There is only one way forward: into legend."

498904.oracleText: Combat Inspiration — At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
498904.translation: 战斗激励～在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

498906.oracleText:
"If you had just one wish, what would it be? Gold, or angel song? Finding a lost love, or finding your way back home? Let me sing a song about one wish that came true . . ."
—Ellywick Tumblestrum
498906.translation:
「如果你只能许一个愿望，你会祈求什么？是要眼前黄金遍地，还是耳边颂曲萦绕？是要寻获失落爱情，抑或找到回家的路？请听这首关于祈愿成真的歌曲…」
～艾利薇鼓琴

498907.oracleText: You may play a card you own from outside the game this turn.
498907.translation: 本回合中，你可以从游戏外使用一张由你拥有的牌。

498909.oracleText: Xorns are native to the Elemental Plane of Earth, where gems and rare stones are plentiful. When summoned elsewhere they can be quite destructive in search of food.
498909.translation: 索尔石怪诞生在地元素位面，该处蕴藏大量晶矿和稀有宝石。当被召唤到其他地方时，它们会为满足食欲而破坏性大增。

498910.oracleText: If you would create one or more Treasure tokens, instead create those tokens plus an additional Treasure token.
498910.translation: 如果你将派出一个或数个珍宝衍生物，则改为派出该些衍生物加上一个额外的珍宝衍生物。

498911.oracleText: You Come to the Gnoll Camp

498912.oracleText:
"Easy now, everyone. I'll take care of this."
—Nadaar
498912.translation:
「各位别紧张。我来就行。」
～那达尔

498913.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+1 until end of turn.
498913.translation: 目标生物得+3/+1直到回合结束。

498914.oracleText: Choose one — • Intimidate Them — Up to two target creatures can't block this turn. • Fend Them Off — Target creature gets +3/+1 until end of turn.
498914.translation: 选择一项～ •  吓阻他们～至多两个目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。 •  避开他们～目标生物得+3/+1直到回合结束。

498918.oracleText: Choose one — • Break Their Chains — Destroy target artifact. • Interrogate Them — Exile the top three cards of target opponent's library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast it.
498918.translation: 选择一项～ •  砸开铁链～消灭目标神器。 •  审问他们～放逐目标对手牌库顶的三张牌。选择其中一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放它的费用。

498920.oracleText: You See a Pair of Goblins

498921.oracleText:
"I have the shot. Shall I take it?"
—Varis, Silverymoon ranger
498921.translation:
「我射得中。要我动手吗？」
～银月城游侠瓦力斯

498922.oracleText: Choose one — • Charge Them — Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. • Befriend Them — Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.
498922.translation: 选择一项～ •  冲锋攻击～由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。 •  结交朋友～派出两个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

498926.oracleText: Fire giants love to fight on a large scale, and Duke Zalto is one of the greatest warmongers of his age.
498926.translation: 火巨人喜欢引发大战，而札尔托公爵名列当世顶尖的战争贩子之中。

498927.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, venture into the dungeon.
498927.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，深入地城。

498928.oracleText: Whenever Zalto, Fire Giant Duke is dealt damage, venture into the dungeon.
498928.translation: 每当火巨人公爵札尔托受到伤害时，深入地城。

498931.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
498931.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

498932.oracleText: Create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
498932.translation: 派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

498933.oracleText: At the end of the first combat phase on your turn, untap target creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
498933.translation: 在你回合首个战斗阶段的战斗结束时，重置目标由你操控的生物。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

498934.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the end of the first combat phase on your turn, untap target creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase."
498934.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「在你回合首个战斗阶段的战斗结束时，重置目标由你操控的生物。在此阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。」

498936.oracleText: Capable of moving swiftly through even tightly-packed earth and leaping surprising distances above ground, bulettes are difficult to escape once they've caught scent of prey.
498936.translation: 鲨蜥兽能在压实的土地里快速穿行，又能自地面高高跃起，猎物一旦被嗅到气味就很难逃脱。

498937.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
498937.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498938.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Bulette.
498938.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则在鲨蜥兽上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498940.oracleText: As the iron bars of the portcullis parted like reeds, the defenders of the keep suddenly felt much less secure.
498940.translation: 看着闸门铁条像芦苇一样分开，要塞守卫心凉了半截。

498941.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn. Untap it.
498941.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。将之重置。

498943.oracleText:
"Move it, Varis, or I'll pick one for you!"
—Ellywick Tumblestrum
498943.translation:
「快点，瓦力斯，否则我就替你选了！」
～艾利薇鼓琴

498946.oracleText: Choose one — • Two-Weapon Fighting — Double target creature's power and toughness until end of turn. • Archery — This spell deals 5 damage to target creature with flying.
498946.translation: 选择一项～ •  双武器战斗～将目标生物的力量与防御力加倍直到回合结束。 •  弓箭射击～此咒语对目标具飞行异能的生物造成5点伤害。

498949.oracleText: The realms protected by druids of the Circle of Dreams are gleaming, fruitful places, where dream and reality blur together and the weary can find rest.
498949.translation: 由梦境结社德鲁伊守护的国度通常都充满活力、硕果累累，其间梦境和现实交织，疲惫者能获得休息。

498952.oracleText: Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of nature who haunt the deepest parts of the wilderness.
498952.translation: 明月结社的德鲁伊是大自然的凶猛护卫，出没于荒野最深处。

498957.oracleText: "You might be four times my size, but I will not be ignored!"
498957.translation: 「你或许比我壮四倍，但你不能无视我！」

498958.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able.
498958.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3，且本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

498960.oracleText: Large as horses, dire wolves must hunt often to satisfy their ravenous hunger. A mere human does little more than blunt their appetite.
498960.translation: 凶暴狼大如马匹，必须时常捕食来满足其极度饥饿。一个人类只能稍稍降低它们的食欲。

498961.oracleText: {o1oG}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 and gains haste until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
498961.translation: {o1oG}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+2/+2且获得敏捷异能。每回合只能起动一次。

498962.oracleText: {o1oG}: Dire Wolf Prowler gets +2/+2 and gains haste until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
498962.translation: {o1oG}：直到回合结束，凶暴掠狼得+2/+2且获得敏捷异能。每回合只能起动一次。

498966.oracleText: This creature's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
498966.translation: 此生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

498967.oracleText: When this Class becomes level 3, target land you control becomes a creature with haste and "This creature's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control." It's still a land.
498967.translation: 当此职业成为等级3时，目标由你操控的地成为生物，且具有敏捷与「此生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。」它仍然是地。

498971.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. If it's legendary, you gain 3 life. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
498971.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌并将它置于你手上。如果它是传奇，则你获得3点生命。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

498972.oracleText: Creatures you control have trample and haste and get +2/+2 for each differently named dungeon you've completed.
498972.translation: 由你操控的生物具有践踏与敏捷异能，且你完成过的地城中每有一个不同名称便得+2/+2。

498973.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control have trample and haste and get +2/+2 for each differently named dungeon you've completed."
498973.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「由你操控的生物具有践踏与敏捷异能，且你完成过的地城中每有一个不同名称便得+2/+2。」

498976.oracleText: Since the fall of Elturel, they've walked the Sword Coast from Tethyr to Icewind Dale, eyes always on their prey.
498976.translation: 自从艾尔托瑞尔陷落后，他们便行走于剑湾，从泰瑟尔到冰风谷，密切留意其猎物。

498982.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile up to that many target cards from their graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME for each creature card exiled this way. You gain 1 life for each noncreature card exiled this way.
498982.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将至多等量的目标牌从其坟墓场放逐。每以此法放逐一张生物牌，便在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。每以此法放逐一张非生物牌，你便获得1点生命。

498983.oracleText: Whenever Froghemoth deals combat damage to a player, exile up to that many target cards from their graveyard. Put a +1/+1 counter on Froghemoth for each creature card exiled this way. You gain 1 life for each noncreature card exiled this way.
498983.translation: 每当沼喉怪对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将至多等量的目标牌从其坟墓场放逐。每以此法放逐一张生物牌，便在沼喉怪上放置一个+1/+1指示物。每以此法放逐一张非生物牌，你便获得1点生命。

498986.oracleText: Yipping and cackling, the hunters tore through the village, leaving nothing but snapped bones and burning homes in their wake.
498986.translation: 这些猎手鼓噪着喉头飞快穿过村庄，沿途只留下断骨和焚烧的房屋。

498987.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
498987.translation: 集群战术～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498988.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever Gnoll Hunter attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, put a +1/+1 counter on Gnoll Hunter.
498988.translation: 集群战术～每当豺狼人猎手攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则在豺狼人猎手上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

498990.oracleText: Green dragons take special pleasure in corrupting the good-hearted.
498990.translation: 绿龙酷爱腐蚀善心人士。

498995.oracleText: A shepherd's crook is useful for cleaning bits of wool out of the teeth.
498995.translation: 牧羊人手杖很适合用来剔除塞在牙缝里的羊毛。

498998.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a blue permanent you don't control.
498998.translation: 如果此咒语以不由你操控的蓝色永久物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

498999.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Then it deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
498999.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。然后它对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

499002.oracleText: "Wake up, my friends! There are deeds to be done and treasures to be won!"
499002.translation: 「醒醒，我的朋友们！有事情要做，有宝物要夺！」

499003.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
499003.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

499008.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a harmony counter on CARDNAME.
499008.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以在CARDNAME上放置一个和声指示物。

499009.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a harmony counter on Instrument of the Bards.
499009.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以在吟游诗人乐器上放置一个和声指示物。

499010.oracleText: {o3oG}, {oT}: Search your library for a creature card with mana value equal to the number of harmony counters on CARDNAME, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If that card is legendary, create a Treasure token. Then shuffle.
499010.translation: {o3oG}，{oT}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，且其法术力值须等同于CARDNAME上和声指示物的数量，展示该牌，将它置于你手上。如果该牌是传奇，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。然后洗牌。

499011.oracleText: {o3oG}, {oT}: Search your library for a creature card with mana value equal to the number of harmony counters on Instrument of the Bards, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If that card is legendary, create a Treasure token. Then shuffle.
499011.translation: {o3oG}，{oT}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，且其法术力值须等同于吟游诗人乐器上和声指示物的数量，展示该牌，将它置于你手上。如果该牌是传奇，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。然后洗牌。

499014.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, venture into the dungeon.
499014.translation: 集群战术～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则深入地城。

499015.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever Intrepid Outlander attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, venture into the dungeon.
499015.translation: 集群战术～每当无畏化外之民攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则深入地城。

499026.oracleText: A job well done means a rest well earned.
499026.translation: 工作干得好，休息睡到饱。

499027.oracleText: Return X target cards with different mana values from your graveyard to your hand. If eight or more cards were returned to your hand this way, your life total becomes equal to your starting life total. Exile CARDNAME.
499027.translation: 选择X张目标在你坟墓场中的牌，且其法术力值须各不相同。将它们从该处移回你手上。如果以此法将八张或更多牌移回你手上，则你的总生命成为等同于你的起始总生命。放逐CARDNAME。

499028.oracleText: Return X target cards with different mana values from your graveyard to your hand. If eight or more cards were returned to your hand this way, your life total becomes equal to your starting life total. Exile Long Rest.
499028.translation: 选择X张目标在你坟墓场中的牌，且其法术力值须各不相同。将它们从该处移回你手上。如果以此法将八张或更多牌移回你手上，则你的总生命成为等同于你的起始总生命。放逐长休。

499030.oracleText: "You see, stalac-tites grow down from the ceiling, while stalag-mites reach—AAHHHHHHHHH—"
499030.translation: 「你看，钟乳石从顶上往下长，而石笋则是从～啊啊啊～」

499031.oracleText: Lurking Roper doesn't untap during your untap step.
499031.translation: 伏击树绳妖于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

499032.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, untap Lurking Roper.
499032.translation: 每当你获得生命时，重置伏击树绳妖。

499034.oracleText: Its life force entwined with its tree, a dryad is an elusive and solitary being that wishes only to be left alone.
499034.translation: 树精寄身树木，生命缠绕合一，这种费解的独居生灵从不想被打扰。

499035.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
499035.translation: {o2}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

499036.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice Neverwinter Dryad: Search your library for a basic Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
499036.translation: {o2}，牺牲绝冬之森树精：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

499043.oracleText: The ancient green dragon Claugiyliamatar is often seen with a mangled corpse dangling from her mouth.
499043.translation: 远古绿龙克劳吉丽娅玛塔经常被人看到嘴边挂着尸体碎片。

499044.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, create that many Treasure tokens.
499044.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出等量的珍宝衍生物。

499047.oracleText: Many people believe a misguided wizard created the first owlbear, but others insist that these creatures have always dwelled in the Feywild.
499047.translation: 许多人相信第一头枭头熊是法师出错的成品，其他人则坚持认为这些生物一直住在妖精荒野。

499051.oracleText: The dragon's noxious breath withered the forest. The whistle of a hundred arrows filled the air. The ground roiled as if shaken by an earthquake. The tyrant fell from the sky.
499051.translation: 巨龙毒息焦炙树林。箭支成百呼啸天空。震波轰响传遍大地。天际暴君已然坠落。

499056.oracleText: Underground civilizations maintain magical barriers around their settlements to deter these monsters.
499056.translation: 地底文明在居处周围立起魔法屏障来阻止这些怪物。

499057.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if a creature died this turn.
499057.translation: 如果本回合中有生物死去，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

499061.oracleText: Whenever you attack, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature.
499061.translation: 每当你攻击时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

499064.oracleText: With the right weapon, a fearsome beholder is nothing more than a big floating bullseye.
499064.translation: 有了合适的武器，可怕的眼魔也不过是个巨大飞靶。

499065.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+1 and has reach.
499065.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+1且具有延势异能。

499068.oracleText: "I could help you, or I could eat you for lunch. I haven't decided yet."
499068.translation: 「我可以帮上你，也可以吃掉你。我还没决定好。」

499070.oracleText: "Every coin helps rebuild the town they destroyed."
499070.translation: 「每一枚硬币都会用于重建遭其毁坏的城镇。」

499071.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each mana from a Treasure that was spent to cast this spell. Then that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
499071.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物与目标由对手操控的生物。施放此咒语时每支付过一点来自珍宝的法术力，前者便得+1/+0直到回合结束。然后前者对后者造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

499079.oracleText: CARDNAME has haste and ward {o10} as long as it was cast.
499079.translation: 只要CARDNAME经牌手施放，它便具有敏捷与守护{o10}。

499080.oracleText: The Tarrasque has haste and ward {o10} as long as it was cast.
499080.translation: 只要末日毁灭兽经牌手施放，它便具有敏捷与守护{o1}0。

499081.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it fights target creature defending player controls.
499081.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它与目标由防御牌手操控的生物互斗。

499082.oracleText: Whenever The Tarrasque attacks, it fights target creature defending player controls.
499082.translation: 每当末日毁灭兽攻击时，它与目标由防御牌手操控的生物互斗。

499084.oracleText:
"See how the statues all have chunks bitten out of them? We're dealing with a basilisk, or I'm a froghemoth."
—Larissa Kyriln, learned warlock
499084.translation:
「看到这些雕像都被咬下了一大块吗？我要不是沼喉怪的话，就说明我们要去对付石化蜥蜴了。」
～博学的邪术师拉丽萨姬琳

499087.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature or planeswalker spell, venture into the dungeon. This ability triggers only once each turn.
499087.translation: 每当你施放生物或鹏洛客咒语时，深入地城。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

499088.oracleText: Whenever you complete a dungeon, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
499088.translation: 每当你完成地城时，派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

499091.oracleText: "There's a new ballad waiting to be born around every corner."
499091.translation: 「随处都有新的歌谣等待诞生。」

499092.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you had a land enter the battlefield under your control this turn, venture into the dungeon.
499092.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有地在你的操控下进战场，则深入地城。

499094.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, draw a card.
499094.translation: 集群战术～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则抓一张牌。

499095.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever Werewolf Pack Leader attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, draw a card.
499095.translation: 集群战术～每当狼人群首领攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则抓一张牌。

499096.oracleText: {o3oG}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME has base power and toughness 5/3, gains trample, and isn't a Human.
499096.translation: {o3oG}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力为5/3，获得践踏异能，且不是人类。

499097.oracleText: {o3oG}: Until end of turn, Werewolf Pack Leader has base power and toughness 5/3, gains trample, and isn't a Human.
499097.translation: {o3oG}：直到回合结束，狼人群首领的基础力量与防御力为5/3，获得践踏异能，且不是人类。

499102.oracleText: Choose one. Until end of turn, target creature you control has that base power and toughness, becomes that creature type, and gains that ability. • 1/3 Turtle with hexproof. • 1/5 Spider with reach. • 3/3 Elephant with trample.
499102.translation: 选择一项。直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物具有相应的基础力量与防御力，成为相应生物类别，且获得相应异能。 •  1/3龟，辟邪。 •  1/5蜘蛛，延势。 •  3/3象，践踏。

499105.oracleText: Choose one — • Smash It — Destroy target artifact. • Lift the Curse — Destroy target enchantment. • Steal Its Eyes — Create a Treasure token and venture into the dungeon.
499105.translation: 选择一项～ •  砸碎雕像～消灭目标神器。 •  解除诅咒～消灭目标结界。 •  偷走双眼～派出一个珍宝衍生物并深入地城。

499109.oracleText: Choose one — • Journey On — Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle. • Make Camp — Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
499109.translation: 选择一项～ •  继续旅行～从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。 •  就地扎营～将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

499113.oracleText: Choose one — • Form a Party — Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal any number of creature cards from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. • Start a Brawl — Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
499113.translation: 选择一项～ •  组成团队～检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中任意数量的生物牌，并将它们置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。 •  互相争斗～由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。

499116.oracleText: Gold dragons are the greatest of the metallic dragons in size, power, and wisdom, and often take it upon themselves to safeguard mortal communities from evils that might threaten them.
499116.translation: 金龙在金属龙里体型、力量与智慧均为上乘，通常自愿担起责任守护凡人社群不受邪恶威胁。

499120.oracleText: Legendary spells you cast cost {oRoG} less to cast. This effect reduces only the amount of colored mana you pay.
499120.translation: 你施放的传奇咒语减少{oRoG}来施放。此效应仅减少你支付的有色法术力数量。

499122.oracleText: Whenever you cast a legendary spell, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play them this turn.
499122.translation: 每当你施放传奇咒语时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

499125.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, return up to one creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield if you've completed a dungeon.
499125.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，如果你完成过地城，则将至多一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

499126.oracleText: Whenever Barrowin of Clan Undurr attacks, return up to one creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield if you've completed a dungeon.
499126.translation: 每当乌杜尔部族的芭罗雯攻击时，如果你完成过地城，则将至多一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

499128.oracleText: "Knew I'd find ye in trouble if I came out an' looked for ye!"
499128.translation: 「就知道我每次去找你，你都会有麻烦！」

499129.oracleText: Each creature you control gets +2/+0 for each Equipment attached to it.
499129.translation: 对每个由你操控的生物而言，其上每贴附一个武具，便得+2/+0。

499130.oracleText: You may pay {o0} rather than pay the equip cost of the first equip ability you activate each turn.
499130.translation: 你每回合首度起动佩带异能时可以支付{o0}，而不支付其佩带费用。

499135.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies, if it had power greater than Drizzt's power, put a number of +1/+1 counters on Drizzt equal to the difference.
499135.translation: 每当一个生物死去时，若其力量大于崔斯特，则在崔斯特上放置等同于该差距数量的+1/+1指示物。

499138.oracleText: "A pact is a tool, not a damnation."

499139.oracleText: Dark One's Own Luck — Whenever you roll one or more dice, CARDNAME gains flying and menace until end of turn. If any of those results was 10 or higher, draw a card.
499139.translation: 黑暗强运～每当你掷一颗或数颗骰子时，CARDNAME获得飞行与威慑异能直到回合结束。如果其中任一掷骰结果为10点或更大，则抓一张牌。

499140.oracleText: Dark One's Own Luck — Whenever you roll one or more dice, Farideh, Devil's Chosen gains flying and menace until end of turn. If any of those results was 10 or higher, draw a card.
499140.translation: 黑暗强运～每当你掷一颗或数颗骰子时，魔王子民法莉黛获得飞行与威慑异能直到回合结束。如果其中任一掷骰结果为10点或更大，则抓一张牌。

499146.oracleText: Equip abilities you activate cost {o2} less to activate.
499146.translation: 你起动的佩带异能减少{o2}来起动。

499148.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks, up to one target creature blocks it this combat if able.
499148.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，至多一个目标生物本次战斗若能阻挡它，则须如此作。

499151.oracleText: "Plant what you wish to see grow. Listen for the stories you want to hear told."
499151.translation: 「种下你希望大地生长的东西。聆听你想让人们传颂的故事。」

499152.oracleText: {o2oGoU}: Draw a card. You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
499152.translation: {o2oGoU}：抓一张牌。你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

499154.oracleText: "Someone took the time to carve these inscriptions. The least we can do is care enough to read them."
499154.translation: 「有人花时间刻下这些铭文。我们至少应该仔细解读。」

499155.oracleText: Room abilities of dungeons you own trigger an additional time.
499155.translation: 由你拥有之地城的房间异能均额外触发一次。

499162.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player loses 1 life and mills a card, then you gain 1 life and scry 1.
499162.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手失去1点生命且磨一张牌，然后你获得1点生命且占卜1。

499163.oracleText: Whenever Krydle of Baldur's Gate deals combat damage to a player, that player loses 1 life and mills a card, then you gain 1 life and scry 1.
499163.translation: 每当博德之门的克吕德对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手失去1点生命且磨一张牌，然后你获得1点生命且占卜1。

499164.oracleText: Whenever you attack, you may pay {o2}. If you do, target creature can't be blocked this turn.
499164.translation: 每当你攻击时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

499169.oracleText: {oX}: Until end of turn, target creature you control has base power and toughness X/X and becomes a Giant in addition to its other types. Activate only as a sorcery.
499169.translation: {oX}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物之基础力量与防御力为X/X，且额外具有巨人此类别。只能于法术时机起动。

499171.oracleText: The second spell you cast each turn costs {o1} less to cast.
499171.translation: 你每回合中施放的第二个咒语减少{o1}来施放。

499173.oracleText: When this Class becomes level 2, return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
499173.translation: 当此职业成为等级2时，将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

499175.oracleText: You may cast this card from exile as long as you've cast another spell this turn.
499175.translation: 只要你本回合中施放过其他咒语，你便可以从放逐区施放此牌。

499176.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. For as long as it remains exiled, it has "You may cast this card from exile as long as you've cast another spell this turn."
499176.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。于其持续放逐的时段内，它具有「只要你本回合中施放过其他咒语，你便可以从放逐区施放此牌。」

499178.oracleText: Each other creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. You lose X life.
499178.translation: 每个其他生物各得-X/-X直到回合结束。你失去X点生命。

499179.oracleText: Each other creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. You lose X life.
499179.translation: 每个其他生物各得-X/-X直到回合结束。你失去X点生命。

499180.oracleText: Return up to X target creature cards with total mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. They gain haste until end of turn.
499180.translation: 选择至多X张目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于X。将它们从该处移回战场。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

499181.oracleText: Return up to X target creature cards with total mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. They gain haste until end of turn.
499181.translation: 选择至多X张目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于X。将它们从该处移回战场。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

499185.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of that player's library face down. You may look at it for as long as it remains exiled.
499185.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，牌面朝下地放逐该牌手的牌库顶牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视它。

499188.oracleText: You may play cards exiled with CARDNAME, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
499188.translation: 你可以使用以CARDNAME放逐的牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放这类咒语的费用。

499189.oracleText: You may play cards exiled with Rogue Class, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
499189.translation: 你可以使用以职业：盗贼放逐的牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放这类咒语的费用。

499195.oracleText: Whispers of the Grave — At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.
499195.translation: 坟墓低语～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

499198.oracleText: Each Skeleton you control has trample, attacks each combat if able, and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of other Skeletons you control.
499198.translation: 对每个由你操控的骷髅妖而言，其具有践踏异能，每次战斗若能攻击则必须攻击，且得+X/+0，X为由你操控之其他骷髅妖数量。

499199.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a tapped 1/1 black Skeleton creature token. If a creature died this turn, create two of those tokens instead.
499199.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个已横置的1/1黑色骷髅妖衍生生物。若本回合中有生物死去，改为派出两个上述衍生物。

499204.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU} or {oR}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell or to gain a Class level.
499204.translation: {oT}：加{oU}或{oR}。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语，或是获得职业等级。

499205.oracleText: Creatures you control have "{oT}: Add {oU} or {oR}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell or to gain a Class level."
499205.translation: 由你操控的生物具有「{oT}：加{oU}或{oR}。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语，或是获得职业等级。」

499207.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, that spell deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of instant and sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
499207.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，该咒语向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于你本回合中施放过的瞬间和法术咒语数量。

499209.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, attacking creatures get +1/+0 until end of turn.
499209.translation: 集群战术～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则进行攻击的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

499210.oracleText: Pack tactics — Whenever Targ Nar, Demon-Fang Gnoll attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, attacking creatures get +1/+0 until end of turn.
499210.translation: 集群战术～每当魔齿豺狼人塔格纳攻击时，若你本次战斗中用以攻击之生物力量总和等于或大于6，则进行攻击的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

499211.oracleText: {o2oRoG}: Double Targ Nar's power and toughness until end of turn.
499211.translation: {o2oRoG}：将塔格纳的力量与防御力加倍直到回合结束。

499218.oracleText: "Eilistraee teaches us that we are not bound by the circumstances of our birth. We all may find beauty and light, if we have the courage to seek them."
499218.translation: 「艾丽丝翠教导我们不要受出身所限。拿出勇气去追寻，我们都能找到美丽和光明。」

499222.oracleText: Whenever Triumphant Adventurer attacks, venture into the dungeon.
499222.translation: 每当凯旋冒险者攻击时，深入地城。

499224.oracleText: "The beholder told me I had a good eye for details. Who was I to argue?"
499224.translation: 「那个眼魔说我看细节的眼光极好。我有什么资格跟他争论呢？」

499225.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell that doesn't share a creature type with a creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard, copy that spell.
499225.translation: 每当你施放与由你操控的生物或你坟墓场中之生物牌均不具共通生物类别的生物咒语时，复制该咒语。

499226.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell that doesn't share a creature type with a creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard, copy that spell. (A copy of a creature spell becomes a token.)
499226.translation: 每当你施放与由你操控的生物或你坟墓场中之生物牌均不具共通生物类别的生物咒语时，复制该咒语。（生物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

499228.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, choose target opponent. Until end of turn, that player can't cast spells, you may look at the top card of their library any time, you may play the top card of their library, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast spells this way.
499228.translation: 在你的维持开始时，选择目标对手。直到回合结束，该牌手不能施放咒语，你可以随时检视其牌库顶牌，你可以使用其牌库顶牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付以此法施放之咒语的费用。

499236.oracleText: "Wait, is that a secret door? I can't tell for sure . . . there's some blood in the way."
499236.translation: 「等等，那个是密门吗？我也不确定…不过沿途有血迹。」

499237.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Venture into the dungeon. Activate only as a sorcery.
499237.translation: {o3}，{oT}：深入地城。只能于法术时机起动。

499239.oracleText: "I see all things as they truly are! I see . . . decay in all flesh, and betrayal in every heart."
499239.translation: 「我看到了万物真实样貌！我看到了…所有肉体内的腐朽，以及所有心中的背叛。」

499242.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay {o2}. If you do, you draw a card and you lose 2 life.
499242.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则你抓一张牌且失去2点生命。

499244.oracleText: Climb Over — {oT}: Target Wall can't block this turn.
499244.translation: 攀越～{oT}：目标墙本回合不能进行阻挡。

499246.oracleText: Tie Up — {o3}, {oT}: Target creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
499246.translation: 捆绑～{o3}，{oT}：目标生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

499248.oracleText: Rappel Down — {o4}, {oT}: Venture into the dungeon. Activate only as a sorcery.
499248.translation: 降下～{o4}，{oT}：深入地城。只能于法术时机起动。

499251.oracleText: "If you're so mighty, scaled one, then why are you dead?"
499251.translation: 「有鳞片的家伙，如果你真那么厉害，怎么会死呢？」

499253.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, equipped creature or a creature you control named Vecna gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
499253.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，佩带此武具的生物或一个由你操控且名称为威可那的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你手牌的数量。

499254.oracleText: Equip—Pay 1 life for each card in your hand.
499254.translation: 佩带～你每有一张手牌，便支付1点生命。

499256.oracleText: Once an iron golem is set to a task, it won't turn aside until that task is complete or it has been destroyed.
499256.translation: 一旦身负任务，铁魔像只有完成任务或者遭破坏才会停下。

499257.oracleText: Iron Golem attacks or blocks each combat if able.
499257.translation: 铁魔像每次战斗若能攻击或阻挡，则须如此作。

499259.translation: 重量轻，灵活性高，保护力强。

499260.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+1 and has ward {o1}.
499260.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+1且具有守护{o1}。

499261.oracleText: Equip {o0}. Activate only once each turn.
499261.translation: 佩带{o0}。每回合只能起动一次。

499263.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Mimic: Add one mana of any color.
499263.translation: {oT}，牺牲拟身怪：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

499264.oracleText: {o2}: CARDNAME becomes a Shapeshifter artifact creature with base power and toughness 3/3 until end of turn.
499264.translation: {o2}：CARDNAME成为基础力量与防御力为3/3的变形兽神器生物直到回合结束。

499265.oracleText: {o2}: Mimic becomes a Shapeshifter artifact creature with base power and toughness 3/3 until end of turn.
499265.translation: {o2}：拟身怪成为基础力量与防御力为3/3的变形兽神器生物直到回合结束。

499267.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice Spare Dagger. When you do, this creature deals 1 damage to any target.
499267.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲备用匕首。当你如此作时，此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

499268.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice Spare Dagger. When you do, this creature deals 1 damage to any target."
499268.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有「每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲备用匕首。当你如此作时，此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

499287.oracleText: {o4oW}: CARDNAME becomes a 3/4 white Dragon creature with flying until end of turn. It's still a land.
499287.translation: {o4oW}：CARDNAME成为3/4白色，具飞行异能的龙生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

499288.oracleText: {o4oW}: Cave of the Frost Dragon becomes a 3/4 white Dragon creature with flying until end of turn. It's still a land.
499288.translation: {o4oW}：霜龙洞穴成为3/4白色，具飞行异能的龙生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

499291.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
499291.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

499292.oracleText: {o3oR}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a 3/2 red Goblin creature with "Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking." It's still a land.
499292.translation: {o3oR}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为3/2红色鬼怪生物，且具有「每当此生物攻击时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。」它仍然是地。

499293.oracleText: {o3oR}: Until end of turn, Den of the Bugbear becomes a 3/2 red Goblin creature with "Whenever this creature attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking." It's still a land.
499293.translation: {o3oR}：直到回合结束，熊哥布林窝巢成为3/2红色鬼怪生物，且具有「每当此生物攻击时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。」它仍然是地。

499296.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Tap an untapped legendary creature you control: Venture into the dungeon. Activate only as a sorcery.
499296.translation: {o4}，{oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的传奇生物：深入地城。只能于法术时机起动。

499297.oracleText: Parts of Faerun still churn with the magic of arrogant Netherese archmages long dead.
499297.translation: 虽然耐瑟瑞尔的自负大法师早已死去，费伦的某些部分仍受其魔法扰动。

499300.oracleText: {o5oU}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a 7/7 blue Giant creature with ward {o3}. It's still a land.
499300.translation: {o5oU}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为7/7蓝色，具守护{o3}的巨人生物。它仍然是地。

499301.oracleText: {o5oU}: Until end of turn, Hall of Storm Giants becomes a 7/7 blue Giant creature with ward {o3}. It's still a land.
499301.translation: {o5oU}：直到回合结束，风暴巨人大厅成为7/7蓝色，具守护{o3}的巨人生物。它仍然是地。

499304.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, exile target card from defending player's graveyard.
499304.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，将目标牌从防御牌手的坟墓场放逐。

499305.oracleText: {o3oB}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a 3/3 black Beholder creature with menace and "Whenever this creature attacks, exile target card from defending player's graveyard." It's still a land.
499305.translation: {o3oB}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为3/3黑色眼魔生物，且具有威慑与「每当此生物攻击时，将目标牌从防御牌手的坟墓场放逐。」它仍然是地。

499306.oracleText: {o3oB}: Until end of turn, Hive of the Eye Tyrant becomes a 3/3 black Beholder creature with menace and "Whenever this creature attacks, exile target card from defending player's graveyard." It's still a land.
499306.translation: {o3oB}：直到回合结束，魔眼暴君栖巢成为3/3黑色眼魔生物，且具有威慑与「每当此生物攻击时，将目标牌从防御牌手的坟墓场放逐。」它仍然是地。

499309.oracleText: {oXoG}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes an X/X green Hydra creature. It's still a land. X can't be 0.
499309.translation: {oXoG}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为X/X绿色多头龙生物。它仍然是地。X不能为0。

499310.oracleText: {oXoG}: Until end of turn, Lair of the Hydra becomes an X/X green Hydra creature. It's still a land. X can't be 0.
499310.translation: {oXoG}：直到回合结束，多头蛇蜥巢穴成为X/X绿色多头龙生物。它仍然是地。X不能为0。

499316.oracleText: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.
499316.translation: 其中财富足以主宰王朝兴亡。

499317.oracleText: {oXoX}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create X Treasure tokens.

499318.oracleText: {oXoX}, {oT}, Sacrifice Treasure Vault: Create X Treasure tokens.
499318.translation: {oXoX}，{oT}，牺牲宝窖：派出X个珍宝衍生物。

499329.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} become a 2/1 Construct artifact creature with flying and ward {o1}?
499329.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}成为2/1，具飞行与守护{o1}的组构体神器生物？

499330.oracleText: Target a creature without first strike, double strike, or vigilance.
499330.translation: 指定一个不具先攻，连击或警戒异能的生物为目标。

499331.oracleText: Target any number of other creatures you control.
499331.translation: 指定任意数量由你操控的其他生物为目标。

499333.oracleText: Target up to one artifact or creature you control.
499333.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的神器或生物为目标。

499334.oracleText: Target a nontoken artifact you control.
499334.translation: 指定一个由你操控且非衍生物的神器为目标。

499337.oracleText: Target a non-Ooze creature an opponent controls.
499337.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且非流浆的生物为目标。

499338.oracleText: Target a creature card exiled with {1, CardId}.
499338.translation: 指定一个被{1, CardId}放逐的生物为目标。

499339.oracleText: Target a non-Angel, non-Demon, non-Devil, non-Dragon creature.
499339.translation: 指定一个非天使、非恶魔、非魔鬼且非龙的生物为目标。

499340.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or a Treasure.
499340.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或一个珍宝。

499347.oracleText: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
499347.translation: 此生物对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

499350.oracleText: {oR}, Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand: Add {oCoCoR}. Activate only as a sorcery.
499350.translation: {oR}，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上：加{oCoCoR}。只能于法术时机起动。

499351.oracleText: {oR}, Return Grinning Ignus to its owner's hand: Add {oCoCoR}. Activate only as a sorcery.
499351.translation: {oR}，将蔑笑火灵移回其拥有者手上：加{oCoCoR}。只能于法术时机起动。

499352.oracleText: If an opponent controls more lands than you, search your library for up to three Plains cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
499352.translation: 如果某对手操控的地比你多，则从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张平原牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

499353.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker with mana value 3 or less.
499353.translation: 消灭目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物或鹏洛客。

499354.oracleText: Target player reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it with mana value 3 or less. That player discards that card.
499354.translation: 目标牌手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

499355.oracleText: Gain control of target creature with mana value 3 or less until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
499355.translation: 获得目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物之操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

499356.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
499356.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，展示这些牌，将一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

499357.oracleText: Search your library for a green creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
499357.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张绿色生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

499358.oracleText: Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
499358.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，展示该牌，并将它置于你手上。然后洗牌。

499359.oracleText: Choose two — • Target player gains 7 life. • Put target noncreature permanent on top of its owner's library. • Target player shuffles their graveyard into their library. • Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
499359.translation: 选择两项～ •  目标牌手获得7点生命。 •  将目标非生物的永久物置于其拥有者的牌库顶。 •  目标牌手将其坟墓场洗入其牌库。 •  从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

499360.oracleText: Exile target permanent with mana value 4 or greater.
499360.translation: 放逐目标法术力值等于或大于4的永久物。

499361.oracleText: You've traced the tensions in Ten-Towns to the dwindling reindeer populations . . . but what has been hunting them?
499361.translation: 你发现十镇紧张气氛的根源是驯鹿数量减少…但究竟是什么在猎杀它们？

499362.oracleText: Seeking to learn why the ancestors have fallen silent, you've made your way to their ancient cairns.
499362.translation: 你动身前往先祖的古代石冢，想要弄清它们沉默不语的原因。

499363.oracleText: Searching for a vanished caravan that was bound for Silverymoon, you've come to a bank of mysterious fog.
499363.translation: 你听闻一支前往银月城的商队消失无踪，于是动身搜索，不久就遇到一股神秘迷雾。

499364.oracleText: Venturing beneath the desert sands, you've discovered an alien power pulsing with inconceivable energy.
499364.translation: 你冒险深入黄沙之底，找到一股脉动着不可思议能源的奇异力量。

499365.oracleText: In crystal-studded waters far below the surface, you've discovered an incubating egg of mysterious origin.
499365.translation: 你在布满结晶的水下深处发现一颗蛋，它来源不明，且正在孵化。

499366.oracleText: After careful study, you've determined that the giant ruins served to track the movement of the planets . . . and they will soon align once more.
499366.translation: 你经过一番研究，推定这些巨大遗迹是为追踪行星轨迹而建…而它们不久之后即将再次连成一线。

499367.oracleText: As your ship clears the edge of Waterdeep harbor, you notice pirate sails on the horizon. What has made them so bold?
499367.translation: 你的船扫清了深水城港口周遭，此时你注意到海平面上出现海盗船帆影。是什么原因让他们如此放肆？

499368.oracleText: Alarmed by the news you brought, the storm giant king of the Maelstrom has called his kin to council.
499368.translation: 你带来的消息警醒了漩涡堡的风暴巨人王，他随即召集族人讨论相关事宜。

499369.oracleText: As a plague ravages the world above, you've made your way into the Underdark in search of a fungal panacea.
499369.translation: 你来到幽暗地域探寻真菌灵药，想为正受瘟疫摧残的地上世界带来生机。

499370.oracleText: Your search for a stolen artifact has brought you to the edge of the Mere of Dead Men.
499370.translation: 你一路探寻遭窃神器，来到了亡者沼泽边缘。

499371.oracleText: As you trudge through the sewers of Baldur's Gate it dawns on you: where are all the rats?
499371.translation: 你在博德之门的下水道费力前行，一个念头自脑际闪过：老鼠都去哪里了？

499372.oracleText: You expected to meet hostile drow in this ancient ruin . . . but they fled long ago. What darkness could have driven them out?
499372.translation: 你本以为会在这片古老遗迹中遇到怀有敌意的卓尔精灵…但他们早已逃离。连他们都无法抗衡的黑暗究竟是何等面貌？

499373.oracleText: You meant to simply rest in Hundelstone, but the miners have told you stories of whispers in the dark below.
499373.translation: 你本只想在海德尔之石镇小憩，但矿工讲述的地底黑暗细语故事让你无法不在意。

499374.oracleText: Your path lies across the Spine of the World, where every cave hides some new danger.
499374.translation: 你的旅程需要穿越世界之脊，那里的每个洞穴都暗藏着新的危险。

499375.oracleText: You've ventured deep into the heart of the mountain to determine what can calm its quaking rage.
499375.translation: 你深入山脉的内部，希望找出方法抚平其隆震狂怒。

499376.oracleText: As you make camp near the ancient ruin, you hear the sound of drums echoing in halls where no dwarf has lived in generations.
499376.translation: 你于古老遗迹附近扎营时，听见鼓声在大厅中回响，但数代之前便已无矮人居住该处。

499377.oracleText: As the sun reaches its zenith on the day of the solstice, a castle shimmers into view on the hilltop, just as the ancient text predicted.
499377.translation: 太阳于至日升到天顶，此时一座城堡逐渐显现于山顶，正如古代文字所预示。

499378.oracleText: As you venture deeper under the boughs of Neverwinter Wood, arrows in a tree trunk suggest you might not be welcome.
499378.translation: 你在绝冬之森的树荫之下越走越深，树干上的箭表明，你在这里或许不受欢迎。

499379.oracleText: Before the elf queen will aid you, you must find a way to cure the strange rot afflicting the roots of the ancient trees.
499379.translation: 你要想得精灵女王出手相助，便需先治愈古老树根，使其免受怪异腐疾折磨。

499380.oracleText: Target a creature card with mana value 3 or less.
499380.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌为目标。

499381.oracleText: Target a spell or permanent with mana value 1 or greater.
499381.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或大于1的咒语或永久物为目标。

499384.oracleText: Search for up to four creature cards with different names that have mana value {2, Number} or less.
499384.translation: 搜寻至多四张名称各不相同且法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的四张生物牌。

499387.oracleText: Search for a creature card with lesser mana value.
499387.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值更小的生物牌。

499388.oracleText: Target a creature card with mana value 2 or less.
499388.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌为目标。

499389.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value less than or equal to {1, CardId}'s power from among them without paying its mana cost?
499389.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用施放其中一个法术力值等于或小于{1, CardId}之力量的瞬间或法术咒语？

499390.oracleText: Target a noncreature, nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less.
499390.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于2的非生物且非地永久物为目标。

500575.oracleText: Target a creature card with mana value 1.
500575.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于1的生物牌为目标。

500578.oracleText: Target a permanent card with mana value 3 or less.
500578.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌为目标。

500595.oracleText: Put a nonland permanent card with mana value {2, Number} or less onto the battlefield?
500595.translation: 是否要将一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的非地永久物牌放进战场？

501763.oracleText: Search for an artifact card with mana value equal to 1 plus the sacrificed artifact's mana value.
501763.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于所牺牲之神器的法术力值加1的神器牌。

501764.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less.
501764.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于2的非地永久物为目标。

501772.oracleText: Put a harmony counter on {1, CardId}?
501772.translation: 是否要在{1, CardId}上放置一个和声指示物？

501773.oracleText: Search for a creature card with mana value equal to the number of harmony counters on {1, CardId}.
501773.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于{1, CardId}上和声指示物的数量的生物牌。

501787.oracleText: Search for a card named Monk of the Open Hand.
501787.translation: 搜寻一张名称为散打武僧的牌。

501788.oracleText: Get equipped creature or a creature you control named Vecna.
501788.translation: 选择佩带此武具的生物或一个由你操控且名称为威可那的生物。

501805.oracleText: Light streaked down from the heavens, and a voice whispered in the soldier's ear, "You shall not fall today."
501805.translation: 只见一道明光自天而降，士兵耳中传来细语幽声：「你今天不会死。」

501806.oracleText: Whenever a creature attacks, you may pay {o3}. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
501806.translation: 每当一个生物攻击时，你可以支付{o3}。当你如此作时，在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

501871.oracleText: In a flash of light and a burst of aether, despair turned to hope and defeat turned to victory.
501871.translation: 随着一阵亮光闪动、乙太爆发，原本的绝望顿成希望，颓势立转胜势。

501872.oracleText: Return all artifact, enchantment, and planeswalker cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
501872.translation: 将所有神器、结界和鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

501937.oracleText: The "legend rule" doesn't apply to permanents you control.
501937.translation: 「传奇规则」不对由你操控的永久物生效。

502013.oracleText: Checking around every corner doesn't help if you forget to look up.
502013.translation: 你要是忘了向上瞧一瞧，四下检查得再仔细也没用。

502014.oracleText: Whenever a token you control leaves the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
502014.translation: 每当一个由你操控的衍生物离开战场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

502060.oracleText:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord
502060.translation:
「去死吧。知道你这悲惨的一生能为我换回莫大回报，你也死得明白。」
～巫妖领主祝亚许

502139.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +4/+0 and has trample.
502139.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+4/+0且具有践踏异能。

502144.oracleText: CARDNAME can't attack a player it has already attacked this turn.
502144.translation: CARDNAME不能攻击它本回合中攻击过的牌手。

502145.oracleText: Port Razer can't attack a player it has already attacked this turn.
502145.translation: 港口劫盗不能攻击它本回合中攻击过的牌手。

502236.oracleText: "Run!" screamed its living mouths. "Come!" cried its dead ones.
502236.translation: 「快逃！」身上的活口尖叫道。「快来！」身上的死物咆哮着。

502237.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Elves you control plus the number of Elf cards in your graveyard.
502237.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的妖精数量与你坟墓场中的妖精牌数量之总和。

502238.oracleText: Abomination of Llanowar's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Elves you control plus the number of Elf cards in your graveyard.
502238.translation: 罗堰憎恶兽的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的妖精数量与你坟墓场中的妖精牌数量之总和。

502260.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
502260.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

502288.oracleText: "I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."
502288.translation: 「我与部落每位成员并肩，他们也时刻与我同在。」

502289.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
502289.translation: 你每操控一个其上有+1/+1指示物的生物，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

502290.oracleText: Creature spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
502290.translation: 你每操控一个其上有+1/+1指示物的生物，你施放的生物咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

502303.oracleText: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."
502303.translation: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."

502304.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on Juri, Master of the Revue.
502304.translation: 每当你牺牲一个永久物时，在剧团业主裘里上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

502305.oracleText: When Juri dies, it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
502305.translation: 当裘里死去时，它对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

502314.oracleText: {oT}: Each player may draw a card, then each player who drew a card this way gains 1 life.
502314.translation: {oT}：每位牌手各可以抓一张牌，然后每位以此法抓牌的牌手各获得1点生命。

502316.oracleText: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.
502316.translation: 眼前生物的尊贵气质让猎手深受触动，她热泪盈眶地放下手中弓箭。

502317.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life this turn, distribute up to that many +1/+1 counters among any number of other target creatures.
502317.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则将至多等量之+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量的其他目标生物。

502336.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control that's enchanted or equipped attacks, that creature gains double strike until end of turn.
502336.translation: 每当一个由你操控且已结附灵气或已佩带武具的生物攻击时，该生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

502351.oracleText: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.
502351.translation: 它起初就只是水滴。魔法明镜将之晶化为更有用的事物。

502420.oracleText: Target up to two other creatures.
502420.translation: 指定至多两个其他生物为目标。

502421.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
502421.translation: 在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

502442.oracleText: Distribute counters among any number of other target creatures.
502442.translation: 将指示物分配给任意数量的其他目标生物。

502443.oracleText: Target any number of other creatures.
502443.translation: 指定任意数量的其他生物为目标。

502448.oracleText: "Flesh is a betrayal of the self."

502449.oracleText: Golems you control have first strike.
502449.translation: 由你操控的魔像具有先攻异能。

502453.oracleText: Return each nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand.
502453.translation: 将每个不由你操控的非地永久物各移回其拥有者手上。

502470.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. Morbid — CARDNAME deals 5 damage instead if a creature died this turn.
502470.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。丧心～如果本回合中有生物死去，则改为CARDNAME造成5点伤害。

502471.oracleText:
Brimstone Volley deals 3 damage to any target. 
Morbid — Brimstone Volley deals 5 damage instead if a creature died this turn.
502471.translation:
硫磺射击对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。
丧心～如果本回合中有生物死去，则改为硫磺射击造成5点伤害。

502476.oracleText: Target creature gains double strike until end of turn. Ferocious — That creature also gains trample until end of turn if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
502476.translation: 目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。威猛～如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则受影响的生物再获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

502477.oracleText:
Target creature gains double strike until end of turn. 
Ferocious — That creature also gains trample until end of turn if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
502477.translation:
目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。
威猛～如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则受影响的生物再获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

502492.oracleText: As long as Arixmethes has a slumber counter on it, it's a land.
502492.translation: 只要阿力马昔斯上有静眠指示物，它便是地。

502493.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you may remove a slumber counter from Arixmethes.
502493.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，你可以从阿力马昔斯上移去一个静眠指示物。

502497.oracleText: Breya deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker.
502497.translation: 布莱娅对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

502498.oracleText: Breya deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker.
502498.translation: 布莱娅对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

502499.oracleText: Target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn.
502499.translation: 目标生物得-4/-4直到回合结束。

502501.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice two artifacts: Choose one — • Breya deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker. • Target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn. • You gain 5 life.
502501.translation: {o2}，牺牲两个神器：选择一项～ •  布莱娅对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 •  目标生物得-4/-4直到回合结束。 •  你获得5点生命。

502503.oracleText: Creature tokens you control have haste.
502503.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物具有敏捷异能。

502520.oracleText: Whenever a permanent becomes untapped, that permanent's controller mills a card.
502520.translation: 每当一个永久物成为未横置时，该永久物的操控者磨一张牌。

502521.oracleText:
"Even if we defeat it, what remains to be saved?"
—Glissa Sunseeker
502521.translation:
「就算我们击败了它，又还能救下什么东西？」
～寻日者格莉莎

502522.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token and that player mills ten cards.
502522.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物，且该牌手磨十张牌。

502525.oracleText: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.
502525.translation: 克撒渴求力量与知识，深掘多明纳里亚古老的过往。

502526.oracleText: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.
502526.translation: 克撒全力投入其研究，一再突破可能性与道德的边界。

502527.oracleText: Urza studied the creations of the Thran not simply to learn from them, but to surpass them.
502527.translation: 克撒钻研索蓝造物，不仅从中学习，更欲凌驾其上。
