507015.translation: {o3oUoU}：将受惊而醒从你的坟墓场放进战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

507049.oracleText: {o1}, Discard a card: Create a 1/1 black Vampire Knight creature token with lifelink. Activate only once each turn.
507049.translation: {o1}，弃一张牌：派出一个1/1黑色，具系命异能的吸血鬼／骑士衍生生物。此异能每回合只能起动一次。

507076.oracleText: Delirium — {o2oB}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
507076.translation: 躁狂～{o2oB}：转化CARDNAME。只能于你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多时起动此异能。

507077.oracleText: Delirium — {o2oB}: Transform Kindly Stranger. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
507077.translation: 躁狂～{o2oB}：转化慈祥老妪。只能于你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多时起动此异能。

507094.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card. Delirium — If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as the exiled card, exile those cards, then that player shuffles.
507094.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌，并放逐该牌。躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，则从该牌手的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与所放逐之牌同名的牌，放逐这些牌，然后该牌手洗牌。

507095.oracleText:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card. 
Delirium — If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as the exiled card, exile those cards, then that player shuffles.
507095.translation:
目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌，并放逐该牌。
躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，则从该牌手的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与所放逐之牌同名的牌，放逐这些牌，然后该牌手洗牌。

507099.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may pay {oX}. If you do, return another target Zombie creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield.
507099.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以支付{oX}。若你如此作，将另一张目标法术力值为X的灵俑生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

507100.oracleText: When Relentless Dead dies, you may pay {oX}. If you do, return another target Zombie creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield.
507100.translation: 当无情亡者死去时，你可以支付{oX}。若你如此作，将另一张目标法术力值为X的灵俑生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

507196.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library. Any opponent may have you put that card into your graveyard. If a player does, CARDNAME deals damage to that player equal to that card's mana value. Otherwise, put that card into your hand.
507196.translation: 在你的维持开始时，展示你的牌库顶牌。任意对手可以令你将该牌置入你的坟墓场。若有牌手如此作，则CARDNAME对该牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。若否，则将该牌置于你手上。

507197.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library. Any opponent may have you put that card into your graveyard. If a player does, Sin Prodder deals damage to that player equal to that card's mana value. Otherwise, put that card into your hand.
507197.translation: 在你的维持开始时，展示你的牌库顶牌。任意对手可以令你将该牌置入你的坟墓场。若有牌手如此作，则纵恶魔鬼对该牌手造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。若否，则将该牌置于你手上。

507280.oracleText: Return any number of cards with different mana values from your graveyard to your hand. Put CARDNAME on the bottom of its owner's library.
507280.translation: 将任意数量的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上，且这些牌的法术力值须各不相同。将CARDNAME置于其拥有者的牌库底。

507281.oracleText: Return any number of cards with different mana values from your graveyard to your hand. Put Seasons Past on the bottom of its owner's library.
507281.translation: 将任意数量的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上，且这些牌的法术力值须各不相同。将时迁季移置于其拥有者的牌库底。

507288.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Delirium — If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, instead search your library for a creature or land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
507288.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，则改为从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物或地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

507289.oracleText:
Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. 
Delirium — If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, instead search your library for a creature or land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
507289.translation:
从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。
躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，则改为从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物或地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

507336.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a charge counter on CARDNAME, then you may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on CARDNAME from your hand without paying its mana cost.
507336.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在CARDNAME上放置一个充电指示物，然后你可以从你手上施放一张法术力值等同于CARDNAME上充电指示物数量的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

507337.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a charge counter on Brain in a Jar, then you may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on Brain in a Jar from your hand without paying its mana cost.
507337.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在瓶中脑上放置一个充电指示物，然后你可以从你手上施放一张法术力值等同于瓶中脑上充电指示物数量的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

507446.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on {1, CardId} from your hand without paying its mana cost?
507446.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用，从你手上施放一张法术力值等同于{1, CardId}上充电指示物数量的瞬间或法术牌？

507460.oracleText: Your opponents can't cast spells with mana value 3 or less.
507460.translation: 所有对手都不能施放法术力值等于或小于3的咒语。

507547.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand?
507547.translation: 是否要将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上？

507549.oracleText: Target a spell with mana value 4 or less.
507549.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于4的咒语为目标。

507574.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment with mana value 4 or less.
507574.translation: 消灭目标法术力值等于或小于4的神器或结界。

507615.oracleText: Choose target artifact or creature. You get {oEoEoEoE}, then you may pay an amount of {oE} equal to that permanent's mana value. If you do, gain control of it.
507615.translation: 选择目标神器或生物。你得到{oEoEoEoE}，然后你可以支付等同于该永久物法术力值之数量的{oE}。如果你如此作，则获得其操控权。

507628.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control the artifact with the highest mana value or tied for the highest mana value, draw a card.
507628.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你操控法术力值最高或与他者同为最高的神器，抓一张牌。

507667.oracleText: Choose a nonartifact, nonland card name. Search target player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with that name and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.
507667.translation: 选择一个非神器且非地的牌之名称。从目标牌手的坟墓场，手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手洗牌，然后每有一张以此法放逐的手牌，他便抓一张牌。

507745.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You get {oEoE}.
507745.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你得到{oEoE}。

507805.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first spell each turn, reveal the top card of your library. You may cast it without paying its mana cost if it's a spell with lesser mana value. If you don't cast it, put it into your hand.
507805.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个咒语时，展示你的牌库顶牌。若该牌为非地牌，且其法术力值小于该咒语，则你可以施放它，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你未施放所展示的牌，则将它置于你手上。

507810.oracleText: Search your library for up to three artifact cards with different names, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
507810.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张名称各不相同的神器牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

507857.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control.
507857.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为所有由你操控之非生物神器法术力值的总和。

507905.oracleText: Target an artifact or enchantment with mana value 4 or less.
507905.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于4的神器或结界为目标。

507909.oracleText: Pay an amount of {oE} equal to that permanent's mana value?
507909.translation: 是否要支付等同于该永久物法术力值之数量的{oE}？

507936.oracleText: Cast a spell revealed this way with mana value less than that spell's without paying its mana cost?
507936.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用施放一个法术力值小于该咒语且以此法展示的咒语？

507951.oracleText: You may cast a spell with mana value 3 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
507951.translation: 你可以从你手上施放一张法术力值等于或小于3的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

507969.oracleText: Destroy target creature if it has mana value 2 or less. Revolt — Destroy that creature if it has mana value 4 or less instead if a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn.
507969.translation: 如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于2，则消灭之。反抗～如果本回合中有由你操控的永久物离开战场，则改为如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于4，则消灭之。

507970.oracleText:
Destroy target creature if it has mana value 2 or less. 
Revolt — Destroy that creature if it has mana value 4 or less instead if a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn.
507970.translation:
如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于2，则消灭之。
反抗～如果本回合中有由你操控的永久物离开战场，则改为如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于4，则消灭之。

507996.oracleText: Destroy X target artifacts and/or creatures. For each permanent destroyed this way, its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until an artifact or creature card is revealed and exiles that card. Those players put the exiled cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
507996.translation: 消灭X个目标神器和／或生物。为每个以此法消灭的永久物进行以下流程～其操控者从其牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张神器或生物牌为止，放逐该牌。这些牌手各将所放逐的牌放进战场，然后将各自的牌库洗牌。

508047.oracleText: You may cast a spell with mana value 5 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
508047.translation: 你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于5的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

508104.oracleText: {o8}, {oT}: Search your library for a permanent card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
508104.translation: {o8}，{oT}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张永久物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

508106.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return to your hand target artifact card in your graveyard with lesser mana value.
508106.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的神器从战场进入坟墓场时，将目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值小于前述神器的神器牌移回你手上。

508107.oracleText: Whenever Scrap Trawler or another artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return to your hand target artifact card in your graveyard with lesser mana value.
508107.translation: 每当废铁打捞械或另一个由你操控的神器从战场进入坟墓场时，将目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值小于前述神器的神器牌移回你手上。

508109.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card with mana value 3 or less. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Put all revealed cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
508109.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。将所有以此法展示且未施放的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

508110.oracleText: When Treasure Keeper dies, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card with mana value 3 or less. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Put all revealed cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
508110.translation: 当宝藏守卫死去时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。将所有以此法展示且未施放的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

508121.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value 3 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost?
508121.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于3的咒语？

508131.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value 5 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost?
508131.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于5的咒语？

508139.oracleText: Target an artifact card in your graveyard with lesser mana value.
508139.translation: 指定一个在你坟墓场中且法术力值更小的神器牌为目标。

508198.oracleText: Once each turn, you may pay {o0} rather than pay the mana cost for a spell you cast with mana value X or less, where X is the number of time counters on CARDNAME.
508198.translation: 你于施放法术力值等于或小于X的咒语时，可以支付{o0}，而不支付其法术力费用，X为CARDNAME上的计时指示物数量。每回合限如此作一次。

508199.oracleText: Once each turn, you may pay {o0} rather than pay the mana cost for a spell you cast with mana value X or less, where X is the number of time counters on As Foretold.
508199.translation: 你于施放法术力值等于或小于X的咒语时，可以支付{o0}，而不支付其法术力费用，X为预示成真上的计时指示物数量。每回合限如此作一次。

508260.oracleText: Choose an artifact card name. Search target opponent's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the chosen name and exile them. Then that player shuffles.
508260.translation: 选择一个神器牌的名称。从目标对手的坟墓场，手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。然后该牌手将其牌库洗牌。

508266.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you have one or fewer cards in hand.
508266.translation: {o2oB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动，且于你的手牌为一张或更少时才能起动。

508267.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return Dread Wanderer from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you have one or fewer cards in hand.
508267.translation: {o2oB}：将恐怖游尸从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动，且于你的手牌为一张或更少时才能起动。

508372.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, you may search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
508372.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

508373.oracleText: When you cycle Shefet Monitor, you may search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
508373.translation: 当你循环谢菲巨蜥时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

508382.oracleText: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card or a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of loyalty counters on CARDNAME, you may put that card onto the battlefield.
508382.translation: 检视你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是地牌或法术力值等于或小于CARDNAME上忠诚指示物数量的生物牌，则你可以将该牌放进战场。

508383.oracleText: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card or a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of loyalty counters on Nissa, Steward of Elements, you may put that card onto the battlefield.
508383.translation: 检视你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是地牌或法术力值等于或小于地源守护妮莎上忠诚指示物数量的生物牌，则你可以将该牌放进战场。

508431.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your graveyard, hand, and/or library for a card named God-Pharaoh's Gift and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle. Activate only if there are six or more creature cards in your graveyard.
508431.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你的坟墓场，手牌和／或牌库中搜寻一张名称为法老神赋礼的牌，并将之放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。只能于你的坟墓场中有六张或更多生物牌时起动。

508432.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Gate to the Afterlife: Search your graveyard, hand, and/or library for a card named God-Pharaoh's Gift and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle. Activate only if there are six or more creature cards in your graveyard.
508432.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲来世之门：从你的坟墓场，手牌和／或牌库中搜寻一张名称为法老神赋礼的牌，并将之放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。只能于你的坟墓场中有六张或更多生物牌时起动。

508438.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
508438.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

508439.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Evolving Wilds: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
508439.translation: {oT}，牺牲成形野地：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

508455.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 4 or greater, draw a card.
508455.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于4的生物咒语时，抓一张牌。

508466.oracleText: {o1}, Discard a card: Choose 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, or 8 at random. Create a token that's a copy of a random creature card with mana value equal to that number. Activate only as a sorcery.
508466.translation: {o1}，弃一张牌：随机选择1，2，3，4，5，6，7或8。派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为随机一张法术力值等于该数的生物牌之复制品。只能于法术时机起动。

508528.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value equal to the number of doom counters on CARDNAME, CARDNAME deals that much damage to any target. Then put a doom counter on CARDNAME.
508528.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等同于CARDNAME上末日指示物数量的咒语时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。然后在CARDNAME上放置一个末日指示物。

508529.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value equal to the number of doom counters on Imminent Doom, Imminent Doom deals that much damage to any target. Then put a doom counter on Imminent Doom.
508529.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等同于灾祸临头上末日指示物数量的咒语时，灾祸临头对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。然后在灾祸临头上放置一个末日指示物。

508547.oracleText: Search your library for up to two creature and/or planeswalker cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
508547.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张生物和／或鹏洛客牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

508560.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target spell's controller equal to that spell's mana value.
508560.translation: CARDNAME对目标咒语的操控者造成伤害，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

508561.oracleText: Refuse /// Cooperate deals damage to target spell's controller equal to that spell's mana value.
508561.translation: 拒绝对目标咒语的操控者造成伤害，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

508563.oracleText: Refuse deals damage to target spell's controller equal to that spell's mana value.
508563.translation: 拒绝对目标咒语的操控者造成伤害，其数量等同于该咒语的法术力值。

508662.oracleText: Exile all attacking creatures target player controls. That player may search their library for that many basic land cards, put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
508662.translation: 选择目标牌手。放逐所有由该牌手操控且进行攻击的生物。该牌手可以从其牌库中搜寻等量的基本地牌，将这些牌横置放进战场，然后将其牌库洗牌。

508745.oracleText: {o3oR}: Gain control of target creature an opponent controls until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
508745.translation: {o3oR}：获得目标由对手操控的生物之操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

508768.oracleText: Raid — {o3oRoR}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you attacked this turn.
508768.translation: 突击～{o3oRoR}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你曾以生物攻击的回合中起动。

508769.oracleText: Raid — {o3oRoR}: Return Repeating Barrage from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you attacked this turn.
508769.translation: 突击～{o3oRoR}：将持续齐射从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你曾以生物攻击的回合中起动。

508780.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from your hand, reveal the top X cards of your library, where X is that spell's mana value. You may cast a spell with mana value X or less from among cards revealed this way without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
508780.translation: 每当你从你手上施放咒语时，展示你牌库顶的X张牌，X为该咒语的法术力值。你可以从以此法展示的牌之中施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

508874.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. Each player searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield, then shuffles.
508874.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标由对手操控的非基本地。每位牌手各从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

508875.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Field of Ruin: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. Each player searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield, then shuffles.
508875.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲战场遗迹：消灭目标由对手操控的非基本地。每位牌手各从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

508905.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value {2, Number} or less from among cards revealed this way without paying its mana cost?
508905.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用施放一个以此法展示之牌中法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的咒语？

508972.oracleText: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
508972.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

508974.oracleText: Choose one — • Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. • Put a card you own from outside the game into your hand.
508974.translation: 选择一项～ •  从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。 •  从游戏外选择一张由你拥有的牌，并将它置于你手上。

509024.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap it. It gains haste until end of turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step if it has mana value 3 or less.
509024.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。将之重置。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。在下一个结束步骤开始时，如果其法术力值等于或小于3，则将它牺牲。

509086.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Draw a card, then exile a card from your hand. If cards with five or more different mana values are exiled with CARDNAME, you gain 5 life, untap CARDNAME, and transform it.
509086.translation: {o1}，{oT}：抓一张牌，然后从你手上放逐一张牌。如果放逐区中以CARDNAME放逐之各牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则你获得5点生命，重置CARDNAME，并转化它。

509087.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Draw a card, then exile a card from your hand. If cards with five or more different mana values are exiled with Azor's Gateway, you gain 5 life, untap Azor's Gateway, and transform it.
509087.translation: {o1}，{oT}：抓一张牌，然后从你手上放逐一张牌。如果放逐区中以俄佐闸门放逐之各牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则你获得5点生命，重置俄佐闸门，并转化它。

509122.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step if it has mana value 3 or less.
509122.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，如果其法术力值等于或小于3，则将它牺牲。

509204.oracleText: Search your library for two cards. Put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard. Then shuffle.
509204.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张置入你的坟墓场。然后洗牌。

509296.oracleText: Look at the top X cards of your library. You may put any number of land and/or legendary permanent cards with mana value X or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest into your graveyard.
509296.translation: 检视你牌库顶的X张牌。你可以将其中任意数量的地和／或法术力值等于或小于X的传奇永久物牌放进战场。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

509400.oracleText: Put any number of land or legendary permanent cards with mana value {2, Number} or less onto the battlefield?
509400.translation: 是否要将任意数量的地或法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的传奇永久物牌放进战场？

509437.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {oX}. When you do, return target creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield with a corpse counter on it. If that creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else.
509437.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{oX}。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值为X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且其上有一个尸体指示物。如果该生物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。

509438.oracleText: Whenever Isareth the Awakener attacks, you may pay {oX}. When you do, return target creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield with a corpse counter on it. If that creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else.
509438.translation: 每当唤尸依萨蕾攻击时，你可以支付{oX}。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值为X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且其上有一个尸体指示物。如果该生物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。

509482.oracleText: {o4oUoBoR}: Exile CARDNAME, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
509482.translation: {o4oUoBoR}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

509483.oracleText: {o4oUoBoR}: Exile Nicol Bolas, the Ravager, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
509483.translation: {o4oUoBoR}：放逐烈龙尼可波拉斯，然后将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

509528.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield with a corpse counter on it.
509528.translation: 将目标法术力值为X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且其上有一个尸体指示物。

509578.oracleText: Choose a creature card with mana value 1 in your graveyard, then do the same for creature cards with mana value 2 and 3. Return those cards to the battlefield.
509578.translation: 从你坟墓场中的生物牌中，法术力值为1，2，3的生物牌各选择一张。将这些牌移回战场。

509580.oracleText: Undergrowth — Search your library for a black card with mana value less than or equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
509580.translation: 朽力～坟墓场中的生物牌从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于你坟墓场中生物牌数量的黑色牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

509692.oracleText: {oX}: Lazav, the Multifarious becomes a copy of target creature card in your graveyard with mana value X, except its name is Lazav, the Multifarious, it's legendary in addition to its other types, and it has this ability.
509692.translation: {oX}：选择目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值为X的生物牌。百相拉札夫成为该牌的复制品，但其名称仍是百相拉札夫，额外具有传奇此超类别，且具有此异能。

509695.oracleText: {oXoR}, {oT}: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control with mana value X. You may choose new targets for the copy.
509695.translation: {oXoR}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控且法术力值为X的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

509740.oracleText: Choose a card name. Search target opponent's graveyard, hand, and library for up to four cards with that name and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.
509740.translation: 选择一个牌名。从目标对手的坟墓场，手牌及牌库中搜寻至多四张具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手将其牌库洗牌，然后每有一张以此法放逐的手牌，他便抓一张牌。

509756.oracleText: Each opponent returns a nonland permanent they control with the highest mana value among permanents they control to its owner's hand, then discards a card.
509756.translation: 每位对手各将由其操控的永久物中法术力值最高的一个非地永久物移回其拥有者的手上，然后弃一张牌。

509760.oracleText: Copy target instant or sorcery spell with mana value 4 or less. You may choose new targets for the copy.
509760.translation: 复制目标法术力值等于或小于4的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

509798.oracleText: Choose a creature card with mana value 1 in your graveyard, a creature card with mana value 2 in your graveyard, and a creature card with mana value 3 in your graveyard.
509798.translation: 选择你坟墓场中法术力值分别为1，2，3的生物牌各一张。

509799.oracleText: Search for a black card with mana value less than or equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
509799.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于你坟墓场中生物牌数量的黑色牌。

509815.oracleText: Return a nonland permanent you control with the highest mana value among permanents you control to its owner's hand.
509815.translation: 将由你操控的永久物中法术力值最高的一个非地永久物移回其拥有者的手上。

509816.oracleText: Target an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 4 or less.
509816.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于4的瞬间或法术牌为目标。

509891.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target. You may cast a spell with mana value X or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
509891.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。你可以从你手上施放一张法术力值等于或小于X的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

509892.oracleText: Electrodominance deals X damage to any target. You may cast a spell with mana value X or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
509892.translation: 控驭电能对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。你可以从你手上施放一张法术力值等于或小于X的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

509913.oracleText: {o3oR}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets. Activate only if CARDNAME has a +1/+1 counter on it.
509913.translation: {o3oR}：CARDNAME对任意一个或两个目标造成共2点伤害，你可以任意分配。只能于CARDNAME上有+1/+1指示物时起动。

509914.oracleText: {o3oR}: Skarrgan Hellkite deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets. Activate only if Skarrgan Hellkite has a +1/+1 counter on it.
509914.translation: {o3oR}：始卡克残虐者对任意一个或两个目标造成共2点伤害，你可以任意分配。只能于始卡克残虐者上有+1/+1指示物时起动此异能。

509921.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, you may search your library for a card named Growth-Chamber Guardian, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
509921.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为生长室守护者的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

509922.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Growth-Chamber Guardian, you may search your library for a card named Growth-Chamber Guardian, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
509922.translation: 每当在生长室守护者上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为生长室守护者的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

509978.oracleText: Each opponent can't cast noncreature spells with mana value greater than the number of lands that player controls.
509978.translation: 每位对手均不能施放法术力值大于由其操控之地数量的非生物咒语。

510033.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
510033.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

510055.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value {2, Number} or less from your hand without paying its mana cost?
510055.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的咒语？

510058.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target noncreature artifact becomes an artifact creature with power and toughness each equal to its mana value.
510058.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标非生物的神器成为神器生物，其力量和防御力各等同于其法术力值。

510129.oracleText: You may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost.
510129.translation: 你可以使用你的牌库顶牌。如果你以此法施放咒语，则支付等同于其法术力值数量的生命，而不支付其法术力费用。

510214.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Lands you control have indestructible." Search your library for any number of Forest cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
510214.translation: 你获得具有「由你操控的地具有不灭异能」的徽记。从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量的树林牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

510217.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic Forest cards. If you control a Nissa planeswalker, instead search your library for up to three land cards. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
510217.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张基本的树林牌。如果你操控妮莎鹏洛客，则改为从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张地牌。展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

510347.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on CARDNAME.
510347.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭所有法术力值等同于CARDNAME上充电指示物数量的非地永久物。

510348.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice Blast Zone: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on Blast Zone.
510348.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲爆裂地带：消灭所有法术力值等同于爆裂地带上充电指示物数量的非地永久物。

510376.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value less than or equal to {1, CardId}'s power from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
510376.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放目标法术力值等于或小于{1, CardId}之力量的瞬间或法术牌？

510377.oracleText: Target an instant or sorcery card with mana value less than or equal to {1, CardId}'s power.
510377.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于{1, CardId}之力量的瞬间或法术牌为目标。

510378.oracleText: Cast up to one target instant card with mana value {2, Number} or less and/or up to one target sorcery card with mana value {2, Number} or less from your graveyard without paying their mana costs?
510378.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放至多一张目标法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的瞬间牌和／或至多一张目标法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的法术牌？

510415.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage to an opponent, you may reveal your hand. If cards with at least six different mana values are revealed this way, that player loses the game.
510415.translation: 每当CARDNAME向任一对手造成伤害时，你可以展示你的手牌。若以此法展示出之各牌的法术力值有至少六种，则该对手输掉这盘游戏。

510416.oracleText: Whenever Atemsis, All-Seeing deals damage to an opponent, you may reveal your hand. If cards with at least six different mana values are revealed this way, that player loses the game.
510416.translation: 每当全观爱缇席向任一对手造成伤害时，你可以展示你的手牌。若以此法展示出之各牌的法术力值有至少六种，则该对手输掉这盘游戏。

510425.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}: Search your library for a card named Heart-Piercer Bow or Vial of Dragonfire, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
510425.translation: {oU}，{oT}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为穿心弓或龙炎瓶的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

510440.oracleText: Exile target creature an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less and all other creatures that player controls with the same name as that creature. Then that player reveals their hand and exiles all cards with that name from their hand and graveyard.
510440.translation: 选择目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于2的生物。放逐该生物和所有由该牌手操控且与之同名的其他生物。然后该牌手展示其手牌，并放逐其手上和坟墓场中所有具该名称的牌。

510443.oracleText: Choose two target players. Each of them searches their library for a card, then shuffles and puts that card on top.
510443.translation: 选择两位目标牌手。他们各从自己的牌库中搜寻一张牌，然后将自己的牌库洗牌，并将该牌置于其上。

510519.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice a land: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
510519.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲一个地：从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

510559.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Choose a card name, then reveal the top card of your library. If that card has the chosen name, sacrifice CARDNAME and draw three cards. Activate only as a sorcery.
510559.translation: {o1}，{oT}：选择一个牌名，然后展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌具有该名称，则牺牲CARDNAME且抓三张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

510560.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Choose a card name, then reveal the top card of your library. If that card has the chosen name, sacrifice Diviner's Lockbox and draw three cards. Activate only as a sorcery.
510560.translation: {o1}，{oT}：选择一个牌名，然后展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌具有该名称，则牺牲先知密柜且抓三张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

510587.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less.
510587.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于2且由对手操控的生物为目标。

510591.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard?
510591.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场中施放目标法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间或法术牌？

510592.oracleText: Target an instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less.
510592.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间或法术牌为目标。

510659.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Pay 2 life: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
510659.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，支付2点生命：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

510721.oracleText: You may cast spells with mana value less than or equal to the number of lands you control without paying their mana costs.
510721.translation: 对法术力值等于或小于由你操控之地数量的咒语而言，你施放此类咒语时可以不需支付其法术力费用。

510787.oracleText: Return up to X target artifact and/or non-Aura enchantment cards each with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. If X is 6 or more, those permanents are 4/4 creatures in addition to their other types.
510787.translation: 选择至多X张目标在你坟墓场中的神器和／或非灵气结界牌，且其法术力值均须等于或小于X。将它们移回战场。如果X等于或大于6，则这些永久物为4/4生物，且仍具有原本类别。

510793.oracleText: Counter target spell with mana value less than or equal to the number of cards in its controller's graveyard.
510793.translation: 反击目标咒语，且其法术力值须等于或小于其操控者坟墓场中牌的数量。

510794.oracleText: Destroy target creature with mana value less than or equal to the number of cards in its controller's graveyard.
510794.translation: 消灭目标生物，且其法术力值须等于或小于其操控者坟墓场中牌的数量。

510795.oracleText: Choose one — • Counter target spell with mana value less than or equal to the number of cards in its controller's graveyard. • Destroy target creature with mana value less than or equal to the number of cards in its controller's graveyard.
510795.translation: 选择一项～ •  反击目标咒语，且其法术力值须等于或小于其操控者坟墓场中牌的数量。 •  消灭目标生物，且其法术力值须等于或小于其操控者坟墓场中牌的数量。

510865.oracleText: {o8}: CARDNAME has base power and toughness 10/10 until end of turn. Activate only if you control an Oko planeswalker.
510865.translation: {o8}：CARDNAME之基础力量与防御力为10/10直到回合结束。只能于你操控瓯柯鹏洛客时起动。

510866.oracleText: {o8}: Bramblefort Fink has base power and toughness 10/10 until end of turn. Activate only if you control an Oko planeswalker.
510866.translation: {o8}：棘堡奥夫之基础力量与防御力为10/10直到回合结束。只能于你操控瓯柯鹏洛客时起动。

510923.oracleText: Target a spell with mana value less than or equal to the number of cards in its controller's graveyard.
510923.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于其操控者坟墓场中牌的数量的咒语为目标。

510924.oracleText: Target a creature with mana value less than or equal to the number of cards in its controller's graveyard.
510924.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于其操控者坟墓场中牌之数量的生物为目标。

510932.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies, if an Aura you controlled was attached to it, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
510932.translation: 每当一个生物死去时，若其上贴附有由你操控的灵气，则将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

510940.oracleText: Exile target permanent an opponent controls with mana value 3 or greater.
510940.translation: 放逐目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或大于3的永久物。

510999.oracleText: Spells you cast with mana value 5 or greater cost {o1} less to cast and can't be countered.
510999.translation: 你施放之法术力值等于或大于5的咒语减少{o1}来施放，且不能被反击。

511123.oracleText: {o4oG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token. Activate only during your turn.
511123.translation: {o4oG}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。只能于你的回合中起动。

511124.oracleText: {o4oG}, Sacrifice Wolfwillow Haven: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token. Activate only during your turn.
511124.translation: {o4oG}，牺牲狼林庇护地：派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。只能于你的回合中起动。

511158.oracleText: Haktos has protection from each mana value other than the chosen number.
511158.translation: 哈克托斯具有「保护～反所选数字以外的其他法术力值」。

511210.oracleText: Target a permanent an opponent controls with mana value 3 or greater.
511210.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且法术力值等于或大于3的永久物为目标。

511243.oracleText: Protection from each mana value other than the chosen number
511243.translation: 保护～反所选数字以外的其他法术力值

511259.oracleText: CARDNAME has protection from each mana value of the chosen quality.
511259.translation: CARDNAME具有「保护～反该种数值的法术力值」。

511260.oracleText: Lavabrink Venturer has protection from each mana value of the chosen quality.
511260.translation: 熔缘城冒险家具有「保护～反该种数值的法术力值」。

511301.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create an X/X blue Shark creature token with flying, where X is that spell's mana value.
511301.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个X/X蓝色，具飞行异能的鲨鱼衍生生物，X为该咒语的法术力值。

511310.oracleText: Return up to two target creature cards with total mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a deathtouch counter on either of them. Then put a menace counter on either of them.
511310.translation: 将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值的总和须等于或小于3。在这些生物之一上放置一个死触指示物。然后在这些生物之一上放置一个威慑指示物。

511313.oracleText: Choose odd or even. Exile each creature with mana value of the chosen quality.
511313.translation: 选择奇数或偶数。放逐所有法术力值是该种数值的生物。

511314.oracleText: Choose odd or even. Exile each creature with mana value of the chosen quality. (Zero is even.)
511314.translation: 选择奇数或偶数。放逐所有法术力值是该种数值的生物。（零是偶数。）

511337.oracleText: Exile target creature you control, then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card with higher mana value. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
511337.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的生物，然后从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值大于该生物的生物牌为止。将该牌放进战场，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

511366.oracleText: If {oUoB} was spent to cast this spell, search your library for a card, put that card into your graveyard, then shuffle.
511366.translation: 如果施放此咒语时支付过{oUoB}，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。

511386.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, mill two cards. Then return a creature card with lesser mana value than the creature that died from your graveyard to your hand.
511386.translation: 每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，磨两张牌。然后将一张法术力值小于死去者的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

511387.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You gain life equal to the highest mana value among creatures you control.
511387.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控之生物中法术力值最大者的数值。

511388.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Death's Oasis: You gain life equal to the highest mana value among creatures you control.
511388.translation: {o1}，牺牲死亡绿洲：你获得若干生命，其数量等同于由你操控之生物中法术力值最大者的数值。

511411.oracleText: Draw a card, then you may discard a card. When you discard a nonland card this way, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker.
511411.translation: 抓一张牌，然后你可以弃一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张非地牌时，CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。

511412.oracleText: Draw a card, then you may discard a card. When you discard a nonland card this way, Narset of the Ancient Way deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker.
511412.translation: 抓一张牌，然后你可以弃一张牌。当你以此法弃掉一张非地牌时，古道娜尔施对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。

511440.oracleText: Whenever this creature mutates, you may cast target noncreature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
511440.translation: 每当此生物合变时，你可以从你的坟墓场中施放目标法术力值等于或小于3的非生物牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

511450.oracleText: {oXo(B/G)}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Search your library for a creature card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
511450.translation: {oXo(B/G)}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物：从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。只能于法术时机起动。

511453.oracleText: Companion — Your starting deck contains only cards with even mana values.
511453.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中仅包含法术力值为偶数的牌。

511469.oracleText: Companion — Your starting deck contains only cards with mana value 3 or greater and land cards.
511469.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中仅包含地牌和法术力值等于或大于3的牌。

511474.oracleText: Companion — Each permanent card in your starting deck has mana value 2 or less.
511474.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中各永久物牌的法术力值均为2或更少。

511483.oracleText: Companion — Your starting deck contains only cards with odd mana values and land cards.
511483.translation: 行侣～你起始套牌中仅包含地牌和法术力值为奇数的牌。

511484.oracleText: If a source you control with an odd mana value would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage to that permanent or player instead.
511484.translation: 如果某个由你操控且法术力值为奇数的来源将对任一永久物或牌手造成伤害，则改为它对该永久物或牌手造成两倍的伤害。

511519.oracleText: Protection from each mana value of the chosen quality
511519.translation: 保护～反该种数值的法术力值

511523.oracleText: Target up to two creature cards with total mana value 3 or less.
511523.translation: 指定至多两张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌为目标。

511533.oracleText: Return a creature card with lesser mana value than the creature that died to your hand.
511533.translation: 将一张法术力值小于死去者的生物牌移回你手上。

511541.oracleText: When you discard a nonland card this way, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's mana value to target creature or planeswalker.
511541.translation: 当你以此法弃掉一张非地牌时，CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。

511546.oracleText: Cast target noncreature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
511546.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放目标法术力值等于或小于3的非生物牌？

511547.oracleText: Target a noncreature card with mana value 3 or less.
511547.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于3的非生物牌为目标。

511549.oracleText: Search for a creature card with mana value {2, Number} or less.
511549.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌。

511551.oracleText: Put a creature card with an even mana value onto the battlefield.
511551.translation: 将一张法术力值为偶数的生物牌放进战场。

511576.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying. Activate only if you have at least 7 life more than your starting life total and only as a sorcery.
511576.translation: {oT}：派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。只能于你的总生命比你的起始总生命至少多7点时起动，且只能于法术时机起动。

511626.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}: Each opponent loses 2 life. Activate only if a creature died this turn.
511626.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}：每位对手各失去2点生命。只能于有生物死去的回合中起动。

511661.oracleText: Choose a card name other than a basic land card name. Search target opponent's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with that name and exile them. That player shuffles, then creates a 2/2 black Zombie creature token for each card exiled from their hand this way.
511661.translation: 选择一个基本地牌名称以外的牌名。从目标对手的坟墓场，手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手将其牌库洗牌，然后每有一张以此法放逐的手牌，他便派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

511711.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may search your library for a creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
511711.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

511712.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, you may search your library for a creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle."
511712.translation: 你获得具有「在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌」的徽记。

511732.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
511732.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以从你的牌库和／或坟墓场中搜寻一张祭祠牌，并将之放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则将它洗牌。

511769.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner creates an X/X blue Illusion creature token, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
511769.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者派出一个X/X蓝色虚影衍生生物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

511770.oracleText: When Skyclave Apparition leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner creates an X/X blue Illusion creature token, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
511770.translation: 当空境亡灵离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者派出一个X/X蓝色虚影衍生生物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

511810.oracleText: Draw a card and reveal it. Remove a number of loyalty counters equal to that card's mana value from CARDNAME.
511810.translation: 抓一张牌并展示之。从CARDNAME上移去若干忠诚指示物，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。

511811.oracleText: Draw a card and reveal it. Remove a number of loyalty counters equal to that card's mana value from Jace, Mirror Mage.
511811.translation: 抓一张牌并展示之。从镜像法师杰斯上移去若干忠诚指示物，其数量等同于该牌的法术力值。

511815.oracleText: Gain control of target creature with mana value X.
511815.translation: 获得目标法术力值为X的生物之操控权。

511843.oracleText: Return from your graveyard to the battlefield any number of target creature cards that each have a different mana value X or less.
511843.translation: 选择任意数量目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌，其法术力值须各不相同且均须等于或小于X。将它们从该处移回战场。

511852.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker with mana value 2 or less. If this spell was kicked, instead destroy target creature or planeswalker.
511852.translation: 消灭目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物或鹏洛客。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。

511854.oracleText: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. If you have a full party, you may cast a spell with mana value 4 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
511854.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。如果你的冒险团满编，则你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于4的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

511865.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a card from it with mana value 3 or greater. That player discards that card.
511865.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张法术力值等于或大于3的牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

511950.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. If this spell was kicked, search your library for two basic land cards instead of one.
511950.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为从你的牌库中搜寻两张基本地牌，而非一张。

511965.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield. If that card has mana value 3 or less, it enters with three additional +1/+1 counters on it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
511965.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以将其中的一张生物牌放进战场。如果该牌的法术力值等于或小于3，则它进场时上面额外有三个+1/+1指示物。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

512000.oracleText: You may put a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of lands you control onto the battlefield from your hand or graveyard with two +1/+1 counters on it.
512000.translation: 你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于由你操控之地数量的生物牌从你手上或坟墓场中放进战场，且其上额外有两个+1/+1指示物。

512064.oracleText: Target up to one nonland, nontoken permanent you don't control with mana value 4 or less.
512064.translation: 指定至多一个不由你操控，非地，非衍生物且法术力值等于或小于4的永久物为目标。

512075.oracleText: Target any number of creature cards that have a different mana value {2, Number} or less.
512075.translation: 指定任意数量法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}且各不相同的生物牌为目标。

512076.oracleText: Target a creature or planeswalker with mana value 2 or less.
512076.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于2的生物或鹏洛客为目标。

512077.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value 4 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost?
512077.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于4的咒语？

512078.oracleText: Choose a card from it with mana value 3 or greater.
512078.translation: 选择其中一张法术力值等于或大于3的牌。

512093.oracleText: Put a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of lands you control onto the battlefield?
512093.translation: 是否要将一张法术力值等于或小于由你操控之地数量的生物牌放进战场？

512108.oracleText: Noncreature spells your opponents cast with mana value 4 or greater cost {o2} more to cast.
512108.translation: 对手施放之法术力值等于或大于4的非生物咒语增加{o2}来施放。

512121.oracleText: Search your library for a snow permanent card, a legendary card, or a Saga card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 1 life for each {oSi} spent to cast this spell.
512121.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张雪境永久物牌，传奇牌或传纪牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。施放此咒语时每支付过一点{oSi}，你便获得1点生命。

512132.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, choose a card type, then reveal the top two cards of your library. Put all cards of the chosen type revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
512132.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，选择一种牌张类别，然后展示你牌库顶的两张牌。将所有该类别的牌置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

512198.oracleText: Then return a creature or planeswalker card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the amount of {oSi} spent to cast this spell.
512198.translation: 然后将一张法术力值等于或小于X之生物或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为施放此咒语时支付过的{oSi}数量。

512259.oracleText: {oX}: Choose a creature card exiled with Valki with mana value X. Valki becomes a copy of that card.
512259.translation: {oX}：选择一张以瓦尔基放逐且法术力值为X的生物牌。瓦尔基成为该牌的复制品。

512448.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if Sarulf has one or more +1/+1 counters on it, you may remove all of them. If you do, exile each other nonland permanent with mana value less than or equal to the number of counters removed this way.
512448.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若萨茹夫上有一个或更多+1/+1指示物，则你可以移去所有此类指示物。若你如此作，则放逐所有其他法术力值等于或小于以此法移去之指示物数量的非地永久物。

512465.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Search your library for a creature card that shares a creature type with the sacrificed creature and has mana value equal to 1 plus that creature's mana value. Put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
512465.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：从你的牌库中搜寻一张与所牺牲之生物具共通生物类别的生物牌，且其法术力值须等同于所牺牲之生物的法术力值加1。将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。只能于法术时机起动。

512468.oracleText: {oWoWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME and a creature you control: Create a 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature token with flying and vigilance. Activate only as a sorcery.
512468.translation: {oWoWoB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME与一个由你操控的生物：派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使／战士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

512469.oracleText: {oWoWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice Great Hall of Starnheim and a creature you control: Create a 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature token with flying and vigilance. Activate only as a sorcery.
512469.translation: {oWoWoB}，{oT}，牺牲斯达海姆正殿与一个由你操控的生物：派出一个4/4白色，具飞行与警戒异能的天使／战士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

512521.oracleText: Return a creature or planeswalker card with mana value {2, Number} or less to the battlefield.
512521.translation: 将一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的生物或鹏洛客牌移回战场。

512562.oracleText: Search for a creature card that shares a creature type with the sacrificed creature and has mana value equal to 1 plus that creature's mana value.
512562.translation: 搜寻一张与所牺牲之生物具共通生物类别且其法术力值须等同于所牺牲之生物的法术力值加1的生物牌。

512567.oracleText: Exile the top six cards of your library. You may cast up to two sorcery spells with mana value 3 or less from among them without paying their mana costs. Put the exiled cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.

527890.oracleText: Sacrifice five Treasures: Search your library for an artifact or Dragon card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

528005.oracleText: Boast — {o1oG}: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
528005.translation: 炫威～{o1oG}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

528011.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may cast a permanent spell from your hand with mana value equal to 1 plus the highest mana value among other permanents you control without paying its mana cost. If you don't, scry 1.
528011.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等同于「由你操控之其他永久物间最高之法术力值加1」的永久物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你未如此作，则占卜1。

528038.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
528038.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

528064.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, search your library for a creature card with power or toughness 6 or greater, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
528064.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张力量或防御力等于或大于6的生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

528065.oracleText: When Rootless Yew dies, search your library for a creature card with power or toughness 6 or greater, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
528065.translation: 当无根紫杉死去时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张力量或防御力等于或大于6的生物牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

528121.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater this turn, draw two cards, then discard a card.
528121.translation: 本回合中，每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

528128.oracleText: Search your library for a Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
528128.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

528149.oracleText: Search your library for a card named Halvar, God of Battle or an Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
528149.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为战斗神哈尔瓦的牌或一张武具牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

528298.oracleText: {o1oRoRoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for an Aura card and/or an Equipment card, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
528298.translation: {o1oRoRoW}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你的牌库中搜寻一张灵气牌和／或一张武具牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

528299.oracleText: {o1oRoRoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Axgard Armory: Search your library for an Aura card and/or an Equipment card, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
528299.translation: {o1oRoRoW}，{oT}，牺牲艾席嘉军械库：丛你的牌库中搜寻—张灵气牌和／或一张武具牌，展示这些牌将它们置于你手上．然后洗牌。

528310.oracleText: {oGoWoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control. They gain vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
528310.translation: {oGoWoW}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：在至多两个目标由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。它们获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

528311.oracleText: {oGoWoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Bretagard Stronghold: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control. They gain vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
528311.translation: {oGoWoW}，{oT}，牺牲碧塔嘉城塞：在至多两个目标由你操控的生物上客放置一个+1/+1指示物。它们获得警成与系命异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

528347.oracleText: {o1oBoRoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to target player. That player discards a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
528347.translation: {o1oBoRoR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标牌手造成3点伤害。该牌手弃一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

528348.oracleText: {o1oBoRoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice Immersturm Skullcairn: It deals 3 damage to target player. That player discards a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
528348.translation: {o1oBoRoR}，{oT}，牺牲无尽风暴骨冢：它对目标牌手造成3点伤害。该牌手弃一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

528366.oracleText: {o2oBoBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Up to one target creature you don't control gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Create two 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.
528366.translation: {o2oBoBoG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：至多一个目标不由你操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。派出两个1/1绿色妖精／战士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

528367.oracleText: {o2oBoBoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice Skemfar Elderhall: Up to one target creature you don't control gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Create two 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.
528367.translation: {o2oBoBoG}，{oT}，牺牲斯肯法长老厅：至多一个目标不由你操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。派出两个1/1绿色妖精/战士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

528376.oracleText: {o2oUoUoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Scry 2. CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
528376.translation: {o2oUoUoR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：占卜2。CARDNAME对每个生物各造成2点伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

528377.oracleText: {o2oUoUoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice Surtland Frostpyre: Scry 2. Surtland Frostpyre deals 2 damage to each creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
528377.translation: {o2oUoUoR}，{oT}，牺牲瑟特兰霜焰：占卜2。瑟特兰霜焰对每个生物各造成2点伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

528391.oracleText: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for any number of God cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
528391.translation: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量的神牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

528392.oracleText: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}, {oT}, Sacrifice The World Tree: Search your library for any number of God cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
528392.translation: {oWoWoUoUoBoBoRoRoGoG}，{oT}，牺牲世界树：从你的牌库中搜寻任意数量的神牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

528408.oracleText: Pay 3 life: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you had an Angel or Berserker enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
528408.translation: 支付3点生命：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于有天使或狂战士在你的操控下进战场之回合中起动。

528409.oracleText: Pay 3 life: Return Cleaving Reaper from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you had an Angel or Berserker enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
528409.translation: 支付3点生命：将挥扫索命客从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于有天使或狂战士在你的操控下进战场之回合中起动。

528534.oracleText: Target a permanent card with mana value 2 or less.
528534.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌为目标。

528547.oracleText: Cast a permanent spell from your hand with mana value equal to 1 plus the highest mana value among other permanents you control without paying its mana cost?
528547.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个法术力值等同于「由你操控之其他永久物间最高之法术力值加1」的永久物咒语？

528555.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater this turn, draw two cards, then discard a card.
528555.translation: 本回合中，每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

528702.oracleText: You may cast a spell with mana value 4 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
528702.translation: 你可以从你手上施放一张法术力值等于或小于4的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

528744.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create an X/X colorless Construct artifact creature token, where X is that spell's mana value.
528744.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个X/X无色组构体衍生神器生物，X为该咒语的法术力值。

528745.oracleText: {o3oUoU}, Exile CARDNAME: Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you control six or more artifacts.
528745.translation: {o3oUoU}，放逐CARDNAME：将所有瞬间与法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你操控六个或更多神器时起动。

528746.oracleText: {o3oUoU}, Exile Metallurgic Summonings: Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only if you control six or more artifacts.
528746.translation: {o3oUoU}，放逐冶金召唤：将所有瞬间与法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。只能于你操控六个或更多神器时起动。

528805.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
528805.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于X的神器牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

528823.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.
528823.translation: 牺牲一个神器或生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

528824.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager. Activate only as a sorcery.
528824.translation: 牺牲一个神器或生物：在无畏回收师上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

528917.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target creature. Activate only if you control two or more artifacts.
528917.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标生物。只能于你操控两个或更多神器时起动。

528918.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice Underhanded Designs: Destroy target creature. Activate only if you control two or more artifacts.
528918.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲暗中设局：消灭目标生物。只能于你操控两个或更多神器时起动。

528998.oracleText: You may cast a spell with mana value 2 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
528998.translation: 你可以从你手上施放一张法术力值等于或小于2的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

529381.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target player discards a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
529381.translation: {oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标牌手弃一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

529382.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice Implement of Malice: Target player discards a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
529382.translation: {oB}，牺牲恶意擎具：目标牌手弃一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

529440.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
529440.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

529441.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Renegade Map: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
529441.translation: {oT}，牺牲乱匠地图：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

529506.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for an artifact card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only if you control three or more artifacts.
529506.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你的牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。只能于你操控三个或更多神器时起动。

529507.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice Inventors' Fair: Search your library for an artifact card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only if you control three or more artifacts.
529507.translation: {o4}，{oT}，牺牲发明家博览会：从你的牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。只能于你操控三个或更多神器时起动。

529510.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color. Activate only if you control an artifact.
529510.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：加一点任意颜色的法术力。只能于你操控神器时起动。

529567.oracleText: Search for an artifact card with mana value 3.
529567.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值为3的神器牌。

529568.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value 3?
529568.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于3的神器牌？

529569.oracleText: Search for an artifact card with mana value {2, Number} or less.
529569.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于 {2, Number}的神器牌。

529572.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value 2 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost?
529572.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于2的咒语？

529604.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
529604.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标地。该地的操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

529605.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Ghost Quarter: Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
529605.translation: {oT}，牺牲魂魅城区：消灭目标地。该地的操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

529608.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand: Search your library for a Gate card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. If you control ten or more Gates with different names, you win the game.
529608.translation: {o3}，{oT}，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上：从你的牌库中搜寻一张门牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。如果你操控十个或更多名称各不相同的门，你便赢得这盘游戏。

529609.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Return Maze's End to its owner's hand: Search your library for a Gate card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. If you control ten or more Gates with different names, you win the game.
529609.translation: {o3}，{oT}，将迷宫终点移回其拥有者手上：从你的牌库中搜寻一张门牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。如果你操控十个或更多名称各不相同的门，你便赢得这盘游戏。

529613.oracleText: {o9}: Untap CARDNAME. Activate only during your upkeep.
529613.translation: {o9}：重置CARDNAME。只能于你的维持中起动。

529614.oracleText: {o9}: Untap Colossus of Sardia. Activate only during your upkeep.
529614.translation: {o9}：重置沙地亚巨像。只能于你的维持中起动。

529625.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay 2 life. If you do, search your library for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top.
529625.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于其上。

529633.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a Forest or Plains: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
529633.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个树林或平原：从你的牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

529636.oracleText: {oT}: Search your library for a legendary card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
529636.translation: {oT}：从你牌库中搜寻一张传奇牌，展示该牌并将其置于你的手上，然后洗牌。

529645.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}, Discard a creature card: Search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
529645.translation: {oG}，{oT}，弃一张生物牌：从你的牌库中搜寻一张生物牌，展示该牌，并将它置入你手上。然后洗牌。

529651.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
529651.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

529652.oracleText: When you cycle Krosan Tusker, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
529652.translation: 当你循环克洛萨长牙野猪时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

529669.oracleText: Adeline, Resplendent Cathar's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
529669.translation: 华辉护教军艾德琳的力量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

529670.oracleText: Whenever you attack, for each opponent, create a 1/1 white Human creature token that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control.
529670.translation: 每当你攻击时，为每位对手各进行以下流程～派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物，其为横置且正向该牌手或一个由其操控的鹏洛客进行攻击。

529673.oracleText: Coven — {o1oWoW}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
529673.translation: 鸠集～{o1oWoW}：转化CARDNAME。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

529674.oracleText: Coven — {o1oWoW}: Transform Ambitious Farmhand. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
529674.translation: 鸠集～{o1oWoW}：转化雄心农工。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

529677.oracleText: "The cathars have taught me many things, but I will never forget the hard, honest work that first callused my hands."
529677.translation: 「虽然我也在护教军中久经历练，但看到手上老茧，却总会想起我人生中的那第一份粗活苦工。」

529679.oracleText: Charity is rare on Innistrad, but kindness is always repaid.
529679.translation: 依尼翠人并不好心，但善举总有回报。

529682.oracleText: As long as evil threatens his town, the Blessed Sleep can wait.
529682.translation: 只要小镇仍受邪恶威胁，他就还不急于得享受福安眠。

529683.oracleText: If CARDNAME would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
529683.translation: 如果CARDNAME将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

529684.oracleText: If Generous Soul would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
529684.translation: 如果慷慨魂灵将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

529686.oracleText: "With Avacyn gone, I no longer knew who to pray to. Alone, I wept for a sister who would never return."
529686.translation: 「艾维欣离去之后，我不知道该向谁祈祷。只得孤身一人，独自为逝去姐妹伤心落泪。」

529687.oracleText: When another creature you control dies, transform CARDNAME.
529687.translation: 当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，转化CARDNAME。

529688.oracleText: When another creature you control dies, transform Bereaved Survivor.
529688.translation: 当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，转化丧亲幸存者。

529690.oracleText: "It was Sigarda who lifted me from despair and gave me the strength to fight on."
529690.translation: 「是席嘉妲引导我走出绝望深渊，赐予我继续作战的力量。」

529691.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
529691.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。

529692.oracleText: Whenever Dauntless Avenger attacks, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
529692.translation: 每当不屈复仇者攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。

529694.oracleText: "If I'm going, I'm taking you with me!"
529694.translation: 「如果我活不了，就带你一起走！」

529695.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains lifelink until end of turn. When that creature dies this turn, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
529695.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得系命异能。本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

529697.oracleText: Teferi stepped calmly into the fray. Suddenly the sun paused in the sky and the werewolves' snarls froze on their faces.
529697.translation: 泰菲力平静地踏入战局。空中太阳登时停滞不前，狼人脸上狰狞面容也凝固不动。

529707.oracleText: "Like a thousand candles fighting back the darkness, we are strongest when we stand together."
529707.translation: 「烛光千缕便能照退黑暗，同心一致才能展现雄威。」

529708.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn.
529708.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则CARDNAME获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

529709.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, Candlegrove Witch gains flying until end of turn.
529709.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则烛光林巫婆获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

529711.oracleText: Coven — {o2oW}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile enchanted creature. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
529711.translation: 鸠集～{o2oW}，牺牲CARDNAME：放逐所结附的生物。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

529712.oracleText: Coven — {o2oW}, Sacrifice Candletrap: Exile enchanted creature. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
529712.translation: 鸠集～{o2oW}，牺牲烛光陷阱：放逐所结附的生物。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

529714.oracleText: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."
529714.translation: 「正经战术是留给正经敌人用的。狼人滥捕无辜旅人，就算他们睡着我也会在他们后背捅上一刀。」

529715.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Cathar Commando: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
529715.translation: {o1}，牺牲护教军突击兵：消灭目标神器或结界。

529717.oracleText: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking. The rest redoubled their efforts to carry out her work.
529717.translation: 艾维欣离去后，有些护教军就此深陷绝望。而有些则加倍努力完成她未竟之事。

529718.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
529718.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

529719.oracleText: Enchanted creature has vigilance and "At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 white Human creature token."
529719.translation: 所结附的生物具有警戒与「在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。」

529723.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your graveyard.
529723.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置入你的坟墓场。

529727.oracleText: Each creature you control has ward {o1}.
529727.translation: 每个由你操控的生物均具有守护{o1}。

529728.oracleText: If Chapel Shieldgeist would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
529728.translation: 如果礼拜堂盾游魂将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

529730.oracleText: The sound of the trumpet is both warning and comfort: it tells of approaching danger but also reminds the village folk that someone is there to stand against it.
529730.translation: 号角之声既引人担心，又令人宽慰：它虽是威胁来袭的警告，却也提醒村民尚有人挺身抗击。

529734.oracleText: Spells with the chosen name enchanted player casts cost {o2} more to cast.
529734.translation: 所结附的牌手施放之具该名称的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

529735.oracleText: Whenever enchanted player casts a spell with the chosen name, you may sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, draw a card.
529735.translation: 每当所结附的牌手施放具该名称的咒语时，你可以牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

529736.oracleText: Whenever enchanted player casts a spell with the chosen name, you may sacrifice Curse of Silence. If you do, draw a card.
529736.translation: 每当所结附的牌手施放具该名称的咒语时，你可以牺牲封口诅咒。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

529739.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn.
529739.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则目标由你操控的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

529741.oracleText: If your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, instead transform CARDNAME and your life total becomes 3. Then if CARDNAME didn't transform this way, you lose the game.
529741.translation: 如果你的总生命将降至0或更少，则改为转化CARDNAME且你的总生命成为3。然后如果CARDNAME未以此法转化，则你输掉这盘游戏。

529742.oracleText: If your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, instead transform Enduring Angel and your life total becomes 3. Then if Enduring Angel didn't transform this way, you lose the game.
529742.translation: 如果你的总生命将降至0或更少，则改为转化永续天使且你的总生命成为3。然后如果永续天使未以此法转化，则你输掉这盘游戏。

529744.oracleText: Angelic Enforcer's power and toughness are each equal to your life total.
529744.translation: 执法天使的力量和防御力各等同于你的总生命。

529745.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, double your life total.
529745.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将你的总生命加倍。

529746.oracleText: Whenever Angelic Enforcer attacks, double your life total.
529746.translation: 每当执法天使攻击时，将你的总生命加倍。

529748.oracleText: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.
529748.translation: 索霖感觉有诈，便急忙赶往祖父安息陵墓；但已然有人捷足先登。

529749.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Its controller investigates.
529749.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。其操控者探查。

529751.oracleText: "I fell to my knees. I called out to Sigarda. And then I saw my tormentors blaze with blessed sunlight."
529751.translation: 「我屈身双膝跪地。我虔诚向席嘉妲祈祷。然后我就看到施虐恶物在受福阳光下熊熊燃烧。」

529752.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's a Human, instead it gets +3/+3 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
529752.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2。如果它是人类，则改为直到回合结束，它得+3/+3且获得不灭异能。

529755.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with mana value 3 or less from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
529755.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

529757.oracleText: More than heat and the strength of his arm, it was his faith that gave the blade its unyielding edge.
529757.translation: 令其手中刀刃锐利无匹的，并非只是熊熊炉火或精巧手艺，还有虔诚信念。

529760.oracleText: The elite cathars of the Parish-Blades train in all manner of techniques designed to delay and frustrate the beasts that hunt the crossways.
529760.translation: 护教军集结精锐组成教区尖刃队，学习各式能够拖延或阻挠猎道野兽的布陷技艺。

529762.oracleText: In Kessig, even celebration wears a fearsome face.
529762.translation: 在凯锡革，就连庆典也笼罩恐怖气氛。

529763.oracleText: Equipped creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 4 or greater.
529763.translation: 佩带此武具的生物不能被力量等于或大于4的生物阻挡。

529765.oracleText: "C'mon, fiend. I'll carve you up like a Harvesttide ham."
529765.translation: 「尽管过来，魔鬼。看我把你当成收成节的火腿一样剁。」

529766.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains vigilance until end of turn.
529766.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

529770.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 for each valor counter on CARDNAME.
529770.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个勇气指示物，由你操控的生物便得+1/+1。

529771.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 for each valor counter on Intrepid Adversary.
529771.translation: 无畏仇敌上每有一个勇气指示物，由你操控的生物便得+1/+1。

529773.oracleText: Silverstreak had lost her rider, but not her instinct to help humankind.
529773.translation: 虽然银纹失去了背上骑手，但并未忘记救助人类的本能。

529777.oracleText: "Even in our darkest times, Avacyn's light still guides us."
529777.translation: 「纵使在至暗时刻，艾维欣的光芒依然为吾人照亮前路。」

529780.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control leaves the battlefield, you gain 1 life.
529780.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物离开战场时，你获得1点生命。

529781.oracleText: If Luminous Phantom would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
529781.translation: 如果月辉幽魅将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

529783.oracleText: "It's creepy out here, isn't it, boy? I always feel like someone's watching us."
529783.translation: 「小子，这里还挺吓人的，不是吗？我总觉得有人在看着我们。」

529785.oracleText: "You could see the spirits all along, couldn't you? Well, now I can too."
529785.translation: 「你是不是一直都看得见鬼魂？现在我也能看见了。」

529786.oracleText: If Morning Apparition would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
529786.translation: 如果啼晓亡灵将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

529788.oracleText: Terms like "safe route" and "cleared district" are a source of dark humor to the cathars who patrol the ruins of Thraben.
529788.translation: 像「安全路线」、「区域无事」这样的回报，都是巡守瑟班遗迹的护教军口中黑色幽默的来源。

529789.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
529789.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

529790.oracleText: Whenever Odric's Outrider or another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
529790.translation: 每当欧吉克的前导兵或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

529792.oracleText: "By ancient magics, by angels' grace, we will survive this night."
529792.translation: 「得远古魔法加护，承天使恩典保佑，我们定能挺过长夜。」

529793.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
529793.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

529794.oracleText: Coven — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures with different powers, Ritual Guardian gains lifelink until end of turn.
529794.translation: 鸠集～在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则仪式守护者获得系命异能直到回合结束。

529797.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Coven — If you control three or more creatures with different powers, creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn instead.
529797.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。鸠集～如果你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则改为由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

529798.oracleText:
Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. 
Coven — If you control three or more creatures with different powers, creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn instead.
529798.translation:
由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。
鸠集～如果你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物，则改为由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。

529800.oracleText: "Werewolves leave messy trails. Easy to follow. Hard to forget."
529800.translation: 「狼人所到之处必留下混乱痕迹。这虽然方便追踪他们，但破坏惨状难以忘怀。」

529801.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each creature you attacked with this turn.
529801.translation: 本回合中你每以一个生物攻击过，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

529806.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card if your life total is greater than or equal to the last noted life total for CARDNAME. Then note your life total.
529806.translation: 在你的维持开始时，如果你的总生命等于或大于最后为CARDNAME记下的总生命，则抓一张牌。然后记下你的总生命。

529807.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card if your life total is greater than or equal to the last noted life total for Sigarda's Splendor. Then note your life total.
529807.translation: 在你的维持开始时，如果你的总生命等于或大于最后为席嘉妲辉耀记下的总生命，则抓一张牌。然后记下你的总生命。

529808.oracleText: Whenever you cast a white spell, you gain 1 life.
529808.translation: 每当你施放白色咒语时，你获得1点生命。

529810.oracleText: "Begone, moon-cursed! These folk are no prey of yours."
529810.translation: 「月诅邪物退散！这些人不是你们的猎物。」

529815.oracleText: It conducts the souls of the righteous to their blessed rest and the spirits of the evil to justice.
529815.translation: 它引导善魂前往受福歇息，押解恶灵接受正义审判。

529819.oracleText: Heida allowed herself a moment of satisfaction as she watched the beast fall, then turned to seek another foe. It would be a long, long night.
529819.translation: 在野兽倒下那一瞬间，亥妲放开紧绷神经沉浸这一胜利时刻，然后便转头去找下一个敌人。这注定会是个漫漫长夜。

529823.oracleText: Coven — {o1oW}: Choose a color. CARDNAME gains hexproof from that color until end of turn and can't be blocked by creatures of that color this turn. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
529823.translation: 鸠集～{o1oW}：选择一种颜色。CARDNAME获得反该色辟邪异能直到回合结束，且本回合不能被该色生物阻挡。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

529824.oracleText: Coven — {o1oW}: Choose a color. Sungold Sentinel gains hexproof from that color until end of turn and can't be blocked by creatures of that color this turn. Activate only if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
529824.translation: 鸠集～{o1oW}：选择一种颜色。旭金哨卫获得反该色辟邪异能直到回合结束，且本回合不能被该色生物阻挡。只能于你操控三个或更多力量各不相同的生物时起动。

529826.oracleText: If an opponent has more life than you, you gain 4 life.
529826.translation: 如果某对手的总生命比你多，则你获得4点生命。

529827.oracleText: If an opponent controls more creatures than you, create two 1/1 white Human creature tokens.
529827.translation: 如果某对手操控的生物比你多，则你派出两个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

529828.oracleText: If an opponent has more cards in hand than you, draw a card.
529828.translation: 如果某对手的手牌比你多，则你抓一张牌。

529830.oracleText: Chandra, Teferi, and Arlinn sought clues to the Moonsilver Key's whereabouts while Kaya dispatched the spirits obstructing their path.
529830.translation: 茜卓、泰菲力和雅琳四处搜寻月银钥下落的线索，而卡娅却不时派出灵魂加以阻挠。

529831.oracleText: Exile target Spirit, creature with disturb, or enchantment.
529831.translation: 放逐目标精怪，结界或具惊扰异能的生物。

529832.oracleText: "We survived the Travails! Killer angels! Horrors from beyond the moon! Now some big werewolves think they can scare us? Let 'em try."
529832.translation: 「我们挺过了癫狂劫！杀人天使！月亮背面的异境惧物！现在有些大狼人觉得他们能吓到我们？但来无妨。」

529834.oracleText: Odric took no joy in violence but neither did he mourn for the twisted things he dispatched. All that mattered were the lives he had saved.
529834.translation: 欧吉克并未因暴力而欢喜，也没替除掉的扭曲怪物而伤悲。眼下最重要的，是他亲手救出的鲜活生命。

529836.oracleText: Geor was determined to stay out until he got a bite from something big.
529836.translation: 吉奥原本打定主意通宵垂钓，直到有大东西咬钩为止。

529839.oracleText: Even in death, he casts his lines, forever fishing for reasons long forgotten.
529839.translation: 就算在死后，他仍不断放饵、继续垂钓，但却早已忘记自己为何坚持。

529840.oracleText: If Hook-Haunt Drifter would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
529840.translation: 如果祟钩漂泊灵将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

529842.oracleText: "Keep master busy with new bits or else maybe she wonders if I'm made of bits too."
529842.translation: 「要让主人忙着处理新材料，不然她或许会以为我也是材料。」

529844.oracleText: Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day, you may tap or untap target nonland permanent.
529844.translation: 每当白昼成为黑夜或黑夜成为白昼时，你可以横置或重置目标非地永久物。

529846.oracleText: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!
529846.translation: 伊沃德吓得吸了一口气：除非是有特别怪异的虫子爬到镜头前，否则他总算是亲眼看到了游魂！

529848.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, mill three cards.

529849.oracleText: When Covetous Castaway dies, mill three cards.
529849.translation: 当贪婪遭黜人死去时，磨三张牌。

529854.oracleText: If Ghostly Castigator would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
529854.translation: 如果魂魅涤除灵将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

529856.oracleText: For every eye gouged out, two blinked open.
529856.translation: 每挖去一只眼，就会睁开两只来。
