530720.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, amass X, where X is that spell's mana value.
530720.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，囤兵X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

532663.oracleText: {o2oW}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Create two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying. Activate only as a sorcery.
532663.translation: {o2oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：派出两个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

532664.oracleText: {o2oW}, Exile Nearheath Chaplain from your graveyard: Create two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying. Activate only as a sorcery.
532664.translation: {o2oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐原陲教士：派出两个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

532903.oracleText: Discard a card: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only once each turn.
532903.translation: 弃一张牌：转化CARDNAME。每回合只能起动一次。

532904.oracleText: Discard a card: Transform Heir of Falkenrath. Activate only once each turn.
532904.translation: 弃一张牌：转化伐肯纳传人。每回合只能起动一次。

532959.oracleText: Discard a card: Vampires you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
532959.translation: 弃一张牌：由你操控的吸血鬼得+1/+1直到回合结束。此异能每回合只能起动一次。

533377.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice three Clues: Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
533377.translation: {oT}，牺牲三个线索：从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌并置于你手上。然后洗牌。

533473.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
533473.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放目标法术力值等于或小于3的瞬间或法术牌？

533623.oracleText: {oT}: Tap target creature. Activate only if you had a creature enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
533623.translation: {oT}：横置目标生物。只能于有生物在你的操控下进战场之回合中起动。

533625.oracleText: Gain control of target nonland permanent with mana value 1 or less.
533625.translation: 获得目标法术力值等于或小于1的非地永久物之操控权。

533626.oracleText: Choose one — • Counter target spell. • Target player draws two cards. • Gain control of target nonland permanent with mana value 1 or less.
533626.translation: 选择一项～ •  反击目标咒语。 •  目标牌手抓两张牌。 •  获得目标法术力值等于或小于1的非地永久物之操控权。

533927.oracleText: Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
533927.translation: 消灭目标地。该地的操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后将其牌库洗牌。

545605.oracleText: Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr's power and toughness are each equal to the number of permanents you control that are Spirits and/or enchantments.
545605.translation: 曙鹿集殉道者凯蒂妲的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控且为精怪和／或结界之永久物的数量。

545608.oracleText: Enchanted creature has flying, lifelink, and protection from Vampires, and it gets +X/+X, where X is the number of permanents you control that are Spirits and/or enchantments.
545608.translation: 所结附的生物具有飞行、系命与反吸血鬼保护异能，且它得+X/+X，X为由你操控且为精怪和／或结界之永久物的数量。

545609.oracleText: If Katilda's Rising Dawn would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545609.translation: 如果凯蒂妲破晓之威将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545613.oracleText: "Thank you, Grandmother. I love you too."

545614.oracleText: If Ancestor's Embrace would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545614.translation: 如果先祖之拥将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545617.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life. [X is the number of creatures you control.]
545617.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。［X为由你操控的生物数量。］

545618.oracleText: Lantern Flare deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life. [X is the number of creatures you control.]
545618.translation: 提灯闪光对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。［X为由你操控的生物数量。］

545620.oracleText: "We can wait like helpless children for a hero, or we can gather our courage and be the heroes. Who's with me?"
545620.translation: 「与其像无助小孩坐等英雄解救，我们更该齐心奋勇化作英雄。谁跟我一起上？」

545621.translation: 民兵召集人不能单独进行攻击。

545622.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap target creature.
545622.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置目标生物。

545623.oracleText: Whenever Militia Rallier attacks, untap target creature.
545623.translation: 每当民兵召集人攻击时，重置目标生物。

545625.oracleText: A moment of distraction, an hour off course.

545632.oracleText: "Stay in the light. I don't know what lurks in those shadows, and I'd like to keep it that way."
545632.translation: 「留在光亮的地方。我不知道阴影中藏着什么，也不想去知道。」

545633.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
545633.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：目标由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得系命与不灭异能直到回合结束。

545634.oracleText: Sacrifice Ollenbock Escort: Target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
545634.translation: 牺牲欧雷巴卫士：目标由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得系命与不灭异能直到回合结束。

545637.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life.
545637.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

545638.oracleText: Whenever Panicked Bystander or another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life.
545638.translation: 每当惊慌观客或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

545639.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, transform CARDNAME.
545639.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过3点或更多生命，则转化CARDNAME。

545640.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, transform Panicked Bystander.
545640.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过3点或更多生命，则转化惊慌观客。

545642.oracleText: "Ha! They fall for it every time."

545643.oracleText: Whenever Cackling Culprit or another creature you control dies, you gain 1 life.
545643.translation: 每当咳笑魁首或另一个由你操控的生物死去时，你获得1点生命。

545644.oracleText: {o1oB}: CARDNAME gains deathtouch until end of turn.
545644.translation: {o1oB}：CARDNAME获得死触异能直到回合结束。

545645.oracleText: {o1oB}: Cackling Culprit gains deathtouch until end of turn.
545645.translation: {o1oB}：咳笑魁首获得死触异能直到回合结束。

545647.oracleText: The recruits trained in eternal night, fueled by the hope that they might one day see the sun again.
545647.translation: 新兵在永夜黑暗中刻苦训练，心中满是再见日光破晓的殷切希望。

545648.oracleText: When Parish-Blade Trainee dies, put its counters on target creature you control.
545648.translation: 当教区精兵学员死去时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

545650.oracleText:
"Creatures of the night dissolve like shadows in the light of faith."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
545650.translation:
「黯夜邪物如同阴影一般，经信念明光照耀便会消散。」
～瑟班守护者莎利雅

545651.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. Scry 1.
545651.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成2点伤害。占卜1。

545652.oracleText: Piercing Light deals 2 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. Scry 1.
545652.translation: 穿心明光对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成2点伤害。占卜1。

545654.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has vigilance.
545654.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+0且具有警戒异能。

545655.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return CARDNAME to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target opponent.
545655.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将CARDNAME在你的操控下移回战场且已转化，并贴附在目标对手上。

545656.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return Radiant Grace to the battlefield transformed under your control attached to target opponent.
545656.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将辉光华彩在你的操控下移回战场且已转化，并贴附在目标对手上。

545658.oracleText:
"Even in times of brutal darkness, never mistake beauty and delicacy for weakness."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
545658.translation:
「哪怕是在暴力横行的黑暗岁月当中，也绝不要把柔美误作软弱。」
～瑟班守护者莎利雅

545661.oracleText:
"It's not that I didn't expect some defiance, but I did hope it wouldn't be so heavily armed."
—Olivia Voldaren
545661.translation:
「倒不是说我没想过他们会反抗，而是没想到会有如此的重装部队。」
～奥莉薇亚沃达连

545665.oracleText:
"Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
545665.translation:
「奥莉薇亚沃达连只顾自己。我们则为更崇高的理念效命。」
～瑟班守护者莎利雅

545667.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME trains, exile up to one other target creature from the battlefield or creature card from a graveyard.
545667.translation: 每当CARDNAME见习时，选择至多另一个目标战场上的生物或坟墓场中的生物牌。将从该处它放逐。

545668.oracleText: Whenever Savior of Ollenbock trains, exile up to one other target creature from the battlefield or creature card from a graveyard.
545668.translation: 每当欧雷巴救星见习时，选择至多另一个目标战场上的生物或坟墓场中的生物牌。将从该处它放逐。

545669.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, put the exiled cards onto the battlefield under their owners' control.
545669.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，将所放逐之牌在其拥有者的操控下放进战场。

545670.oracleText: When Savior of Ollenbock leaves the battlefield, put the exiled cards onto the battlefield under their owners' control.
545670.translation: 当欧雷巴救星离开战场时，将所放逐之牌在其拥有者的操控下放进战场。

545672.oracleText: {o4oW}: Exile enchanted creature. Create a Blood token.
545672.translation: {o4oW}：放逐所结附的生物。派出一个血滴衍生物。

545674.oracleText: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.
545674.translation: 趁奥莉薇亚分神之际，席嘉妲挣脱束缚，召来麾下苍鹭天使。

545675.oracleText: Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have base power and toughness 4/4, have flying, and are Angels in addition to their other types.
545675.translation: 由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物之基础力量与防御力为4/4，具有飞行异能，且额外具有天使此类别。

545677.oracleText: This spell has flash as long as you control a Spirit.
545677.translation: 只要你操控精怪，此咒语便具有闪现异能。

545678.oracleText: When you cast this spell, tap up to two target creatures you don't control.
545678.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，横置至多两个目标不由你操控的生物。

545679.oracleText: "Thraben belongs to the living. I will not rest until it is cleansed."
545679.translation: 「瑟班是生者之地。未彻底净化之前，我绝不歇息。」

545681.oracleText: Priests of the Sigardian Sect travel to the farthest reaches to spread hope and healing, even in the darkest times.
545681.translation: 席嘉妲宗僧侣走遍大陆每个角落，不断传扬希望与生机，就连在最黑暗的时光当中也从未间断。

545682.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn. You gain 1 life. Activate only as a sorcery.
545682.translation: {oT}：目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。你获得1点生命。只能于法术时机起动。

545684.oracleText: She faced down a howlpack alone, saving her town at the cost of her life.
545684.translation: 她只身一人面对整支嚎群，牺牲自己救下全镇性命。

545687.oracleText: Since her passing, many more travelers have made it home alive.
545687.translation: 她过世后，庇护了更多旅人安全返家。

545688.oracleText: If Twinblade Invocation would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545688.translation: 如果双刃祝愿将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545690.oracleText:
"Is this twisted ceremony simply a mockery of the human rite, or has Olivia fallen for her own charade?"
—Sorin Markov
545690.translation:
「究竟这颠狂庆典是用来嘲弄人类的仪式，或者奥莉薇亚已太过入戏无法自拔？」
～索霖马可夫

545692.oracleText: {o4oW}: Put a +1/+1 counter on Unholy Officiant.
545692.translation: {o4oW}：在不洁司仪上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

545694.oracleText: When Kaya saved her village, Berit realized even vampires could be killed. When she brought one down herself, she realized she had found her calling.
545694.translation: 当眼见卡娅拯救村庄之时，蓓丽特才意识到原来吸血鬼也能被杀死。当亲手解决一个之后，她才意识到自己的使命。

545695.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage to a Vampire, destroy that creature.
545695.translation: 每当CARDNAME对一个吸血鬼造成伤害时，消灭后者。

545696.oracleText: Whenever Vampire Slayer deals damage to a Vampire, destroy that creature.
545696.translation: 每当吸血鬼克星对一个吸血鬼造成伤害时，消灭后者。

545698.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Voice of the Blessed.
545698.translation: 每当你获得生命时，在受福者之声上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

545699.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has four or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying and vigilance.
545699.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有四个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有飞行与警戒异能。

545700.oracleText: As long as Voice of the Blessed has four or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has flying and vigilance.
545700.translation: 只要受福者之声上有四个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有飞行与警戒异能。

545701.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has ten or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has indestructible.
545701.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有十个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有不灭异能。

545702.oracleText: As long as Voice of the Blessed has ten or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has indestructible.
545702.translation: 只要受福者之声上有十个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便具有不灭异能。

545704.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put an invitation counter on CARDNAME. If you attacked with two or more creatures this turn, draw a card. Otherwise, create a 1/1 white Human creature token. Then if CARDNAME has three or more invitation counters on it, transform it.
545704.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个请柬指示物。若你本回合中曾以两个或更多生物攻击，则抓一张牌。若否，则派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。然后若CARDNAME上有三个或更多请柬指示物，则转化它。

545705.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put an invitation counter on Wedding Announcement. If you attacked with two or more creatures this turn, draw a card. Otherwise, create a 1/1 white Human creature token. Then if Wedding Announcement has three or more invitation counters on it, transform it.
545705.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在成婚佳讯上放置一个请柬指示物。若你本回合中曾以两个或更多生物攻击，则抓一张牌。若否，则派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。然后若成婚佳讯上有三个或更多请柬指示物，则转化它。

545707.oracleText: Vampires from every bloodline mingled together, all swelling with pride to be seen at the event of the century.
545707.translation: 各血脉的吸血鬼全都受邀齐聚一堂，个个盛饰严装期望在这世纪庆典上展现风采。

545709.oracleText: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.
545709.translation: 婚礼贵客甫抵会场，便受到华服礼宾热情相迎。

545712.oracleText: To most, a terrifying apparition. To a necro-alchemist, a potent fuel source.
545712.translation: 对大多数人来说，这是可怖亡魂。对死灵炼金术士而言，则是潜在燃料。

545714.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent [you control] to its owner's hand.
545714.translation: 将目标［由你操控的］非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

545716.oracleText: Whenever Binding Geist attacks, target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-0 until end of turn.
545716.translation: 每当缠缚游魂攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。

545719.oracleText: If Spectral Binding would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545719.translation: 如果幽魂缚身将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545722.oracleText: Serpents leave their eggs in the cold and inky depths . . .
545722.translation: 巨蛇会将卵产在寒冷深渊之中…

545724.oracleText: When you sacrifice CARDNAME, return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
545724.translation: 当你牺牲CARDNAME，在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

545725.oracleText: When you sacrifice Biolume Egg, return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
545725.translation: 当你牺牲生辉奇卵，在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

545727.oracleText: . . . knowing their hatchlings are more fearsome than anything else that might come along.
545727.translation: …因为它们知道破壳而出的幼蛇，要比所有东西都来得可怕。

545728.oracleText: Sacrifice two Islands: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
545728.translation: 牺牲两个海岛：CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

545729.oracleText: Sacrifice two Islands: Biolume Serpent can't be blocked this turn.
545729.translation: 牺牲两个海岛：生辉巨蛇本回合不能被阻挡。

545733.oracleText: Once each turn, you may cast a spell from the top of your library if it shares a card type with a card exiled with CARDNAME.
545733.translation: 限每回合一次，你可以从你的牌库顶施放咒语，但其须与以CARDNAME放逐的任一牌具共通之牌张类别。

545734.oracleText: Once each turn, you may cast a spell from the top of your library if it shares a card type with a card exiled with Cemetery Illuminator.
545734.translation: 限每回合一次，你可以从你的牌库顶施放咒语，但其须与以墓地燃灯灵放逐的任一牌具共通之牌张类别。

545736.oracleText: Frozen is frozen, whether it's with cold, terror, or both.
545736.translation: 僵住就是僵住，无论原因是寒冷、恐惧或是兼而有之。

545737.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control a Zombie.
545737.translation: 如果你操控灵俑，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

545740.oracleText:
"Don't worry everyone—I hear hoofbeats! The Gavony Riders are coming to save us!"
—Adin, Moorland villager
545740.translation:
「大家不用怕～我听到了马蹄声！加渥尼骑兵来救我们了！」
～荒野村民艾汀

545741.oracleText: {o3oU}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Draw a card.
545741.translation: {o3oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：抓一张牌。

545742.oracleText: {o3oU}, Exile Cobbled Lancer from your graveyard: Draw a card.
545742.translation: {o3oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐拼组枪骑手：抓一张牌。

545744.oracleText: Nephalia's tides obey an unforgiving moon.
545744.translation: 明月无情，催动涅非利亚烈浪滔滔。

545745.oracleText: Each player chooses a nonland permanent they control. Return all nonland permanents not chosen this way to their owners' hands. Then you draw a card for each opponent who has more cards in their hand than you.
545745.translation: 每位牌手各选择一个由其操控的非地永久物。将所有未以此法选中的非地永久物移回各自拥有者手上。然后每有一位手牌比你多的对手，你便抓一张牌。

545750.oracleText:
"I escaped, so why do I still feel like I'm being watched?"
—Gregel, militia leader
545750.translation:
「我明明已经逃了出来，但为什么还有种被盯着的感觉？」
～民兵领袖革利格

545753.oracleText: It doesn't need to breathe, but the suit does help keep the parts together.
545753.translation: 它不用呼吸，这套器具的助益是避免身体散掉。

545758.oracleText: {o3oUoU}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn. Activate only if you own a card in exile.
545758.translation: {o3oUoU}：CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。只能于放逐区中有由你拥有的牌时起动。

545759.oracleText: {o3oUoU}: Dreadlight Monstrosity can't be blocked this turn. Activate only if you own a card in exile.
545759.translation: {o3oUoU}：怖光巨蟹本回合不能被阻挡。只能于放逐区中有由你拥有的牌时起动。

545762.oracleText: Target creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
545762.translation: 目标生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

545763.oracleText: Target creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
545763.translation: 目标生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

545764.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose up to one — • Tap target creature. • Target creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
545764.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择至多一项～ •  横置目标生物。 •  目标生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

545769.oracleText: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.
545769.translation: 塔迷尔一直都想仔细端详游魂的提灯。如今他有无穷尽的时间来好好研究。

545770.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control a Spirit. It also costs {o1} less to cast if you control an enchantment.
545770.translation: 如果你操控精怪，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。如果你操控结界，则它也减少{o1}来施放。

545772.oracleText: "Do you like it, Sister? Its dreadful visage was inspired by your own."
545772.translation: 「姐姐，喜欢吗？它那吓人脸蛋可是照着你做出来的。」

545773.translation: 由你操控的灵俑具有飞行异能。

545774.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice another nontoken creature: Create an X/X blue Zombie creature token, where X is the sacrificed creature's toughness.
545774.translation: {oU}，{oT}，牺牲另一个非衍生物的生物：派出一个X/X蓝色灵俑衍生生物，X为所牺牲生物的防御力。

545776.oracleText: Geists have a knack for showing up wherever they're least expected.
545776.translation: 游魂总能在最意想不到的地方出现。

545777.oracleText: Gutter Skulker can't be blocked as long as it's attacking alone.
545777.translation: 只要水沟匿魂单独进行攻击，它便不能被阻挡。

545779.oracleText: Some people take that as inspiration.
545779.translation: 有些人就从中获得启发。

545780.oracleText: Enchanted creature can't be blocked as long as it's attacking alone.
545780.translation: 只要所结附的生物单独进行攻击，它便不能被阻挡。

545781.oracleText: If Gutter Shortcut would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545781.translation: 如果水沟捷径将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545783.oracleText: Return target spell you don't control to its owner's hand.
545783.translation: 将目标不由你操控的咒语移回其拥有者手上。

545784.oracleText: Return target spell you don't control to its owner's hand.
545784.translation: 将目标不由你操控的咒语移回其拥有者手上。

545785.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
545785.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

545786.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, choose up to one — • Return target spell you don't control to its owner's hand. • Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
545786.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，选择至多一项～ •  将目标不由你操控的咒语移回其拥有者手上。 •  将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

545788.oracleText: Stitching is an ever-evolving field, with each new advancement reaching a new height of horror.
545788.translation: 尸体拼接是一门不断进步的技艺，每项新进展都会将恐怖推到新高度。

545790.oracleText: Draw three cards. [Your maximum hand size is reduced by three for the rest of the game.]
545790.translation: 抓三张牌。［于这盘游戏接下来的时段，你的手牌上限减少三张。］

545792.oracleText: "Our world may be dark, but there's still plenty to see."
545792.translation: 「我们或许生活在黑暗的世界里，但你依旧能看清许多东西。」

545793.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card, then exile a card from your hand face down. You may look at that card for as long as it remains exiled. You may pay {o4oUoU}. If you do, transform CARDNAME.
545793.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌，然后从你手上牌面朝下地放逐一张牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视它。你可以支付{o4oUoU}。如果你如此作，则转化CARDNAME。

545794.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card, then exile a card from your hand face down. You may look at that card for as long as it remains exiled. You may pay {o4oUoU}. If you do, transform Jacob Hauken, Inspector.
545794.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌，然后从你手上牌面朝下地放逐一张牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视它。你可以支付{o4oUoU}。如果你如此作，则转化巡检官雅各布豪肯。

545796.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library face down. You may look at that card for as long as it remains exiled.
545796.translation: 在你的维持开始时，牌面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视它。

545797.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may play a land or cast a spell from among the cards exiled with this permanent without paying its mana cost.
545797.translation: 仅于你的每个回合中且限一次，你可以从以此永久物放逐的牌之中使用一个地或施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

545799.oracleText: Val didn't know what the silent geist was offering . . .
545799.translation: 珐尔并不清楚无声游魂的意图为何…

545801.oracleText: . . . but she knew it would be rude to refuse.
545801.translation: …只知道断然拒绝就太不礼貌。

545802.oracleText: If Lanterns' Lift would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545802.translation: 如果灯浮升空将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545805.oracleText: Return target [Wolf or Werewolf] creature to its owner's hand.
545805.translation: 将目标［狼或狼人］生物移回其拥有者手上。

545810.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of enchanted creature, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types.
545810.translation: 在你的维持开始时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为所结附的生物之复制品，但额外具有精怪此类别。

545811.oracleText: If Ghastly Mimicry would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545811.translation: 如果鬼魅拟装将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545813.oracleText:
"I never get any knitting done, but I don't entirely mind."
—Lorn, Lambholt innkeeper
545813.translation:
「我从来都做不了针线活，但我一点也不在意。」
～羊屯旅店主萝恩

545814.oracleText: Whenever Mischievous Catgeist deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
545814.translation: 每当顽皮猫魂对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

545816.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
545816.translation: 所结附的生物具有「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌。」

545817.oracleText: If Catlike Curiosity would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
545817.translation: 如果好奇猫心将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

545819.oracleText:
"Geralf's prowess continues to grow. He can now replicate my own creations with near-perfect accuracy."
—Ludevic's laboratory notes
545819.translation:
「基拉夫的手法日益精湛。他如今已能复造我的作品，几乎分毫不差。」
～卢德维的实验室纪录

545822.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability.
545822.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，反击目标咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。

545823.oracleText: When Overcharged Amalgam exploits a creature, counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability.
545823.translation: 当溢电拼合怪榨取生物时，反击目标咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。

545825.oracleText: {o2oU}: Exile target creature card from your graveyard and put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
545825.translation: {o2oU}：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐，并在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

545826.oracleText: {o2oU}: Exile target creature card from your graveyard and put a +1/+1 counter on Patchwork Crawler.
545826.translation: {o2oU}：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场放逐，并在拼装匍尸上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

545828.oracleText: Patchwork Crawler has all activated abilities of all creature cards exiled with it.
545828.translation: 拼装匍尸具有所有以它放逐之生物牌的所有起动式异能。

545830.oracleText: Created to capture the spark of genius for later use.
545830.translation: 造来捕捉奇想火花，留备稍后运用。

545831.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
545831.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

545832.oracleText: When Repository Skaab exploits a creature, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
545832.translation: 当集电尸嵌榨取生物时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

545834.oracleText: Stitchers delegate the most important tasks to assistants with a good eye for detail.
545834.translation: 拼接师手上最重要的事情，都会交办给最眼尖的助手。

545835.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put two of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
545835.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余的牌则置入你的坟墓场。

545837.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more creatures, target player mills that many cards.
545837.translation: 每当你以一个或数个生物攻击时，目标牌手磨等量的牌。

545838.oracleText: {o2oU}: Put CARDNAME from your graveyard into your library second from the top.
545838.translation: {o2oU}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶数来第二张的位置。

545839.oracleText: {o2oU}: Put Screaming Swarm from your graveyard into your library second from the top.
545839.translation: {o2oU}：将尖鸣妖群从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶数来第二张的位置。

545841.oracleText: It knows one fundamental truth: bodies belong in graves.
545841.translation: 它知道一个基本真理：尸身该留在墓地里。

545842.oracleText: {oT}, Discard a creature card: Draw a card.

545844.oracleText: The merchant did guarantee the new bait would bring in something big.
545844.translation: 鱼饵商人确实保证这种新饵能钓上来大东西。

545845.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature becomes a blue Serpent with base power and toughness 5/5.
545845.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物成为基础力量与防御力为5/5的蓝色巨蛇。

545848.oracleText:
"If I wanted all the parts to match, I wouldn't have become a stitcher."
—Barton, stitcher
545848.translation:
「如果我坚持所有部位都能对上，我就不只是拼接师了。」
～拼接师巴顿

545854.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your graveyard.
545854.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置入你的坟墓场。

545855.oracleText: Whenever a creature card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, remove an omen counter from CARDNAME. Then if it has no omen counters on it, transform it.
545855.translation: 每当一张生物牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场时，从CARDNAME上移去一个预兆指示物。然后若其上没有预兆指示物，则转化它。

545856.oracleText: Whenever a creature card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, remove an omen counter from Soulcipher Board. Then if it has no omen counters on it, transform it.
545856.translation: 每当一张生物牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场时，从密魂谜板上移去一个预兆指示物。然后若其上没有预兆指示物，则转化它。

545858.oracleText: Rather than consort with demons, the Quietus Cult seeks wisdom from the dead.
545858.translation: 偿生教派不再崇拜恶魔，而是转向死者寻求智慧。

545859.oracleText: Cipherbound Spirit can block only creatures with flying.
545859.translation: 缚密精怪只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。

545860.oracleText: {o3oU}: Draw two cards, then discard a card.

545862.oracleText: Some geists imitate the lives they left behind. Others follow the dreams they never realized.
545862.translation: 有些游魂会模仿旧有习惯继续生活。而有些就大胆追求从未实现的梦想。

545866.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, scry 1, then draw a card.
545866.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

545867.oracleText: When Stitched Assistant exploits a creature, scry 1, then draw a card.
545867.translation: 当缝组助手榨取生物时，占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

545869.oracleText:
"Blasted drake's interfering with the conductivity again. Garl! Go chase it away."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist
545869.translation:
「讨厌的龙兽又来干扰电流通导了。嘎耳！快去把它赶跑。」
～死灵炼金术士卢德维

545870.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell you control, draw a card.
545870.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为由你操控之咒语的目标时，抓一张牌。

545871.oracleText: Whenever Stormchaser Drake becomes the target of a spell you control, draw a card.
545871.translation: 每当逐风龙兽成为由你操控之咒语的目标时，抓一张牌。

545872.oracleText: "Fool! Can't you see the tide has turned against you?"
545872.translation: 「蠢货！你没看到浪潮已经逆转了吗？」

545874.oracleText: The third step in creating a skaab requires draining the body of blood and replacing it with viscus vitae, a mixture of angel's blood and lamp oil.
545874.translation: 制造尸嵌的第三步，需要将尸体内的血液抽干，换用天使鲜血与提灯灯油混合而成的生命精华灌注其中。

545875.oracleText: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell. Create a Blood token.
545875.translation: 反击目标生物或鹏洛客咒语。派出一个血滴衍生物。

545877.oracleText:
"This is your only warning, alchemist. The secrets of the sea are not yours to behold. Lord Krothuss will not be so merciful next time."
—Runo Stromkirk
545877.translation:
「炼金术士，我只警告一次。切莫妄自探寻大海的秘密。我主寇瑟斯下次就不会这么客气了。」
～卢诺溪堡

545878.oracleText: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a basic land card.
545878.translation: 抓三张牌。然后除非你弃一张基本地牌，否则弃两张牌。

545880.oracleText: The towers and catwalks of the Voldaren fortress are lit by the lanterns of geists endlessly seeking a way out.
545880.translation: 困于沃达连堡中的无数游魂不断找寻出路，手中提灯照亮了要塞中每一处高塔与步道。

545881.oracleText: Wanderlight Spirit can block only creatures with flying.
545881.translation: 游灯精怪只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。

545883.oracleText:
"May the ocean take it"
—Nephalia expression meaning
"good riddance"
545883.translation:
「愿海洋将它带走」
～涅非利亚用语，意指
「终得解脱」

545885.oracleText: Counter target spell [that wasn't cast from its owner's hand].
545885.translation: 反击目标咒语［，且该咒语须未从其拥有者手上施放］。

545887.oracleText: Ivold was aghast when his device revealed the full scope of the geist infestation.
545887.translation: 透过自己仪器观察到的游魂侵扰全貌，让伊沃德大为震惊。

545888.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.
545888.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

545890.oracleText:
"No, no, it's just a murder of crows, not an omen of murder. . . . I think."
—York, Kessig tracker
545890.translation:
「不是，不是，这应该只是骇人鸦群，不是害命征兆…应该。」
～凯锡革追迹人约克

545894.oracleText: Target player shuffles up to four target cards from their graveyard into their library. You look at the top four cards of your library, then put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
545894.translation: 目标牌手将至多四张目标牌从其坟墓场洗入其牌库。你检视你牌库顶的四张牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

545896.oracleText:
"Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!"
—Beltstad, cathar recruit, last words
545896.translation:
「糟了。糟了。糟了。糟了，还来啊！」
～护教军新兵贝兹德的遗言

545897.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may search your library for a card named Wretched Throng, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
545897.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张名称为污劣大群的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

545898.oracleText: When Wretched Throng dies, you may search your library for a card named Wretched Throng, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
545898.translation: 当污劣大群死去时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张名称为污劣大群的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

545900.translation:
「次次见效。」
～凯锡革护林者荷拉娜

545902.oracleText: Target opponent exiles two cards from their hand.
545902.translation: 目标对手从其手上放逐两张牌。

545903.oracleText: Choose one — • Exile target Zombie. • Target opponent exiles two cards from their hand.
545903.translation: 选择一项～ •  放逐目标灵俑。 •  目标对手从其手上放逐两张牌。

545905.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Zombie you control dies, look at the top card of your library. If it's a Zombie card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard.
545905.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的灵俑死去时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是灵俑牌，则你可以展示该牌并将它置于你手上。若你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

545906.oracleText: Whenever Archghoul of Thraben or another Zombie you control dies, look at the top card of your library. If it's a Zombie card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. If you don't put the card into your hand, you may put it into your graveyard.
545906.translation: 每当瑟班大尸鬼或另一个由你操控的灵俑死去时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是灵俑牌，则你可以展示该牌并将它置于你手上。若你未将该牌置于你手上，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

545908.oracleText:
"Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized."
—Anje Falkenrath
545908.translation:
「把嘴巴擦干净，孩子。可不能让奥莉薇亚觉得我们没教养。」
～安姬伐肯纳

545909.oracleText: Target creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
545909.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得-13/-13。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

545913.oracleText: {o3oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
545913.translation: {o3oB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

545914.oracleText: {o3oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice Blood Fountain: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
545914.translation: {o3oB}，{oT}，牺牲融血喷泉：将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

545917.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice a Blood token. If you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
545917.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲一个血滴衍生物。若你如此作，则它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

545918.oracleText: Whenever Bloodcrazed Socialite attacks, you may sacrifice a Blood token. If you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
545918.translation: 每当血狂名流攻击时，你可以牺牲一个血滴衍生物。若你如此作，则它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

545920.oracleText: {o1oB}, Discard a card: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it. Then if there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, transform CARDNAME.
545920.translation: {o1oB}，弃一张牌：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。然后如果你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，则转化CARDNAME。

545921.oracleText: {o1oB}, Discard a card: Bloodsworn Squire gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it. Then if there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, transform Bloodsworn Squire.
545921.translation: {o1oB}，弃一张牌：血誓扈从获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。然后如果你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，则转化血誓扈从。

545923.oracleText: Bloodsworn Knight's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
545923.translation: 血誓骑士的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

545924.oracleText: {o1oB}, Discard a card: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
545924.translation: {o1oB}，弃一张牌：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

545925.oracleText: {o1oB}, Discard a card: Bloodsworn Knight gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
545925.translation: {o1oB}，弃一张牌：血誓骑士获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

545927.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, that player creates a Blood token.
545927.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，该牌手派出一个血滴衍生物。

545928.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Blood token defending player controls.
545928.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手每操控一个血滴衍生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

545929.oracleText: Whenever Bloodvial Purveyor attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Blood token defending player controls.
545929.translation: 每当血瓶贩商攻击时，防御牌手每操控一个血滴衍生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

545931.oracleText: These days, ghouls are the only abundant resource in Thraben.
545931.translation: 这时节，瑟班还充足的东西就只有食尸鬼了。

545932.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures that each have toughness greater than their power, transform CARDNAME.
545932.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多防御力比力量大的生物，则转化CARDNAME。

545933.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures that each have toughness greater than their power, transform Catapult Fodder.
545933.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控三个或更多防御力比力量大的生物，则转化抛石炮灰。

545935.oracleText: And they're more than happy to share the wealth.
545935.translation: 而它们也非常乐于与他人分享富足。

545936.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Target opponent loses life equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness.
545936.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物：目标对手失去若干生命，其数量等同于所牺牲之生物的防御力。

545938.oracleText: Remove X counters from target permanent, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
545938.translation: 从目标永久物上移去X个指示物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

545939.oracleText: Remove X counters from target permanent, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
545939.translation: 从目标永久物上移去X个指示物，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

545940.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
545940.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

545941.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.
545941.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为所放逐之牌的法术力值。

545945.oracleText: Specifics were kept secret, but word quickly spread that the show was a must-see.
545945.translation: 虽然内容尚未揭晓，但人人都说这演出非看不可。

545946.oracleText: {o2oB}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

545947.oracleText: {o2oB}: Transform Concealing Curtains. Activate only as a sorcery.
545947.translation: {o2oB}：转化遮物帘幕。只能于法术时机起动。

545950.oracleText: When this creature transforms into CARDNAME, target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player discards that card, then draws a card.
545950.translation: 当此生物转化为CARDNAME时，目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。若你如此作，则该牌手弃掉该牌，然后抓一张牌。

545951.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Revealing Eye, target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player discards that card, then draws a card.
545951.translation: 当此生物转化为揭物巨眼时，目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。若你如此作，则该牌手弃掉该牌，然后抓一张牌。

545953.oracleText: Swarms of bats poured from Lurenbraum Fortress carrying wedding invitations to vampires of every bloodline.
545953.translation: 无数蝙蝠从卢仁堡蜂拥而出，将婚礼请柬送向各支血脉的吸血鬼。

545957.oracleText:
"Do not try to negotiate with me, human. You want power? This is the price."
—Ormendahl
545957.translation:
「休想跟我谈条件，人类。你想要力量？这就是代价。」
～欧魔达

545958.oracleText: Exile the top thirteen cards of your library, then search your library for a card. Put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
545958.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的十三张牌，然后从你牌库中搜寻一张牌。将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。

545960.oracleText: A tragic moment pushed him to a blasphemous act.
545960.translation: 悲剧当头，迫他犯下叛教之举。

545961.oracleText: When another creature you control dies, transform Desperate Farmer.
545961.translation: 当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，转化情急农夫。

545963.oracleText: Once he'd tasted that dark power, there was no turning back.
545963.translation: 自从触碰黑暗力量后，他就再也回不了头。

545965.oracleText: It can barely feel the sword anymore.
545965.translation: 它几乎再也感受不到刀剑之苦。

545968.oracleText: The most dangerous place to be in Kessig is alone.
545968.translation: 全凯锡革最危险之处，便是「独处」。

545971.oracleText: Target player reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it [with mana value 2 or less]. That player discards that card.
545971.translation: 目标牌手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张［法术力值等于或小于2的］非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

545973.oracleText: By the sixth day of darkness, the lake was more blood than water.
545973.translation: 到了黑夜的第六天，湖水已近乎成为血池。

545974.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice a non-Demon creature. If you do, create a token that's a copy of CARDNAME.
545974.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲一个非恶魔生物。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为CARDNAME的复制品。

545975.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice a non-Demon creature. If you do, create a token that's a copy of Dreadfeast Demon.
545975.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，牺牲一个非恶魔生物。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为飨惧恶魔的复制品。

545977.oracleText:
"I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached."
—Olivia Voldaren
545977.translation:
「我以前会请帮手，但后来发现还是有手有脚的才更适合当侍从。」
～奥莉薇亚沃达连

545978.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards, create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
545978.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张牌时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

545980.oracleText: "Here you go. Can't have you sleeping through your own wedding day."
545980.translation: 「乖乖喝下去。你可不能在自己成婚的日子上一睡不醒。」

545981.oracleText: When you discard CARDNAME, you may pay {oB}. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
545981.translation: 当你弃掉CARDNAME时，你可以支付{oB}。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

545982.oracleText: When you discard Edgar's Awakening, you may pay {oB}. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
545982.translation: 当你弃掉艾德嘉觉醒时，你可以支付{oB}。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

545984.translation: 伐肯纳先人不能进行阻挡。

545985.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a Blood token.
545985.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

545986.oracleText: Whenever Falkenrath Forebear deals combat damage to a player, create a Blood token.
545986.translation: 每当伐肯纳先人对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

545987.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice two Blood tokens: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield.
545987.translation: {oB}，牺牲两个血滴衍生物：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场。

545988.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice two Blood tokens: Return Falkenrath Forebear from your graveyard to the battlefield.
545988.translation: {oB}，牺牲两个血滴衍生物：将伐肯纳先人从你的坟墓场移回战场。

545991.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.
545991.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

545992.oracleText: When Fell Stinger exploits a creature, target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.
545992.translation: 当极恶刺蝎榨取生物时，目标牌手抓两张牌且失去2点生命。

545994.oracleText:
"You are one of the few to whom we offer our blessing. What fool would reject immortality?"
—Runo Stromkirk
545994.translation:
「你是少数能得到我们祝福的人。怎样的蠢货才会甘愿拒绝永生？」
～卢诺溪堡

545995.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 as long as it's a Vampire. Otherwise, it gets -2/-2.
545995.translation: 只要所结附的生物是吸血鬼，它便得+2/+2。若否，则它得-2/-2。

545998.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Blood token, you gain 1 life.
545998.translation: 每当你牺牲一个血滴衍生物时，你获得1点生命。

546000.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, destroy target planeswalker.
546000.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，消灭目标鹏洛客。

546001.oracleText: When Graf Reaver exploits a creature, destroy target planeswalker.
546001.translation: 当墓地裂肢兵榨取生物时，消灭目标鹏洛客。

546002.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, Graf Reaver deals 1 damage to you.
546002.translation: 在你的维持开始时，墓地裂肢兵对你造成1点伤害。

546004.oracleText:
"You can always tell who's new from the screaming."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist
546004.translation:
「你能从叫声听出谁是新人。」
～史革达教众蒂努娅

546005.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Create two Blood tokens.
546005.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。派出两个血滴衍生物。

546007.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+0. It gets an additional +0/+2 and has deathtouch as long as an Equipment named Bride's Gown is attached to a creature you control.
546007.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+0。只要由你操控的生物上贴附有名称为新娘婚纱的武具，佩带此武具的生物便再得+0/+2且具有死触异能。

546009.oracleText: He wanders the Moorlands hoping to one day chop off a head worthy of replacing his own.
546009.translation: 他在荒野四处游荡，希望有天能够砍到值得换上的脑袋。

546010.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another nontoken Zombie you control dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
546010.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的灵俑死去时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

546011.oracleText: Whenever Headless Rider or another nontoken Zombie you control dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
546011.translation: 每当无头骑手或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的灵俑死去时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

546015.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one that hasn't been chosen — • Each player sacrifices a creature. • You draw a card and you lose 1 life. • Transform CARDNAME.
546015.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ •  每位牌手各牺牲一个生物。 •  你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。 •  转化CARDNAME。

546016.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one that hasn't been chosen — • Each player sacrifices a creature. • You draw a card and you lose 1 life. • Transform Henrika Domnathi.
546016.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ •  每位牌手各牺牲一个生物。 •  你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。 •  转化亨莉卡多纳提。

546018.oracleText: "Once you've tasted demon blood, you'll wonder why you ever settled for human."
546018.translation: 「在尝过恶魔鲜血之后，你就会怀疑此前为何区区人血就能满足自己。」

546019.oracleText: {o1oBoB}: Each creature you control with flying, deathtouch, and/or lifelink gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
546019.translation: {o1oBoB}：每个由你操控且具有飞行，死触和／或系命异能的生物各得+1/+0直到回合结束。

546020.oracleText: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.
546020.translation: 欧吉克倾尽全力想要抵御吸血鬼的诅咒。但在与怪物缠斗一生之后，自己注定也要成为怪物。

546022.oracleText: "Aren't you going to invite me in?"

546023.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, any opponent may sacrifice a creature. If no one does, transform CARDNAME.
546023.translation: 在你的维持开始时，任意对手可以牺牲一个生物。若无人如此作，则转化CARDNAME。

546024.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, any opponent may sacrifice a creature. If no one does, transform Innocent Traveler.
546024.translation: 在你的维持开始时，任意对手可以牺牲一个生物。若无人如此作，则转化无辜旅人。

546026.oracleText: "Aren't you going to offer me a drink?"

546027.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as an opponent controls a Human.
546027.translation: 只要任一对手操控人类，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

546028.oracleText: Malicious Invader gets +2/+0 as long as an opponent controls a Human.
546028.translation: 只要任一对手操控人类，恶毒侵客便得+2/+0。

546030.oracleText:
"This still doesn't make you the brains of the operation."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa
546030.translation:
「就算这样你也没办法成为行动首脑。」
～尸鬼牧者基沙

546031.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, each opponent exiles a card from their hand.
546031.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，每位对手各从其手上放逐一张牌。

546032.oracleText: When Mindleech Ghoul exploits a creature, each opponent exiles a card from their hand.
546032.translation: 当夺念食尸鬼榨取生物时，每位对手各从其手上放逐一张牌。

546034.oracleText: Some wicked souls linger only to consume the warmth of life.
546034.translation: 有些邪恶灵魂徘徊世间，只是为了贪图生机暖意。

546036.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target [Human] creature. You gain 3 life.
546036.translation: CARDNAME对目标［人类］生物造成3点伤害。你获得3点生命。

546037.oracleText: Parasitic Grasp deals 3 damage to target [Human] creature. You gain 3 life.
546037.translation: 寄生之攫对目标［人类］生物造成3点伤害。你获得3点生命。

546039.oracleText: To Olivia's guests, a welcome. To everyone else, a warning.
546039.translation: 对奥莉薇亚的宾客而言，这是欢迎之路。对所有其他人来说，则是警告之途。

546041.oracleText: Destroy all creatures [with mana value 2 or less].
546041.translation: 消灭所有［法术力值等于或小于2的］生物。

546043.oracleText:
"The jaw bone's connected to the skull bone. The skull bone's connected to the . . . uh . . . hook thingy."
—Garl, stitcher's assistant
546043.translation:
「腭骨接在头骨上。头骨接在…呃…接在那像钩子的东西上。」
～拼接师助手嘎耳

546044.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
546044.translation: {o2oB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

546045.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return Persistent Specimen from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
546045.translation: {o2oB}：将复组标本从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

546047.oracleText: Small talk is a dying art.

546048.oracleText: You draw two cards, lose 2 life, then create a Blood token.
546048.translation: 你抓两张牌，失去2点生命，然后派出一个血滴衍生物。

546050.oracleText: "Forgive my manners. It's been so long since I had a guest for dinner."
546050.translation: 「请恕我招待不周。我已经很久没有留客人一起用餐了。」

546051.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you discarded a card this turn, transform CARDNAME.
546051.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中弃过牌，则转化CARDNAME。

546052.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you discarded a card this turn, transform Ragged Recluse.
546052.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中弃过牌，则转化褴褛隐士。

546054.oracleText: Her cauldron refilled, she settled in to wait for the next unsuspecting traveler to knock at her door.
546054.translation: 就这样，她把锅再度装满，又坐回椅子上，静待下一位毫无戒心的旅人敲开房门。

546055.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
546055.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

546056.oracleText: Whenever Odious Witch attacks, defending player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
546056.translation: 每当可憎巫婆攻击时，防御牌手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

546058.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, create a Blood token.
546058.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则派出一个血滴衍生物。

546059.oracleText: Sacrifice two Blood tokens: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.
546059.translation: 牺牲两个血滴衍生物：转化CARDNAME。只能于法术时机起动。

546060.oracleText: Sacrifice two Blood tokens: Transform Restless Bloodseeker. Activate only as a sorcery.
546060.translation: 牺牲两个血滴衍生物：转化无休觅血客。只能于法术时机起动。

546062.oracleText: {o4oB}: Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
546062.translation: {o4oB}：每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

546065.oracleText: Now that it doesn't need to breathe, its hunting ground extends well beyond the sea.
546065.translation: 既然现在再也不用呼吸，它的狩猎地盘就已超越海洋。

546066.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, each opponent sacrifices a creature.
546066.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，每位对手各牺牲一个生物。

546067.oracleText: When Rot-Tide Gargantua exploits a creature, each opponent sacrifices a creature.
546067.translation: 当腐潮巨罡兽榨取生物时，每位对手各牺牲一个生物。

546069.oracleText: Olivia set a few villagers loose in the hedge maze as part of the evening's "entertainment."
546069.translation: 奥莉薇亚让几位村民在树篱迷宫中自由活动，当作傍晚的「余兴活动」。

546073.oracleText: Look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card and put it into your hand. If you do, you lose life equal to its mana value.
546073.translation: 检视你的牌库顶牌。你可以展示该牌并将它置于你手上。如果你如此作，则你失去等同于其法术力值的生命。

546074.oracleText: Create a 2/3 black Vampire creature token with flying and lifelink.
546074.translation: 派出一个2/3黑色，具飞行与系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。

546075.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 13 damage to any target. You gain 13 life.
546075.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成13点伤害。你获得13点生命。

546076.oracleText: Sorin the Mirthless deals 13 damage to any target. You gain 13 life.
546076.translation: 阴郁的索霖对任意一个目标造成13点伤害。你获得13点生命。

546078.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, put a slime counter on each creature you don't control.
546078.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，在每个不由你操控的生物上各放置一个黏菌指示物。

546079.oracleText: Creatures you don't control get -1/-1 for each slime counter on them.
546079.translation: 对每个不由你操控的生物而言，其上每有一个黏菌指示物，它便得-1/-1。

546080.oracleText: Whenever a creature you don't control with a slime counter on it dies, create a 1/1 black Slug creature token.
546080.translation: 每当一个不由你操控且其上有黏菌指示物的生物死去时，你派出一个1/1黑色蛞蝓衍生生物。

546081.oracleText: {oUoB}, Sacrifice a Slug: Draw a card.

546084.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may exile it. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
546084.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以将它放逐。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

546085.oracleText: When Undead Butler dies, you may exile it. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
546085.translation: 当不死管家死去时，你可以将它放逐。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

546087.oracleText: Few take kindly to being put in their place, especially if their place is the grave.
546087.translation: 没人乐意被逼到绝地，特别是绝地就是墓地的时候。

546089.oracleText:
"In case any of you new recruits were wondering, this is why we don't use mass graves anymore."
—Kerren of the Mausoleum Guards
546089.translation:
「你们这些新人如果好奇过为什么不干脆把死人集体一埋了事的话，这就是答案。」
～陵墓守卫珂伦

546092.oracleText: Young vampires gorge themselves at every meal, but their elders have learned to savor the smallest bite.
546092.translation: 年轻吸血鬼每餐都狼吞虎咽，但其长者已学会了每口都啜吸细品。

546093.oracleText: Target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. Create two Blood tokens.
546093.translation: 目标牌手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。你派出两个血滴衍生物。

546095.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another nontoken creature you control dies, create a Blood token.
546095.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

546096.oracleText: Whenever Voldaren Bloodcaster or another nontoken creature you control dies, create a Blood token.
546096.translation: 每当沃达连血育师或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

546097.oracleText: Whenever you create a Blood token, if you control five or more Blood tokens, transform CARDNAME.
546097.translation: 每当你派出一个血滴衍生物时，若你操控五个或更多血滴衍生物，则转化CARDNAME。

546098.oracleText: Whenever you create a Blood token, if you control five or more Blood tokens, transform Voldaren Bloodcaster.
546098.translation: 每当你派出一个血滴衍生物时，若你操控五个或更多血滴衍生物，则转化沃达连血育师。

546100.oracleText: "Humans throw rice and release doves at their weddings? How quaint."
546100.translation: 「人类婚礼上会撒米粒、放白鸽？真奇怪。」

546101.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to one target Blood token you control becomes a 2/2 black Bat creature with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
546101.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，至多一个目标由你操控的血滴衍生物成为2/2黑色，具飞行与敏捷异能的蝙蝠生物，且仍具有原本类别。

546103.oracleText: In lieu of payment, he was granted permission to devour any unauthorized visitors.
546103.translation: 这份工作虽没有实质报酬，但他有权吞食一切擅闯访客。

546104.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice a Blood token. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and draw a card.
546104.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲一个血滴衍生物。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物并抓一张牌。

546105.oracleText: Whenever Wedding Security attacks, you may sacrifice a Blood token. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on Wedding Security and draw a card.
546105.translation: 每当婚礼警卫攻击时，你可以牺牲一个血滴衍生物。若你如此作，则在婚礼警卫上放置一个+1/+1指示物并抓一张牌。

546106.oracleText: The Falkenrath progenitor was a vicious falconer, and the line is quick to remind others of its heritage.
546106.translation: 伐肯纳血脉的先祖曾是凶狠的驯鹰师，其族人也常常会向他者展现自家传统。

546109.oracleText: Take an extra turn after this one. During that turn, damage can't be prevented. [At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game.]
546109.translation: 于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。于该回合中，伤害不能被防止。［在该回合的结束步骤开始时，你输掉这盘游戏。］

546113.oracleText: When you attack with exactly two creatures, transform CARDNAME.
546113.translation: 当你以正好两个生物攻击时，转化CARDNAME。

546114.oracleText: When you attack with exactly two creatures, transform Alluring Suitor.
546114.translation: 当你以正好两个生物攻击时，转化迷人求婚者。

546116.oracleText: When this creature transforms into CARDNAME, add {oRoR}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
546116.translation: 当此生物转化为CARDNAME时，加{oRoR}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

546117.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Deadly Dancer, add {oRoR}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
546117.translation: 当此生物转化为致命共舞者时，加{oRoR}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

546118.oracleText: {oRoR}: CARDNAME and another target creature each get +1/+0 until end of turn.
546118.translation: {oRoR}：CARDNAME与另一个目标生物各得+1/+0直到回合结束。

546119.oracleText: {oRoR}: Deadly Dancer and another target creature each get +1/+0 until end of turn.
546119.translation: {oRoR}：致命共舞者与另一个目标生物各得+1/+0直到回合结束。

546121.oracleText: "One vampire for every family member I've lost."
546121.translation: 「每位逝去家人，都要用一条吸血鬼性命陪葬。」

546122.oracleText: Target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of cards named Ancestral Anger in your graveyard.
546122.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得践踏异能且得+X/+0，X为你坟墓场中名称为先祖怒火之牌的数量加1。

546124.oracleText: "Careful, this thing's dangerous. Wouldn't want anyone getting hurt."
546124.translation: 「小心，这东西很危险。不想见到有人被伤到。」

546125.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
546125.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

546126.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Ballista Watcher deals 1 damage to any target.
546126.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：巨弩守卫对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

546128.oracleText: {o2oR}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. A creature dealt damage this way can't block this turn.
546128.translation: {o2oR}：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。以此法受到伤害的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

546129.oracleText: {o2oR}: Ballista Wielder deals 1 damage to any target. A creature dealt damage this way can't block this turn.
546129.translation: {o2oR}：巨弩持兽对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。以此法受到伤害的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

546131.oracleText: Whenever Belligerent Guest deals combat damage to a player, create a Blood token.
546131.translation: 每当好斗宾客对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

546133.oracleText: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.
546133.translation: 碰上这么一位尤物，亚冯心醉神迷地献上了自己的血液。

546134.translation: 鲜血催眠师不能进行阻挡。

546135.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice one or more Blood tokens, target creature can't block this turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.
546135.translation: 每当你牺牲一个或数个血滴衍生物时，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

546137.oracleText: Blood Petal Celebrant has first strike as long as it's attacking.
546137.translation: 只要血瓣主祭正进行攻击，它便具有先攻异能。

546138.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a Blood token.
546138.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

546139.oracleText: When Blood Petal Celebrant dies, create a Blood token.
546139.translation: 当血瓣主祭死去时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

546141.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Create a Blood token.
546141.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。派出一个血滴衍生物。

546144.oracleText: Whenever a player plays a land or casts a spell, if it shares a card type with the exiled card, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player.
546144.translation: 每当任一牌手使用地或施放咒语时，若它与所放逐的牌具共通之牌张类别，则CARDNAME对该牌手造成2点伤害。

546145.oracleText: Whenever a player plays a land or casts a spell, if it shares a card type with the exiled card, Cemetery Gatekeeper deals 2 damage to that player.
546145.translation: 每当任一牌手使用地或施放咒语时，若它与所放逐的牌具共通之牌张类别，则墓地守门者对该牌手造成2点伤害。

546147.oracleText: Add {oR}. CARDNAME deals 1 damage to up to one target player or planeswalker.
546147.translation: 加{oR}。CARDNAME对至多一位目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

546148.oracleText: Add {oR}. Chandra, Dressed to Kill deals 1 damage to up to one target player or planeswalker.
546148.translation: 加{oR}。盛装茜卓对至多一位目标牌手或鹏洛客造成1点伤害。

546149.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. If it's red, you may cast it this turn.
546149.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。如果它是红色，则本回合中，你可以施放它。

546150.oracleText: Whenever you cast a red spell, this emblem deals X damage to any target, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell.
546150.translation: 每当你施放红色咒语时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量。

546151.oracleText: Exile the top five cards of your library. You may cast red spells from among them this turn. You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a red spell, this emblem deals X damage to any target, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell."
546151.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的五张牌。本回合中，你可以从其中施放红色咒语。你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当你施放红色咒语时，此徽记对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量。」

546153.oracleText:
"We cannot escape change, but with faith and fortitude, we can mold it to our liking."
—Marel, Dawnhart witch
546153.translation:
「虽然改变无可逃避，但凭着强烈信念与坚定意志，我们能将改变为己所用。」
～曙鹿集女巫玛芮尔

546154.oracleText: Discard your hand, then draw a card for each card you've discarded this turn.
546154.translation: 弃掉你的手牌，然后你本回合中每弃过一张牌，便抓一张牌。

546156.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if you attacked with exactly one other creature this combat, you may have that creature's base power and toughness become 4/3 until end of turn.
546156.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你本次战斗中还以正好一个其他生物攻击，则你可以使后者生物之基础力量与防御力成为4/3直到回合结束。

546157.oracleText: Whenever Creepy Puppeteer attacks, if you attacked with exactly one other creature this combat, you may have that creature's base power and toughness become 4/3 until end of turn.
546157.translation: 每当可怖控偶师攻击时，若你本次战斗中还以正好一个其他生物攻击，则你可以使后者生物之基础力量与防御力成为4/3直到回合结束。

546159.oracleText: Creatures attacking enchanted player have trample.
546159.translation: 向所结附之牌手进行攻击的生物具有践踏异能。

546160.oracleText: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to enchanted player, that player exiles the top card of their library. Until end of turn, that creature's controller may play that card and they may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.
546160.translation: 每当一个生物对所结附的牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手放逐其牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，该生物的操控者可以使用该牌，且他可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

546162.oracleText: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.
546162.translation: 在经历数周的无尽黑暗之后，这丝曙光正是点燃全史顿襄人民战斗意志的引线。

546165.oracleText: "You can join me or feed me. Choose fast."
546165.translation: 「你可以加入我或喂饱我。选快点。」

546169.oracleText: When the defenses around Lurenbraum Fortress faltered, the Crimson Ballroom received some unexpected guests.
546169.translation: 卢仁堡周围的防线瓦解后，绯红舞宴厅内迎来了一些不速之客。

546170.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature and planeswalker they control.
546170.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

546171.oracleText: End the Festivities deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature and planeswalker they control.
546171.translation: 喜庆终结向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

546176.oracleText: When Harold ran from the wolves, the others called him a coward.
546176.translation: 眼见哈罗德面对狼群狼狈逃窜，其他村民还笑他作懦夫。

546178.oracleText: Come nightfall, they were the ones fleeing in terror.
546178.translation: 夜幕降临后，就轮到其他村民狼狈逃窜。

546180.oracleText:
"I noticed you were short on party favors, so I brought my own."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf
546180.translation:
「我注意到你伴手礼没带够，所以自己也带了一些。」
～卡兹特克星队长希佳

546181.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
546181.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果本回合中该永久物将被置入坟墓场，则改为将其放逐。

546182.oracleText: Flame-Blessed Bolt deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
546182.translation: 炎佑弩矢对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

546184.oracleText:
"Devils need no reason to stir up chaos. The chaos itself is their reward."
—Rem Karolus, Fiendslayer
546184.translation:
「魔鬼煽动混乱根本就不需要理由。混乱本身便是回报。」
～邪鬼克星连卡洛

546186.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Frenzied Devils gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
546186.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，狂热魔鬼得+2/+2直到回合结束。

546188.oracleText: A carriage crafted from the finest materials. Horses bred from the finest stock. Skulls taken from the finest foes.
546188.translation: 上等材料塑车厢。上级血统育挽马。上佳敌手供响骨。

546189.oracleText: Tap two untapped creatures you control: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
546189.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的生物：CARDNAME成为神器生物直到回合结束。

546190.oracleText: Tap two untapped creatures you control: Honeymoon Hearse becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
546190.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的生物：蜜月柩车成为神器生物直到回合结束。

546192.oracleText: Even vampires know to travel faster when they hear howling in the Geier Reach passes.
546192.translation: 就连吸血鬼都晓得，要是在基尔山脉听见狼嚎，脚程就得加快些。

546193.oracleText: As long as you control another Wolf or Werewolf, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and has trample.
546193.translation: 只要你操控另一个狼或狼人，CARDNAME便得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

546194.oracleText: As long as you control another Wolf or Werewolf, Hungry Ridgewolf gets +1/+0 and has trample.
546194.translation: 只要你操控另一个狼或狼人，饥饿脊狼便得+1/+0且具有践踏异能。

546197.oracleText: Whenever Ill-Tempered Loner is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target.
546197.translation: 每当暴躁独行客受到伤害时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

546198.oracleText: {o1oR}: Ill-Tempered Loner gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
546198.translation: {o1oR}：暴躁独行客得+2/+0直到回合结束。

546200.oracleText: Whenever a permanent you control is dealt damage, CARDNAME deals that much damage to any target.
546200.translation: 每当一个由你操控的永久物受到伤害时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

546201.oracleText: Whenever a permanent you control is dealt damage, Howlpack Avenger deals that much damage to any target.
546201.translation: 每当一个由你操控的永久物受到伤害时，嚎群复仇者对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

546202.oracleText: {o1oR}: Howlpack Avenger gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
546202.translation: {o1oR}：嚎群复仇者得+2/+0直到回合结束。

546204.oracleText:
"When lost souls wander into the woods, the wilds have a way of showing them who they really are."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha
546204.translation:
「迷途之人误入林间后，野境便有办法让他们认清自我。」
～维汀群首领拉希妲

546205.oracleText: It becomes night. Discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards plus one.
546205.translation: 当前成为黑夜。弃任意数量的牌，然后抓该数量加一的牌。

546207.oracleText: "Hunter's fire" was meant for slaying monsters in the Ulvenwald, but that never stopped Ralen from showing it off.
546207.translation: 本来「猎人秘火」是用来在沃文森内杀戮怪物用的，但拉仁总忍不住要四处炫耀。

546208.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Kessig Flamebreather deals 1 damage to each opponent.
546208.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，凯锡革喷焰师向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

546210.oracleText: "It's a perfect partnership. My village is safe from wolf attacks, and she gets to eat any vampires we catch."
546210.translation: 「我们的合作堪称完美。这样一来我的村庄就可以免遭狼群袭击，而她也能尽情享用我们逮到的吸血鬼。」

546211.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}, Exile three cards from your graveyard: Create a 3/2 red Wolf creature token.
546211.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌：派出一个3/2红色的狼衍生生物。

546213.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature. Create a number of Blood tokens equal to the amount of excess damage dealt to that creature this way.
546213.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害。派出若干血滴衍生物，其数量等同于以此法对该生物造成的过量伤害数量。

546214.oracleText: Lacerate Flesh deals 4 damage to target creature. Create a number of Blood tokens equal to the amount of excess damage dealt to that creature this way.
546214.translation: 利爪碎身对目标生物造成4点伤害。派出若干血滴衍生物，其数量等同于以此法对该生物造成的过量伤害数量。

546216.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Lambholt Raconteur deals 1 damage to each opponent.
546216.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，羊屯说书人向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

546218.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.
546218.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

546219.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Lambholt Ravager deals 2 damage to each opponent.
546219.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，羊屯吞噬兽向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

546221.oracleText: These thick-furred wolves have adapted to Stensia's storms, channeling their energy into bursts of supernatural speed.
546221.translation: 这类狼群皮毛厚实，已然适应史顿襄的风暴天气，甚至还能通导其间闪电能量化作异常疾速。

546222.oracleText: {o1oR}: CARDNAME gains first strike until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
546222.translation: {o1oR}：CARDNAME获得先攻异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

546223.oracleText: {o1oR}: Lightning Wolf gains first strike until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
546223.translation: {o1oR}：闪电狼获得先攻异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

546226.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to CARDNAME while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove that many +1/+1 counters from it. When one or more counters are removed from CARDNAME this way, it deals that much damage to any target.
546226.translation: 如果CARDNAME于其上有+1/+1指示物时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并从其上移去等量的+1/+1指示物。当以此法从CARDNAME上移去一个或数个指示物时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

546227.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to Magma Pummeler while it has a +1/+1 counter on it, prevent that damage and remove that many +1/+1 counters from it. When one or more counters are removed from Magma Pummeler this way, it deals that much damage to any target.
546227.translation: 如果岩浆猛击灵于其上有+1/+1指示物时将受到伤害，则防止该伤害，并从其上移去等量的+1/+1指示物。当以此法从岩浆猛击灵上移去一个或数个指示物时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

546229.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create an X/X red Dragon Illusion creature token with flying and haste, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell. Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step.
546229.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个X/X红色，具飞行与敏捷异能的龙／虚影衍生生物，X为施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量。在下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该衍生物。

546231.oracleText: Target Vampire you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.
546231.translation: 目标由你操控的吸血鬼对另一个目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

546232.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. • Target Vampire you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.
546232.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。 •  目标由你操控的吸血鬼对另一个目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

546234.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage, create that many Blood tokens.
546234.translation: 每当CARDNAME造成伤害时，派出等量的血滴衍生物。

546235.oracleText: Whenever Olivia's Attendants deals damage, create that many Blood tokens.
546235.translation: 每当奥莉薇亚的喜娘造成伤害时，派出等量的血滴衍生物。

546236.oracleText: {o2oR}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
546236.translation: {o2oR}：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

546237.oracleText: {o2oR}: Olivia's Attendants deals 1 damage to any target.
546237.translation: {o2oR}：奥莉薇亚的喜娘对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

546239.oracleText: Memories of the Harvesttide tragedy festered until they grew into an incarnate rage that set the world ablaze.
546239.translation: 收成节惨剧的记忆持续积聚，直至此时化作怨火成形，点燃整个世界。

546240.oracleText: When Pyre Spawn dies, it deals 3 damage to any target.
546240.translation: 当葬火孽物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

546242.oracleText: A stitcher looks at their creation and sees the result of years of study and hours of toil. A devil sees a new plaything.
546242.translation: 拼接师看着自己的成果，感慨多年研究与数日劳苦终得回报。魔鬼则看到了新的玩物。

546244.oracleText:
"It is our duty to bring the Blessed Sleep to the dead, even if they resist that gift."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft
546244.translation:
「我们的职责是确保死者得享受福安眠，就算对方拒绝亦然。」
～圣沙弗骑士团的葛俐

546245.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that permanent is a Spirit, CARDNAME also deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller.
546245.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。如果该永久物是精怪，则CARDNAME再对该永久物的操控者造成2点伤害。

546246.oracleText: Rending Flame deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that permanent is a Spirit, Rending Flame also deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller.
546246.translation: 劈裂烈火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。如果该永久物是精怪，则劈裂烈火再对该永久物的操控者造成2点伤害。

546248.oracleText: The wolf's captor hid his fear, but he knew someday the runes would fail, the collar would break, and the wolf would remember his face.
546248.translation: 捕到这头狼的猎人压下心头恐惧，但他知道总有一天会符文失效、项圈破碎，恶狼又再度想起他的面容。

546249.oracleText: {o3oR}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of Wolves and Werewolves you control to target opponent.
546249.translation: {o3oR}，{oT}：CARDNAME向目标对手造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的狼和狼人数量。

546250.oracleText: {o3oR}, {oT}: Runebound Wolf deals damage equal to the number of Wolves and Werewolves you control to target opponent.
546250.translation: {o3oR}，{oT}：符锢狼向目标对手造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的狼和狼人数量。

546253.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Blood token, you may have CARDNAME become a 3/3 Vampire artifact creature with haste until end of turn.
546253.translation: 每当你牺牲血滴衍生物时，你可以使CARDNAME成为3/3，具敏捷异能的吸血鬼神器生物直到回合结束。

546254.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Blood token, you may have Sanguine Statuette become a 3/3 Vampire artifact creature with haste until end of turn.
546254.translation: 每当你牺牲血滴衍生物时，你可以使血色塑像成为3/3，具敏捷异能的吸血鬼神器生物直到回合结束。

546256.oracleText: "Vampires have done nothing but take from us. Tonight, we reclaim what's ours!"
546256.translation: 「吸血鬼只知道拿取。今晚我们要夺回一切！」

546257.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 red Human creature token. Then if you control exactly thirteen permanents, you may sacrifice CARDNAME. When you do, it deals 7 damage to any target.
546257.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个1/1红色人类衍生生物。然后若你操控正好十三个永久物，则你可以牺牲CARDNAME。当你如此作时，它对任意一个目标造成7点伤害。

546258.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 red Human creature token. Then if you control exactly thirteen permanents, you may sacrifice Stensia Uprising. When you do, it deals 7 damage to any target.
546258.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个1/1红色人类衍生生物。然后若你操控正好十三个永久物，则你可以牺牲史顿襄式抗暴。当你如此作时，它对任意一个目标造成7点伤害。

546259.oracleText: Before the officiant even had a chance to ask if anyone objected to the Voldaren-Markov union, Arlinn made her opinion known.
546259.translation: 还没轮到司仪询问是否有人反对本次沃马联姻，雅琳就抢先发表了意见。

546261.oracleText: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.
546261.translation: 奥莉薇亚很快让所有村庄见识到，拒付血税会是什么下场。

546262.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each non-Vampire creature. Create a Blood token.
546262.translation: CARDNAME对每个非吸血鬼生物各造成2点伤害。派出一个血滴衍生物。

546263.oracleText: Vampires' Vengeance deals 2 damage to each non-Vampire creature. Create a Blood token.
546263.translation: 吸血鬼复仇对每个非吸血鬼生物各造成2点伤害。派出一个血滴衍生物。

546265.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 1 damage to each of up to one target creature, up to one target player, and/or up to one target planeswalker.
546265.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对至多一个目标生物，至多一位目标牌手和／或至多一个目标鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

546266.oracleText: Whenever Volatile Arsonist attacks, it deals 1 damage to each of up to one target creature, up to one target player, and/or up to one target planeswalker.
546266.translation: 每当易怒纵火人攻击时，它对至多一个目标生物，至多一位目标牌手和／或至多一个目标鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

546268.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 2 damage to each of up to one target creature, up to one target player, and/or up to one target planeswalker.
546268.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对至多一个目标生物，至多一位目标牌手和／或至多一个目标鹏洛客各造成2点伤害。

546269.oracleText: Whenever Dire-Strain Anarchist attacks, it deals 2 damage to each of up to one target creature, up to one target player, and/or up to one target planeswalker.
546269.translation: 每当怖狼脉崇乱兽攻击时，它对至多一个目标生物，至多一位目标牌手和／或至多一个目标鹏洛客各造成2点伤害。

546271.oracleText: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"
546271.translation: 「如果你不学会提升品味，永生不死又有何意义？」

546275.oracleText: She spent many years trying to harness chaos.
546275.translation: 她曾耗费多年光阴试图掌控混乱。

546276.oracleText: {oT}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to you. Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
546276.translation: {oT}：CARDNAME对你造成2点伤害。放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。只能于法术时机起动。

546277.oracleText: {oT}: Voltaic Visionary deals 2 damage to you. Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
546277.translation: {oT}：电流幻视师对你造成2点伤害。放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。只能于法术时机起动。

546278.oracleText: When you play a card exiled with CARDNAME, transform CARDNAME.
546278.translation: 当你使用以CARDNAME放逐的牌时，转化CARDNAME。

546279.oracleText: When you play a card exiled with Voltaic Visionary, transform Voltaic Visionary.
546279.translation: 当你使用以电流幻视师放逐的牌时，转化电流幻视师。

546281.oracleText: She finally realized that chaos was meant to run rampant, as was she.
546281.translation: 她最后终于明白，混乱天性不受掌控，而她天性也该如此。

546282.translation: 涌电狂战士不能进行阻挡。

546284.oracleText: "Your guard attacked me. He got what was coming to him."
546284.translation: 「你的守卫先动的手。他得到了该有的报应。」

546287.oracleText: Wrathful Jailbreaker attacks each combat if able.
546287.translation: 愤怒脱囚兽每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

546289.oracleText: Innistrad's best archers are trained by the Quiver of Kessig, an order of cathars who specialize in ranged combat.
546289.translation: 凯锡革利箭团是护教军中专精于远程打击的分支，而全依尼翠最准的神射手尽皆出身于此。

546293.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
546293.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于4的咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

546294.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on Ascendant Packleader.
546294.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于4的咒语时，在成长首领上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

546296.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put two +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control.
546296.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

546299.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
546299.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

546302.oracleText: {o2oG}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: You gain 5 life.
546302.translation: {o2oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：你获得5点生命。

546303.oracleText: {o2oG}, Exile Bramble Wurm from your graveyard: You gain 5 life.
546303.translation: {o2oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐刺藤亚龙：你获得5点生命。

546305.oracleText: She monitors the roads in every province, mapping safe routes through hunting grounds and haunting grounds alike.
546305.translation: 她时刻监视各省道路情况，并在图上标出穿越危险地带的安全路径～无论那里闹狼还是闹鬼。

546306.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put up to two land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
546306.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中至多两张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

546309.oracleText: Spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each card type they share with cards exiled with CARDNAME.
546309.translation: 对你施放的咒语而言，它与以CARDNAME放逐的各牌每有一种共通之牌张类别，便减少{o1}来施放。

546310.oracleText: Spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each card type they share with cards exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
546310.translation: 对你施放的咒语而言，它与以墓地游掠狼放逐的各牌每有一种共通之牌张类别，便减少{o1}来施放。

546312.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on one or more Humans you control, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
546312.translation: 每当在一个或数个由你操控的人类上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

546315.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere during your turn, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
546315.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌于你的回合中从任何区域进入你的坟墓场时，派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

546316.oracleText:
"The forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves."
—Wrenn
546316.translation:
「这个世界的树林敢于保护自己。」
～芮恩

546319.oracleText: Cultivator Colossus's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
546319.translation: 培护巨像的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

546323.oracleText: "Our coven finds strength in nature and purpose in serving our communities."
546323.translation: 「我们集群在自然万物中寻得力量，在服务集众间找到目标。」

546327.oracleText: Things buried on Innistrad rarely seem to stay that way.
546327.translation: 埋在依尼翠地下的东西几乎都不会长留原地。

546329.oracleText: Search your library for a [basic land] card, [reveal it,] put it into your hand, then shuffle.
546329.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张［基本地］牌，［展示该牌，］将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。

546331.oracleText: As the natural cycle of day and night grew twisted, old powers stirred deep in the Ulvenwald.
546331.translation: 于昼夜自然转变遭邪力扭曲后，远古之力也开始在沃文森深处复苏。

546332.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then if that creature has toughness 6 or greater, transform CARDNAME.
546332.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后若该生物的防御力等于或大于6，则转化CARDNAME。

546333.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then if that creature has toughness 6 or greater, transform Dormant Grove.
546333.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后若该生物的防御力等于或大于6，则转化休眠古林地。

546335.oracleText: Far from the bloodsoaked wedding, unseen by human eyes, a long-slumbering force arose to protect its home.
546335.translation: 在远离血腥婚宴之地，远离人眼所及之处，一股沉眠力量开始醒转卫护家园。

546337.oracleText:
"I would welcome her into my pack with honor."
—Arlinn Kord
546337.translation:
「她倘愿加入我的狼群，便是我莫大荣耀。」
～雅琳珂德

546341.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain trample until end of turn.
546341.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

546342.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain trample until end of turn.
546342.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

546343.oracleText: Target land gains "{oT}: Add {oGoGoG}" until end of turn.
546343.translation: 目标地获得「{oT}：加{oGoGoG}」直到回合结束。

546344.oracleText: Target land gains "{oT}: Add {oGoGoG}" until end of turn.
546344.translation: 目标地获得「{oT}：加{oGoGoG}」直到回合结束。

546345.oracleText: Draw a card if you control a creature with power 3 or greater.
546345.translation: 如果你操控力量等于或大于3的生物，则抓一张牌。

546346.oracleText: Draw a card if you control a creature with power 3 or greater.
546346.translation: 如果你操控力量等于或大于3的生物，则抓一张牌。

546347.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one — • Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain trample until end of turn. • Target land gains "{oT}: Add {oGoGoG}" until end of turn. • Draw a card if you control a creature with power 3 or greater. • You gain 3 life.
546347.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择一项～ •  直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。 •  目标地获得「{oT}：加{oGoGoG}」直到回合结束。 •  如果你操控力量等于或大于3的生物，则抓一张牌。 •  你获得3点生命。

546352.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may search your library for a basic land card that doesn't share a land type with a land you control, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
546352.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，且其不得与由你操控的地有共通之地类别，将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。

546353.oracleText: Whenever Hiveheart Shaman attacks, you may search your library for a basic land card that doesn't share a land type with a land you control, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
546353.translation: 每当巢心祭师攻击时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，且其不得与由你操控的地有共通之地类别，将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。

546354.oracleText: {o5oG}: Create a 1/1 green Insect creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
546354.translation: {o5oG}：派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。在该衍生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。只能于法术时机起动。

546356.oracleText: The local gossips swore Nesmith lost his hands in a fight with a werewolf.
546356.translation: 当地人的流言一致认定聂密斯是跟狼人搏斗而失去双手。

546359.oracleText: Riphook Raider can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
546359.translation: 裂钩劫狼不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

546361.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target Wolf or Werewolf you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
546361.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的狼或狼人得+2/+2直到回合结束。
