546362.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts their second spell each turn, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
546362.translation: 每当任一对手施放每回合中其第二个咒语时，你派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

546364.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If it's a Wolf or Werewolf, untap CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.
546364.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}：你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。如果它是狼或狼人，则重置CARDNAME。只能于法术时机起动。

546365.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If it's a Wolf or Werewolf, untap Howlpack Piper. Activate only as a sorcery.
546365.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}：你可以将一张生物牌从你手上放进战场。如果它是狼或狼人，则重置嚎群笛手。只能于法术时机起动。

546370.oracleText: There's only so many times she can take being asked . . .
546370.translation: 她受不了人们三番五次地问她…

546378.oracleText:
"We are not here to mourn their loss. We are here to celebrate their lives."
—Vesna, Dawnhart witch
546378.translation:
「我们集聚于此，并非悲悼生命离逝。我们集聚于此，是为追念灿烂往生。」
～曙鹿集女巫文斯娜

546379.oracleText: Whenever a Human you control dies, draw a card.
546379.translation: 每当一个由你操控的人类死去时，抓一张牌。

546382.oracleText:
"Run! It's coming for us! Eventually!"
—Yaster, Havengul shopkeeper
546382.translation:
「快跑！它在追我们！总会追得上！」
～海温古店主雅斯特

546384.oracleText: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.
546384.translation: 拼接师、教众、食腐兽，在多方争抢下，如今尸体需求旺盛。

546388.oracleText:
"Tread carefully. You remember what happened in the last quiet, peaceful clearing."
—Halana, to Alena
546388.translation:
「下脚时务必当心。上次也是一片看似安静祥和的空地，你没忘记后来怎样了吧。」
～荷拉娜告诫阿雷娜

546392.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +2/+2.
546392.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+2/+2。

546393.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a land, it has "{oT}: Add two mana of any one color."
546393.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是地，它便具有「{oT}：加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。」

546396.oracleText: He blends seamlessly into the forest, waiting silently for his prey.
546396.translation: 他完美融入树林，静待猎物现身。

546399.oracleText: Even when he strikes, the only sound is the snap of jaws through bone.
546399.translation: 就连他出击，也只在利颚咬断骨头时才有声音。

546401.oracleText: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.
546401.translation: 单头幼狼是危险讯号，因为幼狼总不落单。

546402.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another Wolf or Werewolf, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
546402.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控另一个狼或狼人，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

546403.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another Wolf or Werewolf, put a +1/+1 counter on Packsong Pup.
546403.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控另一个狼或狼人，则在唤群幼狼上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

546404.oracleText: When Packsong Pup dies, you gain life equal to its power.
546404.translation: 当唤群幼狼死去时，你获得等同于其力量的生命。

546406.oracleText: All druids seek to preserve nature, but some go about it in rather unusual ways.
546406.translation: 所有德鲁伊都希望能将自然保留原样，只是有些会采取一些极不寻常的方式。

546407.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +3/+2 as long as there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard.
546407.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，CARDNAME便得+3/+2。

546408.oracleText: Reclusive Taxidermist gets +3/+2 as long as there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard.
546408.translation: 只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多生物牌，隐居标本师便得+3/+2。

546410.oracleText: The roots preserved the armor for a hundred years, safeguarding it for a traveler in need.
546410.translation: 树根已将盔甲保管上百年，留待有需要的旅人取用。

546411.oracleText: Return up to one target creature card and up to one target noncreature permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile CARDNAME.
546411.translation: 将至多一张目标生物牌和至多一张目标非生物的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。放逐CARDNAME。

546412.oracleText: Return up to one target creature card and up to one target noncreature permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile Retrieve.
546412.translation: 将至多一张目标生物牌和至多一张目标非生物的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。放逐取回旧物。

546414.oracleText: The Dawnhart survivors welcome recruits of all shapes and sizes.
546414.translation: 曙鹿集幸存者欢迎新人加入，不限体型，无论大小。

546418.oracleText: Destroy target artifact an opponent controls.
546418.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控的神器。

546419.oracleText: Destroy target artifact an opponent controls.
546419.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控的神器。

546420.oracleText: CARDNAME fights target Zombie an opponent controls.
546420.translation: CARDNAME与目标由对手操控的灵俑互斗。

546421.oracleText: Sawblade Slinger fights target Zombie an opponent controls.
546421.translation: 锯轮射手与目标由对手操控的灵俑互斗。

546425.oracleText:
"We're not at odds with the woods. How could we be, when we share so many enemies?"
—Marel, Dawnhart witch
546425.translation:
「我们不会与树林为敌。眼下我们双方同需抵御外敌，又怎能节外生枝？」
～曙鹿集女巫玛芮尔

546429.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, you may sacrifice a Forest. If you do, that creature gains trample until end of turn.
546429.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个树林。若你如此作，则该生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

546431.oracleText:
"These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again. Now, their patience is rewarded."
—Wrenn
546431.translation:
「这些种子虔诚等待太阳再度升起。如今它们的耐心终得回报。」
～芮恩

546434.oracleText:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein
546434.translation:
「记得等几年真菌全死掉后再回来。到时候我们再来瞧瞧箱子里头是个什么东西。」
～老鲁斯登

546435.oracleText: When Spore Crawler dies, draw a card.
546435.translation: 当芽孢匍菌死去时，抓一张牌。

546437.oracleText: The mushrooms growing in the wolves' fur possess curative properties incredible enough to tempt many alchemists into risking their lives to track one down.
546437.translation: 长在这种狼毛当中的蘑菇具有奇妙疗效，吸引众多炼金术士甘愿拼死追猎。

546440.oracleText:
"You want that venom? Collect it yourself! I'm not losing another pair of dragonhide gloves."
—Old Rutstein
546440.translation:
「你想要蝎毒？自己去采！我不想再糟蹋一副龙皮手套。」
～老鲁斯登

546444.oracleText:
"Obviously it's dangerous, but I've never seen anything like it. This could be an entirely new species! I say we follow it."
—Halana, Kessig ranger
546444.translation:
「虽然它看起来就很危险，但我从来没见过这生物。可能会是全新物种也说不定！我觉得该跟上。」
～凯锡革护林者荷拉娜

546448.oracleText:
"We've learned enough! I say we run."
—Alena, Kessig trapper
546448.translation:
「我们看得够清楚了！我觉得该快逃。」
～凯锡革布陷人阿雷娜

546449.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +1/+1 and have trample and haste.
546449.translation: 由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1且具有践踏与敏捷异能。

546453.oracleText: . . . does not always mean living in peace.

546455.oracleText: Ever since the ritual, Ryla didn't have an appetite at the dinner table, but her long walks in the forest always seemed to satiate her hunger.
546455.translation: 打从仪式之后，芮乐在餐桌上总是没有胃口，但每次在林间长时散步就能填饱肚子。

546456.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains reach until end of turn. Untap it.
546456.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得延势异能。将它重置。

546458.oracleText: Tovolar's howlpack had scattered, but the Dire-Strain survivors were still on the hunt.
546458.translation: 虽然托瓦拉嚎群已被击溃，但怖狼脉中的幸存诸狼仍在狩猎。

546459.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn if it's night. Then it deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
546459.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物和目标不由你操控的生物。如果当前是黑夜，则该由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。然后前者对后者造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

546461.oracleText: The villagers feared him. The cathars scorned him. Only in the wilds did he find a family that accepted him.
546461.translation: 村民们惧怕他。护教军唾弃他。只有野境的家族愿意接纳他。

546462.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if you control a Wolf or Werewolf.
546462.translation: 如果你操控狼或狼人，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

546464.oracleText: He raged not just against vampires, but against civilization itself.
546464.translation: 他不仅对吸血鬼有怨，更对整个文明社会有仇。

546465.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Wolf or Werewolf you control dies, draw a card.
546465.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的狼或狼人死去时，抓一张牌。

546466.oracleText: Whenever Wedding Crasher or another Wolf or Werewolf you control dies, draw a card.
546466.translation: 每当婚礼破坏兽或另一个由你操控的狼或狼人死去时，抓一张牌。

546468.oracleText: The soft creak of trees in the wind is not always cause for comfort.
546468.translation: 听闻树枝在风中摇曳沙沙作响，并不一定能让人安心。

546469.oracleText: Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
546469.translation: 每个由你操控且防御力比力量大的生物皆依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。

546473.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice another creature or a Blood token: Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
546473.translation: {o2}，牺牲另一个生物或一个血滴衍生物：每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

546476.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is twice the number of Blood tokens you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
546476.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之血滴衍生物数量的两倍。只能于法术时机起动。

546477.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Bloodtithe Harvester: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is twice the number of Blood tokens you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
546477.translation: {oT}，牺牲血税收集官：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之血滴衍生物数量的两倍。只能于法术时机起动。

546485.oracleText: If Brinebound Gift would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
546485.translation: 如果海底赠礼将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

546487.oracleText: Her face shines with youthful innocence.
546487.translation: 她的稚气脸庞洋溢着孩提童真。

546488.oracleText: {o2oRoG}: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
546488.translation: {o2oRoG}：派出一个2/2绿色的狼衍生生物。

546490.translation: 她的尖锐利爪则是另一回事。

546492.oracleText: "Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest."
546492.translation: 「只要沃达连家的人一天还在呼吸，我就一天不会安息。」

546494.oracleText: When Dorothea, Vengeful Victim attacks or blocks, sacrifice it at end of combat.
546494.translation: 当怨仇亡者多萝霞攻击或阻挡，在战斗结束时将它牺牲。

546496.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a 4/4 white Spirit creature token with flying that's tapped and attacking. Sacrifice that token at end of combat.
546496.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在战斗结束时，牺牲该衍生物。

546497.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature attacks, create a 4/4 white Spirit creature token with flying that's tapped and attacking. Sacrifice that token at end of combat."
546497.translation: 所结附的生物具有「每当此生物攻击时，派出一个4/4白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。在战斗结束时，牺牲该衍生物。」

546498.oracleText: If Dorothea's Retribution would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
546498.translation: 如果多萝霞的报偿将从任何区域进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

546500.oracleText: "Our kind has taken my gift for granted. It is time to correct that folly."
546500.translation: 「吸血鬼族类已将我的馈赠当作应得之义。是时候修正这一错误观念了。」

546501.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.
546501.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

546502.oracleText: When Edgar, Charmed Groom dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control.
546502.translation: 当遭魅新郎艾德嘉死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

546504.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 white and black Vampire creature token with lifelink and put a bloodline counter on CARDNAME. Then if there are three or more bloodline counters on it, remove those counters and transform it.
546504.translation: 在你的维持开始时，派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物，并在CARDNAME上放置一个血脉指示物。然后若其上有三个或更多血脉指示物，则移去这些指示物并转化它。

546505.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 white and black Vampire creature token with lifelink and put a bloodline counter on Edgar Markov's Coffin. Then if there are three or more bloodline counters on it, remove those counters and transform it.
546505.translation: 在你的维持开始时，派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物，并在艾德嘉马可夫之棺上放置一个血脉指示物。然后若其上有三个或更多血脉指示物，则移去这些指示物并转化它。

546507.oracleText: She is cursed with visions of monsters and suffering . . . and all her visions come true.
546507.translation: 她遭受诅咒，终日被怪物与苦难视像困扰…且这些视像竟一一成真。

546508.oracleText: If you would draw a card, exile the top two cards of your library instead. You may play those cards this turn.
546508.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌，则改为放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

546510.oracleText: Whenever a Frog you control attacks, mill three cards.
546510.translation: 每当一个由你操控的蛙攻击时，磨三张牌。

546511.oracleText: Whenever a permanent card is put into your graveyard from your library, exile it with a croak counter on it.
546511.translation: 每当一张永久物牌从你的牌库进入你的坟墓场时，将它放逐，且上面有一个蛙声指示物。

546512.oracleText: You may play lands and cast spells from among cards you own in exile with croak counters on them.
546512.translation: 你可以从放逐区中由你拥有且其上有蛙声指示物的牌之中使用地和施放咒语。

546514.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is Halana and Alena's power. That creature gains haste until end of turn.
546514.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为荷拉娜与阿雷娜的力量。该生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

546516.oracleText: Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature token you control.
546516.translation: 由你操控的生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。在至多一个目标由你操控的衍生生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

546517.oracleText: Until end of turn, if one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
546517.translation: 直到回合结束，如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为派出两倍数量的该类衍生物。

546518.oracleText: Exile all cards from all graveyards, then create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying for each card exiled this way.
546518.translation: 放逐所有坟墓场，然后每以此法放逐一张牌，便派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

546520.oracleText: The ceremonial "incense" was a concoction of Edgar's own design, a precise blend of blood from his favorite human lineages.
546520.translation: 典礼上所用「熏香」乃是依照艾德嘉亲笔配方调制而成，其中精确混合了来自其最喜爱人类各家族的血液。

546521.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, you may pay {o2}. If you do, draw a card.
546521.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

546524.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to two target creatures you control each get +1/+0 until end of turn.
546524.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，至多两个目标由你操控的生物各得+1/+0直到回合结束。

546532.oracleText: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.
546532.translation: 她的盛大婚礼只有一个目的：在她治下一统吸血鬼诸血脉。

546533.oracleText: When you don't control a legendary Vampire, exile this creature.
546533.translation: 当你未操控传奇吸血鬼时，放逐此生物。

546534.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking. It gains "When you don't control a legendary Vampire, exile this creature."
546534.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。它获得「当你未操控传奇吸血鬼时，放逐此生物。」

546535.oracleText: Whenever Olivia, Crimson Bride attacks, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking. It gains "When you don't control a legendary Vampire, exile this creature."
546535.translation: 每当绯红新娘奥莉薇亚攻击时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场且正进行攻击。它获得「当你未操控传奇吸血鬼时，放逐此生物。」

546539.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card. If a creature card with mana value 6 or greater is revealed this way, transform CARDNAME.
546539.translation: 在你的维持开始时，检视你的牌库顶牌。你可以展示该牌。若以此法展示出一张法术力值等于或大于6的生物牌，则转化CARDNAME。

546540.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card. If a creature card with mana value 6 or greater is revealed this way, transform Runo Stromkirk.
546540.translation: 在你的维持开始时，检视你的牌库顶牌。你可以展示该牌。若以此法展示出一张法术力值等于或大于6的生物牌，则转化卢诺溪堡。

546542.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of another target attacking creature. If that creature is a Kraken, Leviathan, Octopus, or Serpent, create two of those tokens instead.
546542.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标进行攻击之生物的复制品，并为横置且正进行攻击。若该生物是巨海兽，海怪，章鱼或巨蛇，则改为派出两个上述衍生物。

546543.oracleText: Whenever Krothuss, Lord of the Deep attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of another target attacking creature. If that creature is a Kraken, Leviathan, Octopus, or Serpent, create two of those tokens instead.
546543.translation: 每当深渊之主寇瑟斯攻击时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标进行攻击之生物的复制品，并为横置且正进行攻击。若该生物是巨海兽，海怪，章鱼或巨蛇，则改为派出两个上述衍生物。

546545.oracleText: As long as you've put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature this turn, CARDNAME has trample and lifelink.
546545.translation: 只要你本回合中在生物上放置过一个或数个+1/+1指示物，CARDNAME便具有践踏与系命异能。

546546.oracleText: As long as you've put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature this turn, Sigardian Paladin has trample and lifelink.
546546.translation: 只要你本回合中在生物上放置过一个或数个+1/+1指示物，席嘉妲神圣武士便具有践踏与系命异能。

546547.oracleText: {o1oGoW}: Target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains trample and lifelink until end of turn.
546547.translation: {o1oGoW}：目标由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得践踏与系命异能直到回合结束。

546549.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control exploits a nontoken creature, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
546549.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物榨取非衍生物的生物时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

546551.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, create a 1/1 green and white Human Soldier creature token with training.
546551.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，派出一个1/1，绿白双色，具见习异能的人类／士兵衍生生物。

546553.oracleText: {o2oGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 green Insect creature token for each creature card in your graveyard. Activate only as a sorcery.
546553.translation: {o2oGoU}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，便派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

546554.oracleText: {o2oGoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice Vilespawn Spider: Create a 1/1 green Insect creature token for each creature card in your graveyard. Activate only as a sorcery.
546554.translation: {o2oGoU}，{oT}，牺牲孽恶蜘蛛：你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，便派出一个1/1绿色昆虫衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

546559.oracleText:
"Please, my friends, help yourselves to the help."
—Olivia Voldaren
546559.translation:
「朋友们，不必客气，一切都可在服务台自取。」
～奥莉薇亚沃达连

546562.oracleText:
"Sturdy nails make for sound sleep."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard
546562.translation:
「钉得越牢，睡得越熟。」
～席尔本卫队的考伯洛

546563.translation: 向你进行攻击的生物得-1/-0。

546564.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you were dealt 4 or more damage this turn, exile CARDNAME.
546564.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中受过4点或更多伤害，则放逐CARDNAME。

546565.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you were dealt 4 or more damage this turn, exile Boarded Window.
546565.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中受过4点或更多伤害，则放逐钉板窗户。

546567.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage, create a Blood token.
546567.translation: 每当此生物造成战斗伤害时，派出一个血滴衍生物。

546568.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage, create a Blood token."
546568.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有「每当此生物造成战斗伤害时，派出一个血滴衍生物。」

546570.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each Construct you control.
546570.translation: 你每操控一个组构体，此生物便得+1/+1。

546571.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a token that's a copy of the exiled card, except it's a 0/0 Construct artifact in addition to its other types and it has "This creature gets +1/+1 for each Construct you control." It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
546571.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为所放逐之牌的复制品，但它是0/0组构体神器，仍具有原本类别，且具有「你每操控一个组构体，此生物便得+1/+1。」它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

546573.oracleText: As the sand eroded, a faint sound could be heard whirling under the ground.
546573.translation: 泥沙消退后，地下远远传来一阵机械运转声。

546574.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Put an omen counter on CARDNAME.
546574.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。在CARDNAME上放置一个预兆指示物。

546575.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Put an omen counter on Foreboding Statue.
546575.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。在恶兆塑像上放置一个预兆指示物。

546576.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if there are three or more omen counters on CARDNAME, untap it, then transform it.
546576.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若CARDNAME上有三个或更多预兆指示物，则将它重置，然后转化它。

546577.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if there are three or more omen counters on Foreboding Statue, untap it, then transform it.
546577.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若恶兆塑像上有三个或更多预兆指示物，则将它重置，然后转化它。

546579.oracleText: Were it not for the cultists' fatal curiosity, the terrible machine might have lain dormant for decades more.
546579.translation: 若不是教众过分好奇，这可怕机械可能还会继续沉眠地底。

546582.oracleText: After the Travails, Runechanters set about repairing twisted symbols of Avacyn as the first step in restoring faith in the Church.
546582.translation: 癫狂劫过后，符颂师便开始着手修复扭曲的艾维欣标志，作为恢复人们对教会信仰的第一步。

546587.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove a suspect counter from CARDNAME: Draw a card.
546587.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个怀疑指示物：抓一张牌。

546588.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove a suspect counter from Investigator's Journal: Draw a card.
546588.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从调查员日志上移去一个怀疑指示物：抓一张牌。

546589.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice Investigator's Journal: Draw a card.

546592.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Exile all cards from all graveyards, then draw a card.
546592.translation: {o1}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：放逐所有坟墓场，然后抓一张牌。

546593.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Exile Lantern of the Lost: Exile all cards from all graveyards, then draw a card.
546593.translation: {o1}，{oT}，放逐逝者明灯：放逐所有坟墓场，然后抓一张牌。

546597.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature can't be blocked this turn. If it's a Vampire, it also gains lifelink until end of turn.
546597.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。如果它是吸血鬼，则它再获得系命异能直到回合结束。

546598.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Wedding Invitation: Target creature can't be blocked this turn. If it's a Vampire, it also gains lifelink until end of turn.
546598.translation: {oT}，牺牲婚礼请柬：目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。如果它是吸血鬼，则它再获得系命异能直到回合结束。

546600.oracleText: Deadly mushrooms litter these woods, each waiting for an errant footstep to release its noxious spores.
546600.translation: 致命蘑菇遍布林地，误踩哪株都会引发剧毒孢雾。

546603.oracleText: Soothing whispers invite travelers to step closer, closer, closer . . . until they vanish soundlessly beneath the surface.
546603.translation: 温馨细语吸引旅人靠近，靠近，再靠近…直到他们悄无声息地消失在水面之下。

546605.oracleText:
"Spend too much time scanning the shadows for evil and you'll never see the beauty our world has to offer."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
546605.translation:
「若你过度聚焦阴影找寻邪恶，便会错过这世界上光明之处的众多美景。」
～曙鹿集巫首凯蒂妲

546607.oracleText: The Quietus Cult holds their grim ceremonies in the dark places where unburied dead litter the ground.
546607.translation: 尸横遍野未及掩埋的黑暗之处，便是偿生教众举行邪恶仪式的好地点。

546610.oracleText: Frequent, violent storms shape the Nephalia coastline, sculpting cliffs and caves where monsters often lurk.
546610.translation: 涅非利亚海岸经常遭受猛烈风暴吹袭侵蚀，将山崖岩洞塑造成如今模样，便于怪物藏匿其间。

546613.oracleText: Riders chase the fading light recklessly through the mountains, desperate for one last glimpse of day.
546613.translation: 骑兵穿行山脉，不顾一切地追逐渐渐消逝的亮光，只为将白昼的最后时光留在眼中。

546616.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Vampire spell.
546616.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放吸血鬼咒语。

546617.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Create a Blood token. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each Vampire you control.
546617.translation: {o5}，{oT}：派出一个血滴衍生物。你每操控一个吸血鬼，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

546619.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.
546619.translation: {o1}，{oT}，弃一张牌，牺牲此神器：抓一张牌。

546620.oracleText: "Our dear Madam Mina is once more our teacher. Her eyes have been where we were blinded. Now we are on the track once again, and this time we may succeed."
546620.translation: 「瑟班是生者之地。未彻底净化之前，我绝不歇息。」

546621.oracleText: I knew he had left the castle now, and thought to use the opportunity to explore more than I had dared to do as yet.
546621.translation: 我知道他已离开城堡，于是就打算借此机会来探索我此前未敢深入之处。

546622.oracleText: Nothing can be more dreadful than those awful women, who were—who are—waiting to suck my blood.
546622.translation: 没有谁比这些怪女人更恐怖的了，她们原本就要吸我的血，现在已经更迫不及待。

546623.oracleText: I looked at her throat just now as she lay asleep, and the tiny wounds seem not to have healed.
546623.translation: 我刚在她躺下睡去后检查了她的颈部，那两个小孔如今尚未愈合。

546624.oracleText: Van Helsing raised his lantern and drew the slide; by the concentrated light that fell on Lucy's face we could see that the lips were crimson with fresh blood.
546624.translation: 范海辛举起提灯并拉下灯罩；顺着照在露西脸上的灯光，我们清楚看到她嘴唇因沾有鲜血而分外红艳。

546625.oracleText: "Do you mean to tell me that Lucy was bitten by such a bat . . . ?"
546625.translation: 「您是想说，露西就是被这种蝙蝠咬了…？」

546626.oracleText: She was ghastly, chalkily pale; the red seemed to have gone even from her lips and gums, and the bones of her face stood out prominently; her breathing was painful to see or hear.
546626.translation: 她面色惨白，甚至连嘴唇和牙龈都毫无血色，脸上颧骨高高突起，喘息样子令人目不忍视。

546627.oracleText: We want no proofs; we ask none to believe us! This boy will some day know what a brave and gallant woman his mother is.
546627.translation: 我们不需要证据，也不要求别人来相信我们！总有一天，这个孩子会知道他妈妈曾有多么无畏勇敢。

546628.oracleText: "It is in the hold, perhaps in one of those boxes. I'll unscrew them one by one and see. You work the helm."
546628.translation: 「他就在货舱，可能藏在哪个箱子里。我要把箱子一个个都拆开来瞧一瞧。你来掌舵。」

546629.oracleText: "The blood is the life! The blood is the life!"

546630.oracleText: He seems absolutely imperturbable. I can fancy what a wonderful power he must have over his patients.
546630.translation: 他看上去绝对沉着。我能想象他对病人有多么大的影响力。

546633.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
546633.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

546636.oracleText: Target up to two creatures you don't control.
546636.translation: 指定至多两个不由你操控的生物为目标。

546637.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
546637.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

546641.translation: 是否要放逐两张生物牌？

546643.translation: 是否要弃一张基本地牌？

546644.oracleText: Search for a card named Wretched Throng.
546644.translation: 搜寻一张名称为污劣大群的牌。

546645.oracleText: Search your library for a card named Wretched Throng?
546645.translation: 是否要从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称为污劣大群的牌？

546650.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
546650.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

546652.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
546652.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

546653.oracleText: Target up to one player or planeswalker.
546653.translation: 指定至多一位牌手或一个鹏洛客为目标。

546654.oracleText: Target a creature with mana value less than or equal to the number of Vampires you control.
546654.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于由你操控之吸血鬼数量的生物为目标。

546655.oracleText: When one or more counters are removed from CARDNAME this way, it deals that much damage to any target.
546655.translation: 当以此法从CARDNAME上移去一个或数个指示物时，它对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

546656.oracleText: Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step.
546656.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该衍生物。

546657.oracleText: It deals 7 damage to any target.
546657.translation: 它对任意一个目标造成7点伤害。

546659.oracleText: Target up to one noncreature permanent card.
546659.translation: 指定至多一张非生物永久物牌为目标。

546660.oracleText: Target an artifact an opponent controls.
546660.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的神器为目标。

546661.oracleText: Target a Zombie an opponent controls.
546661.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的灵俑为目标。

546664.oracleText: Sacrifice that token at end of combat.
546664.translation: 在战斗结束时，牺牲该衍生物。

546665.oracleText: Target up to one creature token you control.
546665.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的衍生生物为目标。

546666.oracleText: Spend only on: A Vampire Spell
546666.translation: 只能用于支付：吸血鬼咒语

546916.oracleText: When that creature dies, its owner lose the game.
546916.translation: 当该生物死去时，其拥有者输掉这盘游戏。

546936.oracleText: Search for up to five Dragon cards not named Tiamat that each have different names.
546936.translation: 搜寻至多五张名称各不相同且其名称都不能是提亚玛特的的龙牌。

547012.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Distribute damage among {2, Number} target creature or planeswalker.} other {Distribute damage among {2, Number} target creatures and/or planeswalkers.}}
547012.translation: {2, plural, =1 {分配伤害给{2, Number}个目标生物或鹏洛客。} other {分配伤害给{2, Number}个目标生物和／或鹏洛客。}}

547265.oracleText: Return any number of cards with different mana values to your hand.
547265.translation: 将任意数量的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上，且这些牌的法术力值须各不相同。

547393.oracleText: Cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs?
547393.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用施放任意数量的复制品？

547404.oracleText: Target up to {2, plural, =1 {{2, Number} card} other {{2, Number} cards}}.
547404.translation: 指定至多{2, plural, =1 {{2, Number}张牌} other {{2, Number}张牌}}为目标。

547405.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} become a copy of another target creature, except it has this ability?
547405.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}成为另一个目标生物的复制品，但它具有此异能？

547411.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, each player seeks a nonland card with mana value 2 or less.
547411.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，每位牌手掏一张法术力值等于或小于2的非地牌。

547412.oracleText: When Manor Guardian dies, each player seeks a nonland card with mana value 2 or less.
547412.translation: 当庄园守卫死去时，每位牌手掏一张法术力值等于或小于2的非地牌。

547414.oracleText: Seek a nonland card with mana value 2 or less.
547414.translation: 掏一张法术力值等于或小于2的非地牌。

547444.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls to get -3/-0 until your next turn.
547444.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的生物为目标，它得-3/-0直到你的下一个回合。

547445.oracleText: Target up to one other creature to get -2/-0 until your next turn.
547445.translation: 指定至多另一个生物为目标，它得-2/-0直到回合结束。

547446.oracleText: Target up to one other creature to get -1/-0 until your next turn.
547446.translation: 指定至多另一个生物为目标，它得-1/-0直到回合结束。

547449.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, exile it. If you do, conjure three cards named Reassembling Skeleton into your graveyard.
547449.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将它放逐。若你如此作，变出三张名称为重组骷髅妖的牌置入你的坟墓场。

547450.oracleText: When Boneyard Aberration dies, exile it. If you do, conjure three cards named Reassembling Skeleton into your graveyard.
547450.translation: 当聚骨场畸变体死去时，将它放逐。若你如此作，变出三张名称为重组骷髅妖的牌置入你的坟墓场。

547454.translation: 是否要牺牲诈术师神符？

547702.oracleText: Choose a creature card exiled with {1, CardId} with mana value {2, Number}.
547702.translation: 选择一张以{1, CardId}放逐且法术力值为{2, Number}的生物牌。

547710.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target a card.} other {Target {2, Number} cards with different mana values.}}
547710.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定一张牌为目标。} other {指定{2, Number}张法术力值各不相同的牌为目标。}}

548111.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} card with different mana values.} other {Target {2, Number} cards with different mana values.}}
548111.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定{2, Number}张法术力值各不相同的牌为目标。} other {指定{2, Number}张法术力值各不相同的牌为目标。}}

548117.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target up to {2, Number} creature card with mana value {2, Number} or less.} other {Target up to {2, Number} creature cards with total mana value {2, Number} or less.}}
548117.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定至多{2, Number}张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌为目标。} other {指定至多{2, Number}张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌为目标。}}

548157.translation: 是否要牺牲一个血滴衍生物？

548159.oracleText: Target up to one Blood token you control.
548159.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的血滴衍生物为目标。

548160.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} become a 3/3 Vampire artifact creature with haste until end of turn?
548160.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}成为3/3，具敏捷异能的吸血鬼神器生物直到回合结束？

548161.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or a Blood token.
548161.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或一个血滴衍生物。

548164.oracleText: Return X target creature cards with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
548164.translation: 将X张目标法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

548167.oracleText: Delirium — At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, that player mills three cards.
548167.translation: 躁狂～在每位对手的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中牌的类别有四种或更多，则该牌手磨三张牌。

548168.translation: 所有老鼠具有恐惧异能。

548169.oracleText:
"The nezumi will do things for money no other thinking creature would consider. This, of course, makes them useful beyond words."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror
548169.translation:
「这些鼠人，瞧着就恶心。他们为了钱，不管什么脏事都肯作；当然了，他们也因此显得更有用处。」
～昙镜梅洛古

548170.oracleText: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.
548170.translation: 鬼怪们依军事用途造出一团乱七八糟的东西。

548172.oracleText:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying
548172.translation:
每只幼崽都有妈妈用牙齿在保护。
——妖精谚语「暂译」

548173.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
548173.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌，将它们放进战场，然后洗牌。

548174.oracleText: "Gnawed to death. Bad way to go."

548175.oracleText:
"The bear is never cautious—which is why it wasn't born a human."
—Mirri of the Weatherlight
548175.translation:
「熊从不谨慎，所以无法生而为人。」
～晴空号的米丽「暂译」

548176.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Sliver creature token. Activate only if you control a Sliver.
548176.translation: {o5}，{oT}：派出一个1/1无色裂片妖衍生生物。只能于你操控裂片妖时起动。

548177.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} creature card with mana value 2 or less.} other {Target {2, Number} creature cards with mana value 2 or less.}}
548177.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定{2, Number}个法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌为目标。} other {指定{2, Number}个法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌为目标。}}

548182.oracleText: Target creature's base power perpetually becomes 0.
548182.translation: 目标生物的基础力量永久为0。

548184.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and it perpetually gets +1/+0.
548184.translation: 每当你循环另一张牌时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。它永久得+1/+0。

548185.oracleText: Whenever you cycle another card, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, return Benalish Partisan from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and it perpetually gets +1/+0.
548185.translation: 每当你循环另一张牌时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则将宾纳里亚拥护者从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。它永久得+1/+0。

548193.oracleText: This creature can attack as though it didn't have defender.
548193.translation: 此生物能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

548194.oracleText: Up to one target creature's base power perpetually becomes equal to its toughness. It perpetually gains "This creature can attack as though it didn't have defender."
548194.translation: 至多一个目标生物的基础力量永久为X，X等于其防御力。该生物永久获得「此生物能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。」

548195.oracleText: Conjure a card named Lumbering Lightshield onto the battlefield.
548195.translation: 变出一张名称为缓行幻光盾的牌放进战场。

548196.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return target white creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain life equal to its toughness.
548196.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，将目标白色生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。你获得若干生命，其数量等同于该生物的防御力。

548197.oracleText: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, return target white creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain life equal to its toughness."
548197.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「在你的结束步骤开始时，将目标白色生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。你获得若干生命，其数量等同于该生物的防御力。」

548199.oracleText: If you have no land cards in your hand, seek a land card and a nonland card. Otherwise, seek two nonland cards.
548199.translation: 若你手上没有地牌，掏一张地牌和一张非地牌。否则掏两张非地牌。

548201.oracleText: This creature doesn't untap during your untap step.
548201.translation: 此生物于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

548203.oracleText: Tap target creature. That creature perpetually gains "This creature doesn't untap during your untap step" and "{o8}: Untap this creature."
548203.translation: 横置目标生物。该生物永久获得「此生物在你的重置步骤中不能重置」和「{o8}：重置此生物。」

548205.oracleText: Conjure a card named Kraken Hatchling into your hand.
548205.translation: 变出一张名称为巨海兽幼雏的牌置于你手上。

548206.oracleText: Untap target creature or land. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that permanent until your next turn.
548206.translation: 重置目标生物或地。直到你的下一个回合，防止该永久物将受到或造成的所有伤害。

548207.oracleText: You may sacrifice a Kraken. If you do, create an 8/8 blue Kraken creature token.
548207.translation: 你可以牺牲一个巨海兽。若你如此作，派出一个8/8蓝色巨海兽衍生生物。

548219.oracleText: Until your next turn, whenever an opponent attacks you and/or planeswalkers you control, they discard a card. If they can't, they sacrifice an attacking creature.
548219.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，每当任一对手攻击你和／或由你操控的鹏洛客时，该牌手弃一张。若该牌手无法如此作，则该牌手牺牲一个进行攻击的生物。

556373.translation: 只能用于支付：你坟墓场中的咒语

557303.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
557303.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

557304.translation: 放逐此传纪，然后将它在你的操控下移回战场且已转化。

557306.oracleText:
"The moths of Eiganjo were once no different from any other great beast of Kamigawa's wilds. It took years of patience and dedication to convince them to bear riders."
—History of the Empire
557306.translation:
「永岩城飞蛾原与神河野境巨兽并无二致，唯经十数年耐心化育，终令它们愿意偕人同翔。」
～《帝国通史》

557309.oracleText: In the time it takes most to master one blade, he mastered two.
557309.translation: 这训练时间大多数人能舞好单剑已属不易，他却能将双刀运用自如。

557312.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +1/+1 for each creature and/or Vehicle you control.

557313.oracleText: This creature crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater.
557313.translation: 此生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。

557314.translation: 魂力～{o2oW}，弃掉CARDNAME：派出两个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

557315.oracleText: Channel — {o2oW}, Discard Born to Drive: Create two 1/1 colorless Pilot creature tokens with "This creature crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
557315.translation: 魂力～{o2oW}，弃掉天赋驾能：派出两个1/1无色驾手衍生生物，且具有「此生物搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。」

557317.oracleText:
"We have done our best to heal this land together, but now I must entrust the future to my sister. She will carry our dreams onward into the sunrise."
—Michiko Konda's journal
557317.translation:
「我们已竭尽所能来治愈这片土地，如今我必须将未来托付予我的姐妹。她将承载吾人梦想腾飞天际，与旭日同辉。」
～今田魅知子的札记

557318.oracleText: Return all artifact and enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
557318.translation: 将所有神器和结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

557321.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有飞行与「你这盘游戏不会输，对手也不会赢。」

557324.oracleText: Cutting-edge Imperial sentinel mechs patrol the skies over Eiganjo.
557324.translation: 皇室卫兵机体乃以尖端科技打造，护永岩城于云霄。

557326.oracleText: Imperial samurai undergo strict training, honing their skills and purifying their spirits in the hope that they will prove worthy of a kami's blessing.
557326.translation: 皇室武士须经严格训练，不断磨炼战技、净化灵魂，以期自己够格蒙受神明祝福。

557327.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
557327.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，该生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

557331.oracleText:
"We have endured lifetimes of war and carved our way to peace by blade and conquest. Now, united at last under Kyodai's guidance, we lay down our weapons and open our minds."
—Aoha, general of the First Emperor
557331.translation:
「我辈一生饱受战事之苦，凭手中刀剑与无畏征伐方才辟出和平大道。如今得香醍引领，吾人甘愿团结一心，抛却手中武器，放开脑中思绪。」
～始帝将军青叶

557334.translation: 每位牌手各获得所有由其拥有之永久物的操控权。

557336.oracleText: For his transgressions against the kami, Lord Konda's immortal body was turned to stone, then shattered into a thousand still-living pieces.
557336.translation: 今田城主犯下逆神行径，其不朽身躯被化作石像，后又碎落成千百块在生碎片。

557342.oracleText: It seeks those who act with kindness and offers friendship.
557342.translation: 寻善心之士，以友谊相报。

557345.oracleText: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.
557345.translation: 永岩城内设金尾院，由狐族一脉相承负责教导，其间学子不论是武打技艺还是帝业忠诚均无出其右。

557348.oracleText: "If your mech is factory standard, you might as well be walking."
557348.translation: 「如果你的机体是量产型的话，还是走着比较可靠。」

557349.translation: CARDNAME搭载载具时视同其力量为原数值加2。

557352.translation: 被选中卫护皇宫者不仅战技无匹，亦是帝业拥趸。

557353.oracleText: Create three 2/2 white Samurai creature tokens with vigilance. Scry 3.

557377.oracleText: "That way lies death. This way, a chance."
557377.translation: 「彼处死路一条。此路仍有生机。」

557378.translation: 在目标生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。将它重置。

557379.oracleText: Choose one — • Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle. Untap it. • Return target permanent you control to its owner's hand.
557379.translation: 选择一项～ •  在目标生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。将它重置。 •  将目标由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

557389.translation: 狮头饰带上每有一个+1/+1指示物，佩带此武具的生物便得+1/+1。

557392.oracleText: The playful kami reserved its greatest blessings for those who brought not wealth or rare delicacies, but particularly amusing trinkets.
557392.translation: 这有趣神明并不看重财富或珍馐，反而会让供奉特别有趣琐物者交上大运。

557393.oracleText: Destroy target artifact with mana value 3 or less. You gain 3 life.
557393.translation: 消灭目标法术力值等于或小于3的神器。你获得3点生命。

557395.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of white cards from your hand. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
557395.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐任意数量的白色牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

557396.oracleText: Exile target artifact, creature, or enchantment with mana value X or less.
557396.translation: 放逐目标法术力值等于或小于X的神器，生物或结界。

557398.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
557398.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，目标生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

557399.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
557399.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，目标生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

557401.oracleText: Long ago, as the first mortal to bond with Kyodai, Michiko Konda brought an end to the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.
557401.translation: 今田魅知子是首位与神明缔结亲缘的凡人，许久之前正是她凭此终结逆神之战，引领神河进入布真和谐的全新时代。

557402.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
557402.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

557403.oracleText: Portrait of Michiko gets +1/+1 for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
557403.translation: 你每操控一个神器和／或结界，魅知子画像便得+1/+1。

557406.oracleText:
"Be proud, young pup! You've earned your wings. Rise and become the western wind."
—Swift-Arm, Golden-Tail headmaster
557406.translation:
「抬头挺胸，小子！你已得蛾翼相助。勇敢飞翔，化作西风。」
～金尾院长迅腕

557409.oracleText: "The blades will have their say, but peace is built with words."

557410.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, you may cast target enchantment card from your graveyard this turn.
557410.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，本回合中，你可以从你的坟墓场施放目标结界牌。

557412.oracleText: Before her spark pulled her away again, the Emperor appointed the wise Light-Paws to guide Kamigawa in her absence.
557412.translation: 在火花再次带她远行前，飘萍皇立明臣轻脚为相，嘱其在自己云游期间统领神河。

557413.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's an enchantment creature or legendary creature, instead put a +1/+1 counter on it and it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
557413.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果它是结界生物或传奇生物，则改为在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

557415.oracleText:
"You are a guest in this realm, and you've overstayed your welcome."
—Yui, Imperial intercessor
557415.translation:
「你在此界虽为客，但也不能真把这当家。」
～皇室调停人由依

557416.oracleText: Choose one — • Exile target creature with power 4 or greater. • Exile target enchantment.
557416.translation: 选择一项～ •  放逐目标力量等于或大于4的生物。 •  放逐目标结界。

557418.oracleText: You may discard a card. When you do, return target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
557418.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

557420.oracleText:
"A visionary looks at rubble and sees not only what was, but also what could be."
—Onyx-Eye, architect of Eiganjo
557420.translation:
「从瓦砾之间，有远见者不仅能看到过往旧貌，更能构出未来蓝图。」
～永岩城筑师瑙眼

557421.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
557421.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

557422.oracleText: Whenever Architect of Restoration attacks or blocks, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
557422.translation: 每当重砌筑师像攻击或阻挡时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

557424.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, it gains lifelink until end of turn.
557424.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

557425.oracleText: Sacrifice Selfless Samurai: Another target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
557425.translation: 牺牲无私武士：另一个目标由你操控的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

557427.oracleText: "I have taught you all I can. Take this blade and rise as my equal."
557427.translation: 「我已再无他物能够传授于你。请收下此刃，承我之业。」

557431.oracleText: Imperial samurai who show exceptional honor and dexterity are invited to train as mothriders, elite guards charged with protecting the skies of Eiganjo.
557431.translation: 英勇果敢、身手过人的皇室武士会获邀受训转晋翔蛾骑士，摇身成为戍卫永岩城天空的菁英护卫。

557433.oracleText: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.
557433.translation: 她与几个淘气神灵结下友谊，很快这一「小团体」就成为永岩城内诸多恶戏的根源。

557436.oracleText: Channel — {o2}, Discard CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 2 life.
557436.translation: 魂力～{o2}，弃掉CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得2点生命。

557437.oracleText: Channel — {o2}, Discard Sunblade Samurai: Search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 2 life.
557437.translation: 魂力～{o2}，弃掉阳刃武士：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得2点生命。

557441.oracleText: Channel — {o1oW}, Discard CARDNAME: Exile target artifact or creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
557441.translation: 魂力～{o1oW}，弃掉CARDNAME：放逐目标神器或生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

557442.oracleText: Channel — {o1oW}, Discard Touch the Spirit Realm: Exile target artifact or creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
557442.translation: 魂力～{o1oW}，弃掉亲触灵界：放逐目标神器或生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

557444.oracleText: Just as Jin-Gitaxias's victory seemed certain, the Wanderer appeared, her blade already in motion. One mighty slash was enough to take the praetor out of the fight.
557444.translation: 金吉塔厦自认大局底定时，飘萍突然现身，手中长剑已扬。只见亮光闪过，她的一记重斩就足以击碎魔判官的所有胜算。

557445.oracleText: Wanderer's Intervention deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
557445.translation: 飘萍干预对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。

557449.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. It gains first strike until end of turn.
557449.translation: 在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

557450.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with vigilance.
557450.translation: 派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。

557451.oracleText: Exile target tapped creature. You gain 2 life.
557451.translation: 放逐目标已横置的生物。你获得2点生命。

557453.oracleText: Since Imperial custom strictly forbade the Emperor to reveal her name—even to Kaito, her closest childhood friend—she had to suffer him calling her "your emperorness" for much of their shared youth.
557453.translation: 皇室严禁今上向任何人透露自己姓名～就连她的青梅竹马魁渡也不例外。因此在共度的大半年少岁月中，她只得一直忍受对方称呼自己「皇上」。

557454.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control an artifact and an enchantment, those creatures also gain lifelink until end of turn.
557454.translation: 至多两个目标生物各得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果你同时操控神器和结界，则这些生物再获得系命异能直到回合结束。

557457.oracleText: You can never have too many arms.

557458.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
557458.translation: 每当CARDNAME或佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

557459.oracleText: Whenever Acquisition Octopus or equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
557459.translation: 每当窃物八爪械或佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

557461.oracleText: The Wanderer sighed in relief as the Reality Chip tethered her wayward spark to Kamigawa.
557461.translation: 飘萍眼见实界晶片将其难控火花栓定神河之后，反而长舒一口气。

557462.oracleText: Search your library for an Equipment or Vehicle card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle. If it has mana value less than the sacrificed permanent's mana value, scry 2.
557462.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张武具或载具牌，将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。如果该牌的法术力值小于所牺牲之永久物，则占卜2。

557465.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+1 and has ward {o2}.
557465.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+1且具有守护{o2}。

557470.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it has base power and toughness 1/1.
557470.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它的基础力量与防御力便为1/1。

557472.oracleText: Creatures you don't control get -2/-0 until your next turn.
557472.translation: 不由你操控的生物得-2/-0直到你的下一个回合。

557473.oracleText: If you have one or fewer cards in hand, draw four cards. Otherwise, scry 2, then draw two cards.
557473.translation: 如果你的手牌为一张或更少，则抓四张牌。若否，则占卜2，然后抓两张牌。

557475.oracleText: Even as her students' minds succumbed to madness, Azami's obsession with the kami of forbidden knowledge only grew.
557475.translation: 纵使学院门生难承重压失智发狂，但蓟夫人对禁识神痴迷之情却只增不减。

557476.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each card in your hand.

557477.oracleText: Vision of the Unspeakable gets +1/+1 for each card in your hand.
557477.translation: 你每有一张手牌，忌话图视像便得+1/+1。

557479.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may put an artifact card with mana value less than or equal to that damage from your hand onto the battlefield.
557479.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于该伤害的神器牌从你手上放进战场。

557480.oracleText: Whenever Covert Technician deals combat damage to a player, you may put an artifact card with mana value less than or equal to that damage from your hand onto the battlefield.
557480.translation: 每当隐秘技师对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于该伤害的神器牌从你手上放进战场。

557482.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. Exile one of them face down and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost if it's an instant spell with mana value 2 or less. If you don't, put that card into your hand.
557482.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。牌面朝下地放逐其中一张，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。如果所放逐之牌是法术力值等于或小于2的瞬间咒语，则你可以施放它，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未如此作，则将该牌置于你手上。

557484.oracleText: "Let's just turn that off, shall we?"

557485.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap an untapped artifact you control or pay {o1}.
557485.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器或支付{o1}，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

557486.oracleText: The Futurists regard the tradition of kami-bonding as anachronistic and inefficient, striving constantly to surpass spiritual power with technology.
557486.translation: 赛博派觉得「结神缘」这一传统既过时效果又不彰，故而致力发展科技，希冀有朝一日以此超越灵力。

557488.oracleText: "The Imperials can't arrest you for illegal tech if you never even existed."
557488.translation: 「如果你未曾存在，皇室当然就没法以滥用技术罪名来拘捕你。」

557489.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is tapped, it's a Human Citizen with base power and toughness 1/1 and can't be blocked.
557489.translation: 只要CARDNAME已横置，它便是基础力量与防御力为1/1的人类／市民，且不能被阻挡。

557490.oracleText: As long as Futurist Operative is tapped, it's a Human Citizen with base power and toughness 1/1 and can't be blocked.
557490.translation: 只要赛博派特务已横置，它便是基础力量与防御力为1/1的人类／市民，且不能被阻挡。

557493.oracleText:
"I folded a model in paper first to test the relative tensile strength of the plates."
—Katsumasa, the Animator
557493.translation:
「我是先用纸来折出模型，好测试钢板之间的相对拉伸强度。」
～灵机贺津间佐

557495.oracleText: It seeks those driven by curiosity and offers enlightenment.
557495.translation: 寻好奇之士，以启蒙相报。

557496.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. When you do, target player mills X cards, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
557496.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，目标牌手磨X张牌，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

557500.oracleText: Modified creatures you control can attack as though they didn't have defender.
557500.translation: 由你操控且有饰装的生物能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

557502.oracleText: Return up to one target creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand.
557502.translation: 将至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。

557503.oracleText: Return an artifact card from your graveyard to your hand. If you can't, draw a card.
557503.translation: 将一张神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果你无法如此作，则抓一张牌。

557505.oracleText:
"While they squabble below, let us rise above."
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists
557505.translation:
「趁他们还在下面争执不休，我们借机飞升即位。」
～赛博派会长依民列

557506.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, your opponents can't cast spells with the same mana value as that spell until your next turn.
557506.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，直到你的下一个回合，所有对手都不能施放与该咒语具相同法术力值的咒语。

557508.oracleText:
"Are you seriously telling me your heavy combat mech . . . blew away?"
—Risona, leader of the Asari Uprisers
557508.translation:
「你说你的重型战斗机体被风吹飞了…认真的？」
～浅利起事军首领理想那

557509.oracleText: Gain control of target artifact or creature. Untap it.
557509.translation: 获得目标神器或生物的操控权。将它重置。

557511.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact, instant, or sorcery spell, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn.
557511.translation: 每当你施放神器，瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

557512.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact, instant, or sorcery spell, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
557512.translation: 每当你施放神器，瞬间或法术咒语时，复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。此异能每回合只会触发一次。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

557513.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts an artifact, instant, or sorcery spell, counter that spell. This ability triggers only once each turn.
557513.translation: 每当任一对手施放神器，瞬间或法术咒语时，反击该咒语。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

557515.oracleText: Return any number of target nonland permanents with total mana value 6 or less to their owners' hands.
557515.translation: 选择任意数量的目标非地永久物，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于6。将它们分别移回其拥有者手上。

557516.oracleText: Return any number of target nonland permanents with total mana value 6 or less to their owners' hands.
557516.translation: 选择任意数量的目标非地永久物，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于6。将它们分别移回其拥有者手上。

557517.oracleText: Mill six cards, then return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
557517.translation: 磨六张牌，然后将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557518.oracleText: Mill six cards, then return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
557518.translation: 磨六张牌，然后将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557519.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, choose one — • Return any number of target nonland permanents with total mana value 6 or less to their owners' hands. • Mill six cards, then return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
557519.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，选择一项～ •  选择任意数量的目标非地永久物，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于6。将它们分别移回其拥有者手上。 •  磨六张牌，然后将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557520.oracleText: When Kairi, the Swirling Sky dies, choose one — • Return any number of target nonland permanents with total mana value 6 or less to their owners' hands. • Mill six cards, then return up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
557520.translation: 当旋穹开璃死去时，选择一项～ •  选择任意数量的目标非地永久物，且其法术力值总和须等于或小于6。将它们分别移回其拥有者手上。 •  磨六张牌，然后将至多两张瞬间和／或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557522.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of blue cards from your hand. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
557522.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐任意数量的蓝色牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

557523.oracleText: Up to X target creatures phase out.

557525.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes crewed for the first time each turn, until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn, except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types, and it has flying.
557525.translation: 每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为已搭载时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为目标本回合中搭载它之非传奇生物的复制品，但它是4/3，额外是载具神器，且具有飞行异能。

557526.oracleText: Whenever Mindlink Mech becomes crewed for the first time each turn, until end of turn, Mindlink Mech becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature that crewed it this turn, except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types, and it has flying.
557526.translation: 每当系灵机体每回合首度成为已搭载时，直到回合结束，系灵机体成为目标本回合中搭载它之非传奇生物的复制品，但它是4/3，额外是载具神器，且具有飞行异能。

557528.oracleText: Channel — {o2oU}, Discard CARDNAME: Counter target spell or ability unless its controller pays {o3}.
557528.translation: 魂力～{o2oU}，弃掉CARDNAME：除非目标咒语或异能的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

557529.oracleText: Channel — {o2oU}, Discard Mirrorshell Crab: Counter target spell or ability unless its controller pays {o3}.
557529.translation: 魂力～{o2oU}，弃掉镜壳蟹：除非目标咒语或异能的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。

557531.oracleText:
"Let the Imperials search our laboratories. Will they think to look for secrets in a pretty bauble?"
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists
557531.translation:
「实验室就让皇室放手去查。反正他们也想不到要在漂亮饰品中去找秘密。」
～赛博派会长依民列

557532.oracleText: {o1oU}, Sacrifice Mnemonic Sphere: Draw two cards.

557533.oracleText: Channel — {oU}, Discard CARDNAME: Draw a card.

557534.oracleText: Channel — {oU}, Discard Mnemonic Sphere: Draw a card.
557534.translation: 魂力～{oU}，弃掉记忆饰球：抓一张牌。

557536.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes crewed, up to one other target Vehicle you control becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
557536.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为已搭载时，至多另一个目标由你操控的载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

557537.oracleText: Whenever Mobilizer Mech becomes crewed, up to one other target Vehicle you control becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
557537.translation: 每当灵动机体成为已搭载时，至多另一个目标由你操控的载具成为神器生物直到回合结束。

557539.oracleText: Draw a card, then discard a card.
557539.translation: 抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

557540.oracleText: Draw a card, then discard a card.
557540.translation: 抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

557542.oracleText: It drifted from the spirit realm into a neon world full of new possibilities . . . and decided to stay.
557542.translation: 它从灵界误入一个充满全新可能性的霓虹新世界…于是决定就此留下。

557547.oracleText: "Research is hardly the dry, serious pastime outsiders make it out to be."
557547.translation: 「研究从来就不是外人想象中那种枯燥严肃的消遣。」

557549.oracleText: Whenever Moonfolk Puzzlemaker becomes tapped, scry 1.
557549.translation: 每当出谜月人成为横置时，占卜1。

557551.oracleText: {oT}, Tap an untapped artifact or creature you control: Add {oC}.
557551.translation: {oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器或生物：加{oC}。

557552.oracleText: Channel — {o4oU}, Discard CARDNAME: The owner of target nonland permanent puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
557552.translation: 魂力～{o4oU}，弃掉CARDNAME：目标非地永久物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

557553.oracleText: Channel — {o4oU}, Discard Moonsnare Prototype: The owner of target nonland permanent puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
557553.translation: 魂力～{o4oU}，弃掉月索原型：目标非地永久物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

557558.oracleText: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."
557558.translation: 「不出所料。他们自以为把终端机藏好之后，就不用费心去加密了。」

557562.oracleText: Jin-Gitaxias had long coveted the secrets of planeswalking. Spirits that could pass between worlds made for perfect test subjects.
557562.translation: 金吉塔厦早对穿行时空的秘密觊觎多时。能够穿行两界的灵体正是最佳实验对象。

557563.oracleText: Exile target artifact or creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
557563.translation: 放逐目标神器或生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

557565.oracleText: Whenever one or more Ninja or Rogue creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
557565.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个忍者或浪客生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

557568.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is attached to a creature, you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
557568.translation: 只要CARDNAME贴附于生物上，你便可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放咒语。

557569.oracleText: As long as The Reality Chip is attached to a creature, you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
557569.translation: 只要实界晶片贴附于生物上，你便可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放咒语。

557572.oracleText: Kaito grabbed the chip, hoping it held answers.
557572.translation: 魁渡抢下晶片，希望能从其中找到答案。

557573.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal up to two artifact cards from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
557573.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中的至多两张神器牌，并将它们置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

557576.oracleText: "Step one is innovation. Step two is production. Sometimes step one is optional."
557576.translation: 「第一步是创新。第二步是制造。但有的时候也可以跳过第一步。」

557579.oracleText: One to clear the way, another to erase their trail.

557580.oracleText: Channel — {o3oU}, Discard CARDNAME: Tap up to two target creatures you don't control. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
557580.translation: 魂力～{o3oU}，弃掉CARDNAME：横置至多两个目标不由你操控的生物。这些生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

557581.oracleText: Channel — {o3oU}, Discard Saiba Trespassers: Tap up to two target creatures you don't control. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
557581.translation: 魂力～{o3oU}，弃掉赛博派侵客：横置至多两个目标不由你操控的生物。这些生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

557583.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets -3/-0 and loses flying.
557583.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得-3/-0且失去飞行异能。

557585.oracleText: Once they swam alone among the clouds, but now the people of Kamigawa have built high enough to reach them.
557585.translation: 它们曾经遨游云端，如今神河建物已高到让民众也能漫步天际。

557587.oracleText: For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.
557587.translation: 魁渡和多美代的所有计划里面，都没想到他们会要对上全力出击的非瑞克西亚魔判官。

557589.oracleText: With a reckless leap into the pilot's seat, Hirori went from smallest kid on the block to biggest hero in the city.
557589.translation: 弘理纵身跳向机师驾驶座，转眼就从街区最弱少年摇身变为城中最大英雄。

557590.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature or Vehicle becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 4/5.
557590.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物或载具成为基础力量与防御力为4/5的神器生物。

557592.oracleText: Whenever one or more noncreature permanents are returned to hand, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
557592.translation: 每当一个或数个非生物永久物移回任一牌手的手上时，你抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

557593.oracleText: {oXoW}, Return a land you control to its owner's hand: Return target artifact or enchantment card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
557593.translation: {oXoW}，将一个由你操控的地移回其拥有者手上：将目标法术力值等于或小于X的神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

557595.translation: 结附于神器，生物或鹏洛客

557598.oracleText: Enchanted permanent loses all abilities and doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
557598.translation: 所结附的永久物失去所有异能，且于其操控者的重置步骤中不能重置。

557600.oracleText: The first activated ability of an artifact you activate each turn costs {o2} less to activate.
557600.translation: 你每回合起动的首个神器起动式异能减少{o2}来起动。

557601.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.
557601.translation: 抓两张牌。然后除非你弃一张神器牌，否则弃两张牌。

557602.oracleText: Target artifact becomes an artifact creature. If it isn't a Vehicle, it has base power and toughness 4/4.
557602.translation: 目标神器成为神器生物。如果它不是载具，则它的基础力量与防御力为4/4。

557603.oracleText: Whenever an artifact you control becomes tapped, draw a card.
557603.translation: 每当一个由你操控的神器成为横置时，抓一张牌。

557604.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever an artifact you control becomes tapped, draw a card."
557604.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当一个由你操控的神器成为横置时，抓一张牌。」

557605.oracleText: "Knowledge is the universal currency of the Multiverse. It is power. It is freedom. It is possibility itself."
557605.translation: 「知识是整个多重宇宙的通货。它就是力量。它就是自由。它就是可能。」

557610.oracleText: A Reckoner always has another trick up their sleeve—or as their sleeve.
557610.translation: 帮派成员总有暗藏玄机～或隐于袖中，或纹于身上。

557611.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control an artifact and {o1} less to cast if you control an enchantment.
557611.translation: 如果你操控神器，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放；如果你操控结界，则此咒语也减少{o1}来施放。

557615.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may remove a menace counter from it. When you do, that player reveals their hand and you choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card.
557615.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从其上移去一个威慑指示物。当你如此作时，该牌手展示其手牌且你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌。

557616.oracleText: Whenever Biting-Palm Ninja deals combat damage to a player, you may remove a menace counter from it. When you do, that player reveals their hand and you choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card.
557616.translation: 每当啮掌忍者对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从其上移去一个威慑指示物。当你如此作时，该牌手展示其手牌且你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌。

557619.oracleText: Equipped creature has base power and toughness 5/5, has menace, and is a black Demon in addition to its other colors and types.
557619.translation: 佩带此武具之生物的基础力量与防御力为5/5，具威慑异能，且额外具有黑色此颜色与恶魔此类别。

557623.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or equipped creature attacks, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
557623.translation: 每当CARDNAME或佩带此武具的生物攻击时，它得+2/+0直到回合结束。

557624.oracleText: Whenever Chainflail Centipede or equipped creature attacks, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
557624.translation: 每当链枷千足虫或佩带此武具的生物攻击时，它得+2/+0直到回合结束。

557626.oracleText: A kami's anger never fades, never sleeps, never loosens its grasp.
557626.translation: 神明怒火永不消退，永不歇息，永不放手。

557627.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets -1/-1 and can't block.
557627.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得-1/-1且不能进行阻挡。

557628.oracleText: Enchanted permanent has "At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life."
557628.translation: 所结附的永久物具有「在你的维持开始时，你失去1点生命。」

557630.oracleText: The masters weren't speaking figuratively when they said guilt could be all-consuming.
557630.translation: 罪行要穷尽一生补偿；师父对弟子的谨慎告诫远超言喻。

557631.oracleText: Target opponent exiles an enchantment they control.
557631.translation: 目标对手放逐一个由其操控的结界。

557632.oracleText: Choose one — • Target opponent exiles a creature they control. • Target opponent exiles an enchantment they control.
557632.translation: 选择一项～ •  目标对手放逐一个由其操控的生物。 •  目标对手放逐一个由其操控的结界。

557635.oracleText: The squirming is how you know it's fresh.

557636.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Draw a card.
557636.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲一个神器或生物：抓一张牌。

557639.oracleText: Don't fear the blade, fear the shadows.
557639.translation: 刀不可怕，可怕的是阴影。

557641.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may discard a creature card. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
557641.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以弃一张生物牌。当你如此作时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

557642.oracleText: Whenever Dokuchi Silencer deals combat damage to a player, you may discard a creature card. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
557642.translation: 每当毒血帮销音客对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以弃一张生物牌。当你如此作时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

557645.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes attached to a creature, tap that creature.
557645.translation: 每当CARDNAME新贴附在生物上时，横置该生物。

557646.oracleText: Whenever Enormous Energy Blade becomes attached to a creature, tap that creature.
557646.translation: 每当庞巨能量刃新贴附在生物上时，横置该生物。

557648.oracleText: It seeks those with hate in their hearts and offers vengeance.
557648.translation: 寻怨恨之士，以复仇相报。

557649.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. When you do, destroy target creature with toughness X or less, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
557649.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，消灭目标防御力等于或小于X的生物，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

557651.oracleText: It appears only to those whose lives are ending, welcoming them to their fate.
557651.translation: 这精魂仅有将死之士得见，每次出没只为奉迎逝者安息。

557657.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. When you exile a nonland card this way, CARDNAME deals damage equal to the exiled card's mana value to any target.
557657.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。当你以此法放逐一张非地牌时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所放逐之牌的法术力值。

557658.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. When you exile a nonland card this way, Hidetsugu, Devouring Chaos deals damage equal to the exiled card's mana value to any target.
557658.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。当你以此法放逐一张非地牌时，噬生浑魔碑出告对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所放逐之牌的法术力值。

557660.oracleText: "They can't follow your footprints if you never touch the ground."
557660.translation: 「只要脚不着地，你就没有脚印会让人追踪。」

557661.oracleText: {o3oB}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

557662.oracleText: {o3oB}: Inkrise Infiltrator gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
557662.translation: {o3oB}：墨升渗透者得+2/+2直到回合结束。

557664.oracleText: Although officials said it was a sewer failure, the people whispered that it was a warning of night's reach.
557664.translation: 虽然正式公告只说这是下水道不畅，但人们纷纷传言这是夜幕明神的警告。

557665.oracleText: Target opponent sacrifices a creature. If they can't, they lose 2 life and you draw a card. Then repeat this process for an enchantment and a planeswalker.
557665.translation: 目标对手牺牲一个生物。如果他无法如此作，则他失去2点生命且你抓一张牌。然后他为一个结界和一个鹏洛客各重复此流程。

557667.oracleText: Each opponent discards two cards and loses 2 life.
557667.translation: 每位对手各弃两张牌且失去2点生命。

557668.oracleText: Each opponent discards two cards and loses 2 life.
557668.translation: 每位对手各弃两张牌且失去2点生命。

557669.oracleText: Put target non-Dragon creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. You lose 2 life.
557669.translation: 将目标非龙生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。你失去2点生命。

557670.oracleText: Put target non-Dragon creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. You lose 2 life.
557670.translation: 将目标非龙生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。你失去2点生命。

557671.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, choose one — • Each opponent discards two cards and loses 2 life. • Put target non-Dragon creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. You lose 2 life.
557671.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，选择一项～ •  每位对手各弃两张牌且失去2点生命。 •  将目标非龙生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。你失去2点生命。

557672.oracleText: When Junji, the Midnight Sky dies, choose one — • Each opponent discards two cards and loses 2 life. • Put target non-Dragon creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. You lose 2 life.
557672.translation: 当夜穹殉至死去时，选择一项～ •  每位对手各弃两张牌且失去2点生命。 •  将目标非龙生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。你失去2点生命。

557674.oracleText: Kaito knew every rooftop in the city, and closed in quickly on his quarry—but he knew nothing of the Planar Bridge until it was already too late.
557674.translation: 虽然魁渡熟知城里每一片屋瓦，得以凭地利快速逼近猎物～但他对时空渡桥却一无所知，待他弄清头绪时早已过晚。

557675.oracleText: Target player discards two cards. Ninjas and Rogues you control gain menace until end of turn.
557675.translation: 目标牌手弃两张牌。由你操控的忍者与浪客获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

557677.oracleText: Return up to one target Ninja or Rogue creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
557677.translation: 将至多一张目标忍者或浪客生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557678.oracleText: Return up to one target Ninja or Rogue creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
557678.translation: 将至多一张目标忍者或浪客生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557679.oracleText: Put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
557679.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

557680.oracleText: Put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
557680.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

557684.oracleText: It feeds on things better left unknown, savoring the bitterness of lies and regrets.
557684.translation: 它以不应为人所知之事为食，细细品味谎言与悔恨当中的苦涩。

557690.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. It gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each modified creature you controlled as you cast this spell.
557690.translation: 选择目标生物。该生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。你于施放此咒语时每操控一个有饰装的生物，则所选生物便再得一次-1/-1直到回合结束。

557693.oracleText: Choose one — • Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. • Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. • You gain 2 life.
557693.translation: 选择一项～ •  目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。 •  目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。 •  你获得2点生命。

557695.oracleText:
"Some called him the hero of the Kami War, others a selfish thief. As ever, the truth is hidden somewhere in between."
—Reki, founder of the Living Historians
557695.translation:
「有人尊他为逆神之战的英雄，有人则唾其为自私窃贼。如世间诸事一般，真相往往藏于两者之间。」
～现世史家始祖历

557696.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Add {oB}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell.
557696.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：加{oB}。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间或法术咒语。

557698.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature unless they discard a card.
557698.translation: 对每位对手而言，除非他弃一张牌，否则牺牲一个生物。

557699.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature unless they discard a card.
557699.translation: 对每位对手而言，除非他弃一张牌，否则牺牲一个生物。

557701.oracleText: The dark myojin's gifts were instrumental in ending the Kami War.
557701.translation: 这黑暗明神的赠礼，乃是逆神之战终结的关键。

557702.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in defending player's graveyard.
557702.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为防御牌手坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

557703.oracleText: Whenever Animus of Night's Reach attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in defending player's graveyard.
557703.translation: 每当夜幕恶意攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为防御牌手坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

557705.oracleText:
"That? A minor test, nothing more. Incompleat flesh is weak."
—Jin-Gitaxias
557705.translation:
「那个啊？只是个小小测试罢了。未经完化的肉身果然很弱。」
～金吉塔厦

557707.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of black cards from your hand. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
557707.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐任意数量的黑色牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

557708.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life.
557708.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。

557709.oracleText: March of Wretched Sorrow deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life.
557709.translation: 伤悲行进对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，且你获得X点生命。

557711.oracleText: The Mukotai Reckoners specialize in stealth and subterfuge.
557711.translation: 无孤帮众精于匿踪隐遁。

557713.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another artifact or creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and it gains menace until end of turn.
557713.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个神器或生物。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

557714.oracleText: Whenever Mukotai Soulripper attacks, you may sacrifice another artifact or creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on Mukotai Soulripper and it gains menace until end of turn.
557714.translation: 每当无孤帮剥魂械攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个神器或生物。若你如此作，则在无孤帮剥魂械上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

557716.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of each player's library. Until end of turn, you may play one of those cards. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
557716.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用其中一张。如果你以此法施放咒语，则支付等同于其法术力值的生命，而不支付其法术力费用。

557717.oracleText: Whenever Nashi, Moon Sage's Scion deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of each player's library. Until end of turn, you may play one of those cards. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
557717.translation: 每当月智者后裔哪失对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐每位牌手的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用其中一张。如果你以此法施放咒语，则支付等同于其法术力值的生命，而不支付其法术力费用。

557719.oracleText: "It's not one or the other, kami or technology. Both offer power. I will not limit myself."
557719.translation: 「神明与科技并非互斥之物，两者均能予人力量。而我不愿只选其一。」

557720.oracleText: CARDNAME has deathtouch as long as you control an artifact.
557720.translation: 只要你操控神器，CARDNAME便具有死触异能。

557721.oracleText: Nezumi Bladeblesser has deathtouch as long as you control an artifact.
557721.translation: 只要你操控神器，祝刃鼠人便具有死触异能。

557722.oracleText: CARDNAME has menace as long as you control an enchantment.
557722.translation: 只要你操控结界，CARDNAME便具有威慑异能。

557723.oracleText: Nezumi Bladeblesser has menace as long as you control an enchantment.
557723.translation: 只要你操控结界，祝刃鼠人便具有威慑异能。

557728.oracleText: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
557728.translation: 每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

557729.oracleText: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
557729.translation: 每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

557731.oracleText: United by defiant pride in their outsider status, the nezumi of the Okiba Reckoners boast the most advanced cyberbikes and the best riders of all the Reckoner gangs.
557731.translation: 炽场帮鼠人因同以局外人为豪而结聚成团，如今他们拥有各黑道帮派中最高段的赛博机车和机车骑士。

557732.translation: 由你操控的载具具有威慑异能。

557734.oracleText: "Some fool would rather throw a whole mech away than repair one hydraulic actuator? It must be my lucky day."
557734.translation: 「居然有人连一个小小的液压致动器都不修，就把机体整个丢弃？我今天一定是走大运了。」

557735.oracleText: Return target creature or Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Then put two +1/+1 counters on that permanent if you control an artifact and an enchantment.
557735.translation: 将目标生物或载具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。然后如果你同时操控神器和结界，则在该永久物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

557737.oracleText:
"That's a start. What else do you have for us?"
—Takumi, Reckoner enforcer
557737.translation:
「这只是开始。你还有什么没告诉我们的？」
～帮派打手拓巳

557738.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player discards that card. If you don't, put two +1/+1 counters on a creature or Vehicle you control.
557738.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张非地牌。如果你如此作，则该牌手弃掉该牌。如果你未如此作，则在一个由你操控的生物或载具上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

557740.oracleText: Restricted auctions are held once a year at the Dragon's Lair—the sacred, neutral meeting ground of all Reckoner gangs.
557740.translation: 在育龙巢这块所有黑道帮派都不许妄动的面会中立圣地上，每年都举办一场限要人参加的特殊拍卖。

557741.oracleText: You gain life equal to the sacrificed permanent's mana value. Draw two cards.
557741.translation: 你获得若干生命，其数量等同于所牺牲之永久物的法术力值。抓两张牌。

557743.oracleText:
"You're hurt? Too bad. You stop fighting when I say, and not a moment sooner."
—Satoru Umezawa
557743.translation:
「你受伤了？可惜啊。你只有在我说停的时候才能停，早一刻都不行。」
～梅泽悟

557744.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains lifelink and "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control."
557744.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+0且获得系命与「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。」

557746.oracleText: Return target creature or planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
557746.translation: 将目标生物或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

557749.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
557749.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

557750.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, if you don't control a creature named Keimi, create Keimi, a legendary 3/3 black and green Frog creature token with "Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."
557750.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，若你未操控名称为哇魅的生物，则派出传奇衍生生物哇魅，其为3/3，黑绿双色的蛙，且具有「每当你施放结界咒语时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。」

557751.oracleText: {o1o(G/U)}: CARDNAME and target Frog you control can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with flying or reach.
557751.translation: {o1o(G/U)}：CARDNAME与目标由你操控的蛙本回合只能被具飞行或延势异能的生物阻挡。

557752.oracleText: {o1o(G/U)}: Tatsunari, Toad Rider and target Frog you control can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with flying or reach.
557752.translation: {o1o(G/U)}：乘蟾达成与目标由你操控的蛙本回合只能被具飞行或延势异能的生物阻挡。

557754.oracleText: Each opponent creates a 1/1 black Rat Rogue creature token.
557754.translation: 每位对手各派出一个1/1黑色老鼠／浪客衍生生物。

557755.oracleText: Each opponent creates a 1/1 black Rat Rogue creature token.
557755.translation: 每位对手各派出一个1/1黑色老鼠／浪客衍生生物。

557759.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card.
557759.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

557760.oracleText: Whenever Echo of Death's Wail attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card.
557760.translation: 每当亡嚎回响攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

557762.oracleText: Evil kami are drawn to mortals who share their grim fascinations.
557762.translation: 寡情冷酷的凡人会招惹上冷酷寡情的邪恶神明。

557763.oracleText: Enchant artifact or creature you control
557763.translation: 结附于由你操控的神器或生物

557766.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +1/+1.
557766.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+1/+1。

557768.oracleText: "That will pay for another arm extension all by itself! Well, as long as it doesn't explode."
557768.translation: 「光这东西就能值回一套延展义肢！只要它不爆炸。」

557769.oracleText: {oT}: Create a Treasure token. Activate only if a creature died this turn.
557769.translation: {oT}：派出一个珍宝衍生物。只能于有生物死去的回合中起动。

557771.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the number of modified creatures you control.
557771.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为由你操控且有饰装的生物数量。
