557772.oracleText: Whenever Unforgiving One attacks, return target creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the number of modified creatures you control.
557772.translation: 每当记怨魂攻击时，将目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，X为由你操控且有饰装的生物数量。

557774.oracleText:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent
557774.translation:
「他们得耗上好几天时间来检查代码，才能发现根源在哪！」
～赛博派特务映太

557777.oracleText: So swift and sharp was his blade that the ogre never even felt the cut.
557777.translation: 他手起刀落，剑锋行云流水，食人魔甚至从未察觉身躯已分为二。

557780.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken modified creature you control dies, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
557780.translation: 每当一个由你操控、有饰装且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

557783.oracleText:
"Carry the heat of the furnace in your steel, and never let it fade."
—Keni-Keni, akki smith
557783.translation:
「把熔炉怒火带到钢刃上，别让它灭了。」
～恶鬼铁匠柯尼柯尼

557784.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
557784.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

557786.oracleText: Akki paint bright, bold designs on their salvaged Imperial mechs, leaving no doubt as to who they belong to now.
557786.translation: 恶鬼会在拾荒捡回的皇室机体上涂绘鲜艳大胆的图案，让其如今归属一目了然。

557787.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +2/+1.
557787.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+2/+1。

557789.oracleText: In the clangor and chaos of the akki attack, few even noticed the frogs on their heads.
557789.translation: 恶鬼攻势阵仗混乱喧闹异常，在这情况下几乎没人注意到他们头上顶着的是青蛙。

557790.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. If you control a modified creature, draw a card.
557790.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。如果你操控有饰装的生物，则抓一张牌。

557792.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
557792.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

557793.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, choose one — • Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards. • Create three Treasure tokens.
557793.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，选择一项～ •  放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。 •  派出三个珍宝衍生物。

557794.oracleText: When Atsushi, the Blazing Sky dies, choose one — • Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards. • Create three Treasure tokens.
557794.translation: 当炽穹轧赐死去时，选择一项～ •  放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。 •  派出三个珍宝衍生物。

557797.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+2 and has trample.
557797.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+2且具有践踏异能。

557799.oracleText: The transition from spiritual to material is sometimes as shocking as it is beautiful.
557799.translation: 灵体具现这一过程有时令人既震撼又惊艳。

557800.oracleText: Enchanted land is a 3/3 red Spirit creature with haste. It's still a land.
557800.translation: 所结附的地是3/3红色，具敏捷异能的精怪生物。它仍然是地。

557801.oracleText: If enchanted land would be destroyed, instead sacrifice CARDNAME and that land gains indestructible until end of turn.
557801.translation: 如果所结附的地将被消灭，则改为牺牲CARDNAME且该地获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

557802.oracleText: If enchanted land would be destroyed, instead sacrifice Crackling Emergence and that land gains indestructible until end of turn.
557802.translation: 如果所结附的地将被消灭，则改为牺牲裂响突现且该地获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

557806.oracleText: {o4}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals damage equal to the number of charge counters on it to target player and that much damage to up to one target creature.
557806.translation: {o4}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标牌手造成等同于其上充电指示物数量的伤害，并对至多一个目标生物造成等量的伤害。

557807.oracleText: {o4}, Sacrifice Dragonspark Reactor: It deals damage equal to the number of charge counters on it to target player and that much damage to up to one target creature.
557807.translation: {o4}，牺牲龙火反应炉：它对目标牌手造成等同于其上充电指示物数量的伤害，并对至多一个目标生物造成等量的伤害。

557809.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or leaves the battlefield, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
557809.translation: 当CARDNAME进战场或离开战场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

557810.oracleText: When Experimental Synthesizer enters or leaves the battlefield, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
557810.translation: 当实验融合仪进入或离开战场时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

557811.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with vigilance. Activate only as a sorcery.
557811.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

557812.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice Experimental Synthesizer: Create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with vigilance. Activate only as a sorcery.
557812.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲实验融合仪：派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。只能于法术时机起动。

557814.oracleText: Kaito and Tamiyo charged headlong into Jin-Gitaxias's secret lab, unaware that the praetor was eagerly awaiting their arrival.
557814.translation: 魁渡和多美代一举冲入金吉塔厦的秘密实验室，全然不知这位魔判官已在该处恭候多时。

557815.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature.
557815.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器。在至多一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

557817.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap any number of untapped creatures you control. This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each creature tapped this way.
557817.translation: 你可以横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法横置一个生物，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

557818.oracleText: Explosive Singularity deals 10 damage to any target.
557818.translation: 火爆奇点对任意一个目标造成10点伤害。

557820.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a Treasure token.
557820.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

557821.oracleText: Create a 2/2 red Goblin Shaman creature token with "Whenever this creature attacks, create a Treasure token."
557821.translation: 派出一个2/2红色鬼怪／祭师衍生生物，且具有「每当此生物攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

557822.oracleText: You may discard up to two cards. If you do, draw that many cards.
557822.translation: 你可以弃至多两张牌。若你如此作，则抓等量的牌。

557824.oracleText: Blessed by Keiga, the Tide Star, Kiki-Jiki would one day master the art of duplication.
557824.translation: 得苍龙京河祝福后，奇奇几奇总有一天能掌握复制之道。

557825.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Create a token that's a copy of another target nonlegendary creature you control, except it has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
557825.translation: {o1}，{oT}：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标由你操控之非传奇生物的复制品，但它具有敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

557827.oracleText: "What? Why would it need a cooling unit?"
557827.translation: 「什么？为何这上面需要冷却装置？」

557828.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you controlled a modified creature as you cast this spell, it deals X plus 2 damage instead.
557828.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。如果你于施放此咒语时操控有饰装的生物，则改为它造成X加2点伤害。

557829.oracleText: Flame Discharge deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you controlled a modified creature as you cast this spell, it deals X plus 2 damage instead.
557829.translation: 火焰涌射对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。如果你于施放此咒语时操控有饰装的生物，则改为它造成X加2点伤害。

557831.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +2/+2 and has menace.
557831.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+2/+2且具有威慑异能。

557832.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, create a 2/2 red Spirit creature token with menace.
557832.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，派出一个2/2红色，具威慑异能的精怪衍生生物。

557833.oracleText: When Gift of Wrath leaves the battlefield, create a 2/2 red Spirit creature token with menace.
557833.translation: 当愤怒赋礼离开战场时，派出一个2/2红色，具威慑异能的精怪衍生生物。

557835.oracleText: It seeks those consumed with rage and offers burning blades.
557835.translation: 寻忿怒之士，以炽刃相报。

557836.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. When you do, CARDNAME deals X damage to target player or planeswalker, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
557836.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

557837.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. When you do, Go-Shintai of Ancient Wars deals X damage to target player or planeswalker, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
557837.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，古战御神体对目标牌手或鹏洛客造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的祭祠数量。

557839.oracleText: {oR}: Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
557839.translation: {oR}：由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

557840.oracleText: {o3oRoR}: Create a 5/5 red Dragon Spirit creature token with flying. Activate only if you control an attacking modified creature.
557840.translation: {o3oRoR}：派出一个5/5红色，具飞行异能的龙／精怪衍生生物。只能于由你操控且有饰装的生物进行攻击期间起动。

557842.oracleText: "I prefer to let my sword do the talking."

557843.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, you may cast target artifact card from your graveyard this turn.
557843.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，本回合中，你可以从你的坟墓场施放目标神器牌。

557845.oracleText: You may cast up to two instant and/or sorcery spells with total mana value 6 or less from your graveyard and/or hand without paying their mana costs. If those spells would be put into your graveyard, exile them instead. Exile CARDNAME.
557845.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中和／或手上施放至多两个法术力值总和等于或小于6的瞬间和／或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果这些咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它们放逐。放逐CARDNAME。

557846.oracleText: You may cast up to two instant and/or sorcery spells with total mana value 6 or less from your graveyard and/or hand without paying their mana costs. If those spells would be put into your graveyard, exile them instead. Exile Invoke Calamity.
557846.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中和／或手上施放至多两个法术力值总和等于或小于6的瞬间和／或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果这些咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它们放逐。放逐召现苦难。

557848.oracleText:
"I'm glad she can run again, but this might have been a bit much."
—Kenji, Sokenzan artisan
557848.translation:
「虽然她能重新跑起来确实令人高兴，可这也太兴奋了。」
～霜剑山工匠乾志

557849.oracleText: Channel — {o1oR}, Discard CARDNAME: Target creature gets +3/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
557849.translation: 魂力～{o1oR}，弃掉CARDNAME：直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+1且获得践踏异能。

557850.oracleText: Channel — {o1oR}, Discard Ironhoof Boar: Target creature gets +3/+1 and gains trample until end of turn.
557850.translation: 魂力～{o1oR}，弃掉铁蹄野猪：直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+1且获得践踏异能。

557852.oracleText: It takes many arms to arm an army.

557856.oracleText: "The flames are a gift from my companion. They won't hurt me. You, on the other hand . . ."
557856.translation: 「这火焰是我神伴相赠，不会伤我分毫。至于你…」

557857.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. CARDNAME also deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller if you control a modified creature.
557857.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。如果你操控有饰装的生物，则CARDNAME再对该永久物的操控者造成2点伤害。

557858.oracleText: Kami's Flare deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Kami's Flare also deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller if you control a modified creature.
557858.translation: 神明火光对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。如果你操控有饰装的生物，则神明火光再对该永久物的操控者造成2点伤害。

557859.oracleText: The only thing better than hitting hard is hitting first.

557861.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent and each planeswalker they control.
557861.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手和每个由对手操控的鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

557862.oracleText: Kumano Faces Kakkazan deals 1 damage to each opponent and each planeswalker they control.
557862.translation: 熊野大战渴苛斩向每位对手和每个由对手操控的鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

557865.oracleText: Many kami came to demand a secret he did not know, and every one of them fell.
557865.translation: 许多神明前来求索熊野自己也不知道的秘密，然而全都无功而返。

557866.oracleText: If a creature dealt damage this turn by a source you controlled would die, exile it instead.
557866.translation: 如果本回合中受过由你操控之来源伤害的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

557870.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of red cards from your hand. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
557870.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐任意数量的红色牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

557871.oracleText: Exile the top X cards of your library. You may play up to two of those cards until the end of your next turn.
557871.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的X张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用其中至多两张。

557874.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
557874.translation: 每当CARDNAME或佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。若你如此作，则弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

557875.oracleText: Whenever Ogre-Head Helm or equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
557875.translation: 每当食人魔头盔或佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。若你如此作，则弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

557878.oracleText: "I fear I have run out of worthy opponents."
557878.translation: 「我担心世上已无好手能与我匹敌。」

557879.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, the next spell you cast this turn costs {o1} less to cast.
557879.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，你本回合中施放的下一个咒语减少{o1}来施放。

557884.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
557884.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

557885.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return Reinforced Ronin to its owner's hand.
557885.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，将强化浪人移回其拥有者手上。

557886.oracleText: Channel — {o1oR}, Discard CARDNAME: Draw a card.

557887.oracleText: Channel — {o1oR}, Discard Reinforced Ronin: Draw a card.
557887.translation: 魂力～{o1oR}，弃掉强化浪人：抓一张牌。

557889.oracleText: "This big metal guy will make some amazing wind chimes!"
557889.translation: 「这么大的铁家伙，经风吹过的声响一定很好听！」

557890.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact with mana value X: Return target artifact card with mana value less than X from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn.
557890.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个法术力值为X的神器：将目标法术力值小于X的神器牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

557892.oracleText: "You've got about three seconds to get out of here before you get a faceful of metal."
557892.translation: 「你有三秒钟的时间滚出这里，否则别怪我朝着你脸就是一锤。」

557893.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another artifact: CARDNAME gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
557893.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个神器：CARDNAME得+2/+1直到回合结束。

557894.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another artifact: Scrapyard Steelbreaker gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
557894.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个神器：废铁场碎钢工得+2/+1直到回合结束。

557896.oracleText: "Step carefully, Imperial. Even the earth rises against you."
557896.translation: 「宫里的，小心脚下。就连大地都在跟你们作对。」

557897.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target and 1 damage to each nonartifact creature target opponent controls.
557897.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且向每个由目标对手操控的非神器生物各造成1点伤害。

557898.oracleText: Seismic Wave deals 2 damage to any target and 1 damage to each nonartifact creature target opponent controls.
557898.translation: 地动波对任意一个目标造成2点伤害，且向每个由目标对手操控的非神器生物各造成1点伤害。

557900.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap it. It gains haste until end of turn.
557900.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。将它重置。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

557901.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
557901.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

557903.oracleText:
"In the wake of the Kami War, Kamigawa descended into a state of constant warfare. Even with Kyodai's wisdom guiding them, it took the first Imperials decades of work and bloodshed to subdue the clans and bring peace to the land."
—History of the Empire
557903.translation:
「逆神之战过后，神河仍深陷战争乱世。纵有香醍辅佐，始帝家亦经数十载惨烈战斗方才平定各方，令和平重回大地。」
～《帝国通史》

557906.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or equipped creature becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to defending player.
557906.translation: 每当CARDNAME或佩带此武具的生物被阻挡时，它对防御牌手造成1点伤害。

557907.oracleText: Whenever Simian Sling or equipped creature becomes blocked, it deals 1 damage to defending player.
557907.translation: 每当猿猴掷械或佩带此武具的生物被阻挡时，它对防御牌手造成1点伤害。

557909.oracleText: Among the artisans of Sokenzan City, reusing every scrap of metal is a point of pride.
557909.translation: 对霜剑山市的工匠来说，重复利用每块废铁是件值得骄傲的事情。

557910.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {o1} and sacrifice an artifact. If you do, create a 3/1 red Construct artifact creature token with haste.
557910.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{o1}并牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则派出一个3/1红色，具敏捷异能的组构体衍生神器生物。

557912.oracleText: Many master samurai make pilgrimages deep into the Sokenzan Mountains, where they train and meditate in silence, hoping to commune with a lava kami.
557912.translation: 许多武士高人会选择独入霜剑山脉修行，于无声中淬炼武艺、静心冥想，希望能亲得熔岩神提点。

557913.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
557913.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

557915.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then CARDNAME deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of modified creatures you control other than CARDNAME.
557915.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后CARDNAME向每位对手各造成X点伤害，X为CARDNAME以外由你操控且有饰装的生物数量。

557916.oracleText: Whenever Thundering Raiju attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then Thundering Raiju deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of modified creatures you control other than Thundering Raiju.
557916.translation: 每当轰鸣雷兽攻击时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后轰鸣雷兽向每位对手各造成X点伤害，X为轰鸣雷兽以外由你操控且有饰装的生物数量。

557918.oracleText: Most Uprisers augment their bodies for speed, strength, or protection, but a few just want to be one with the music.
557918.translation: 大多数起事军将士强化身躯，是为了动作更快、力量更强、防护更佳，但也有人只是为了能与音乐合而为一。

557923.oracleText: "Pierce the heart and pierce the head, even the mightiest fall down dead."
557923.translation: 「射穿心脏又爆头，武艺再强也死透。」

557925.oracleText: Channel — {o1oR}, Discard CARDNAME: It deals 2 damage to any target.
557925.translation: 魂力～{o1oR}，弃掉CARDNAME：它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

557926.oracleText: Channel — {o1oR}, Discard Twinshot Sniper: It deals 2 damage to any target.
557926.translation: 魂力～{o1oR}，弃掉双箭神射手：它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

557928.oracleText: Touma never met a door he didn't hate.
557928.translation: 灯磨还没碰到过一扇他不讨厌的门。

557931.oracleText: "My streets, my rules. You picked the wrong neighborhood for a fight."
557931.translation: 「我的地盘，由我作主。你打架选错地方了。」

557932.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 for each other modified creature you control.
557932.translation: 你每操控一个其他有饰装的生物，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

557933.oracleText: Upriser Renegade gets +2/+0 for each other modified creature you control.
557933.translation: 你每操控一个其他有饰装的生物，起事变节者便得+2/+0。

557935.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice an artifact.
557935.translation: 你可以牺牲一个神器，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

557936.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell's additional cost was paid, CARDNAME deals 4 damage instead.
557936.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果曾支付此咒语的额外费用，则改为CARDNAME造成4点伤害。

557937.oracleText: Voltage Surge deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell's additional cost was paid, Voltage Surge deals 4 damage instead.
557937.translation: 电压翻涌对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果曾支付此咒语的额外费用，则改为电压翻涌造成4点伤害。

557939.oracleText: You may play an additional land this turn.
557939.translation: 本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

557942.oracleText:
"I ask for nothing more than a new journey and a fresh path to greet my feet when I wake each morning."
—Azusa
557942.translation:
「我每日醒来，只求能开辟一段未知旅程，双脚迈上一条全新道路。」
～梓纱

557943.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked, untap up to three lands you control.
557943.translation: 每当CARDNAME被阻挡时，重置至多三个由你操控的地。

557944.oracleText: Whenever Likeness of the Seeker becomes blocked, untap up to three lands you control.
557944.translation: 每当云游者纺像被阻挡时，重置至多三个由你操控的地。

557947.oracleText: "Do not mistake tranquility for domestication. This land is wild, and will always remain so."
557947.translation: 「切勿把静谧当作顺从。这片大地仍带野性，且将长存。」

557948.oracleText: Channel — {o4oG}, Discard CARDNAME: Destroy target creature with flying.
557948.translation: 魂力～{o4oG}，弃掉CARDNAME：消灭目标具飞行异能的生物。

557949.oracleText: Channel — {o4oG}, Discard Bamboo Grove Archer: Destroy target creature with flying.
557949.translation: 魂力～{o4oG}，弃掉竹林射手：消灭目标具飞行异能的生物。

557951.oracleText: Members of the Living Historians don't simply chronicle the past; they embody it.
557951.translation: 现世史家并非只是记载历史，而是亲身承载历史。

557952.oracleText: {o5oG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target enchantment creature. It gains trample until end of turn.
557952.translation: {o5oG}：在目标结界生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

557957.oracleText: She closed her eyes and remembered the smell of the leaves of Jukai Forest. When she opened them, the buildings of Towashi had grown small.
557957.translation: 她闭上双眼，感觉自己又重新回忆起树海中翠叶芬芳气息。再度睁眼时，只见都和市的建筑已变得小巧。

557958.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the greatest mana value among permanents you control. Untap it.
557958.translation: 目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之永久物中的最大法术力值。将它重置。

557960.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic Forest cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
557960.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本的树林牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

557961.oracleText: Put up to one target land card from your graveyard on top of your library.
557961.translation: 将至多一张目标地牌从你坟墓场置于你的牌库顶。

557963.oracleText: Though they razed the surrounding forest, the builders of Towashi left Boseiju unscathed, shaping the city around the ancient tree.
557963.translation: 虽然在建造都和市时周围树木遭大举砍伐，但筑城者却并未触动母圣树分毫，而是以其为中心来规划都市。

557964.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each land you control.

557965.oracleText: Branch of Boseiju gets +1/+1 for each land you control.
557965.translation: 你每操控一个地，母圣树枝桠便得+1/+1。

557967.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +1/+3 and has reach and "{oT}: Add {oGoG}."
557967.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+1/+3且具有延势与「{oT}：加{oGoG}。」

557968.oracleText: Channel — {o1oG}, Discard CARDNAME: Create a 1/1 green Human Monk creature token with "{oT}: Add {oG}."
557968.translation: 魂力～{o1oG}，弃掉CARDNAME：派出一个1/1绿色人类／修行僧衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：加{oG}。」

557969.oracleText: Channel — {o1oG}, Discard Careful Cultivation: Create a 1/1 green Human Monk creature token with "{oT}: Add {oG}."
557969.translation: 魂力～{o1oG}，弃掉细心栽培：派出一个1/1绿色人类／修行僧衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：加{oG}。」

557973.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control that doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
557973.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在目标由你操控且其上没有+1/+1指示物的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

557974.oracleText: Whenever Coiling Stalker deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control that doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
557974.translation: 每当盘卷潜行客对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在目标由你操控且其上没有+1/+1指示物的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

557976.oracleText: The kami of Jukai Forest accept only the most respectful petitioners.
557976.translation: 树海的神明仅接受最虔诚者的祈求。

557977.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an enchantment or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
557977.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张结界或地牌，并将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

557979.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Look at the top three cards of your library. Exile one of them face down with a hatching counter on it, then put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
557979.translation: 你获得2点生命。检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，且上面有一个孵化指示物，然后将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

557980.oracleText: You gain 2 life. Look at the top three cards of your library. Exile one of them face down with a hatching counter on it, then put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
557980.translation: 你获得2点生命。检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，且上面有一个孵化指示物，然后将其余的牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

557982.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or a Dragon you control dies, you may cast a creature spell from among cards you own in exile with hatching counters on them without paying its mana cost.
557982.translation: 每当CARDNAME或一个由你操控的龙死去时，你可以从放逐区里由你拥有且其上有孵化指示物的牌之中施放一个生物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

557983.oracleText: Whenever Dragon-Kami's Egg or a Dragon you control dies, you may cast a creature spell from among cards you own in exile with hatching counters on them without paying its mana cost.
557983.translation: 每当龙神之卵或一个由你操控的龙死去时，你可以从放逐区里由你拥有且其上有孵化指示物的牌之中施放一个生物咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

557984.oracleText:
"Memories fade and wither with time. If we do not nurture the garden of history, we may once more wander blindly through barren lands."
—Reki, founder of the Living Historians
557984.translation:
「记忆会随着时间流逝而消散凋零。如果我们不悉心照料历史花园，就有可能要再度于荒芜之地上盲目游荡。」
～现世史家始祖历

557986.oracleText:
"Let me give you a taste of the poison you've poured into our land."
—Shigeki, founder of the Order of Jukai
557986.translation:
「换你尝尝祸害吾人土地的毒液滋味。」
～树海团创始人茂树

557988.oracleText: The land chooses its own champions.
557988.translation: 大地会选择属于自己的斗士。

557989.oracleText: As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +3/+3 and has reach.
557989.translation: 只要所结附的永久物是生物，它便得+3/+3且具有延势异能。

557990.oracleText: Channel — {o1oG}, Discard CARDNAME: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains reach until end of turn.
557990.translation: 魂力～{o1oG}，弃掉CARDNAME：直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得延势异能。

557991.oracleText: Channel — {o1oG}, Discard Favor of Jukai: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains reach until end of turn.
557991.translation: 魂力～{o1oG}，弃掉树海眷恩：直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+3且获得延势异能。

557993.oracleText: It is said that one must modestly refuse a gift three times before accepting it to show humility before the kami.
557993.translation: 收受神明馈赠之前，须得推托三次方显礼数。

557994.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
557994.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

557996.oracleText: A mysterious kami will sometimes appear to overworked monks and offer them a warm, relaxing bath.
557996.translation: 有时谜样神明会现身过劳修行僧面前，令其得在温泉中沐浴身心。

558000.oracleText: It seeks those with untamed spirits and offers wild strength.
558000.translation: 寻畅活之士，以蛮力相报。

558001.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target Shrine for each Shrine you control.
558001.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，选择目标祭祠。你每操控一个祭祠，便在前者上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558006.oracleText: The kami permit few mortals to dwell in Jukai Forest, but the clever, playful tanuki are welcomed as friends and guardians.
558006.translation: 几无凡间生灵获准长居树海，但机灵调皮的貉则深得神明欢心，充任此地守护者。

558007.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
558007.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

558008.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard Greater Tanuki: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
558008.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉巨貉：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

558010.oracleText: Where the spirit and mortal realms overlap, the laws of reality are rewritten.
558010.translation: 灵界与实界交迭之处，现实定律便遭改写。

558011.oracleText: Enchanted land is a 4/5 green Spirit creature with vigilance and haste. It's still a land.
558011.translation: 所结附的地是4/5绿色，具警戒与敏捷异能的精怪生物。它仍然是地。

558012.oracleText: If enchanted land would be destroyed, instead sacrifice Harmonious Emergence and that land gains indestructible until end of turn.
558012.translation: 如果所结附的地将被消灭，则改为牺牲和谐突现且该地获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

558015.oracleText: On the last day of a Jukai agent's training, they are bequeathed a powerful relic blessed by the kami.
558015.translation: 树海密探在训练的最后一天，才会得授经神明祝福的强大遗宝。

558022.oracleText: After large sections were clear-cut to build Towashi, the once-peaceful Jukai Forest grew violently hostile to outsiders.
558022.translation: 自从树海大片林木因建造都和市被砍伐一空后，原本安宁祥和的此地对外界敌意便与日俱增。

558023.oracleText: Create two 4/5 green Spirit creature tokens. For each of them, put your choice of a vigilance counter, a reach counter, or a trample counter on it.
558023.translation: 派出两个4/5绿色精怪衍生生物。为它们各进行以下流程～在其上依你的选择放置一个警戒指示物，一个延势指示物或一个践踏指示物。

558025.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Human Monk creature token with "{oT}: Add {oG}."
558025.translation: 派出一个1/1绿色人类／修行僧衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：加{oG}。」

558026.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
558026.translation: 在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558029.oracleText: As long as you control five or more modified creatures, CARDNAME gets +5/+5 and has trample.
558029.translation: 只要你操控五个或更多有饰装的生物，CARDNAME便得+5/+5且具有践踏异能。

558030.oracleText: As long as you control five or more modified creatures, Remnant of the Rising Star gets +5/+5 and has trample.
558030.translation: 只要你操控五个或更多有饰装的生物，珠眼遗形便得+5/+5且具有践踏异能。

558032.oracleText: "The kami grant you this boon, not I."

558034.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard CARDNAME: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control.
558034.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉CARDNAME：在至多两个目标由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558035.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard Jukai Preserver: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control.
558035.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉树海卫护人：在至多两个目标由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558037.oracleText: "The Order of Jukai accepts only the strongest of body and spirit. I will train until I meet their expectations."
558037.translation: 「唯有身灵最强健者方能加入树海团。在自己够格前，我将不断修练。」

558038.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
558038.translation: 每当CARDNAME进行阻挡或被阻挡时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

558039.oracleText: Whenever Jukai Trainee blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
558039.translation: 每当树海学员进行阻挡或被阻挡时，它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

558041.oracleText: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Kami of Transience.
558041.translation: 每当你施放结界咒语时，在无常神上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558042.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if an enchantment was put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn, you may return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
558042.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有结界从战场进入你的坟墓场，则你可以将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

558043.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if an enchantment was put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn, you may return Kami of Transience from your graveyard to your hand.
558043.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有结界从战场进入你的坟墓场，则你可以将无常神从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

558048.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may remove a deathtouch counter from it. When you do, exile target artifact or enchantment that player controls.
558048.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从其上移去一个死触指示物。当你如此作时，放逐目标由该牌手操控的神器或结界。

558049.oracleText: Whenever Kappa Tech-Wrecker deals combat damage to a player, you may remove a deathtouch counter from it. When you do, exile target artifact or enchantment that player controls.
558049.translation: 每当返璞河童对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从其上移去一个死触指示物。当你如此作时，放逐目标由该牌手操控的神器或结界。

558051.oracleText: Modified creatures you control have trample.
558051.translation: 由你操控且有饰装的生物具有践踏异能。

558052.oracleText: Whenever a modified creature you control deals combat damage to a player, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
558052.translation: 每当一个由你操控且有饰装的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

558054.oracleText: Search your library for up to three land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
558054.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多三张地牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

558055.oracleText: Search your library for up to three land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
558055.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多三张地牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。

558056.oracleText: Create an X/X green Spirit creature token, where X is the number of lands you control.
558056.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色精怪衍生生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

558057.oracleText: Create an X/X green Spirit creature token, where X is the number of lands you control.
558057.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色精怪衍生生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

558058.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, choose one — • Search your library for up to three land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle. • Create an X/X green Spirit creature token, where X is the number of lands you control.
558058.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，选择一项～ •  从你牌库中搜寻至多三张地牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。 •  派出一个X/X绿色精怪衍生生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

558059.oracleText: When Kura, the Boundless Sky dies, choose one — • Search your library for up to three land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle. • Create an X/X green Spirit creature token, where X is the number of lands you control.
558059.translation: 当芳穹空罗死去时，选择一项～ •  从你牌库中搜寻至多三张地牌，展示这些牌，将它们置于你手上，然后洗牌。 •  派出一个X/X绿色精怪衍生生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

558061.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile any number of green cards from your hand. This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each card exiled this way.
558061.translation: 你可以从你手上放逐任意数量的绿色牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。每以此法放逐一张牌，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

558062.oracleText: Choose target creature with mana value less than X. Search your library for a creature card with the same name as that creature, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
558062.translation: 选择目标法术力值小于X的生物。从你牌库中搜寻一张与该生物同名的生物牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

558064.oracleText: "You have always been a promising student, but your arrogance far outstrips your prowess."
558064.translation: 「为师一直深觉你前途无量，但你孤高倨傲定会自缚手脚。」

558067.oracleText: One day the spirit and mortal realms will be one. Until then, she faithfully guards the sites where they merge.
558067.translation: 灵实二界终将融合一体。她将虔心守护融界之地，静待时刻到来。

558068.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is modified, it has "{oT}: Add {oGoG}."
558068.translation: 只要CARDNAME有饰装，它便具有「{oT}：加{oGoG}。」

558069.oracleText: As long as Orochi Merge-Keeper is modified, it has "{oT}: Add {oGoG}."
558069.translation: 只要护融蛇人有饰装，它便具有「{oT}：加{oGoG}。」

558072.oracleText: Channel — {oXoGoG}, Discard CARDNAME: Put X +1/+1 counters on target land you control. It becomes a 0/0 green Spirit creature with haste. It's still a land.
558072.translation: 魂力～{oXoGoG}，弃掉CARDNAME：在目标由你操控的地上放置X个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0绿色，具敏捷异能的精怪生物。它仍然是地。

558073.oracleText: Channel — {oXoGoG}, Discard Roaring Earth: Put X +1/+1 counters on target land you control. It becomes a 0/0 green Spirit creature with haste. It's still a land.
558073.translation: 魂力～{oXoGoG}，弃掉土石咆哮：在目标由你操控的地上放置X个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0绿色，具敏捷异能的精怪生物。它仍然是地。

558075.oracleText: Pavement ripped like paper as the ancient kami awoke from her long slumber beneath the city.
558075.translation: 长眠城市地底古神醒转起身，现代铺装地面如纸一般应声撕裂。

558077.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest into your graveyard.
558077.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上：展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中的一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

558078.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Return Shigeki, Jukai Visionary to its owner's hand: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest into your graveyard.
558078.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，将树海幻视师茂树移回其拥有者手上：展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中的一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌置入你的坟墓场。

558079.oracleText: Channel — {oXoXoGoG}, Discard Shigeki: Return X target nonlegendary cards from your graveyard to your hand.
558079.translation: 魂力～{oXoXoGoG}，弃掉茂树：将X张目标非传奇的牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

558081.oracleText: Members of the Order of Jukai commune with kami to enhance their martial prowess.
558081.translation: 树海团员经由通悟神明来增进武术技艺。

558082.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to each of X target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
558082.translation: 目标由你操控的生物依其力量，对X个目标生物和／或鹏洛客各造成该数量的伤害。

558086.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
558086.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

558087.oracleText: Whenever Spring-Leaf Avenger deals combat damage to a player, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
558087.translation: 每当春叶复仇者对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

558089.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
558089.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

558093.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle you control. It gains vigilance until end of turn.
558093.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

558094.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle you control. It gains vigilance until end of turn.
558094.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物或载具上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

558096.oracleText:
"In times of strife, the foolish make a fist while the wise make a friend."
—First Address of Seshiro the Anointed as Broodmaster of the Orochi Colonies
558096.translation:
「战乱时代，愚人争强，智者争友。」
～《蛇圣濑四郎首任王蛇就职演讲词》

558098.oracleText: To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.
558098.translation: 为免实界晶片落于金吉塔厦之手，飘萍将它交给多美代悉心保管。

558099.oracleText: Target permanent you control gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. You gain 2 life.
558099.translation: 目标由你操控的永久物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。你获得2点生命。

558101.oracleText: Mill three cards. Create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
558101.translation: 磨三张牌。派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

558102.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
558102.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558104.oracleText: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. When you do, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
558104.translation: 将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

558105.oracleText: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. When you do, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
558105.translation: 将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

558106.oracleText: Exile target noncreature card from a graveyard. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
558106.translation: 将目标非生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558107.oracleText: Exile target noncreature card from a graveyard. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
558107.translation: 将目标非生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558108.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, choose one — • Exile target creature card from a graveyard. When you do, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token. • Exile target noncreature card from a graveyard. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
558108.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择一项～ •  将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。 •  将目标非生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558109.oracleText: Whenever Kirin-Touched Orochi attacks, choose one — • Exile target creature card from a graveyard. When you do, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token. • Exile target noncreature card from a graveyard. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
558109.translation: 每当应麟蛇人攻击时，选择一项～ •  将目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。 •  将目标非生物牌从坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558111.oracleText: Other enchantment creatures you control get +1/+1.
558111.translation: 由你操控的其他结界生物得+1/+1。

558112.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control from an enchantment source. You may choose new targets for the copy.
558112.translation: {oG}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控且来源为结界的起动式或触发式异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

558115.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+4 and has reach.
558115.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+4且具有延势异能。

558118.oracleText: Whenever a Samurai or Warrior you control attacks alone, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each Samurai or Warrior you control.
558118.translation: 每当一个由你操控的武士或战士单独攻击时，你每操控一个武士或战士，该攻击生物便得+1/+0直到回合结束。

558120.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard CARDNAME: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
558120.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉CARDNAME：将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

558121.oracleText: Channel — {o2oG}, Discard Colossal Skyturtle: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand.
558121.translation: 魂力～{o2oG}，弃掉巨型空龟：将目标牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

558122.oracleText: Channel — {o1oU}, Discard CARDNAME: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
558122.translation: 魂力～{o1oU}，弃掉CARDNAME：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

558123.oracleText: Channel — {o1oU}, Discard Colossal Skyturtle: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
558123.translation: 魂力～{o1oU}，弃掉巨型空龟：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

558125.oracleText: Two different visions of freedom clashed at the gates of the Imperial Palace.
558125.translation: 两种不同的自由思路在皇宫门口剧烈碰撞。

558126.oracleText: Create X 2/2 white Samurai creature tokens with vigilance. They gain menace and haste until end of turn.
558126.translation: 派出X个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。它们获得威慑与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

558127.oracleText: Each opponent creates X minus one 2/2 white Samurai creature tokens with vigilance.
558127.translation: 每位对手各派出X减一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的武士衍生生物。

558129.oracleText: "Greetings, fellow inventors!" the akki shouted, attempting a friendly smile. To her dismay, the greeting was met only with shrieks and alarms being activated.
558129.translation: 「各位发明家同僚，大家好！」恶鬼高声招呼，脸上还试着要堆出一丝微笑。但令她失望的是，她的一番问候只换来了惊声尖叫和警报齐鸣。

558135.oracleText: It's hard to say which is more deadly: her bike or her bite.
558135.translation: 很难说是哪样东西更致命：她的机车，还是她的尖牙。

558136.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, return target Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of your next end step.
558136.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，将目标载具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回其拥有者手上。

558138.oracleText: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value 1 or less.
558138.translation: 消灭所有法术力值等于或小于1的非地永久物。

558141.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals damage, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
558141.translation: 每当CARDNAME造成伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

558155.oracleText: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

558167.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, search your library for a blue or black creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle."
558167.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从你牌库中搜寻一张蓝色或黑色生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。」

566773.translation: 将至多两个目标由你操控且非衍生物之生物的复制牌置于你手中。

566774.oracleText: {o1oBoB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Shuffle it into your library. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie in addition to its other types. Activate only as a sorcery.
566774.translation: {o1oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：将它洗回你的牌库。派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为它的复制品，但它是4/4黑色灵俑，仍具有原本类别。只能于法术时机起动。

566775.oracleText: Target creature card in your graveyard perpetually gains "{o1oBoB}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Shuffle it into your library. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie in addition to its other types. Activate only as a sorcery."
566775.translation: 目标在你的坟墓场中的生物牌永久得「{o1oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：将它洗回你的牌库。派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为它的复制品，但它是4/4黑色灵俑，仍具有原本类别。只能于法术时机起动。」

566776.oracleText: Target player reveals all cards with mana value 2 or greater in their hand. You choose a card from among those cards. Exile that card. If a card was exiled this way, that player drafts a card from Break Expectations's spellbook and reveals it.
566776.translation: 目标牌手展示其手上所有法术力值等于或大于2的牌。你从中选择一张牌。放逐该牌。若以此法放逐一张牌，该牌手从打破预期的法术书中发现一张牌，展示该牌。

566777.oracleText: For the right price, he's willing to serve. Just don't talk to him about tea.
566777.translation: 只要价格合适，他就愿意服务。只是别和他谈论茶。「暂译」

566778.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, exile up to one target creature card from your graveyard. If you do, seek a creature card with mana value equal to the mana value of that card plus one. That card perpetually gains menace.
566778.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，从你的坟墓场放逐至多一张目标生物牌。若你如此作，掏一张法术力值等同于所放逐之牌法术力值加一的生物牌。该牌永久得威慑异能。

566783.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, this permanent deals 2 damage to you unless you sacrifice it.
566783.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你牺牲该永久物，否则它对你造成2点伤害。

566786.oracleText: When this creature dies, you may shuffle it into its owner's library if it's in your graveyard. If you do, investigate.
566786.translation: 当此生物死去时，若其在你的坟墓场，你可以将之洗入其拥有者的牌库。若你如此作，探查。

566791.oracleText: Discard a land card: Conjure a card named Hollowhenge Beast into your hand. You may also activate this ability while CARDNAME is in your graveyard.
566791.translation: 弃一张地牌：变出一张名称为空圆地野兽的牌置于你手上。CARDNAME在你的坟墓场时你也能起动此异能。

566792.oracleText: Discard a land card: Conjure a card named Hollowhenge Beast into your hand. You may also activate this ability while Hollowhenge Wrangler is in your graveyard.
566792.translation: 弃一张地牌：变出一张名称为空圆地野兽的牌置于你手上。空圆地驯师在你的坟墓场时你也能起动此异能。

566793.oracleText: As werewolves, vampires, and humans contend for power, Ishkanah builds her own army in the shadows.
566793.translation: 当狼人、吸血鬼和人类争夺权力时，伊什卡娜在阴影中组件了自己的军队。「暂译」

566794.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, seek a card with mana value equal to that damage.
566794.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，掏一张法术力值等同于该伤害数量的牌。

566800.oracleText: Target up to two nontoken creatures you control.
566800.translation: 指定至多两个由你操控且非衍生物的生物为目标。

566802.oracleText: Seek a creature card with mana value equal to the mana value of that card plus one.
566802.translation: 掏一张法术力值等同于所放逐之牌法术力值加一的生物牌。

566804.oracleText: Search for any number of cards with the same name.
566804.translation: 搜寻任意数量同名的牌。

566805.oracleText: Seek two creature cards with mana value 3 or less.
566805.translation: 掏两张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌。

567008.oracleText: Seek an instant or sorcery card.

567011.oracleText: Still and solemn as the statues of her kind that decorated the Park Heights rooftops, she gazed in sorrow on the city below.
567011.translation: 她犹如高地园屋顶静肃的饰像，悲悯地俯视着城市。

567012.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each Citizen you control.
567012.translation: 你每操控一个市民，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

567014.oracleText: "My sources say the Beamtown Bullies were spotted in the Mezzio. Keep your eyes sharp and stay close to me."
567014.translation: 「我的线人说梅齐奥区有钢梁镇蛮汉团出没。睁大眼，跟紧我。」

567017.oracleText: Don't try to cut in. They'll cut back.
567017.translation: 别妄想插队。他们会插回来的。

567018.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, CARDNAME and up to one other target creature you control both gain your choice of first strike or lifelink until end of turn.
567018.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，CARDNAME和至多另一个目标由你操控的生物均依你的选择获得先攻或系命异能直到回合结束。

567019.oracleText: Whenever Ballroom Brawlers attacks, Ballroom Brawlers and up to one other target creature you control both gain your choice of first strike or lifelink until end of turn.
567019.translation: 每当舞厅喧哗人攻击时，舞厅喧哗人和至多另一个目标由你操控的生物均依你的选择获得先攻或系命异能直到回合结束。

567021.oracleText:
"Saving a stranger's life is an excellent recruitment method. Luckily, peril is so easy to come by."
—Falco Spara
567021.translation:
「拯救陌生人的性命非常利于招募成员。幸运的是，危险无处不在。」
～冯柯斯帕拉

567022.oracleText: Put a shield counter on target creature.
567022.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

567025.oracleText: Regarding the relative might of pen and sword, the official position of the Brokers is "Why choose?"
567025.translation: 关于笔与剑何者较强，扶济社的正式立场是「何不全拿？」

567026.oracleText: {o4o(G/U)}: CARDNAME has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn.
567026.translation: {o4o(G/U)}：CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。

567027.oracleText: {o4o(G/U)}: Brokers Initiate has base power and toughness 5/5 until end of turn.
567027.translation: {o4o(G/U)}：扶济社新手的基础力量与防御力为5/5直到回合结束。

567029.oracleText: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.
567029.translation: 大嘴米奇的名号在他和葛古理奥达成交易后依旧保留了下来，虽然他此后再也没说过半句话。

567030.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a Treasure token.
567030.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567032.oracleText: After a brief but memorable incident at her first performance, she was never heckled again.
567032.translation: 她的首演有段令人难忘的小风波，此后她再也没听过嘘声。

567039.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Citizen's Crowbar: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
567039.translation: {oW}，{oT}，牺牲市民撬棒：消灭目标神器或结界。

567040.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "{oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Citizen's Crowbar: Destroy target artifact or enchantment."
567040.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有「{oW}，{oT}，牺牲市民撬棒：消灭目标神器或结界。」

567042.oracleText: Descended from Old Capenna's paladins, the Brokers are masters of defensive combat.
567042.translation: 扶济社渊流自旧卡佩纳的神圣武士，精通防御战术。

567047.oracleText: No screams rang out. No blood stained the streets. In an instant, the bustling metropolis simply fell silent.
567047.translation: 街上没有呼喊，也没留血迹。熙熙攘攘的大都市倏地安静下来。

567048.oracleText: Each player who controls a multicolored creature draws a card. Then destroy all creatures.
567048.translation: 每位操控多色生物的牌手各抓一张牌。然后消灭所有生物。

567050.oracleText: Choose up to one target creature. Put a +1/+1 counter and a counter from among flying, first strike, lifelink, or vigilance on it.
567050.translation: 选择至多一个目标生物。在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物和一个飞行，先攻，系命或警戒指示物。

567051.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may put a permanent card with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield with a shield counter on it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
567051.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以将其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌放进战场，且上面有一个后盾指示物。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

567052.oracleText: Create five 3/3 white Angel creature tokens with flying.
567052.translation: 派出五个3/3白色，具飞行异能的天使衍生生物。

567057.oracleText: A plus-one is simply not enough.
567057.translation: 只有一人说「我也来」远远不够。

567061.oracleText: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.
567061.translation: 乐舞会全部的金圆竟来自一名少女。

567063.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW}. Spend this mana only to cast an Angel spell.
567063.translation: {oT}：加{oW}。此法术力只能用来施放天使咒语。

567065.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}, Untap a tapped creature you control: Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567065.translation: {oW}，{oT}，重置一个由你操控且已横置的生物：派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567066.oracleText: {oWoW}, {oT}, Untap two tapped creatures you control: Draw a card.
567066.translation: {oWoW}，{oT}，重置两个由你操控且已横置的生物：抓一张牌。

567067.oracleText: {oWoWoWoWoW}, {oT}, Untap fifteen tapped creatures you control: You win the game.
567067.translation: {oWoWoWoWoW}，{oT}，重置十五个由你操控且已横置的生物：你赢得这盘游戏。

567069.oracleText:
"Let's find out how much your friends think you're worth."
—Gino, hired kidnapper
567069.translation:
「且来瞧瞧你的朋友们觉得你值多少钱。」
～受雇绑匪基诺

567070.oracleText: {o7}: Hold for Ransom's controller sacrifices it and draws a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
567070.translation: {o7}：囚禁索赎的操控者将它牺牲并抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

567071.oracleText: Enchanted creature can't attack or block and has "{o7}: Hold for Ransom's controller sacrifices it and draws a card. Activate only as a sorcery."
567071.translation: 所结附的生物不能进行攻击或阻挡，且具有「{o7}：囚禁索赎的操控者将它牺牲并抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。」

567073.oracleText: The Obscura reserve their keenest blades for traitors in their midst.
567073.translation: 秘闻帮最快的刀专门伺候自家叛徒。

567074.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell you control, it connives.
567074.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为由你操控之咒语的目标时，令它筹谋。

567075.oracleText: Whenever Illuminator Virtuoso becomes the target of a spell you control, it connives.
567075.translation: 每当耀刃名手成为由你操控之咒语的目标时，令它筹谋。

567077.oracleText:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard
567077.translation:
「这座城市确实需要更多神力相助。」
～巡检员吉勒德

567079.oracleText:
"In the assassination trade, no one lives to make more than one mistake."
—Anhelo, the Painter
567079.translation:
「在刺客这行，一个失误就能赔掉性命。」
～华艺家安海洛

567081.oracleText: "Subsequent efforts to deconstruct this facility will be punished with increasing severity."
567081.translation: 「倘有进一步毁坏本设施之情事，将实施更严厉的处分。」

567082.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a red creature.
567082.translation: 如果此咒语以红色生物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

567083.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature and you gain 2 life.
567083.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

567084.oracleText: Knockout Blow deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature and you gain 2 life.
567084.translation: 致昏重击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害，且你获得2点生命。

567087.oracleText: Crime sometimes makes unlikely allies into lifelong friends.
567087.translation: 脱法之举有时能将机缘凑合的同伙化为终生相随的朋友。

567088.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this creature: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o1}.
567088.translation: {o1}，牺牲此生物：除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

567095.oracleText: "Don't tell me who sent you or who you work for. The less I know, the better."
567095.translation: 「别告诉我是谁派你来或替谁做事。我知道得越少越好。」

567096.oracleText: Return up to three target creature cards with total mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
567096.translation: 将至多三张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于3。

567099.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more creatures, create that many 1/1 green and white Citizen creature tokens. Then if you control ten or more creatures, you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
567099.translation: 每当你以一个或数个生物攻击时，派出等量的1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。然后如果你操控十个或更多生物，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567101.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard by paying {o2oW} rather than paying its mana cost.
567101.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放CARDNAME，但须支付{o2oW}，而不支付其法术力费用。

567102.oracleText: You may cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {o2oW} rather than paying its mana cost.
567102.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放拉斐茵的指引，但须支付{o2oW}，而不支付其法术力费用。

567104.oracleText: "I've analyzed the vault schematic. Do you want the fast way, the easy way, or the secret way in?"
567104.translation: 「我已将宝库图纸分析完毕。你想怎么进去？要快，要方便，还是要隐密？」

567108.oracleText: Her opponent threw her through the window, so she retaliated by throwing the window through her opponent.
567108.translation: 对手将她扔穿窗户，所以她的回报是将窗户扔穿对手。

567109.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+7 until end of turn. Untap it.
567109.translation: 目标生物得+2/+7直到回合结束。将它重置。

567111.oracleText: As Ob Nixilis closed in, Halo swept through Giada like an electrical current, and inside her, something long dormant unfurled its wings.
567111.translation: 欧尼希兹逐步逼近，金圆突如电流通导吉娅妲全身，体内一股沉睡已久的力量终得展翼。

567112.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it has a counter on it, it also gains flying and lifelink until end of turn.
567112.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果其上有指示物，则它再获得飞行与系命异能直到回合结束。

567114.oracleText: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."
567114.translation: 「它们的主人毫无戒心地自言自语，里头透露的事情可真有意思。」

567123.oracleText: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"
567123.translation: 「号外！尚夺尔勋爵遇害！嫌犯在逃！」

567124.oracleText: {o3oW}: You and target opponent each draw a card.

567126.oracleText: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."
567126.translation: 「朋友啊，不管你在烦什么，今晚这杯就消愁！明天更有气力！」

567134.oracleText: Whenever you discard a card, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-0 until your next turn, where X is the number of different mana values among cards in your graveyard.
567134.translation: 每当你弃一张牌时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-0直到你的下一个回合，X为你坟墓场中牌的不同法术力值种数。

567136.oracleText: "I could show you what's in the case, but it'd be the last thing you ever see."
567136.translation: 「我是可以给你看箱子里装着什么，但这会是你这辈子最后看的东西。」

567137.oracleText: As long as there are two or more counters among creatures you control, CARDNAME can attack as though it didn't have defender.
567137.translation: 只要由你操控的生物上总共有两个或更多指示物，CARDNAME便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

567138.oracleText: As long as there are two or more counters among creatures you control, Backstreet Bruiser can attack as though it didn't have defender.
567138.translation: 只要由你操控的生物上总共有两个或更多指示物，后巷恶棍便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

567140.oracleText: One last job before he retires.

567141.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put a shield counter on target creature you control.
567141.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

567142.oracleText: When Brokers Veteran dies, put a shield counter on target creature you control.
567142.translation: 当扶济社老手死去时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个后盾指示物。

567144.oracleText: Steel doors and iron bars are child's play for an Obscura operative.
567144.translation: 钢门铁栏对秘闻帮特务只是小菜一碟。

567145.oracleText: Draw two cards, then look at the top card of each player's library.
567145.translation: 抓两张牌，然后检视每位牌手的牌库顶牌。

567148.oracleText: Target player mills half their library, rounded down.
567148.translation: 目标牌手磨其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

567149.oracleText:
"I've known for a year that you would cast this exact spell, at this exact spot, at this exact time."
—Raffine
567149.translation:
「时间、地点、咒语：你的所有作为与我一年前所料分毫不差。」
～拉斐茵

567152.oracleText: The rendezvous took place hours ago, but the Obscura agent read the residue with ease.
567152.translation: 密会落幕多时，但秘闻帮密探不费吹灰之力便判读出迹证。

567155.oracleText: Few know her face, but everyone knows her work.
567155.translation: 她的样貌鲜为人知，但作品无人不识。

567156.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Copy target spell you control that wasn't cast. You may choose new targets for the copy.
567156.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控且未经施放的咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

567158.oracleText: Those who try to rob the Obscura often leave behind more than they take away.
567158.translation: 妄图抢劫秘闻帮的人，最后留下的东西比带走的多。

567159.oracleText: This spell costs {oUoUoU} less to cast if an opponent has drawn four or more cards this turn.
567159.translation: 如果任一对手本回合中抓过四张或更多牌，则此咒语减少{oUoUoU}来施放。

567161.oracleText:
"Altonio? No, I'm sorry. No one by that name works here."
—Raffine
567161.translation:
「阿托尼奥？抱歉，我们这里没有这号人物。」
～拉斐茵

567162.oracleText: {o1oU}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This creature can't be blocked." Activate only as a sorcery.
567162.translation: {o1oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能被阻挡。」只能于法术时机起动。

567163.oracleText: {o1oU}, Exile Expendable Lackey from your graveyard: Create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This creature can't be blocked." Activate only as a sorcery.
567163.translation: {o1oU}，从你的坟墓场放逐炮灰跟班：派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能被阻挡。」只能于法术时机起动。

567164.oracleText: "Greedy vault guard, wouldn't share. Now there's Halo in your hair!"
567164.translation: 「宝库守卫贪婪无度不肯分享。就让我来抹点金圆到你头上！」

567166.oracleText: "All is calm. All is well. You know me to be a trusted member of your family, and I would like to discuss the contents of our safe."
567166.translation: 「你感到平静。你感到安全。你知道我是值得信赖的家族成员，我想谈谈我们保险箱里的东西。」

567171.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, CARDNAME connives.
567171.translation: 每当任一牌手施放每回合中他的第二个咒语时，令CARDNAME筹谋。

567172.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, Ledger Shredder connives.
567172.translation: 每当任一牌手施放每回合中他的第二个咒语时，令碎帐艾文筹谋。

567176.oracleText: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.
567176.translation: 新卡佩纳的雕像掩藏着旧卡佩纳的秘密。

567177.oracleText: Until end of turn, target artifact or creature becomes a 4/4 Angel artifact creature and gains flying.
567177.translation: 直到回合结束，目标神器或生物成为4/4天使神器生物且获得飞行异能。

567180.oracleText: Obscura initiates are required to bring a gift of information. They are judged on both how useful it is and how hard it was to obtain.
567180.translation: 秘闻帮的新手需要带一份情报当入门礼。情报价值与获取难度都会影响自己的评定。

567181.oracleText: {o1o(W/B)}: CARDNAME gains lifelink until end of turn.
567181.translation: {o1o(W/B)}：CARDNAME获得系命异能直到回合结束。

567182.oracleText: {o1o(W/B)}: Obscura Initiate gains lifelink until end of turn.
567182.translation: {o1o(W/B)}：秘闻帮新手获得系命异能直到回合结束。

567184.oracleText: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.
567184.translation: 艾紫培想要答案。尚夺尔需要间谍。其命运注定交会。

567185.oracleText: Counter target noncreature spell. Its controller creates two Treasure tokens.
567185.translation: 反击目标非生物咒语。其操控者派出两个珍宝衍生物。

567188.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a green permanent.
567188.translation: 如果此咒语以绿色永久物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

567190.oracleText: She knows your next move before you do.
567190.translation: 在你行动前，她就知道你的下一步。

567196.oracleText: Every Halo smuggler walks a razor's edge between untold riches and sudden disaster.
567196.translation: 每名金圆走私犯都游走在无尽财富和意外遭难的边缘。

567197.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, draw a card.
567197.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，抓一张牌。

567199.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if CARDNAME is untapped, any opponent may tap an untapped creature they control. If they do, tap CARDNAME and create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This creature can't be blocked."
567199.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若CARDNAME未横置，则任意对手可以横置一个由其操控且未横置的生物。若他如此作，则你横置CARDNAME并派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能被阻挡。」

567200.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, if Reservoir Kraken is untapped, any opponent may tap an untapped creature they control. If they do, tap Reservoir Kraken and create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This creature can't be blocked."
567200.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若水库巨海兽未横置，则任意对手可以横置一个由其操控且未横置的生物。若他如此作，则你横置水库巨海兽并派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能被阻挡。」

567203.oracleText: Better to depart in haste than be dearly departed.
567203.translation: 宁愿仓皇逃命，也不要一命呜呼。

567205.oracleText: As long as enchanted creature is attacking alone, it can't be blocked.
567205.translation: 只要所结附的生物单独进行攻击，它便不能被阻挡。

567206.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, it connives.
567206.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，令它筹谋。

567207.oracleText: Enchanted creature has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, it connives."
567207.translation: 所结附的生物具有「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，令它筹谋。」

567209.oracleText:
"Quick, let's hide in the sewer!"
—Ginsi the Thief, now deceased
567209.translation:
「快，我们躲到下水道去！」
～盗贼金曦，喊于生前

567210.oracleText: {o3oU}: CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn. This ability costs {o3} less to activate if there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard.
567210.translation: {o3oU}：CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。如果你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则此异能减少{o3}来起动。

567211.oracleText: {o3oU}: Sewer Crocodile can't be blocked this turn. This ability costs {o3} less to activate if there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard.
567211.translation: {o3oU}：下水道鳄鱼本回合不能被阻挡。如果你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则此异能减少{o3}来起动。

567217.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It phases out.
567217.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。令它跃离。

567223.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, up to one other target creature gains flying until end of turn.
567223.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，至多另一个目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

567224.oracleText: Whenever Wingshield Agent attacks, up to one other target creature gains flying until end of turn.
567224.translation: 每当翼盾密探攻击时，至多另一个目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

567226.oracleText: Whenever you draw your first card during each of your draw steps, draw a card. Then if you have nine or more cards in hand, you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
567226.translation: 每当你抓你每个抓牌步骤中你的第一张牌时，抓一张牌。然后如果你有九张或更多手牌，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567228.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a green and white Citizen creature with base power and toughness 1/1 named Legitimate Businessperson.
567228.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为1/1，名称为合法商人的绿白双色市民生物。

567231.oracleText: "If you wish for blessings, mortal, ask your demon masters. We've given enough to your kind."
567231.translation: 「凡人，要祈福就去找你的恶魔老板吧。吾辈已向你们施舍得够多了。」

567232.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to you, prevent that damage and mill twice that many cards.
567232.translation: 如果你将受到伤害，则防止该伤害并磨两倍于该数量的牌。

567234.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, CARDNAME connives.
567234.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，令CARDNAME筹谋。

567235.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, Body Launderer connives.
567235.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，令洁尸客筹谋。

567236.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return another target non-Rogue creature card with equal or lesser power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
567236.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将另一张目标力量等于或小于它的非浪客生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

567237.oracleText: When Body Launderer dies, return another target non-Rogue creature card with equal or lesser power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
567237.translation: 当洁尸客死去时，将另一张目标力量等于或小于它的非浪客生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

567239.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may mill three cards. Then if there are twenty or more cards in your graveyard, you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
567239.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以磨三张牌。然后如果你坟墓场中有二十张或更多牌，则你可以使用所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567241.oracleText:
"I wouldn't call what they have here a justice system. More like an auction."
—Elspeth
567241.translation:
「依我看，这一套与其说是司法流程，倒更像是拍卖流程。」
～艾紫培

567244.oracleText: "Nothing to see here. Just carrying a carpet. Yes, the carpet wears boots. Stop asking questions."
567244.translation: 「不要大惊小怪。我只是背着一卷地毯而已。没错，地毯也穿鞋。别问了。」

567246.oracleText: Everybody is worth their weight in gold.
567246.translation: 每个人都值与其等重的黄金。

567249.oracleText: The fights may sometimes be rigged, but the front-row spectators know the wounds are real.
567249.translation: 虽然有些格斗赛会作假，但前排观众都知道伤口是实打实的。

567250.oracleText: Pay 1 life: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
567250.translation: 支付1点生命：CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

567251.oracleText: Pay 1 life: Cutthroat Contender gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
567251.translation: 支付1点生命：割喉竞技者得+1/+0直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

567253.oracleText:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus
567253.translation:
「把劲爆的背叛谣言抖给传谣者。挑起这两方的恩怨，会是我们的好生意。」
～秘闻帮天眼卡蜜兹

567254.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn. Target player mills three cards.
567254.translation: 目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。目标牌手磨三张牌。

567256.oracleText: Ob Nixilis extends his hand not in partnership, but to affirm your subservience.
567256.translation: 欧尼希兹伸手不是跟你合作，而是要你效忠。

567258.oracleText: Mill two cards, then you may return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
567258.translation: 磨两张牌，然后你可以将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

567260.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature, discard a card, or pay 4 life.
567260.translation: 牺牲一个生物，弃一张牌或支付4点生命，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

567264.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a creature, enchantment, or planeswalker card from it. That player discards that card.
567264.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张生物，结界或鹏洛客牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

567265.oracleText: Choose one — • Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a creature, enchantment, or planeswalker card from it. That player discards that card. • Target opponent sacrifices an enchantment.
567265.translation: 选择一项～ •  目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张生物，结界或鹏洛客牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。 •  目标对手牺牲一个结界。

567267.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token.
567267.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，且你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567268.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token."
567268.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，且你派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

567270.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Rogue creature token.
567270.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色浪客衍生生物。

567271.oracleText: When Girder Goons dies, create a tapped 2/2 black Rogue creature token.
567271.translation: 当扛梁蛮汉死去时，派出一个已横置的2/2黑色浪客衍生生物。

567274.oracleText: "Up and at 'em, buddy. We've got more work to do."
567274.translation: 「醒醒啦，兄弟。还有好多活等着我们呢。」

567275.oracleText: This spell has flash as long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard.
567275.translation: 只要你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，此咒语便具有闪现异能。

567277.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. If it was dealt noncombat damage this turn, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to it and you gain 3 life. Otherwise, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to it and you gain 1 life.
567277.translation: 选择目标生物或鹏洛客。如果它本回合中受过非战斗伤害，则CARDNAME对它造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。若否，则CARDNAME对它造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

567278.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. If it was dealt noncombat damage this turn, Grisly Sigil deals 3 damage to it and you gain 3 life. Otherwise, Grisly Sigil deals 1 damage to it and you gain 1 life.
567278.translation: 选择目标生物或鹏洛客。如果它本回合中受过非战斗伤害，则恐怖印记对它造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。若否，则恐怖印记对它造成1点伤害且你获得1点生命。

567280.oracleText: Whatever the Maestros had ordered, it wasn't anyone's business, including his.
567280.translation: 绝艺盟下订的东西，对谁来说都不是上门的好生意，包括他。

567282.oracleText:
"If I were you, I'd check that elf's coat. I saw him slipping something into his pocket just before you arrived."
—Krandal, freelance instigator
567282.translation:
「换作是我，我会检查一下那个妖精的大衣。就在你来之前，我看到他把什么东西塞进了自己的口袋。」
～惹事包工寇兰多

567283.oracleText: Choose two target creatures controlled by the same player. That player sacrifices one of them.
567283.translation: 选择两个目标由同一牌手操控的生物。该牌手牺牲其中一个。

567285.translation: 「大块头，我们现在是一家人了。」

567286.oracleText: Create a 4/3 black Ogre Warrior creature token.
567286.translation: 派出一个4/3黑色食人魔／战士衍生生物。

567288.oracleText:
"How far are you willing to go for your family, cleanblade?"
—Lord Xander
567288.translation:
「新来的，你会为家族付出多少？」
～尚夺尔勋爵

567289.oracleText: {o4o(U/R)}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
567289.translation: {o4o(U/R)}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

567290.oracleText: {o4o(U/R)}, Exile Maestros Initiate from your graveyard: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
567290.translation: {o4o(U/R)}，从你的坟墓场放逐绝艺盟新手：抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

567292.oracleText: The broad avenues and graceful spires of Park Heights are the playground of the affluent. After nightfall, they also make a fine hunting ground.
567292.translation: 高地园的宽敞马路和优雅高楼是富人的游乐场。入夜后，这里也是片不错的狩猎场。

567293.oracleText: Ob Nixilis decided the fastest way to seize control of New Capenna would be to usurp the networks of power already hidden there. Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.
567293.translation: 欧尼希兹认定，掌控新卡佩纳最迅速的方法，便是篡夺此城既有地下势力网。尚夺尔的绝艺盟最先遭殃。

567299.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
567299.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

567300.oracleText: When Raffine's Silencer dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is Raffine's Silencer's power.
567300.translation: 当拉斐茵的销音客死去时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为拉斐茵的销音客的力量。

567304.oracleText: Between the five of them, they'd committed every crime on the books and invented a few new ones.
567304.translation: 他们五位犯过世上所有的罪行，甚至新发明了几条。

567305.oracleText: For each color, return up to one target creature card of that color from your graveyard to your hand.
567305.translation: 对每种颜色而言，将至多一张目标该颜色的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

567308.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.
567308.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你坟墓场中牌的法术力值有五种或更多，则你可以支付2点生命。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

567310.oracleText:
"Build your towers as tall as you want. The shadow always reaches higher."
—Message scrawled on an alley wall
567310.translation:
「任你万丈高楼拔地起，阴影更有一山高。」
～暗巷墙上留字

567311.oracleText: If your life total is less than your starting life total, this spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the difference.
567311.translation: 如果你的总生命小于你的起始总生命，则此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为两者之间的差值。

567313.oracleText: "Look, we both get what we want. I get your Halo. You get to keep your kneecaps."
567313.translation: 「你瞧，这样我们两边都高兴。我拿到你的金圆。你留住自己的膝盖。」

567314.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player may have you draw a card. If they do, untap CARDNAME and remove it from combat.
567314.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手可以令你抓一张牌。若他如此作，则重置CARDNAME并将其移出战斗。

567315.oracleText: Whenever Shakedown Heavy attacks, defending player may have you draw a card. If they do, untap Shakedown Heavy and remove it from combat.
567315.translation: 每当搜探壮汉攻击时，防御牌手可以令你抓一张牌。若他如此作，则重置搜探壮汉并将其移出战斗。

567316.oracleText: "Only a chump stops after one unlucky loss. You're not a chump, are you?"
567316.translation: 「不小心输一把就收手的人最傻。你不傻吧？」

567319.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard using its blitz ability.
567319.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用CARDNAME的急袭异能来施放之。

567320.oracleText: You may cast Tenacious Underdog from your graveyard using its blitz ability.
567320.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用顽强败犬的急袭异能来施放之。

567322.oracleText: No one remains on her list for long.
567322.translation: 名字在她的清单上待不久。

567323.oracleText: Whenever you gain life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
567323.translation: 每当你于你的回合中获得生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567324.oracleText: Whenever you gain life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Vampire Scrivener.
567324.translation: 每当你于你的回合中获得生命时，在吸血书记员上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567325.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
567325.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567326.oracleText: Whenever you lose life during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Vampire Scrivener.
567326.translation: 每当你于你的回合中失去生命时，在吸血书记员上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

567329.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a white creature.
567329.translation: 如果此咒语以白色生物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

567331.oracleText:
"The little guy had guts at least. You can see 'em right there between those cobbles."
—Glunk, freelance crusher
567331.translation:
「那矮子胆子还挺大。你可以去瞧瞧，就散在那些鹅卵石之间。」
～猛击包工葛朗克

567332.oracleText: Target creature gets +4/+3 until end of turn.
567332.translation: 目标生物得+4/+3直到回合结束。

567334.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, exile an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard. Then copy each card exiled with CARDNAME. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.
567334.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个瞬间或法术咒语时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。然后复制每张以CARDNAME放逐的牌。你可以施放任意数量的复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567335.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, exile an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard. Then copy each card exiled with Arcane Bombardment. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.
567335.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个瞬间或法术咒语时，随机从你的坟墓场放逐一张瞬间或法术牌。然后复制每张以秘法轰炸放逐的牌。你可以施放任意数量的复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

567337.oracleText: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a vivid imagination."
567337.translation: 「有钱到难以想象？我向你保证，我有丰富的想象力。」

567339.oracleText: For the next week, Park Heights smelled of burnt oil paint and brimstone.
567339.translation: 接下来的一周，高地园弥漫着烧焦的油漆和硫磺味。

567340.oracleText: Players can't gain life this turn. Damage can't be prevented this turn. CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target.
567340.translation: 本回合中，牌手不能获得生命。本回合中，伤害不能被防止。CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

567341.oracleText: Players can't gain life this turn. Damage can't be prevented this turn. Call In a Professional deals 3 damage to any target. (Shield counters don't prevent this damage as they're removed.)
567341.translation: 本回合中，牌手不能获得生命。本回合中，伤害不能被防止。找来行家对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。（此时仍要移去后盾指示物，但如此也无法防止伤害。）

567343.oracleText: As the Adversary's forces descended upon the gala, Elspeth whispered to Giada, "I can get you out of here, but we have to go now."
567343.translation: 见到魔头的部队突临晚会，艾紫培对吉娅妲悄悄说道，「我能带你逃出去，但马上得走。」

567346.oracleText: Nobody thought twice about checking their weapons at the door, until they were informed there was no weapon check at the door.
567346.translation: 所有人想都没想就在门口寄存了自己的武器；后来他们才知道进门不用寄存武器。

567350.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567350.translation: 派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567351.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
567351.translation: 派出一个1/1，绿白双色的市民衍生生物。

567355.oracleText: The only thing Ziatora desires is "more."
567355.translation: 齐朵拉想要的只有「更多」。

567356.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. Put a stash counter on CARDNAME.
567356.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。在CARDNAME上放置一个匿物指示物。

567357.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. Put a stash counter on Glittering Stockpile.
567357.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。在金光宝堆上放置一个匿物指示物。

567358.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of stash counters on CARDNAME.
567358.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为CARDNAME上的匿物指示物数量。

567359.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Glittering Stockpile: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of stash counters on Glittering Stockpile.
567359.translation: {oT}，牺牲金光宝堆：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为金光宝堆上的匿物指示物数量。

567362.oracleText: The staccato clatter of its metal claws on pavement is unmistakable.
567362.translation: 它铁爪摩擦地面刮出的刺耳声响，绝对没人会听错。

567363.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Goldhound: Add one mana of any color.
567363.translation: {oT}，牺牲金辉猎犬：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

567365.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token for each artifact they control.
567365.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，他每操控一个神器，你便派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567366.oracleText: Whenever Hoard Hauler deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token for each artifact they control.
567366.translation: 每当藏品搬运车对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，他每操控一个神器，你便派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567368.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Create a Treasure token.
567368.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

567370.translation:
「精细徒有虚名。」
～蛮石欧菲奥先生

567372.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Discard a card: Create a token that's a copy of another target creature you control. It gains haste and "When this creature dies, draw a card." Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.
567372.translation: {oR}，{oT}，弃一张牌：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标由你操控的生物之复制品。它获得敏捷与「当此生物死去时，抓一张牌。」在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。只能于法术时机起动。

567375.oracleText: Light 'Em Up deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567375.translation: 全烧光对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。

567377.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
567377.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

567378.oracleText: Whenever Mayhem Patrol attacks, target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
567378.translation: 每当破坏巡卫攻击时，目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。

567380.oracleText: Whenever Plasma Jockey attacks, target creature an opponent controls can't block this turn.
567380.translation: 每当电浆操纵手攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

567383.oracleText: Sacrifice a Treasure: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
567383.translation: 牺牲一个珍宝：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

567385.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
567385.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，其为已横置且正进行攻击，并具有「当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

567386.oracleText: Whenever Pugnacious Pugilist attacks, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
567386.translation: 每当好斗拳师攻击时，派出一个1/1红色魔鬼衍生生物，其为已横置且正进行攻击，并具有「当此生物死去时，它对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

567389.oracleText: Everything from damaged furniture to inconvenient corpses becomes fuel for Ziatora's ever-burning foundry.
567389.translation: 从损坏的家具到不该出现的尸体，一切都会成为齐朵拉不熄锻炉之燃料。

567390.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of permanents you've sacrificed this turn.
567390.translation: {o1}，{oT}：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为你本回合中已牺牲的永久物数量。

567391.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Pyre-Sledge Arsonist deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of permanents you've sacrificed this turn.
567391.translation: {o1}，{oT}：葬火锤纵燃师对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为你本回合中已牺牲的永久物数量。

567393.oracleText:
"It's too quiet tonight. Go make trouble."
—Ziatora
567393.translation:
「今晚太安静了。去惹点麻烦。」
～齐朵拉

567394.oracleText: Ready to Rumble deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
567394.translation: 准备出击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

567395.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. • Destroy target artifact.
567395.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

567396.oracleText: Choose one — • Ready to Rumble deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. • Destroy target artifact.
567396.translation: 选择一项～ •  准备出击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器。

567399.oracleText: Young viashino flock to the Riveteers for Ziatora's leadership, eager to unleash their own inner dragons.
