614553.oracleText: Pay any amount of mana. Look at that many cards from the top of your library, then put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
614553.translation: 支付任意数量的法术力，检视你牌库顶等数量的牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

614554.oracleText: Tap an untapped artifact you control: This emblem deals 1 damage to any target.
614554.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器：此徽记对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

614555.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Tap an untapped artifact you control: This emblem deals 1 damage to any target."
614555.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器：此徽记对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

614558.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast with the chosen name cost {o2} more to cast.
614558.translation: 对手施放之具该名称的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

614559.oracleText: Activated abilities of sources with the chosen name cost {o2} more to activate unless they're mana abilities.
614559.translation: 除法术力异能之外，具有该名称之来源的起动式异能都增加{o2}来起动。

614571.oracleText: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.
614571.translation: 新阿基夫热情接纳了因瑞斯时空覆盖而流离失所的寇族，寇族则以坚贞忠诚回报。

614572.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each creature you control.
614572.translation: 你每操控一个生物，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

614574.oracleText: To conserve ammunition, Jhoira modified ancient Thran artillery cannons to fire gouts of pure Shivan lava.
614574.translation: 为了节约弹药，尤依拉改造了远古的索蓝火炮，好让它们发射纯粹的西瓦熔岩。

614575.oracleText: Domain — CARDNAME deals X damage to target tapped creature, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.
614575.translation: 领土～CARDNAME对目标已横置的生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量加1。

614576.oracleText: Domain — Artillery Blast deals X damage to target tapped creature, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.
614576.translation: 领土～火炮爆击对目标已横置的生物造成X点伤害，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量加1。

614578.oracleText: "A single light can hold back endless darkness."
614578.translation: 「单缕明光就能阻挡无尽黑暗。」

614581.oracleText: Even he didn't know what he was until he felt his skin shifting and splitting, his mind overtaken by a chaos of whispers.
614581.translation: 直到感觉皮肤移位撕裂、心智遭混沌细语占据，他甚至自己都不知道其潜藏身份。

614584.oracleText:
"Argivia's walls may run on powerstones, but its real power comes from its people."
—King Darien XLVIII
614584.translation:
「阿基瓦的高墙靠魔力石来运转，但其真正力量来自城中人民。」
～国王达利安四十八世

614586.oracleText: "This battlefield is an anvil, my mace a forging hammer . . . and you, Phyrexian scum, are the scrap metal that's about to be reshaped as I see fit."
614586.translation: 「这战场就是铁砧，我的战锤便是锻锤…至于你，非瑞克西亚败类，就是块任我重塑的铁渣。」

614588.oracleText: "What lurks behind the faces of those you think you can trust?"
614588.translation: 「还不来看看忠厚之人表皮底下是副什么面孔？」

614594.oracleText: Argivia's clockwork fortifications are the stuff of legend, reminding all on Dominaria that ingenuity has saved them before and can do so again.
614594.translation: 阿基瓦的发条工事个个都是传奇，时刻提醒多明纳里亚的所有人：精巧装置曾救过生灵性命，且未来仍可安心仰仗。

614601.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast white permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {oW} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of white mana you pay.
614601.translation: 你可以支付2点生命，以作为施放白色永久物咒语的额外费用。如果你以此法支付生命，则该咒语减少{oW}来施放。此效应仅减少你支付的白色法术力数量。

614602.oracleText: Whenever you cast a white permanent spell, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
614602.translation: 每当你施放白色永久物咒语时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

614604.oracleText: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.
614604.translation: 撒拉之美善最常体现为抚触治伤，但也能令邪物仁慈死亡。

614605.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater. • Destroy target enchantment.
614605.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标防御力等于或大于4的生物。•  消灭目标结界。

614606.oracleText: Griffin flocks still patrol the skies above the Zhalfirin void, as though they are waiting for their old home to reappear.
614606.translation: 狮鹫依旧成群地飞翔在赛费尔虚境上空，似在等待故乡重现。

614608.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enlists a creature, scry 2.

614609.oracleText: Whenever Guardian of New Benalia enlists a creature, scry 2.
614609.translation: 每当新宾纳里亚守护者征列生物时，占卜2。

614610.oracleText: Discard a card: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
614610.translation: 弃一张牌：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

614611.oracleText: Discard a card: Guardian of New Benalia gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
614611.translation: 弃一张牌：新宾纳里亚守护者获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

614613.translation: 「为了凯尔顿！为了宾纳里亚！为了多明纳里亚！」

614614.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, those creatures also gain trample until end of turn.
614614.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则这些生物再获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

614616.oracleText:
"Okay—you take the sixteen ragers and the hulk on the right. I'll take the ten defilers and the plaguelord on the left. Ready?"
—Danitha, to Radha
614616.translation:
「好～你解决右边的十六头狂怒兽和那个巨汉。我解决左边的十头渎者和这个疫病王。准备好了吗？」
～达妮莎吩咐拉妲

614618.oracleText: "What Phyrexia takes, the grace of Freyalise shall replenish."
614618.translation: 「非瑞克西亚夺走的东西，在妃雅丽兹的辉映下会重现光芒。」

614622.oracleText: "Phyrexians destroyed my village, but they cannot break my hope."
614622.translation: 「非瑞克西亚人摧毁了我的村庄，但他们击碎不了我的希望。」

614623.oracleText: {o1oW}: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

614624.oracleText: {o1oW}: Knight of Dawn's Light gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

614627.oracleText: Love Song of Night and Day

614629.oracleText: You and target opponent each draw two cards.
614629.translation: 你和目标对手各抓两张牌。

614630.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying.
614630.translation: 派出一个1/1白色，具有飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

614631.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
614631.translation: 在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

614633.oracleText: In the fight to defeat Phyrexia, the courage of Benalish knights is matched only by that of their pegasus steeds.
614633.translation: 与非瑞克西亚交战时，唯有将英勇宾纳里亚骑兵跟无畏飞空骏马相配方能得胜。

614640.oracleText: When a Phyrexian agent cannot be killed, they must be contained.
614640.translation: 既然杀不尽非瑞克西亚密探，就必须能将之看住。

614644.oracleText: Morale rarely survives the sudden appearance of a squad of Sursi skirmishers at an army's flank.
614644.translation: 眼见侧翼杀出一队苏西侦卫时，鲜有军队还能留有战意。

614648.oracleText: Destroy target tapped creature. If this spell was kicked, scry 2.
614648.translation: 消灭目标已横置的生物。如果此咒语已增幅，则占卜2。

614650.oracleText: "Spiritual wholeness is not something you can give to yourself: it is attained only through the divine blessing of healing another."
614650.translation: 「你无法自行获得心灵上的完整：只有用治愈他人的神圣祝福才能实现。」

614651.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, you gain 1 life and scry 1.
614651.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，你获得1点生命并占卜1。

614652.oracleText: Whenever Samite Herbalist becomes tapped, you gain 1 life and scry 1.
614652.translation: 每当撒姆尼草药师成为横置时，你获得1点生命并占卜1。

614654.oracleText: When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain 2 life.
614654.translation: 当此永久物从战场进入坟墓场时，将它放逐且你获得2点生命。

614655.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may play a land from your graveyard or cast a permanent spell with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain 2 life."
614655.translation: 仅于你的每回合中且限一次，你可以从你的坟墓场中使用地或施放法术力值等于或小于3的永久物咒语。如果你如此作，则它获得「当此永久物从战场进入坟墓场时，将它放逐且你获得2点生命。」

614657.oracleText: Armed by Multani, she protected the forest from above.
614657.translation: 她蒙穆塔尼赐力，从空中保佑树林安宁。

614659.oracleText: Tap up to two target creatures. If this spell was kicked, put a stun counter on each of those creatures.
614659.translation: 横置至多两个生物。如果此咒语已增幅，则在这些生物上各放置一个晕眩指示物。

614661.oracleText: "You are all part of my pride. As long as I live, I will protect you."
614661.translation: 「你就是我的群伴。只要我活着，就会保你平安。」

614662.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
614662.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得系命与不灭异能直到回合结束。

614664.oracleText: "Any one of us could be compromised," said Karn. "No one leaves until we know who can be trusted."
614664.translation: 「我们谁都可能是潜探，」卡恩说道。「在弄清楚谁值得信赖之前，谁都不许走。」

614668.oracleText: Scry 4, then you may reveal the top card of your library. If a planeswalker card is revealed this way, put it into your hand.
614668.translation: 占卜4，然后你可以展示你的牌库顶牌。如果以此法展示出一张鹏洛客牌，则将它置于你的手上。

614669.oracleText: You may put a planeswalker card with mana value 6 or less from your hand onto the battlefield.
614669.translation: 你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于6的鹏洛客牌从你手上放进战场。

614670.oracleText: You may activate the loyalty abilities of planeswalkers you control twice this turn rather than only once.
614670.translation: 本回合中，你可以起动由你操控之鹏洛客的忠诚异能两次，而不是只能起动一次。

614672.oracleText: "Let them come. We will show them that Argivian steel is stronger than any Phyrexian metal."
614672.translation: 「让它们放马过来。我们会教它们知道：阿基夫的钢铁比任何非瑞克西亚的金属都要硬。」

614673.translation: 由你操控的其他士兵得+1/+1。

614674.oracleText: {o3oWoW}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Soldier you control.
614674.translation: {o3oWoW}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：在每个由你操控的士兵上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

614675.oracleText: {o3oWoW}, Exile Valiant Veteran from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Soldier you control.
614675.translation: {o3oWoW}，从你的坟墓场放逐英勇老兵：在每个由你操控的士兵上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

614681.oracleText: As a young student, she dusted the shelves of Tolaria's great library. Now, she writes the books that line them.
614681.translation: 她还是年轻学生时，曾亲手扫除陶拉里亚大图书馆书架。如今她的亲著书作已列满该处。

614682.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player may draw an additional card. If they do, spells they cast this turn cost {o2} more to cast.
614682.translation: 在每位牌手的抓牌步骤开始时，该牌手可以额外抓一张牌。若他如此作，则本回合中，他施放的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

614684.oracleText: Once the Society of Mishra took control, the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam became a haven for dark research.
614684.translation: 自从米斯拉社团掌权后，陶拉里亚大学院的拉特南分院便成为黑暗研究的乐土。

614685.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
614685.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

614687.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying.
614687.translation: 派出一个1/1白色，具有飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

614688.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying.
614688.translation: 派出一个1/1白色，具有飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

614689.oracleText: Return another target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
614689.translation: 将另一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

614690.oracleText: Return another target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
614690.translation: 将另一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

614697.oracleText: As long as enchanted creature is legendary, it gets +1/+1 and has ward {o1}.
614697.translation: 只要所结附的生物是传奇，它便得+1/+1且具有守护{o1}。

614699.oracleText: The seafloor is strewn with the wreckage of Vodalia's would-be conquerors.
614699.translation: 原本号称要夺下伏特里亚的征服者，如今只见舰只残骸布满海床。

614700.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Target player mills X cards, where X is the number of creatures you control with defender.
614700.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：目标牌手磨X张牌，X为由你操控且具守军异能的生物数量。

614703.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast blue permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {oU} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of blue mana you pay.
614703.translation: 你可以支付2点生命，以作为施放蓝色永久物咒语的额外费用。如果你以此法支付生命，则该咒语减少{oU}来施放。此效应仅减少你支付的蓝色法术力数量。

614704.oracleText: Whenever you cast a blue permanent spell, draw a card.
614704.translation: 每当你施放蓝色永久物咒语时，抓一张牌。

614706.oracleText: Djinn of the Fountain gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
614706.translation: 喷泉巨灵得+1/+1直到回合结束。

614707.oracleText: Exile CARDNAME. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
614707.translation: 放逐CARDNAME。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

614708.oracleText: Exile Djinn of the Fountain. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
614708.translation: 放逐喷泉巨灵。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

614709.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, choose one — • CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn. • Exile CARDNAME. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. • Scry 1.
614709.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，选择一项～ •  CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。 •  放逐CARDNAME。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。 •  占卜1。

614710.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, choose one — • Djinn of the Fountain gets +1/+1 until end of turn. • Exile Djinn of the Fountain. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. • Scry 1.
614710.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，选择一项～ •  喷泉巨灵得+1/+1直到回合结束。 •  放逐喷泉巨灵。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。 •  占卜1。

614712.oracleText: "You're not so special, Karn. Anything that has been assembled can be disassembled."
614712.translation: 「卡恩，你并不特别。只要是拼组出来的东西就能拆得掉。」

614713.oracleText: This spell costs {oU} less to cast if an opponent cast two or more spells this turn.
614713.translation: 如果任一对手本回合中施放过两个或更多咒语，则此咒语减少{oU}来施放。

614714.oracleText:
"Phyrexians pollute everything they touch, so the solution is simple: don't let them touch anything."
—Teferi
614714.translation:
「非瑞克西亚人碰过的东西都会被污染，解决方案也很简单：别让他们碰任何东西。」
～泰菲力

614716.oracleText: You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 1 or 2 from your hand without paying its mana cost.
614716.translation: 你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值为1或2的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

614718.oracleText: Exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy.
614718.translation: 将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场放逐。将其复制。你可以施放该复制品。

614723.oracleText: "I adore your outfit. It's so . . . rustic."
614723.translation: 「我喜欢你的装扮。看上去非常…淳朴。」

614724.oracleText: Haughty Djinn's power is equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
614724.translation: 狂妄巨灵的力量等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌的数量加总。

614726.oracleText: Some bad dreams stay with you forever.
614726.translation: 有些噩梦会永远缠着你。

614727.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked as long as you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
614727.translation: 只要你本回合中施放过瞬间或法术咒语，CARDNAME便不能被阻挡。

614728.oracleText: Haunting Figment can't be blocked as long as you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
614728.translation: 只要你本回合中施放过瞬间或法术咒语，不散拟体便不能被阻挡。

614730.oracleText: Tap target creature and put three stun counters on it.
614730.translation: 横置目标生物并在其上放置三个晕眩指示物。

614731.oracleText:
"I've always made snap decisions. I'm just better at making the right ones now that I'm older and wiser."
—Teferi
614731.translation:
「我一向决断迅速。只是我现在随着年岁阅历增长，决断也越来越正确。」
～泰菲力

614733.oracleText: The Tolarians had the maps, but only the Yavimayans knew how to read them.
614733.translation: 地图虽在陶拉里亚人手中，但只有亚维马雅人才能读懂。

614734.oracleText: Scry 2, then draw a card. If this spell was kicked, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
614734.translation: 占卜2，然后抓一张牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则你可以将一张地牌从你手上放进战场。

614736.oracleText: "Ideas don't have to be big to be great."
614736.translation: 「想法不是只有声势大才会成效大。」

614739.oracleText:
"It's frustrating, isn't it, to be so weak and ineffectual? Don't worry, you'll be compleat soon enough."
—Rona
614739.translation:
"It's frustrating, isn't it, to be so weak and ineffectual? Don't worry, you'll be compleat soon enough."
—Rona

614741.oracleText: Another target nonland permanent phases out. It can't phase in for as long as you control CARDNAME.
614741.translation: 另一个目标非地永久物跃离。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，它不能跃回。

614742.oracleText: Another target nonland permanent phases out. It can't phase in for as long as you control The Phasing of Zhalfir.
614742.translation: 另一个目标非地永久物跃离。于你操控赛费尔跃离纪的时段内，它不能跃回。

614743.oracleText: Another target nonland permanent phases out. It can't phase in for as long as you control CARDNAME.
614743.translation: 另一个目标非地永久物跃离。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，它不能跃回。

614744.oracleText: Another target nonland permanent phases out. It can't phase in for as long as you control The Phasing of Zhalfir.
614744.translation: 另一个目标非地永久物跃离。于你操控赛费尔跃离纪的时段内，它不能跃回。

614745.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. For each creature destroyed this way, its controller creates a 2/2 black Phyrexian creature token.
614745.translation: 消灭所有生物。对每个以此法消灭的生物而言，其操控者派出一个2/2黑色非瑞人衍生生物。

614747.oracleText:
"Even if they're hunting for sleeper agents, who looks twice at a bird?"
—Rona
614747.translation:
「就算他们在追捕潜藏密探，谁又会仔细看一只鸟呢？」
～罗娜

614748.oracleText: Draw two cards. If this spell was kicked, each opponent discards a card.
614748.translation: 抓两张牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则每位对手各弃一张牌。

614752.oracleText: If this spell was kicked, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
614752.translation: 如果此咒语已增幅，则派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

614753.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o1} for each creature you control.
614753.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者为每个由你操控的生物各支付{o1}，否则反击之。

614755.oracleText: Return target creature or planeswalker you don't control to its owner's hand. If this spell was kicked, put that permanent on the bottom of its owner's library instead.
614755.translation: 将目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客移回其拥有者手上。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为将该永久物置于其拥有者牌库底。

614757.oracleText: Homarid shells are adapted to the crushing pressure of the deepest depths; on land, their sturdiness seems supernatural.
614757.translation: 荷马利族的甲壳因要适应深洋水压而不断进化；等上到陆地后，就显得坚韧异常。

614758.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. Untap it.
614758.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得辟邪异能。将它重置。

614760.oracleText: Karn's creation allowed him to monitor events across Dominaria—and everything he saw worried him.
614760.translation: 卡恩的造物让他能洞悉多明纳里亚每处动向～但所见发展都让他忧心忡忡。

614761.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME as though it had flash if X is 3 or less.
614761.translation: 如果X小于等于3，则你可以将CARDNAME视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

614762.oracleText: You may cast Silver Scrutiny as though it had flash if X is 3 or less.
614762.translation: 如果X小于等于3，则你可以将银镜洞察视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

614764.oracleText: The already spectacular views from the towers of the College at Lat-Nam are sometimes enhanced by glimpses of drakes diving into the ocean to devour small sharks.
614764.translation: 从大学院拉特南分院的高塔登高远望，其壮阔景象已然美不胜收；而有时还能看到龙兽俯冲洋面叼食幼鲨，更在秀丽画卷上增添生动点缀。

614766.oracleText: Domain — Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, reveal the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
614766.translation: 领土～每当CARDNAME对任意牌手造成战斗伤害时，展示你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。由任一对手将他们分为两堆。将其中一堆置于你的手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。

614769.oracleText:
"The Talas pirates are motivated by money, so we paid them twice what they could steal from us to spy for us instead."
—Jhoira
614769.translation:
「塔拉斯海盗全都见钱眼开，因此我把可能被他们拿走的损失加倍雇用他们来侦察。」
～尤依拉

614770.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
614770.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你的手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

614771.oracleText: When Talas Lookout dies, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
614771.translation: 当塔拉斯警戒员死去时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你的手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

614773.oracleText: Prized by wizards as a mobile scrying pool, it bears visions drawn from the depths of the sea.
614773.translation: 它是法师们眼中珍贵的移动占卜池，承载着取自深洋的视象。

614775.oracleText: Students fled with their research as Tolaria fell to the Phyrexians.
614775.translation: 陶拉里亚落入非瑞克西亚之手后，学生们纷纷带着自己的研究逃跑。

614776.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-0 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature blocks this turn if able.
614776.translation: 目标生物得-1/-0直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则该生物本回合若能进行阻挡，则必须阻挡。

614778.oracleText: "If they don't drown, perhaps they'll rust."
614778.translation: 「如果他们淹不死，大概也会生锈。」

614779.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Draw a card. If this spell was kicked, you gain 3 life.
614779.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。抓一张牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则你获得3点生命。

614781.oracleText: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.
614781.translation: 在这之后，人们迅速修订许多关于海洋巨蛇形态学方面的论述。

614783.oracleText:
"There hasn't been an original thought on Vesuva in centuries."
—Emmest, Tolarian chronicler
614783.translation:
「维苏瓦几百年来未再出现过任何原创思想。」
～陶拉里亚年代史家埃默斯特

614784.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single artifact or creature you control, create a token that's a copy of that artifact or creature, except it's not legendary.
614784.translation: 每当你施放仅以单一由你操控的神器或生物为目标的咒语时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该神器或生物的复制品，但它不是传奇。

614789.oracleText: "You're just one more pollutant to be removed from the sea."
614789.translation: 「你不过是另一个要从海里除掉的污染物。」

614790.oracleText: Sacrifice a Merfolk: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {o1}.
614790.translation: 牺牲一个人鱼：除非目标非生物咒语的操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

614798.oracleText: Ships suspected of carrying Sheoldred's agents have a tendency to drift far off course as they sail through the Voda Sea.
614798.translation: 怀疑搭载希欧蕊密探的船只在航经伏特海时，往往会大幅偏离航道。

614799.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell or a kicked spell.
614799.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来施放瞬间，法术或已增幅的咒语。

614801.oracleText: Squee's orders basically came down to "attack the squishy parts."
614801.translation: 斯奎的命令基本上都可以归结为「照软处打」。

614802.oracleText: Target player discards two cards. If this spell was kicked, it deals 3 damage to that player.
614802.translation: 目标牌手弃两张牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则它对该牌手造成3点伤害。

614808.oracleText:
"Since when is it cheating to give one side an unfair advantage?"
—Braids
614808.translation:
「让一方获得不公平的优势怎么能算是作弊呢？」
～布蕾德

614809.oracleText: Target creature gains deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn.
614809.translation: 目标生物获得死触和不灭异能直到回合结束。

614811.oracleText: Having encountered the bitter Phyrexian battleflies before, Squee knew not to bother eating them—or at least to stop after the fifth.
614811.translation: 斯奎尝过非瑞克西亚战蝇的苦味道，知道犯不着再去吃它们～或最多吃五只就停下。

614812.oracleText: {oB}: Battlefly Swarm gains deathtouch until end of turn.
614812.translation: {oB}：战蝇大群获得死触异能直到回合结束。

614814.oracleText:
"Keep your distance. It may be broken, but it's far from benign."
—Stenn
614814.translation:
「保持距离。它或许坏了，但远没到无害的程度。」
～斯特恩

614815.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}: Each opponent loses X life, where X is the number of creatures with defender you control.
614815.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}：每位对手各失去X点生命，X为由你操控且具守军异能的生物数量。

614816.oracleText:
"Steel may be more durable, but nothing channels the spite of the unjustly dead like bone."
—Braids
614816.translation:
「钢铁或许更耐用，但还是骨头最适合传递冤死者的愤恨。」
～布蕾德

614818.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker. If you do, each opponent may sacrifice a permanent that shares a card type with it. For each opponent who doesn't, that player loses 2 life and you draw a card.
614818.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以牺牲一个神器、生物、结界、地或鹏洛客。若你如此作，则每位对手各可以牺牲一个与之具共通牌张类别的永久物。对每位未如此作的对手而言，该牌手失去2点生命且你抓一张牌。

614820.oracleText: You may sacrifice a creature. If you do, each opponent discards a card.
614820.translation: 你可以牺牲一个生物。若你如此作，则每位对手各弃一张牌。

614821.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
614821.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

614822.oracleText: Target opponent may sacrifice a nonland, nontoken permanent. If they don't, they lose 2 life and you draw a card.
614822.translation: 目标对手可以牺牲一个非地且非衍生物的永久物。如果他未如此作，则他失去2点生命且你抓一张牌。

614824.oracleText: The Phyrexians were as surprised as anyone to discover they still needed to breathe.
614824.translation: 非瑞克西亚人同样错愕地发现，自己依然需要呼吸。

614825.oracleText: If this spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
614825.translation: 如果此咒语已增幅，则在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

614827.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a creature or planeswalker card from it. That player discards that card.
614827.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张生物或鹏洛客牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

614828.oracleText: Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 3 life.
614828.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。你失去3点生命。

614829.oracleText: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
614829.translation: 将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

614831.oracleText: His eternal rest turned out to be more of a quick nap.
614831.translation: 他的长眠结果更像是小憩。

614833.oracleText: {o1oB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only if a non-Skeleton creature died under your control this turn.
614833.translation: {o1oB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于有非骷髅妖生物在你操控下死去的回合中起动。

614834.oracleText: {o1oB}: Return Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only if a non-Skeleton creature died under your control this turn.
614834.translation: {o1oB}：将教派应征妖从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于有非骷髅妖生物在你操控下死去的回合中起动。

614835.oracleText:
"There can be no mercy, no half measures. When facing Phyrexians, it's kill swiftly or die."
—Jodah
614835.translation:
「切勿怜悯，务使全力。对上非瑞克西亚人时，不先下手就会先阵亡。」
～裘达

614836.oracleText: Destroy target creature with total power and toughness 5 or less.
614836.translation: 消灭目标力量与防御力加总等于或小于5的生物。

614838.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast black permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {oB} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of black mana you pay.
614838.translation: 你可以支付2点生命，以作为施放黑色永久物咒语的额外费用。如果你以此法支付生命，则该咒语减少{oB}来施放。此效应仅减少你支付的黑色法术力数量。

614839.oracleText: Whenever you cast a black permanent spell, target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains menace until end of turn.
614839.translation: 每当你施放黑色永久物咒语时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得威慑异能。

614841.oracleText: Windgrace's gladehunters hibernate in the quagmires of Urborg until the scent of Phyrexian technology awakens their hunger.
614841.translation: 风华的林地猎手沉眠在乌尔博格的泥沼之下，非瑞克西亚科技的味道唤醒了他们的饥饿。

614842.oracleText: Domain — Each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.
614842.translation: 领土～每个生物各得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别数量加1。

614845.oracleText: {o4oB}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
614845.translation: {o4oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：将另一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

614846.oracleText: {o4oB}, Exile Eerie Soultender from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
614846.translation: {o4oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐神秘护魂灵：将另一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

614848.oracleText: {oB}: CARDNAME becomes a Human Cleric with base power and toughness 2/2.
614848.translation: {oB}：CARDNAME成为基础力量与防御力为2/2的人类／僧侣。

614849.oracleText: {oB}: Evolved Sleeper becomes a Human Cleric with base power and toughness 2/2.
614849.translation: {oB}：进化潜探成为基础力量与防御力为2/2的人类／僧侣。

614850.oracleText: {o1oB}: If CARDNAME is a Cleric, put a deathtouch counter on it and it becomes a Phyrexian Human Cleric with base power and toughness 3/3.
614850.translation: {o1oB}：如果CARDNAME是僧侣，则在其上放置一个死触指示物且它成为基础力量与防御力为3/3的非瑞人／人类／僧侣。

614851.oracleText: {o1oB}: If Evolved Sleeper is a Cleric, put a deathtouch counter on it and it becomes a Phyrexian Human Cleric with base power and toughness 3/3.
614851.translation: {o1oB}：如果进化潜探是僧侣，则在其上放置一个死触指示物且它成为基础力量与防御力为3/3的非瑞人／人类／僧侣。

614852.oracleText: {o1oBoB}: If CARDNAME is a Phyrexian, put a +1/+1 counter on it, then you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
614852.translation: {o1oBoB}：如果CARDNAME是非瑞人，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

614853.oracleText: {o1oBoB}: If Evolved Sleeper is a Phyrexian, put a +1/+1 counter on it, then you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
614853.translation: {o1oBoB}：如果进化潜探是非瑞人，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

614855.oracleText: Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.
614855.translation: 雅亚不想死，但若是为了多明纳里亚，纵死而无憾。

614856.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. If its mana value was 3 or less, you gain 3 life.
614856.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。如果其法术力值等于或小于3。则你获得3点生命。

614859.oracleText:
"Who needs stone walls when you can hide behind an impenetrable barrier of screaming nightmares?"
—Braids
614859.translation:
「如果能躲在无法穿透的尖叫梦魇屏障背后，谁又需要石头墙呢？」
～布蕾德

614860.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain 1 life and draw a card.
614860.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲一个生物：你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

614862.oracleText: {o1oB}: Knight of Dusk's Shadow gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

614866.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the highest mana value among cards in your graveyard.
614866.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场内牌中的最大法术力值。

614867.oracleText: Monstrous War-Leech's power and toughness are each equal to the highest mana value among cards in your graveyard.
614867.translation: 巨大战蛭的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场内牌中的最大法术力值。

614868.oracleText:
"Resist if you must. It makes no difference. As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia."
—Sheoldred
614868.translation:
「你们尽可抵抗，但结果不会改变。你们的世界会和秘罗地一样臣服于非瑞克西亚。」
～希欧蕊

614870.oracleText: Before he was the Father of Machines, Yawgmoth was a twisted Thran physician, and his legacy of medical atrocities lives on in New Phyrexia.
614870.translation: 在被尊为机械之父前，约格莫夫是一名病态的索蓝医师，他的医学暴行在新非瑞克西亚得到了传承。

614871.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, scry 1.
614871.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，占卜1。

614876.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: CARDNAME gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
614876.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个其他生物：CARDNAME得+2/+1直到回合结束。

614877.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Phyrexian Warhorse gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
614877.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个其他生物：非瑞克西亚战马得+2/+1直到回合结束。

614879.oracleText: To the merchant, it was nothing more than a few missing trinkets. To Tinybones, it was the greatest heist of all time.
614879.translation: 在商人看来，自己不过是少了几件琐物。在细骨看来，那可是惊天大劫案。

614881.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if a player discarded a card this turn, create a 1/1 black Bird creature token with flying and "This creature can't block."
614881.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌手弃过牌，则派出一个1/1黑色，具有飞行异能与「此生物不能进行阻挡」的鸟衍生生物。

614882.oracleText: {o3oB}, {oT}: Each opponent discards a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
614882.translation: {o3oB}，{oT}：每位对手各弃一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

614884.oracleText: "We cannot afford to let the Phyrexians win. They taste terrible."
614884.translation: 「我们不能让非瑞克西亚人赢。他们太难喝了。」

614885.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures die, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.
614885.translation: 每当有一个或数个生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

614886.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures die, put a +1/+1 counter on Sengir Connoisseur. This ability triggers only once each turn.
614886.translation: 每当有一个或数个生物死去时，在辛格氏鉴赏家上放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

614889.oracleText: Domain — Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 2 life.
614889.translation: 领土～检视你牌库顶牌的X张牌，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。将其中至多两张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。你失去2点生命。

614891.oracleText: Backstabbing is common within demonic cults. So are front- and side-stabbing.
614891.translation: 恶魔教派里常有背刺发生。从正面或侧面下手也很常见。

614892.translation: 由你操控的其他僧侣得+1/+1。

614893.oracleText: {o3oBoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice another Cleric: Search your library for a black creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
614893.translation: {o3oBoB}，{oT}牺牲另一个僧侣：从你牌库中搜寻一张黑色生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

614896.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card, they lose 2 life.
614896.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌时，他失去2点生命。

614898.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was kicked, you gain life equal to that card's mana value. Otherwise, you lose that much life.
614898.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。如果此咒语已增幅，则你获得等同于该牌法术力值的生命。若否，则你失去等量的生命。

614902.oracleText:
"For some, perfection is but a single moment when form and purpose converge."
—Rona
614902.translation:
「对某些东西而言，完美不过是形意合一的那一瞬间。」
～罗娜

614903.oracleText: When Splatter Goblin dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
614903.translation: 当空坠鬼怪死去时，目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

614908.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, you may reveal the top card of your library and put it into your hand. If you do, you lose life equal to its mana value.
614908.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的生物对任意牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以展示你的牌库顶牌并置于你的手上。若你如此作，则你失去等同于其法术力值的生命。

614910.oracleText:
"Ah yes, I remember that one. I turned him inside out and cast his soul into an endless nightmare a few centuries ago."
—Braids
614910.translation:
「啊，没错，我记得那家伙。几百年前我就把他里外翻了个面，把他的灵魂扔进了无尽的梦魇。」
～布蕾德

614911.oracleText: {o1oB}: Tattered Apparition gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

614913.oracleText: Deep in the forgotten reaches of Urborg, ancient Phyrexian monstrosities shamble endlessly, putrid ichor leaking from their rusted forms.
614913.translation: 在乌尔博格深处被人遗忘的角落，古老的非瑞克西亚怪兽仍在蠢动，锈迹身躯不断渗出恶臭脓水。

614916.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
614916.translation: 目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间和法术牌，该生物便再得一次-1/-1直到回合结束。

614918.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. You gain 2 life. If this spell was kicked, return another target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
614918.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。你获得2点生命。如果此咒语已增幅，则将另一张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

614920.oracleText:
"We sent three of our best legions! You're telling me no one came back?"
—Tori D'Avenant
614920.translation:
「我们派出的是整整三个团的精锐！你跟我说他们一个都没回来？」
～托莉阿维农

614923.oracleText: When Balduvian Berserker dies, it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
614923.translation: 当博都维狂战士死去时，它对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

614925.oracleText: Exile up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, up to one target enchantment, up to one target planeswalker, and/or up to one target land. For each permanent exiled this way, its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a card that shares a card type with it, puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles.
614925.translation: 放逐至多一个目标神器，至多一个目标生物，至多一个目标结界，至多一个目标鹏洛客和/或至多一个目标地。对每个以此法放逐的永久物而言，其操控者从其牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张与之具共同牌张类别的牌为止，将该牌放进战场，然后洗牌。

614927.oracleText: Anger is his greatest weapon, and he sharpens it daily.
614927.translation: 愤怒是他最有力的武器，而他每天都会让武器更锋利。

614930.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast red permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {oR} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of red mana you pay.
614930.translation: 你可以支付2点生命，以作为施放红色永久物咒语的额外费用。如果你以此法支付生命，则该咒语减少{oR}来施放。此效应仅减少你支付的红色法术力数量。

614931.oracleText: Whenever you cast a red permanent spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
614931.translation: 每当你施放红色永久物咒语时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

614932.oracleText: Whenever you cast a red permanent spell, Defiler of Instinct deals 1 damage to any target.
614932.translation: 每当你施放红色永久物咒语时，本能渎者对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

614934.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature and each opponent.
614934.translation: CARDNAME向每个生物和每位对手各造成2点伤害。

614935.oracleText: The Elder Dragon War deals 2 damage to each creature and each opponent.
614935.translation: 长老龙之战向每个生物和每位对手各造成2点伤害。

614936.oracleText: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
614936.translation: 弃任意数量的牌，然后抓等量的牌。

614937.oracleText: Create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.
614937.translation: 派出一个4/4红色，具有飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

614939.oracleText:
"That's not exactly what I had in mind when I said ‘charge,' but I like your enthusiasm!"
—Balmor, battlemage captain
614939.translation:
「我想说的是『充』电而不是『冲』锋，但我喜欢你的劲头！」
～战巫师队长巴尔莫

614940.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Electrostatic Infantry.
614940.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，在静电步兵放置一个+1/+1指示物。

614942.oracleText: The drums and horns were expected, but the goblin dance was a pleasant surprise.
614942.translation: 欢鼓齐鸣、号乐阵阵～传统庆祝方式悉数登场，而鬼怪舞蹈则更是意外之喜。

614943.oracleText: If this spell was kicked, draw a card. CARDNAME deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of cards in your hand.
614943.translation: 如果此咒语已增幅，则抓一张牌。CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成等同于你手牌数量的伤害。

614944.oracleText: If this spell was kicked, draw a card. Fires of Victory deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of cards in your hand.
614944.translation: 如果此咒语已增幅，则抓一张牌。胜利烟火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成等同于你手牌数量的伤害。

614946.oracleText: The rumor that contact with flowstone would reveal Phyrexian sleeper agents was spread mostly by Phyrexian sleeper agents.
614946.translation: 「接触液石就能暴露非瑞克西亚潜藏密探」之谣言的来源，往往就是非瑞克西亚密探本身。

614948.oracleText: The kavu adjusted easily to the Rathi overlay, incorporating the invasive flowstone into their own adaptable forms.
614948.translation: 卡甫轻松适应了瑞斯时空覆盖，并将侵入性的液石结合到了自己多变的形态之中。

614949.oracleText: {oR}: Flowstone Kavu gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

614951.oracleText: Minotaurs sometimes pretend to be lost in a battle rage, leading their opponents to underestimate their cleverness.
614951.translation: 牛头怪有时会假装因战怒而失控，好让对手误认他们只是一群莽夫。

614952.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
614952.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+0且获得先攻异能。占卜1。

614956.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Ghitu Amplifier gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
614956.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，基图增效师得+2/+0直到回合结束。

614958.oracleText: Countless generations of Shivan goblins have worked on the Mana Rig, giving them an unparalleled eye for useful relics.
614958.translation: 西瓦鬼怪世世代代都在魔力钻探机上操作，让他们拥有无以伦比的眼力，能鉴别有用的遗宝。

614960.oracleText:
"It's my fault, really. I told him to throw anything he could find at the enemy."
—Throppel, auxiliary commander
614960.translation:
「这确实都怪我不好。我告诉他手边有什么就朝敌人扔。」
～援军指挥官索佩尔

614961.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature: Hurler Cyclops deals 1 damage to any target.
614961.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个其他生物：掷物独眼巨人对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

614963.oracleText: The magical echoes of the Hurloon mountain range greatly increase the potency of spells based on song or speech.
614963.translation: 回荡在夏浓山脉的魔法之声会应和歌声或讲词来大幅提升咒语强度。

614964.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was kicked, you gain 4 life.
614964.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果此咒语已增幅，则你获得4点生命。

614965.oracleText: Hurloon Battle Hymn deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was kicked, you gain 4 life.
614965.translation: 夏浓战歌对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果此咒语已增幅，则你获得4点生命。

614967.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, sacrifice that creature at the beginning of the next end step.
614967.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该生物。

614969.oracleText: Create a 1/1 red Monk creature token with prowess.
614969.translation: 派出一个1/1红色，具灵技异能的修行僧衍生生物。

614970.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
614970.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。选择其中一张。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

614971.oracleText: Choose target creature an opponent controls. Whenever you attack this turn, CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of attacking creatures to that creature.
614971.translation: 选择目标由对手操控的生物。本回合中，每当你攻击时，CARDNAME对该生物造成伤害，其数量等同于进行攻击的生物数量。

614972.oracleText: Choose target creature an opponent controls. Whenever you attack this turn, Jaya, Fiery Negotiator deals damage equal to the number of attacking creatures to that creature.
614972.translation: 选择目标由对手操控的生物。本回合中，每当你攻击时，烈火来使雅亚对该生物造成伤害，其数量等同于进行攻击的生物数量。

614973.oracleText: Whenever you cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy it twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
614973.translation: 每当你施放红色瞬间或法术咒语时，将其复制两次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

614974.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy it twice. You may choose new targets for the copies."
614974.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当你施放红色瞬间或法术咒语时，将其复制两次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。」

614976.oracleText:
"For all their supposed advances, the Phyrexians still aren't fireproof."
—Jaya Ballard
614976.translation:
「不管非瑞克西亚人怎么进化，他们仍然还是不防火。」
～雅亚巴拉德

614977.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Scry 1.
614977.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。占卜1。

614978.oracleText: Jaya's Firenado deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Scry 1.
614978.translation: 雅亚的火龙卷对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。占卜1。

614980.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is CARDNAME's power. You may exile an instant or sorcery card with mana value X or less from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
614980.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为CARDNAME的力量。你可以放逐其中一张法术力值等于或小于X的瞬间或法术牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

614981.oracleText: Whenever Keldon Flamesage attacks, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is Keldon Flamesage's power. You may exile an instant or sorcery card with mana value X or less from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
614981.translation: 每当凯尔顿火智者攻击时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为凯尔顿火智者的力量。你可以放逐其中一张法术力值等于或小于X的瞬间或法术牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

614986.oracleText: Danitha watched in shock as electricity lanced from Jaya's fingertips, obliterating the charging Phyrexians. "What?" said the pyromancer serenely. "I told you I'd learned some new tricks."
614986.translation: 眼见雅亚指尖窜出闪电将来袭非瑞克西亚人劈散，达妮莎看得目瞪口呆。「怎么？」烈焰术士平淡地说。「告诉过你我学了新招数。」

614988.oracleText: Arrows fashioned from the living wood of Yavimaya carry all of the forest's rage in their fire-hardened points.
614988.translation: 箭矢利用亚维马雅活木制成，其淬火箭尖承载了整片森林的怒火。

614992.oracleText: The cold snap killed off most of the heat-loving hellions . . . leaving only the strongest alive to breed.
614992.translation: 骤霜灭绝了几乎所有喜爱炽热的地狱兽…只留下了最强者繁衍生息。

614994.translation: 凤凰幼雏不能进行阻挡。

614995.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, you may pay {oRoR}. If you do, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with a +1/+1 counter on it.
614995.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，你可以支付{oRoR}。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，其为正进行攻击且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

614996.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, you may pay {oRoR}. If you do, return Phoenix Chick from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with a +1/+1 counter on it.
614996.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，你可以支付{oRoR}。若你如此作，则将凤凰幼雏从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，其为正进行攻击且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

614998.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature defending player controls with power less than CARDNAME's power can't block this turn.
614998.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由防御牌手操控且力量小于CARDNAME之生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

614999.oracleText: Whenever Radha's Firebrand attacks, target creature defending player controls with power less than Radha's Firebrand's power can't block this turn.
614999.translation: 每当拉妲的挑事人攻击时，目标由防御牌手操控且力量小于拉妲的挑事人之生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

615000.oracleText: Domain — {o5oR}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
615000.translation: 领土～{o5oR}：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。由你操控之地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。每回合只能起动一次。

615001.oracleText: Domain — {o5oR}: Radha's Firebrand gets +2/+2 until end of turn. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
615001.translation: 领土～{o5oR}：拉妲的挑事人得+2/+2直到回合结束。由你操控之地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。每回合只能起动一次。

615003.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Goblin you control dies, exile the top card of your library. If it's a Goblin creature card, you may cast that card until the end of your next turn.
615003.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的鬼怪死去时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。若它是鬼怪生物牌，则直到你的下一个回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

615004.oracleText: Whenever Rundvelt Hordemaster or another Goblin you control dies, exile the top card of your library. If it's a Goblin creature card, you may cast that card until the end of your next turn.
615004.translation: 每当温德汶群领或另一个由你操控的鬼怪死去时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。若它是鬼怪生物牌，则直到你的下一个回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

615007.oracleText: There were many reasons why Shiv was not high on Sheoldred's list of places to conquer: big, fiery reasons.
615007.translation: 在希欧蕊的征服清单上，西瓦并未排在靠前的位置，其中有诸多原因：巨大而火爆的原因。

615010.oracleText: Smash to Dust deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
615010.translation: 砸为粉尘向每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

615011.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target artifact. • Destroy target creature with defender. • CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
615011.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器。 •  消灭目标具守军异能的生物。 •  CARDNAME向每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

615012.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target artifact. • Destroy target creature with defender. • Smash to Dust deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control.
615012.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器。 •  消灭目标具守军异能的生物。 •  砸为粉尘向每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

615016.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice a land: Draw a card.

615018.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
615018.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

615019.oracleText: Whenever Squee, Dubious Monarch attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
615019.translation: 每当伪王斯奎攻击时，派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

615020.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard by paying {o3oR} and exiling four other cards from your graveyard rather than paying its mana cost.
615020.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放CARDNAME，但须支付{o3oR}并从你的坟墓场放逐四张其他牌，而非支付其法术力费用。

615021.oracleText: You may cast Squee, Dubious Monarch from your graveyard by paying {o3oR} and exiling four other cards from your graveyard rather than paying its mana cost.
615021.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中施放伪王斯奎，但须支付{o3oR}并从你的坟墓场放逐四张其他牌，而非支付其法术力费用。

615024.oracleText: Choose up to X creatures and/or planeswalkers you control, where X is the number of times this spell was kicked. Those permanents phase out.
615024.translation: 选择至多X个由你操控的生物和/或鹏洛客，X为此咒语的增幅次数。这些永久物跃离。

615025.oracleText: Temporal Firestorm deals 5 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
615025.translation: 历时极焰暴等于每个生物和鹏洛客各造成5点伤害。

615026.oracleText:
"The most delicious ingredients are often the most dangerous to obtain."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, The Underworld Cookbook
615026.translation:
「最美味的食材，其获取过程也往往最危险。」
～阿司魔拉诺马尔迪卡带斯提纳酷达卡，《地底世界食谱》

615028.oracleText:
"More fire?" Jaya asked.
"More fire," Jodah agreed.
615028.translation:
「再加把火？」雅亚问。
「再加把火。」裘达附和道。

615032.oracleText: {o2oR}: Viashino Branchrider gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
615032.translation: {o2oR}：溜枝凡尔西诺得+2/+0直到回合结束。

615034.oracleText: Keldons may be outnumbered, but they are never outmatched.
615034.translation: 凯尔顿人可能在数量上处劣势，但绝不会落下风。

615035.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, whenever a creature you control dies this turn, draw a card.
615035.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，抓一张牌。

615038.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Yavimaya Steelcrusher: Destroy target artifact.
615038.translation: {o1}，牺牲亚维马雅碎钢猿：消灭目标神器。

615040.oracleText: Create a 0/2 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying named Ornithopter.
615040.translation: 派出一个0/2无色，名为扑翼机，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

615041.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped artifacts you control. When you do, CARDNAME deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker.
615041.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的神器。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

615042.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped artifacts you control. When you do, Yotia Declares War deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker.
615042.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的神器。当你如此作时，佑天宣战史对目标生物或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

615043.oracleText: Up to one target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 4/4 until end of turn.
615043.translation: 至多一个目标由你操控的神器成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的神器生物直到回合结束。

615045.oracleText:
"Phyrexia may be ancient, but Gaea is eternal."
—Queen Allenal of Ruadach
615045.translation:
「非瑞克西亚或许很古老，但盖亚更恒久。」
～罗达科的阿勒奈女王

615047.oracleText:
"Yavimaya takes care of herself; the kavu are evidence of this. What does your Coalition offer that the forest cannot provide?"
—Jenson Carthalion
615047.translation:
「亚维马雅自给自足；卡甫便是佐证。你的联盟能给出什么森林提供不了的东西？」
～延森卡萨隆

615051.oracleText:
"Serra guides our shots true. Also, I just tuned the cannons."
—Tiana
615051.translation:
「撒拉保佑我们百发百中。另外，我刚刚还调校了一下火力。」
～蒂娅娜

615053.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, instead that creature gets +4/+4 and gains trample and haste until end of turn.
615053.translation: 目标生物得+3/+3直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为直到回合结束，该生物得+4/+4且获得践踏与敏捷异能。

615055.oracleText: "I can provide the Coalition with poisons that will break down Phyrexian machinery as easily as they stop the heart."
615055.translation: 「我能向联盟提供毒素，它能轻松地停止心跳，也能同样轻松地瓦解非瑞克西亚的机器。」

615057.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast green permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {oG} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of green mana you pay.
615057.translation: 你可以支付2点生命，以作为施放绿色永久物咒语的额外费用。如果你以此法支付生命，则该咒语减少{oG}来施放。此效应仅减少你支付的绿色法术力数量。

615058.oracleText: Whenever you cast a green permanent spell, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
615058.translation: 每当你施放绿色永久物咒语时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

615060.oracleText: The wurms consume everything in their path, so the elves make sure that their path goes through as many Phyrexians as possible.
615060.translation: 亚龙会吞噬沿途的一切，因此妖精只需确保它们是沿着非瑞克西亚人最多的那条路前进。

615062.oracleText: "Water remembers every living thing it has ever been a part of. We need only bring that recollection to the surface."
615062.translation: 「流水记得自己经过的每一个生灵。我们做的就只是重显记忆。」

615068.oracleText:
"Why fight over the lumber in a tree's trunk when its branches have room for all?"
—Multani
615068.translation:
「既然树枝上有足够的地方能容纳所有人，又何必为树干上的一块木头而争吵？」
～穆塔尼

615070.oracleText: Domain — Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token for each basic land type among lands you control.
615070.translation: 领土～由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，便派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

615071.oracleText: {o1oG}, Discard CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 3 life.
615071.translation: {o1oG}，弃掉CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得3点生命。

615072.oracleText: {o1oG}, Discard Herd Migration: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You gain 3 life.
615072.translation: {o1oG}，弃掉兽群迁徙：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。你获得3点生命。

615075.oracleText: "The seedling you save today may be the sheltering boughs of generations to come."
615075.translation: 「你今日救下的幼苗或能成为庇护未来数代人的林枝。」

615076.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Elf spell, you may pay {oG}. If you do, draw a card.
615076.translation: 每当你施放妖精咒语时，你可以支付{oG}。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

615078.oracleText: Linebreaker Baloth can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
615078.translation: 破阵巴洛西不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

615080.oracleText: Domain — {o7oG}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. It gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else." This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
615080.translation: 领土～{o7oG}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。它获得「如果此永久物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。」由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

615081.oracleText: Domain — {o7oG}: Return Llanowar Greenwidow from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. It gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else." This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
615081.translation: 领土～{o7oG}：将罗堰绿寡妇从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。它获得「如果此永久物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。」由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

615083.oracleText: Twigs broken underfoot in Llanowar tend to return the favor.
615083.translation: 在罗堰，被你用脚踩断的树枝往往会反过来踩断你的脚。

615084.oracleText: {oT}: Target land you control becomes a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste until end of turn. It's still a land. Activate only as a sorcery.
615084.translation: {oT}：目标由你操控的地成为3/3，具敏捷异能的元素生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。只能于法术时机起动。

615086.oracleText: If you spot one elf in Llanowar, it's likely there's another with a knife at your back.
615086.translation: 如果你在罗堰发现了一个妖精，那很可能会有另一个正用刀抵着你的后背。

615090.oracleText: When one of Yavimaya's enormous magnigoth trees awakens into a treefolk, it is a towering presence of physical strength and ancient wisdom.
615090.translation: 亚维马雅的参天马尼古斯树一旦觉醒为树妖，便是雄力与睿智合一的强大存在。

615092.oracleText: Older than the mountains, the dragons, and the wars of humans and machines.
615092.translation: 比山脉、巨龙及人械大战的历史更悠久。

615095.oracleText: Though native to cold climates, the nishoba have adapted to more temperate environments since the Ice Age ended.
615095.translation: 虽然尼索巴原为长寒气候带生物，但从冰雪时代结束后，他们早已适应温暖环境。

615096.oracleText: Domain — CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615096.translation: 领土～CARDNAME的力量等同于由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

615097.oracleText: Domain — Nishoba Brawler's power is equal to the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615097.translation: 领土～好斗尼索巴的力量等同于由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

615100.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Quirion Beastcaller.
615100.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，在奎利恩唤兽师上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

615101.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
615101.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将X个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量目标由你操控的生物，X为CARDNAME上的+1/+1指示物数量。

615102.oracleText: When Quirion Beastcaller dies, distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on Quirion Beastcaller.
615102.translation: 当奎利恩唤兽师死去时，将X个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量目标由你操控的生物，X为奎利恩唤兽师上的+1/+1指示物数量。

615104.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. If this spell was kicked, create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
615104.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。如果此咒语已增幅，则派出两个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

615106.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
615106.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

615107.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
615107.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

615108.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell, choose one — • Destroy target artifact or enchantment. • Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. • You gain 4 life.
615108.translation: 每当你施放生物咒语时，选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器或结界。 •  检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。 •  你获得4点生命。

615110.oracleText: Domain — Search your library for up to two land cards that each have a basic land type, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to one of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
615110.translation: 领土～从你牌库中搜寻至多两张具基本地类别的地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。将其中至多一张置于你的牌库顶，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

615111.oracleText: In the rich jungles of Yavimaya, bright colors are the perfect camouflage.
615111.translation: 在亚维马雅生意盎然的丛林中，身披鲜艳颜色便是最佳伪装。

615113.oracleText:
"Root and wing, claw and sword; this will be a memorable stand, indeed."
—Lyra Dawnbringer
615113.translation:
「根配翼，爪加剑，这绝对是值得纪念的抵抗方式。」
～黎明使者莱拉

615114.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
615114.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

615116.oracleText: A rootwalla's prey includes anything or anyone that wanders into view.
615116.translation: 进入萝特瓦拉眼帘者便会成其猎物～无论那是静物还是活物。

615117.oracleText: Domain — {o3oG}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
615117.translation: 领土～{o3oG}：直到回合结束，由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。每回合只能起动一次。

615118.oracleText: Domain — {o3oG}: Until end of turn, Sunbathing Rootwalla gets +1/+1 for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
615118.translation: 领土～{o3oG}：直到回合结束，由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，浴日萝特瓦拉便得+1/+1。每回合只能起动一次。

615120.oracleText: Choose target creature you control and target creature you don't control. If you cast this spell during your main phase, the creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Then those creatures fight each other.
615120.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物和目标不由你操控的生物。如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则该由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。然后这些生物互斗。

615122.oracleText: No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.
615122.translation: 谁也不知道心灵贩子为何会对非瑞克西亚科技感到如此分奴，但对联盟而言，算是交上了好运。

615123.oracleText: Exile target artifact or enchantment. If this spell was kicked, exile target nonland permanent instead.
615123.translation: 放逐目标神器或结界。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为放逐目标非地永久物。

615125.oracleText: The Coalition was more than just treaties and alliances: it was the soul of a world rising up against the invading tide.
615125.translation: 多明联盟并非只是协定与联合：而是世界之灵面对侵攻浪潮的团结与抗争。

615126.oracleText: Domain — CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615126.translation: 领土～CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之地中基本地类别数量的两倍。

615127.oracleText: Domain — Territorial Maro's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615127.translation: 领土～据地玛洛的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之地中基本地类别数量的两倍。

615129.oracleText: Search your library for up to four creature cards with different powers and reveal them. An opponent chooses two of those cards. Shuffle the chosen cards into your library and put the rest into your hand.
615129.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多四张力量各不相同的生物牌并展示之。任一对手选择其中两张牌。将所选之牌洗入你的牌库，其余则置于你手上。

615134.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
615134.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你坟墓场中的生物牌数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

615135.oracleText: Urborg Lhurgoyf's power is equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
615135.translation: 乌尔博格拉高耶夫的力量等同于你坟墓场中的生物牌数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

615140.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
615140.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

615141.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
615141.translation: 派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

615142.oracleText: Domain — Target creature you control gets +X/+X and gains trample until end of turn, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615142.translation: 领土～直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X且获得践踏异能，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

615144.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal a non-Saga permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
615144.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中一张非传纪永久物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

615145.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal a non-Saga permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
615145.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。你可以展示其中一张非传纪永久物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

615146.oracleText: Put up to two non-Saga permanent cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
615146.translation: 将至多两张非传纪永久物牌从你手上放进战场。

615148.oracleText: Steel weapons hold a forbidden allure to some of the younger Yavimayans.
615148.translation: 一些年轻的亚维马雅人经不住钢铁兵器的禁忌诱惑。

615152.oracleText: To the long-lived treefolk, the Phyrexians invading again after only three centuries was as though they never left.
615152.translation: 在长寿的树妖眼里，刚过三百年就再次进犯的非瑞克西亚人就像是从没离开过一样。

615154.oracleText: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature or planeswalker card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, you may put it on the bottom of your library.
615154.translation: 展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是生物或鹏洛客牌，则将它置于你手上。若否，则你可以将其置于你的牌库底。

615155.oracleText: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among up to three target creatures. They gain vigilance until end of turn.
615155.translation: 将三个+1/+1指示物分配给至多三个目标生物。它们获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

615156.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature or planeswalker spell, target opponent gets two poison counters.
615156.translation: 每当你施放生物或鹏洛客咒语时，目标牌手得到两个中毒指示物。

615157.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a creature or planeswalker spell, target opponent gets two poison counters."
615157.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当你施放生物或鹏洛客咒语时，目标牌手得到两个中毒指示物。」

615159.oracleText:
"He may look like my father, but the man I knew and loved is gone."
—Danitha
615159.translation:
「他或许长得像我父亲，但我过去熟知并爱戴的父亲已不复存在。」
～达妮莎

615160.oracleText: {oWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
615160.translation: {oWoB}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物：在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

615164.translation: 由你操控的武具具有佩戴{o1}。

615165.translation: 由你操控的载具具有搭载1。

615167.oracleText: "Fear doesn't make you a coward; giving in to it does. Now take up your sword and fight!"
615167.translation: 「心生恐惧并非懦弱；屈从恐惧才是。挥舞长剑，奋勇战斗！」

615168.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control a creature with power greater than its base power, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
615168.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控其力量比基础力量大的生物，则派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

615170.oracleText: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."
615170.translation: 「就算是装备最精良的军队，也没有足够器具来抵御源自空中的天惊突袭。」

615171.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain trample until end of turn.
615171.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得践踏异能。

615175.translation: 虐之华寇族黜人依拉丝

615177.oracleText: "All will bow to the Whispering One."

615178.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
615178.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

615181.oracleText: Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. Its controller draws a card.
615181.translation: 反击目标咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。其操控者抓一张牌。

615182.oracleText: Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. Its controller draws a card.
615182.translation: 反击目标咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。其操控者抓一张牌。

615183.oracleText: Destroy another target creature or planeswalker. Its controller draws a card.
615183.translation: 消灭另一个目标生物或鹏洛客。其操控者抓一张牌。

615184.oracleText: Destroy another target creature or planeswalker. Its controller draws a card.
615184.translation: 消灭另一个目标生物或鹏洛客。其操控者抓一张牌。

615188.oracleText: "Let's see who gets more kills, Radha."
615188.translation: 「拉妲，我们来比比谁的人头更多。」

615189.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, draw a card if it was attacking. Otherwise, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
615189.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，如果它正进行攻击，则抓一张牌。若否，则CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

615190.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, draw a card if it was attacking. Otherwise, Garna, Bloodfist of Keld deals 1 damage to each opponent.
615190.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，如果它正进行攻击，则抓一张牌。若否，则凯尔顿血拳加娜向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

615192.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell that targets only a single creature other than CARDNAME, you may copy that spell. The copy targets Ivy.
615192.translation: 每当任一牌手施放仅以单一生物为目标的咒语，且目标不是CARDNAME时，你可以复制该咒语。该复制品以艾薇为目标。

615193.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell that targets only a single creature other than Ivy, Gleeful Spellthief, you may copy that spell. The copy targets Ivy.
615193.translation: 每当任一牌手施放仅以单一生物为目标的咒语，且目标不是欢笑窃咒客艾薇时，你可以复制该咒语。该复制品以艾薇为目标。

615195.oracleText: {oT}: Put two ingenuity counters on CARDNAME, then you may put an artifact card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield, where X is the number of ingenuity counters on Jhoira.
615195.translation: {oT}：在CARDNAME上放置两个精妙指示物，然后你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于X的神器牌从你手上放进战场，X为尤依拉上精妙指示物的数量。

615196.oracleText: {oT}: Put two ingenuity counters on Jhoira, Ageless Innovator, then you may put an artifact card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield, where X is the number of ingenuity counters on Jhoira.
615196.translation: {oT}：在长生发明家尤依拉上放置两个精妙指示物，然后你可以将一张法术力值等于或小于X的神器牌从你手上放进战场，X为尤依拉上精妙指示物的数量。

615198.oracleText: Legendary creatures you control get +X/+X, where X is the number of legendary creatures you control.
615198.translation: 由你操控的传奇生物得+X/+X，X为由你操控的传奇生物数量。

615199.oracleText: Whenever you cast a legendary spell from your hand, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a legendary nonland card with lesser mana value. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
615199.translation: 每当你从你手上施放传奇咒语时，从你牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张法术力值比它还小的传奇非地牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

615201.oracleText: {o3oGoW}: Put a +1/+1 counter on King Darien and create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
615201.translation: {o3oGoW}：在国王达利安放置一个+1/+1指示物并派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

615202.oracleText: Sacrifice King Darien: Creature tokens you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
615202.translation: 牺牲国王达利安：由你操控的衍生生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

615204.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 2/1 red Elemental creature token with trample and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
615204.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，派出一个2/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的元素衍生生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

615205.oracleText: {oT}: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only if five or more creatures died this turn.
615205.translation: {oT}：从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。只能于有五个或更多生物死去的回合中起动。

615207.oracleText: "Why fear artifice? Is it not also of this world?"
615207.translation: 「奇械又有什么好怕的呢？它们不也一样属于这个世界吗？」

615208.oracleText: Tap an untapped nontoken artifact you control: Add {oG}.
615208.translation: 横置一个由你操控、未横置且非衍生物的神器：加{oG}。

615209.oracleText: Tap two untapped nontoken artifacts you control: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
615209.translation: 横置两个由你操控、未横置且非衍生物的神器：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

615211.oracleText: Domain — Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to one of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom in a random order. Then if there are five basic land types among lands you control, draw a card.
615211.translation: 领土～每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。将其中至多一张置于你的牌库顶，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。然后若由你操控的地中有五种基本地类别，则抓一张牌。

615212.oracleText: Domain — Whenever Nael, Avizoa Aeronaut deals combat damage to a player, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to one of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom in a random order. Then if there are five basic land types among lands you control, draw a card.
615212.translation: 领土～每当佐雅飞兽乘员妮尔对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。将其中至多一张置于你的牌库顶，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。然后若由你操控的地中有五种基本地类别，则抓一张牌。

615218.oracleText: If a creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead. When you do, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
615218.translation: 如果某个由对手操控的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。当你如此作时，派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

615219.oracleText: {oG}, Sacrifice a Saproling: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
615219.translation: {oG}，牺牲一个腐生物：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

615220.oracleText: {oG}, Sacrifice a Saproling: Nemata, Primeval Warden gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
615220.translation: {oG}，牺牲一个腐生物：太古守护灵奈玛塔得+2/+2直到回合结束。

615221.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice two Saprolings: Draw a card.

615223.oracleText: Queen Allenal of Ruadach's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
615223.translation: 罗达科的阿勒奈女王之力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的生物数量。

615224.oracleText: If one or more creature tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus a 1/1 white Soldier creature token are created instead.
615224.translation: 如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生生物，则改为派出该些衍生物加上一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

615226.oracleText: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"
615226.translation: 「热身结束了。希欧蕊，你给我等着！」

615227.oracleText: Domain — Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, another target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615227.translation: 领土～每当CARDNAME成为横置时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

615228.oracleText: Domain — Whenever Radha, Coalition Warlord becomes tapped, another target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615228.translation: 领土～每当联盟军阀拉妲成为横置时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

615230.oracleText: "This old ship has seen a lot, but she's not done yet."
615230.translation: 「这艘旧船虽历经波澜，但仍有生机。」

615231.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may tap two untapped creatures you control. If you do, draw a card.
615231.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以横置两个由你操控且未横置的生物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

615232.oracleText: {o3oWoW}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn.
615232.translation: {o3oWoW}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

615234.oracleText: Other Zombies you control have vigilance.
615234.translation: 由你操控的其他灵俑具有警戒异能。

615235.oracleText: Whenever another legendary creature you control dies, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's not legendary and it's a 2/2 black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types.
615235.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的传奇生物死去时，派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为死去生物的复制品，但它不是传奇，为2/2黑色灵俑，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。

615237.oracleText: Other Dragons you control have ward {o2}.
615237.translation: 由你操控的其他龙具有守护{o2}。

615238.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature or planeswalker an opponent controlled was dealt excess damage this turn, create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.
615238.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客曾受到过量伤害，则派出一个4/4红色，具有飞行异能的龙衍生生物。

615241.oracleText: {oT}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast Dragon creature spells.
615241.translation: {oT}：加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放龙生物咒语。

615242.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a Dragon creature spell from your graveyard.
615242.translation: 仅于你的每个回合中且限一次，你可以从你坟墓场中施放龙生物咒语。

615243.oracleText: When this creature dies, exile it.
615243.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它放逐。

615244.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Dragon creature spell from your graveyard, it gains "When this creature dies, exile it."
615244.translation: 每当你从你坟墓场中施放龙生物咒语时，它获得「当此生物死去时，将它放逐。」

615246.oracleText: "Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of compleation."
615246.translation: 「你该庆幸自己走运。并非所有人都得赠完化之礼。」

615247.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, each opponent loses 1 life.
615247.translation: 当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

615248.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard by discarding two cards in addition to paying its other costs.
615248.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场施放CARDNAME，但在其他费用之外，还须弃两张牌。

615249.oracleText: You may cast Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful from your graveyard by discarding two cards in addition to paying its other costs.
615249.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场施放希欧蕊信徒罗娜，但在其他费用之外，还须弃两张牌。

615251.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you didn't put a card onto the battlefield this way, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
615251.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。如果你未以此法将牌放进战场，则派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

615252.oracleText: Whenever Rulik Mons, Warren Chief attacks, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you didn't put a card onto the battlefield this way, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
615252.translation: 每当繁殖地酋长卢丽芒氏攻击时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。如果你未以此法将牌放进战场，则派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。

615254.oracleText: Shanna had heard Sisay's legend all her life. Now it was time to forge her own.
615254.translation: 莎娜此生已听尽了西赛的传说，如今是时候来铸就属于自己的传奇。

615255.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {oX}. If you do, draw X cards. X can't be greater than the amount of life you gained this turn.
615255.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{oX}。若你如此作，则抓X张牌。X不能大于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

615258.oracleText: Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
615258.translation: 每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

615259.oracleText: Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
615259.translation: 每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

615261.oracleText: Sol'kanar the Tainted deals 3 damage to up to one other target creature or planeswalker.

615262.oracleText: Exile Sol'kanar, then return it to the battlefield under an opponent's control.
615262.translation: 放逐败坏魔索坎纳，然后将它在任一对手的操控下移回战场。

615263.oracleText: Exile Sol'kanar, then return it to the battlefield under an opponent's control.
615263.translation: 放逐败坏魔索坎纳，然后将它在任一对手的操控下移回战场。

615264.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, choose one that hasn't been chosen — • Draw a card. • Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. • CARDNAME deals 3 damage to up to one other target creature or planeswalker. • Exile Sol'kanar, then return it to the battlefield under an opponent's control.
615264.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ •  抓一张牌。 •  每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。 •  CARDNAME对至多另一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 •  放逐败坏魔索坎纳，然后将它在任一对手的操控下移回战场。

615265.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, choose one that hasn't been chosen — • Draw a card. • Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. • Sol'kanar the Tainted deals 3 damage to up to one other target creature or planeswalker. • Exile Sol'kanar, then return it to the battlefield under an opponent's control.
615265.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ •  抓一张牌。 •  每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。 •  败坏魔索坎纳对至多另一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。 •  放逐败坏魔索坎纳，然后将它在任一对手的操控下移回战场。

615270.oracleText: {oG}, Discard a land card: You gain 3 life.

615271.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard a land card: Draw a card.

615272.oracleText: {o2oB}, Discard a land card: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
615272.translation: {o2oB}，弃一张地牌：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

615273.oracleText: {o2oB}, Discard a land card: Soul of Windgrace gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
615273.translation: {o2oB}，弃一张地牌：风华之魂获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

615277.oracleText: {o1oWoU}: Exile Stenn. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
615277.translation: {o1oWoU}：放逐斯特恩。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

615281.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, all other attacking creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Other red attacking creatures you control gain trample until end of turn. Untap each other white attacking creature you control.
615281.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，所有由你操控且进行攻击的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。由你操控且进行攻击的其他红色生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。重置所有由你操控且进行攻击的其他白色生物。

615282.oracleText: Whenever Tori D'Avenant, Fury Rider attacks, all other attacking creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Other red attacking creatures you control gain trample until end of turn. Untap each other white attacking creature you control.
615282.translation: 每当怒火骑士托莉阿维农攻击时，所有由你操控且进行攻击的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。由你操控且进行攻击的其他红色生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。重置所有由你操控且进行攻击的其他白色生物。

615284.oracleText: "The sky is my birthright. I dare you to try and take it from me."
615284.translation: 「翱翔长空乃是我天生权力。你有种就来试试从我手中夺走。」

615285.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
615285.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个1/1白色士兵衍生生物。

615287.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of land cards in your graveyard.
615287.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你坟墓场中的地牌数量。

615288.oracleText: Uurg, Spawn of Turg's power is equal to the number of land cards in your graveyard.
615288.translation: 托咕后裔呜咕的力量等同于你坟墓场中的地牌数量。

615289.oracleText: {oBoG}, Sacrifice a land: You gain 2 life.

615292.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded an instant or sorcery card this way, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
615292.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。如果你以此法弃掉一张瞬间或法术牌，则每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

615293.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard this turn. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
615293.translation: {o2}，牺牲CARDNAME：本回合中，你可以从你坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

615294.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice Vohar, Vodalian Desecrator: You may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard this turn. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
615294.translation: {o2}，牺牲伏特里亚渎圣人伏赫：本回合中，你可以从你坟墓场中施放目标瞬间或法术牌。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

615295.translation: 依法瓦传人札娅欧亚奈

615296.oracleText: "I carry my home in my heart."

615297.oracleText: Domain — Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with toughness less than the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615297.translation: 领土～每当CARDNAME成为横置时，计算由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量，在每个由你操控且防御力小于该数值的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

615298.oracleText: Domain — Whenever Zar Ojanen, Scion of Efrava becomes tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with toughness less than the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615298.translation: 领土～每当依法瓦传人札娅欧亚奈成为横置时，计算由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量，在每个由你操控且防御力小于该数值的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

615300.oracleText: Enchantment creatures you control have deathtouch, lifelink, and hexproof.
615300.translation: 由你操控的结界生物具有死触、系命、与辟邪异能。

615301.oracleText: {o1oW}: Target non-Aura enchantment you control becomes a creature in addition to its other types and has base power and base toughness each equal to its mana value.
615301.translation: {o1oW}：目标由你操控的非灵气结界成为基础力量与基础防御力各等同于其法术力值的生物，且仍具有原本类别。

615303.oracleText: Enforcing absolute quiet with extreme prejudice since 3285 AR.
615303.translation: 利用极端偏见确保绝对安静，从阿基夫纪元3285年起始终如一。

615306.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile each creature that crewed it this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
615306.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，放逐所有本回合中搭载过它的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。

615308.oracleText:
"A blade is just a tool. Its power comes from the hand that wields it."
—Danitha
615308.translation:
「刀剑不过是工具。其力量来自于挥舞它们的手。」
～达妮莎

615309.oracleText: As long as equipped creature is legendary, it has trample and haste.
615309.translation: 只要佩戴此武具的生物是传奇，它便具有践踏与敏捷异能。
