615311.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put a land card from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, draw a card.
615311.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：展示你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张地牌置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。如果不未以此法将牌置于手上，则抓一张牌。

615312.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Inscribed Tablet: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put a land card from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, draw a card.
615312.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲雕印石板：展示你牌库顶的五张牌。将其中一张地牌置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。如果不未以此法将牌置于手上，则抓一张牌。

615314.oracleText:
"If you remember nothing else of our world's history, remember this: Phyrexians can be defeated."
—Jodah
615314.translation:
「如果你不晓得我们世界的其他历史，那就请记住这条：非瑞克西亚人能被击败。」
～裘达

615315.oracleText: Domain — {o5}, {oT}: Draw a card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
615315.translation: 领土～{o5}，{oT}：抓一张牌。由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

615318.oracleText: Players can't pay life to cast spells or to activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.
615318.translation: 牌手不能支付生命来施放咒语或来起动不属于法术力异能的异能。

615319.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X or less. Activate only as a sorcery.
615319.translation: {oX}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：消灭所有法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物。只能于法术时机起动。

615320.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Exile Karn's Sylex: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X or less. Activate only as a sorcery.
615320.translation: {oX}，{oT}，放逐卡恩的同兆：消灭所有法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物。只能于法术时机起动。

615321.oracleText:
"Material at dig site 165-beta confirmed to be of Null Moon origin. Immediate excavation assistance requested."
—Tolarian field dispatch
615321.translation:
「165乙挖掘场发现的材料经鉴定来自于虚无之月。急需协助挖掘。」
～陶拉里亚现场调度电文

615323.oracleText:
"If the worst parts of history can repeat themselves, it stands to reason that the best parts can as well."
—Teferi
615323.translation:
「如果历史上最糟糕的事件会重复发生，那理论上最美好的事件也会。」
～泰菲力

615324.oracleText: Tap an untapped legendary creature you control: Add one mana of any color.
615324.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的传奇生物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

615326.oracleText:
"When weapons of war are repurposed for peaceful ends, you know society has advanced."
—Jodah
615326.translation:
「当战争兵器被改造用于和平用途后，你就知道社会已然进步。」
～裘达

615327.oracleText: {o1}: Add one mana of any color. Activate only once each turn.
615327.translation: {o1}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。每回合只能起动一次。

615333.oracleText: Urza exploited nature to power his war machines; in time, nature exploited his war machines to renew itself.
615333.translation: 克撒曾滥用自然资源来为其战争机械助力；到头来，自然也滥用其战争机械来重生资源。

615337.oracleText: When a Keldon takes a trophy from an enemy, it's usually something they can use to kill more enemies.
615337.translation: 凯尔顿人从倒下敌人处拿走的纪念品，往往是能够助其继续奋勇杀敌之物。

615339.oracleText: {o2}: Until end of turn, target creature with defender gains haste, can attack as though it didn't have defender, and assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power. Activate only as a sorcery.
615339.translation: {o2}：直到回合结束，目标具守军异能的生物获得敏捷异能，能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击，且依照其防御力来分配战斗伤害，而不是依照力量。只能于法术时机起动。

615341.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has four or more phyresis counters on it, it's a Phyrexian creature in addition to its other types.
615341.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有四个或更多非瑞化指示物，它便是非瑞人生物，且仍具有原本类别。

615342.oracleText: As long as Weatherlight Compleated has four or more phyresis counters on it, it's a Phyrexian creature in addition to its other types.
615342.translation: 只要完化的晴空号上有四个或更多非瑞化指示物，它便是非瑞人生物，且仍具有原本类别。

615343.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, put a phyresis counter on CARDNAME. Then draw a card if it has seven or more phyresis counters on it. If it doesn't, scry 1.
615343.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个非瑞化指示物。然后如果其上有七个或更多非瑞化指示物，则抓一张牌。若否，则占卜1。

615344.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, put a phyresis counter on Weatherlight Compleated. Then draw a card if it has seven or more phyresis counters on it. If it doesn't, scry 1.
615344.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，在完化的晴空号上放置一个非瑞化指示物。然后如果其上有七个或更多非瑞化指示物，则抓一张牌。若否，则占卜1。

615345.oracleText: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.
615345.translation: 兄弟之战后荒废的地块不断提醒着人们，联盟若是失败，多明纳里亚会面临何种命运。

615346.oracleText: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.
615346.translation: 沉寂多年后，洞窟内再度回荡起非瑞克西亚人备战声响。

615348.oracleText: The caves stretch farther than anyone knows, and the terrible legacy of Yawgmoth lurks in every shadow.
615348.translation: 洞窟崎岖延展深不见底，每处阴影均有约格莫夫的可怖遗产潜伏其间。

615353.oracleText: There are still a few places where the natural dangers outweigh even those posed by Phyrexian sleeper agents.
615353.translation: 如今在某些地方，仍然是自然变化比潜藏密探更凶险。

615356.oracleText: Some of the nature spirits and wraiths that haunt Urborg take offense at the term "ghost town."
615356.translation: 部分盘踞在乌尔博格的精怪和鬼魂觉得「鬼城」这称呼颇不礼貌。

615359.oracleText: In the tradition of the original Tolarian Academy, every Tolarian campus is built near a body of water.
615359.translation: 按照旧陶拉里亚大学院的传统，每个陶拉里亚校园都傍水而建。

615361.oracleText: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.
615361.translation: 在嶙峋覆雪的山峰之间，茂密的耐寒常青树为四处游荡的半兽人和鬼怪突击队提供了完美掩护。

615363.oracleText: Though dangerous, Shiv teems with both life and mana, making it a tempting destination for ambitious mages.
615363.translation: 西瓦虽然危机四伏，但其勃勃生机与充沛法力仍令无数有志法师心向往之。

615366.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a legendary spell.
615366.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放传奇咒语。

615367.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color among legendary permanents you control.
615367.translation: {oT}：加一点法术力，其颜色为由你操控之传奇永久物所具有的任一颜色。

615368.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Target legendary creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
615368.translation: {o3}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：目标传奇生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

615369.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Exile Plaza of Heroes: Target legendary creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
615369.translation: {o3}，{oT}，放逐群英广场：目标传奇生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

615371.oracleText: Yavimaya's inhabitants are dedicated to protecting its unspoiled jungle from the scourge of artifice.
615371.translation: 亚维马雅丛林尚未受战火波及，而其间生灵均致力保卫此处免遭奇械劫运降临。

615374.oracleText: Everyone is welcome in the floating Serran cities, though few but the most faithful attempt the ascent.
615374.translation: 漂浮空中的撒拉都市欢迎所有人到访，但仅有寥寥无几的虔诚信徒才会尝试跻身其间。

615376.oracleText: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.
615376.translation: 西瓦周边的沸腾洋面，为重新夺回的魔力钻探机提供了一道不可多得的防御天堑。

615377.oracleText: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.
615377.translation: 燃烧群岛万物皆可燃，包括法术力本身。

615379.oracleText: Even the poisoned land around the Stronghold blossomed with new life in the wake of the Great Mending.
615379.translation: 世界愈合后，就连天罗城塞周边的剧毒土壤也绽放出新的生命。

615382.oracleText: Many of Terisiare's islands are merely extensions of the root system of the Yavimaya magnigoth forests.
615382.translation: 许多泰瑞西亚岛屿不过是亚维马雅马尼古斯树林根系的延伸。

615387.oracleText: Thran Portal is the chosen type in addition to its other types.
615387.translation: 索蓝境界通道额外具有该类别。

615388.oracleText: Mana abilities of CARDNAME cost an additional 1 life to activate.
615388.translation: CARDNAME的法术力异能须额外支付1点生命来起动。

615389.oracleText: Mana abilities of Thran Portal cost an additional 1 life to activate.
615389.translation: 索蓝境界通道的法术力异能须额外支付1点生命来起动。

615391.oracleText: The power of long-forgotten empires still pulses in the earth of Dominaria, giving rise to strange, mana-rich pockets of growth.
615391.translation: 遭忘已久的王朝力量仍在多明纳里亚地表脉动，令各地纷纷出现许多富含法术力的奇异植生区域。

615393.oracleText: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.
615393.translation: 随着马尼古斯树穿越大海扎根阿玛兹和新阿基夫，大家方才醒悟亚维马雅的边界绝不会受海岸束缚。

615395.oracleText: "Heroism is neither a strong arm nor a divine destiny. It is the choice to stand unbowed against impossible odds."
615395.translation: "Heroism is neither a strong arm nor a divine destiny. It is the choice to stand unbowed against impossible odds."

615398.oracleText:
"All knowledge, past and future, is etched upon reality. Every answer we seek is out there, hidden only by the limits of our minds."
—Jodah
615398.translation:
"All knowledge, past and future, is etched upon reality. Every answer we seek is out there, hidden only by the limits of our minds."
—Jodah

615399.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
615399.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌的加总。

615402.oracleText: The chosen creature gets +3/+3 and has flying.
615402.translation: 所选生物得+3/+3具有飞行异能。

615403.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, sacrifice the chosen creature.
615403.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，牺牲所选生物。

615404.oracleText: When Tyrannical Pitlord leaves the battlefield, sacrifice the chosen creature.
615404.translation: 当残暴暗渊王离开战场时，牺牲所选生物。

615406.oracleText:
"Well, the good news is that sound wasn't the volcano erupting . . ."
—George, Coalition scout
615406.translation:
"Well, the good news is that sound wasn't the volcano erupting . . ."
—George, Coalition scout

615407.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, CARDNAME gains double strike until end of turn.
615407.translation: 当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则CARDNAME获得连击异能直到回合结束。

615408.oracleText: Whenever Ragefire Hellkite attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, Ragefire Hellkite gains double strike until end of turn.
615408.translation: 当怒焰残虐者攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则怒焰残虐者获得连击异能直到回合结束。

615410.oracleText: Flora and fauna alike rose to Yavimaya's defense.
615410.translation: 动植物俱皆奋起护卫亚维马雅。

615411.oracleText: Domain — Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615411.translation: 领土～每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

615412.oracleText: Domain — Whenever Briar Hydra deals combat damage to a player, put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
615412.translation: 领土～每当荆木多头龙对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控之地中基本地类别的数量。

615413.oracleText: Put an Aura or Equipment card onto the battlefield?
615413.translation: 将一张灵气或武具牌放进战场？

615414.oracleText: Target up to one nonland permanent an opponent controls.
615414.translation: 以至多一个由对手操控的非地永久物为目标。

615415.oracleText: Put a planeswalker card with mana value 6 or less onto the battlefield?
615415.translation: 将一个法术力值小于等于6的鹏洛客牌放进战场？

615417.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 1 or 2 from your hand without paying its mana cost?
615417.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你手上施放一个法术力值为1或2的瞬间或法术咒语？

615418.oracleText: Search for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 1.
615418.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值为1的瞬间或法术牌。

615419.oracleText: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 1?
615419.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张法术力值为1的瞬间或法术牌？

615421.oracleText: Put one of those cards into your library?
615421.translation: 将其中一张置入你的牌库？

615422.oracleText: Target a creature with power less than {1, CardId}'s power.
615422.translation: 选择一个力量小于{1, CardId}的生物为目标。

615423.oracleText: Spend only on: An Instant or Sorcery Spell or a Kicked Spell
615423.translation: 只能用于支付：瞬间或法术或已增幅咒语。

615425.translation: 牺牲一个非地、非衍生永久物？

615426.oracleText: Search for a black creature card.

615429.oracleText: Sacrifice that creature at the beginning of the next end step.
615429.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该生物。

615431.oracleText: Whenever you attack this turn, CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of attacking creatures to that creature.
615431.translation: 每当你攻击时，CARDNAME对该生物造成伤害，其数量等同于进行攻击的生物数量。

615432.oracleText: Exile an instant or sorcery card with mana value {2, Number} or less?
615432.translation: 放逐一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的瞬间或法术牌？

615433.oracleText: Target a creature defending player controls with power less than {1, CardId}'s power.
615433.translation: 以一个由防御牌手操控且力量小于{1, CardId}的生物为目标。

615435.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Choose up to {2, Number} creature or planeswalker you control.} other {Choose up to {2, Number} creatures and/or planeswalkers you control.}}
615435.translation: {2, plural, =1 {至多选择{2, Number}个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客。}另外{至多选择{2, Number}个由你操控的生物和/或鹏洛客。}}

615436.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies this turn, draw a card.
615436.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，抓一张牌。

615437.oracleText: CARDNAME deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker.
615437.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

615438.oracleText: Target up to one artifact you control.
615438.translation: 至多选择一个由你操控的神器。

615439.oracleText: Search for up to four creature cards with different powers.
615439.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多四张力量各不相同的生物牌。

615440.translation: 展示一张非传纪永久物牌？

615441.oracleText: Put up to two non-Saga permanent cards onto the battlefield.
615441.translation: 将至多两张非传纪永久物牌从你手上放进战场。

615442.oracleText: Distribute counters among up to three target creatures.
615442.translation: 指示物分配给至多三个目标生物。

615443.oracleText: Reveal an Equipment or Vehicle card?
615443.translation: 展示一张武具或载具牌？

615444.oracleText: Put an artifact card with mana value {2, Number} or less onto the battlefield?
615444.translation: 将一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的神器牌放进战场？

615445.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
615445.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

615446.oracleText: Tap an untapped nontoken artifact you control.
615446.translation: 横置一个由你操控、未横置且非衍生物的神器。

615447.oracleText: Tap two untapped nontoken artifacts you control.
615447.translation: 横置两个由你操控、未横置且非衍生物的神器。

615449.oracleText: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
615449.translation: 派出一个1/1绿色腐生物衍生生物。

615450.oracleText: Tap two untapped creatures you control?
615450.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的生物？

615451.oracleText: Spend only on: Dragon Creature Spells
615451.translation: 只能用于支付：龙生物咒语

615452.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
615452.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

615453.oracleText: Target up to one land you control.
615453.translation: 至多以一个由你操控的地为目标。

615454.oracleText: Target a non-Aura enchantment you control.
615454.translation: 以一个非灵气由你操控的结界为目标。

615455.oracleText: Return them to the battlefield tapped under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
615455.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。

615456.oracleText: Search for a creature card with defender.
615456.translation: 搜寻一张具守军异能的生物牌。

615457.oracleText: Search your library for a creature card with defender?
615457.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张具守军异能的生物牌？

615458.oracleText: Spend only on: A Legendary Spell
615458.translation: 只能用于支付：传奇咒语

615459.oracleText: Target up to one creature to become 1/1 until end of turn.
615459.translation: 至多一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为1/1直到回合结束。

615460.oracleText: Target up to one other creature to become 4/4 until end of turn.
615460.translation: 至多另一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为4/4直到回合结束。

615461.oracleText: Play a card with mana value less than or equal to the damage dealt from the top of your library without paying its mana cost?
615461.translation: 是否要从你的牌库顶使用一张地牌，或从该处施放一个法术力值等于或小于所造成伤害之数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用？

615462.oracleText: Target up to one creature card of that color.
615462.translation: 指定至多一张该颜色的生物牌为目标。

615517.oracleText: Target up to one white creature card.
615517.translation: 指定至多一张白色生物牌为目标。

615518.oracleText: Target up to one blue creature card.
615518.translation: 指定至多一张蓝色生物牌为目标。

615519.oracleText: Target up to one black creature card.
615519.translation: 指定至多一张黑色生物牌为目标。

615520.oracleText: Target up to one red creature card.
615520.translation: 指定至多一张红色生物牌为目标。

615521.oracleText: Target up to one green creature card.
615521.translation: 指定至多一张绿色生物牌为目标。

615522.oracleText: Spend only on: Spells With Exactly Three Colors
615522.translation: 只能用于支付：正好为三色的咒语。

615682.oracleText: Choose two cards in your opponent's graveyard.
615682.translation: 选择对手坟墓场中的两张牌。

616757.oracleText: Choose up to two nonland permanents you control.
616757.translation: 选择至多两个由你操控的非地永久物。

616758.oracleText: Have your opponent draw a card?
616758.translation: 是否要令对手抓一张牌？

616763.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell.
616763.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。此法术力不能用来施放非神器咒语。

616821.oracleText: Reveal it and put it into your hand?
616821.translation: 是否要展示它并将它置于你手上？

616827.oracleText: Spend only on: Blue Creature Spells
616827.translation: 只能用于支付：蓝色生物咒语。

616830.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target attacking creature connives.
616830.translation: 每当你攻击时，令目标进行攻击的生物筹谋。

616832.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, if that card is still exiled, put it into your graveyard and create a Treasure token.
616832.translation: 在下个结束步骤开始时，若该牌仍被放逐，将它置入你的坟墓场且派出一个珍宝衍生物。

616881.oracleText: Choose a creature card in your hand without blitz.
616881.translation: 选择你手上一张不具急袭异能的生物牌。

616882.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, creatures you control and creature cards in your hand, library, and graveyard perpetually get +1/+1.
616882.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，由你操控的生物和你手上、牌库中和坟墓场中的生物牌各永久得+1/+1。

616991.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control get +3/+3 and gain trample.
616991.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+3/+3和践踏异能。

617015.oracleText: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
617015.translation: 将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

617016.oracleText: Exile two other cards named Calim, Djinn Emperor?
617016.translation: 是否要放逐两张其他名称为巨灵皇帝卡林的牌？

617120.oracleText: Discard a nonland card with the greatest mana value among cards in your hand.
617120.translation: 弃一张非地牌，且须是其手上法术力值最高者。

617166.oracleText: Target a creature to perpetually get -2/-0.
617166.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，它永久得-2/-0。

617167.oracleText: You've heard rumors of bandits along the Coast Way, but your journey so far has been surprisingly uneventful.
617167.translation: 你听说湾岸公路沿途强盗肆虐，但是旅程至今竟一直太平无事。

617168.oracleText: Lady Bormul claims an owlbear has been trampling her fields, but there's something unnatural about the tracks it left behind.
617168.translation: 你听玻穆尔夫人说田地间有枭头熊出没，便动身前往调查，却发现野兽留下的行踪有一些不自然之处。

617169.oracleText: After spending all day trying to track down a rare tome, you're about to give up when you hear your name whispered from a dark alley.
617169.translation: 你花上整天时间遍寻一本罕见卷册而无果，正心灰意冷准备放弃之时，恰好听到黑暗小巷中有人低语轻呼你的名字。

617170.oracleText: You arrive at Baldur's Gate with instructions to head straight to the heart of the rumor mill: the bakery.
617170.translation: 你来到博德之门，受命直奔八卦消息总部：那家面包坊。

617171.oracleText: As you sail past the imposing Seatower of Balduran, you realize that breaking your friend out of that prison will be much harder than you thought.
617171.translation: 你驾船经过博德兰望海塔亲见其雄伟巍峨之后，才意识到要将朋友从该处劫狱救出可谓难于登天。

617172.oracleText: As you gaze down upon Wyrm's Crossing, you hear distant cries of alarm, and you notice that all traffic on the bridge has come to a halt.
617172.translation: 你正在高处俯瞰巨龙横渡，突然听到远处传来警报呼声，桥上人流来往顿时停滞。

617173.oracleText: You're about to disembark to find the harbormaster when you spot a merfolk darting underneath your ship.
617173.translation: 你在准备下船去找港务总管时，看见有人鱼在你船底疾游猛进。

617174.oracleText: The ship's captain promised she'd get you safely to the Netherese ruin, but she is the one who just washed overboard.
617174.translation: 你虽得船长保证，会被安稳送抵耐瑟瑞尔遗迹，但说这话的她刚刚才被海浪卷下甲板。

617175.oracleText: Now that you've clearly hit the "marsh" part of Lizard Marsh, you begin to worry about the "lizard" part.
617175.translation: 你现在已经来到了蜥蜴沼泽的「沼泽」部分，开始担心此地名称中的「蜥蜴」部分。

617176.oracleText: The sudden sinkhole was surprising enough, but nothing could have prepared you for the ancient city that was hidden underneath.
617176.translation: 你面对这突如其来的地陷已经被吓得手脚慌乱，但对于埋藏地底的古城遗迹来说，这点热身还远远不够。

617177.oracleText: The old wizard's experiments destroyed the castle centuries ago. So why does some of the rubble look recent?
617177.translation: 你知道这座城堡毁于数百年前老法师的一次疯狂实验。但为什么有些碎石看起来很新？

617178.oracleText: At the mouth of the sewer pipe, you realize it's massive enough that even a giant could walk through without stooping. That gives you an idea . . .
617178.translation: 你站在下水道口，发觉整个管道十分庞大，甚至巨人不需弯腰也能出入自如。你顿时心生一计…

617179.oracleText: As you explore the slums of the Outer City, you keep hearing rumors of a den of werewolves in the caves below Dusthawk Hill.
617179.translation: 你在探索外城区的贫民窟时，常能听到尘鹰山脚洞穴中藏有一处狼人巢穴的传言。

617180.oracleText: Lord Jannath sent you to secure the mine from gnoll raiders, but so far you haven't seen any gnolls . . . or, for that matter, any miners.
617180.translation: 你受加纳斯领主之托，前去保护矿井免受豺狼人掠夺者袭击，但你到现在都没见到任何豺狼人…甚至也没有见到任何矿工。

617181.oracleText: Rumor holds that powerful artifacts and untold wealth are hidden away in Ramazith's Tower, and today you plan to find out for yourself.
617181.translation: 你一直听说拉马齐斯之塔里面藏有强力奇械与无尽财富，如今终有机会亲身一探究竟。

617182.oracleText: As you pause mid-climb to catch your breath, you'd swear you can hear a heartbeat pulsing deep within the mountain.
617182.translation: 你爬到半山腰停下来想喘口气，回荡群山之间的隆隆心跳清晰到你愿立誓为证。

617183.oracleText: You know that hiexel bark produces a lot of smoke when burned, but why would Rilsa Rael need so much of it?
617183.translation: 你知道烽火木树皮烧起来会产生滚滚烽烟，但为什么廖莎雷尔要用到这么多呢？

617184.oracleText: The lights in the cavern glow and fade, glow and fade in a rhythm that must have a deeper meaning, if only you can figure it out.
617184.translation: 你发现洞窟深处透出的光芒时明时暗，其中的规律必有深意；不过你得自己推敲出来。

617185.oracleText: You continue to mutter and complain as you trip over yet another gnarled root. From behind the nearest tree trunk, something mutters back.
617185.translation: 你又给多瘤的树根跘倒了一次，忍不住碎嘴了几句。而在靠你最近的树干后方，也有个什么东西对你碎嘴着。

617186.oracleText: You're on your way home when you spot the gates of a strange city . . . one that isn't on the map and wasn't here when you traveled this path four days ago.
617186.translation: 你在回家路上瞥见这座通往陌生城市的门户…它不在地图上，而且你四天前才走过这条路，那时也没这东西。

617187.oracleText: You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
617187.translation: 在本盘游戏接下来的时段，你的手牌数量没有上限。

617188.oracleText: Remove all perpetual effects from your commander?
617188.translation: 是否要移除你指挥官上的所有永久效果？

617191.oracleText: If there are four or more creature cards in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control and it gains deathtouch until end of turn.
617191.translation: 如果你的坟墓场有四张或更多生物牌，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且它获得死触异能直到回合结束。

617226.oracleText: Target a nontoken creature you control.
617226.translation: 指定一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物为目标。

617228.oracleText: Target a creature card exiled with this creature.
617228.translation: 指定以此生物放逐的一张生物牌为目标。

617229.oracleText: Distribute that many +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures.
617229.translation: 将该数量的指示物分配给任意数量的目标生物。

617230.oracleText: Put target creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of study counters removed this way from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
617230.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于以此法移去之读书指示物数量的生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

617231.oracleText: Target a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of study counters removed this way.
617231.translation: 指定一张生物牌为目标，其法术力值须等于或小于以此法移去的读书指示物数量。

617232.oracleText: CARDNAME deals that much damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
617232.translation: CARDNAME向目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成该数量的伤害。

617233.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
617233.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

617234.oracleText: Choose a creature card exiled with this creature.
617234.translation: 选择一张以此生物放逐的一张生物牌。

617235.oracleText: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
617235.translation: 将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

617236.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or an artifact?
617236.translation: 是否要牺牲另一个生物或神器？

617237.oracleText: Target up to one artifact or enchantment.
617237.translation: 指定至多一个神器或结界为目标。

617297.oracleText: Target a creature card in an opponent's graveyard.
617297.translation: 指定任一对手坟墓场中的一张生物牌为目标。

617317.oracleText: Cast target card named Pass the Torch from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
617317.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场施放目标名称为传递火炬的牌，且无须支付其法术力费用？

617318.oracleText: Target a card named Pass the Torch.
617318.translation: 指定一张名称为传递火炬的牌为目标。

617492.oracleText: Remove all perpetual effects from your commander? If you do it will unspecialize.
617492.translation: 是否要移除你指挥官上的所有永久效果？若你如此作，它将不再特化。

617733.oracleText: Choose a card exiled with {1, CardId}?
617733.translation: 是否要选择一张以{1, CardId}放逐的牌？

617785.oracleText: Add {oUoUoU}. Spend this mana only to cast blue creature spells.
617785.translation: 加{oUoUoU}。此法术力只能用来施放蓝色生物咒语。

617786.oracleText: Whenever you attack, up to one target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. At the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand.
617786.translation: 每当你攻击时，至多一个目标进行攻击的生物本回合不能被阻挡。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该生物移回其拥有者手上。

617793.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, return that creature to its owner's hand.
617793.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该生物移回其拥有者手上。

617798.oracleText: Seek two creature cards with mana value less than or equal to the number of study counters removed this way.
617798.translation: 掏两张法术力值各等于或小于以此法移去之读书指示物数量的生物牌。将其中一张放进战场，另一张则洗入你的牌库。

617799.oracleText: Draw three cards unless target opponent pays 5 life.
617799.translation: 除非目标对手支付5点生命，否则抓三张牌。

617801.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target, where X is that creature's power. If the sacrificed creature was a Hamster, draw X cards.
617801.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，X为该生物的力量。如果所牺牲的生物是仓鼠，则抓X张牌。

617802.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. If its mana value is 4 or greater, sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
617802.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。如果其法术力值等于或大于4，在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

617803.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
617803.translation: 在你的下个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

617804.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
617804.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。该生物于其操控者的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

617805.oracleText: Target any number of creatures controlled by different opponents.
617805.translation: 指定任意数量由不同牌手操控的生物为目标。

617940.oracleText: Target any number of creature cards with total mana value {2, Number} or less.
617940.translation: 指定任意数量法术力值总和等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌为目标。

617950.oracleText:
"The ground is where wars are waged, but the air is where they are won."
—Harbin, vanguard aviator
617950.translation:
「兴战于陆地，决胜于天空。」
～飞行先锋哈宾

617957.oracleText: "It would be folly to fight a dragon engine head-on. Let's hit it from above."
617957.translation: 「正面对抗龙形引擎可谓愚蠢至极。让我们从上方入手。」

617958.oracleText: {o5}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
617958.translation: {o5}：由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

617960.oracleText: The sylex's blast had razed the land, leaving behind only snow and sorrow. Urza stood alone in the sudden silence.
617960.translation: 同兆爆炸强威夷平大地，仅余飘雪与悲戚。喧嚣骤静，克撒兀自伫立。

617961.oracleText: Exile all graveyards. Players can't cast noncreature spells this turn. Exile CARDNAME.
617961.translation: 放逐所有坟墓场。本回合中，牌手不能施放非生物咒语。放逐CARDNAME。

617962.oracleText: Exile all graveyards. Players can't cast noncreature spells this turn. Exile Calamity's Wake.
617962.translation: 放逐所有坟墓场。本回合中，牌手不能施放非生物咒语。放逐灾祸残迹。

617964.oracleText:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general
617964.translation:
「自动机械虽然快速精准、永不停歇，但它们都有同一缺陷：行为固定。找出规律。趁暴露弱点时出击。」
～克撒军将领霍兰斯

617965.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target tapped creature and you gain 2 life.
617965.translation: CARDNAME对目标已横置生物造成3点伤害且你获得2点生命。

617966.oracleText: Deadly Riposte deals 3 damage to target tapped creature and you gain 2 life.
617966.translation: 致命还击对目标已横置的生物造成3点伤害且你获得2点生命。

617967.oracleText: "One down, several thousand more to go."

617973.oracleText: The battlefield became so pockmarked with craters and trenches that casualties were regularly attributed to "fell in a hole."
617973.translation: 战场上很快就布满了弹迹壕沟，伤亡原因也都被简单归结为「掉进坑里」。

617974.oracleText: {o5oW}: Exile target nonland permanent you don't control until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.
617974.translation: {o5oW}：放逐目标不由你操控的非地永久物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。只能于法术时机起动且只能起动一次。

617975.oracleText: {o5oW}: Exile target nonland permanent you don't control until In the Trenches leaves the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.
617975.translation: {o5oW}：放逐目标不由你操控的非地永久物，直到壕沟备战离开战场为止。只能于法术时机起动且只能起动一次。

617977.oracleText: Create a 2/2 colorless Construct artifact creature token.
617977.translation: 派出一个2/2无色组构体衍生神器生物。

617978.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control. It gains double strike until end of turn.
617978.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得连击异能直到回合结束。

617979.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
617979.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

617981.oracleText: Choose two — • Create a 2/2 colorless Construct artifact creature token. • Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control. It gains double strike until end of turn. • Search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. • You gain 2 life and scry 2.
617981.translation: 选择两项～ •  派出一个2/2无色组构体衍生神器生物。 •  在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得连击异能直到回合结束。 •  从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。 •  你获得2点生命且占卜2。

617983.oracleText: Anyone can destroy a continent. Few have the vision to rebuild one.
617983.translation: 任谁都能毁灭大陆。没人设想重建愿景。

617984.oracleText: Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put up to X artifact and/or creature cards with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
617984.translation: 检视你牌库顶的七张牌。将其中至多X张法术力值等于或小于3的神器和／或生物牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

617986.oracleText: She'll swing a blade all her life, but never again for war.
617986.translation: 她愿终身挥刃，也不再为战事举兵。

617987.oracleText: Exile target creature with mana value less than or equal to the number of Plains you control. Its controller gains 3 life.
617987.translation: 放逐目标生物，且其法术力值须等于或小于由你操控的平原数量。其操控者获得3点生命。

617989.oracleText: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.
617989.translation: 身为学者，她未将同兆当作武器，而是洞悉过往的关键。

617992.oracleText: {oT}: You and target opponent each draw a card.

617994.oracleText: Urza and Mishra may have been Tocasia's most famous students, but Loran was the true heir to her legacy.
617994.translation: 虽然托卡西雅诸学子中属克撒与米斯拉最广为人知，但罗兰才是她一生所学的正统传承。

617998.oracleText: As Terisia City burned, Feldon pressed the sylex into Loran's hands and urged her to run. Hope ran with her.
617998.translation: 眼见泰瑞西亚城火光熊熊倾覆在即，费顿急忙将同兆硬塞到罗兰手中，让她赶紧逃命。希望与她随行。

617999.oracleText: Target artifact or creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. Scry 1.
617999.translation: 目标神器或生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。占卜1。

618001.oracleText:
"I need an army, not a masterpiece. Accelerate output, whatever it takes."
—Urza, notes to his engineers
618001.translation:
「我要的是军队，不是作品。加速生产，不计代价。」
～克撒，给工程师的批注

618002.oracleText: Create four 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature tokens.
618002.translation: 派出四个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618004.oracleText: "Remember, students, if it's glowing, humming, or whirring, don't touch it!"
618004.translation: 「同学们切记，如果是发光、嗡响或啸叫的，千万别碰！」

618005.oracleText: {o2oW}: Return target permanent you control to its owner's hand. If it has unearth, instead exile it, then return that card to its owner's hand. Activate only during your turn.
618005.translation: {o2oW}：将目标由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果它具有破坟异能，则改为将它放逐，然后将该牌移回其拥有者手上。只能于你的回合中起动。

618009.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create X 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature tokens, where X is the number of Soldiers you control.
618009.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出X个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物，X为由你操控的士兵数量。

618010.oracleText: Whenever Myrel, Shield of Argive attacks, create X 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature tokens, where X is the number of Soldiers you control.
618010.translation: 每当阿基夫之盾穆雷尔攻击时，派出X个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物，X为由你操控的士兵数量。

618012.oracleText: The cool, sleek automatons beside her mirrored her own iron resolve.
618012.translation: 她身边环绕的冷酷光亮自动机械，正映照出她的钢铁决心。

618016.oracleText: "Well there's your problem—resonance leak lowering output by thirty percent. I can patch that up."
618016.translation: 「你的问题出在这～共振泄漏损失了百分之三十的输出。我能修好。」

618017.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a tapped Powerstone token.
618017.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618018.oracleText: When Powerstone Engineer dies, create a tapped Powerstone token.
618018.translation: 当魔力石工程师死去时，派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618020.oracleText: War prisoners were ineffective political pawns, as neither brother cared enough to trade for them.
618020.translation: 战俘都是不重要的政治筹码，两兄弟均无意付出利益来交换。

618023.oracleText: "Put your backs into it! If we don't lay claim to it, the Fallaji will!"
618023.translation: 「都给我使劲拉！如果我们不拖走，法拉吉人就会动手了！」

618026.oracleText: "Every name on this list is already a hero! Will you add your own to it?"
618026.translation: 「凡登记在册者都无愧英雄盛名！你是否愿来同享荣光？」

618027.oracleText: {o3oW}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with mana value 3 or less from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
618027.translation: {o3oW}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

618029.oracleText:
"Throw the bodies out. They'll just weigh down the frame."
—Rolf, Argivian mechanic
618029.translation:
「把遗体都抛出去。他们只会徒增重量。」
～阿基夫技师罗尔夫

618030.oracleText: Return target artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Create a tapped Powerstone token.
618030.translation: 将目标神器，结界或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618032.oracleText: "Steady, recruit. We fight in the light of justice. We cast no shadow."
618032.translation: 「稳着点，新来的。我们置身正义之光作战，不留下一丝阴影。」

618033.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken Soldier you control dies, create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.
618033.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的士兵死去时，派出一个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618035.oracleText: Teferi's body couldn't travel through time far enough, but with Kaya's help, his spirit could.
618035.translation: 泰菲力肉身能够穿行的时间有限，但在卡娅帮助下，他的灵魂能够回到需要的时刻。

618036.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. For as long as that card remains exiled, its owner may play it. A spell cast by an opponent this way costs {o2} more to cast.
618036.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，其拥有者可以使用之。对手以此法施放的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

618042.oracleText: At first, the merchant state of Korlis saw no need to involve itself in the conflict between Yotia and the Fallaji. Mishra's dragon engines changed that.
618042.translation: 起初，行商国度寇利斯觉得没必要卷入佑天和法拉吉的纷争之中。米斯拉的龙形引擎改变了这想法。

618043.oracleText: {o1oW}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Scry 2.

618044.oracleText: {o1oW}, Exile Survivor of Korlis from your graveyard: Scry 2.
618044.translation: {o1oW}，从你的坟墓场放逐寇利斯幸存者：占卜2。

618046.oracleText: "She'll only fly once. Make it count!"

618049.oracleText: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much. He wanted me to look after you, to care for you should something happen to him."
618049.translation: 「我跟你们的父亲交情很深，我也欠他一份人情。他怕自己有个万一，所以交待要我照顾你们。」

618052.oracleText: Terisia City at last opened its ivory towers to all who sought respite from the endless war.
618052.translation: 泰瑞西亚城最终敞开了象牙塔的大门，接纳希望逃避无休烽火的民众入内暂避。

618053.oracleText: Draw a card, then you gain life equal to the number of cards in your hand.
618053.translation: 抓一张牌，然后你获得等同于你手牌数量的生命。

618055.oracleText: "The Warlord thinks we've gone soft, does he? The Fist of Progress will prove him wrong!"
618055.translation: 「大领主是不是觉得我们变软弱了？进展之拳会让他刮目相看！」

618056.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap two untapped artifacts, creatures, and/or lands you control.
618056.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器，生物和／或地，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

618058.oracleText:
"Go, save as many as you can! The city walls may be rubble, but Kroog will live on in its people."
—Queen Kayla bin-Kroog
618058.translation:
「快，能救多少救多少！城墙或会化作齑粉，但萼城将在人民心中长存。」
～萼城的凯拉皇后

618060.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target Assembly-Worker you control.
618060.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在目标由你操控的组装工人上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618065.oracleText:
"Hear that thud-clank, thud-clank? We're saved."
—Ani, Urzan soldier
618065.translation:
「听到那咔嚓、咔嚓的声音没？我们得救了。」
～克撒军士兵亚尼

618066.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more other creatures, draw a card.
618066.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控两个或更多其他生物，则抓一张牌。

618067.oracleText: {o3oW}: Create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.
618067.translation: {o3oW}：派出一个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618074.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gains your choice of flying, vigilance, or lifelink until end of turn.
618074.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择飞行，警戒或系命。目标由你操控的生物获得该异能直到回合结束。

618076.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, you gain 2 life.
618076.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，你获得2点生命。

618077.oracleText: When Tocasia's Onulet leaves the battlefield, you gain 2 life.
618077.translation: 当托卡西雅的安瑙纳离开战场时，你获得2点生命。

618080.oracleText: {o2oWoW}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Each player chooses six lands they control. Destroy all other permanents. Activate only as a sorcery.
618080.translation: {o2oWoW}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：每位牌手各选择六个由其操控的地。消灭所有其他永久物。只能于法术时机起动。

618081.oracleText: {o2oWoW}, {oT}, Exile Urza's Sylex: Each player chooses six lands they control. Destroy all other permanents. Activate only as a sorcery.
618081.translation: {o2oWoW}，{oT}，放逐克撒的同兆：每位牌手各选择六个由其操控的地。消灭所有其他永久物。只能于法术时机起动。

618082.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into exile from the battlefield, you may pay {o2}. If you do, search your library for a planeswalker card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
618082.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入放逐区时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻一张鹏洛客牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

618083.oracleText: When Urza's Sylex is put into exile from the battlefield, you may pay {o2}. If you do, search your library for a planeswalker card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
618083.translation: 当克撒的同兆从战场进入放逐区时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻一张鹏洛客牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

618087.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, another target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
618087.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

618088.oracleText: Whenever Yotian Frontliner attacks, another target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
618088.translation: 每当佑天前线兵攻击时，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

618091.oracleText: "Today our blades remember Kroog! May the seven brass gods be with us!"
618091.translation: 「今日手中利刃会铭记萼城荣光！愿黄铜七神与我们同在！」

618092.oracleText: {o3}: Target Soldier gains flying until end of turn.
618092.translation: {o3}：目标士兵获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

618093.oracleText: "Aha! This must be one of the ancient keys to . . . No, wait. It's just another puzzle toy."
618093.translation: 「啊哈！这肯定是开启神秘珍宝的古董钥匙…不对，等等。只是又一个拼装玩具罢了。」

618095.oracleText: Counter target artifact or enchantment spell. If a spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
618095.translation: 反击目标神器或结界咒语。如果以此法反击了咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入拥有者的坟墓场。

618096.oracleText: Choose one — • Counter target artifact or enchantment spell. If a spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard. • Counter target activated or triggered ability.
618096.translation: 选择一项～ •  反击目标神器或结界咒语。如果以此法反击了咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入拥有者的坟墓场。 •  反击目标起动式或触发式异能。

618098.oracleText: Before Kaya could pull Teferi's spirit back, the overloaded temporal anchor failed, and he was set adrift in the currents of time.
618098.translation: 超载的时间锚很快就故障失灵，此时卡娅未及将泰菲力灵魂拽回，只得空留他在时间流中飘荡。

618099.oracleText: Target nonland permanent's owner puts it on the top or bottom of their library. Scry 2.
618099.translation: 目标非地永久物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。占卜2。

618102.oracleText: Alongside his wife, Hurkyl, Drafna built a legacy of scholarship that endured for millennia.
618102.translation: 札夫拿与妻子河鼓共创了一门崭新学术体系，最终传承千代、造福万年。

618103.oracleText: {o1oU}: Return target artifact you control to its owner's hand.
618103.translation: {o1oU}：将目标由你操控的神器移回其拥有者手上。

618104.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Copy target artifact spell you control.
618104.translation: {o3}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控的神器咒语。

618105.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Copy target artifact spell you control. (The copy becomes a token.)
618105.translation: {o3}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控的神器咒语。（所成之复制品会成为衍生物。）

618110.oracleText:
"Focus your mind. Do you hold a piece of the ocean or a thousand drops of rain?"
—Hurkyl
618110.translation:
「集中精神。你控制的是一片海洋，还是千滴雨水？」
～河鼓

618111.oracleText: Draw a card for each Island you control, then discard two cards.
618111.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控的海岛数量，然后弃两张牌。

618113.oracleText: The metal turned and blossomed with Saheeli's will, each filigreed twist bringing the temporal anchor closer to completion.
618113.translation: 丝金会随着莎希莉的想法蜿蜒伸展，每次金属扭动，都让时间锚离完成更近一步。

618114.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal any number of artifact cards from among them and put the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
618114.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中任意数量的神器牌，并将所展示的牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

618117.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you've cast a noncreature spell this turn, reveal the top five cards of your library. For each card type among noncreature spells you've cast this turn, you may put a card of that type from among the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
618117.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中已施放非生物咒语，则展示你牌库顶的五张牌。你本回合中已施放的非生物咒语中每有一种牌张类别，你便可以从所展示的牌中将一张该类别的牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

618120.oracleText: Return all nonland permanents to their owners' hands. End the turn.
618120.translation: 将所有非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。结束回合。

618121.oracleText: Return all nonland permanents to their owners' hands. End the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack, including this card. The player whose turn it is discards down to their maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects end.)
618121.translation: 将所有非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。结束本回合。（放逐堆叠上的所有咒语和异能，包括此牌。轮到此回合的牌手将手牌弃至其手牌上限。生物上的伤害消失，并且注记着「本回合」与「直到回合结束」的效应均结束。）

618123.oracleText:
"Back to the ivory towers! This won't hold for long!"
—Vayor, Third Path cryomancer
618123.translation:
「退回象牙塔！这样撑不了太久！」
～蹊径会凛寒术士瓦约

618124.oracleText: Tap up to two target artifacts and/or creatures. Put two stun counters on each of them.
618124.translation: 横置至多两个目标神器和／或生物。在其上各放置两个晕眩指示物。

618126.oracleText: "What you call magic, I call the power of memory."
618126.translation: 「你管这叫作魔法，我则称其为回忆之力。」

618127.oracleText: {o3}: Put target artifact, instant, or sorcery card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
618127.translation: {o3}：将目标神器，瞬间或法术牌从坟墓场置于其拥有者的牌库底。

618132.oracleText: "Every book is a doorway to enlightenment. Curiosity is your key."
618132.translation: 「每本著作都是通向启迪之门。求知欲则是你打开大门的钥匙。」

618133.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Lat-Nam Adept.
618133.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，在拉特南专家上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618135.oracleText: The Warlord decreed that only someone who could move the statue was strong enough to marry the princess. So Urza moved it.
618135.translation: 大领主曾颁令公告，唯有能够搬动雕像的强者，方能与公主联姻。克撒办到了。

618136.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control an artifact creature.
618136.translation: 如果你操控神器生物，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

618139.oracleText: Enchanted artifact is a creature with base power and toughness 4/4 in addition to its other types.
618139.translation: 所结附的神器是基础力量与防御力为4/4的生物，且仍具有原本类别。

618141.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a spell from your hand or the top of your library without paying its mana cost.
618141.translation: 仅于你的每个回合中且限一次，你可以从你手上或你的牌库顶施放咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

618143.oracleText: The humming tome burned his leather glove, nearly taking his hand along with it. Then a strange power coursed through him.
618143.translation: 巨著嗡嗡作响，已然将皮手套烧穿，甚至差点废掉他的手。然后就有股奇异力量在其体内奔流。

618144.oracleText: {o2}: CARDNAME gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

618145.oracleText: {o2}: Retrieval Agent gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

618147.oracleText: Mishra's army demanded the secrets of the Third Path. Hurkyl's followers graciously showed them.
618147.translation: 米斯拉军要求蹊径会交出秘密。河鼓追随者大方地让他们见识了一下。

618148.oracleText: Counter target artifact or creature spell unless its controller pays {o4}.
618148.translation: 除非目标神器或生物咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。

618150.oracleText: "Landing zone is clear. Activate and deploy!"

618151.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.
618151.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618152.oracleText: Whenever Skystrike Officer attacks, create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.
618152.translation: 每当天袭长官攻击时，派出一个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618153.oracleText: Tap three untapped Soldiers you control: Draw a card.
618153.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的士兵：抓一张牌。

618155.oracleText: As the glowing stone broke apart, so too did the last shred of the brothers' bond.
618155.translation: 随着闪亮魔石断裂分离，兄弟之间最后一点情谊也荡然无存。

618156.oracleText: Create two tapped Powerstone tokens. If the sacrificed artifact was legendary, draw a card.
618156.translation: 派出两个已横置的魔力石衍生物。如果所牺牲的神器是传奇，则抓一张牌。

618158.oracleText:
"The brothers are brilliant, but their quarreling will be the death of me."
—Tocasia, journal entry
618158.translation:
「虽然两兄弟都聪颖过人，但他们争吵起来可整死我了。」
～托卡西雅的日志片段

618159.oracleText: Draw two cards, then discard a card. Create a tapped Powerstone token.
618159.translation: 抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618161.oracleText: Though neither brother cared to admit it, flying the ancient thopter was their last happy moment together.
618161.translation: 虽然两兄弟都不愿承认，但合力让远古振翼机重新腾空，是他们共享的最后一段快乐时光。

618162.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, draw a card.
618162.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，抓一张牌。

618163.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has flying and "Whenever this creature attacks, draw a card."
618163.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+0且具有飞行与「每当此生物攻击时，抓一张牌。」

618165.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, put a loyalty counter on CARDNAME.
618165.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，在CARDNAME上放置一个忠诚指示物。

618166.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, put a loyalty counter on Teferi, Temporal Pilgrim.
618166.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，在历时旅人泰菲力上放置一个忠诚指示物。

618168.oracleText: Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
618168.translation: 每当你抓一张牌时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618169.oracleText: Create a 2/2 blue Spirit creature token with vigilance and "Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature."
618169.translation: 派出一个2/2蓝色精怪衍生生物，且具有警戒与「每当你抓一张牌时，在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。」

618170.oracleText: Target opponent chooses a permanent they control and returns it to its owner's hand. Then they shuffle each nonland permanent they control into its owner's library.
618170.translation: 目标对手选择一个由其操控的永久物并将它移回其拥有者手上。然后将所有由其操控的非地永久物洗入其拥有者的牌库。

618172.oracleText: As Mishra's army bore down on Terisia City, Corlo felt his focus, his patience, and his willpower twine together. With a deep breath, he plucked answers from the air.
618172.translation: 眼看米斯拉军兵临泰瑞西亚城下，寇洛终觉自己精、气、神结合为一。于是他深深吸气，信手凭空给出回应。

618175.oracleText: "You want me to install a seat belt? Please. You're lucky to get a seat!"
618175.translation: 「你还想让我给你装安全带？拜托。我给你装座位就不错了！」

618176.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Mechanic.
618176.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，在振翼机技师上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618177.oracleText: When Thopter Mechanic dies, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
618177.translation: 当振翼机技师死去时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

618179.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more artifact cards, create a tapped Powerstone token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
618179.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张神器牌时，派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

618181.oracleText: Creatures you don't control get -2/-0 until end of turn.
618181.translation: 不由你操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。

618182.translation: 派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618183.oracleText: Create a tapped 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control."
618183.translation: 派出一个已横置的0/0无色组构体衍生神器生物，且具有「你每操控一个神器，此生物便得+1/+1。」

618184.oracleText: Choose two — • Creatures you don't control get -2/-0 until end of turn. • Create a tapped Powerstone token. • Create a tapped 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control." • Scry 1, then draw a card.
618184.translation: 选择两项～ •  不由你操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。 •  派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。 •  派出一个已横置的0/0无色组构体衍生神器生物，且具有「你每操控一个神器，此生物便得+1/+1。」 •  占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

618186.oracleText:
"As usual, my brother's maneuvers are brash and impulsive."
—Urza
618186.translation:
「跟往常一样，弟弟的行动鲁莽无谋。」
～克撒

618187.oracleText: Choose one — • Counter target spell. • Tap up to two target creatures.
618187.translation: 选择一项～ •  反击目标咒语。 •  横置至多两个目标生物。

618192.oracleText: "The welds are weaker at the top."

618200.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as you control an Island.

618201.oracleText: Coastal Bulwark gets +2/+0 as long as you control an Island.
618201.translation: 只要你操控海岛，沿岸筑垒械便得+2/+0。

618204.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice Combat Courier: Draw a card.

618206.oracleText: Depth Charge Colossus doesn't untap during your untap step.
618206.translation: 深渊冲锋巨像于你的重置步骤中不能重置。

618215.oracleText: {oU}: CARDNAME loses defender and gains "This creature can't be blocked."
618215.translation: {oU}：CARDNAME失去守军异能并获得「此生物不能被阻挡。」

618216.oracleText: {oU}: Surge Engine loses defender and gains "This creature can't be blocked."
618216.translation: {oU}：浪涌引擎失去守军异能并获得「此生物不能被阻挡。」

618217.oracleText: {o2oU}: CARDNAME becomes blue and has base power and toughness 5/4. Activate only if CARDNAME doesn't have defender.
618217.translation: {o2oU}：CARDNAME成为蓝色且基础力量与防御力为5/4。只能于CARDNAME不具守军时起动。

618218.oracleText: {o2oU}: Surge Engine becomes blue and has base power and toughness 5/4. Activate only if Surge Engine doesn't have defender.
618218.translation: {o2oU}：浪涌引擎成为蓝色且基础力量与防御力为5/4。只能于浪涌引擎不具守军时起动。

618219.oracleText: {o4oUoU}: Draw three cards. Activate only if CARDNAME is blue and only once.
618219.translation: {o4oUoU}：抓三张牌。只能于CARDNAME为蓝色时起动且只能起动一次。

618220.oracleText: {o4oUoU}: Draw three cards. Activate only if Surge Engine is blue and only once.
618220.translation: {o4oUoU}：抓三张牌。只能于浪涌引擎为蓝色时起动且只能起动一次。

618222.oracleText: Whenever you choose to put one or more cards on the bottom of your library while scrying, exile that many cards from the bottom of your library.
618222.translation: 每当你于占卜期间选择将一张或数张牌置于你牌库底时，从你牌库底放逐等量的牌。

618223.oracleText: During your turn, you may play cards exiled with CARDNAME.
618223.translation: 于你的回合中，你可以使用以CARDNAME放逐的牌。

618224.oracleText: During your turn, you may play cards exiled with The Temporal Anchor.
618224.translation: 于你的回合中，你可以使用以时间锚放逐的牌。

618226.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player mills half their library, rounded up.
618226.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手磨其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

618227.oracleText: Whenever Terisian Mindbreaker attacks, defending player mills half their library, rounded up.
618227.translation: 每当泰瑞西亚攻心械攻击时，防御牌手磨其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后舍去。

618230.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, create a tapped Powerstone token.
618230.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618231.oracleText: Whenever Ashnod, Flesh Mechanist attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, create a tapped Powerstone token.
618231.translation: 每当肉身械师阿士诺攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618232.oracleText: {o5}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a tapped 3/3 colorless Zombie artifact creature token.
618232.translation: {o5}，从你的坟墓场放逐一张生物牌：派出一个已横置的3/3无色灵俑衍生神器生物。

618234.oracleText: "Listen, Duck. Gix is everywhere, playing every side. Mishra won't listen . . . but perhaps Urza will."
618234.translation: 「听着，鸭鸭。基克斯势力无处不在，遍布各界。米斯拉听不进去…或许克撒愿听。」

618235.oracleText: When this creature dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, return it to its owner's hand.
618235.translation: 当此生物死去或从战场进入放逐区时，将它移回拥有者手上。

618236.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, return it to its owner's hand."
618236.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得「当此生物死去或从战场进入放逐区时，将它移回拥有者手上。」

618238.oracleText: "Any more giant metal monsters want to try their luck? I'm just getting warmed up!"
618238.translation: 「还有哪个大铁家伙想要来试试运气吗？我这才刚热身呢！」

618239.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Each opponent loses 2 life. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each creature card in your graveyard.
618239.translation: {o5}，{oT}：每位对手各失去2点生命。你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

618241.oracleText: No honor. No glory. No leftovers.
618241.translation: 绝不光彩。绝不光荣。绝不剩余。

618244.oracleText: "Most wise, most thoughtful, most powerful qadir," said the Gixian, "we offer whatever help we may give in your illustrious name."
618244.translation: 「最睿智，最博学，最伟大的族长，」基克斯派教徒说道，「承您盛名，我们会献上您要的任何助力。」

618245.oracleText: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.
618245.translation: 基克斯刺穿信徒思维，吸取经历，获取所知。

618247.oracleText: "Machines feel no fear, no sorrow, no hunger—only glorious purpose, true and pure."
618247.translation: 「机械毫无恐惧，从未伤悲，不知饥渴～眼中只有荣光使命，真诚而纯粹。」

618250.oracleText: With a snap of metal like a strike of lightning, the tide of war shifted in Mishra's favor.
618250.translation: 随着雷鸣般的金属碎裂之声，战局瞬间倒向米斯拉一方。

618252.oracleText: Mishra's nightmares of Phyrexia rang with screams of agony and groans of twisted metal. The sounds stayed with him long after he awoke.
618252.translation: 米斯拉关于非瑞克西亚的梦魇之中，总是充斥着苦痛折磨的尖鸣与金属扭曲的啸响。就算清醒之后，此等声音仍在其脑中萦绕不散。

618253.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact or creature card from it, then choose an artifact or creature card from their graveyard. Exile the chosen cards.
618253.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张神器或生物牌，然后选择其坟墓场中一张神器或生物牌。放逐所选之牌。

618255.oracleText: Scurrying repair bots quietly turned the tide of many battles, patching damaged automatons back into fighting form.
618255.translation: 迅捷维修械能够快速整修受损机械，令其恢复作战能力，从而悄然扭转战局。

618256.oracleText: Return target artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.
618256.translation: 将目标神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。派出一个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618258.oracleText:
"Get the sylex to Urza at any cost. Tell him to fill it with memories of the land."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos
618258.translation:
「把同兆交给克撒，不计代价。叫他在里面装满大地的回忆。」
～阿士诺嘱咐达硌士

618259.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the mana value of target artifact or creature you control. An opponent gains control of that permanent.
618259.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于目标由你操控之神器或生物的法术力值。任一对手获得该永久物的操控权。

618261.oracleText: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to one of your opponents, its controller may pay 1 life. If they do, they draw a card.
618261.translation: 每当一个生物向你的任一对手造成战斗伤害时，其操控者可以支付1点生命。若其如此作，则其抓一张牌。

618262.oracleText: {o4oBoBoB}, Discard X cards: Exile the top X cards of target opponent's library. You may play lands and cast spells from among cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
618262.translation: {o4oBoBoB}，弃X张牌：放逐目标对手牌库顶的X张牌。你可以从以此法放逐的牌之中使用地和施放咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

618264.oracleText: "Show me all the delicious misery you've sown."
618264.translation: 「让我看看你经历的美味伤悲。」

618266.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on up to one creature. It gains lifelink until end of turn.
618266.translation: 在至多一个生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

618267.oracleText: Destroy each creature with power 2 or less.
618267.translation: 消灭所有力量等于或小于2的生物。

618268.oracleText: Return up to two creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
618268.translation: 将至多两张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

618269.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature with the highest power among creatures they control.
618269.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最大者。

618270.oracleText: Choose two — • Put two +1/+1 counters on up to one creature. It gains lifelink until end of turn. • Destroy each creature with power 2 or less. • Return up to two creature cards from your graveyard to your hand. • Each opponent sacrifices a creature with the highest power among creatures they control.
618270.translation: 选择两项～ •  在至多一个生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它获得系命异能直到回合结束。 •  消灭所有力量等于或小于2的生物。 •  将至多两张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。 •  每位对手各牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最大者。

618272.oracleText: "Terisia City's fall is inevitable. My master's plan runs as sure and steady as the oil in my veins."
618272.translation: 「泰瑞西亚城陷落只是时间问题。主人的计划平稳而顺利，正如我血脉中流淌的烁油一般。」

618273.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on Gixian Infiltrator.
618273.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个永久物时，在基克斯派渗透者上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618276.oracleText: To some, desecration. To Gix, decoration.
618276.translation: 对别人来说，这是亵渎圣物。对基克斯来说，这是增效神物。

618277.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
618277.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

618278.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return another target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
618278.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将另一张目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

618279.oracleText: When Gixian Puppeteer dies, return another target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
618279.translation: 当基克斯派控偶师死去时，将另一张目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

618282.oracleText: "With every culling, we bring this world closer to compleation."
618282.translation: 「每杀一人，就令世界离完化更进一步。」

618283.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are three or more creature cards in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
618283.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中有三张或更多生物牌，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618284.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are three or more creature cards in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on Gixian Skullflayer.
618284.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中有三张或更多生物牌，则在基克斯派掠颅客上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618286.oracleText:
"Everyone warns about the sand and the food, but the rats are worse than both put together!"
—Sanwell, letter to his family
618286.translation:
「所有人都提醒我沙暴肆虐、食物糟糕；但老鼠比这两者加起来还要难缠！」
～山威尔家书

618289.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, target creature you don't control gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
618289.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，目标不由你操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

618290.oracleText: When Gnawing Vermin dies, target creature you don't control gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
618290.translation: 当啮食病媒死去时，目标不由你操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

618291.oracleText: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down. Mishra made her people pay for the insult.
618291.translation: 当泰坦尼亚提议收兵时，克撒只不过言辞上加以拒绝。而米斯拉则以行动令她的子民为此等羞辱付出代价。

618293.oracleText: Mishra was gone—all that remained was a machine wearing his face.
618293.translation: 米斯拉已一去不返～剩下的不过是一尊长着相同面庞的机器。

618294.oracleText: Choose one — • You draw two cards and you lose 2 life. • Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn.
618294.translation: 选择一项～ •  你抓两张牌且失去2点生命。 •  由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

618296.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Gurgling Anointer.
618296.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，在骇笑赐圣兽上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618297.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return another target creature card with mana value less than or equal to CARDNAME's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
618297.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将另一张目标法术力值等于或小于CARDNAME力量的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

618298.oracleText: When Gurgling Anointer dies, return another target creature card with mana value less than or equal to Gurgling Anointer's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
618298.translation: 当骇笑赐圣兽死去时，将另一张目标法术力值等于或小于骇笑赐圣兽力量的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

618300.oracleText: Exile the top three cards of your library in a face-down pile, then exile the top three cards of your library in another face-down pile. Look at the cards in each pile, then turn a pile of your choice face up. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard. You lose 3 life.
618300.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的三张牌并牌面朝下地放作一堆，然后放逐你牌库顶的三张牌并牌面朝下地放作另一堆。检视各牌堆的牌，然后选择一堆并将其翻为牌面朝上。由任一对手选择其中的一堆，将该堆牌置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。你失去3点生命。

618302.oracleText: Her circus training proved surprisingly valuable on the battlefield.
618302.translation: 她曾在马戏团中受训，结果证明此等经历在战场上格外有用。

618303.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn.
618303.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则CARDNAME获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

618304.oracleText: Whenever Kill-Zone Acrobat attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, Kill-Zone Acrobat gains flying until end of turn.
618304.translation: 每当交战地带舞者攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则交战地带舞者获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

618306.oracleText: In the ruins of Kroog, only anguish thrived.
618306.translation: 在萼城废墟中，唯有悲痛还不断增长。

618307.oracleText: {o1}: Misery's Shadow gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

618309.oracleText: "Well? What are you waiting for? Let's not keep the buzzards waiting."
618309.translation: 「喂？你还在等什么？别浪费兀鹰时间。」

618310.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+1 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
618310.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+1且获得系命异能。

618312.oracleText: Dying for the cause is overrated.
618312.translation: 英勇赴死只是虚高气节。

618313.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a creature card with mana value 3 or less.
618313.translation: 如果此咒语以法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌为目标，则减少{o3}来施放。

618315.oracleText: Tocasia's face haunted his vision. The explosion still rung in his ears. Mishra kept running and never once looked back.
618315.translation: 他的眼前浮现出托卡西雅的面庞。他的耳边萦绕着隆隆爆炸声响。米斯拉埋头奔行，从未回头。

618316.oracleText: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.
618316.translation: 米斯拉不惜代价想要击败兄长，于是便放任基克斯毁灭自己作最终一搏。

618318.oracleText:
"Move! When the powerstone blows, that behemoth will be nothing but a hole in the ground."
—Ashnod, to Hajar
618318.translation:
「快跑！魔力石一旦爆炸，就连那尊庞然大物都会只剩地面巨坑。」
～阿士诺提醒哈札

618324.oracleText: Glacian built his automatons to last, and last they did, beyond even the Thran themselves.
618324.translation: 格雷贤打造自动机械时，设计寿命颇为长久。而它们也不负所望，甚至在索蓝灭亡之后仍坚守不辍。

618325.oracleText: Whenever one or more artifact and/or creature cards leave your graveyard during your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
618325.translation: 每当一张或数张神器和/或生物牌于你的回合中离开你坟墓场时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618327.oracleText: Urza and Mishra weren't the only denizens of Terisiare to covet the powerstones' energy.
618327.translation: 克撒和米斯拉并非泰瑞西亚大陆上唯一觊觎魔力石能量的生灵。

618328.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Draw a card.
618328.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：抓一张牌。

618330.oracleText: It can hear a panicked heartbeat from a thousand paces away.
618330.translation: 它在千步开外就能听到慌乱心跳。

618331.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, CARDNAME has deathtouch and lifelink.
618331.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，CARDNAME便具有死触异能和系命异能。

618332.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, Trench Stalker has deathtouch and lifelink.
618332.translation: 只要你本回合中已抓两张或更多牌，壕沟伏兽便具有死触异能和系命异能。

618334.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile target card from a graveyard.
618334.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

618335.oracleText: Whenever Ashnod's Harvester attacks, exile target card from a graveyard.
618335.translation: 每当阿士诺的索命械攻击时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

618337.oracleText: Tawnos built his clay statues for durability, not knowing they'd keep fighting long after the war.
618337.translation: 达硌士打造黏土像时，希望它们能经久耐用。但他不知道的是，这些黏土像战后许久仍在奋战。

618339.oracleText: {o2oB}: Return Clay Revenant from your graveyard to your hand.
618339.translation: {o2oB}：将黏土复仇像从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

618341.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has menace.
618341.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有威慑异能。

618345.oracleText: Built to crush walls and wills in equal measure.
618345.translation: 打造时便希冀能一举粉碎壁垒、击垮意志。

618347.oracleText: Ward—Pay life equal to CARDNAME's power.
618347.translation: 守护～支付等同于CARDNAME力量的生命。

618348.oracleText: Ward—Pay life equal to Phyrexian Fleshgorger's power.
618348.translation: 守护～支付等同于非瑞克西亚噬生亚龙力量的生命。

618350.translation: 锐鞭变械人不能进行阻挡。

618351.oracleText: {o4oBoB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. This ability costs {o4} less to activate if an opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
618351.translation: {o4oBoB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。如果任一对手操控四个或更多非基本地，则此异能减少{o4}来起动。

618352.oracleText: {o4oBoB}: Return Razorlash Transmogrant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. This ability costs {o4} less to activate if an opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
618352.translation: {o4oBoB}：将锐鞭变械人从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。如果任一对手操控四个或更多非基本地，则此异能减少{o4}来起动。

618356.oracleText:
"The human body—like any other machine—can be stripped for parts."
—Ashnod
618356.translation:
「人身躯体就跟其他机械一样，能够拆解备用。」
～阿士诺

618358.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Create a 3/3 colorless Zombie artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
618358.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲一个生物：派出一个3/3无色灵俑衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

618360.oracleText: Fallaji soldiers hated seeing loved ones' faces among the transmogrants. Ashnod devised a solution.
618360.translation: 法拉吉士兵厌恶看到变械人长着一副熟人面庞。阿士诺想出了解决办法。

618361.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, draw a card.
618361.translation: 每当佩戴此武具的生物死去时，抓一张牌。

618364.oracleText: "You want it good, fast, or cheap? You can't have all three."
618364.translation: 「你是想要东西性能好、生产快还是成本低？没法三者兼顾。」

618365.oracleText: {o3oR}: You may put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield. That artifact gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
618365.translation: {o3oR}：你可以将一张神器牌从你手上放进战场。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

618367.oracleText: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.
618367.translation: 和平峰会证明，克撒与米斯拉之间的嫌隙只能以流血收场。

618370.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
618370.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

618371.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Bitter Reunion: Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
618371.translation: {o1}，牺牲苦涩重逢：由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

618373.oracleText: The brothers' rivalry escalated into all-out enmity, and Tocasia paid the price.
618373.translation: 兄弟间的对立升级成全面对抗，付出代价的却是托卡西雅。

618374.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
618374.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成3点伤害。

618375.oracleText: Brotherhood's End deals 3 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
618375.translation: 兄弟反目对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成3点伤害。

618376.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts with mana value 3 or less.
618376.translation: 消灭所有法术力值等于或小于3的神器。

618377.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. • Destroy all artifacts with mana value 3 or less.
618377.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成3点伤害。 •  消灭所有法术力值等于或小于3的神器。

618378.oracleText: Choose one — • Brotherhood's End deals 3 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. • Destroy all artifacts with mana value 3 or less.
618378.translation: 选择一项～ •  兄弟反目对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成3点伤害。 •  消灭所有法术力值等于或小于3的神器。

618380.oracleText: "Funny," remarked Laga to his squad. "Mishra's lackeys wear luxurious silks in their gilded palaces, while we toil in the trenches eating stale bread."
618380.translation: 「真有趣。」拉加跟同袍抱怨。「米斯拉的跟班能在镶金宫殿里自在逍遥，我们就得在壕沟里啃馊面包。」

618381.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.
618381.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618382.oracleText: When Conscripted Infantry dies, create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.
618382.translation: 当受征步兵死去时，派出一个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618384.oracleText: {o1}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

618385.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has flying, haste, and "{o1}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn." It's a Dragon in addition to its other types.
618385.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1，且具有飞行、敏捷与「{o1}：此生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。」它额外具有龙此类别。

618386.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return Draconic Destiny to its owner's hand.
618386.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将化龙命运移回其拥有者手上。

618389.oracleText: Urza's engineers could take weeks to dig out a powerstone. The goblins weren't so painstaking.
618389.translation: 克撒的工程师往往要花上数星期才能挖出一枚魔力石。鬼怪就没有这么磨蹭。

618390.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. Create a tapped Powerstone token.
618390.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618391.oracleText: Excavation Explosion deals 3 damage to any target. Create a tapped Powerstone token.
618391.translation: 掘古爆破对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618393.oracleText: As retaliation for the Warlord's ambush at the peace summit, Mishra leveled Yotia's capital city.
618393.translation: 为报复大领主在和平峰会上的突袭，米斯拉将佑天首都夷为平地。

618394.oracleText: Choose target opponent. Destroy target land that player controls. CARDNAME deals 3 damage to that player and 1 damage to each creature they control.
618394.translation: 选择目标对手。消灭目标由该牌手操控的地。CARDNAME对该牌手造成3点伤害，且对每个由其操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

618395.oracleText: Choose target opponent. Destroy target land that player controls. The Fall of Kroog deals 3 damage to that player and 1 damage to each creature they control.
618395.translation: 选择目标对手。消灭目标由该牌手操控的地。萼城陷落对该牌手造成3点伤害，且对每个由其操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

618397.oracleText: She was eager to show the invading Yotians how she earned her nickname, "The Sandstorm of Tomakul."
618397.translation: 她迫不及待地想要向佑天侵略者展示自己「托玛库沙暴」外号的由来。

618398.oracleText: {o2}: CARDNAME gains double strike until end of turn.
618398.translation: {o2}：CARDNAME获得连击异能直到回合结束。

618399.oracleText: {o2}: Fallaji Chaindancer gains double strike until end of turn.
618399.translation: {o2}：法拉吉舞链兵获得连击异能直到回合结束。

618401.translation: 若纳掘古师费顿不能进行阻挡。

618402.oracleText: Whenever Feldon is dealt damage, exile that many cards from the top of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
618402.translation: 每当费顿受到伤害时，从你牌库顶放逐等量的牌。选择其中一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

618404.oracleText:
"Don't excavate too far into those canyons. I promised your parents I'd return you in one piece."
—Tocasia
618404.translation:
「不要在这峡谷中挖得太深。我答应过你们父母会将你们安全送回。」
～托卡西雅

618406.oracleText: Most goblins can light a fuse and run, but only the cleverest remember to drop the bomb.
618406.translation: 大多数鬼怪都会点燃引信后带着炸弹跑，但只有聪明的记得要把炸弹丢出去。

618407.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 and has menace as long as you sacrificed a permanent this turn.
618407.translation: 只要你本回合中牺牲过永久物，CARDNAME便得+2/+0且具有威慑异能。

618408.oracleText: Goblin Blast-Runner gets +2/+0 and has menace as long as you sacrificed a permanent this turn.
618408.translation: 只要你本回合中牺牲过永久物，运弹鬼怪便得+2/+0且具有威慑异能。

618411.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, sacrifice a Powerstone.
618411.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，牺牲一个魔力石。

618412.oracleText: When Horned Stoneseeker leaves the battlefield, sacrifice a Powerstone.
618412.translation: 当寻石角蜥离开战场时，牺牲一个魔力石。

618414.oracleText: First the automatons reinforced depleted squads. Then they replaced them entirely.
618414.translation: 一开始只是用自动机械来为减员部队补充战力。之后便全面取而代之。

618415.oracleText: If a red or artifact source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 1 instead.
618415.translation: 如果某个由你操控的红色或神器来源将向任一对手或任一由对手操控的永久物造成伤害，则改为它造成原数量加1点伤害。

618417.oracleText: While Urza read books, Mishra learned to read the desert itself.
618417.translation: 当克撒在研读书本时，米斯拉学着去研读沙漠本身。

618418.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Discard a card: Draw a card.

618419.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more artifact cards, add {oRoR}. This ability triggers only once each turn.
618419.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张神器牌时，加{oRoR}。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

618421.oracleText: Choose target player. They may discard up to X cards. Then they draw a card for each card discarded this way.
618421.translation: 选择目标牌手。其可以弃至多X张牌。然后每以此法弃掉一张牌，其便抓一张牌。

618422.oracleText: This spell deals X damage to target creature.
618422.translation: 此咒语对目标生物造成X点伤害。

618423.oracleText: This spell deals X damage to target planeswalker.
618423.translation: 此咒语对目标鹏洛客造成X点伤害。

618424.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+0 and gains haste until end of turn.
618424.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+X/+0且获得敏捷异能。

618425.oracleText: Choose two — • Choose target player. They may discard up to X cards. Then they draw a card for each card discarded this way. • This spell deals X damage to target creature. • This spell deals X damage to target planeswalker. • Target creature gets +X/+0 and gains haste until end of turn.
618425.translation: 选择两项～ •  选择目标牌手。其可以弃至多X张牌。然后每以此法弃掉一张牌，其便抓一张牌。 •  此咒语对目标生物造成X点伤害。 •  此咒语对目标鹏洛客造成X点伤害。 •  直到回合结束，目标生物得+X/+0且获得敏捷异能。

618427.oracleText: Power radiated from the Weakstone, binding the dragon engine to Mishra's command.
618427.translation: 从弱能石中散发出来的力量，让龙形引擎屈身听从米斯拉号令。

618428.oracleText: As long as you control enchanted creature, it gets +2/+2. Otherwise, it can't block.
618428.translation: 只要你操控所结附的生物，它便得+2/+2。若否，则它不能进行阻挡。

618430.oracleText:
"Hah. Urza has underestimated my strength yet again."
—Mishra
618430.translation:
「哈。克撒又低估了我的力量。」
～米斯拉

618431.oracleText: Create two 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature tokens.
618431.translation: 派出两个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618432.oracleText: Choose one — • Create two 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature tokens. • Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
618432.translation: 选择一项～ •  派出两个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。 •  由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。

618433.oracleText: She focused her mind on the volcano's fury, and hers erupted in kind.
618433.translation: 她将精神全数专注在火山怒火上，并爆发同等烈焰回报。

618435.oracleText: In desperation, Pero called on his memory of a lightning storm that nearly killed his family. When he opened his eyes, only smoke and dust remained.
618435.translation: 在绝望之中，佩洛脑海中回忆起那场险些令其家人丧命的闪电风暴。等他睁开眼后，周身仅余乌烟飘尘。

618436.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
618436.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

618437.oracleText: Obliterating Bolt deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
618437.translation: 抹灭击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

618439.oracleText: Each player reveals a number of cards from the top of their library equal to the number of nonland permanents they control, puts all permanent cards they revealed this way onto the battlefield, and puts the rest into their graveyard.
618439.translation: 每位牌手各进行以下流程～展示其牌库顶若干牌，其数量等同于由其操控的非地永久物数量，将所有以此法展示出的永久物牌放进战场，其余则置入其坟墓场。

618441.oracleText: His child-lifting act was second only to his cauldron-punting routine.
618441.translation: 他的负孩举重秀相当精彩，仅次于铁锅大脚踢的好戏。

618442.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an artifact: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn and deals 1 damage to each opponent.
618442.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个神器：CARDNAME得+1+1直到回合结束。且向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

618443.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an artifact: Penregon Strongbull gets +1/+1 until end of turn and deals 1 damage to each opponent.
618443.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个神器：潘瑞冈蛮生得+1+1直到回合结束。且向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

618445.oracleText: Only the quartermaster wept for their loss.
618445.translation: 只有军需官为损失落泪。

618446.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target. Draw a card.
618446.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲生物的力量。抓一张牌。

618447.oracleText: Pyrrhic Blast deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target. Draw a card.
618447.translation: 成仁冲击波对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲生物的力量。抓一张牌。

618449.oracleText: First one, then a second, then a third of the ivory towers fell to the invaders, who moved in a circle around the city like an apocalyptic clock.
618449.translation: 象牙塔一座座接二连三地倾倒，敌兵攻势绕着环形的城墙走，一站站推动末日钟的指针。

618450.oracleText: Destroy target artifact. If its mana value was 1 or less, draw a card.
618450.translation: 消灭目标神器。如果其法术力值等于或小于1，则抓一张牌。

618452.oracleText: "Never track the roc itself with your eyes, for it will swoop with the sun at its back and blind you. Instead, track its shadow and, when it's almost upon you, heave your javelin upward with all your might."
618452.translation: 「洛克鸟会背对太阳俯冲袭击，借助阳光遮蔽你的双眼，因此千万不要用眼睛直接盯它的位置。而是要凭它的影子来判断，等到快落到你头上时，就使劲全力把你手中长矛往头上扔。」

618455.oracleText: When Urza betrayed the Sardian dwarves, they called upon the might of their neighbors for aid.
618455.translation: 当沙地亚矮人遭克撒背叛后，他们便向友邻之力求助。

618456.oracleText: As long as it's your turn and you control four or more Mountains, CARDNAME gets +X/+0, where X is the number of Mountains you control.
618456.translation: 只要是在你的回合中且你操控四个或更多山脉，CARDNAME便得+X/+0，X为由你操控的山脉数量。

618457.oracleText: As long as it's your turn and you control four or more Mountains, Sardian Cliffstomper gets +X/+0, where X is the number of Mountains you control.
618457.translation: 只要是在你的回合中且你操控四个或更多山脉，沙地亚跺崖兵便得+X/+0，X为由你操控的山脉数量。

618459.oracleText: Gain control of target artifact or creature until end of turn. Untap it. It gains haste until end of turn. Create a tapped Powerstone token.
618459.translation: 获得目标神器或生物的操控权直到回合结束。将之重置。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618464.oracleText: In war, dragons don't see sides, just side dishes.
618464.translation: 战时，巨龙不挑边，只挑菜。

618466.oracleText: {oR}: Tyrant of Kher Ridges gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
618466.translation: {oR}：喀尔山脊暴君得+1/+0直到回合结束。

618468.oracleText: The new cannon's destructive power more than made up for its unpredictable blast radius.
618468.translation: 新式火炮的毁灭威力，大大弥补了它爆破范围不可预测的缺陷。

618469.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker and 2 damage to that permanent's controller.
618469.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害，且对该永久物的操控者造成2点伤害。

618470.oracleText: Unleash Shell deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker and 2 damage to that permanent's controller.
618470.translation: 猛烈开火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害，且对该永久物的操控者造成2点伤害。

618472.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't play a card from exile this turn, create a tapped Powerstone token.
618472.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从放逐区使用过牌，则派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618474.oracleText:
"I will trust desert steel in Fallaji hands over a soulless machine any day."
—Hajar, Mishra's bodyguard
618474.translation:
「我总觉得法拉吉人打造的沙漠兵器比毫无灵魂的机器更可靠。」
～米斯拉的保镖哈札

618475.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+0 and gains first strike and trample until end of turn.
618475.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得先攻与践踏异能。

618477.oracleText: While Urza's machines favored defense, Mishra built his to end the war quickly.
618477.translation: 克撒建造机械时更注重其防御性能，而米斯拉打造的机械则胜于快速结束战斗。

618479.oracleText: {o2}: Fallaji Dragon Engine gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
618479.translation: {o2}：法拉吉龙形引擎得+1/+0直到回合结束。

618481.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, tap CARDNAME unless you pay {o3}.
618481.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你支付{o3}，否则横置CARDNAME。
