618482.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, tap Heavyweight Demolisher unless you pay {o3}.
618482.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你支付{o3}，否则横置重型毁灭械。

618485.oracleText: Mishra's Juggernaut attacks each combat if able.
618485.translation: 米斯拉的攻城巨车每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

618488.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
618488.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。选择其中一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

618489.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Mishra's Research Desk: Exile the top two cards of your library. Choose one of them. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
618489.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲米斯拉的书案：放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。选择其中一张。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

618495.translation: 非瑞克西亚臣民米斯拉

618497.oracleText: Mishra deals 3 damage to any target.
618497.translation: 米斯拉对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

618498.oracleText: Mishra deals 3 damage to any target.
618498.translation: 米斯拉对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

618499.translation: 消灭目标神器或鹏洛客。

618500.translation: 消灭目标神器或鹏洛客。

618501.oracleText: Creatures you control gain menace and trample until end of turn.
618501.translation: 由你操控的生物获得威慑与践踏异能直到回合结束。

618502.oracleText: Creatures you control gain menace and trample until end of turn.
618502.translation: 由你操控的生物获得威慑与践踏异能直到回合结束。

618503.translation: 派出两个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618504.translation: 派出两个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618513.oracleText: "This metal belonged to Argoth before it was ripped from the ground. Now it belongs to Argoth again."
618513.translation: 「这金属在被从地里掘出之前，原本就属于亚格斯。现在它又重归亚格斯怀抱。」

618514.oracleText: {o2oG}: Until end of turn, target noncreature artifact you control becomes a 4/4 artifact creature.
618514.translation: {o2oG}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的非生物神器成为4/4神器生物。

618516.translation: 「自然会自我适应。我们也应当如此。」

618519.oracleText:
"Make the exhaust vents smaller next time!"
—Urza, notes to his engineers
618519.translation:
「下次把排气口造小一点！」
～克撒，给工程师的批注

618520.oracleText: Argothian Sprite can't be blocked by artifact creatures.
618520.translation: 亚格斯仙子不能被神器生物阻挡。

618522.oracleText: {o7}: Put two +1/+1 counters on Argothian Sprite.
618522.translation: {o7}：在亚格斯仙子上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

618525.oracleText: When Audacity is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.
618525.translation: 当勇猛无畏从战场进入坟墓场时，抓一张牌。

618527.oracleText:
"We expected the Argothians to stand their ground. We didn't expect the ground itself to stand."
—Myrel, Shield of Argive
618527.translation:
「我们料到了亚格斯人会固守大地，但没料中大地自己起身固守。」
～阿基夫之盾穆雷尔

618528.oracleText: Create X 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature tokens. (They're affected by summoning sickness.)
618528.translation: 派出X个1/1绿色树林／树灵衍生地生物。（它们受召唤失调影响。）

618529.oracleText: Some armor is forged, some is forested.
618529.translation: 有些盔甲乃是金属铸就，而有些则是林木织就。

618534.oracleText:
"That's odd. I don't remember seeing plans to dig a trench near here."
—Lognell, Argivian scout
618534.translation:
「奇怪。我记得没准备在这挖壕沟啊。」
～阿基夫斥候罗格聂

618535.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, mill four cards.

618536.oracleText: When Burrowing Razormaw dies, mill four cards.
618536.translation: 当掘地锐吼兽死去时，磨四张牌。

618538.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
618538.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

618539.oracleText: Choose one — • Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. • Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.
618539.translation: 选择一项～ •  从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。 •  目标由你操控的生物与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

618542.oracleText: The endless grind of the Brothers' War had fouled Terisiare's land and blackened its skies. Argoth's defenders were determined to protect their isle from the same fate.
618542.translation: 兄弟之战不断延烧，令泰瑞西亚土地枯萎、天色蒙灰。亚格斯守护者决意保护自己的岛屿，以免落入同样境地。

618543.oracleText: {oT}, Tap an untapped artifact or creature you control: Add one mana of any color.
618543.translation: {oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器或生物：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

618544.oracleText:
"You've let yourself grow old, and your light is dimming. Shall we talk one last time, or must I slay you now?"
—Mishra, to Urza
618544.translation:
「你让你自己衰老得太快啦，所以你的光减弱了。我们该好好谈这最后一次呢，还是我现在就杀了你？」
～米斯拉嘲笑克撒

618546.oracleText: After a long hibernation, Argoth began slowly recovering from the ravages of war.
618546.translation: 经过漫长的冬眠之后，亚格斯才开始从战事疮痍中缓慢复苏。

618547.oracleText: Each player who controls an artifact or enchantment creates a 2/2 green Bear creature token. Then destroy all artifacts and enchantments.
618547.translation: 每位操控神器或结界的牌手各派出一个2/2绿色的熊衍生生物。然后消灭所有神器和结界。

618549.oracleText: Few relics excited Fallaji archaeologists more than Thran powerstones, which they called "eyes of the Old Ones."
618549.translation: 法拉吉考古学家从没遇到过像索蓝魔力石这样令他们欣喜若狂的遗宝。他们把这东西叫作「先贤之眼」。

618550.oracleText: Create three tapped Powerstone tokens. You gain 3 life.
618550.translation: 派出三个已横置的魔力石衍生物。你获得3点生命。

618551.oracleText: "I call on both predators and protectors, for now is a season of war."
618551.translation: 「所有猎食者与保护者都听我号令，如今战事将至。」

618553.oracleText: So thick was the fog on Argoth's shores that the brothers' forces passed within shouting distance of each other without realizing it.
618553.translation: 亚格斯沿岸的浓雾异常厚重，让两兄弟的部队在其中相向而行都未能察觉对方。

618554.oracleText: You gain 1 life for each creature on the battlefield. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures with power 3 or less.
618554.translation: 战场上每有一个生物，你便获得1点生命。于本回合中，防止力量等于或小于3的生物将造成之所有战斗伤害。

618556.oracleText: "Even the leaves oppose your being here. What hope have you against nature's might?"
618556.translation: 「就连树叶也反对你的到来。你又拿什么来跟自然之力作对？」

618557.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if there are three or more creature cards in your graveyard, draw a card.
618557.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你坟墓场中有三张或更多生物牌，则抓一张牌。

618558.oracleText: Whenever Gaea's Courser attacks, if there are three or more creature cards in your graveyard, draw a card.
618558.translation: 每当盖亚的骏马攻击时，若你坟墓场中有三张或更多生物牌，则抓一张牌。

618560.oracleText: When it came to fighting an army of trees, even Mishra's best generals were stumped.
618560.translation: 当要与树木大军作战时，就连米斯拉最优秀的将领都一筹莫展。

618561.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains reach, trample, hexproof, and indestructible until end of turn.
618561.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得延势、践踏、辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

618562.oracleText:
"Imagine being scared of pixies. Just smoosh them under your boot!"
—Kerish, Urzan mechanist
618562.translation:
「就想象一下你被碧仙吓到的时候。直接抬脚把他们踩扁！」
～克撒军机械师凯瑞许

618564.oracleText: The flames of war consumed most of Argoth's treefolk. Vengeance consumed the rest.
618564.translation: 亚格斯的树灵大多数都遭战争火焰吞噬。幸存的则被复仇怒火吞噬。

618569.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with power 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and untap it.
618569.translation: 每当你施放力量等于或大于5的生物咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物并重置它。

618570.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with power 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on Gwenna, Eyes of Gaea and untap it.
618570.translation: 每当你施放力量等于或大于5的生物咒语时，在盖亚之眼关娜上放置一个+1/+1指示物并重置它。

618572.oracleText: To the spiders of Argoth, thopters were just bigger, crunchier flies.
618572.translation: 对亚格斯的蜘蛛来说，扑翼机不过只是更大、更脆的苍蝇罢了。

618573.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put up to one other target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
618573.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将至多另一张目标牌从坟墓场置于其拥有者的牌库底。

618574.oracleText: When Hoarding Recluse dies, put up to one other target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
618574.translation: 当贮宝遁蛛死去时，将至多另一张目标牌从坟墓场置于其拥有者的牌库底。

618576.oracleText: The Fallaji quickly learned that the Kher Ridges held too many caves and valleys to be surveyed from the air alone.
618576.translation: 法拉吉人很快就发现，喀尔山脊洞窟密布、峡谷错落，单从空中无法侦察全貌。

618580.oracleText: "This metal junk is ugly, but it's got its uses."
618580.translation: 「这金属垃圾虽然丑陋，但也不是毫无用处。」

618583.oracleText: Gwenna stayed her hand only once, to save young Harbin's life—a mistake she would never repeat.
618583.translation: 关娜曾经为救年轻哈宾一命而没有痛下杀手～这错误她永远不会再犯第二次。

618584.oracleText: Exile target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
618584.translation: 放逐目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。

618586.oracleText: While his master tried to surpass nature, Tawnos aimed to capture its beauty.
618586.translation: 他的师傅试图超越自然，达硌士则致力于捕捉自然之美。

618587.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target artifact, creature, or land you control. Untap that permanent. If it isn't a creature, it becomes a 0/0 creature in addition to its other types.
618587.translation: 在目标由你操控的神器、生物或地上放置两个+1/+1指示物。重置该永久物。如果它不是生物，则它成为0/0生物，且仍具有原本类别。

618589.oracleText: CARDNAME has deathtouch as long as you control three or more artifacts.
618589.translation: 只要你操控三个或更多神器，CARDNAME便具有死触异能。

618590.oracleText: Teething Wurmlet has deathtouch as long as you control three or more artifacts.
618590.translation: 只要你操控三个或更多神器，初牙幼龙便具有死触异能。

618594.oracleText: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, you gain 2 life.
618594.translation: 每当一张或数张地牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场时，你获得2点生命。

618595.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are four or more land cards in your graveyard and you both own and control CARDNAME and a land named Argoth, Sanctum of Nature, exile them, then meld them into Titania, Gaea Incarnate.
618595.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多地牌，且你同时拥有并操控CARDNAME和一个名称为自然圣所亚格斯的地，则放逐后两者，然后将它们融合为盖亚化身泰坦尼亚。

618596.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are four or more land cards in your graveyard and you both own and control Titania, Voice of Gaea and a land named Argoth, Sanctum of Nature, exile them, then meld them into Titania, Gaea Incarnate.
618596.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多地牌，且你同时拥有并操控盖亚之声泰坦尼亚和一个名称为自然圣所亚格斯的地，则放逐后两者，然后将它们融合为盖亚化身泰坦尼亚。

618598.oracleText: Exile target player's graveyard. You gain 1 life for each card exiled this way.
618598.translation: 放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。每以此法放逐一张牌，你便获得1点生命。

618599.oracleText: Search your library for up to two land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
618599.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻至多两张地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

618600.oracleText: Create two 2/2 green Bear creature tokens.
618600.translation: 派出两个2/2绿色的熊衍生生物。

618601.oracleText: Choose two — • Exile target player's graveyard. You gain 1 life for each card exiled this way. • Search your library for up to two land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. • Create two 2/2 green Bear creature tokens. • Put two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
618601.translation: 选择两项～•  放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。每以此法放逐一张牌，你便获得1点生命。 •  从你牌库中搜寻至多两张地牌，将它们横置放进战场，然后洗牌。 •  派出两个2/2绿色的熊衍生生物。 •  在每个由你操控的生物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。

618603.oracleText: In the Great Desert, one law is enforced over all others: water belongs to all.
618603.translation: 在大沙漠有条至高无上的法律：水源共有。

618605.oracleText: Once the brothers discovered the pristine island of Argoth, the war came down to who could plunder it faster.
618605.translation: 当两兄弟发现亚格斯岛这片净土之后，战事就变成谁能抢得更快。

618606.oracleText: Mill five cards. You may put a permanent card from among the cards milled this way into your hand.
618606.translation: 磨五张牌，你可以将以此法磨掉的一张永久物牌置于你手上。

618608.oracleText:
"Artifice is not the only form of creation."
—Titania
618608.translation:
「打造奇械并非创造的唯一方式。」
～泰坦尼亚

618611.oracleText: A thousand years of growth, harvested in minutes.
618611.translation: 成长经千年，分秒收割净。

618612.oracleText: {oT}: Add an amount of {oG} equal to Cradle Clearcutter's power.
618612.translation: {oT}：加若干{oG}，其数量等同于育苗地皆伐械的力量。

618614.oracleText:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer
618614.translation:
「它们虽然很容易碾碎，但从工作台上清干净很麻烦。」
～鬼怪爆炸家特格尔

618615.oracleText: When Haywire Mite dies, you gain 2 life.
618615.translation: 当失控虫械死去时，你获得2点生命。

618616.oracleText: {oG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile target noncreature artifact or noncreature enchantment.
618616.translation: {oG}，牺牲CARDNAME：放逐目标非生物神器或非生物结界。

618617.oracleText: {oG}, Sacrifice Haywire Mite: Exile target noncreature artifact or noncreature enchantment.
618617.translation: {oG}，牺牲失控虫械：放逐目标非生物神器或非生物结界。

618619.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target attacking creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
618619.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

618620.oracleText: Whenever Iron-Craw Crusher attacks, target attacking creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is Iron-Craw Crusher's power.
618620.translation: 每当铁爪轧龙攻击时，目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为铁爪轧龙的力量。

618622.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create an X/X colorless Golem artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
618622.translation: {oX}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个X/X无色魔像衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

618623.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Sacrifice Mask of the Jadecrafter: Create an X/X colorless Golem artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
618623.translation: {oX}，{oT}，牺牲雕玉匠面具：派出一个X/X无色魔像衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

618628.oracleText: {o3oGoG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create an X/X colorless Golem artifact creature token, where X is three times CARDNAME's power. It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
618628.translation: {o3oGoG}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个X/X无色魔像衍生神器生物，X为CARDNAME力量的三倍。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

618629.oracleText: {o3oGoG}, Sacrifice Rootwire Amalgam: Create an X/X colorless Golem artifact creature token, where X is three times Rootwire Amalgam's power. It gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
618629.translation: {o3oGoG}，牺牲根缆拼合械：派出一个X/X无色魔像衍生神器生物，X为根缆拼合械力量的三倍。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

618631.oracleText:
"You know those seedpods cluttering the eastern approach? I've got an idea . . . ."
—Calle, Urzan sergeant
618631.translation:
「还记得堆在东线的那些育苗舱吗？我想到个主意。…」
～克撒军士官凯勒

618637.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
618637.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

618638.oracleText: Arbalest Engineers deals 1 damage to any target.
618638.translation: 弩械工程师对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

618639.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains trample and haste until end of turn.
618639.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

618640.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains trample and haste until end of turn.
618640.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

618641.translation: 派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618646.oracleText: Creatures you control have "{oT}: Add {oC}. This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell."
618646.translation: 由你操控的生物具有「{oT}：加{oC}。此法术力不能用来施放非神器咒语。」

618647.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact spell with mana value 6 or greater, draw a card.
618647.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于6的神器咒语时，抓一张牌。

618649.oracleText: Each fallen friend was a seed of regret, eager to blossom again in Gaea's name.
618649.translation: 每位丧命亲友均是悔恨之种，期望能以盖亚之名再度绽放。

618650.oracleText: {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
618650.translation: {oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

618652.oracleText: "Forge the future in metal and oil!"

618654.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and has menace.
618654.translation: 只要你本回合已抓两张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+0且具有威慑异能。

618655.oracleText: As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, Evangel of Synthesis gets +1/+0 and has menace.
618655.translation: 只要你本回合已抓两张或更多牌，合成福音师便得+1/+0且具有威慑异能。

618657.oracleText: "The Burnished Banner will show the Warlord that the Suwwardi Marches belong to the Fallaji!"
618657.translation: 「铮旗军定会让大领主明白，苏瓦地岭属于法拉吉！」

618661.oracleText: "I've stood by Mishra's side from the beginning. I will not abandon him now."
618661.translation: 「我从最开始就伴随米斯拉左右。现在也不会弃他而去。」

618662.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Legendary creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible until end of turn.
618662.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：直到回合结束，由你操控的传奇生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

618663.oracleText: Sacrifice Hajar, Loyal Bodyguard: Legendary creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible until end of turn.
618663.translation: 牺牲忠诚保镖哈札：直到回合结束，由你操控的传奇生物得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

618665.oracleText: "Yotia is my birthright, father. Let me fight for it."
618665.translation: 「父亲，佑天是生我养我之地。请让我为它而战。」

618666.oracleText: Whenever you attack with five or more Soldiers, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain flying until end of turn.
618666.translation: 每当你以五个或更多士兵攻击时，直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得飞行异能。

618668.oracleText: History forgot her name but not her victories.
618668.translation: 姓名未留青史，战绩流芳百世。

618671.oracleText: Creatures you control with mana value 3 or less get +1/+0.
618671.translation: 由你操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物得+1/+0。

618674.oracleText: {o1oBoR}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Until end of turn, other creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain menace and haste.
618674.translation: {o1oBoR}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+0且获得威慑与敏捷异能。

618676.oracleText:
"For the love of the seven brass gods, it's a city of academics! How are they doing this?"
—Sharaman, Urzan lieutenant
618676.translation:
「黄铜七神在上，这可是座学术之城！他们怎么下得了手？」
～克撒军副官沙勒曼

618677.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls and all tokens that player controls with the same name as that permanent.
618677.translation: 放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物和所有由该牌手操控且与该永久物同名的衍生物。

618683.oracleText: Permanents you control have "Ward—Sacrifice a permanent."
618683.translation: 由你操控的永久物具有「守护～牺牲一个永久物。」

618684.oracleText: Each artifact card in your graveyard has unearth {o1oBoR}.
618684.translation: 你坟墓场中的每张神器牌均具有破坟{o1oBoR}。

618686.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Discard all the cards in your hand, then draw that many cards. You may choose an artifact or creature card with mana value 1 you discarded this way, then do the same for artifact or creature cards with mana values 2 and 3. Return those cards to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
618686.translation: {o4}，{oT}：弃掉你的手牌，然后抓等量的牌。你可以选择一张以此法弃掉且法术力值为1的神器或生物牌，然后对法术力值为2和3的神器或生物牌执行同样的流程。将这些牌移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

618688.oracleText: Scry 1. You may tap an untapped artifact you control. If you do, draw a card.
618688.translation: 占卜1。你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

618689.oracleText: Create two 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying. They gain haste until end of turn.
618689.translation: 派出两个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

618690.translation: 由你操控的神器生物得+1/+1。

618691.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Artifact creatures you control get +1/+1" and "Artifact spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast."
618691.translation: 你获得具以下异能的徽记～「由你操控的神器生物得+1/+1」与「你施放的神器咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

618693.oracleText: It felt the rumblings of war and uncoiled itself from the depths of the world.
618693.translation: 它感受到了战争的隆响，于是便从世界深处舒展现身。

618698.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may gain 1 life for each creature card in your graveyard. If you do, exile CARDNAME from your graveyard.
618698.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以获得等同于你坟墓场中生物牌数量的生命。若你如此作，则从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME。

618699.oracleText: When Skyfisher Spider dies, you may gain 1 life for each creature card in your graveyard. If you do, exile Skyfisher Spider from your graveyard.
618699.translation: 当捕空蜘蛛死去时，你可以获得等同于你坟墓场中生物牌数量的生命。若你如此作，则从你的坟墓场放逐捕空蜘蛛。

618701.oracleText: "Don't thank me. Thank nature for its wondrous designs!"
618701.translation: 「不用谢我。要谢就谢自然的造物天工！」

618702.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Beast or Bird creature spell, you may copy it, except the copy is an artifact in addition to its other types.
618702.translation: 每当你施放野兽或鸟生物咒语时，你可以将其复制，但该复制品额外具有神器此类别。

618703.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Beast or Bird creature spell, you may copy it, except the copy is an artifact in addition to its other types. (The copy becomes a token.)
618703.translation: 每当你施放野兽或鸟生物咒语时，你可以将其复制，但该复制品额外具有神器此类别。（所成之复制品会成为衍生物。）

618705.oracleText: "When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail. I merely propose expanding our toolbox."
618705.translation: 「如果你手上只有锤子，那所有东西都只会看着像钉子。我只是建议工具箱里多备点其他器具。」

618706.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature token.
618706.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，派出一个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618708.oracleText: Creatures you control have vigilance and "{oT}: Surveil 1."
618708.translation: 由你操控的生物具有警戒与「{oT}：刺探1。」

618709.oracleText: {o2oGoGoWoWoUoU}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Return any number of target artifact cards with total mana value 10 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
618709.translation: {o2oGoGoWoWoUoU}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：将任意数量的目标神器牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于10。只能于法术时机起动。

618710.oracleText: {o2oGoGoWoWoUoU}, Exile Tocasia, Dig Site Mentor from your graveyard: Return any number of target artifact cards with total mana value 10 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
618710.translation: {o2oGoGoWoWoUoU}，从你的坟墓场放逐挖掘导师托卡西雅：将任意数量的目标神器牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于10。只能于法术时机起动。

618712.oracleText: Artifact, instant, and sorcery spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
618712.translation: 你施放的神器、瞬间与法术咒语减少{o1}来施放。

618713.oracleText: {o7}: If you both own and control CARDNAME and an artifact named The Mightstone and Weakstone, exile them, then meld them into Urza, Planeswalker. Activate only as a sorcery.
618713.translation: {o7}：如果你同时拥有并操控CARDNAME和一个名称为强能石与弱能石的神器，则放逐它们，然后将它们融合为鹏洛客克撒。只能于法术时机起动。

618714.oracleText: {o7}: If you both own and control Urza, Lord Protector and an artifact named The Mightstone and Weakstone, exile them, then meld them into Urza, Planeswalker. Activate only as a sorcery.
618714.translation: {o7}：如果你同时拥有并操控护国勋爵克撒和一个名称为强能石与弱能石的神器，则放逐它们，然后将它们融合为鹏洛客克撒。只能于法术时机起动。

618716.oracleText: The prince consort was happy to let Yotia's coffers fund his extravagant research.
618716.translation: 亲王很高兴能动用佑天国库来继续他的奢华研究。

618717.oracleText: {o6}: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact you control, except it's a 1/1 Soldier creature in addition to its other types.
618717.translation: {o6}：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的神器之复制品，但它是1/1士兵生物，且仍具有原本类别。

618719.oracleText: "I joined this war to protect my homeland, not to destroy someone else's."
618719.translation: 「我参战是为了保卫自己的家园，而不是要破坏别人的。」

618722.oracleText: "Time for the Iron Alliance to remind the qadir's army how inhospitable the Sword Marches can be."
618722.translation: 「就让我们钢铁盟来向族长军队提醒一下，梭地岭有多险恶。」

618736.oracleText: Volunteers rarely questioned why the airborne battalion always seemed to be recruiting.
618736.translation: 志愿兵几乎从没问过空战营为什么总在募员。

618738.oracleText: Unable to settle on just one versatile being, Urza decided to create myriad adaptable machines.
618738.translation: 克撒不满足于只有一台多用途机械，决定要造出一支自适应大军。

618739.oracleText: {o1}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME gets -1/-1 and gains your choice of flying, vigilance, deathtouch, or haste.
618739.translation: {o1}：选择飞行，警戒，死触或敏捷。直到回合结束，CARDNAME得-1/-1且获得该异能。

618740.oracleText: {o1}: Until end of turn, Argivian Avenger gets -1/-1 and gains your choice of flying, vigilance, deathtouch, or haste.
618740.translation: {o1}：选择飞行，警戒，死触或敏捷。直到回合结束，阿基夫复仇者得-1/-1且获得该异能。

618742.oracleText: When you cast this spell and whenever CARDNAME attacks, destroy up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a tapped Powerstone token.
618742.translation: 当你施放此咒语和每当CARDNAME攻击时，消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618743.oracleText: When you cast this spell and whenever Cityscape Leveler attacks, destroy up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a tapped Powerstone token.
618743.translation: 当你施放此咒语和每当夷城械攻击时，消灭至多一个目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618746.translation:
「原始能量蕴含无限可能。」
～克撒

618749.oracleText:
"And if this works, Tawnos is gonna let us build the full-sized version!"
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer
618749.translation:
「如果这个管用的话，达硌士就会允许我们造原寸版！」
～鬼怪爆炸家特格尔

618750.oracleText: {o7}, {oT}, Sacrifice Goblin Firebomb: Destroy target permanent.
618750.translation: {o7}，{oT}，牺牲鬼怪火焰弹：消灭目标永久物。

618752.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Levitating Statue.
618752.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在悬浮雕像上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618753.oracleText: {o2}: CARDNAME becomes a 1/1 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
618753.translation: {o2}：CARDNAME成为1/1组构体神器生物直到回合结束。

618754.oracleText: {o2}: Levitating Statue becomes a 1/1 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
618754.translation: {o2}：悬浮雕像成为1/1组构体神器生物直到回合结束。

618756.oracleText: You may cast colorless spells and artifact spells as though they had flash.
618756.translation: 你可以将无色咒语和神器咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

618757.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if the amount of mana spent to cast that spell is greater than CARDNAME's power, put a +1/+1 counter on Liberator.
618757.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量大于CARDNAME之力量，则在解放者号上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618758.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if the amount of mana spent to cast that spell is greater than Liberator, Urza's Battlethopter's power, put a +1/+1 counter on Liberator.
618758.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若施放该咒语时所支付的法术力数量大于克撒战翼机解放者号之力量，则在解放者号上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

618760.oracleText: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.
618760.translation: 目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。

618763.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oCoC}. This mana can't be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
618763.translation: {oT}：加{oCoC}。此法术力不能用来施放非神器咒语。

618766.oracleText: You may activate the loyalty abilities of CARDNAME twice each turn rather than only once.
618766.translation: 你每回合可以起动CARDNAME的忠诚异能两次，而不是只能起动一次。

618767.oracleText: You may activate the loyalty abilities of Urza, Planeswalker twice each turn rather than only once.
618767.translation: 你每回合可以起动鹏洛客克撒的忠诚异能两次，而不是只能起动一次。

618768.oracleText: Artifact, instant, and sorcery spells you cast this turn cost {o2} less to cast. You gain 2 life.
618768.translation: 你本回合中施放的神器、瞬间和法术咒语减少{o2}来施放。你获得2点生命。

618769.oracleText: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
618769.translation: 抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

618770.oracleText: Create two 1/1 colorless Soldier artifact creature tokens.
618770.translation: 派出两个1/1无色士兵衍生神器生物。

618771.oracleText: Artifacts and planeswalkers you control gain indestructible until end of turn. Destroy all nonland permanents.
618771.translation: 由你操控的神器和鹏洛客获得不灭异能直到回合结束。消灭所有非地永久物。

618773.oracleText: Following his hunger for knowledge and power from the past, Urza starved Dominaria's future.
618773.translation: 在从过往汲取足够力量与知识之后，克撒继而耗尽了多明纳里亚的未来。

618774.oracleText: {oT}: You gain 1 life. If you control creatures named Power Plant Worker and Tower Worker, you gain 3 life instead.
618774.translation: {oT}：你获得1点生命。如果你操控名称为动力炉工人和高塔工人的生物，则改为你获得3点生命。

618776.oracleText: After five thousand years, the nightmare returned.

618779.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It's a Phyrexian in addition to its other types.
618779.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。它额外具有非瑞人此类别。

618781.oracleText: Mechanical workers toiled away, tirelessly fueling the impossible.
618781.translation: 机械工人埋头苦干，不知疲倦地为突破不可能助力。

618782.oracleText: {o3}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control creatures named Mine Worker and Tower Worker, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME instead. Activate only once each turn.
618782.translation: {o3}：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果你操控名称为矿脉工人和高塔工人的生物，则改为在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。每回合只能起动一次。

618783.oracleText: {o3}: Power Plant Worker gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control creatures named Mine Worker and Tower Worker, put two +1/+1 counters on Power Plant Worker instead. Activate only once each turn.
618783.translation: {o3}：动力炉工人得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果你操控名称为矿脉工人和高塔工人的生物，则改为在动力炉工人上放置两个+1/+1指示物。每回合只能起动一次。

618785.oracleText: From above, the brothers noticed strange glyphs etched into the desert sand.
618785.translation: 飞翔空中，两兄弟才注意到沙漠黄砂中隐藏的奇异图符。

618787.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another nontoken artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield or is put into exile from the battlefield, create a tapped Powerstone token.
618787.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的神器从战场进入坟墓场或放逐区时，派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618788.oracleText: Whenever Slagstone Refinery or another nontoken artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield or is put into exile from the battlefield, create a tapped Powerstone token.
618788.translation: 每当矿渣精炼炉或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的神器从战场进入坟墓场或放逐区时，派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618792.oracleText: Tawnos built it to be absolutely impermeable to any force inside. Luckily it worked for any force outside as well.
618792.translation: 达硌士建造时仅确保其内里能量永不泄漏出外。所幸外部能量也不能进入其内。

618793.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: You gain protection from everything until your next turn.
618793.translation: {o2}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：你获得反一切保护异能直到你的下一个回合。

618794.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile The Stasis Coffin: You gain protection from everything until your next turn.
618794.translation: {o2}，{oT}，放逐静态棺材：你获得反一切保护异能直到你的下一个回合。

618796.oracleText: Reports differed on whether the figure was an automaton or a mage, mostly because few who saw it survived.
618796.translation: 至于这身影是自动机械还是法师，不同报告的结论各异，主因是见过它的几乎没人活下来。

618800.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile CARDNAME: Choose a card name. Search target opponent's graveyard, hand, and library for up to four cards with that name and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way. Activate only as a sorcery.
618800.translation: {o2}，{oT}，放逐CARDNAME：选择一个牌名。从目标对手的坟墓场，手牌及牌库中搜寻至多四张具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手洗牌，然后每以此法从其手上放逐一张牌，其便抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

618801.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Exile The Stone Brain: Choose a card name. Search target opponent's graveyard, hand, and library for up to four cards with that name and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way. Activate only as a sorcery.
618801.translation: {o2}，{oT}，放逐魔石大脑：选择一个牌名。从目标对手的坟墓场，手牌及牌库中搜寻至多四张具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手洗牌，然后每以此法从其手上放逐一张牌，其便抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

618803.oracleText: Automatons could be rebuilt. Powerstones could not.
618803.translation: 自动机械坏了能重造。魔力石坏了可不能修。

618806.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, add eight {oC}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
618806.translation: 当CARDNAME其死去时，加八点{oC}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

618807.oracleText: When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, add eight {oC}. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
618807.translation: 当护窟苏其死去时，加八点{oC}。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

618809.oracleText: New armaments, fresh provisions, and best of all, dry socks.
618809.translation: 里面有崭新装备、新鲜口粮，最棒的是还有干燥袜子。

618813.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Sacrifice Supply Drop: Draw a card.

618815.oracleText: Inspired by fishing raptors, Tawnos designed the drake's talons to seize prey with overwhelming speed and precision.
618815.translation: 达硌士从捕鱼猛禽上得到启发，设计的龙兽利爪能在极速飞行时精准逮住猎物。

618819.oracleText:
"Achieving perfection is simple. Watch, I'll do it twice."
—Mishra
618819.translation:
「实现完美很简单。仔细看，我只作两次。」
～米斯拉

618822.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it and has ward {o2}.
618822.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有守护{o2}，且其上每贴附有一个灵气和武具，便得+1/+1。

618826.oracleText: {o7}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
618826.translation: {o7}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张神器牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

618828.oracleText: Even Urza's most mundane creations shared his obsession with perfection.
618828.translation: 就算是克撒最普通的造物，也能从中看到他对完美的执著。

618829.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. If you control creatures named Mine Worker and Power Plant Worker, add {oCoCoC} instead.
618829.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。如果你操控名称为矿脉工人和动力炉工人的生物，则改为加{oCoCoC}。

618833.oracleText: {o2oGoG}, {oT}: Create a 2/2 green Bear creature token, then mill three cards. Activate only as a sorcery.
618833.translation: {o2oGoG}，{oT}：派出一个2/2绿色的熊衍生生物，然后磨三张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

618835.oracleText: Titania, Gaea Incarnate's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
618835.translation: 盖亚化身泰坦尼亚的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地之数量。

618837.oracleText: {o3oG}: Put four +1/+1 counters on target land you control. It becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.
618837.translation: {o3oG}：在目标由你操控的地上放置四个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0，具敏捷异能的元素生物。它仍然是地。

618838.oracleText:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—The Antiquities War
618838.translation:
「随着泰瑞西亚矿藏渐被挖空，金属废渣变得愈发常见。」
～《古文明之战》

618839.oracleText:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—The Antiquities War
618839.translation:
「在通往托玛库的路上，克撒每隔三十里便设置一处要冲，如此构成的壕沟网络四通八达，引得两兄弟数十年间拉锯不休。」
～《古文明之战》

618841.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. That land's controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. You may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
618841.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标由对手操控的非基本地。该地的操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

618842.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Demolition Field: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. That land's controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. You may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
618842.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲颓垣废址：消灭目标由对手操控的非基本地。该地的操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

618843.oracleText:
"There's a certain beauty in destruction. Some will consider this war a masterpiece."
—Ashnod
618843.translation:
「毁灭之中亦有美感。或有人会觉得这场战事是幅杰作。」
～阿士诺

618847.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Soldiers you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
618847.translation: {o5}，{oT}：由你操控的士兵得+1/+1直到回合结束。

618849.oracleText: The Thran's machines were not dead after all, merely dormant . . . and waiting.
618849.translation: 索蓝的机器并未死亡，只是在休眠…在等待。

618850.translation: {o4}，{oT}：派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

618851.oracleText:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—The Antiquities War
618851.translation:
「同兆震爆不仅标志着战事终结，更标志着诸人所熟知的多明纳里亚已然作古。」
～《古文明之战》

618853.oracleText: {o2}: CARDNAME becomes a 2/2 Assembly-Worker artifact creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
618853.translation: {o2}：CARDNAME成为2/2组装工人神器生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

618854.oracleText: {o2}: Mishra's Foundry becomes a 2/2 Assembly-Worker artifact creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
618854.translation: {o2}：米斯拉的铸造厂成为2/2组装工人神器生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

618855.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Target attacking Assembly-Worker gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
618855.translation: {o1}，{oT}：目标进行攻击的组装工人得+2/+2直到回合结束。

618857.oracleText: Sent by their noble parents to toughen up and learn something of the world's past, Urza and Mishra instead uncovered Terisiare's future.
618857.translation: 克撒和米斯拉的父母将孩子送来此处，只是想好好锻炼贵族后代并从世界的过往学习；未料他们竟揭晓了泰瑞西亚的未来。

618859.oracleText:
"The war polluted the land, turning what had once been fruitful fields into fetid morasses of mud and rusted corpses."
—The Antiquities War
618859.translation:
「战争污染了大地，将原本的富饶田野变作遍布泥泞与锈尸的腐臭沼泽。」
～《古文明之战》

618861.oracleText: It brings the two things weary soldiers need most: medicine and morale.

650237.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} permanent.} other {Target {2, Number} permanents.}}
650237.translation: {2, plural, =1 {选择{2, Number}个永久物。} other {选择{2, Number}个永久物。}}

650627.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell with mana value 3 or less, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player.
650627.translation: 每当任一牌手施放法术力值等于或小于3的咒语时，CARDNAME对该牌手造成2点伤害。

651411.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}: Put target card from your graveyard on the bottom of your library. Activate only if you control two or more white permanents.
651411.translation: {oW}，{oT}：将目标牌从你的坟墓场置于你的牌库底。 只能于你操控两个或更多白色永久物时起动。

651460.oracleText: Discard a card with mana value {2, Number}.
651460.translation: 弃一张法术力值为 {2, Number}的牌。

651891.oracleText: Search your library for up to three basic land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
651891.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻至多三张基本地牌，展示这些牌，并将它们置于你手上。然后将你的牌库洗牌。

652489.oracleText: Metalcraft — {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Activate only if you control three or more artifacts.
652489.translation: 金技～{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。只能于你操控三个或更多神器时起动此异能。

653825.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target player mills two cards. If two cards that share a color were milled this way, repeat this process.
653825.translation: {o3}，{oT}：目标牌手磨两张牌。如果以此法磨掉两张具共通颜色的牌，则重复此流程。

654548.oracleText: {oT}: Desert deals 1 damage to target attacking creature. Activate only during the end of combat step.
654548.translation: {oT}：沙漠对目标进行攻击的生物造成1点伤害。只能于战斗结束步骤中起动。

654745.oracleText: Search your library for an instant card or a card with flash, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
654745.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张瞬间牌或一张具闪现异能的牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

655912.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if an opponent controls three or more creatures, sacrifice CARDNAME, search your library for up to two creature cards, put those cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
655912.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若某对手操控三个或更多生物，则牺牲CARDNAME，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，将这些牌放进在战场，然后洗牌。

655913.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if an opponent controls three or more creatures, sacrifice Defense of the Heart, search your library for up to two creature cards, put those cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
655913.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若某对手操控三个或更多生物，则牺牲心防，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，将这些牌放进在战场，然后洗牌。

656407.oracleText: Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, discard a card at random, then shuffle.
656407.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置于你手上，随机弃一张牌，然后洗牌。

656432.oracleText: Destroy each artifact with mana value X or less.
656432.translation: 消灭所有法术力值等于或小于X的神器。

656754.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target up to {2, Number} artifact or enchantment.} other {Target up to {2, Number} artifacts and/or enchantments.}}
656754.translation: {2, plural, =1 {至多指定{2, Number}个神器或结界为目标。} other {至多指定{2, Number}个神器和／或结界为目标。}}

660552.translation: 是否要重置目标神器或生物？

661392.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Move a counter from target permanent you control onto another target permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.
661392.translation: {o1}，{oT}：将一个指示物从目标由你操控的永久物移到另一个目标永久物上。只能于法术时机起动。

662150.oracleText: {oB}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if you control five or more Vampires.
662150.translation: {oB}：转化CARDNAME。只能于你操控五个或更多吸血鬼时起动。

662151.oracleText: {oB}: Transform Bloodline Keeper. Activate only if you control five or more Vampires.
662151.translation: {oB}：转化血脉维系者。只能于你操控五个或更多吸血鬼时起动。

662224.oracleText: Morbid — {oT}, Tap two untapped creatures you control: Create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying. Activate only if a creature died this turn.
662224.translation: {oT}：横置两个由你操控且未横置的生物：派出一个5/5黑色，具飞行异能的恶魔衍生生物。只能于有生物死去的回合中起动。

662408.oracleText: {o2oG}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
662408.translation: {o2oG}：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。此异能每回合只能起动一次。

662651.oracleText: Return a creature card at random to your hand.
662651.translation: 随机将一张生物牌移回你手上。

662839.oracleText: Search your library for a card and put that card into your hand. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, instead search your library for two cards and put those cards into your hand. Then shuffle.
662839.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌并置于你手上。如果野心渐增是从坟墓场施放，则改为从你的牌库中搜寻两张牌并置于你手上。然后洗牌。

663050.oracleText: {o1}: You may cast target creature card in a graveyard this turn. When you cast it this turn, CARDNAME gains all activated abilities of that card until end of turn.
663050.translation: {o1}：你本回合可以从任一坟墓场施放目标生物牌。当你本回合施放它时，CARDNAME获得该牌的所有起动式异能直到回合结束。

663051.oracleText: {o1}: You may cast target creature card in a graveyard this turn. When you cast it this turn, Havengul Lich gains all activated abilities of that card until end of turn.
663051.translation: {o1}：你本回合可以从任一坟墓场施放目标生物牌。当你本回合施放它时，海温古巫妖获得该牌的所有起动式异能直到回合结束。

663134.oracleText: When you cast it this turn, CARDNAME gains all activated abilities of that card until end of turn.
663134.translation: 当你本回合施放它时，CARDNAME获得该牌的所有起动式异能直到回合结束。

663909.oracleText: Search your library for a Swamp card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
663909.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张沼泽牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

664462.oracleText: Destroy target nonland permanent with mana value 3 or less.
664462.translation: 消灭目标法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物。

665286.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
665286.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

665287.oracleText: Choose one — • Return target creature you control and all Auras you control attached to it to their owner's hand. • Destroy target creature and you lose life equal to its toughness. • Return target creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
665287.translation: 选择一项～ •  将目标由你操控的生物及所有由你操控且贴附于其上的灵气移回其拥有者手上。 •  消灭目标生物，且你失去等同于其防御力的生命。 •  将目标法术力值等于或小于1的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

665481.oracleText: Target a creature card with mana value 1 or less.
665481.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于1的生物牌为目标。

666088.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice six creatures named Shadowborn Apostle: Search your library for a Demon creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
666088.translation: {oB}，牺牲六个名称为影裔宗徒的生物：从你牌库中搜寻一张恶魔生物牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

666267.oracleText: Sacrifice six creatures named Shadowborn Apostle.
666267.translation: 牺牲六个名称为影裔宗徒的生物。

667645.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell with mana value 3 or less, Eidolon of the Great Revel deals 2 damage to that player.
667645.translation: 每当任一牌手施放法术力值等于或小于3的咒语时，盛欢幻灵对该牌手造成2点伤害。

668335.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 2/1 blue Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token. Then you may choose a token you control. If you do, each other token you control becomes a copy of that token.
668335.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，派出一个2/1蓝色非瑞人／秘耳衍生神器生物。然后你可以选择一个由你操控的衍生物。若你如此作，则每个由你操控的其他衍生物均成为该衍生物的复制品。

668864.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
668864.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置进战场，然后将你的牌库洗牌。

668865.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice Embodiment of Spring: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
668865.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，牺牲春晓化身：从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置进战场，然后将你的牌库洗牌。

669008.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to any target. Raid — If you attacked this turn, instead CARDNAME deals 5 damage to that permanent or player and the damage can't be prevented.
669008.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。突击～如果你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则改为箭矢风暴对所影响的永久物或牌手造成5点伤害，且其伤害不能被防止。

669009.oracleText:
Arrow Storm deals 4 damage to any target. 
Raid — If you attacked this turn, instead Arrow Storm deals 5 damage to that permanent or player and the damage can't be prevented.
669009.translation:
箭矢风暴对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。
突击～如果你于本回合中曾进行攻击，则改为箭矢风暴对所影响的永久物或牌手造成5点伤害，且其伤害不能被防止。

669031.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 6 damage to target creature. When that creature dies this turn, exile its controller's graveyard.
669031.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成6点伤害。本回合中，当该生物死去时，放逐其操控者坟墓场中的所有牌。

669032.oracleText: Burn Away deals 6 damage to target creature. When that creature dies this turn, exile its controller's graveyard.
669032.translation: 焚烧殆尽对目标生物造成6点伤害。本回合中，当该生物死去时，放逐其操控者坟墓场中的所有牌。

669037.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target. Ferocious — CARDNAME deals X plus 2 damage instead if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
669037.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。威猛～如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则改为CARDNAME造成X加2点伤害。

669038.oracleText:
Crater's Claws deals X damage to any target. 
Ferocious — Crater's Claws deals X plus 2 damage instead if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
669038.translation:
山口龙爪对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。
威猛～如果你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则改为山口龙爪造成X加2点伤害。

669288.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile the top four cards of your library. Until end of turn, you may cast noncreature spells from among those cards without paying their mana costs.
669288.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，放逐你牌库顶的四张牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放本回合中以娜尔施放逐的非生物牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

669289.oracleText: Whenever Narset, Enlightened Master attacks, exile the top four cards of your library. Until end of turn, you may cast noncreature spells from among those cards without paying their mana costs.
669289.translation: 每当悟道大师娜尔施攻击时，放逐你牌库顶的四张牌。直到回合结束，你可以施放本回合中以娜尔施放逐的非生物牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

669311.oracleText: {o2oG}: Savage Knuckleblade gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
669311.translation: {o2oG}：蛮野指套剑手得+2/+2直到回合结束。此异能每回合只能起动一次。

669358.oracleText: Target opponent exiles the top X cards of their library. You may cast any number of spells with mana value X or less from among them without paying their mana costs.
669358.translation: 目标对手放逐其牌库顶的X张牌。你可以施放其中任意数量总法术力等于或小于X的非地牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

669452.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, exile its controller's graveyard.
669452.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，放逐其操控者坟墓场中的所有牌。

669462.oracleText: Exile that card at the beginning of your next end step.
669462.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该牌。

669463.oracleText: Return a creature card at random to the battlefield.
669463.translation: 随机将一张生物牌移回战场。

669465.oracleText: Cast any number of spells with mana value {2, Number} or less from among them without paying their mana costs?
669465.translation: 是否要施放一个或数个法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的咒语，而不支付它们的法术力费用？

670180.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls with power less than {1, CardId}'s power.
670180.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且力量小于{1, CardId}之力量的生物为目标。

672069.oracleText: Discard a card with mana value X: Counter target spell with mana value X.
672069.translation: 弃一张法术力值为X的牌：反击目标法术力值为X的咒语。

672075.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, reveal the top card of your library. You may put that card onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card with mana value 3 or less. Otherwise, put that card into your hand.
672075.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌为永久物牌，且其法术力值等于或小于3，则你可以将它放进战场。若否，则将该牌置于你手上。

672076.oracleText: When Matter Reshaper dies, reveal the top card of your library. You may put that card onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card with mana value 3 or less. Otherwise, put that card into your hand.
672076.translation: 当塑质恶体死去时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌为永久物牌，且其法术力值等于或小于3，则你可以将它放进战场。若否，则将该牌置于你手上。

673070.oracleText: Spells you cast with mana value 6 or greater have cascade.
673070.translation: 你施放之法术力值等于或大于6的咒语具有倾曳异能。

673252.oracleText: Enchanters add layer upon layer of complexity to the world around them.
673252.translation: 咒术师会给周围的世界层层叠加复杂度。

673253.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile this enchantment. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
673253.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以放逐此结界。若你如此作，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

673416.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
673416.translation: {o2}，{oT}：派出一个1/1无色自动机神器衍生生物。

673417.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Servo: Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
673417.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲一个自动机：派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机神器衍生生物。

673418.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a Thopter: Create a 4/4 colorless Construct artifact creature token.
673418.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个振翼机：派出一个4/4无色组构体神器衍生生物。

673464.oracleText: If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
673464.translation: 如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为派出两倍数量的该类衍生物。

673496.oracleText:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology
673496.translation:
「你的自说自话让大家获益匪浅。务请继续。」
～古物密码学教授游尔德

673497.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts their second spell each turn, you create a Treasure token.
673497.translation: 每当任一对手施放每回合中其第二个咒语时，你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

673600.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
673600.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

673601.oracleText: Whenever Laelia, the Blade Reforged attacks, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
673601.translation: 每当重铸利锋拉耶梨攻击时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

673602.oracleText: Whenever one or more cards are put into exile from your library and/or your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on Laelia.
673602.translation: 每当一张或数张牌从你的牌库和／或你的坟墓场进入放逐区时，在拉耶梨上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673642.oracleText: Destroy up to X target artifacts and/or enchantments. Create twice X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life."
673642.translation: 消灭至多X个目标神器和／或结界。派出两倍于X数量的1/1，黑绿双色的害虫衍生生物，且具有「每当此生物死去时，你获得1点生命。」

673659.oracleText: "Even in death, we never stop growing."
673659.translation: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

673660.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control. It's a Forest land.
673660.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以将它在其拥有者的操控下牌面朝下地移回战场。它是树林地。

673698.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 6/6 blue Whale creature token with "When this creature dies, create a 9/9 blue Kraken creature token."
673698.translation: 当此生物死去时，派出一个6/6蓝色鲸鱼衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，派出一个9/9蓝色巨海兽衍生生物」。

673705.oracleText: Choose a nonland card exiled this way.
673705.translation: 选择以此法被放逐的一张非地牌。

673710.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control?
673710.translation: 是否要将它在其拥有者的操控下牌面朝下地移回战场？

673712.oracleText: Her writhing, boneless movements are unsettling to humans, but hypnotic to her serpent brood.
673712.translation: 她宛若无骨的舞姿令人不安，但对于她的蛇而言却是催眠。

673744.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}, {oT}: Return target enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
673744.translation: {oWoUoBoRoG}，{oT}：将目标结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

673879.oracleText: The Flowing Staff technique does not differentiate between offense and defense.
673879.translation: 流动的魔法没有进攻与防守之分。

673903.translation: 鼎镬佣兽不能进行阻挡。

673904.oracleText: Whenever one or more non-Human creatures you control attack, look at the top six cards of your library. You may put a Human creature card from among them onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. It gains indestructible until end of turn. Put the rest of the cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.
673904.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的非人类生物攻击时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以将其中一张人类生物牌放进战场，其为横置且正进行攻击。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

673906.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, you may have CARDNAME's base power and toughness become 5/1 or 1/5 until end of turn.
673906.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，你可以使CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力成为5/1或1/5直到回合结束。

673907.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant, sorcery, or Wizard spell, you may have Master of Winds's base power and toughness become 5/1 or 1/5 until end of turn.
673907.translation: 每当你施放瞬间，法术或法术师咒语时，你可以使风幻大师的基础力量与防御力成为5/1或1/5直到回合结束。

673910.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
673910.translation: {oB}，牺牲另一个生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673911.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on Skyclave Shadowcat.
673911.translation: {oB}，牺牲另一个生物：在空境影猫上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673917.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
673917.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673918.oracleText: Whenever Oran-Rief Ooze attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
673918.translation: 每当欧兰黎流浆攻击时，在每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673920.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on a creature you control, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
673920.translation: 每当在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在下一个结束步骤开始时将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

673921.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on a creature you control, return Moss-Pit Skeleton from your graveyard to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
673921.translation: 每当在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在下一个结束步骤开始时将苔坑骷髅妖从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

673925.oracleText: Return A-CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
673925.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将炼-CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

673928.oracleText: {oGoWoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures you control. They gain vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
673928.translation: {oGoWoW}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标生物。它们获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

673929.oracleText: {oGoWoW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Bretagard Stronghold: Distribute two +1/+1 counters among one or two target creatures you control. They gain vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
673929.translation: {oGoWoW}，{oT}，牺牲碧塔嘉城塞：将两个+1/+1指示物分配给一个或两个目标生物。它们获得警成与系命异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

673932.oracleText: {oW}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
673932.translation: {oW}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

673938.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may pay {o2}. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy."
673938.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。」

673940.oracleText: Exile up to five target permanents. For each permanent exiled this way, its controller creates a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
673940.translation: 放逐至多五个目标永久物。对每个以此法放逐的永久物而言，其操控者派出一个4/4，蓝红双色的元素衍生生物。

673944.oracleText: Delirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +2/+0, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.
673944.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，CARDNAME便得+2/+0，具飞行异能，且每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

673945.oracleText: Delirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, Dragon's Rage Channeler gets +2/+0, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.
673945.translation: 躁狂～只要你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，龙怒通念师便得+2/+0，具飞行异能，且每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

673947.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Delirium — CARDNAME deals 4 damage instead if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
673947.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则改为CARDNAME造成4点伤害。

673948.oracleText:
Unholy Heat deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. 
Delirium — Unholy Heat deals 4 damage instead if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
673948.translation:
不洁热火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。
躁狂～如果你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多，则改为不洁热火造成4点伤害。

673956.oracleText: {oGoW}: Target creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it gains trample and lifelink until end of turn.
673956.translation: {oGoW}：目标由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物获得践踏与系命异能直到回合结束。

673961.oracleText: Draw two cards, then nonland cards in your hand with mana value 3 or less perpetually gain "When you cast this spell, you lose 1 life."
673961.translation: 抓两张牌，然后你手上法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌永久得「当你施放此咒语时，你失去1点生命。」

673962.oracleText: Select the starting number of lore counters.
673962.translation: 选择学问指示物的初始数量。

673966.oracleText: Search for up to two land cards that have a basic land type.
673966.translation: 至多搜寻两张具有据本地类别的地牌。

673972.oracleText: Cannot pay for: A Nonartifact Spell
673972.translation: 不能用于支付：非神器咒语

673973.oracleText: Choose any amount of mana to pay.
673973.translation: 选择任意数量想支付的法术力。

673983.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker?
673983.translation: 牺牲一个神器、生物、结界、地或鹏洛客？

673984.oracleText: Sacrifice a permanent that shares a card type with it?
673984.translation: 牺牲一个与它具有相同牌张类别的永久物？

673985.oracleText: Sacrifice a permanent of the corresponding type; if you decline, you lose 2 life and your opponent draws a card.
673985.translation: 牺牲一个具有相同类别的永久物；如果你拒绝，你将失去2点生命且你的对手将抓一张牌。

674036.oracleText: Tap a creature for {1, CardId} to enlist.
674036.translation: 点击一个生物使其被{1, CardId}征列。

674917.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped artifacts you control.
674917.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的神器。

674919.oracleText: Sacrifice a nonland, nontoken permanent; if you decline, you lose 2 life and your opponent draws a card.
674919.translation: 牺牲一个非地、非衍生永久物；如果你拒绝，你将失去2点生命且你的对手将抓一张牌。

675904.oracleText: Target an artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker card.
675904.translation: 指定一张神器、结界或鹏洛客牌为目标。

675964.translation: 不能用于支付：非神器咒语

675967.oracleText: Insufficent creatures to pay for Enlist costs.
675967.translation: 没有足够的生物来支付征列费用。

675973.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, choose a creature card in your hand at random. It perpetually becomes a Phyrexian in addition to its other types.
675973.translation: 在你的维持开始时，随机选择你手上的一张生物牌。除了原有类型之外，它永久成为非瑞人。

675974.oracleText: Whenever a Phyrexian you control deals combat damage to a player, that player gets two poison counters.
675974.translation: 每当一个由你操控的非瑞人对一个牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手获得两个中毒指示物。

675990.oracleText: Whenever Oracle of the Alpha attacks, scry 1.
675990.translation: 每当阿尔法先知攻击时，占卜1。

676001.oracleText: Whenever you draw a Dragon card, it perpetually gets +1/+1.
676001.translation: 每当你抓一张龙牌，它永久得+1/+1。

676006.oracleText: {oBoB}: CARDNAME perpetually gets -1/-1, then return it to the battlefield. Activate only if CARDNAME is in your graveyard and its toughness is 2 or greater.
676006.translation: {oBoB}：CARDNAME永久获得-1/-1，然后将它移回战场。只能于CARDNAME在你的坟墓场中且其防御力大于等于2时起动。

676007.oracleText: {oBoB}: Diminished Returner perpetually gets -1/-1, then return it to the battlefield. Activate only if Diminished Returner is in your graveyard and its toughness is 2 or greater.
676007.translation: {oBoB}：渐衰回归者永久获得-1/-1，然后将它移回战场。只能于渐衰回归者在你的坟墓场中且其防御力大于等于2时起动。

676010.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature card in your graveyard perpetually becomes an artifact. You may cast that card this turn. (It loses all other card types.)
676010.translation: {oT}：目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌永久成为神器。本回合中，你可以施放该牌。（它会失去所有其他类别）

676012.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature that crewed it this turn perpetually gains your choice of menace, deathtouch, or lifelink.
676012.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标本回合中搭载它的生物由你选择其永久获得威慑、死触还是系命。

676013.oracleText: Whenever Smogbelcher Chariot attacks, target creature that crewed it this turn perpetually gains your choice of menace, deathtouch, or lifelink.
676013.translation: 每当喷雾战车攻击时，你选择目标本回合中搭载它的生物永久获得威慑、死触还是系命。

676015.oracleText: At the beginning of your precombat main phase, you may discard a card. If you do, seek a card with greater mana value and exile it. Until the end of your next turn, you may play the exiled card.
676015.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，掏一张法术力值大于此牌的牌并将它放逐。直到你的下个回合结束时，你可以使用所放逐的牌。

676018.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, conjure a random card from Goblin Influx Array's spellbook into your hand.
676018.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，从鬼怪潮涌阵列的法术书中随机变出一张牌置于你手上。

676020.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enlists a nontoken creature, you may conjure a duplicate of that creature into the top five cards of your library at random. The duplicate perpetually gets +1/+0 and gains haste.
676020.translation: 每当CARDNAME征列一个非衍生生物，你可以变出一个该生物的复制牌并将其随机置于你牌库顶的五张牌中。该复制牌永久得+1/+0并具有敏捷异能。

676021.oracleText: Whenever Goblin Morale Sergeant enlists a nontoken creature, you may conjure a duplicate of that creature into the top five cards of your library at random. The duplicate perpetually gets +1/+0 and gains haste.
676021.translation: 每当鬼怪振励军士长征列一个非衍生生物，你可以变出一个该生物的复制牌并将其随机置于你牌库顶的五张牌中。该复制牌永久得+1/+0并具有敏捷异能。

676025.oracleText: "We are one family, connected by the sacred roots of Llanowar."
676025.translation: 「我们是一个家族，由神圣的罗堰之根链接。」

676026.oracleText: Conjure a card named Marwyn, the Nurturer and X cards named Llanowar Elves onto the battlefield.
676026.translation: 变出一张名为培育人玛雯的牌和X张名为罗堰的妖精的牌并放进战场。

676032.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a random land card from your library into your graveyard.
676032.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，随机将一张地牌从你的牌库置入你的坟墓场。

676034.oracleText: "It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, Ichabod."

676035.oracleText: Domain — {o7oG}: Seek a creature card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
676035.translation: 领土～{o7oG}：掏一张生物牌。由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

676036.translation: 晴空号走私贩阿尔瓦德

676037.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, CARDNAME perpetually gets +X/+X where X is the number of creatures that died this turn. This ability also triggers if Arvad is in your graveyard.
676037.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，CARDNAME永久得+X/+X，X的数量为本回合死去的生物数量。此异能阿尔瓦德在坟场时也能触发。

676038.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, Arvad, Weatherlight Smuggler perpetually gets +X/+X where X is the number of creatures that died this turn. This ability also triggers if Arvad is in your graveyard.
676038.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，晴空号走私贩阿尔瓦德永久得+X/+X，X的数量为本回合死去的生物数量。此异能阿尔瓦德在坟场时也能触发。

676041.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Choose a nonland card in your hand. It perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
676041.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：选择一张你手中的非地牌。它永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

676043.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled, remove an egg counter from it. Then if it has no egg counters on it, put it onto the battlefield.
676043.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐，从其上移去一个蛋卵指示物。然后如果其上没有蛋卵指示物，将之放进战场。

676044.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, conjure a random card from Darigaaz, Shivan Champion's spellbook into exile face down with three egg counters on it. It gains "At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is exiled, remove an egg counter from it. Then if it has no egg counters on it, put it onto the battlefield."
676044.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，从西瓦斗士达里迦的法术书中随机变出一张牌，并面朝下置入放逐区且其上具有三个蛋卵指示物。它获得「在你的维持开始时，若此牌已放逐，从其上移去一个蛋卵指示物。然后如果其上没有蛋卵指示物，将之放进战场。」

676050.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
676050.translation: 每当此生物成为咒语或异能的目标时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

676056.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes crewed, until end of turn, it becomes a copy of the exiled card, except it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types.
676056.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为已搭载时，直到回合结束，它成为所放逐之牌的复制品，额外具有载具与神器类别。

676057.oracleText: Whenever Protean War Engine becomes crewed, until end of turn, it becomes a copy of the exiled card, except it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types.
676057.translation: 每当变幻战争引擎成为已搭载时，直到回合结束，它成为所放逐之牌的复制品，额外具有载具与神器类别。

676059.oracleText: At last, some room to grow.
676059.translation: 最后，还有一些成长空间。

676063.oracleText: Counter target spell. Each card in its controller's graveyard, hand, and library with the same name as that spell perpetually gain "This spell costs {o2} more to cast."
676063.translation: 反击目标咒语。其操控者手上、牌库中和坟墓场中所有名称与该咒语相同的牌永久获得「此咒语增加{o2}来施放。」

676065.oracleText: When CARDNAME or another legendary creature you control crews a Vehicle, that Vehicle perpetually gets +1/+0.
676065.translation: 当CARDNAME或其他传奇生物搭载一个载具时，该载具永久得+1/+0。

676066.oracleText: When Tiana, Angelic Mechanic or another legendary creature you control crews a Vehicle, that Vehicle perpetually gets +1/+0.
676066.translation: 当技师天使蒂娅娜或其他传奇生物搭载一个载具时，该载具永久得+1/+0。

676068.oracleText: Whenever one or more other nontoken creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, choose one of those creatures. Conjure a duplicate of the chosen creature into your hand.
676068.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他非衍生生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从这些生物中选择一个。变出一张所选生物的复制牌置于你手上。

676071.oracleText: Coalition Construct is the chosen type in addition to its other types.
676071.translation: 联盟组构体额外具有所选类别。

676075.oracleText:
"Superior force meets woefully inadequate object. What paradox were you expecting?"
—Azguri, archmage of Evos Isle
676075.translation:
"Superior force meets woefully inadequate object. What paradox were you expecting?"
—Azguri, archmage of Evos Isle

676076.oracleText: Choose a nonland card in your hand.
676076.translation: 选择一张你手中的非地牌。

676078.oracleText: Target a creature that crewed it this turn.
676078.translation: 以本回合中搭载它的生物为目标。

676079.oracleText: Seek a card with greater mana value.
676079.translation: 掏一张法术力值更大的牌。

676080.oracleText: Target a card in an opponent's graveyard.
676080.translation: 以任一牌手坟墓场中的牌为目标。

676081.oracleText: Put a random land card into your graveyard.
676081.translation: 随机将一张地牌置入你的坟墓场。

676082.oracleText: Target a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn.
676082.translation: 指定一张在你坟墓场中的非传奇生物牌为目标，且须为于本回合中从战场进入坟墓场的。

676084.oracleText: "Baldurians are free to worship any deities they choose. Where will faith and fate lead me?"
676084.translation: "Baldurians are free to worship any deities they choose. Where will faith and fate lead me?"

676085.oracleText: "May Lathander's light guide you to greet tomorrow's sunrise."
676085.translation: "May Lathander's light guide you to greet tomorrow's sunrise."

676086.oracleText: "Have you seen the Unrolling Scroll? A truly marvelous shrine dedicated to Oghma's wisdom and teachings."
676086.translation: "Have you seen the Unrolling Scroll? A truly marvelous shrine dedicated to Oghma's wisdom and teachings."

676087.oracleText: "The Dead Three—Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul—walk among us. It's time we remake this city to their liking."
676087.translation: "The Dead Three—Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul—walk among us. It's time we remake this city to their liking."

676088.oracleText: "The rage of Talos is mine own, and I am become the eye of the storm."
676088.translation: "The rage of Talos is mine own, and I am become the eye of the storm."

676089.oracleText: "Silvanus and Chauntea, like grass in cracked stone, can always find little spaces to flourish."
676089.translation: "Silvanus and Chauntea, like grass in cracked stone, can always find little spaces to flourish."

676092.oracleText: "You know what must be done. Do it now!"
676092.translation: "You know what must be done. Do it now!"

676093.oracleText: "You've a sharp tongue, elf. Would that your mind proved its equal."
676093.translation: "You've a sharp tongue, elf. Would that your mind proved its equal."

676095.oracleText: "A githyanki creche must be near; its caretaker has the means to cleanse us."
676095.translation: 「这附近一定有吉斯洋基养育所；那的守护者有办法净化我们。」

676096.oracleText: "Most of my memory is gone, and I don't remember why."
676096.translation: "Most of my memory is gone, and I don't remember why."

676097.oracleText: "Maybe, just maybe, there's a little spark of goodness in Zariel still."
676097.translation: "Maybe, just maybe, there's a little spark of goodness in Zariel still."

676098.oracleText: "The sword, the sword! I know where it is!"
676098.translation: "The sword, the sword! I know where it is!"

676099.oracleText: "Through the gate to Avernus we went, tearing through devils like a song through air."
676099.translation: "Through the gate to Avernus we went, tearing through devils like a song through air."

676100.oracleText: "The Zariel I knew is gone, replaced by a devil with a halo of fire and vengeance."
676100.translation: "The Zariel I knew is gone, replaced by a devil with a halo of fire and vengeance."

676101.oracleText: "I wandered Avernus for a time—a harsh, horrible place devoid of growth."
676101.translation: "I wandered Avernus for a time—a harsh, horrible place devoid of growth."

676103.oracleText: "Those who walk the path of evil will never know peace."
676103.translation: "Those who walk the path of evil will never know peace."

676104.oracleText: "I shall endeavor to let wisdom be our torch."
676104.translation: "I shall endeavor to let wisdom be our torch."

676105.oracleText: "My heart is not so peaceful as it may seem."
676105.translation: "My heart is not so peaceful as it may seem."

676109.oracleText: "Isn't this great? All of us, doing nice things, being happy."
676109.translation: "Isn't this great? All of us, doing nice things, being happy."

676110.oracleText: "I knew a mage once, but he was pretty stuffy. You're not like that."
676110.translation: "I knew a mage once, but he was pretty stuffy. You're not like that."

676111.oracleText: "I'm so sweet, I've got rotting teeth and gums!"
676111.translation: "I'm so sweet, I've got rotting teeth and gums!"

676112.oracleText: "Hey, I think everyone would be happier if we were a little nicer."
676112.translation: "Hey, I think everyone would be happier if we were a little nicer."

676113.oracleText: "What a great forest, huh? I've never seen trees like these before."
676113.translation: "What a great forest, huh? I've never seen trees like these before."

676117.oracleText: "No rest for the wicked, I see."
676117.translation: "No rest for the wicked, I see."

676119.oracleText: "Oh, what a tangled Weave we web."
676119.translation: "Oh, what a tangled Weave we web."

676121.oracleText: "I'll stick with you, no matter what."
676121.translation: "I'll stick with you, no matter what."

676123.oracleText: "Just like old times. Well, except for the torture and all."
676123.translation: "Just like old times. Well, except for the torture and all."

676124.oracleText: "My blade will cut ya down to size!"
676124.translation: "My blade will cut ya down to size!"

676125.oracleText: "I wish I could spend more time in the forest. I feel so alive."
676125.translation: "I wish I could spend more time in the forest. I feel so alive."

676127.oracleText: "The Demiplanar Chambers take a lot longer to clean than you'd think."
676127.translation: "The Demiplanar Chambers take a lot longer to clean than you'd think."

676128.oracleText: "I find the Endless Chant comforting. How else could I fall asleep?"
676128.translation: "I find the Endless Chant comforting. How else could I fall asleep?"

676129.oracleText: "If you've never met Miirym, I'll say nothing else. Let it be a fun surprise."
676129.translation: "If you've never met Miirym, I'll say nothing else. Let it be a fun surprise."

676130.oracleText: "Whoever's stealing potions and gold from my personal chambers better fess up now!"
676130.translation: "Whoever's stealing potions and gold from my personal chambers better fess up now!"

676131.oracleText: "An undiscovered prediction of Alaundo! . . . Or just his recipe for Three-Chicken Pie."
676131.translation: "An undiscovered prediction of Alaundo! . . . Or just his recipe for Three-Chicken Pie."

676132.oracleText: "We children of Bhaal cannot be stopped."
676132.translation: "We children of Bhaal cannot be stopped."

676133.oracleText: "This is how it was meant to be. Let no one bar our path."
676133.translation: "This is how it was meant to be. Let no one bar our path."

676135.oracleText: "Death comes for you. Feel its icy breath!"
676135.translation: "Death comes for you. Feel its icy breath!"

676136.oracleText: "We should kill something soon. My impatience grows."
676136.translation: "We should kill something soon. My impatience grows."

676137.oracleText: "In this light, it seems all the insects that prey on the living have retreated to the shadows."
676137.translation: "In this light, it seems all the insects that prey on the living have retreated to the shadows."

676142.oracleText: "Got to keep focused—can't afford to get attached. To anyone."
676142.translation: "Got to keep focused—can't afford to get attached. To anyone."

676145.oracleText: "With the guidance of Shar, we shall prosper."
676145.translation: "With the guidance of Shar, we shall prosper."

676146.oracleText: "I see you have learned much in your short life span."
676146.translation: "I see you have learned much in your short life span."

676147.oracleText: "Trust is for the foolish. And the dead."
676147.translation: "Trust is for the foolish. And the dead."

676149.oracleText: "Your forests seem very strange . . . and yet somehow familiar."
676149.translation: "Your forests seem very strange . . . and yet somehow familiar."

676150.oracleText: "This better be good if ye're thinking to keep the ale from me lips."
676150.translation: "This better be good if ye're thinking to keep the ale from me lips."

676152.oracleText: "Not a sight ye'd see every day, eh?"
676152.translation: "Not a sight ye'd see every day, eh?"

676153.oracleText: "If ye have coin and drink, we're bound to be friends."
676153.translation: "If ye have coin and drink, we're bound to be friends."

676155.oracleText: "Cross me, and I'll leave ye held and helpless in the forest."
676155.translation: "Cross me, and I'll leave ye held and helpless in the forest."

676156.oracleText: "Us True Souls gotta look out for one another."
676156.translation: "Us True Souls gotta look out for one another."

676157.oracleText: "All you need to do is open yourself to the Absolute, and I'll do the rest."
676157.translation: "All you need to do is open yourself to the Absolute, and I'll do the rest."

676158.oracleText: "Got a lot of weird things swimmin' around in that head of yours."
676158.translation: "Got a lot of weird things swimmin' around in that head of yours."

676159.oracleText: "You're gonna be my new pet. A ferocious squiddie, all for myself."
676159.translation: "You're gonna be my new pet. A ferocious squiddie, all for myself."

676160.oracleText: "The Absolute's voice is a blade—it'd cut your brain to bits."
676160.translation: "The Absolute's voice is a blade—it'd cut your brain to bits."

676161.oracleText: "Yer flesh is marked. The Absolute is upon you!"
676161.translation: "Yer flesh is marked. The Absolute is upon you!"

676162.oracleText: "Most souls in Avernus are just meat for the grinder. But not me."
676162.translation: "Most souls in Avernus are just meat for the grinder. But not me."

676163.oracleText: "I didn't escape the hells to lose my soul to another evil."
676163.translation: "I didn't escape the hells to lose my soul to another evil."

676164.oracleText: "Until I've shaken Zariel off my back, I'd only put a target on yours."
676164.translation: "Until I've shaken Zariel off my back, I'd only put a target on yours."

676165.oracleText: "Want me to send them to the Hells? Just say the word."
676165.translation: "Want me to send them to the Hells? Just say the word."

676166.oracleText: "I've spat in Baphomet's eye and lived to tell the tale."
676166.translation: "I've spat in Baphomet's eye and lived to tell the tale."

676167.oracleText: "It's a rescue mission then—should be fun. Let's get to work."
676167.translation: "It's a rescue mission then—should be fun. Let's get to work."

676179.oracleText: "Like the moon, I appear in many phases."
676179.translation: "Like the moon, I appear in many phases."

676180.oracleText: "None as observant or elegant as the hawk."
676180.translation: "None as observant or elegant as the hawk."

676181.oracleText: "No creature as tenacious and calculating as the crocodile."
676181.translation: "No creature as tenacious and calculating as the crocodile."

676182.oracleText: "Never an animal as deadly and venomous as the scorpion."
676182.translation: "Never an animal as deadly and venomous as the scorpion."

676183.oracleText: "Nothing as ferocious or wily as the wolf."
676183.translation: "Nothing as ferocious or wily as the wolf."

676184.oracleText: "There's not a beast as mighty or primal as the bear."
676184.translation: "There's not a beast as mighty or primal as the bear."

676185.oracleText: "Do not place your aggression on one if you cannot handle the wrath of many."
676185.translation: "Do not place your aggression on one if you cannot handle the wrath of many."

676186.oracleText: "Surviving the frigid cold means hunting without patience or mercy."
676186.translation: "Surviving the frigid cold means hunting without patience or mercy."

676187.oracleText: "The meek and ugly masses would be wise to not sully my master's lands."
676187.translation: "The meek and ugly masses would be wise to not sully my master's lands."

676188.oracleText: "Intelligence is a delusion of the weak. Brutality is power's true measure."
676188.translation: "Intelligence is a delusion of the weak. Brutality is power's true measure."

676189.oracleText: "All will bow and swear fealty to my master. Dragonkind included."
676189.translation: "All will bow and swear fealty to my master. Dragonkind included."

676190.oracleText: "Brute strength is a waste of effort when deception will fare more elegantly."
676190.translation: "Brute strength is a waste of effort when deception will fare more elegantly."

676936.oracleText: Target up to one creature you don't control with flying.
676936.translation: 选择至多一个不由你操控且具飞行异能的生物为目标。

677167.oracleText: Fight the Current — The owner of target nonland permanent puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
677167.translation: 强渡急流～目标非地永久物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

677168.oracleText: Choose one — • Fight the Current — The owner of target nonland permanent puts it on the top or bottom of their library. • Find a Crossing — Target creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
677168.translation: 选择一项～ •  强渡急流～目标非地永久物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。 •  绕路通过～目标生物得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

677249.oracleText: When you cast this spell, create a Treasure token and this spell perpetually loses this ability.
677249.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，派出一个珍宝衍生物且此咒语永久失去此异能。

677323.oracleText: {o1oU}: Water Weird gets +1/-1 until end of turn.

677363.oracleText: {o2oR}: Dragonborn Immolator gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
677363.translation: {o2oR}：龙裔煽焰师得+2/+0直到回合结束。

677469.translation: 以一个非衍生、非地永久物为目标。

677921.oracleText: Target a creature you control with flying.
677921.translation: 以一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物为目标

678383.oracleText: {o4oW}: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn. Activate only during your turn.
678383.translation: {o4oW}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。只能于你的回合中起动。

678387.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. When you spend this mana to cast a Dragon creature spell, scry 2.
678387.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语，占卜2。

678395.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. If that mana is spent on a Dragon creature spell, it gains haste until end of turn.
678395.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

678400.oracleText: You may mill three cards. Then return up to two creature and/or land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
678400.translation: 你可以磨三张牌。然后将至多两张生物和/或地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

678407.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, you may put it on the bottom of your library.
678407.translation: {o3}，{oT}：检视你的牌库顶牌。如果它是地牌，则你可以将之横置放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则你可以将它置于你的牌库底。

678409.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
678409.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌和／或门牌，展示这些牌，将一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

678410.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Navigation Orb: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
678410.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲领航法球：从你牌库中搜寻至多两张基本地牌和／或门牌，展示这些牌，将一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

678513.oracleText: When you spend this mana to cast a Dragon creature spell, scry 2.
678513.translation: 当你将此法术力用来施放龙生物咒语，占卜2。

678514.oracleText: Return up to two creature and/or land cards to your hand.
678514.translation: 将至多两张生物和/或地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

678519.oracleText: Select a permanent that was exiled. You will reveal cards until you reveal a card that shares a type with the selected permanent.
678519.translation: 选择一个被放逐的永久物。你一直展示牌直到展示一张与所选永久物具有相同类别的牌为止。

678520.oracleText: Choose a nonland permanent card in your hand.
