678520.translation: 在你的手牌中选择一张非地永久物牌。

678562.oracleText: Goblin spells you cast cost {oR} less to cast. (If it doesn't require {oR}, it costs {o1} less to cast.)
678562.translation: 你施放的鬼怪咒语减少{oR}来施放。(如果它不需要{oR}，则它减少{o1}来施放。)

678563.oracleText: Conjure a duplicate of that creature into the top five cards of your library at random?
678563.translation: 变出一个该生物的复制牌并将其随机置于你牌库顶的五张牌中？

678820.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG} for each creature you control with defender.
678820.translation: {oT}：你每操控一个具守军异能的生物，便加{oG}。

678845.oracleText: When this Class becomes level 3, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain life equal to that creature's toughness.
678845.translation: 当此职业成为等级3时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。你获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。

678846.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3] [When this Class becomes level 3, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain life equal to that creature's toughness.]
678846.translation: 职业等级[3] [当此职业成为等级3时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。你获得等同于该生物防御力的生命。]

679405.oracleText: At end of combat, exile this creature.
679405.translation: 在战斗结束时，放逐此生物。

679406.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, choose target creature you control, then roll a d20. 1-14 | Create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of that creature, except it's not legendary and it has "At end of combat, exile this creature." 15-20 | Create one of those tokens. You may roll again.
679406.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择目标由你操控的生物，然后掷一颗d20。 1-14 | 派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击，但它不是传奇，且具有「在战斗结束时，放逐此生物。」15-20 | 派出一个上述衍生物。你可以再掷一次。

679407.oracleText: Whenever Delina, Wild Mage attacks, choose target creature you control, then roll a d20. 1-14 | Create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of that creature, except it's not legendary and it has "At end of combat, exile this creature." 15-20 | Create one of those tokens. You may roll again.
679407.translation: 每当狂野法师德莉娜攻击时，选择目标由你操控的生物，然后掷一颗d20。 1-14 | 派出一个为该生物之复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击，但它不是传奇，且具有「在战斗结束时，放逐此生物。」15-20 | 派出一个上述衍生物。你可以再掷一次。

679789.oracleText: Draw a card for each creature you control [with flying].
679789.translation: 你每操控一个[具飞行异能的］生物，便抓一张牌。

679790.oracleText: Draw a card for each creature you control [with flying].
679790.translation: 你每操控一个[具飞行异能的］生物，便抓一张牌。

680292.oracleText: You may cast Oakshade Stalker as though it had flash if you pay {o2} more to cast it.
680292.translation: 如果你施放橡影潜伏客时多支付{o2}，则你可以将它视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

680947.oracleText: Each opponent chooses a permanent they control that shares a card type with the sacrificed permanent and sacrifices it.
680947.translation: 每位对手各选择一个由其操控的永久物，且其须与所牺牲永久物具有共通的牌张类别，并将它牺牲。

681279.oracleText: Choose a permanent you control that shares a card type with the sacrificed permanent.
681279.translation: 选择一个由你操控且与被牺牲永久物具共通牌张类别的永久物。

682058.oracleText: Choose up to one artifact or creature card with mana value 1 discarded this way, up to one artifact or creature card with mana value 2 discarded this way, and up to one artifact or creature card with mana value 3 discarded this way.
682058.translation: 选择至多一张以此法弃掉且法术力值为1的神器或生物牌，至多一张以此法弃掉且法术力值为2的神器或生物牌，和至多一张以此法弃掉且法术力值为3的神器或生物牌。

682059.oracleText: Choose artifact or creature cards you discarded with mana value 1, mana value 2, and mana value 3 to return to the battlefield.
682059.translation: 从你弃掉的牌中，法术力值为1，2，3的神器或生物牌各选择一张。将这些牌移回战场。

682320.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you may put it on the bottom of its owner's library. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then put all revealed cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order. This ability triggers only once each turn.
682320.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，你可以将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。若你如此作，则从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张非地牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。然后将所有以此法展示且未经施放的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

682356.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature card in your graveyard perpetually becomes an artifact. You may cast that card this turn.
682356.translation: {oT}：目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌永久成为神器。本回合中，你可以施放该牌。

682364.oracleText: Goblin spells you cast cost {oR} less to cast.
682364.translation: 你施放的鬼怪咒语减少{oR}来施放。

682365.oracleText: Create X 1/1 green Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
682365.translation: 派出X个1/1绿色树林／树灵衍生地生物。

682366.oracleText: Choose a permanent to return to your hand. Your other nonland permanents will be shuffled into their owner's library.
682366.translation: 选择一个永久物移回你手上。你的其它非地永久物将会被洗回其拥有者的牌库。

682367.oracleText: Target a creature to deal X damage to.
682367.translation: 指定一个目标生物以造成X点伤害。

682368.oracleText: Target a planeswalker to deal X damage to.
682368.translation: 指定一个目标鹏洛客以造成X点伤害。

682369.oracleText: Target a creature to get +X/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
682369.translation: 指定一个目标生物得+X/+0且获得敏捷异能。

682844.oracleText: Choose a Plains, an Island, a Swamp, a Mountain, and a Forest.
682844.translation: 选择一个平原，一个海岛，一个沼泽，一个山脉和一个树林。

682845.oracleText: Choose a land of each basic land type to destroy.
682845.translation: 为每种基本地类别各选择一个地以消灭。

682847.oracleText: Exile target artifact or creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
682847.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的神器或生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

682848.oracleText: Return target artifact or creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
682848.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

682849.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Exile target artifact or creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. • Return target artifact or creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
682849.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  放逐目标由你操控的神器或生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。 •  将目标法术力值等于或小于3的神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

682851.oracleText: There's never a need to change the watch, for the servants of Norn are sleepless.
682851.translation: 他们放哨从来不需要换岗，因为艾蕾侬的仆从全都不眠不休。

682856.oracleText: "Be not afraid of the holy chorus. Join in rapturous harmony."
682856.translation: 「圣歌齐颂非滋扰，携手同心共欢愉。」

682857.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, CARDNAME has double strike.
682857.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

682858.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, Apostle of Invasion has double strike.
682858.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，移行使徒便具有连击异能。

682864.oracleText: "Let those thanebound dissenters prattle about their dead god. I serve the Mother of Machines, and in her name I carve out their heresy."
682864.translation: 「就让那些忠于伯爵的逆徒念叨他们死去的神。我侍奉机械之母，誓以她之名涤净异端。」

682867.oracleText: {o1}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn.
682867.translation: {o1}：从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

682868.oracleText: {o1}, Remove an oil counter from Bladed Ambassador: Bladed Ambassador gains indestructible until end of turn.
682868.translation: {o1}，从利刃大使上移去一个烁油指示物：利刃大使获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

682870.oracleText: Charge of the Mites deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker.
682870.translation: 虫械冲锋对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

682871.oracleText: Create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
682871.translation: 派出两个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

682872.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker. • Create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
682872.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。 •  派出两个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

682873.oracleText: Choose one — • Charge of the Mites deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to target creature or planeswalker. • Create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
682873.translation: 选择一项～ •  虫械冲锋对目标生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。 •  派出两个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

682875.oracleText: "Elspeth, my friend, the Multiverse has answered my prayers to bring you here so that I may gather you into my pride and forever protect you."
682875.translation: 「吾友艾紫培，多重宇宙终于回应我的祈祷带你前来；你将融入狮群，永享我的守护。」

682876.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If that creature has toxic, draw a card.
682876.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果该生物具有下毒异能，则抓一张牌。

682878.oracleText: "We need not be swift. We are inexorable."
682878.translation: 「我们不需快步前行。我们齐心势不可当。」

682879.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
682879.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

682880.oracleText: When Crawling Chorus dies, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
682880.translation: 当匍行唱团死去时，派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

682882.oracleText: "There is no hate behind our blades. We kill out of love, and the desire to share Norn's blessings with all."
682882.translation: 「我们的剑不带仇恨。我们为大爱杀戮，渴望分送艾蕾侬的福祉给众生。」

682887.oracleText: No more than one creature can attack CARDNAME each combat.
682887.translation: 每次战斗中，攻击CARDNAME的生物不得多于一个。

682888.oracleText: No more than one creature can attack The Eternal Wanderer each combat.
682888.translation: 每次战斗中，攻击永世飘萍的生物不能多于一个。

682889.oracleText: Exile up to one target artifact or creature. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of that player's next end step.
682889.translation: 放逐至多一个目标神器或生物。在其拥有者的下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

682890.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Samurai creature token with double strike.
682890.translation: 派出一个2/2白色，具连击异能的武士衍生生物。

682891.oracleText: For each player, choose a creature that player controls. Each player sacrifices all creatures they control not chosen this way.
682891.translation: 为每位牌手各选择一个由其操控的生物。每位牌手各牺牲所有由其操控但未以此法选中的生物。

682896.oracleText: "My mother wore this into battle against the first Phyrexians. Now I wear it in her honor."
682896.translation: 「我的母亲曾头戴此盔，在非瑞克西亚首度入侵时奋战。如今我头戴此盔继承她的志业。」

682900.oracleText: Creatures you control that are equipped get +1/+0.
682900.translation: 由你操控的生物且佩带武具的生物得+1/+0。

682903.oracleText:
"You think it's creepy now? You should see how it eats."
—Melira
682903.translation:
「这你就觉得恶心了？那你该去看看它是怎么吃东西的。」
～梅梨莱

682904.oracleText: Corrupted — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
682904.translation: 腐化～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

682905.oracleText: Corrupted — Whenever Incisor Glider attacks, if an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
682905.translation: 腐化～每当切牙滑翔械攻击时，若某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

682910.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
682910.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

682912.oracleText: "I have room for a few more teeth in my collection. Who's next?"
682912.translation: 「我的藏品里还有几颗牙齿的位置。下一个谁来？」

682916.oracleText: {o3oWoW}: Create a 2/2 white Cat creature token.
682916.translation: {o3oWoW}：派出一个2/2白色的猫衍生生物。

682918.oracleText: "It's hard to fight for the future if you can't see the way forward."
682918.translation: 「看不清前路，就很难为未来而战。」

682919.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is equipped, it gets +1/+1.

682920.oracleText: As long as Leonin Lightbringer is equipped, it gets +1/+1.
682920.translation: 只要狮族光明使者佩带武具，它便得+1/+1。

682922.oracleText: While one mouth feeds, the other chatters mindless paeans of Elesh Norn's glory.
682922.translation: 一张嘴只顾吃喝，另一张嘴则用来吟唱艾蕾侬荣光的机械颂歌。

682926.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+1 and has vigilance.
682926.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+1且具有警戒异能。

682929.oracleText: {o1o(W/P)o(W/P)}, Sacrifice two other artifacts and/or creatures: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
682929.translation: {o1o(W/P)o(W/P)}，牺牲两个其他神器和／或生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

682930.oracleText: {o1o(W/P)o(W/P)}, Sacrifice two other artifacts and/or creatures: Put an indestructible counter on Mondrak, Glory Dominus.
682930.translation: {o1o(W/P)o(W/P)}，牺牲两个其他神器和／或生物：在荣光圣主蒙垂克上放置一个不灭指示物。

682932.translation:
「没溺其中，你便能再度呼吸。」
～亚崔夏

682933.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, scry 1 and put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
682933.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，占卜1并在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

682934.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, scry 1 and put an oil counter on Norn's Wellspring.
682934.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物死去时，占卜1并在艾蕾侬涌泉上放置一个烁油指示物。

682935.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Remove two oil counters from CARDNAME: Draw a card.
682935.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去两个烁油指示物：抓一张牌。

682936.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Remove two oil counters from Norn's Wellspring: Draw a card.
682936.translation: {o1}，{oT}，从艾蕾侬涌泉上移去两个烁油指示物：抓一张牌。

682938.oracleText: The mites sniff out any potential interlopers. He handles the rest.
682938.translation: 虫械能嗅出潜藏的入侵者。之后就由他接手。

682939.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as you control two or more artifacts.
682939.translation: 只要你操控两个或更多神器，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

682940.oracleText: Orthodoxy Enforcer gets +2/+0 as long as you control two or more artifacts.
682940.translation: 只要你操控两个或更多神器，正道执法僧便得+2/+0。

682942.oracleText: Only Elesh Norn's most loyal servants are granted the honor of becoming part of her throne.
682942.translation: 只有艾蕾侬最忠诚的仆从，才有幸纳入她圣座一隅。

682943.translation: 结附于由你操控的基本地

682947.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to CARDNAME, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, CARDNAME deals that much damage to any other target.
682947.translation: 如果CARDNAME将受到伤害，则防止该伤害。当以此法防止伤害时，CARDNAME对任意另一个目标造成等量的伤害。

682948.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to Phyrexian Vindicator, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, Phyrexian Vindicator deals that much damage to any other target.
682948.translation: 如果非瑞克西亚雪恨兽将受到伤害，则防止该伤害。当以此法防止伤害时，非瑞克西亚雪恨兽对任意另一个目标造成等量的伤害。

682950.oracleText: New Phyrexia's planar defenses scattered the Planeswalker strike team on arrival. Elesh Norn knew they were coming.
682950.translation: 鹏洛客突袭队刚到新非瑞克西亚，便遭此处的时空防御打散：艾蕾侬早就知道他们会来。

682952.oracleText:
"Witness the glory of true, unwavering unity."
—Ajani
682952.translation:
「敬请见证精纯无他的团结荣光。」
～阿耶尼

682954.oracleText: "There is a single, glorious truth, etched in the hearts of the faithful. Join in unity, or be washed away."
682954.translation: 「信众心中均已镌刻此等真理，它独一无二、光荣至上：携手共晋大一统，自立独行无前路。」

682955.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If that creature has toxic, instead it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
682955.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。若该生物具有下毒异能，则改为它得+2/+2直到回合结束。

682957.oracleText: "Well, aren't you a sight for sore eyes!" said Koth. "I was about to say the same, my friend," Elspeth replied.
682957.translation: 「啊，还能见到你真是太好了！」寇斯说。「老朋友，我也一样。」艾紫培展颜相迎。

682958.oracleText: Equipped creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
682958.translation: 由你操控且佩带武具的生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

682960.oracleText: He spreads word of the Argent Etchings to a captive audience.
682960.translation: 他广为传扬《银蚀圣典》箴言，藉此将观众一网打尽。

682961.oracleText: Corrupted — {oW}, {oT}: Tap target creature. Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
682961.translation: 腐化～{oW}，{oT}：横置目标生物。只能于某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物时起动。

682964.translation: 叛逃虫械斯勒夫不能进行阻挡。

682965.oracleText: {o(W/P)}, {oT}: Choose a color. Another target creature you control gains toxic 1 and hexproof from that color until end of turn. It can't be blocked by creatures of that color this turn.
682965.translation: {o(W/P)}，{oT}：选择一种颜色。直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得下毒1与反该色辟邪异能。它本回合不能被该色生物阻挡。

682967.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life and create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
682967.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你失去1点生命并派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

682968.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control with toxic have lifelink.
682968.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，由你操控且具下毒异能的生物便具有系命异能。

682970.oracleText:
"It's hard to tell with this glare, but those must be the skyhunter reinforcements! They have arrived at last!"
—Prahan, Mirran rebel
682970.translation:
「虽然强光刺眼看不清楚，但那些一定是来增援的空猎者！他们总算到了！」
～秘罗反抗军普拉翰

682972.oracleText: Faced with a blast that would level not only New Phyrexia, but also a dozen innocent worlds, Elspeth consigned it—and herself—to the nothingness in between.
682972.translation: 此般爆裂震荡行将横扫新非瑞克西亚、同时牵连诸多无辜世界；艾紫培毅然将之连同自身逐入诸界间的黑暗虚空。

682973.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} more to cast if it targets a creature.
682973.translation: 如果此咒语以生物为目标，则它增加{o3}来施放。

682975.oracleText:
"Hear only harmony. See only glory. Speak only truth."
—Atraxa
682975.translation:
「只闻和谐。只见荣光。只言真理。」
～亚崔夏

682979.oracleText: You gain X life. Create X 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block." If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures.
682979.translation: 你获得X点生命。派出X个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」如果X等于或大于5，则消灭所有其他生物。

682981.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, enchanted creature gets an additional +1/+0 and has first strike.
682981.translation: 腐化～只要某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，所结附的生物便再得+1/+0且具有先攻异能。

682983.oracleText: For the aspirants of the Progress Engine, being launched into the sphere's upper reaches is a great honor. Some are even granted wings beforehand.
682983.translation: 对于进展引擎的望化兽来说，能被送入狱界外沿就已是莫大荣耀。还有些在此之前会得赐双翼。

682984.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+3 and gains flying and toxic 1.
682984.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+3且获得飞行与下毒1。

682987.oracleText: It is Jin-Gitaxias's deepest exasperation that any part of his domain still requires maintenance.
682987.translation: 自身地界中还有地方需要维护，这点令金吉塔厦极为恼火。

682988.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
682988.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

682989.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on Atmosphere Surgeon.
682989.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在气界医士上放置一个烁油指示物。

682990.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Target creature gains flying until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
682990.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

682991.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from Atmosphere Surgeon: Target creature gains flying until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
682991.translation: 从气界医士上移去一个烁油指示物：目标生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

682993.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes attached to a creature, for as long as CARDNAME remains attached to it, you may have that creature become a copy of another target creature you control.
682993.translation: 每当CARDNAME新贴附在任一生物上时，于CARDNAME持续贴附于其上期间，你可以使该生物成为另一个目标由你操控之生物的复制品。

682994.oracleText: Whenever Blade of Shared Souls becomes attached to a creature, for as long as Blade of Shared Souls remains attached to it, you may have that creature become a copy of another target creature you control.
682994.translation: 每当共魂利刃新贴附在任一生物上时，于共魂利刃持续贴附于其上期间，你可以使该生物成为另一个目标由你操控之生物的复制品。

682996.oracleText:
"Where once there was ignorance, Jin-Gitaxias brought knowledge, and an age of progress dawned."
—Monument inscription
682996.translation:
「于原本无知之地，金吉塔厦带来智识，进展时代就此兴起。」
～丰碑铭文

682997.oracleText: Gain control of target creature with mana value X or less. If X is 5 or more, create a token that's a copy of that creature.
682997.translation: 获得目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物之操控权。如果X等于或大于5，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该生物的复制品。

682999.oracleText: Kaya watched in horror as the illusion vanished from her hands. Jace held the real Sylex—and had activated it before phyresis claimed his mind.
682999.translation: 卡娅惊恐地看着虚影在手中消逝。真正的同兆在杰斯手中～且他在心智遭非瑞化之前就已起动。

683000.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}. Corrupted — Counter that spell instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
683000.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。腐化～如果该生物的操控者具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则改为反击该咒语。

683001.oracleText:
Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}. 
Corrupted — Counter that spell instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
683001.translation:
除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。
腐化～如果该生物的操控者具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则改为反击该咒语。

683003.oracleText: It can catch a rat and perform a spinal tap with one graceful swipe of its paw.
683003.translation: 它只需爪子优雅一挥，就能轻松抓住老鼠抽取脊液。

683006.oracleText: "Free will was an illusion so perfect it fooled even me. I know better now."
683006.translation: 「自由意志这一幻象如此完美，连我都曾遭欺骗。现在的我看得更透彻。」

683007.oracleText: Corrupted — This spell costs {o2} less to cast if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
683007.translation: 腐化～如果某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

683009.oracleText:
"Careful—however they might look, they're not human. A step too close and they'll drag you in."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
683009.translation:
「当心～不管样貌如何，他们现在都已不是人类。一旦走得太近，他们就会把你也拉进去。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

683010.oracleText: Nonland permanents you control are artifacts in addition to their other types. The same is true for permanent spells you control and nonland permanent cards you own that aren't on the battlefield.
683010.translation: 由你操控的非地永久物额外具有神器此类别。由你操控的永久物咒语和由你拥有且不在战场上的非地永久物牌也额外具有该类别。

683012.oracleText: One morning, the test subject decided to perform trials on the scientists.
683012.translation: 某天早晨，实验对象决定拿科学家来做实验。

683013.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-0 until end of turn, where X is the number of artifacts you control.
683013.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-0直到回合结束，X为由你操控的神器数量。

683014.oracleText: Whenever Escaped Experiment attacks, target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-0 until end of turn, where X is the number of artifacts you control.
683014.translation: 每当逃脱实验体攻击时，目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-0直到回合结束，X为由你操控的神器数量。

683016.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. Proliferate.
683016.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。增殖。

683022.oracleText:
"Drink deeply of the truth, and become compleat."
—Tamiyo

683025.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target player mills X cards, where X is the number of oil counters on CARDNAME.
683025.translation: {o3}，{oT}：目标牌手磨X张牌，X为CARDNAME上的烁油指示物数量。

683026.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target player mills X cards, where X is the number of oil counters on Font of Progress.
683026.translation: {o3}，{oT}：目标牌手磨X张牌，X为进展洗礼池上的烁油指示物数量。

683028.oracleText: An inconsistency in a routine vivisection sparked a revelation about the inner workings of the Orthodoxy's centurions.
683028.translation: 常规活体解剖过程中一次违规操作，碰巧揭示了机械正道百夫长的内部运作机理。

683032.oracleText: Bored with the ruins of Lumengrid, it migrated to the ruins of the Mephidross.
683032.translation: 在玩厌博识都遗迹之后，它来到蔓非沼废墟寻乐。

683035.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: CARDNAME gets +1/-1 until end of turn.
683035.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：CARDNAME得+1/-1直到回合结束。

683036.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from Gitaxian Raptor: Gitaxian Raptor gets +1/-1 until end of turn.
683036.translation: 从吉塔厦派猛禽上移去一个烁油指示物：吉塔厦派猛禽得+1/-1直到回合结束。

683039.oracleText: "The oil is all-knowing. The trick is to ask the right questions."
683039.translation: 「全能烁油无所不知。关键在于问对问题。」

683041.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Scry 1.
683041.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：占卜1。

683042.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from Glistener Seer: Scry 1.
683042.translation: {oT}，从油亮预言家上移去一个烁油指示物：占卜1。

683044.oracleText: "I've isolated the chirality of the glistening oil, so there will be no wasted precursors."
683044.translation: 「我已将烁油的对掌性分离，从此不会再产生无用前质。」

683045.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on Ichor Synthesizer.
683045.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在脓水合成师上放置一个烁油指示物。

683046.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has four or more oil counters on it, it gets +2/+0 and can't be blocked.
683046.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有四个或更多烁油指示物，它便得+2/+0且不能被阻挡。

683047.oracleText: As long as Ichor Synthesizer has four or more oil counters on it, it gets +2/+0 and can't be blocked.
683047.translation: 只要脓水合成师上有四个或更多烁油指示物，它便得+2/+0且不能被阻挡。

683050.oracleText: Take an extra turn after this one.
683050.translation: 于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。

683051.oracleText: Planeswalkers you control have "[0]: Proliferate" and "[-12]: Take an extra turn after this one."
683051.translation: 由你操控的鹏洛客具有「[0]：增殖」与「[-12]：于本回合后进行额外的一个回合。」

683052.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, choose a counter on target permanent. Put an additional counter of that kind on that permanent.
683052.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，选择目标永久物上的一个指示物。在该永久物上额外放置一个同种类的指示物。

683054.oracleText: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -3/-0.
683054.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，至多一个目标生物得-3/-0。

683055.oracleText: Target player mills three cards. Then if a graveyard has twenty or more cards in it, you draw three cards. Otherwise, you draw a card.
683055.translation: 目标牌手磨三张牌。然后如果某坟墓场中有二十张或更多牌，则你抓三张牌。若否，则你抓一张牌。

683056.oracleText: Target player mills three times X cards.
683056.translation: 目标牌手磨三倍于X数量的牌。

683059.oracleText: Each of the Gitaxian sectives watches the others, looking for any hint of imperfection.
683059.translation: 吉塔厦派各组之间互相监视，不放过一丝瑕疵。

683060.oracleText: When Malcator's Watcher dies, draw a card.
683060.translation: 当麻卡特的看守械死去时，抓一张牌。

683062.oracleText:
"Imagine a giant room, like a library . . . except instead of books, it's filled with body parts."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
683062.translation:
「想象一个巨大的房间，就如图书馆那样…但里面堆满的不是书本，而是肢体。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

683066.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: It becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
683066.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：它成为神器生物直到回合结束。

683067.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from Meldweb Strider: It becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
683067.translation: 从融思网神行械上移去一个烁油指示物：它成为神器生物直到回合结束。

683070.translation: 善变舞咒客不能被阻挡。

683071.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on Mercurial Spelldancer.
683071.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在善变舞咒客上放置一个烁油指示物。

683078.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
683078.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

683079.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put an oil counter on Mindsplice Apparatus.
683079.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在剖念装置上放置一个烁油指示物。

683080.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each oil counter on CARDNAME.
683080.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个烁油指示物，你施放的瞬间与法术咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

683081.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each oil counter on Mindsplice Apparatus.
683081.translation: 剖念装置上每有一个烁油指示物，你施放的瞬间与法术咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

683083.oracleText: No matter how many times he saw it, Sarnvax always relished the look of dawning horror as his foes realized their mistake.
683083.translation: 无论看过多少遍，萨恩瓦依然享受对手在意识到自己失误时脸上浮现出的惊恐表情。

683084.oracleText: Counter target spell with mana value 1 or less.
683084.translation: 反击目标法术力值等于或小于1的咒语。

683086.oracleText: "Please, for science, tell me how it feels. Leave nothing out."
683086.translation: 「为科研发展，请如实告诉我期间感受。不要遗漏任何细节。」

683087.oracleText: Each opponent gets a poison counter.
683087.translation: 每位对手各得到一个中毒指示物。

683089.oracleText: It no longer needs to eat, but old instincts are put to use ridding the Surgical Bay of spies.
683089.translation: 虽然它已不用进食，但其古老本能仍能用来清除外展海湾的间谍。

683092.oracleText:
"Your theory holds merit. You do not."
—Sarnvax, Gitaxian sective
683092.translation:
「你的理论尚存价值。你却没有。」
～吉塔厦组的萨恩瓦

683093.oracleText: Counter target spell. If that spell's mana value was 3 or less, proliferate.
683093.translation: 反击目标咒语。如果该咒语的法术力值等于或小于3，则增殖。

683095.oracleText: "I bring a message from the Autonomous Furn—argh!"
683095.translation: 「我带来了自治熔炉的口信～啊！」

683096.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If that permanent had mana value 3 or less, proliferate.
683096.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果该永久物的法术力值等于或小于3，则增殖。

683098.oracleText: Visitors to the Surgical Bay often become permanent residents.
683098.translation: 外展海湾的访客通常都会永久居留。

683101.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Tap target artifact or creature.
683101.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：横置目标神器或生物。

683102.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from Tamiyo's Immobilizer: Tap target artifact or creature.
683102.translation: {oT}，从多美代的捆缚具上移去一个烁油指示物：横置目标神器或生物。

683104.oracleText:
"We are opening a new chapter in the one true story of Phyrexia. Someone must record it for posterity."
—Tamiyo
683104.translation:
「我们将开启非瑞克西亚正统叙事的全新篇章。要有人为后世留下纪录。」
～多美代

683105.oracleText: {o5oU}, {oT}: Draw a card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each other artifact you control.
683105.translation: {o5oU}，{oT}：抓一张牌。你每操控一个其他神器，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

683107.oracleText: If you would proliferate, proliferate twice instead.
683107.translation: 如果你将增殖，则改为增殖两次。

683108.oracleText: {o1o(U/P)o(U/P)}, Remove three counters from among other artifacts, creatures, and planeswalkers you control: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
683108.translation: {o1o(U/P)o(U/P)}，从由你操控的其他神器、生物和鹏洛客上移去总共三个指示物：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

683109.oracleText: {o1o(U/P)o(U/P)}, Remove three counters from among other artifacts, creatures, and planeswalkers you control: Put an indestructible counter on Tekuthal, Inquiry Dominus.
683109.translation: {o1o(U/P)o(U/P)}，从由你操控的其他神器、生物和鹏洛客上移去总共三个指示物：在求知圣主特库索上放置一个不灭指示物。

683115.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each oil counter on it.
683115.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+1。

683116.oracleText: Trawler Drake gets +1/+1 for each oil counter on it.
683116.translation: 拖曳龙兽上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+1。

683117.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on Trawler Drake.
683117.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在拖曳龙兽上放置一个烁油指示物。

683120.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, draw a card, then discard a card.
683120.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

683121.oracleText: Other blue creatures you control have "Whenever this creature becomes tapped, draw a card, then discard a card."
683121.translation: 由你操控的其他蓝色生物具有「每当此生物成为横置时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。」

683122.oracleText: {o(U/P)}: Until end of turn, target creature you control becomes a blue artifact in addition to its other colors and types. Activate only as a sorcery.
683122.translation: {o(U/P)}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物成为蓝色神器，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。只能于法术时机起动。

683127.oracleText: "Experimental Log 290: Leaving the subject's pain receptors active appears to yield an unprecedented combination of incoherence and hyperawareness."
683127.translation: 「实验日志290：保留对象的痛觉受体，似乎同时产生了无意识跟超意识的结果，此前从未观察到此类现象。」

683131.oracleText: After a series of ambushes, Uulbrek demanded a sentry with no blind spots.
683131.translation: 在遭受连串伏击后，乌布雷要求派没有丝毫盲点的哨卫来巡逻。

683133.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, draw cards equal to the number of oil counters on it.
683133.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，抓若干牌，其数量等同于其上的烁油指示物数量。

683134.oracleText: When Watchful Blisterzoa dies, draw cards equal to the number of oil counters on it.
683134.translation: 当警醒刺螫佐雅死去时，抓若干牌，其数量等同于其上的烁油指示物数量。

683136.oracleText: The Mirran forces thought they'd vanquished their foes . . . until a nearby monument got up and started stalking toward them.
683136.translation: 秘罗军以为已全歼敌人…直到附近的丰碑起身向他们缓步前进。

683140.oracleText: By gaze, sting, and claw, Vraska will see the will of Phyrexia done.
683140.translation: 瞪视、毒刺、利爪，瓦丝卡总有办法确保非瑞克西亚意志得以贯彻。

683141.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay {o4} or sacrifice an artifact or creature.
683141.translation: 支付{o4}或牺牲一个神器或生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

683143.oracleText: Many vatkeepers use necrogen etchings to judge the value of their aspirants. If the wounds rot and fester, the recipient is not worth further effort.
683143.translation: 许多司缸依据望化兽身上的化尸瘴蚀刻来判断其价值。如果其身上伤口腐败溃烂，就没必要继续投入精力。

683144.oracleText: Exile target creature if it has mana value 3 or less. Corrupted — Exile that creature instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
683144.translation: 如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于3，则放逐之。腐化～如果该生物的操控者具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则改为放逐该生物。

683145.oracleText:
Exile target creature if it has mana value 3 or less. 
Corrupted — Exile that creature instead if its controller has three or more poison counters.
683145.translation:
如果目标生物的法术力值等于或小于3，则放逐之。
腐化～如果该生物的操控者具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则改为放逐该生物。

683148.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from CARDNAME. Then if it has no oil counters on it, you lose the game.
683148.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物。然后如果其上没有烁油指示物，则你输掉这盘游戏。

683149.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from Archfiend of the Dross. Then if it has no oil counters on it, you lose the game.
683149.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从深沼翼邪鬼上移去一个烁油指示物。然后如果其上没有烁油指示物，则你输掉这盘游戏。

683150.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, its controller loses 2 life.
683150.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，该操控者失去2点生命。

683152.oracleText:
"Watch your footing around here. Anything you might step on probably has teeth."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
683152.translation:
「在这地方下脚时要当心。你踩到的任何东西都可能有牙齿。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

683154.oracleText:
"Where once there was complacence, Sheoldred brought ambition, and soon the will of Yawgmoth reigned."
—Monument inscription
683154.translation:
「于原本自满之地，希欧蕊带来雄心，约格莫夫意志将成正统。」
～丰碑铭文

683155.oracleText: Up to one target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. If X is 5 or more, return a creature card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
683155.translation: 至多一个目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束。如果X等于或大于5，则将一张法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

683159.oracleText:
"Get away from there! I must rebuild that one for the next bout. Shoo, shoo!"
—Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor
683159.translation:
「从那玩意上走开！我得重新修好那东西，下次战斗还要用。嘘，嘘！」
～血肉雕匠刻兹杰

683160.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, CARDNAME has deathtouch and lifelink.
683160.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，CARDNAME便具有死触和系命异能。

683161.oracleText: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, Bonepicker Skirge has deathtouch and lifelink.
683161.translation: 腐化～只要某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，拣骨斯克魔便具有死触和系命异能。

683163.oracleText: What cannot be remade will be unmade, one scrap at a time.
683163.translation: 不能修好重用的就将之弃置，一次销毁一小块。

683164.oracleText: Corrupted — Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Draw a card. Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters and only once each turn.
683164.translation: 腐化～牺牲一个神器或生物：抓一张牌。只能于某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物时起动，且每回合限一次。

683166.oracleText: The gospel of lies sounds sweetest when whispered by many mouths.
683166.translation: 只要众口齐声传唱，谎言福音就最为甜美。

683171.oracleText: "We both serve the Demon Thane. Your parts would better serve with me."
683171.translation: 「我们都服侍恶魔伯爵。但你化整为零为我所用，效果会更好。」

683172.oracleText: Sacrifice another artifact or creature: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
683172.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

683173.oracleText: Sacrifice another artifact or creature: Cutthroat Centurion gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
683173.translation: 牺牲另一个神器或生物：割喉百夫长得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

683175.oracleText: {o(B/P)o(B/P)}, Exile three creature cards from your graveyard: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
683175.translation: {o(B/P)o(B/P)}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张生物牌：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

683176.oracleText: {o(B/P)o(B/P)}, Exile three creature cards from your graveyard: Put an indestructible counter on Drivnod, Carnage Dominus.
683176.translation: {o(B/P)o(B/P)}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张生物牌：在杀戮圣主缀文诺上放置一个不灭指示物。

683178.oracleText: Sinking into the Dross is neither a gentle death nor a quiet one. But once the necrogen takes hold, it is inevitable.
683178.translation: 陷入深沼后死起来绝不安详，也绝不安静。但一旦吸入化尸瘴，就必死无疑。

683179.oracleText: Target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn. Proliferate.
683179.translation: 目标生物得-4/-4直到回合结束。增殖。

683180.oracleText:
"Give of yourself, for compleation awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred
683180.translation:
「请先奉献自己，因唯有已涤净者方得完化。」
～希欧蕊僧侣诺卡

683182.oracleText: They wished to become vital parts of the Dross Pits. Azax-Azog granted their request.
683182.translation: 他们希望能在蔓非深沼中担任要职。亚札佐从他们所愿。

683183.oracleText: You draw three cards and you lose 3 life. Corrupted — Each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 3 life.
683183.translation: 你抓三张牌且失去3点生命。腐化～每位具有三个或更多中毒指示物的对手各失去3点生命。

683184.oracleText:
You draw three cards and you lose 3 life. 
Corrupted — Each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 3 life.
683184.translation:
你抓三张牌且失去3点生命。
腐化～每位具有三个或更多中毒指示物的对手各失去3点生命。

683186.oracleText: What she lacks in skin she makes up in swagger.
683186.translation: 没有皮肤带来的劣势，她靠架势补回。

683187.oracleText: Corrupted — {o2oB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. You lose 1 life. Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
683187.translation: 腐化～{o2oB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。你失去1点生命。只能于某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物时起动。

683188.oracleText: Corrupted — {o2oB}: Return Fleshless Gladiator from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. You lose 1 life. Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
683188.translation: 腐化～{o2oB}：将无肌角斗士从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。你失去1点生命。只能于某位对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物时起动。

683190.oracleText: "It seems someone forgot to read the fine print."

683191.oracleText: {o1oBoB}, {oT}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains "If this creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else." Activate only as a sorcery.
683191.translation: {o1oBoB}，{oT}：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得「如果此生物将离开战场，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其他区域。」只能于法术时机起动。

683193.oracleText:
"Does anyone else hear that horrible crunching sound?"
—Jace
683193.translation:
「你们都没人听到那恐怖的咔嚓声吗？」
～杰斯

683197.oracleText: "I give you pain, you give me information. A simple trade, is it not?"
683197.translation: 「我给你痛苦，你予我信息。很简单的交易，不是吗？」

683198.oracleText: You draw two cards and you lose 2 life. Each opponent gets a poison counter.
683198.translation: 你抓两张牌且失去2点生命。每位对手各得到一个中毒指示物。

683200.oracleText: Other Rats you control have toxic 1.
683200.translation: 由你操控的其他老鼠具有下毒1。

683203.translation: 所结附的生物具有下毒2。

683206.oracleText: Necrosquito gets +1/+1 for each oil counter on it.
683206.translation: 化尸蚊上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+1。

683207.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
683207.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

683208.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on Necrosquito.
683208.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在化尸蚊上放置一个烁油指示物。

683214.oracleText: "Give all you are to Phyrexia, and you will receive more than you could have ever desired."
683214.translation: 「将你的一切都献予非瑞克西亚，所得回报将远超所想。」

683216.oracleText: The praetors of the other Spheres privately wonder how Sheoldred always has a surplus of glistening oil at her disposal.
683216.translation: 其他狱界的魔判官私底下都想搞清楚，为何希欧蕊手边总有用不完的烁油。

683217.oracleText: For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love. A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.
683217.translation: 在那苦乐参半的一瞬间，杰斯曾以为自己还有机会救下心中所爱。而瓦丝卡需要的就正是这一瞬间。她趁机低语道：「为了非瑞克西亚荣光。」

683218.oracleText:
"Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain."
—Sheoldred
683218.translation:
「让我看看那些谄媚艾蕾侬的家伙美丽瓷体底下都是些什么东西。」
～希欧蕊

683220.oracleText: Some of Sheoldred's goliaths spread the glory of Phyrexia. Others just eat.
683220.translation: 希欧蕊手下有些巨身兽努力散播非瑞克西亚荣光。而有些就只会吃。

683224.oracleText: "I have raised many of my own contenders for the Coliseum. This one will be fearsome one day, mark my words."
683224.translation: 「我曾为竞技场输送过不少亲自培养的精英选手。这位总有一天也会大杀四方，记住我的话。」

683225.oracleText: Whenever you proliferate, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
683225.translation: 每当你增殖时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

683228.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature.
683228.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。

683229.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature token.
683229.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个衍生生物。

683230.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个鹏洛客。

683231.oracleText: Choose one — • Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature. • Each opponent sacrifices a creature token. • Each opponent sacrifices a planeswalker.
683231.translation: 选择一项～ •  每位对手各牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。 •  每位对手各牺牲一个衍生生物。 •  每位对手各牺牲一个鹏洛客。

683233.oracleText: The punishment for sedition, like every other crime in the Dross Pits, is execution.
683233.translation: 煽动罪的刑责与蔓非深沼内其他罪行并无区别～都是死刑。

683235.oracleText: From within its form, a single word echoed forth: "Devour."
683235.translation: 从其体内，两个字音不断回响：「吞噬。」

683236.oracleText: When Stinging Hivemaster dies, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
683236.translation: 当螯刺御虫师死去时，派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

683238.oracleText: She proudly carries the weight of Phyrexia's creed, both figuratively and literally.
683238.translation: 她光荣承担非瑞克西亚信条之重～无论精神上或肉体上皆是如此。

683239.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
683239.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

683240.oracleText: When Testament Bearer dies, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
683240.translation: 当负约徒死去时，检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

683242.oracleText: The first rebirth is a reward. The fifty-first is a punishment.
683242.translation: 第一次再生是奖赏。第五十一次则是惩罚。

683243.oracleText: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. Proliferate.
683243.translation: 将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。增殖。

683245.oracleText: Whenever another artifact or creature you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
683245.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

683246.oracleText: Whenever another artifact or creature you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on Vat of Rebirth.
683246.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器或生物从战场进入坟墓场时，在再生缸上放置一个烁油指示物。

683247.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Remove four oil counters from CARDNAME: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
683247.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去四个烁油指示物：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

683248.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}, Remove four oil counters from Vat of Rebirth: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
683248.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}，从再生缸上移去四个烁油指示物：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

683250.oracleText: "Soon enough each praetor will have hired me to kill the others, and I will stand alone as the true Father of Machines."
683250.translation: 「很快其他魔判官也都会来雇我来除掉魔判异己，最后只剩我成为真正机械之父。」

683251.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control die, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. This ability triggers only once each turn.
683251.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他生物死去时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

683253.oracleText: You draw a card and you lose 1 life. Proliferate.
683253.translation: 你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。增殖。

683254.oracleText: Target creature becomes a Treasure artifact with "{oT}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color" and loses all other card types and abilities.
683254.translation: 目标生物成为具「{oT}，牺牲此神器：加一点任意颜色的法术力」的珍宝神器，且失去所有其他牌张类别和异能。

683255.oracleText: If target player has fewer than nine poison counters, they get a number of poison counters equal to the difference.
683255.translation: 如果目标牌手具有少于九个中毒指示物，则其得到等同于此差距数量的中毒指示物。

683257.oracleText: The dull, creeping pain of phyresis curdled in Vraska's blood. She knew as soon as it took her, she would betray everything—even Jace.
683257.translation: 非瑞化的针刺隐痛逐渐在瓦丝卡的血液凝结。她从自己染疾的那一刻起，就知道自己会背叛一切～甚至是杰斯。

683258.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker and gets a poison counter.
683258.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个生物或鹏洛客并得到一个中毒指示物。

683260.oracleText: "Live or die, you serve the Steel Thanes now."
683260.translation: 「无论生死，你现在都要服侍钢铁伯爵。」

683261.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Proliferate.
683261.translation: 目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。增殖。

683263.oracleText: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.
683263.translation: 移行树穿破黑暗虚空，令非瑞克西亚完化势力在多重宇宙之间自如奔流。

683264.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more counters on a permanent or player, CARDNAME deals that much damage to target opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls.
683264.translation: 每当你在一个永久物或一位牌手上放置一个或数个指示物时，CARDNAME对目标对手，由对手操控的生物或由对手操控的鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

683265.oracleText: Whenever you put one or more counters on a permanent or player, All Will Be One deals that much damage to target opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls.
683265.translation: 每当你在一个永久物或一位牌手上放置一个或数个指示物时，万界归一对目标对手，由对手操控的生物或由对手操控的鹏洛客造成等量的伤害。

683267.oracleText:
"Without faith in each other, we truly would have nothing left. Isn't that right, Malach? . . . Malach?"
—Darven, Mirran rebel, last words
683267.translation:
「要彼此之间都信不过，我们就真的什么都没有了。你说是吧，马拉克？…马拉克？」
～秘罗反抗军达文的遗言

683268.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. If it's equipped, you may destroy all Equipment attached to that creature.
683268.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。如果它佩带武具，则你可以消灭所有贴附在该生物上的武具。

683270.oracleText: "I will not rest until the truth of Phyrexia is inscribed across the Multiverse."
683270.translation: 「在非瑞克西亚真理刻遍整个多重宇宙之前，我不会停歇。」

683272.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME, Discard a card: Draw a card.
683272.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物，弃一张牌：抓一张牌。

683273.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from Axiom Engraver, Discard a card: Draw a card.
683273.translation: {oT}，从镌言师上移去一个烁油指示物，弃一张牌：抓一张牌。

683275.oracleText: "Finally, a safe way to punch the rotters in the face."
683275.translation: 「终于能够安全地照着腐化者脸上给他一拳。」

683277.oracleText: "To dance to the music of Juex, leap like the flickering flame and hit like the hammer."
683277.translation: 「若要随着朱业音乐起舞，只需如火焰般跃动，似铁锤般重击。」

683278.oracleText: Equipment spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
683278.translation: 你施放的武具咒语减少{o1}来施放。

683279.oracleText: Activated abilities of Equipment you control that target CARDNAME cost {o1} less to activate.
683279.translation: 对由你操控的武具而言，其以CARDNAME为目标的起动式异能减少{o1}来起动。

683280.oracleText: Activated abilities of Equipment you control that target Bladegraft Aspirant cost {o1} less to activate.
683280.translation: 对由你操控的武具而言，其以殖刃望化兽为目标的起动式异能减少{o1}来起动。

683282.oracleText:
"They call themselves the Quiet Furnace? Ironic."
—Tyvar
683282.translation:
「他们居然自称静谧熔炉？真是讽刺。」
～泰瓦

683285.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, proliferate.
683285.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。若你如此作，则增殖。

683286.oracleText: Whenever Cacophony Scamp deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. If you do, proliferate.
683286.translation: 每当杂音恶兽对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它牺牲。若你如此作，则增殖。

683287.oracleText: When Cacophony Scamp dies, it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
683287.translation: 当杂音恶兽死去时，它对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

683289.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you have nine or more cards in your graveyard.
683289.translation: 如果你的坟墓场中有九张或更多牌，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

683293.oracleText:
"They're violent, headstrong, and wildly unpredictable. It should be amusing to see how Norn's vaunted tactics try to cope with them."
—Urabrask
683293.translation:
「他们性情暴烈，头脑顽固，行不可测。用他们来试试艾蕾侬自诩的高明战术会如何应对，想必会很有意思。」
～洼巴司

683297.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put an oil counter on another target nontoken artifact or creature you control.
683297.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的神器或生物上放置一个烁油指示物。

683298.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature token. Activate only if an oil counter was removed from a permanent you controlled this turn or a permanent with an oil counter on it was put into a graveyard this turn.
683298.translation: {o2}，{oT}：派出一个1/1红色非瑞人／鬼怪衍生生物。只能于由你操控的永久物上移去烁油指示物，或是其上有烁油指示物之永久物进入坟墓场的回合起动。

683300.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has flying and haste.
683300.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有飞行与敏捷异能。

683303.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 for each oil counter on it.
683303.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+0。

683304.oracleText: Exuberant Fuseling gets +1/+0 for each oil counter on it.
683304.translation: 亢奋引火怪上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+0。

683308.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on Forgehammer Centurion.
683308.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在铸锤百夫长上放置一个烁油指示物。

683309.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may remove two oil counters from it. When you do, target creature can't block this turn.
683309.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从其上移去两个指示物。若你如此作，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

683310.oracleText: Whenever Forgehammer Centurion attacks, you may remove two oil counters from it. When you do, target creature can't block this turn.
683310.translation: 每当铸锤百夫长攻击时，你可以从其上移去两个指示物。若你如此作，目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

683312.oracleText: He finally understood that phyresis was not an ending, but a new, perfect beginning.
683312.translation: 他终于明白，非瑞化并非结束，而是一个全新的完美开始。

683313.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Put two oil counters on it.
683313.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。在其上放置两个烁油指示物。

683315.oracleText: She marks her favorite creations with a searing brand, leaving all others to be consumed by the furnace.
683315.translation: 她会给自己喜欢的造物打上炽灼印记，其他的就放任熔炉吞噬。

683316.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to that player unless they control two or more basic lands.
683316.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，除非该牌手操控两个或更多基本地，否则CARDNAME对其造成2点伤害。

683317.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, Furnace Punisher deals 2 damage to that player unless they control two or more basic lands.
683317.translation: 在每位牌手的维持开始时，除非该牌手操控两个或更多基本地，否则熔炉惩罚者对其造成2点伤害。

683319.oracleText: With the Quiet Furnace closed to all other factions, Urabrask's smiths were free to build anything their creativity demanded.
683319.translation: 随着静谧熔炉向其他派系关闭后，洼巴司的工匠便能手随心动，自由打造创意想象之物。

683321.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Target creature you control gains haste until end of turn.
683321.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：目标由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

683322.oracleText: Remove an oil counter from Furnace Strider: Target creature you control gains haste until end of turn.
683322.translation: 从熔炉神行兽上移去一个烁油指示物：目标由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

683324.oracleText: Urabrask encourages creativity in all its forms, even the destructive ones. Especially the destructive ones.
683324.translation: 洼巴司鼓励各式创新，甚至是毁灭式创新。特别是毁灭式创新。

683325.oracleText: Destroy target artifact. If you controlled that artifact, create three 1/1 red Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens.
683325.translation: 消灭目标神器。如果你操控该神器，则派出三个1/1红色非瑞人／鬼怪衍生生物。

683327.oracleText: The Machine Orthodoxy finds strength in numbers. The Quiet Furnace finds that amusing.
683327.translation: 机械正道认为数量就是力量。静谧熔炉认为这观点很可笑。

683328.oracleText: Hazardous Blast deals 1 damage to each creature your opponents control. Creatures your opponents control can't block this turn.
683328.translation: 毒焰冲击波向每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。由对手操控的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

683332.oracleText:
"No matter how tough they are, even Phyrexians prefer to keep their guts on the inside."
—Jor Kadeen
683332.translation:
「无论非瑞克西亚人有多强，他们也更愿意内脏留在体内。」
～尤克定

683333.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature. If that creature has toxic, CARDNAME deals 4 damage to that creature instead.
683333.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成2点伤害。如果该生物具有下毒异能，则改为金角板斩击对该生物造成4点伤害。

683334.oracleText: Hexgold Slash deals 2 damage to target creature. If that creature has toxic, Hexgold Slash deals 4 damage to that creature instead.
683334.translation: 金角板斩击对目标生物造成2点伤害。如果该生物具有下毒异能，则改为金角板斩击对该生物造成4点伤害。

683336.oracleText: Search your library for a basic Mountain card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
683336.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

683337.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Mountains you control.
683337.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的山脉数量。

683338.oracleText: Koth, Fire of Resistance deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Mountains you control.
683338.translation: 志士烈火寇斯对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的山脉数量。

683343.oracleText: You would laugh too if you just burned through a tyrranax's stomach.
683343.translation: 你要是刚从霸蛛龙的胃里烧穿出来，你也会笑。

683344.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of permanents you control with oil counters on them.
683344.translation: 每当 CARDNAME攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为由你操控且其上有烁油指示物的永久物数量。

683345.oracleText: Whenever Kuldotha Cackler attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of permanents you control with oil counters on them.
683345.translation: 每当库度沙咯笑兽攻击时，它得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为由你操控且其上有烁油指示物的永久物数量。

683349.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand unless you remove two oil counters from it.
683349.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，除非你从CARDNAME上移去两个烁油指示物，否则将它移回其拥有者手上。

683350.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, return Magmatic Sprinter to its owner's hand unless you remove two oil counters from it.
683350.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，除非你从岩浆疾步客上移去两个烁油指示物，否则将它移回其拥有者手上。

683352.oracleText: "Perhaps this will show the Orthodoxy what we think of their attempts at indoctrination."
683352.translation: 「或许这样能向机械正道表明我们对其试图教导的立场。」

683353.oracleText: Molten Rebuke deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
683353.translation: 熔铁拒斥对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。

683355.oracleText: Choose one or both — • CARDNAME deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. • Destroy target Equipment.
683355.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。 •  消灭目标武具。

683356.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Molten Rebuke deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. • Destroy target Equipment.
683356.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  熔铁拒斥对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。 •  消灭目标武具。

683358.oracleText: Nahiri's last free breath became a defiant roar as she tore apart Sheoldred's Coliseum.
683358.translation: 娜希丽利用最后一口自由气息将希欧蕊竞技场彻底摧毁，令这声反抗怒吼震撼全域。

683359.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature with mana value X.
683359.translation: 牺牲一个法术力值为X的神器或生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

683360.oracleText: Nahiri's Sacrifice deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures.
683360.translation: 娜希丽献身对任意数量的目标生物造成共X点伤害，你可以任意分配。

683362.oracleText: Popular wisdom says that Phyrexians don't feel fear. But popular wisdom has never tried to hold a bridge against an angry ogre.
683362.translation: 一般认为非瑞克西亚人不晓得何谓恐惧。但在面对愤怒食人魔来袭时，一般也不会去妄想死守桥梁。

683365.oracleText: "That Great Work of yours is looking pretty fragile, Urabrask!"
683365.translation: 「洼巴司，你的伟大志业看起来不堪一击！」

683366.oracleText: Rebel Salvo deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. That permanent loses indestructible until end of turn.
683366.translation: 反抗迸火对目标生物或鹏洛客造成5点伤害。该永久物失去不灭异能直到回合结束。

683368.oracleText:
"Where once there was apathy, Urabrask brought passion, and the Great Work truly began."
—Monument inscription
683368.translation:
「于原本冷漠之地，洼巴司带来激情，伟大志业真切开展。」
～丰碑铭文

683369.oracleText: Destroy up to X target artifacts. If X is 5 or more, for each artifact destroyed this way, create a token that's a copy of it. Those tokens gain haste. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
683369.translation: 消灭至多X个目标神器。如果X等于或大于5，则每以此法消灭一个神器，便派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。这些衍生物获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们放逐。

683371.oracleText: When the Vulshok taught him the word for "home," he knew it was what he had been fighting for.
683371.translation: 当瓦许可人教会他「家」这个字时，便立刻明白这就是他一直为之战斗的东西。

683373.oracleText: Sometimes the Great Work requires destruction to allow for more efficient reconstruction.
683373.translation: 有时，伟大志业需要先毁坏才能更有效地重建。

683374.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on Sawblade Scamp.
683374.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在锯刃恶兽上放置一个烁油指示物。

683375.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: It deals 1 damage to each opponent.
683375.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

683376.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from Sawblade Scamp: It deals 1 damage to each opponent.
683376.translation: {oT}，从锯刃恶兽上移去一个烁油指示物：它向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

683378.oracleText:
"They may have unlimited mites, but that just means we have unlimited ammunition."
—Urabrask
683378.translation:
「他们或许有无数虫械，但这也就意味着我们会有无穷弹药。」
～洼巴司

683383.oracleText: Once he fought to save Mirrodin. Now he fights to remake it.
683383.translation: 他原来为保卫秘罗地而战。他现在为重塑秘罗地而战。

683384.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Add an amount of {oR} equal to the sacrificed artifact's mana value. Spend this mana only to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
683384.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器：加若干{oR}，其数量等同于所牺牲神器的法术力值。此法术力只能用来施放神器咒语，或是起动神器的异能。

683386.oracleText: If a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals double that damage to that player or permanent instead.
683386.translation: 如果某个由你操控的来源将向任一对手或由对手操控的永久物造成非战斗伤害，则改为它对该牌手或永久物造成两倍的伤害。

683387.oracleText: {o1o(R/P)o(R/P)}, Discard two cards: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
683387.translation: {o1o(R/P)o(R/P)}，弃两张牌：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

683388.oracleText: {o1o(R/P)o(R/P)}, Discard two cards: Put an indestructible counter on Solphim, Mayhem Dominus.
683388.translation: {o1o(R/P)o(R/P)}，弃两张牌：在破坏圣主索非穆上放置一个不灭指示物。

683389.oracleText: As the infection spread, Nahiri's thoughts grew tangled. She needed to protect what she loved from Phyrexia . . . or maybe only Phyrexia could protect what she loved.
683389.translation: 随着侵染不断扩散，娜希丽的思绪逐渐纠结。她需要保护心爱事物免遭非瑞克西亚毒手…但或许只有非瑞克西亚才能真正施以保护。

683391.oracleText: "You were so eager to spy on my work, I assume you'll appreciate a hands-on demonstration."
683391.translation: 「既然你这么迫不及待地想要偷看我的作品，那我觉得你会更喜欢来亲自体验。」

683395.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put an oil counter on CARDNAME, then create an X/1 red Phyrexian Horror creature token with trample and haste, where X is the number of oil counters on CARDNAME. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
683395.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物，然后派出一个X/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的非瑞人／惊惧兽衍生生物，X为CARDNAME上之烁油指示物数量。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

683396.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put an oil counter on Urabrask's Forge, then create an X/1 red Phyrexian Horror creature token with trample and haste, where X is the number of oil counters on Urabrask's Forge. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
683396.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在洼巴司的煅冶炉上放置一个烁油指示物，然后派出一个X/1红色，具践踏与敏捷异能的非瑞人／惊惧兽衍生生物，X为洼巴司的煅冶炉上之烁油指示物数量。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

683398.oracleText: Her faith burns hot enough to sear away the flesh of the heretic.
683398.translation: 她的信念之火足够热烈，能烧尽异教徒的肉身。

683399.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on Vindictive Flamestoker.
683399.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在怀恨炉焰师上放置一个烁油指示物。

683400.oracleText: {o6oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Discard your hand, then draw four cards. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each oil counter on CARDNAME.
683400.translation: {o6oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：弃掉你的手牌,然后抓四张牌。CARDNAME上每有一个烁油指示物,此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

683401.oracleText: {o6oR}, Sacrifice Vindictive Flamestoker: Discard your hand, then draw four cards. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each oil counter on Vindictive Flamestoker.
683401.translation: {o6oR}，牺牲怀恨炉焰师：弃掉你的手牌,然后抓四张牌。怀恨炉焰师上每有一个烁油指示物,此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

683402.oracleText:
"There's a war brewing between Norn and Urabrask. Exploit the chaos, and we can take them both down for good."
—Koth
683402.translation:
「艾蕾侬与洼巴司之间的战争一触即发。利用这混乱，也许就能把他们两派一网打尽。」
～寇斯

683404.oracleText:
"Not my style, but it'll get the job done."
—Nahiri
683404.translation:
「虽不符我的风格，但一样能完事。」
～娜希丽

683407.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
683407.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得警戒异能。

683408.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
683408.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+2且获得警戒异能。

683413.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +3/+0 as long as it has three or more oil counters on it.
683413.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有三个或更多烁油指示物，它便得+3/+0。

683414.oracleText: Armored Scrapgorger gets +3/+0 as long as it has three or more oil counters on it.
683414.translation: 只要装甲噬渣兽上有三个或更多烁油指示物，它便得+3/+0。

683415.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, exile target card from a graveyard and put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
683415.translation: 每当CARDNAME成为横置时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐并在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

683416.oracleText: Whenever Armored Scrapgorger becomes tapped, exile target card from a graveyard and put an oil counter on Armored Scrapgorger.
683416.translation: 每当装甲噬渣兽成为横置时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐并在装甲噬渣兽上放置一个烁油指示物。

683418.oracleText: Whenever Bloated Contaminator deals combat damage to a player, proliferate.
683418.translation: 每当涨囊污染兽对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，增殖。

683420.oracleText: Some Vicious Swarm aspirants hang motionless in the canopy for weeks, allowing poisonous flowers to root in their flesh and weave tendrils through their hair.
683420.translation: 有些暴恶蛮群的望化兽会在林冠上一动不动地垂挂数周，任由剧毒花朵扎根肉身，盘曲卷须直埋发梢。

683423.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Choose one — • Destroy target artifact. • Destroy target enchantment. • Proliferate.
683423.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器。 •  消灭目标结界。 •  增殖。

683424.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Cankerbloom: Choose one — • Destroy target artifact. • Destroy target enchantment. • Proliferate.
683424.translation: {o1}，牺牲散疡菌兽：选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器。 •  消灭目标结界。 •  增殖。

683426.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying. If that permanent's mana value was 3 or less, proliferate.
683426.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。如果该永久物法术力值等于或小于3，则增殖。

683428.oracleText: {oT}: Choose target nonland permanent card in your graveyard. If you haven't cast a spell this turn, you may cast that card. If you do, you can't cast additional spells this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
683428.translation: {oT}：选择目标在你坟墓场中的非地永久物牌。如果你本回合中未施放过咒语，则你可以施放该牌。若你如此作，则你本回合中不能再施放咒语。只能于法术时机起动。

683434.oracleText: Its webs are not true silk, but woven from thousands of delicate mycosynth strands.
683434.translation: 它的蛛网并非真正的蛛丝，而是由千万缕精细的构生菌丝线编纺而成。

683439.oracleText: CARDNAME has trample as long as it has two or fewer oil counters on it. Otherwise, it has hexproof.
683439.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有两个或更少烁油指示物，它便具有践踏异能。若否，则它具有辟邪异能。

683440.oracleText: Evolved Spinoderm has trample as long as it has two or fewer oil counters on it. Otherwise, it has hexproof.
683440.translation: 只要蜕变斯宾驼登上有两个或更少烁油指示物，它便具有践踏异能。若否，则它具有辟邪异能。

683441.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from CARDNAME. Then if it has no oil counters on it, sacrifice it.
683441.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从蜕变斯宾驼登上移去一个CARDNAME。然后若其上没有烁油指示物，则将它牺牲。

683442.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oil counter from Evolved Spinoderm. Then if it has no oil counters on it, sacrifice it.
683442.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从蜕变斯宾驼登上移去一个烁油指示物。然后若其上没有烁油指示物，则将它牺牲。

683445.oracleText: Evolving Adaptive gets +1/+1 for each oil counter on it.
683445.translation: 进化适境客上每有一个烁油指示物，便得+1/+1。

683449.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. Put up to two land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you put fewer than two lands onto the battlefield this way, proliferate a number of times equal to the difference.
683449.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。将其中至多两张地牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。如果你以此法放进战场的地牌数量少于两张，则增殖等同于此差距数量的次数。

683451.oracleText: Reveal the top X plus one cards of your library. Choose a creature card and/or a land card from among them. Put those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If X is 5 or more, instead put the chosen cards onto the battlefield or into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
683451.translation: 展示你牌库顶的X加一张牌。选择其中一张生物牌和／或一张地牌。将这些牌置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。如果X等于或大于5，则改为将所选的牌都放进战场或置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

683454.oracleText: Warm forges and tasty goblins lured it from the Hunter Maze to the Quiet Furnace.
683454.translation: 温暖的锻坊跟美味的鬼怪将它从猎者迷林吸引到了静谧熔炉。

683456.oracleText:
"This one needs a bit longer to ripen."
—Glissa Sunslayer
683456.translation:
「这个要久一点才会熟透。」
～戮日者格莉莎

683458.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
683458.translation: {o4}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

683459.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}, Remove an oil counter from Incubation Sac: Create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
683459.translation: {o4}，{oT}，从护育液囊上移去一个烁油指示物：派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

683461.oracleText:
"Let me tell you why you must never close your eyes when on watch. Not even for a second."
—Jor Kadeen
683461.translation:
「我来告诉你为什么站岗的时候千万不能闭眼。哪怕一秒钟都不行。」
～尤克定

683462.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control. Each opponent gets a poison counter.
683462.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。每位对手获得一个中毒指示物。

683464.translation:
「洼巴司的思维格局还不够大。」
～戮日者格莉莎

683466.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may remove an oil counter from it. If you do, untap it and it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
683466.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从其上移去一个烁油指示物。若你如此作，则将它重置且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

683467.oracleText: Whenever Lattice-Blade Mantis attacks, you may remove an oil counter from it. If you do, untap it and it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
683467.translation: 每当栅刃螳螂攻击时，你可以从其上移去一个烁油指示物。若你如此作，则将它重置且它得+1/+1直到回合结束。

683472.oracleText: Create an X/X green Phyrexian Horror creature token, where X is CARDNAME's loyalty.
683472.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色非瑞人／惊惧兽衍生生物，X为CARDNAME的忠诚。

683473.oracleText: Create an X/X green Phyrexian Horror creature token, where X is Nissa, Ascended Animist's loyalty.
683473.translation: 派出一个X/X绿色非瑞人／惊惧兽衍生生物，X为升华物灵师妮莎的忠诚。

683475.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control get +1/+1 for each Forest you control and gain trample.
683475.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得践踏异能，且你每操控一个树林，它们便得+1/+1。

683477.oracleText: Even as they brought the beast down, they could feel its poison working into their blood, altering their bodies, and filling their minds with the thrill of the eternal hunt.
683477.translation: 就算他们已然击倒野兽，也仍能感受到对方体内毒素在自己血液中穿行，改变众人肉身，令大家心智充满无尽狩猎的渴望。

683478.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn. Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller gets a poison counter.
683478.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。本回合中，每当一个生物进行阻挡时，其操控者得到一个中毒指示物。

683481.oracleText: Metal or flesh, it didn't matter—seasoned with ichor, it all tasted so good.
683481.translation: 是铁是肉，都无所谓～佐以脓水，同样美味。

683485.oracleText: The strategies and politics of the Vicious Swarm are as subtle as Vorinclex himself.
683485.translation: 暴恶蛮群无论是作战策略还是政治手法，都跟弗霖凯本人一样精致。

683487.oracleText: Paladin of Predation can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
683487.translation: 野猎神圣武士不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

683489.oracleText: {o2oG}: Each other creature you control with toxic gains toxic 1 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
683489.translation: {o2oG}：每个由你操控且具下毒异能的其他生物均获得下毒1直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

683491.oracleText:
"Best we move on. That gurgling means it's feeding time."
—Melira
683491.translation:
「我们脚步最好不要停。刚才那阵咕噜声说明进食时间到了。」
～梅梨莱

683493.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
683493.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

683494.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}, Remove an oil counter from Predation Steward: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
683494.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}，从野猎监管人上移去一个烁油指示物：目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

683497.oracleText:
"All elves aspire to be part of nature. Only Phyrexia can truly grant that wish."
—Glissa Sunslayer
683497.translation:
「所有妖精都渴望能够融入自然。只有非瑞克西亚才能真正实现这愿望。」
～戮日者格莉莎

683498.oracleText: {oT}: Put an oil counter on CARDNAME.

683499.oracleText: {oT}: Put an oil counter on Rustvine Cultivator.
683499.translation: {oT}：在锈蔓栽培师上放置一个烁油指示物。

683500.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Untap target land.
683500.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：重置目标地。

683501.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from Rustvine Cultivator: Untap target land.
683501.translation: {oT}，从锈蔓栽培师上移去一个烁油指示物：重置目标地。

683503.oracleText: In the Hunter Maze, today's apex predator is tomorrow's prey.
683503.translation: 在猎者迷林中，今日的顶端猎者明日可能就成他人猎物。

683505.oracleText:
"I bet even Skithiryx would take the long way around this one."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
683505.translation:
「我打赌就连极兹锐看到它也会绕远路。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

683506.oracleText: Skyscythe Engulfer can't be blocked by creatures with flying.
683506.translation: 空镰噬生兽不能被具飞行异能的生物阻挡。

683508.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +4/+4 and has trample.
683508.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+4/+4且具有践踏异能。

683511.oracleText: Choose one — • Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. • Proliferate.
683511.translation: 选择一项～ •  从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。 •  增殖。

683513.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be the target of nongreen spells your opponents control or abilities from nongreen sources your opponents control.
683513.translation: 对由对手操控之非绿色咒语或由对手操控之非绿色来源的异能而言，CARDNAME不能成为其目标。

683514.oracleText: Thrun, Breaker of Silence can't be the target of nongreen spells your opponents control or abilities from nongreen sources your opponents control.
683514.translation: 对由对手操控之非绿色咒语或由对手操控之非绿色来源的异能而言，破诫巨魔图伦不能成为其目标。

683516.oracleText:
"It is as the Mirrans say: True strength comes from within."
—Ich-Tekik, Salvage Splicer
683516.translation:
「就跟秘罗人常说的一样：真正的力量源自体内。」
～废品接合师衣克铁克

683519.oracleText: While some predators specialize in speed, size, or deadly venom, the adaptive tyrranax see no need to limit themselves.
683519.translation: 虽然有些猎者专精于发展速度、体型或致命毒素等优势，但善于适应环境的霸蛛龙觉得没必要限制自己。

683524.oracleText: "When they write songs about this battle, I will make sure your name is forgotten, devil."
683524.translation: 「当他们为这场战斗写颂歌时，我会确保其间不会提及你的名字，魔鬼。」

683525.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +X/+X and gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
683525.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+X/+X且获得辟邪与不灭异能。

683527.oracleText: "If you don't reassemble me immediately, the Mother of Machines will notice my absence, and this entire layer will face her wrath!"
683527.translation: 「如果你不立刻将我重新组装回来，机械之母便会知晓我未能赶到，而后整层狱界都将直面她的怒火！」

683528.oracleText: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. Proliferate.
683528.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。增殖。

683530.oracleText:
"This was once a peaceful spring, but I wouldn't advise taking a sip."
—Melira
683530.translation:
「这里曾是一处祥和的涌泉，但如今我不建议饮用其流水。」
～梅梨莱

683531.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell, target opponent gets a poison counter.
683531.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物成为咒语的目标时，目标对手得到一个中毒指示物。

683539.oracleText: {o(G/P)o(G/P)}, Sacrifice two other creatures: Put an indestructible counter on CARDNAME.
683539.translation: {o(G/P)o(G/P)}，牺牲两个其他生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个不灭指示物。

683540.oracleText: {o(G/P)o(G/P)}, Sacrifice two other creatures: Put an indestructible counter on Zopandrel, Hunger Dominus.
683540.translation: {o(G/P)o(G/P)}，牺牲两个其他生物：在饥渴圣主佐潘坠上放置一个不灭指示物。

683545.oracleText: Equip abilities you activate of other Equipment cost {o1} less to activate.
683545.translation: 你起动的其他武具之佩带异能减少{o1}来起动。

683549.oracleText: Silent observers swim through the air of Norn's Seedcore, watching the nascent Invasion Tree for any signs of interference.
683549.translation: 观察械安静地漂浮在艾蕾侬的树种核心空中，保卫刚萌芽的移行树免遭任何侵扰。

683550.oracleText: Cephalopod Sentry's power is equal to the number of artifacts you control.
683550.translation: 头足哨卫的力量等同于由你操控的神器数量。

683553.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put an oil counter on Charforger.
