683685.translation: {o2oG}，牺牲CARDNAME：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683686.oracleText: {o2oG}, Sacrifice Maze Skullbomb: Target creature you control gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
683686.translation: {o2oG}，牺牲迷林骨击弹：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+3/+3且获得践踏异能。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683688.oracleText:
"Melira helped me design it. Those who are infected by the oil cannot cross the threshold. We should be safe inside."
—Koth
683688.translation:
「这是梅梨莱帮我设计的。遭烁油感染的人无法踏过门槛。我们在里面应该很安全。」
～寇斯

683689.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is on the battlefield, it has all activated abilities of all land cards in all graveyards.
683689.translation: 只要CARDNAME在战场上，它便具有所有坟墓场中所有地牌的所有起动式异能。

683690.oracleText: As long as Mirran Safehouse is on the battlefield, it has all activated abilities of all land cards in all graveyards.
683690.translation: 只要秘罗避难屋在战场上，它便具有所有坟墓场中所有地牌的所有起动式异能。

683692.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Search your library for a basic, Sphere, or Locus land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
683692.translation: {o3}，{oT}：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本，域界或处所地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

683693.oracleText: {o3}: CARDNAME becomes a 9/9 Phyrexian Construct artifact creature, loses all abilities, and gains indestructible and toxic 9. Activate only if there are nine or more lands with different names among the basic, Sphere, and Locus lands you control.
683693.translation: {o3}：CARDNAME成为9/9非瑞人／组构体神器生物，失去所有异能，并获得不灭与下毒9。只能于你操控九个或更多不同名称的基本、域界与处所地时起动。

683694.oracleText: {o3}: Monument to Perfection becomes a 9/9 Phyrexian Construct artifact creature, loses all abilities, and gains indestructible and toxic 9. Activate only if there are nine or more lands with different names among the basic, Sphere, and Locus lands you control.
683694.translation: {o3}：完美丰碑成为9/9非瑞人／组构体神器生物，失去所有异能，并获得不灭与下毒9。只能于你操控九个或更多不同名称的基本、域界与处所地时起动。

683696.oracleText: Humble, obedient, and tireless, myr require little modification to excel as servants of Phyrexia.
683696.translation: 秘耳卑微、顺从、无休，因此几乎不需改造就能成为非瑞克西亚的优秀仆从。

683697.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 2 life: Add one mana of any color.
683697.translation: {oT}，支付2点生命：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

683699.oracleText:
"Myr will go where the work is. We always have. We always will."
—Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch
683699.translation:
「哪里有工作，秘耳就去哪里。过去一直如此。将来仍会如此。」
～蒙纳珂孑遗尔铁

683703.oracleText:
"Our resistance is like the myr: small and easily overlooked, but loyal and resilient beyond measure."
—Melira
683703.translation:
「我们的反抗就如同秘耳一般：虽势小易被看轻，但忠毅却难以估量。」
～梅梨莱

683707.oracleText: Since conquering Mirrodin, Phyrexian engineers have worked tirelessly to transform the plane's original two layers into a more fitting array of nine.
683707.translation: 自从征服秘罗地之后，非瑞克西亚工程师便不眠不休地改造此处，将此时空原本的两层结构改为更合适的九层。

683708.oracleText: Corrupted — Whenever CARDNAME becomes tapped, each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 1 life.
683708.translation: 腐化～每当CARDNAME成为横置时，每位具有三个或更多中毒指示物的对手各失去1点生命。

683709.oracleText: Corrupted — Whenever Phyrexian Atlas becomes tapped, each opponent who has three or more poison counters loses 1 life.
683709.translation: 腐化～每当非瑞克西亚地层录成为横置时，每位具有三个或更多中毒指示物的对手各失去1点生命。

683710.oracleText:
"The five suns may have dimmed, but their light still guides us."
—Thrun
683710.translation:
「五阳之光或已黯淡，但仍能指导我们前行。」
～图伦

683712.oracleText: Why carry a subject to a surgical lab when you can bring the surgical lab to them?
683712.translation: 当你能将手术实验室搬到对象身边时，为什么还要设法把对象搬进手术实验室？

683713.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +0/+2 and has toxic 1.
683713.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+0/+2且具有下毒1。

683717.oracleText:
"Lock the door and eat the key."
—Vraan, Executioner Thane
683717.translation:
「锁上大门，吞下钥匙。」
～行刑伯爵瓦兰

683718.oracleText: Permanent cards in graveyards can't enter the battlefield.
683718.translation: 坟墓场中的永久物牌不能进战场。

683719.oracleText: Players can't cast noncreature spells from graveyards or exile.
683719.translation: 牌手不能从坟墓场或放逐区中施放非生物咒语。

683721.oracleText: {oT}, Pay 1 life: Destroy target permanent you own.
683721.translation: {oT}，支付1点生命：消灭目标由你拥有的永久物。

683727.oracleText: It crackles with the intellect of a twisted genius.
683727.translation: 曲志天才的无边智慧令其脆响。

683728.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Surgical Skullbomb: Draw a card.

683729.oracleText: {o2oU}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
683729.translation: {o2oU}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683730.oracleText: {o2oU}, Sacrifice Surgical Skullbomb: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
683730.translation: {o2oU}，牺牲外展骨击弹：将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

683732.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has protection from red and from green.
683732.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+2/+2且具有反红保护与反绿保护。

683733.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn. You may play an additional land this turn.
683733.translation: 每当佩戴此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

683735.oracleText: {oT}: Put an oil counter on Tablet of Compleation.
683735.translation: {oT}：在完化荣志上放置一个烁油指示物。

683736.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Activate only if CARDNAME has two or more oil counters on it.
683736.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。只能于CARDNAME上有两个或更多烁油指示物时起动。

683737.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Activate only if Tablet of Compleation has two or more oil counters on it.
683737.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。只能于完化荣志上有两个或更多烁油指示物时起动。

683738.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if CARDNAME has five or more oil counters on it.
683738.translation: {o1}，{oT}：抓一张牌。只能于CARDNAME上有五个或更多烁油指示物时起动。

683739.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if Tablet of Compleation has five or more oil counters on it.
683739.translation: {o1}，{oT}：抓一张牌。只能于完化荣志上有五个或更多烁油指示物时起动。

683741.oracleText: It watches through the never-ending day, motionless save for the unsettling, twitching dance it performs as each sun reaches its apex.
683741.translation: 它在无尽白昼中观察不辍，纹丝不动，唯有在每个太阳升到顶空时方才扭动身躯跳起奇诡舞蹈。

683742.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their first multicolored spell each turn, each other player draws a card.
683742.translation: 每当任一牌手施放每回合中其第一个多色咒语时，每位其他牌手各抓一张牌。

683745.oracleText: In Urabrask's domain, mighty forges echo day and night with the clangor of the Great Work.
683745.translation: 在洼巴司的地界，巨大锻炉铿锵作响日夜不停，共同编绘伟大志业宏伟蓝图。

683748.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice The Autonomous Furnace: Draw a card.
683748.translation: {o1oR}, {oT}, 牺牲自治熔炉：抓一张牌。

683749.oracleText: Where ambition meets industry, passion is poisoned by greed.
683749.translation: 在雄心与勤勉交汇之处，贪欲拖累上进激情。

683750.oracleText: Where fire meets ferocity, a greater evolution begins.
683750.translation: 在烈火与凶蛮交汇之处，碰撞推动进化发展。

683751.oracleText: Where curiosity meets cruelty, hideous innovations arise.
683751.translation: 在好奇与残暴交汇之处，骇人发明日新月异。

683753.oracleText: In Sheoldred's domain, the Steel Thanes wage a never-ending war in her long shadow.
683753.translation: 在希欧蕊的地界，钢铁伯爵兴战不休，却永难与她平起平坐。

683756.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice The Dross Pits: Draw a card.
683756.translation: {o1oB}, {oT}, 牺牲蔓非深沼：抓一张牌。

683758.oracleText: In Elesh Norn's domain, the gospel of unity is the highest law.
683758.translation: 在艾蕾侬的地界，大一统福音便是最高戒律。

683761.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice The Fair Basilica: Draw a card.

683763.oracleText: In Vorinclex's domain, only the mightiest survive, and all are prey in his endless hunt.
683763.translation: 在弗霖凯的地界，唯有最强者方能生存，其余物种均是其无尽行猎的猎物。

683766.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Sacrifice The Hunter Maze: Draw a card.

683770.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
683770.translation: {o3}，{oT}：派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

683773.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Put an oil counter on target artifact or creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
683773.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：在目标由你操控的神器或生物上放置一个烁油指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

683774.oracleText: {oT}, Remove an oil counter from The Monumental Facade: Put an oil counter on target artifact or creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
683774.translation: {oT}，从丰碑外壳上移去一个烁油指示物：在目标由你操控的神器或生物上放置一个烁油指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

683776.oracleText: As the Invasion Tree grew, its branches pierced through the world's silent core.
683776.translation: 随着移行树不断生长，其枝干早已穿透这世界的静寂核心。

683777.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: CARDNAME becomes a copy of target nontoken artifact you control with mana value X.
683777.translation: {oX}，{oT}：CARDNAME成为目标由你操控、法术力值为X且非衍生物的神器之复制品。

683778.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: The Mycosynth Gardens becomes a copy of target nontoken artifact you control with mana value X.
683778.translation: {oX}，{oT}：构生菌园成为目标由你操控、法术力值为X且非衍生物的神器之复制品。

683779.oracleText: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.
683779.translation: 在演化与禁制交汇之处，原初蛮力桀骜不羁。

683780.oracleText: Where indoctrination meets inquiry, currents roil restlessly beneath the surface.
683780.translation: 在教导与求知交汇之处，平静之下激流涌动。

683782.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast Phyrexian creature spells.
683782.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放非瑞人生物咒语。

683783.oracleText: Corrupted — {oT}: Target 1/1 creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn. Activate only if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
683783.translation: 腐化～{oT}：目标1/1生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。只能于某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物时起动。

683785.oracleText: In Jin-Gitaxias's domain, strange and terrible experiments iterate toward perfection, unbound by ethics.
683785.translation: 在金吉塔厦的地界，各式诡怖实验不断翻新日趋完美，丝毫不受道德约束。

683788.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}, Sacrifice The Surgical Bay: Draw a card.

683789.oracleText:
"The Phyrexian's monuments of today will be nothing but dust tomorrow. With enough tomorrows, so will their rule."
—Koth
683789.translation:
「非瑞克西亚今日丰碑不过明日尘土。假使给足明日，其霸权也将消亡。」
～寇斯

683792.oracleText: {o3o(W/P)}: Create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
683792.translation: {o3o(W/P)}：派出一个1/1无色非瑞人／虫械衍生神器生物，且具有下毒1与「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

683794.oracleText: A thousand riddles, each with a single answer: "The glory of Phyrexia."
683794.translation: 谜面千变，谜底归一：「非瑞克西亚荣光」。

683795.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an oil counter on Serum Sovereign.
683795.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在浆液君王上放置一个烁油指示物。

683796.oracleText: {oU}, Remove an oil counter from CARDNAME: Draw a card, then scry 2.
683796.translation: {oU}，从CARDNAME上移去一个烁油指示物：抓一张牌，然后占卜2。

683797.oracleText: {oU}, Remove an oil counter from Serum Sovereign: Draw a card, then scry 2.
683797.translation: {oU}，从浆液君王上移去一个烁油指示物：抓一张牌，然后占卜2。

683799.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may pay 2 life and exile it. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's 1/1 and has toxic 1.
683799.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以支付2点生命并将它放逐。若你如此作，则派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为该生物的复制品，但它是1/1且具有下毒1。

683802.oracleText: Never get between a goblin and the closest shiny object.
683802.translation: 千万别挡在鬼怪和离他最近的发光物中间。

683803.oracleText: Whenever an equipped creature you control other than CARDNAME attacks or dies, you may attach all Equipment attached to that creature to Rhuk.
683803.translation: 每当一个CARDNAME以外由你操控且佩带武具的生物攻击或死去时，你可以将所有贴附在该生物上的武具贴附于鲁刻。

683804.oracleText: Whenever an equipped creature you control other than Rhuk, Hexgold Nabber attacks or dies, you may attach all Equipment attached to that creature to Rhuk.
683804.translation: 每当一个金角板袭鬼鲁刻以外由你操控且佩带武具的生物攻击或死去时，你可以将所有贴附在该生物上的武具贴附于鲁刻。

683808.oracleText: Corrupted — At the beginning of your upkeep, if an opponent has three or more poison counters, choose a creature you control, then draw cards equal to its total toxic value.
683808.translation: 腐化～在你的维持开始时，若某对手具有三个或更多中毒指示物，则你选择一个由你操控的生物，然后抓等同于其总下毒值的牌。

683814.oracleText: Obedience is the armor that turns any blade.
683814.translation: 服从便是抵御利刃加身的最佳护甲。

683815.oracleText: To resist the embrace of the Flesh Singularity is to reject unconditional acceptance.
683815.translation: 抵御骨肉合一派之包容，相当于抗拒无条件接纳。

683816.oracleText: Phyrexia will stretch from sea to sky, across worlds and realities, inescapable and perfect.
683816.translation: 非瑞克西亚必将蔽洋漫天，降临诸界；终竟没处可避、至善无暇。

683817.oracleText: Even the most insignificant creature can be perfected.
683817.translation: 就连最不起眼的生物，也能臻至完美。

683818.oracleText: Etch your victories in iron, that the world may celebrate them forever.
683818.translation: 将胜利蚀刻于钢铁之上，便可令全世颂扬不息。

683819.oracleText: Be the blade that severs hierarchy.

683820.oracleText: Will you be the flame which burns the world, or merely be consumed as fuel?
683820.translation: 你是愿当照亮世界的明焰，还是沦作维系火光的燃料？

683821.oracleText: Feel the joy of losing yourself to feed the land.
683821.translation: 敬请感受献身丰沃大地的喜悦。

683822.oracleText: In the embrace of the Mother of Machines, hard work never goes unrewarded.
683822.translation: 蒙机械之母加恩，辛勤工作绝非无报。

683823.oracleText: Submit and know the Mother‘s glory. Resist and and know her wrath.
683823.translation: 屈从得享圣母荣光。抵抗便知圣母怒火。

683824.oracleText: Take everything from them. Lives. Flesh. The very ground they walk on. Only then will your victory be compleat.
683824.translation: 夺去他们的一切：生命，血肉，脚下每寸土地。唯有如此，才算完化胜利。

683825.oracleText: Do not fear death. Fear failure.
683825.translation: 无需畏惧死亡。但要害怕失败。

683826.oracleText: The Forge embraces all who contribute to the Great Work.
683826.translation: 锻炉热忱接纳所有献身伟大志业者。

683827.oracleText: Who is an enemy but a friend who has yet to accept perfection?
683827.translation: 不过只是尚未接受完化的朋友罢了，怎么能算是敌人呢？

683828.oracleText: Target an artifact or creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or less.
683828.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且其法术力值等于或小于3的神器或生物为目标。

683829.oracleText: Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of that player's next end step.
683829.translation: 在其拥有者的下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

683830.oracleText: Choose a creature that player controls.
683830.translation: 选择一个由该牌手操控的生物。

683831.oracleText: Sacrifice two other artifacts and/or creatures.
683831.translation: 牺牲两个其他神器和／或生物

683833.oracleText: Target a spell with mana value 1 or less.
683833.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于1的咒语为目标

683837.oracleText: Return a creature card with mana value {2, Number} or less to the battlefield.
683837.translation: 将一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌移回战场。

683838.translation: 牺牲另一个神器或生物。

683839.oracleText: Reveal any number of Rat cards?
683839.translation: 是否要展示任意数量的老鼠牌？

683841.oracleText: Destroy all Equipment attached to that creature?
683841.translation: 消灭所有贴附在该生物上的武具？

683843.oracleText: Search for a basic Mountain card.
683843.translation: 搜寻一张基本的山脉牌。

683844.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact or creature with mana value {2, Number}.
683844.translation: 牺牲一个法术力值等于{2, Number}神器或生物。

683845.oracleText: Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
683845.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们放逐。

683846.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target up to {2, Number} artifact.} other {Target up to {2, Number} artifacts.}}
683846.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定{2, Number}个神器为目标。} other {指定{2, Number}个神器为目标。}}

683848.oracleText: Choose a creature card and/or a land card.
683848.translation: 选择一张生物和/或地牌。

683849.oracleText: Whenever a creature blocks this turn, its controller gets a poison counter.
683849.translation: 本回合中，每当一个生物进行阻挡时，其操控者得到一个中毒指示物。

683850.oracleText: Return one of them to its owner's hand?
683850.translation: 将其中一个移回其拥有者手上？

683851.oracleText: When it is put into a graveyard this turn, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
683851.translation: 本回合中，当它进入坟墓场时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

683852.oracleText: Return a creature card with mana value 2 or less to the battlefield?
683852.translation: 将一张法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌移回战场？

683853.oracleText: When you discard a card this way, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value less than or equal to the mana value of the discarded card.
683853.translation: 当你以此法弃牌时，消灭目标由对手操控的非地永久物，且其法术力值须等于或小于所弃之牌的法术力值。

701449.translation: 在你的维持开始时，从凯拉的激奋的法术书中发现一张牌并将它放逐。直到回合结束，你可以施放该牌。

701451.oracleText: "Sir, I believe we've taken out their . . . everything." —Dajin, Suwwardi sniper-captain
701451.translation: "Sir, I believe we've taken out their . . . everything." —Dajin, Suwwardi sniper-captain

701452.oracleText: As long as this creature is on the battlefield, damage isn't removed from it during cleanup steps.
701452.translation: 只要此生物在战场上，其上标记的伤害在清除步骤中就不会被移除。

701453.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. If it's a creature, it perpetually gains "As long as this creature is on the battlefield, damage isn't removed from it during cleanup steps."
701453.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。若它是生物，它永久获得「只要此生物在战场上，其上标记的伤害在清除步骤中就不会被移除。」

701454.oracleText: Melt Through deals 2 damage to any target. If it's a creature, it perpetually gains "As long as this creature is on the battlefield, damage isn't removed from it during cleanup steps."
701454.translation: 炉心融穿对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。如果此目标是生物，则其永久获得「只要此生物在战场上，其上标记的伤害在清除步骤中便不会被移除。」

701456.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, it perpetually gets +2/+2.

701457.oracleText: When Tomakul Phoenix dies, it perpetually gets +2/+2.
701457.translation: 当托玛库凤凰死去时，它永久得+2/+2。

701458.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oXoR}, where X is CARDNAME's power. If you do, return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
701458.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oXoR}，X等同于CARDNAME的力量。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场。

701459.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oXoR}, where X is Tomakul Phoenix's power. If you do, return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
701459.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oXoR}，X等同于托玛库凤凰的力量。若你如此作，则将托玛库凤凰从你的坟墓场移回战场。

701461.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, conjure a card named Forest onto the battlefield tapped.
701461.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，变出一张名称为树林的牌横置放进战场。

701462.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on each of X target lands you control. They each become 0/0 Elemental creatures with reach, haste, and "When this creature leaves the battlefield, conjure a card named Forest onto the battlefield tapped." They're still lands.
701462.translation: 在X个目标由你操控的地上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。它们各成为0/0，具延势，敏捷和「当此生物离开战场时，变出一张名称为树林的牌横置放进战场」的元素生物。它们仍然是地。

701464.oracleText: On Argoth, Mishra forced the land to serve him.
701464.translation: On Argoth, Mishra forced the land to serve him.

701470.oracleText: "What can I say? Victory just comes naturally to me."
701470.translation: "What can I say? Victory just comes naturally to me."

701471.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control if you weren't the starting player. Then that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
701471.translation: 选择目标由你操控的生物。若你不是先手牌手，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后该生物对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

701473.oracleText: A local greeting with a universal message.
701473.translation: A local greeting with a universal message.

701474.oracleText: Destroy up to one target creature with power 4 or greater.
701474.translation: 消灭至多一个目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

701475.oracleText: Choose a nonland card in your hand. It perpetually gains flash.
701475.translation: 选择一张你手中的非地牌。它永久获得闪现异能。

701477.oracleText: Search the top third of your library, rounded up, for a card. Put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
701477.translation: 从你牌库顶前三分之一的牌中搜寻一张牌，将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。小数点后进位。

701479.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may discard a card. If you do, create a Treasure token and choose ambitious or expedient. If you chose ambitious, seek a card with greater mana value than the discarded card. If you chose expedient, seek a card with lesser mana value than the discarded card.
701479.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则派出一个珍宝衍生物并选择「雄心勃勃」或「韬光养晦」。若你选择前者，则掏一张法术力值大于所弃之牌的牌。若你选择后者，则掏一张法术力值小于所弃之牌的牌。

701483.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw cards equal to CARDNAME's intensity.
701483.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，你可以弃掉你的手牌。若你如此作，你抓等同于CARDNAME强度之数量的牌。

701484.oracleText: When Great Desert Hellion leaves the battlefield, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw cards equal to Great Desert Hellion's intensity.
701484.translation: 当高大沙漠地狱兽离开战场时，你可以弃掉你的手牌。若你如此作，你抓等同于高大沙漠地狱兽强度之数量的牌。

701489.oracleText: Artificers must always cope with the tension between exploration and explosion.
701489.translation: Artificers must always cope with the tension between exploration and explosion.

701490.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value 2 or less and a card with mana value 3 or greater. Discard those cards at the beginning of your next turn's end step.
701490.translation: 掏一张法术力值小于或等于2的牌和掏一张法术力值大于或等于3的牌。在你下一回合的结束步骤开始时，弃掉这些牌。

701492.oracleText: "The age of machine magic is dead. You may die with it, or live with us."
701492.translation: "The age of machine magic is dead. You may die with it, or live with us."

701493.oracleText: Whenever one or more Knights you control attack, draft a card from Raddic, Tal Zealot's spellbook.
701493.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的骑士攻击时，从塔尔狂信者拉狄克的法术书中发现一张牌。

701495.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay {o1}. When you do, target artifact card in your graveyard perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast." If it's a creature or Vehicle card, it perpetually gets +2/+2. Put it into your library second from the top.
701495.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作，目标在你坟墓场中的神器牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」 如果它是生物或载具牌，它永久得+2/+2。将它置于你牌库顶数来第二张的位置。

701499.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put an hour counter on each permanent you control named Midnight Clock. Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
701499.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在每个由你操控且名为午夜怪钟的永久物上放置一个时刻指示物。每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

701506.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return target creature card with power less than CARDNAME's power from your graveyard to the battlefield. Its base power perpetually becomes equal to CARDNAME's power.
701506.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将目标力量小于CARDNAME力量的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它的基础力量永久成为CARDNAME的力量。

701507.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return target creature card with power less than Forgefire Automaton's power from your graveyard to the battlefield. Its base power perpetually becomes equal to Forgefire Automaton's power.
701507.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将目标力量小于锻火机械兽力量的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。其基础力量永久成为锻火机械兽的力量。

701509.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies or is put into your graveyard from your hand or library, conjure a card named Gixian Recycler into your graveyard.
701509.translation: 当CARDNAME死去或从你的手牌或牌库进入你的坟墓场时，变出一张名为基克斯派回收客的牌并将之置入你的坟墓场。

701510.oracleText: When Gixian Recycler dies or is put into your graveyard from your hand or library, conjure a card named Gixian Recycler into your graveyard.
701510.translation: 当基克斯派回收客死去或从你的手牌或牌库进入你的坟墓场时，变出一张名为基克斯派回收客的牌并将之置入你的坟墓场。

701518.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or dies, seek an Urza's land card.
701518.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或死去时，掏一张克撒的地牌。

701519.oracleText: Whenever Urza's Construction Drone attacks or dies, seek an Urza's land card.
701519.translation: 每当克撒的施工无人机攻击或死去时，掏一张克撒的地牌。

701523.translation: 指定至多一个士兵为目标。

701524.oracleText: Choose a Soldier card in your hand.
701524.translation: 选择你手上的一张士兵牌。

701527.oracleText: Choose a creature with the least toughness among creatures your opponents control.
701527.translation: 选择一个生物，且须是由对手操控的生物中防御力最小者。

701528.oracleText: Target a nontoken creature or artifact you control.
701528.translation: 指定一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物或神器为目标。

701529.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target {2, Number} land you control.} other {Target {2, Number} lands you control.}}
701529.translation: {2, plural, =1 {选择目标由你操控的地。} other {选择{2, Number}个目标由你操控的地。}}

701530.oracleText: Target up to one creature with power 4 or greater.
701530.translation: 指定至多一个力量等于或大于4的生物为目标。

701531.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value equal to {1, CardId}'s intensity from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
701531.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场施放一个法术力值等同于{1, CardId}力量的咒语，且不支付法术力费用？

701532.oracleText: Discard those cards at the beginning of your next turn's end step.
701532.translation: 在你下一回合的结束步骤开始时，弃掉这些牌。

701533.oracleText: Target artifact card in your graveyard perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast." If it is a creature or Vehicle card, it perpetually gets +2/+2. Put it into your library second from the top.
701533.translation: 目标你坟墓场中的神器牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放」。若它是生物或载具牌，它永久得+2/+2。将它置于你牌库顶数来第二张的位置。

701534.oracleText: Target a creature card with power less than {1, CardId}'s power.
701534.translation: 选择一个力量小于{1, CardId}的生物牌为目标。

701535.oracleText: Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
701535.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

701580.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards you have discarded this turn.
701580.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你本回合中弃掉牌的数量。

701785.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value 2 or less and a card with mana value 3 or greater.
701785.translation: 掏一张法术力值等于或小于2的牌和一张法术力值等于或大于3的牌。

701795.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that's exactly two colors, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a card that's exactly two colors from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
701795.translation: 每当你施放正好两色的咒语时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张正好两色的牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

701802.oracleText: "Heliod shines his light on all things, excising the shadows of doubt. Rejoice, for beneath his purifying eyes, Theros is united as one!"
701802.translation: 「赫利欧德光照万物，褪除疑影。欢呼吧，得他纯洁之眼涤净此处，塞洛斯必将万界归一！」

701804.oracleText: Elspeth shone like a sixth sun, inspiring hope in the Mirrans and terror in New Phyrexia.
701804.translation: 艾紫培如第六太阳照亮天空，给秘罗人以希望，陷新非瑞克西亚于恐惧。

701805.oracleText: Target creature or planeswalker you control gains protection from colorless or from the color of your choice until end of turn. If it's a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
701805.translation: 选择一种颜色。目标由你操控的生物或鹏洛客获得反无色保护或反该色保护异能直到回合结束。如果它是生物，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

701807.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token with lifelink.
701807.translation: 派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的士兵衍生生物。

701808.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. It becomes an Angel in addition to its other types and gains flying.
701808.translation: 在目标生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物。它成为天使，且仍具有原本类别，并获得飞行异能。

701809.oracleText: Return all nonland permanent cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
701809.translation: 将所有法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

701812.oracleText: The same sturdy kitesail that once carried her safely through the Roil now allows her to monitor the pods' progress from above.
701812.translation: 同一航筝，往昔带她安全穿越狂搅，如今准她从高空监视树荚进展。

701813.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or battle, transform up to one target Incubator token you control.
701813.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，转化至多一个目标由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701814.oracleText: Whenever Attentive Skywarden deals combat damage to a player or battle, transform up to one target Incubator token you control.
701814.translation: 每当警觉护空卫对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，转化至多一个目标由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701817.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, tap target artifact or creature an opponent controls.
701817.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，横置目标由对手操控的神器或生物。

701819.oracleText: Her blades were twin beacons, calling the worthy to glory and the wretched to despair.
701819.translation: 她手中利刃宛如双重信标，引英灵向荣耀，赐堕者以绝望。

701821.oracleText: With one swift, merciful stroke, Tamiyo's story came to an end.
701821.translation: 剑光一闪，多美代的传典篇章直抵慈悲终焉。

701822.oracleText: Destroy target planeswalker that was activated this turn or tapped creature.
701822.translation: 消灭目标本回合中已起动的鹏洛客或已横置的生物。

701824.oracleText: "We sailed to Ixalan guided by a promise—the Age of Everflowing Blood. No machine will take that from us."
701824.translation: 「吾人不畏千辛远洋万里来到依夏兰，就只为探寻朱光时代这一美好承诺。任何机械都挡不住我们的追求。」

701825.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
701825.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

701826.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Dusk Legion Duelist, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
701826.translation: 每当在暮影军团斗客上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

701828.oracleText: Whenever a source an opponent controls deals damage to you or a permanent you control, that source's controller loses 2 life unless they pay {o1}.
701828.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的来源对你或任一由你操控的永久物造成伤害时，除非该来源的操控者支付{o1}，否则其失去2点生命。

701829.oracleText: {o2oW}, Sacrifice three other creatures: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
701829.translation: {o2oW}，牺牲三个其他生物：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

701830.oracleText: {o2oW}, Sacrifice three other creatures: Exile Elesh Norn, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
701830.translation: {o2oW}，牺牲三个其他生物：放逐艾蕾侬，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

701832.oracleText: Incubate 2 five times, then transform all Incubator tokens you control.
701832.translation: 抚育2五次，然后转化所有由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701833.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain double strike until end of turn.
701833.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得连击异能。

701834.oracleText: Destroy all other permanents except for artifacts, lands, and Phyrexians. Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
701834.translation: 消灭所有其他永久物，但神器、地和非瑞人除外。放逐CARDNAME，然后将它移回战场。

701837.oracleText: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her. Her nightmare had become flesh.
701837.translation: 随着一道光辉直透胸膛，艾蕾侬惨叫之声回荡不息：她的噩梦终究成真。

701838.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
701838.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

701839.oracleText: Elspeth's Smite deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
701839.translation: 艾紫培的重击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。如果本回合中该生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

701841.translation: 「我会跟你在一起。永远不分离。」

701842.oracleText: When this creature dies, put its counters on target creature you control.
701842.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。

701844.oracleText: Johar had never heard of a pterodon. He just knew Saheeli's new invention let him fly circles around the invading monsters.
701844.translation: 乔哈从没听说过什么翼牙龙。他只知道，莎希莉这个新发明能让他绕着侵攻怪物一直盘旋。

701846.oracleText: She was hope incarnate, an incandescent bulwark against the tide of machines.
701846.translation: 她乃希望化身，是抵御机械浪潮的耀亮堡垒。

701850.oracleText:
"Compleat the faith, compleat the god."
—Ajani Goldmane
701850.translation:
"Compleat the faith, compleat the god."
—Ajani Goldmane

701853.oracleText: {o3o(U/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701854.oracleText: {o3o(U/P)}: Transform Heliod, the Radiant Dawn. Activate only as a sorcery.
701854.translation: {o3o(U/P)}：转化曙光耀辉赫利欧德。只能于法术时机起动。

701857.oracleText:
"Compleat the god, compleat the plane."
—Ajani Goldmane
701857.translation:
"Compleat the god, compleat the plane."
—Ajani Goldmane

701858.oracleText: Spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each card your opponents have drawn this turn.
701858.translation: 所有对手本回合中每抓过一张牌，你施放的咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

701860.oracleText: The diamond storms of Gobakhan hampered Phyrexia's progress until they recruited some of the local shieldmages.
701860.translation: 高巴汗的钻石风暴大大延缓了非瑞克西亚的侵攻进展～直到他们将当地的盾法师招入麾下。

701862.translation: 当遭染变节者死去时，抚育3。

701863.oracleText:
"Let's show these soulless fiends what a real army looks like! Forward!"
—Shella, knight of Zhalfir
701863.translation:
「让这些没有灵魂的魔物见识一下何谓真正的军队！冲啊！」
～赛费尔骑士熙拉

701868.oracleText: "Just as a flute turns breath into music, we are the vessel through which the Sacred Winds produce glorious justice."
701868.translation: "Just as a flute turns breath into music, we are the vessel through which the Sacred Winds produce glorious justice."

701873.oracleText: "I was there when Phyrexia doomed Serra's realm with a single touch. I was there when Yawgmoth tried and failed to conquer Dominaria. And I will still be here when Elesh Norn lies dead."
701873.translation: "I was there when Phyrexia doomed Serra's realm with a single touch. I was there when Yawgmoth tried and failed to conquer Dominaria. And I will still be here when Elesh Norn lies dead."

701877.oracleText: The weight of Phyrexia crashed down upon Gobakhan, but the will of its people endured.
701877.translation: The weight of Phyrexia crashed down upon Gobakhan, but the will of its people endured.

701878.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature that attacked this turn.
701878.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在每个本回合中攻击过的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

701879.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
701879.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控的生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

701880.oracleText: Sacrifice Lightshield Array: Creatures you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
701880.translation: 牺牲光盾阵列：由你操控的生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

701885.oracleText: When the sun falters and the seas disperse, when the wilds wither and the forges go cold, when death itself succumbs, she endures.
701885.translation: When the sun falters and the seas disperse, when the wilds wither and the forges go cold, when death itself succumbs, she endures.

701886.oracleText: CARDNAME has lifelink and indestructible as long as you control at least three other enchantments.
701886.translation: 只要你操控至少三个其他结界，CARDNAME便具有系命与不灭异能。

701887.oracleText: Ephara, Ever-Sheltering has lifelink and indestructible as long as you control at least three other enchantments.
701887.translation: 只要你操控至少三个其他结界，尽责庇护厄芳拉便具有系命与不灭异能。

701890.oracleText: "Brother, guide my right hand. Sister, my left. Rest well, my kin, but Lorwyn still needs me. I will not be joining you quite yet."
701890.translation: 「哥哥，请指引我的右手。姐姐，请指引我的左手。各位亲人，请先安息，但洛温还需要我。我还不能马上与你们团聚。」

701892.oracleText: Raised in a long tradition of heroes, every Benalish knight knows the day might come when they will be called to face Phyrexia.
701892.translation: 每位宾纳里亚骑士祖上都英雄辈出，他们都知道自己这辈总有一天也要与非瑞克西亚兵戎相见。

701898.oracleText: An ancient weapon for a modern war.
701898.translation: 一柄适于现代战争的远古武器。

701903.oracleText: Whenever a permanent you control transforms into a Phyrexian, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
701903.translation: 每当一个由你操控的永久物转化为非瑞人时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

701907.translation: 由你操控的非瑞人具有警戒异能。

701909.oracleText: Quintorius muffled a sob as he watched the thing that was once Professor Pitnik "confiscate" yet another priceless historical tome.
701909.translation: 眼见先前还是皮尼克教授的怪物又「没收」了一本无价历史巨著，昆托力虽悲从中来，但也只能强忍泣声。

701910.oracleText: Each player can't cast more than one non-Phyrexian spell each turn.
701910.translation: 每位牌手每回合施放之不是非瑞人的咒语不能多于一个。

701916.oracleText: {oT}: Transform target Incubator token you control.
701916.translation: {oT}：转化目标由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701918.oracleText: The Invasion Tree wasn't merely a conduit through which to breach planes. It was a living, writhing extension of Phyrexia's will.
701918.translation: 移行树并非只是穿越时空的管道。而是非瑞克西亚意志的鲜活具现与扭曲延伸。

701920.oracleText: Bim lashed out with the only weapon she'd never run out of: lecture notes.
701920.translation: 毕姆使出了她唯一用之不竭的武器：课堂笔记。

701921.oracleText: Exile up to one target artifact, creature, or enchantment you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
701921.translation: 放逐至多一个目标由你操控的神器，生物或结界，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

701925.oracleText: The angels had vowed to protect New Capenna. She was determined to uphold that vow, no matter the cost.
701925.translation: The angels had vowed to protect New Capenna. She was determined to uphold that vow, no matter the cost.

701926.oracleText: {o4o(B/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701927.oracleText: {o4o(B/P)}: Transform Seraph of New Capenna. Activate only as a sorcery.
701927.translation: {o4o(B/P)}：转化新卡佩纳炽天使。只能于法术时机起动。

701929.oracleText: With her Halo reserves exhausted, she began to change, and she made a new promise to bless New Capenna with glistening perfection.
701929.translation: With her Halo reserves exhausted, she began to change, and she made a new promise to bless New Capenna with glistening perfection.

701930.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, CARDNAME gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
701930.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则CARDNAME得+2/+1直到回合结束。

701931.oracleText: Whenever Seraph of New Phyrexia attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, Seraph of New Phyrexia gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
701931.translation: 每当新非瑞克西亚炽天使攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则新非瑞克西亚炽天使得+2/+1直到回合结束。

701933.oracleText: "Alara has been broken before. I will not let it break again."
701933.translation: 「阿拉若曾散作断片。我不许它再度破碎。」

701935.oracleText: Light glinted off the raised weapons of the Sun Empire, filling her with an unbreakable hope . . .
701935.translation: Light glinted off the raised weapons of the Sun Empire, filling her with an unbreakable hope . . .

701936.oracleText: {o5o(R/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701937.oracleText: {o5o(R/P)}: Transform Sun-Blessed Guardian. Activate only as a sorcery.
701937.translation: {o5o(R/P)}：转化阳佑守护者。只能于法术时机起动。

701939.oracleText: . . . but even the unbreakable can be reshaped.
701939.translation: . . . but even the unbreakable can be reshaped.

701940.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of it. Put a +1/+1 counter on that token for each +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
701940.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个为它复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。CARDNAME上每有一个+1/+1指示物，便在该衍生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

701941.oracleText: Whenever Furnace-Blessed Conqueror attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of it. Put a +1/+1 counter on that token for each +1/+1 counter on Furnace-Blessed Conqueror. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
701941.translation: 每当炉佑征服者攻击时，派出一个为它复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。炉佑征服者上每有一个+1/+1指示物，便在该衍生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

701943.oracleText: Destroy target nontoken artifact or enchantment an opponent controls. Incubate 2.
701943.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控且非衍生物的神器或结界。抚育2。

701944.oracleText: Incubate 2, then transform an Incubator token you control.
701944.translation: 抚育2，然后转化一个由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701945.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target nontoken artifact or enchantment an opponent controls. Incubate 2. • Incubate 2, then transform an Incubator token you control.
701945.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标由对手操控且非衍生物的神器或结界。抚育2。 •  抚育2，然后转化一个由你操控的抚育器衍生物。

701947.oracleText:
"Let the light scour away your imperfect flesh."
—Heliod
701947.translation:
「让明光扫除汝等不净肉身。」
～赫利欧德

701948.oracleText: Exile all creatures. Incubate X, where X is the number of creatures exiled this way.
701948.translation: 放逐所有生物。抚育X，X为以此法放逐的生物数量。

701950.oracleText: No Meletian had ever laid eyes on an angel, but when protective Halo flooded the Multiverse, they knew a divine blessing was at hand.
701950.translation: 虽然迈勒提斯人从未见过天使，但当保护性金圆浪潮充盈整个多重宇宙时，他们也知道神圣祝福就在身旁。

701951.oracleText: You and permanents you control gain hexproof until end of turn. Prevent all damage that black and/or red sources would deal to creatures you control this turn.
701951.translation: 你和由你操控的永久物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。于本回合中，防止黑色和／或红色来源将对由你操控之生物造成的所有伤害。

701953.oracleText: The Royal Knights of Belenon are equally practiced in courtesy and combat.
701953.translation: 贝列侬皇家骑士的礼仪和战技俱佳。

701954.oracleText: CARDNAME has first strike as long as another Knight entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
701954.translation: 只要本回合中有另一个骑士在你的操控下进战场，CARDNAME便具有先攻异能。

701955.oracleText: Swordsworn Cavalier has first strike as long as another Knight entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
701955.translation: 只要本回合中有另一个骑士在你的操控下进战场，剑誓骑兵便具有先攻异能。

701957.oracleText:
"Obey the teachings of the dragonlords, for they provide all. They grant us magic and safety, and in return we offer respect."
—Baihir, Dromoka mage
701957.translation:
"Obey the teachings of the dragonlords, for they provide all. They grant us magic and safety, and in return we offer respect."
—Baihir, Dromoka mage

701958.oracleText: {o4o(G/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701959.oracleText: {o4o(G/P)}: Transform Tarkir Duneshaper. Activate only as a sorcery.
701959.translation: {o4o(G/P)}：转化鞑契塑砂师。只能于法术时机起动。

701962.oracleText:
"Your precious dragonlords repressed your instincts, cur. You were born a hunter. Evolve, and hunt again."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might
701962.translation:
"Your precious dragonlords repressed your instincts, cur. You were born a hunter. Evolve, and hunt again."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

701964.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that targets one or more permanents, incubate 2.
701964.translation: 每当你施放以一个或数个永久物为目标的咒语时，抚育2。

701966.oracleText: The Phyrexians armored themselves against blades, fire, and every conjuration they could think of. She brought a war rhino.
701966.translation: 非瑞克西亚人全副武装，能够抵挡一切刀砍火烧及他们能想到的一切魔法。而她竟骑着一头战犀牛冲上前来。

701970.oracleText: Errant wouldn't allow anything to stop her from decorating the streets of New Capenna.
701970.translation: 流芳只想专心涂画新卡佩纳街头，不容任何干扰。

701971.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Counter target spell. • Draw two cards, then discard a card.
701971.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  反击目标咒语。 •  抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

701973.oracleText: "You have no viable escape vector. Cease your resistance and accept perfection."
701973.translation: 「你没有可行的逃脱线路。即刻停止抵抗，接受完化。」

701974.oracleText: Counter target creature or battle spell unless its controller pays {o4}. If they do, you incubate 2.
701974.translation: 除非目标生物或战役咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。若其如此作，则你抚育2。

701978.oracleText: Izzet researchers agreed to keep the unusual weird contained until they understood the extent of its powers.
701978.translation: 在遇到不寻常的怪奇时，伊捷研究员普遍会遵循这样的规范：先把它控制起来，直到弄清其力量底细为止。

701979.oracleText: {o3o(R/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

701980.oracleText: {o3o(R/P)}: Transform Captive Weird. Activate only as a sorcery.
701980.translation: {o3o(R/P)}：转化遭囚怪奇。只能于法术时机起动。

701983.oracleText: The Furnace Host saw no need for such caution.
701983.translation: 而熔炉兵团就不需要这么谨慎。

701984.oracleText: When this creature transforms into CARDNAME, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
701984.translation: 当此生物转化为CARDNAME时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

701985.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Compleated Conjurer, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
701985.translation: 当此生物转化为完化成体时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

701987.oracleText: "It's not your fault. Strixhaven taught you an imperfect premise. Okay, the imperfect execution was your fault."
701987.translation: 「这也不是你的错。斯翠海文教给你之假定就是不完美的。好吧，演算时的不完美就是你的错。」

701988.oracleText: Counter target spell with mana value 2 or less.
701988.translation: 反击目标法术力值等于或小于2的咒语。

701989.oracleText: Counter target red or green spell with mana value 6 or less.
701989.translation: 反击目标法术力值等于或小于6的红色或绿色咒语。

701990.oracleText: Choose one — • Counter target spell with mana value 2 or less. • Counter target red or green spell with mana value 6 or less.
701990.translation: 选择一项～ •  反击目标法术力值等于或小于2的咒语。 •  反击目标法术力值等于或小于6的红色或绿色咒语。

701993.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, incubate X, where X is that spell's mana value.
701993.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，抚育X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

701995.oracleText: You may cast sorcery spells this turn as though they had flash.
701995.translation: 本回合中，你可以将法术咒语视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

701996.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
701996.translation: 本回合中，当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，将该咒语复制两次。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

702003.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets -X/-0, where X is the number of cards in its controller's graveyard.
702003.translation: 所结附的生物得-X/-0，X为其操控者坟墓场中牌的数量。

702005.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Surveil 2.
702005.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。刺探2。

702007.oracleText: Skills honed on perilous treasure hunts helped Zendikar's adventurers stay a crucial step ahead of their Phyrexian foes.
702007.translation: 赞迪卡冒险者在平时艰险寻宝之旅中磨练出来的过人技艺，让他们在面对非瑞克西亚敌人时能抢占重要先机。

702008.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, CARDNAME can attack as though it didn't have defender and it can't be blocked.
702008.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，CARDNAME便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击，且不能被阻挡。

702009.oracleText: As long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, Expedition Lookout can attack as though it didn't have defender and it can't be blocked.
702009.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，探险队警戒员便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击，且不能被阻挡。

702011.oracleText: No longer bound by the myopic limitations of flesh, Ekken would truly see the realms.
702011.translation: 在视界脱离肉身局限后，埃肯方能真切见得各个境域。

702014.translation: 第二十七届世界冠军高桥优太

702015.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws their second card each turn, you draw a card.
702015.translation: 每当任一对手抓每回合中其第二张牌时，你抓一张牌。

702018.oracleText: Where had she first seen that symbol? She usually took such detailed notes, but her memory of it was like a fading nightmare.
702018.translation: 第一次见到这符号是在什么地方？通常她都会把这些内容事无巨细地记录下来，但对这符号的记忆却像是一场逐渐模糊的噩梦。

702020.oracleText: Innistrad's stitchers were practiced at incorporating magical substances into undead creations.
702020.translation: 将魔法物质与不死作品相结合，这可是依尼翠拼接师的长项。

702027.oracleText: No professors, no grades, no room for mistakes.
702027.translation: 不涉教授，不评成绩，不容有失。

702028.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand, you may copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
702028.translation: 每当你从你手上施放瞬间或法术咒语时，你可以复制该咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

702034.oracleText: The pace of Kamigawa's development meant that Jin-Gitaxias's intel was already outdated when the invaders arrived.
702034.translation: The pace of Kamigawa's development meant that Jin-Gitaxias's intel was already outdated when the invaders arrived.

702035.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player or battle, draw a card.
702035.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

702036.oracleText: Whenever Rooftop Saboteurs deals combat damage to a player or battle, draw a card.
702036.translation: 每当屋顶破坏者对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

702040.translation: 塞哥维亚海暴君凯特斯

702041.oracleText: Noncreature spells you cast have convoke.
702041.translation: 你施放的非生物咒语具有召集异能。

702042.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, untap up to four target creatures.
702042.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，重置至多四个目标生物。

702046.oracleText:
"On my signal, disable the safeguards. Let's blow these metal freaks right back to their own world!"
—Gav Beleren, mage-ring engineer
702046.translation:
"On my signal, disable the safeguards. Let's blow these metal freaks right back to their own world!"
—Gav Beleren, mage-ring engineer

702047.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Copy target spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
702047.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：复制目标由你操控的咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

702048.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Overloaded Mage-Ring: Copy target spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
702048.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲过负载法师环塔：复制目标由你操控的咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

702050.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell with mana value 3 or greater, draw a card.
702050.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于3的非生物咒语时，抓一张牌。

702051.oracleText: {o3oU}: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you have seven or more cards in hand.
702051.translation: {o3oU}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你有七张或更多手牌时。

702052.oracleText: {o3oU}: Exile Jin-Gitaxias, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you have seven or more cards in hand.
702052.translation: {o3oU}：放逐金吉塔厦，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限你有七张或更多手牌时。

702054.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand. You have no maximum hand size for as long as you control CARDNAME.
702054.translation: 抓等同于你手牌数量的牌。于你操控CARDNAME的时段内，你的手牌数量没有上限。

702055.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand. You have no maximum hand size for as long as you control The Great Synthesis.
702055.translation: 抓等同于你手牌数量的牌。于你操控伟大合成的时段内，你的手牌数量没有上限。

702056.oracleText: Return all non-Phyrexian creatures to their owners' hands.
702056.translation: 将所有不是非瑞人的生物移回其拥有者手上。

702057.oracleText: You may cast any number of spells from your hand without paying their mana costs. Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
702057.translation: 你可以从手上施放任意数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。放逐CARDNAME，然后将它移回战场。

702060.oracleText:
"If something seems impossible, you probably haven't tried asking for help."
—Niambi, cleric of Dominaria
702060.translation:
「若有事看似不可能，你或未尝试求助。」
～多明纳里亚僧侣妮安碧

702062.oracleText: On the precipice of eternity, Elspeth made a choice. The fight would not end without her.
702062.translation: 在虚空边缘，艾紫培作了个决定。这场战斗要由她来终结。

702063.oracleText: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand, one into your graveyard, and one on the bottom of your library.
702063.translation: 检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，一张置入你的坟墓场，一张置于你的牌库底。

702064.oracleText: Teferi gave them time. Karn gave them a chance. But it was Melira who paid the ultimate price to free Ajani from Phyrexia's grasp.
702064.translation: 泰菲力赢回时间。卡恩夺回机会。但还是梅梨莱付出了生命代价，才最终救回阿耶尼，令其摆脱非瑞克西亚魔爪。

702066.oracleText: Even before Phyrexia's forces arrived on Tarkir, Silumgar's draconic brood had a discerning eye for valuables.
702066.translation: 在非瑞克西亚势力降临鞑契之前，席穆嘉一脉龙群就已生出对财宝挑剔的眼神。

702067.oracleText: When Oculus Whelp dies, draw a card.
702067.translation: 当复眼幼龙死去时，抓一张牌。

702068.oracleText: As long as you control a transformed permanent, CARDNAME has "When Oculus Whelp dies, draw a card."
702068.translation: 只要你操控已转化的永久物，CARDNAME便具有「当复眼幼龙死去时，抓一张牌。」

702069.oracleText: As long as you control a transformed permanent, Oculus Whelp has "When Oculus Whelp dies, draw a card."
702069.translation: 只要你操控已转化的永久物，复眼幼龙便具有「当复眼幼龙死去时，抓一张牌。」

702071.oracleText: After years of fabricating visions for naive customers of the Obscura, Stafano was flummoxed by the nightmarish scenes that played out unbidden in his mind's eye.
702071.translation: 斯塔法诺多年来都在为秘闻帮的无知客户编造视像，却因灵眼当中突现的噩梦景象困惑不已。

702072.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oCoU}. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.
702072.translation: {oT}：加{oCoU}。此法术力只能用来起动异能。

702074.oracleText: Draw a card, then discard a card.
702074.translation: 抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

702075.oracleText: Shuffle up to four target cards with mana value 3 or greater from your graveyard into your library.
702075.translation: 将至多四张目标法术力值等于或大于3的牌从你的坟墓场洗入你牌库。

702076.oracleText: Shuffle up to four target cards with mana value 3 or greater from your graveyard into your library.
702076.translation: 将至多四张目标法术力值等于或大于3的牌从你的坟墓场洗入你牌库。

702080.oracleText: The Magic Mirror of Vantress showed Catrina a twisted vision of black oil and bloody machines.
702080.translation: The Magic Mirror of Vantress showed Catrina a twisted vision of black oil and bloody machines.

702081.oracleText: {o3o(W/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702082.oracleText: {o3o(W/P)}: Transform Order of the Mirror. Activate only as a sorcery.
702082.translation: {o3o(W/P)}：转化魔镜骑士团。只能于法术时机起动。

702084.oracleText: Soon she understood that it was not the vision that had been twisted, but her own mind.
702084.translation: Soon she understood that it was not the vision that had been twisted, but her own mind.

702085.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked by a creature, that creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
702085.translation: 每当CARDNAME被生物阻挡时，后者得-1/-1直到回合结束。

702086.oracleText: Whenever Order of the Alabaster Host becomes blocked by a creature, that creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
702086.translation: 每当洁白兵团骑士团被生物阻挡时，后者得-1/-1直到回合结束。

702089.oracleText: On Kylem, the omens of impending invasion went largely unnoticed, drowned out by the everyday fanfare of Valor's Reach.
702089.translation: 关于侵攻大军即将降临的预兆虽已传至凯勒姆，但大多数人都未曾听闻，因为每日英勇巅竞技场的喧嚣早就淹没了四处的示警呼声。

702093.oracleText: "Ingress without proper writ of extraplanar intent? Unacceptable!"
702093.translation: 「没有取得正式外时空意向手令就擅自闯入？无法接受！」

702097.oracleText: Whenever you cast a legendary spell, untap CARDNAME.
702097.translation: 每当你施放传奇咒语时，重置CARDNAME。

702098.oracleText: Whenever you cast a legendary spell, untap Rona, Herald of Invasion.
702098.translation: 每当你施放传奇咒语时，重置进军传令罗娜。

702099.oracleText: {o5o(B/P)}: Transform Rona. Activate only as a sorcery.
702099.translation: {o5o(B/P)}：转化罗娜。只能于法术时机起动。

702102.oracleText: Whenever a source deals damage to CARDNAME, that source's controller exiles a card from their hand at random. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield under your control. Otherwise, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
702102.translation: 每当一个来源对CARDNAME造成伤害时，该来源的操控者随机从其手上放逐一张牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之在你的操控下放进战场。若否，则你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

702103.oracleText: Whenever a source deals damage to Rona, Tolarian Obliterator, that source's controller exiles a card from their hand at random. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield under your control. Otherwise, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
702103.translation: 每当一个来源对陶拉里亚抹煞兽罗娜造成伤害时，该来源的操控者随机从其手上放逐一张牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之在你的操控下放进战场。若否，则你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

702105.oracleText: "Good luck getting through a class-seven proxy ward, creep."
702105.translation: 「这七级代理防护祝你破解顺利，杂碎。」

702108.oracleText: Copy target spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
702108.translation: 复制目标咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

702109.oracleText: Copy target spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
702109.translation: 复制目标咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

702113.oracleText: Together with her beloved falcon, she had explored every waterway on Zendikar, from the Tazeem highlands to the inland sea.
702113.translation: Together with her beloved falcon, she had explored every waterway on Zendikar, from the Tazeem highlands to the inland sea.

702114.oracleText: {o4o(G/P)}: Transform Skyclave Aerialist. Activate only as a sorcery.
702114.translation: {o4o(G/P)}：转化空境飞天客。只能于法术时机起动。

702117.oracleText: With her guidance, the oil coursed freely across the world.
702117.translation: With her guidance, the oil coursed freely across the world.

702118.oracleText: When this creature transforms into CARDNAME, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
702118.translation: 当此生物转化为CARDNAME时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

702119.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Skyclave Invader, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
702119.translation: 当此生物转化为空境入侵客时，检视你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，则你可以将之放进战场。若你未将该牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

702121.oracleText: Old glitches in mage-ring function became critical tools in Vryn's defense.
702121.translation: 法师环塔的陈年故障，成了维林防线上的重要工具。

702122.oracleText: Enchanted creature has base power and toughness 0/2, has defender, and loses all other abilities.
702122.translation: 所结附的生物之基础力量与防御力为0/2，具有守军异能，且失去所有其他异能。

702125.oracleText: The owner of target nonland permanent puts it into their library second from the top or on the bottom.
702125.translation: 目标非地永久物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶数来第二张的位置或牌库底。

702127.oracleText: Just as all seemed lost, the griffin riders of Zhalfir arrived with the force of a gathered storm.
702127.translation: 就在看似败局已定之际，赛费尔狮鹫骑兵携雷霆万钧之势杀到。

702129.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may tap two other untapped creatures you control. If you do, CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn.
702129.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他生物。若你如此作，则CARDNAME本回合不能被阻挡。

702130.oracleText: Whenever Tidal Terror attacks, you may tap two other untapped creatures you control. If you do, Tidal Terror can't be blocked this turn.
702130.translation: 每当潮浪惧兽攻击时，你可以横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他生物。若你如此作，则潮浪惧兽本回合不能被阻挡。

702132.oracleText: Wrenn reached out to Teferi through the Blind Eternities, and an impossible connection flared across the vast emptiness.
702132.translation: 芮恩通过黑暗虚空想要向泰菲力传话，竟有一道非凡光芒闪过无垠旷域连接彼此。

702134.oracleText: Tap up to two target creatures. Put a stun counter on either of them. Then put a stun counter on either of them.
702134.translation: 横置至多两个目标生物。在其中之一上放置一个晕眩指示物。然后在其中之一上放置一个晕眩指示物。

702136.oracleText: Phyrexia broke the laws of reality to invade the planes. On Xerex, reality merely bent around the invaders.
702136.translation: 非瑞克西亚破坏实界法则进军时空。但在兹雷兹，则是实界扭曲了入侵者。

702137.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 2/2 white and blue Knight creature token with vigilance. Activate only if you've cast two or more spells this turn.
702137.translation: {oT}：派出一个2/2，白蓝双色，具警戒异能的骑士衍生生物。只能于你施放过两个或更多咒语的回合中起动。

702142.oracleText: Patient and observant, the people of Zhalfir lurked beyond the veil of time until their moment came to finally strike at Phyrexia.
702142.translation: 赛费尔人民极具耐心、眼光敏锐，他们一直潜伏在时间帘幕之外，静心等待攻击非瑞克西亚的机遇到来。

702143.oracleText: Target creature has base power and toughness 4/3 until end of turn.
702143.translation: 目标生物的基础力量与防御力为4/3直到回合结束。

702145.oracleText: The Consulate of Kaladesh had always valued his particular talent for extracting information . . .
702145.translation: The Consulate of Kaladesh had always valued his particular talent for extracting information . . .

702146.oracleText: {o4o(U/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702147.oracleText: {o4o(U/P)}: Transform Aetherblade Agent. Activate only as a sorcery.
702147.translation: {o4o(U/P)}：转化乙太刃密探。只能于法术时机起动。

702149.oracleText: . . . but the Chrome Host's methods were far more efficient.
702149.translation: . . . but the Chrome Host's methods were far more efficient.

702150.oracleText: Whenever Gitaxian Mindstinger deals combat damage to a player or battle, draw a card.
702150.translation: 每当吉塔厦派刺灵客对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

702152.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
702152.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

702154.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: CARDNAME deals X damage to target opponent or battle and you gain X life, where X is the sacrificed permanent's mana value.
702154.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：CARDNAME向目标对手或战役造成X点伤害且你获得X点生命。X为所牺牲永久物的法术力值。

702155.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Ayara, Widow of the Realm deals X damage to target opponent or battle and you gain X life, where X is the sacrificed permanent's mana value.
702155.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：世境寡人阿娅拉向目标对手或战役造成X点伤害且你获得X点生命。X为所牺牲永久物的法术力值。

702156.oracleText: {o5o(R/P)}: Transform Ayara. Activate only as a sorcery.
702156.translation: {o5o(R/P)}：转化阿娅拉。只能于法术时机起动。

702159.oracleText: Ayara cherished her new machine servitors just as much as she once did her many suitors: not at all.
702159.translation: Ayara cherished her new machine servitors just as much as she once did her many suitors: not at all.

702160.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, return up to one target artifact or creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
702160.translation: 在回合的战斗开始时，将至多一个目标神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它放逐。

702165.oracleText: Mudcreep loved the taste of the funny oil that leaked from the wrecked machines in Urborg.
702165.translation: Mudcreep loved the taste of the funny oil that leaked from the wrecked machines in Urborg.

702166.oracleText: {o3o(G/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702167.oracleText: {o3o(G/P)}: Transform Blightreaper Thallid. Activate only as a sorcery.
702167.translation: {o3o(G/P)}：转化刈萎散绿菌。只能于法术时机起动。

702169.oracleText: Then one day, Mudcreep started to feel funny itself.
702169.translation: 然后突然有一天,匍泥觉得自己也怪怪的。

702170.oracleText: When this creature transforms into CARDNAME or dies, create a 1/1 green Phyrexian Saproling creature token.
702170.translation: 当此生物转化为CARDNAME或死去时，派出一个1/1绿色非瑞人／腐生物衍生生物。

702171.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Blightsower Thallid or dies, create a 1/1 green Phyrexian Saproling creature token.
702171.translation: 当此生物转化为播萎散绿菌或死去时，派出一个1/1绿色非瑞人／腐生物衍生生物。

702173.oracleText: Sacrifice another Phyrexian: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
702173.translation: 牺牲另一个非瑞人：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702174.oracleText: Sacrifice another Phyrexian: Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloated Processor.
702174.translation: 牺牲另一个非瑞人：在涨囊处理兽上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702175.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, incubate X, where X is its power.
702175.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，抚育X，X为其力量。

702176.oracleText: When Bloated Processor dies, incubate X, where X is its power.
702176.translation: 当涨囊处理兽死去时，抚育X，X为其力量。

702178.translation:
「所有世界终将知晓完化之美。」
～艾蕾侬

702179.oracleText: Each player mills ten cards. For each player, choose a creature or planeswalker card in that player's graveyard. Put those cards onto the battlefield under your control. Then each creature you control becomes a Phyrexian in addition to its other types.
702179.translation: 每位牌手各磨十张牌。为每位牌手各选择一张在其坟墓场中的生物或鹏洛客牌。将这些牌在你的操控下放进战场。然后每个由你操控的生物均成为非瑞人，且仍具有原本类别。

702181.oracleText: Night fell all at once. Specifically, on the Phyrexian.
702181.translation: 突然之间重重夜幕降临。都砸在了同一个非瑞克西亚人身上。

702183.oracleText: The elves of Lorwyn sought perfection. The Etched Host supplied it.
702183.translation: 洛温的妖精追求完美。蚀刻兵团提供完美。

702184.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Incubate 3.
702184.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：抚育3。

702186.oracleText: Doji found the Phyrexian's essence foul, but every drop added an hour to their life.
702186.translation: 虽然杜吉嫌弃非瑞克西亚人的菁华污秽不堪，但它们只需一滴便能为其延寿四刻。

702188.oracleText:
"For the good of all, those who stand against the harmony of Phyrexia must be cut down."
—Ajani Goldmane
702188.translation:
「为全世福祉，凡反对非瑞克西亚和谐大义者均当斩。」
～金鬃阿耶尼

702190.oracleText: Daretti looked down disdainfully. "You call yourself machines? Where's the elegance? Nothing but ugly piles of scrap."
702190.translation: 达雷迪居高临下道：「你凭什么把自己当机械？你这样子哪有半点优雅？不过是堆丑陋的破铜烂铁罢了。」

702192.oracleText: Bodies too damaged to survive phyresis are collected and broken down into useful raw materials.
702192.translation: 受损严重而无法成功非瑞化的遗体都被收集起来，重新分解成有用原料。

702193.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
702193.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器或生物：每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

702197.oracleText: When Etched Familiar dies, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
702197.translation: 当蚀刻佣兽死去时，每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

702199.oracleText: Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
702199.translation: 目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

702200.oracleText: Choose target battle. If an opponent protects it, remove three defense counters from it. Otherwise, put three defense counters on it.
702200.translation: 选择目标战役。若任一对手防卫之，则从其上移去三个布防指示物。若否，则在其上放置三个布防指示物。

702201.oracleText: Choose target battle. If an opponent protects it, remove three defense counters from it. Otherwise, put three defense counters on it.
702201.translation: 选择目标战役。若任一对手防卫之，则从其上移去三个布防指示物。若否，则在其上放置三个布防指示物。

702205.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，刺探2。

702207.oracleText: Strixhaven braced for another Oriq assault, but something far worse arrived.
702207.translation: 虽然斯翠海文为抵御欧理可下次攻击做好了十足准备，但没想到等来的却是更强之敌。

702208.translation: 增幅～牺牲一个神器或生物。

702209.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets -6/-6 until end of turn instead.
702209.translation: 目标生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为该生物得-6/-6 直到回合结束。

702211.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, each player mills two cards. Then you may exile CARDNAME. When you do, put target creature or battle card from your graveyard on top of your library.
702211.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，每位牌手各磨两张牌。然后你可以放逐轻盈游击灵。当你如此作时，将目标生物或战役牌从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

702212.oracleText: When Flitting Guerrilla dies, each player mills two cards. Then you may exile Flitting Guerrilla. When you do, put target creature or battle card from your graveyard on top of your library.
702212.translation: 当轻盈游击灵死去时，每位牌手各磨两张牌。然后你可以放逐轻盈游击灵。当你如此作时，将目标生物或战役牌从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

702216.oracleText: Whenever a Phyrexian you control dies, surveil 1.
702216.translation: 每当一个由你操控的非瑞人死去时，刺探1。

702218.oracleText: As oil began to pour from Ikoria's crystals, some monsters developed strange mechanical mutations. Others were simply pulled under.
702218.translation: 随着烁油从依克黎的水晶源源不断喷涌而出，有些怪兽因此进化出了奇异的机械突变。而其他的则被淹没其间。

702219.oracleText: All creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn. Creatures that are green and/or white get an additional -2/-2 until end of turn.
702219.translation: 所有生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。绿色和/或白色的生物额外得-2/-2直到回合结束。

702225.translation: 由你操控的其他非瑞人得+1/+1。

702226.oracleText: {o3oB}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
702226.translation: {o3oB}，牺牲一个神器或生物：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

702227.oracleText: {o3oB}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Return Grafted Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
702227.translation: {o3oB}，牺牲一个神器或生物：将植髓屠夫从你的坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

702231.oracleText: Spells you cast from exile have convoke.
702231.translation: 你从放逐区施放的咒语具有召集异能。

702233.oracleText: {oB}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Incubate 2. Activate only as a sorcery.
702233.translation: {oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：抚育2。只能于法术时机起动。

702234.oracleText: {oB}, Exile Ichor Drinker from your graveyard: Incubate 2. Activate only as a sorcery.
702234.translation: {oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐脓水吸啜鬼：抚育2。只能于法术时机起动。

702237.oracleText: As oil seeped into their funeral shrouds, Tolvada's dead rose to join the invaders' ranks.
702237.translation: 随着烁油逐渐渗入包裹尸身的油布，托瓦达的亡者随即起身加入侵攻者的行列。

702238.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an artifact or creature was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
702238.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有神器或生物从战场进入坟墓场，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702239.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an artifact or creature was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Ichor Shade.
702239.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有神器或生物从战场进入坟墓场，则在脓水阴魂上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

702243.oracleText: When the courts fell, Eldraine's fae turned from their usual pranks to deadlier tricks.
702243.translation: 宫殿尽墨后，艾卓的仙儿便将自己的日常恶戏换成夺命技俩。

702244.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has two or fewer cards in hand, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to them.
702244.translation: 在每位对手的维持开始时，若该牌手的手牌为两张或更少，则CARDNAME对其造成2点伤害。

702245.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if that player has two or fewer cards in hand, Prickle Faeries deals 2 damage to them.
702245.translation: 在每位对手的维持开始时，若该牌手的手牌为两张或更少，则戳刺仙灵对其造成2点伤害。

702254.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, remove all counters from up to one target permanent.
702254.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，移去至多一个目标永久物上的所有指示物。

702255.oracleText: Whenever Marchesa, Resolute Monarch attacks, remove all counters from up to one target permanent.
702255.translation: 每当坚毅君主玛切莎攻击时，移去至多一个目标永久物上的所有指示物。

702256.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you haven't been dealt combat damage since your last turn, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
702256.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你在你上回合后都未受过战斗伤害，则你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

702261.oracleText: The eerie magic animating Innistrad's zombies rendered them immune to phyresis, making them crucial to the plane's defense.
702261.translation: The eerie magic animating Innistrad's zombies rendered them immune to phyresis, making them crucial to the plane's defense.

702263.oracleText: {o2oB}: Exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a creature card, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
702263.translation: {o2oB}：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。如果它是生物牌，则派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

702269.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and you gain 1 life.
702269.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且你获得1点生命。

702270.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Grandmother Ravi Sengir and you gain 1 life.
702270.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，在拉薇辛格氏祖母上放置一个+1/+1指示物，且你获得1点生命。

702272.oracleText: As the harvesters bore away the last of his limbs, what remained of Urabrask heard Elesh Norn say, "Leave the traitor be."
702272.translation: 正当收割兽刚截下洼巴司最后余下的四肢时，他仅存的部分就听到艾蕾侬说：「这叛徒就留他这样吧。」

702275.oracleText: "You were my mistake. I will forever bear the weight of your horrors, and of your end."
702275.translation: 「你是我一手酿成的错误。我将永远承担你所施恐惧之重，铭记你最终覆亡之时。」

702278.oracleText: {o5o(W/P)}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.

702279.oracleText: {o5o(W/P)}: Transform Nezumi Freewheeler. Activate only as a sorcery.
702279.translation: {o5o(W/P)}：转化鼠人无拘车手。只能于法术时机起动。

702281.oracleText: Freedom became a distasteful memory, a thing to fear and destroy.
702281.translation: Freedom became a distasteful memory, a thing to fear and destroy.

702282.oracleText: When this creature transforms into CARDNAME, put target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
702282.translation: 当此生物转化为CARDNAME时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

702283.oracleText: When this creature transforms into Hideous Fleshwheeler, put target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
702283.translation: 当此生物转化为骇人筋肉车手时，将目标法术力值等于或小于2的永久物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。

702285.oracleText: "Tell Boss Umezawa there's a new gang moving in on our territory. I'm forwarding their insignia. Watch for it elsewhere."
702285.translation: 「告诉梅泽老大，有个新帮派在我们地盘上活动。现把他们的标志发给你。留意这符号有没有在其他地方出现。」

702287.oracleText:
"Of course I'd rather it hadn't skinned six of my best wizards, but as nightmare fuel goes, it's a truly inspired design."
—Braids
702287.translation:
「我当然希望它没有活剥我手下最强的那六位法师，不过就驱动梦魇的成效来说，这当真振奋人心。」
～布蕾德

702289.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Surveil 2.
702289.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。刺探2。

702291.oracleText: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence, glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source. The compleated invaders ceased to function and crumpled to the ground.
702291.translation: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence, glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source. The compleated invaders ceased to function and crumpled to the ground.

702292.oracleText: Remove up to five counters from target permanent.
702292.translation: 从目标永久物上移去至多五个指示物。

702294.oracleText: "Before I fall, I will taste the blood of Sarulf himself!"
702294.translation: 「在我倒下前，我要亲自尝尝萨茹夫鲜血的滋味！」

702295.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice this creature: Draw a card.

702299.oracleText: {o4oB}: Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
702299.translation: {o4oB}：放逐CARDNAME，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌时。

702300.oracleText: {o4oB}: Exile Sheoldred, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
702300.translation: {o4oB}：放逐希欧蕊，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动，且仅限任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌时。

702302.oracleText: For each opponent, destroy up to one target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
702302.translation: 为每位对手各进行以下流程～消灭至多一个目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

702303.oracleText: Each opponent discards three cards, then mills three cards.
702303.translation: 每位对手各弃三张牌，然后各磨三张牌。

702304.oracleText: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. Exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
702304.translation: 将所有坟墓场中的所有生物牌在你的操控下放进战场。放逐CARDNAME，然后将它移回战场。

702307.oracleText: Tenured Oilcaster gets +3/+0 as long as an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
702307.translation: 只要任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，常任挥油师便得+3/+0。

702308.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks, each player mills a card.
702308.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击或阻挡时，每位牌手各磨一张牌。

702309.oracleText: Whenever Tenured Oilcaster attacks or blocks, each player mills a card.
702309.translation: 每当常任挥油师攻击或阻挡时，每位牌手各磨一张牌。

702311.oracleText: "My new form must be hard to understand."
702311.translation: 「我的新形态，你一定很难理解。」

702312.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a creature or battle card from it. If you do, that player discards that card. If you don't, incubate 3.
702312.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你可以选择其中一张生物或战役牌。如果你如此作，则该牌手弃掉该牌。若你未如此作，则抚育3。

702314.oracleText: On Amonkhet, Phyrexia found a ready-made army of horrors waiting for a new master.
702314.translation: 非瑞克西亚势力来到阿芒凯后，发现此处有支现成的恐怖大军深埋地底，静候新主人来发号施令。

702315.oracleText: Each player mills three cards. Then you return up to two creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
702315.translation: 每位牌手各磨三张牌。然后你将至多两张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

702316.oracleText: When Atraxa first arrived, the people of New Capenna rejoiced at the sight of such a grand angel. Then the slaughter began.
702316.translation: 亚崔夏初临新卡佩纳时，此处人民因得见此等壮美天使而欢欣不已。随之而来的却是惨不忍睹的屠杀悲剧。

702318.oracleText: The Furnace Host found great value in the chaotic ingenuity of Kamigawa's akki and allowed willing converts to "experiment" however they saw fit.
702318.translation: 熔炉兵团看中了神河恶鬼狂乱才智蕴含的巨大潜力，因而允许易化者随心所欲地「做实验」。

702319.oracleText: {o1oR}, {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact or land: Draw a card.
702319.translation: {o1oR}，{oT}，牺牲一个神器或地：抓一张牌。

702321.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, create a Treasure token.
702321.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

702323.translation: 血羽凤凰不能进行阻挡。

702324.oracleText: Whenever an instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage to an opponent or battle, you may pay {oR}. If you do, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn.
702324.translation: 每当一个由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语向任一对手或战役造成伤害时，你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

702325.oracleText: Whenever an instant or sorcery spell you control deals damage to an opponent or battle, you may pay {oR}. If you do, return Bloodfeather Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn.
702325.translation: 每当一个由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语向任一对手或战役造成伤害时，你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则将血羽凤凰从你的坟墓场移回战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

702327.oracleText: Ixalan greeted Phyrexia with a defiant roar.
702327.translation: 依夏兰以无畏嘶吼迎接非瑞克西亚的到来。

702328.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
702328.translation: 直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+2/+0且获得敏捷异能。

702330.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn.
702330.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

702331.oracleText: Add two mana in any combination of colors.
702331.translation: 加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。

702332.oracleText: Exile the top five cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among those exiled cards.
702332.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的五张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以从所放逐的牌之中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语。

702333.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each of up to two targets.
702333.translation: CARDNAME对至多两个目标各造成X点伤害。

702334.oracleText: Chandra, Hope's Beacon deals X damage to each of up to two targets.
702334.translation: 希望信标茜卓对至多两个目标各造成X点伤害。

702336.oracleText: If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage instead.
702336.translation: 如果某个由你操控的来源将对任一永久物或牌手造成伤害，则改为它造成三倍的伤害。

702338.oracleText: "I have a reckless idea," Koth offered. Chandra grinned and cracked her knuckles.
702338.translation: 「我有个疯狂的想法，」寇斯提议道。茜卓咧嘴一笑，随即捏响拳头跃跃欲试。

702342.oracleText: {o9o(G/P)}: Transform Etali. Activate only as a sorcery.
702342.translation: {o9o(G/P)}：转化始霸埃泰力。只能于法术时机起动。

702345.oracleText: The contagion spreads and the Multiverse quakes.
702345.translation: The contagion spreads and the Multiverse quakes.

702346.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, they get that many poison counters.
702346.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手得到等量的中毒指示物。

702347.oracleText: Whenever Etali, Primal Sickness deals combat damage to a player, they get that many poison counters.
702347.translation: 每当始病埃泰力对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手得到等量的中毒指示物。

702349.oracleText: "Hold nothing back, my friends. Tonight we feast in Starnheim!"
702349.translation: 「朋友们，今朝我们全力以赴杀来敌，夜晚齐聚斯达海姆享盛宴！」

702351.oracleText: {o1oR}: Furnace Gremlin gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

702352.oracleText: When Furnace Gremlin dies, incubate X, where X is its power.
702352.translation: 当熔炉怪灵死去时，抚育X，X为其力量。

702354.oracleText: With barely a moment's warning, a one-giant avalanche crashed into Kaldheim's defenders.
702354.translation: 警报声响刚传出，就见到一个巨人大小的雪崩直冲凯德海姆士兵防线。

702356.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, create a Treasure token.
702356.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

702357.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it gains haste and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, create a Treasure token."
702357.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。直到回合结束，它获得敏捷与「每当此生物对任一牌手或战役造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

702359.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
702359.translation: 每当此生物成为横置时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

702361.oracleText: As strange portals roared open across Theros, Lydus gathered his prototype and fled. He was so close to perfecting his design.
702361.translation: As strange portals roared open across Theros, Lydus gathered his prototype and fled. He was so close to perfecting his design.

702362.oracleText: {o3o(W/P)}: Transform Harried Artisan. Activate only as a sorcery.
702362.translation: {o3o(W/P)}：转化疲惫工匠。只能于法术时机起动。

702364.oracleText: Soaring in Realmbreaker's embrace, he finally understood what perfection was.
702364.translation: Soaring in Realmbreaker's embrace, he finally understood what perfection was.

702366.oracleText: The rest of the Gatewatch retreated. Chandra and Wrenn went in blazing.
702366.translation: 其余的守护者成员先行撤退。茜卓和芮恩火热前冲。

702367.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature, planeswalker, and battle.
702367.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物、鹏洛客、和战役各造成2点伤害。

702368.oracleText: Into the Fire deals 2 damage to each creature, planeswalker, and battle.
702368.translation: 进入焰境对每个生物、鹏洛客、和战役各造成2点伤害。

702369.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature, planeswalker, and battle. • Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your library, then draw that many cards plus one.
702369.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对每个生物、鹏洛客、和战役各造成2点伤害。 •  将任意数量的牌从你手上置于你的牌库底，然后抓该数量加一的牌。

702370.oracleText: Choose one — • Into the Fire deals 2 damage to each creature, planeswalker, and battle. • Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your library, then draw that many cards plus one.
