703882.oracleText: Whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga you control resolves, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a Saga card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. This ability triggers only once each turn.
703882.translation: 每当一个由你操控的传纪之最终章节异能结算时，从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张传纪牌为止。将该牌放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

703884.oracleText: "I am Ugluk. I command. I return to Isengard by the shortest road."
703884.translation: 「我是乌格鲁克。我说了算。我回艾森加德，走最短的路。」

703885.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. If that creature was a Goblin or Orc, put two +1/+1 counters on Ugluk instead.
703885.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若该生物是鬼怪或半兽人，则改为在乌格鲁克上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

703886.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Ugluk of the White Hand. If that creature was a Goblin or Orc, put two +1/+1 counters on Ugluk instead.
703886.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，在白手的乌格鲁克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若该生物是鬼怪或半兽人，则改为在乌格鲁克上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

703888.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, create two tapped 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying. If that creature is legendary, instead create two of those tokens that are tapped and attacking.
703888.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，派出两个已横置的1/1白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。若该生物是传奇，则改为派出两个已横置且正进行攻击的上述衍生物。

703890.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, that creature loses all abilities until end of turn.
703890.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物阻挡生物或被生物阻挡时，后者失去所有异能直到回合结束。

703892.oracleText: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigor as it coursed upward, right to the tips of the hair.
703892.translation: 饮料的效果先从脚趾开始，缓慢攀升到四肢，一路带去焕新感觉与激情活力，直达发梢。

703893.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature with power X. Activate only as a sorcery.
703893.translation: {oX}，{oT}：在目标力量为X的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

703895.oracleText: Equipped creature has first strike and gets +1/+0 for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
703895.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有先攻异能，且你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，便得+1/+0。

703896.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand with mana value less than or equal to that damage without paying its mana cost.
703896.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等于或小于该伤害数量的瞬间或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

703899.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Create X 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens, where X is the number of Humans you control.
703899.translation: {o3}，{oT}：派出X个1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物，X为由你操控的人类数量。

703901.oracleText:
"He that blows this horn shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends."
—Eowyn
703901.translation:
「吹响这号角，就能使敌人丧胆，友人振奋。」
～伊奥温

703902.oracleText: Whenever two or more creatures you control attack a player, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
703902.translation: 每当由你操控的两个或更多生物攻击一位牌手时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张生物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

703904.oracleText:
"Keep it secret, and keep it safe!"
—Gandalf

703907.oracleText: They could eat of it and find new strength even as they ran.
703907.translation: 这种食物他们可以边跑边吃，重续体力。

703911.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, its owner shuffles it into their library.
703911.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，其拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

703912.oracleText: When Lembas is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, its owner shuffles it into their library.
703912.translation: 当兰巴斯从战场进入坟墓场时，其拥有者将它洗入其牌库。

703914.oracleText: "Your Quest stands upon the edge of a knife. Stray but a little and it will fail, to the ruin of all. Yet hope remains while all the Company is true."
703914.translation: 「你们的任务正在刀尖边缘。稍有差池便会失败，全盘尽毁。但只要远征队精诚团结，就还有希望。」

703915.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}: Scry 1, then draw a card. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.
703915.translation: {o5}，{oT}：占卜1，然后抓一张牌。你每操控一个传奇生物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

703922.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life for each burden counter on CARDNAME.
703922.translation: 在你的维持开始时，CARDNAME上每有一个重负指示物，你便失去1点生命。

703923.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life for each burden counter on The One Ring.
703923.translation: 在你的维持开始时，至尊戒上每有一个重负指示物，你便失去1点生命。

703924.oracleText: {oT}: Put a burden counter on CARDNAME, then draw a card for each burden counter on CARDNAME.
703924.translation: {oT}：在CARDNAME上放置一个重负指示物，然后CARDNAME上每有一个重负指示物，便抓一张牌。

703925.oracleText: {oT}: Put a burden counter on The One Ring, then draw a card for each burden counter on The One Ring.
703925.translation: {oT}：在至尊戒上放置一个重负指示物，然后至尊戒上每有一个重负指示物，便抓一张牌。

703927.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put an influence counter on CARDNAME and scry 2. Then target opponent may have you draw a card. If that player doesn't, you mill X cards, where X is the number of influence counters on CARDNAME, and that player loses life equal to the total mana value of those cards.
703927.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个感化指示物并占卜2。然后目标对手可以令你抓一张牌。若该牌手未如此作，则你磨X张牌，X为CARDNAME上之感化指示物数量，且该牌手失去等同于这些牌法术力值总和的生命。

703928.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put an influence counter on Palantir of Orthanc and scry 2. Then target opponent may have you draw a card. If that player doesn't, you mill X cards, where X is the number of influence counters on Palantir of Orthanc, and that player loses life equal to the total mana value of those cards.
703928.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在欧尔桑克的帕蓝提尔上放置一个感化指示物并占卜2。然后目标对手可以令你抓一张牌。若该牌手未如此作，则你磨X张牌，X为欧尔桑克的帕蓝提尔上之感化指示物数量，且该牌手失去等同于这些牌法术力值总和的生命。

703930.oracleText: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out."
703930.translation: 「愿黑暗中众光熄灭时,它能成为你的明光。」

703931.oracleText: If you would draw a card while you have no cards in hand, draw two cards instead.
703931.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌时手上没有牌，则改为抓两张牌。

703932.oracleText: If you would gain life while you have 5 or less life, you gain twice that much life instead.
703932.translation: 如果你将获得生命时你的总生命为5或更少，则改为你获得该数量两倍的生命。

703934.translation:
「你这花园真是美不胜收！」
～甘道夫

703936.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, untap equipped creature.
703936.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，重置佩带此武具的生物。

703937.oracleText: Equipped creature has first strike as long as it's blocking or blocked by a Goblin or Orc.
703937.translation: 只要佩带此武具的生物正阻挡鬼怪或半兽人或正被后者阻挡，它便具有先攻异能。

703939.oracleText:
"At the Stone of Erech they shall stand again
and hear there a horn in the hills ringing."
—Malbeth the Seer
703939.translation:
「在埃瑞赫的黑石，他们将再起身
听见山陵中吹角回鸣。」
～先知瑁贝斯

703940.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile target player's graveyard. Draw a card.
703940.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。抓一张牌。

703941.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Stone of Erech: Exile target player's graveyard. Draw a card.
703941.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲埃瑞赫的黑石：放逐目标牌手的坟墓场。抓一张牌。

703944.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Add X mana in any combination of colors.
703944.translation: {oX}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：加X点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。

703945.oracleText: {oX}, {oT}, Sacrifice Wizard's Rockets: Add X mana in any combination of colors.
703945.translation: {oX}，{oT}，牺牲巫师焰火：加X点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。

703946.oracleText: When Wizard's Rockets is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.
703946.translation: 当巫师焰火从战场进入坟墓场时，抓一张牌。

703948.oracleText:
"Those who pass the gates of Barad-dur do not return."
—Gandalf
703948.translation:
「那些进入巴拉督尔大门的，都一去不返。」
～甘道夫

703951.oracleText: {oXoXoB}, {oT}: Amass Orcs X. Activate only if a creature died this turn.
703951.translation: {oXoXoB}，{oT}：囤兵半兽人X。只能于有生物死去的回合中起动。

703953.oracleText:
"Renewed shall be blade that was broken:
The crownless again shall be king."
—Bilbo
703953.translation:
「青锋断刃将重铸，无冕者再临为王。」
～比尔博

703954.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast legendary spells.
703954.translation: {o1}，{oT}：加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放传奇咒语。

703956.oracleText: There dwelt Cirdan the Shipwright, and some say he dwells there still, until the Last Ship sets sail into the West.
703956.translation: 这正是造船者奇尔丹的居所，有人说他仍住在那里，直到「最后航船」扬帆驶向西方。

703958.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color among legendary creature cards in your graveyard.
703958.translation: {oT}：加一点法术力，其颜色为你坟墓场中传奇生物牌所具有的任一颜色。

703960.oracleText:
"I would see the White Tree in flower again in the courts of the kings, and Minas Tirith in peace."
—Faramir
703960.translation:
「我愿看见白树在诸王庭院中繁花重欣，米那斯提力斯安享和平。」
～法拉米尔

703962.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if you attacked with two or more creatures this turn.
703962.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}：抓一张牌。只能于你以两个或更多生物攻击的回合中起动。

703964.oracleText:
"Moria! Moria! Wonder of the Northern world!"
—Gloin
703964.translation:
「墨瑞亚！墨瑞亚！北方世界的奇迹！」
～格罗因

703966.oracleText: {o3oR}, {oT}, Exile three cards from your graveyard: Create two Treasure tokens.
703966.translation: {o3oR}，{oT}，从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌：派出两个珍宝衍生物。

703969.oracleText: {o1oBoR}, {oT}: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.

703970.oracleText: {o1oBoR}, {oT}: Mount Doom deals 1 damage to each opponent.
703970.translation: {o1oBoR}，{oT}：末日山向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

703971.oracleText: {o5oBoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME and a legendary artifact: Choose up to two creatures, then destroy the rest. Activate only as a sorcery.
703971.translation: {o5oBoR}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME和一个传奇神器：选择至多两个生物，然后消灭其他生物。只能于法术时机起动。

703972.oracleText: {o5oBoR}, {oT}, Sacrifice Mount Doom and a legendary artifact: Choose up to two creatures, then destroy the rest. Activate only as a sorcery.
703972.translation: {o5oBoR}，{oT}，牺牲末日山和一个传奇神器：选择至多两个生物，然后消灭其他生物。只能于法术时机起动。

703974.oracleText:
"Were I to go where my heart dwells, I would now be wandering in the fair valley of Rivendell."
—Aragorn
703974.translation:
「假如能前往一心牵挂之地，那我现在就会倘祥在幽谷美丽山峡间。」
～阿拉贡

703976.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Scry 2. Activate only if you control a legendary creature.
703976.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：占卜2。只能于你操控传奇生物时起动。

703978.oracleText:
"You must start somewhere and have some roots, and the soil of the Shire is deep."
—Merry
703978.translation:
「你必须有个起步的地方，扎下些根，而夏尔的土壤是很深的。」
～梅里

703980.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Tap an untapped creature you control: Create a Food token.
703980.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物：派出一个食品衍生物。

703982.oracleText: Everything looked fresh, and the new green of Spring was shimmering in the fields.
703982.translation: 一切都显得清新，田野间无不闪烁着春天的新绿。

703983.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
703983.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

703984.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Shire Terrace: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
703984.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲夏尔梯田：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

703990.translation: 指定一个非地史迹永久物为目标。

703993.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls.
703993.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物。

703995.oracleText: Target a creature that blocked or was blocked by a legendary creature this turn.
703995.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，且须为本回合中曾阻挡传奇生物或被传奇生物阻挡者。

703996.translation: 指定一个由你操控的马为目标。

703998.translation: 由你操控的未知永久物

703999.translation: 指定两个其他传奇生物为目标。

704000.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell with equal or lesser mana value from your hand without paying its mana cost?
704000.translation: 是否要从你的手牌中施放一个法术力值等于或小于此的瞬间或法术咒语，且不支付法术力费用？

704001.oracleText: Target a spell or nonland permanent an opponent controls.
704001.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的咒语或非地永久物为目标。

704002.oracleText: Target a creature spell with power or toughness 2 or less.
704002.translation: 指定一个力量或防御力等于或小于2的生物咒语为目标。

704003.translation: 指定至多一个巨海兽为目标。

704005.oracleText: Target any number of instant and/or sorcery spells.
704005.translation: 指定任意数量的瞬间和／或法术咒语为目标。

704006.oracleText: Reveal a creature card that doesn't share a creature type with a creature you control?
704006.translation: 是否要展示一张与由你操控之生物不具共通生物类别的生物牌？

704009.oracleText: Target up to one other legendary creature you control.
704009.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的其他传奇生物为目标。

704010.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
704010.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。

704011.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or a token?
704011.translation: 是否要牺牲另一个生物或衍生物？

704013.oracleText: Return another permanent card to the battlefield?
704013.translation: 是否要将另一张永久物牌移回战场？

704014.oracleText: Discard an enchantment, instant, or sorcery card?
704014.translation: 是否要弃一张结界，瞬间或法术牌？

704015.oracleText: When one or more cards are milled this way, exile target enchantment, instant, or sorcery card with equal or lesser mana value than that spell from an opponent's graveyard. Copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
704015.translation: 当以此法磨掉一张或数张牌时，将目标法术力值等于或小于该咒语的结界，瞬间或法术牌从对手的坟墓场中放逐。复制所放逐的牌。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

704016.oracleText: Target an enchantment, instant, or sorcery card with equal or lesser mana value than that spell.
704016.translation: 指定一张结界，瞬间或法术牌为目标，且其法术力值须等于或小于该咒语。

704017.oracleText: Sacrifice a legendary artifact or legendary creature?
704017.translation: 是否要牺牲一个传奇神器或传奇生物？

704018.oracleText: Put a creature card with lesser power onto the battlefield?
704018.translation: 是否要将一张力量更低的生物牌放进战场？

704019.oracleText: Target a creature with power {2, Number}.
704019.translation: 指定一个力量为{2, Number}的生物为目标。

704020.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand with mana value less than or equal to that damage without paying its mana cost?
704020.translation: 是否要施放一个法术力值等于或小于此伤害数量的瞬间或法术咒语，且不支付其法术力费用？

704022.oracleText: Sacrifice {1, CardId} and a legendary artifact.
704022.translation: 牺牲{1, CardId}和一个传奇神器。

704025.oracleText: Seek a card with greater mana value than the discarded card.
704025.translation: 掏一张法术力值大于所弃之牌的牌。

704026.oracleText: Seek a card with lesser mana value than the discarded card.
704026.translation: 掏一张法术力值小于所弃之牌的牌。

704028.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent card in your graveyard.
704028.translation: 指定一张在你坟墓场中的非地永久物牌为目标。

704029.oracleText: Target up to one Equipment you control.
704029.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控的武具为目标。

704031.oracleText:
"Not idly do the leaves of Lorien fall."
—Aragorn
704031.translation:
「罗瑞恩的树叶不会无端掉落。」
～阿拉贡

704034.oracleText: Even as he came swooping down, Gwaihir saw the two figures fall, worn out, hiding their eyes from death.
704034.translation: 就在它俯冲下来的同时，格怀希尔看到两个人影趴下了，他们疲惫不堪，死死捂住眼睛。

704038.oracleText: Minas Tirith Garrison's power is equal to the number of cards in your hand.
704038.translation: 米那斯提力斯驻防兵的力量等同于你的手牌数量。

704039.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may tap any number of untapped Humans you control. Draw a card for each Human tapped this way.
704039.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以横置任意数量由你操控的未横置人类。每以此法横置一个人类，便抓一张牌。

704040.oracleText: Whenever Minas Tirith Garrison attacks, you may tap any number of untapped Humans you control. Draw a card for each Human tapped this way.
704040.translation: 每当米那斯提力斯驻防兵攻击时，你可以横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的人类。每以此法横置一个人类，便抓一张牌。

704042.oracleText: Other Orcs and Goblins you control have menace.
704042.translation: 由你操控的其他半兽人和鬼怪具有威慑异能。

704043.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, amass Orcs 2.
704043.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，囤兵半兽人2。

704045.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each Human you control.
704045.translation: 你每操控一个人类，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

704046.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if CARDNAME attacked this turn, return it to its owner's hand. If you do, create a number of 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens equal to its toughness.
704046.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若CARDNAME本回合中曾进行攻击，将它移回其拥有者手上。若你如此作，则派出若干1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物，且数量等同于其防御力。

704047.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if Riders of the Mark attacked this turn, return it to its owner's hand. If you do, create a number of 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens equal to its toughness.
704047.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若马克的骑兵本回合中曾进行攻击，将它移回其拥有者手上。若你如此作，则派出若干1/1白色人类／士兵衍生生物，且数量等同于其防御力。

704049.oracleText: The dark things that were driven out of Mirkwood have returned in greater numbers, and it is again an evil place, save where the Elvish realm is maintained.
704049.translation: 被赶出黑森林的黑暗生物以更浩大的声势卷土重来，这里又变成了邪恶之地，只有精灵王国还在勉力维持。

704050.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target Elf you control gains trample and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Forests you control.
704050.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，目标由你操控的妖精获得践踏异能且得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的树林数量。

704054.oracleText: Tap two other untapped Halflings you control: Saradoc gets +2/+0 and gains lifelink until end of turn.
704054.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他半身人：直到回合结束，萨拉道克得+2/+0且获得系命异能。

704056.oracleText: In the days of the Kings, most of the High Elves dwelt with Cirdan or in the seaward lands of Lindon.
704056.translation: 在诸王统治的年代，大多数的高等精灵都跟奇尔丹一起，聚居于林顿的海滨地带。

704057.translation: 每当精灵海员攻击时，占卜1。

704058.oracleText: Whenever you scry, tap up to X target nonland permanents, where X is the number of cards looked at while scrying this way.
704058.translation: 每当你占卜时，横置至多X个目标非地永久物，X为以此法占卜期间所检视的牌张数量。

704062.oracleText: When the Ring tempts you, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
704062.translation: 当魔戒引诱你时，将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

704063.oracleText: When the Ring tempts you, return Ringwraiths from your graveyard to your hand.
704063.translation: 当魔戒引诱你时，将戒灵从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

704065.oracleText: Amass Orcs X, then Goblins and Orcs you control gain double strike and haste until end of turn.
704065.translation: 囤兵半兽人X，然后由你操控的鬼怪和半兽人获得连击与敏捷异能直到回合结束。

704067.oracleText: Her father Samwise gave her the Red Book for safekeeping before he sailed into the West.
704067.translation: 她父亲山姆怀斯在扬帆驶向西方之前，将《红皮书》交给她保管。

704069.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you sacrificed a Food this turn, you may search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
704069.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中牲过食品，则你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

704072.oracleText: Frodo's heart flamed within him. He drew his sword and advanced.
704072.translation: 弗罗多心潮一同激昂起来。只见他拔出佩剑，大步向前。

704077.oracleText: He has passed through the fire and the abyss, and the enemy shall fear him.
704077.translation: 他曾穿越烈火深渊，敌人见他便会畏惧不前。

704078.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. Scry 1.
704078.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。占卜1。

704079.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may put it into its owner's library fifth from the top.
704079.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第五张的位置。

704080.oracleText: When Gandalf, White Rider dies, you may put it into its owner's library fifth from the top.
704080.translation: 当白骑士甘道夫死去时，你可以将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第五张的位置。

704081.oracleText: Now the cries of clear strong voices came ringing over the fields. They rode in: a long line of mail-clad Men, swift, shining, fell and fair to look upon. Suddenly they swept up with a noise like thunder, and the foremost horseman swerved.
704081.translation: 这时，原野彼端传来阵阵清晰有力的呼喝。只见一队骑兵奔驰而来：他们均是人类，身披铠甲，行动迅捷，装备闪亮，凶猛英俊。转眼间，他们便踏着雷鸣般蹄声来到面前，此时领头的骑手突然策马转向。

704083.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top two cards of your library, put them back in any order, then choose land or nonland. An opponent guesses whether the top card of your library is the chosen kind. Reveal that card. If they guessed right, remove Gollum from combat. Otherwise, you draw a card and Gollum can't be blocked this turn.
704083.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌，将它们以任意顺序放回，然后选择地或非地。任一对手猜你的牌库顶牌是否为所选类别。展示该牌。若其猜对，则将咕噜移出战斗。若否，则你抓一张牌且咕噜本回合不能被阻挡。

704084.oracleText: Whenever Gollum, Scheming Guide attacks, look at the top two cards of your library, put them back in any order, then choose land or nonland. An opponent guesses whether the top card of your library is the chosen kind. Reveal that card. If they guessed right, remove Gollum from combat. Otherwise, you draw a card and Gollum can't be blocked this turn.
704084.translation: 每当密谋向导咕噜攻击时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌，将它们以任意顺序放回，然后选择地或非地。任一对手猜你的牌库顶牌是否为所选类别。展示该牌。若其猜对，则将咕噜移出战斗。若否，则你抓一张牌且咕噜本回合不能被阻挡。

704087.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player sacrifices a creature with the least power among creatures they control.
704087.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最小者。

704088.oracleText: Whenever Witch-king, Bringer of Ruin attacks, defending player sacrifices a creature with the least power among creatures they control.
704088.translation: 每当毁灭使者巫王攻击时，防御牌手牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最小者。

704092.oracleText: {o2oR}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. When you play a card this way, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each player.
704092.translation: {o2oR}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。当你以此法使用牌时，CARDNAME对每位牌手各造成2点伤害。

704093.oracleText: {o2oR}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. When you play a card this way, Fires of Mount Doom deals 2 damage to each player.
704093.translation: {o2oR}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。当你以此法使用牌时，末日山烈焰对每位牌手各造成2点伤害。

704094.oracleText: The fighting waxed furious on the fields of the Pelennor; and the din of arms rose upon high, with the crying of Men and the neighing of horses. But the hosts of Mordor were enheartened, and filled with a new fury they came yelling to the onset.
704094.translation: 佩兰诺平野上战斗更趋白热化：兵器铮鸣愈发频繁，人呼马啸不绝于耳。但魔多大军却更为振奋，再度群情激昂呐喊冲锋。

704096.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature.
704096.translation: 在另一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

704097.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature.
704097.translation: 在另一个目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

704101.oracleText: An evil of the Ancient World, both a shadow and a flame.
704101.translation: 来自古代世界的邪物，它既是阴影，又是火焰。

704102.oracleText: When a legendary creature an opponent controls dies, put CARDNAME on the bottom of its owner's library.
704102.translation: 当一个由对手操控的传奇生物死去时，将CARDNAME置于其拥有者的牌库底。

704103.oracleText: When a legendary creature an opponent controls dies, put The Balrog, Flame of Udun on the bottom of its owner's library.
704103.translation: 当一个由对手操控的传奇生物死去时，将乌顿之火炎魔置于其拥有者的牌库底。

704106.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks alone, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
704106.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物单独攻击时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

704108.translation: 新婚燕尔阿拉贡与阿尔玟

704110.oracleText: Aragorn the King Elessar wedded Arwen Undomiel, and the tale of their long waiting and labors came to fulfillment.
704110.translation: 埃莱萨王阿拉贡与阿尔玟·乌多米尔成婚，他们漫长等待与历经艰辛的故事终于有了圆满结局。

704114.oracleText: There is an Eye in the Dark Tower that does not sleep.
704114.translation: 邪黑塔中，有只不眠不休的眼睛。

704117.oracleText: {o1oBoR}: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. Each opponent loses 2 life.
704117.translation: {o1oBoR}：由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。每位对手各失去2点生命。

704118.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped Humans you control?
704118.translation: 是否要横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的人类？

704119.translation: 指定一个由你操控的妖精为目标。

704121.oracleText: Tap two other untapped Halflings you control.
704121.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他半身人。

704122.oracleText: Attach target Equipment you control with mana value 2 or 3 to {1, CardId}?
704122.translation: 是否将目标由你操控且法术力值等于2或3的武具贴附于{1, CardId}上？

704123.oracleText: Target an Equipment you control with mana value 2 or 3.
704123.translation: 指定一个由你操控且法术力值等于2或3的武具为目标。

704124.oracleText: Put it into its owner's library fifth from the top?
704124.translation: 是否将它置于其拥有者牌库顶数来第五张的位置？

704125.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature with the least power among creatures they control.
704125.translation: 牺牲一个生物，且须是由其操控的生物中力量最小者。

704126.translation: 指定一个半身人为目标。

704128.oracleText: It was a time for rebuilding, but first Ikoria's wrecked cities had to be cleared of monsters.
704128.translation: 现在虽是重建之时，但首要任务却是将游荡于依克黎坏灭都市中怪兽清除干净。

704129.oracleText: Each other Human you control gets +1/+0 and has ward {o1}.
704129.translation: 每个由你操控的其他人类均得+1/+0且各具有守护{o1}。

704133.oracleText: Planeswalkers you control of the chosen type have hexproof.
704133.translation: 由你操控的该类别鹏洛客具有辟邪异能。

704134.oracleText: As long as you control a creature, if damage dealt to a planeswalker you control of the chosen type would result in all loyalty counters on it being removed, instead all but one of those counters are removed.
704134.translation: 只要你操控生物，如果对任一由你操控的该类别鹏洛客造成之伤害将移去其上所有忠诚指示物，则改为留下一个此类指示物并将其余的移去。

704136.oracleText: Survivors put the strength of former war mounts to good use clearing the rubble of Orazca.
704136.translation: 战时坐骑原有的充沛精力，正好被幸存者用来清理欧拉兹卡的瓦砾。

704137.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
704137.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

704138.oracleText: Whenever Harnessed Snubhorn deals combat damage to a player, return target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
704138.translation: 每当佩挽短角龙对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

704140.oracleText: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turned their eyes to their former captors: demons.
704140.translation: 随着远古宿敌尽数败退，新卡佩纳的天使便将目光转向过往囚禁他们的对手：恶魔。

704141.oracleText: Whenever Metropolis Reformer is dealt damage, you gain that much life.
704141.translation: 每当都会变革使受到伤害时，你获得等量的生命。

704143.oracleText: Phyrexia was defeated, but the repercussions of the invasion rippled through the Blind Eternities.
704143.translation: 非瑞克西亚虽已被击败，但侵攻余波仍在整个黑暗虚空回荡。

704145.oracleText: Each planeswalker with one or more loyalty counters on it loses all abilities and is a creature with power and toughness each equal to the number of loyalty counters on it.
704145.translation: 对每个其上有一个或数个忠诚指示物的鹏洛客而言，它失去所有异能，且是力量和防御力各等同于其上忠诚指示物数量的生物。

704147.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any of this creature's colors. Spend this mana only to activate an ability of a creature. Activate only if this creature has another activated ability.
704147.translation: {oT}：加一点法术力，其颜色为此生物的任一颜色。此法术力只能用来起动生物的异能。只能于此生物有另一个起动式异能时起动。

704148.oracleText: Each creature you control has "{oT}: Add one mana of any of this creature's colors. Spend this mana only to activate an ability of a creature. Activate only if this creature has another activated ability."
704148.translation: 每个你操控的生物具有「{oT}：加一点法术力，其颜色为此生物的任一颜色。此法术力只能用来起动生物的异能。只能于此生物有另一个起动式异能时起动。」

704149.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}, {oT}: Mill five cards. Put all creature cards with activated abilities that aren't mana abilities from among the milled cards into your hand.
704149.translation: {oWoUoBoRoG}，{oT}：磨五张牌。从所磨掉之牌中将所有具有不属于法术力异能之起动式异能的生物牌置于你手上。

704151.oracleText: The glistening oil had been rendered inert, but planes wouldn't begin to truly heal until every last drop was purged.
704151.translation: 虽然残存于各时空内的烁油都已失去活性，但要把每点每滴都涤除干净后，时空才会真正开始愈合。

704152.oracleText: Return all noncreature, nonland permanents to their owners' hands.
704152.translation: 将所有非生物且非地的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

704156.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, for each opponent, choose up to one target creature they control with a rejection counter on it. That creature's owner puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
704156.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，为每位对手各选择至多一个目标由其操控且上面有拒斥指示物的生物。该生物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

704157.oracleText: For those who survived, being prepared for the next crisis became one of the greatest virtues.
704157.translation: 对活下来的人来说，时刻做好准备应对下次危机已经成当代的一大美德。

704159.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, you may reveal the top card of your library. If you reveal a creature card this way, CARDNAME becomes a copy of that card until end of turn, except it has flying.
704159.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，你可以展示你的牌库顶牌。若你以此法展示出一张生物牌，则CARDNAME成为该牌的复制品直到回合结束，但它具有飞行异能。

704160.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, you may reveal the top card of your library. If you reveal a creature card this way, Vesuvan Drifter becomes a copy of that card until end of turn, except it has flying.
704160.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，你可以展示你的牌库顶牌。若你以此法展示出一张生物牌，则维苏瓦漂泊者成为该牌的复制品直到回合结束，但它具有飞行异能。

704162.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, if it has fewer than four +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then if it has exactly four +1/+1 counters on it, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
704162.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若其上的+1/+1指示物数量少于四个，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后如果其上正好有四个+1/+1指示物，则从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

704163.oracleText: Whenever Ayara's Oathsworn deals combat damage to a player, if it has fewer than four +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then if it has exactly four +1/+1 counters on it, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
704163.translation: 每当阿娅拉的守誓骑士对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若其上的+1/+1指示物数量少于四个，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后如果其上正好有四个+1/+1指示物，则从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

704165.oracleText: After the invasion, many wanted to leave a life of violence. But once you're a Reckoner, you die a Reckoner.
704165.translation: 侵攻过后，帮众都厌倦了在刀口上讨生活。只是一入江湖，一生江湖。

704166.oracleText: Target opponent exiles a creature or planeswalker they control with the greatest mana value among creatures and planeswalkers they control.
704166.translation: 目标对手放逐一个由其操控的生物或鹏洛客，且须是由其操控的生物和鹏洛客中法术力值最大者。

704168.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast for each creature that died this turn.
704168.translation: 本回合中每有一个生物死去，此咒语便减少{o2}来施放。

704175.oracleText: CARDNAME has flying as long as a card exiled with it has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
704175.translation: 只要以它放逐的某张牌具有飞行异能，CARDNAME便具有飞行异能。且先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、威慑、延势、践踏与警戒异能亦比照办理。

704176.oracleText: Urborg Scavengers has flying as long as a card exiled with it has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
704176.translation: 只要以它放逐的某张牌具有飞行异能，乌尔博格拾荒灵便具有飞行异能。且先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、威慑、延势、践踏与警戒异能亦比照办理。

704180.oracleText: Conflict is a constant. Only the enemies change.
704180.translation: 冲突是常量。敌人是变量。

704181.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
704181.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张龙牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

704182.oracleText: Whenever Kolaghan Warmonger attacks, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Dragon card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
704182.translation: 每当寇安甘族好战者攻击时，检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张龙牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

704185.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card. An opponent chooses a nonland card exiled this way. You may cast up to two spells from among the other cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
704185.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每位牌手各从其牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张非地牌为止。任一对手选择一张以此法放逐的非地牌。你可以从依此法放逐的其他牌之中施放至多两个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

704187.oracleText: The relic shattered, and something in Nahiri broke as well.
704187.translation: 看着遗宝在眼前破碎，娜希丽心中仿佛也有东西也随之脱落而去。

704188.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact card, reveal it, put it into your hand, shuffle, then discard a card at random. If an artifact card was discarded this way, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.
704188.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，洗牌，然后随机弃一张牌。如果以此法弃掉一张神器牌，则CARDNAME向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

704189.oracleText: Search your library for an artifact card, reveal it, put it into your hand, shuffle, then discard a card at random. If an artifact card was discarded this way, Reckless Handling deals 2 damage to each opponent.
704189.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张神器牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，洗牌，然后随机弃一张牌。如果以此法弃掉一张神器牌，则鲁莽处置向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

704191.oracleText: The creature was unlike any Nissa had seen, but she dealt with it as she would any threat.
704191.translation: 虽然这生物跟妮莎此前见过的截然不同，但她仍照应对威胁一般将它制服在地。

704192.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a legendary creature you control.
704192.translation: 如果此咒语以由你操控的传奇生物为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

704193.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to twice its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
704193.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者力量的两倍。

704195.oracleText: When Nissa tapped into Zhalfir's leylines, she was shocked to feel not a piece of Dominaria, but a plane all its own.
704195.translation: 当妮莎与赛费尔的地脉相联时，她惊奇地发现此处已感受不到多明纳里亚的任何气息，而是作为独立时空存在。

704197.oracleText: {oT}: Add five mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast spells.
704197.translation: {oT}：加五点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放咒语。

704198.oracleText: Enchanted creature has ward {o2} and "{oT}: Add five mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast spells."
704198.translation: 所结附的生物具有守护{o2}与「{oT}：加五点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放咒语。」

704202.oracleText: X can't be greater than the number of players in the game.
704202.translation: X不能大于这盘游戏中的牌手数量。

704203.oracleText: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X land cards. Put those land cards onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
704203.translation: 从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出X张地牌为止。将这些地牌横置放进战场，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

704208.oracleText: Light shone on parts of the undercity for the first time in centuries.
704208.translation: 数百年来，这是首度有阳光照耀在地底城区上。

704209.oracleText: Undergrowth — Distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard as you cast this spell. Creatures you control gain vigilance until end of turn.
704209.translation: 朽力～将X个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量目标由你操控的生物，X为于你施放此咒语时你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。由你操控的生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

704213.oracleText: Whenever Calix or an enchanted creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may create a token that's a copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control. Do this only once each turn.
704213.translation: 每当凯利斯或一个由你操控且受有灵气的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为一个由你操控的非传奇结界之复制品。每回合只能如此作一次。

704215.oracleText: Reconstructing the past is Lorehold's specialty.
704215.translation: 重构过去乃是衡鉴学院的专长。

704216.oracleText: Return up to one target artifact or enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
704216.translation: 将至多一张目标神器或结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

704218.oracleText:
"When all the stories find their ends, a new one shall begin."
—The Endsaga
704218.translation:
「所有传说终结后，必有新章从头起。」
～《落幕终章》

704219.oracleText: Choose target permanent card in your graveyard. If it has mana value 3 or less, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don't put it onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
704219.translation: 选择目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌。如果它的法术力值等于或小于3，则你可以将它放进战场。如果你未将它放进战场，则将它置于你手上。

704220.translation: 新宾纳里亚之光达妮莎

704221.oracleText: Danitha had spent her whole life preparing to lead House Capashen, but she mourned that the opportunity had come so soon.
704221.translation: 虽然达妮莎这一生都在为领导卡帕轩家族做准备，但她仍为此重任太早落在她身上而悲伤不已。

704222.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an Aura or Equipment spell from your graveyard.
704222.translation: 仅于你的每个回合中且限一次，你可以从你坟墓场中施放灵气或武具咒语。

704224.oracleText: To hear them tell it, they charged bare-handed into New Phyrexia and beat up Elesh Norn all by themselves.
704224.translation: 用他们的话来说，他们就是赤手空拳地冲进了新非瑞克西亚，全拥而上把艾蕾侬痛揍一频后得胜而归。

704225.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if one or more creatures died this turn, you gain that much life and distribute that many +1/+1 counters among creatures you control.
704225.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有一个或数个生物死去，则你获得等量生命，并将等量的+1/+1指示物分配给由你操控的生物。

704228.oracleText: Worlds apart, Huatli built a device Saheeli would have been proud of.
704228.translation: 虽然两人分处不同世界，但华特莉也造出了一个连莎希莉都会为之骄傲的装置。

704229.oracleText: Each legendary permanent you control has ward {o2}.
704229.translation: 每个由你操控的传奇永久物均具有守护{o2}。

704231.oracleText: "Our strength lies not in our walls, but in our people."
704231.translation: 「我们的力量并非建于高墙之上，而是深存人民心中。」

704233.oracleText: Sacrifice Jirina: Humans you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
704233.translation: 牺牲杰琳娜：由你操控的人类获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

704235.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to one target land you control becomes an X/X green and blue Bird creature with flying and haste until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand. It's still a land.
704235.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，至多一个目标由你操控的地成为X/X，绿蓝双色，具飞行与敏捷异能的鸟生物直到回合结束，X为你的手牌数量。它仍然是地。

704236.oracleText: Whenever a land creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
704236.translation: 每当一个由你操控的地生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

704240.oracleText: Legendary spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each card exiled with CARDNAME.
704240.translation: 每有一张以CARDNAME放逐的牌，你施放的传奇咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

704241.oracleText: Legendary spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast for each card exiled with The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
704241.translation: 每有一张以肯理斯皇室葬礼放逐的牌，你施放的传奇咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

704243.oracleText: Whenever you cast a Kraken, Leviathan, Octopus, or Serpent spell from your hand, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is that spell's mana value. You may cast a spell with mana value less than X from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
704243.translation: 每当你从你手上施放巨海兽，海怪，章鱼或巨蛇咒语时，检视你牌库顶的X张牌，X为该咒语的法术力值。你可以从其中施放一个法术力值小于X的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

704245.oracleText: Whenever an equipped creature you control attacks, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. You may cast Equipment spells this way without paying their mana costs.
704245.translation: 每当一个由你操控且佩带武具的生物攻击时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。你可以依此法施放武具咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

704248.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and have haste.
704248.translation: 由你操控的生物得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

704249.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, exile any number of nontoken artifacts and/or creatures you control. Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of your next upkeep.
704249.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，放逐任意数量由你操控且非衍生物的神器和／或生物。在你的下一个维持开始时，将这些牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

704251.oracleText: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."
704251.translation: 他们起初将她的独特视界称为「天赋」。但在她看到真相后，这一切转眼就成了「威胁」。

704252.translation: 由你操控的生物具有灵技异能。

704253.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile target noncreature, nonland card with mana value less than Narset's power from a graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
704253.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标既非生物也非地、且法术力值小于娜尔施力量的牌从坟墓场放逐并将它复制。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

704254.oracleText: Whenever Narset, Enlightened Exile attacks, exile target noncreature, nonland card with mana value less than Narset's power from a graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
704254.translation: 每当受启黜人娜尔施攻击时，将目标既非生物也非地、且法术力值小于娜尔施力量的牌从坟墓场放逐并将它复制。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

704257.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile up to one target legendary or Rat card from your graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy.
704257.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将至多一张目标传奇或老鼠牌从你的坟墓场放逐并将它复制。你可以施放该复制品。

704260.oracleText: Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard that's exactly two colors has jump-start.
704260.translation: 你坟墓场中每张正好两色的瞬间与法术牌均具有再起异能。

704262.oracleText: Stranded on New Capenna without a spark, he faced five families out for blood.
704262.translation: 没有火花的他如今不仅受困新卡佩纳无法脱身，还要面对五个家族的复仇怒火。

704263.oracleText: Whenever one or more opponents each lose exactly 1 life, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Exile the top card of your library. Until your next end step, you may play that card.
704263.translation: 每当一位或多位对手各失去正好1点生命时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用该牌。

704264.oracleText: Whenever one or more opponents each lose exactly 1 life, put a +1/+1 counter on Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin. Exile the top card of your library. Until your next end step, you may play that card.
704264.translation: 每当一位或多位对手各失去正好1点生命时，在受困魔头欧尼希兹上放置一个+1/+1指示物。放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用该牌。

704266.translation: 先是乱匠，再成革命家，现为重建师。

704267.translation: 由你操控的振翼机具有敏捷异能。

704268.oracleText: Whenever you play a land from exile or cast a spell from exile, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
704268.translation: 每当你从放逐区使用地或从放逐区施放咒语时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

704270.oracleText: The Phyrexian design had to go, but the materials could be put to good use.
704270.translation: 非瑞克西亚式样必得移除，但其材料可善加利用。

704271.oracleText: Choose target land. Create three tokens that are copies of it, except they're 3/3 creatures in addition to their other types and they have vigilance and menace.
704271.translation: 选择目标地。派出三个为其复制品的衍生物，但它们是额外是3/3生物，且具有警戒与威慑异能。

704272.oracleText: Choose target land. Create three tokens that are copies of it, except they're 3/3 creatures in addition to their other types and they have vigilance and menace. (They're affected by summoning sickness.)
704272.translation: 选择目标地。派出三个为其复制品的衍生物，但它们是额外是3/3生物，且具有警戒与威慑异能。（它们会受召唤失调影响。）

704274.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each player exiles the top card of their library. Until your next end step, each player may play the card they exiled this way.
704274.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每位牌手各放逐其牌库顶牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，每位牌手各可以使用其以此法放逐的牌。

704275.oracleText: Whenever a player plays a land from exile or casts a spell from exile, you put a +1/+1 counter on target creature and create a Food token.
704275.translation: 每当任一牌手从放逐区使用地或从放逐区施放咒语时，你在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物并派出一个食品衍生物。

704278.oracleText: "Try to keep up, Djeru. We have lots of work to do."
704278.translation: 「杰鲁，尽量跟上我的脚步。要做的事情还很多。」

704283.oracleText: You may cast Angel spells and Human spells from the top of your library.
704283.translation: 你可以从你的牌库顶施放天使和人类咒语。

704286.oracleText: Whenever one or more Elves you control attack, they gain deathtouch until end of turn.
704286.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个妖精攻击时，它们获得死触异能直到回合结束。

731065.translation: 在战斗结束时，将该生物移回其拥有者的手上。（每当好战恶棍攻击时，直到回合结束，至多一个目标进行攻击的生物得+2/+0且获得践踏异能。在战斗结束时，将该生物移回其拥有者的手上。（若它在战场上，才须将它移回。））

731066.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, you may return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control. It's a Forest land. (It has no other types or abilities.)
731066.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，你可以将它在其拥有者的操控下牌面朝下地移回战场。它是树林地。（它没有其他类别和异能。）

731067.oracleText: As long as Arixmethes has a slumber counter on it, it's a land. (It's not a creature.)
731067.translation: 只要阿力马昔斯上有静眠指示物，它便是地。（它不是生物。）

731068.oracleText: Whenever Nashi, Moon's Legacy attacks, exile up to one target legendary or Rat card from your graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy. (You still pay its costs. A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
731068.translation: 每当月智传承哪失攻击时，将至多一张目标传奇或老鼠牌从你的坟墓场放逐并将它复制。你可以施放该复制品。（你依旧要支付其费用，永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

731069.oracleText: Target any number of creatures or planeswalkers controlled by different opponents.
731069.translation: 指定任意数量由不同对手操控的生物或鹏洛客为目标。

731096.oracleText: Distribute counters among creatures you control.
731096.translation: 将指示物分配到由你操控的生物上。

731099.oracleText: Choose a nonland card, your opponent won't be able to cast the card you choose.
731099.translation: 选择一张非地牌，你的对手将不能施放所选的牌。

731144.oracleText: The curse of Redtooth Keep could only be broken by a mystical rose that blooms in moonlight.
731144.translation: 赤牙砦下的诅咒，唯有午夜盛开的神秘玫瑰方能解开。

731145.oracleText: Other creatures you control that are enchanted by Auras you control have base power and toughness 4/4 and have flying.
731145.translation: 对由你操控且受有由你操控之灵气的其他生物而言，它们的基础力量与防御力为4/4且具有飞行异能。

731147.oracleText: A winged dawn dispels the terrors of night.
731147.translation: 黎明晨翼，驱散暗夜恐惧。

731149.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If this spell was bargained, that creature also gains flying and lifelink until end of turn.
731149.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。如果此咒语已加码，则直到回合结束，该生物再获得飞行与系命异能。

731151.oracleText: They help ensure that the forges of the dwarves are always squeaky clean.
731151.translation: 吱响声间，它们麻利搬运，确保矮人熔炉整洁如新。

731152.oracleText: Celebration — CARDNAME gets +0/+2 as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
731152.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，CARDNAME便得+0/+2。

731153.oracleText: Celebration — Armory Mice gets +0/+2 as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
731153.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，军械库鼠群便得+0/+2。

731156.oracleText: "You are no monster to me, my love."

731158.oracleText: Create a Royal Role token attached to target creature you control.
731158.translation: 派出一个皇族角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

731160.oracleText: As Hylda watched Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious form through the cold, Hylda felt something she hadn't felt in a long time: compassion.
731160.translation: 在严寒之中，小红玉拖着凯澜毫无意识的身躯，在雪地上蹒跚前行～希尔妲将这一切看在眼中，心头忽然浮现出一丝久违的情感：怜悯。

731161.oracleText: Destroy target enchantment. If a permanent you controlled or a token was destroyed this way, draw a card.
731161.translation: 消灭目标结界。如果以此法消灭的是衍生物或由你操控的永久物，则抓一张牌。

731167.oracleText: "Get back here, vile rodent! I was almost done cursing that ring!"
731167.translation: “死耗子你快给我回来！戒指差一点就诅咒完了！”

731169.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. It can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater this turn.
731169.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。它于本回合不能被力量大于或等于3的生物阻挡。

731171.oracleText:
"Cold iron's all you need to hold a faerie. The charms are mostly decorative."
—Eulyn, Edgewall peddler
731171.translation:
“要想关住仙灵，单凭铁笼就能做到。上面的护符纯粹只是为了好看。”
～边墙镇小贩尤凌

731173.oracleText: It was the first and last time anyone attempted to levy a tax on the witches of Dunbarrow.
731173.translation: 这是第一次有人想要向黯沼野的女巫收税；也是最后一次。

731177.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if an opponent controls more lands than you, create a Treasure token.
731177.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若某对手操控的地比你多，则你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

731178.oracleText: {o2oW}: Choose another player. That player gains control of target Treasure you control. You draw a card.
731178.translation: {o2oW}：选择另一位牌手。该牌手获得目标由你操控的珍宝之操控权。你抓一张牌。

731180.oracleText: She stayed by her master's side, leaving only to hunt. She would guard him until he woke, however long it took.
731180.translation: 她一直留在主人身旁，只在猎食时才离开。她一直守护主人安危，不论他多久才醒来。

731181.oracleText: {o2oW}, Sacrifice two enchantments: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
731181.translation: {o2oW}，牺牲两个结界：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

731182.oracleText: {o2oW}, Sacrifice two enchantments: Return Dutiful Griffin from your graveyard to your hand.
731182.translation: {o2oW}，牺牲两个结界：将守责狮鹫从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

731184.oracleText: Ranks of sleeping Ardenvale knights filled Eriette's throne room, ready to defend their witch-queen with unthinking devotion.
731184.translation: 雅登瓦迷睡骑士大军集聚艾纶缇所处正殿，准备以无谋衷心保卫巫后。

731185.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control this turn by creatures.
731185.translation: 于本回合中，防止生物将对你和由你操控之生物造成的所有伤害。

731187.oracleText: When a redcap raid threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh, Goddric had no choice but to reveal his true identity and douse the invaders in dragonfire.
731187.translation: 就在深掘台外红帽客压境、堂皇舞宴行将夭折之际，戈垂克被迫亮明身份，喷出龙火将闯入者全数烧尽。

731188.oracleText: Choose a number between 0 and 10. Destroy all creatures with power greater than or equal to the chosen number.
731188.translation: 选择一个0到10之间的数字。消灭所有力量等于或大于该数字的生物。

731190.oracleText: The sentry watched impassively, its spear unmoving. One by one, the would-be adventurers stumbled and fell, frostbitten, to the ground.
731190.translation: 哨卫就只是冷冷地看着，手中长矛甚至都未动分毫。没多久，那些想要踏上征程的冒险者便难抵严寒，步履珊，逐一倒地。

731192.oracleText: "Time for your just desserts, redcap scum!"
731192.translation: 「红帽混蛋，你们点的报应来了！」

731193.oracleText: Celebration — CARDNAME has double strike as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
731193.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

731194.oracleText: Celebration — Gallant Pie-Wielder has double strike as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
731194.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，盛装掷饼人便具有连击异能。

731195.oracleText: While Neva's mind wandered the realm of dreams, her body lay protected as mages worked frantically to find a cure for the Wicked Slumber.
731195.translation: 白涅娃思绪畅游梦境，其沉睡身躯安眠无虞～只是周遭围满了焦急的法师，不眠不休地想要找到解开沉睡咒的灵方。

731198.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, scry 2.
731198.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，占卜2。

731199.oracleText: When Hopeful Vigil is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, scry 2.
731199.translation: 当怀望守夜从战场进入坟墓场时，占卜2。

731203.oracleText: Kellan struck out on pure instinct, and his conjured blades cleaved through the icy guardians as though they were nothing but air.
731203.translation: 凯澜就只是凭着本能甩手回击，未想这幻变刀刃却轻松撕裂寒冰守卫身躯，如若无物。

731204.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If this spell was bargained, destroy that creature instead.
731204.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。如果此咒语已加码，则改为消灭该生物。

731205.oracleText: Kellan's Lightblades deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If this spell was bargained, destroy that creature instead.
731205.translation: 凯澜光刃斩对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。如果此咒语已加码，则改为消灭该生物。

731207.oracleText: So many birds, yet the air was still and empty of song. Part of Syr Damon knew something wasn't right, but it was a far-off worry, unimportant and soon forgotten.
731207.translation: 身边似有无数鸟影掠过，然而周遭始终静滞无声～尽管戴蒙爵士已觉事态有异，但这一无关忧虑很快便被抛诸脑后。

731208.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying.
731208.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界从战场进入坟墓场时，派出一个1/1白色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

731210.oracleText: Hardened by the Phyrexian invasion, Will's knights starved the nightmares of the thing they craved most: fear.
731210.translation: 经历非瑞克西亚大侵攻之后，威尔手下的骑士就没让梦魇从他们身上汲取到任何渴求之物：恐惧。

731211.oracleText: Untap target creature. It gets +1/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn.
731211.translation: 重置目标生物。直到回合结束，它得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。

731212.oracleText: Choose one — • Untap target creature. It gets +1/+0 and gains indestructible until end of turn. • Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.
731212.translation: 选择一项～ •  重置目标生物。直到回合结束，它得+1/+0且获得不灭异能。 •  消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。

731214.oracleText: High King Kenrith's armies followed him into the afterlife, ready to charge at his command.
731214.translation: 至高王肯理斯魔下部队追随他进入来生，随时准备听命冲锋。

731218.oracleText: When Hylda froze Loch Larent to create her palace, some merfolk dove deep enough underwater to escape the chill. Others weren't so lucky.
731218.translation: 当希尔妲冻结拉伦特湖筑造宫殿时，有些人鱼早早潜入湖底深处，躲过了这次严寒。但有些就没有那么走运。

731219.oracleText: Tap up to one target creature. Scry 1, then draw a card.
731219.translation: 横置至多一个目标生物。占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

731221.oracleText: Exile up to one target creature.
731221.translation: 放逐至多一个目标生物。

731222.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains flying until end of turn.
731222.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得飞行异能。

731223.oracleText: Return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
731223.translation: 将所放逐之牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

731225.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a Young Hero Role token attached to up to one target creature you control.
731225.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个青年英雄角色衍生物，并贴附在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731226.oracleText: When Protective Parents dies, create a Young Hero Role token attached to up to one target creature you control.
731226.translation: 当戒护家长死去时，派出一个青年英雄角色衍生物，并贴附在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731229.oracleText:
"It's entirely peaceful, as long as you don't try to pet it, pen it, take its food, take its hide, sit on its grass, or dress it up in colorful garb for human holidays."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger
731229.translation: 「它性格很温顺啦，只要你不要去试着抚摸它、圈养它、抢它食物、剪它皮毛、坐它草坪，或是为了人类节日让它穿红戴绿就好。」～边境地巡林客斯图温

731230.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the number of nonland permanents you control.
731230.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的非地永久物数量。

731231.oracleText: Regal Bunnicorn's power and toughness are each equal to the number of nonland permanents you control.
731231.translation: 庄严独角兔的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的非地永久物数量。

731233.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Create a Young Hero Role token attached to it.
731233.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。派出一个青年英雄角色衍生物并贴附于其上。

731235.oracleText: Attracted by the quiet of Hylda's realm, reindeer herds moved in and made themselves at home near the palace of ice.
731235.translation: 希尔妲王国环境幽雅静谥，吸引驯鹿成群迁徙此处，散居于寒冰宫殿周围。

731238.oracleText: Even lost in slumber, the citizens of Ardenvale dream of a tireless protector standing guard over their homes.
731238.translation: 纵使雅登瓦民众静眠不醒，他们仍会梦到一位保卫家园的不懈卫士。

731239.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on Savior of the Sleeping.
731239.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界从战场进入坟墓场时，在迷睡者救星上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731241.oracleText: Dreams of a realm united gave him strength even in sleep.
731241.translation: 世境统一之梦令他在沉眠当中也心潮澎湃。

731243.oracleText: {o2oW}: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each enchantment you control.
731243.translation: {o2oW}：你每操控一个结界，CARDNAME便得+1/+i直到回合结束。

731244.oracleText: {o2oW}: Slumbering Keepguard gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each enchantment you control.
731244.translation: {o2oW}：你每操控一个结界，静眠殿卫便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

731247.oracleText: Whenever you tap an untapped creature an opponent controls, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
731247.translation: 每当你横置一个由对手操控且未横置的生物时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731249.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {o1}. When you do, create a Sorcerer Role token attached to target creature you control.
731249.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，派出一个术士角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

731251.translation: 「怎么？我不过是想留着晚点再吃罢了。」

731255.oracleText: The assembled partygoers fell silent and stared. As the helmet came to a clattering stop, the only sound was Ash's distant footsteps.
731255.translation: 原本热闹的宴会顿时安静下来，大家眼光聚集一处。待到盔甲落地的声音停歇后，唯有灰钴娘远去的脚步声在舞厅回荡。

731256.oracleText: Destroy target nonland permanent. Its controller creates a 1/1 white Human creature token.
731256.translation: 消灭目标非地永久物。其操控者派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

731258.oracleText: With every retelling of Agatha's demise, Kellan got taller and Ruby got stronger. But the core story stayed the same, and people remembered what happens to those who prey on the weak.
731258.translation: 每次重讲阿加莎陨命的故事时，凯澜都会更高一分，小红玉也都更壮一圈。但故事的主旨却始终没变，大家也都记住了欺负弱者的人会有什么下场。

731259.translation: 由你操控且受有灵气的生物得+2/+2。

731261.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Mouse creature token.
731261.translation: 派出一个1/1白色家鼠衍生生物。

731262.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target token you control.
731262.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的衍生物之复制品。

731263.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target token you control.
731263.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的衍生物之复制品。

731264.oracleText: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn.
731264.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

731266.oracleText: "Weary traveler, follow me. The night is a cage, and my light is the key."
731266.translation: 「疲惫的旅人啊，快快随我来。若夜晚是加锁牢笼，我的灯光便是开锁之钥。」

731267.oracleText: Celebration — CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and has lifelink as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
731267.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，CARDNAME便得+1/+0直具有系命异能。

731268.oracleText: Celebration — Tuinvale Guide gets +1/+0 and has lifelink as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
731268.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，图音谷向导便得+1/+0直具有系命异能。

731271.oracleText: "The archmage Valya? Why yes, I do believe I've heard of her."
731271.translation: 「大法师瓦尔娅？怎么，我确实听说过这么一个人。」

731275.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Untap those creatures.
731275.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。重置这些生物。

731282.oracleText: {o1oW}, Sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard: You gain 2 life.
731282.translation: {o1oW}，牺牲半狐保镖：你获得2点生命。

731284.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
731284.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个瞬间或法术咒语时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

731285.oracleText: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, Aquatic Alchemist gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
731285.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第一个瞬间或法术咒语时，水生炼金术士得+2/+0直到回合结束。

731287.oracleText: Put target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard on top of your library.
731287.translation: 将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

731289.oracleText: "Fascinating. It says here that dragons cannot read."

731292.oracleText: You may cast Asinine Antics as though it had flash if you pay {o2} more to cast it.
731292.translation: 如果你施放变驴变马时多支付{o2}，则你可以将它视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

731293.oracleText: For each creature your opponents control, create a Cursed Role token attached to that creature.
731293.translation: 为每个由对手操控的生物各派出一个倒楣鬼角色衍生物并贴附在该生物上。

731295.oracleText: "And what makes you think Lady Grandsquall wants to see you, little one?"
731295.translation: “小家伙，你又为什么会觉得巨风女王想要接见你呢？”

731297.oracleText: Return target creature you don't control with mana value 3 or less to its owner's hand.
731297.translation: 将目标不由你操控且法术力值等于或小于3的生物移回其拥有者手上。

731300.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {o1}. If you do, scry 1, then draw a card.
731300.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

731301.oracleText: When Bitter Chill is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {o1}. If you do, scry 1, then draw a card.
731301.translation: 当苦寒霜冻从战场进入坟墓场时，你可以支付{o1}。若你如此作，则占卜1，然后抓一张牌。

731303.oracleText: ". . . so the knight stabbed the troll, the troll threw the knight off the bridge, and they both forgot about the sword."
731303.translation: “··· 最后，骑士刺中巨魔，巨魔将骑士打落桥下，大家都忘了宝剑的事情。”

731307.oracleText: In retrospect, using storm magic against a storm giant was not the wisest strategy.
731307.translation: 回头来看，利用风暴魔法来对付风暴巨人并非最佳之选。

731313.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. If this spell was bargained, look at the top eight cards of your library instead. Put two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
731313.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。如果此咒语已加码，则改为检视你牌库顶的八张牌。将其中两张置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

731315.oracleText:
"I'm getting the sense we shouldn't expect a warm welcome."
—Kellan
731315.translation:
“我越发觉得，不该期待会有人热脸相迎。”
～凯澜

731316.oracleText: Tap target creature an opponent controls and put three stun counters on it. Scry 2.
731316.translation: 横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置三个晕眩指示物。占卜2。

731318.oracleText: Create a Cursed Role token attached to up to one target creature.
731318.translation: 派出一个倒楣鬼角色衍生物，并贴附在至多一个目标生物上。

731322.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
731322.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

731328.oracleText: The owner of target attacking creature you don't control puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
731328.translation: 选择目标不由你操控且进行攻击的生物，其拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

731330.oracleText: Hylda built an ice statuary from all those who couldn't understand "go away."
731330.translation: 希尔妲将那些装作听不懂「走开」命令的人全都冻作一尊冰雕，以儆效尤。

731331.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if it's bargained.
731331.translation: 如果此咒语已加码，则它减少{o1}来施放。

731333.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o1oU}. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls.
731333.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o1oU}。当你如此作时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

731334.oracleText: Whenever Icewrought Sentry attacks, you may pay {o1oU}. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls.
731334.translation: 每当冰铸哨卫攻击时，你可以支付{o1oU}。当你如此作时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

731335.oracleText: Whenever you tap an untapped creature an opponent controls, CARDNAME gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
731335.translation: 每当你横置一个由对手操控且未横置的生物时，CARDNAME得+2/+1直到回合结束。

731336.oracleText: Whenever you tap an untapped creature an opponent controls, Icewrought Sentry gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
731336.translation: 每当你横置一个由对手操控且未横置的生物时，冰铸哨卫得+2/+1直到回合结束。

731339.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if CARDNAME has one or more +1/+1 counters on it, you may remove a +1/+1 counter from it. If you do, draw a card.
731339.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若CARDNAME上有一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则你可以从其上移去一个+1/+1指示物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

731340.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if Ingenious Prodigy has one or more +1/+1 counters on it, you may remove a +1/+1 counter from it. If you do, draw a card.
731340.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若妙法逸才上有一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则你可以从其上移去一个+1/+1指示物。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

731342.oracleText: Kellan stepped from his village into a strange world where trees bore jeweled fruit. A regal, inhuman voice rang in his ears: "Tell me, brave hero, are you true of heart?"
731342.translation: 凯澜刚走出村庄，正要踏入树上结满珍稀珠宝的奇异世界。此时，他耳畔响起一阵异族的庄严之声：「勇敢的英雄啊，告诉我，你是否真心闯荡？」

731343.oracleText: Draw three cards. Create a 1/1 blue Faerie creature token with flying and "This creature can block only creatures with flying."
731343.translation: 抓三张牌。派出一个1/1蓝色仙灵衍生生物，且具有飞行与「此生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。」

731345.oracleText: "Just . . . stay in there . . . for one . . . second!"
731345.translation: 「给我……在里面待住…一秒钟……就好！」

731346.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it's bargained.
731346.translation: 如果此咒语已加码,则它减少{o2}来施放。

731347.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Draw a card.
731347.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。抓一张牌。

731349.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw a card. Create a Sorcerer Role token attached to up to one other target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
731349.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：抓一张牌。派出一个术士角色衍生物，并贴附在至多另一个目标由你操控的生物上。只能于法术时机起动。

731350.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Living Lectern: Draw a card. Create a Sorcerer Role token attached to up to one other target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
731350.translation: {o1}，牺牲活体讲台：抓一张牌。派出一个术士角色衍生物，并贴附在至多另一个目标由你操控的生物上。只能于法术时机起动。

731352.oracleText: "Wooden swords rot. Steel axes rust. But coral only grows."
731352.translation: 「木剑会朽。铁斧会锈。但珊瑚只会不断生长。」

731353.oracleText: {o1}: Merfolk Coralsmith gets +1/-1 until end of turn.
731353.translation: {o1}：人鱼珊瑚匠得+1/-1直到回合结束。

731355.translation: 当人鱼珊瑚匠死去时，占卜2。

731357.oracleText: Yarvis was almost certain he'd seen the same tree an hour ago, but then again, didn't all trees look alike? He shelved his doubts and followed the friendly, twinkling motes deeper into the forest.
731357.translation: 雅维斯几乎确信自己一小时前就见过同一棵树，但话说回来，树不都长得差不多吗？于是他将自己的疑惑抛诸脑后，继续跟随看似友好的浮灵幽光踏入树林深处。

731358.oracleText: Target creature's owner puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
731358.translation: 目标生物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

731360.oracleText: "Look at me, everyone! I'm a High Fae! Watch me do important High Fae things!"
731360.translation: 「大家来看呐！我是至高仙！看我作至高仙会作的事！」

731362.oracleText: Obyra's devoted servants shrieked as their sleeping mistress slashed at them, unseeing.
731362.translation: 眼见他们的主人在沉睡中闭眼挥剑砍来，欧拜拉手下的忠心仆从纷纷大声尖叫。

731365.translation: 作弄之心锁不进笼子里。

731367.oracleText: Mill four cards. Then put an instant, sorcery, or Faerie card from among the milled cards into your hand.
731367.translation: 磨四张牌。然后将一张瞬间，法术或仙灵牌从所磨掉之牌中置于你手上。

731369.oracleText: At first, Johann was annoyed that the library had decided to reorganize itself. But he had to admit that storing the cookbooks in the cauldron made a certain kind of sense.
731369.translation: 最一开始时，约翰对书库决定自行重整的作法感到恼火。但他又不得不承认，用锅来装烹饪书也确实有点道理。

731374.oracleText: The farmer was amazed to see the penny vanish into thin air, but the goose knew he'd just slipped it to the faerie.
731374.translation: 眼见金币就在跟前凭空消失，农夫看得目瞪口呆；但连身旁的白鹅都明白，对方不过是把金币递给了仙灵。

731379.oracleText: "You are but learning to walk in a world where I fly, mortal."
731379.translation: 「凡人，在这个我能自如飞行的世界中，你才刚蹒跚学步而已。」

731380.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2} plus an additional {o1} for each Faerie you control.
731380.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，并为每个由你操控的仙灵各支付{o1}，否则反击之。

731382.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a Sorcerer Role token attached to up to one other target creature you control.
731382.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，派出一个术士角色衍生物，并贴附在至多另一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731384.oracleText: To the giants, it was one little gem among thousands. But to Kylene, it was a haul that would feed her family for years.
731384.translation: 对巨人来说，这宝石不过是他们不计其数珍宝其中不起眼的一颗。但对奇莲来说，这就是一笔能够让她和家人多年间不愁吃穿的巨大财富。

731385.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
731385.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

731386.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, put two +1/+1 counters on Stormkeld Prowler.
731386.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，在风暴域游掠者上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

731388.oracleText:
"I've never known cold like it. It burned like fire and bit like an adder's fangs. Call me a coward if you wish, but I won't go back there."
—Syr Lydel, knight of Vantress
731388.translation:
「我从未见过这样的严寒：如烈火般灼人，似毒牙般刺骨。随你叫我懦夫，但我绝不回去。」
～凡翠丝骑士，吕德爵士

731389.oracleText: Tap one or two target creatures an opponent controls. Put a stun counter on each of them.
731389.translation: 横置一个或两个目标由对手操控的生物。在这些生物上各放置一个晕眩指示物。

731391.oracleText: "The Kindly Lord does not issue invitations to their court lightly. I suggest you accept."
731391.translation: 「仁慈仙王从不轻易请人入廷。在此建议你乖乖从命。」

731392.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more Faeries, draw a card, then discard a card. When you discard a card this way, put a +1/+1 counter on target Faerie you control.
731392.translation: 每当你以一个或数个仙灵攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。当你以此法弃一张牌时，在目标由你操控的仙灵上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731394.oracleText: "An intact volume of Tales of the Fae? The king will be pleased."
731394.translation: 「全新的完本《仙儿传说》？皇上一定会喜出望外。」

731398.oracleText: "My orders were to capture you alive. They didn't specify in what form."
731398.translation: 「我接到的命令是要抓活的。但却没规定怎样活。」

731400.oracleText: Tap target creature. Create a Cursed Role token attached to it.
731400.translation: 横置目标生物。派出一个倒楣鬼角色衍生物并贴附于其上。

731403.oracleText: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
731403.translation: 复制目标由你操控的起动式或触发式异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

731405.oracleText: Luckily for the plummeting Johann, the hydroloft spell was one he had actually mastered.
731405.translation: 虽然约翰遍览群书，却只会熟练运用浮水魔咒这一个咒语，但对于现正高速急坠的他来说，真的是学得多不如学得巧。

731406.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature you control has base power and toughness 4/4 and gains flying and hexproof.
731406.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物之基础力量与防御力为4/4且获得飞行与辟邪异能。

731408.oracleText: If you would pay life while your library has at least that many cards in it, exile that many cards from the top of your library instead.
731408.translation: 如果你将支付生命时你牌库中有至少相同数量的牌，则改为从你牌库顶放逐等量的牌。

731409.oracleText: Look at the top two cards of your library. Exile one of them and put the other into your hand.
731409.translation: 检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张放逐，另一张则置于你手上。

731410.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if a card was put into exile this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
731410.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若本回合中有牌进入放逐区，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731411.oracleText: Create two 1/1 black Nightmare creature tokens with "At the beginning of combat on your turn, if a card was put into exile this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature."
731411.translation: 派出两个1/1黑色梦魇衍生生物，且具有「在你回合的战斗开始时，若本回合中有牌进入放逐区，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。」

731412.oracleText: Target player exiles the top X cards of their library, where X is the total mana value of cards you own in exile.
731412.translation: 目标牌手放逐其牌库顶的X张牌，X为放逐区中由你拥有之牌的法术力值总和。

731414.oracleText: Neva's dreams were haunted by memories of the invasion—oil-black tendrils grasping at her through the mist. Or . . . was this something new?
731414.translation: 大侵攻记忆在白涅娃梦中索绕不散～经常会有油黑触手穿过迷雾向她袭来。或者…这次是不同的东西？

731415.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.
731415.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界从战场进入坟墓场时，抓一张牌。

731417.oracleText: Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand. If this spell was bargained, you may put one of those cards with mana value 4 or less onto the battlefield instead of putting it into your hand.
731417.translation: 将至多两张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果此咒语已加码，则你可以改为将其中一张法术力值等于或小于4的牌放进战场，而非置于你手上。

731419.oracleText: "The difference between mischief and malice? Numbers."
731419.translation: 「你要问作弄与作恶差在哪？程度。」

731420.oracleText: CARDNAME has lifelink as long as you control another Faerie.
731420.translation: 只要你操控另一个仙灵，CARDNAME便具有系命异能。

731421.oracleText: Barrow Naughty has lifelink as long as you control another Faerie.
731421.translation: 只要你操控另一个仙灵，土冢淘气灵便具有系命异能。

731422.oracleText: {o2oB}: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

731423.oracleText: {o2oB}: Barrow Naughty gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
731423.translation: {o2oB}：土冢淘气灵得+1/+0直到回合结束。

731425.oracleText: Search your library for a card, exile it face down, then shuffle. If this spell was bargained, you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost if that spell's mana value is 4 or less. Put the exiled card into your hand if it wasn't cast this way.
731425.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它牌面朝下地放逐，然后洗牌。若此咒语已加码，则如果所放逐之牌施放时的咒语之法术力值等于或小于4，你便可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果未以此法施放该牌，则将所放逐的牌置于你手上。

731427.oracleText: "Don't you mean ‘poisonous'? There's no such thing as a venomous—AGGHHH!"
731427.translation: 「你是想说『有毒』吧？哪有什么恶毒的～啊呀！」

731428.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn. If this spell was bargained, that creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn instead.
731428.translation: 目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。如果此咒语已加码，则改为该生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。

731430.translation: 她不太喜欢面对镜子自省。

731432.oracleText: Create a Wicked Role token attached to target creature you control.
731432.translation: 派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

731434.oracleText: The Wicked Slumber saved Eldraine from Phyrexia's grasp, but instead of fading when the invasion ended, it continued to spread.
731434.translation: 沉睡咒令艾卓逃过非瑞克西亚的魔爪，但侵攻结束后，这一诅咒非但没有消退，反而愈发蔓延。

731435.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, up to one target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
731435.translation: 每当你在对手的回合中施放咒语时，至多一个目标由对手操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。

731437.oracleText: "You've wasted your life. Let's see if I can do any better with it."
731437.translation: 「你的生命已在你手上毁于一旦。让我看看能否将它用到更好的地方。」

731438.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card. If you don't control a Faerie, exile a card from your hand.
731438.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。如果你未操控仙灵，则从你手上放逐一张牌。

731440.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if your life total is 5 or less.
731440.translation: 如果你的总生命等于或小于5，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

731441.oracleText: Exile target creature or planeswalker. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that permanent and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.
731441.translation: 放逐目标生物或鹏洛客。从其操控者的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量与该永久物同名的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手洗牌，然后每以此法从其手上放逐一张牌，其便抓一张牌。

731443.oracleText: Target opponent discards two cards. Create a Wicked Role token attached to up to one target creature you control.
731443.translation: 目标对手弃两张牌。派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731446.oracleText: {o2oB}, Exile Faerie Dreamthief from your graveyard: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
731446.translation: {o2oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐窃梦仙灵：你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

731448.oracleText: Even in the grip of the Wicked Slumber, the High Fae princess Obyra is a blademaster of unrivaled skill.
731448.translation: 就算受沉睡咒所扰，至高仙公主欧拜拉的剑术也依然无人能敌。

731449.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. That creature gets an additional -3/-3 until end of turn if you controlled a Faerie as you cast this spell.
731449.translation: 目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束。如果你于施放此咒语时操控仙灵，则该生物再得-3/-3直到回合结束。

731451.oracleText: Kellan heard Agatha howl when he slammed into her, heard her scream as she fell into the cauldron, but couldn't afford to think about the implications just yet.
731451.translation: 凯澜听到阿加莎怒吼时慌不择路迎头撞上，使得后者脚步趔趄跌入镬中，凶狠咆哮旋即变作痛苦哀嚎。此时凯澜还未意识到自己已完成一件壮举。

731452.oracleText: Destroy target creature with mana value 3 or less. If it's your turn, create a Food token.
731452.translation: 消灭目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物。如果是在你的回合中，则派出一个食品衍生物。

731454.oracleText: When Fell Horseman dies, put it on the bottom of its owner's library.
731454.translation: 当极恶骑士死去时，将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

731466.oracleText: When Hopeless Nightmare is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, scry 2.
731466.translation: 当无望梦魇从战场进入坟墓场时，占卜2。

731470.oracleText: In their rotting minds, they still quest for virtue and glory.
731470.translation: 纵使思绪腐坏，他们肉身仍执着追寻美德与荣光。

731471.oracleText: Sacrifice any number of artifacts, enchantments, and/or tokens. Return that many creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
731471.translation: 牺牲任意数量的神器，结界和／或衍生物。将等量的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

731475.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731475.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731479.oracleText: At the beginning of your draw step, if you control an enchanted creature, you lose 1 life and you draw an additional card.
731479.translation: 在你的抓牌步骤开始时，若你操控受有灵气的生物，则你失去1点生命且额外抓一张牌。

731482.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731482.translation: 派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731483.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731483.translation: 派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731484.oracleText: You may sacrifice another creature. If you do, scry 2, then draw a card.
731484.translation: 你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则占卜2，然后抓一张牌。

731485.oracleText: You may sacrifice another creature. If you do, scry 2, then draw a card.
731485.translation: 你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则占卜2，然后抓一张牌。

731489.oracleText: If the sugary abominations of Sweettooth Village were ever under someone's control, that time is long past.
731489.translation: 就算甘饴村的糖怪以前曾是谁的手下，那时光也早已一去不复返。

731490.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a Food token.
731490.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个食品衍生物。

731491.oracleText: When Mintstrosity dies, create a Food token.
731491.translation: 当薄荷糖怪死去时，派出一个食品衍生物。

731493.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control, then create a Wicked Role token attached to it.
731493.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，然后派出一个恶人角色衍生物并贴附于其上。

731494.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature you control gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control, then create a Wicked Role token attached to it."
731494.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场，然后派出一个恶人角色衍生物并贴附于其上。」

731496.oracleText: The louder they scream, the harder he laughs.
731496.translation: 受害者叫得越大声，他就笑得越开心。

731497.translation: 每位牌手各失去4点生命。

731498.oracleText: Choose one or more — • Each player discards two cards. • Each player loses 4 life. • Each player sacrifices two creatures.
731498.translation: 选择一项或多项～ •  每位牌手各弃两张牌。 •  每位牌手各失去4点生命。 •  每位牌手各牺牲两个生物。

731500.translation: 「帮我拿一下这个。」～鼠群笛手托腾坦

731501.oracleText: Up to one target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. You create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731501.translation: 至多一个目标生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。你派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731503.oracleText: If this spell was bargained, look at the top four cards of your library, then put up to two of them back on top of your library in any order and the rest into your graveyard.
731503.translation: 如果此咒语已加码，则检视你牌库顶的四张牌，然后将其中至多两张以任意顺序放回你牌库顶，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

731505.oracleText: Too much sugar is bad for your health.

731506.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, create a Food token.
731506.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个食品衍生物。

731507.oracleText: Whenever Scream Puff deals combat damage to a player, create a Food token.
731507.translation: 每当泡芙蓬怪对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个食品衍生物。

731509.oracleText: Destroy target creature or enchantment. Create a Wicked Role token attached to up to one target creature you control.
731509.translation: 消灭目标生物或结界。派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731514.oracleText: "Who'll never amount to anything now, Father?"
731514.translation: 「父亲，现在又是谁会一事无成呢？」

731520.oracleText:
"I smell frosting. Ready your weapons!"
—Greta, Scourge of Sweettooth
731520.translation:
「我闻到了霜雾中的甜味。备战！」
～甘饴村之灾格蕾特

731522.oracleText: "Try some pie! Your brother helped make it, and he really poured his heart into it."
731522.translation: 「试试这馅饼！你哥哥也帮忙出了力，他的整副心肝都在里面。」

731524.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a Food: Target player loses 2 life.
731524.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个食品：目标牌手失去2点生命。

731526.oracleText: Dying in your sleep is never peaceful when Ashiok is involved.
731526.translation: 只要安梭苛插手，就绝不可能在睡梦中安详逝去。

731527.oracleText: Exile target creature. If you control an enchantment, scry 2.
731527.translation: 放逐目标生物。如果你操控结界，则占卜2。

731529.oracleText: Clawing for scraps and driven mad by hunger, the individual rats became a writhing mass.
731529.translation: 因饥饿难耐而日趋疯狂的一只只老鼠，为争夺食物残渣而纠拧成群、集体出击。

731530.translation: 纠结鼠群不能进行阻挡。

731531.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create X 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This creature can't block," where X is the amount of damage dealt to it this turn.
731531.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出X个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡」，X为它本回合中受过的伤害数量。

731532.oracleText: When Tangled Colony dies, create X 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This creature can't block," where X is the amount of damage dealt to it this turn.
731532.translation: 当纠结鼠群死去时，派出X个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡」，X为它本回合中受过的伤害数量。

731538.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn. You gain 2 life.
731538.translation: 目标生物得-3/-3直到回合结束。你获得2点生命。

731540.oracleText: Lord Skitter promised the starving rats of Edgewall that they would never go hungry again.
731540.translation: 捷敏王向边墙镇的饥饿鼠群庄严许诺：它们将永不挨饿。

731543.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Voracious Vermin.
731543.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物死去时，在贪饕病媒上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731545.oracleText: For every rat she kills, ten more take its place.
731545.translation: 她每捕杀一只老鼠，就有十只冒出来。

731546.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731546.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界从战场进入坟墓场时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731547.oracleText: {o1oB}: Warehouse Tabby gains deathtouch until end of turn.
731547.translation: {o1oB}：仓库斑猫获得死触异能直到回合结束。

731549.oracleText: Amalgamations of many childhood nightmares stalked the realm of dreams, feeding on the collective terror of all those trapped in the Wicked Slumber.
731549.translation: 童年时期的诸多梦魇拼合成形、漫游梦境，不断汲取受困于沉睡咒中众人的恐惧之情而日益壮大。
