731550.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life.
731550.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界从战场进入坟墓场时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

731552.oracleText: Destroy target creature an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less.
731552.translation: 消灭目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于2的生物。

731554.oracleText: Create a Wicked Role token attached to target creature you control.
731554.translation: 派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

731556.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
731556.translation: 欢庆～在你回合的战斗开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

731558.oracleText: You can't give an ogre the runaround.

731561.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, attach CARDNAME to up to one target creature you control.
731561.translation: 欢庆～在你回合的战斗开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则将CARDNAME贴附在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731562.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, attach Bespoke Battlegarb to up to one target creature you control.
731562.translation: 欢庆～在你回合的战斗开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则将订制战甲贴附在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731564.oracleText: "You only find out who was hunting who when one of you is dead."
731564.translation: 「只有其中一方倒下后，你才会知道谁是猎人，谁是猎物。」

731565.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
731565.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

731567.oracleText: Discard a card, then draw a card.
731567.translation: 弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。

731568.oracleText: Create a Wicked Role token attached to target creature you control.
731568.translation: 派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

731572.oracleText: Cut In deals 4 damage to target creature.
731572.translation: 及时介入对目标生物造成4点伤害。

731573.oracleText: Create a Young Hero Role token attached to up to one target creature you control.
731573.translation: 派出一个青年英雄角色衍生物，并贴附在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731575.oracleText: The mayor sent hounds to root out Lord Skitter, but their loyalty was easily bought with a handful of bones.
731575.translation: 镇长派出成群猎犬去除掉捷敏王，但后者只用一把骨头就俘获了它们的衷心。

731578.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a Young Hero Role token attached to another target creature.
731578.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个青年英雄角色衍生物，并贴附在另一个目标生物上。

731579.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Embereth Veteran: Create a Young Hero Role token attached to another target creature.
731579.translation: {o1}，牺牲鞍博雷老兵：派出一个青年英雄角色衍生物，并贴附在另一个目标生物上。

731581.oracleText: "From here, hit the antique gong, ricochet off the suit of armor, and get Gunrudd on the nose? Is that all?"
731581.translation: 「你要我从这里出手，先打到古锣、弹到铠甲，最后打中老甘头的鼻子？就这么简单？」

731582.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. You create a Treasure token.
731582.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

731583.oracleText: Flick a Coin deals 1 damage to any target. You create a Treasure token.
731583.translation: 轻弹硬币对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

731585.oracleText: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.
731585.translation: 由于没能来得及分发武器，矮人只能靠手边的东西跟红帽客搏斗。

731586.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals damage to any target equal to 1 plus the number of permanents named Food Fight you control.
731586.translation: {o2}，牺牲此神器：它对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控且名称为食物大战之永久物的数量加1。

731587.oracleText: Artifacts you control have "{o2}, Sacrifice this artifact: It deals damage to any target equal to 1 plus the number of permanents named Food Fight you control."
731587.translation: 由你操控的神器具有「{o2}，牺牲此神器：它对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控且名称为食物大战之永久物的数量加1。」

731589.oracleText: Johann's conjecture about draconic fire dispelling rainwater elementals proved to be correct. Now he just needed a way to dispel draconic fire.
731589.translation: 约翰猜想，雨水元素肆虐时可用龙火来驱散。如今这点已经事实验证无误，只是现在他得另找办法来扑灭龙火。

731590.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature, where X is 2 plus the number of cards in your graveyard that are instant cards, sorcery cards, and/or have an Adventure.
731590.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中瞬间牌、法术牌和／或具历险之牌的总数量加2。

731591.oracleText: Frantic Firebolt deals X damage to target creature, where X is 2 plus the number of cards in your graveyard that are instant cards, sorcery cards, and/or have an Adventure.
731591.translation: 狂乱火束对目标生物造成X点伤害，X为你坟墓场中瞬间牌、法术牌和／或具历险之牌的总数量加2。

731593.oracleText: Totentanz's song had no lyrics, but the rats understood it nonetheless. "You own this land," it said. "You deserve to feast."
731593.translation: 托腾坦的歌曲中本没有词，但这并不妨碍老鼠理解其中含义。曲是这么唱的：「土地归你，食物归你。」

731594.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies this turn, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731594.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。本回合中，每当一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731596.oracleText: {oR}: Dragons you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
731596.translation: {oR}：由你操控的龙得+1/+0直到回合结束。

731597.oracleText: Celebration — As long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, CARDNAME is a Dragon with base power and toughness 4/4, flying, and "{oR}: Dragons you control get +1/+0 until end of turn."
731597.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，CARDNAME便是基础力量与防御力为4/4的龙，且具有飞行与「{oR}：由你操控的龙得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

731598.oracleText: Celebration — As long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, Goddric, Cloaked Reveler is a Dragon with base power and toughness 4/4, flying, and "{oR}: Dragons you control get +1/+0 until end of turn." (It loses all other creature types.)
731598.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，华袍狂欢客戈垂克便是基础力量与防御力为4/4的龙，且具有飞行与「{oR}：由你操控的龙得+1/+0直到回合结束。」

731600.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice an artifact or land: Draw a card.
731600.translation: {o2oR}，牺牲一个神器或地：抓一张牌。

731603.oracleText: It takes a lot to pull a master blacksmith from their work, but Maurice couldn't pass up an invitation to a lavish Delverhaugh feast.
731603.translation: 铁匠大师手中事务繁多，一般无暇顾及这类闲乐，但毛瑞斯可不愿轻易错过深掘台奢华盛宴的邀请。

731604.oracleText: Celebration — CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and has trample as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
731604.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，CARDNAME便得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

731605.oracleText: Celebration — Grand Ball Guest gets +1/+1 and has trample as long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
731605.translation: 欢庆～只要本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，堂皇舞宴宾客便得+1/+1且具有践踏异能。

731607.oracleText: "Why're you vermin so daft? This is a warehouse full of bricks. BRICKS! You can't eat bricks."
731607.translation: 「你们这些脏东西是多蠢？仓库里全是砖头。全是砖头！你们又没法吃砖头。」

731608.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731608.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731609.oracleText: When Harried Spearguard dies, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731609.translation: 当烦乱矛卫死去时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731611.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the number of cards in your graveyard that are instant cards, sorcery cards, and/or have an Adventure.
731611.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为你坟墓场中瞬间牌、法术牌和／或具历险之牌的总数量。

731614.oracleText: "The realm needs a ruler, not a boy playing king."
731614.translation: 「世境需要的是领袖，而不是玩国王过家家的男孩。」

731615.oracleText: Whenever an instant or sorcery spell you control that targets only a single creature deals damage to that creature, Imodane deals that much damage to each opponent.
731615.translation: 每当一个由你操控且仅以单一生物为目标的瞬间或法术咒语对该生物造成伤害时，依莫丹向每位对手各造成等量的伤害。

731617.oracleText: Even in the grip of Hylda's unnatural cold, something in Kellan felt bright as spring, something that poured into the empty hilts he'd been given by Talion and formed thorn-sharp blades of light.
731617.translation: 纵使受困于希尔妲的奇异冰霜之中，凯澜仍觉得有股暖流似春风拂晓在体内不断翻涌、最终流经手尖全数灌入塔莱恩留给自己的残柄，汇成一束如棘刺般尖锐的光芒剑刃。

731619.oracleText: Exile the top three cards of target opponent's library. You may play those cards this turn.
731619.translation: 放逐目标对手牌库顶的三张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

731625.oracleText: Mines that once rang with the strikes of pickaxes now echo with shouts of reckless glee.
731625.translation: 此处矿坑曾经铁镐叮当作响，如今空余冒险欢笑回荡。

731628.oracleText:
"My, what big paws y—"
—Thomas the woodsman, last words
731628.translation:
「天呐，爪子可真～」
～伐木工托马斯的遗言

731629.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn. Create a Monster Role token attached to it.
731629.translation: 目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。派出一个怪物角色衍生物并贴附于其上。

731631.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
731631.translation: 欢庆～在你回合的战斗开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

731633.translation: 「它们都是从哪不断冒出来的？！」

731636.oracleText: Create two 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This creature can't block."
731636.translation: 派出两个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731640.oracleText: {o1oR}: Realm-Scorcher Hellkite deals 1 damage to any target.
731640.translation: {o1oR}：炙境残虐者对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

731644.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
731644.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物并放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

731645.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on Redcap Gutter-Dweller and exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.
731645.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以牺牲另一个生物。若你如此作，则在居渠红帽客上放置一个+1/+1指示物并放逐你的牌库顶牌。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

731647.oracleText: "Shiny is best. Then sharp. Sharp is good. Anything else is basically trash."
731647.translation: 「亮晶晶的最好。然后是刺尖尖。刺尖尖的不错。其他就都垃圾。」

731650.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, put a skewer counter on CARDNAME. Then you may sacrifice it. If you do, exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of skewer counters on CARDNAME. You may play those cards this turn.
731650.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烤叉指示物。然后你可以将它牺牲。若你如此作，则放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为CARDNAME上的烤叉指示物数量。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

731651.oracleText: Whenever Rotisserie Elemental deals combat damage to a player, put a skewer counter on Rotisserie Elemental. Then you may sacrifice it. If you do, exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of skewer counters on Rotisserie Elemental. You may play those cards this turn.
731651.translation: 每当烹烤元素对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在烹烤元素上放置一个烤叉指示物。然后你可以将它牺牲。若你如此作，则放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为烹烤元素上的烤叉指示物数量。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

731653.oracleText: One way or another, dwarven meals end up in someone's stomach.
731653.translation: 不管怎样，矮人总有办法把食物塞进别人的肚子里。

731654.oracleText: Whenever Skewer Slinger blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, Skewer Slinger deals 1 damage to that creature.
731654.translation: 每当烤叉掷客阻挡生物或被生物阻挡时，烤叉掷客对该生物造成1点伤害。

731656.oracleText: Townsfolk tapped their feet and hummed along, unwittingly amplifying the tune that would summon their doom.
731656.translation: 镇民随着节奏舞动节拍、齐声跟唱，殊不知这样会为旋律增效，令自己的末日更快到来。

731657.oracleText: Create X 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This creature can't block." Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
731657.translation: 派出X个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

731659.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was bargained, it deals twice X damage to that permanent instead.
731659.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。如果此咒语已加码，则改为它对该永久物造成两倍于X数量的伤害。

731660.oracleText: Stonesplitter Bolt deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was bargained, it deals twice X damage to that permanent instead.
731660.translation: 裂石击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害。如果此咒语已加码，则改为它对该永久物造成两倍于X数量的伤害。

731662.oracleText: "What's that, Snappers? Yes, you're right! It was very rude of the innkeeper to throw us out!"
731662.translation: 「怎么回事呀快脚？你说得对！旅店主把我们赶出来太无礼了！」

731663.oracleText: Whenever a Rat you control becomes blocked, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
731663.translation: 每当一个由你操控的老鼠被阻挡时，它得+2/+0直到回合结束。

731665.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was bargained, instead it deals 3 damage to that permanent and you scry 1.
731665.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果此咒语已加码，则改为它对该永久物造成3点伤害且你占卜1。

731666.oracleText: Torch the Tower deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If this spell was bargained, instead it deals 3 damage to that permanent and you scry 1.
731666.translation: 点燃塔楼对目标生物或鹏洛客造成2点伤害。如果此咒语已加码，则改为它对该永久物造成3点伤害且你占卜1。

731667.oracleText: If a permanent dealt damage by CARDNAME would die this turn, exile it instead.
731667.translation: 本回合中，如果受过CARDNAME伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

731668.oracleText: If a permanent dealt damage by Torch the Tower would die this turn, exile it instead.
731668.translation: 本回合中，如果受过点燃塔楼伤害的永久物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

731670.oracleText: Create a Wicked Role token attached to up to one target creature.
731670.translation: 派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在至多一个目标生物上。

731675.oracleText: An autonomous, self-loading catapult had seemed like such a good idea.
731675.translation: 投石车要是能自主瞄准、自动装填该有多棒～这事情还是想想就好。

731676.oracleText: {oT}: Unruly Catapult deals 1 damage to each opponent.
731676.translation: {oT}：难驭投石车向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

731677.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, untap Unruly Catapult.
731677.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，重置难驭投石车。

731679.oracleText: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, you may exile that many cards from the top of your library. You may play those cards this turn.
731679.translation: 每当一个由你操控的来源向任一对手造成非战斗伤害时，你可以从你牌库顶放逐等量的牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

731681.oracleText: Embereth Blaze deals 2 damage to any target.
731681.translation: 鞍博雷烈焰对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

731683.oracleText: You may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
731683.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓两张牌。

731684.oracleText: Create a Wicked Role token attached to up to one target creature you control.
731684.translation: 派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在至多一个目标由你操控的生物上。

731686.oracleText: The witchstalkers circled the armored figure, drawn to the corrupting stink of dark magic. Kellan and Ruby fled to the sound of savage howls and snapping jaws.
731686.translation: 猎巫狼群受黑暗魔法的腐化恶臭吸引，将披甲身影团团包围。随着蛮野嚎叫与断骨啮咬响声不断，凯澜和小红玉匆忙逃离这片危险之地。

731687.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each creature that attacked this turn.
731687.translation: 本回合中每有一个生物攻击过，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

731688.oracleText: Witchstalker Frenzy deals 5 damage to target creature.
731688.translation: 猎巫狼狂乱对目标生物造成5点伤害。

731694.oracleText: When Beluna's pets escape Stormkeld, villages fall and new Everstalks rise.
731694.translation: 贝伦娜的宠物逃离暴风域后，只见村庄尽毁、新生极茎拔地而起。

731697.oracleText: "There is a fierce joy in losing yourself to savagery, and a bitter pain in regaining your senses afterward. You could never understand."
731697.translation: 「受制野性沉沦其间，能享非凡狂乐；而在恢复意识重掌情绪后，又会苦楚悔恨。这种感受你永远都不会懂。」

731698.oracleText: {o4oG}: Return Bestial Bloodline from your graveyard to your hand.
731698.translation: {o4oG}：将野性血脉从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

731702.oracleText: Activated abilities of lands you control cost {o1} less to activate.
731702.translation: 由你操控的地之起动式异能减少{o1}来起动。

731706.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Discard a card: Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
731706.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，弃一张牌：将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

731707.oracleText: {o1oG}, {oT}, Discard a card: Return Bramble Familiar to its owner's hand.
731707.translation: {o1oG}，{oT}，弃一张牌：将刺藤佣兽移回其拥有者手上。

731709.oracleText: Mill seven cards. Then put a creature, enchantment, or land card from among the milled cards onto the battlefield.
731709.translation: 磨七张牌。然后将一张生物，结界或地牌从所磨掉之牌中放进战场。

731711.oracleText: If this spell was bargained, target land you control becomes a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land.
731711.translation: 如果此咒语已加码，则目标由你操控的地成为3/3，具敏捷异能的元素生物，且仍然是地。

731712.oracleText: Agatha befriended the beasts of the wilds, and under her influence they grew bolder . . . and more savage. Some herbivores developed a taste for flesh.
731712.translation: 阿加莎漫游幻野，广交野兽，而野兽也受其影响愈发凶狠、野性十足。甚至有些食草动物开始对血肉有了兴趣。

731714.oracleText: Create a Monster Role token attached to target creature you control. When you do, that creature fights up to one target creature you don't control.
731714.translation: 派出一个怪物角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。当你如此作时，该生物与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

731720.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may exile a creature card from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may cast the exiled card this turn. At the beginning of the next combat phase this turn, target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to up to one target creature you don't control.
731720.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以放逐其中一张生物牌。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。本回合中，你可以施放所放逐的牌。在本回合下一个战斗阶段开始时，自标由你操控的生物对至多一个目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

731723.oracleText: Each night, the elves of Redtooth Keep transform into feral, monstrous beasts.
731723.translation: 每天晚上，赤牙砦的妖精都会转化为凶狠野兽。

731725.oracleText: Create a Monster Role token attached to target creature you control.
731725.translation: 派出一个怪物角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

731727.oracleText: The fauns of the Tanglespan are adept at using the precarious environment against larger opponents.
731727.translation: 当蜿结谷的羊怪遇上体型较大的对手时，他们善于利用险恶地形来智取。

731728.oracleText: Any number of target enchanted creatures you control and up to one other target creature you control each deal damage equal to their power to target creature you don't control.
731728.translation: 选择任意数量目标由你操控且受有灵气的生物、至多另一个目标由你操控的生物，以及目标不由你操控的生物。前述由你操控的生物各依其力量对该不由你操控的生物造成伤害。

731732.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
731732.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，在每个由你操控且名称为粗野三人众的生物上各放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于死去者的力量。

731733.oracleText: When Gruff Triplets dies, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
731733.translation: 当粗野三人众死去时，在每个由你操控且名称为粗野三人众的生物上各放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于死去者的力量。

731737.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a Food: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
731737.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个食品：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

731738.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a Food: Hollow Scavenger gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
731738.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个食品：空腹食腐狼得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

731741.oracleText:
"I have to hand it to you, Yorvo. Since your pet showed up, not a single smallfolk has even made it to the door of my vault."
—Beluna Grandsquall
731741.translation: 「约沃，你真令我刮目相看。打从你的宠物出现后，就再没有小家伙到过我宝库门前。」～巨风贝伦娜

731742.oracleText: CARDNAME has haste as long as you own a card in exile that has an Adventure.
731742.translation: 只要放逐区中有由你拥有之具历险的牌，CARDNAME便具有敏捷异能。

731743.oracleText: Howling Galefang has haste as long as you own a card in exile that has an Adventure.
731743.translation: 只要放逐区中有由你拥有之具历险的牌，嚎叫哮牙兽便具有敏捷异能。

731745.oracleText: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
731745.translation: 派出一个3/3绿色野兽衍生生物。

731746.oracleText: You may sacrifice a creature. If you do, search your library for a creature or basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
731746.translation: 你可以牺牲一个生物。若你如此作，则从你牌库中搜寻一张生物或基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

731747.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.
731747.translation: 直到回合结束，至多两个目标生物各得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。

731749.oracleText: Witchstalkers have extremely powerful legs—all the better to reach you with.
731749.translation: 猎巫狼的四肢都无比强壮～这样便能更快地抓到你。

731750.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+3 and gains reach until end of turn. Untap it.
731750.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+1/+3且获得延势异能。将它重置。

731753.translation: 由你操控的食品具有「{oT}：加{oG}。」

731754.oracleText: {o5oGoG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Foods you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
731754.translation: {o5oGoG}，牺牲CARDNAME：由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的食品数量。只能于法术时机起动。

731755.oracleText: {o5oGoG}, Sacrifice Night of the Sweets' Revenge: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of Foods you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
731755.translation: {o5oGoG}，牺牲糖果复仇夜：由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的食品数量。只能于法术时机起动。

731757.oracleText: Some family trees are thornier than others.

731760.oracleText: "I'm just as deadly during the day."

731764.oracleText: Choose two — • Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. • Create a 1/1 white Human creature token. • Create a Food token.
731764.translation: 选择两项～ •  从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。 •  派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。 •  派出一个食品衍生物。

731766.oracleText: "Human feet aren't inferior to hooves for climbing. It's their plodding, mistrustful personalities that hold them back."
731766.translation: 「人类的双脚在攀爬时并不比蹄子来得差。他们是因背负重压、生性多疑而畏缩不前。」

731769.oracleText: Target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn. Create a Royal Role token attached to that creature.
731769.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。派出一个皇族角色衍生物并贴附在该生物上。

731771.oracleText: Return target card you own in exile that has an Adventure to your hand.
731771.translation: 将目标在放逐区中由你拥有且具历险的牌移回你手上。

731772.oracleText: Return target card you own in exile that has an Adventure to your hand.
731772.translation: 将目标在放逐区中由你拥有且具历险的牌移回你手上。

731773.oracleText: Put target card you don't own in exile that has an Adventure on the bottom of its owner's library.
731773.translation: 将目标在放逐区中不由你拥有且具历险的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。

731774.oracleText: Put target card you don't own in exile that has an Adventure on the bottom of its owner's library.
731774.translation: 将目标在放逐区中不由你拥有且具历险的牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。

731779.oracleText: Cloud eaters, heaven tillers, beanstalk wurms—he favors prey worthy of a giant's appetite.
731779.translation: 吞云鸟、犁天兽、噬茎龙～他偏好符合巨人胃口的猎物。

731780.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, create a Food token.
731780.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，派出一个食品衍生物。

731782.oracleText: To the giant spiders of Dunbarrow, there's little difference between fly and faerie.
731782.translation: 对黯沼野的巨型蜘蛛来说，苍蝇与仙灵并无太大差别。

731783.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying. Create a Food token.
731783.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器，结界或具飞行异能的生物。派出一个食品衍生物。

731785.oracleText: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.
731785.translation: 他驱熊如雷鸣，出击似闪电。

731786.oracleText: Stormkeld Vanguard can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
731786.translation: 暴风域先锋不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

731789.oracleText: "The trolls have your scent, traveler. Hurry on, and let me take care of them."
731789.translation: 「旅行者，巨魔已经闻到了你的味道。快快赶路，他们就交给我来对付。」

731792.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
731792.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

731793.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Territorial Witchstalker gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.
731793.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控力量等于或大于4的生物，则据地猎巫狼得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合中能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

731795.oracleText: Look at the top twenty cards of your library. You may reveal up to two creature cards from among them. If this spell was bargained, put the revealed cards onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put the revealed cards into your hand. Then shuffle.
731795.translation: 检视你牌库顶的二十张牌。你可以展示其中至多两张生物牌。如果此咒语已加码，则将所展示的牌放进战场。若否，则将所展示的牌置于你手上。然后洗牌。

731796.oracleText: "Looks like you need a bigger net, mister fae-catcher."
731796.translation: 「捕仙客先生，你可能要换张大点的网。」

731798.oracleText: Where an ouphe makes its home, the land blooms with color and joy.
731798.translation: 奥夫定居之处，大地也会笑逐颜开，盛开缤纷花朵。

731799.oracleText: {o3oG}: Put a +1/+1 counter on Toadstool Admirer.
731799.translation: {o3oG}：在毒蕈崇者上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731802.oracleText: {o2oG}: Target noncreature artifact you control becomes a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
731802.translation: {o2oG}：目标由你操控的非生物神器成为4/4神器生物直到回合结束。

731803.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Tough Cookie: You gain 3 life.
731803.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲勇敢饼人：你获得3点生命。

731805.oracleText: Heavy is the head that wears the vase.

731809.oracleText:
"It's not so bad. All you have to do is keep from looking down."
—Troyan, to Kellan and Ruby
731809.translation: 「也没多难。你们只要想办法让自己不往下看就行。」～特洛扬勉励凯澜和小红玉

731813.oracleText: Some knights who survived the invasion have forsaken what remains of their courts. The newly formed Verdant Order has sworn to defend the last untouched parts of the wilds.
731813.translation: 大侵攻后，部分活下来的骑士与自己的宫殿残部断绝关系，转而自组新绿骑士团，誓死守卫幻野最后的净土。

731814.oracleText: {o1oG}: CARDNAME can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
731814.translation: {o1oG}：CARDNAME本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

731815.oracleText: {o1oG}: Verdant Outrider can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
731815.translation: {o1oG}：新绿前导兵本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

731817.oracleText: If you tap a basic land for mana, it produces three times as much of that mana instead.
731817.translation: 如果你横置某基本地以产生法术力，则改为它产生三倍的该类法术力。

731819.oracleText: Return target creature or land card from your graveyard to your hand.
731819.translation: 将目标生物或地牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

731821.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
731821.translation: 派出一个1/1白色人类衍生生物。

731822.oracleText: Put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is one plus the number of Foods you control.
731822.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的食品数量加一。

731824.oracleText: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {oX} less to activate, where X is CARDNAME's power. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
731824.translation: 由你操控的生物之起动式异能减少{oX}来起动，X为CARDNAME的力量。此效应无法将该费用中的法术力减少到少于一点法术力。

731825.oracleText: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {oX} less to activate, where X is Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's power. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
731825.translation: 由你操控的生物之起动式异能减少{oX}来起动，X为巫鼎镬阿加莎的力量。此效应无法将该费用中的法术力减少到少于一点法术力。

731826.oracleText: {o4oRoG}: Other creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain trample and haste until end of turn.
731826.translation: {o4oRoG}：直到回合结束，由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直获得践踏与敏捷异能。

731828.oracleText: Choose target nontoken creature you control that doesn't have the same name as a token you control. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it isn't legendary, is a Reflection in addition to its other types, and has haste.
731828.translation: 选择目标由你操控且非衍生物的生物，且其不能与任一由你操控的衍生物同名。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它不是传奇，额外具有映影此类别，且具有敏捷异能。

731829.oracleText: Choose target nontoken creature you control that doesn't have the same name as a token you control. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it isn't legendary, is a Reflection in addition to its other types, and has haste.
731829.translation: 选择目标由你操控且非衍生物的生物，且其不能与任一由你操控的衍生物同名。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它不是传奇，额外具有映影此类别，且具有敏捷异能。

731830.translation: 牺牲所有由你操控的映影。

731832.oracleText: "Get up and dance! Let your feet thunder like forgehammers!"
731832.translation: 「起身，跳舞！踏动双脚，震撼发声，如铸锤般作响！」

731833.oracleText: Celebration — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Ash.
731833.translation: 欢庆～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则在灰钴娘上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731834.oracleText: Celebration — Whenever Ash, Party Crasher attacks, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Ash.
731834.translation: 欢庆～每当舞会红人灰钴娘攻击时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则在灰钴娘上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731836.oracleText: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."
731836.translation: 「现在别闹。我要你们好好睡觉。」

731837.oracleText: Each creature that's enchanted by an Aura you control can't attack you or planeswalkers you control.
731837.translation: 对受有由你操控之灵气的生物而言，它们均不能攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客。

731838.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Auras you control.
731838.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每位对手各失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的灵气数量。

731842.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an Aura attached to CARDNAME: CARDNAME fights target creature you don't control. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
731842.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个贴附在CARDNAME上的灵气：CARDNAME与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。如果本回合中后者将死去，则改为将它放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

731843.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an Aura attached to Faunsbane Troll: Faunsbane Troll fights target creature you don't control. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
731843.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个贴附在克羊怪巨魔上的灵气：克羊怪巨魔与目标不由你操控的生物互斗。如果本回合中后者将死去，则改为将它放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

731849.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice a Food. If you do, draw a card.
731849.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

731850.oracleText: Whenever The Goose Mother attacks, you may sacrifice a Food. If you do, draw a card.
731850.translation: 每当鹅鹅妈攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

731853.oracleText: {oG}, Sacrifice a Food: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
731853.translation: {oG}，牺牲一个食品：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

731854.oracleText: {o1oB}, Sacrifice a Food: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
731854.translation: {o1oB}，牺牲一个食品：你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

731856.oracleText: Create a 4/4 white and blue Elemental creature token.
731856.translation: 派出一个4/4，白蓝双色的元素衍生生物。

731857.oracleText: Create a 4/4 white and blue Elemental creature token.
731857.translation: 派出一个4/4，白蓝双色的元素衍生生物。

731858.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
731858.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731860.oracleText: Whenever you tap an untapped creature an opponent controls, you may pay {o1}. When you do, choose one — • Create a 4/4 white and blue Elemental creature token. • Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. • Scry 2, then draw a card.
731860.translation: 每当你横置一个由对手操控且未横置的生物时，你可以支付{o1}。当你如此作时，选择一项～ •  派出一个4/4，白蓝双色的元素衍生生物。 •  在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。 •  占卜2，然后抓一张牌。

731862.oracleText: "Okay. First I'll calm the elementals. Then I'll put out the fire. Then I'll unflood the basement. Then I'll do the chores myself."
731862.translation: 「好吧。我要先安抚元素。然后扑灭大火。然后抽干地库。最后再自己来收拾。」

731863.oracleText: Once each turn, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from the top of your library.
731863.translation: 限每回合一次，你可以从你的牌库顶施放瞬间或法术咒语。

731866.oracleText: {oX}: CARDNAME becomes a copy of target creature card in your graveyard with mana value X, except it has flying and this ability. Activate only as a sorcery.
731866.translation: {oX}：选择目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值为X的生物牌。CARDNAME成为该牌的复制品，但它具有飞行与此异能。只能于法术时机起动。

731867.oracleText: {oX}: Likeness Looter becomes a copy of target creature card in your graveyard with mana value X, except it has flying and this ability. Activate only as a sorcery.
731867.translation: {oX}：选择目标在你坟墓场中且法术力值为X的生物牌。形踪掠夺灵成为该牌的复制品，但它具有飞行与此异能。只能于法术时机起动。

731871.oracleText: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on Neva, then scry 1.
731871.translation: 每当一个由你操控的结界从战场进入坟墓场时，在白涅娃上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后占卜1。

731874.oracleText: Obyra sleepwalks through the wilds, hunting for worthy opponents.
731874.translation: 欧拜拉在沉眠中漫游幻野，苦苦寻找值得一战的对手。

731877.oracleText: "No more days withering at a negotiating table with my brother. I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power."
731877.translation: 「我不会再在谈判桌前与我弟弟空耗时光。我要亲自重建艾卓～从旧法，凭武力。」

731878.oracleText: {oT}: Spells you cast this turn that are black and/or red cost {oX} less to cast, where X is the amount of life you lost this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
731878.translation: {oT}：你本回合中施放的黑色和／或红色咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为你本回合中失去过的生命数量。只能于法术时机起动。

731880.oracleText: Neither the sharpest thorns nor the foulest beasts would stop her from finding her brother.
731880.translation: 无论荆棘有多锋利，野兽有多凶险，都挡不住她找寻哥哥的脚步。

731881.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Ruby gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
731881.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物时攻击，小红玉得+2/+2直到回合结束。

731882.oracleText: Whenever Ruby, Daring Tracker attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Ruby gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
731882.translation: 每当大胆追迹人小红玉于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物时攻击，小红玉得+2/+2直到回合结束。

731885.oracleText: Whenever you tap one or more untapped creatures your opponents control, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
731885.translation: 每当你横置一个或数个由对手操控且未横置的生物时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

731889.translation: 由你操控且受有灵气的生物得+1/+1。

731893.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell with mana value, power, or toughness equal to the chosen number, that player loses 2 life and you draw a card.
731893.translation: 每当任一对手施放法术力值，力量或防御力等同于该数字的咒语时，该牌手失去2点生命且你抓一张牌。

731896.oracleText: Among the rats, he found the acceptance the human world never gave him.
731896.translation: 他在老鼠群中，找到了人类世界从未给过他的归属感。

731897.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another nontoken creature you control dies, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731897.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731898.oracleText: Whenever Totentanz, Swarm Piper or another nontoken creature you control dies, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
731898.translation: 每当鼠群笛手托腾坦或另一个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

731899.oracleText: {o1oB}: Target attacking Rat you control gains deathtouch until end of turn.
731899.translation: {o1oB}：目标由你操控且进行攻击的老鼠获得死触异能直到回合结束。

731901.oracleText: "The streets of Ravnica were stifling. Eldraine is an endless adventure paved in gold."
731901.translation: 「拉尼卡的街道沉闷无趣。艾卓则是四处黄金的无尽冒险。」

731902.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oGoU}. Spend this mana only to cast spells with mana value 5 or greater or spells with {oX} in their mana costs.
731902.translation: {oT}：加{oGoU}。此法术力只能用来施放法术力值等于或大于5或法术力费用中包括{oX}的咒语。

731904.oracleText: "It's easy to cry ‘For glory!' and charge those who disagree with you. But it takes finesse to turn enemies into allies rather than corpses."
731904.translation: 「高喊『荣耀万岁！』向异己兵戎相向并不困难。难的是用谋略巧思来化敌为友，而非赶尽杀绝。」

731905.oracleText: {oT}: Spells you cast this turn that are white and/or blue cost {oX} less to cast, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
731905.translation: {oT}：你本回合中施放的白色和／或蓝色咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为你本回合中获得过的生命数量。只能于法术时机起动。

731907.oracleText: "My people are both bloom and thorn."

731908.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Choose target enchantment you control that doesn't have the same name as another permanent you control. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it isn't legendary. If the token is an Aura, untap CARDNAME, then scry 2. Activate only as a sorcery.
731908.translation: {o2}，{oT}：选择目标由你操控的结界，且其不能与由你操控的其他永久物同名。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它不是传奇。如果该衍生物是灵气，则重置CARDNAME，然后占卜2。只能于法术时机起动。

731909.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Choose target enchantment you control that doesn't have the same name as another permanent you control. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it isn't legendary. If the token is an Aura, untap Yenna, Redtooth Regent, then scry 2. Activate only as a sorcery.
731909.translation: {o2}，{oT}：选择目标由你操控的结界，且其不能与由你操控的其他永久物同名。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它不是传奇。如果该衍生物是灵气，则重置赤牙砦摄政叶娜，然后占卜2。只能于法术时机起动。

731911.oracleText: Permanent spells you cast that have an Adventure cost {o1} less to cast.
731911.translation: 你施放之具历险的永久物咒语减少{o1}来施放。

731913.oracleText: Mill seven cards. Then put all cards that have an Adventure from among the milled cards into your hand.
731913.translation: 磨七张牌。然后将所有具历险的牌从所磨掉之牌中置于你手上。

731918.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to any other target. Then sacrifice it.
731918.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对任意另一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。然后将它牺牲。

731920.oracleText: Cruel Somnophage's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in all graveyards.
731920.translation: 残忍噬惧怪的力量和防御力各等同于所有坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

731923.oracleText: Whenever Decadent Dragon attacks, create a Treasure token.
731923.translation: 每当享乐巨龙攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

731925.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of target opponent's library face down. You may look at and play those cards for as long as they remain exiled.
731925.translation: 牌面朝下地放逐目标对手牌库顶的两张牌。于这些牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视并使用它们。

731927.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token. If you don't, tap CARDNAME.
731927.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以牺牲一个神器，结界或衍生物。若你未如此作，则横置CARDNAME。

731928.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token. If you don't, tap Devouring Sugarmaw.
731928.translation: 在你的维持开始时，你可以牺牲一个神器，结界或衍生物。若你未如此作，则横置吞噬糖喉兽。

731930.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Human creature token and a Food token.
731930.translation: 派出一个1/1白色人类衍生物和一个食品衍生物。

731932.oracleText: Creatures with power less than Elusive Otter's power can't block it.
731932.translation: 力量小于匿迹水獭的生物不能阻挡它。

731934.oracleText: Distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control.
731934.translation: 将X个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量目标由你操控的生物。

731937.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Frolicking Familiar gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
731937.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，嬉闹佣兽得+1/+1直到回合结束。

731939.oracleText: Blow Off Steam deals 1 damage to any target.
731939.translation: 火气外泄对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。

731944.oracleText: "The fire of Embereth will never be doused!"

731946.oracleText: Heartflame Slash deals 3 damage to any target.
731946.translation: 心火劈斩对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。

731952.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +1/+0 for each Aura and Equipment attached to CARDNAME.
731952.translation: CARDNAME上每贴附一个灵气和武具，由你操控的其他生物便得+1/+0。

731953.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +1/+0 for each Aura and Equipment attached to Kellan, the Fae-Blooded.
731953.translation: 仙儿血脉凯澜上每贴附一个灵气和武具，由你操控的其他生物便得+1/+0。

731956.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may cast it from your graveyard as an Adventure until the end of your next turn.
731956.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以从你的坟墓场中将它作为历险施放。

731957.oracleText: When Mosswood Dreadknight dies, you may cast it from your graveyard as an Adventure until the end of your next turn.
731957.translation: 当藓木林恐惧骑士死去时，直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以从你的坟墓场中将它作为历险施放。

731960.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, CARDNAME gains double strike until end of turn.
731960.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物时攻击，CARDNAME获得连击异能直到回合结束。

731961.oracleText: Whenever Picnic Ruiner attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, Picnic Ruiner gains double strike until end of turn.
731961.translation: 每当野餐搅席客于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物时攻击，野餐搅席客获得连击异能直到回合结束。

731963.oracleText: Distribute three +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control.
731963.translation: 将三个+1/+1指示物分配给任意数量目标由你操控的生物。

731965.oracleText: She can drive off any threat, from owl to hunter to Phyrexian monster.
731965.translation: 她能赶走任何威胁，从猫头鹰到猎人，甚至是非瑞克西亚怪物。

731967.oracleText: Target creature you control gains vigilance and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
731967.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得警戒异能且得+X/+X，X为由你操控的生物数量。

731969.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that's white, blue, black, or red, put a +1/+1 counter on Questing Druid.
731969.translation: 每当你施放白色，蓝色，黑色或红色咒语时，在追索德鲁伊上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731971.oracleText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Until your next end step, you may play those cards.
731971.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用这些牌。

731974.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell with mana value 3 or less, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to that player.
731974.translation: 每当任一对手施放法术力值等于或小于3的咒语时，CARDNAME对该牌手造成1点伤害。

731975.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell with mana value 3 or less, Scalding Viper deals 1 damage to that player.
731975.translation: 每当任一对手施放法术力值等于或小于3的咒语时，灼烫毒蛇对该牌手造成1点伤害。

731984.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
731984.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731985.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on Tempest Hart.
731985.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于5的咒语时，在暴风雄鹿上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

731988.oracleText: Giggles of delight may be the last thing you hear.
731988.translation: 这些欢闹的嬉笑声，可能就是你最后听到的声音。

731991.oracleText: "We spin and spin to keep us busy, but somehow you're the one who's dizzy."
731991.translation: 「我们不断盘旋向上，好让自己闲不下来，但似乎只有你犯晕。」

731993.oracleText: Exile target nontoken creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
731993.translation: 放逐目标非衍生物的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

731995.oracleText: He left knighthood behind to heal the scars of the invasion.
731995.translation: 他毅然抛弃骑士身份，全心疗愈大侵攻的创痕。

731998.oracleText: Put target permanent card from your graveyard on top of your library.
731998.translation: 将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场置于你牌库顶。

732000.oracleText: You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to activate abilities of creatures you control.
732000.translation: 你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来起动由你操控的生物之异能。

732001.oracleText: Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have all activated abilities of all creature cards exiled with CARDNAME.
732001.translation: 对由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物而言，它们具有所有以CARDNAME放逐之生物牌的所有起动式异能。

732002.oracleText: Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have all activated abilities of all creature cards exiled with Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
732002.translation: 对由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物而言，它们具有所有以阿加莎的灵魂鼎镬放逐之生物牌的所有起动式异能。

732003.oracleText: {oT}: Exile target card from a graveyard. When a creature card is exiled this way, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
732003.translation: {oT}：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。当以此法放逐一张生物牌时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

732006.oracleText:
"Look! Another one! Who cares what Mother said? We'll be home before she gets back."
—Daniela, Edgewall youth
732006.translation:
「看呐！又一颗！谁还把妈妈说过的话放心上？我们在她回来之前就到家。」
～边墙镇少女丹妮拉

732008.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You gain 3 life and draw a card.
732008.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：你获得3点生命且抓一张牌。

732009.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Candy Trail: You gain 3 life and draw a card.
732009.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲糖果小径：你获得3点生命且抓一张牌。

732011.oracleText: Beluna makes a habit of "liberating" valuables from the world below, from priceless artifacts to historic buildings.
732011.translation: 贝伦娜有「解救」云下世界珍宝的习惯，小到无价奇械、大到历史建筑全都涉猎。

732012.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Draw a card, then discard a card. Create a Treasure token.
732012.translation: {o2}，{oT}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。派出一个珍宝衍生物。

732016.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Eriette's Tempting Apple: You gain 3 life.
732016.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲艾纶缇的诱人苹果：你获得3点生命。

732017.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target opponent loses 3 life.

732018.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Eriette's Tempting Apple: Target opponent loses 3 life.
732018.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲艾纶缇的诱人苹果：目标对手失去3点生命。

732019.oracleText: Sometimes, "as fast as you can" isn't quite fast enough.
732019.translation: 有些时候，「尽你所能的快点」也不够快。

732021.oracleText: With each day she wore the crown, her icy kingdom spread, and her heart grew ever colder.
732021.translation: 这顶皇冠在她头上每戴一天，她的冰雪王国便扩大一分，她的内心也更冰冷一度。

732022.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Tap target creature. This ability costs {o1} less to activate during your turn.
732022.translation: {o1}，{oT}：横置目标生物。此异能在你的回合中减少{o1}来起动。

732023.oracleText: {o3}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw a card for each tapped creature your opponents control.
732023.translation: {o3}，牺牲CARDNAME：所有对手每操控一个已横置的生物，你便抓一张牌。

732024.oracleText: {o3}, Sacrifice Hylda's Crown of Winter: Draw a card for each tapped creature your opponents control.
732024.translation: {o3}，牺牲希尔妲的凛冬皇冠：所有对手每操控一个已横置的生物，你便抓一张牌。

732028.oracleText:
"Most dreams reveal but fragments of what you could be. Only nightmares can show you who you truly are."
—Ashiok
732028.translation:
「你虽能在大多数梦境中见得未来所成，但也只不过是只言片影。唯有噩梦方能展现你的真实全貌。」
～安梭苛

732030.oracleText:
"You're doing a splendid job, my noble stitched friend. Not a single bird has attacked us!"
—Troyan
732030.translation:
「好样的，我的缝组好友。到现在还没有鸟来咬过我们！」
～特洛扬

732033.oracleText: CARDNAME has trample, hexproof, and haste as long as an opponent controls a planeswalker.
732033.translation: 只要任一对手操控鹏洛客，CARDNAME便具有践踏、辟邪与敏捷异能。

732034.oracleText: Syr Ginger, the Meal Ender has trample, hexproof, and haste as long as an opponent controls a planeswalker.
732034.translation: 只要任一对手操控鹏洛客，封餐绝点姜饼爵士便具有践踏、辟邪与敏捷异能。

732035.oracleText: Whenever another artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Ginger and scry 1.
732035.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的神器从战场进入坟墓场时，在姜饼爵士上放置一个+1/+1指示物并占卜1。

732036.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Syr Ginger: You gain life equal to its power.
732036.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲姜饼爵士：你获得等同于其力量的生命。

732038.oracleText: Three Bowls of Porridge deals 2 damage to target creature.
732038.translation: 三碗粥对目标生物造成2点伤害。

732040.oracleText: Sacrifice Three Bowls of Porridge. You gain 3 life.
732040.translation: 牺牲三碗粥。你获得3点生命。

732041.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Choose one that hasn't been chosen — • CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature. • Tap target creature. • Sacrifice CARDNAME. You gain 3 life.
732041.translation: {o2}，{oT}：选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ •  CARDNAME对目标生物造成2点伤害。 •  横置目标生物。 •  牺牲CARDNAME。你获得3点生命。

732042.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Choose one that hasn't been chosen — • Three Bowls of Porridge deals 2 damage to target creature. • Tap target creature. • Sacrifice Three Bowls of Porridge. You gain 3 life.
732042.translation: {o2}，{oT}：选择一项，且不得是此前选过的～ •  三碗粥对目标生物造成2点伤害。 •  横置目标生物。 •  牺牲三碗粥。你获得3点生命。

732043.oracleText: What little light filters down through frost and fathoms is refracted into a million rainbow shards.
732043.translation: 穿过冰霜深水的丝缕光线，经反复折射后，化作万千霓虹碎片散落渊底。

732047.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target card that has an Adventure from your graveyard to your hand.
732047.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标具历险的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

732048.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice Edgewall Inn: Return target card that has an Adventure from your graveyard to your hand.
732048.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲边墙镇旅店：将目标具历险的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

732049.oracleText:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is you."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger
732049.translation: 「诚然，幻野地势变幻多变：河流忽而改道，树木抽枝弯折，岩石开裂破碎。但旅人啊，请谨记我的话～在外会变的，主要是你自己。」～边境地巡林客斯图温

732052.oracleText: {o1oRoW}: CARDNAME becomes a 2/2 red and white Ox creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
732052.translation: {o1oRoW}：CARDNAME成为2/2，红白双色的牛生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

732054.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

732055.oracleText: Whenever Restless Bivouac attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
732055.translation: 每当不息营地攻击时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

732058.translation: {o2oBoG}：CARDNAME成为4/4，黑绿双色的惊惧兽生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

732059.oracleText: {o2oBoG}: Restless Cottage becomes a 4/4 black and green Horror creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
732059.translation: {o2oBoG}：不息小屋成为4/4，黑绿双色的惊惧兽生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

732060.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a Food token and exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
732060.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个食品衍生物，并将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

732061.oracleText: Whenever Restless Cottage attacks, create a Food token and exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
732061.translation: 每当不息小屋攻击时，派出一个食品衍生物，并将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

732064.oracleText: {o2oWoB}: CARDNAME becomes a 1/4 white and black Nightmare creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
732064.translation: {o2oWoB}：CARDNAME成为1/4，白黑双色的梦魇生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

732065.oracleText: {o2oWoB}: Restless Fortress becomes a 1/4 white and black Nightmare creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
732065.translation: {o2oWoB}：不息要塞成为1/4，白黑双色的梦魇生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。

732066.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, defending player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
732066.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，防御牌手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

732067.oracleText: Whenever Restless Fortress attacks, defending player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
732067.translation: 每当不息要塞攻击时，防御牌手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

732073.translation: 每当不息尖塔攻击时，占卜1。

732076.oracleText: {o3oGoU}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME becomes a 5/5 green and blue Plant creature with trample. It's still a land.
732076.translation: {o3oGoU}：直到回合结束，CARDNAME成为5/5，绿蓝双色，具践踏异能的植物生物。它仍然是地。

732077.oracleText: {o3oGoU}: Until end of turn, Restless Vinestalk becomes a 5/5 green and blue Plant creature with trample. It's still a land.
732077.translation: {o3oGoU}：直到回合结束，不息蔓茎成为5/5，绿蓝双色，具践踏异能的植物生物。它仍然是地。

732078.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，至多另一个目标生物的基础力量与防御力为3/3直到回合结束。

732079.oracleText: Whenever Restless Vinestalk attacks, up to one other target creature has base power and toughness 3/3 until end of turn.

732081.translation:
「跟绵羊蜂一样忙」
～仙灵用语，意指「睡得很香」

732085.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of your end step, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, draw a card.
732085.translation: 欢庆～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则抓一张牌。

732088.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
732088.translation: 欢庆～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

732089.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Pests of Honor.
732089.translation: 欢庆～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则在自来嘉宾上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

732091.oracleText: Return all creatures to their owners' hands. For each opponent who controlled a creature returned this way, you create two 1/1 blue Faerie creature tokens with flying and "This creature can block only creatures with flying."
732091.translation: 将所有生物移回其拥有者手上。每有一位所操控之生物被此法移回的对手，你便派出两个1/1蓝色仙灵衍生生物，且具有飞行与「此生物只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。」

732093.oracleText:
"Stolen treasures can be reclaimed, but stolen knowledge is yours forever."
—Alela
732093.translation:
「偷来的珍宝会被夺回去，但偷来的知识永远属于你。」
～阿莉莱

732095.oracleText: After the royal nanny had finished his dull, droning recital of the prince and princess's bedtime story, their secret friend emerged and the real story began.
732095.translation: 待皇室保姆机械麻木地应付完王子公主的睡前故事后，他们的神秘朋友便会现身续写真正传说。

732096.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure spell, draw a card.
732096.translation: 每当你施放历险咒语时，抓一张牌。

732099.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Food, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This creature can't block."
732099.translation: 每当你牺牲食品时，派出一个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

732102.oracleText:
"Was there a fearsome witch around here? Or was it a cruel dragon? The tales were confu—oh no."
—Osval, adventurer
732102.translation:
「这里究竟是有可怕的巫师？还是残暴的巨龙？传说语焉不～啊，不。」
～冒险家欧斯瓦

732107.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, create a Food token.
732107.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则你派出一个食品衍生物。

732108.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
732108.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。

732109.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Old Flitterfang gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
732109.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：老飞牙得+2/+2直到回合结束。

732111.oracleText: One or two target creatures each gain haste until end of turn. For each of those creatures, create a Monster Role token attached to it.
732111.translation: 一个或两个目标生物各获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。为每个此类生物各派出一个怪物角色衍生物并贴附于其上。

732113.oracleText: "Soon the rats are gonna run this town, so I'm gonna run with them!"
732113.translation: 「这城很快会被老鼠接管，我要和它们一起撒欢！」

732114.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，每有一个进行攻击的生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。若有老鼠正进行攻击，则CARDNAME获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

732115.oracleText: Whenever Charging Hooligan attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each attacking creature. If a Rat is attacking, Charging Hooligan gains trample until end of turn.
732115.translation: 每当莽撞小混混攻击时，每有一个进行攻击的生物，它便得+1/+0直到回合结束。若有老鼠正进行攻击，则莽撞小混混获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

732121.translation: 每当无畏掘菌猪单独攻击时，派出一个食品衍生物。

732126.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，进行攻击的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

732127.oracleText: Whenever Provisions Merchant attacks, you may sacrifice a Food. If you do, attacking creatures get +1/+1 and gain trample until end of turn.
732127.translation: 每当美食摊贩攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，进行攻击的生物得+1/+1且获得践踏异能。

732129.oracleText: "Not bad. If only you had branches."
732129.translation: 「不错。你要能长出枝桠来就更好了。」

732132.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

732169.translation: 派出一个术士角色衍生物，并贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

732171.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} become a legendary Equipment artifact named Everflame, Heroes ' Legacy?
732171.translation: 是否要令{1, CardId}成为名称为英雄传承永焰剑的传奇武具神器？

732173.oracleText:
"Oaths are naught but empty air. Take what measures you must to ensure absolute loyalty."
—The Witch's Way
732173.translation:
「庄严誓言亦口说无凭，须采一切可能手段确保忠诚。」
～《巫婆之道》

732174.oracleText:
"She was the rising sun, her courage banishing the terrors of the night."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights
732174.translation:
「她乃初升之朝阳，其勇气如万丈光芒刺破长空，将黯夜恐惧全数驱散。」
～《金辉骑士传》

732176.oracleText:
"The witch wrapped her heart in briar vines, hid it away in the ancient keep in the depths of the forest. If none could find it, the prophecy could never come to pass."
—Beyond the Great Henge
732176.translation:
「巫婆用荆条将她心脏包起，藏进树林深处的古堡当中。如果无人能够找到她心在何处，预言也就不可能成真。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

732179.oracleText:
"The hunter drew her dagger and found she grasped a flower. She reached for an arrow, but her quiver held only leaves."
—Tales of the Fae
732179.translation:
「猎人拔刀相迎，却见手中空握鲜花；她转身抽箭，惊觉袋内只余绿叶。」
～《仙儿传说》

732180.oracleText:
"Davin's heart swelled with a heady mix of excitement and fear. If the young griffin accepted him, he would begin his path to knighthood."
—Skies of Ardenvale
732180.translation:
「戴文心潮澎湃，惊喜交加：如果这年轻狮鹫接纳了他，他便能就此踏上骑士之路。」
～《雅登瓦青云志》

732181.oracleText:
"Find glory not in blood, nor dragons felled,
But in kindness given, oaths upheld."
—"The Scholar & the Knight"
732181.translation:
「勿以杀伐屠龙争虚名，
试凭守誓行善见品行。」
～「学者与骑士」

732182.oracleText:
"I have wronged your family on a fool's errand. All I can offer is myself, that you might take your revenge."
—The Folly of Syr Perrin
732182.translation:
「我曾因愚人之命而令贵府蒙冤，如今登门谢罪，任君处置。」
～《佩林爵士愚行录》

732183.oracleText:
"‘That town is rudely blocking my view!' said the witch. The giant bowed and smiled."
—The Goose Mother and Other Tales
732183.translation:
「『那小镇把我视野挡得干干净净！』巫婆愤怒道。巨人微笑欠身，得令退下。」
～《鹅鹅妈故事集》

732184.oracleText:
"An enchanted glade revealed itself, offering safety in its warm embrace. Still she walked on."
—The Nameless Knight of Summer
732184.translation:
「她眼前出现一片魔法林地，温暖宜人，似可长留此处安全无忧。但她未加理会，径直前行。」
～《无名仲夏骑士传》

732185.oracleText:
"While the realm's great minds quarreled over the strange eclipse, Locthwain fell to the invaders."
—Last Stand of the Realm
732185.translation:
「就在世境权威还在为天蚀异象争论不休时，洛司温早已屈从侵攻者。」
～《世境末日战》

732186.oracleText:
"The king ordered those lost in sleep be placed in glass caskets, protected and watched in case they might one day wake."
—The Wicked Slumber
732186.translation:
「国王下令，将迷失沉睡者置于玻璃棺中照护看管，静待他们有朝苏醒。」
～《恶邪倦眠咒》

732187.oracleText:
"They laughed with glee as the pixie spun gold from straw. They smiled and shrugged when their curtains and clothes were next on the wheel. Then he grabbed their hair."
—The Goose Mother and Other Tales
732187.translation:
「看着碧仙从稻草中纺出黄金，他们笑逐颜开。看着碧仙接着将他们窗帘服饰放上纺车，他们笑容渐止。然后碧仙开始扯起了他们的头发。」
～《鹅鹅妈故事集》

732188.oracleText:
"O my love, would that you could understand!
Adventure beckons; I must take its hand."
—"The Scholar & the Knight"
732188.translation:
「卿卿吾爱，盼你领情！
冒险呼唤，需我远行。」
～「学者与骑士」

732189.oracleText:
"‘I don't need anyone else,' muttered Hylda. ‘You don't need anyone else,' her reflection agreed."
—Witch of Winter
732189.translation:
「『我不需要其他人，』希尔妲低声自语。『你不需要其他人，』镜中影像随声附和。」
～《凛冬女巫传》

732190.oracleText:
"Valtry gasped. The strange new coral was not coral at all, but a fallen drywalker! But how did it get to the bottom of Loch Larent?"
—The Merfolk Who Walked
732190.translation:
「瓦翠惊得倒吸一口气：这株奇怪的新生珊瑚根本就不是珊瑚，而是一个落水的地上人！但它又是怎样来到拉伦特湖底的呢？」
～《长脚的人鱼》

732191.oracleText:
"‘My kingdom for a feast!' quoth the king. A faerie appeared before him, and spoke through a wicked grin: ‘As you wish.'"
—Tales of the Fae
732191.translation:
「『就用王国换大餐！』国王说道。突然有个仙灵在他面前出现，坏笑道：『如你所愿。』」
～《仙儿传说》

732192.oracleText:
"I saw my mind stretch like cloth on a loom,
Warping, twisting toward a deathless doom."
—A Traveler's Trials
732192.translation:
「在我眼前，自身思绪如织机上的滚动缕线，
拉伸扭曲，缓缓扯向死气沉沉的无尽黯涧。」
～《旅人渡劫记》

732193.oracleText:
"The thief fled with her ill-gotten prize, her mind awhirl with visions of wealth and glory. In her pack, unnoticed, the egg began to stir and crack."
—Tales of the Fae
732193.translation:
「飞贼得手后，带着收获信步离开，脑中已满是飞黄腾达的美妙幻想。但她藏在包中的那颗蛋暗自开始扭动、破壳。」
～《仙儿传说》

732194.oracleText:
"The dark forest lit up with a thousand eyes, and for the first time, Jurald considered that the High Fae might be more than myth."
—Beyond the Great Henge
732194.translation:
「黑暗森林中刹那之间睁开万千只眼睛，这是裘若首次觉得至高仙可能不仅只是传说。」
～《圆石阵奇谭》

732195.oracleText:
"The towers were like a song on the night breeze, faint and lovely, calling her home."
—A Quickling's Journey
732195.translation:
高塔映入眼帘，就像那随夜风传来的思乡歌谣，低声轻柔地唤她回家。」
～《迅敏灵之旅》

732196.oracleText:
"A glowing spring appeared before her, promising untold wisdom. Still she walked on."
—The Nameless Knight of Summer
732196.translation:
「她眼前出现一道亮光涌泉，水流淙淙，似在应允传授隐世奇知。但她未加理会，径直前行。」
～《无名仲夏骑士传》

732197.oracleText:
"They are led by Talion, the Kindly Lord, First and Greatest of the High Fae, Sovereign of the Court, the Liege of Laughter, Finder of the First Yew, and the One True Lord of Eldraine."
—On the High Fae
732197.translation:
「仙灵全都听令于塔莱恩，仁慈之主，甚伟至高始仙，仙灵廷君主，欢笑王侯，初代紫杉发现者，艾卓唯一真王。」
～《至高仙传》

732198.oracleText:
"Despite her father's warnings, Valtry's fascination with the surface only grew. She collected things that fell to the bottom, daydreaming of life on land."
—The Merfolk Who Walked
732198.translation:
「虽屡遭父亲劝止，但瓦翠对陆地却越发向往。她不停收集落入湖底的东西，不断想象水面上的生活风貌。」
～《长脚的人鱼》

732199.oracleText:
"Hasty efforts to defend Castle Vantress left it more moat than castle."
—Last Stand of the Realm
732199.translation:
「凡翠丝堡守军仓促应战，致使城堡荡然无存，空余护城河水流动。」
～《世境末日战》

732200.oracleText:
"Tarry not in Tuinvale,
Ignore the flowers' heady scents.
Take no thing, stay to the trail,
Lest the fae seek recompense."
—To Walk the Wilds
732200.translation:
「图音谷中勿停留，
鲜花芬芳不要嗅。
路遇他物莫伸手，
以免仙儿来寻仇。」
～《幻野游记》

732201.oracleText:
"Ours is a path of the outcast, of pain given and pain received. But for the strong, it is a path that leads to power untethered from fae riddles."
—The Witch's Way
732201.translation:
「我们所选之道虽然受人唾弃：不仅予人痛苦，自身也会受尽折磨；但对强者而言，这是掌握破除仙灵谜题困扰之强大力量的必由之路。」
～《巫婆之道》

732202.oracleText:
"‘Fools,' sneered the witch. ‘I never intended to leave here alive. And thanks to your dogged insistence on following me, neither will you.'"
—Hexes of Dunbarrow
732202.translation:
「『蠢货，』巫婆冷笑道。『我从没想过要活着离开这里。既然你们都已死死跟了过来，那就都别走。』」
～《黯沼野邪咒》

732203.oracleText:
"Malevolent lights pulsed around her, whispering of riches in the dark. Still she walked on."
—The Nameless Knight of Summer
732203.translation:
「她眼前出现一阵邪恶幽光，忽明忽暗，似怕人不知深处藏财富。但她未加理会，径直前行。」
～《无名仲夏骑士传》

732204.oracleText:
"‘The human world will fall,' whispered the monstrous rat. ‘You have but one choice to make: Will you fall with it?'"
—Song of the Vermin
732204.translation:
「『人界将亡，』硕鼠低语。『你只需作一个选择：是否要随之一同毁灭？』」
～《病媒魔曲》

732205.oracleText:
"‘Get out! Get out!' the dead screamed. ‘We've not room for one more! Get out!'"
—Hexes of Dunbarrow
732205.translation: 「『滚出去！滚出去！』亡者嚷道。『已经没位了！滚出去！』」～《黯沼野邪咒》

732206.oracleText:
"'Twas the cruelest of ironies: the realm, in desperate need of rest, gripped by endless sleep that offered no comfort."
—The Wicked Slumber
732206.translation:
「这真是一个莫大的讽刺：世境虽亟需休养生息，但却困于无尽沉眠中不得安宁。」
～《恶邪倦眠咒》

732207.oracleText:
"The witch smiled, savoring every stolen year. Every love the knight would never court, every meal he'd never taste, every honor he'd never win, was sweet as honey on her tongue."
—Hexes of Dunbarrow
732207.translation:
「巫婆笑容满面，细细品味她窃来的每年时光。骑士未及赢得的每份爱意，未及品尝的每顿佳肴，未及争来的每份荣耀，在巫婆舌尖都如蜜糖般甜美。」
～《黯沼野邪咒》

732208.oracleText:
"What first seemed like a ridiculous and vaguely demeaning task quickly turned into a vicious struggle for survival."
—Welcome to Sweettooth
732208.translation:
「起初看似荒唐丢脸的无谓任务，很快就变成了尔虞我诈的求生之争。」
～《甘饴村迎客》

732209.oracleText:
"Should prying eyes observe the ritual, seize them for the cauldron, and soak the altar with the blood of the witness."
—The Witch's Way
732209.translation:
「若有人胆敢偷看仪式，就将他们丢入锅中，用他们的鲜血来浸洗祭坛。」
～《巫婆之道》

732210.oracleText:
"The knights of Embereth fought with the fire of the Irencrag in their hearts. Though many fell, not a single one retreated."
—Last Stand of the Realm
732210.translation:
「鞍博雷骑士心怀伊雷岩烈焰奋勇作战。虽纷纷折戟沙场，却无人后退一步。」
～《世境末日战》

732211.oracleText:
"The wyrm's dread eye upon the land was turned,
And all its people bent the knee—or burned."
—"The Night of Dragonfire"
732211.translation:
「恶龙惧目，大地翻震，
人民屈膝，违者遭焚。」
～「龙火之夜」

732212.oracleText:
"With reckless courage, Cade embraced the flame.
He vowed they wouldn't dare forget his name."
—"The Night of Dragonfire"
732212.translation:
「蛮勇凯德挡烈焰，誓令世人把名念。」
～「龙火之夜」

732213.oracleText:
"Mighty Torbran struck the invading phalanx like a bolt from the heavens. When the light faded, only ash remained around him."
—Last Stand of the Realm
732213.translation:
「强大的托班从天而降，以雷霆万钧之势直扑侵攻军团。待电光落定之后，四周只余尘土。」
～《世境末日战》

732214.oracleText:
"What redcaps lack in strategic acumen they more than make up for with brazen audacity."
—The Kenriths' Royal Bestiary
732214.translation:
「红帽客鬼怪大胆无畏，这点大大补充了他们在战术意识上的不足。」
～《肯理斯皇家怪物图鉴》

732215.oracleText:
"With tears in his smoke-scorched eyes, he watched the living flames consume the only home he'd ever known."
—The Apprentice's Folly
732215.translation:
「他被浓烟熏得泪水直流，只能眼睁睁地看着活体火焰将他所知的唯一家园烧个精光。」
～《学徒闯大祸》

732216.oracleText:
"I give my heart to the mountain, my memories to the wind. Let my last moment be burned into history."
—Daughters of Flame
732216.translation:
「我将心胸献给山河，将记忆奉予清风。就让我焚烧自己，将生命最后时刻写入历史。」
～《烈焰的女儿》

732217.oracleText:
"For slaying dozens of redcaps using only fruit and cakes, the dwarven survivors were dubbed the Gluttoneers."
—Assault on Delverhaugh
732217.translation:
「因其单凭水果及蛋糕击杀成群红帽客之壮举，所有的矮人幸存者都被封为饕枪客。」
～《突袭深掘台》

732218.oracleText:
"Tugrunn threw blow after blow, howling with pain as his fist met solid rock. The creature merely stared quizzically at him, unsure when the fight would start."
—The Goose Mother and Other Tales
732218.translation:
「图古伦接连出击，拳点如雨，但又因捶石吃痛而哀叫不断。对方只是不解地看着他，不知道这场架什么时候才能开始。」
～《鹅鹅妈故事集》

732219.oracleText:
"The feud between dwarves and redcaps had raged for so long that no one could quite recall how it started. Few would believe it was sparked by a long-ago dispute over a spoon."
—Assault on Delverhaugh
732219.translation:
「矮人跟红帽客之间积怨已久，甚至已经没人能说清起因到底为何。有传说这梁子是因许久以前的一次争抢汤勺而结下的。」
～《突袭深掘台》

732220.oracleText:
"Korlag carefully prepared to try the new ‘am bush' strategy he'd heard about."
—The Ogre's Revenge
732220.translation:
「寇葛精心准备，迫不及待地想要尝试他新听到的『伏棘』妙计。」
～《食人魔复仇记》

732221.oracleText:
"And as the rose began to bloom, the curse of Redtooth Keep began, at last, to wither."
—Curse of the Werefox
732221.translation:
「随着玫瑰逐渐绽放，赤牙砦下的诅咒方才慢慢褪去。」
～《半狐诅咒》

732222.oracleText:
"They laid her to rest in the wilds, in a sacred place beyond the reach of nightmares or machines."
—The Nameless Knight of Summer
732222.translation:
「她被葬在幻野深处的圣洁地界，纵连梦魇邪械亦不能及。」
～《无名仲夏骑士传》

732223.oracleText:
"Before me writhed the guardian of my prize,
A serpent with stone skin and cunning eyes!"
—A Traveler's Trials
732223.translation:
「眼前珍宝守卫盘卷身躯，想阻我得手；
巨蛇顽石附体眼神灵动，怕是难赶走！」
～《旅人渡劫记》

732224.oracleText:
"The troll took the fauns' hesitation as fear and roared in triumph. In truth, they'd seen the ledge begin to crack beneath his weight."
—The Goose Mother and Other Tales
732224.translation:
「巨魔见羊怪行动迟缓，觉得自己已经威服对方，不禁发出胜利怒号。然而，羊怪是看到巨魔脚下岩石不堪重压开始崩裂，才没有轻举妄动。」
～《鹅鹅妈故事集》

732225.oracleText:
"Brave Syr Armont mused: Was the elves' true nature that of day's civility or night's savagery? Could such bestial rage be bestowed by curse alone?"
—Curse of the Werefox
732225.translation:
「勇敢的娅蒙爵士若有所思：妖精真正的本性到底为何？是白天的谦恭有礼，还是夜晚的凶蛮无道？这等狂野的兽性，难道就只因为诅咒之故？」
～《半狐诅咒》

732226.oracleText:
"There would be time later to mourn the lost, to weep for their fallen homes and lost treasures. But for now, they breathed in the untainted air and allowed themselves to hope again."
—Last Stand of the Realm
732226.translation:
「日后有的是时间来为死难同胞发丧，为失落家园和损失财富落泪。如今是要让生者存于未受污染的空气之下，让他们重燃光复家园的希望。」
～《世境末日战》

732227.oracleText:
"Should you hear witchstalkers howl,
Best to hide or run away.
They hunt witches vile and foul.
Fear both predator and prey."
—To Walk the Wilds
732227.translation:
「猎巫狼群一声吼，
赶忙躲起快逃走。
猎杀巫婆下狠手，
猎人猎物见了愁。」
～《幻野游记》

732229.oracleText: Select a player or battle to attack.
732229.translation: 选择要攻击的牌手或战役。

732230.oracleText: Select a player, planeswalker, or battle to attack.
732230.translation: 选择要攻击的牌手、鹏洛客或战役。

732238.oracleText: Spend only on: An Ability of a Creature
732238.translation: 只能用于支付：生物的异能

732505.oracleText: Target a creature or battle spell.
732505.translation: 指定一个生物或战役咒语为目标。

732511.oracleText: Choose a creature to be your Ring-bearer.
732511.translation: 选择一个生物作为你的持戒人。

732518.oracleText: Your Ring-bearer is legendary and can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.
732518.translation: 你的持戒人是传奇且不能被力量比它大的生物阻挡。

732519.oracleText: Whenever your Ring-bearer attacks, draw a card. Then discard a card.
732519.translation: 每当你的持戒人攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

732520.oracleText: Whenever your Ring-bearer becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller sacrifices it at end of combat.
732520.translation: 每当你的持戒人被一个生物阻挡，在战斗结束时该生物的操控者将它牺牲。

732521.oracleText: Whenever your Ring-bearer deals combat damage to a player, each opponent loses 3 life.
732521.translation: 每当你的持戒人对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，每位对手各失去 3 点生命。

732523.oracleText: That creature's controller sacrifices it at end of combat.
732523.translation: 在战斗结束时，该生物的操控者将它牺牲。

732570.translation: 移动一个或数个指示物。

733373.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target creature can't be blocked this turn.
733373.translation: 每当你攻击时，目标生物本回合不能被阻挡。

734481.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, scry 2, then draw a card. Discard a card unless CARDNAME entered the battlefield this turn.
734481.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，占卜2，然后抓一张牌。除非CARDNAME是于本回合进战场，否则你弃一张牌。

734482.oracleText: Whenever Moon-Circuit Hacker deals combat damage to a player, scry 2, then draw a card. Discard a card unless Moon-Circuit Hacker entered the battlefield this turn.
734482.translation: 每当月路骇客对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，占卜2，然后抓一张牌。除非月路骇客是于本回合进战场，否则你弃一张牌。

734487.oracleText: Each creature card in your hand has ninjutsu {o1oUoB}.
734487.translation: 你手上的每张生物牌均具有忍术{o1oUoB}。

734492.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may discard a card. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
734492.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以弃一张牌。当你如此作时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

734493.oracleText: Whenever Dokuchi Silencer deals combat damage to a player, you may discard a card. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
734493.translation: 每当毒血帮销音客对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以弃一张牌。当你如此作时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

734605.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
734605.translation: 消灭目标由该牌手操控的生物或鹏洛客。

735041.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, exile that token unless CARDNAME is your Ring-bearer.
735041.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，除非CARDNAME是你的持戒人，否则将该衍生物放逐。

735637.oracleText: Destroy target tapped creature. You gain 2 life.
735637.translation: 消灭目标已横置的生物。你获得2点生命。

735640.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put all cards exiled with CARDNAME into their owner's hand.
735640.translation: {o1}，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌置于其拥有者的手上。

735641.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Celestial Vault: Put all cards exiled with Celestial Vault into their owner's hand.
735641.translation: {o1}，牺牲天界宝库：将所有以天界宝库放逐的牌置于其拥有者的手上。

736645.oracleText: When Haywire Mite dies, you gain 3 life.
736645.translation: 当失控虫械死去时，你获得3点生命。

736674.oracleText: If you weren't the starting player, you gain 3 life.
736674.translation: 如果你不是先手牌手，你获得3点生命。

737020.oracleText: Quintorius touched the old poncho he'd found. A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.
737020.translation: 昆托力轻轻碰了一下他刚发现的旧斗篷，未料其间魔力涌现，汇聚成念世灵之形，先父阿布罗就此现身。

737021.oracleText: Return target artifact or non-Aura enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield with X additional +1/+1 counters on it. It's a 1/1 Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types.
737021.translation: 将目标神器或非灵气结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面额外有X个+1/+1指示物。它是1/1，具飞行异能的精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。

737023.oracleText: As the cliff began to crumble, Wayta danced fearlessly across the tumbling stones, knowing Ajij would never let her fall.
737023.translation: 眼见崖壁崩落，薇塔仍在滚石间轻盈跳动，脸上却亳无畏惧神色～因为她深知阿吉不会让她掉下去。

737025.oracleText: Left to their own devices, gnomes reengineer their own devices.
737025.translation: 遭放任自流后，侏械便开始将自身装置重作他用。

737026.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.
737026.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

737027.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard. Activate only as a sorcery.
737027.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物：在适境卫石械上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

737029.oracleText: Few humans are steady-handed enough to match a gnome's precision. Even the slightest change to a single line can wildly alter a glyph's meaning.
737029.translation: 论精准稳定，鲜有人类的手工技艺能与侏械相媲美。哪怕是一条直线上的细微出入，都会极大影响雕符含义。

737030.oracleText: Whenever Attentive Sunscribe becomes tapped, scry 1.
737030.translation: 每当专注阳刻械成为横置时，占卜1。

737040.oracleText:
"I love the smell of freshly baked gnomes!"
—Yelha, Oltec artisan
737040.translation:
「我喜欢新鲜出窑的侏械气味！」
～欧尔特克工匠叶尔哈

737044.oracleText: Cosmium is the tangible essence of Chimil's power. The Oltec's cosmium-laced tattoos ensure that power can be called upon when needed.
737044.translation: 宇金乃是奇密理威能的有形具现。欧尔特克人会在纹身图案上嵌入少许宇金，好在需要时能够让此等力量为己所用。

737045.oracleText: Cosmium Blast deals 4 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
737045.translation: 宇金冲击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成4点伤害。

737047.oracleText: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.
737047.translation: 令莽霸联盟探险者沮丧的是，他们很快就发现大炮根本不能打动欧尔特克人。

737048.oracleText: {oXoXoW}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy each artifact with mana value X.
737048.translation: {oXoXoW}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭所有法术力值为X的神器。

737049.oracleText: {oXoXoW}, Sacrifice Dauntless Dismantler: Destroy each artifact with mana value X.
737049.translation: {oXoXoW}，牺牲不屈拆械人：消灭所有法术力值为X的神器。

737051.oracleText:
"All that is made can be unmade. Chimil's light is the only constant."
—Oltec artificers' creed
737051.translation:
「人造之物必能拆除。唯奇密理光芒永恒不变。」
～欧尔特克神器师信条

737052.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice Deconstruction Hammer: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
737052.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲解构锤：消灭目标神器或结界。

737053.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "{o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice Deconstruction Hammer: Destroy target artifact or enchantment."
737053.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有「{o3}，{oT}，牺牲解构锤：消灭目标神器或结界。」

737058.oracleText: Though wary of each other at first, the Malamet and the Oltec found a common enemy in the mycoids. They began to share glyph knowledge and other crafting secrets.
737058.translation: 起初豹族与欧尔特克人互相提防，但随着智蕈崛起，双方都认识到应联手应对这一威胁。就这样，两族人开始逐渐交流雕符知识与其他造械秘密。

737059.oracleText: {o4oW}: Create a 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature token.
737059.translation: {o4oW}：派出一个1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物。

737061.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW}. Spend this mana only to cast an artifact spell or activate an ability of an artifact source.
737061.translation: {oT}：加{oW}。此法术力只能用来施放神器咒语或起动神器来源的异能。

737062.oracleText: {o2oW}, {oT}, Exile one or more other artifacts you control with total mana value X: Return target artifact card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
737062.translation: {o2oW}，{oT}，放逐一个或数个由你操控且法术力值总和为X的其他神器：将目标法术力值等于或小于X的神器牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

737064.oracleText: Huatli smiled up at Akal. "Our peoples have too long been parted, and yet we are cousins still."
737064.translation: 华特莉抬头向阿卡笑道：「虽然我们分隔已久，但仍是骨肉同胞。」

737065.oracleText: Creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn.
737065.translation: 由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

737066.oracleText: Choose one — • Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. • Creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn.
737066.translation: 选择一项～ •  由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。 •  由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

737068.oracleText: Destroy target creature, enchantment, or planeswalker. Its controller creates two Map tokens.
737068.translation: 消灭目标生物，结界或鹏洛客。其操控者派出两个地图衍生物。

737070.oracleText: "Everyone wants to be remembered. Few are willing to do what it takes."
737070.translation: 「谁都想被铭记。谁都不愿付出。」

737074.oracleText: The Core was sealed long ago by the Deep Gods, who set the angels to the eternal task of defending its golden gates.
737074.translation: 深邃尊神很久以前就将世界核心封印，并派出天使永世守卫黄金伟门。

737075.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap four untapped artifacts, creatures, and/or lands you control.
737075.translation: 横置四个由你操控且未横置的神器，生物和／或地，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

737077.oracleText: Itzmin walked away from the collapse with a new friend—and an enduring fear of heights.
737077.translation: 奇敏从塌方现场逃出生天后，不仅交到了一位新朋友，还治好了自己的惧高症。

737078.oracleText: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
737078.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。

737080.oracleText:
"Train your mind and your muscles with equal ferocity, cub. Without wisdom, even a mighty warrior is nothing but a bully."
—Sovereign Okinec Ahau
737080.translation:
「孩子，无论是头脑还是肌肉，你都得利用同样凶猛的方式来训练。缺乏智谋，再强大的战士也不过一介莽夫。」
～豹王欧奇尼亚豪

737085.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME for each creature that left the battlefield under your control this turn.
737085.translation: 本回合中每有一个生物在你操控下离开战场，便在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737086.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on Kutzil's Flanker for each creature that left the battlefield under your control this turn.
737086.translation: 本回合中每有一个生物在你操控下离开战场，便在库琪的侧击兵上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737091.oracleText: The glyph is mightier than the sword.

737095.oracleText: "Maize, sweet and fresh! Tamal, hot and filling! Water, still or sparkling!"
737095.translation: 「玉米棒，新鲜甘甜！玉米粽，温热料足！山泉水，沁人心脾！」

737096.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
737096.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

737097.oracleText: When Market Gnome dies, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
737097.translation: 当市集侏械死去时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

737098.oracleText: When CARDNAME is exiled from the battlefield while you're activating a craft ability, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
737098.translation: 当CARDNAME于你起动任一化炼异能期间被从战场上放逐时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

737099.oracleText: When Market Gnome is exiled from the battlefield while you're activating a craft ability, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
737099.translation: 当市集侏械于你起动任一化炼异能期间被从战场上放逐时，你获得1点生命且抓一张牌。

737101.oracleText: Malamet histories speak of a time when they were not yet confined to mortal bodies and existed as ferocity unrestrained.
737101.translation: 依史书记载，豹族曾不拘于凡人之躯，过着自由自在的野性生活。

737102.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
737102.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得警戒异能。

737104.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, target creature you control explores.
737104.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，令目标由你操控的生物勘察。

737105.oracleText: When Miner's Guidewing dies, target creature you control explores.
737105.translation: 当矿工向导鸟死去时，令目标由你操控的生物勘察。

737107.oracleText:
"Either he made a gnome very angry when he took that, or he'll make one very happy when he brings it back."
—Ihio, Oteclan market vendor
737107.translation:
「被他叼走的那台侏械会很生气，给他叼回来的那台侏械会很开心。」
～欧特克兰市集商贩伊西奥

737111.oracleText: If one or more creature tokens would be created under your control, three times that many of those tokens are created instead.
737111.translation: 如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生生物，则改为派出三倍数量的该类衍生物。

737112.oracleText: When Ojer Taq dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed under its owner's control.
737112.translation: 当塔克尊神死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场且已转化。

737114.oracleText: Chimil gave the Oltec life. Ojer Taq taught them how to live together.
737114.translation: 奇密理为欧尔特克孕育生命。塔克尊神教他们如何有序共存。

737115.oracleText: {o2oW}, {oT}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn and only as a sorcery.
737115.translation: {o2oW}，{oT}：转化CARDNAME。 只能于你以三个或更多生物攻击的回合中起动，且仅限法术时机。

737116.oracleText: {o2oW}, {oT}: Transform Temple of Civilization. Activate only if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn and only as a sorcery.
737116.translation: {o2oW}，{oT}：转化文明殿堂。 只能于你以三个或更多生物攻击的回合中起动，且仅限法术时机。

737118.oracleText: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
737118.translation: 将目标神器牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

737123.oracleText: Many Oltec youth dream of one day joining the elite bat-riding cavalry of the Thousand Moons military force.
737123.translation: 许多欧尔特克年轻人都梦想自己有朝一日能入伍千月军，跻身菁英蝙蝠骑兵之列。

737130.oracleText: Dusk Legion invaders sought lone Oltec travelers to prey upon. The Core's guidestones did not approve.
737130.translation: 暮影军团的入侵者专挑落单的欧尔特克旅人下手。但世界核心的导石械不允许此事发生。

737131.oracleText: Whenever Oteclan Levitator attacks, target attacking creature without flying gains flying until end of turn.
737131.translation: 每当欧特克兰浮空械攻击时，目标进行攻击且不具飞行 异能的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

737133.oracleText: Those who break the laws of the Malamet become cold, silent warnings to others who might try.
737133.translation: 违反豹族法例的人都会化作冰冷沉寂的石像，警示任何心存侥幸想要尝试的后人。

737135.oracleText:
"Those who would steal the blood and breath of the living will drink their fill of the sand."
—Sovereign Okinec Ahau
737135.translation:
「对于那些窃取生者血液与呼吸的家伙来说，饮尽黄砂才是他们的归宿。」
～豹王欧奇尼亚豪

737136.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if it targets a tapped creature.
737136.translation: 如果此咒语以已横置的生物为目标，则它减少{o3}来施放。

737138.oracleText:
"Look! Aclazotz sends his children to watch over our pilgrimage."
—Clavileno, First of the Blessed
737138.translation:
「看呐！阿洛佐兹派出自己的子嗣来见证我们的朝圣之旅。」
～受福众首克莱维诺

737139.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, scry 1.
737139.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则占卜1。

737151.oracleText: Tap two other untapped artifacts you control: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
