737151.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他神器：CARDNAME成为神器生物直到回合结束。

737152.oracleText: Tap two other untapped artifacts you control: Bladewheel Chariot becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
737152.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的其他神器：刃轮战车成为神器生物直到回合结束。

737154.oracleText: The Thousand Moons practice every maneuver thousands of times, allowing them to strike flawlessly without hesitation in the heat of battle.
737154.translation: 千月军每一招都会练上千遍，令他们在激战时也能毫不犹豫地挥出精准一击。

737155.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o2oW}. When you do, tap target creature.
737155.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o2oW}。若你如此作，横置目标生物。

737156.oracleText: Whenever Thousand Moons Crackshot attacks, you may pay {o2oW}. When you do, tap target creature.
737156.translation: 每当千月军轰击手攻击时，你可以支付{o2oW}。若你如此作，横置目标生物。

737158.oracleText: The Thousand Moons train and fight in tight-knit squads of ten. Every tenth Moon functions as an officer, every hundredth as a captain, and the thousandth, Anim Pakal, as supreme commander.
737158.translation: 千月军通常十人编作一队，同队成员共同训练作战，结下深厚情谊。如此，每十人一名十月长，每百人一名百月长，而到千月之势时， 便由最高统帅阿妮帕卡来统筹全军。

737159.oracleText: Untap Thousand Moons Infantry during each other player's untap step.
737159.translation: 在每位其他牌手的重置步骤中重置千月军步兵。

737161.oracleText: This creature's power and toughness are each equal to the number of artifacts and/or creatures you control.
737161.translation: 此生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器和／或生物的总数量。

737168.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell using mana produced by CARDNAME, create a white Gnome Soldier artifact creature token with "This creature's power and toughness are each equal to the number of artifacts and/or creatures you control."
737168.translation: 每当你利用CARDNAME产生之法术力来施放神器或生物咒语，派出一个白色地侏／士兵衍生神器生物，且具有「此生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器和／或生物的总数量。」

737169.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell using mana produced by Barracks of the Thousand, create a white Gnome Soldier artifact creature token with "This creature's power and toughness are each equal to the number of artifacts and/or creatures you control."
737169.translation: 每当你利用千月军兵营产生之法术力来施放神器或生物咒语，派出一个白色地侏／士兵衍生神器生物，且具有「此生物的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控之神器和／或生物的总数量。」

737171.oracleText: Never leave home without a gnome.

737173.oracleText: {oW}, Sacrifice Tinker's Tote: You gain 3 life.
737173.translation: {oW}，牺牲修补匠背袋：你获得3点生命。

737179.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell during their turn, they can't attack you or planeswalkers you control this turn.
737179.translation: 每当任一对手于其回合中施放咒语时，该牌手本回合中不能攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客。

737180.oracleText: Each opponent who attacked you or a planeswalker you control this turn can't cast spells.
737180.translation: 每位本回合中攻击过你或由你操控之鹏洛客的对手均不能施放咒语。

737182.oracleText: "No one soul is worth more than Torrezon's salvation. Press on."
737182.translation: 「没有谁的灵魂比救赎图瑞琮更重要。继续前进。」

737183.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
737183.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

737184.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Vanguard of the Rose gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
737184.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：蔷薇先锋获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

737186.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has three or more counters on it, it has flying and vigilance.
737186.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有三个或更多指示物，它便具有飞行与警戒异能。

737187.oracleText: As long as Warden of the Inner Sky has three or more counters on it, it has flying and vigilance.
737187.translation: 只要内宇护卫上有三个或更多指示物，它便具有飞行与警戒异能。

737188.oracleText: Tap three untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Scry 1. Activate only as a sorcery.
737188.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。占卜1。只能于法术时机起动。

737189.oracleText: Tap three untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on Warden of the Inner Sky. Scry 1. Activate only as a sorcery.
737189.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物：在内宇护卫上放置一个+1/+1指示物。占卜1。只能于法术时机起动。

737191.oracleText: "These lost children of Aclazotz are misguided, but perhaps there can be reconciliation of our ideals without war."
737191.translation: 「这些遭阿洛佐兹蒙蔽的孩子已走上歧途，但仍有一丝不必诉诸战争便能和解的机会。」

737192.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's end step, if an artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
737192.translation: 在每位牌手的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有神器在你操控下进战场，则检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

737194.oracleText: A typical conversation with Echoes is three parts wisdom and one part gossip.
737194.translation: 当与念世灵对话时，往往是七分求知智慧，三分闲话家常。

737196.oracleText: When the Malamet told him to avoid the river, he thought they meant it wasn't safe to drink.
737196.translation: 当豹族跟他说别碰这条河时，他以为只是提醒别喝这的水。

737197.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. If it was tapped, create a Map token.
737197.translation: 将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。如果它已横置，则你派出一个地图衍生物。

737201.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a net counter from CARDNAME: Tap another target nonland permanent. Its activated abilities can't be activated for as long as it remains tapped.
737201.translation: {oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个罗网指示物：横置另一个目标非地永久物。于该永久物持续横置的时段内，其起动式异能都不能起动。

737202.oracleText: {oT}, Remove a net counter from Braided Net: Tap another target nonland permanent. Its activated abilities can't be activated for as long as it remains tapped.
737202.translation: {oT}，从织综渔网上移去一个罗网指示物：横置另一个目标非地永久物。于该永久物持续横置的时段内，其起动式异能都不能起动。

737205.oracleText: The Oltec repurpose objects out of reverence rather than scarcity, believing them strengthened by the memory of each past function.
737205.translation: 欧尔特克人常会重造身边事物另作他用；这并非因为物质稀缺，而是他们崇敬过往，相信其往昔每段功用都令其更加牢靠。

737206.oracleText: {o3oU}, {oT}: Draw a card for each artifact you control, then put CARDNAME into its owner's library third from the top.
737206.translation: {o3oU}，{oT}：你每操控一个神器，便抓一张牌，然后将CARDNAME置于其拥有者的牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

737207.oracleText: {o3oU}, {oT}: Draw a card for each artifact you control, then put Braided Quipu into its owner's library third from the top.
737207.translation: {o3oU}，{oT}：你每操控一个神器，便抓一张牌，然后将织综奇普结置于其拥有者的牌库顶数来第三张的位置。

737208.oracleText: As the River Heralds began to decipher the ancient map, they were staggered by the vastness of the world-within-the-world that it revealed.
737208.translation: 随着川流使逐渐解开上古地图的奥秘，他们无不为其间展现之世中世界的广阔天地而震撼。

737210.oracleText: Years of adventure and adversity on the open seas did not prepare Brog for the humiliation of losing a sparring match to a cogwork doll less than half his size.
737210.translation: 虽然布洛葛早在惊涛骇浪中历练多年，但当他在拳赛中输给不及自己半身高的齿轮机械时，还是很难咽下这口气。

737213.oracleText: Explorers learned not to tamper with sites of ancient power without learning their purpose.
737213.translation: 探险队早已学会，在没弄清楚古迹力量用途前，不要乱碰其中任何物品。

737214.oracleText: Choose one — • Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. • Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o4}.
737214.translation: 选择一项～ •  检视你牌库顶的四张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。 •  除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。

737216.oracleText: The Komon Winaq, ancestors of the Oltec, linger on as the eldest of the Echoes.
737216.translation: 科门维纳族人是欧尔特克人的先祖，也是徘徊世间最古老的念世灵。

737221.oracleText: "These glyphs are more than trail markings! They tell a story as they go. But does it end in celebration or tragedy?"
737221.translation: 「这些雕符不只是路标！一路上的内容能够连成一段故事。但这结局究竟是喜是悲？」

737222.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken Merfolk you control become tapped, create a 1/1 blue Merfolk creature token with hexproof.
737222.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的人鱼成为横置时，派出一个1/1蓝色，具辟邪异能的人鱼衍生生物。

737224.oracleText: The folk of the Sun Empire respect their ancestors. The Oltec go further, communing with spirits of esteemed elders after death.
737224.translation: 烈阳帝国的人民崇敬先祖。但欧尔特克人则更近一步，他们在尊贵长者逝后仍能直接与之对话。

737226.oracleText: Descend 4 — CARDNAME has flying as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737226.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，CARDNAME便具有飞行异能。

737227.oracleText: Descend 4 — Didact Echo has flying as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737227.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，布道念世灵便具有飞行异能。

737229.oracleText: It is ill-advised to swim where even the River Heralds do not.
737229.translation: 建议不要在连川流使都不去的地方下水。

737230.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a black Skeleton creature with base power and toughness 1/1.
737230.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为1/1的黑色骷髅妖生物。

737231.oracleText: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a black Skeleton creature with base power and toughness 1/1. (It loses all other card types and creature types.)
737231.translation: 所结附的生物失去所有异能，且是基础力量与防御力为1/1的黑色骷髅妖生物。（它会失去其他牌张类别和生物类别。）

737234.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oCoC}. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.
737234.translation: {oT}：加{oCoC}。此法术力只能用来起动异能。

737235.oracleText: Craft with four or more nonlands with activated abilities {o8oU}
737235.translation: 以四个或更多具起动式异能之非地物件化炼{o8oU}

737237.oracleText: CARDNAME has each activated ability of the exiled cards used to craft it. You may activate each of those abilities only once each turn.
737237.translation: CARDNAME具有所有用以化炼它所放逐之牌的所有起动式异能。每个此类异能每回合你都只能起动一次。

737238.oracleText: Locus of Enlightenment has each activated ability of the exiled cards used to craft it. You may activate each of those abilities only once each turn.
737238.translation: 启蒙之核具有所有用以化炼它所放逐之牌的所有起动式异能。每个此类异能每回合你都只能起动一次。

737239.oracleText: Whenever you activate an ability that isn't a mana ability, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
737239.translation: 每当你起动不属法术力异能的异能时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

737243.oracleText: Descend 8 — At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard, transform CARDNAME.
737243.translation: 落坟8～在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，则转化CARDNAME。

737244.oracleText: Descend 8 — At the beginning of your upkeep, if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard, transform The Everflowing Well.
737244.translation: 落坟8～在你的维持开始时，若你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，则转化汩汩涌井。

737247.oracleText: Whenever you cast a permanent spell using mana produced by CARDNAME, up to one other target permanent you control becomes a copy of that spell until end of turn.
737247.translation: 每当你利用CARDNAME产生之法术力来施放永久物咒语时，至多另一个目标由你操控的永久物成为该咒语的复制品直到回合结束。

737248.oracleText: Whenever you cast a permanent spell using mana produced by The Myriad Pools, up to one other target permanent you control becomes a copy of that spell until end of turn.
737248.translation: 每当你利用连绵灌池产生之法术力来施放永久物咒语时，至多另一个目标由你操控的永久物成为该咒语的复制品直到回合结束。

737251.oracleText:
"Remember that weird salamander thing we found in the jungle stream? I think we just met its god."
—Carella, quartermaster of the Windshark
737251.translation:
「还记得我们在丛林溪流里碰到的那条奇怪火蜥蜴吗？我想我们现在遇到它的神了。」
～风鲨号军需官卡雷拉

737252.oracleText: Descend 4 — CARDNAME gets +2/+0 as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737252.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，CARDNAME便得+2/+0。

737253.oracleText: Descend 4 — Frilled Cave-Wurm gets +2/+0 as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737253.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，刃鳍洞窟亚龙便得+2/+0。

737255.oracleText: It devoured the shell's original owner long ago, but it's just about ready to start looking for a new home—and a meal to go with it.
737255.translation: 它很久以前就吞掉了这个壳的旧主，现在又打起了搬新家的主意～同时还想借此美餐一顿。

737256.oracleText: {o1oU}: CARDNAME gets +3/-3 until end of turn.

737257.oracleText: {o1oU}: Hermitic Nautilus gets +3/-3 until end of turn.
737257.translation: {o1oU}：遁世鹦鹉螺得+3/-3直到回合结束。

737259.oracleText: Counter target artifact or creature spell. Discover X, where X is that spell's mana value.
737259.translation: 反击目标神器或生物咒语。倾探X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

737265.oracleText: The force of a blizzard. The rage of a monstrosaur.
737265.translation: 如暴风雪般威猛。似暴霸龙般愤怒。

737266.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may tap or untap target artifact or creature.
737266.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以横置或重置目标神器或生物。

737267.oracleText: Whenever Iceberg Titan attacks, you may tap or untap target artifact or creature.
737267.translation: 每当冰山泰坦攻击时，你可以横置或重置目标神器或生物。

737276.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.
737276.translation: {o1}，{oT}：令目标由你操控的生物勘察。只能于法术时机起动。

737278.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, put a chorus counter on it. Draw a card, then discard a card. If there are four or more chorus counters on Malcolm, you may cast the discarded card without paying its mana cost.
737278.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置一个合韵指示物。抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。如果马科姆上有四个或更多合韵指示物，则你可以施放所弃之牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

737279.oracleText: Whenever Malcolm, Alluring Scoundrel deals combat damage to a player, put a chorus counter on it. Draw a card, then discard a card. If there are four or more chorus counters on Malcolm, you may cast the discarded card without paying its mana cost.
737279.translation: 每当迷声恶棍马科姆对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置一个合韵指示物。抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。如果马科姆上有四个或更多合韵指示物，则你可以施放所弃之牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

737281.oracleText: Ancient glyphs are a lot harder to decipher when attached to an apex predator.
737281.translation: 当远古雕符出现在顶级掠食者身上时，解读难度就大大增加。

737283.oracleText:
"Learn all you can of this underground sea. I suspect more secrets of our ancestors lie waiting in its depths."
—Tishana
737283.translation:
「尽你所能摸透这片地下海的底细。我怀疑其深处还有更多先祖秘密待我们去发现。」
～提莎娜

737284.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
737284.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

737285.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores, Merfolk Cave-Diver gets +1/+0 until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
737285.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察时，潜窟人鱼得+1/+0直到回合结束，且本回合不能被阻挡。

737287.oracleText: The ship's carpenter adorned the figurehead with a small cosmium gem, never expecting the figurehead to take flight.
737287.translation: 造船木匠不过是给船首像装上一枚宇金碎石作点缀，未曾想这雕像就此飞空。

737288.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to cast an artifact spell or activate an ability of an artifact source.
737288.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来施放神器咒语或起动神器来源的异能。

737290.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant spell from your hand, it gains rebound.
737290.translation: 每当你从你手上施放瞬间咒语时，它获得弹回异能。

737291.oracleText: When Ojer Pakpatiq dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed under its owner's control with three time counters on it.
737291.translation: 当巴帕提尊神死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，其为已横置、已转化且其上有三个计时指示物。

737293.oracleText: Chimil gave the Oltec time. Ojer Pakpatiq gave them the tools to learn its lessons.
737293.translation: 奇密理令欧尔特克得观时间。巴帕提尊神教他们如何从中纪事。

737294.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Remove a time counter from CARDNAME.
737294.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。从CARDNAME上移去一个计时指指示物。

737295.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Remove a time counter from Temple of Cyclical Time.
737295.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。从环时殿堂上移去一个计时指指示物。

737296.oracleText: {o2oU}, {oT}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if it has no time counters on it and only as a sorcery.
737296.translation: {o2oU}，{oT}：转化CARDNAME。只能于其上没有计时指示物时起动，且仅限法术时机。

737297.oracleText: {o2oU}, {oT}: Transform Temple of Cyclical Time. Activate only if it has no time counters on it and only as a sorcery.
737297.translation: {o2oU}，{oT}：转化环时殿堂。只能于其上没有计时指示物时起动，且仅限法术时机。

737299.oracleText: Between Quintorius's archaeological expertise and Huatli's knowledge of ancient glyphs, the "impossible" lock finally yielded, and the door to the underground world rumbled open.
737299.translation: 在昆托力的考古专才与华特莉的古符知识携手攻关之下，终于解开了这道「不破密锁」，通往地底世界的大门就此隆隆开启。

737300.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
737300.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

737301.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Orazca Puzzle-Door: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
737301.translation: {o1}，{oT}，牺牲欧拉兹卡密门:检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

737303.oracleText:
"The Core is not a simple trove to be plundered by intruders from the surface. It will reject those who do not accord it respect."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan
737303.translation:
「世界核心并非是放任地上入侵者劫掠的普通宝库。任何未示敬意者都会被拒之门外。」
～欧特克兰首席宰相阿卡帕卡

737304.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if it targets a creature spell.
737304.translation: 如果此咒语以生物咒语为目标，则它减少{o2}来施放。

737306.oracleText: "Landlubbers just don't understand the value of a proper hat."
737306.translation: 「旱鸭子根本不懂好帽子的价值。」

737307.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
737307.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

737308.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, draw a card, then discard a card."
737308.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有「每当此生物攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。」

737311.oracleText:
"Well, that's one less share to divide up."
—Dranach, Dire Fleet boatswain
737311.translation:
「好，这下少一个分钱的。」
～焦炬舰队水手长卓纳克

737312.oracleText: Until end of turn, target artifact or creature becomes a Dinosaur artifact creature with base power and toughness 4/3 in addition to its other types.
737312.translation: 直到回合结束，目标神器或生物成为基础力量与防御力为4/3的恐龙神器生物，且仍具有原本类别。

737314.oracleText: "Don't worry, little swimmers. I'm here for the ruins, not you."
737314.translation: 「小鱼们，不用担心。我是为遗迹而来，无意伤害你们。」

737321.oracleText: Some Echoes remember every moment of their past lives and spend their existence contemplating past choices.
737321.translation: 有些念世灵会记得前世的每个瞬间，于是便将眼下存在全部用来反思过往抉择。

737324.oracleText: As long as an artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn, CARDNAME can attack as though it didn't have defender.
737324.translation: 只要本回合中有神器在你操控下进战场，CARDNAME便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

737325.oracleText: As long as an artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn, Shipwreck Sentry can attack as though it didn't have defender.
737325.translation: 只要本回合中有神器在你操控下进战场，遇难船哨卫便能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

737332.oracleText: Fathomless descent — Enchanted permanent gets -X/-0, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
737332.translation: 落坟无边～被结附的永久物得-X/-0，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。

737338.oracleText: "Leave you? Not a chance. You still owe me money."
737338.translation: 「丢下你？想得美。你还欠我钱呢。」

737347.oracleText:
"First rule down here is the same as it is on the water: always double-check your knots."
—Captain Lannery Storm
737347.translation:
「地底下的首要规矩跟水面上一样:时刻复查绳结有没有绑好。」
～兰娜莉速腾船长

737348.oracleText: Target artifact or creature's owner puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
737348.translation: 目标神器或生物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

737352.oracleText: Descend 8 — CARDNAME can't be blocked as long as there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737352.translation: 落坟8～只要你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，CARDNAME便不能被阻挡。

737353.oracleText: Descend 8 — Watertight Gondola can't be blocked as long as there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737353.translation: 落坟8～只要你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，水密吊舱便不能被阻挡。

737357.oracleText: "The only drink in your future is seawater."
737357.translation: 「你以后能喝到的就只有海水。」

737361.oracleText: Enchanted artifact is a Golem creature with base power and toughness 5/4 in addition to its other types.
737361.translation: 所结附的神器是基础力量与防御力为5/4的魔像生物，且仍具有原本类别。

737362.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, discover 3.
737362.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，倾探3。

737363.oracleText: When Zoetic Glyph is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, discover 3.
737363.translation: 当生机雕符从战场进入坟墓场时，倾探3。

737365.oracleText: Its kin once overran entire civilizations, but they tore each other to pieces in their unending hunger. Now only it remains.
737365.translation: 它的同族扫平了一切文明，却仍未能满足无尽饕欲而彼此相食。如今只剩它一个留存于世。

737370.oracleText: Whenever Aclazotz attacks, each opponent discards a card. For each opponent who can't, you draw a card.
737370.translation: 每当阿洛佐兹攻击时，每位对手各弃一张牌。每有一位无法如此作的对手，你便抓一张牌。

737371.oracleText: Whenever an opponent discards a land card, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
737371.translation: 每当任一对手弃一张地牌时，你派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

737372.oracleText: When Aclazotz dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed under its owner's control.
737372.translation: 当阿洛佐兹死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场且已转化。

737374.oracleText: Chimil gave the Oltec peace in death. Aclazotz ripped it away.
737374.translation: 奇密理赋欧尔特克逝后安眠。阿洛佐兹将这切剥夺殆尽。

737375.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if a player has one or fewer cards in hand and only as a sorcery.
737375.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}：转化CARDNAME。 只能于某牌手的手牌为一张或更少时起动，且仅限法术时机。

737376.oracleText: {o2oB}, {oT}: Transform Temple of the Dead. Activate only if a player has one or fewer cards in hand and only as a sorcery.
737376.translation: {o2oB}，{oT}：转化亡者殿堂。 只能于某牌手的手牌为一张或更少时起动，且仅限法术时机。

737378.oracleText: "Great Aclazotz, receive this offering. Wrought with skill. Captured with strength. Anointed with the blood of your enemies."
737378.translation: 「阿洛佐兹在上，请收下此物。巧匠技艺铸造，无匹实力夺获，蒙你仇敌鲜血洗礼。」

737379.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
737379.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

737381.oracleText: The pull of duty was so strong that they barely paused to notice they'd died.
737381.translation: 职责的呼唤是如此强烈，他们甚至都没闲暇来注意自己是否还在喘气。

737382.oracleText: You may mill two cards. Then return up to two creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
737382.translation: 你可以磨两张牌。然后将至多两张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

737384.oracleText: Though he wept at Inti's death, Caparocti's eyes were keen, and his spear pierced cleanly through Clavileno's tainted heart.
737384.translation: 虽然卡帕罗提内心仍由于因提战殁而悲伤不已，但是其仍眼疾手快抓住机会，一枪刺穿了克莱维诺那颗堕落之心。

737385.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or pay 3 life.
737385.translation: 弃一张牌或支付3点生命，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

737388.oracleText: Its very presence rips old wounds open to bleed anew.
737388.translation: 它甫一现身，旧伤开裂，鲜血涌出。

737389.oracleText: If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead.
737389.translation: 如果某对手将于你的回合中失去生命，则改为其失去两倍于该数量的生命。

737391.oracleText:
"This weapon embodies both the strength and the weakness of the Legion of Dusk. They will endure any pain to achieve their ends, but they suffer pointlessly just to prove their dedication."
—Huatli
737391.translation:
「 这件武器优缺点分明，正如暮影军团本身。他们为达目的甘愿忍受一切苦痛，但却只是为自证虔诚而无端遭难。」
～华特莉

737397.oracleText: As the massive mycoids known as rage titans charge into battle, lesser ones swarm in their wake, gobbling up any survivors.
737397.translation: 名唤怒火泰坦的巨型智蕈率先冲入战场，体型较小的智蕈紧随其后，伺机吞噬侥幸存活者。

737398.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, create a 1/1 black Fungus creature token with "This creature can't block."
737398.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则派出一个1/1黑色真菌衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

737400.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
737400.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737401.oracleText: {o5oBoB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Create a 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying.
737401.translation: {o5oBoB}，牺牲CARDNAME：派出一个4/3，白黑双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

737402.oracleText: {o5oBoB}, Sacrifice Canonized in Blood: Create a 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying.
737402.translation: {o5oBoB}，牺牲鲜血封圣：派出一个4/3，白黑双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

737405.oracleText: It needs no food, yet still it hungers.
737405.translation: 它虽不需进食，但仍饥渴依旧。

737409.oracleText: Skeletons you control get +1/+0 and have haste.
737409.translation: 由你操控的骷髅妖得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

737412.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return CARDNAME to its owner's hand.
737412.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则你可以支付1点生命。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上。

737413.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return Corpses of the Lost to its owner's hand.
737413.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则你可以支付1点生命。若你如此作，则将失落者之骸移回其拥有者手上。

737414.oracleText: The hired goblins were not, as advertised, worth their weight in gold.
737414.translation: 雇来的鬼怪并不像他们吹嘘的那样，值得搭上等重的金子。

737416.oracleText: Mycoids have no concept of life or death. All things exist, and all things can be made useful.
737416.translation: 智蕈没有生死的概念。所有东西既存于世，便都能派上用场。

737421.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
737421.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737422.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Deep Goblin Skulltaker.
737422.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则在深邃夺骨鬼怪上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737424.oracleText: The first shriek locates the prey. The second immobilizes it.
737424.translation: 第一声尖啸找到猎物。第二声令其动弹不得。

737428.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature explores, then it explores again.
737428.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。令该生物勘察，然后再勘察。

737430.oracleText:
"It's a mournful fate, to remember so well the taste of blood yet be forever unable to drink."
—Bartolome del Presidio, director of the Queen's Bay Company
737430.translation:
「 此般命运是如此悲哀，虽能清楚记得鲜血滋味，却再也无法亲口品尝。」
～女王湾连队总督巴洛梅德普西迪奥

737431.oracleText: Descend 4 — As long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
737431.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

737432.oracleText: Descend 4 — As long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, Echo of Dusk gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.
737432.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，暮影念世灵便得+1/+1且具有系命异能。

737434.oracleText: The gateway could be opened only by the spilling of innocent blood. Vito did not hesitate.
737434.translation: 闸门只有洒上无辜之血后才能打开。维托没有点犹豫。

737435.oracleText: Draw two cards and create a Map token.
737435.translation: 抓两张牌并派出一个地图衍生物。

737437.oracleText: When enchanted creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control.
737437.translation: 当所结附的生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场。

737439.oracleText:
"Does everything down here want to suck my blood?"
—Derilene, expedition porter
737439.translation:
「难道这地底下每一个东西都想吸我的血吗?」
～探险队脚夫德利涅

737440.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each Cave you control and each Cave card in your graveyard.
737440.translation: 你每操控一个洞窟或你坟墓场中每有一张洞窟牌，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

737442.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. Put a dread counter on CARDNAME. Then if there are three or more dread counters on it, transform it.
737442.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，它获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。在CARDNAME上放置一个怖惧指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多怖惧指示物，则转化它。

737443.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. Put a dread counter on Grasping Shadows. Then if there are three or more dread counters on it, transform it.
737443.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，它获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。在缠攫阴影上放置一个怖惧指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多怖惧指示物，则转化它。

737446.oracleText: The shadows make no mark upon the flesh. It is the mind they claw and strangle.
737446.translation: 此等阴影从不留痕肉身，只会紧缠心灵。

737447.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}, Remove a dread counter from CARDNAME: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
737447.translation: {oB}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去一个怖惧指示物：你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

737448.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}, Remove a dread counter from Shadows' Lair: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
737448.translation: {oB}，{oT}，从阴影巢穴上移去一个怖惧指示物：你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

737450.oracleText: Neither Nurgam nor the mycoid who laid the trap could quite believe their luck.
737450.translation: 努甘和设陷的智蕈都不敢相信自己会有如此好运。

737451.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
737451.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，占卜1并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

737452.oracleText: When Greedy Freebooter dies, scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
737452.translation: 当贪婪掠盗死去时，占卜1并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

737454.oracleText: The more creatures that plunge to their deaths in the abyss, the more angry Echoes that arise to drag others down.
737454.translation: 随着堕亡深渊者数量增加，愤怒起身想要拖人入列的念世灵也多了起来。

737455.oracleText: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn. Descend 4 — That creature gets -10/-10 until end of turn instead if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737455.translation: 目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。落坟4～如果你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则改为该生物得-10/-10直到回合结束。

737456.oracleText:
Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn. 
Descend 4 — That creature gets -10/-10 until end of turn instead if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737456.translation:
目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。
落坟4～如果你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则改为该生物得-10/-10直到回合结束。

737458.oracleText: Aclazotz laughed as the dark shards closed around Chimil, plunging the Core into unnatural darkness. At long last, his bloody reign would begin.
737458.translation: 随着黑暗碎片集聚奇密理表面，令世界核心坠入无边异黯之中，阿洛佐兹不由畅怀大笑。历经艰辛，他的血腥统治终能揭开帷幕。

737459.oracleText: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn. If a creature an opponent controls would die this turn, exile it instead.
737459.translation: 所有生物得-2/-2直到回合结束。如果本回合中由对手操控的生物将死去，则改为将它放逐。

737461.oracleText:
"Don't look at me. I'm not drinking it."
—Dranach, Dire Fleet boatswain
737461.translation:
「别看我，我可不喝。」
～焦炬舰队水手长卓纳克

737465.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
737465.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击总生命最高或与他者同为最高的牌手时，派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。

737466.oracleText: Whenever Preacher of the Schism attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
737466.translation: 每当叛教帮传道士攻击总生命最高或与他者同为最高的牌手时，派出一个1/1白色，具系命异能的吸血鬼衍生生物。

737467.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while you have the most life or are tied for most life, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
737467.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你是总生命最高或与他者同为最高的牌手时攻击，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

737468.oracleText: Whenever Preacher of the Schism attacks while you have the most life or are tied for most life, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
737468.translation: 每当叛教帮传道士于你是总生命最高或与他者同为最高的牌手时攻击，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

737470.oracleText: Cave crawlers devour anything from plant matter to solid rock, but they prefer fresh meat.
737470.translation: 虽然洞窟爬虫万物皆能食，植物岩石全不忌，但它们还是更喜欢鲜肉。

737472.translation: 当原初啮骨虫死去时，倾探3。

737480.oracleText:
"We know Chimil's light as a warming, healing presence, but make no mistake: to those who would desecrate her lands, it is a terrible force of scouring fury."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan
737480.translation:
「虽然奇密理的光芒温暖怡人，但并非万物都作此感受：对那些胆敢亵渎她土地的生灵来说，这光芒便是展现灼热怒火的可怖力量。」
～欧特克兰首席宰相阿卡帕卡

737481.oracleText: Exile target creature, Vehicle, or nonbasic land. Scry 1.
737481.translation: 放逐目标生物，载具或非基本地。占卜1。

737483.oracleText: After a slow death in darkness, she flies into a rage at the slightest glimpse of light.
737483.translation: 由于她是在黑暗中受因而死，因此一见点滴亮光便会勃然大怒。

737484.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, mill a card.

737485.oracleText: Whenever Screaming Phantom attacks, mill a card.
737485.translation: 每当尖鸣幽魅攻击时，磨一张牌。

737488.oracleText:
"Oh, come on! Aren't regular snails gross enough?"
—Derilene, expedition porter
737488.translation:
「得了吧！普通的蜗牛还不够恶心吗？」
～探险队脚夫德利涅

737492.oracleText:
"As the snake sheds its skin to be born anew, we cast off death to rise as servants of Aclazotz."
—Vito, Church of Dusk heretic
737492.translation:
「正如蛇褪去皮肤方能获得新生，吾人直面死亡才有幸随侍阿洛佐兹。」
～暮影教异端维托

737493.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
737493.translation: {oB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

737494.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice Soulcoil Viper: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
737494.translation: {oB}，{oT}，牺牲缠魂毒蛇：将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

737497.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or sacrifice a permanent.
737497.translation: 弃一张牌或牺牲一个永久物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

737498.oracleText: Fathomless descent — Souls of the Lost's power is equal to the number of permanent cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
737498.translation: 落坟无边～失落者灵魂的力量等同于你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

737500.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Stalactite Stalker.
737500.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则在钟乳石伏客上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737501.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
737501.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

737502.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice Stalactite Stalker: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is Stalactite Stalker's power.
737502.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲钟乳石伏客：目标生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为钟乳石伏客的力量。

737506.oracleText: Descend 8 — Whenever you draw a card, if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
737506.translation: 落坟8～每当你抓一张牌时，若你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，则目标对手失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

737508.oracleText: Caverns uninhabited by mycoids are often infested with worse.
737508.translation: 没有智蕈的洞窟里面，往往住着其他更恐怖的东西。

737509.oracleText: Descend 4 — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
737509.translation: 落坟4～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

737510.oracleText: Descend 4 — Whenever Stinging Cave Crawler attacks, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
737510.translation: 落坟4～每当毒刺洞窟爬虫攻击时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

737513.oracleText:
"It's no good killing them? Then what do we do? Distract them with a tea party?"
—Mervin, Brazen Coalition prospector
737513.translation:
「杀死它们没有用？那我们能怎么办？开茶会引开它们？」
～莽霸联盟勘探员莫文

737514.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create two 1/1 black Fungus creature tokens with "This creature can't block."
737514.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出两个1/1黑色真菌衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

737515.oracleText: When Synapse Necromage dies, create two 1/1 black Fungus creature tokens with "This creature can't block."
737515.translation: 当突蕈死灵法师死去时，派出两个1/1黑色真菌衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡。」

737517.oracleText: Though officially deemed a heretic for his reverent writings on Aclazotz, Tarrian is viewed as a holy martyr by the most radical sects of the Church of Dusk.
737517.translation: 塔理安因在文字中流露出对阿洛佐兹的崇敬之情而被定为异端，但在暮影教会最为极端的派别眼中，他与殉道圣士无异。

737518.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another artifact or creature: Draw a card. Activate only as a sorcery.
737518.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个神器或生物：抓一张牌。只能于法术时机起动。

737520.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Discard your hand: Transform Tarrian's Journal.
737520.translation: {o2}，{oT}，弃掉你的手牌：转化塔理安的日志。

737524.oracleText: Those who go under rise again as cruel mockeries of their former selves, spewing foul water and keening with sorrow.
737524.translation: 遭浪潮吞噬的人往往会再度起身，化作过往存在的拙劣酷影，口吐污水，悲伤前行。

737525.oracleText: Fathomless descent — All creatures get -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
737525.translation: 落坟无边～所有生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。

737530.oracleText:
"Slake my thirst so that we both may be free."
—Faded inscription
737530.translation:
「解我干渴，你我同得解脱。」
～模糊不清的铭文

737537.oracleText:
"It's not my fault! The glyphs for ‘blessed' and ‘cursed' look very similar!"
—Diego, Brazen Coalition translator
737537.translation:
「这不是我的错！表示『祝福』和『诅咒』的雕符长得就差不多！」
～莽霸联盟翻译迭戈

737541.oracleText: "We usher in the Age of Everflowing Blood, when those who are fed upon will be fed, and those who feed will be satiated."
737541.translation: 「我们行将开创朱光时代，觅食者终饱餐无忧，喂食者亦性命无愁。」

737542.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. It gains menace until end of turn.
737542.translation: {oB}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得威慑直到回合结束。

737543.oracleText: {oB}, Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on Vito's Inquisitor. It gains menace until end of turn.
737543.translation: {oB}，牺牲另一个生物或神器：在维托的审判官上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得威慑直到回合结束。

737544.oracleText:
"What do you mean a walking clock destroyed all our cannons?!"
—Captain Lannery Storm
737544.translation:
「你说一个会走路的钟把我们的大炮全毁了是什么意思？！」
～兰娜莉速腾船长

737546.oracleText:
"You surface-dwellers may have forgotten your history, but it has not forgotten you."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan
737546.translation:
「你们地上人可能已经忘记了自身的历史，但历史并没有忘记你们。」
～欧特克兰首席宰相阿卡帕卡

737548.oracleText: One day it will be as terrifying as it thinks it is.
737548.translation: 总有一天它会跟它所想的一样可怕。

737553.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play them this turn. If you exiled a land card this way, create a 3/1 red Dinosaur creature token. If you exiled a nonland card this way, create a Treasure token.
737553.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。如果你以此法放逐了地牌，则派出一个3/1红色恐龙衍生生物。如果你以此法放逐了非地牌，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

737557.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, put a bore counter on CARDNAME. Then if there are three or more bore counters on it, remove those counters and transform it.
737557.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则在CARDNAME上放置一个钻孔指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多钻孔指示物，则移去这些指示物并转化它。

737558.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, put a bore counter on Brass's Tunnel-Grinder. Then if there are three or more bore counters on it, remove those counters and transform it.
737558.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则在霸司的掘隧机上放置一个钻孔指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多钻孔指示物，则移去这些指示物并转化它。

737560.oracleText: Whenever you cast a permanent spell using mana produced by CARDNAME, discover X, where X is that spell's mana value.
737560.translation: 每当你利用CARDNAME产生之法术力来施放永久物咒语时，倾探X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

737561.oracleText: Whenever you cast a permanent spell using mana produced by Tecutlan, the Searing Rift, discover X, where X is that spell's mana value.
737561.translation: 每当你利用炙热裂缝蒂库澜产生之法术力来施放永久物咒语时，倾探X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

737563.oracleText: "The secret is footwork. Plus an extra sword."
737563.translation: 「秘诀在于脚下步法。外加多带一把剑。」

737564.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while you control two or more artifacts, it gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
737564.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你操控两个或更多神器时攻击，它得+2/+1直到回合结束。

737565.oracleText: Whenever Brazen Blademaster attacks while you control two or more artifacts, it gets +2/+1 until end of turn.
737565.translation: 每当莽霸大剑师于你操控两个或更多神器时攻击，它得+2/+1直到回合结束。

737567.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
737567.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

737568.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
737568.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

737569.oracleText: Whenever a Pirate you control attacks, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — • Create a Treasure token. • Target creature can't block this turn. • Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
737569.translation: 每当一个由你操控的海盗攻击时，选择一项，且不得是本回合中此前选过的～ •  派出一个珍宝衍生物。 •  目标生物本回合不能进行阻挡。 •  放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

737571.oracleText: "By fire and lightning, tooth and claw, we will send these invaders fleeing back to Torrezon!"
737571.translation: 「烈火闪电、尖牙利爪，我们会凭手中一切将这些入侵者赶回图瑞琮！」

737572.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks or blocks while you control a Dinosaur, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
737572.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你操控恐龙时攻击或阻挡，CARDNAME得+1/+1直到回合结束。

737573.oracleText: Whenever Burning Sun Cavalry attacks or blocks while you control a Dinosaur, Burning Sun Cavalry gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
737573.translation: 每当炙阳骑兵于你操控恐龙时攻击或阻挡，炙阳骑兵得+1/+1直到回合结束。

737575.oracleText:
"For ‘immortal conquerors,' these vampires seem very susceptible to being crushed by boulders."
—Chara Rebal, bat rider
737575.translation:
这些自称「永生征服者」的吸血鬼，似乎很容易就被巨石压扁。」
～蝙蝠骑手查拉雷拔

737576.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature and each planeswalker, where X is the number of Caves you control plus the number of Cave cards in your graveyard.
737576.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的洞窟数量与你坟墓场中的洞窟牌数量之总和。

737577.oracleText: Calamitous Cave-In deals X damage to each creature and each planeswalker, where X is the number of Caves you control plus the number of Cave cards in your graveyard.
737577.translation: 灾难塌陷对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成X点伤害，X为由你操控的洞窟数量与你坟墓场中的洞窟牌数量之总和。

737579.oracleText: It is a living eruption, unquenchable fury given form.
737579.translation: 它是火山喷发的化身，是不熄愤怒的具现。

737580.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Child of the Volcano.
737580.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则在火山之子上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737582.oracleText: "Put your hammers away and bring me some blankets! Such a gift from Tilonalli must be handled with the utmost care."
737582.translation: 「收起锤子，拿几条毛毯过来！此等蒂洛纳理赋礼必得悉心呵护。」

737583.oracleText: Whenever you discover, discover again for the same value. This ability triggers only once each turn.
737583.translation: 每当你倾探时，再度倾探相同数值。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

737587.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, create a Treasure token."
737587.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有「每当此生物攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。」

737590.translation:
「哇，莎希莉会爱上你的。」
～华特莉

737596.oracleText: "Thought you were out of my skull-bashin' range, didn't you?"
737596.translation: 「你是不是以为我砸不到你脑袋了?」

737597.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact other than Dire Blunderbuss. When you do, this creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature.
737597.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个焦炬短炮以外的神器。当你如此作时，此生物对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

737598.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+0 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact other than Dire Blunderbuss. When you do, this creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature."
737598.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+0且具有「每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个焦炬短炮以外的神器。当你如此作时，此生物对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。」

737600.oracleText:
"A little innovation can lead to a big score."
—Admiral Beckett Brass
737600.translation:
「小小发明可能带来大收获。」
～贝克蒂霸司总帅

737604.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Until end of turn, target creature gains haste and gets +X/+0, where X is the number of artifacts you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
737604.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：直到回合结束，目标生物获得敏捷异能且得+X/+0，X为由你操控的神器数量。只能于法术时机起动。

737606.oracleText:
"That's the fifth ship lost in three days! Can't we build them out of something stronger?"
—Malcolm Lee
737606.translation:
「这已是三天来损失的第五艘了！我们就不能用更坚固的东西来造船吗？」
～马科姆李

737607.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, destroy target artifact that player controls.
737607.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的神器。

737608.oracleText: Until end of turn, target attacking creature gets +2/+2 and gains trample and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, destroy target artifact that player controls."
737608.translation: 直到回合结束，目标进行攻击的生物得+2/+2且获得践踏与「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，消灭目标由该牌手操控的神器。」

737610.oracleText: "He would've wanted me to have it!"
737610.translation: 「他肯定不希望我能得到这玩意！」

737611.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, create a Treasure token.
737611.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则派出一个珍宝衍生物。

737619.oracleText: Enterprising goblins can extract their body weight in loot. Ambitious ones have a big meal first.
737619.translation: 雄心勃勃的鬼怪会尽可能地减轻体重好带出更多财宝。而野心勃勃的鬼怪则会先饱餐一顿。

737620.oracleText: As long as you control an artifact, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and has haste.
737620.translation: 高必究只要你操控神器，CARDNAME便得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

737621.oracleText: As long as you control an artifact, Goblin Tomb Raider gets +1/+0 and has haste.
737621.translation: 高必究只要你操控神器，古墓奇鬼便得+1/+0且具有敏捷异能。

737623.oracleText:
"Let's send our vampiric visitors a welcoming party, shall we?"
—Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
737623.translation:
「吸血鬼朋友远道而来，就让我们来为他们接风洗尘如何？」
～千月统帅阿妮帕卡

737624.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
737624.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物：目标生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

737626.oracleText: Discover 10. If the discovered card's mana value is less than 10, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to the difference.
737626.translation: 倾探10。如果所倾探之牌的法术力值小于10，则派出等同于该差距数量之已横置的珍宝衍生物。

737628.oracleText: As the surface-dwellers became bolder in their intrusions, Oltec artificers began to repurpose courier gnomes for intelligence gathering and distraction.
737628.translation: 随着地上人的入侵行动愈发大胆，欧尔特克神器师们便开始改装信使侏械，派作收集情报、吸引注意之用。

737635.oracleText: Whenever you attack, you may discard a card. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature. It gains trample until end of turn.
737635.translation: 每当你攻击时，你可以弃一张牌。当你如此作时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

737636.oracleText: Whenever you discard one or more cards, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until your next end step.
737636.translation: 每当你弃一张或数张牌时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你的下一个结束步骤，你可以使用该牌。

737640.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures your opponents control are dealt excess noncombat damage, create a Treasure token.
737640.translation: 每当由对手操控的一个或数个生物受到过量的非战斗伤害时，你派出一个珍宝衍生物。

737642.oracleText: If a red source you control would deal an amount of noncombat damage less than Ojer Axonil's power to an opponent, that source deals damage equal to Ojer Axonil's power instead.
737642.translation: 如果由你操控的红色来源将对一个对手造成低于安雄理尊神力量的非战斗伤害，则改为造成等同于安雄理尊神力量的伤害。

737643.oracleText: When Ojer Axonil dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed under its owner's control.
737643.translation: 当安雄理尊神死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场且已转化。

737645.oracleText: Chimil gave the Oltec passion. Ojer Axonil challenged them to harness it.
737645.translation: 奇密理让欧尔特克激情澎湃。安雄理尊神教他们如何有序挥洒。

737646.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if red sources you controlled dealt 4 or more noncombat damage this turn and only as a sorcery.
737646.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：转化CARDNAME。 只能于由你操控的红色来源总共造成过4点或更多非战斗伤害的回合中起动，且仅限法术时机。

737647.oracleText: {o2oR}, {oT}: Transform Temple of Power. Activate only if red sources you controlled dealt 4 or more noncombat damage this turn and only as a sorcery.
737647.translation: {o2oR}，{oT}：转化力量殿堂。 只能于由你操控的红色来源总共造成过4点或更多非战斗伤害的回合中起动，且仅限法术时机。

737649.oracleText: Early Sun Empire expeditions learned the hard way that some surface dinosaurs were particularly ill-suited to the caverns' enclosed environments.
737649.translation: 最初一批深入地底的烈阳帝国探险队在付出惨痛代价后，才知道有些地表恐龙并不适应洞窟这样的幽闭环境。

737650.oracleText: {oT}: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.

737651.oracleText: {oT}: Panicked Altisaur deals 2 damage to each opponent.
737651.translation: {oT}：惊慌硕伟龙向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

737653.oracleText: "Whatever it is, it set off a trap. It must be valuable!"
737653.translation: 「不管是什么，它触发了机关，一定很值钱！」

737657.oracleText: Whenever one or more Dinosaurs you control attack, create that many Treasure tokens.
737657.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个恐龙攻击时，派出等量的珍宝衍生物。

737658.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, create a 3/1 red Dinosaur creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
737658.translation: 每当你施放神器咒语时，派出一个3/1红色恐龙衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

737660.oracleText: Anticipating tight spaces and trivial fauna, the first Dusk Legion expeditions were small, mobile, and lightly armored. Hundreds of casualties later, they started sending plate-clad platoons.
737660.translation: 最初一批深入地底的暮影军团探险队以为洞窟里面地形狭窄、动物稀少，因此便散作灵活机动的小规模团队轻装出阵。在减员高达数百人之后，他们才开始派出装甲部队。

737661.oracleText: Rampaging Ceratops can't be blocked except by three or more creatures.
737661.translation: 莽闯特角龙只能被三个或更多生物阻挡。

737662.oracleText: Sometimes an expedition reaches a natural conclusion. Sometimes it all just comes crashing down.
737662.translation: 有时探险会自然结束。有时探险则会突然结束。

737665.oracleText: Craft with one or more Dinosaurs {o4oR}
737665.translation: 以一个或更多恐龙化炼{o4oR}

737667.oracleText: While Huatli ventured underground, Saheeli used her unique expertise to bolster the Sun Empire's defenses.
737667.translation: 当华特莉深入地底时，莎希莉利用她的独门手艺来巩固烈阳帝国的防线。

737668.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the total power of the exiled cards used to craft it.
737668.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于用以化炼它所放逐之牌的力量总和。

737669.oracleText: Mastercraft Raptor's power is equal to the total power of the exiled cards used to craft it.
737669.translation: 巧艺迅猛龙的力量等同于用以化炼它所放逐之牌的力量总和。

737671.oracleText:
"She's a smart one. Noticed all on her own that the bloodsuckers wave their hands around to do their filthy magic, so she rips off their hands first."
—Citamitzin, Sun Empire warrior
737671.translation:
「她很聪明。在意识到那群吸血鬼手上要有动作才能施展肮脏魔法之后，她就抢先把他们的手都扯了下来。」
～烈阳帝国战士希坦钦

737672.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, if it's not their turn, CARDNAME deals 4 damage to them.
737672.translation: 每当任一牌手施放咒语时，若当前不是该牌手的回合，则CARDNAME对其造成4点伤害。

737673.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, if it's not their turn, Scytheclaw Raptor deals 4 damage to them.
737673.translation: 每当任一牌手施放咒语时，若当前不是该牌手的回合，则镰爪迅猛龙对其造成4点伤害。

737675.oracleText: {o2oR}, Sacrifice a land: Draw a card.

737677.oracleText: "Let Tilonalli's light burn a path through this darkness."
737677.translation: 「让蒂洛纳理的光芒在黑暗中烧出一条通路。」

737678.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice Sunfire Torch. When you do, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.
737678.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个阳焰炬。若你如此作，此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

737679.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice Sunfire Torch. When you do, this creature deals 2 damage to any target."
737679.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且具有「每当此生物攻击时，你可以牺牲一个阳焰炬。若你如此作，此生物对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。」

737681.oracleText: As the Legion of Dusk closed in, Oltec citizens rallied to support the Thousand Moons and drive off the invaders.
737681.translation: 随着暮影军团逐渐逼近，欧尔特克市民自发集结起来支援千月军击退入侵者。

737682.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent. Activate only as a sorcery.
737682.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和/或生物：CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

737683.oracleText: Tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control: Sunshot Militia deals 1 damage to each opponent. Activate only as a sorcery.
737683.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和/或生物：阳击民兵向每位对手各造成1点伤害。只能于法术时机起动。

737685.oracleText:
"The ground is on fire, the ceiling's made of spears, and I think a mushroom tried to curse me. Don't tell me not to panic!"
—Jino Grag, Brazen Coalition scout
737685.translation:
「 地上着火，天上下矛，还有个蘑菇想要诅咒我。你让我怎么不慌张！」
～莽霸联盟斥候基诺格拉格

737686.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature they control.
737686.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

737687.oracleText: Tectonic Hazard deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature they control.
737687.translation: 地壳灾害向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物各造成1点伤害。

737689.oracleText: With crunchy outer shells and juicy innards, cave crawlers quickly became a favorite snack of the Sun Empire's dinosaur companions.
737689.translation: 洞窟爬虫外壳酥脆、内脏多汁，很快就成了烈阳帝国恐龙行伴的最爱点心。

737690.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature equal to 2 or the greatest power among Dinosaurs you control, whichever is greater.
737690.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于2与「由你操控之恐龙中的最大力量」两者间较大者。

737691.oracleText: Triumphant Chomp deals damage to target creature equal to 2 or the greatest power among Dinosaurs you control, whichever is greater.
737691.translation: 得胜撕咬对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于2与「由你操控之恐龙中的最大力量」两者间较大者。

737695.oracleText: {o2oR}, Discard CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
737695.translation: {o2oR}，弃掉CARDNAME：它对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

737696.oracleText: {o2oR}, Discard Trumpeting Carnosaur: It deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
737696.translation: {o2oR}，弃掉长吼食肉龙：它对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

737698.oracleText: Touched eons ago by Ojer Axonil's flaming macuahuitl, it still burns with his boundless fury.
737698.translation: 万千年前它曾蒙安雄理尊神的火焰石锯剑触碰，如今它内里仍燃烧着无尽怒火。

737699.oracleText: Whenever Volatile Wanderglyph becomes tapped, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
737699.translation: 每当易怒漫游符成为横置时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。

737701.oracleText: The owner of target artifact or creature with mana value 1 or greater shuffles it into their library. Then that player discovers X, where X is its mana value.
737701.translation: 目标法术力值等于或大于1之神器或生物的拥有者将它洗入其牌库。然后该牌手倾探X，X为它的法术力值。

737703.oracleText:
"She's devoted to protecting her herd. We're just lucky she considers us part of it."
—Huatli
737703.translation:
「她会全心尽力地保护自己的族群。能被她视作自己人，我们实属荣幸。」
～华特莉

737708.oracleText:
"Even our most learned philosophers can only hope to approach the inner serenity of the humble capybara."
—Nelli, Oltec didact
737708.translation:
「就连我们知识最渊博的哲学家，也只能希冀自己终能达到水豚一般的平静境界。」
～欧尔特克布道人奈莉

737709.oracleText: Descend 4 — CARDNAME gets +3/+0 as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737709.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，CARDNAME便得+3/+0。

737710.oracleText: Descend 4 — Basking Capybara gets +3/+0 as long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737710.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，沐日水豚便得+3/+0。

737712.oracleText: Many temples have strong foundations. Few are also wise.
737712.translation: 许多殿堂都有坚实的根基。少数根基还充满智慧。

737716.oracleText: {o3oG}: CARDNAME can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
737716.translation: {o3oG}：CARDNAME本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

737717.oracleText: {o3oG}: Cavern Stomper can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn.
737717.translation: {o3oG}：洞窟跺地龙本回合不能被力量等于或小于2的生物阻挡。

737719.oracleText: "If you're afraid to dive into the unknown, how will you ever find anything new?"
737719.translation: 「你若是害怕潜入未知之境，又岂能发现新鲜事物？」

737722.oracleText: The difference between trash and treasure is a matter of perspective.
737722.translation: 废物和宝物之间，不过是观点差异。

737726.oracleText: Accustomed to hunting nimble flying prey, the dinosaur was delighted to have its meal delivered neatly in a box.
737726.translation: 这恐龙虽早已惯于猎捕动作灵巧的飞行猎物，但有整盒装好喂到嘴边的食物，它也很乐意享用。

737728.oracleText: Search your library for a Cave card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
737728.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张洞窟牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

737729.oracleText: Put three +1/+1 counters on a Cave you control. It becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.
737729.translation: 在一个由你操控的洞窟上放置三个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0，具敏捷异能的元素生物。它仍然是地。

737730.oracleText: Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once. • Search your library for a Cave card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. • Put three +1/+1 counters on a Cave you control. It becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land. • Destroy target enchantment.
737730.translation: 选择三项。你可以多次选择同一项。 •  从你牌库中搜寻一张洞窟牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。 •  在一个由你操控的洞窟上放置三个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0，具敏捷异能的元素生物。它仍然是地。 •  消灭目标结界。

737732.oracleText: "I'm telling you, the wall just blinked!"
737732.translation: 「跟你说，那堵墙刚刚眨了下眼！」

737733.oracleText: Until end of turn, target land you control becomes a 4/4 Dinosaur creature with reach and haste. It's still a land. It must be blocked this turn if able.
737733.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的地成为4/4，具延势与敏捷异能的恐龙生物。它仍然是地。它本回合若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

737735.oracleText:
"I suggest we leave this cavern for someone else to conquer."
—Amalia, master cartographer
737735.translation:
「我提议让其他人来征服这洞窟。」
～制图大师阿玛利亚

737740.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
737740.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737741.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Explorer's Cache.
737741.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物死去时，在探险家密储上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737742.oracleText: {oT}: Move a +1/+1 counter from Explorer's Cache onto target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
737742.translation: {oT}：将一个+1/+1指示物从探险家密储移到目标生物上。只能于法术时机起动。

737744.oracleText: A thundering roar calls forth a primeval army.
737744.translation: 雷霆怒吼引来太古大军。

737748.oracleText:
"Wow. It's a good thing we brought a poet."
—Wayta
737748.translation:
「哇。幸好我们带着诗人一起来。」
～乌艾塔

737749.oracleText: Return target Cave card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
737749.translation: 将目标洞窟牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

737750.oracleText: Choose one — • Search your library for a basic Forest card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. • Return target Cave card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
737750.translation: 选择一项～ •  从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林牌，将该牌横置放进战场，然后洗牌。 •  将目标洞窟牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

737752.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it explores.
737752.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，令它勘察。

737753.oracleText: Equipped creature has "You may look at the top card of your library any time" and "Whenever this creature attacks, it explores."
737753.translation: 佩带此武具的生物具有「你可以随时检视你的牌库顶牌」与「每当此生物攻击时，令它勘察。」

737754.oracleText: Though the Sun Empire and the River Heralds once came together to plant the sacred forest, its roots have been tended by the mycoids ever since.
737754.translation: 虽然这片圣洁丛林最初是由烈阳帝国与川流使联手栽下，但其繁密根系却一直是由智蕈悉心照管。

737758.oracleText: {o3o(R/W)o(R/W)}: Exile Huatli, then return her to the battlefield transformed under her owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
737758.translation: {o3o(R/W)o(R/W)}：放逐华特莉，然后将她在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。只能于法术时机起动。

737760.oracleText: Create two 3/3 green Dinosaur creature tokens.
737760.translation: 派出两个3/3绿色恐龙衍生生物。

737761.oracleText: Creatures you control have "{oT}: Add {oR}, {oG}, or {oW}."
737761.translation: 由你操控的生物具有「{oT}：加{oR}，{oG}或{oW}。」

737762.oracleText: CARDNAME gains "Creatures you control have ‘{oT}: Add {oR}, {oG}, or {oW}.'"
737762.translation: CARDNAME获得「由你操控的生物具有「{oT}：加{oR}，{oG}或{oW}。」」

737763.oracleText: Roar of the Fifth People gains "Creatures you control have ‘{oT}: Add {oR}, {oG}, or {oW}.'"
737763.translation: 第五势力之吼获得「由你操控的生物具有「{oT}：加{oR}，{oG}或{oW}。」」

737764.oracleText: Search your library for a Dinosaur card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
737764.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张恐龙牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

737765.oracleText: Dinosaurs you control gain double strike and trample until end of turn.
737765.translation: 由你操控的恐龙获得连击与践踏异能直到回合结束。

737767.oracleText:
"Inti's name will grace our poems and histories for generations. Yours will collect dust, forgotten, in this cave."
—Huatli, to Vito
737767.translation:
「因提之名将随我们的诗歌与史诗传扬万代。而你的名字将在这洞窟里落寞蒙灰、遭人遗忘。」
～华特莉怒斥维托

737769.oracleText:
"I watched him rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half once. A few vampires will barely slow him down."
—Huatli
737769.translation:
「我曾见过他一口将非瑞克西亚无畏舰咬成两半。区区几个吸血鬼根本拖不住他。」
～华特莉

737772.oracleText:
"Finally, those glowing purple bone-monsters are gone and we can get back to the real excitement: archaeology!"
—Quintorius Kand
737772.translation:
「那些冒着紫色幽光的骨头怪物终于消失不见，接下来可以回头来作激动人心的事情了：考古！」
～昆托力康德

737777.oracleText: "Did we follow the dinosaurs out of the caverns, or did they follow us? These glyphs could change our entire understanding of our history."
737777.translation: 「是我们跟随恐龙走出洞窟，还是恐龙跟着我们？这些雕符或会彻底改变我们对历史的认知。」

737778.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Dinosaur spell or activate an ability of a Dinosaur source.
737778.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放恐龙咒语或起动恐龙来源的异能。

737784.oracleText: When the merfolk fled underground, they brought the life force of the jungle with them.
737784.translation: 当人鱼逃亡地下时，他们一并带走了丛林的生命之力。

737788.oracleText: The River Heralds found clues to a grand heritage below Ixalan's surface.
737788.translation: 川流使发现的线索表明，依夏兰地表之下尚有一处宏伟遗迹等待发掘。

737796.oracleText: The Oltec long ago abandoned the caverns to the mycoids, but the Deep Gods still keep watch over the spore-strewn darkness.
737796.translation: 虽然欧尔特克人很久之前就已抛弃洞窟，任由智蕈在其间生长，但深邃诸神仍在看护这片遍布孢子的无边黑暗。

737798.oracleText:
"Let's not give the surface-dwellers time to learn what tactics work best here."
—Daram, Malamet marshal
737798.translation:
「别让地上人有时间学到在这边哪种战术最有用。」
～豹族元帅达兰

737801.oracleText: "I bear the marking of the Deep King, and in his name I will rend you to nothing but spores on the wind!"
737801.translation: 「我身上有深邃王的印记，以他之名我要将你化作风中残孢！」

737802.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target attacking creature gains trample until end of turn.
737802.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标进行攻击的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

737803.oracleText: Whenever Malamet Brawler attacks, target attacking creature gains trample until end of turn.
737803.translation: 每当好斗豹族攻击时，目标进行攻击的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

737807.oracleText: The mightiest Malamet warriors train as titan-killers, elite champions capable of facing down the caverns' most fearsome beasts.
737807.translation: 最孔武有力的豹族战士会受训成为巨兽杀手，他们是族中的精英斗士，能够与洞窟中最恐怖的怪物相匹敌。

737808.oracleText: Descend 4 — Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
737808.translation: 落坟4～每当CARDNAME攻击时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737809.oracleText: Descend 4 — Whenever Malamet Veteran attacks, if there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
737809.translation: 落坟4～每当豹族老兵攻击时，若你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，则在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737811.oracleText: Anything that falls into the pit—relics, rubble, even corpses—ends up snared in its magic-infused web.
737811.translation: 掉下坑中的一切～无论是遗宝、碎砾还是尸体～最后都会落在它的魔法蛛网里面。

737817.oracleText: Whenever Ojer Kaslem deals combat damage to a player, reveal that many cards from the top of your library. You may put a creature card and/or a land card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
737817.translation: 每当卡司勒尊神对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从你的牌库顶展示等量的牌。你可以将其中一张生物牌和／或一张地牌放进战场。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

737818.oracleText: When Ojer Kaslem dies, return it to the battlefield tapped and transformed under its owner's control.
737818.translation: 当卡司勒尊神死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下横置移回战场且已转化。

737820.oracleText: Chimil gave the Oltec sacred lands. Ojer Kaslem brought them to life.
737820.translation: 奇密理使欧尔特克满布沃土。卡司勒尊神令此地充满勃勃生机。

737821.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if you control ten or more permanents and only as a sorcery.
737821.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}：转化CARDNAME。只能于你操控十个或更多永久物时起动，且仅限法术时机。

737822.oracleText: {o2oG}, {oT}: Transform Temple of Cultivation. Activate only if you control ten or more permanents and only as a sorcery.
737822.translation: {o2oG}，{oT}：转化殖生殿堂。只能于你操控十个或更多永久物时起动，且仅限法术时机。

737824.oracleText: Target creature you control explores, then it explores again.
737824.translation: 令目标由你操控的生物勘察，然后再勘察。

737825.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target artifact or enchantment. • Target creature you control explores, then it explores again.
737825.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器或结界。 •  令目标由你操控的生物勘察，然后再勘察。

737827.oracleText: When you don't know what dangers you'll face, bring the biggest danger with you.
737827.translation: 当你不知道会遇到何种凶险时，不妨将最大的凶险带在身边。

737830.oracleText:
"Bright as any dinosaur—and just as with other great hunters, its colors are a warning."
—Huatli
737830.translation:
「 它像恐龙一样光鲜亮丽~而这也跟其他捕食者一样，明亮的颜色就是一种警告。」
～华特莉

737831.oracleText: {o2}: CARDNAME gains deathtouch until end of turn.
737831.translation: {o2}：CARDNAME获得死触异能直到回合结束。

737832.oracleText: {o2}: Poison Dart Frog gains deathtouch until end of turn.
737832.translation: {o2}：毒镖蛙获得死触异能直到回合结束。

737834.oracleText:
"I don't know whether it hates the mycoids or just loves breaking things. I say we leave it be."
—Samin, Oltec scout
737834.translation:
「我不知道它是跟智蕈有仇还是只是喜欢砸东西。随它去吧。」
～欧尔特克斥候撒明

737835.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while you don't control another Dinosaur, put a stun counter on it.
737835.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你未操控另一个恐龙时攻击，在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

737836.oracleText: Whenever Pugnacious Hammerskull attacks while you don't control another Dinosaur, put a stun counter on it.
737836.translation: 每当好斗颅锤龙于你未操控另一个恐龙时攻击，在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

737840.oracleText: "We weren't fleeing a broken world. We were running toward paradise!"
737840.translation: 「我们并非逃离破败世界。我们是在奔向天堂！」

737841.oracleText: {o2oG}: CARDNAME explores. Activate only as a sorcery.
737841.translation: {o2oG}：令CARDNAME勘察。只能于法术时机起动。

737842.oracleText: {o2oG}: Seeker of Sunlight explores. Activate only as a sorcery.
737842.translation: {o2oG}：令寻光客勘察。只能于法术时机起动。

737845.oracleText: "Halt, traveler. Whatever you seek, you will not find it here."
737845.translation: 「站住，旅人。不管你在找什么，它都不在这里。」

737849.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control die, create a green Fungus Dinosaur creature token with base power and toughness each equal to the total power of those creatures.
737849.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，派出一个绿色真菌/恐龙衍生生物，其基础力量与防御力各等同于死去生物之力量总和。

737850.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Double target creature's power until end of turn.
737850.translation: {o2}，{oT}：将目标生物的力量加倍直到回合结束。

737856.oracleText:
"Ah well . . . the temple was due for a new roof anyhow."
—Kusi, Oltec gardener
737856.translation:
「啊…反正神殿的屋顶也该翻新了。」
～欧尔特克园丁库西

737858.oracleText: Every mycoid carries within itself the makings of an entire colony.
737858.translation: 每个智蕈内里都能创造整个群落。

737859.oracleText: {o5oGoG}: Put seven +1/+1 counters on target noncreature land you control. It becomes a 0/0 Fungus creature with haste. It's still a land.
737859.translation: {o5oGoG}：在目标由你操控的非生物地上放置七个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0，具敏捷异能的真菌生物。它仍然是地。

737860.oracleText:
"I suppose we'll just hope those ancient monoliths lost to our people for centuries weren't particularly important."
—Toxayac, Sun Empire historian
737860.translation:
「这些远古巨石已失落我们人民手中达千百年之久，就希望它们没有那么重要好了。」
～烈阳帝国史家托夏亚

737862.oracleText: If a creature you control would explore, instead you scry 1, then that creature explores.
737862.translation: 如果某个由你操控的生物将勘察，则改为你占卜1，然后该生物勘察。

737868.oracleText: {o3oG}, {oT}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
737868.translation: {o3oG}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中的一张生物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

737870.oracleText: Return up to one target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. Discover 4.
737870.translation: 将至多一张目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。倾探4。

737872.oracleText: "Come, friends. Let us see if this world remembers us."
737872.translation: 「来吧，朋友，看看这个世界是否还记得我们。」

737873.oracleText: {o1oWoU}: Exile another target creature or artifact you control. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
737873.translation: {o1oWoU}：放逐另一个目标由你操控的生物或神器。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

737875.oracleText: Descend 4 — As long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +2/+2 and has trample.
737875.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，CARDNAME便得+2/+2且具有践踏异能。

737876.oracleText: Descend 4 — As long as there are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard, Akawalli, the Seething Tower gets +2/+2 and has trample.
737876.translation: 落坟4～只要你坟墓场中有四张或更多永久物牌，火热伟菇阿卡瓦利便得+2/+2且具有践踏异能。

737877.oracleText: Descend 8 — As long as there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard, Akawalli gets an additional +2/+2 and can't be blocked by more than one creature.
737877.translation: 落坟8～只要你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，火热伟菇阿卡瓦利便再得+2/+2且不能被多于一个生物阻挡。

737878.translation: 阿玛利亚贝纳维德阿格雷

737879.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, CARDNAME explores. Then destroy all other creatures if its power is exactly 20.
737879.translation: 每当你获得生命时，令CARDNAME勘察。然后如果其力量为正好20，则消灭所有其他生物。

737880.oracleText: Whenever you gain life, Amalia Benavides Aguirre explores. Then destroy all other creatures if its power is exactly 20.
737880.translation: 每当你获得生命时，令阿玛利亚贝纳维德阿格雷勘察。然后如果其力量为正好20，则消灭所有其他生物。

737883.oracleText: Descend 8 — CARDNAME can't attack or block unless there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737883.translation: 落坟8～除非你的坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，否则CARDNAME不能进行攻击或阻挡。

737884.oracleText: Descend 8 — The Ancient One can't attack or block unless there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
737884.translation: 落坟8～除非你的坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，否则远古祖神不能进行攻击或阻挡。

737885.oracleText: {o2oUoB}: Draw a card, then discard a card. When you discard a card this way, target player mills cards equal to its mana value.
737885.translation: {o2oUoB}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。当你以此法弃一张牌时，目标牌手磨数量等同于其法术力值的牌。

737887.oracleText: "If we are to protect this world, we can no longer hide within it!"
737887.translation: 「我们若要保护这个世界，就不能再藏身其中！」

737888.oracleText: Whenever you attack with one or more non-Gnome creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on Anim Pakal, then create X 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens that are tapped and attacking, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on Anim Pakal.
737888.translation: 每当你以一个或数个非地侏生物攻击时，在阿妮帕卡上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后派出X个1/1无色地侏衍生神器生物，其为横置且正进行攻击，X为阿妮帕卡上的+1/+1指示物数量。

737890.oracleText: "Bless this sinner, who sacrificed his blood so that I may live."
737890.translation: [祝福这位罪人，他献出了自己的鲜血，让我能够活下去。」

737891.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
737891.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或神器：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737892.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on Bartolome del Presidio.
737892.translation: 牺牲另一个生物或神器：在巴洛梅德普西迪奥上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737894.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a Treasure token. Until end of turn, you may look at the top card of your library any time, and you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
737894.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。直到回合结束，你可以随时检视你的牌库顶牌，且你可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放咒语。

737895.oracleText: Whenever The Belligerent attacks, create a Treasure token. Until end of turn, you may look at the top card of your library any time, and you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
737895.translation: 每当好战者号攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。直到回合结束，你可以随时检视你的牌库顶牌，且你可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放咒语。

737897.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control. If you do, discover 3.
737897.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物。若你如此作，则倾探3。

737898.oracleText: Whenever Caparocti Sunborn attacks, you may tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control. If you do, discover 3.
737898.translation: 每当炫日卡帕罗提攻击时，你可以横置两个由你操控且未横置的神器和／或生物。若你如此作，则倾探3。

737900.oracleText: "To the mother lode, and death take the wary!"

737904.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, CARDNAME explores. Then you may have it become a copy of another creature you control until end of turn.
737904.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，令CARDNAME勘察。然后你可以使它成为另一个由你操控的生物之复制品直到回合结束。

737905.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, Deepfathom Echo explores. Then you may have it become a copy of another creature you control until end of turn.
737905.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，令深涧念世灵勘察。然后你可以使它成为另一个由你操控的生物之复制品直到回合结束。

737907.oracleText:
"Dinosaurs have no concept of royalty, but they recognize the scent of the mightiest among them."
—Atla Palani, nest tender
737907.translation:
「恐龙不知忠诚，但能闻出最强者的气味。」
～护巢人娥拉帕拉尼

737912.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card with mana value 3 or less, put it into your hand. Otherwise, you may put it into your graveyard.
737912.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌，则将它置于你手上。若否，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

737913.oracleText: Whenever Kellan, Daring Traveler attacks, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card with mana value 3 or less, put it into your hand. Otherwise, you may put it into your graveyard.
737913.translation: 每当胆识旅人凯澜攻击时，展示你的牌库顶牌。如果它是法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌，则将它置于你手上。若否，则你可以将它置入你的坟墓场。

737914.oracleText: Create X Map tokens, where X is one plus the number of opponents who control an artifact.
737914.translation: 派出X个地图衍生物，X为操控神器的对手数量加一。

737916.oracleText: "Invaders in the West Chasm? Give me an hour and they'll be fungus food."
737916.translation: 「西部峡谷有入侵者？给我一小时，他们很快就会变成真菌的食物。」

737917.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control each with power greater than its base power deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.
737917.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且力量比其基础力量大的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌。

737923.oracleText:
"The Fomori are a foul and distant memory, but their war machines taught us much about large-scale armorcraft."
—Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
737923.translation:
「虽然佛莫里人依旧是不堪回首的遥远回忆，但他们的战争机械对我们铸造大型装甲裨益良多。」
～千月统帅阿妮帕卡

737924.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 4/4 white and blue Golem artifact creature token. Activate only if CARDNAME or another artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
737924.translation: {oT}：派出一个4/4， 白蓝双色的魔像衍生神器生物。只能于CARDNAME或另一个神器在你操控下进战场的回合中起动。

737925.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 4/4 white and blue Golem artifact creature token. Activate only if Master's Manufactory or another artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
737925.translation: {oT}：派出一个4/4， 白蓝双色的魔像衍生神器生物。只能于大师组装厂或另一个神器在你操控下进战场的回合中起动。

737927.oracleText: Destroy target noncreature, nonland permanent with mana value 1 or less.
737927.translation: 消灭目标法术力值等于或小于1、非生物且非地的永久物。

737928.oracleText: Choose one. If you descended this turn, you may choose both instead. • Destroy target creature or planeswalker. • Destroy target noncreature, nonland permanent with mana value 1 or less.
737928.translation: 选择一项。如果你本回合中有落坟，则你可以改为都选。 •  消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。 •  消灭目标法术力值等于或小于1、非生物且非地的永久物。

737931.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control that are Fungi and/or Saprolings.
737931.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控且为真菌和／或腐生物之生物的总数量。

737932.oracleText: The Mycotyrant's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control that are Fungi and/or Saprolings.
737932.translation: 智蕈暴君的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控且为真菌和／或腐生物之生物的总数量。

737933.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create X 1/1 black Fungus creature tokens with "This creature can't block," where X is the number of times you descended this turn.
737933.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，派出X个1/1黑色真菌衍生生物，且具有「此生物不能进行阻挡，」，X为本回合你落坟的次数。

737935.oracleText: "This water can guide you anywhere, if you know how to ask."
737935.translation: 「如果你晓得如何发问，水流便能指引你去往任何地方。」

737936.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores a land card, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
737936.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察到地牌时，你可以将一张地牌从你手上横置放进战场。

737937.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
737937.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察到非地牌时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737938.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control explores a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on Nicanzil, Current Conductor.
737938.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物勘察到非地牌时，在水流通导师妮坎琪上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

737942.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control one or more Eggs, sacrifice an Egg, then create a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token.
737942.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你操控一个或数个蛋，则牺牲一个蛋，然后派出一个3/3绿色恐龙衍生生物。

737945.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
737945.translation: 每当你从放逐区施放咒语时，CARDNAME对每位对手各造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。

737946.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, Quintorius Kand deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
737946.translation: 每当你从放逐区施放咒语时，昆托力康德对每位对手各造成2点伤害且你获得2点生命。

737947.oracleText: Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
737947.translation: 派出一个3/2，红白双色的精怪衍生生物。

737949.oracleText: Exile any number of target cards from your graveyard. Add {oR} for each card exiled this way. You may play those cards this turn.
737949.translation: 将任意数量目标牌从你的坟墓场放逐。每以此法放逐一张牌，便加{oR}。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。

737951.oracleText: What began as a single gift for Huatli became a battalion of automatons unlike anything ever seen on Ixalan.
737951.translation: 原本只是送给华特莉的礼物，最终变成了依夏兰前所未见的机械大军。

737952.oracleText: {oUoR}, {oT}: Create a token that's a copy of another target creature or artifact you control, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types. It gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
737952.translation: {oUoR}，{oT}：派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为另一个目标由你操控的生物或神器之复制品，但它额外具有神器此类别。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

737955.oracleText: As surface empires send their explorers down, his hungry eyes look upward.
737955.translation: 随着地表诸帝国派人下探，他的饥饿眼光便开始瞄向地上。

737956.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, for each creature you control with power greater than that creature's base power, put a number of +1/+1 counters on that creature equal to the difference.
737956.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，对每个由你操控且力量比其基础力量大的生物而言，在该生物上放置等同于该差距数量的+1/+1指示物。

737957.oracleText: Whenever Sovereign Okinec Ahau attacks, for each creature you control with power greater than that creature's base power, put a number of +1/+1 counters on that creature equal to the difference.
737957.translation: 每当豹王欧奇尼亚豪攻击时，对每个由你操控且力量比其基础力量大的生物而言，在该生物上放置等同于该差距数量的+1/+1指示物。

737959.oracleText: Due to archaic Brazen Coalition guidelines regarding hats, a few mycoids are now technically pirate captains.
737959.translation: 根据莽霸联盟关于帽子的陈年规定，有几个智蕈如今严格来说已是海盗船长。

737960.oracleText: Fathomless descent — Return to the battlefield target nonland permanent card in your graveyard with mana value less than or equal to the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
737960.translation: 落坟无边～将目标非地永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且其法术力值须等于或小于你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。

737963.oracleText: Descend 8 — {o4oUoB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard and only as a sorcery.
737963.translation: 落坟8～{o4oUoB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌时起动，且仅限法术时机。

737964.oracleText: Descend 8 — {o4oUoB}: Return Uchbenbak, the Great Mistake from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard and only as a sorcery.
737964.translation: 落坟8～{o4oUoB}：将厄灾骨绷霸从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。只能于你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌时起动，且仅限法术时机。

737966.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another permanent, you gain 2 life if this is the first time this ability has resolved this turn. If it's the second time, each opponent loses 2 life. If it's the third time, create a 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying.
737966.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个永久物时，如果这是此异能在本回合第一次的结算，则你获得2点生命。如果是第二次的结算，则每位对手各失去2点生命。如果是第三次的结算，则派出一个4/3，白黑双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

737968.oracleText: Descend 8 — Choose one. If there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard as you cast this spell, choose one or more instead. • Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. • Target opponent discards a card. • Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
737968.translation: 落坟8～选择一项。如果于你施放此咒语时你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌，则改为选择一项或多项。 •  将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。 •  目标对手弃一张牌。 •  检视你牌库顶的三张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，其余则置入你的坟墓场。

737970.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, each opponent may discard a card or sacrifice a permanent. CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each opponent who didn't.
737970.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则每位对手各可以弃一张牌或牺牲一个永久物。CARDNAME向每位未如此作的对手各造成3点伤害。

737971.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, each opponent may discard a card or sacrifice a permanent. Zoyowa Lava-Tongue deals 3 damage to each opponent who didn't.
737971.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中有落坟，则每位对手各可以弃一张牌或牺牲一个永久物。熔岩舌佐佑瓦向每位未如此作的对手各造成3点伤害。

737973.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Buried Treasure: Add one mana of any color.
737973.translation: {oT}，牺牲遭埋珍宝：加一点任意颜色的法术力。
