737974.oracleText: {o5}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Discover 5. Activate only as a sorcery.
737974.translation: {o5}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：倾探5。只能于法术时机起动。

737975.oracleText: {o5}, Exile Buried Treasure from your graveyard: Discover 5. Activate only as a sorcery.
737975.translation: {o5}，从你的坟墓场放逐遭埋珍宝：倾探5。只能于法术时机起动。

737977.oracleText: Whenever Careening Mine Cart attacks, create a Treasure token.
737977.translation: 每当偏斜矿车攻击时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

737979.oracleText: Ever since the Fomori's attempt long ago to extinguish Chimil's light, the Oltec have taken extensive measures to never get lost in the Core.
737979.translation: 自从许久以前佛莫里人尝试熄灭奇密理后，欧尔特克人就已采取大量措施防患未然，确保自己在世界核心中不会迷失方向。

737982.oracleText: Spells you control can't be countered.
737982.translation: 由你操控的咒语不能被反击。

737983.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, discover 5.
737983.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，倾探5。

737985.oracleText:
"I'm certain it's some kind of sophisticated navigational tool. If only I had any idea what it was telling me!"
—Colbo, Brazen Coalition surveyor
737985.translation:
「我很肯定这是某种复杂的导航工具。要是能知道它刚才在说什么就好了！」
～莽霸联盟勘探者科尔博

737989.oracleText: Whenever you're dealt combat damage, the attacking player gains control of CARDNAME and untaps it.
737989.translation: 每当你受到战斗伤害时，攻击牌手获得CARDNAME的操控权并将它重置。

737990.oracleText: Whenever you're dealt combat damage, the attacking player gains control of Contested Game Ball and untaps it.
737990.translation: 每当你受到战斗伤害时，攻击牌手获得争竞赛球的操控权并将它重置。

737991.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Draw a card and put a point counter on CARDNAME. Then if it has five or more point counters on it, sacrifice it and create a Treasure token.
737991.translation: {o2}，{oT}：抓一张牌并在CARDNAME上放置一个得分指示物。然后如果其上有五个或更多得分指示物，则牺牲它并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

737992.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Draw a card and put a point counter on Contested Game Ball. Then if it has five or more point counters on it, sacrifice it and create a Treasure token.
737992.translation: {o2}，{oT}：抓一张牌并在争竞赛球上放置一个得分指示物。然后如果其上有五个或更多得分指示物，则牺牲它并派出一个珍宝衍生物。

737994.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Exile up to four target cards from a single graveyard. Activate only as a sorcery.
737994.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：将至多四张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

737995.oracleText: Sacrifice Digsite Conservator: Exile up to four target cards from a single graveyard. Activate only as a sorcery.
737995.translation: 牺牲挖掘点照护械：将至多四张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

737996.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may pay {o4}. If you do, discover 4.
737996.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以支付{o4}。若你如此作，则倾探4。

737997.oracleText: When Digsite Conservator dies, you may pay {o4}. If you do, discover 4.
737997.translation: 当挖掘点照护械死去时，你可以支付{o4}。若你如此作，则倾探4。

737999.oracleText: Wherever the spores begin to take hold, it crushes the ground to rubble.
737999.translation: 一旦孢子在某处集聚，它就会将该地锤个粉碎。

738000.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile target card from an opponent's graveyard.
738000.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标牌从任一对手的坟墓场放逐。

738001.oracleText: Whenever Disruptor Wanderglyph attacks, exile target card from an opponent's graveyard.
738001.translation: 每当滋扰漫游符攻击时，将目标牌从任一对手的坟墓场放逐。

738003.oracleText: They scour for secrets in places too distant or dangerous for humans to tread.
738003.translation: 它们会代替人类前往遥远危险之处探寻秘密。

738004.oracleText: {o2}: Put target card from a graveyard on the bottom of its owner's library.
738004.translation: {o2}：将目标牌从坟墓场置于其拥有者的牌库底。

738006.oracleText:
"Ow! I think a wasp just stung me, cap'n."
—Nirk Doobin, last words
738006.translation:
「哎呀！我好像被黄蜂蜇了一下，船长。」
～纳克多宾的遗言

738009.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Transform CARDNAME. Activate only if there are four or more permanent types among cards in your graveyard.
738009.translation: {o4}，{oT}：转化CARDNAME。只能于你坟墓场中牌的永久物类别有四种或更多时起动。

738012.oracleText: Centuries ago, under siege from the Mycotyrant, the Oltec sealed the Core off from the world . . . until Huatli's party arrived.
738012.translation: 数百年前，由于遭到智蕈暴君的围攻，欧尔特克人被迫封闭世界核心与世隔绝……直到华特莉一行人来到这里为止。

738013.oracleText: Fathomless descent — {oT}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
738013.translation: 落坟无边～{oT}：加X点任意颜色的单色法术力，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数。

748290.translation: 侦结～如果将在你的操控下派出一个或数个衍生物，则改为派出该些衍生物加上一个线索衍生物。

748292.oracleText: To solve — You've gained 5 or more life this turn.
748292.translation: 侦办～你本回合中获得过5点或更多生命。

748293.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard.
748293.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场中施放此牌。

748294.oracleText: Solved — Sacrifice this Case: Creature cards in your graveyard gain "You may cast this card from your graveyard" until end of turn.
748294.translation: 侦结～牺牲此案件：你坟墓场中的生物牌获得「你可以从你坟墓场中施放此牌」直到回合结束。

748296.translation:
「不要在高窗边上争论不休。」
～泰莎

748299.oracleText: "It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you."
748299.translation: 富有人格魅力，消息灵通，懂行。

748300.oracleText: Creatures you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater.
748300.translation: 由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物不能被力量等于或大于3的生物阻挡。

748301.oracleText: If an ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
748301.translation: 如果由你操控且力量等于或小于2之生物的异能触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

748303.oracleText: Parties at Karlov Manor are strictly invitation only.
748303.translation: 毫无帮助。回答问题时只会嘶哈嘶哈地流口水。

748309.oracleText: In a city as old as Ravnica, history takes on a life of its own—even when you least expect it.
748309.translation: 像拉尼卡这样年头悠久的城市，历史都能活出真我～甚至是在你最不希望看到的时候。

748311.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn. Untap them.
748311.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。将它们重置。

748312.oracleText: When Essence of Antiquity is turned face up, creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn. Untap them.
748312.translation: 当古迹菁华翻回正面时，由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。将它们重置。

748315.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, return another target permanent you control to its owner's hand and put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
748315.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，将另一个目标由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上，并在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748316.oracleText: When Forum Familiar is turned face up, return another target permanent you control to its owner's hand and put a +1/+1 counter on Forum Familiar.
748316.translation: 当法院佣兽翻回正面时，将另一个目标由你操控的永久物移回其拥有者手上，并在法院佣兽上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748319.oracleText:
"The desperate will tread unexpected paths. Be prepared to follow."
—Tam Sennic, Ezrim's second-in-command
748319.translation:
「亡命之徒逃跑时会慌不择路。时刻做好准备追上去。」
～伊泽霖副手坦姆森尼克

748322.oracleText: "Call the Boros if you want. While they figure out if they have enough people to send a patrol, I'll be out clobbering the lowlifes who robbed you."
748322.translation: 「你要报官找波洛斯就去报。等他们还在研究是否有人手出队巡逻时，我早就已经把那些抢劫你的混蛋打得满地找牙了。」

748328.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}: Target Detective you control gets +2/+0 and gains vigilance until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
748328.translation: {o3}，{oT}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的侦探得+2/+0且获得警戒异能。只能于法术时机起动。

748330.oracleText: Teysa trusts only those for whom money has no meaning.
748330.translation: 泰莎只信任钱财对其了无意义者。

748331.oracleText: Permanents your opponents control can't be turned face up during your turn.
748331.translation: 由对手操控之永久物于你的回合中不能翻回正面。

748332.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
748332.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

748335.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice Krovod Haunch: You gain 3 life.
748335.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲克瓦兽腿肉骨：你获得3点生命。

748336.oracleText: When CARDNAME is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, create two 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
748336.translation: 当CARDNAME从战场进入坟墓场时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则派出两个1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

748337.oracleText: When Krovod Haunch is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {o1oW}. If you do, create two 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
748337.translation: 当克瓦兽腿肉骨从战场进入坟墓场时，你可以支付{o1oW}。若你如此作，则派出两个1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

748339.oracleText:
"If you're thinking only one step ahead, you're already falling behind."
—Teysa
748339.translation:
「如果你只想到一步之外，那就已经落后了。」
～泰莎

748340.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with power 4 or greater.
748340.translation: 消灭目标神器，结界或力量等于或大于4的生物。

748342.oracleText: Kaya clung to the cords of the barrier ward with all her might, trapping the thrashing dryad like a fly in a spider's web.
748342.translation: 卡娅牢牢牵紧魔法绳索，将愤怒出击的树灵困在屏障结界之中，令其犹如落入蛛网的飞蝇一般动弹不得。

748347.oracleText: "It's amazing how efficient a detective you can be when you're not slowed down by things like self-preservation or walls."
748347.translation: 「在不用考虑自身安危，免受墙壁阻挡之后，瞧瞧你这个侦探多能干。」

748351.oracleText: "You there, halt! The gallery is closed. Wait—what are you doing?"
748351.translation: 「那边的，站住！展馆已经打烊了。等等～你要干什么？」

748352.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
748352.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

748353.oracleText: When Museum Nightwatch dies, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
748353.translation: 当博物馆夜巡卫死去时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

748355.oracleText: A rare and beloved exception to the Agency's "no one is above suspicion" rule.
748355.translation: 目前把第八区和第九区各处当自己家，近来延伸到第十区的一部分。

748358.oracleText: When cunning fails, there's always violence.
748358.translation: 动口不成的时候，总还是能动手。

748359.oracleText: Each player who controls the most creatures investigates. Then destroy all creatures.
748359.translation: 令每位操控生物最多的牌手探查。然后消灭所有生物。

748361.oracleText: "You know, Proft, I've done a lot of questionable things in my life, but helping a pompous detective save lives is a new low, even for me."
748361.translation: 「波费，你知道吗，虽然我这辈子已经干过许多亏心事，但帮一位自大侦探救人性命，就连我都觉得很没面子。」

748363.oracleText:
"If the perfect evidence appears at your feet, your first task is to rule out misdirection."
—The Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations handbook
748363.translation:
「如果脚边出现完美证据，首要之务便是排除误导。」
～拉尼卡循魔调查局手册

748366.oracleText: For all their differences, Kaya, Kellan, and Agrus Kos agreed on one thing: none of them would rest until Teysa's murderer was brought to justice.
748366.translation: 尽管分歧众多，但卡娅、凯澜和阿固寇斯在一件事上达成了共识：不将谋杀泰莎的凶手绳之于法，他们绝不停歇。

748367.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn. Investigate.
748367.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。探查。

748369.oracleText: He makes sure no one sets foot in a fresh crime scene—not even himself.
748369.translation: 他确保无人踏足新犯案现场～包括他自己。

748373.oracleText: {o2oW}, {oT}: Tap target creature. You may put a stun counter on it. If you do, put a stun counter on CARDNAME.
748373.translation: {o2oW}，{oT}：横置目标生物。你可以在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置一个晕眩指示物。

748374.oracleText: {o2oW}, {oT}: Tap target creature. You may put a stun counter on it. If you do, put a stun counter on Sanctuary Wall.
748374.translation: {o2oW}，{oT}：横置目标生物。你可以在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。若你如此作，则在圣地围墙上放置一个晕眩指示物。

748376.oracleText:
"I appreciate working with associates whose greatest loyalty is to the job at hand."
—Skurad of the Foundway Associates
748376.translation:
「我喜欢跟忠于手头工作的同事合作。」
～寻路侦探社的斯库拉因德

748377.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
748377.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

748378.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, Seasoned Consultant gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
748378.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，老练顾问得+2/+0直到回合结束。

748380.oracleText: {o1oW}, Collect evidence 2: CARDNAME becomes a Human Detective with base power and toughness 4/4 and gains vigilance.
748380.translation: {o1oW}，搜证2：CARDNAME成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的人类／侦探且获得警戒异能。

748381.oracleText: {o1oW}, Collect evidence 2: Tenth District Hero becomes a Human Detective with base power and toughness 4/4 and gains vigilance.
748381.translation: {o1oW}，搜证2：第十区勇士成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的人类／侦探且获得警戒异能。

748382.oracleText: Other creatures you control have indestructible.
748382.translation: 由你操控的其他生物具有不灭异能。

748383.oracleText: {o2oW}, Collect evidence 4: If CARDNAME is a Detective, it becomes a legendary creature named Mileva, the Stalwart, it has base power and toughness 5/5, and it gains "Other creatures you control have indestructible."
748383.translation: {o2oW}，搜证4：如果CARDNAME是侦探，则它成为名称为坚兵米勒娃的传奇生物，其基础力量与防御力为5/5，且获得「由你操控的其他生物具有不灭异能。」

748384.oracleText: {o2oW}, Collect evidence 4: If Tenth District Hero is a Detective, it becomes a legendary creature named Mileva, the Stalwart, it has base power and toughness 5/5, and it gains "Other creatures you control have indestructible."
748384.translation: {o2oW}，搜证4：如果第十区勇士是侦探，则它成为名称为坚兵米勒娃的传奇生物，其基础力量与防御力为5/5，且获得「由你操控的其他生物具有不灭异能。」

748386.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, exile another target nonland permanent. If you controlled it, return it to the battlefield tapped. Otherwise, its controller creates a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
748386.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，放逐另一个目标非地永久物。如果你操控它，则将它横置移回战场。若否，则其操控者派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

748387.oracleText: When Unyielding Gatekeeper is turned face up, exile another target nonland permanent. If you controlled it, return it to the battlefield tapped. Otherwise, its controller creates a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
748387.translation: 当刚毅门卫翻回正面时，放逐另一个目标非地永久物。如果你操控它，则将它横置移回战场。若否，则其操控者派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

748391.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance and "{o3}, {oT}: Tap target creature."
748391.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒与「{o3}，{oT}：横置目标生物。」

748398.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may collect evidence 6.
748398.translation: 你可以搜证6，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

748399.oracleText: Until end of turn, target artifact or creature becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 4/3. If evidence was collected, it has base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn instead.
748399.translation: 直到回合结束，目标神器或生物成为基础力量与防御力为4/3的神器生物。如果已搜证，则改为它的基础力量与防御力为1/1直到回合结束。

748401.oracleText: Scientists from the Simic Combine are regularly seconded to various detective agencies in hopes that sharing their expertise will improve the guild's tarnished reputation.
748401.translation: 析米克联合的科学家经常为各家侦探社提供帮助，希冀能透过分享所知来改善公会业已受损的声誉。

748406.oracleText: By the time they noticed the missing vials, Glovax was three fathoms away.
748406.translation: 等到他们发现有瓶子不见的时候，格洛瓦早就已经游出三寻开外。

748408.oracleText: As CARDNAME is turned face up, put four +1/+1 counters on it.
748408.translation: 于CARDNAME翻回正面时，在其上放置四个+1/+1指示物。

748409.oracleText: As Bubble Smuggler is turned face up, put four +1/+1 counters on it.
748409.translation: 于吐泡走私客翻回正面时，在其上放置四个+1/+1指示物。

748411.oracleText: "You must have known all those lies would catch up to you eventually."
748411.translation: 「想必你也很清楚，这些谎言终究会反噬自身。」

748412.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 as long as it's a Detective you control. Otherwise, it has base power and toughness 1/1 and can't block Detectives.
748412.translation: 闪现结附于生物只要所结附之生物是由你操控的侦探，它便得+2/+2。若否，则它的基础力量与防御力为1/1且不能阻挡侦探。

748414.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，刺探2。

748415.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, surveil 2."
748415.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有「每当此生物攻击时，刺探2。」

748419.oracleText: To solve — You control three or more artifacts.
748419.translation: 侦办～你操控三个或更多神器。

748420.oracleText: Solved — {o2oU}, Sacrifice this Case: Put four +1/+1 counters on target noncreature artifact. It becomes a 0/0 Bird creature with flying in addition to its other types.
748420.translation: 侦结～{o2oU}，牺牲此案件：在目标非生物的神器上放置四个+1/+1指示物。它成为0/0，具飞行异能的鸟生物，且仍具有原本类别。

748422.oracleText: To solve — You've cast four or more instant and sorcery spells this turn.
748422.translation: 侦办～你本回合中施放过四个或更多瞬间与法术咒语。

748423.oracleText: Solved — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card.
748423.translation: 侦结～每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，抓一张牌。

748425.oracleText: "It's a rare privilege to investigate one's own death."
748425.translation: 「调查自己死亡，可是件罕见的差事。」

748426.oracleText: When Cold Case Cracker dies, investigate.
748426.translation: 当悬案破解灵死去时，探查。

748428.oracleText: "There can be many motives and opportunities, but there is always only one truth."
748428.translation: 「动机机遇或有很多，但真相只有一个。」

748431.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, gain control of target permanent you own but don't control.
748431.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，获得目标由你拥有但不由你操控之永久物的操控权。

748432.oracleText: Whenever Coveted Falcon attacks, gain control of target permanent you own but don't control.
748432.translation: 每当珍异猎鹰攻击时，获得目标由你拥有但不由你操控之永久物的操控权。

748434.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, target opponent gains control of any number of target permanents you control. Draw a card for each one they gained control of this way.
748434.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，目标对手获得任意数量目标由你操控之永久物的操控权。该牌手每以此法获得一个永久物的操控权，你便抓一张牌。

748435.oracleText: When Coveted Falcon is turned face up, target opponent gains control of any number of target permanents you control. Draw a card for each one they gained control of this way.
748435.translation: 当珍异猎鹰翻回正面时，目标对手获得任意数量目标由你操控之永久物的操控权。该牌手每以此法获得一个永久物的操控权，你便抓一张牌。

748443.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
748443.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

748444.oracleText: {o1oU}: Return Cryptic Coat to its owner's hand.
748444.translation: {o1oU}：将隐密大衣移回其拥有者手上。

748446.oracleText: Each time he replayed the attack in his mind, new details emerged.
748446.translation: 他每次在脑海中重演袭击，都会浮现出新的细节。

748447.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, investigate.
748447.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。

748448.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, investigate."
748448.translation: 结附于生物所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。」

748450.oracleText: Proft lit up like a man who had just been handed a glorious and unexpected gift. "I know who's responsible for this," he said. "And I can prove it."
748450.translation: 波费眼前一亮，就像有份惊喜大礼摆在面前。「我知道这是谁干的了，」他说。「而且我能证明。」

748454.oracleText: {oUoU}: Shuffle enchanted creature into its owner's library.
748454.translation: {oUoU}：将所结附之生物洗入其拥有者的牌库。

748456.oracleText: "Half the city had motive. Time to narrow down who also had the means and opportunity."
748456.translation: 「半个城市的人都有动机。现在来缩小范围，看看谁还有手段和机遇。」

748457.oracleText: Investigate. Creatures your opponents control get -2/-0 until end of turn. If any of them are suspected, they're no longer suspected.
748457.translation: 探查。由对手操控的生物得-2/-0直到回合结束。如果其中有已遭疑的生物，则它们不再遭疑。

748459.oracleText: Exit Specialist can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater.
748459.translation: 脱逃专家不能被力量等于或大于3的生物阻挡。

748460.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, return another target creature to its owner's hand.
748460.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，将另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

748461.oracleText: When Exit Specialist is turned face up, return another target creature to its owner's hand.
748461.translation: 当脱逃专家翻回正面时，将另一个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

748466.oracleText: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, investigate.
748466.translation: 每当你施放神器咒语时，探查。

748467.oracleText: Activated abilities of artifacts you control cost {o1} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
748467.translation: 由你操控的神器之起动式异能减少{o1}来起动。此效应无法将该费用中的法术力减少到少于一点法术力。

748470.oracleText: {oT}, Collect evidence 3: Tap target creature you don't control.
748470.translation: {oT}，搜证3：横置目标不由你操控的生物。

748473.oracleText:
"Glad to see you made it in one piece. Next time, try not looking so obviously nervous."
—Linghu of the Foundway Associates
748473.translation:
「你最后能平安无事真好。下次记得不要看着这么紧张。」
～寻路侦探社的凌湖楚

748474.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked as long as you've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
748474.translation: 只要你本回合中牺牲过神器，CARDNAME便不能被阻挡。

748475.oracleText: Furtive Courier can't be blocked as long as you've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
748475.translation: 只要你本回合中牺牲过神器，鬼祟通讯使便不能被阻挡。

748476.oracleText: Whenever Furtive Courier attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
748476.translation: 每当鬼祟通讯使攻击时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

748479.oracleText: They always think they're better than the local investigators. They're usually right.
748479.translation: 他们总觉得自己比当地调查员强。他们通常是对的。

748483.oracleText: Reveal the top five cards of your library and separate them into two piles. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard. Create a 0/0 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying, then put a +1/+1 counter on it for each card put into your graveyard this way.
748483.translation: 展示你牌库顶的五张牌，并分成两堆。由任一对手选择其中一堆。将该堆牌置于你手上，另一堆则置入你的坟墓场。派出一个0/0无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物，然后每以此法将一张牌置入你的坟墓场，便在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748485.oracleText: "Oh, good, another case with too many victims and not enough clues."
748485.translation: 「好样的，又是一桩受害人过多、证据不足的无头案。」

748486.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, CARDNAME loses defender and gains vigilance until end of turn.
748486.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME失去守军异能并获得警戒异能。

748487.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, Jaded Analyst loses defender and gains vigilance until end of turn.
748487.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，疲惫分析员失去守军异能并获得警戒异能。

748489.oracleText: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, skip that draw instead.
748489.translation: 如果你将抓一张牌但牌库没有牌，则改为略过该次抓牌。

748490.oracleText: As long as there are no cards in your library, CARDNAME has base power and toughness 10/10 and has flying and vigilance.
748490.translation: 只要你牌库没有牌，CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力便为10/10且具有飞行与警戒异能。

748491.oracleText: As long as there are no cards in your library, Living Conundrum has base power and toughness 10/10 and has flying and vigilance.
748491.translation: 只要你牌库没有牌，活体谜团的基础力量与防御力便为10/10且具有飞行与警戒异能。

748495.oracleText: Tapped creatures you control have hexproof.
748495.translation: 由你操控且已横置的生物具有辟邪异能。

748497.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, investigate.
748497.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。

748498.oracleText: When Mistway Spy is turned face up, until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, investigate.
748498.translation: 当雾道探子翻回正面时，直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。

748500.oracleText:
"We'll get their statements after they defrost."
—Dvika of the Foundway Associates
748500.translation:
「等解冻之后再来录他们的口供。」
～寻路侦探社的妮湖格卡德

748501.oracleText: Tap up to two target creatures and put a stun counter on each of them. Investigate.
748501.translation: 横置至多两个目标生物并在这些生物上各放置一个晕眩指示物。探查。

748504.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've drawn more than one card this turn, put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn minus one.
748504.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，若你本回合中抓过的牌多于一张，则在目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你本回合已抓的牌数量减一。

748506.oracleText: "Bring up the particulars from yesterday's altercation, and enhance."
748506.translation: 「调出昨日争执的细节，并放清楚些。」

748510.oracleText: "Merle had the motive, but Blovinac was the one caught with the murder weapon. And who was the seven-foot-tall hooded figure? This case is a mess!"
748510.translation: 「虽然默雷有动机，但被逮时手握凶器的是牛维亚。那个身高七尺戴着兜帽的人影又是谁？这案子一整个就是团乱麻！」

748511.oracleText: Suspect up to one target creature.
748511.translation: 怀疑至多一个目标生物。

748513.oracleText: At Proft's command, an ethereal model of the ransacked workshop sprang into being, every detail perfectly recreated. He'd missed something—he knew it—but what?
748513.translation: 波费大手一挥，遭劫工作室的虚像模型便跃然眼前，每处细节都已完美还原。但他还是漏了点东西～他自己也知道这一点～但漏了什么呢？

748514.oracleText: Exile target nonland card in a graveyard that was put there from anywhere this turn. Copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
748514.translation: 放逐目标在坟墓场中的非地牌，且须为本回合中从任何区域置入该处者。将它复制。你可以施放该复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

748521.oracleText: Proft had never been a by-the-book investigator, but even he never expected to find himself breaking a notorious assassin out of a maximum-security Azorius holding cell.
748521.translation: 波费从来就不是个照着常理出牌的探员，不过他也从未想过自己有一天会深入戒备森严的俄佐立拘留室，帮助恶名杀手逃出生天。

748522.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Surveil 1.
748522.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。刺探1。

748525.oracleText: "Well, cause of death seems pretty straightforward, but what else can you tell me, friend?"
748525.translation: 「嗯，死因看起来很明显，但你还能告诉我些什么呢，朋友？」

748526.oracleText: {o2oB}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw a card. If the sacrificed creature was suspected, draw two cards instead.
748526.translation: {o2oB}，牺牲另一个生物：抓一张牌。如果所牺牲的生物已遭疑，则改为抓两张牌。

748530.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, target opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
748530.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，目标对手失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

748531.oracleText: When Alley Assailant is turned face up, target opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
748531.translation: 当暗巷凶徒翻回正面时，目标对手失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

748535.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
748535.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

748536.oracleText: Whenever Barbed Servitor deals combat damage to a player, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
748536.translation: 每当带刺随侍对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你抓一张牌且失去1点生命。

748537.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, target opponent loses that much life.
748537.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，目标对手失去等量的生命。

748538.oracleText: Whenever Barbed Servitor is dealt damage, target opponent loses that much life.
748538.translation: 每当带刺随侍受到伤害时，目标对手失去等量的生命。

748541.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you gain 1 life and surveil 1.
748541.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你获得1点生命且刺探1。

748542.oracleText: Whenever Basilica Stalker deals combat damage to a player, you gain 1 life and surveil 1.
748542.translation: 每当大教堂潜行客对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你获得1点生命且刺探1。

748546.oracleText: To solve — You control no suspected Skeletons.
748546.translation: 侦办～你未操控已遭疑的骷髅妖。

748547.oracleText: Solved — {o1oB}, Sacrifice this Case: Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
748547.translation: 侦结～{o1oB}，牺牲此案件：从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。只能于法术时机起动。

748549.oracleText:
"Never rely on secondhand description. Always review the memory yourself."
—Lazav
748549.translation:
「永远不要觉得二手转述靠得住。每次都要亲自检查记忆内容。」
～拉札夫

748550.oracleText: Choose one — • Target opponent discards two cards. • Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
748550.translation: 选择一项～ •  目标对手弃两张牌。 •  目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。该牌手弃掉该牌。

748552.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. If evidence was collected, exile a card from an opponent's graveyard. Then search its owner's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with that name and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.
748552.translation: 消灭所有生物。如果已搜证，则从对手的坟墓场中放逐一张牌。然后从其拥有者的坟墓场、手牌及牌库中搜寻任意数量具该名称的牌，并将它们放逐。该牌手洗牌，然后每以此法从其手上放逐一张牌，其便抓一张牌。

748554.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature. If evidence was collected, instead each opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control.
748554.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个生物。如果已搜证，则改为每位对手各牺牲一个由其操控之生物中力量最大的生物。

748556.oracleText:
"Four Dead in Zombie Leech Attack, Dozens Nauseated"
—Tenth District Times headline
748556.translation:
「腐蛭肆虐，四人遇难，多人呕吐」
～《第十区时报》头条

748557.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you mill two cards.
748557.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你磨两张牌。

748558.oracleText: Whenever Festerleech deals combat damage to a player, you mill two cards.
748558.translation: 每当溃伤蛭对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你磨两张牌。

748559.oracleText: {o1oB}: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
748559.translation: {o1oB}：CARDNAME得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

748560.oracleText: {o1oB}: Festerleech gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
748560.translation: {o1oB}：溃伤蛭得+2/+2直到回合结束。每回合只能起动一次。

748562.oracleText: In her line of work, the dead are often better sources than the living.
748562.translation: 侦查能力：无可挑剔。沟通能力：严重不足。

748563.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control die, investigate. This ability triggers only once each turn.
748563.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且非衍生物的生物死去时，探查。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

748568.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, each opponent loses 3 life.
748568.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，每位对手各失去3点生命。

748569.oracleText: When Hunted Bonebrute dies, each opponent loses 3 life.
748569.translation: 当遭缉骨身兽死去时，每位对手各失去3点生命。

748574.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with an impostor counter on it dies, exile it. Return up to one other target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
748574.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有冒名指示物的生物死去时，将它放逐。将至多另一张目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

748576.oracleText: Etrata had committed dozens of murders, all of which she recalled in perfect, loving detail. But no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't remember killing Zegana.
748576.translation: 艾庄塔干过十多票谋杀，每次细节她都能记得清清楚楚。但就是洁加娜这桩案子，她无论怎样试着回想，都没有印象自己动过手。

748577.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Suspect it.
748577.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。怀疑它。

748579.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
748579.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物死去时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

748580.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice Lead Pipe: Draw a card.

748582.oracleText: "Ooh, this one does look nasty. Maybe they'll send Proft!"
748582.translation: 「哦哦，这桩案子太恶劣了。或许他们会派波费来！」

748583.oracleText: {o2oBoB}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Create two tapped 1/1 black Bat creature tokens with flying.
748583.translation: {o2oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：派出两个已横置的1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

748584.oracleText: {o2oBoB}, Exile Leering Onlooker from your graveyard: Create two tapped 1/1 black Bat creature tokens with flying.
748584.translation: {o2oBoB}，从你的坟墓场放逐空乏旁观客：派出两个已横置的1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

748586.oracleText: As the days grew longer, so did the list of missing persons.
748586.translation: 随着日子一天天过去，失踪人员的名字也在一个个增加。

748588.oracleText:
"Eyewitness testimony, coming right up! Just let me finish regenerating their eyes."
—Nelo, Agency coroner
748588.translation:
「下一个就轮到目击证人出庭作证了！让我先把他的眼睛重生出来。」
～魔调局验尸官涅洛

748589.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if a creature card was put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn.
748589.translation: 如果本回合中有生物牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

748591.oracleText: "‘Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."
748591.translation: 「『这是我干的吗？』你得具体说是哪件事。」

748592.translation: 由你操控的生物具有干枯异能。

748593.oracleText: Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, if its toughness was less than 1, draw a card.
748593.translation: 每当一个由对手操控的生物死去时，若其防御力小于1，则你抓一张牌。

748594.oracleText: Laughter and conversation trailed off as the revelers gathered around Zegana's body. Three things quickly became clear: it was a murder, the killer was likely among them, and Teysa's party was definitely over.
748594.translation: 随着狂欢人群聚拢在洁加娜遗体周围，欢声笑语逐渐止歇。大家很快就弄清楚了三件事：这是桩谋杀案；凶手就在众人之间；泰莎的派对当真结束了。

748599.oracleText:
"When you can't erase your own trail, leave as many false ones as possible."
—Etrata
748599.translation:
「如果你抹不掉自己的踪迹，那就尽可能多留一些假的痕迹。」
～艾庄塔

748600.oracleText: Target opponent exiles the top X cards of their library face down. You may look at and play those cards for as long as they remain exiled. If you cast a spell this way, you may spend mana as though it were mana of any type to cast it.
748600.translation: 目标对手牌面朝下地放逐其牌库顶的X张牌。于这些牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视并使用它们。如果你以此法施放咒语，则你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来施放。

748604.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Clue, target opponent gets two poison counters.
748604.translation: 每当你牺牲一个线索时，目标对手得到两个中毒指示物。

748608.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Collect evidence 3: Each opponent loses 3 life unless they discard a card or sacrifice a creature.
748608.translation: {o2}, {oT}，搜证3：对每位对手而言，除非其弃一张牌或牺牲一个生物，否则失去3点生命。

748610.oracleText: "Corpses are pulled from the undercity canals every day. They'll assume one's mine."
748610.translation: 「地底城运河里每天都会捞起新尸体。他们会把其中某具当成我的。」

748611.oracleText: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and suspect it.
748611.translation: 当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场并怀疑它。

748612.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and suspect it."
748612.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+2/+0且获得「当此生物死去时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场并怀疑它。」

748614.oracleText: "Blasted sketch artist did too good a job. Looks like it's time for me to lie low for a little while."
748614.translation: 「这该死的素描画师画得也太像。我得低调一小段时间了。」

748615.oracleText: {o2oB}: If CARDNAME is suspected, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Otherwise, suspect it.
748615.translation: {o2oB}：如果CARDNAME已遭疑，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若否，则怀疑它。

748616.oracleText: {o2oB}: If Repeat Offender is suspected, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Otherwise, suspect it.
748616.translation: {o2oB}：如果累犯恶徒已遭疑，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。若否，则怀疑它。

748618.oracleText: Every week, the necropsy lab's unclaimed bodies are transferred to the Golgari for "recycling."
748618.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，直到回合结束，腐尸农场杀生虫得+1/+0且获得威慑与系命异能。

748619.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and gains menace and lifelink until end of turn.
748619.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+0且获得威慑与系命异能。

748620.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, Rot Farm Mortipede gets +1/+0 and gains menace and lifelink until end of turn.
748620.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，直到回合结束，腐尸农场杀生虫得+1/+0且获得威慑与系命异能。

748622.oracleText:
"Proft has been poking his nose where it doesn't belong. I want him out of the way."
—Judith, to Massacre Girl
748622.translation:
「波费最近的手伸得有些长。我想让他少管闲事。」
～裘蒂丝叮嘱杀戮女郎

748624.oracleText:
"Isn't it gorgeous? It's my most efficient corpse eliminator! One head bites while the other chews."
—Glogus, Golgari leechbreeder
748624.translation:
「厉害吧？它是我最高效的毁尸怪！一个脑袋咬，一个脑袋嚼。」
～葛加理育蛭人格噶斯

748625.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control with power 2 or less gets +1/+0 and gains deathtouch until end of turn.
748625.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物得+1/+0且获得死触异能。

748627.oracleText:
"I'd offer your dog a treat, but I'm afraid I don't have any appendages to spare."
—Alquist Proft, to Judith
748627.translation:
「我真的很想喂喂你的狗，但可惜我没带多余的器官。」
～阿奎斯波费告诉裘蒂丝

748630.oracleText: Judith's plan was close to fruition. She couldn't have Agrus get in the way.
748630.translation: 裘蒂丝的计划就快大功告成。这时可不能让阿固寇斯坏了好事。

748633.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
748633.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，每位对手各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

748635.oracleText: "Poison this deadly is only used by the Ochran. Either the Golgari are behind this, or someone wants us to think they are."
748635.translation: 「只有瓯坎的人才会用上这般猛烈的毒药。要么这就是葛加理干的，要么是有人想让我们以为是他们干的。」

748636.oracleText: Target creature gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. Investigate.
748636.translation: 目标生物获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。探查。

748638.oracleText: With their guild shunned for opening the doors to Phyrexia, some among the Golgari embraced their status as pariahs and took out their bitterness on all who crossed their paths.
748638.translation: 葛加理由于当初向非瑞克西亚打开门户，现在公会声望每况日下；其间部分成员也接受了最底层的身份，将一切苦楚都宣泄在不小心碰到的路人身上。

748643.oracleText: Obtaining evidence through the "proper" channels can take weeks of paperwork. Sometimes justice just can't wait.
748643.translation: 通过「正规」渠道取得证据得花上数周时间来走书面流程。有时正义等不了这么久。

748646.oracleText: "I'm afraid your investigation has reached a dead end."
748646.translation: 「恐怕你的调查已经走到了死路。」

748648.oracleText: Whenever a creature dies, target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
748648.translation: 每当一个生物死去时，目标对手失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。

748650.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts you don't control, then exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of artifacts that were put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn. You may put a creature card exiled this way onto the battlefield. It gains haste. Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
748650.translation: 消灭所有不由你操控的神器，然后放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为本回合中从战场进入坟墓场的神器数量。你可以将以此法放逐的一张生物牌放进战场。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

748652.oracleText: Determining the culprit was not difficult. Getting him to stop committing the crime long enough to be arrested, however, was a massive challenge.
748652.translation: 找到犯事的人并不难。拖住让他不再轻举妄动乃至最终逮捕他，才是真正难的部分。

748656.oracleText: To solve — Three or more sources you controlled dealt damage this turn.
748656.translation: 侦办～本回合中有三个或更多由你操控的来源造成过伤害。

748657.oracleText: Solved — Sacrifice this Case: Exile the top three cards of your library. Choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
748657.translation: 侦结～牺牲此案件：放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。选择其中一张。本回合中，你可以使用该牌。

748660.oracleText: To solve — You have no cards in hand.

748661.oracleText: Solved — At the beginning of your upkeep, discard your hand, then draw two cards.
748661.translation: 侦结～在你的维持开始时，弃掉你的手牌，然后抓两张牌。

748663.oracleText: "Wait, stop! I've been framed! Extremely convincingly!"
748663.translation: 「等等，住手！我是被冤枉的！千真万确！」

748664.oracleText: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Suspect it.
748664.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。怀疑它。

748666.oracleText: Etrata evaded the Boros arresters and Azorius lawmages, but not even a master assassin could give Kaya the slip.
748666.translation: 虽然艾庄塔逃过了波洛斯逮捕人，躲过了俄佐立律法师，但这位专业杀手也没能从卡娅手中溜走。

748667.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Investigate.
748667.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+0且获得先攻异能。探查。

748670.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, attach it to target creature you control.
748670.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

748671.oracleText: When Concealed Weapon is turned face up, attach it to target creature you control.
748671.translation: 当匿藏武器翻回正面时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

748673.oracleText: "How could I have missed it? The answer was right in front of me all along!"
748673.translation: 「我怎么就没看见呢？原来答案一直就近在眼前！」

748674.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks, exile the top card of your library face down.
748674.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，牌面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌。

748675.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard your hand, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put all cards exiled with CARDNAME into their owners' hands.
748675.translation: {o1oR}，弃掉你的手牌，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有以CARDNAME放逐的牌置于其拥有者手上。

748676.oracleText: {o1oR}, Discard your hand, Sacrifice Connecting the Dots: Put all cards exiled with Connecting the Dots into their owners' hands.
748676.translation: {o1oR}，弃掉你的手牌，牺牲连点成线：将所有以连点成线放逐的牌置于其拥有者手上。

748680.oracleText: {o2oR}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
748680.translation: {o2oR}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

748681.oracleText: {o2oR}: Return Convenient Target from your graveyard to your hand.
748681.translation: {o2oR}：将便捷目标从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

748683.oracleText: Monax knew attacking the detective was a reckless move, but he was at the end of his rope.
748683.translation: 莫纳兹知道向侦探动手是鲁莽之举，但他绳子已经放到头了。

748688.oracleText: "But then he peeled off the mask, revealing a sight that made Groja's blood run cold—Brulu was actually Vogos in disguise!"
748688.translation: 「但之后他揭下了面具，眼前的一切顿时令格罗杰大惊失色～原来布露鲁一直都是沃戈斯假扮的！」

748689.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and add {oR}.
748689.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物并加{oR}。

748690.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on Crime Novelist and add {oR}.
748690.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在犯罪小说家上放置一个+1/+1指示物并加{oR}。

748692.oracleText: After the attempt on Aurelia's life, she gave the Agency an ultimatum: solve the case in twenty-four hours, or the Boros Legion would declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.
748692.translation: 欧瑞梨遭袭险丢性命后，她向魔调局发出最后通牒：二十四小时之内破不了案的话，波洛斯教团就会向拉铎司宗派宣战。

748693.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or discard a card.
748693.translation: 牺牲一个神器或弃一张牌，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

748695.translation: 天文数字的财富阻碍了平稳交接的过程。

748696.oracleText: Whenever a creature is dealt damage, its controller may exile that many cards from the top of their library. They may play those cards until the end of their next turn.
748696.translation: 每当一个生物受到伤害时，其操控者可以从其牌库顶放逐等量的牌。直到该牌手下一个回合的回合结束，其可以使用这些牌。

748698.oracleText: Turn target face-down creature face up.
748698.translation: 将目标牌面朝下的生物翻回正面。

748699.oracleText: Exile any number of face-up creatures you control with disguise in a face-down pile, shuffle that pile, then cloak them.
748699.translation: 放逐任意数量由你操控、具伪装异能且牌面朝上的生物并放作牌面朝下的一堆，将该堆洗牌，然后匿伏这些牌。

748700.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Turn target face-down creature face up. • Exile any number of face-up creatures you control with disguise in a face-down pile, shuffle that pile, then cloak them.
748700.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  将目标牌面朝下的生物翻回正面。 •  放逐任意数量由你操控、具伪装异能且牌面朝上的生物并放作牌面朝下的一堆，将该堆洗牌，然后匿伏这些牌。

748702.oracleText: It's hard to keep the peace if you can't even control your temper.
748702.translation: 如果连让自己和气都作不到，维护和平就更难了。

748703.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains haste until end of turn. When that creature dies this turn, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
748703.translation: 直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0且获得敏捷异能。本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

748709.oracleText: Disguise {o5oR}. This cost is reduced by {o1} for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
748709.translation: 伪装{o5oR}。你坟墓场中每有一张瞬间与法术牌，此费用便减少{o1}。

748710.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
748710.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

748711.oracleText: When Fugitive Codebreaker is turned face up, discard your hand, then draw three cards.
748711.translation: 当漂泊破码客翻回正面时，弃掉你的手牌，然后抓三张牌。

748713.oracleText: "Why doesn't Kylox put an off switch on these things?!"
748713.translation: 「奇洛兹为什么没在这些东西上装个开关？！」

748714.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature. If you've drawn two or more cards this turn, CARDNAME deals 5 damage to that creature instead.
748714.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成3点伤害。如果你本回合中抓过两张或更多牌，则改为CARDNAME对该生物造成5点伤害。

748715.oracleText: Galvanize deals 3 damage to target creature. If you've drawn two or more cards this turn, Galvanize deals 5 damage to that creature instead.
748715.translation: 电流光闪对目标生物造成3点伤害。如果你本回合中抓过两张或更多牌，则改为电流光闪对该生物造成5点伤害。

748717.oracleText:
"In her defense, thopters are very fun to smash."
—Udol of the Foundway Associates
748717.translation:
「用她的话来说，这是因为扑翼机砸起来很有趣。」
～寻路侦探社的乌楚姆

748718.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact.
748718.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器。

748719.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact.
748719.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器。

748720.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
748720.translation: 牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

748721.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on Gearbane Orangutan.
748721.translation: 牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则在厌械长臂猿上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

748726.oracleText: "When you can't show your own face, try one of mine!"
748726.translation: 「如果你露不了自己的脸，不妨来试试我的脸！」

748727.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, face-down spells you cast this turn cost {o1} less to cast.
748727.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你本回合中施放之牌面朝下的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

748728.oracleText: Whenever Goblin Maskmaker attacks, face-down spells you cast this turn cost {o1} less to cast.
748728.translation: 每当鬼怪面具师攻击时，你本回合中施放之牌面朝下的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

748730.oracleText: After the eleventh consecutive thopter failed to return from Gruul territory, she developed a disposable model.
748730.translation: 在向古鲁地界连续放飞十一个振翼机都有去无回之后，她开发出了用后即丢的型号。

748731.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying. It gains haste until end of turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
748731.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。在你的下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

748733.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, you may collect evidence X. When you do, CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature and planeswalker that player controls.
748733.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以搜证X。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对由该牌手操控的每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成X点伤害。

748734.oracleText: Whenever Incinerator of the Guilty deals combat damage to a player, you may collect evidence X. When you do, Incinerator of the Guilty deals X damage to each creature and planeswalker that player controls.
748734.translation: 每当罪人焚龙对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以搜证X。当你如此作时，罪人焚龙对由该牌手操控的每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成X点伤害。

748736.oracleText: "Whoops, this isn't my street! Don't mind me! I'll just be on my way while you enjoy your . . . very sharp knives."
748736.translation: 「哎呀，我想回我自己街上但走错路了！不用管我！我马上就走，你们慢慢忙…磨你的刀。」

748737.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME is dealt 3 or more damage, investigate.
748737.translation: 每当CARDNAME受到3点或更多伤害时，探查。

748738.oracleText: Whenever Innocent Bystander is dealt 3 or more damage, investigate.
748738.translation: 每当无辜旁观客受到3点或更多伤害时，探查。

748743.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice an artifact: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Goblin you control.
748743.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个神器：在每个由你操控的鬼怪上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748744.oracleText: Whenever an artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {oR}. If you do, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. It gains haste until end of turn.
748744.translation: 每当一个神器从战场进入坟墓场时，你可以支付{oR}。若你如此作，则派出一个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

748750.oracleText: The only warning was the faint smell of burning plasma.
748750.translation: 淡淡的电浆焦味是唯一警告。

748751.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may exile it and collect evidence 4. If you do, return CARDNAME to the battlefield tapped.
748751.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，你可以将它放逐并搜证4。若你如此作，则将CARDNAME横置移回战场。

748752.oracleText: When Lamplight Phoenix dies, you may exile it and collect evidence 4. If you do, return Lamplight Phoenix to the battlefield tapped.
748752.translation: 当灯火凤凰死去时，你可以将它放逐并搜证4。若你如此作，则将灯火凤凰横置移回战场。

748754.oracleText:
"In a city this big, anyone can blend in."
—Imel of the Foundway Associates
748754.translation:
「城市这么大，谁都可以混进去。」
～寻路侦探社的凌罗梅因

748759.oracleText: "Maybe they're following someone else," Alvis thought to himself, despite mounting evidence to the contrary.
748759.translation: 「也许他们跟踪的是别人，」阿维斯内心自语道。但有越来越多的证据表明并非如此。

748766.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control is turned face up, that creature deals damage equal to its power to each opponent.
748766.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的生物翻回正面时，该生物向每位对手各造成等同于其力量的伤害。

748767.oracleText: Whenever Pyrotechnic Performer or another creature you control is turned face up, that creature deals damage equal to its power to each opponent.
748767.translation: 每当烟火表演者或另一个由你操控的生物翻回正面时，该生物向每位对手各造成等同于其力量的伤害。

748770.oracleText: He's gonna crack this thing wide open.
748770.translation: 他大动干戈想要砸破一切。

748771.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact or discard a card. If you do, draw a card and CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
748771.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲一个神器或弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌且CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

748772.oracleText: Whenever Reckless Detective attacks, you may sacrifice an artifact or discard a card. If you do, draw a card and Reckless Detective gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
748772.translation: 每当无忌侦探攻击时，你可以牺牲一个神器或弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌且无忌侦探得+2/+0直到回合结束。

748775.oracleText:
"Thopters are but one option in our suite of autonomous surveillance solutions."
—Kylox
748775.translation:
「我们有许多自动化布控方案，扑翼机不过是其中一种。」
～奇洛兹

748776.oracleText: Red Herring attacks each combat if able.
748776.translation: 扰神红鱼械每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

748777.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice Red Herring: Draw a card.

748779.oracleText: "I did it! Double—no, triple homicide! In a building I set on fire. Yep, all me."
748779.translation: 「我干的！两条～不，三条人命！就在我点着的那栋楼里。全是我干的。」

748780.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, if it's not suspected, you may suspect it.
748780.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，若它未遭疑，则你可以怀疑它。

748781.oracleText: Whenever Rubblebelt Braggart attacks, if it's not suspected, you may suspect it.
748781.translation: 每当瓦砾区吹嘘客攻击时，若它未遭疑，则你可以怀疑它。

748782.oracleText: She realized that she could not, in fact, handle the truth.
748782.translation: 实际上，她刚发现自己承受不了这现实。

748784.oracleText:
"Clearly someone wanted us to find this."
—Runubi of the Foundway Associates
748784.translation:
「显然有人希望我们留意到这个。」
～寻路侦探社的尔努库伐

748785.oracleText: This spell costs {o3} less to cast if you've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
748785.translation: 如果你本回合中牺牲过神器，则此咒语减少{o3}来施放。

748786.oracleText: Suspicious Detonation deals 4 damage to target creature.
748786.translation: 可疑爆炸对目标生物造成4点伤害。

748788.oracleText: "I won't waste my time hunting down petty thieves while my brother's killer still walks free."
748788.translation: 「杀害我兄弟的凶手尚未伏法，我绝不会浪费时间去管什么小偷小摸。」

748789.oracleText: Whenever an opponent sacrifices an artifact, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to them.
748789.translation: 每当任一对手牺牲一个神器时，CARDNAME对其造成2点伤害。

748790.oracleText: Whenever an opponent sacrifices an artifact, Vengeful Tracker deals 2 damage to them.
748790.translation: 每当任一对手牺牲一个神器时，怨仇追迹人对其造成2点伤害。

748792.oracleText: "Could someone bring me more evidence markers? Like . . . a lot more?"
748792.translation: 「谁能再帮我多拿点证据标牌来吗？大概要…很多个？」

748794.oracleText: {o3oG}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
748794.translation: {o3oG}，牺牲CARDNAME：将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

748795.oracleText: {o3oG}, Sacrifice Aftermath Analyst: Return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
748795.translation: {o3oG}，牺牲事后分析师：将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

748799.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and can't become suspected.
748799.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且不能成为遭疑。

748801.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may collect evidence 8.
748801.translation: 你可以搜证8，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

748802.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card. If evidence was collected, instead search your library for a creature or land card. Reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
748802.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌。如果已搜证，则改为从你牌库中搜寻一张生物或地牌。展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

748804.oracleText: Search your library for a creature or land card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land card. Otherwise, put it into your hand. Then shuffle.
748804.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张生物或地牌并展示之。如果它是地牌，则将它横置放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。然后洗牌。

748805.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
748805.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

748806.oracleText: Choose one — • Search your library for a creature or land card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land card. Otherwise, put it into your hand. Then shuffle. • Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control. • Exile target artifact or enchantment.
748806.translation: 选择一项～ •  从你牌库中搜寻一张生物或地牌并展示之。如果它是地牌，则将它横置放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。然后洗牌。 •  在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。 •  放逐目标神器或结界。

748808.oracleText: Trostani was as regal and vibrant as ever, but Kaya couldn't shake the sense that there was something off, some discordant note lurking deep within the chorus.
748808.translation: 卓塔妮依然威风堂堂、活跃如昔，但卡娅总感觉有哪里不对劲：表面和声韵集之下，仿佛有一些异声音符在鼓动。

748809.oracleText: Create a 0/1 green Plant creature token, then draw cards equal to the number of differently named creature tokens you control.
748809.translation: 派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生生物，然后抓若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控之衍生生物中名称不同者的种数。

748813.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may collect evidence 6. This spell costs {o2} less to cast if evidence was collected.
748813.translation: 你可以搜证6，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。如果已搜证，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

748814.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn. It deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
748814.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+0直到回合结束。它对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

748816.oracleText: To solve — You control seven or more lands.
748816.translation: 侦办～你操控七个或更多地。

748817.oracleText: Solved — You may look at the top card of your library any time, and you may play lands and cast creature and enchantment spells from the top of your library.
748817.translation: 侦结～你可以随时检视你的牌库顶牌，且你可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放生物与结界咒语。

748820.oracleText: To solve — Creatures you control have total power 8 or greater.
748820.translation: 侦办～由你操控之生物的力量总和等于或大于8。

748821.oracleText: Solved — Whenever you attack, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature. It gains trample until end of turn.
748821.translation: 侦结～每当你攻击时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

748823.oracleText:
"In your search for a suspect, never forget that the most important person is the victim."
—Ezrim, Agency chief
748823.translation:
「在追寻嫌犯时，绝对不要忘记受害人才是最重要的。」
～魔调局局长伊泽霖

748824.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token, then investigate.
748824.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物，然后探查。

748826.oracleText: The bite at the end of the tunnel.
748826.translation: 历经隧道险，苦尽血口来。

748831.oracleText: "What is this? An ambush or a staring contest?" Kaya taunted. As if in answer, the robed figure lunged forward.
748831.translation: 「现在是干吗？你是要动手还只是盯着看？」卡娅讥讽道。斗篷覆体的身影猛然挥击，算是给出了回应。

748833.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each Forest you control.
748833.translation: 你每操控一个树林，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。

748834.oracleText: Flourishing Bloom-Kin gets +1/+1 for each Forest you control.
748834.translation: 你每操控一个树林，茁壮花身便得+1/+1。

748835.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, search your library for up to two Forest cards and reveal them. Put one of them onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
748835.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张树林牌并展示之。将其中一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

748836.oracleText: When Flourishing Bloom-Kin is turned face up, search your library for up to two Forest cards and reveal them. Put one of them onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.
748836.translation: 当茁壮花身翻回正面时，从你牌库中搜寻至多两张树林牌并展示之。将其中一张横置放进战场，另一张则置于你手上，然后洗牌。

748838.oracleText: "Apologies for using you like a stepladder. On the other hand, thank you, you're a wonderful stepladder!"
748838.translation: 「抱歉把你当成梯子一样到处踩。话说回来，也还得谢谢你，你当梯子真不赖！」

748839.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+1 for each creature you control and gains reach.
748839.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物获得延势异能，且你每操控一个生物，它便得+1/+1。

748841.oracleText: The spider just loved how the gems twinkled, and the high-class prey they attracted.
748841.translation: 这蜘蛛喜欢宝石闪闪发光的样子，以及宝石吸引来的高雅猎物。

748847.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
748847.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

748848.oracleText: When Greenbelt Radical is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
748848.translation: 当绿地闹事徒翻回正面时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。由你操控的生物获得践踏异能直到回合结束。

748850.oracleText:
"Keen eyes and an analytical mind are some of a detective's most important tools. As is a mean left hook."
—Senior Inspector Holjo
748850.translation:
「敏锐目光跟灵活大脑是侦探不可或缺的重要工具。强劲勾拳也是其中之一。」
～资深巡检员何勒乔

748853.oracleText: You may choose not to untap Hedge Whisperer during your untap step.
748853.translation: 你可以选择于你的重置步骤中不重置树篱语者。

748854.oracleText: {o3oG}, {oT}, Collect evidence 4: Target land you control becomes a 5/5 green Plant Boar creature with haste for as long as CARDNAME remains tapped. It's still a land. Activate only as a sorcery.
748854.translation: {o3oG}，{oT}，搜证4：于CARDNAME持续横置的时段内，目标由你操控的地成为5/5绿色，具敏捷异能的植物／野猪生物。它仍然是地。只能于法术时机起动。

748855.oracleText: {o3oG}, {oT}, Collect evidence 4: Target land you control becomes a 5/5 green Plant Boar creature with haste for as long as Hedge Whisperer remains tapped. It's still a land. Activate only as a sorcery.
748855.translation: {o3oG}，{oT}，搜证4：于树篱语者持续横置的时段内，目标由你操控的地成为5/5绿色，具敏捷异能的植物／野猪生物。它仍然是地。只能于法术时机起动。

748857.oracleText: The trees look beautiful . . . until they look back.
748857.translation: 这树很好看…直到它们看回来。

748858.oracleText: Look at the top five cards of your library, cloak two of them, and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
748858.translation: 检视你牌库顶的五张牌，匿伏其中两张，并将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

748862.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME, Reveal the creature type you chose: If target attacking creature token is the chosen type, put three +1/+1 counters on it and it gains deathtouch until end of turn.
748862.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME，展示所选生物类别：如果目标进行攻击的衍生生物为该类别，则在其上放置三个+1/+1指示物且其获得死触异能直到回合结束。

748863.oracleText: Sacrifice A Killer Among Us, Reveal the creature type you chose: If target attacking creature token is the chosen type, put three +1/+1 counters on it and it gains deathtouch until end of turn.
748863.translation: 牺牲凶手在侧，展示所选生物类别：如果目标进行攻击的衍生生物为该类别，则在其上放置三个+1/+1指示物且其获得死触异能直到回合结束。

748868.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
748868.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，CARDNAME得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

748869.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, Loxodon Eavesdropper gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
748869.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，直到回合结束，象族偷听客得+1/+1且获得警戒异能。

748872.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, search your library for a land card with a basic land type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
748872.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，从你牌库中搜寻一张具基本地类别的地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

748873.oracleText: When Nervous Gardener is turned face up, search your library for a land card with a basic land type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
748873.translation: 当紧张的园丁翻回正面时，从你牌库中搜寻一张具基本地类别的地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

748875.oracleText: A reliable, general-purpose toxin is a handy way to save on belt space.
748875.translation: 选用效果可靠、泛用性强的毒药能够有效节省腰带空间。

748876.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个神器。

748877.oracleText: Choose one — • Each opponent sacrifices an artifact. • Each opponent sacrifices an enchantment. • Each opponent sacrifices a creature with flying.
748877.translation: 选择一项～ •  每位对手各牺牲一个神器。 •  每位对手各牺牲一个结界。 •  每位对手各牺牲一个具飞行异能的生物。

748882.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by creatures that don't have a name.
748882.translation: CARDNAME不能被没有名称的生物阻挡。

748883.oracleText: Pompous Gadabout can't be blocked by creatures that don't have a name.
748883.translation: 浮夸游荡客不能被没有名称的生物阻挡。

748886.oracleText: This spell costs {oX} less to cast, where X is the total toughness of creatures you control.
748886.translation: 此咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为由你操控之生物的防御力总和。

748887.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw cards equal to its toughness.
748887.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓等同于其防御力的牌。

748888.oracleText: {o2oUoU}: Until end of turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0, gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw cards equal to its toughness," and can attack as though it didn't have defender.
748888.translation: {o2oUoU}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0，获得「每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓等同于其防御力的牌」，且能视同不具守军异能地进行攻击。

748889.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+2, has reach, and can't be blocked by more than one creature.
748889.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+2，具有延势异能，且不能被多于一个生物阻挡。

748893.oracleText: {oG}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
748893.translation: {oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

748894.oracleText: {oG}, Exile Rubblebelt Maverick from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
748894.translation: {oG}，从你的坟墓场放逐瓦砾区独行客：在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

748897.oracleText: "Whatever broke out of here is at least half bear . . . and I'd say some lizard as well."
748897.translation: 「从这里逃出的有一半是熊…而且我看还有一部分是蜥蜴。」

748898.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may collect evidence 3. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
748898.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以搜证3。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748899.oracleText: Whenever Sample Collector attacks, you may collect evidence 3. When you do, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
748899.translation: 每当样本收集员攻击时，你可以搜证3。当你如此作时，在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748904.oracleText: Create a 0/0 green Ooze creature token with trample. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is two plus the total number of cards you own in exile and in your graveyard that are Oozes or are named Slime Against Humanity.
748904.translation: 派出一个0/0绿色，具践踏异能的流浆衍生生物。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为放逐区和你坟墓场中由你拥有且为流浆或名称为反人淤泥者之牌的数量加二。

748905.oracleText: A deck can have any number of cards named Slime Against Humanity.
748905.translation: 名称为反人淤泥的牌，在套牌中的数量不受限制。

748907.oracleText:
"Running doesn't prove guilt, but innocent people don't typically flee into the North Ridge Forest."
—Alst of the Foundway Associates
748907.translation:
「虽说并非只有罪犯才会逃跑，但一般无辜的人逃命不会躲进北脊林里。」
～寻路侦探社的阿莱斯特

748908.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Investigate.
748908.translation: 从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。探查。

748911.oracleText: The gardens around Karlov Manor are oddly bereft of birdsong.
748911.translation: 奇怪的是，卡洛夫庄园周围的花圃内都听不见鸟鸣。

748914.oracleText: "When your perp goes underground, I know where to find 'em."
748914.translation: 「如果你要抓的人往地底逃了的话，我知道能在哪里找到他。」

748915.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a face-down creature entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
748915.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌面朝下的生物在你操控下进战场，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748916.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a face-down creature entered the battlefield under your control this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Tunnel Tipster.
748916.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌面朝下的生物在你操控下进战场，则在隧道情报贩上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

748918.oracleText:
"I want eyes on the scene of the crime, day and night. I have a feeling our killer won't be able to resist coming back."
—Thare of the Foundway Associates
748918.translation:
「我要有人日夜盯着这犯罪现场。我感觉凶手会忍不住再回来看看。」
～寻路侦探社的特伐

748919.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
748919.translation: 在你的维持开始时，将目标地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

748921.oracleText: Seeking intact evidence in the Rubblebelt is a fool's errand.
748921.translation: 要在瓦砾区找到完好无损的证据，简直就是异想天开。

748923.oracleText: When Vengeful Creeper is turned face up, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
748923.translation: 当复仇匍行怪翻回正面时，消灭目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

748928.oracleText: "Eventually I'll give retirement another shot. But not today."
748928.translation: 「有朝一日我会再考虑是否要退休。不过不是今天。」

748933.oracleText: {oXoWoUoU}, {oT}, Sacrifice a Clue: You draw X cards and gain X life.
748933.translation: {oXoWoUoU}，{oT}，牺牲一个线索：你抓X张牌且获得X点生命。

748936.oracleText: His claws tear at the foundations of civilization.
748936.translation: 他的利爪撕扯文明根基。

748939.oracleText: {o3oRoRoGoG}: Anzrag must be blocked each combat this turn if able.
748939.translation: {o3oRoRoGoG}：本回合中，安札格每次战斗若能被阻挡，则须如此作。

748940.oracleText:
"Not just any floriculturist can grow this caliber of nightbloom. We're looking for a rooftop hothouse with quite particular conditions."
—Dr. A of the Foundway Associates
748940.translation:
「不是随随便便哪个花匠都能种好这么大棵的月下美人。得有特定设施的屋顶暖房才能办到。」
～寻路侦探社的妮乌

748942.oracleText: Whenever a player attacks with three or more creatures, you draw a card.
748942.translation: 每当任一牌手以三个或更多生物攻击时，你抓一张牌。

748943.oracleText: Whenever a player attacks with five or more creatures, CARDNAME deals 3 damage to each of your opponents and you gain 3 life.
748943.translation: 每当任一牌手以五个或更多生物攻击时，CARDNAME向你的每位对手各造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

748944.oracleText: Whenever a player attacks with five or more creatures, Aurelia, the Law Above deals 3 damage to each of your opponents and you gain 3 life.
748944.translation: 每当任一牌手以五个或更多生物攻击时，苍天铁律欧瑞梨向你的每位对手各造成3点伤害且你获得3点生命。

748947.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures die, mill a card and put a bloodstain counter on CARDNAME. Then sacrifice it if it has five or more bloodstain counters on it. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
748947.translation: 每当一个或数个生物死去时，磨一张牌并在CARDNAME上放置一个血迹指示物。然后如果其上有五个或更多血迹指示物，则牺牲它。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

748948.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures die, mill a card and put a bloodstain counter on Blood Spatter Analysis. Then sacrifice it if it has five or more bloodstain counters on it. When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
748948.translation: 每当一个或数个生物死去时，磨一张牌并在血迹分析上放置一个血迹指示物。然后如果其上有五个或更多血迹指示物，则牺牲它。当你如此作时，将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

748953.oracleText:
"People are being brainwashed into these attacks. We must find the puppet master."
—Alquist Proft
748953.translation:
「民众是被人鼓动了才这样四处攻击。我们必须把幕后黑手找出来。」
～阿奎斯波费

748954.oracleText: Enchanted creature has base power and toughness 1/1, has deathtouch, and is an Assassin in addition to its other types.
748954.translation: 所结附之生物的基础力量与防御力为1/1，具有死触异能，且额外具有杀手此类别。

748961.oracleText:
"When you said I could learn a lot from a corpse, I have to admit I wasn't expecting it to lecture me on forensic procedure."
—Kellan, to Ezrim
748961.translation:
「我必须说，当你告诉我尸体能教会我很多的时候，我绝没想过是尸体亲自来跟我讲法证规程。」
～凯澜告诉伊泽霖

748962.oracleText: When you sacrifice a Clue, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
748962.translation: 当你牺牲一个线索时，将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

748963.oracleText: When you sacrifice a Clue, return Curious Cadaver from your graveyard to your hand.
748963.translation: 当你牺牲一个线索时，将好奇尸身从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

748965.oracleText: Teysa's security was unrivaled. Etrata was locked up. Kaya was left with nothing but multiplying questions . . . and a dead friend.
748965.translation: 泰莎的警卫都是万里挑一。惯犯艾庄塔也已羁押在案。现在摆在卡娅面前的就只剩无尽的问题…和朋友的遗体。

748966.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target suspected creature you control. You may have it become no longer suspected.
748966.translation: 在目标由你操控且已遭疑的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。你可以使其不再遭疑。

748967.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Destroy target creature. • Put a +1/+1 counter on target suspected creature you control. You may have it become no longer suspected.
748967.translation: 选择一项或都选～ •  消灭目标生物。 •  在目标由你操控且已遭疑的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。你可以使其不再遭疑。

748969.oracleText: It's a crime lab in a bag.
748969.translation: 打包带走的犯罪实验室。

748971.oracleText: {oT}: Create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying. Activate only if you've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
748971.translation: {oT}：派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。只能于你牺牲过神器的回合中起动。

748974.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, create two tapped 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
748974.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，派出两个已横置之1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

748975.oracleText: When Dog Walker is turned face up, create two tapped 1/1 white Dog creature tokens.
748975.translation: 当遛狗民众翻回正面时，派出两个已横置之1/1白色的狗衍生生物。

748977.oracleText:
"Suspect spotted at the Tin Street Market, Yescu Street entrance. And the Oak Street entrance. And somehow also in Lobar Alley!"
—Avult of the Foundway Associates
748977.translation:
「有人看到嫌犯在锡街市场的耶库街口出现。同时还在橡树街口出现。同时还能在阔叶巷出现！」
～寻路侦探社的戈瓦拉

748978.oracleText: For each of X target permanents, create X tokens that are copies of that permanent.
748978.translation: 为X个目标永久物各进行以下流程～派出X个为该永久物复制品的衍生物。

748980.oracleText: "Let's gather what we can before the Golgari tidy up the scene."
748980.translation: 「在葛加理来收拾之前，证据能搜集多少是多少。」

748981.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token. If a creature died this turn, you gain 2 life, surveil 2, then investigate.
748981.translation: 派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。如果本回合中有生物死去，则你获得2点生命，刺探2，然后探查。

748983.oracleText: {o2oUoB}: Turn this creature face up. If you can't, exile it, then you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
748983.translation: {o2oUoB}：将此生物翻回正面。若你无法如此作，则将它放逐，然后你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

748984.oracleText: Face-down creatures you control have "{o2oUoB}: Turn this creature face up. If you can't, exile it, then you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost."
748984.translation: 由你操控且牌面朝下的生物具有「{o2oUoB}：将此生物翻回正面。若你无法如此作，则将它放逐，然后你可以施放所放逐的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用」。

748985.oracleText: Whenever an Assassin you control deals combat damage to an opponent, cloak the top card of that player's library.
748985.translation: 每当一个由你操控的杀手向任一对手造成战斗伤害时，匿伏该牌手的牌库顶牌。

748987.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may collect evidence 4.
748987.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以搜证4。

748992.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice an artifact: Ezrim gains your choice of vigilance, lifelink, or hexproof until end of turn.
748992.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个神器：伊泽霖依你的选择获得警戒、系命或辟邪异能直到回合结束。

748995.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
748995.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

748996.oracleText: When Faerie Snoop is turned face up, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
748996.translation: 当嗅探仙灵翻回正面时，检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张置于你手上，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。

749003.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
749003.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749004.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on Gleaming Geardrake.
749004.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在光亮金械龙兽上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749008.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, you may tap or untap target creature.
749008.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，你可以横置或重置目标生物。

749009.oracleText: When Granite Witness is turned face up, you may tap or untap target creature.
749009.translation: 当观路岗岩像翻回正面时，你可以横置或重置目标生物。

749011.oracleText: Only too late did the Agency custodians realize the device had not been inactive—it was just waiting for the right trigger.
749011.translation: 当魔调局保管员发现看似静止的装置仍在运行时，一切都为时已晚～它只是在等合适的爆发时机。

749012.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then you may discard two cards. When you do, CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature, where X is the greatest mana value among cards discarded this way.
749012.translation: 抓两张牌。然后你可以弃两张牌。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为以此法所弃各牌中的最大法术力值。

749013.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then you may discard two cards. When you do, Ill-Timed Explosion deals X damage to each creature, where X is the greatest mana value among cards discarded this way.
749013.translation: 抓两张牌。然后你可以弃两张牌。当你如此作时，厄时爆炸对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为以此法所弃各牌中的最大法术力值。

749015.oracleText: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi allowed Trostani to reach every crack and crevice in the city.
749015.translation: 维图加基的繁杂根系，让卓塔妮能自如触及城市中的每道缝隙。

749016.oracleText: Creature tokens you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
749016.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

749017.oracleText: Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token, then put a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
749017.translation: 每当一张或数张生物牌离开你的坟墓场时，派出一个0/1绿色植物衍生生物，然后在每个由你操控的植物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749021.oracleText: Sacrifice four tokens: Surveil 2, then draw two cards. You gain 2 life.
749021.translation: 牺牲四个衍生物：刺探2，然后抓两张牌。你获得2点生命。

749023.oracleText: "I don't make my living hiding the truth, detective. I shout it from the stage."
749023.translation: 「侦探先生，隐藏真相可挣不了钱。在台上把它们大声喊出来才行。」

749024.oracleText: That spell gains deathtouch and lifelink.
749024.translation: 该咒语获得死触与系命异能。

749025.oracleText: That spell gains deathtouch and lifelink.
749025.translation: 该咒语获得死触与系命异能。

749026.oracleText: When this creature dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent.
749026.translation: 当此生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

749027.oracleText: Create a 2/2 red Imp creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent."
749027.translation: 派出一个2/2红色小恶魔衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。」

749028.oracleText: Create a 2/2 red Imp creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent."
749028.translation: 派出一个2/2红色小恶魔衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。」

749029.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, choose one — • That spell gains deathtouch and lifelink. • Create a 2/2 red Imp creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent."
749029.translation: 每当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，选择一项～ •  该咒语获得死触与系命异能。 •  派出一个2/2红色小恶魔衍生生物，且具有「当此生物死去时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。」

749031.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control and/or creature cards in your graveyard are put into exile, you may choose a creature card from among them. Until end of turn, target token you control becomes a copy of it, except it has flying.
749031.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的生物和／或一张或数张你坟墓场中的生物牌进入放逐区时，你可以选择其中一张生物牌。直到回合结束，目标由你操控的衍生物成为其复制品，但它具有飞行异能。

749032.oracleText: Surveil 2, then exile a card from a graveyard.
749032.translation: 刺探2，然后从任一坟墓场放逐一张牌。

749033.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
749033.translation: 派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

749034.oracleText: Exile target creature you control. For each other player, exile up to one target creature that player controls.
749034.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的生物。为每位其他牌手各进行以下流程～放逐至多一个目标由该牌手操控的生物。

749037.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, destroy up to one target artifact. If you controlled that permanent, draw a card.
749037.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，消灭至多一个目标神器。如果你操控该永久物，则抓一张牌。

749038.oracleText: Whenever Kellan, Inquisitive Prodigy attacks, destroy up to one target artifact. If you controlled that permanent, draw a card.
749038.translation: 每当奇探逸才凯澜攻击时，消灭至多一个目标神器。如果你操控该永久物，则抓一张牌。

749040.oracleText: Investigate. You may play an additional land this turn.
749040.translation: 探查。本回合中，你可以额外使用一个地。

749043.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, sacrifice any number of other creatures, then exile the top X cards of your library, where X is their total power. You may cast any number of instant and/or sorcery spells from among the exiled cards without paying their mana costs.
749043.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，牺牲任意数量的其他生物，然后放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为这些生物的力量总和。你可以从所放逐的牌之中施放任意数量的瞬间和／或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

749044.oracleText: Whenever Kylox, Visionary Inventor attacks, sacrifice any number of other creatures, then exile the top X cards of your library, where X is their total power. You may cast any number of instant and/or sorcery spells from among the exiled cards without paying their mana costs.
749044.translation: 每当幻视发明家奇洛兹攻击时，牺牲任意数量的其他生物，然后放逐你牌库顶的X张牌，X为这些生物的力量总和。你可以从所放逐的牌之中施放任意数量的瞬间和／或法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

749046.oracleText: Collect evidence 6: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
749046.translation: 搜证6：CARDNAME成为神器生物直到回合结束。

749047.oracleText: Collect evidence 6: Kylox's Voltstrider becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
749047.translation: 搜证6：奇洛兹的电行械成为神器生物直到回合结束。

749048.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among cards exiled with it. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.
749048.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以从以其放逐的牌之中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语。如果该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

749049.oracleText: Whenever Kylox's Voltstrider attacks, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from among cards exiled with it. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.
749049.translation: 每当奇洛兹的电行械攻击时，你可以从以其放逐的牌之中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语。如果该咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。

749052.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile target card from a graveyard, then investigate.
749052.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐，然后探查。

749053.oracleText: Whenever Lazav, Wearer of Faces attacks, exile target card from a graveyard, then investigate.
749053.translation: 每当千面变换拉札夫攻击时，将目标牌从坟墓场放逐，然后探查。

749054.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Clue, you may have Lazav become a copy of a creature card exiled with it until end of turn.
749054.translation: 每当你牺牲一个线索时，你可以使拉札夫成为一张以其放逐之生物牌的复制品直到回合结束。

749056.oracleText: If Leyline of the Guildpact is in your opening hand, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield.
749056.translation: 如果你的起手牌中包含了十会盟地脉，则你可以让它在战场上来开始游戏。

749057.oracleText: Each nonland permanent you control is all colors.
749057.translation: 每个由你操控的非地永久物均是五色。

749058.oracleText: After heavy casualties in the Phyrexian invasion, the Boros mage-priests trained as many rank-and-file soldiers as possible to wield the Legion's legendary battle magic.
749058.translation: 经历非瑞克西亚大侵攻的惨痛伤亡后，波洛斯的法师僧侣开始向普通士兵传授知识，希望有尽可能多的人能够自如运用教团的传奇战斗魔法。

749060.oracleText: "Well, if it isn't mean old Mr. Larchbottom, who's always been so eager to have the only dumpling stall in Oxblood Alley."
749060.translation: 「哎呀，这不是臭脾气的老松底先生嘛。你是不是还急着在牛血巷开出一家面点铺？」

749061.oracleText: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, investigate.
749061.translation: 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时，探查。

749064.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, it deals X damage to any target, target player draws X cards, and you gain X life, where X is the number of different color pairs among permanents you control that are exactly two colors.
749064.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，目标牌手抓X张牌，且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控且为正好两色的永久物中不同双色色组的种数。

749065.oracleText: Whenever Niv-Mizzet, Guildpact deals combat damage to a player, it deals X damage to any target, target player draws X cards, and you gain X life, where X is the number of different color pairs among permanents you control that are exactly two colors.
749065.translation: 每当十会盟尼米捷对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，它对任意一个目标造成X点伤害，目标牌手抓X张牌，且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控且为正好两色的永久物中不同双色色组的种数。

749067.oracleText:
"Lies fester and flourish in shadow. Our job is to bathe them in light."
—Ezrim, Agency chief
749067.translation:
「黯影之中，谎言会不断腐生滋长。我们的任务便是将其曝露在明光之下。」
～魔调局局长伊泽霖

749068.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o3}. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
749068.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o3}，否则反击之。如果以此法反击该咒语，则改为将它放逐，而非置入其拥有者的坟墓场。

749070.oracleText: No guest was permitted to leave before being questioned in an Azorius verity circle.
749070.translation: 每位宾客都要进入俄佐立真相环之中接受讯问，没完成之前不准离开。

749071.oracleText: This spell costs {oWoU} more to cast for each target beyond the first.
749071.translation: 此咒语在第一个目标之外每有一个目标，便增加{oWoU}来施放。

749072.oracleText: Choose any number of target players. Investigate X times, where X is the total number of creatures those players control.
749072.translation: 选择任意数量的目标牌手。探查X次，X为由这些牌手操控之生物的总数量。

749076.translation: 由你操控的其他侦探得+1/+1。

749077.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, target Detective can't be blocked this turn.
749077.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，目标侦探本回合不能被阻挡。

749079.oracleText: "Finally, a performance worthy of my applause!"
749079.translation: 「终于有了一场值得我亲自喝彩的演出！」

749080.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, target opponent may sacrifice two nonland, nontoken permanents. If they don't, you draw two cards.
749080.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，目标对手可以牺牲两个非地且非衍生物的永久物。若其未如此作，则你抓两张牌。

749086.oracleText:
"Many have tried to subjugate Ravnica. All have failed. All will fail."
—Museum of Ravnican History
749086.translation:
「曾有许多势力想要征服拉尼卡。它们过去没办到。将来也办不到。」
～拉尼卡历史博物馆

749087.oracleText: Return up to one target artifact card, up to one target land card, and up to one target non-Aura enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield. They are 5/5 Elemental creatures in addition to their other types.
749087.translation: 将至多一张目标神器牌，至多一张目标地牌和至多一张目标非灵气结界牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。它们是5/5元素生物，且仍具有原本类别。

749089.oracleText:
"Remind me to send the biomancer team a gift basket."
—Olana, Simic field researcher
749089.translation:
「记得提醒我要给生机术士组送篮礼品。」
～析米克勘验学者欧兰纳
