749090.oracleText: Put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. Then counter up to one target spell unless its controller pays mana equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
749090.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物。然后除非至多一个目标咒语的操控者支付等同于由你操控之生物中最大力量的法术力，否则反击之。

749092.oracleText: Like any Ravnican denizen, it decided to visit Plaza West for lunch.
749092.translation: 跟其他拉尼卡市民一样，它也决定去西城广场用午餐。

749095.oracleText: Notice: Guests of Hellbender may be exposed to occasional bursts of flame.
749095.translation: 警告：参访地狱乐园的游客或会遭受偶发烈焰侵袭。

749098.oracleText: {o3oBoR}, Sacrifice a suspected creature: Target creature gets -5/-5 until end of turn.
749098.translation: {o3oBoR}，牺牲一个已遭疑的生物：目标生物得-5/-5直到回合结束。

749101.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, another target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
749101.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

749102.oracleText: When Sanguine Savior is turned face up, another target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
749102.translation: 当血色救助僧翻回正面时，另一个目标由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

749104.oracleText: Rakdos snitches rarely survive to get stitches.
749104.translation: 拉铎司告密者鲜少活到被发现的时候。

749105.oracleText: When Shady Informant dies, it deals 2 damage to any target.
749105.translation: 当可疑线人死去时，它对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

749108.oracleText: Taking a secret to your grave still doesn't make it safe from the Orzhov.
749108.translation: 就算你把秘密带进坟墓里，也还是瞒不过欧佐夫。

749109.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card. If the card's mana value is 1 or less, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
749109.translation: 目标对手展示其手牌。你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌。如果该牌的法术力值等于或小于1，则派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。

749111.oracleText: The great meditation garden of Sumala was no place for Ravnica's rising crime wave, and he would keep it that way.
749111.translation: 索马拉的大冥想花园仍旧清净，不受拉尼卡日益渐增的犯罪浪潮滋扰；而他意欲继续如此。

749112.oracleText: Whenever a face-down permanent you control is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it and a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
749112.translation: 每当一个由你操控且牌面朝下的永久物翻回正面时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物且在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749113.oracleText: Whenever a face-down permanent you control is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it and a +1/+1 counter on Sumala Sentry.
749113.translation: 每当一个由你操控且牌面朝下的永久物翻回正面时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物且在索马拉哨卫上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749115.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, investigate for each opponent who lost life this turn.
749115.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，每有一位本回合中失去过生命的对手，你便探查一次。

749116.oracleText: Whenever a Clue you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.
749116.translation: 每当一个由你操控的线索从战场进入坟墓场时，派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

749119.oracleText: "The lawmages are trying to hush it up, but I'm telling you—the guard didn't fall off that balcony. He was pushed!"
749119.translation: 「律法师想要把这件事瞒过去，但我跟你说～守卫不是自己掉下阳台的。他是被人推下去的！」

749120.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oRoG}. Spend this mana only to cast face-down spells or to turn creatures face up.
749120.translation: {oT}：加{oRoG}。此法术力只能用来施放牌面朝下的咒语，或是将生物翻回正面。

749124.oracleText: Whenever a Wolf you control attacks, if Tolsimir attacked this combat, target creature an opponent controls blocks that Wolf this combat if able.
749124.translation: 每当一个由你操控的狼攻击时，若托西密本次战斗中攻击过，则目标由对手操控的生物本次战斗若能阻挡该狼，则须如此作。

749126.oracleText: Loot's easy to divide by one.

749127.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature that dealt damage this turn.
749127.translation: 牺牲一个本回合中造成过伤害的生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

749128.oracleText: Draw three cards. Each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
749128.translation: 抓三张牌。每位对手各失去3点生命且你获得3点生命。

749130.oracleText: Tangled in the heart of Vitu-Ghazi, they guard their secrets from eager ears.
749130.translation: 她们三位一体居于维图加基中心，守护秘密让好奇之人无从探知。

749131.oracleText: {o1oG}: Target creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
749131.translation: {o1oG}：目标生物获得死触异能直到回合结束。

749132.oracleText: {o(G/W)}: Target creature gains vigilance until end of turn.
749132.translation: {o(G/W)}：目标生物获得警戒异能直到回合结束。

749133.oracleText: {o2oW}: Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
749133.translation: {o2oW}：目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

749135.oracleText:
"The Golgari can read the dead like a newspaper."
—Taboro of the Foundway Associates
749135.translation:
「葛加理人解析遗体，就跟翻阅报纸一样轻松。」
～寻路侦探社的莱努瓦梅卡

749136.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, collect evidence X, where X is the total mana value of the permanents this spell targets.
749136.translation: 搜证X，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用，X为此咒语指定作目标之各永久物的法术力值总和。

749137.oracleText: Destroy up to one target artifact, up to one target creature, up to one target enchantment, and up to one target planeswalker.
749137.translation: 消灭至多一个目标神器，至多一个目标生物，至多一个目标结界和至多一个目标鹏洛客。

749139.oracleText: Cloak a card from your hand.

749140.oracleText: Cloak a card from your hand.

749141.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
749141.translation: 在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749142.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
749142.translation: 在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749143.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose one — • Cloak a card from your hand. • Put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
749143.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择一项～ •  从你手上匿伏一张牌。 •  在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749145.oracleText: While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion, Kaya and Kellan raced against the clock, desperate to stave off a war the guilds might not survive.
749145.translation: 一边欧瑞梨召集波洛斯教团整军备战，另一边卡娅与凯澜争分夺秒破解案件，竭尽全力要把这场可能会令所有公会同归于尽的战争扼杀在萌芽之中。

749149.oracleText: {o5oWoB}: Creatures you control with power 2 or less gain deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn.
749149.translation: {o5oWoB}：由你操控且力量等于或小于2的生物获得死触与系命异能直到回合结束。

749151.oracleText: "Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"
749151.translation: 「囤物居奇，借灾牟利，勾结外敌～他们所有人都在拉尼卡最需要帮助的时候背叛了这座城市。他们都该死。我还没有完！」

749152.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to any target. Put up to X land cards from your hand and/or graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
749152.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。将至多X张地牌从你手上和／或你坟墓场中横置放进战场。

749153.oracleText: Worldsoul's Rage deals X damage to any target. Put up to X land cards from your hand and/or graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
749153.translation: 世界之魂怒火对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。将至多X张地牌从你手上和／或你坟墓场中横置放进战场。

749154.oracleText: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

749155.oracleText: Whenever one or more face-down creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
749155.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且牌面朝下的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

749156.oracleText: Whenever a face-down creature you control dies, return it to the battlefield face down under its owner's control if it's a permanent card, then turn it face up.
749156.translation: 每当一个由你操控且牌面朝下的生物死去时，如果它是永久物牌，则将它在其拥有者的操控下牌面朝下地移回战场，然后将它翻回正面。

749158.oracleText: Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard. Target player gains 2 life and draws a card.
749158.translation: 将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的牌从该处放逐。目标牌手获得2点生命且抓一张牌。

749163.oracleText: Each opponent mills three cards, then you may cast a spell from each opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
749163.translation: 每位对手各磨三张牌，然后你可以从每位对手的坟墓场中各施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若以此法施放的咒语将进入坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

749167.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each attacking creature you control.
749167.translation: 在每个由你操控且进行攻击的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749168.oracleText: Create three 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature tokens with flying. Surveil 2.
749168.translation: 派出三个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。刺探2。

749172.oracleText: Target creature attacks or blocks this turn if able.
749172.translation: 目标生物本回合若能攻击或阻挡，则须如此作。

749173.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn. You may turn a creature you control face up.
749173.translation: 直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+2/+2且获得践踏异能。你可以将一个由你操控的生物翻回正面。

749177.oracleText: Put up to two target creature cards from a single graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. They gain haste until end of turn. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
749177.translation: 将至多两张目标在同一坟墓场中的生物牌在你操控下从该处放进战场。它们获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

749181.oracleText: {oT}, Collect evidence 3: Add one mana of any color. Put an unlock counter on CARDNAME.
749181.translation: {oT}，搜证3：加一点任意颜色的法术力。在CARDNAME上放置一个解锁指示物。

749182.oracleText: {oT}, Collect evidence 3: Add one mana of any color. Put an unlock counter on Cryptex.
749182.translation: {oT}，搜证3：加一点任意颜色的法术力。在密码械上放置一个解锁指示物。

749183.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: Surveil 3, then draw three cards. Activate only if CARDNAME has five or more unlock counters on it.
749183.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：刺探3，然后抓三张牌。只能于CARDNAME上有五个或更多解锁指示物时起动。

749184.oracleText: Sacrifice Cryptex: Surveil 3, then draw three cards. Activate only if Cryptex has five or more unlock counters on it.
749184.translation: 牺牲密码械：刺探3，然后抓三张牌。只能于密码械上有五个或更多解锁指示物时起动。

749186.oracleText: The empty graves grew tired of waiting for bodies to fill them and set out to make some.
749186.translation: 空旷墓地等不及遗体自然填满，决定起身自己去开拓来源。

749187.oracleText: {o2}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Exile target card from a graveyard.
749187.translation: {o2}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

749188.oracleText: {o2}, Exile Gravestone Strider from your graveyard: Exile target card from a graveyard.
749188.translation: {o2}，从你的坟墓场放逐墓碑驮行像：将目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

749191.oracleText: {o2}: Until end of turn, you may look at face-down creatures you don't control any time.
749191.translation: {o2}：直到回合结束，你可以随时检视不由你操控且牌面朝下的生物。

749194.oracleText: It recovers precious jewelry, murder weapons, and discarded food tins with equal excitement.
749194.translation: 奇洛兹迄今最先进的探测械。切勿让它靠近你的钥匙。

749197.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on Magnetic Snuffler.
749197.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，在磁性嗅探械上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

749198.oracleText:
"These footprints mean only one thing: the streetcleaner is running late!"
—Argyle, Agency junior detective
749198.translation:
「这些脚印只意味着一件事：清洁工迟到了！」
～魔调局初级侦探阿格雷

749200.oracleText: "I am once again bursting with discarded theories. Disposal imminent."
749200.translation: 「我又被废弃理论装满了。亟需清理。」

749203.oracleText:
"I find that my greatest insights rarely arrive when my ears are cold."
—Senior Inspector Holjo
749203.translation:
「我发现我的伟大见解，都是在耳朵没冻僵的时候想出来的。」
～资深巡检员何勒乔

749207.oracleText: When CARDNAME is turned face up, add two mana of any one color. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
749207.translation: 当CARDNAME翻回正面时，加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

749208.oracleText: When Branch of Vitu-Ghazi is turned face up, add two mana of any one color. Until end of turn, you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end.
749208.translation: 当维图加基分枝翻回正面时，加两点任意颜色的单色法术力。直到回合结束，你不会因步骤与阶段结束失去这份法术力。

749216.oracleText: No self-respecting criminal has a basement with only one exit.
749216.translation: 但凡知道自己名声的罪犯，地下室里都不会只留有一条出路。

749217.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Escape Tunnel: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
749217.translation: {oT}，牺牲脱逃暗道：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

749218.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
749218.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

749219.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Escape Tunnel: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
749219.translation: {oT}，牺牲脱逃暗道：目标力量等于或小于2的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

749238.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice Scene of the Crime: Draw a card.

749254.oracleText: You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast Case spells.
749254.translation: 你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来施放案件咒语。

749257.oracleText: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know . . ."
749257.translation: 「嗯，这显然不是从我认识的人身上掉下来的…」

749258.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, investigate once for each opponent who has more cards in hand than you.
749258.translation: 在你的维持开始时，每有一位手牌比你多的对手，你便探查一次。

749260.oracleText: "Look, buddy, you're not in trouble. I just wanna ask you a questio—"
749260.translation: 「听我说，兄弟，你没惹上麻烦。我只是想问你个问～」

749261.oracleText: The owner of target spell or nonland permanent puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
749261.translation: 目标咒语或非地永久物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

749263.oracleText: Thopters don't take breaks, and neither does he.
749263.translation: 振翼机从不休息，他也一样。

749266.oracleText: Whenever you collect evidence, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
749266.translation: 每当你搜证时，派出一个1/1无色，具飞行异能的振翼机衍生神器生物。

749269.oracleText: To solve — Three or more creature cards were put into graveyards from anywhere this turn.
749269.translation: 侦办～本回合中有三张或更多生物牌从任何区域进入坟墓场。

749270.oracleText: Solved — This Case is a 4/4 Gorgon creature with deathtouch and lifelink in addition to its other types.
749270.translation: 侦结～此案件是4/4，具死触与系命异能的蛇发妖生物，且仍具有原本类别。

749274.oracleText: Whenever one or more suspected creatures you control attack, surveil 1.
749274.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控且已遭疑的生物攻击时，刺探1。

749276.oracleText:
"He was scheduled to meet me tomorrow with something important to share. This was no coincidence."
—Algrom of the Foundway Associates
749276.translation:
「他原定明天要跟我碰面，有些重要情报要给我。这绝对不会是巧合。」
～寻路侦探社的阿尔戈罗格姆

749277.oracleText: CARDNAME deals twice X damage to target creature. If excess damage was dealt to that creature this way, investigate.
749277.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成两倍于X数量的伤害。如果以此法对该生物造成过量伤害，则探查。

749278.oracleText: Torch the Witness deals twice X damage to target creature. If excess damage was dealt to that creature this way, investigate.
749278.translation: 证人成炬对目标生物造成两倍于X数量的伤害。如果以此法对该生物造成过量伤害，则探查。

749281.oracleText: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card from among them. If that card has mana value 2 or less, you may put it onto the battlefield and it gains haste until end of turn. If you didn't put the revealed card onto the battlefield this way, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
749281.translation: 检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张生物牌。如果该牌的法术力值等于或小于2，则你可以将它放进战场且它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。若你未以此法将所展示的牌放进战场，则将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

749283.oracleText:
"Er, sir, we could try to cite him for mishandling evidence, but I'm not sure he technically has hands."
—Argyle, Agency junior detective
749283.translation:
「呃，长官，我们是可以试着用动手毁损证物罪来逮捕他，但我不确定他那算不算有手。」
～魔调局初级侦探阿格雷

749288.oracleText: Whenever Undercover Crocodelf deals combat damage to a player, investigate.
749288.translation: 每当卧底鳄身妖精对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。

749291.oracleText: CARDNAME's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
749291.translation: CARDNAME的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌之总数量的两倍。

749292.oracleText: Melek, Reforged Researcher's power and toughness are each equal to twice the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
749292.translation: 重铸研究员梅列克的力量和防御力各等同于你坟墓场中瞬间与法术牌之总数量的两倍。

749293.oracleText: The first instant or sorcery spell you cast each turn costs {o3} less to cast.
749293.translation: 你每回合施放的第一个瞬间或法术咒语减少{o3}来施放。

749296.oracleText: Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures, if two or more of those creatures are attacking you and/or planeswalkers you control, that opponent loses 3 life and you draw a card.
749296.translation: 每当任一对手以生物攻击时，若这些生物中有两个或更多正向你和／或由你操控的鹏洛客进行攻击，则该对手失去3点生命且你抓一张牌。

749298.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is the number of Elves you control. Draw a card for each Wolf you control.
749298.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的妖精数量。你每操控一个狼，便抓一张牌。

749299.oracleText: Whenever Voja, Jaws of the Conclave attacks, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is the number of Elves you control. Draw a card for each Wolf you control.
749299.translation: 每当盟会尖颚沃亚攻击时，在每个由你操控的生物上各放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为由你操控的妖精数量。你每操控一个狼，便抓一张牌。

749304.oracleText:
"Four prints plus one murder weapon equals a case even Juri won't be able to wriggle out of."
—Agency memo
749304.translation:
「四处指纹加一件凶器，等于一桩连裘里都赖不掉的铁案。」
～魔调局备忘录

749305.oracleText:
With the Gnat Alley mugging case solved, maybe we can finally figure out who's been leaving shoes all over the Sixth Precinct."
—Agency memo
749305.translation:
［蚊蚋巷劫案已侦结，现在也许能查清楚到底是谁在第六城区乱丢鞋子了。」
～魔调局备忘录

749306.oracleText:
"As we suspected, someone appears to be targeting Tolsimir specifically."
—Agency memo
749306.translation:
「跟我们怀疑的一样，似乎有人专门盯着托西密下手。」
～魔调局备忘录

749307.oracleText:
"Whatever it is, the smell alone could stun a loxodon. Simic involvement?"
—Agency memo
749307.translation:
「不管是什么，就凭这气味连象族都得晕眩半天。析米克插手了？」
～魔调局备忘录

749308.oracleText:
"Confiscated from the twin heirs of the Lusaht family. Will not be easy to unlock."
—Agency memo
749308.translation:
「自卢萨特家族双胞胎后人处没入。不易解锁。」
～魔调局备忘录

749310.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Target up to {2, Number} other creature from the battlefield or creature card from graveyards.} other {Target up to {2, Number} other creatures from the battlefield and/or creature cards from graveyards.}}
749310.translation: {2, plural, =1 {指定至多{2, Number}个其他战场上的生物或坟墓场中的生物牌为目标。} other {指定至多{2, Number}个其他战场上的生物或坟墓场中的生物牌为目标。}}

749311.oracleText: Target a creature you control other than enchanted creature.
749311.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物为目标，但不得是所结附的生物。

749312.oracleText: Target a creature you control with power 2 or less.
749312.translation: 指定一个由你操控，且力量等于或小于2的生物为目标。

749313.oracleText: Target an artifact, enchantment, or creature with power 4 or greater.
749313.translation: 指定一个神器，结界，或力量等于或大于4的生物为目标。

749314.oracleText: Put a stun counter on it?
749314.translation: 是否要在其上放置一个晕眩指示物？

749315.oracleText: Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, investigate.
749315.translation: 直到回合结束，每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，探查。

749316.oracleText: Target a nonland card in a graveyard that was put there from anywhere this turn.
749316.translation: 指定一张坟墓场中的非地牌为目标，且它必须是本回合中进入坟墓场的。

749317.oracleText: Discard an instant or sorcery card or a creature card with flying?
749317.translation: 是否要弃一张瞬间或法术牌，或一张具飞行异能的生物牌？

749319.oracleText: Return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
749319.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它移回你手上。

749320.oracleText: Put a creature card exiled this way onto the battlefield?
749320.translation: 是否要将一张以此法放逐的生物牌放进战场？

749322.oracleText: Exile that many cards from the top of their library?
749322.translation: 是否要从其牌库顶放逐等量的牌？

749323.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
749323.translation: 在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

749324.oracleText: Destroy up to one nonbasic land that player controls.
749324.translation: 消灭至多一个由该牌手操控的非基本地。

749327.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature, where X is the greatest mana value among cards discarded this way.
749327.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物各造成X点伤害，X为以此法所弃各牌中的最大法术力值。

749329.oracleText: Cast an instant or sorcery spell from among cards exiled with it?
749329.translation: 是否要从以它放逐的牌中施放一个瞬间或法术咒语？

749331.translation: 是否要牺牲两个非地且非衍生物的永久物？

749333.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature that dealt damage this turn.
749333.translation: 牺牲一个本回合中造成过伤害的生物。

749334.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Put up to {2, Number} land card onto the battlefield.} other {Put up to {2, Number} land cards onto the battlefield.}}
749334.translation: {2, plural, =1 {将至多{2, Number}张地牌放进战场。} other {将至多{2, Number}张地牌放进战场。}}

749335.oracleText: Cast a spell from each opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost?
749335.translation: 是否要从每位对手的坟墓场中各施放一个咒语，且不支付其法术力费用？

749336.oracleText: Turn a creature you control face up?
749336.translation: 是否要将一个由你操控的生物翻到牌面朝上？

749337.oracleText: Tap an untapped artifact or land you control?
749337.translation: 是否要横置一个由你操控，且未横置的神器或地？

749338.oracleText: Target a token an opponent controls.
749338.translation: 指定一个由对手操控的衍生物为目标。

749340.oracleText: When equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, draw three cards.
749340.translation: 当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则抓三张牌。

749341.oracleText: When equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice Mystery Key. If you do, draw three cards.
749341.translation: 当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，牺牲神秘钥匙。若你如此作，则抓三张牌。

749343.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of lands that player controls.
749343.translation: CARDNAME向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于由该牌手操控的地数量。

749344.oracleText: Treacherous Terrain deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of lands that player controls.
749344.translation: 大地变节向每位对手各造成伤害，其数量等同于由该牌手操控的地数量。

749406.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物得+2/+2。

750019.oracleText: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw two cards.
750019.translation: 每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓两张牌。

750248.translation: 指定一个由你操控的侦探为目标。

750249.oracleText: Search for a card named Magnifying Glass and/or a card named Thinking Cap.
750249.translation: 搜寻一张名称为放大镜的牌和／或一张名称为思考帽的牌。

750250.oracleText: When that creature dies this turn, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
750250.translation: 本回合中，当该生物死去时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

750251.oracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
750251.translation: 将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

750253.oracleText: Sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token.
750253.translation: 牺牲一个神器、结界或衍生物。

750256.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks, exile the top card of your library face down. (You can't look at it.)
750256.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物攻击时，牌面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌。（你不能检视它。）

750477.oracleText: Look at the top two cards of target opponent's library. Exile one of them face down and put the other on the bottom of that library. You may play the exiled card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.
750477.translation: 检视目标对手牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，另一张牌则置于该牌库底。于所放逐之牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以使用该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

750789.oracleText: Tap any number of untapped creatures you control. When you do, shuffle target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value X or less into its owner's library, where X is the number of creatures tapped this way.
750789.translation: 横置任意数量由你操控且未横置的生物。当你如此作时，将目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物牌洗入其拥有者的牌库，X为以此法横置的生物数量。

750872.oracleText: Shuffle target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value X or less into its owner's library, where X is the number of creatures tapped this way.
750872.translation: 将目标由对手操控且法术力值等于或小于X的非地永久物牌洗入其拥有者的牌库，X为以此法横置的生物数量。

751451.oracleText: Put an exiled creature card used to craft {1, CardId} onto the battlefield?
751451.translation: 是否要将一张用以化炼{1, CardId}所放逐的生物牌放进战场？

751454.oracleText: "Too bad for this Wicked Slumber-—I've always been an insomniac!"
751454.translation: “这邪恶倦眠真是太糟糕了——我一直都是一个失眠症患者！”

751455.oracleText: At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, if you gained life this turn, seek a card with the highest mana value among cards in your library with mana value less than or equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
751455.translation: 在你的第二个行动阶段开始时，若你本回合获得过生命，则从你牌库中掏一张法术力值最大的牌，且须法术力值等于或小于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

751459.oracleText: {o1oW}: Tokens you control gain indestructible until end of turn. Activate only once.
751459.translation: {o1oW}：由你操控的衍生物获得不灭异能直到回合结束。只能起动一次。

751461.oracleText: The smallest bowl was temptingly cute; from the middle bowl wafted a soothing aroma; but the big bowl held a generous portion, and she was hungry . . .
751461.translation: 最小的碗可爱得诱人；大小中等的碗里飘出一股舒缓的香气；但大碗里的份量很大，她也饿了……

751462.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value less than the number of cards in your hand.
751462.translation: 掏一张法术力值小于你手牌数量的牌。

751463.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value greater than the number of cards in your hand.
751463.translation: 掏一张法术力值大于你手牌数量的牌。

751464.oracleText: Count the number of cards in your hand. You may cast a spell with mana value equal to that number from your hand without paying its mana cost.
751464.translation: 计算你的手牌数量。你可以从你手上施放一个法术力值等于该数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

751466.oracleText: Return target creature you control to its owner's hand. That card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
751466.translation: 将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。该牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

751467.oracleText: Return target creature you don't control to its owner's hand. That card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} more to cast."
751467.translation: 将目标不由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。该牌永久获得「此咒语增加{o1}来施放。」

751468.oracleText: Choose one or both — • Return target creature you control to its owner's hand. That card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast." • Return target creature you don't control to its owner's hand. That card perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} more to cast."
751468.translation: 选择一项或都选～• 将目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。该牌永久获得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」 • 将目标不由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。该牌永久获得「此咒语增加{o1}来施放。」

751470.oracleText: "You spent your life toiling to learn a few simple tricks, and you call yourself an archmage? Truly, the arrogance of mortals knows no bounds."
751470.translation: “你辛苦了一辈子，才学会了几个简单的招数，还自称大法师？真是狂妄无边的凡人。”

751474.oracleText: Filled with illustrations by Gadwick himself, the prized tome is coveted by every apprentice, witch, and librarian on Eldraine.
751474.translation: 这本珍贵的书充满了盖威克亲自绘制的插图，为艾卓的每一个学徒、女巫和图书管理员所垂涎。

751475.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, conjure a random card from Tome of Gadwick's spellbook into your hand.
751475.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从盖威克的巨著的法术书中随机变出一张牌置于你手上。

751477.oracleText: "The Wicked Slumber was just the beginning."

751483.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if three or more creatures died this turn, each opponent loses 5 life and you gain 5 life.
751483.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，如果本回合中有三个或更多生物死去，则每位对手各失去5点生命且你获得5点生命。

751486.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you have a boon, you mill three cards, draw a card, and lose 2 life.
751486.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，如果你具有祝福，则你磨三张牌，抓一张牌且失去2点生命。

751488.oracleText: Draconic Debut deals X damage to any target.
751488.translation: 龙族登场对任意一个目标造成X点伤害。

751489.oracleText: The next Dragon creature spell you cast costs {oX} less to cast.
751489.translation: 你施放的下一个龙生物咒语减少{oX}来施放。

751492.translation: {o2oR}，从你手上展示CARDNAME：CARDNAME永久成为龙，得+3/+3，且获得飞行异能。

751493.oracleText: {o2oR}, Reveal Heir to Dragonfire from your hand: Heir to Dragonfire perpetually becomes a Dragon, gets +3/+3, and gains flying.
751493.translation: {o2oR}，从你手上展示龙火传人：龙火传人永久成为龙，得+3/+3，且获得飞行异能。

751495.oracleText: "You'll eat it and you'll like it! Anyone care to argue?"
751495.translation: “你会吃它并且会喜欢它的！有人愿意争辩吗？”

751496.oracleText: Celebration — At the beginning of your end step, create a Food token. If two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, instead conjure a card named Food Fight onto the battlefield.
751496.translation: 欢庆～在你的结束步骤开始时，派出一个食品衍生物。如果本回合中有两个或更多非地永久物在你的操控下进战场，则改为变出一张名称为食物大战的牌放进战场。

751498.oracleText: Tales of Will and Imodane's duel spread through the kingdom like wildfire, though the specifics varied greatly based on which side the teller supported.
751498.translation: 《意志的故事》和伊莫丹的决斗像野火一样传遍了整个王国，尽管具体细节因讲述者支持哪一方而有很大差异。

751499.oracleText: Damage isn't removed from creatures during cleanup steps.
751499.translation: 生物上标记的伤害在清除步骤不会被移除。

751500.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。CARDNAME获得「生物上标记的伤害在清除步骤不会被移除。」

751501.oracleText: Victory of the Pyrohammer deals 4 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. Victory of the Pyrohammer gains "Damage isn't removed from creatures during cleanup steps."
751501.translation: 烈焰锤得胜对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成4点伤害。烈焰锤得胜获得「生物上标记的伤害在清除步骤不会被移除。」

751503.oracleText: Victory of the Pyrohammer deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.

751505.translation: 烈焰锤得胜对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

751507.translation: 这只镀金的鹅漫无目的地在这片土地上旅行，随心所欲地产蛋，不知不觉地给幸运的农民带来了一生的财富。

751508.oracleText: Conjure a card named Gilded Goose onto the battlefield.
751508.translation: 变出一张名称为金鹅的牌放进战场。

751509.oracleText: You may tap an untapped Bird you control and sacrifice an artifact. If you do, conjure a card named Golden Egg onto the battlefield.
751509.translation: 你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的鸟并牺牲一个神器。若你如此作，则变出一张名称为金蛋的牌放进战场。

751512.translation: 与凯澜一起长大的经历赋予了它嗅出仙灵魔法痕迹的不可思议的本领。

751513.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure spell, if CARDNAME is on the battlefield or in exile, it perpetually gets +1/+1. Then if it's on the battlefield, exile it with a fetch counter on it.
751513.translation: 每当你施放历险咒语时，如果CARDNAME在战场或在放逐区中，则它永久得+1/+1。然后如果它在战场，则将它放逐且上面有一个叼回指示物。

751514.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure spell, if Hex, Kellan's Companion is on the battlefield or in exile, it perpetually gets +1/+1. Then if it's on the battlefield, exile it with a fetch counter on it.

751515.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, if Hex is in exile with a fetch counter on it, put it onto the battlefield.
751515.translation: 每当你从放逐区施放咒语时，如果海克斯在放逐区中且上面有一个叼回指示物，则将它放进战场。

751517.oracleText:
"And the pigs called to the wolf, ‘WE'LL RIP YOUR CAVE DOWN STONE BY STONE . . .'"
—Gylwain, "The Pigs' Revenge"
751517.translation:
「群猪对狼喊道，‘我们会把你的洞穴一块一块地拆掉……’」
～桂尔温，《小猪的复仇》

751518.translation: 如果你操控三个或更多名称各不相同的野猪，则将三只小猪的法术书中的所有牌变出放进战场。

751519.translation: 如果你操控两个或更少名称各不相同的野猪，则从三只小猪的法术书中选择两张牌变出并置于你手上，然后将其中一张放进战场。

751526.oracleText: Conjure a card of your choice from the Three Pigs spellbook onto the battlefield.

751527.oracleText: Conjure a card of your choice from the Three Pigs spellbook onto the battlefield.
751527.translation: 从三只小猪的法术书中选择一张牌，变出该牌放进战场。

751528.oracleText: Return up to three target Boar creature cards with different names from your graveyard to the battlefield.
751528.translation: 将至多三张名称各不相同的目标野猪生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

751535.oracleText:
"True love can make the mundane magical and the unbearable bearable."
—Malacan, Vantress exile
751535.translation:
「真爱能让平凡变得神奇，让难以忍受变得可以忍受。」
～Malacan, Vantress exile

751536.oracleText: Seek two creature cards from among the top ten cards of your library, then shuffle. Creature cards in your hand perpetually get +1/+1.
751536.translation: 从牌库顶的十张牌中掏两张生物牌，然后洗牌。你手中的生物牌永久得+1/+1。

751538.oracleText: A life-or-death struggle for a human is but a moment's entertainment for the fae.
751538.translation: 人类的生死之战对于仙灵来说不过是一时的娱乐而已。

751539.oracleText: Perpetually exchange target creature's base power with another target creature's base power.
751539.translation: 永久将目标生物的基础力量与另一目标生物的基础力量交换。

751540.oracleText: Perpetually exchange target creature's base power with another target creature's base power.
751540.translation: 永久将目标生物的基础力量与另一目标生物的基础力量交换。

751541.oracleText: CARDNAME perpetually has base power and toughness 4/1.
751541.translation: CARDNAME的基础力量与防御力永久为4/1。

751542.oracleText: High Fae Prankster perpetually has base power and toughness 4/1.
751542.translation: 至高仙恶戏灵的基础力量与防御力永久为4/1。

751546.oracleText: "Hey, I don't hear any whistling! Get back to work!"
751546.translation: “嘿，我没有听到任何哨声！回去工作吧！”

751551.oracleText: She brings the crowd to their feet and her opponents to their knees.
751551.translation: 她让观众起立，让对手跪下。

751554.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to CARDNAME while it's equipped, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, sacrifice an Equipment attached to CARDNAME.

751555.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to Outfitted Jouster while it's equipped, prevent that damage. When damage is prevented this way, sacrifice an Equipment attached to Outfitted Jouster.
751555.translation: 如果武装矛兵将受到伤害且正佩带武具，则防止该伤害。当以此法防止伤害时，牺牲一个贴附在武装矛兵上的武具。

751561.oracleText: Exile target creature. You gain 1 life for each Boar you control.
751561.translation: 放逐目标生物。你每操控一个野猪，你便获得1点生命。

751563.translation: {o2o(W/B)o(W/B)}：CARDNAME永久成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的野猪／精怪且获得飞行异能。只能于CARDNAME不是精怪时起动。

751564.oracleText: {o2o(W/B)o(W/B)}: Second Little Pig perpetually becomes a Boar Spirit with base power and toughness 4/4 and gains flying. Activate only if Second Little Pig isn't a Spirit.
751564.translation: {o2o(W/B)o(W/B)}：第二只小猪永久成为基础力量与防御力为4/4的野猪／精怪且获得飞行异能。只能于第二只小猪不是精怪时起动。

751566.oracleText: Whenever you attack, CARDNAME perpetually gets +1/+1. This ability also triggers if CARDNAME is in exile.
751566.translation: 每当你攻击时，CARDNAME永久得+1/+1。此异能于CARDNAME在放逐区中时也会触发。

751567.oracleText: Whenever you attack, Steady Tortoise perpetually gets +1/+1. This ability also triggers if Steady Tortoise is in exile.
751567.translation: 每当你攻击时，稳健老龟永久得+1/+1。此异能于稳健老龟在放逐区中时也会触发。

751569.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. It gains haste until end of turn.
751569.translation: 派出一个1/1白色的兔衍生生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

751571.oracleText: He scours the furthest reaches of Eldraine for novelties to add to Beluna's vault.
751571.translation: 他在艾卓最远的地方搜寻新奇的东西，以添加到贝伦娜的宝库中。

751575.oracleText: Conjure X random cards from Giant Secrets's spellbook into your hand.
751575.translation: 从庞大奥秘的法术书中随机变出X张牌置入你手上。

751576.translation: 约书亚爵士与萨克森爵士

751577.oracleText: They were inseparable in waking life, and they fought in perfect coordination even as puppets of the Wicked Slumber.
751577.translation: 他们在清醒时形影不离，即使是成为邪恶倦眠者的傀儡，他们也能完美配合地战斗。

751578.oracleText: If you control exactly two legendary permanents named Syr Joshua and Syr Saxon, the "legend rule" doesn't apply to them.
751578.translation: 如果你正好操控两个名称为约书亚爵士与萨克森爵士的传奇永久物，则「传奇规则」不对它们生效。

751579.oracleText: Each other creature you control named Syr Joshua and Syr Saxon has battle cry.
751579.translation: 所有由你操控的其他名称为约书亚爵士与萨克森爵士的生物具有战嚎异能。

751581.oracleText: Whenever you conjure one or more other cards, CARDNAME perpetually gets +1/+1. This ability also triggers if CARDNAME is in your graveyard.
751581.translation: 每当你变出一张或更多其他牌时，CARDNAME永久得+1/+1。此异能于CARDNAME在你的坟墓场时也会触发。

751582.oracleText: Whenever you conjure one or more other cards, Third Little Pig perpetually gets +1/+1. This ability also triggers if Third Little Pig is in your graveyard.
751582.translation: 每当你变出一张或更多其他牌时，第三只小猪永久得+1/+1。此异能于第三只小猪在你的坟墓场时也会触发。

751584.oracleText:
"All roads lead to where you are meant to go."
—Talion
751584.translation:
「所有的路都通向你想去的地方。」
～塔莱恩

751589.oracleText:
"The Ice Witch thinks this place silent and still. But beneath the surface, my people thrive."
—Sharae
751589.translation:
「冰雪女巫认为这个地方寂静无声。但在地表之下，我的人民正在蓬勃发展。」
～莎蕾

751593.oracleText: Serum was once derived from Mirrodin's blinkmoths, offering visions of inspiration. Now it is pulled from Phyrexian inkmoths, yielding visions of perfection.
751593.translation: 原本采自秘罗地光蛾的浆液，可让饮者眼中见得启悟。如今浆液萃自非瑞克西亚墨蛾，能令受者眼中得见完美。

751595.oracleText: Target up to one other nonland, nontoken permanent.
751595.translation: 指定至多另一个非地且非衍生物的永久物为目标。

751596.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value less than the number of cards in your hand.
751596.translation: 掏一张法术力值小于你手牌数量的牌。

751597.oracleText: Seek a card with mana value greater than the number of cards in your hand.
751597.translation: 掏一张法术力值大于你手牌数量的牌。

751598.oracleText: Cast a spell with mana value equal to that number from your hand without paying its mana cost?
751598.translation: 是否从你手上施放一个法术力值等于该数量的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用？

751599.oracleText: Tap an untapped Bird you control?
751599.translation: 是否横置一个由你操控且未横置的鸟？

751600.oracleText: Target up to three Boar creature cards with different names.
751600.translation: 指定至多三张名称各不相同的野猪生物牌为目标。

751602.oracleText: When damage is prevented this way, sacrifice an Equipment attached to CARDNAME.
751602.translation: 当以此法防止伤害时，牺牲一个贴附在CARDNAME上的武具。

751603.oracleText: Sacrifice an Equipment attached to {1, CardId}.
751603.translation: 牺牲一个贴附在{1, CardId}上的武具。

751605.oracleText: Target up to one creature that was dealt damage this turn.
751605.translation: 指定至多一个本回合中受过伤害的生物为目标。

751743.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Savage Gorger. (Damage causes loss of life.)
751743.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有对手失去过生命，则在粗蛮饕客上放置一个+1/+1指示物。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

751746.oracleText: At the beginning of your next turn's declare attackers step, return it to the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
751746.translation: 在你下一个回合的宣告攻击者步骤开始时，将它在你的操控下横置移回战场且正进行攻击。

751823.oracleText: Counter target activated or triggered ability. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
751823.translation: 反击目标起动式异能或触发式异能。（其目标不能是法术力异能。）

751828.oracleText: Put up to one creature card onto the battlefield.
751828.translation: 将至多一张生物牌放进战场。

751897.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Knight of the Ebon Legion. (Damage causes loss of life.)
751897.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有牌手失去过4点或更多生命，则在黑檀军团骑士上放置一个+1/+1指示物。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

751916.oracleText: Whenever you lose life, draw that many cards. (Damage causes loss of life.)
751916.translation: 每当你失去生命，抽等量的牌。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

752062.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a Blood token, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
752062.translation: 每当你牺牲一个血滴衍生物，每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得1点生命。

752091.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, each Dragon card in your hand perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} less to cast."
752091.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你手上的每张龙牌永久得「此咒语减少{o1}来施放。」

752156.oracleText: Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Vengeful Warchief. (Damage causes loss of life.)
752156.translation: 每当你每回合首度失去生命时，在复仇战酋长上放置一个+1/+1指示物。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

752284.oracleText: Target up to one other artifact or creature you control.
752284.translation: 指定至多另一个由你操控的神器或生物为目标。

752285.oracleText: Target up to one artifact or creature an opponent controls.
752285.translation: 指定至多一个由对手操控的神器或生物为目标。

752287.oracleText: Target up to one spell or nonland permanent.
752287.translation: 指定至多一个咒语或非地永久物为目标。

752289.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Transform Matzalantli, the Great Door. Activate only if there are four or more permanent types among cards in your graveyard. (Artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, land, and planeswalker are permanent types.)
752289.translation: {o4}，{oT}：转化通核伟门玛察栏蒂。只能于你坟墓场中牌的永久物类别有四种或更多时起动。（永久物的类别包括神器、战役、生物、结界、地以及鹏洛客。）

752290.oracleText: If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead. (Damage causes loss of life.)
752290.translation: 如果某对手将于你的回合中失去生命，则改为其失去两倍于该数量的生命。（伤害会导致失去生命。）

752293.oracleText: Put any number of Aura cards onto the battlefield?
752293.translation: 将任意数量的灵气牌放进战场？

752294.oracleText: Activate each of those abilities only once each turn?
752294.translation: 是否要起动每个每回合只能起动一次的异能？

752312.oracleText: Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
752312.translation: 反击目标咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。（其目标不能是法术力异能。）

752645.oracleText: Create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
752645.translation: 派出一个1/1无色精怪衍生生物。

752646.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
752646.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

753170.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control from an enchantment source. You may choose new targets for the copy. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
753170.translation: {oG}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控且来源为结界的起动式或触发式异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（其目标不能是法术力异能。）

753172.oracleText: Seek a card with the highest mana value among cards in your library with mana value less than or equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
753172.translation: 从你牌库中掏一张法术力值最大的牌，且须法术力值等于或小于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

754098.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
754098.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

754100.oracleText: Exile four or more nonlands with activated abilities.
754100.translation: 放逐四个或更多具起动式异能的非地永久物。

754106.oracleText: Exile a Dinosaur, a Merfolk, a Pirate, and a Vampire.
754106.translation: 放逐一个恐龙、一个人鱼、一个海盗和一个吸血鬼。

754110.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. Then amass Orcs 1.
754110.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌，且不是其于自己的每个抓牌步骤中所抓的第一张牌时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。然后囤兵半兽人1。

754111.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, Orcish Bowmasters deals 1 damage to any target. Then amass Orcs 1.
754111.translation: 每当任一对手抓一张牌，且不是其于自己的每个抓牌步骤中所抓的第一张牌时，奥克弓手对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。然后囤兵半兽人1。

754113.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a burden counter on CARDNAME, then draw a card for each burden counter on CARDNAME.
754113.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在CARDNAME上放置一个重负指示物，然后CARDNAME上每有一个重负指示物，便抓一张牌。

754114.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}: Put a burden counter on The One Ring, then draw a card for each burden counter on The One Ring.
754114.translation: {o1}，{oT}：在至尊戒上放置一个重负指示物，然后至尊戒上每有一个重负指示物，便抓一张牌。

754671.oracleText: You may pay {oWoUoBoRoG} rather than pay the mana cost for spells you cast.
754671.translation: 你可以支付{oWoUoBoRoG}，而不支付你施放之咒语的法术力费用。

754866.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, look at the top three cards of that player's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest into their graveyard. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
754866.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视该牌手牌库顶的三张牌，将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，然后将其余的牌置入其坟墓场。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视之，你可以施放之，且你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

754867.oracleText: Whenever Thief of Sanity deals combat damage to a player, look at the top three cards of that player's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest into their graveyard. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
754867.translation: 每当心智窃贼对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视该牌手牌库顶的三张牌，将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，然后将其余的牌置入其坟墓场。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以检视之，你可以施放之，且你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

755200.oracleText: {oT}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell of the chosen type or activate an ability of a creature source of the chosen type.
755200.translation: {oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。此法术力只能用来施放该类别的生物咒语，或是起动为该类别的生物来源的异能。

755268.oracleText: Spend only on: A Creature Spell of the Chosen Type or an Ability of a Creature Source of the Chosen Type: {0}
755268.translation: 只能用于支付：所选类别之生物咒语或所选类别之生物来源的异能：{0}

755394.oracleText: {oT}: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creature sources.
755394.translation: {oT}：加两点法术力，其颜色组合由你选择。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语，或是起动生物来源异能。

755494.oracleText: Spend only on: Creature Spells or Abilities of Creature Sources
755494.translation: 只能用于支付：生物咒语或生物来源的异能

755513.oracleText:
"Few now have the skill in healing to match such evil weapons."
—Strider
755513.translation:
「现在几乎没有人能治疗这种邪恶武器造成的创伤。」
～大步佬

755518.oracleText:
"Narsil was broken and its light extinguished, and it has not yet been forged again."
—Elrond
755518.translation:
「纳熙尔圣剑被折断了，其上的光芒也消失了，它还没有被重铸。」
～埃尔隆德

755522.oracleText: There loomed against the westward stars a dark black shape: a great barrow stood there.
755522.translation: 在西边星光的映衬下，有个黑色的东西隐约浮现：一座巨大的古墓矗立在那里。

755528.oracleText: The hall was long and wide and filled with shadows. Mighty pillars upheld its lofty roof.
755528.translation: 大厅长而宽阔，到处都是影子。巨大的柱子支撑着高大的屋顶。

755529.translation: 埃多拉斯金殿美杜塞尔德

755564.oracleText: There's a gnome built for just about every job in Oteclan, including building gnomes.
755564.translation: 在欧特克兰，存在一种几乎能胜任所有工作的侏械，包括制造侏械本身。

755565.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may exile another artifact you control or an artifact card in your graveyard. If you do, seek an artifact card. That card perpetually has base power and toughness 1/1 and becomes a Gnome creature in addition to its other types.
755565.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以放逐另一个由你操控的神器或一张你坟墓场中的神器牌。若你如此作，则掏一张神器牌。该牌永久成为基础力量和防御力为1/1的地侏生物，且仍具有原本类别。

755567.oracleText: Return any number of creature cards with total mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is CARDNAME's intensity.
755567.translation: 将任意数量的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于X，X为CARDNAME的强度数值。

755568.oracleText: Return any number of creature cards with total mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is Legion's Chant's intensity.
755568.translation: 将任意数量的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌的法术力值总和须等于或小于X，X为军团吟颂的强度数值。

755569.oracleText: All Chorus cards you own intensify by 1.
755569.translation: 所有你拥有的齐颂牌强度增加1。

755571.oracleText: Pure faith enkindled can sear even those blessed by the sun.
755571.translation: 心中燃起的纯真信仰之火甚至能灼伤那些烈阳眷恩者。

755572.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater. If you weren't the starting player, you gain 4 life.
755572.translation: 消灭目标力量等于或大于4的生物。如果你不是先手牌手，则你获得4点生命。

755573.oracleText: When you cycle CARDNAME, if you weren't the starting player, you gain 2 life.
755573.translation: 当你循环CARDNAME时，如果你不是先手牌手，则你获得2点生命。

755574.oracleText: When you cycle Radiant Smite, if you weren't the starting player, you gain 2 life.
755574.translation: 当你循环辉光一击时，如果你不是先手牌手，则你获得2点生命。

755576.oracleText: The Thousand Moons chose to ride giant bats as a message to Aclazotz: Anything you twist can be undone.
755576.translation: 千月军选择骑乘巨型蝙蝠来向阿洛佐兹示意：你所扭曲的一切皆能复原。

755577.oracleText: When you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {o1}. If you don't, each opponent draws a card.
755577.translation: 当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你未如此作，则每位对手各抓一张牌

755578.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, that player gets a one-time boon with "When you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {o1}. If you don't, each opponent draws a card."
755578.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手获得持续一次的具有「当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你未如此作，则每位对手各抓一张牌」的祝福。

755579.oracleText: Whenever Valiant Batrider deals combat damage to a player, that player gets a one-time boon with "When you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {o1}. If you don't, each opponent draws a card."
755579.translation: 每当英勇蝙蝠骑兵对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，该牌手获得持续一次的具有「当你施放非生物咒语时，你可以支付{o1}。若你未如此作，则每位对手各抓一张牌」的祝福。

755581.oracleText:
"Dawn! The morning tide! Arise! Arise!"
—River Herald chant
755581.translation:
「黎明已至！早潮将临！苏醒吧！苏醒吧！」
～川流使号令

755582.oracleText: Draw a card. If a permanent you controlled explored this turn, seek a Merfolk card instead.
755582.translation: 抓一张牌。若本回合中有由你操控的永久物勘察过，则改为掏一张人鱼牌。

755584.oracleText:
"As there was one age, there shall be another."
—Hymn to the Ages, chorus

755585.oracleText: Draw a number of cards equal to this spell's intensity.
755585.translation: 抓若干牌，其数量等同于此咒语的强度数值。

755587.oracleText: "Let's see: if that bit is the tunnel, and the blue scribble is the waterfall . . . yep, we're going the wrong way."
755587.translation: 「让我们看看地图：如果那一小块是隧道，那么涂画的蓝色这块就是瀑布…嗯，我们走错了。」

755588.oracleText: Whenever Landlore Navigator attacks, create a Map token.
755588.translation: 每当地学领航员攻击时，派出一个地图衍生物。

755589.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if two or more artifacts entered the battlefield under your control this turn, conjure a card named Thieving Magpie onto the battlefield.
755589.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有两个或更多神器在你的操控下进战场，则变出一张名称为窃鹊的牌放进战场。

755591.oracleText: Seek a nonland artifact card with mana value X or less and put it onto the battlefield. If a card with mana value less than X is put onto the battlefield this way, this spell perpetually gains "This spell costs {o1} more to cast," then return this spell to its owner's hand.
755591.translation: 掏一张法术力值等于或小于X的非地神器牌并将其放进战场。若以此法将一张法术力值小于X的牌放进战场，则此咒语永久获得「此咒语增加{o1}来施放」，然后将此咒语移回其拥有者手上。

755593.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose target creature card in your graveyard. Conjure a duplicate of it into your graveyard.
755593.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择目标在你坟墓场中的生物牌。变出一张它的复制牌置于你的坟墓场。

755594.oracleText: Descend 8 — Exile a permanent card from your graveyard: You may play it. Activate only as a sorcery and only if there are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
755594.translation: 落坟8～从你坟墓场放逐一张永久物牌：你可以使用该牌。只能于法术时机且你坟墓场中有八张或更多永久物牌时起动。

755596.oracleText: In the darkness of Ixalan's underworld, the Legion found new lands to claim.
755596.translation: 于依夏兰地底世界黑暗深处，军团仍能开疆拓土。

755597.oracleText: Draw a card. If an opponent lost life this turn and you gained life this turn, seek two Vampire cards instead.
755597.translation: 抓一张牌。若有对手本回合中失去过生命且你本回合中获得过生命，则改为掏两张吸血鬼牌。

755599.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. If you do, conjure a duplicate of it into your graveyard. The duplicate perpetually becomes a black Skeleton with base power and toughness 3/1 in addition to its other colors and types.
755599.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，将至多一张目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则变出一张该牌的复制牌置入你的坟墓场。该复制牌永久成为基础力量和防御力为3/1的黑色骷髅妖生物，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。

755600.oracleText: Whenever Legion Reconsecrator attacks, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. If you do, conjure a duplicate of it into your graveyard. The duplicate perpetually becomes a black Skeleton with base power and toughness 3/1 in addition to its other colors and types.
755600.translation: 每当军团复圣者攻击时，将至多一张目标生物牌从坟墓场放逐。若你如此作，则变出一张该牌的复制牌置入你的坟墓场。该复制牌永久成为基础力量和防御力为3/1的黑色骷髅妖生物，且仍具有原本颜色与类别。

755601.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, return another target creature card with power or toughness 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
755601.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将另一个目标力量或防御力为1的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

755602.oracleText: When Legion Reconsecrator dies, return another target creature card with power or toughness 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
755602.translation: 当军团复圣者死去时，将另一个目标力量或防御力为1的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

755604.translation: 他们齐声歌唱，永不停息。

755606.oracleText: Each player sacrifices X creatures and you gain X life, where X is this spell's intensity.
755606.translation: 每位牌手各牺牲X个生物且你获得X点生命，X为此咒语的强度数值。

755608.oracleText: If you weren't the starting player, this spell costs {o1} less to cast.
755608.translation: 如果你不是先手牌手，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

755609.oracleText: Target opponent reveals each nonland card in their hand with mana value 4 or less. Choose a card revealed this way or a card in their graveyard. Exile that card.
755609.translation: 目标对手展示其手上所有法术力值等于或小于4的非地牌。选择一张以此法展示的牌或一张在其坟墓场中的牌。放逐该牌。

755613.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, put all cards exiled with it onto the battlefield under their owner's control. Conjure four cards named Volcanic Geyser into your library, then shuffle.
755613.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，将所有以它放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下放进战场。变出四张名称为火泉喷发的牌置于你的牌库，然后洗牌。

755614.oracleText: When Caldera Breaker dies, put all cards exiled with it onto the battlefield under their owner's control. Conjure four cards named Volcanic Geyser into your library, then shuffle.
755614.translation: 当火山口裂地像死去时，将所有以它放逐的牌在其拥有者的操控下放进战场。变出四张名称为火泉喷发的牌置于你的牌库，然后洗牌。

755617.oracleText: {oR}: Kamachal, Ship's Mascot gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
755617.translation: {oR}：船宠卡玛查尔得+1/+0直到回合结束。

755618.oracleText: Whenever Kamachal deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token. Then exile from that player's library a random card with mana value equal to the damage dealt. You may cast that card this turn.
755618.translation: 每当卡玛查尔对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。然后从该牌手的牌库中随机放逐一张法术力值等同于所造成伤害数量的牌。本回合中你可以施放该牌。

755620.oracleText: To the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, gold and distant horizons are both reason enough to set sail.
755620.translation: 对于莽霸联盟海盗们来说，黄金与远方的地平线皆足以吸引他们扬帆起航。

755621.oracleText: Draw a card. If mana from a Treasure was spent to cast this spell, seek a Pirate card instead.
755621.translation: 抓一张牌。若施放此咒语时支付过来自珍宝的法术力，则改为掏一张海盗牌。

755623.oracleText: This spell deals damage equal to its intensity to target creature or planeswalker.
755623.translation: 此咒语对目标生物或鹏洛客造成等同于其强度数值的伤害。

755625.oracleText: A harmonious crescendo that ends in a loud bellow.
755625.translation: 渐强之协音止于巨声之咆哮。

755626.oracleText: Conjure X cards named Colossal Dreadmaw onto the battlefield, where X is this spell's intensity.
755626.translation: 变出X张名称为庞巨血口龙的牌放进战场，X为此咒语的强度数值。

755629.oracleText: Mythweaver Poq's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
755629.translation: 神话织匠波克的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的地数量。

755634.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a spore counter on Propagator Primordium.
755634.translation: 在你的维持开始时，在繁殖原基上放置一个孢子指示物。

755635.oracleText: Remove three spore counters from CARDNAME: Return target Fungus creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
755635.translation: 从CARDNAME上移去三个孢子指示物：将目标真菌生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

755636.oracleText: Remove three spore counters from Propagator Primordium: Return target Fungus creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
755636.translation: 从繁殖原基上移去三个孢子指示物：将目标真菌生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

755638.oracleText: "Rough-Tail, old friend! You're far from the herd today. Is something stirring in the jungle?"
755638.translation: 「嗨，老朋友粗尾龙！你今日离开族群远道而来，是丛林中有什么躁动吗？」

755642.oracleText: Conjure a card named Savage Stomp into your hand.
755642.translation: 变出一张名称为蛮野重跺的牌置于你手上。

755643.oracleText: Conjure a card named Savage Stomp into your hand.
755643.translation: 变出一张名称为蛮野重跺的牌置于你手上。

755644.oracleText: Conjure a card named Naturalize into your hand.
755644.translation: 变出一张名称为回归自然的牌置于你手上。

755645.oracleText: Conjure a card named Naturalize into your hand.
755645.translation: 变出一张名称为回归自然的牌置于你手上。

755649.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If excess damage is dealt this way, conjure a card with mana value equal to that excess damage from Brazen Boarding's spellbook onto the battlefield. If that excess damage is 4 or greater, instead conjure a card named Admiral Beckett Brass onto the battlefield.
755649.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。若以此法造成了过量伤害，则从莽霸登舰的法术书中变出一张法术力值等同于该过量伤害数量的牌放进战场。若该过量伤害等于或大于4，则改为变出一张名称为贝克蒂霸司总帅的牌放进战场。

755650.oracleText: Brazen Boarding deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If excess damage is dealt this way, conjure a card with mana value equal to that excess damage from Brazen Boarding's spellbook onto the battlefield. If that excess damage is 4 or greater, instead conjure a card named Admiral Beckett Brass onto the battlefield.
755650.translation: 莽霸登舰对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。若以此法造成了过量伤害，则从莽霸登舰的法术书中变出一张法术力值等同于该过量伤害数量的牌放进战场。若该过量伤害等于或大于4，则改为变出一张名称为贝克蒂霸司总帅的牌放进战场。

755652.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, conjure a card named Arguel's Blood Fast onto the battlefield and you may transform it. If you control an enchantment named Arguel's Blood Fast and a land named Temple of Aclazotz, instead create two 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature tokens with flying.
755652.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，变出一张名称为阿古尔血禁仪式的牌放进战场且你可以转化它。若你同时操控名称为阿古尔血禁仪式的结界和名称为阿洛佐兹神殿的地，则改为派出两个4/3，白黑双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

755653.oracleText: When High Marshal Arguel dies, conjure a card named Arguel's Blood Fast onto the battlefield and you may transform it. If you control an enchantment named Arguel's Blood Fast and a land named Temple of Aclazotz, instead create two 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature tokens with flying.
755653.translation: 当高阶元帅阿古尔死去时，变出一张名称为阿古尔血禁仪式的牌放进战场且你可以转化它。若你同时操控名称为阿古尔血禁仪式的结界和名称为阿洛佐兹神殿的地，则改为派出两个4/3，白黑双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

755655.oracleText: The farther she swam from one world, the closer she came to the next.
755655.translation: 她游离一世愈远，身临下一世愈近。

755660.oracleText: The mycelium pulsed slowly, as if counting the beats of an enormous heart. The bones around them shuddered, then stood again.
755660.translation: 智蕈缓缓蠕动，其声如巨大心脏之心跳。周围的骸骨随之一震，骤然而起。

755661.oracleText: Fathomless descent — Each creature card in your graveyard perpetually gets +X/+X, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard. Then return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
755661.translation: 落坟无边～你坟墓场中的每张生物牌各永久得加+X/+X，X为你坟墓场中的永久物牌数量。然后将一张生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

755666.oracleText: {o2}: Target creature you control becomes a copy of a creature card exiled with CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.
755666.translation: {o2}：目标由你操控的生物成为以CARDNAME放逐之生物的复制。只能于法术时机起动且只能起动一次。

755667.oracleText: {o2}: Target creature you control becomes a copy of a creature card exiled with Reflection Net. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.
755667.translation: {o2}：目标由你操控的生物成为以映象网阵放逐之生物的复制。只能于法术时机起动且只能起动一次。

755669.oracleText: The Oltec learned from their Imperial cousins, and applied new magic to old artifice in defense of the Core.
755669.translation: 欧尔特人效仿其皇室亲眷，以新式魔法运用于旧时技艺来守卫世界核心。

755670.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, discover X, where X is that damage.
755670.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，倾探X，X为该伤害的数量。

755671.oracleText: Whenever Scalesoul Gnome deals combat damage to a player, discover X, where X is that damage.
755671.translation: 每当鳞魂地侏对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，倾探X，X为该伤害的数量。

755672.oracleText: Whenever you play a card from exile, conjure a duplicate of it into your hand.
755672.translation: 每当你从放逐区使用牌时，变出一张该牌的复制牌置于你手上。

755674.oracleText:
"Give her space! She'll adapt to the Cosmium in her, or kill us trying."
—Yeyetzi, Sun Empire sergeant
755674.translation:
「离她远点！她会适应体内的宇金，那时我们可就惨了！」
～烈阳帝国军士耶耶吉

755675.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever CARDNAME is dealt damage, other Dinosaurs you control and Dinosaur cards in your hand and library perpetually get +1/+1.
755675.translation: 激怒～每当CARDNAME受到伤害时，由你操控的其他恐龙与你手上及牌库中的恐龙牌永久得+1/+1。

755676.oracleText: Enrage — Whenever Stalwart Speartail is dealt damage, other Dinosaurs you control and Dinosaur cards in your hand and library perpetually get +1/+1.
755676.translation: 激怒～每当壮硕矛尾龙受到伤害时，由你操控的其他恐龙与你手上及牌库中的恐龙牌永久得+1/+1。

755677.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o3}. When you do, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
755677.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o3}。当你如此作时，CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

755678.oracleText: Whenever Stalwart Speartail attacks, you may pay {o3}. When you do, Stalwart Speartail deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
755678.translation: 每当壮硕矛尾龙攻击时，你可以支付{o3}。当你如此作时，壮硕矛尾龙对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

755680.oracleText:
"I, who have seen all the world, now go on to what comes next."
—Tan Jolom, last words
755680.translation:
「我曾历经此世，现将步往来世。」
～谭霍勒姆的遗言

755681.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose up to one target artifact or land you control that isn't a creature or token. Until end of turn, it becomes a 3/3 Spirit creature with vigilance and double team in addition to its other types.
755681.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，选择至多一个目标由你操控且既非生物也非衍生物的神器或地。直到回合结束，它成为3/3，具警戒和后继异能的精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。

755683.oracleText: Return any number of creature cards with total mana value {2, Number} or less to the battlefield.
755683.translation: 将任意数量法术力值总和等于或小于{2, Number}的生物牌移回战场。

755684.oracleText: Seek a nonland artifact card with mana value {2, Number} or less.
755684.translation: 掏一张法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的非地神器牌。

755688.oracleText: Target a creature card with power or toughness 1.
755688.translation: 指定一个力量或防御力为1的生物牌为目标。

755693.translation: 指定一张真菌生物牌为目标。

755694.oracleText: Target a Merfolk creature you control.
755694.translation: 指定一个由你操控的人鱼生物为目标。

755696.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
755696.translation: CARDNAME对每个生物和每个鹏洛客各造成1点伤害。

755697.oracleText: Target up to one artifact or land you control that isn't a creature or token.
755697.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控且既非生物也非衍生物的神器或地为目标。

755965.oracleText: Target a permanent you own but don't control.
755965.translation: 指定一个由你拥有但不由你操控的永久物为目标。

755966.oracleText: Target any number of permanents you control.
755966.translation: 指定任意数量由你操控的永久物为目标。

755967.oracleText: Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell.
755967.translation: 你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

755968.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}: Conjure a random card from Tome of the Infinite's spellbook into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755968.translation: {oU}，{oT}：从永恒巨著的法术书中随机变出一张牌置于你手上。所变之牌永久获得「你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。」

755971.oracleText: Whenever a player discards a card during your turn, they choose another player. That player conjures a duplicate of that card into their hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755971.translation: 每当一位牌手在你的回合弃一张牌时，他选择另一位牌手。该牌手变出一张该牌的复制牌置于其手中。它永久得「你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。」

755977.oracleText: When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, exile the top three cards of your library. You may play one of those cards this turn.
755977.translation: 当你施放一个瞬间或法术咒语时，放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。直到回合结束，你可以从中使用一张牌。

755978.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target. You get a one-time boon with "When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, exile the top three cards of your library. You may play one of those cards this turn."
755978.translation: CARDNAME对任意目标造成2点伤害。你获得一次具有「当你施放一个瞬间或法术咒语时，放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。直到回合结束，你可以从中使用一张牌。」的祝福

755979.oracleText: Electrostatic Blast deals 2 damage to any target. You get a one-time boon with "When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, exile the top three cards of your library. You may play one of those cards this turn."
755979.translation: 静电冲击对任意目标造成2点伤害。你获得一次具有「当你施放一个瞬间或法术咒语时，放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。直到回合结束，你可以从中使用一张牌。」的祝福

755980.oracleText: When CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile a nonland card from their library at random. During any turn you attacked with a Wolf or Werewolf, you may cast that card and mana of any type can be spent to cast it.
755980.translation: 当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从该牌手的牌库中随机放逐一张非地牌。于你以狼或狼人攻击过的回合中，你可以施放该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

755981.oracleText: When Rahilda, Wanted Cutthroat deals combat damage to a player, exile a nonland card from their library at random. During any turn you attacked with a Wolf or Werewolf, you may cast that card and mana of any type can be spent to cast it.
755981.translation: 当遭缉割喉客拉希妲对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从该牌手的牌库中随机放逐一张非地牌。于你以狼或狼人攻击过的回合中，你可以施放该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

755982.oracleText: When Rahilda, Feral Outlaw deals combat damage to a player, exile a nonland card from their library at random. During any turn you attacked with a Wolf or Werewolf, you may cast that card and mana of any type can be spent to cast it.
755982.translation: 当野性狂徒拉希妲对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，从该牌手的牌库中随机放逐一张非地牌。于你以狼或狼人攻击过的回合中，你可以施放该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。

755990.oracleText: Target opponent discards a card. Then they may discard an additional card. If they don't, conjure a duplicate of a random card from their library into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755990.translation: 目标对手弃一张牌。然后他可以额外弃一张牌。若他未如此作，从其牌库中随机变出一张牌的复制牌置于你手上。该牌永久得「你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。」

755991.oracleText: Target player sacrifices a nontoken creature. When they do, you may discard a card. If you do, conjure a duplicate of the sacrificed creature into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
755991.translation: 目标牌手牺牲一个非衍生物的生物。当他如此作时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，变出一张所牺牲生物的复制牌置于你手上。该牌永久得「你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。」

755992.oracleText: When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this boon deals damage equal to the noted number to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls.
755992.translation: 当你施放一个瞬间或法术咒语时，祝福对目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成等同于该过量数额的伤害。

If excess damage was dealt this way, note that excess damage, then you get a one-time boon with "When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this boon deals damage equal to the noted number to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls."
755993.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。若以此法造成过量伤害，你获得一次具有「当你施放一个瞬间或法术咒语时，祝福对目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成等同于该过量数额的伤害。」的祝福

755994.oracleText: Molten Impact deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If excess damage was dealt this way, note that excess damage, then you get a one-time boon with "When you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this boon deals damage equal to the noted number to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls."
755994.translation: 熔融冲击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。若以此法造成过量伤害，你获得一次具有「当你施放一个瞬间或法术咒语时，祝福对目标由对手操控的生物或鹏洛客造成等同于该过量数额的伤害。」的祝福

755996.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Choose target opponent. Conjure a duplicate of the top card of their library into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell." Then they exile the top card of their library face down.

755998.oracleText: Choose one — • Counter target noncreature spell. • Conjure a duplicate of target creature card in an opponent's graveyard into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."

756002.translation: 将目标非衍生、非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果此咒语已增幅，变出该牌的复制牌置入你手上。它永久获得「你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。」

756007.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, it perpetually gets +X/+X, where X is its power.
756007.translation: 当你施放一个生物咒语时，它永久得+X/+X，X为其力量。

756020.oracleText: When they sacrifice a creature this way, you may discard a card. If you do, conjure a duplicate of the sacrificed creature into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
756020.translation: 当他如此作时，你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，变出一张所牺牲生物的复制牌置于你手上。该牌永久得「你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。」

756027.oracleText: Weary travelers trade stories of the Eversaloon, an extraplanar respite that appears at the moment it is most needed.
756027.translation: 疲惫旅行者之间的谈资都少不了恒永吧，这处外时空的暂息之地总会在最需要的时候出现。

756028.oracleText: Exile any number of creatures you control, then return them to the battlefield under their owner's control. Then repeat this process X more times.
756028.translation: 放逐任意数量由你操控的生物，然后将它们在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。然后将此流程再重复X次。

756031.oracleText:
"I always wanted to ride a slow cannonball with legs!"
—Kellan
756031.translation:
「会爬的缓行炮弹！我一直都想骑一下。」
～凯澜

756032.oracleText: {o3oW}: CARDNAME gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is its toughness.
756032.translation: {o3oW}：CARDNAME得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为其防御力。

756033.oracleText: {o3oW}: Armored Armadillo gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is its toughness.
756033.translation: {o3oW}：披坚犰狳得+X/+0直到回合结束，X为其防御力。

756037.oracleText: Spells your opponents cast from graveyards or from exile cost {o2} more to cast.
756037.translation: 对手从坟墓场或放逐区中施放的咒语增加{o2}来施放。

756040.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. You gain 1 life for each of those creatures.
756040.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。每有一个此类生物，你便获得1点生命。

756041.oracleText: Whenever Bounding Felidar attacks while saddled, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. You gain 1 life for each of those creatures.
756041.translation: 每当弹跃晶角兽于已乘驾时攻击，在每个由你操控的其他生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。每有一个此类生物，你便获得1点生命。

756044.oracleText: No one could prove the ox did it, but no one tried to harness it again either.
756044.translation: 没人能证明是那头牛干的，但也没人再想去去拴住它。

756045.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or creature. Its controller creates a 2/2 white Ox creature token.
756045.translation: 消灭目标神器或生物。其操控者派出一个2/2白色的牛衍生生物。

756048.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, create a 1/1 white Sheep creature token.
756048.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，派出一个1/1白色绵羊衍生生物。

756049.oracleText: Whenever Bridled Bighorn attacks while saddled, create a 1/1 white Sheep creature token.
756049.translation: 每当御辔巨角羊于已乘驾时攻击，派出一个1/1白色绵羊衍生生物。

756059.oracleText: When Kellan questioned her, Eriette reminded him that she'd been asked only to put the guard to sleep—the request said nothing about waking up.
756059.translation: 当凯澜追究起来时，艾纶缇辩解说当初只是要让她把守卫弄睡着～能不能醒可没提。

756062.oracleText: + {o1} — All creatures lose all abilities until end of turn.
756062.translation: + {o1}～所有生物失去所有异能直到回合结束。

756063.oracleText: + {o1} — Choose a creature you control. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
756063.translation: + {o1}～选择一个由你操控的生物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

756068.oracleText: Whenever Fortune attacks while saddled, at end of combat, exile it and up to one creature that saddled it this turn, then return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control.
756068.translation: 每当福琼于已乘驾时攻击，在战斗结束时，将它和至多一个本回合中乘驾它的生物放逐，然后将这些牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

756074.oracleText: As the vault collapsed around them, Kellan made sure Akul couldn't follow them out.
756074.translation: 随着宝库在他们周围坍塌，凯澜终于确定阿库尔再也不会跟上来。

756075.oracleText: + {o1} — Exile target nontoken creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
756075.translation: + {o1}～放逐目标非衍生物的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

756076.oracleText: + {o2} — Destroy target creature if no other creature has greater power.
756076.translation: + {o2}～选择目标生物。如果其他生物中没有力量比它大的，则将它消灭。

756078.oracleText: They both knew only one of them would walk away.
756078.translation: 他们都清楚：两者之间只有一人能活着离开。

756079.oracleText: {o4oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 5 damage to any target.
756079.translation: {o4oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

756080.oracleText: {o4oR}, Sacrifice High Noon: It deals 5 damage to any target.
756080.translation: {o4oR}，牺牲日正当中：它对任意一个目标造成5点伤害。

756083.oracleText: After it passed by, the rancher swore she saw hope shining in the pigs' eyes.
756083.translation: 自从它飞过之后，牧场主发誓她看到自家的猪眼中都闪烁着希望。

756087.oracleText: "We must forge for ourselves the gifts that nature neglected to give us."
756087.translation: 「自然不愿赋予我们之技艺，我们必须自行打造。」

756088.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and CARDNAME doesn't have a flying counter on it, put a flying counter on it.
756088.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语且CARDNAME上没有飞行指示物，则在其上放置一个飞行指示物。

756089.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and Inventive Wingsmith doesn't have a flying counter on it, put a flying counter on it.
756089.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语且创新翼匠上没有飞行指示物，则在其上放置一个飞行指示物。

756092.oracleText: {oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
756092.translation: {oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。

756096.oracleText: Kellan had no plan. He simply poured his focus into the train and willed it to stop.
756096.translation: 凯澜没有计划。他就只是将注意力倾注在列车上，用意念之力将之截停。

756097.oracleText: You may cast Mystical Tether as though it had flash if you pay {o2} more to cast it.
756097.translation: 如果你施放神秘栓链时多支付{o2}，则你可以将它视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

756100.oracleText: "Count yourself lucky I came upon you. This is not a world of second chances."
756100.translation: 「遇上我该算你自己走运。这世界通常不给人第二次机会。」

756104.oracleText: Freestriders took to patrolling near the Omenpaths, protecting new arrivals from the robbers and charlatans prowling for easy marks.
756104.translation: 畅行帮最近开始在预兆港附近巡逻，保护新来的人不被劫匪骗徒当凯子削。

756105.oracleText: CARDNAME has double strike as long as you've committed a crime this turn.
756105.translation: 只要你本回合中曾犯下罪行，CARDNAME便具有连击异能。

756106.oracleText: Omenport Vigilante has double strike as long as you've committed a crime this turn.
756106.translation: 只要你本回合中曾犯下罪行，预兆港义警便具有连击异能。

756108.oracleText: + {o2} — Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
756108.translation: + {o2}～将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

756109.oracleText: + {o1} — Return target Mount or Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
756109.translation: + {o1}～将目标坐骑或载具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

756110.oracleText: + {o1} — Return target Aura or Equipment card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to a creature you control.
756110.translation: + {o1}～将目标灵气或武具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在一个由你操控的生物上。

756112.oracleText: "What are you gonna do, walk a hundred miles for a second opinion?"
756112.translation: 「你要怎样，是要走一百哩后找第二个人问一问吗？」

756113.oracleText: When Outlaw Medic dies, draw a card.
756113.translation: 当狂徒医士死去时，抓一张牌。

756115.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
756115.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756116.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Prairie Dog.
756116.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语，则在草原犬鼠上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756117.oracleText: {o4oW}: Until end of turn, if you would put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, put that many plus one +1/+1 counters on it instead.
756117.translation: {o4oW}：直到回合结束，如果你将在某个由你操控的生物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物，则改为在其上放置该数量加一的+1/+1指示物。

756120.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a token: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
756120.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个衍生物：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

756121.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice a token: Prosperity Tycoon gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
756121.translation: {o2}，牺牲一个衍生物：兴旺镇大亨获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

756123.oracleText: The Freestriders believe in liberation, in all its many forms.
756123.translation: 解放是畅行帮的信条～各种形式的解放都算。

756126.oracleText: + {o1} — Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls.
756126.translation: + {o1}～在由目标牌手操控的每个生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756129.oracleText: + {o1} — Untap all creatures target player controls.
756129.translation: + {o1}～重置由目标牌手操控的所有生物。

756130.oracleText: + {o1} — Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
756130.translation: + {o1}～目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

756132.oracleText: It catches those who are not ready to fall.
756132.translation: 它会接住那些没准备好就跌落的人。

756142.oracleText:
"Just because you can saddle a critter, doesn't mean it'll let you ride."
—Annie Flash
756142.translation:
「牲口愿让你配鞍，并不代表它愿意被你骑。」
～电闪安妮

756143.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. CARDNAME deals 4 damage to that creature instead if you controlled a Mount as you cast this spell.
756143.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成2点伤害。如果你于施放此咒语时操控坐骑，则改为CARDNAME对该生物造成4点伤害。

756144.oracleText: Steer Clear deals 2 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. Steer Clear deals 4 damage to that creature instead if you controlled a Mount as you cast this spell.
756144.translation: 扭身甩开对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成2点伤害。如果你于施放此咒语时操控坐骑，则改为扭身甩开对该生物造成4点伤害。

756146.oracleText: "If you don't want to tell me where the stash is, you'd best start getting comfy in there. You just let me know when you've changed your mind."
756146.translation: 「你要是不愿告诉我东西藏哪了，那就在里头好好待着吧。等你改主意了再叫我。」

756149.oracleText: The Sterling Company can always rely on him to bring the thunder.
756149.translation: 银光社总能靠他雷震四方。

756152.oracleText: The frontier was an anvil on which many an unlikely hero would be forged.
756152.translation: 边疆就像座大铁砧，许多原本不像英雄的人在此都能锤炼成名。

756156.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while saddled, it gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
756156.translation: 每当CARDNAME于已乘驾时攻击，它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。占卜1。

756157.oracleText: Whenever Trained Arynx attacks while saddled, it gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
756157.translation: 每当驯使猛猁于已乘驾时攻击，它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。占卜1。

756159.oracleText: "The Sterling Company says they protect us, but where are they when the Hellspurs burn half the town? Counting their vaults!"
756159.translation: 「银光社口口声声说会保护我们，但当炼刺帮烧掉大半个镇子时他们又在哪？清点对方的宝库！」

756160.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control die, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
756160.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756161.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control die, put a +1/+1 counter on Vengeful Townsfolk.
756161.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他生物死去时，在复仇镇民上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

756163.oracleText: Many a would-be captor has gotten close enough to count its feathers, only to be left behind with nothing but regret and a dangling rope.
756163.translation: 许多接近成功的擒手原本都追到能够数清羽毛的距离，但出手后又被其甩开，只能看着绳索落空，抱憾而归。

756164.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
756164.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

756165.oracleText: When Wanted Griffin dies, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
756165.translation: 当遭缉狮鹫死去时，派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

756168.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost. That card gains flashback {o0} until end of turn instead if CARDNAME is saddled.
756168.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌获得返照异能直到回合结束。其返照费用等同于其法术力费用。如果大法师的蝾螈已乘驾，则改为该牌获得返照{o0}直到回合结束。

756169.oracleText: Whenever Archmage's Newt deals combat damage to a player, target instant or sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost. That card gains flashback {o0} until end of turn instead if Archmage's Newt is saddled.
756169.translation: 每当大法师的蝾螈对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，目标在你坟墓场中的瞬间或法术牌获得返照异能直到回合结束。其返照费用等同于其法术力费用。如果大法师的蝾螈已乘驾，则改为该牌获得返照{o0}直到回合结束。

756172.oracleText: They cluster near shallow river crossings, blending into the rocks, waiting for unsuspecting travelers to step within range of their claws.
756172.translation: 它们聚集在河口浅滩处，跟四周石头融成一体，静静等着没有提防的旅行者踏入钳子范围。

756173.oracleText: {o1oU}: Canyon Crab gets +2/-2 until end of turn.

756174.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn, draw a card, then discard a card.
756174.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语，则抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

756177.oracleText: It's amazing how many sticky situations you can get out of simply by being ten times faster than anyone expects.
756177.translation: 有太多的惊险情况，只需动作比其他人想的都要快十倍就能安然脱身。

756181.oracleText: "Heard you've been horning in on my turf. How about I introduce you to some surf?"
756181.translation: 「听说你最近在我的地盘上嚣张。要不要我介绍你点场子去转转？」

756182.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, each opponent mills three cards. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756182.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，每位对手各磨三张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756184.oracleText: No one knew if the waterfall was a natural wonder the djinn guarded or if he'd conjured it to hide something even greater.
756184.translation: 没人知道这瀑布是巨灵守护的自然奇观，还是他为隐藏更大秘密而变化出来的幻象。

756187.oracleText: The best alibi is being in multiple places at the same time.
756187.translation: 最好的不在场证明，便是同时在多个地方出场。

756188.oracleText: Whenever you cast an outlaw spell, copy that spell.
756188.translation: 每当你施放狂徒咒语时，复制该咒语。

756190.translation: 第二十八届世界冠军Nathan Steuer

756191.oracleText: CARDNAME's power is equal to the number of cards you've drawn this turn.
756191.translation: CARDNAME的力量等同于你本回合已抓的牌数量。

756192.oracleText: Duelist of the Mind's power is equal to the number of cards you've drawn this turn.
756192.translation: 心灵斗客的力量等同于你本回合已抓的牌数量。

756193.oracleText: Whenever you commit a crime, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
756193.translation: 每当你犯下罪行时，你可以抓一张牌。若你如此作，则弃一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

756195.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and CARDNAME isn't a creature, it becomes a 3/3 Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types.
756195.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语且CARDNAME不是生物，则它成为3/3，具飞行异能的精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。

756196.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and Emergent Haunting isn't a creature, it becomes a 3/3 Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types.
756196.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中未从你手上施放过咒语且新魂萦绕不是生物，则它成为3/3，具飞行异能的精怪生物，且仍具有原本类别。

756198.oracleText:
"We should have taken the blasted ferry!"
—Hope Hagan, prospector
756198.translation:
「我们当初就该去坐那该死的渡轮！」
～探矿人霍普海根

756199.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. If you control a Desert, surveil 1.
756199.translation: 将目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。如果你操控沙漠，则刺探1。

756201.oracleText: The top card of your library has plot. The plot cost is equal to its mana cost.
