757067.translation: {oT}，放逐CARDNAME：每位牌手各放逐其牌库顶的七张牌。直到你的下一个回合，所有牌手都可以使用其以此法放逐的牌，且不能从其手上使用牌。只能于法术时机起动。

757068.oracleText: {oT}, Exile Memory Vessel: Each player exiles the top seven cards of their library. Until your next turn, players may play cards they exiled this way, and they can't play cards from their hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
757068.translation: {oT}，放逐记忆皿：每位牌手各放逐其牌库顶的七张牌。直到你的下一个回合，所有牌手都可以使用其以此法放逐的牌，且不能从其手上使用牌。只能于法术时机起动。

757070.oracleText: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.
757070.translation: 谁都没见过安洁琳的这一面，包括她自己。

757071.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or creature you control, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types. It gains haste until end of turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
757071.translation: 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的神器或生物之复制品，但它额外具有神器此类别。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

757075.oracleText: CARDNAME has all activated abilities of the exiled card.
757075.translation: CARDNAME具有所放逐之牌的所有起动式异能。

757076.oracleText: Territory Forge has all activated abilities of the exiled card.
757076.translation: 领地煅冶炉具有所放逐之牌的所有起动式异能。

757078.oracleText:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!" 
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener
757078.translation:
「我怀疑那东西就是想让我没活干！」 
～仙掌人园丁尖棘比利

757079.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell that's one or more colors, you may gain 1 life for each of that spell's colors. Do this only once each turn.
757079.translation: 每当你施放有色的咒语时，该咒语每有一种颜色，你便可以获得1点生命。每回合只能如此作一次。

757082.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice a Food. If you do, mill three cards. You may put a permanent card from among them into your hand.
757082.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则磨三张牌。你可以将其中一张永久物牌置于你手上。

757083.oracleText: Whenever Bristlebud Farmer attacks, you may sacrifice a Food. If you do, mill three cards. You may put a permanent card from among them into your hand.
757083.translation: 每当棘芽农夫攻击时，你可以牺牲一个食品。若你如此作，则磨三张牌。你可以将其中一张永久物牌置于你手上。

757087.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, choose a card at random exiled with CARDNAME and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
757087.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，随机选择一张以CARDNAME放逐的牌并将之横置放进战场。

757088.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, choose a card at random exiled with Omenpath Journey and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
757088.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，随机选择一张以预兆路旅程放逐的牌并将之横置放进战场。

757090.oracleText: Mora didn't want friends, but she didn't mind having someone to watch her back.

757195.translation: 选择一个以你或由你操控的永久物为目标的咒语。

757199.translation: 当你施放一个生物咒语时，它永久得+1/+0。

757202.translation: 当你施放一个生物咒语时，它永久得+2/+0。

757224.oracleText: When this creature specializes, conjure a duplicate of target creature card exiled with this creature into your hand. The duplicate perpetually gets +1/+0 and gains haste and "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
757224.translation: 当此生物专精时，变出目标从以此生物放逐之生物牌的一张复制牌。该复制牌永久得+1/+0，且获得敏捷异能和「你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。」

757225.oracleText: When this creature specializes, conjure a duplicate of target creature card exiled with this creature into your hand. The duplicate perpetually gets +2/+2 and gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
757225.translation: 当此生物专精时，变出目标从以此生物放逐之生物牌的一张复制牌。该复制牌永久得+2/+2且获得「你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来支付施放该咒语的费用。」

757230.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may return target Pirate creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. It has base power and toughness 4/4. It gains haste until end of turn.
757230.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以将目标海盗生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且其上有一个终命指示物。它的基础力量与防御力为4/4。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

757232.oracleText: When this creature dies, draw a card and create a tapped 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying.
757232.translation: 当此生物死去时，抓一张牌且派出一个已横置的4/3，黑白双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。

757233.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target attacking Vampire that isn't a Demon becomes a Demon in addition to its other types. It gains "When this creature dies, draw a card and create a tapped 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying."
757233.translation: 每当你攻击时，目标进行攻击且不是恶魔的吸血鬼成为恶魔，且仍具有原本类别。它获得「当此生物死去时，抓一张牌且派出一个已横置的4/3，黑白双色，具飞行异能的吸血鬼／恶魔衍生生物。」

757257.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, untap each permanent you control with a counter on it.
757257.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，重置所有由你操控且其上有指示物的永久物。

757258.oracleText: Return target Pirate creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it?
757258.translation: 是否要将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且其上有一个终命指示物？

757259.translation: 指定一张海盗生物牌为目标。

757260.oracleText: Target an attacking Vampire that isn't a Demon.
757260.translation: 指定一个正进行攻击，且非恶魔的吸血鬼为目标。

758362.oracleText: Copy a creature card exiled with it.
758362.translation: 复制一张以其放逐的生物牌。

759691.oracleText: Copy a creature card exiled with {1, CardId}.
759691.translation: 复制一张以{1, CardId}放逐的生物牌。

759692.oracleText: Exile another artifact you control or an artifact card in your graveyard?
759692.translation: 放逐另一个由你操控的神器或一张你坟墓场中的神器牌？

759693.oracleText: Choose a card revealed this way or a card in their graveyard.
759693.translation: 选择一张以此法展示的牌或一张在其坟墓场中的牌。

759694.oracleText: Exile a random card with mana value equal to the damage dealt.
759694.translation: 随机放逐一张法术力值等同于所造成伤害数量的牌。

759695.oracleText: Its gaze gifts you with knowledge no mortal mind should possess.
759695.translation: 其凝视目光能传授你凡人思想不应拥有之知识。

759696.oracleText: Sagas sing of realms long forgotten, shattered by doomskars and cleaved violently from the World Tree.
759696.translation: 末日劫曾将诸多境域粉碎殆尽、从世界树上强行切离。这些遭世人遗忘之地，如今只能从传唱的传纪中窥知一二。

759697.oracleText:
"No one has heard Drivnod speak. But we have seen him do unspeakable things. As he drifts over Ish Sah, a deathly whisper rides the wind. I can never watch for long—I turn away and hide."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster
759697.translation:
「谁也没听过缀文诺出言发声，但都见过他犯下难以言状的累累恶行。他飘过伊沙时，肃杀低语甚至随风传扬。就连我都无法长久注视～只能匆忙逃离隐蔽。」
～志士间谍大师凯拉黎

759698.oracleText:
"I paid a price to one I will not name to escape the abyss. A bit of my soul for a second chance. And I'd do it again, and again—until I had no soul left to trade."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist
759698.translation:
「为能逃出黑暗深渊，我向不能言说之人付出了代价：用部分灵魂来换取重生机会。这笔交易我愿意重复一次又一次～直到灵魂耗光为止。」
～史革达教众蒂努娅

759699.oracleText: "Art exposes truth. Each step of my dance brings me closer to the secrets of the universe."
759699.translation: 「艺术能揭示真理。我每舞动一步，就向洞悉宇宙奥秘更近一分。」

759702.oracleText: "You said you'd hit me with everything you have. Was that all?"
759702.translation: 「你不是说要使尽浑身解数招呼我的来着？就这点能耐？」

759704.oracleText: His pride denied him; his brother did not.
759704.translation: 狮群将他抛弃；兄长并未远离。

759707.oracleText: Whenever one or more other Cats you control die, you may exile Ajani, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
759707.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他猫死去时，你可以放逐阿耶尼，然后将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

759709.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Cat you control.
759709.translation: 在每个由你操控的猫上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

759710.oracleText: Create a 2/1 white Cat Warrior creature token. When you do, if you control a red permanent other than CARDNAME, he deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to any target.
759710.translation: 派出一个2/1白色猫/战士衍生生物。当你如此作时，若你除CARDNAME以外还操控红色永久物，则他对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

759711.oracleText: Create a 2/1 white Cat Warrior creature token. When you do, if you control a red permanent other than Ajani, Nacatl Avenger, he deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to any target.
759711.translation: 派出一个2/1白色猫/战士衍生生物。当你如此作时，若你除拿卡地复仇者阿耶尼以外还操控红色永久物，则他对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

759712.oracleText: Each opponent chooses an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a planeswalker from among the nonland permanents they control, then sacrifices the rest.
759712.translation: 每位对手各从由其操控的非地永久物中选择一个神器、一个生物、一个结界和一个鹏洛客，然后牺牲其余的非地永久物。

759714.oracleText: When disturbed, razorgrass skewers unwary intruders in violent, jingling bursts.
759714.translation: 当锐草遭侵扰时，其尖端会趁来者还没防备时猛然刺过去，扬起叮当声响。

759715.oracleText: Razorgrass Ambush deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
759715.translation: 锐草伏击对目标进行攻击或阻挡的生物造成3点伤害。

759717.oracleText: Leonin hide their dwellings within the Razor Fields, making approach deadly without knowledge of their secret paths.
759717.translation: 狮族将巢穴藏在锐草原野深处，除独门密径之外，任何人想要靠近都是死路一条。

759720.oracleText: Shilgengar's famine once starved Stensia into embracing vampirism. The Dawnhart Coven would not let the same happen to Kessig.
759720.translation: 席更格引致的饥荒曾让食不果腹的史顿襄投入吸血鬼的怀抱。但曙鹿集女巫绝不会让此事在凯锡革重演。

759723.oracleText:
"Ghrin-Danu will not let her people go hungry."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
759723.translation:
「吉琳达努不会让其子民忍饥挨饿。」
～曙鹿集巫首凯蒂妲

759727.oracleText: Whenever the research team stepped out, the specimen emerged to conduct experiments of its own.
759727.translation: 每次研究小组一离开，样本就会浮出缸外投身自己的实验。

759731.oracleText: As long as the scientists were present, the specimen floated patiently or swam quietly about, biding its time, watching.
759731.translation: 只要科学家在场，样本便会耐心漂浮或安静游动，暗中观察、等待时机。

759735.oracleText: The kami help travelers find profound relief, by freeing them from their mortal concerns.
759735.translation: 此处的神明能够帮助旅人斩断实界忧虑，得到彻底放松。

759736.oracleText: Return target spell or nonland permanent an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
759736.translation: 将目标由对手操控的咒语或非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

759738.oracleText: Desperate travelers journey from across Kamigawa, drawn by rumors of relief from all their troubles.
759738.translation: 此地能够排解万千忧虑的消息传开之后，神河各地的绝望旅人便不远万里跋涉而来寻求解脱。

759743.oracleText: Whenever Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student attacks, investigate.
759743.translation: 每当好问学徒多美代攻击时，探查。

759744.oracleText: When you draw your third card in a turn, exile Tamiyo, then return her to the battlefield transformed under her owner's control.
759744.translation: 每当你抓同一回合中你的第三张牌时，放逐多美代，然后将她在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

759746.oracleText: Until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, it gets -1/-0 until end of turn.
759746.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，每当一个生物攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客时，它得-1/-0直到回合结束。

759747.oracleText: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. If it's a green card, add one mana of any color.
759747.translation: 将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。如果它是绿色牌，则加一点任意颜色的法术力。

759748.oracleText: Draw cards equal to half the number of cards in your library, rounded up. You get an emblem with "You have no maximum hand size."
759748.translation: 抓等同于你牌库中牌数量一半的牌，小数点后进位。你获得具有以下异能的徽记~「你的手牌数量没有上限。」

759750.oracleText: "Look what I found, and it's only been dead for a week!"
759750.translation: 「瞧瞧我找到了什么，它刚死还没一星期呢！」

759753.oracleText: A boggart warren is usually located in a place rich with sensations . . . good and bad.
759753.translation: 波尬的繁殖地周围往往充满各式气味……好的坏的都有。

759757.oracleText:
"I can think of no fate more fitting for one so foul as you."
—Aryel, knight of Windgrace
759757.translation:
「像你这般卑劣之物，如此也是我能想到的最合适下场。」
～风华骑士娅耶尔

759759.oracleText:
"The Nethermire is all the salvation you deserve."
—Aryel, knight of Windgrace
759759.translation:
「冥府沼是你能得的唯一救赎。」
～风华骑士娅耶尔

759765.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to the amount of life you gained this turn to any target.
759765.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

759766.oracleText: Sorin, Ravenous Neonate deals damage equal to the amount of life you gained this turn to any target.
759766.translation: 贪婪稚儿索霖对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于你本回合中获得过的生命数量。

759767.oracleText: Gain control of target creature. It becomes a Vampire in addition to its other types. Put a lifelink counter on it if you control a white permanent other than that creature or Sorin.
759767.translation: 获得目标生物的操控权。它成为吸血鬼，且仍具有原本类别。如果你除该生物或索霖之外还操控白色永久物，则在该生物上放置一个系命指示物。

759769.oracleText: Narset brought the Jeskai djinn ancient wisdom and the promise to challenge the status quo.
759769.translation: 娜尔施给洁斯凯巨灵带来了远古智慧的教导，以及改变现状的承诺。

759772.oracleText:
"Fear not the fall. Fear never reaching the pinnacle."
—Narset
759772.translation:
「不应惧怕跌落山崖。而应害怕无法登顶。」
～娜尔施

759776.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell during your turn, flip a coin. If you lose the flip, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to you. If you win the flip, you may exile Ral. If you do, return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
759776.translation: 每当你于你的回合中施放瞬间或法术咒语时，掷一枚硬币。如果你猜错此掷，CARDNAME对你造成1点伤害。如果你猜对此掷，你可以放逐拉尔。若你如此作，则将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

759777.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell during your turn, flip a coin. If you lose the flip, Ral, Monsoon Mage deals 1 damage to you. If you win the flip, you may exile Ral. If you do, return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
759777.translation: 每当你于你的回合中施放瞬间或法术咒语时，掷一枚硬币。如果你猜错此掷，风雨法师拉尔对你造成1点伤害。如果你猜对此掷，你可以放逐拉尔。若你如此作，则将他在其拥有者的操控下移回战场且已转化。

759781.oracleText: Until your next turn, instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.
759781.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，你施放的瞬间与法术咒语减少{o1}来施放。

759782.oracleText: Ral deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets. Draw a card if you control a blue permanent other than Ral.
759782.translation: 拉尔对任意一个或两个目标造成共2点伤害，你可以任意分配。如果你除拉尔以外还操控蓝色永久物，则抓一张牌。

759783.oracleText: Exile the top eight cards of your library. You may cast instant and sorcery spells from among them this turn without paying their mana costs.
759783.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的八张牌。本回合中，你可以从其中施放瞬间和法术咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。

759785.oracleText:
"Idea: Climbing boots also balanced for running."
—Expedition journal entry, very scorched
759785.translation:
「备注待用：登山靴也适合逃命时穿。」
～探险队日志一笔，已严重烧毁

759786.oracleText: Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Creatures without flying can't block this turn.
759786.translation: 消灭目标地。其操控者可以从其牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。不具飞行异能的生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

759788.oracleText: Even the most seasoned adventurers think twice before testing their fortunes on the volcanic teeth of Akoum.
759788.translation: 就算是经验最丰富的冒险者，在要前往阿库姆火山口试试运气前都会再三思量。

759792.oracleText:
"I thought trolls were supposed to be under bridges!"
—Nelvin, Vantress squire
759792.translation:
「我以为巨魔全都躲在桥底下才是！」
～凡翠丝扈从奈温

759793.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. It fights up to one target creature you don't control.
759793.translation: 目标由你操控的生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。它与至多一个目标不由你操控的生物互斗。

759795.oracleText: The chasm formed during the Phyrexian Invasion quickly filled with new life.
759795.translation: 非瑞克西亚大侵攻期间留下的大地裂谷，转眼之间也已重焕生机。

759798.oracleText: "Freyalise is gone, but her song lives on."
759798.translation: 「妃雅丽兹虽逝，但其颂歌永存。」

759802.oracleText: The Juniper Order safeguards secret places that still thrum with traces of Freyalise's life-giving magic.
759802.translation: 如今尚有许多地方仍得妃雅丽兹赋生魔法余效恩泽，杜松教派负责守护各处，使其秘密不被外人所知。

759809.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token, then mill two cards. Put a deathtouch counter on the token if a black card was milled this way.
759809.translation: 派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的昆虫衍生生物，然后磨两张牌。如果以此法磨掉一张黑色牌，则在该衍生物上放置一个死触指示物。

759810.oracleText: For each creature card in your graveyard, create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 1/1 black and green Insect.
759810.translation: 对你坟墓场中的每张生物牌而言，派出一个为前者复制品的衍生物，但它是1/1，黑绿双色的昆虫。

759813.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each 1 life your opponents have lost this turn.
759813.translation: 所有对手本回合中每失去过1点生命，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

759814.oracleText: Target opponent exiles the top three cards of their library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards. If you cast a spell this way, mana of any type can be spent to cast it.
759814.translation: 目标对手放逐其牌库顶的三张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。如果你以此法施放咒语，则可以用任意种类的法术力来施放。

759816.oracleText: All who enter the bog despair, for the first thing it steals is hope.
759816.translation: 进入泥沼者都会彻底绝望，因为其首先窃走的正是希望。

759820.oracleText:
"Mangeni's children take their places among us."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims
759820.translation:
「曼盖尼的子孙与我们同行。」
～坚信朝圣客高阶僧侣艾栗

759822.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if {oC} was spent to cast it, create two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
759822.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若施放它时支付过{oC}，则派出两个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

759824.oracleText:
"Eldrazi scour the world of impurity so that we, the faithful, will inherit paradise."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims
759824.translation:
「奥札奇将世界的不洁清扫而空，令吾等信徒能得享天堂。」
～坚信朝圣客高阶僧侣艾栗

759828.oracleText: Serra may be long gone, but Benalia's faithful still draw strength from her blessings.
759828.translation: 撒拉或早已离去，但宾纳里亚的信徒仍能从其祝福中获得力量。

759830.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has flying and lifelink.
759830.translation: 结附于生物所结附的生物得+2/+2且具有飞行与系命异能。

759832.oracleText:
"Empires fall, cities crumble, righteousness remains."
—Chapel inscription
759832.translation:
「帝国衰落，都市崩毁，正气永存。」
～礼拜堂铭文

759836.oracleText:
"The firemane angels are mighty, but their greatest value lies in the fervor their presence kindles in the heart of a soldier."
—Agrus Kos
759836.translation:
「炎鬃天使虽战力不凡，但其最厉害之处，便是单单现身战场就能点燃士兵心中的热情。」
～阿固寇斯

759838.oracleText: Until end of turn, double target creature's power and it gains first strike.
759838.translation: 直到回合结束，将目标生物的力量加倍且它获得先攻异能。

759840.oracleText: Boros fortresses bristle with high towers so that, even at rest, Legion soldiers can remain in the light of the sun.
759840.translation: 波洛斯要塞当中高塔林立，令教团士兵休息之时仍得沐浴阳光。

759844.oracleText:
"Today, we feast! Tomorrow, we fight! Then, we feast again!"
—Harald, king of Skemfar
759844.translation:
「今天，我们大快朵颐！明天，我们大杀四方！然后，我们再大快朵颐！」
～斯肯法国王哈拉德

759846.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains indestructible until end of turn.
759846.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。

759848.oracleText: The most potent elvish tonics and potions are brewed from the trees containing their imprisoned gods, the Einir.
759848.translation: 妖精最有用的补品与药剂，均是采禁锢妖精古神之树木原料精制而成。

759852.oracleText:
"Insight is like a waterfall—near-limitless power, but only if properly harnessed."
—Saheeli Rai
759852.translation:
「洞察之力正如那瀑布流水一般～虽内蕴无限力量，唯驾驭得当方能显威。」
～莎希莉莱伊

759854.oracleText: Draw two cards. Then discard a card at random unless you pay {oEoE}.
759854.translation: 抓两张牌。然后除非你支付{oEoE}，否则便随机弃一张牌。

759856.oracleText: In the wilds beyond Ghirapur, raw magical energy permeates the landscape.
759856.translation: 在吉拉波之外的野境中，原始魔法能量遍布大地。

759860.oracleText: The Kelema Veil flows through Setessa, allowing Karametra's faithful followers direct access to her wisdom and power.
759860.translation: 刻勒马星帘遍布瑟特萨境内，令卡拉美特拉的信徒得以直接接触她的智慧与力量。

759862.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each creature and/or enchantment you control.
759862.translation: 结附于生物你每操控一个生物和／或结界，所结附的生物便得+1/+1。

759864.oracleText:
"For us, a temple is a part of nature, not something we impose upon it."
—Sythis, Harvest's Hand
759864.translation:
「在我们眼中，殿堂与自然融为一体，并非刻意强加之物。」
～丰收之手叙提丝

759868.oracleText:
"Don't be a superstitious coward. What's a tree going to do, slowly fall on us?"
—Sebastian the Logger
759868.translation:
「别总是神神叨叨地吓自己。一棵树又能怎样，慢慢砸下来？」
～樵夫塞巴斯蒂安

759871.oracleText: The loggers never questioned why the last crew had abandoned camp.
759871.translation: 樵夫从不过问上次前来的人为何弃营而逃。

759875.oracleText: The Consulate's aether spotlights have a setting to incapacitate trespassers on contact.
759875.translation: 执政院的乙太探照灯，能够设定为一照到闯入者就令其全身脱力。

759877.oracleText: Tap all creatures target player controls. You may pay X {oE}, then choose up to X creatures tapped this way. Put a stun counter on each of them.
759877.translation: 横置由目标牌手操控的所有生物。你可以支付X个{oE}，然后选择至多X个以此法横置的生物。在这些生物上各放置一个晕眩指示物。

759879.oracleText:
"Chaos fuels the flames of violence. Only through order can peace be assured."
—Dovin Baan
759879.translation:
「混乱会给暴行火上浇油。唯有秩序才能令和平永驻。」
~多温班恩

759883.oracleText: The long-dead librarians are still on hand to recommend selected titles.
759883.translation: 早已往生的图书馆员仍在亲手推荐珍藏书籍。

759886.oracleText: Moldering tomes line rotting shelves. Generations of priceless knowledge fade from memory beneath the waves.
759886.translation: 渐朽书架上摆满了发霉巨著。几代人累积下来的无价知识，如今只能在波涛之下逐渐遭人遗忘。

759890.oracleText: The shackles of reality were stifling. It would unmake all that had bound it.
759890.translation: 实界的枷锁沉重得令人窒息。它将牵扯其间的一切全都粉碎。

759891.oracleText: When you cast this spell, you gain 1 life for each colorless permanent you control.
759891.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，你每操控一个无色永久物，便获得1点生命。

759894.oracleText: You may reveal this card from your opening hand. If you do, at the beginning of your first upkeep, look at the top four cards of your library. You may put one of those cards back on top of your library. Exile the rest.
759894.translation: 你可以从你的起手牌中展示此牌。如果你如此作，则在你的第一个维持开始时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中一张放回你的牌库顶。放逐其余的牌。

759895.oracleText: When you cast this spell, exile target permanent that's one or more colors.
759895.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，放逐目标有色的永久物。

759898.oracleText: When Emrakul arrived on Innistrad, even fossils answered her twisted call.
759898.translation: 当伊莫库来到依尼翠之后，就连化石都回应了她的扭曲呼唤。

759899.oracleText: When you cast or cycle CARDNAME, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
759899.translation: 当你施放或循环CARDNAME时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

759900.oracleText: When you cast or cycle Drownyard Lurker, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
759900.translation: 当你施放或循环沉船地伏击虫时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

759903.oracleText: If a triggered ability of a colorless spell you control or another colorless permanent you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
759903.translation: 如果由你操控之无色咒语或由你操控之其他无色永久物的某触发式异能触发，则该异能额外触发一次。

759904.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
759904.translation: 每当你施放无色咒语时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

759905.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
759905.translation: 每当你施放无色咒语时，将它复制。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。）

759907.oracleText: Sacrifice two Eldrazi: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
759907.translation: 牺牲两个奥札奇：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

759908.oracleText: Sacrifice two Eldrazi: Return Eldrazi Ravager from your graveyard to your hand.
759908.translation: 牺牲两个奥札奇：将劫夺奥札奇从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

759910.oracleText: When you cast this spell, gain control of all creatures target player controls.
759910.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，获得由目标牌手操控的所有生物之操控权。

759912.oracleText: Protection from permanents that were cast this turn
759912.translation: 反本回合施放之永久物保护

759913.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, sacrifice all creatures you control.
759913.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，牺牲所有由你操控的生物。

759914.oracleText: When Emrakul, the World Anew leaves the battlefield, sacrifice all creatures you control.
759914.translation: 当世界一新伊莫库离开战场时，牺牲所有由你操控的生物。

759917.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
759917.translation: 每当你施放无色咒语时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

759923.oracleText: When you cast this spell, you may exile your hand. If you do, draw three cards.
759923.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，你可以放逐你的手牌。若你如此作，则抓三张牌。

759924.oracleText: Each creature spell you cast has emerge. The emerge cost is equal to its mana cost.
759924.translation: 每个你施放的生物咒语均具有化生异能。其化生费用等同于其法术力费用。

759926.oracleText:
"At first we ignored the little ones. By the time we realized our error, it was too late."
—General Tazri, allied commander
759926.translation:
「一开始我们没把这些小东西放心上。等我们意识到错误时，已经来不及了。」
～盟军指挥官塔兹莉将军

759927.oracleText: Colorless spells you cast with mana value 7 or greater cost {o1} less to cast.
759927.translation: 你施放之法术力值等于或大于7的无色咒语减少{o1}来施放。

759928.oracleText: Other colorless creatures you control get +1/+1.
759928.translation: 由你操控的其他无色生物得+1/+1。

759930.oracleText: When you cast this spell, up to two target players each manifest two cards from their hands. For each card manifested this way, you draw a card.
759930.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，至多两位目标牌手各从其手上显化两张牌。每以此法显化一张牌，你便抓一张牌。

759931.oracleText: Other colorless creatures you control get +3/+2.
759931.translation: 由你操控的其他无色生物得+3/+2。

759934.oracleText: Target player creates X 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
759934.translation: 目标牌手派出X个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

759935.oracleText: Target player scries X, then draws a card.
759935.translation: 目标牌手占卜X，然后抓一张牌。

759936.oracleText: Exile target creature with mana value X or less.
759936.translation: 放逐目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物。

759937.oracleText: Exile up to X target cards from graveyards.
759937.translation: 将至多X张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

759938.oracleText: Choose two — • Target player creates X 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}." • Target player scries X, then draws a card. • Exile target creature with mana value X or less. • Exile up to X target cards from graveyards.
759938.translation: 选择两项～ •  目标牌手派出X个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」 •  目标牌手占卜X，然后抓一张牌。 •  放逐目标法术力值等于或小于X的生物。 •  将至多X张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

759940.oracleText:
"Despite my years, I am still but a student of the Multiverse. How arrogant to think yourself its master."
—Ugin, to Nicol Bolas
759940.translation:
「我此生经年，仍在不断学习多重宇宙新知。你又怎敢妄想成其主宰。」
～乌金怒斥尼可波拉斯

759941.oracleText: Choose one — • Counter target multicolored spell. • Destroy target multicolored permanent.
759941.translation: 选择一项～ •  反击目标多色咒语。 •  消灭目标多色永久物。

759944.oracleText: When you cast this spell, draw two cards.
759944.translation: 每当你施放此咒语时，抓两张牌。

759948.oracleText: When you cast this spell, tap up to two target permanents. Put a stun counter on each of them.
759948.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，横置至多两个目标永久物。在其上各放置一个晕眩指示物。

759954.oracleText: Ulamog has annihilator X, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
759954.translation: 钨拉莫具有歼灭X，X为其上的+1/+1指示物数量。

759957.oracleText: Once, foraging for truffles, the very average boar fell asleep beneath the moon . . . .
759957.translation: 以前，它还只是头普通野猪，每日拱土找寻松露为食，直到它有天在异月之下睡去…

759958.oracleText: When you cast or cycle Warped Tusker, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
759958.translation: 当你施放或循环拧曲长牙野猪时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

759961.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if it was kicked with its {oG} kicker, exile target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
759961.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若曾以{oG}增幅之，则放逐目标由对手操控的神器或结界。

759962.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if it was kicked with its {o1oU} kicker, return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
759962.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若曾以{o1oU}增幅之，则将目标由对手操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

759964.oracleText: The hordechief's ground tactics were unsurpassed. If only he'd thought to watch the skies.
759964.translation: 部落长在地面上的用兵出神入化。可惜他就没想着抬头往空中看一看。

759967.oracleText: Exile target creature an opponent controls with power 3 or greater.
759967.translation: 放逐目标由对手操控且力量等于或大于3的生物。

759968.oracleText: Create a 2/1 white Cat Warrior creature token, then put a vigilance counter on a creature you control.
759968.translation: 派出一个2/1白色猫／战士衍生生物，然后在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个警戒指示物。

759969.oracleText: Target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn.
759969.translation: 目标由你操控的生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

759972.oracleText: Whenever two or more creatures attack, put an oil counter on CARDNAME.
759972.translation: 每当两个或更多生物攻击时，在CARDNAME上放置一个烁油指示物。

759973.oracleText: Whenever two or more creatures attack, put an oil counter on Argent Dais.
759973.translation: 每当两个或更多生物攻击时，在银蚀高台上放置一个烁油指示物。

759974.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove two oil counters from CARDNAME: Exile another target nonland permanent. Its controller draws two cards.
759974.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从CARDNAME上移去两个烁油指示物：放逐另一个目标非地永久物。其操控者抓两张牌。

759975.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Remove two oil counters from Argent Dais: Exile another target nonland permanent. Its controller draws two cards.
759975.translation: {o2}，{oT}，从银蚀高台上移去两个烁油指示物：放逐另一个目标非地永久物。其操控者抓两张牌。

759977.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, put a collection counter on CARDNAME. Then if there are three or more collection counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, draw a card, then you may search your library for a Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
759977.translation: 每当任一牌手施放非生物咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个收藏指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多收藏指示物，将它牺牲。若你如此作，则抓一张牌，然后你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

759978.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell, put a collection counter on Charitable Levy. Then if there are three or more collection counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, draw a card, then you may search your library for a Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
759978.translation: 每当任一牌手施放非生物咒语时，在征赋济贫上放置一个收藏指示物。然后如果其上有三个或更多收藏指示物，将它牺牲。若你如此作，则抓一张牌，然后你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

759980.oracleText: As long as another player controls enchanted creature, it can't attack or block. Otherwise, CARDNAME has umbra armor.
759980.translation: 只要所结附的生物是由另一位牌手操控，它便不能进行攻击或阻挡。若否，则CARDNAME具有本影甲异能。

759981.oracleText: As long as another player controls enchanted creature, it can't attack or block. Otherwise, Dog Umbra has umbra armor.
759981.translation: 只要所结附的生物是由另一位牌手操控，它便不能进行攻击或阻挡。若否，则狗本影具有本影甲异能。

759984.oracleText: Modified creatures you control have lifelink.
759984.translation: 由你操控且有饰装的生物具有系命异能。

759986.oracleText:
"It safeguards the greatest treasure of all: our memories of those most precious to us."
—Elspeth
759986.translation:
「它守护着我们最宝贵的东西：与珍爱之人的美好回忆。」
～艾紫培

759987.oracleText: {oT}: Return another target permanent you control and all Auras you control attached to it to their owner's hand. Activate only during your turn.
759987.translation: {oT}：将另一个目标由你操控的永久物和所有由你操控且贴附于其上的灵气移回其拥有者手上。只能于你的回合中起动。

759989.oracleText: Choose target creature with mana value 3 or less. If this spell was kicked, instead choose target creature. Exile the chosen creature, then its controller gains life equal to its mana value.
759989.translation: 选择目标法术力值等于或小于3的生物。如果此咒语已增幅，则改为选择目标生物。放逐所选生物，然后其操控者获得等同于其法术力值的生命。

759991.oracleText: "I call upon a power greater than myself."
759991.translation: 「我可借助比我更强大的力量。」

759992.oracleText: You may sacrifice a nontoken white creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
759992.translation: 你可以牺牲一个非衍生物的白色生物，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

759993.oracleText: Until end of turn, your life total can't change, and permanents you control gain hexproof and indestructible.
759993.translation: 直到回合结束，你的总生命不会改变，且由你操控的永久物获得辟邪与不灭异能。

759997.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
759997.translation: CARDNAME上每有一个+1/+1指示物，所结附的生物便得+1/+1。

759998.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on Glyph Elemental.
759998.translation: 图符元素上每有一个+1/+1指示物，所结附的生物便得+1/+1。

760000.oracleText: Whenever a modified creature you control dies, manifest the top card of your library.
760000.translation: 每当一个由你操控且有饰装的生物死去时，显化你的牌库顶牌。

760003.oracleText: Whenever you attack, you may pay {oEoEoE}. When you do, put two +1/+1 counters and a flying counter on target attacking creature. It becomes an Angel in addition to its other types.
760003.translation: 每当你攻击时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。当你如此作时，在目标进行攻击的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物和一个飞行指示物。它成为天使，且仍具有原本类别。

760007.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, it gains first strike until end of turn.
760007.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

760008.oracleText: Whenever Hexgold Slith attacks, you may pay {oEoE}. If you do, it gains first strike until end of turn.
760008.translation: 每当金角板斯立兹攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。若你如此作，则它获得先攻异能直到回合结束。

760009.oracleText: Whenever Hexgold Slith deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
760009.translation: 每当金角板斯立兹对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760011.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has afterlife 1.
760011.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有往生1。

760015.oracleText: Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
760015.translation: 派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

760016.oracleText: Create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
760016.translation: 派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

760020.oracleText: Choose up to one target artifact or creature card in your graveyard. You get {oEoE}. Then you may pay an amount of {oE} equal to that card's mana value. If you do, return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
760020.translation: 选择至多一张目标在你坟墓场中的神器或生物牌。你得到{oEoE}。然后你可以支付等同于该牌法术力值数量的{oE}。若你如此作，则将其从你的坟墓场移回战场。

760022.oracleText: The Machine Orthodoxy finds skin impure, and will not sully their creations with impure material.
760022.translation: 机械正道视皮肤为不洁之物，避免让自己的造物遭其沾染。

760023.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has flying.
760023.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有飞行异能。

760025.oracleText: "I am no sleeper agent. I am a liberator. It is you who are asleep."
760025.translation: 「我不是潜藏密探。我是解放者。你才是沉睡不醒那一个。」

760029.oracleText: Morbid — At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, populate.
760029.translation: 丧心～在你的结束步骤开始时，若本回合中有生物死去，则殖民。

760031.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has mentor.
760031.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且具有训导异能。

760035.oracleText: Enchantment spells you cast have affinity for Auras.
760035.translation: 你施放的结界咒语具有灵气共鸣异能。

760036.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Aura spell that targets a modified permanent you control, draw a card.
760036.translation: 每当你施放以由你操控且有饰装之永久物为目标的灵气咒语时，抓一张牌。

760038.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile up to one other target nonland permanent. At the beginning of the next end step, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Phelia.
760038.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，放逐至多另一个目标非地永久物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。如果它是在你的操控下进场，则在费利亚上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760039.oracleText: Whenever Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd attacks, exile up to one other target nonland permanent. At the beginning of the next end step, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on Phelia.
760039.translation: 每当亢奋牧犬费利亚攻击时，放逐至多另一个目标非地永久物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。如果它是在你的操控下进场，则在费利亚上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760041.oracleText: Put a shield counter on target permanent.
760041.translation: 在目标永久物上放置一个后盾指示物。

760042.oracleText: Put a shield counter on target permanent.
760042.translation: 在目标永久物上放置一个后盾指示物。

760049.oracleText: "Embrace the light, or succumb to the shadows."

760058.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to twice the number of creatures you control to target creature.
760058.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之生物数量的两倍。

760059.oracleText: Thraben Charm deals damage equal to twice the number of creatures you control to target creature.
760059.translation: 瑟班护符对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之生物数量的两倍。

760060.oracleText: Exile any number of target players' graveyards.
760060.translation: 放逐任意数量目标牌手的坟墓场。

760061.oracleText: Choose one — • CARDNAME deals damage equal to twice the number of creatures you control to target creature. • Destroy target enchantment. • Exile any number of target players' graveyards.
760061.translation: 选择一项～ •  CARDNAME对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之生物数量的两倍。 •  消灭目标结界。 •  放逐任意数量目标牌手的坟墓场。

760062.oracleText: Choose one — • Thraben Charm deals damage equal to twice the number of creatures you control to target creature. • Destroy target enchantment. • Exile any number of target players' graveyards.
760062.translation: 选择一项～ •  瑟班护符对目标生物造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控之生物数量的两倍。 •  消灭目标结界。 •  放逐任意数量目标牌手的坟墓场。

760066.oracleText: CARDNAME gains vigilance and lifelink until end of turn.
760066.translation: CARDNAME获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。

760067.oracleText: Voltstorm Angel gains vigilance and lifelink until end of turn.
760067.translation: 激电暴天使获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。

760068.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
760068.translation: 由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

760069.oracleText: Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
760069.translation: 由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

760070.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oEoE}. When you do, choose one — • CARDNAME gains vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. • Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
760070.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oEoE}。当你如此作时，选择一项～ •  CARDNAME获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。 •  由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

760071.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oEoE}. When you do, choose one — • Voltstorm Angel gains vigilance and lifelink until end of turn. • Other creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
760071.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oEoE}。当你如此作时，选择一项～ •  激电暴天使获得警戒与系命异能直到回合结束。 •  由你操控的其他生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

760073.oracleText: His oath required no service beyond death, but his honor demanded it.
760073.translation: 他的誓言不追及往生，但他的荣耀令其死后依然效忠如常。

760077.oracleText: After a moment's confusion, the otter splashed through clouds and gamboled in the wind, delighting in its newfound freedom.
760077.translation: 水獭起初还略不适应，但很快就能穿梭云间、随风嬉戏，享受这份新的自在之身。

760078.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Put a flying counter on it. Scry 1.
760078.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。在其上放置一个飞行指示物。占卜1。

760080.oracleText: Even the weather of Dominaria shifts to assail would-be invaders.
760080.translation: 就连多明纳里亚的天气，都变作狂风暴雨来迎接即将到来的入侵者。

760081.oracleText: You get X {oE}, then you may pay any amount of {oE}. Destroy each artifact, creature, and enchantment with mana value less than or equal to the amount of {oE} paid this way.
760081.translation: 你得到X个{oE}，然后你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。消灭所有法术力值等于或小于以此法支付之{oE}数量的神器、生物和结界。

760083.oracleText:
"The shield doesn't block the fire physically. It tells the fire to stop."
—Genku, future shaper
760083.translation:
「这护盾实际上并非阻隔火焰。它是让火焰自己熄灭。」
～未来塑师玄古

760084.oracleText: Choose target spell. You get {oEoE}, then you may pay any amount of {oE}. Counter that spell unless its controller pays {o1} for each {oE} paid this way.
760084.translation: 选择目标咒语。你得到{oEoE}，然后你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。除非该咒语的操控者为每个以此法支付的{oE}各支付{o1}，否则反击之。

760090.oracleText: Pay {oEoEoEoE}: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
760090.translation: 支付{oEoEoEoE}：CARDNAME成为神器生物直到回合结束。

760091.oracleText: Pay {oEoEoEoE}: Bespoke Battlewagon becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
760091.translation: 支付{oEoEoEoE}：订制陆行舰成为神器生物直到回合结束。

760093.oracleText: In the Cosmos, secrets swirl and spark like windborne embers, and only Alrund can capture them.
760093.translation: 寰宇之内，各式秘密飘摇其间，如风中残烬一般明灭不定，唯有艾朗德能够将其为己所用。

760094.oracleText: Draw four cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.
760094.translation: 抓四张牌，然后将两张牌从你手上以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

760096.oracleText: He wept not for what was, but what could never be.
760096.translation: 他并非为过去之既往伤感，而是为将来所不达落泪。

760098.oracleText: Counter target triggered ability or colorless spell.
760098.translation: 反击目标触发式异能或无色咒语。

760100.oracleText: The best hiding places are other people.
760100.translation: 最好的藏身之处，就是藏在他人身上。

760101.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it connives.
760101.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，令它筹谋。

760106.oracleText: Within its body, three lineages warred for supremacy.
760106.translation: 在其体内，有三股血脉在互相争夺主导之势。

760110.oracleText: Forced to behold such a pitiful demonstration of scholarship, Archmage Jeven could hold his tongue no longer.
760110.translation: 在无奈地看完这些糟糕的学术展示之后，大法师耶文都没忍住要说上几句。

760111.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast for each card you've drawn this turn.
760111.translation: 你本回合中每抓过一张牌，此咒语便减少{o1}来施放。

760114.oracleText: Target player draws two cards, then discards a card.
760114.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

760115.oracleText: Target player draws two cards, then discards a card.
760115.translation: 目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

760116.oracleText: When you cast this spell, choose one. If it was kicked, choose both instead. • Return target creature to its owner's hand. • Target player draws two cards, then discards a card.
760116.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，选择一项。如果它已增幅，则改为两项都选。 •  将目标生物移回其拥有者手上。 •  目标牌手抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

760118.oracleText: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, proliferate.
760118.translation: 每当任一牌手施放每回合中其第二个咒语时，你增殖。

760125.oracleText: "Obey her will! Don't be a fool! Submit your mind to Emrakul!"
760125.translation: 「遵从她的意志！别做傻事！把思想交给伊莫库！」

760126.oracleText: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760126.translation: 每当你抓每回合中你的第二张牌时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760128.oracleText: "I see where you're going with that, and I don't like it."
760128.translation: 「我知道你要作什么。我不喜欢。」

760129.oracleText: You may sacrifice a nontoken blue creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
760129.translation: 你可以牺牲一个非衍生物的蓝色生物，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。反击目标咒语。

760131.oracleText: The rising moon calls mercilessly to the waves, commanding the sea to rise high enough to devour mountains.
760131.translation: 月亮升起，召引浪潮接连来袭，使得海面不断攀升，淹没高山也不在话下。

760135.oracleText: When you cast this spell, counter target spell an opponent controls unless they pay {o1}.
760135.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，除非目标由对手操控的咒语之操控者支付{o1}，否则反击之。

760137.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 4, 5, or 6, create two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760137.translation: 每当你施放法术力值为4，5或6的生物咒语时，派出两个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760138.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 7 or greater, draw three cards.
760138.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于7的生物咒语时，抓三张牌。

760140.oracleText: When you cast this spell, tap up to one target creature and put a stun counter on it.
760140.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，横置至多一个目标生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

760142.oracleText: "The world shifts constantly, but that doesn't mean it can't be mapped. Our maps must shift as well."
760142.translation: 「虽然世界一直在变，但不意味着没办法绘制地图。只是我们的地图也要一直跟着变。」

760146.oracleText: "Someday, we will walk the Blind Eternities and see the truths that lie beyond the stifling veil of reality."
760146.translation: 「总有一天，我们能够自由穿行黑暗虚空，亲身看清藏在实界沉重帘幕之后的真相。」

760147.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. Spend this mana only to cast a colorless spell or to activate an ability.
760147.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。此法术力只能用来施放无色咒语，或是起动异能。

760149.oracleText: "Pre-criminal notions detected in the Sixth Precinct. The suspect will confess when arrested in two hours."
760149.translation: 「第六城区侦测到犯罪预备思想。嫌犯两小时后就会被逮捕并认罪。」

760153.oracleText: Live fully, then return to the beginning.
760153.translation: 充实地过完一生，然后重归起点。

760156.oracleText: Some birds sing to nature's beauty and the freedom of the skies. Others simply ask questions.
760156.translation: 有些飞鸟为自然美景和壮阔天空而歌。而有些就只会提问。

760157.oracleText: Counter target artifact, creature, or planeswalker spell. Its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying.
760157.translation: 反击目标神器，生物或鹏洛客咒语。其操控者派出一个2/2蓝色，具飞行异能的鸟衍生生物。

760159.oracleText: Until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, it gets -2/-0 until end of turn.
760159.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，每当一个生物攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客时，它得-2/-0直到回合结束。

760160.oracleText: Discard any number of cards, then investigate twice for each card discarded this way.
760160.translation: 弃任意数量的牌，然后每以此法弃掉一张牌，便探查两次。

760161.oracleText: Shuffle up to three target cards from your graveyard into your library.
760161.translation: 将至多三张目标牌从你的坟墓场洗入你的牌库。

760163.oracleText: "The Golden City was a trinket compared to the power that lies beneath the waves."
760163.translation: 「与潜藏海浪之下的力量相比，黄金城所具有者就跟玩具无异。」

760165.oracleText: {oT}, Pay {oE}: Draw a card, then discard a card.
760165.translation: {oT}，支付{oE}：抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

760168.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME is a creature, it has prowess.
760168.translation: 只要CARDNAME是生物，它便具有灵技异能。

760169.oracleText: As long as Triton Wavebreaker is a creature, it has prowess.
760169.translation: 只要破浪屈东是生物，它便具有灵技异能。

760170.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has prowess.
760170.translation: 所结附的生物得+1/+1且具有灵技异能。

760172.oracleText: "The kami whisper of other worlds, brimming with stories untold. It would take a lifetime to learn them. A lifetime well spent."
760172.translation: 「神明之间低语相传他界之事，有丰富经历未曾言说，可能要花上一生的时间才能探清全貌。但这一辈子花得值。」

760175.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell with mana value 7 or greater, you may exile CARDNAME from your graveyard. When you do, return each nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand.
760175.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于7的无色咒语时，你可以将CARDNAME从你坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，将所有不由你操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

760176.oracleText: Whenever you cast a colorless spell with mana value 7 or greater, you may exile Ugin's Binding from your graveyard. When you do, return each nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand.
760176.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于7的无色咒语时，你可以将乌金的束缚从你坟墓场放逐。当你如此作时，将所有不由你操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

760178.oracleText:
"Maybe we are all just figments of Kozilek's imagination."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage
760178.translation:
「也许我们都只是寇基雷想象出来的虚构之物。」
～遗迹智者亚诺文

760179.oracleText: Draw three cards and create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760179.translation: 抓三张牌并派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760181.oracleText: "I used to think my life was meaningless. Now I know for certain."
760181.translation: 「我一直以为我的生命了无意义。如今我终于确信此事。」

760184.oracleText: Hexproof from activated and triggered abilities
760184.translation: 反起动式与触发式异能辟邪

760188.oracleText: The Accursed are ever drawn to the Hekma, as though its presence provides a brief respite in their lives of eternal torment.
760188.translation: 受诅者一直都被避世帘所吸引，仿佛其存在能为其永恒折磨带来些许缓息。

760194.oracleText:
"Bodies are so much more cooperative with the soul out of the way."
—Liliana
760194.translation:
「没有灵魂碍事之后，躯体就听话多了。」
～莉莲娜

760195.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. You gain 1 life for each of its colors.
760195.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。它每有一种颜色，你便获得1点生命。

760198.oracleText: Pay X {oE}, Sacrifice a creature, Return CARDNAME to its owner's hand: Return target creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
760198.translation: 支付X个{oE}，牺牲一个生物，将CARDNAME移回其拥有者手上：将目标法术力值为X的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

760199.oracleText: Pay X {oE}, Sacrifice a creature, Return Chthonian Nightmare to its owner's hand: Return target creature card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
760199.translation: 支付X个{oE}，牺牲一个生物，将阴冥魇境移回其拥有者手上：将目标法术力值为X的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。只能于法术时机起动。

760201.oracleText: While crossing the mire, Lort the Sneaky found the perfect shortcut to the end of his life.
760201.translation: 鬼祟精洛特在穿越泥沼时发现了一条绝佳捷径，可惜这条路也死得最快。

760202.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life, where X is the number of Swamps you control.
760202.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的沼泽数量。

760203.oracleText: Consuming Corruption deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life, where X is the number of Swamps you control.
760203.translation: 噬物腐化对目标生物或鹏洛客造成X点伤害且你获得X点生命，X为由你操控的沼泽数量。

760210.oracleText: Search your library for a card, exile it face down, then shuffle.
760210.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它牌面朝下地放逐，然后洗牌。

760211.oracleText: Turn the exiled card face up. If it's a creature card, you lose life equal to its mana value.
760211.translation: 将所放逐的牌翻回正面。如果它是生物牌，则你失去等同于其法术力值的生命。

760212.oracleText: You may put the exiled card onto the battlefield if it's a creature card. If you don't put it onto the battlefield, put it into its owner's hand.
760212.translation: 若所放逐的牌是生物牌，你可以将它放进战场。如果你未将它放进战场，则将它置于其拥有者手上。

760215.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
760215.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个神器或生物：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760216.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice another artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on Dreadmobile.
760216.translation: {o1}，牺牲另一个神器或生物：在恐惧夜车上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760218.oracleText: The dream she tastes will be your last.
760218.translation: 她所品尝的梦境，就是你的最后一个。

760220.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, it gains menace until end of turn.
760220.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

760221.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Dreamdrinker Vampire, it gains menace until end of turn.
760221.translation: 每当在饮梦吸血鬼上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，它获得威慑异能直到回合结束。

760223.oracleText: Whenever equipped creature attacks, each opponent loses 1 life.
760223.translation: 每当佩带此武具的生物攻击时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

760226.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
760226.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，将至多一张目标牌从坟墓场放逐。

760228.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, put a creature card exiled with CARDNAME onto the battlefield under your control with a finality counter on it. It gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
760228.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，将一张以CARDNAME放逐的生物牌在你操控下放进战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

760229.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Emperor of Bones, put a creature card exiled with Emperor of Bones onto the battlefield under your control with a finality counter on it. It gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
760229.translation: 每当在白骨帝王上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，将一张以白骨帝王放逐的生物牌在你操控下放进战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。它获得敏捷异能。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它牺牲。

760232.oracleText: The inherently adaptive bodies of the slith made them coveted subjects for compleation.
760232.translation: 斯立兹的身体天生就能根据环境快速调整，因此令他们成了炙手可热的完化对象。

760233.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it. When you do, you may remove a counter from another target permanent or opponent.
760233.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。当你如此作时，你可以从另一个目标永久物或对手上移去一个指示物。

760234.oracleText: Whenever Etched Slith deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it. When you do, you may remove a counter from another target permanent or opponent.
760234.translation: 每当蚀刻斯立兹对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。当你如此作时，你可以从另一个目标永久物或对手上移去一个指示物。

760236.oracleText: Etherium Pteramander can block only creatures with flying.
760236.translation: 乙金翼蜥只能阻挡具飞行异能的生物。

760237.oracleText: {o6oB}: Adapt 4. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each other artifact you control.
760237.translation: {o6oB}：演化4。你每操控一个其他神器，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

760239.oracleText: "We're all just the sum of our parts."
760239.translation: 「我们不过是身体各部分的总和。」

760241.oracleText:
When the night comes knocking
—Kessig expression meaning "in dire times"
760241.translation:
当夜幕来敲门
～凯锡革用语，意指「危急时刻」

760243.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, you may draw two cards. If you do, you lose 2 life.
760243.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以抓两张牌。若你如此作，则你失去2点生命。

760244.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Fetid Gargantua, you may draw two cards. If you do, you lose 2 life.
760244.translation: 每当在腥臭巨罡兽上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以抓两张牌。若你如此作，则你失去2点生命。

760246.oracleText: "Suffer as I have suffered. Lose as I have lost."
760246.translation: 「受我所受之苦。失我所失之物。」

760247.oracleText: You may sacrifice a nontoken black creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
760247.translation: 你可以牺牲一个非衍生物的黑色生物，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

760248.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker with the greatest mana value among creatures and planeswalkers they control.
760248.translation: 每位对手各牺牲一个生物或鹏洛客，且须是由其操控的生物和鹏洛客中法术力值最大者。

760250.oracleText: Target player creates a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
760250.translation: 目标牌手派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。

760251.oracleText: Choose one — • Target player creates a 2/2 black Zombie creature token. • Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
760251.translation: 选择一项～ •  目标牌手派出一个2/2黑色灵俑衍生生物。 •  将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

760256.oracleText: The bustle of life in Towashi opened up new avenues for less benevolent kami.
760256.translation: 都和市行色匆匆的各色人流，让不那么友善的神明看到许多可乘之机。

760257.oracleText: {o4oB}: Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life. This ability costs {o4oB} less to activate if you've drawn three or more cards this turn. Activate only once each turn.
760257.translation: {o4oB}：每位对手各失去2点生命且你获得2点生命。如果你本回合中抓过三张或更多牌，则此异能减少{o4oB}来起动。每回合只能起动一次。

760259.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or sacrifice a modified creature.
760259.translation: 牺牲一个生物或牺牲一个有饰装的生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

760260.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. If the modified creature was sacrificed, draw a card.
760260.translation: 消灭目标生物或鹏洛客。如果牺牲的是有饰装的生物，则抓一张牌。

760262.oracleText: "Ah! Yes! I got its leg to twitch!"
760262.translation: 「哇！好耶！我让它的脚动起来了！」

760263.oracleText: Whenever another creature or artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, each opponent loses 1 life.
760263.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物或神器从战场进入坟墓场时，每位对手各失去1点生命。

760268.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, you may pay any amount of life. If you do, draw that many cards.
760268.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，你可以支付任意数量的生命。若你如此作，则抓等量的牌。

760269.oracleText: Your maximum hand size is five.

760270.oracleText: If a card or token would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
760270.translation: 如果某牌或衍生物将从任何区域进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

760272.oracleText: Nethergoyf's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
760272.translation: 阴间耶夫的力量等同于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别数量，其防御力等同于该数量加1。

760273.oracleText: Escape—{o2oB}, Exile any number of other cards from your graveyard with four or more card types among them.
760273.translation: 逸脱～{o2oB}，从你的坟墓场中放逐任意数量牌张类别总数达四种或更多的其他牌。

760277.oracleText: {o5oB}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each quest counter on CARDNAME. Activate only as a sorcery.
760277.translation: {o5oB}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。CARDNAME上每有一个探索指示物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。只能于法术时机起动。

760278.oracleText: {o5oB}, Sacrifice Quest for the Necropolis: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each quest counter on Quest for the Necropolis. Activate only as a sorcery.
760278.translation: {o5oB}，牺牲探索死冥地：将目标生物牌在你的操控下从坟墓场放进战场。探索死冥地上每有一个探索指示物，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。只能于法术时机起动。

760280.oracleText: When her beloved pet died, the artificer turned to necromancy.
760280.translation: 在她的爱宠过世后，这位神器师转而投身研习死灵术。

760284.oracleText:
"Repair it again! I need reinforcements by tomorrow."
—Ashnod
760284.translation:
「给我重新修！我明天就要见到增援。」
～阿士诺

760285.oracleText: {o3oB}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with two +1/+1 counters on it.
760285.translation: {o3oB}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，且上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

760286.oracleText: {o3oB}: Return Retrofitted Transmogrant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with two +1/+1 counters on it.
760286.translation: {o3oB}：将翻新变械人从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，且上面有两个+1/+1指示物。

760288.oracleText: As the monster lay dying, it stared into the eyes of the human who slew it. Decades later, it has yet to break its gaze.
760288.translation: 怪物倒下直至断气，它都一直死死盯着将其性命夺走的人类。过了数十年之后，它仍在盯着。

760292.oracleText: Queen Marchesa's agents always manage to find the exact evidence they're looking for.
760292.translation: 玛切莎女王的密探总是能够找到他们要找的证据。

760296.oracleText: Sacrifice another creature: Create a Blood token. If you sacrificed an Angel this way, create a number of Blood tokens equal to its toughness instead.
760296.translation: 牺牲另一个生物：派出一个血滴衍生物。如果你以此法牺牲的是天使，则改为派出等同于其防御力数量的血滴衍生物。

760297.oracleText: {o(W/B)o(W/B)o(W/B)}, Sacrifice six Blood tokens: Return each creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Those creatures are Vampires in addition to their other types.
760297.translation: {o(W/B)o(W/B)o(W/B)}，牺牲六个血滴衍生物：将所有生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且上面都有一个终命指示物。这些生物均额外具有吸血鬼此类别。

760300.oracleText: "The living take their souls for granted. The dead know what they're worth."
760300.translation: 「生者不把自己的灵魂当回事。死者知道它们价值几何。」

760301.oracleText: Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature: Create a Treasure token.
760301.translation: 支付1点生命，牺牲另一个生物：派出一个珍宝衍生物。

760303.oracleText:
"Death itself is nothing to cry about. The real tragedy is letting a death go to waste."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student
760303.translation:
「死亡本身并不值得为之哭泣。放任死亡流逝才是真正悲剧。」
～靡华修习法师迪娜

760304.oracleText: {o1oB}, Exile CARDNAME from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
760304.translation: {o1oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐CARDNAME：在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

760305.oracleText: {o1oB}, Exile Wither and Bloom from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
760305.translation: {o1oB}，从你的坟墓场放逐靡美繁华：在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

760307.oracleText: Even a scrap of Phyrexian machinery can be lethal.
760307.translation: 就算非瑞克西亚机械的废料，也能置人死地。

760308.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, create a 1/2 black Phyrexian Wurm artifact creature token with deathtouch and a 2/1 black Phyrexian Wurm artifact creature token with lifelink.
760308.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个1/2黑色，具死触异能的非瑞人／亚龙衍生神器生物，和一个2/1黑色，具系命异能的非瑞人／亚龙衍生神器生物。

760309.oracleText: When Wurmcoil Larva dies, create a 1/2 black Phyrexian Wurm artifact creature token with deathtouch and a 2/1 black Phyrexian Wurm artifact creature token with lifelink.
760309.translation: 当亚龙卷幼虫死去时，派出一个1/2黑色，具死触异能的非瑞人／亚龙衍生神器生物，和一个2/1黑色，具系命异能的非瑞人／亚龙衍生神器生物。

760311.oracleText: Revolt — As long as a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn, if a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
760311.translation: 反抗～只要本回合中有由你操控的永久物离开战场，如果某个由你操控的来源将向任一对手或由对手操控的永久物造成非战斗伤害，便改为它造成原数量加2点伤害。

760312.oracleText: Whenever you get one or more {oE}, CARDNAME deals that much damage to any target.
760312.translation: 每当你得到一个或数个{oE}时，CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

760313.oracleText: Whenever you get one or more {oE}, Aether Revolt deals that much damage to any target.
760313.translation: 每当你得到一个或数个{oE}时，乙太之乱对任意一个目标造成等量的伤害。

760318.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, discard a card, then draw a card. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent and each creature they control. If it's the third time, add {oRoRoRoR}.
760318.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。如果这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则CARDNAME向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物各造成2点伤害。如果是第三次的结算，则加{oRoRoRoR}。

760319.oracleText: Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, discard a card, then draw a card. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, Ashling, Flame Dancer deals 2 damage to each opponent and each creature they control. If it's the third time, add {oRoRoRoR}.
760319.translation: 魔艺～每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，弃一张牌，然后抓一张牌。如果这是此异能在本回合第二次的结算，则舞焰客灰儿向每位对手和每个由对手操控的生物各造成2点伤害。如果是第三次的结算，则加{oRoRoRoR}。

760322.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has flying and haste.
760322.translation: 所结附的生物得+2/+2且具有飞行与敏捷异能。

760323.oracleText: You may cast CARDNAME from your graveyard using its bestow ability.
760323.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用CARDNAME之神授异能来施放之。

760324.oracleText: You may cast Detective's Phoenix from your graveyard using its bestow ability.
760324.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场中利用侦探的凤凰之神授异能来施放之。

760326.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gains haste and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of Eldrazi you control.
760326.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，直到回合结束，目标由你操控的生物获得敏捷异能且得+X/+0，X为由你操控的奥札奇数量。

760328.oracleText: With Dorble's natural immunity to venom, he'd always taken certain comfort in the knowledge that he wouldn't die of snakebite.
760328.translation: 由于多伯天生免疫毒液，因此他总是莫名自信自己不会被蛇咬死。

760329.oracleText: Fanged Flames deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
760329.translation: 利齿烈焰对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。如果本回合中该生物或鹏洛客将死去，则改为将它放逐。

760331.oracleText: "Decent. But let me show you what mastery looks like."
760331.translation: 「很好。但让我给你见识一下何谓杰作。」

760332.oracleText: You may sacrifice a nontoken red creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
760332.translation: 你可以牺牲一个非衍生物的红色生物，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

760335.oracleText: Laws of nature on Mirrodin are always malleable.
760335.translation: 秘罗地的自然法则也很有韧性。

760337.oracleText: Some mornings it wakes up determined to consume the red sun itself.
760337.translation: 有时它早上醒来时，便决心要以红阳本身为食。

760338.oracleText: {oR}: Furnace Hellkite gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
760338.translation: {oR}：熔炉残虐者得+1/+0直到回合结束。

760340.oracleText:
"Remember, if you find a rock making crackly noises, just put it back. Carefully."
—Bo, Great Desert prospector
760340.translation: 「记住，如果你碰到爆裂作响的石头，赶紧放回去。轻轻地。」～大沙漠勘探家博

760341.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. You get {oEoEoE}, then you may pay any amount of {oE}. CARDNAME deals that much damage to that permanent.
760341.translation: 选择目标生物或鹏洛客。你得到{oEoEoE}，然后你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。电流涌射对该永久物造成等量的伤害。

760342.oracleText: Choose target creature or planeswalker. You get {oEoEoE}, then you may pay any amount of {oE}. Galvanic Discharge deals that much damage to that permanent.
760342.translation: 选择目标生物或鹏洛客。你得到{oEoEoE}，然后你可以支付任意数量的{oE}。电流涌射对该永久物造成等量的伤害。

760344.oracleText: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it won't hurt.
760344.translation: 你看不见它，不代表它不会伤人。

760345.oracleText: This spell costs {o2} less to cast if an opponent controls a multicolored permanent.
760345.translation: 如果任一对手操控多色永久物，则此咒语减少{o2}来施放。

760346.oracleText: Ghostfire Slice deals 4 damage to any target.
760346.translation: 灵火削斩对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

760348.oracleText: Gisela beheld true divinity, and was humbled.
760348.translation: 姬瑟拉亲眼见证了真神之威，随即屈身臣服。

760349.oracleText: Exile the top three cards of your library. You may play those cards this turn. At the beginning of the next end step, if any of those cards remain exiled, put them into your graveyard, then create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token for each card put into your graveyard this way. Those tokens have "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760349.translation: 放逐你牌库顶的三张牌。本回合中，你可以使用这些牌。在下一个结束步骤开始时，若这些牌中仍有被放逐者，则将它们置入你的坟墓场，然后每以此法将一张牌置入你的坟墓场，便派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物。这些衍生物具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760352.oracleText: Possession is nine-tenths of the law. His fist is the other tenth.
760352.translation: 俗话说现实占有，九胜一败。他的拳头就是你吃下的那一败。

760353.oracleText: When CARDNAME exploits a creature, gain control of target artifact or creature until end of turn. Untap that permanent. It gains haste until end of turn.
760353.translation: 当CARDNAME榨取生物时，获得目标神器或生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该永久物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

760354.oracleText: When Infernal Captor exploits a creature, gain control of target artifact or creature until end of turn. Untap that permanent. It gains haste until end of turn.
760354.translation: 当炼狱诱引魔榨取生物时，获得目标神器或生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该永久物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

760360.oracleText: There was absolutely nothing suspicious about three moggs carrying barrels of explosives—or so they told everyone who would listen.
760360.translation: 三个带着炸药桶的莫葛一点都不可疑～至少他们向愿听的人是这么说的。

760361.oracleText: Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
760361.translation: 牺牲CARDNAME：它对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共3点伤害，你可以任意分配。

760362.oracleText: Sacrifice Mogg Mob: It deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
760362.translation: 牺牲莫葛暴群：它对任意一个，两个或三个目标造成共3点伤害，你可以任意分配。

760369.oracleText: Noncreature spells you cast from exile have convoke.
760369.translation: 你从放逐区施放的非生物咒语具有召集异能。

760372.oracleText:
"We have made a friend today."
—Slobad, Iron Goblin
760372.translation:
「我们今天交到了新朋友。」
～钢铁鬼怪史罗巴

760374.oracleText: {oT}, Pay {oEoEoE}: Create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
760374.translation: {oT}，支付{oEoEoE}：派出一个3/3无色非瑞人／魔像衍生神器生物。只能于法术时机起动。

760376.oracleText: For every action, a reaction. For every force, a firestorm.

760377.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may reveal the top card of your library. If you do, you may cast that card without paying its mana cost if the two spells have the same mana value.
760377.translation: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，你可以展示你的牌库顶牌。若你如此作，则如果施放该牌所成之咒语的法术力值与对手咒语的法术力值相同，你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

760379.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each creature and planeswalker your opponents control.
760379.translation: CARDNAME向每个由对手操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成2点伤害。

760380.oracleText: Ral and the Implicit Maze deals 2 damage to each creature and planeswalker your opponents control.
760380.translation: 拉尔与隐匿迷宫向每个由对手操控的生物和鹏洛客各造成2点伤害。

760381.oracleText: You may discard a card. If you do, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play them until the end of your next turn.
760381.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用之。

760382.translation: 派出一个咒润怪奇衍生物。

760387.oracleText: "Eureka! Now to show those fools at the Academy how easily I can replicate these results!"
760387.translation: 「有了有了！接下来该让学院的那些蠢货看看我复制这些结果有多容易！」

760389.oracleText: Reiterating Bolt deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
760389.translation: 重诵击对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

760391.oracleText: Built to be super soldiers, the goblins preferred just being super destructive.
760391.translation: 原本想把它们打造成超级士兵，但这些鬼怪却更喜欢搞超级破坏。

760392.oracleText: {o3oR}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 4 damage to target creature.
760392.translation: {o3oR}，牺牲CARDNAME：它对目标生物造成4点伤害。

760393.oracleText: {o3oR}, Sacrifice Sarpadian Simulacrum: It deals 4 damage to target creature.
760393.translation: {o3oR}，牺牲撒尔帕汀拟像械：它对目标生物造成4点伤害。

760395.oracleText: Target creature gets +3/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
760395.translation: 直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+2且获得践踏异能。

760396.oracleText: Choose one — • Destroy target artifact. • Target creature gets +3/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
760396.translation: 选择一项～ •  消灭目标神器。 •  直到回合结束，目标生物得+3/+2且获得践踏异能。

760398.oracleText: It pushes ahead, eliminating lookouts and tactically sowing spawn.
760398.translation: 它不断向前推进，一边清除哨岗，一边有计划地播撒后裔。

760399.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice a nontoken permanent, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760399.translation: 当你牺牲一个非衍生物的永久物时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760403.oracleText: Grandeur — Discard another card named Skoa, Embermage, Sacrifice two Mountains: Skoa deals 4 damage to any target.
760403.translation: 声威～弃掉另一张名称为烬法师斯酷的牌，牺牲两个山脉：斯酷对任意一个目标造成4点伤害。

760406.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {oE}. If you do, another target attacking creature gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
760406.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{oE}。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

760407.oracleText: Whenever Smelted Chargebug attacks, you may pay {oE}. If you do, another target attacking creature gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
760407.translation: 每当热熔充电虫攻击时，你可以支付{oE}。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，另一个目标进行攻击的生物得+1/+0且获得威慑异能。

760410.oracleText: When you cast this spell, create three 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760410.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，派出三个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760411.oracleText: {o1oC}, Sacrifice an Eldrazi: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.
760411.translation: {o1oC}，牺牲一个奥札奇：CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

760412.oracleText: {o1oC}, Sacrifice an Eldrazi: Spawn-Gang Commander deals 2 damage to any target.
760412.translation: {o1oC}，牺牲一个奥札奇：后裔指挥官对任意一个目标造成2点伤害。

760414.oracleText: As wild as unbound aether, and just as dangerous.
760414.translation: 跟无羁乙太一样狂野，也同样危险。

760416.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {oEoEoE}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
760416.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。若你如此作，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760417.oracleText: Whenever Thriving Skyclaw attacks, you may pay {oEoEoE}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
760417.translation: 每当强旺空爪龙攻击时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。若你如此作，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760420.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
760420.translation: 每当你从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

760421.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, Unstable Amulet deals 1 damage to each opponent.
760421.translation: 每当你从你手牌以外的任何区域施放咒语时，不稳定的护身符向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

760422.oracleText: {oT}, Pay {oEoE}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it until you exile another card with CARDNAME.
760422.translation: {oT}，支付{oEoE}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你以CARDNAME放逐另一张牌为止，你可以使用该牌。

760423.oracleText: {oT}, Pay {oEoE}: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it until you exile another card with Unstable Amulet.
760423.translation: {oT}，支付{oEoE}：放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你以不稳定的护身符放逐另一张牌为止，你可以使用该牌。

760429.oracleText: The wheel only has one sure output: chaos.
760429.translation: 这个轮盘只有一个确定结果：混乱。

760430.oracleText: You get {oEoEoE}, then you may pay X {oE}.
760430.translation: 你得到{oEoEoE}，然后你可以支付X个{oE}。

760431.oracleText: Each player may exile their hand and draw X cards. If X is 7 or more, you may play cards you own exiled this way until the end of your next turn.
760431.translation: 每位牌手各可以放逐其手牌并抓X张牌。如果X等于或大于7，则直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用以此法放逐且由你拥有的牌。

760435.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, you may create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760435.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760436.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Basking Broodscale, you may create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760436.translation: 每当在沐日孳巢蜥上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，你可以派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760438.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control a creature, look at the top seven cards of your library. Then you may sacrifice a creature. If you do, you may put a creature card with mana value X or less from among those cards onto the battlefield, where X is 1 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
760438.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你操控生物，则检视你牌库顶的七张牌。然后你可以牺牲一个生物。若你如此作，你可以将这些牌其中一张法术力值等于或小于X的生物牌放进战场，X为所牺牲之生物的法术力值加1。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

760441.oracleText: Target creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
760441.translation: 目标生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

760442.oracleText: Choose one or more — • Destroy target artifact. • Destroy target enchantment. • Target creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
760442.translation: 选择一项或多项～ •  消灭目标神器。 •  消灭目标结界。 •  目标生物获得辟邪与不灭异能直到回合结束。

760444.oracleText: No legs to quake, no lungs to bellow, but if you see its teeth, it's still too late.
760444.translation: 无腿震颤大地，无肺咆哮长空，但如果你看到利齿现形，还是晚了。

760445.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +6/+6 and has trample.
760445.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+6/+6且具有践踏异能。

760448.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}, Tap two untapped creatures you control: Reveal a card from your hand or the top card of your library. If you reveal a creature card this way, put it onto the battlefield. Activate only during your turn.
760448.translation: {oG}，{oT}，横置两个由你操控且未横置的生物：展示你的一张手牌或牌库顶牌。如果你以此法展示出一张生物牌，则将之放进战场。只能于你的回合中起动。

760450.oracleText:
"I almost admire their ability to avoid waste. Almost."
—General Tazri, allied commander
760450.translation:
「我差点就要赞美它们废物利用的能力。就差一点。」
～盟军指挥官塔兹莉将军

760451.oracleText: When you cast this spell and when CARDNAME dies, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760451.translation: 当你施放此咒语和当CARDNAME死去时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760452.oracleText: When you cast this spell and when Eldrazi Repurposer dies, create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760452.translation: 当你施放此咒语和当易生奥札奇死去时，派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760455.oracleText: She remembers every breakthrough, from the gene's mutation to the new life's propagation.
760455.translation: 从基因突破以至新生繁衍，曾被实现的重大突破均永志其心。

760457.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on CARDNAME, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
760457.translation: 每当在CARDNAME上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

760458.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on Evolution Witness, return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
760458.translation: 每当在进化见证人上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，将目标永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

760460.oracleText: Ferocious — {oT}: Add {oGoGoGoG}. Activate only if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
760460.translation: 威猛～{oT}：加{oGoGoGoG}。只能于你操控力量等于或大于4的生物时起动。

760463.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature that had a +1/+1 counter put on it this way.
760463.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后将每个以此法在其上放置了+1/+1指示物的生物上之+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

760464.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, then double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature that had a +1/+1 counter put on it this way.
760464.translation: 在每个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后将每个以此法在其上放置了+1/+1指示物的生物上之+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

760467.oracleText: You may sacrifice a nontoken green creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
760467.translation: 你可以牺牲一个非衍生物的绿色生物，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

760469.oracleText: With a resounding wallop, the ancient battle between buzzard and druid was finally finished.
760469.translation: 随着一记惊天重击，兀鹰与德鲁伊之间这场旷世鏖战终告结束。

760472.oracleText: Ohran mages willingly endure the bites of vipers, believing the snakes bestow great power on those who survive their venom.
760472.translation: 欧然法师相信唯有挺过毒液侵袭者，方能领受毒蛇赋予的强大力量，因此都会心甘情愿受其啮咬。

760473.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter, a reach counter, and a deathtouch counter on target creature. Untap it.
760473.translation: 在目标生物上放置一个 +1/+1指示物一个延势指示物和一个死触指示物。重置该生物。

760475.oracleText: With shifting forms and no angel to pray to, Innistrad's werewolves were especially susceptible to Emrakul's influence.
760475.translation: 依尼翠的狼人本身就能变换形态，加之如今没有天使可供祈祷，所以就特别容易受到伊莫库影响。

760476.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control. If you control an Eldrazi, you gain 3 life.
760476.translation: 目标由你操控的生物对目标不由你操控的生物或鹏洛客造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。如果你操控奥札奇，则你获得3点生命。

760478.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token.
760478.translation: 派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的昆虫衍生生物。

760479.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token.
760479.translation: 派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的昆虫衍生生物。

760480.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token.
760480.translation: 派出一个1/1，黑绿双色的昆虫衍生生物。

760481.oracleText: Sacrifice any number of creatures. Search your library and/or graveyard for a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of creatures sacrificed this way and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
760481.translation: 牺牲任意数量的生物。从你牌库和／或你坟墓场中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于以此法牺牲之生物数量的生物牌，并将之放进战场。如果你以此法搜寻你的牌库，则洗牌。

760483.oracleText: You may exert CARDNAME as it attacks. When you do, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of counters on permanents you control.
760483.translation: 你可以于CARDNAME攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的永久物上之指示物总数量。

760484.oracleText: You may exert Hydra Trainer as it attacks. When you do, target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of counters on permanents you control.
760484.translation: 你可以于多头龙驯师攻击时耗竭之。当你如此作时，目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的永久物上之指示物总数量。

760487.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 and has vigilance and reach.
760487.translation: 所结附的生物得+3/+3且具有警戒与延势异能。

760490.oracleText: What emerged from Turntimber was even more twisted than the forest itself.
760490.translation: 从旋林中突长而出的生命，比这片森林本身还要扭曲。

760491.oracleText: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a permanent card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard. Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760491.translation: 展示你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中一张永久物牌置于你手上。将其余的牌置入你坟墓场。派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760493.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with power 5 or greater, discover X, where X is that spell's mana value.
760493.translation: 每当你施放力量等于或大于5的生物咒语时，倾探X，X为该咒语的法术力值。

760495.oracleText: "Death is a natural part of life. Without the mulch to feed new sprouts, everything withers."
760495.translation: 「死亡是生命不可或缺的一部分。如果没有盖土来滋养新芽，那么万物都会凋零。」

760499.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME and has reach and trample.
760499.translation: 所结附的生物具有延势与践踏异能，且CARDNAME上每有一个+1/+1指示物，它便得+1/+1。

760500.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on Nyxborn Hydra and has reach and trample.
760500.translation: 所结附的生物具有延势与践踏异能，且天裔多头龙上每有一个+1/+1指示物，它便得+1/+1。

760504.oracleText: Eldrazi you control have "{oT}: Add one mana of any color."
760504.translation: 由你操控的奥札奇具有「{oT}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」

760505.oracleText: Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 7 or greater, you gain 4 life.
760505.translation: 每当你施放法术力值等于或大于7的生物咒语时，你获得4点生命。

760507.oracleText: When Gaea speaks, all of nature falls silent.
760507.translation: 盖亚开口时，自然万物皆噤声聆听。

760509.oracleText: You may cast creature spells with mana value 3 or less by paying {oE} rather than paying their mana costs. If you cast a spell this way, you may cast it as though it had flash.
760509.translation: 你可以藉由「支付{oE}，而不支付其法术力费用」之方式施放法术力值等于或小于3的生物咒语。如果你以此法施放咒语，则你可以将之视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

760511.oracleText: Creature tokens you control have evolve.
760511.translation: 由你操控的衍生生物具有进化异能。

760512.oracleText: {o3oG}: Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760512.translation: {o3oG}：派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760514.oracleText: A lone dinosaur in gorilla territory doesn't stand a chance.
760514.translation: 落单的恐龙，在大猩猩的地盘上没有任何胜算。

760515.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control, then each modified creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
760515.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后每个由你操控且有饰装的生物各依其力量对目标不由你操控的生物造成伤害。

760517.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among them into your hand.
760517.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，磨三张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌置于你手上。

760518.oracleText: Whenever Six attacks, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among them into your hand.
760518.translation: 每当六树妖攻击时，磨三张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌置于你手上。

760523.oracleText: When you cast this spell, search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
760523.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。

760524.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if it was kicked, exile target land.
760524.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若它已增幅，则放逐目标地。

760532.oracleText: Its position on the food chain causes great confusion in everyone from hunters to other monsters.
760532.translation: 谁都不清楚它为什么能处在食物链的这个位置～无论是猎人还是其他怪物。

760536.oracleText: When this creature leaves the battlefield, target opponent draws a card.
760536.translation: 当此生物离开战场时，目标对手抓一张牌。

760537.oracleText: When you cast this spell, exile up to one target noncreature, nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 4 or less. If you do, CARDNAME gains "When this creature leaves the battlefield, target opponent draws a card."
