760537.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，放逐至多一个目标由对手操控、法术力值等于或小于4且既非生物也非地的永久物。若你如此作，则CARDNAME获得「当此生物离开战场时，目标对手抓一张牌。」

760538.oracleText: When you cast this spell, exile up to one target noncreature, nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 4 or less. If you do, Thief of Existence gains "When this creature leaves the battlefield, target opponent draws a card."
760538.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，放逐至多一个目标由对手操控、法术力值等于或小于4且既非生物也非地的永久物。若你如此作，则窃生恶体获得「当此生物离开战场时，目标对手抓一张牌。」

760540.oracleText:
"Wait. Is that one Dad?"
—Rowan Kenrith, to Will
760540.translation:
「等等。那头是不是父王？」
～萝婉肯理斯问威尔

760542.oracleText: All who behold its twisted form are consumed by a single-minded obsession: destroy it.
760542.translation: 所有见过它扭曲形态的生灵，脑中都只剩下一个执念：消灭它。

760543.oracleText: When you cast this spell, if {oC} wasn't spent to cast it, target opponent may put a creature card from their hand onto the battlefield.
760543.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，若施放它时未支付过{oC}，则目标对手可以将一张生物牌从其手上放进战场。

760545.oracleText:
"Kozilek experiences reality on his own terms."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims
760545.translation:
「寇基雷会以独到的方式来感受现实。」
～坚信朝圣客高阶僧侣艾栗

760546.oracleText: Exile target nonland permanent. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend colorless mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.
760546.translation: 放逐目标非地永久物。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放该牌，且你可以将无色法术力视同任意颜色的法术力来施放该咒语。

760547.translation: 空骑士队长亚娜肯吕德

760548.oracleText: Whenever a modified creature you control attacks, double the number of each kind of counter on it. Then for each nontoken permanent attached to it, create a token that's a copy of that permanent attached to that creature.
760548.translation: 每当一个由你操控且有饰装的生物攻击时，将其上每种指示物的数量加倍。然后对每个贴附其上且非衍生物的永久物而言，派出一个为该永久物之复制品的衍生物并贴附在该生物上。

760550.oracleText: Warned against wearing metal in a lightning storm, Smurt took it as a challenge.
760550.translation: 有人警告司莫特，不要在电闪雷鸣的日子里穿金属盔甲，而他把这当作了一项挑战。

760552.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {oE}. If you do, another target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains haste until end of turn.
760552.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以支付{oE}。若你如此作，则直到回合结束，另一个目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

760554.oracleText: To ensure proper fit, the mandibles can be inserted directly into the ears.
760554.translation: 为确保完美贴合，其下颚还可以直接插入耳中。

760555.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +X/+1, where X is the number of artifacts you control.
760555.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+X/+1，X为由你操控的神器数量。

760559.oracleText: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this permanent, put an additional +1/+1 counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn.
760559.translation: 每当在此永久物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在其上额外放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

760560.oracleText: Permanents you control have "Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this permanent, put an additional +1/+1 counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn."
760560.translation: 由你操控的永久物具有「每当在此永久物上放置一个或数个+1/+1指示物时，在其上额外放置一个+1/+1指示物。此异能每回合只会触发一次。」

760563.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, you may pay {oEoEoE}. When you do, CARDNAME deals damage equal to its power to any target.
760563.translation: 当CARDNAME巨人死去时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。当你如此作时，超导独眼巨人对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

760564.oracleText: When Cyclops Superconductor dies, you may pay {oEoEoE}. When you do, Cyclops Superconductor deals damage equal to its power to any target.
760564.translation: 当超导独眼巨人死去时，你可以支付{oEoEoE}。当你如此作时，超导独眼巨人对任意一个目标造成等同于其力量的伤害。

760567.oracleText: Pay {oEoE}: Put an exalted counter on target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
760567.translation: 支付{oEoE}：在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个颂威指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

760569.oracleText:
"It eats the royal garbage. Of course it's growing!"
—Prince Bolbuss
760569.translation:
「它吃的是皇室的垃圾。当然会越来越大！」
～波巴斯王子

760571.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target modified creature you control.
760571.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，在目标由你操控且有饰装的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760572.oracleText: Whenever Expanding Ooze attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target modified creature you control.
760572.translation: 每当膨胀流浆攻击时，在目标由你操控且有饰装的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760574.oracleText: Though its official designation was Third Battalion Patrol Hound 7, the soldiers dubbed their new companion Lord Fancy-Paws.
760574.translation: 虽然它的正式呼号是「三营七号犬」，但士兵们都管他们的新伙伴叫花爪大人。

760583.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken permanent you control leaves the battlefield, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn. Create a creature token with those characteristics. • 2/2 white Fox with vigilance. • 1/2 blue Moonfolk with flying. • 1/1 black Rat with lifelink.
760583.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的永久物离开战场时，选择一项，且不得是本回合中此前选过的。派出一个具相应特征的衍生生物。 •  2/2白色的狐，且具警戒异能。 •  1/2蓝色月人，且具飞行异能。 •  1/1黑色老鼠，且具系命异能。

760584.oracleText: {o3oWoU}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
760584.translation: {o3oWoU}：在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760586.oracleText: Aura and Equipment spells you cast cost {oX} less to cast, where X is CARDNAME's power.
760586.translation: 你施放的灵气与武具咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为CARDNAME的力量。

760587.oracleText: Aura and Equipment spells you cast cost {oX} less to cast, where X is Golden-Tail Trainer's power.
760587.translation: 你施放的灵气与武具咒语减少{oX}来施放，X为金尾训练师的力量。

760588.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, other modified creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is CARDNAME's power.
760588.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，由你操控且有饰装的其他生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为CARDNAME的力量。

760589.oracleText: Whenever Golden-Tail Trainer attacks, other modified creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is Golden-Tail Trainer's power.
760589.translation: 每当金尾训练师攻击时，由你操控且有饰装的其他生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为金尾训练师的力量。

760591.oracleText:
"The daylight's done, the nightmare's spun.
It crawls off the loom, and into your room."
—Kithkin children's rhyme
760591.translation:
「夕阳西下，梦魇上架。
爬下织房，进你厅堂。」
～洁英童谣

760592.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may draw cards equal to its power. If you do, discard that many cards.
760592.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以抓等同于其力量的牌。若你如此作，则弃等量的牌。

760593.oracleText: Whenever Horrid Shadowspinner attacks, you may draw cards equal to its power. If you do, discard that many cards.
760593.translation: 每当骇怖纺影怪攻击时，你可以抓等同于其力量的牌。若你如此作，则弃等量的牌。

760597.oracleText: {o3oR}, Sacrifice an artifact: Imskir deals damage equal to the sacrificed artifact's mana value to any target.
760597.translation: {o3oR}，牺牲一个神器：依斯奇对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于所牺牲之神器的法术力值。

760599.oracleText:
"Skreeg! I thought I told you to stop messing with . . . Oh, that worked. Good job, Skreeg."
—Ral Zarek
760599.translation:
「司格力！我叫你不要乱搞…噢，这样通了。好样的，司格力。」
～拉尔查雷克

760600.oracleText: Choose target spell, then flip a coin. If you win the flip, gain control of that spell and you may choose new targets for it. If you lose the flip, counter that spell.
760600.translation: 选择目标咒语，然后掷一枚硬币。如果你猜对此掷，则获得该咒语的操控权，且你可以为其选择新的目标。如果你猜错此掷，则反击该咒语。

760602.oracleText: Hard hats are required. Shock-resistant coveralls aren't, but are highly recommended.
760602.translation: 须着工作帽方能入内。防电工作服虽未硬性规定，但强烈建议穿上。

760603.oracleText: If you would get one or more {oE}, you get that many plus one {oE} instead.
760603.translation: 如果你将得到一个或数个{oE}，则改为你得到该数量加一的{oE}。

760604.oracleText: {oT}: Draw a card. Activate only if you've paid or lost four or more {oE} this turn.
760604.translation: {oT}：抓一张牌。只能于你已支付或失去四个或更多{oE}的回合中起动。

760606.oracleText: Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.
760606.translation: 于巨硕花岗岩上诞生，以极致香甜蜂蜜育养，在狂风暴雪中登基。

760607.oracleText: Other creatures have base power and toughness 2/2 and are Bears in addition to their other types.
760607.translation: 其他生物的基础力量与防御力为2/2，且额外具有熊此类别。

760609.oracleText: Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your hand. This ability triggers only twice each turn.
760609.translation: 每当此生物成为咒语或异能的目标时，展示你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，将之放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。此异能每回合只会触发两次。

760610.oracleText: Creatures you control have "Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your hand. This ability triggers only twice each turn."
760610.translation: 由你操控的生物具有「每当此生物成为咒语或异能的目标时，展示你的牌库顶牌。若它是地牌，将之放进战场。若否，则将它置于你手上。此异能每回合只会触发两次。」

760613.oracleText: Land cards in your graveyard have dredge 2.
760613.translation: 你坟墓场中的地牌具有发掘2。

760615.oracleText: CARDNAME has flying as long as it's modified.
760615.translation: 只要CARDNAME有饰装，它便具有飞行异能。

760616.oracleText: Obstinate Gargoyle has flying as long as it's modified.
760616.translation: 只要顽强石像鬼有饰装，它便具有飞行异能。

760618.oracleText: Whenever another modified creature you control dies, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
760618.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且有饰装的生物死去时，在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

760619.oracleText: Whenever another modified creature you control dies, put two +1/+1 counters on Ondu Knotmaster.
760619.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且有饰装的生物死去时，在昂度结绳师上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

760624.oracleText: Escape—{oRoRoWoW}, Exile five other cards from your graveyard.
760624.translation: 逸脱～{oRoRoWoW}，从你的坟墓场放逐五张其他牌。

760626.oracleText: Out of nothing, something was born.
760626.translation: 万物虚空之内，新境就此诞生。

760627.oracleText: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't, put a card from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
760627.translation: 检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中一张地牌横置放进战场。如果你未如此作，则将其中一张牌置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

760629.oracleText: Some frogs poison the body. Some frogs poison the mind.
760629.translation: 有些蛙会荼毒身体。有些蛙则会荼毒心灵。

760630.oracleText: Whenever Psychic Frog deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, draw a card.
760630.translation: 每当灵能蛙对任一牌手或鹏洛客造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。

760631.oracleText: Discard a card: Put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
760631.translation: 弃一张牌：在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760632.oracleText: Discard a card: Put a +1/+1 counter on Psychic Frog.
760632.translation: 弃一张牌：在灵能蛙上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760633.oracleText: Exile three cards from your graveyard: CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn.
760633.translation: 从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌：CARDNAME获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

760634.oracleText: Exile three cards from your graveyard: Psychic Frog gains flying until end of turn.
760634.translation: 从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌：灵能蛙获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

760636.oracleText: Death has never kept Darigaaz down for long.
760636.translation: 死亡从未让达里迦沉眠太久。

760637.oracleText: Return target artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand. CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's mana value to up to one target creature or planeswalker.
760637.translation: 将目标神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。火热重生对至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成等同于所移回之牌法术力值的伤害。

760638.oracleText: Return target artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Pyretic Rebirth deals damage equal to that card's mana value to up to one target creature or planeswalker.
760638.translation: 将目标神器或生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。火热重生对至多一个目标生物或鹏洛客造成等同于所移回之牌法术力值的伤害。

760641.oracleText: Whenever you attack, you may pay {oEoE}. When you do, target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
760641.translation: 每当你攻击时，你可以支付{oEoE}。当你如此作时，目标由你操控的生物获得系命异能直到回合结束。

760645.oracleText: {oT}: Reveal any number of cards with {oX} in their mana cost in your hand. Add {oCoC} for each card revealed this way. Spend this mana only on costs that contain {oX}.
760645.translation: {oT}：从你手上展示任意数量法术力费用中包含{oX}的牌。每以此法展示一张牌，便加{oCoC}。此法术力只能用来支付包含{oX}的费用。

760647.oracleText: A whiff of aether brings the horde out of hiding.
760647.translation: 一阵乙太微风就能令全员倾巢而出。

760650.oracleText: Pay {oEoEoEoE}: Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.
760650.translation: 支付{oEoEoEoE}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。

760653.oracleText: Once considered a delicacy, turtle soup is no longer served in Nephalia's inns.
760653.translation: 龟汤原本是涅非利亚的旅馆佳肴，如今这道美食在此处已难觅踪影。

760656.oracleText: Though the High Fae gave explicit instructions not to tarry, she stayed in Sweettooth Village for seconds, thirds, and then dessert.
760656.translation: 虽然至高仙明令禁止逗留，但她还是在甘饴村吃到了第二道、第三道菜乃至甜品。

760657.oracleText: When you draw your third card in a turn, return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
760657.translation: 每当你抓同一回合中你的第三张牌时，将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

760658.oracleText: When you draw your third card in a turn, return Sneaky Snacker from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
760658.translation: 每当你抓同一回合中你的第三张牌时，将鬼祟贪吃灵从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

760660.oracleText: With a shriek, it directed the spawn toward the temple where the refugees sheltered.
760660.translation: 尖啸声后，它领后裔冲向难民藏身的殿堂。

760661.oracleText: When you cast this spell and whenever CARDNAME attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
760661.translation: 当你施放此咒语和每当CARDNAME攻击时，在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760662.oracleText: When you cast this spell and whenever Titans' Vanguard attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each colorless creature you control.
760662.translation: 当你施放此咒语和每当巨物先锋攻击时，在每个由你操控的无色生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760664.oracleText: Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.
760664.translation: 她对班特地貌了然于胸，此点深得新恶魔领主的赏识。

760665.oracleText: Wight of the Reliquary gets +1/+1 for each creature card in your graveyard.
760665.translation: 你坟墓场中每有一张生物牌，圣物老妖便得+1/+1。

760666.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice another creature: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760666.translation: {oT}，牺牲另一个生物：从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760668.oracleText: When you cast this spell, create two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760668.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，派出两个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760669.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another Eldrazi, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
760669.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个奥札奇时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760670.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice another Eldrazi, put a +1/+1 counter on Writhing Chrysalis.
760670.translation: 每当你牺牲另一个奥札奇时，在纠拧孵化蛹上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760673.oracleText: Spells with the chosen name cost {o3} more to cast.
760673.translation: 具该名称的咒语增加{o3}来施放。

760676.oracleText: {o1oC}, {oT}: Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760676.translation: {o1oC}，{oT}：派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760677.oracleText: Whenever another Eldrazi you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
760677.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的奥札奇死去时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760678.oracleText: Whenever another Eldrazi you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Idol of False Gods.
760678.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的奥札奇死去时，在伪神雕像上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760679.oracleText: As long as CARDNAME has eight or more +1/+1 counters on it, it's a 0/0 creature in addition to its other types and it has annihilator 2.
760679.translation: 只要CARDNAME上有八个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便是0/0生物，仍具有原本类别，且具有歼灭2。

760680.oracleText: As long as Idol of False Gods has eight or more +1/+1 counters on it, it's a 0/0 creature in addition to its other types and it has annihilator 2.
760680.translation: 只要伪神雕像上有八个或更多+1/+1指示物，它便是0/0生物，仍具有原本类别，且具有歼灭2。

760684.oracleText: {oT}, Pay {oE}: Add one mana of any color.
760684.translation: {oT}，支付{oE}：加一点任意颜色的法术力。

760686.oracleText: No one knew who invented it. No one knew its purpose. All anyone knew was they didn't like being anywhere near it.
760686.translation: 没人知道谁发明了它。没人知道它有何作用。所有人只知道谁都不想靠近它。

760687.oracleText: Whenever a player casts a spell, if no mana was spent to cast it, counter that spell.
760687.translation: 每当任一牌手施放咒语，若施放它时未支付过法术力，则反击该咒语。

760688.oracleText: {o1}, {oT}, Sacrifice Vexing Bauble: Draw a card.

760690.oracleText:
"The sun and moon have decided to make a competition of our misery."
—Naromin, veteran explorer
760690.translation:
「太阳和月亮决定来比一比，谁会让我们更痛苦。」
～资深探险家纳若敏

760691.oracleText: Players can't untap more than one nonbasic land during their untap steps.
760691.translation: 牌手于其重置步骤中所重置的非基本地不能多于一个。

760694.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}: The next spell you cast this turn has improvise.
760694.translation: {oU}，{oT}：你本回合中施放的下一个咒语具有拼造异能。

760697.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Exert CARDNAME: Add {oRoR}. If that mana is spent on a creature spell, it gains haste until end of turn.
760697.translation: {oR}，{oT}，耗竭CARDNAME：加{oRoR}。如果该法术力用以支付生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

760698.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}, Exert Arena of Glory: Add {oRoR}. If that mana is spent on a creature spell, it gains haste until end of turn.
760698.translation: {oR}，{oT}，耗竭荣光竞技场：加{oRoR}。如果该法术力用以支付生物咒语，则它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。

760699.oracleText: A graveyard for conquerors and conquered alike.
760699.translation: 征服者与抵抗者共眠一处的坟墓。

760701.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Forest, Island, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760701.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，海岛或山脉牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760702.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Bountiful Landscape: Search your library for a basic Forest, Island, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760702.translation: {oT}，牺牲富饶地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，海岛或山脉牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760705.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Plains, Island, or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760705.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原，海岛或沼泽牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760706.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Contaminated Landscape: Search your library for a basic Plains, Island, or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760706.translation: {oT}，牺牲污化地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原，海岛或沼泽牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760709.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Plains, Swamp, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760709.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原，沼泽或树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760710.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Deceptive Landscape: Search your library for a basic Plains, Swamp, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760710.translation: {oT}，牺牲欺瞒地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的平原，沼泽或树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760712.oracleText: Once a prosperous Vantress town, now swept clean and reclaimed by the waters of the wilds.
760712.translation: 此处曾有一座繁华的凡翠丝小镇，如今已被幻野流水冲刷殆尽，消失一空。

760714.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Swamp, Forest, or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760714.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，树林或海岛牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760715.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Foreboding Landscape: Search your library for a basic Swamp, Forest, or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760715.translation: {oT}，牺牲恶兆地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，树林或海岛牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760719.oracleText: {o2oWoW}, {oT}: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a historic card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
760719.translation: {o2oWoW}，{oT}：检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张史迹牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

760721.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Island, Mountain, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760721.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛，山脉或平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760722.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Perilous Landscape: Search your library for a basic Island, Mountain, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760722.translation: {oT}，牺牲险恶地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛，山脉或平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760724.oracleText: A warped gateway that seeps toxins and malevolence into the waters around Towashi.
760724.translation: 将怨毒与恶意渗入都和市周遭水域的扭曲门户。

760726.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Island, Swamp, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760726.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛，沼泽或山脉牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760727.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Seething Landscape: Search your library for a basic Island, Swamp, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760727.translation: {oT}，牺牲火热地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的海岛，沼泽或山脉牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760730.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Mountain, Plains, or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760730.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉，平原或沼泽牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760731.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Shattered Landscape: Search your library for a basic Mountain, Plains, or Swamp card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760731.translation: {oT}，牺牲破碎地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉，平原或沼泽牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760734.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760734.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉，树林或平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760735.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Sheltering Landscape: Search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760735.translation: {oT}，牺牲庇护地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的山脉，树林或平原牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760739.oracleText: Delirium — {o2oGoG}: CARDNAME becomes a copy of target permanent card in your graveyard until end of turn. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
760739.translation: 躁狂～{o2oGoG}：CARDNAME成为目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌之复制品直到回合结束。只能于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多时起动。

760740.oracleText: Delirium — {o2oGoG}: Shifting Woodland becomes a copy of target permanent card in your graveyard until end of turn. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
760740.translation: 躁狂～{o2oGoG}：变幻林地成为目标在你坟墓场中的永久物牌之复制品直到回合结束。只能于你坟墓场中牌的牌张类别有四种或更多时起动。

760743.oracleText: {oB}, {oT}: Target creature you control connives X, where X is the number of creatures that died this turn.
760743.translation: {oB}，{oT}：令目标由你操控的生物筹谋X，X为本回合中死去的生物数量。

760745.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Forest, Plains, or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760745.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，平原或海岛牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760746.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Tranquil Landscape: Search your library for a basic Forest, Plains, or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760746.translation: {oT}，牺牲安宁地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的树林，平原或海岛牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760749.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a basic Swamp, Mountain, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760749.translation: {oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，山脉或树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760750.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice Twisted Landscape: Search your library for a basic Swamp, Mountain, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760750.translation: {oT}，牺牲扭曲地境：从你牌库中搜寻一张基本的沼泽，山脉或树林牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760755.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. If a card is exiled with CARDNAME, add {oCoC} instead.
760755.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。如果仍有以CARDNAME放逐之牌，则改为加{oCoC}。

760756.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oC}. If a card is exiled with Ugin's Labyrinth, add {oCoC} instead.
760756.translation: {oT}：加{oC}。如果仍有以乌金的迷宫放逐之牌，则改为加{oCoC}。

760757.oracleText: {oT}: Return the exiled card to its owner's hand.
760757.translation: {oT}：将所放逐之牌移回其拥有者手上。

760760.oracleText: No matter how deep Urza delved, he couldn't escape his regrets.
760760.translation: 无论克撒挖掘多深，都埋葬不了他的悔恨。

760761.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760761.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760762.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Sacrifice Urza's Cave: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
760762.translation: {o3}，{oT}，牺牲克撒的洞窟：从你牌库中搜寻一张地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

760763.oracleText: An underground paradise, bright and thriving beneath the surface of Ixalan.
760763.translation: 依夏兰表面之下，是一片充满希望、生机盎然的地底天堂。

760764.oracleText: Home and hunting ground for Kaldheim's fearsome trolls.
760764.translation: 凯德海姆可怖巨魔的家园与猎场。

760766.oracleText: {o4oW}, {oT}: Exile another target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
760766.translation: {o4oW}，{oT}：放逐另一个目标由你操控的生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

760767.oracleText: "The kingdom is in peril! Who among you is brave enough to defend it?"
760767.translation: 「王国有难！勇士快来保家卫国！」

760769.oracleText: Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, you may copy this spell and may choose a new target for the copy.
760769.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。如果此咒语是从坟墓场施放，则你可以复制此咒语，且可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

760771.oracleText: "No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"
760771.translation: 「万象不出我掌握。你凭什么觉得自己有此能耐？」

760772.oracleText:
"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."
—Teferi
760772.translation:
「凯雷威克相信龙兽们的鸣叫是在预言他的胜利；然而事实上，它们是在为他即将面临的死亡哀悼。」
～泰菲力

760775.oracleText: For each {oB} in a cost, you may pay 2 life rather than pay that mana.
760775.translation: 对任一费用中的每个{oB}而言，你可以支付2点生命，而不支付该法术力。

760776.oracleText: Whenever you cast a black spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
760776.translation: 每当你施放黑色咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760777.oracleText: Whenever you cast a black spell, put a +1/+1 counter on K'rrik, Son of Yawgmoth.
760777.translation: 每当你施放黑色咒语时，在约格莫夫之子格锐克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

760778.oracleText: Catastrophes happened so often at the mana rig that the viashino language had a special word to describe them.
760778.translation: 魔力钻探机经常发生大灾变，以至于凡尔西诺甚至以专有名词来描述它。

760779.oracleText: As Aclazotz's undead forces approached the temple of Ojer Kaslem, they met a roaring wall of vibrant, flourishing life.
760779.translation: 眼看阿洛佐兹的不死大军就要逼近卡司勒尊神的神殿，此地忽然怒吼声起，诸多物种生机勃发，犹如高墙一般堵住了来犯者的去路。

760780.oracleText: In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.
760780.translation: 在广袤无垠的虚无之中，卡莉雅发现自己并非独自一人。

760781.oracleText: It is a sun-dappled glade in the morning, the aroma of spring's first blossoms, and the melody of birds chirping in a joyful chorus. It is life.
760781.translation: 它是清晨中阳光斑驳的林地，是春花初绽时的芬芳，是飞鸟齐鸣的欢乐颂歌。它就是生命。

760782.oracleText: It is the imposing heft of a ruler's scepter, the stench of death after a victory in battle, and the mournful wail of an enemy kneeling in supplication. It is power.
760782.translation: 它是权杖上王者威严的象征，是血战险胜后的腐臭，是脚下俘虏的苦苦哀声。它就是力量。

760783.oracleText: It is a helping hand reaching out to the downtrodden, the acrid-sweet tang of burning incense during prayer, and the harmony of voices uplifted in unison. It is faith.
760783.translation: 它是艰困时伸向难民的援手，是焚香祈祷时的辛甜，是团结高呼的振奋和音。它就是信念。

760784.oracleText: It is the warm glow of the setting sun at journey's end, the scent of the evening meal crackling over a fire, and the cacophony of a raucous song shared over tankards of mead. It is freedom.
760784.translation: 它是终点处西下斜阳的柔光，是晚餐篝火中的飘香，是举杯欢庆的热情高歌。它就是自由。

760785.oracleText: It is the glimpse of a new horizon beyond the hills, the briny taste of salt spray off a ship's hull, and the whisper of pages turning in a new book. It is discovery.
760785.translation: 它是跋涉后崭新天地的风景，是远洋航船上的咸涩，是翻阅新书的纸页摩挲。它就是发现。

760786.oracleText:
"Our recruitment drives are bringing in fewer fresh troops every day. We need a new strategy."
—Urza, to Tawnos
760786.translation:
「我们的征兵宣传每天招徕的新员数量越来越少。我们得有新的方案。」
～克撒嘱咐达硌士

760787.oracleText: A monument to long-forgotten gods, it stands as a tribute to the fleeting nature of human ways.
760787.translation: 这是早受遗忘之诸神的纪念碑，见证着人类行为的快速变迁。

760788.oracleText:
"A cursed silhouette to look upon. Even if the halls stand empty, its vile shadows blight the land. I shudder to think of the evils that it held."
—Koth
760788.translation:
「光看残影便令人毛骨悚然。纵使如今已人去楼空，其黑暗阴影仍在侵蚀大地。我甚至不敢回想它曾经承载的邪恶。」
～寇斯

760794.oracleText: If you control a red permanent other than CARDNAME, he deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control to any target.
760794.translation: 若你除CARDNAME以外还操控红色永久物，则他对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于由你操控的生物数量。

760795.oracleText: Until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, it gets -1/-0 until end of turn.
760795.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，每当一个生物攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客时，它得-1/-0直到回合结束。

760798.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Choose up to {2, Number} creature tapped this way?} other {Choose up to {2, Number} creatures tapped this way?}}
760798.translation: {2, plural, =1 {是否要选择至多{2, Number}个以此法横置的生物？} other {是否要选择至多{2, Number}个以此法横置的生物？}}

760799.oracleText: At the beginning of your first upkeep, look at the top four cards of your library. You may put one of those cards back on top of your library. Exile the rest.
760799.translation: 在你的第一个维持开始时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以将其中一张放回你的牌库顶。放逐其余的牌。

760802.translation: 指定至多两个永久物为目标。

760803.translation: 是否要牺牲两个永久物？

760805.oracleText: Target a creature an opponent controls with power 3 or greater.
760805.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且力量等于或大于3的生物为目标。

760806.oracleText: Put a vigilance counter on a creature you control.
760806.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个警戒指示物。

760807.translation: 牺牲一个非衍生物的白色生物。

760808.oracleText: Pay an amount of {oE} equal to that card's mana value?
760808.translation: 是否要支付等同于该牌法术力值之数量的{oE}？

760809.oracleText: Target up to one artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
760809.translation: 指定至多一张你坟墓场中的神器或生物牌为目标。

760814.oracleText: Target up to one nonbasic land.
760814.translation: 指定至多一个非基本地为目标。

760815.translation: 牺牲一个非衍生物的蓝色生物。

760816.oracleText: Spend only on: A Colorless Spell or an Ability
760816.translation: 只能用于支付：异能或无色咒语

760817.oracleText: Target an artifact, creature, or planeswalker spell.
760817.translation: 指定一个神器，生物或鹏洛客咒语为目标。

760818.oracleText: Until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, it gets -2/-0 until end of turn.
760818.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，每当一个生物攻击你或由你操控的鹏洛客时，它得-2/-0直到回合结束。

760819.oracleText: Return each nonland permanent you don't control to its owner's hand.
760819.translation: 将每个不由你操控的非地永久物各移回其拥有者手上。

760821.oracleText: Cast a spell from among cards exiled this way without paying its mana cost?
760821.translation: 是否要从以此法放逐的牌之中施放一个咒语，且不支付其法术力费用？

760822.oracleText: Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
760822.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

760823.oracleText: You may remove a counter from another target permanent or opponent.
760823.translation: 你可以从另一个目标永久物或对手上移去一个指示物。

760824.oracleText: Remove a counter from another target permanent or opponent?
760824.translation: 是否要从另一个目标永久物或对手上移去一个指示物？

760825.translation: 牺牲一个非衍生物的黑色生物。

760826.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature or planeswalker with the greatest mana value among creatures and planeswalkers you control.
760826.translation: 牺牲一个由你操控的生物或鹏洛客，且须是由你操控的生物和鹏洛客中法术力值最大者。

760827.oracleText: Search for a card with mana value less than or equal to your devotion to black.
760827.translation: 搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于你黑色献力的牌。

760828.translation: 牺牲一个有饰装的生物。

760829.translation: 牺牲一个非衍生物的红色生物。

760830.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, if any of those cards remain exiled, put them into your graveyard, then create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token for each card put into your graveyard this way. Those tokens have "Sacrifice this creature: Add {oC}."
760830.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，若这些牌中仍有被放逐者，则将它们置入你的坟墓场，然后每以此法将一张牌置入你的坟墓场，便派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物。这些衍生物具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」

760831.oracleText: Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
760831.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它放逐。

760832.oracleText: Discard another card named Skoa, Embermage.
760832.translation: 弃掉另一张名称为烬法师斯酷的牌。

760835.oracleText: Reveal a card from your hand or the top card of your library.
760835.translation: 从你手上或你的牌库顶展示一张牌。

760836.translation: 牺牲一个非衍生物的绿色生物。

760837.oracleText: Search for a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of creatures sacrificed this way.
760837.translation: 从你牌库和／或你坟墓场中搜寻一张法术力值等于或小于以此法牺牲之生物数量的生物牌。

760839.translation: 指定一个有饰装的生物为目标。

760840.oracleText: Target up to one noncreature, nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 4 or less.
760840.translation: 指定至多一个由对手操控、法术力值等于或小于4且既非生物也非地的永久物为目标。

760841.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to its power to any target.
760841.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成伤害，其数量等同于前者的力量。

760842.oracleText: Target a modified creature you control.
760842.translation: 指定一个由你操控且有饰装的生物为目标。

760843.oracleText: Target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.
760843.translation: 指定一个由你操控的生物为目标，它获得系命异能直到回合结束。

760844.oracleText: Put a card with {oX} in its mana cost into your hand?
760844.translation: 是否要将一张法术力费用中包含{oX}的牌置于你手上？

760845.oracleText: Search for a basic Forest, Island, or Mountain card.
760845.translation: 搜寻一张基本的树林，海岛或山脉牌。

760846.oracleText: Search for a basic Plains, Swamp, or Forest card.
760846.translation: 搜寻一张基本的平原，沼泽或树林牌。

760847.oracleText: Search for a basic Swamp, Forest, or Island card.
760847.translation: 搜寻一张基本的沼泽，树林或海岛牌。

760848.oracleText: Search for a basic Island, Mountain, or Plains card.
760848.translation: 搜寻一张基本的海岛，山脉或平原牌。

760849.oracleText: Exile a colorless card with mana value 7 or greater?
760849.translation: 是否要放逐一张法术力值等于或大于7的无色牌？

760854.oracleText: Additional effect when spent on: An Artifact or Creature Spell
760854.translation: 用于施放神器或生物咒语时有额外效应

760855.oracleText: Additional effect when spent on: A Permanent Spell
760855.translation: 用于施放永久物咒语时有额外效应

760858.oracleText: Sacrifice any number of other creatures.
760858.translation: 牺牲任意数量的其他生物。

760859.oracleText: Cast any number of instant and/or sorcery spells from among the exiled cards without paying their mana costs?
760859.translation: 是否要从所放逐之牌中施放任意数量的瞬间和／或法术咒语，且不支付它们的法术力费用？

760929.oracleText: CARDNAME deals damage equal to its intensity to any target. Then cards you own named Static Discharge intensify by 1.
760929.translation: CARDNAME对任意一个目标造成等同于其强度数值的伤害。然后你拥有的名称为静电放射的牌强度增加1。

760930.oracleText: Static Discharge deals damage equal to its intensity to any target. Then cards you own named Static Discharge intensify by 1.
760930.translation: 静电放射对任意一个目标造成等同于其强度数值的伤害。然后你拥有的名称为静电放射的牌强度增加1。

760931.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals damage equal to its intensity to any target. Then CARDNAME intensifies by 1.
760931.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成等同于其强度数值的伤害。然后CARDNAME强度增加1。

760932.oracleText: Whenever Bellowsbreath Ogre attacks, it deals damage equal to its intensity to any target. Then Bellowsbreath Ogre intensifies by 1.
760932.translation: 每当嚎息食人魔攻击时，它对任意一个目标造成等同于其强度数值的伤害。然后嚎息食人魔强度增加1。

760956.oracleText: Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional amount of {oG} equal to CARDNAME's intensity. Then CARDNAME intensifies by 1.
760956.translation: 每当横置所结附的地以产生法术力时，其操控者额外加若干点{oG}，其数量等同于CARDNAME的强度数值。然后CARDNAME强度增加1。

760957.oracleText: Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional amount of {oG} equal to Runaway Growth's intensity. Then Runaway Growth intensifies by 1.
760957.translation: 每当横置所结附的地以产生法术力时，其操控者额外加若干点{oG}，其数量等同于落跑蔓生的强度数值。然后落跑蔓生强度增加1。

760963.oracleText: Target up to one non-Aura enchantment card.
760963.translation: 指定至多一张非灵气的结界牌为目标。

761148.oracleText: Whenever one or more permanents you control leave the battlefield, cards you own named Minthara of the Absolute intensify by 1. This ability triggers only once each turn.
761148.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的永久物离开战场时，你拥有的名称为至上真神教派明萨拉的牌强度增加1。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

761170.oracleText: Cards you own named Piece It Together intensify by 1.
761170.translation: 你拥有的名称为聚力修补的牌强度增加1。

761220.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice CARDNAME unless you discard a card. If you discard a card this way, CARDNAME intensifies by 1.
761220.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你弃一张牌，否则牺牲CARDNAME。如果你以此法弃一张牌，则CARDNAME强度增加1。

761221.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Great Desert Hellion unless you discard a card. If you discard a card this way, Great Desert Hellion intensifies by 1.
761221.translation: 在你的维持开始时，除非你弃一张牌，否则牺牲高大沙漠地狱兽。如果你以此法弃一张牌，则高大沙漠地狱兽强度增加1。

761225.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may cast a spell with mana value equal to CARDNAME's intensity from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If you do, Jarsyl intensifies by 1.
761225.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以从你的坟墓场施放一个法术力值等同于CARDNAME之强度数值的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你如此作，则雅西尔强度增加1。

761226.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may cast a spell with mana value equal to Jarsyl, Dark Age Scion's intensity from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If you do, Jarsyl intensifies by 1.
761226.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，你可以从你的坟墓场施放一个法术力值等同于暗纪末裔雅西尔之强度数值的咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。若你如此作，则雅西尔强度增加1。

761296.oracleText: {o3oWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Target opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is Arek's intensity.
761296.translation: {o3oWoB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：目标对手失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为阿雷克的强度数值。

761297.oracleText: {o3oWoB}, {oT}, Sacrifice Arek, False Goldwarden: Target opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is Arek's intensity.
761297.translation: {o3oWoB}，{oT}，牺牲伪金坚卫阿雷克：目标对手失去X点生命且你获得X点生命，X为阿雷克的强度数值。

761298.oracleText: Charismatic and well connected. Knows their worth and charges accordingly.
761298.translation: 富有人格魅力，消息灵通，懂行。

761299.oracleText: No help. Answered questions with a mix of hissing and drool.
761299.translation: 毫无帮助。回答问题时只会嘶哈嘶哈地流口水。

761300.oracleText: Currently defines its neighborhood as all of Districts Eight and Nine, extending lately into parts of the Tenth.
761300.translation: 目前把第八区和第九区各处当自己家，近来延伸到第十区的一部分。

761301.oracleText: A great boon to have an angel on hand, but highly suspect she reports information to Aurelia before us.
761301.translation: 局里有天使确实很方便，但强烈怀疑会先把情报透露给欧瑞梨。

761302.oracleText: Invariably reaches the correct conclusion. Cannot be rushed.
761302.translation: 总能给出正确结论。但绝不能催。

761303.oracleText: Investigative skills: impeccable. People skills: lacking.
761303.translation: 侦查能力：无可挑剔。沟通能力：严重不足。

761304.oracleText: Identity unknown. Body count unknown but potentially in the dozens.
761304.translation: 身份不明。杀害人数不详，或达数十人之众。

761305.oracleText: Just let the Golgari deal with it.

761306.oracleText: Patient and surprisingly clever, though he does need to be reminded not to eat the corpses.
761306.translation: 富有耐心，意外地聪明，但需要提醒他勿食尸体。

761307.oracleText: Owner and star of Hellbender. A trendsetter in both fashion and violence.
761307.translation: 地狱乐园的园长兼明星。时尚界与暴行界的红人。

761308.oracleText: Do not approach. Stay a safe distance away, and then take five more steps back.
761308.translation: 切勿靠近。保持安全距离，并再往后退五步。

761309.oracleText: Chaotic, but surprisingly fearless. Often seen in the company of a strangely intelligent hound.
761309.translation: 爱闹事，但格外勇敢。常带着一条异常聪明的狗。

761310.oracleText: An actual signatory of the original Guildpact. Over 10,000 years old, but doesn't look a day over 2,500.
761310.translation: 原原十会盟实际签署者之一。年龄已超一万岁，但看起来不过两千五。

761311.oracleText: Kylox's most advanced detector yet. Don't let it near your keys.
761311.translation: 奇洛兹迄今最先进的探测械。切勿让它靠近你的钥匙。

761314.oracleText:
"One of these people is the mastermind. I wonder, do they still believe they won't be caught?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761314.translation:
「案件主谋就藏在这些人当中。我在想，他们是否依然觉得自己能够逍遥法外？」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761315.oracleText:
"The Azorius are too obsessed with facts to see the truth that knits them together. They'll never solve this case unless I step in."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761315.translation:
「俄佐立过于注重个别事证，却看不清将它们串成一体的真相。我要是不出手，他们永远破不了案。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761316.oracleText:
"Honestly, the real surprise would be if a powerful member of the Orzhov didn't hang around after their demise."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761316.translation:
「说实话，如果哪个欧佐夫权贵死掉之后没有在现场露脸，那才是意料之外。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761317.oracleText:
"With the treacherous Oba separated from her sisters, I'm hopeful that Trostani will, in some form, eventually recover."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761317.translation:
「性情大变的欧芭已脱离姐妹身躯，但我相信卓塔妮最终一定会如常恢复均衡。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761318.oracleText:
"It's not so bad working with Etrata. She's taciturn, and she has saved my life twice today."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761318.translation:
「跟艾庄塔一起行动也不是坏事。她不太说话，但光今天就救了我两次命。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761319.oracleText:
"The Agency's detectives will eliminate the false leads. I will find the truth."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761319.translation:
「魔调局侦探会排除错误线索。我会找到真相。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761320.oracleText:
"Of course! It was all so obvious. I should have made the connection days ago."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761320.translation:
「就该如此！这都再明显不过了。我几天前就该把它们都串起来。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761321.oracleText:
"As I suspected, Kylox had prepared a secret exit. But the question remains: Did he escape his assailants or was he taken against his will?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761321.translation:
「跟我想的一样，奇洛兹果然留了一道密门。不过谜团还没解开：他是自行逃出还是被人掳走？」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761322.oracleText:
"The Azorius will be annoyed with me for breaking out their star suspect, but what else is new."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761322.translation:
「我带着俄佐立的头号嫌疑犯脱逃，他们看我更不顺眼，一切就老样子。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761323.oracleText:
"Etrata claims she has no memory of committing the murder. Somehow, I believe she's telling the truth."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761323.translation:
「艾庄塔声称她对自己犯下这桩血案毫无记忆。我总觉得她说的是真话。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761324.oracleText:
"The manner of death, the way the body was displayed, the carefully arranged guild emblems . . . someone is trying to send a message."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761324.translation:
「离奇的死亡方式、怪异的遗体姿态、刻意摆齐的公会徽记···有人想藉此传递什么讯息。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761325.oracleText:
"Something about Massacre Girl's brazen attack doesn't make sense. Why would the Cult of Rakdos be involved at all?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761325.translation:
「杀戮女郎这样明目张胆地袭击我，怎么想都不对劲。拉铎司宗派为什么一定要来蹚这趟浑水？」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761326.oracleText:
"If she's innocent, as she so vehemently claims, why did she run?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761326.translation:
「她既然如此坚称无辜，那又为什么要逃？」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761327.oracleText:
"I suppose, from Aurelia's perspective, she was being generous by giving us one entire day to solve the most complex case in Ravnican history."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761327.translation:
「我想，也许在欧瑞梨看来，给我们整整一天时间来破这桩拉尼卡史上最复杂的案子，已经很宽容了。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761328.oracleText:
"More bizarre metaphors about rot and renewal. Wildly unhelpful."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761328.translation:
「一大堆关于腐败与新生的奇诡隐喻。亳无帮助。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761329.oracleText:
"Kaya and Kellan were attacked today! This is excellent news. Clearly we are on the trail of the true killer."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761329.translation:
「卡娅和凯澜今天遭人袭击了！这可是大好消息。证明我们查对方向，就要找到真凶了。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761330.oracleText:
"Mind control—anyone could be a threat!"
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761330.translation:
「心灵操控～谁都可能是威胁！」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761331.oracleText:
"Etrata was in custody long before Teysa was killed. It's impossible that she could be the culprit."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761331.translation:
「泰莎命案发生时，艾庄塔早已被羁押。她不可能是凶手。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761332.oracleText:
"Oh gods, here come the verity circles. Do the Azorius ever tire of them?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761332.translation:
「老天啊，他们又把真相环拿出来了。俄佐立老搞这套就不会腻吗？」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761333.oracleText:
"I fear a war between the guilds is exactly what our killer wants. Who could stand to benefit from such destruction?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761333.translation:
「我担心，公会之间战火重燃正是凶手想要的结果。这般乱局当中，谁又能从中渔利？」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761334.oracleText:
"Oba fought Realmbreaker's corruption alone, hiding her pain even from her sisters. Even after everything she's done, I can't hate her. I pity her."
—Alquist Proft, case notes
761334.translation:
「欧芭独自对抗洞境树的腐化，强忍其间苦痛，就连姐妹也不曾相告。纵使她导致此等变故，我对她仍无恨意，只有惋惜。」
～阿奎斯波费，探案笔记

761335.oracleText: Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
761335.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

761336.translation: 复制另一个由你操控的生物？

761346.oracleText: Target a creature to deal 2 damage to.
761346.translation: 指定一个生物为目标，来对其造成2点伤害。

761348.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature with the greatest power.
761348.translation: 牺牲一个力量最高的生物。

762471.oracleText: Copy a creature card exiled with it?
762471.translation: 是否要复制一张以它放逐的生物牌？

762478.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, untap each creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
762478.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，重置所有由你操控的生物。在此战斗阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

762479.oracleText: Whenever Port Razer deals combat damage to a player, untap each creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
762479.translation: 每当港口劫盗对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，重置所有由你操控的生物。在此战斗阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

762480.oracleText: To solve — There are five colors among permanents you control. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762480.translation: 侦办～由你操控之永久物中包括的颜色有五种。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762481.oracleText: To solve — Three or more creatures attacked this turn. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762481.translation: 侦办～本回合中有三个或更多生物攻击过。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762482.oracleText: To solve — You control three or more Detectives. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762482.translation: 侦办～你操控三个或更多侦探。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762483.oracleText: To solve — You've gained 5 or more life this turn. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762483.translation: 侦办～你本回合中获得过5点或更多生命。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762484.oracleText: To solve — You control three or more artifacts. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762484.translation: 侦办～你操控三个或更多神器。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762485.oracleText: To solve — You've cast four or more instant and sorcery spells this turn. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762485.translation: 侦办～你本回合中施放过四个或更多瞬间与法术咒语。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762486.oracleText: To solve — You control no suspected Skeletons. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762486.translation: 侦办～你未操控已遭疑的骷髅妖。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762487.oracleText: To solve — Three or more sources you controlled dealt damage this turn. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762487.translation: 侦办～本回合中有三个或更多由你操控的来源造成过伤害。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762488.oracleText: To solve — You have no cards in hand. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762488.translation: 侦办～你没有手牌。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762489.oracleText: To solve — You control seven or more lands. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762489.translation: 侦办～你操控七个或更多地。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762490.oracleText: To solve — Creatures you control have total power 8 or greater. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762490.translation: 侦办～由你操控之生物的力量总和等于或大于8。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762491.oracleText: To solve — Three or more creature cards were put into graveyards from anywhere this turn. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
762491.translation: 侦办～本回合中有三张或更多生物牌从任何区域进入坟墓场。（若本案未侦结，则在你的结束步骤开始时侦办。）

762496.oracleText: As a test of calm and compassion, a Jeskai monk softly approaches a grazing sambar and offers it a lotus from their hand. If the creature eats, the student ascends to the next level of training.
762496.translation: 洁斯凯测试僧徒是否已静心向善，便是派他手持莲花蹑脚步至食草水鹿跟前喂食。如果水鹿吃下了莲花，这名僧徒就能接受下一阶段的训练。

763278.oracleText: Whenever Bomat Courier attacks, exile the top card of your library face down. (You can't look at it.)
763278.translation: 每当博默区讯使攻击时，牌面朝下地放逐你的牌库顶牌。（你不能检视它。）

763282.translation: 指定一个要消灭的生物为目标。

763298.oracleText: Reveal the creature type you chose.
763298.translation: 展示你所选的生物类别。

763299.translation: 指定一个正进行攻击的衍生生物为目标。

763308.oracleText: Exile any number of cards with total mana value 6 or greater.
763308.translation: 放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和需等于或大于6。

763310.oracleText: Exile any number of cards with total mana value 10 or greater.
763310.translation: 放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和需等于或大于10。

763311.oracleText: Exile any number of cards with total mana value 3 or greater.
763311.translation: 放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和需等于或大于3。

763312.oracleText: Exile any number of cards from your graveyard with total mana value 4 or greater?
763312.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场放逐任意数量，且法术力值之和等于或大于4的牌？

763350.oracleText: Battalion — Whenever CARDNAME and at least two other creatures attack, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
763350.translation: 协战～每当CARDNAME与至少两个其他生物攻击时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

763351.oracleText: Battalion — Whenever Makeshift Battalion and at least two other creatures attack, put a +1/+1 counter on Makeshift Battalion.
763351.translation: 协战～每当杂牌大队与至少两个其他生物攻击时，在杂牌大队上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

763425.oracleText: Exile any number of cards with total mana value 2 or greater.
763425.translation: 放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和需等于或大于2。

763426.oracleText: Exile any number of cards with total mana value 4 or greater.
763426.translation: 放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和需等于或大于4。

763429.oracleText: Exile any number of cards with total mana value 8 or greater.
763429.translation: 放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和需等于或大于8。

763430.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
763430.translation: 在目标由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

763431.oracleText: Exile any number of cards from your graveyard with total mana value 3 or greater?
763431.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场放逐任意数量，且法术力值之和等于或大于3的牌？

763437.oracleText: {oT}: Target land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with haste until end of turn. It's still a land. Activate only as a sorcery.
763437.translation: {oT}：目标由你操控的地成为4/4，具敏捷异能的元素生物直到回合结束。它仍然是地。只能于法术时机起动。

763439.oracleText: Domain — {o1oG}: Until end of turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
763439.translation: 领土～{o1oG}：直到回合结束，由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，CARDNAME便得+1/+1。每回合只能起动一次。

763440.oracleText: Domain — {o1oG}: Until end of turn, Sunbathing Rootwalla gets +1/+1 for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
763440.translation: 领土～{o1oG}：直到回合结束，由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，浴日萝特瓦拉便得+1/+1。每回合只能起动一次。

763442.translation: 炼-依法瓦传人札娅欧亚奈

763446.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a land: Draw a card.

763450.translation: 炼-繁殖地酋长卢丽芒氏

763454.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a land: You gain 2 life.

763456.oracleText: {oR}, Discard a land card: Draw a card.

763457.oracleText: {oB}, Discard a land card: CARDNAME gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
763457.translation: {oB}，弃一张地牌：CARDNAME获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

763458.oracleText: {oB}, Discard a land card: Soul of Windgrace gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.
763458.translation: {oB}，弃一张地牌：风华之魂获得不灭异能直到回合结束。将它横置。

763464.oracleText: Domain — {o5oG}: Return CARDNAME from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a finality counter on it. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
763464.translation: 领土～{o5oG}：将CARDNAME从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

763465.oracleText: Domain — {o5oG}: Return Llanowar Greenwidow from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a finality counter on it. This ability costs {o1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
763465.translation: 领土～{o5oG}：将罗堰绿寡妇从你的坟墓场横置移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。由你操控的地中每有一种基本地类别，此异能便减少{o1}来起动。

763467.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature defending player controls with power less than or equal to CARDNAME's power can't block this turn.
763467.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由防御牌手操控且力量小于或等于CARDNAME之生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

763468.oracleText: Whenever Radha's Firebrand attacks, target creature defending player controls with power less than or equal to Radha's Firebrand's power can't block this turn.
763468.translation: 每当拉妲的挑事人攻击时，目标由防御牌手操控且力量小于或等于拉妲的挑事人之生物本回合不能进行阻挡。

763471.oracleText: Pay any amount of mana. Look at that many cards from the top of your library, then put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
763471.translation: 支付任意数量的法术力，检视你牌库顶等数量的牌，然后将其中一张置于你手上，其余则以随机顺序置于你的牌库底。

763472.oracleText: You get an emblem with "Tap an untapped artifact you control: This emblem deals 1 damage to any target."
763472.translation: 你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「横置一个由你操控且未横置的神器：此徽记对任意一个目标造成1点伤害。」

763473.oracleText: Target a creature defending player controls with power less than or equal to {1, CardId}'s power.
763473.translation: 指定一个由对手操控且力量小于或等于{1, CardId}之力量的生物为目标。

763475.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Create a tapped Powerstone token.
763475.translation: CARDNAME对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

763476.oracleText: Excavation Explosion deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. Create a tapped Powerstone token.
763476.translation: 掘古爆破对目标生物或鹏洛客造成4点伤害。派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

763479.translation: {o3}，{oT}：派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

763483.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top two cards of your library. You may play one of those cards this turn.
763483.translation: 在你的维持开始时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。本回合中，你可以使用其中一张牌。

763485.oracleText: Scry 2. If you control an artifact, draw a card.
763485.translation: 占卜2。如果你操控神器，则抓一张牌。

763489.oracleText: Creatures you don't control get -3/-0 until end of turn.
763489.translation: 不由你操控的生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。

763490.oracleText: Choose two — • Creatures you don't control get -3/-0 until end of turn. • Create two tapped Powerstone tokens. • Create a tapped 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with "This creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control." • Scry 2, then draw a card.
763490.translation: 选择两项～ •  不由你操控的生物得-3/-0直到回合结束。 •  派出两个已横置的魔力石衍生物。 •  派出一个已横置的0/0无色组构体衍生神器生物，且具有「你每操控一个神器，此生物便得+1/+1。」 •  占卜2，然后抓一张牌。

763492.oracleText: {o7}: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
763492.translation: {o7}：检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

763494.oracleText: {o5}: Draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
763494.translation: {o5}：抓一张牌并在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

763495.oracleText: {o5}: Draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on Geology Enthusiast.
763495.translation: {o5}：抓一张牌并在狂热地质家上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

763496.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may pay {o2}. If you do, CARDNAME can't be blocked this turn and it perpetually gets +2/+0.
763496.translation: 当CARDNAME攻击时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，则在本回合中CARDNAME不能被阻挡且永久得+2/+0。

763497.oracleText: Whenever Hurkyl's Prodigy attacks, you may pay {o2}. If you do, Hurkyl's Prodigy can't be blocked this turn and it perpetually gets +2/+0.
763497.translation: 每当河鼓的逸才攻击时，你可以支付{o2}。若你如此作，河鼓的逸才本回合不能被阻挡且永久得+2/+0。

763498.oracleText: Seek a nonland card with mana value equal to the number of Powerstones you control.
763498.translation: 掏一张法术力值等同于由你操控之魔力石数量的非地牌。

763499.oracleText: Seek a nonland card with mana value equal to the number of Powerstones you control.
763499.translation: 掏一张法术力值等同于由你操控之魔力石数量的非地牌。

763500.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, choose one that wasn't chosen during your last combat — • Create a tapped Powerstone token. • Seek a nonland card with mana value equal to the number of Powerstones you control.
763500.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择一项，且不得是在你上次战斗中选过的～ •  派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。 •  掏一张法术力值等同于由你操控之魔力石数量的非地牌。

763501.oracleText: Whenever Yotian Courier attacks, choose one that wasn't chosen during your last combat — • Create a tapped Powerstone token. • Seek a nonland card with mana value equal to the number of Powerstones you control.
763501.translation: 每当佑天讯使攻击时，选择一项，且不得是在你上次战斗中选过的～ •  派出一个已横置的魔力石衍生物。 •  掏一张法术力值等同于由你操控之魔力石数量的非地牌。

763706.oracleText: Exile any number of face-up creatures you control with disguise.
763706.translation: 放逐任意数量由你操控，牌面朝上，且具有伪装异能的生物。

763831.oracleText: Choose one. If you control an artifact and an enchantment as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead. • Exile target creature or planeswalker. • Return target creature or planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
763831.translation: 选择一项。如果你于施放此咒语时同时操控神器和结界，则你可以改为两项都选。 •  放逐目标生物或鹏洛客。 •  将目标生物或鹏洛客牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

764159.oracleText: Choose one. If an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, you may choose both instead. • Copy target spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. • Create a token that's a copy of target creature.
764159.translation: 选择一项。如果任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，则你可以改为两项都选。 • 复制目标咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。 • 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标生物之复制品。

764160.oracleText: Choose one. If an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard, you may choose both instead. • Copy target spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.) • Create a token that's a copy of target creature.
764160.translation: 选择一项。如果任一对手的坟墓场中有八张或更多牌，则你可以改为两项都选。 • 复制目标咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。（永久物咒语的复制品会成为衍生物。） • 派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标生物之复制品。

764442.oracleText: Spend only on: Face-Down Spells or Creatures
764442.translation: 只能用于支付：牌面朝下的咒语或生物

764638.oracleText: CARDNAME deals X damage to each creature and planeswalker that player controls.
764638.translation: CARDNAME对由该牌手操控的每个生物和鹏洛客各造成X点伤害。

764640.oracleText: Exile any number of cards from your graveyard with total mana value {2, Number} or greater.
764640.translation: 从你的坟墓场放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和需等于或大于{2, Number}。

764664.oracleText: Exile any number of cards with total mana value X or greater.
764664.translation: 放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和需等于或大于X。

765299.translation: 是否要怀疑其中一个生物？

765406.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME becomes blocked, untap each creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
765406.translation: 每当CARDNAME被阻挡时，重置所有由你操控的生物。在此战斗阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

765407.oracleText: Whenever Anzrag, the Quake-Mole becomes blocked, untap each creature you control. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
765407.translation: 每当地动鼹鼠安札格被阻挡时，重置所有由你操控的生物。在此战斗阶段后，额外多出一个战斗阶段。

765839.oracleText: Have target suspected creature you control become no longer suspected?
765839.translation: 是否要令目标由你操控，且已遭疑的生物不再遭疑？

765840.oracleText: Target a suspected creature you control.
765840.translation: 指定一个由你操控，且已遭疑的生物为目标。

765848.translation: 牺牲一个已遭疑的生物。

793325.oracleText: The Chamber of the Guildpact could be rebuilt, but faith in the guilds would not be restored so easily.
793325.translation: 十会盟堂虽可重建，公会信仰却难复原。

793326.oracleText: When you cast this spell, create a 2/2 white and blue Detective creature token.
793326.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，派出一个2/2，白蓝双色的侦探衍生生物。

793331.oracleText: Choose an instant or sorcery card in your hand or graveyard. That card perpetually incorporates {oU} and gains "When you cast this spell, draw a card." Then return a multicolored instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
793331.translation: 选择你手上或你坟墓场中的一张瞬间或法术牌。该牌永久融入{oU}且获得「当你施放此咒语时，抓一张牌。」然后将一张多色瞬间或法术牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。

793336.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, for each of that spell's colors, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
793336.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，该咒语每有一种颜色，每位对手便各失去1点生命且你获得1点生命。

793339.oracleText: What started as an attempt to burn incriminating evidence soon became a passion project.
793339.translation: 开始只是为了烧毁罪证，很快却发展成了一项狂热爱好。

793340.oracleText: When you cast this spell, it deals 2 damage to each opponent.
793340.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，它向每位对手各造成2点伤害。

793343.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each of that spell's colors.
793343.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，该咒语每有一种颜色，CARDNAME便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

793344.oracleText: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, Construction Arsonist gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each of that spell's colors.
793344.translation: 每当你施放多色咒语时，该咒语每有一种颜色，建筑纵火犯便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

793347.oracleText: To solve — Three or more creatures are damaged.
793347.translation: 侦办～三个或更多生物已受伤。

793348.oracleText: Solved — Whenever you attack with one or more creatures, this Case deals that much damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.
793348.translation: 侦结～每当你以一个或数个生物攻击时，此案件对任意数量的目标共造成X点伤害，X等同于宣告攻击的生物数量。你可以任意分配。

793353.oracleText: It guards the incomplete halls of the new Chamber of the Guildpact.
793353.translation: 它守护着新十会盟堂残缺的门厅。

793356.oracleText: Multicolored creatures you control have ward {o2}.
793356.translation: 由你操控的多色生物具有守护{o2}。

793358.oracleText: "What a confusing tangle of paradigms and perceptions! Our perpetrator may be acting under duress."
793358.translation: 「这些乱糟糟的拼写和思绪真是令人费解！看起来我们的犯人正被逼得手忙脚乱。」

793361.oracleText: "Out of the way! I'm not letting the other detectives snatch up all the good clues!"
793361.translation: 「闪开！我决不会让其他侦探抢走所有有价值的线索！」

793362.oracleText: If you aren't the starting player, you may cast CARDNAME as though it had flash.
793362.translation: 如果你不是先手牌手，则你可以将CARDNAME视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

793363.oracleText: If you aren't the starting player, you may cast Shove Aside as though it had flash.
793363.translation: 如果你不是先手牌手，则你可以将推搡视同具有闪现异能地来施放。

793364.oracleText: Shove Aside deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
793364.translation: 推搡对目标生物或鹏洛客造成3点伤害。

793366.oracleText: The Gruul agreed to let the archaeologists examine the ruins if they agreed to put all the destruction right back where they found it.
793366.translation: 古鲁人同意让这些考古学家考察这些废墟，只要他们能将造成的所有破坏恢复如初。

793367.oracleText: Draft a card from Relics of the Rubblebelt's spellbook twice, then put one of those cards onto the battlefield tapped.
793367.translation: 从瓦砾区遗宝的法术书中发现一张牌两次，然后将其中一张牌横置放进战场。

793369.oracleText: "While Trostani heals, someone must guide the way."
793369.translation: 「于卓塔妮修养之际，须有人肩负起引路重任。」

793373.oracleText:
"The experiment went off without a hitch—only one casualty!"
—Zibens, Izzet record-keeper
793373.translation:
「实验进行得十分顺利～只有一人伤亡！」
～伊捷史官泽本斯

793374.oracleText: When CARDNAME dies, conjure a card named Ionize or a card named Electrolyze into your hand.
793374.translation: 当CARDNAME死去时，变出一张名称为电离化的牌或一张名称为电解的牌置于你手上。

793377.oracleText: "To arms! The unyielding resolve of the Legion will win this day!"
793377.translation: 「拿起武器！教团坚毅不屈的战士今日定能大获全胜！」

793378.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. Then conjure a card with mana value equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it from Tajic, Legion's Valor's spellbook onto the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn and attacks this combat if able.
793378.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后从教团之勇塔疾克的法术书中变出一张法术力值等同于其上+1/+1指示物数量的牌放进战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束且本次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

793379.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Tajic, Legion's Valor. Then conjure a card with mana value equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it from Tajic, Legion's Valor's spellbook onto the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn and attacks this combat if able.
793379.translation: 在你回合的战斗开始时，在教团之勇塔疾克上放置一个+1/+1指示物。然后从教团之勇塔疾克的法术书中变出一张法术力值等同于其上+1/+1指示物数量的牌放进战场。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束且本次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

793381.oracleText: His body is the laboratory where his greatest innovations come to life.
793381.translation: 他的身体就像一座实验室，所有最伟大的创新尽诞生于此。

793387.oracleText:
"It's the newest model—10 percent lighter and 20 percent more expensive!"
—Kylox
793387.translation:
「这可是最新款～轻百分之十的同时当然也会贵百分之二十！」
～奇洛兹

793388.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may collect evidence 5.
793388.translation: 你可以搜证5，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

793394.oracleText: Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, choose a creature card in your hand or a creature you control. It perpetually gets +1/+0.
793394.translation: 每当你牺牲一个神器时，选择一张你手上的生物牌或一个由你操控的生物。它永久得+1/+0。

793396.oracleText: "A bit more vivid than the textbooks, eh?"
793396.translation: 「这可比教科书生动得多，不是吗？」

793397.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another permanent you control is turned face up, seek a non-Elephant creature card with mana value 3 or less and cloak it. This ability triggers only once.
793397.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的永久物翻回正面时，掏一张法术力值等于或小于3的非象生物牌并匿伏它。此异能只会触发一次。

793398.oracleText: Whenever Sleuth Instructor or another permanent you control is turned face up, seek a non-Elephant creature card with mana value 3 or less and cloak it. This ability triggers only once.
793398.translation: 每当侦员讲师或另一个由你操控的永久物翻回正面时，掏一张法术力值等于或小于3的非象生物牌并匿伏它。此异能只会触发一次。

793402.oracleText: When an opponent casts a spell with mana value equal to the chosen number, sacrifice CARDNAME. If you do, copy that spell, and you may choose new targets for the copy.
793402.translation: 当任一对手施放法术力值等同于所选数字的咒语时，牺牲CARDNAME。若你如此作，则复制该咒语且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

793403.oracleText: When an opponent casts a spell with mana value equal to the chosen number, sacrifice Ominous Lockbox. If you do, copy that spell, and you may choose new targets for the copy.
793403.translation: 当任一对手施放法术力值等同于所选数字的咒语时，牺牲恶兆密柜。若你如此作，则复制该咒语且你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。

793404.oracleText: {o2}, Sacrifice Ominous Lockbox: Draw a card.

793406.oracleText: "All my machines come with a lifetime warranty! With exceptions, of course, for intentional crash, user error, and ghosts."
793406.translation: 「我的所有机械都提供终身保修！当然，蓄意捣毁，操作失误，还有鬼怪作祟除外。」

793408.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, conjure a card named Ornithopter into your hand.
793408.translation: 在你的维持开始时，变出一张名称为扑翼机的牌置于你手上。

793410.oracleText: She weaves overlooked strands of detail into a tapestry of truth.
793410.translation: 她用被人忽视的细枝末节编织出事实真相。

793411.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice a Clue: Seek an instant or sorcery card.
793411.translation: {o1}，牺牲一个线索：掏一张瞬间或法术牌。

793413.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a creature, if that creature is still on the battlefield, suspect that creature. It perpetually gains this ability.
793413.translation: 每当CARDNAME对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，若该生物仍在战场上，则怀疑该生物。该生物永久获得此异能。

793414.oracleText: Whenever Snarlfang Vermin deals combat damage to a creature, if that creature is still on the battlefield, suspect that creature. It perpetually gains this ability.
793414.translation: 每当龇牙病媒对任一生物造成战斗伤害时，若该生物仍在战场上，则怀疑该生物。该生物永久获得此异能。

793415.oracleText: Whenever a suspected creature an opponent controls dies while CARDNAME is in your graveyard, that opponent loses 1 life.
793415.translation: 每当一个由对手操控且已遭疑的生物于CARDNAME在你坟墓场中时死去，该对手失去1点生命。

793416.oracleText: Whenever a suspected creature an opponent controls dies while Snarlfang Vermin is in your graveyard, that opponent loses 1 life.
793416.translation: 每当一个由对手操控且已遭疑的生物于龇牙病媒在你坟墓场中时死去，该对手失去1点生命。

793418.oracleText: The tag on its toe read "deceased." It vehemently disagreed.
793418.translation: 它脚趾上的标签写着“已死”。它怒声抗议事实并非如此。

793422.oracleText: Aspiring Hellbender performers often seek inspiration for their acts from particularly grisly crime scenes.
793422.translation: 地狱乐园的有志演员们常常从极其惨烈的犯罪现场中寻找表演灵感。

793425.oracleText: When CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner seeks a nonland card with lesser mana value than the exiled card.
793425.translation: 当CARDNAME离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者掏一张法术力值小于所放逐之牌的非地牌。

793426.oracleText: When Cackling Observer leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner seeks a nonland card with lesser mana value than the exiled card.
793426.translation: 当尖笑监魔离开战场时，所放逐之牌的拥有者掏一张法术力值小于所放逐之牌的非地牌。

793428.oracleText: On special occasions, the Hellbender orchestra will cap off their performance with a virtuoso bomb solo.
793428.translation: 在某些特殊场合，地狱乐园的管弦乐队表演会以震撼的爆破独奏收场。

793432.oracleText: "The Conclave is much like a root system—branching, yet unified. See the connections, and you can tap into their power."
793432.translation: 「盟会很像一个庞大根系，开枝散叶却仍为一体。瞧瞧这些关联处，你可以充分挖掘它们的力量。」

793433.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, CARDNAME gains flying until end of turn if a creature you control or a card in your hand has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
793433.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若由你操控的生物或你手上的某张牌具有飞行异能，则CARDNAME获得飞行异能直到回合结束。且先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、威慑、延势、践踏与警戒异能亦比照办理。

793434.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, Sproutwatch Dryad gains flying until end of turn if a creature you control or a card in your hand has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, and vigilance.
793434.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，若由你操控的生物或你手上的某张牌具有飞行异能，则护芽树灵获得飞行异能直到回合结束。且先攻、连击、死触、敏捷、辟邪、不灭、系命、威慑、延势、践踏与警戒异能亦比照办理。

793436.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. It perpetually becomes a Clue artifact in addition to its other types and gains "{o2}, Sacrifice this permanent: Draw a card."
793436.translation: 从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将该牌置于你手上，然后洗牌。它永久成为线索神器且仍具有原本类别并获得「{o2},牺牲此永久物：抓一张牌。」

793439.oracleText: At this point, mutant rampages are proactively factored into every Simic research project's timeline.
793439.translation: 此时，突变体狂暴已被认为是每个析米克研究项目的必经阶段。

793440.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +2/+2 for each time this creature attacked this game.
793440.translation: CARDNAME本盘游戏中每攻击过一次，便得+2/+2。

793441.oracleText: Rampaging Ursaguana gets +2/+2 for each time this creature attacked this game.
793441.translation: 莽闯熊蜥本盘游戏中每攻击过一次，便得+2/+2。

793444.oracleText: "Though you may have expired, your use to me has not."
793444.translation: 「虽尔之气数已尽，但于吾之用未尽。」

793445.oracleText: You may pay {o(W/B)} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
793445.translation: 你可以支付{o(W/B)}而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

793446.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a non-Spirit creature: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. It perpetually becomes a Spirit, has base power and toughness 1/1, and gains "You may pay {o(W/B)} rather than pay this spell's mana cost." Activate only as a sorcery.
793446.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个非精怪生物：将目标生物牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。它永久成为基础力量与防御力为1/1的精怪且获得「你可以支付{o(W/B)}而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。」只能于法术时机起动。

793449.oracleText: To solve — You control a legendary Homunculus.

793450.oracleText: Solved — You may look at the top card of your library any time and you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
793450.translation: 侦结～你可以随时检视你的牌库顶牌且你可以从你的牌库顶使用地和施放咒语。

793452.oracleText:
Golgari leechbreeders have cultivated over a
hundred different species of leeches, even though they were repeatedly asked not to.
793452.translation: 即使被几番劝阻，葛加理养蛭人仍培育了超过百种形态各异的蛭。

793453.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, conjure a card named Slimy Dualleech onto the battlefield if you control no Leeches. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on each Leech you control.
793453.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你未操控蛭，则变出一张名称为泥泞双头蛭的牌放进战场。若否，则在每个由你操控的蛭上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

793454.oracleText: {oT}, Sacrifice a creature: Add an amount of {oG} equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
793454.translation: {oT}，牺牲一个生物：加若干{oG}，其数量等同于所牺牲生物的力量。

793455.oracleText: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.
793455.translation: 此印记外观样式与佩戴形式不同，其代表涵义也大不一样。有人将其作为地位的象征，而有人则视为负债的标志。

793458.oracleText: Exile any number of cards with total mana value 5 or greater.
793458.translation: 放逐任意数量的牌，且它们的法术力值之和须等于或大于5。

793459.oracleText: Choose a creature card in your hand or a creature you control.
793459.translation: 选择你手上的一张生物牌或一个由你操控的生物。

793460.translation: 选择一个1到20之间的数字。

793461.oracleText: Seek a nonland card with lesser mana value than the exiled card.
793461.translation: 掏一张法术力值小于所放逐之牌的非地牌。

793467.oracleText: Reveal a Mount creature card or a Plains card?
793467.translation: 是否要展示一张坐骑生物牌或平原牌？

793468.translation: 指定一个非坐骑生物为目标。

793469.translation: 指定一个非狂徒生物为目标。

793470.oracleText: Spend only on: Mount or Vehicle Spells
793470.translation: 只能用于支付：坐骑或载具咒语

793471.oracleText: Spend only on: A Mount Spell
793471.translation: 只能用于支付：坐骑咒语

793476.oracleText: Target up to one black card.
793476.translation: 指定至多一张黑色牌为目标。

793477.oracleText: Have {1, CardId} become a copy of that card until end of turn?
793477.translation: 是否令{1, CardId}成为该牌的复制直到回合结束？

793479.oracleText: Put one of those cards onto the battlefield.
793479.translation: 将其中一张牌放进战场。

793481.oracleText: Target a creature that saddled it this turn.
793481.translation: 指定一个本回合中乘驾它的生物为目标。

793482.oracleText: This spell costs {o1oG} more to cast.

793491.oracleText: Exile target nontoken artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls. That player puts a random creature card with lesser mana value from their library onto the battlefield tapped.
793491.translation: 放逐目标由对手操控，且非衍生物的神器，生物或结界。其操控者从其牌库随机将一张法术力值小于前述永久物的生物牌横置放进战场。

793586.oracleText: Target a nontoken artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls.
793586.translation: 指定一个由对手操控，且非衍生物的神器，生物或结界为目标。

793846.oracleText: This spell costs {oW} more to cast.

793847.oracleText: This spell costs {oU} more to cast.

793848.oracleText: Choose an instant or sorcery card in your hand or graveyard.
793848.translation: 选择你手上或你坟墓场中的一张瞬间或法术牌。

793849.oracleText: Return a multicolored instant or sorcery card to your hand.
793849.translation: 将一张多色瞬间或法术牌移回你手上。

793850.oracleText: This spell costs {o1oB} more to cast.

793851.oracleText: Choose a nonland card in your hand?
793851.translation: 是否要选择一张你手上的非地牌？

793852.oracleText: This spell costs {oR} more to cast.

793853.oracleText: Choose an instant or sorcery card in your hand?
793853.translation: 是否要选择你手上的一张瞬间或法术牌？

793854.oracleText: When Izzet Polarizer dies, conjure a card named Ionize or a card named Electrolyze into your hand. (Your choice is not revealed to other players.)
793854.translation: 当伊捷极化师死去时，变出一张名称为电离化的牌或一张名称为电解的牌置于你手上。（你的选择不会展示给其他牌手。）

793855.oracleText: Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
793855.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时牺牲该衍生物。

793856.oracleText: Choose a nonlegendary creature that saddled it this turn.
793856.translation: 选择一个本回合中乘驾它的非传奇生物。

793857.oracleText: Return any number of creatures that saddled it this turn to their owner's hand?
793857.translation: 是否要将任意数量本回合中乘驾它的生物移回其拥有者手上？

793858.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature that saddled it this turn?
793858.translation: 是否要牺牲一个本回合中乘驾它的生物？

793859.oracleText: Exile a nonland card with mana value 3 or less?
793859.translation: 是否要放逐一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌？

793861.oracleText: Spells you cast but don't own cost {o1} less to cast.
793861.translation: 你施放之不由你拥有的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

793862.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, look at the top card of that player's library, then exile it face down. You may play that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
793862.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，检视该牌手的牌库顶牌，然后牌面朝下地放逐它。于该牌持续放逐的时段内，你可以使用该牌，且能用任意种类的法术力来施放该咒语。

793864.oracleText: Whenever one or more outlaws you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token.
793864.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个狂徒对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个珍宝衍生物。

793865.oracleText: {o3}, Sacrifice two Treasures: Put two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
793865.translation: {o3}，牺牲两个珍宝：在每个由你操控的生物上各放置两个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

793867.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
793867.translation: 每当你施放每回合中你的第二个咒语时，放逐你的牌库顶牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用该牌。

793868.oracleText: {oT}: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy. Activate only if you've cast three or more spells this turn.
793868.translation: {oT}：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。只能于你施放过三个或更多咒语的回合中起动。

793872.oracleText: Whenever a Desert card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, create a 4/2 green Plant Warrior creature token with reach.
793872.translation: 每当一张沙漠牌从任何区域进入你的坟墓场时，派出一个4/2绿色，具延势异能的植物／战士衍生生物。

793877.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — All creatures lose all abilities until end of turn. + {o1} — Choose a creature you control. It gains indestructible until end of turn. + {o3oWoW} — Destroy all creatures.
793877.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～所有生物失去所有异能直到回合结束。 + {o1}～选择一个由你操控的生物。它获得不灭异能直到回合结束。 + {o3oWoW}～消灭所有生物。

793878.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Exile target nontoken creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. + {o2} — Destroy target creature if no other creature has greater power.
793878.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～放逐目标非衍生物的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。 + {o2}～选择目标生物。如果其他生物中没有力量比它大的，则将它消灭。

793879.oracleText: Spree + {o2} — Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. + {o1} — Return target Mount or Vehicle card from your graveyard to the battlefield. + {o1} — Return target Aura or Equipment card from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to a creature you control.
793879.translation: 追欢 + {o2}～将目标生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。 + {o1}～将目标坐骑或载具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。 + {o1}～将目标灵气或武具牌从你的坟墓场移回战场并贴附在一个由你操控的生物上。

793880.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Destroy target artifact. + {o1} — Destroy target enchantment. + {o1} — Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls.
793880.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～消灭目标神器。 + {o1}～消灭目标结界。 + {o1}～在由目标牌手操控的每个生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

793881.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Untap all creatures target player controls. + {o1} — Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
793881.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～重置由目标牌手操控的所有生物。 + {o1}～目标生物获得连击异能直到回合结束。

793882.oracleText: Spree + {o3} — Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It can't be blocked this turn. + {o2} — Target artifact or creature's owner puts it on the top or bottom of their library.
793882.translation: 追欢 + {o3}～在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它本回合不能被阻挡。 + {o2}～目标神器或生物的拥有者将它置于其牌库顶或牌库底。

793883.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Until end of turn, target creature becomes a white Rabbit with base power and toughness 0/1. + {o3} — Target player draws two cards.
793883.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～直到回合结束，目标生物成为基础力量与防御力为0/1的白色兔。 + {o3}～目标牌手抓两张牌。

793884.oracleText: Spree + {o3} — Create a 2/2 white Spirit creature token with flying. + {o1} — Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}.
793884.translation: 追欢 + {o3}～派出一个2/2白色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。 + {o1}～除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。

793885.oracleText: Spree + {o2} — Exchange control of two target creatures. + {o1} — Exchange control of two target artifacts. + {o1} — Exchange control of two target enchantments.
793885.translation: 追欢 + {o2}～交换两个目标生物的操控权。 + {o1}～交换两个目标神器的操控权。 + {o1}～交换两个目标结界的操控权。

793886.oracleText: Spree + {o1oU} — Counter target spell. + {o3} — Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or creature you control. + {o2} — Draw two cards, then discard a card.
793886.translation: 追欢 + {o1oU}～反击目标咒语。 + {o3}～派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为目标由你操控的神器或生物之复制品。 + {o2}～抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

793887.oracleText: Spree + {o2} — Search your library for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top. + {oBoB} — Target player draws three cards and loses 3 life.
793887.translation: 追欢 + {o2}～从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。 + {oBoB}～目标牌手抓三张牌且失去3点生命。

793888.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Search your library for a card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle. + {o2} — Return up to two creature cards with total mana value 4 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
793888.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～从你牌库中搜寻一张牌，将它置入你的坟墓场，然后洗牌。 + {o2}～将至多两张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场，且这些牌法术力值总和须等于或小于4。

793889.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Target opponent sacrifices half the creatures they control, rounded up. + {o2} — Target opponent discards half the cards in their hand, rounded up. + {o2} — Target opponent loses half their life, rounded up.
793889.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～目标对手牺牲一半数量由其操控的生物，小数点后进位。 + {o2}～目标对手弃一半数量的手牌，小数点后进位。 + {o2}～目标对手失去一半生命，小数点后进位。

793890.oracleText: Spree + {o2oB} — Destroy target creature. + {o1} — Create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{oT}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."
793890.translation: 追欢 + {o2oB}～消灭目标生物。 + {o1}～派出一个1/1红色佣兵衍生生物，且具有「{oT}：目标由你操控的生物得+1/+0直到回合结束。只能于法术时机起动。」

793891.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each outlaw creature. + {o1} — CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each non-outlaw creature.
793891.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～CARDNAME对每个狂徒生物各造成2点伤害。 + {o1}～CARDNAME对每个非狂徒生物各造成2点伤害。

793892.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Caught in the Crossfire deals 2 damage to each outlaw creature. + {o1} — Caught in the Crossfire deals 2 damage to each non-outlaw creature.
