793892.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～卷入争端对每个狂徒生物各造成2点伤害。 + {o1}～卷入争端对每个非狂徒生物各造成2点伤害。

793893.oracleText: Spree + {o2} — CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target creature. + {o2} — Destroy target artifact.
793893.translation: 追欢 + {o2}～CARDNAME对目标生物造成4点伤害。 + {o2}～消灭目标神器。

793894.oracleText: Spree + {o2} — Explosive Derailment deals 4 damage to target creature. + {o2} — Destroy target artifact.
793894.translation: 追欢 + {o2}～爆破脱轨对目标生物造成4点伤害。 + {o2}～消灭目标神器。

793895.oracleText: Spree + {o2oR} — Untap all creatures you control. If it's your combat phase, there is an additional combat phase after this phase. + {o2} — Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain first strike until end of turn. + {oR} — Choose target opponent. Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to that player this turn, create a tapped Treasure token.
793895.translation: 追欢 + {o2oR}～重置所有由你操控的生物。如果当前是你的战斗阶段，则在此阶段后额外多出一个战斗阶段。 + {o2}～直到回合结束，由你操控的生物得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。 + {oR}～选择目标对手。本回合中，每当一个由你操控的生物对该牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。

793896.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Copy target instant spell, sorcery spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. You may choose new targets for the copy. + {o1} — Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target.
793896.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～复制目标瞬间咒语，法术咒语，起动式异能或触发式异能。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。 + {o1}～为仅指定单一目标的目标咒语或异能更改目标。

793897.oracleText: Spree + {o1} — Search your library for a basic land card or a Desert card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. + {o3} — Create an X/X green Elemental creature token, where X is the number of lands you control.
793897.translation: 追欢 + {o1}～从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌或沙漠牌，将之放进战场，然后洗牌。 + {o3}～派出一个X/X绿色元素衍生生物，X为由你操控的地数量。

793898.oracleText: Spree + {o2} — Mill four cards. You may put up to two creature and/or land cards from among the milled cards into your hand. + {o4oG} — You may put up to two creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield. + {o1} — Creatures you control with power 4 or greater gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.

"Finding a hidden patch of glowberries is almost as joyful as eating them. Almost."
—Ms. Bumbleflower
810993.translation:
「发现一片隐蔽光莓田的快乐，就跟吃掉整片光莓差不多。真的就差不多。」
～野花小姐

810994.oracleText: Create three 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens.
810994.translation: 派出三个1/1白色的兔衍生生物。

810997.oracleText: "I'll light the way, but we must walk it together."
810997.translation: 「我负责把路照亮，但必须一起前进。」

810999.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
810999.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

811001.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control with flying dies, return another target creature card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield.
811001.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物死去时，将另一张目标法术力值比死去生物小的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

811002.oracleText: Whenever Jackdaw Savior or another creature you control with flying dies, return another target creature card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield.
811002.translation: 每当寒鸦救护僧或另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物死去时，将另一张目标法术力值比死去生物小的生物牌从你坟墓场移回战场。

811005.oracleText: "With all the chaos going around, we thought it might be the perfect time to take a break and have a nice picnic. Would you like to join us?"
811005.translation: 「周围世界一团乱麻，现在正是时候抛下一切，享受野餐。要一起来吗？」

811006.oracleText: Whenever you give a gift, draw a card.
811006.translation: 每当你送出礼赠时，抓一张牌。

811009.oracleText: "Why are you eating upside down?" asked the bird. "Why are you eating upside up?" replied the bat.
811009.translation: 「你吃东西时头为什么朝下？」飞鸟问。「你吃东西时头为什么朝上？」蝙蝠反问。

811010.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.
811010.translation: 每当另一个由你操控的生物进场时，你获得1点生命。

811012.oracleText: "You stole a child from its nest," Mabel accused. "The only calamity I see here is you."
811012.translation: 「你从别人窝里偷走幼崽，」玛贝尔控诉道。「我看这里你才是灾星。」

811013.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Up to one other target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
811013.translation: 目标生物得+2/+2直到回合结束。至多另一个目标生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

811015.oracleText: "I'm not here to hurt you, but I will stop you from hurting others."
811015.translation: 「我不是来伤害你的，但会阻止你去伤害别人。」

811016.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, tap target creature an opponent controls.
811016.translation: 英武～每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

811017.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever Mouse Trapper becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, tap target creature an opponent controls.
811017.translation: 英武～每当设陷家鼠每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，横置目标由对手操控的生物。

811019.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, it gets +0/+2 until end of turn.
811019.translation: 英武～每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，它得+0/+2直到回合结束。

811020.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever Nettle Guard becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, it gets +0/+2 until end of turn.
811020.translation: 英武～每当荨麻原守卫每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，它得+0/+2直到回合结束。

811021.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Nettle Guard: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
811021.translation: {o1}，牺牲荨麻原守卫：消灭目标神器或结界。

811024.oracleText: Exile target nontoken creature. If the gift wasn't promised, return that creature to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
811024.translation: 放逐目标非衍生物的生物。如果未应诺礼赠，则在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该生物在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

811026.oracleText: Aerial supporters train for years to make sure the weapons they drop land in the hands of mice and not on their heads.
811026.translation: 空中援军经过长年训练，就为确保其投送的武器最后是落在鼠兵手上而不是头上。

811027.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control without flying.
811027.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811028.oracleText: When Pileated Provisioner enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control without flying.
811028.translation: 当羽冠驰援者进场时，在目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811030.oracleText: You never fight just one rabbitfolk. They bring the strength of their burrow to battle with them.
811030.translation: 你不会只跟一位兔民作对。他们一来就是带着全巢窝的手足一起上。

811031.oracleText: Creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn. If you control a Rabbit, scry 2.
811031.translation: 由你操控的生物得+2/+1直到回合结束。如果你操控兔，则占卜2。

811033.oracleText: The living seasons come to grow, to burn, to wither, and to freeze. As natural as it is for the Calamity Beasts to live, it is just as natural for them to die.
811033.translation: 灾兽出没，引致季节变换，带来生机、酷暑、落叶、严寒。有如其他自然规律一般，既然灾兽有生，那当然也有死。

811034.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power or toughness 4 or greater.
811034.translation: 消灭目标力量或防御力等于或大于4的生物。

811036.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another Bird you control enters, exile up to one target creature you control without flying. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a flying counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
811036.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的鸟进场时，放逐至多一个目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个飞行指示物。

811037.oracleText: Whenever Salvation Swan or another Bird you control enters, exile up to one target creature you control without flying. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a flying counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
811037.translation: 每当济世天鹅或另一个由你操控的鸟进场时，放逐至多一个目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个飞行指示物。

811040.oracleText: {oH} — Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token.
811040.translation: {oH} ～ 派出一个1/1白色的兔衍生生物。

811041.oracleText: {oHoH} — Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller draws a card.
811041.translation: {oHoH} ～ 放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者抓一张牌。

811042.oracleText: {oHoHoH} — Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with an indestructible counter on it.
811042.translation: {oHoHoH} ～ 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个不灭指示物。

811045.oracleText: Never underestimate what a rabbit can do with a root vegetable and some moxie.
811045.translation: 千万不要低估手持块根、勇气充沛兔子的战斗力。

811046.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks while you control a token, CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
811046.translation: 每当CARDNAME于你操控衍生物时攻击，CARDNAME得+2/+0直到回合结束。

811047.oracleText: Whenever Seasoned Warrenguard attacks while you control a token, Seasoned Warrenguard gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
811047.translation: 每当繁殖地菁卫于你操控衍生物时攻击，繁殖地菁卫得+2/+0直到回合结束。

811049.oracleText:
"I've trained every one of them in aerial maneuvers, talon strikes, and dive precision. They are the top of my class, and they may surpass me one day."
—Quickwing, master flyer
811049.translation:
「我亲自教导他们飞行技巧、利爪突袭、精准俯击。个个都是门下精英，有朝一日必成大器。」
～飞行大师锐翼

811051.oracleText: Valley's midnight clerics channel the life force of other animals into blinding strikes and searing shrieks.
811051.translation: 苍茂谷中的午夜僧侣，能将其他动物的生命之力转化为致盲攻击与灼耳尖啸。

811052.oracleText: CARDNAME deals 4 damage to target attacking, blocking, or tapped creature. You gain 3 life if you control a Bat.
811052.translation: CARDNAME对目标进行攻击，进行阻挡或已横置的生物造成4点伤害。如果你操控蝙蝠，则你获得3点生命。

811053.oracleText: Sonar Strike deals 4 damage to target attacking, blocking, or tapped creature. You gain 3 life if you control a Bat.
811053.translation: 声呐击对目标进行攻击，进行阻挡或已横置的生物造成4点伤害。如果你操控蝙蝠，则你获得3点生命。

811055.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained or lost life this turn, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with power 3 or less from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
811055.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得或失去过生命，则检视你牌库顶的四张牌。你可以展示其中一张力量等于或小于3的生物牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

811057.oracleText: Nothing lurks in the purity of the moon's light.
811057.translation: 苍茂谷边境已然戒备森严。尤其是在夜晚。

811058.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. If the gift was promised, return a creature card put into your graveyard this way to the battlefield under your control.
811058.translation: 牌消灭所有生物。如果已应诺礼赠，则将一张以此法置入你坟墓场的生物牌在你的操控下移回战场。

811061.oracleText:
"In hand, a sword to slay the frightful beast; in heart, these words to soothe our frightened kin."
—Lily and the Ember Seed
811061.translation:
「手中，是击灭骇人恶兽的利剑；心中，是安抚受惊亲友的言语。」
～《莉莉与烬种》

811062.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, untap target nonland permanent.
811062.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，重置目标非地永久物。

811063.oracleText: Whenever Thistledown Players attacks, untap target nonland permanent.
811063.translation: 每当蓟冠团演员攻击时，重置目标非地永久物。

811065.oracleText: No battle is fought, or won, alone.
811065.translation:
「英雄如春笋般涌现，不断鼓舞众人心神。」
～《灾兽余生纪》

811066.oracleText: Whenever one or more other Rabbits, Bats, Birds, and/or Mice you control enter, scry 1.
811066.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他兔，蝙蝠，鸟和／或家鼠进场时，占卜1。

811067.oracleText: Other Rabbits, Bats, Birds, and Mice you control get +1/+1.
811067.translation: 由你操控的其他兔、蝙蝠、鸟和家鼠得+1/+1。

811070.oracleText: "There is strength in numbers, yes. More importantly, there is joy."
811070.translation: 「手足越多，确实力量越大。不过更重要的是，快乐也越多。」

811073.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token that's tapped and attacking.
811073.translation: 派出一个1/1白色的兔衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

811074.oracleText: Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token that's tapped and attacking.
811074.translation: 派出一个1/1白色的兔衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。

811075.oracleText: Attacking creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
811075.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

811076.oracleText: Attacking creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
811076.translation: 由你操控且进行攻击的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

811077.oracleText: Whenever you attack, choose one — • Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token that's tapped and attacking. • Attacking creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
811077.translation: 每当你攻击时，选择一项～ •  派出一个1/1白色的兔衍生生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。 •  由你操控且进行攻击的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

811079.oracleText: Batfolk clerics consider the cycle of light and darkness as a sacred allegory of life and death.
811079.translation: 蝠民僧侣将明暗循环视作神圣生死寓言。

811080.oracleText: Whenever you gain or lose life during your turn, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
811080.translation: 每当你于你的回合中获得或失去生命时，CARDNAME得+1/+0直到回合结束。

811081.oracleText: Whenever you gain or lose life during your turn, Wax-Wane Witness gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
811081.translation: 每当你于你的回合中获得或失去生命时，朔望见证僧得+1/+0直到回合结束。

811083.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with mana value 3 or less from among them. You may put it onto the battlefield if it's your turn. If you don't put it onto the battlefield, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
811083.translation: 英武～每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌。如果是在你的回合中，你可以将它放进战场。如果你未将它放进战场，则将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

811084.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever Whiskervale Forerunner becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with mana value 3 or less from among them. You may put it onto the battlefield if it's your turn. If you don't put it onto the battlefield, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
811084.translation: 英武～每当胡须谷前锋每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌。你可以展示其中一张法术力值等于或小于3的生物牌。如果是在你的回合中，你可以将它放进战场。如果你未将它放进战场，则将它置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

811086.oracleText: CARDNAME can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or greater.
811086.translation: CARDNAME不能被力量等于或大于2的生物阻挡。

811087.oracleText: Azure Beastbinder can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or greater.
811087.translation: 碧蓝缚兽客不能被力量等于或大于2的生物阻挡。每当碧蓝缚兽客攻击时，至多一个目标由对手操控的神器，生物或鹏洛客失去所有异能直到你的下一个回合。

811088.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, up to one target artifact, creature, or planeswalker an opponent controls loses all abilities until your next turn. If it's a creature, it also has base power and toughness 2/2 until your next turn.
811088.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，至多一个目标由对手操控的神器，生物或鹏洛客失去所有异能直到你的下一个回合。若它是生物，则它的基础力量与防御力也为2/2直到你的下一个回合。

811089.oracleText: Whenever Azure Beastbinder attacks, up to one target artifact, creature, or planeswalker an opponent controls loses all abilities until your next turn. If it's a creature, it also has base power and toughness 2/2 until your next turn.
811089.translation: 每当碧蓝缚兽客攻击时，至多一个目标由对手操控的神器，生物或鹏洛客失去所有异能直到你的下一个回合。若它是生物，则它的基础力量与防御力也为2/2直到你的下一个回合。

811092.oracleText: Glarb's court can always be found repeating his disastrous visions, even when they're unwelcome.
811092.translation: 不管内容是否顺耳，格拉布宅内每天都会传出他的灾难预告。

811093.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, draw a card, then discard a card.
811093.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

811094.oracleText: When Bellowing Crier enters, draw a card, then discard a card.
811094.translation: 当呱吼报信员进场时，抓一张牌，然后弃一张牌。

811096.oracleText: Zoraline turned her attention to the shore. Helga and Ral's conversation quickly faded from her mind as she watched the gigantic wave approach.
811096.translation: 佐拉琳的目光转向岸边。眼见惊涛骇浪来袭，她瞬时就将赫尔嘉和拉尔的对话抛诸脑后。

811097.oracleText: Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands. Draw two cards, then discard a card.
811097.translation: 将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

811100.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
811100.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你坟墓场施放目标法术力值等于或小于4的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

811101.oracleText: When Daring Waverider enters, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
811101.translation: 当大胆驭浪师进场时，你可以从你坟墓场施放目标法术力值等于或小于4的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。

811103.oracleText: Maintaining brilliant plumage isn't just a statement. It's a tactic.
811103.translation: 维持羽毛亮丽并非只是外在需求，也是战术需要。

811104.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {o2}. If you control a Bird, counter that spell unless its controller pays {o4} instead.
811104.translation: 除非目标咒语的操控者支付{o2}，否则反击之。如果你操控鸟，则改为除非该咒语的操控者支付{o4}，否则反击之。

811106.oracleText: Quickwing's elite flyers were more than capable of navigating ordinary storms, but Dragonhawk's storms were anything but ordinary.
811106.translation: 锐翼麾下的菁英飞将能在普通风暴中来去自如，但龙头鹰的风暴一点也不普通。

811107.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if it targets an attacking or tapped creature.
811107.translation: 如果此咒语以进行攻击或已横置的生物为目标，则它减少{o1}来施放。

811109.oracleText: "Find your mooring and stop clogging the shipping lanes!"
811109.translation:
「口粮配给严格受控。」
～《灾兽余生纪》

811110.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control leave the battlefield without dying, draw a card.
811110.translation: 每当一个或数个由你操控的其他生物离开战场而未死去时，抓一张牌。

811111.oracleText: {o1oU}, {oT}: Return another target creature you control to its owner's hand.
811111.translation: {o1oU}，{oT}：将另一个目标由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。

811114.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped if it's not your turn.
811114.translation: 如果不是在你的回合中，则CARDNAME须横置进场。

811115.oracleText: Eddymurk Crab enters tapped if it's not your turn.
811115.translation: 如果不是在你的回合中，则黯涡蟹须横置进场。

811116.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap up to two target creatures.
811116.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置至多两个目标生物。

811117.oracleText: When Eddymurk Crab enters, tap up to two target creatures.
811117.translation: 当黯涡蟹进场时，横置至多两个目标生物。

811120.oracleText: Eluge's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Islands you control.
811120.translation: 艾鲁格的力量和防御力各等同于由你操控的海岛数量。

811121.oracleText: Whenever Eluge enters or attacks, put a flood counter on target land. It's an Island in addition to its other types for as long as it has a flood counter on it.
811121.translation: 每当艾鲁格进场或攻击时，在目标地上放置一个洪水指示物。只要该地上有洪水指示物，它便额外具有海岛此类别。

811122.oracleText: The first instant or sorcery spell you cast each turn costs {oU} less to cast for each land you control with a flood counter on it.
811122.translation: 对你每回合施放的第一个瞬间或法术咒语而言，你每操控一个其上有洪水指示物的地，该咒语便减少{oU}来施放。

811125.oracleText: When this creature enters, target creature you control gains flying until end of turn.
811125.translation: 当此生物进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得飞行异能直到回合结束。

811127.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, surveil 1.
811127.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物进场时，刺探1。

811129.oracleText: Whenever you attack, target attacking creature with power 3 or less can't be blocked this turn.
811129.translation: 每当你攻击时，目标进行攻击且力量等于或小于3的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

811130.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2] [Whenever you attack, target attacking creature with power 3 or less can't be blocked this turn.]
811130.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2] [每当你攻击时，目标进行攻击且力量等于或小于3的生物本回合不能被阻挡。]

811132.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may exile it, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
811132.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以放逐它，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

811133.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [3] [Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may exile it, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.]
811133.translation: CLASSLEVEL [3] [每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以放逐它，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。]

811135.oracleText: Return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand. If the gift was promised, instead return target nonland permanent an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
811135.translation: 将目标由对手操控的生物移回其拥有者手上。如果已应诺礼赠，则改为将目标由对手操控的非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

811137.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap enchanted creature. If the gift wasn't promised, put three stun counters on it.
811137.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置所结附的生物。如果未应诺礼赠，则在其上放置三个晕眩指示物。

811138.oracleText: When Kitnap enters, tap enchanted creature. If the gift wasn't promised, put three stun counters on it.
811138.translation: 当诱拐幽梦进场时，横置所结附的生物。如果未应诺礼赠，则在其上放置三个晕眩指示物。

811140.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy. Activate only if Kitsa's power is 3 or greater.
811140.translation: {o2}，{oT}：复制目标由你操控的瞬间或法术咒语。你可以为该复制品选择新的目标。只能于奇特莎的力量等于或大于3时起动。

811142.oracleText: His keen eyes can see the glint of scales far below the river's surface.
811142.translation: 他的锐利目光，能穿透河流水面，看到其下的闪亮鱼鳞。

811143.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken Bird you control enters, create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token.
811143.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的鸟进场时，派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物。

811146.oracleText: "Lightning and snail as one!" cried the rat. "It's so beautiful!" the otter gasped in awe.
811146.translation: 「闪电和蜗牛两者合一！」老鼠叫。「太漂亮了！」水獭惊叹。

811148.translation: 当亮壳搭档进场时，刺探2。

811151.oracleText: Other Frogs you control have ward {o1}.
811151.translation: 由你操控的其他蛙具有守护{o1}。

811152.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control can't be blocked this turn. Whenever that creature deals combat damage this turn, you may exile it. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
811152.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由你操控的生物本回合不能被阻挡。本回合中，每当该生物造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它放逐。若你如此作，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

811153.oracleText: When Long River Lurker enters, target creature you control can't be blocked this turn. Whenever that creature deals combat damage this turn, you may exile it. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
811153.translation: 当长河伏客进场时，目标由你操控的生物本回合不能被阻挡。本回合中，每当该生物造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它放逐。若你如此作，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

811155.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. If the gift was promised, instead counter target spell.
811155.translation: 反击目标生物咒语。如果已应诺礼赠，则改为反击目标咒语。

811157.oracleText: Target player draws three cards. If the gift was promised, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
811157.translation: 目标牌手抓三张牌。如果已应诺礼赠，则横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

811160.oracleText: Threshold — As long as seven or more cards are in your graveyard, creatures your opponents control get -1/-0.
811160.translation: 门槛～只要你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，由对手操控的生物便得-1/-0。

811163.oracleText: "Laughing at you? No, no, I'm laughing as you!"
811163.translation: 「别担心，我会守好你的秘密！」鸟民模仿鼠民声音回应道。

811164.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield with mana value less than or equal to the amount of mana spent to cast CARDNAME, except it's a Bird in addition to its other types and it has flying.
811164.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一法术力值等于或小于施放CARDNAME时所支付法术力数量的生物之复制品来进场，但它额外具有鸟此类别，且具有飞行异能。

811165.oracleText: You may have Mockingbird enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield with mana value less than or equal to the amount of mana spent to cast Mockingbird, except it's a Bird in addition to its other types and it has flying.
811165.translation: 你可以使反舌鸟当成战场上任一法术力值等于或小于施放反舌鸟时所支付法术力数量的生物之复制品来进场，但它额外具有鸟此类别，且具有飞行异能。

811167.oracleText: He etches his secrets onto the shimmering shells of mussels, saving them to share with the Great Snail.
811167.translation: 他把自己的秘密刻在闪亮贻贝上存起，留待日后与大蜗牛神分享。

811168.oracleText: Threshold — As long as seven or more cards are in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
811168.translation: 门槛～只要你的坟墓场中有七张或更多的牌，CARDNAME便得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

811169.oracleText: Threshold — As long as seven or more cards are in your graveyard, Nightwhorl Hermit gets +1/+0 and can't be blocked.
811169.translation: 门槛～只要你的坟墓场中有七张或更多的牌，夜眠隐者便得+1/+0且不能被阻挡。

811171.oracleText: Create a 1/1 blue and red Otter creature token with prowess. If this spell was cast from anywhere other than your hand, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
811171.translation: 派出一个1/1，蓝红双色，具灵技异能的水獭衍生生物。如果此咒语是从你手牌以外的任何区域施放，则在该生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811173.oracleText: Otterfolk divers compete to bring up the biggest, purest pearls they can find. Storing elemental magic in them is a bonus.
811173.translation: 獭民潜水客都在相互较劲，比谁能找到最大、最干净的珍珠～能在其中储存元素魔法者尤佳。

811174.oracleText: This spell costs {o1} less to cast if you control an Otter.
811174.translation: 如果你操控水獭，则此咒语减少{o1}来施放。

811176.oracleText: "I defend Valley and its beauty. What better weapon to wield than beauty itself?"
811176.translation: 「我负责守护苍茂谷及其间美景。还有什么武器比美景本身更好用？」

811177.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn.
811177.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

811178.oracleText: When Plumecreed Escort enters, target creature you control gains hexproof until end of turn.
811178.translation: 当羽誓卫士进场时，目标由你操控的生物获得辟邪异能直到回合结束。

811180.oracleText: Reveal the top X cards of your library. For each card type, you may exile a card of that type from among them. Put the rest into your graveyard. You may cast a spell from among the exiled cards without paying its mana cost if you exiled four or more cards this way. Then put the rest of the exiled cards into your hand.
811180.translation: 展示你牌库顶的X张牌。对每种牌张类别而言，你可以从其中放逐一张为该类别的牌。将其余的牌置入你坟墓场。如果你以此法放逐四张或更多牌，则你可以从所放逐的牌之中施放一个咒语，且不需支付其法术力费用。然后将其余所放逐的牌置于你手上。

811181.oracleText: Nobody bothered to look for Libo and Pulla, because everyone knew they didn't want to be found.
811181.translation: 谁都没真的动手去找黎波和璞拉，因为大家都知道他们不想被找到。

811184.oracleText: {oHoH} — Choose an artifact or creature you control. Create a token that's a copy of it.
811184.translation: {oHoH} ～ 选择一个由你操控的神器或生物。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。

811185.oracleText: {oHoHoH} — Return each nonland, nontoken permanent to its owner's hand.
811185.translation: {oHoHoH} ～ 将所有非地且非衍生物的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

811186.oracleText: "Is that all you've got? Put some mussel into it!"
811186.translation: 「你就这点能耐？多加点蚌来补！」

811188.oracleText: A water skimmer's ability to sense danger in the slightest ripple makes them a prized companion for Long River trawlers.
811188.translation: 水黾能从轻微波纹中感知是否有危险，因此成为长河捕捞客间热门的出航伴侣。

811190.oracleText: Threshold — Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, draw a card. Then discard a card unless seven or more cards are in your graveyard.
811190.translation: 门槛～每当河岸掠盗对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。然后除非你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，否则弃一张牌。

811191.oracleText: Threshold — Whenever Shoreline Looter deals combat damage to a player, draw a card. Then discard a card unless seven or more cards are in your graveyard.
811191.translation: 门槛～每当河岸掠盗对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，抓一张牌。然后除非你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，否则弃一张牌。

811194.oracleText: "I don't know how to swim!" said the bird. "That's okay! I don't know how to fly!" laughed the frog.
811194.translation: 「我不会游！」鸟说。「没关系，我也不会飞！」青蛙笑着说。

811195.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile up to one other target creature you control. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
811195.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐至多另一个目标由你操控的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

811196.oracleText: When Skyskipper Duo enters, exile up to one other target creature you control. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
811196.translation: 当掠空搭档进场时，放逐至多另一个目标由你操控的生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

811199.oracleText: Choose one — • Counter target spell. • Surveil 2, then draw two cards.
811199.translation: 选择一项～ •  反击目标咒语。 •  刺探2，然后抓两张牌。

811202.oracleText: When this creature enters, tap up to one target creature and put a stun counter on it.
811202.translation: 当此生物进场时，横置至多一个目标生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

811204.oracleText:
"Don't ask me how it works. If I stopped long enough to question it, I'd lose my legs."
—Lorb, frogfolk wizard
811204.translation: 「别问我其间原理。如果我一直在里头待着去探究，我的腿就要没了。」～蛙民法师洛勃

811205.oracleText: Exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. If that creature is a Bird, Frog, Otter, or Rat, draw a card.
811205.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。如果该生物是鸟，蛙，水獭或老鼠，则抓一张牌。

811207.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 blue and red Otter creature token with prowess.
811207.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出一个1/1，蓝红双色，具灵技异能的水獭衍生生物。

811208.oracleText: When Stormchaser's Talent enters, create a 1/1 blue and red Otter creature token with prowess.
811208.translation: 当逐风客才能进场时，派出一个1/1，蓝红双色，具灵技异能的水獭衍生生物。

811210.oracleText: When this Class becomes level 2, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
811210.translation: 当此职业成为等级2时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

811211.oracleText: CLASSLEVEL [2] [When this Class becomes level 2, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.]
811211.translation: CLASSLEVEL [2] [当此职业成为等级2时，将目标瞬间或法术牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。]

811213.oracleText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 blue and red Otter creature token with prowess.
