811776.oracleText: "Splashy entrances are my specialty. And they can be yours too. Try again!"
811776.translation: 「虽然闪亮出场是我的特色，但你们也能做到。再来一次！」

811777.oracleText: {o1oGoU}: Exile another target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery.
811777.translation: {o1oGoU}：放逐另一个目标由你操控的生物，然后将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。只能于法术时机起动。

811779.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, each opponent loses 1 life.
811779.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得过生命，则每位对手各失去1点生命。

811780.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained and lost life this turn, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.
811780.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中既获得过也失去过生命，则派出一个1/1黑色，具飞行异能的蝙蝠衍生生物。

811782.translation: 由你操控的其他家鼠得+1/+1。

811783.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance, trample, and haste.
811783.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒、践踏与敏捷异能。

811784.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, create Cragflame, a legendary colorless Equipment artifact token with "Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance, trample, and haste" and equip {o2}.
811784.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，派出传奇衍生神器焰齿剑，其为无色武具，且具有「佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒、践踏与敏捷异能」与佩带{o2}。

811785.oracleText: When Mabel, Heir to Cragflame enters, create Cragflame, a legendary colorless Equipment artifact token with "Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance, trample, and haste" and equip {o2}.
811785.translation: 当焰齿剑传人玛贝尔进场时，派出传奇衍生神器焰齿剑，其为无色武具，且具有「佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒、践踏与敏捷异能」与佩带{o2}。

811787.oracleText: "If only you kept your secrets somewhere more secure than your delicate little skull."
811787.translation: 「你要是把秘密藏在比你那小脑壳更安全的地方就好了。」

811788.oracleText: Threshold — As long as seven or more cards are in your graveyard, CARDNAME gets +3/+0.
811788.translation: 门槛～只要你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，CARDNAME便得+3/+0。

811789.oracleText: Threshold — As long as seven or more cards are in your graveyard, Mind Drill Assailant gets +3/+0.
811789.translation: 门槛～只要你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，钻心袭击客便得+3/+0。

811792.oracleText: "The sunrisers have entrusted me with their life force. I intend to repay them bountifully."
811792.translation: 「日光民将生命之力托付于我。我定会加倍回报。」

811793.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you gain 1 life.
811793.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，你获得1点生命。

811794.oracleText: Whenever Moonrise Cleric attacks, you gain 1 life.
811794.translation: 每当月行僧侣攻击时，你获得1点生命。

811796.oracleText: At the beginning of your first main phase, add {oR} or {oG} for each Raccoon you control.
811796.translation: 在你的第一个行动阶段开始时，你每操控一个浣熊，便加{oR}或{oG}。

811797.oracleText: Whenever you expend 4, you gain 3 life.
811797.translation: 每当你花销4时，你获得3点生命。

811798.oracleText: Whenever you expend 8, exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
811798.translation: 每当你花销8时，放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。

811800.oracleText: "Any fledgling can flap their wings. But a true windscout must soar!"
811800.translation: 「所有鸟都会拍翅飞起。但真正的追风斥候要能翱翔天际！」

811801.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control with flying enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control without flying.
811801.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物进场时，在目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811802.oracleText: Whenever Plumecreed Mentor or another creature you control with flying enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control without flying.
811802.translation: 每当羽誓导师或另一个由你操控且具飞行异能的生物进场时，在目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811804.oracleText: "The rainfall brings us news of the world around us. I've learned a lot, but most of all I've learned that it's very exciting out there!"
811804.translation: 「雨水能让我们得知周围世界的消息。我已经知晓了许多，且从所知来看，外面的世界很精彩！」

811805.oracleText: When Pond Prophet enters, draw a card.
811805.translation: 当池塘先知进场时，抓一张牌。

811807.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a loyalty counter on CARDNAME.
811807.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在CARDNAME上放置一个忠诚指示物。

811808.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a loyalty counter on Ral, Crackling Wit.
811808.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在震天急智拉尔上放置一个忠诚指示物。

811809.oracleText: Create a 1/1 blue and red Otter creature token with prowess.
811809.translation: 派出一个1/1，蓝红双色，具灵技异能的水獭衍生生物。

811810.oracleText: Draw three cards, then discard two cards.
811810.translation: 抓三张牌，然后弃两张牌。

811811.oracleText: Instant and sorcery spells you cast have storm.
811811.translation: 你施放的瞬间和法术咒语具有风暴异能。

811812.oracleText: Draw three cards. You get an emblem with "Instant and sorcery spells you cast have storm."
811812.translation: 抓三张牌。你获得具有以下异能的徽记～「你施放的瞬间和法术咒语具有风暴异能。」

811814.oracleText: "Your riposte is good, yes. But how's your footwork?"
811814.translation: 「你还击的反应还挺快的，很好。但你步法如何？」

811815.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever Seedglaive Mentor becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
811815.translation: 英武～每当种剑导师每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811817.oracleText:
"If you think he's loud now, wait until he starts the battle song."
—Clement, pessimistic adventurer
811817.translation:
「你要是现在就觉得他吵的话，请等到他开始弹战歌之后再下结论。」
～忧天冒险家克莱门特

811818.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, target creature you control without flying gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
811818.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

811819.oracleText: Whenever Seedpod Squire attacks, target creature you control without flying gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
811819.translation: 每当种荚扈从攻击时，目标由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

811821.oracleText: "Each star is given a name befitting its grandeur. This one is called Aurax, the Night-Eater. That one is called Blinky."
811821.translation: 「每颗星星都是根据其特点来起的名字。这颗叫噬夜者傲雷兹。那颗叫闪闪。」

811822.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained or lost life this turn, target opponent loses 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card.
811822.translation: 在你的结束步骤开始时，若你本回合中获得或失去过生命，则除非目标对手牺牲一个非地永久物或弃一张牌，否则其失去3点生命。

811824.oracleText: "Only novice mages burn their whiskers. So pay attention!"
811824.translation: 「只有新手法师会烧到自己的胡须。因此请务必集中注意力！」

811826.oracleText: "Castin' lines or castin' spells, ain't no one better than me."
811826.translation: 「不管是甩杆还是甩咒语，没有人能强过我。」

811827.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Tempest Angler.
811827.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，在风暴钓客上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811829.oracleText: "The same tides that bring us knowledge can sweep us away."
811829.translation: 「潮汐既能给我们带来知识，也能将我们全数冲走。」

811830.oracleText: Threshold — When CARDNAME enters, if seven or more cards are in your graveyard, return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
811830.translation: 门槛～当CARDNAME进场时，若你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

811831.oracleText: Threshold — When Tidecaller Mentor enters, if seven or more cards are in your graveyard, return up to one target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
811831.translation: 门槛～当唤潮导师进场时，若你坟墓场中有七张或更多牌，则将至多一个目标非地永久物移回其拥有者手上。

811833.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever CARDNAME becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, it gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
811833.translation: 英武～每当CARDNAME每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。占卜1。

811834.oracleText: Valiant — Whenever Veteran Guardmouse becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, it gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. Scry 1.
811834.translation: 英武～每当鼠卫老兵每回合首度成为由你操控之咒语或异能的目标时，直到回合结束，它得+1/+0且获得先攻异能。占卜1。

811836.oracleText: "In youth, we reap. In death, we sow."
811836.translation: 「趁年轻茁壮时，我们收割备用。待年迈垂危后，我们播撒新生。」

811837.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or dies, create a Food token.
811837.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或死去时，派出一个食品衍生物。

811838.oracleText: When Vinereap Mentor enters or dies, create a Food token.
811838.translation: 当刈藤导师进场或死去时，派出一个食品衍生物。

811840.oracleText: This creature gets +1/+1 for each other Rat you control.
811840.translation: 你每操控一个其他老鼠，此生物便得+1/+1。

811841.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, create X 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This creature gets +1/+1 for each other Rat you control," where X is the number of creatures your opponents controlled that were exiled this turn.
811841.translation: 在每个结束步骤开始时，派出X个1/1黑色老鼠衍生生物，且具有「你每操控一个其他老鼠，此生物便得+1/+1」，X为本回合中被放逐且由对手操控的生物数量。

811843.oracleText: "You've all grown so much since I passed through this burrow last! Let's see, where to begin this story?"
811843.translation: 「从我上次来巢穴之后，你们都已经长这么大了！我看看，故事该从哪里开始？」

811844.oracleText: Whenever you expend 4, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
811844.translation: 每当你花销4时，在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811845.oracleText: Whenever you expend 4, put a +1/+1 counter on Wandertale Mentor.
811845.translation: 每当你花销4时，在云游导师上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811848.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this permanent: You gain 3 life.
811848.translation: {o2}，{oT}，牺牲此永久物：你获得3点生命。

811849.oracleText: Other creatures are Food artifacts in addition to their other types and have "{o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice this permanent: You gain 3 life."
811849.translation: 其他生物都是食品神器，仍具有原本类别，且具有「{o2}，{oT}，牺牲此神器：你获得3点生命。」

811850.oracleText: Whenever a Food is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.
811850.translation: 每当一个食品从战场进入坟墓场时，在CARDNAME上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

811851.oracleText: Whenever a Food is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put two +1/+1 counters on Ygra, Eater of All.
811851.translation: 每当一个食品从战场进入坟墓场时，在万生噬兽依格拉上放置两个+1/+1指示物。

811853.oracleText: Whenever a Bat you control attacks, you gain 1 life.
811853.translation: 每当一个由你操控的蝙蝠攻击时，你获得1点生命。

811854.oracleText: Whenever Zoraline enters or attacks, you may pay {oWoB} and 2 life. When you do, return target nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
811854.translation: 每当佐拉琳进场或攻击时，你可以支付{oWoB}和2点生命。当你如此作时，将目标法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。

811856.oracleText: The farmers hide when it runs out of potatoes to harvest.
811856.translation: 一旦它已无马铃薯可采，就连农夫也得躲起来。

811859.oracleText: When Bumbleflower's Sharepot enters, create a Food token.
811859.translation: 当野花小姐的杂烩锅进场时，派出一个食品衍生物。

811860.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Destroy target nonland permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.
811860.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：消灭目标非地永久物。只能于法术时机起动。

811861.oracleText: {o5}, {oT}, Sacrifice Bumbleflower's Sharepot: Destroy target nonland permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.
811861.translation: {o5}，{oT}，牺牲野花小姐的杂烩锅：消灭目标非地永久物。只能于法术时机起动。

811863.oracleText: Fountainport's town crier once saved the townsfolk from predation by a rottenmouth viper with only their bell.
811863.translation: 喷泉港的传令官有一次仅靠钟声就救下了镇民性命，免受腐臭口毒蛇滋扰。

811864.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
811864.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

811865.oracleText: When Fountainport Bell enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
811865.translation: 当喷泉港响钟进场时，你可以从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，然后洗牌，并将该牌置于牌库顶。

811866.oracleText: {o1}, Sacrifice Fountainport Bell: Draw a card.

811868.oracleText: "The beasts feared fire, and little else. Lily of Valley raised Cragflame and . . ."
811868.translation: 「野兽除了火焰之外，其他什么都不怕。于是苍茂谷的莉莉便高举焰齿剑…」

811869.oracleText: {o4}, {oT}: Draw a card. For each mana in this ability's activation cost, you may tap an untapped creature you control rather than pay that mana. Activate only as a sorcery.
811869.translation: {o4}，{oT}：抓一张牌。对此异能起动费用中的每点法术力而言，你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物，而不支付该法术力。只能于法术时机起动。

811871.oracleText: With thistle, quill, twig, and beak, the finest artisans of each animalfolk society stitched unique quilts, patched together as a symbol of harmony.
811871.translation: 来自不同动物民团体的能工巧匠利用蓟花、羽毛、树枝、鸟喙将不同独特布块缝合一起，组成代表全民融合的团结象征。

811872.oracleText: As CARDNAME enters, choose a creature type.
811872.translation: 于CARDNAME进场时，选择一种生物类别。

811873.oracleText: As Patchwork Banner enters, choose a creature type.
811873.translation: 于百衲旗进场时，选择一种生物类别。

811875.oracleText: Take heart. Take aim. Take them down.
811875.translation: 举头振作。举弓瞄准。举箭射落。

811876.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance and reach.
811876.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+1/+1且具有警戒与延势异能。

811878.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if the gift was promised, attach CARDNAME to target creature you control.
811878.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若已应诺礼赠，则将CARDNAME贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

811879.oracleText: When Starforged Sword enters, if the gift was promised, attach Starforged Sword to target creature you control.
811879.translation: 当星铸剑进场时，若已应诺礼赠，则将星铸剑贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

811880.oracleText: Equipped creature gets +3/+3 and loses flying.
811880.translation: 佩带此武具的生物得+3/+3且失去飞行异能。

811882.oracleText: Tap two untapped tokens you control: CARDNAME becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
811882.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的衍生物：CARDNAME成为神器生物直到回合结束。

811883.oracleText: Tap two untapped tokens you control: Tangle Tumbler becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
811883.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的衍生物：枝结滚车成为神器生物直到回合结束。

811885.oracleText:
"Every paw and claw should be at the celebrations in Three Tree City! Even the float is smiling!"
—Valley Gazetteer, four-acorn review
811885.translation:
「所有手足都应该参加三树城庆典！就连花车都洋溢笑容！」
～《苍茂谷观察报》，四橡实评价

811886.translation: 苍茂谷外有危险～也有希望。

811888.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}, Sacrifice a token: Draw a card.

811889.oracleText: {o3}, {oT}, Pay 1 life: Create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token.
811889.translation: {o3}，{oT}，支付1点生命：派出一个1/1蓝色的鱼衍生生物。

811893.translation: 当隐匿石室进场时，刺探1。

811895.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oU}. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell.
811895.translation: {oT}：加{oU}。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语。

811896.oracleText: {oU}, {oT}: Surveil 2. Activate only if a Bird, Frog, Otter, or Rat entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
811896.translation: {oU}，{oT}：刺探2。只能于有鸟，蛙，水獭或老鼠在你操控下进战场的回合中起动。

811898.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oW}. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell.
811898.translation: {oT}：加{oW}。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语。

811899.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Bat, Bird, Mouse, or Rabbit card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
811899.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张蝙蝠，鸟，家鼠或兔牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

811900.oracleText: {o1oW}, {oT}, Sacrifice Lupinflower Village: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Bat, Bird, Mouse, or Rabbit card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
811900.translation: {o1oW}，{oT}，牺牲鲁冰花村：检视你牌库顶的六张牌。你可以展示其中一张蝙蝠，鸟，家鼠或兔牌并置于你手上。将其余的牌以随机顺序置于你牌库底。

811902.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oB}. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell.
811902.translation: {oT}：加{oB}。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语。

811903.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target Bat, Lizard, Rat, or Squirrel card from your graveyard to your hand.
811903.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，牺牲CARDNAME：将目标蝙蝠，蜥蜴，老鼠或松鼠牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

811904.oracleText: {o1oB}, {oT}, Sacrifice Mudflat Village: Return target Bat, Lizard, Rat, or Squirrel card from your graveyard to your hand.
811904.translation: {o1oB}，{oT}，牺牲泥岸村：将目标蝙蝠，蜥蜴，老鼠或松鼠牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

811906.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oG}. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell.
811906.translation: {oT}：加{oG}。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语。

811907.oracleText: {oG}, {oT}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Frog, Rabbit, Raccoon, or Squirrel you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
811907.translation: {oG}，{oT}：在每个由你操控且为本回合进战场的蛙，兔，浣熊或松鼠上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811909.oracleText: {oT}: Add {oR}. Spend this mana only to cast a creature spell.
811909.translation: {oT}：加{oR}。此法术力只能用来施放生物咒语。

811910.oracleText: {oR}, {oT}: Target Lizard, Mouse, Otter, or Raccoon you control gets +1/+0 and gains haste until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
811910.translation: {oR}，{oT}：直到回合结束，目标由你操控的蜥蜴，家鼠，水獭或浣熊得+1/+0且获得敏捷异能。只能于法术时机起动。

811912.oracleText: As Three Tree City enters, choose a creature type.
811912.translation: 于三树城进场时，选择一种生物类别。

811913.oracleText: {o2}, {oT}: Choose a color. Add an amount of mana of that color equal to the number of creatures you control of the chosen type.
811913.translation: {o2}，{oT}：选择一种颜色。加若干该色法术力，其数量等同于由你操控之所选类别生物数量。

811914.oracleText:
"There are lands beyond Valley. Wild, calamity-scarred, and beautiful."
—Farfeather, birdfolk scout
811914.translation:
「苍茂谷外别有洞天。那边荒蛮未化，灾兽横行，但景致绝美。」
～鸟民斥候远羽

811917.oracleText: Other creatures you control have prowess.
811917.translation: 每当你施放非生物咒语时，目标由你操控的生物本回合不能被阻挡。

811918.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, target creature you control can't be blocked this turn.
811918.translation: 由你操控的其他生物具有灵技异能。

811919.oracleText: Byrke, Long Ear of the Law

811920.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
811920.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811921.oracleText: When Byrke, Long Ear of the Law enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
811921.translation: 当法耳恢恢包尔克进场时，在至多两个目标生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811922.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it attacks, double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
811922.translation: 每当一个由你操控且其上有+1/+1指示物的生物攻击时，将其上的+1/+1指示物数量加倍。

811927.oracleText: Target a noncreature, nonland permanent card.
811927.translation: 指定一张非生物且非地的永久物牌为目标。

811928.oracleText: Target a creature you control without flying.
811928.translation: 指定一个由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物为目标。

811929.oracleText: Target a creature with power or toughness 4 or greater.
811929.translation: 指定一个力量或防御力等于或大于4的生物为目标。

811930.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a flying counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.
811930.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场，且上面有一个飞行指示物。

811931.oracleText: Target up to one creature you control without flying.
811931.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控且不具飞行异能的生物为目标。

811932.oracleText: Target an attacking, blocking, or tapped creature.
811932.translation: 指定一个进行攻击，进行阻挡或已横置的生物为目标。

811933.oracleText: Target up to one artifact, creature, or planeswalker an opponent controls.
811933.translation: 指定至多一个由对手操控的神器，生物或鹏洛克为目标。

811934.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
811934.translation: 是否要不支付法术力费用从你的坟墓场中施放目标法术力值等于或小于4的瞬间或法术牌？

811935.oracleText: Target an instant or sorcery card with mana value 4 or less.
811935.translation: 指定一张法术力值等于或小于4的瞬间或法术牌为目标。

811936.oracleText: Whenever that creature deals combat damage this turn, you may exile it. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
811936.translation: 本回合中，每当该生物造成战斗伤害时，你可以将它放逐。若你如此作，则将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

811937.oracleText: Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
811937.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。

811938.translation: 指定一个生物或食品为目标。

811939.oracleText: You may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value equal to the number of coin counters on CARDNAME from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
811939.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场施放目标法术力值等同于CARDNAME上钱币指示物数量的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果该咒语将进入你的坟墓场，则改为将它放逐。只能于法术时机起动。

811940.oracleText: Cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value equal to the number of coin counters on {1, CardId} from your graveyard without paying its mana cost?
811940.translation: 是否要从你的坟墓场施放目标法术力值等同于{1, CardId}上钱币指示物数量的瞬间或法术牌，且不需支付其法术力费用？

811941.oracleText: Target an instant or sorcery card with mana value equal to the number of coin counters on {1, CardId}.
811941.translation: 指定一张法术力值等同于{1, CardId}上钱币指示物数量的瞬间或法术牌为目标。

811943.oracleText: Sacrifice any number of nonland permanents.
811943.translation: 牺牲任意数量的非地永久物。

811944.oracleText: Select any number of nonland permanents to sacrifice.
811944.translation: 选择并牺牲任意数量的非地永久物。

811945.translation: 是否要牺牲三个其他非地永久物？

811946.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Put {2, Number} card into your hand.} other {Put {2, Number} cards into your hand.}}
811946.translation: {2, plural, =1 {将{2, Number}张牌置于你手上。} other {将{2, Number}张牌置于你手上。}}

811947.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on a Snail you control.
811947.translation: 在一个由你操控的蜗牛上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

811949.oracleText: Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the greatest mana value among cards in your graveyard.
811949.translation: 目标由对手操控的生物得-X/-X直到回合结束，X为你坟墓场内各牌中的最大法术力值。

811950.oracleText: Target up to one creature token.
811950.translation: 指定至多一个衍生生物为目标。

811951.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library?
811951.translation: 是否要放逐你的牌库顶牌？

811952.translation: 指定一个由你操控的家鼠为目标。

811953.oracleText: Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step.
811953.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，放逐该衍生物。

811954.oracleText: Target a creature you control other than that creature.
811954.translation: 指定一个该生物以外由你操控的生物为目标。

811956.oracleText: Tap two untapped tokens you control.
811956.translation: 横置两个由你操控且未横置的衍生物。

811957.oracleText: Tap three untapped tokens you control.
811957.translation: 横置三个由你操控且未横置的衍生物。

811958.oracleText: Tap four untapped tokens you control.
811958.translation: 横置四个由你操控且未横置的衍生物。

811959.oracleText: Target up to one creature you control with lesser mana value.
811959.translation: 指定至多一张由你操控且法术力值更低的生物为目标。

811960.oracleText: Spend only on: Creature Spells With Mana Value 4 or Greater or Creature Spells With {oX} In Their Mana Costs
811960.translation: 只能用于支付：法术力值等于或大于4的生物咒语，或法术力费用包含{oX}的生物咒语

811961.oracleText: Put a Bird creature card onto the battlefield?
811961.translation: 是否要将一张鸟生物牌放进战场？

811962.oracleText: Reveal a Bat, Bird, Mouse, or Rabbit card?
811962.translation: 是否要展示一张蝙蝠，鸟，家鼠或兔牌？

811963.oracleText: Target a Bat, Lizard, Rat, or Squirrel card.
811963.translation: 指定一张蝙蝠，蜥蜴，老鼠或松鼠牌为目标。

811964.oracleText: Target a Lizard, Mouse, Otter, or Raccoon you control.
811964.translation: 指定一个由你操控的蜥蜴，家鼠，水獭或浣熊为目标。

811965.oracleText: "I'm not as quick as I used to be, but the wheat doesn't mind."
811965.translation: 「我的动作虽已不如以前敏捷，但这些麦子并不介意。」

811966.oracleText: "Pah! You call this a comprehensive? I call this nest-stuffing!"
811966.translation: 「哈！你管这叫全面资料？我看不过是些垫窝材料！」

811967.oracleText: For every five you see, there are fifty you don't.
811967.translation: 你看得到的有五只，你看不到的有五十只。

811968.oracleText: Each of them is a bad influence on the rest.
811968.translation: 每只都是彼此的不良榜样。

811970.oracleText:
"Anyone can live next door, but when you fight to defend your neighbors, you become a village."
—Rho, veteran hero
811970.translation:
「住在隔壁，不过只是邻居；有了携手齐力、共御家园的经历之后，才称得上是居民。」
～老练英雄小洛

811971.oracleText: Choose a creature type. For each creature you control of the chosen type, create a token that's a copy of that creature. Those tokens gain haste. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
811971.translation: 选择一个生物类别。你每操控一个该类型的生物，便派出一个衍生生物，该衍生生物为该生物的复制品。这些衍生物获得敏捷异能。在下个结束步骤开始时，放逐它们。

811972.oracleText: The magic of the land is a thread that weaves all of Valley into a tapestry, connecting even the most distant of friends.
811972.translation: 这片土地上的魔法如同绳线，将整座苍翠谷织联一体，朋友纵使远隔天边也有羁绊相牵。

811973.oracleText:
"It started as a prototype for a frog diving suit, but the internal mechanisms didn't leave room for the frog."
—Fitzwhisker, otterfolk inventor
811973.translation:
「一开始我只是想试着给青蛙做套潜水服，但内部装进元件之后，就已经塞不下青蛙了。」
～獭民发明家菲茨威克

811974.oracleText: Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
811974.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它们放逐。

811975.oracleText: They don't follow orders. They follow him.
811975.translation: 它们不听命令。它们只听他。

811976.oracleText:
"She only makes the trek through Valley when she's hungry. I fear it's not just our crops she enjoys."
—Lop, rabbitfolk farmer
811976.translation:
「她只有在饥饿的时候才穿越苍茂谷。恐怕她喜欢的不只是我们的庄稼。」
～兔民农夫垂耳

811977.oracleText:
"How lovely! An ambassador from outside Valley arrived today in Three Tree City. Animalfolk from all over have come to welcome them."
—Ms. Bumbleflower
811977.translation:
「真好！今天有苍茂谷外使者飞抵三树城。引得万民空巷、大家夹道相迎。」
～野花小姐

811979.oracleText: It came from beyond Valley. Not a calamity like the Great Maha, and not animalfolk. It was something new.
811979.translation: 它来自苍茂谷外。既不是蔽夜玛哈这样的灾兽，也不像是动物民，而是某种新东西。

811980.oracleText: "Invite your friends! Invite your family! Invite some strangers! Tonight we feast!"
811980.translation: 「叫上朋友！叫上家人！叫上路人！今晚一起吃大餐！」

811981.oracleText: He calls forth his flock from dancing zephyrs and swirling clouds.
811981.translation: 他从跃动西风与涡旋云彩间唤来族群。

811986.oracleText: Target an instant spell, sorcery spell, activated ability, or triggered ability.
811986.translation: 指定一个瞬间咒语、法术咒语、起动式异能或触发式异能为目标。

812036.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, conjure a duplicate of that spell into your hand. If this spell wasn't kicked, discard the duplicate at the beginning of your next end step.
812036.translation: 当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，变出该咒语的复制牌置于你手上。若它未增幅，在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，弃掉该复制牌。

812106.oracleText: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, conjure a duplicate of that spell into your hand. If this spell wasn't kicked, discard the duplicate at the beginning of your next end step.
812106.translation: 当你施放你的下一个瞬间或法术咒语时，变出该咒语的复制牌置于你手上。若它未增幅，在你的下一个结束步骤开始时，弃掉该复制牌。

812107.oracleText: Discard the duplicate at the beginning of your next end step.
812107.translation: 在你的下个结束步骤开始时，弃掉该复制牌。

812125.oracleText: Shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library?
812125.translation: 是否要将其手牌和坟墓场洗入其牌库？

812223.oracleText: Shuffle your hand and graveyard into your library?
812223.translation: 是否要将你的手牌和坟墓场洗入牌库？

812229.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, target creature, target enchantment, and target land. (You can't cast this spell unless you have legal choices for all its targets.)
812229.translation: 消灭目标神器，目标生物，目标结界和目标地。（除非你能够选出所有合法目标，否则便不能施放此咒语。）

812230.oracleText: "For all his crimes, Lord Konda's greatest legacy is his daughter. I will guide her as I can."
812230.translation: 「今田城主罪行滔天，幸有公主千金遗世。余定将竭尽所能辅佐左右。」

812231.oracleText: Ayula's consort is the hearth to her fire, the honey to her sting, and the mirror to her splendor.
812231.translation: 阿育拉之伴侣，乃是助其烈焰旺燃的火炉，锐其针芒刺锋的花蜜，展其威严雄姿的明镜。

812232.oracleText: "They laughed because I couldn't walk. Now they tremble as I take flight."
812232.translation: 「我跛行窘态曾沦作他人笑柄。飞天雄姿换令对方瘫坐在地。」

812234.oracleText: Put two +1/+1 counters and a flying counter on target attacking creature. It becomes an Angel in addition to its other types.
812234.translation: 在目标进行攻击的生物上放置两个+1/+1指示物和一个飞行指示物。它成为天使，且仍具有原本类别。

812263.oracleText: Whenever one or more other creatures you control with power 2 or less enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
812263.translation: 每当一个或数个力量等于或小于2的其他生物在你的操控下进场时，抓一张牌。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

812352.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
812352.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，放逐目标由对手操控的非地永久物，直到CARDNAME离开战场为止。

812451.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it.
812451.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置目标由对手操控的生物并在其上放置一个晕眩指示物。

812491.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, draw two cards, then discard a card.
812491.translation: 当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，抓两张牌，然后弃一张牌。

812517.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, tap enchanted creature.
812517.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，横置所结附的生物。

812558.oracleText: CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if a creature died this turn.
812558.translation: 如果本回合中有生物死去，则CARDNAME进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。

812971.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
812971.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

813000.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or dies, surveil 1.

813010.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, attach it to target creature you control.
813010.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，将它贴附在目标由你操控的生物上。

813226.oracleText: CARDNAME enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color.
813226.translation: CARDNAME须横置进场。于它进场时，选择一种颜色。

813282.oracleText: Exile target permanent and all others with the same name?
813282.translation: 是否要放逐目标永久物，以及所有同名的其他永久物？

813283.oracleText: Target a creature to put a +1/+1 counter on.
813283.translation: 指定一个要放置+1/+1指示物的生物为目标。

813284.oracleText: Target an artifact or creature to put into its owner's library.
813284.translation: 指定一个神器或生物为目标，将它置于其拥有者的牌库顶。

813285.oracleText: Put a card from exile into their graveyard?
813285.translation: 是否要从放逐区将一张牌置入其坟墓场？

813521.oracleText: Select the number of times to replicate.

813522.oracleText: Seek a card with the highest mana value among cards in your library with mana value {2, Number} or less.
813522.translation: 从你牌库中法术力值等于或小于{2, Number}的牌中掏一张法术力值最大的牌。

813523.translation: 牌面朝下地放逐一张牌。

813820.oracleText: Turn the exiled cards face up?
813820.translation: 是否要将所放逐的牌翻回正面？

813841.oracleText: At the Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center, Mr. Handy robots were repurposed for farming—and turning intruders into fertilizer.
813841.translation: 在避难所科技公司农业研究中心，巧手先生机器人都被改造以供农用～同时还能将入侵者变作肥料。

813864.oracleText: Like him, his tiny flower friend continued to grow larger each day.
813864.translation: 跟他一样，他的小小花朵伙伴每天都在不断长大。

813870.oracleText:
"Another beautiful day in the most dangerous place in the world."
—Nick Valentine
813870.translation:
「又是新的一天，还是待在世界上最危险的地方。」
～尼克·瓦伦坦

813887.oracleText: Something to love, honor, and cherish—and a reminder of someone who once did that for you.
813887.translation: 值得爱恋、尊敬与关爱之物～同时提醒你还有人曾经也对你如此。

813893.oracleText:
"When facing a crisis, don't forget to squeeze your official Vault-Tec stress ball!"
—Overseer's Manual
813893.translation:
「面对危机时，别忘了捏一捏手边的正版避难所科技压力球！」
～《监管人手册》

813898.oracleText: "I don't need brakes. I usually find that if something stops me, it's interesting enough to stop for."
813898.translation: 「我不需要刹车。我发现，能让我停下来的东西，通常都值得我这么作。」

813914.oracleText:
"From up here, you could almost imagine how it was before."
—Wasteland survivor
813914.translation:
「站在这高处，你几乎能想象出以往的风景。」
～废土幸存者

813915.oracleText:
"New Vegas is more than a city—it's the remedy to mankind's derailment."
—Mr. House
813915.translation:
「新维加斯不仅只是一座城市～它是纠正人性偏离的解方。」
～豪斯先生

813917.oracleText: The Poseidon offshore oil rig became one of the Enclave's mightiest fortresses, and eventually, the site of their greatest defeat.
813917.translation: 英克雷将海神石油钻井平台建成了他们最强大的要塞，也在此吞下了他们最惨痛的失利。

813918.oracleText:
"Make no mistake, the rats run these tunnels. We just live here."
—Fiends gang member
813918.translation:
「别搞错了，隧道是老鼠的天下。我们只是借住在这里。」
～恶魔帮成员

813919.oracleText:
"One day, maybe, kids will play here again."
—Preston Garvey
813919.translation:
「有一天，或许孩子们会再一次在这里嬉戏。」
～普雷斯敦·加维

813922.oracleText: Considered the greatest battle in history, Operation: Anchorage showcased the effectiveness of the winterized T-51b power armor.
813922.translation: 冬季T-51b动力装甲的效果，在史上最宏大的战役～安克雷奇行动中展现得淋漓尽致。

813923.oracleText: Radioactive fog was the least of the inhabitants' worries.
813923.translation: 辐射雾反倒是居民最不担心的东西。

813925.oracleText: The pride of Calverton was now the town's only marker.
813925.translation: 卡尔弗顿祈祷团现在成了小镇的唯一地标。

813939.oracleText: Mutant strangler vines carried the town of Tanagra up into the treetops, where it remains to this day.
813939.translation: 变种绞杀藤将整座塔纳格拉镇都抬至树顶。全镇至今依然留在树上。

813949.oracleText: Shortly after the vault dwellers moved out, fire geckos moved in.
813949.translation: 避难所居民搬出去后不久，火蜥蜴就住了进来。

813952.oracleText:
"Must have been something to see a movie on a screen that big."
—Preston Garvey
813952.translation:
「用大的银幕看电影，一定很痛快。」
～普雷斯敦·加维

813970.oracleText: There are more dead here than the gravestones suggest.
813970.translation: 葬于此处的死者，比现今留下的墓碑更多。

813974.oracleText: Whenever a Lhurgoyf permanent card is put into your graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, put it onto the battlefield.
813974.translation: 每当一张拉高耶夫永久物牌从战场以外的任何区域进入你的坟墓场时，将之放进战场。

813975.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Tarmogoyf token.
813975.translation: 每当由你操控的一个或数个生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，派出一个塔莫耶夫衍生物。

813980.oracleText: Each land with an everything counter on it is every land type in addition to its other types.
813980.translation: 每个其上有万物指示物的地均额外具有所有地类别。

813981.oracleText: Each nonland creature with an everything counter on it is every creature type.
813981.translation: 每个其上有万物指示物的非地生物均是所有生物类别。

813983.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of up to one other target nontoken creature you control. You get {oEoE}. At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice that token unless you pay an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value.
813983.translation: 每当CARDNAME攻击时，选择至多另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的生物。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。你得到{oEoE}。在下一个结束步骤开始时，除非你支付等同于该衍生物之法术力值的{oE}，否则牺牲之。

813984.oracleText: Whenever Satya, Aetherflux Genius attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of up to one other target nontoken creature you control. You get {oEoE}. At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice that token unless you pay an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value.
813984.translation: 每当乙太流天才萨提亚攻击时，选择至多另一个目标由你操控且非衍生物的生物。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，其为横置且正进行攻击。你得到{oEoE}。在下一个结束步骤开始时，除非你支付等同于该衍生物之法术力值的{oE}，否则牺牲之。

813986.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Eldrazi spell, you may pay {oCoC}. If you do, copy all spells you control, then copy all other activated and triggered abilities you control. You may choose new targets for the copies.
813986.translation: 每当你施放奥札奇咒语时，你可以支付{oCoC}。若你如此作，则复制所有由你操控的咒语，然后复制所有由你操控的其他起动式和触发式异能。你可以为每个复制品选择新的目标。

813988.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME or another colorless creature you control dies, you get an experience counter.
813988.translation: 每当CARDNAME或另一个由你操控的无色生物死去时，你得到一个经验指示物。

813989.oracleText: Whenever Azlask, the Swelling Scourge or another colorless creature you control dies, you get an experience counter.
813989.translation: 每当翻涌灾祸兹拉克或另一个由你操控的无色生物死去时，你得到一个经验指示物。

813990.oracleText: {oWoUoBoRoG}: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of experience counters you have. Scions and Spawns you control gain indestructible and annihilator 1 until end of turn.
813990.translation: {oWoUoBoRoG}：由你操控的生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为你具有的经验指示物数量。由你操控的孽裔和后裔获得不灭与歼灭1直到回合结束。

813992.oracleText: Other nontoken creatures you control have fabricate 1.
813992.translation: 由你操控且非衍生物的其他生物具有装配1。

813994.translation: {o2}，{oT}：选择一项～ •  殖民。 •  增殖。

813996.oracleText: CARDNAME gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in all graveyards.
813996.translation: CARDNAME得+X/+0，X为所有坟墓场内生物牌中的最大力量。

813997.oracleText: Coram, the Undertaker gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in all graveyards.
813997.translation: 葬仪人寇劳得+X/+0，X为所有坟墓场内生物牌中的最大力量。

813998.oracleText: Whenever Coram attacks, each player mills a card.
813998.translation: 每当寇劳攻击时，每位牌手各磨一张牌。

813999.oracleText: During each of your turns, you may play a land and cast a spell from among cards in graveyards that were put there from libraries this turn.
813999.translation: 于你的每个回合中，你可以从本回合自牌库进入坟墓场的牌之中使用一个地和施放一个咒语。

814003.oracleText: At the beginning of each combat, land creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is Jyoti's power.
814003.translation: 在每次战斗开始时，由你操控的地生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为乔提的力量。

814008.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice that token unless you pay an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value.
814008.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，除非你支付等同于该衍生物之法术力值的{oE}，否则牺牲之。

814009.oracleText: Pay an amount of {oE} equal to its mana value?
814009.translation: 是否要支付等同于其法术力值之数量的{oE}？

814010.oracleText: Target up to one other nontoken creature you control.
814010.translation: 指定至多一个由你操控，且非衍生物的生物为目标。

814012.oracleText:
Choose up to five {oH} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once. 
{oH} — Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. 
{oHoH} — Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller draws a card. 
{oHoHoH} — Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with an indestructible counter on it.
814012.translation:
选择数量加总不超过五个{oH}的模式。你可以多次选择同一项。
{oH}～派出一个1/1白色的兔衍生生物。
{oHoH}～放逐目标非地永久物。其操控者抓一张牌。
{oHoHoH}～将目标法术力值等于或小于3的永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个不灭指示物。

814013.oracleText:
Choose up to five {oH} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once. 
{oH} — Draw a card. 
{oHoH} — Choose an artifact or creature you control. Create a token that's a copy of it. 
{oHoHoH} — Return each nonland, nontoken permanent to its owner's hand.
814013.translation:
选择数量加总不超过五个{oH}的模式。你可以多次选择同一项。
{oH}～抓一张牌。
{oHoH}～选择一个由你操控的神器或生物。派出一个为其复制品的衍生物。
{oHoHoH}～将所有非地且非衍生物的永久物移回其拥有者手上。

814014.oracleText:
Choose up to five {oH} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once. 
{oH} — Each player sacrifices a creature. 
{oHoH} — Draw a card for each creature you controlled that died this turn. 
{oHoHoH} — Each opponent loses X life, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
814014.translation:
选择数量加总不超过五个{oH}的模式。你可以多次选择同一项。
{oH}～每位牌手各牺牲一个生物。
{oHoH}～本回合中每有一个由你操控的生物死去，便抓一张牌。
{oHoHoH}～每位对手各失去X点生命，X为你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

814015.oracleText:
Choose up to five {oH} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once. 
{oH} — Create a tapped Treasure token. 
{oHoH} — Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play them. 
{oHoHoH} — Until the end of your next turn, whenever you cast a spell, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to up to one target creature.
814015.translation:
选择数量加总不超过五个{oH}的模式。你可以多次选择同一项。
{oH}～派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。
{oHoH}～放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。
{oHoHoH}～直到你下一个回合的回合结束，每当你施放咒语时，CARDNAME对至多一个目标生物造成2点伤害。

814016.oracleText:
Choose up to five {oH} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once. 
{oH} — Create a tapped Treasure token. 
{oHoH} — Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play them. 
{oHoHoH} — Until the end of your next turn, whenever you cast a spell, Season of the Bold deals 2 damage to up to one target creature.
814016.translation:
选择数量加总不超过五个{oH}的模式。你可以多次选择同一项。
{oH}～派出一个已横置的珍宝衍生物。
{oHoH}～放逐你牌库顶的两张牌。直到你下一个回合的回合结束，你可以使用这些牌。
{oHoHoH}～直到你下一个回合的回合结束，每当你施放咒语时，勇武季节对至多一个目标生物造成2点伤害。

814017.oracleText:
Choose up to five {oH} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once. 
{oH} — Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control. It gains vigilance and trample until end of turn. 
{oHoH} — Choose artifact or enchantment. Destroy all permanents of the chosen type. 
{oHoHoH} — Draw cards equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
814017.translation:
选择数量加总不超过五个{oH}的模式。你可以多次选择同一项。
{oH}～在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。它获得警戒与践踏异能直到回合结束。
{oHoH}～选择神器或结界。消灭所有该类别的永久物。
{oHoHoH}～抓若干牌，其数量等同于由你操控之生物中的最大力量。

814018.oracleText: Choose an artifact or creature you control.
814018.translation: 选择一个由你操控的神器或生物。

814019.oracleText: Until the end of your next turn, whenever you cast a spell, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to up to one target creature.
814019.translation: 直到你下一个回合的回合结束，每当你施放咒语时，CARDNAME对至多一个目标生物造成2点伤害。

814351.oracleText: The number of colors is insufficient to affect the target.
814351.translation: 颜色数量不足以影响目标。

814360.translation: 指定一个永久物或对手为目标。

814417.oracleText: Spend only on: Costs That Contain {oX}
814417.translation: 只能用于支付：包含{oX}的费用

814418.oracleText: Reveal any number of cards with {oX} in their mana cost in your hand.
814418.translation: 从你手上展示任意数量法术力费用中包含{oX}的牌。

814429.oracleText: "I have a child I want to return to as well," whispered Mabel.
814429.translation: 「我也有个孩子，我也想回到他身边，」玛贝尔低语道。

814430.oracleText:
Be the calm in the storm.
—Birdfolk saying
814430.translation:
暴风之中有静时。 
～鸟民谚语

814431.oracleText: The boundaries of Valley are heavily defended. Especially at night.
814431.translation: 苍茂谷边境已然戒备森严。尤其是在夜晚。

814432.oracleText:
"Heroes grew as steadily as crops, and nourished our spirits."
—Wake of the Beasts
814432.translation:
「英雄如春笋般涌现，不断鼓舞众人心神。」 
～《灾兽余生纪》

814433.oracleText:
"Rations were tightly controlled."
—Wake of the Beasts
814433.translation:
「口粮配给严格受控。」 
～《灾兽余生纪》

814434.oracleText: "Don't worry, your secrets are safe with me!" the birdfolk called back in the ratfolk's own voice.
814434.translation: 「别担心，我会守好你的秘密！」鸟民模仿鼠民声音回应道。

814435.oracleText: "Fighting the snake is to fight starvation itself. Strikes synchronize with hunger pangs."
814435.translation: 「抗蛇患就是抗饥荒。饿意来袭时就正好要出击。」

814436.oracleText: "Oh? Do I need to repeat myself?"

814437.oracleText:
"There was a bold young otterfolk / Who sailed for parts unknown, / Ignored the words her elders spoke, / And crewed the ship alone."
—Songs from Upstream
814437.translation:
「小小獭民志气高，／一心想往外面跑；／老人忠告抛脑后，／独自登船斗水潮。」 
～《上游歌集》

814438.oracleText:
"The same heat with which we forge weapons may also forge friendships."
—Emberheart Forge inscription
814438.translation:
「铸兵热意，亦能铸友。」 
～烬心熔炉铭文

814439.oracleText:
"Here's to good food, good friends, and a good life, together in our Valley."
—Lily Emberseed
814439.translation:
「为美食、佳友、良宵齐聚苍茂谷，干杯。」 
～烬种莉莉

814440.oracleText:
"Raccoonfolk scoured the wreckage, hoping to reunite heirlooms with their owners."
—Tales from Downstream
814440.translation:
「浣熊民遍寻残骸，希望能将遗物归还原主。」
～《下游典传》

814441.oracleText:
Where you are is temporary. What you do is forever.
—Frogfolk saying
814441.translation:
所在一时，所为一世。 
～蛙民谚语

814442.oracleText: When the woodlands are your armory, you can afford to travel light.
814442.translation: 当整片林地都是你的武器库时，当然就能轻装上路。

814443.oracleText:
"The community banded together to revitalize the scorched earth."
—Wake of the Beasts
814443.translation:
「全民携手，助疮痍大地重焕活力。」
～《灾兽余生纪》

814444.oracleText:
"Creatures of all kinds united to patrol the outskirts."
—Wake of the Beasts
814444.translation:
「所有生灵不分种族，联合派员共巡郊野。」
～《灾兽余生纪》

814445.oracleText: While the storm raged, the sage took the lightning and wove a thunderous tapestry.
814445.translation: 风暴正盛时，智者就势抽出闪电，织成一幅雷鸣挂毯。

814448.oracleText: He knows exactly where he's going and exactly how he isn't getting there.
814448.translation: 他清楚知道要去往何方，也十分明白是何物阻住前路。

814449.oracleText: Whenever you play a land or cast a spell, draw a card if you have no cards in hand. Otherwise, discard a card.
814449.translation: 每当你使用地或施放咒语时，如果你没有手牌，抓一张牌。若有手牌，则弃一张牌。

814468.oracleText: "If they didn't want me to steal this, they should've used more than seven layers of shatterproof antimagus glass."
814468.translation: 「要是他们真的不希望我来偷这东西的话，就不该用只有七层的防爆反魔玻璃来保护它。」

814476.oracleText: "Just as new shoots rise from winter's slumber, so too will my people rise to greatness once again."
814476.translation: 「正如寒冬过后新芽萌生，我的人民也定会再度壮大。」

814483.oracleText: Matic had only taken the ring to appease his grandmother when she'd pressed it insistently into his palm. As the rats scurried away from its light, he understood her urgency.
814483.translation: 马提奇才刚取下戒指想要让祖母安心，就被对方一把攥紧握在掌中。直到察觉迸发光芒下老鼠四处逃窜，他才明白祖母为何会有如此反应。

814487.oracleText:
"I'm not sure who's in charge around here, but I'm pretty sure I know where to go to find out."
—Corliss the Wanderer
814487.translation:
「虽然我不知道这里是谁的地盘，但我很确定去哪里能搞清楚。」
～云游者柯力斯

814499.oracleText: An unwelcome light on a dark and foggy night.
814499.translation: 黑沉雾夜中的猛烈焰光。

814507.oracleText: "I am the bridge between sea and sky. Wind and waves alike rise at my whim."
814507.translation: 「我乃连通海空之桥梁，狂风骇浪均听我召唤。」

814515.oracleText: "If you travel only to reach a destination, you will miss the point of the journey."
814515.translation: 「如果仅为朝着终点移动，就已错失旅行的意义。」

814517.oracleText: "A life is meaningless until put to use."

814535.oracleText: {2, plural, =1 {Sacrifice a permanent.} other {Sacrifice {2, Number} permanents.}}
814535.translation: {2, plural, =1 {牺牲1个永久物。} other {牺牲{2, Number}个永久物。}}

814586.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Fox creature token with vigilance.
814586.translation: 派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的狐衍生生物。

814587.oracleText: Create a 2/2 white Fox creature token with vigilance.
814587.translation: 派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的狐衍生生物。

814588.oracleText: Create a 1/2 blue Moonfolk creature token with flying.
814588.translation: 派出一个1/2蓝色，具飞行异能的月人衍生生物。

814589.oracleText: Create a 1/2 blue Moonfolk creature token with flying.
814589.translation: 派出一个1/2蓝色，具飞行异能的月人衍生生物。

814590.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with lifelink.
814590.translation: 派出一个1/1黑色，具系命异能的老鼠衍生生物。

814591.oracleText: Create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with lifelink.
814591.translation: 派出一个1/1黑色，具系命异能的老鼠衍生生物。

814592.oracleText: Whenever another nontoken permanent you control leaves the battlefield, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn. • Create a 2/2 white Fox creature token with vigilance. • Create a 1/2 blue Moonfolk creature token with flying. • Create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with lifelink.
814592.translation: 每当另一个由你操控且非衍生物的永久物离开战场时，选择一项，且不得是本回合中此前选过的～ •  派出一个2/2白色，具警戒异能的狐衍生生物。 •  派出一个1/2蓝色，具飞行异能的月人衍生生物。 •  派出一个1/1黑色，具系命异能的老鼠衍生生物。

814604.oracleText: Exile the top card of your library, a card at random from your graveyard, and a card at random from your hand.
814604.translation: 放逐你的牌库顶牌，你的坟墓场中随机一张牌，以及你手上随机一张牌。

820446.oracleText: Create a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature token with EMBEDDED 1049?
820446.translation: 是否要派出一个0/1无色奥札奇／后裔衍生生物，且具有「牺牲此生物：加{oC}。」？

820543.oracleText: Target up to two creature cards each with mana value 2 or less.
820543.translation: 指定至多两张法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌为目标。

820544.oracleText: Target up to three creature cards each with mana value 2 or less.
820544.translation: 指定至多三张法术力值等于或小于2的生物牌为目标。

820546.oracleText: Return a creature card put into your graveyard this way to the battlefield.
820546.translation: 将一张以此法置入你坟墓场的生物牌移回战场。

820547.translation: 指定两张永久物牌为目标。

820548.translation: 指定两个神器和／或结界为目标。

820647.oracleText: Target a triggered ability or colorless spell.
820647.translation: 指定一个触发式异能或无色咒语为目标。

820652.oracleText: Pay 2 life. (For each {oB} in a cost, you may pay 2 life rather than pay that mana.)
820652.translation: 支付2点生命。（对任一费用中的每个{oB}而言，你可以支付2点生命，而不支付该法术力。）

820659.translation: 选择一个要移动的指示物。

820660.oracleText: Exile any number of other cards from your graveyard with four or more card types among them.
820660.translation: 从你的坟墓场中放逐任意数量牌张类别总数达四种或更多的其他牌。

820661.oracleText: Create an Eldrazi Spawn creature token?
820661.translation: 是否要派出一个奥札奇／后裔衍生生物？

820662.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of counters on permanents you control.
820662.translation: 目标生物得+X/+X直到回合结束，X为由你操控的永久物上之指示物总数量。

820663.oracleText: When you cast this spell, target opponent exiles the top half of their library, rounded up.
820663.translation: 当你施放此咒语时，目标对手放逐其牌库一半数量的牌，小数点后进位。

820680.oracleText: Exile your hand and draw {2, plural, =1 {a card} other {{2, Number} cards}}?
820680.translation: 是否要放逐你的手牌，然后抓{2, plural, =1 {1张牌} other {{2, Number}张牌}}？

820872.oracleText: Change the target of target instant or sorcery spell with a single target to {1, CardId}?
820872.translation: 是否要将目标仅指定单一目标之瞬间或法术咒语的目标更改为{1, CardId}？

820873.oracleText: Choose an instant or sorcery spell with a single target.
820873.translation: 选择一个仅指定单一目标的瞬间或法术咒语。

820875.oracleText: Manifest two cards from their hands.

820876.translation: 指定至多两位牌手为目标。

821971.oracleText: Return target nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
821971.translation: 将目标法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌从你坟墓场移回战场，且上面有一个终命指示物。

821972.oracleText: Target a nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less.
821972.translation: 指定一个法术力值等于或小于3的非地永久物牌为目标。

821973.oracleText: Put the exiled card onto the battlefield?
821973.translation: 是否将所放逐的牌放进战场？

823018.oracleText: At the beginning of the next end step, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it entered under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
823018.translation: 在下一个结束步骤开始时，将该牌在其拥有者的操控下移回战场。如果它是在你的操控下进场，则在CARDNAME上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

823092.oracleText: Select one nonbasic land to untap.
823092.translation: 选择一个非基本地来重置。

823097.translation: 选择两个永久物来重置。

823203.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card.
823203.translation: 当此生物进场时，抓一张牌。

823208.oracleText: During your turn, this creature has first strike.
823208.translation: 于你的回合中，此生物具有先攻异能。

824486.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
824486.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，在目标生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

824543.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
824543.translation: 每当另一个生物在你的操控下进场时，CARDNAME向每位对手各造成1点伤害。

824573.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
824573.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从你牌库中搜寻一张基本地牌，将之横置放进战场，然后洗牌。

824615.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control{5, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({4, Number} of {5, Number})}}
824615.translation: 在一个由你操控的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物{5, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({4, Number} of {5, Number})}}

824616.oracleText: Choose one. Destroy all permanents of the chosen type{3, plural, =1 {.} other {. ({2, Number} of {3, Number})}}

870831.translation: 当尖刺巨鳄进场时，为每个由对手操控的生物各变出一张名称为刺创伤的牌放进战场并贴附在该生物上。

870834.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals each nonland card in their hand. You choose one of those cards and exile it.
870834.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手上的每张非地牌。你选择其中一张并放逐它。

870835.oracleText: When Cackling Observer enters, target opponent reveals each nonland card in their hand. You choose one of those cards and exile it.
870835.translation: 当尖笑监魔进场时，目标对手展示其手上的每张非地牌。你选择其中一张并放逐它。

870860.oracleText: When this Case enters, conjure four cards named Fblthp, the Lost into your library, then shuffle. Draw a card.
870860.translation: 当此案件进场时，变出四张名称为迷途的夫毕佐的牌置入你的牌库，然后洗牌。抓一张牌。

870899.oracleText: When Teysa enters, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying. Teysa intensifies by 1.
870899.translation: 当泰莎进场时，派出一个1/1，白黑双色，具飞行异能的精怪衍生生物。泰莎强度增加1。

870910.oracleText: When Rankle enters, you may pay 1 life. When you do, each player discards a card and sacrifices a creature.
870910.translation: 当兰卡进场时，你可以支付1点生命。当你如此作时，每位牌手各弃一张牌且牺牲一个生物。

870913.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, conjure a card of your choice from Saint Elenda's spellbook into your hand. You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost.
870913.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，从圣伊莲达的法术书中选择一张牌。变出该牌置于你手上。本回合中你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

870914.oracleText: When Saint Elenda enters, conjure a card of your choice from Saint Elenda's spellbook into your hand. You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost.
870914.translation: 当圣伊莲达进场时，从圣伊莲达的法术书中选择一张牌。变出该牌置于你手上。本回合中你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

870919.oracleText: When Vona de Iedo enters, destroy target nonland, nontoken permanent an opponent controls. Then you may discard a card. If you do, conjure a duplicate of that permanent into your hand, and the duplicate perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
870919.translation: 当伊埃多的沃娜进场时，消灭目标由对手操控、既非地也非衍生物的永久物。然后你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则变出一张该永久物的复制牌置于你手上，且该复制牌永久获得「能用任意种类的法术力来施放此咒语。」

870947.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, the next noncreature spell target opponent casts costs {o2} more to cast.
870947.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手施放的下一个非生物咒语增加{o2}来施放。

870948.oracleText: When Stalwart Realmwarden enters, the next noncreature spell target opponent casts costs {o2} more to cast.
870948.translation: 当卫境坚兵进场时，目标对手施放的下一个非生物咒语增加{o2}来施放。

870965.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, discard a card, then heist target opponent's library.
870965.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，弃一张牌，然后偷窃目标对手的牌库。

870966.oracleText: When Impetuous Lootmonger enters, discard a card, then heist target opponent's library.
870966.translation: 当急切掠物贩进场时，弃一张牌，然后偷窃目标对手的牌库。

870969.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, heist target opponent's library twice.

870970.oracleText: When Triumphant Getaway enters, heist target opponent's library twice.
870970.translation: 当得胜脱逃进场时，偷窃目标对手的牌库两次。

870973.oracleText: When Nashi enters, secretly choose a card in your graveyard and conjure a duplicate of it into your hand. If the duplicate isn't a land card, it perpetually gains flash.
870973.translation: 当哪失进场时，私下选择你坟墓场中的一张牌并变出一张该牌的复制牌置于你手上。若该复制牌不是地牌，则该牌永久获得闪现异能。

870980.oracleText: Each player discards a card and sacrifices a creature.
870980.translation: 每位牌手各弃一张牌且牺牲一个生物。

872058.oracleText: When Derevi, Empyrial Tactician enters and whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may tap or untap target permanent.
872058.translation: 当穹光策士德蕾薇进场和每当一个由你操控的生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以横置或重置目标永久物。

872061.oracleText: Whenever another creature enters, you gain 1 life.

873363.oracleText: When Hoverguard Sweepers enters, you may return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands.
873363.translation: 当空卫扫荡队进场时，你可以将至多两个目标生物移回其拥有者手上。

873373.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，且每张牌的法术力值均须等于或小于1，展示这些牌，并将它们置于你手上。若你如此作，则洗牌。

873374.translation: 当亿欧护林兵进场时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻至多两张生物牌，且每张牌的法术力值均须等于或小于1，展示这些牌，并将它们置于你手上。若你如此作，则洗牌。

873439.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, if you cast it from your hand, destroy all creatures your opponents control, then tap all other creatures you control.
873439.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，若你从手上施放之，消灭所有由对手操控的生物，横置所有由你操控的其他生物。

873440.oracleText: When Dread Cacodemon enters, if you cast it from your hand, destroy all creatures your opponents control, then tap all other creatures you control.

873752.oracleText: When Fire Dragon enters, it deals damage to target creature equal to the number of Mountains you control.

873884.translation: 虚空圣杯进场时上面有X个充电指示物。

873887.oracleText: You may have Phyrexian Metamorph enter as a copy of any artifact or creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.

874022.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你可以将目标龙永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

874023.oracleText: When Bladewing the Risen enters, you may return target Dragon permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
874023.translation: 当复生者锋翼进场时，你可以将目标龙永久物牌从你的坟墓场移回战场。

874319.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you gain 1 life. You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter, trample counter, and vigilance counter on it."

874390.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken artifact you control enters, exile a random nonland artifact card with lesser mana value from your library. You may cast that card until the end of your next turn.

874451.oracleText: Exile target nonartifact creature you control. It perpetually gains "This creature enters with an additional shield counter on it." Then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
874451.translation: 放逐目标由你操控的非神器生物。它永久获得「此生物进场时上面有一个后盾指示物。」然后将该牌在其拥有者的操控下放进场。

874480.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you may choose a creature card in your hand. If you do, it perpetually gains "This creature enters with an additional shield counter on it." Otherwise, put a shield counter on CARDNAME.

874755.translation: 每当宾纳里亚骑士领队征列一个生物时，你获得一次具有「当你施放一个生物咒语时，该生物进场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。」的祝福

874782.translation: 渐衰回归者须横置进场。

875325.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, that creature perpetually gains haste if its power is 4 or greater. If its toughness is 4 or greater, you gain 4 life. If its mana value is 4 or greater, seek a creature card.
875325.translation: 每当另一个生物在你的操控下进场时，若该生物的力量等于或大于4，则它永久获得敏捷异能。若该生物的防御力等于或大于4，则你获得4点生命。若该生物的法术力值等于或大于4，则掏一张生物牌。

875597.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters or attacks, conjure a card named Stormfront Pegasus into your hand.
875597.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，变出一张名称为暴锋飞马的牌置于你手上。

875598.oracleText: When Wingsteed Trainer enters or attacks, conjure a card named Stormfront Pegasus into your hand.
875598.translation: 每当飞马训练师进场或攻击时，变出一张名称为暴锋飞马的牌置于你手上。

875694.oracleText: Whenever one or more Humans and/or Warriors you control enter, conjure a card named Utility Knife onto the battlefield. This ability triggers only once each turn.
875694.translation: 每当一个或数个人类和／或战士在你的操控下进场时，变出一张名称为万用刀具的牌放进战场。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

875746.oracleText: Alliance — Whenever one or more other creatures you control enter, seek a land card, then put it onto the battlefield tapped. This ability triggers only once each turn.
875746.translation: 联手～每当一个或数个其他生物在你的操控下进场时，掏一张地牌，然后将它横置放进战场。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

875748.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, target opponent reveals all creature and land cards in their hand. Choose one of them. That card perpetually gains "This permanent enters tapped."
875748.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，目标对手展示其手上所有生物和地牌。选择其中一张。该牌永久获得「此永久物须横置进场。」

875749.oracleText: When Boareskyr Tollkeeper enters, target opponent reveals all creature and land cards in their hand. Choose one of them. That card perpetually gains "This permanent enters tapped."
875749.translation: 当巴里斯凯尔收费员进场时，目标对手展示其手上所有生物和地牌。选择其中一张。该牌永久获得「此永久物须横置进场。」

875753.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with your choice of a +1/+1 counter, a flying counter, or a lifelink counter on it.
875753.translation: 当你施放一个生物咒语时，该生物进场时上面依你的选择有一个+1/+1指示物，一个飞行指示物或一个系命指示物。

875754.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with your choice of a +1/+1 counter, a flying counter, or a lifelink counter on it."

875755.oracleText: When Champions of Tyr enters, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with your choice of a +1/+1 counter, a flying counter, or a lifelink counter on it."

875871.oracleText: During your turn, Gnoll Hunting Party has first strike.
875871.translation: 于你的回合中，豺狼人行猎队具有先攻异能。

875900.oracleText: When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter, reach counter, and trample counter on it.
875900.translation: 当你施放一个生物咒语时，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物，一个延势指示物和一个践踏指示物。

875901.oracleText: You get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with an additional +1/+1 counter, reach counter, and trample counter on it."
875901.translation: 你获得一次具有「当你施放一个生物咒语时，该生物进场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物，一个延势指示物和一个践踏指示物。」的祝福

875981.oracleText: When this creature specializes, you get a one-time boon with "When you cast a creature spell, that creature enters with a lifelink counter on it."
875981.translation: 当此生物专精时，你获得一次具有「当你施放一个生物咒语时，该生物进场时上面有一个系命指示物。」的祝福

876559.oracleText: Whenever CARDNAME enters or attacks, choose three — • Target opponent discards two cards. • Mishra deals 3 damage to any target. • Destroy target artifact or planeswalker. • Creatures you control gain menace and trample until end of turn. • Creatures you don't control get -1/-1 until end of turn. • Create two tapped Powerstone tokens.
876559.translation: 每当CARDNAME进场或攻击时，选择三项～ •  目标对手弃两张牌。 •  米斯拉对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器或鹏洛客。 •  由你操控的生物获得威慑和践踏异能直到回合结束。 •  不由你操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。 •  派出两个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

876560.oracleText: Whenever Mishra, Lost to Phyrexia enters or attacks, choose three — • Target opponent discards two cards. • Mishra deals 3 damage to any target. • Destroy target artifact or planeswalker. • Creatures you control gain menace and trample until end of turn. • Creatures you don't control get -1/-1 until end of turn. • Create two tapped Powerstone tokens.
876560.translation: 每当非瑞克西亚臣民米斯拉进场或攻击时，选择三项～ •  目标对手弃两张牌。 •  米斯拉对任意一个目标造成3点伤害。 •  消灭目标神器或鹏洛客。 •  由你操控的生物获得威慑和践踏异能直到回合结束。 •  不由你操控的生物得-1/-1直到回合结束。 •  派出两个已横置的魔力石衍生物。

876905.translation: 当泰坦尼亚进场时，将所有地牌从你的坟墓场横置移回战场。

876964.oracleText: Whenever one or more nontoken artifacts you control enter, creatures you control perpetually get +1/+1.
876964.translation: 每当一个或数个非衍生物神器在你的操控下进场时，由你操控的生物永久得+1/+1。

876990.oracleText: You may have CARDNAME enter as a copy of any permanent on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
876990.translation: 你可以使CARDNAME当成战场上任一永久物的复制品来进入战场，且它额外具有神器此类别。

876991.oracleText: You may have Surgical Metamorph enter as a copy of any permanent on the battlefield, except it's an artifact in addition to its other types.
876991.translation: 你可以使外展变形兽当成战场上任一永久物的复制品来进入战场，且它额外具有神器此类别。

877033.oracleText: Whenever another creature you control enters, cards you own named Arek, False Goldwarden intensify by 1.
877033.translation: 每当另一个生物在你的操控下进场时，你拥有的名称为伪金坚卫阿雷克的牌强度增加1。

877060.oracleText: When one or more creatures you control enter, create a Wicked Role token attached to one of them.
877060.translation: 当一个或数个生物在你的操控下进场时，派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在其中之一上

877061.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a one-time boon with "When one or more creatures you control enter, create a Wicked Role token attached to one of them." Then if CARDNAME was bargained, return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
877061.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得持续一次的具有「当一个或数个生物在你的操控下进场时，派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在其中之一上」的祝福。然后如果CARDNAME已加码，则将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

877062.oracleText: When Dunbarrow Revivalist enters, you get a one-time boon with "When one or more creatures you control enter, create a Wicked Role token attached to one of them." Then if Dunbarrow Revivalist was bargained, return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
877062.translation: 当黯沼野复兴者进场时，你获得持续一次的具有「当一个或数个生物在你的操控下进场时，派出一个恶人角色衍生物，并贴附在其中之一上」的祝福。然后如果黯沼野复兴者已加码，则将一张生物牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

877130.translation: 每当一个或更多非衍生物的地在你的操控下进场时，为它们各进行以下流程～变出一张该地的复制牌放进战场。此异能每回合只会触发一次。

877157.translation: 每当一个或更多人鱼在你的操控下进场时，令目标由你操控的人鱼生物勘察。

877158.oracleText: When CARDNAME enters, you get a three-time boon with "Whenever one or more Merfolk you control enter, target Merfolk creature you control explores."
877158.translation: 当CARDNAME进场时，你获得持续三次的具有「每当一个或更多人鱼在你的操控下进场时，令目标由你操控的人鱼生物勘察」的祝福。

877159.oracleText: When Merfolk Tunnel-Guide enters, you get a three-time boon with "Whenever one or more Merfolk you control enter, target Merfolk creature you control explores."
877159.translation: 当引隧人鱼进场时，你获得持续三次的具有「每当一个或更多人鱼在你的操控下进场时，令目标由你操控的人鱼生物勘察」的祝福。

877455.translation: 横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物。（{o4}，{oT}：抓一张牌。对此异能起动费用中的每点法术力而言，你可以横置一个由你操控且未横置的生物，而不支付该法术力。只能于法术时机起动。）
